title: DIAL: Decoupling Intent and Action via Latent World Modeling for End-to-End VLA
summary: The development of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has been significantly accelerated by pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, most existing end-to-end VLAs treat the VLM primarily as a multimodal encoder, directly mapping vision-language features to low-level actions. This paradigm underutilizes the VLM's potential in high-level decision making and introduces training instability, frequently degrading its rich semantic representations. To address these limitations, we introduce DIAL, a framework bridging high-level decision making and low-level motor execution through a differentiable latent intent bottleneck. Specifically, a VLM-based System-2 performs latent world modeling by synthesizing latent visual foresight within the VLM's native feature space; this foresight explicitly encodes intent and serves as the structural bottleneck. A lightweight System-1 policy then decodes this predicted intent together with the current observation into precise robot actions via latent inverse dynamics. To ensure optimization stability, we employ a two-stage training paradigm: a decoupled warmup phase where System-2 learns to predict latent futures while System-1 learns motor control under ground-truth future guidance within a unified feature space, followed by seamless end-to-end joint optimization. This enables action-aware gradients to refine the VLM backbone in a controlled manner, preserving pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments on the RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop benchmark show that DIAL establishes a new state-of-the-art, achieving superior performance with 10x fewer demonstrations than prior methods. Furthermore, by leveraging heterogeneous human demonstrations, DIAL learns physically grounded manipulation priors and exhibits robust zero-shot generalization to unseen objects and novel configurations during real-world deployment on a humanoid robot.
summary_zh: 预训练的视觉语言模型显著加速了视觉-语言-动作模型的发展。然而，现有端到端模型大多将视觉语言模型主要作为多模态编码器使用，直接将视觉语言特征映射到低级动作。这种范式未能充分发挥视觉语言模型在高层决策中的潜力，并引入了训练不稳定性，经常削弱其丰富的语义表征能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出了DIAL框架，该框架通过可微分潜在意图瓶颈连接高层决策与低层运动执行。具体而言，基于视觉语言模型的系统-2通过在其原生特征空间内合成潜在视觉前瞻进行潜在世界建模；这种前瞻显式编码意图并构成结构瓶颈。随后，轻量级系统-1策略通过潜在逆动力学方法，将预测意图与当前观测共同解码为精确的机器人动作。为确保优化稳定性，我们采用两阶段训练范式：先在统一特征空间内进行解耦预热，系统-2学习预测潜在未来状态，系统-1在真实未来状态指导下学习运动控制；随后进行无缝的端到端联合优化。这使得动作感知梯度能够以受控方式优化视觉语言模型骨干，同时保留预训练知识。在RoboCasa GR1桌面基准测试上的大量实验表明，DIAL创造了新的性能标杆，仅需十分之一的示范数据即可实现优于现有方法的性能。此外，通过利用异构人类示范数据，DIAL学习了物理基础的操控先验知识，并在人形机器人现实部署中，对未见过的物体和新颖配置展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: DIAL is a VLA framework that decouples high-level intent planning (via a VLM) and low-level action execution, using latent world modeling and a two-stage training scheme to improve stability and performance in robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: DIAL是一个通过潜在世界建模解耦高层意图规划和低层动作执行的VLA框架，采用两阶段训练方案，在机器人操作任务中提升了稳定性和性能。

title: SceneTeract: Agentic Functional Affordances and VLM Grounding in 3D Scenes
summary: Embodied AI depends on interactive 3D environments that support meaningful activities for diverse users, yet assessing their functional affordances remains a core challenge. We introduce SceneTeract, a framework that verifies 3D scene functionality under agent-specific constraints. Our core contribution is a grounded verification engine that couples high-level semantic reasoning with low-level geometric checks. SceneTeract decomposes complex activities into sequences of atomic actions and validates each step against accessibility requirements (e.g., reachability, clearance, and navigability) conditioned on an embodied agent profile, using explicit physical and geometric simulations. We deploy SceneTeract to perform an in-depth evaluation of (i) synthetic indoor environments, uncovering frequent functional failures that prevent basic interactions, and (ii) the ability of frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to reason about and predict functional affordances, revealing systematic mismatches between semantic confidence and physical feasibility even for the strongest current models. Finally, we leverage SceneTeract as a reward engine for VLM post-training, enabling scalable distillation of geometric constraints into reasoning models. We release the SceneTeract verification suite and data to bridge perception and physical reality in embodied 3D scene understanding.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能的发展依赖于支持多样化用户进行有意义活动的交互式3D环境，然而评估这些环境的功能可供性仍是一个核心挑战。我们提出SceneTeract框架，用于验证特定智能体约束下的3D场景功能性。本研究的核心贡献是一个将高层语义推理与底层几何检查相结合的具身验证引擎。SceneTeract将复杂活动分解为原子动作序列，并基于具身智能体配置文件，通过显式物理和几何模拟验证每个步骤是否符合可达性、操作空间及可通行性等可访问性要求。我们运用SceneTeract对以下两方面进行深入评估：（一）合成室内环境的功能缺陷，发现其普遍存在阻碍基本交互的功能性故障；（二）前沿视觉语言模型在推理和预测功能可供性方面的能力，揭示即使当前最先进的模型仍存在语义置信度与物理可行性之间的系统性错配。最后，我们将SceneTeract作为视觉语言模型后训练的奖励引擎，实现了几何约束向推理模型的可扩展性知识蒸馏。我们公开发布SceneTeract验证套件及相关数据，以弥合具身3D场景理解中感知与物理现实之间的鸿沟。
tldr: SceneTeract is a framework for verifying functional affordances in 3D scenes for embodied agents, combining high-level reasoning with low-level geometric checks. It is used to evaluate environments and VLMs, and to improve VLM reasoning through a reward engine for post-training.
tldr_zh: SceneTeract是一个用于验证具身智能体在3D场景中功能可供性的框架，它将高级语义推理与低级几何检查相结合。该框架用于评估环境和视觉语言模型，并通过奖励机制进行后训练，以提升模型推理能力。

title: Hybrid Framework for Robotic Manipulation: Integrating Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces a new hybrid framework that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve robotic manipulation tasks. By utilizing RL for accurate low-level control and LLMs for high level task planning and understanding of natural language, the proposed framework effectively connects low-level execution with high-level reasoning in robotic systems. This integration allows robots to understand and carry out complex, human-like instructions while adapting to changing environments in real time. The framework is tested in a PyBullet-based simulation environment using the Franka Emika Panda robotic arm, with various manipulation scenarios as benchmarks. The results show a 33.5% decrease in task completion time and enhancements of 18.1% and 36.4% in accuracy and adaptability, respectively, when compared to systems that use only RL. These results underscore the potential of LLM-enhanced robotic systems for practical applications, making them more efficient, adaptable, and capable of interacting with humans. Future research will aim to explore sim-to-real transfer, scalability, and multi-robot systems to further broaden the framework's applicability.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习（RL）与大型语言模型（LLM）的新型混合框架，以提升机器人操作任务的性能。该框架利用强化学习实现精确的低层控制，同时借助大型语言模型进行高层任务规划与自然语言理解，从而有效桥接机器人系统中的底层执行与高层推理。这种集成方式使机器人能够理解并执行复杂的类人指令，同时实时适应动态变化的环境。该框架在基于PyBullet的仿真环境中，以Franka Emika Panda机械臂为平台，通过多种操作场景进行测试评估。实验结果表明：相较于仅使用强化学习的系统，该框架在任务完成时间上减少了33.5%，准确性与适应性分别提升了18.1%和36.4%。这些结果突显了大型语言模型增强型机器人系统在实际应用中的潜力，使其更具高效性、适应性和人机交互能力。未来研究将着重探索仿真到现实的迁移、系统可扩展性及多机器人系统协作，以进一步拓展该框架的适用范围。
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework that integrates Reinforcement Learning (RL) for low-level control and Large Language Models (LLMs) for high-level task planning and natural language understanding to improve robotic manipulation, demonstrating significant performance gains in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合框架，将强化学习用于低层控制，大语言模型用于高层任务规划与自然语言理解，以改进机器人操作，在仿真中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: Passive iFIR filters for data-driven velocity control in robotics
summary: We present a passive, data-driven velocity control method for nonlinear robotic manipulators that achieves better tracking performance than optimized PID with comparable design complexity. Using only three minutes of probing data, a VRFT-based design identifies passive iFIR controllers that (i) preserve closed-loop stability via passivity constraints and (ii) outperform a VRFT-tuned PID baseline on the Franka Research 3 robot in both joint-space and Cartesian-space velocity control, achieving up to a 74.5% reduction in tracking error for the Cartesian velocity tracking experiment with the most demanding reference model. When the robot end-effector dynamics change, the controller can be re-learned from new data, regaining nominal performance. This study bridges learning-based control and stability-guaranteed design: passive iFIR learns from data while retaining passivity-based stability guarantees, unlike many learning-based approaches.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非线性机器人机械臂的被动数据驱动速度控制方法，该方法在保持与优化PID控制器相当设计复杂度的同时，实现了更优的跟踪性能。仅需三分钟的探测数据，基于虚拟参考反馈整定（VRFT）的设计方法即可辨识出被动增量有限脉冲响应（iFIR）控制器：该控制器（i）通过无源性约束保持闭环稳定性；（ii）在Franka Research 3机器人上进行关节空间和笛卡尔空间速度控制实验时，均优于基于VRFT整定的PID基准控制器，在最具挑战性的参考模型下，笛卡尔速度跟踪实验的跟踪误差最高降低74.5%。当机器人末端执行器动力学特性发生变化时，可通过新数据重新学习控制器以恢复标称性能。本研究融合了基于学习的控制与稳定性保障设计：与许多基于学习的方法不同，被动iFIR控制器在从数据中学习的同时，仍能保持基于无源性的稳定性保证。
tldr: A data-driven method for designing passive iFIR filters for velocity control of robotic manipulators, which uses short probing data, ensures stability via passivity, and demonstrates improved tracking performance on a Franka Research 3 robot.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于机器人速度控制的被动iFIR滤波器数据驱动方法，利用短暂探测数据，通过无源性保证稳定性，并在Franka Research 3机器人上实现了比PID基线更优的跟踪性能。

title: SafeDMPs: Integrating Formal Safety with DMPs for Adaptive HRI
summary: Robots operating in human-centric environments must be both robust to disturbances and provably safe from collisions. Achieving these properties simultaneously and efficiently remains a central challenge. While Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) offer inherent stability and generalization from single demonstrations, they lack formal safety guarantees. Conversely, formal methods like Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide provable safety but often rely on computationally expensive, real-time optimization, hindering their use in high-frequency control. This paper introduces SafeDMPs, a novel framework that resolves this trade-off. We integrate the closed-form efficiency and dynamic robustness of DMPs with a provably safe, non-optimization-based control law derived from Spatio-Temporal Tubes (STTs). This synergy allows us to generate motions that are not only robust to perturbations and adaptable to new goals, but also guaranteed to avoid static and dynamic obstacles. Our approach achieves a closed-form solution for a problem that traditionally requires online optimization. Experimental results on a 7-DOF robot manipulator demonstrate that SafeDMPs is orders of magnitude faster and more accurate than optimization-based baselines, making it an ideal solution for real-time, safe, and collaborative robotics.
summary_zh: 在人类活动为中心的环境中运行的机器人，必须既对干扰具有鲁棒性，又能保证无可碰撞的安全性。如何同时、高效地实现这两个特性，仍是一个核心挑战。动态运动基元（DMPs）具有固有的稳定性和从单次演示中泛化的能力，但缺乏形式化的安全保障。相反，如控制屏障函数（CBFs）等基于形式化方法的技术可提供可证明的安全性，但通常依赖于计算量大的实时优化，阻碍了其在高频控制中的应用。本文提出了一种新的框架——SafeDMPs，以解决这一矛盾。我们将DMPs的闭式求解效率与动态鲁棒性，与一种基于时空管道（STTs）推导出的、可证明安全且无需优化的控制律相结合。这种协同作用使得我们能够生成的运动不仅对干扰具有鲁棒性，可适应新目标，而且能保证规避静态和动态障碍物。我们的方法为该传统上需要在线优化的问题提供了闭式求解方案。在7自由度机器人机械臂上的实验结果表明，SafeDMPs比基于优化的基准方法快数个数量级，且精度更高，使其成为实时、安全和协作机器人的理想解决方案。
tldr: SafeDMPs integrates Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) with a non-optimization-based control law derived from Spatio-Temporal Tubes (STTs) to provide provably safe and adaptive robot motion generation for human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: SafeDMPs将动态运动基元与来自时空管道的非优化控制律相结合，为实时人机交互场景下的机器人运动生成提供可证明的安全性保证。

title: GraSP-STL: A Graph-Based Framework for Zero-Shot Signal Temporal Logic Planning via Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper studies offline, zero-shot planning under Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications. We assume access only to an offline dataset of state-action-state transitions collected by a task-agnostic behavior policy, with no analytical dynamics model, no further environment interaction, and no task-specific retraining. The objective is to synthesize a control strategy whose resulting trajectory satisfies an arbitrary unseen STL specification. To this end, we propose GraSP-STL, a graph-search-based framework for zero-shot STL planning from offline trajectories. The method learns a goal-conditioned value function from offline data and uses it to induce a finite-horizon reachability metric over the state space. Based on this metric, it constructs a directed graph abstraction whose nodes represent representative states and whose edges encode feasible short-horizon transitions. Planning is then formulated as a graph search over waypoint sequences, evaluated using arithmetic-geometric mean robustness and its interval semantics, and executed by a learned goal-conditioned policy. The proposed framework separates reusable reachability learning from task-conditioned planning, enabling zero-shot generalization to unseen STL tasks and long-horizon planning through the composition of short-horizon behaviors from offline data. Experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness on a range of offline STL planning tasks.
summary_zh: 本文研究信号时序逻辑（STL）规范下的离线零样本规划问题。我们假设仅能访问一个与任务无关的行为策略所收集的状态-动作-状态转移离线数据集，且没有解析动力学模型、额外的环境交互或针对特定任务的重训练。目标是合成一种控制策略，使其产生的轨迹满足任意未见过的STL规范。为此，我们提出GraSP-STL，一种基于图搜索的离线轨迹零样本STL规划框架。该方法从离线数据中学习目标条件价值函数，并利用该函数在状态空间上诱导出有限时域可达性度量。基于此度量，框架构建一个有向图抽象，其中节点代表典型状态，边编码可行的短时域转移。规划问题被转化为对航点序列的图搜索，通过算术几何平均鲁棒性及其区间语义进行评估，并由学习得到的目标条件策略执行。所提出的框架将可复用的可达性学习与任务条件规划相分离，能够通过离线数据中短时域行为的组合，实现未见STL任务的零样本泛化与长时域规划。实验结果在一系列离线STL规划任务中验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces GraSP-STL, a framework for zero-shot robot planning under Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications using offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, separating reusable reachability learning from task-conditioned planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GraSP-STL框架，利用离线目标条件强化学习实现零样本信号时序逻辑规划，将可复用的可达性学习与任务规划分离。

title: Model Predictive Path Integral PID Control for Learning-Based Path Following
summary: Classical proportional--integral--derivative (PID) control is widely employed in industrial applications; however, achieving higher performance often motivates the adoption of model predictive control (MPC). Although gradient-based methods are the standard for real-time optimization, sampling-based approaches have recently gained attention. In particular, model predictive path integral (MPPI) control enables gradient-free optimization and accommodates non-differentiable models and objective functions. However, directly sampling control input sequences may yield discontinuous inputs and increase the optimization dimensionality in proportion to the prediction horizon. This study proposes MPPI--PID control, which applies MPPI to optimize PID gains at each control step, thereby replacing direct high-dimensional input-sequence optimization with low-dimensional gain-space optimization. This formulation enhances sample efficiency and yields smoother inputs via the PID structure. We also provide theoretical insights, including an information-theoretic interpretation that unifies MPPI and MPPI--PID, an analysis of the effect of optimization dimensionality on sample efficiency, and a characterization of input continuity induced by the PID structure. The proposed method is evaluated on the learning-based path following of a mini forklift using a residual-learning dynamics model that integrates a physical model with a neural network. System identification is performed with real driving data. Numerical path-following experiments demonstrate that MPPI--PID improves tracking performance compared with fixed-gain PID and achieves performance comparable to conventional MPPI while significantly reducing input increments. Furthermore, the proposed method maintains favorable performance even with substantially fewer samples, demonstrating its improved sample efficiency.
summary_zh: 经典比例-积分-微分（PID）控制广泛应用于工业领域，但追求更高性能往往促使人们采用模型预测控制（MPC）。尽管基于梯度的方法是实时优化的标准方案，但基于采样的方法近年来备受关注。其中，模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制能够实现无梯度优化，并能处理不可微模型与目标函数。然而，直接对控制输入序列进行采样可能导致输入不连续，且优化维度会随预测时域线性增加。本研究提出MPPI-PID控制方法，通过在每个控制步运用MPPI优化PID增益，从而以低维增益空间优化替代直接的高维输入序列优化。该框架通过PID结构提升了采样效率并产生更平滑的控制输入。本文同时提供了理论分析，包括：统一MPPI与MPPI-PID的信息论阐释、优化维度对采样效率影响的分析，以及PID结构对输入连续性特征的刻画。该方法在微型叉车基于学习的路径跟踪任务中进行了验证，使用了融合物理模型与神经网络的残差学习动力学模型，并通过真实驾驶数据完成了系统辨识。数值路径跟踪实验表明：相较于固定增益PID，MPPI-PID显著提升了跟踪性能；与传统MPPI相比，在实现相当性能的同时大幅降低了输入增量。此外，即使在采样数量显著减少的情况下，该方法仍能保持优越性能，证明了其提升的采样效率。
tldr: Proposes MPPI-PID control, a method that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) sampling to optimize PID gains online, improving sample efficiency and input smoothness for learning-based path-following control of a mini forklift.
tldr_zh: 提出MPPI-PID控制方法，利用模型预测路径积分（MPPI）采样在线优化PID增益，以提升样本效率和输入平滑性，应用于基于学习的迷你叉车路径跟随控制。

title: CReF: Cross-modal and Recurrent Fusion for Depth-conditioned Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Stable traversal over geometrically complex terrain increasingly requires exteroceptive perception, yet prior perceptive humanoid locomotion methods often remain tied to explicit geometric abstractions, either by mediating control through robot-centric 2.5D terrain representations or by shaping depth learning with auxiliary geometry-related targets. Such designs inherit the representational bias of the intermediate or supervisory target and can be restrictive for vertical structures, perforated obstacles, and complex real-world clutter. We propose CReF (Cross-modal and Recurrent Fusion), a single-stage depth-conditioned humanoid locomotion framework that learns locomotion-relevant features directly from raw forward-facing depth without explicit geometric intermediates. CReF couples proprioception and depth tokens through proprioception-queried cross-modal attention, fuses the resulting representation with a gated residual fusion block, and performs temporal integration with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) regulated by a highway-style output gate for state-dependent blending of recurrent and feedforward features. To further improve terrain interaction, we introduce a terrain-aware foothold placement reward that extracts supportable foothold candidates from foot-end point-cloud samples and rewards touchdown locations that lie close to the nearest supportable candidate. Experiments in simulation and on a physical humanoid demonstrate robust traversal over diverse terrains and effective zero-shot transfer to real-world scenes containing handrails, hollow pallet assemblies, severe reflective interference, and visually cluttered outdoor surroundings.
summary_zh: 在几何结构复杂的地形上实现稳定穿越日益需要依赖外部感知能力，然而现有的人形机器人感知运动方法通常仍受限于显式几何抽象——要么通过以机器人为中心的2.5维地形表征作为控制中介，要么借助几何相关辅助目标来约束深度学习过程。这类设计继承了中间表征或监督目标的固有偏差，在面对垂直结构、镂空障碍物及复杂现实杂乱环境时存在局限性。我们提出CReF（跨模态循环融合）框架，这是一种单阶段深度条件化人形机器人运动系统，能够直接从原始前向深度数据中学习运动相关特征，无需依赖显式几何中间表征。CReF通过本体感知查询的跨模态注意力机制耦合本体感知与深度令牌，利用门控残差融合模块整合所得表征，并通过具备高速公路式输出门的门控循环单元（GRU）进行时序集成，实现循环特征与前馈特征的动态状态混合。为提升地形交互能力，我们设计了地形感知落脚点放置奖励机制，该机制从足端点云样本中提取可行落脚候选区域，并对靠近最近可行候选点的触地位置给予奖励。仿真及实体人形机器人实验表明，该系统能稳健穿越多样化地形，并成功实现零样本迁移至真实场景，包括含扶手、镂空托盘组、强反射干扰及视觉杂乱户外环境在内的复杂场景。
tldr: This paper introduces CReF, a single-stage depth-conditioned locomotion framework for humanoid robots that learns directly from raw depth images, using cross-modal attention and temporal fusion, and demonstrates robust traversal in simulation and on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CReF，一种用于人形机器人的单阶段深度条件运动框架，直接从原始深度图像中学习运动相关特征，并展示了在模拟和真实物理机器人上的鲁棒穿越能力。

title: RAAP: Retrieval-Augmented Affordance Prediction with Cross-Image Action Alignment
summary: Understanding object affordances is essential for enabling robots to perform purposeful and fine-grained interactions in diverse and unstructured environments. However, existing approaches either rely on retrieval, which is fragile due to sparsity and coverage gaps, or on large-scale models, which frequently mislocalize contact points and mispredict post-contact actions when applied to unseen categories, thereby hindering robust generalization. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Affordance Prediction (RAAP), a framework that unifies affordance retrieval with alignment-based learning. By decoupling static contact localization and dynamic action direction, RAAP transfers contact points via dense correspondence and predicts action directions through a retrieval-augmented alignment model that consolidates multiple references with dual-weighted attention. Trained on compact subsets of DROID and HOI4D with as few as tens of samples per task, RAAP achieves consistent performance across unseen objects and categories, and enables zero-shot robotic manipulation in both simulation and the real world. Project website: https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/RAAP.
summary_zh: 理解物体可供性是使机器人能够在多样化和非结构化环境中进行有目的和精细交互的关键。然而，现有方法要么依赖检索——由于稀疏性和覆盖范围不足而存在脆弱性，要么依赖大规模模型——当应用于未见类别时常常错误定位接触点并误判接触后动作，从而阻碍了鲁棒的泛化能力。本文提出检索增强的可供性预测框架，该框架将可供性检索与基于对齐的学习相统一。通过解耦静态接触点定位与动态动作方向，该框架通过稠密对应关系迁移接触点，并利用检索增强的对齐模型预测动作方向，该模型通过双重加权注意力整合多个参考信息。该框架基于DROID和HOI4D数据集的紧凑子集进行训练，每个任务仅需数十个样本，即可在未见物体和类别上实现一致的性能表现，并在仿真和现实世界中实现零样本机器人操作能力。项目网站：https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/RAAP。
tldr: RAAP is a novel framework for robotic affordance prediction that combines retrieval with alignment-based learning, decoupling contact localization and action direction, achieving robust generalization to unseen categories and enabling zero-shot robotic manipulation in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: RAAP是一种用于机器人可操作性预测的新框架，它结合了检索与对齐学习，解耦了接触点定位和动作方向预测，实现了对未见类别的稳健泛化，并支持在仿真和真实世界中的零样本机器人操作。

title: CLaD: Planning with Grounded Foresight via Cross-Modal Latent Dynamics
summary: Robotic manipulation involves kinematic and semantic transitions that are inherently coupled via underlying actions. However, existing approaches plan within either semantic or latent space without explicitly aligning these cross-modal transitions. To address this, we propose CLaD, a framework that models how proprioceptive and semantic states jointly evolve under actions through asymmetric cross-attention that allows kinematic transitions to query semantic ones. CLaD predicts grounded latent foresights via self-supervised objectives with EMA target encoders and auxiliary reconstruction losses, preventing representation collapse while anchoring predictions to observable states. Predicted foresights are modulated with observations to condition a diffusion policy for action generation. On LIBERO-LONG benchmark, CLaD achieves 94.7\% success rate, competitive with large VLAs with significantly fewer parameters.
summary_zh: 机器人操作涉及运动学与语义状态的转换，这些转换通过底层动作在本质上相互耦合。然而，现有方法通常仅在语义空间或潜在空间内进行规划，未能显式对齐这些跨模态的转换过程。为此，我们提出CLaD框架，该框架通过非对称交叉注意力机制，建模本体感知状态与语义状态如何在动作作用下协同演化，使运动学转换能够查询语义转换。CLaD采用指数移动平均目标编码器和辅助重建损失进行自监督训练，预测基于实际观测的潜在状态前瞻，从而避免表示坍塌并确保预测结果锚定于可观测状态。通过观测数据调节预测结果后，以条件扩散策略生成动作。在LIBERO-LONG基准测试中，CLaD以显著更少的参数实现94.7%的成功率，与大型视觉语言动作模型性能相当。
tldr: CLaD proposes a cross-modal latent dynamics model for robotic manipulation planning, explicitly aligning kinematic and semantic state transitions to predict grounded foresights, which condition a diffusion policy for action generation, achieving strong performance on a long-horizon benchmark.
tldr_zh: CLaD 提出了一种用于机器人操作规划的跨模态潜在动力学模型，通过显式对齐运动学和语义状态转换来预测有根据的前瞻，从而为扩散策略的动作生成提供条件，在长时程基准测试中取得了优异性能。

title: Learning Semantic Priorities for Autonomous Target Search
summary: The use of semantic features can improve the efficiency of target search in unknown environments for robotic search and rescue missions. Current target search methods rely on training with large datasets of similar domains, which limits the adaptability to diverse environments. However, human experts possess high-level knowledge about semantic relationships necessary to effectively guide a robot during target search missions in diverse and previously unseen environments. In this paper, we propose a target search method that leverages expert input to train a model of semantic priorities. By employing the learned priorities in a frontier exploration planner using combinatorial optimization, our approach achieves efficient target search driven by semantic features while ensuring robustness and complete coverage. The proposed semantic priority model is trained with several synthetic datasets of simulated expert guidance for target search. Simulation tests in previously unseen environments show that our method consistently achieves faster target recovery than a coverage-driven exploration planner.
summary_zh: 在机器人搜索与救援任务中，语义特征的使用能够提升未知环境下目标搜索的效率。当前的目标搜索方法依赖于对相似领域的大规模数据集进行训练，这限制了其对多样化环境的适应性。然而，人类专家在目标搜索任务中拥有关于语义关联的高层知识，能够在多样化且未曾见过的环境中有效引导机器人。本文提出了一种利用专家输入来训练语义优先级模型的目标搜索方法。通过在基于组合优化的前沿探索规划器中运用所学优先级，该方法实现了语义特征驱动的高效目标搜索，同时确保了鲁棒性和完全覆盖性。所提出的语义优先级模型通过多个模拟专家引导的目标搜索合成数据集进行训练。在先前未见的环境中进行模拟测试表明，与覆盖驱动探索规划器相比，本方法能够持续实现更快的目标定位。
tldr: Proposes a target search method for robots that uses expert input to learn semantic priorities for frontier exploration, improving search efficiency in unseen environments.
tldr_zh: 提出一种机器人目标搜索方法，利用专家输入学习语义优先级，用于前沿探索规划，以提高在未知环境中的搜索效率。

title: Interacting Multiple Model Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots
summary: State estimation for legged robots remains challenging because legged odometry generally suffers from limited observability and therefore depends critically on measurement constraints to suppress drift. When exteroceptive sensors are unreliable or degraded, such constraints are mainly derived from proprioceptive measurements, particularly contact-related leg kinematics information. However, most existing proprioceptive odometry methods rely on an idealized point-contact assumption, which is often violated during real locomotion. Consequently, the effectiveness of proprioceptive constraints may be significantly reduced, resulting in degraded estimation accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose an interacting multiple model (IMM)-based proprioceptive odometry framework for legged robots. By incorporating multiple contact hypotheses within a unified probabilistic framework, the proposed method enables online mode switching and probabilistic fusion under varying contact conditions. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior pose estimation accuracy over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 腿式机器人的状态估计仍然是一个挑战，因为腿式里程计通常受到可观测性有限的限制，因此严重依赖于测量约束来抑制漂移。当外感受传感器不可靠或性能下降时，此类约束主要来源于本体感受测量，特别是与接触相关的腿部运动学信息。然而，大多数现有的本体感受里程计方法依赖于理想化的点接触假设，这一假设在实际运动中常常被违反。因此，本体感受约束的有效性可能显著降低，导致估计精度下降。针对这些局限性，本文提出了一种基于交互多模型（IMM）的腿式机器人本体感受里程计框架。该方法通过在统一的概率框架内整合多种接触假设，实现了多变接触条件下的在线模式切换和概率融合。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，所提出的方法在保持相当计算效率的同时，实现了优于现有先进方法的位姿估计精度。
tldr: Proposes an interacting multiple model proprioceptive odometry framework for legged robots to improve state estimation by probabilistically handling varying contact conditions, addressing limitations of idealized point-contact assumptions.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于腿式机器人的交互式多模型本体感知里程计框架，通过概率融合多种接触假设，在线切换模式，以应对实际运动中的接触变化，提升姿态估计精度。

title: Industrial-Grade Robust Robot Vision for Screw Detection and Removal under Uneven Conditions
summary: As the amount of used home appliances is expected to increase despite the decreasing labor force in Japan, there is a need to automate disassembling processes at recycling plants. The automation of disassembling air conditioner outdoor units, however, remains a challenge due to unit size variations and exposure to dirt and rust. To address these challenges, this study proposes an automated system that integrates a task-specific two-stage detection method and a lattice-based local calibration strategy. This approach achieved a screw detection recall of 99.8% despite severe degradation and ensured a manipulation accuracy of +/-0.75 mm without pre-programmed coordinates. In real-world validation with 120 units, the system attained a disassembly success rate of 78.3% and an average cycle time of 193 seconds, confirming its feasibility for industrial application.
summary_zh: 尽管日本劳动力不断减少，但废旧家电的回收量预计将持续增长，这使得回收工厂的拆解过程自动化成为迫切需求。然而，由于空调室外机尺寸差异大、易沾染污垢和锈蚀，其自动化拆解仍面临挑战。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出一种自动化系统，该系统结合了针对特定任务的两阶段检测方法和基于网格的局部校准策略。即使在严重老化条件下，该方法的螺丝检测召回率仍达到99.8%，并在无需预编程坐标的情况下实现了±0.75毫米的操作精度。通过对120台室外机进行实际验证，系统拆解成功率达78.3%，平均循环时间为193秒，证实了其工业应用的可行性。
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based robotic system for detecting and removing screws from used air conditioners in recycling plants, achieving high recall and manipulation accuracy under challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种用于回收工厂的视觉引导机器人系统，用于在恶劣条件下检测和拆卸空调螺丝，实现了高召回率和精确操作。

title: Advancing Multi-Robot Networks via MLLM-Driven Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Comprehensive Survey
summary:
Imagine advanced humanoid robots, powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), coordinating missions across industries like warehouse logistics, manufacturing, and safety rescue. While individual robots show local autonomy, realistic tasks demand coordination among multiple agents sharing vast streams of sensor data. Communication is indispensable, yet transmitting comprehensive data can overwhelm networks, especially when a system-level orchestrator or cloud-based MLLM fuses multimodal inputs for route planning or anomaly detection.
  These tasks are often initiated by high-level natural language instructions. This intent serves as a filter for resource optimization: by understanding the goal via MLLMs, the system can selectively activate relevant sensing modalities, dynamically allocate bandwidth, and determine computation placement. Thus, R2X is fundamentally an intent-to-resource orchestration problem where sensing, communication, and computation are jointly optimized to maximize task-level success under resource constraints.
  This survey examines how integrated design paves the way for multi-robot coordination under MLLM guidance. We review state-of-the-art sensing modalities, communication strategies, and computing approaches, highlighting how reasoning is split between on-device models and powerful edge/cloud servers. We present four end-to-end demonstrations (sense -> communicate -> compute -> act): (i) digital-twin warehouse navigation with predictive link context, (ii) mobility-driven proactive MCS control, (iii) a FollowMe robot with a semantic-sensing switch, and (iv) real-hardware open-vocabulary trash sorting via edge-assisted MLLM grounding. We emphasize system-level metrics -- payload, latency, and success -- to show why R2X orchestration outperforms purely on-device baselines.
summary_zh:
设想由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动的人形机器人，在仓库物流、制造、安全救援等行业中协调执行任务。虽然单个机器人展现出局部自主性，但实际任务需要多个智能体在共享海量传感器数据流的同时进行协同。通信不可或缺，但传输完整数据可能使网络不堪重负，尤其在系统级协调器或云端MLLM融合多模态输入以进行路径规划或异常检测时。

这些任务通常由高层级自然语言指令发起。该意图可作为资源优化的过滤器：通过MLLM理解目标，系统可选择性激活相关感知模态，动态分配带宽，并确定计算部署位置。因此，R2X本质上是一个意图到资源的协同编排问题，通过联合优化感知、通信与计算，以在资源约束下最大化任务层级成功率。

本综述探讨了集成设计如何为MLLM指导下的多机器人协同铺平道路。我们回顾了当前前沿的感知模态、通信策略与计算方法，重点分析了推理如何在设备端模型与强大的边缘/云服务器之间进行分配。我们展示了四项端到端演示（感知→通信→计算→行动）：(i) 基于预测链路背景的数字孪生仓库导航，(ii) 移动性驱动的主动MCS控制，(iii) 配备语义感知切换功能的FollowMe机器人，以及(iv) 通过边缘辅助MLLM落地实现的实际硬件开放词汇垃圾分类。我们通过系统级指标——负载、延迟与成功率——强调R2X协同编排为何优于纯设备端基线方案。
tldr: This survey paper explores how multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can be used to orchestrate sensing, communication, and computation for multi-robot systems, focusing on intent-driven resource optimization to improve task-level performance in scenarios like warehouse navigation and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述论文探讨了如何利用多模态大语言模型来协调多机器人系统中的感知、通信和计算，专注于意图驱动的资源优化，以提升如仓库导航和分拣等任务场景下的性能。

title: MaskAdapt: Learning Flexible Motion Adaptation via Mask-Invariant Prior for Physics-Based Characters
summary: We present MaskAdapt, a framework for flexible motion adaptation in physics-based humanoid control. The framework follows a two-stage residual learning paradigm. In the first stage, we train a mask-invariant base policy using stochastic body-part masking and a regularization term that enforces consistent action distributions across masking conditions. This yields a robust motion prior that remains stable under missing observations, anticipating later adaptation in those regions. In the second stage, a residual policy is trained atop the frozen base controller to modify only the targeted body parts while preserving the original behaviors elsewhere. We demonstrate the versatility of this design through two applications: (i) motion composition, where varying masks enable multi-part adaptation within a single sequence, and (ii) text-driven partial goal tracking, where designated body parts follow kinematic targets provided by a pre-trained text-conditioned autoregressive motion generator. Through experiments, MaskAdapt demonstrates strong robustness and adaptability, producing diverse behaviors under masked observations and delivering superior targeted motion adaptation compared to prior work.
summary_zh: 本文提出MaskAdapt，一种基于物理仿真的拟人控制柔性运动适配框架。该框架采用两阶段残差学习范式。第一阶段通过随机身体部位掩码和正则化项训练掩码不变的基础策略，该正则化项强制不同掩码条件下的动作分布保持一致性，从而构建出在观测缺失时仍能保持稳定的鲁棒运动先验，为后续对应区域的适配奠定基础。第二阶段在冻结的基础控制器上训练残差策略，仅针对目标身体部位进行运动调整，同时保持其他部位的原始行为。我们通过两个应用展示该设计的灵活性：（一）运动合成，通过变化掩码实现在单次运动序列中进行多部位适配；（二）文本驱动的局部目标追踪，使指定身体部位跟随预训练的文本条件自回归运动生成器提供的运动学目标。实验表明，MaskAdapt展现出卓越的鲁棒性与适应性，不仅在掩码观测下能生成多样行为，相比现有方法更能实现精准的定向运动适配。
tldr: MaskAdapt is a framework for physics-based humanoid control that uses a two-stage residual learning approach with stochastic body-part masking to enable flexible motion adaptation, such as motion composition and text-driven partial goal tracking.
tldr_zh: MaskAdapt是一个用于物理模拟人形机器人控制的框架，它采用两阶段残差学习策略和随机身体部位掩码，以实现灵活的运动适应，例如运动组合和基于文本的部分目标跟踪。

title: SuperGrasp: Single-View Object Grasping via Superquadric Similarity Matching, Evaluation, and Refinement
summary: Robotic grasping from single-view observations remains a critical challenge in manipulation. Existing methods still struggle to generate stable and valid grasp poses when confronted with incomplete geometric information. To address these limitations, we propose SuperGrasp, a novel two-stage framework for single-view grasping with parallel-jaw grippers that decomposes the grasping process into initial grasp pose generation and subsequent grasp evaluation and refinement. In the first stage, we introduce a Similarity Matching Module that efficiently retrieves grasp candidates by matching the input single-view point cloud with a pre-computed primitive dataset based on superquadric coefficients. In the second stage, we propose E-RNet, an end-to-end network that expands the graspaware region and takes the initial grasp closure region as a local anchor region, enabling more accurate and reliable evaluation and refinement of grasp candidates. To enhance generalization, we construct a primitive dataset containing 1.5k primitives for similarity matching and collect a large-scale point cloud dataset with 100k stable grasp labels from 124 objects for network training. Extensive experiments in both simulation and realworld environments demonstrate that our method achieves stable grasping performance and strong generalization across varying scenes and novel objects.
summary_zh: 摘要：基于单视角观测的机器人抓取依然是操控领域的关键挑战。现有方法在面对不完整的几何信息时，仍难以生成稳定有效的抓取姿态。为突破这些局限，我们提出SuperGrasp——一种面向平行夹爪单视角抓取的新型两阶段框架，该框架将抓取过程分解为初始抓取姿态生成与后续抓取评估优化两个阶段。第一阶段，我们设计了相似性匹配模块，通过将输入的单视角点云与基于超二次曲面系数预计算的原型数据集进行匹配，高效检索抓取候选姿态。第二阶段，我们提出E-RNet端到端网络，该网络扩展抓取感知区域，并以初始抓取闭合区域作为局部锚定区域，从而实现对抓取候选姿态更精准可靠的评估与优化。为提升泛化能力，我们构建了包含1500个原型的相似性匹配数据集，并采集了来自124个物体的10万条带稳定抓取标签的大规模点云数据集用于网络训练。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，该方法在不同场景及新物体上均实现了稳定的抓取性能和强大的泛化能力。
tldr: This paper introduces SuperGrasp, a two-stage framework for single-view robotic grasping with parallel-jaw grippers, using superquadric-based similarity matching and a neural network for evaluation and refinement to handle incomplete geometry.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SuperGrasp，一个用于单视图平行夹爪抓取的两阶段框架，通过超二次曲面相似性匹配和用于评估与细化的神经网络来处理不完整的几何信息。

title: Long-Reach Robotic Cleaning for Lunar Solar Arrays
summary: Commercial lunar activity is accelerating the need for reliable surface infrastructure and routine operations to keep it functioning. Maintenance tasks such as inspection, cleaning, dust mitigation, and minor repair are essential to preserve performance and extend system life. A specific application is the cleaning of lunar solar arrays. Solar arrays are expected to provide substantial fraction of lunar surface power and operate for months to years, supplying continuous energy to landers, habitats, and surface assets, making sustained output mission-critical. However, over time lunar dust accumulates on these large solar arrays, which can rapidly degrade panel output and reduce mission lifetime. We propose a small mobile robot equipped with a long-reach, lightweight deployable boom and interchangeable cleaning tool to perform gentle cleaning over meter-scale workspaces with minimal human involvement. Building on prior vision-guided long-reach manipulation, we add a compliant wrist with distal force sensing and a velocity-based admittance controller to regulate stable contact during surface cleaning. In preliminary benchtop experiments on a planar surface, the system maintained approximately 2 N normal force while executing a simple cleaning motion over boom lengths from 0.3 m to 1.0 m, with RMS force error of approximately 0.2 N after initial contact. These early results suggest that deployable long-reach manipulators are a promising architecture for robotic maintenance of lunar infrastructure such as solar arrays, radiators, and optical surfaces.
summary_zh: 商业月球活动的加速推进，对可靠的地表基础设施及其常态化运行维护提出了迫切需求。巡检、清洁、防尘及小规模维修等维护任务对于保持系统性能、延长使用寿命至关重要。其中，月球太阳能电池板的清洁是一项典型应用。太阳能电池板预计将为月球表面提供大部分电力，并持续运行数月乃至数年，为着陆器、居住舱及地表设备输送不间断能源，因此维持其稳定输出成为任务关键。然而，随着时间推移，月尘会在这些大型太阳能电池板上不断积聚，导致电池板输出功率急剧下降，缩短任务寿命。我们提出一种配备长伸距轻质可展开机械臂及可替换清洁工具的小型移动机器人方案，能够在米级工作范围内以最小人力介入完成精细化清洁作业。基于先前的视觉引导长伸距操控技术，我们增加了具备末端力感知功能的柔性腕部及基于速度导纳的控制器，以在表面清洁过程中维持稳定的接触力。在平面实验台的初步测试中，该系统在0.3米至1.0米臂展范围内执行简单清洁动作时，能保持约2牛的法向接触力，初始接触后均方根力误差约为0.2牛。这些早期结果表明，可展开式长伸距机械臂为太阳能电池板、辐射器及光学表面等月球基础设施的机器人维护提供了一种极具潜力的技术架构。
tldr: The paper presents a robotic system with a long-reach manipulator for cleaning lunar solar arrays, featuring a compliant wrist, force sensing, and an admittance controller to maintain stable contact during cleaning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于清洁月球太阳能电池板的机器人系统，其采用长臂机械手、柔性腕部、力传感和导纳控制器，以在清洁过程中保持稳定的接触力。

title: Long-Reach Robotic Manipulation for Assembly and Outfitting of Lunar Structures
summary: Future infrastructure construction on the lunar surface will require semi- or fully-autonomous operation from robots deployed at the build site. In particular, tasks such as electrical outfitting necessitate transport, routing, and fine manipulation of cables across large structures. To address this need, we present a compact and long-reach manipulator incorporating a deployable composite boom, capable of performing manipulation tasks across large structures and workspaces. We characterize the deflection, vibration, and blossoming characteristics inherent to the deployable structure, and present a manipulation control strategy to mitigate these effects. Experiments indicate an average endpoint accuracy error of less than 15 mm for boom lengths up to 1.8 m. We demonstrate the approach with a cable routing task to illustrate the potential for lunar outfitting applications that benefit from long reach.
summary_zh: 未来在月球表面进行基础设施建设时，将需要部署在施工现场的机器人实现半自主或全自主运行。特别是电力布线等任务，需要在大规模结构上进行电缆的运输、路径规划与精细操作。为满足这一需求，我们提出一种集成可展开复合材料吊臂的紧凑型长臂机械手，能够在大尺度结构和工作空间内执行操作任务。我们分析了该可展开结构固有的偏转、振动和展开特性，并提出一种操作控制策略以减轻这些影响。实验表明，在吊臂长度达1.8米时，其末端平均定位误差小于15毫米。我们通过电缆布线任务验证了该方法的有效性，展示了这种长臂机械手在月球设施装配应用中的潜力。
tldr: Presents a long-reach robotic manipulator with a deployable composite boom for cable routing and fine manipulation tasks on lunar structures, featuring a control strategy to mitigate deflection and vibration.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于月球结构上电缆布线和精细操作任务的长臂机器人，采用可展开复合臂和一种控制策略来减少偏转和振动。

title: Kilohertz-Safe: A Scalable Framework for Constrained Dexterous Retargeting
summary: Dexterous hand teleoperation requires motion re-targeting methods that simultaneously achieve high-frequency real-time performance and enforcement of heterogeneous kinematic and safety constraints. Existing nonlinear optimization-based approaches often incur prohibitive computational cost, limiting their applicability to kilohertz-level control, while learning-based methods typically lack formal safety guarantees. This paper proposes a scalable motion retargeting framework that reformulates the nonlinear retargeting problem into a convex quadratic program in joint differential space. Heterogeneous constraints, including kinematic limits and collision avoidance, are incorporated through systematic linearization, resulting in improved computational efficiency and numerical stability. Control barrier functions are further integrated to provide formal safety guarantees during the retargeting process. The proposed framework is validated through simulations and hardware experiments on the Wuji Hand platform, outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as Dex-Retargeting and GeoRT. The framework achieves high-frequency operation with an average latency of 9.05 ms, while over 95% of retargeted frames satisfy the safety criteria, effectively mitigating self-collision and penetration during complex manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 灵巧手遥操作需要运动重定向方法，能够同时实现高频实时性能并强制执行异构运动学与安全性约束。现有的基于非线性优化的方法往往计算成本过高，难以应用于千赫兹级别的控制，而基于学习的方法通常缺乏形式化的安全性保证。本文提出一种可扩展的运动重定向框架，将非线性重定向问题重新表述为关节差分空间中的凸二次规划问题。通过系统线性化方法，将包括运动学极限与碰撞避免在内的异构约束融入框架中，从而提高了计算效率和数值稳定性。进一步引入控制屏障函数，为重定向过程提供形式化的安全保障。所提出的框架在Wuji Hand平台上通过仿真和硬件实验验证，其性能优于Dex-Retargeting和GeoRT等现有先进方法。该框架实现了高频运行，平均延迟为9.05毫秒，同时超过95%的重定向帧满足安全标准，有效避免了复杂操作任务中的自碰撞和穿透问题。
tldr: This paper introduces a real-time, safe motion retargeting framework for dexterous hand teleoperation, reformulating the problem as a convex QP with control barrier functions to achieve high-frequency control and safety guarantees, validated on the Wuji Hand platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于灵巧手遥操作的高频、安全的运动重定向框架，将非线性问题转化为凸二次规划，并利用控制屏障函数确保安全，在Wuji Hand平台上进行了验证。

title: Efficient Camera Pose Augmentation for View Generalization in Robotic Policy Learning
summary: Prevailing 2D-centric visuomotor policies exhibit a pronounced deficiency in novel view generalization, as their reliance on static observations hinders consistent action mapping across unseen views. In response, we introduce GenSplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that facilitates view-generalized policy learning through novel view rendering. GenSplat employs a permutation-equivariant architecture to reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scenes from sparse, uncalibrated inputs in a single forward pass. To ensure structural integrity, we design a 3D-prior distillation strategy that regularizes the 3DGS optimization, preventing the geometric collapse typical of purely photometric supervision. By rendering diverse synthetic views from these stable 3D representations, we systematically augment the observational manifold during training. This augmentation forces the policy to ground its decisions in underlying 3D structures, thereby ensuring robust execution under severe spatial perturbations where baselines severely degrade.
summary_zh: 摘要：主流的二维视觉运动策略在新视角泛化方面存在明显不足，因其依赖静态观测的特性阻碍了在未见视角下保持动作映射的一致性。为此，我们提出GenSplat——一种基于前向传播的三维高斯泼溅框架，通过新颖视角渲染促进视角泛化的策略学习。GenSplat采用置换等变架构，仅需单次前向传播即可从稀疏且未校准的输入中重建高保真三维场景。为确保结构完整性，我们设计了一种三维先验蒸馏策略，以规范三维高斯泼溅的优化过程，避免纯光度监督中常见的几何塌陷问题。通过从这些稳定的三维表征中渲染多样化的合成视角，我们系统性地扩展了训练过程中的观测流形。这种增强迫使策略将其决策建立在底层三维结构之上，从而在基线方法严重失效的剧烈空间扰动下仍能保证鲁棒的执行能力。
tldr: The paper introduces GenSplat, a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for generating novel camera views to augment training data and improve the view generalization of robotic visuomotor policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出GenSplat，一种3D高斯溅射框架，用于生成新视角以增强训练数据，从而提升机器人视觉运动策略的视角泛化能力。

title: LatentPilot: Scene-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation by Dreaming Ahead with Latent Visual Reasoning
summary: Existing vision-and-language navigation (VLN) models primarily reason over past and current visual observations, while largely ignoring the future visual dynamics induced by actions. As a result, they often lack an effective understanding of the causal relationship between actions and how the visual world changes, limiting robust decision-making. Humans, in contrast, can imagine the near future by leveraging action-dynamics causality, which improves both environmental understanding and navigation choices. Inspired by this capability, we propose LatentPilot, a new paradigm that exploits future observations during training as a valuable data source to learn action-conditioned visual dynamics, while requiring no access to future frames at inference. Concretely, we propose a flywheel-style training mechanism that iteratively collects on-policy trajectories and retrains the model to better match the agent's behavior distribution, with an expert takeover triggered when the agent deviates excessively. LatentPilot further learns visual latent tokens without explicit supervision; these latent tokens attend globally in a continuous latent space and are carried across steps, serving as both the current output and the next input, thereby enabling the agent to dream ahead and reason about how actions will affect subsequent observations. Experiments on R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and R2R-PE benchmarks achieve new SOTA results, and real-robot tests across diverse environments demonstrate LatentPilot's superior understanding of environment-action dynamics in scene. Project page:https://abdd.top/latentpilot/
summary_zh: 现有的视觉-语言导航模型主要依赖对过去和当前视觉观察的推理，而忽略了行动引发的未来视觉动态。这导致模型往往缺乏对行动与视觉世界变化之间因果关系的有效理解，从而限制了决策的鲁棒性。相比之下，人类能够利用行动-动态的因果关系来预测近期未来，从而提升对环境的理解并优化导航选择。受此启发，我们提出LatentPilot，一种新范式，在训练阶段利用未来的观察作为宝贵的数据源，学习行动条件下的视觉动态，而在推理阶段无需访问未来帧。具体而言，我们提出一种飞轮式训练机制，通过迭代收集在线策略轨迹并重新训练模型，以更好地匹配智能体的行为分布；当智能体过度偏离时，触发专家接管机制。LatentPilot进一步在无显式监督的情况下学习视觉潜在标记；这些标记在连续的潜在空间中全局关注，并跨步骤传递，既作为当前输出又作为下一时间步的输入，从而使智能体能够预见未来，并推理行动将如何影响后续观察。在R2R-CE、RxR-CE和R2R-PE基准测试中取得了新的最优结果，跨多样化环境的真实机器人测试也证明了LatentPilot对环境中行动动态的卓越理解能力。项目页面：https://abdd.top/latentpilot/
tldr: LatentPilot is a new VLN model that learns to anticipate future visual observations to better understand action-dynamics, achieving SOTA on benchmarks and showing success in real-robot tests.
tldr_zh: LatentPilot是一种新的视觉语言导航模型，通过预测未来视觉观察来学习动作-动态因果关系，在基准测试中达到SOTA，并在真实机器人测试中取得成功。

title: Generalizable Dense Reward for Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks
summary: Existing robotic foundation policies are trained primarily via large-scale imitation learning. While such models demonstrate strong capabilities, they often struggle with long-horizon tasks due to distribution shift and error accumulation. While reinforcement learning (RL) can finetune these models, it cannot work well across diverse tasks without manual reward engineering. We propose VLLR, a dense reward framework combining (1) an extrinsic reward from Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for task progress recognition, and (2) an intrinsic reward based on policy self-certainty. VLLR uses LLMs to decompose tasks into verifiable subtasks and then VLMs to estimate progress to initialize the value function for a brief warm-up phase, avoiding prohibitive inference cost during full training; and self-certainty provides per-step intrinsic guidance throughout PPO finetuning. Ablation studies reveal complementary benefits: VLM-based value initialization primarily improves task completion efficiency, while self-certainty primarily enhances success rates, particularly on out-of-distribution tasks. On the CHORES benchmark covering mobile manipulation and navigation, VLLR achieves up to 56% absolute success rate gains over the pretrained policy, up to 5% gains over state-of-the-art RL finetuning methods on in-distribution tasks, and up to $10\%$ gains on out-of-distribution tasks, all without manual reward engineering. Additional visualizations can be found in https://silongyong.github.io/vllr_project_page/
summary_zh: 现有机器人基础策略主要通过大规模模仿学习进行训练。此类模型虽展现出强大能力，但因分布偏移和误差累积问题，往往难以完成长时程任务。虽然强化学习能对这些模型进行微调，但若缺乏人工奖励工程设计，则难以在多样化任务中有效运作。本文提出VLLR稠密奖励框架，其融合了（1）来自大语言模型与视觉语言模型的任务进度识别外部奖励，以及（2）基于策略自确信度的内在奖励。VLLR利用大语言模型将任务分解为可验证的子任务，再通过视觉语言模型估计进度以初始化价值函数，进行短期预热训练，从而避免完整训练过程中的过高推理成本；同时，自确信机制在近端策略优化微调全过程中提供逐步骤的内在指导。消融研究表明两者具有互补优势：基于视觉语言模型的价值初始化主要提升任务完成效率，而自确信机制主要提高成功率，尤其在分布外任务中效果显著。在涵盖移动操控与导航的CHORES基准测试中，VLLR相比预训练策略实现了最高56%的绝对成功率提升，在分布内任务上较现有最优强化学习微调方法提升达5%，在分布外任务上提升达10%，且全程无需人工奖励工程设计。更多可视化结果可访问https://silongyong.github.io/vllr_project_page/
tldr: The paper proposes VLLR, a framework for finetuning robotic foundation policies via dense rewards derived from LLMs for task decomposition and VLMs for progress estimation, combined with a policy self-certainty intrinsic reward, improving success rates and efficiency on long-horizon mobile manipulation and navigation tasks without manual reward engineering.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出VLLR框架，通过结合LLM进行任务分解与VLM评估进度的外部奖励，以及基于策略自确定性的内部奖励，为机器人基础策略提供密集奖励，用于微调。该方法无需人工奖励设计，在移动操作和导航等长视野任务中显著提高了成功率与效率。

title: HCLSM: Hierarchical Causal Latent State Machines for Object-Centric World Modeling
summary: World models that predict future states from video remain limited by flat latent representations that entangle objects, ignore causal structure, and collapse temporal dynamics into a single scale. We present HCLSM, a world model architecture that operates on three interconnected principles: object-centric decomposition via slot attention with spatial broadcast decoding, hierarchical temporal dynamics through a three-level engine combining selective state space models for continuous physics, sparse transformers for discrete events, and compressed transformers for abstract goals, and causal structure learning through graph neural network interaction patterns. HCLSM introduces a two-stage training protocol where spatial reconstruction forces slot specialization before dynamics prediction begins. We train a 68M-parameter model on the PushT robotic manipulation benchmark from the Open X-Embodiment dataset, achieving 0.008 MSE next-state prediction loss with emerging spatial decomposition (SBD loss: 0.0075) and learned event boundaries. A custom Triton kernel for the SSM scan delivers 38x speedup over sequential PyTorch. The full system spans 8,478 lines of Python across 51 modules with 171 unit tests. Code: https://github.com/rightnow-ai/hclsm
summary_zh:
摘要：
现有基于视频预测未来状态的世界模型仍受限于扁平化的潜在表征，这些表征往往混淆对象、忽略因果结构，并将时序动态压缩至单一尺度。本文提出HCLSM——一种基于三大互联原则构建的世界模型架构：通过空间广播解码的槽注意力机制实现以对象为中心的分解；结合选择性状态空间模型（处理连续物理过程）、稀疏变换器（处理离散事件）与压缩变换器（处理抽象目标）的三级引擎实现层次化时序动态；借助图神经网络交互模式学习因果结构。HCLSM采用两阶段训练协议：在动态预测开始前，通过空间重构强制槽特征专业化。我们在Open X-Embodiment数据集中的PushT机器人操作基准上训练了6800万参数模型，实现了0.008的下一状态预测均方误差，同时涌现出空间分解能力（SBD损失：0.0075）并习得事件边界。为状态空间模型扫描定制的Triton内核较顺序PyTorch实现获得38倍加速。完整系统包含51个模块共计8478行Python代码，配备171个单元测试。代码地址：https://github.com/rightnow-ai/hclsm
tldr: Proposes HCLSM, a world model for object-centric video prediction with hierarchical dynamics and causal learning, trained and evaluated on the PushT robotic manipulation benchmark.
tldr_zh: 提出HCLSM，一种用于面向对象的视频预测的世界模型，具有分层动力学和因果学习能力，并在PushT机器人操作基准上进行了训练和评估。

title: Stable Walking for Bipedal Locomotion under Foot-Slip via Virtual Nonholonomic Constraints
summary: Foot slip is a major source of instability in bipedal locomotion on low-friction or uncertain terrain. Standard control approaches typically assume no-slip contact and therefore degrade when slip occurs. We propose a control framework that explicitly incorporates slip into the locomotion model through virtual nonholonomic constraints, which regulate the tangential stance-foot velocity while remaining compatible with the virtual holonomic constraints used to generate the walking gait. The resulting closed-loop system is formulated as a hybrid dynamical system with continuous swing dynamics and discrete impact events. A nonlinear feedback law enforces both classes of constraints and yields a slip-compatible hybrid zero dynamics manifold for the reduced-order locomotion dynamics. Stability of periodic walking gaits is characterized through the associated Poincaré map, and numerical results illustrate stabilization under slip conditions.
summary_zh: 足部滑移是双足机器人在低摩擦或不确定地形上运动时导致失稳的主要因素。标准控制方法通常假设无滑移接触条件，因此在滑移发生时性能会下降。本文提出一种控制框架，通过虚拟非完整约束将滑移显式纳入运动模型，该约束在调控支撑足切向速度的同时，仍能与用于生成步态的虚拟完整约束保持兼容。所构建的闭环系统被表述为具有连续摆动动力学和离散冲击事件的混合动态系统。非线性反馈律同时实施两类约束，并为降维运动动力学生成一个滑移兼容的混合零动态流形。通过相应的庞加莱映射刻画了周期性步态的稳定性，数值结果验证了滑移条件下的稳定控制效果。
tldr: A control framework for bipedal robot locomotion that explicitly models foot slip via virtual nonholonomic constraints to regulate stance-foot velocity, enabling stable walking on low-friction terrain.
tldr_zh: 一种用于双足机器人步行的控制框架，通过虚拟非完整约束显式建模足部滑动以调节支撑足速度，实现在低摩擦力地形上的稳定行走。

title: See Something, Say Something: Context-Criticality-Aware Mobile Robot Communication for Hazard Mitigations
summary: The proverb ``see something, say something'' captures a core responsibility of autonomous mobile robots in safety-critical situations: when they detect a hazard, they must communicate--and do so quickly. In emergency scenarios, delayed or miscalibrated responses directly increase the time to action and the risk of damage. We argue that a systematic context-sensitive assessment of the criticality level, time sensitivity, and feasibility of mitigation is necessary for AMRs to reduce time to action and respond effectively. This paper presents a framework in which VLM/LLM-based perception drives adaptive message generation, for example, a knife in a kitchen produces a calm acknowledgment; the same object in a corridor triggers an urgent coordinated alert. Validation in 60+ runs using a patrolling mobile robot not only empowers faster response, but also brings user trusts to 82\% compared to fixed-priority baselines, validating that structured criticality assessment improves both response speed and mitigation effectiveness.
summary_zh: 眼见为实，言之有物"这句谚语揭示了安全关键场景下自主移动机器人的核心责任：当检测到危险时，它们必须迅速进行有效沟通。在紧急情况下，延迟或不当的响应将直接延长行动响应时间，并显著增加损害风险。我们认为，自主移动机器人需对危险等级、时间敏感性和处置可行性进行系统化的情境敏感评估，以缩短响应时间并提升应对效能。本文提出一种基于视觉语言模型/大语言模型感知的自适应信息生成框架，例如厨房中的刀具会触发平稳确认通知，而相同物体出现在走廊时则引发紧急协同警报。通过巡逻移动机器人超过60次运行的验证表明，该框架不仅实现了更快的响应速度，还将用户信任度提升至82%（相较于固定优先级基准方案），证实了结构化危险评估能同时提升响应速度与处置效果。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for mobile robots to use VLM/LLM-based perception to assess hazard criticality and generate adaptive, context-sensitive emergency communication for faster, more trusted responses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，让移动机器人使用基于VLM/LLM的感知来评估危险关键程度，并生成适应性的、上下文敏感的紧急通信，以实现更快、更可信的响应。

title: Bootstrap Perception Under Hardware Depth Failure for Indoor Robot Navigation
summary: We present a bootstrap perception system for indoor robot navigation under hardware depth failure. In our corridor data, the time-of-flight camera loses up to 78% of its depth pixels on reflective surfaces, yet a 2D LiDAR alone cannot sense obstacles above its scan plane. Our system exploits a self-referential property of this failure: the sensor's surviving valid pixels calibrate learned monocular depth to metric scale, so the system fills its own gaps without external data. The architecture forms a failure-aware sensing hierarchy, conservative when sensors work and filling in when they fail: LiDAR remains the geometric anchor, hardware depth is kept where valid, and learned depth enters only where needed. In corridor and dynamic pedestrian evaluations, selective fusion increases costmap obstacle coverage by 55-110% over LiDAR alone. A compact distilled student runs at 218\,FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano and achieves 9/10 navigation success with zero collisions in closed-loop simulation, matching the ground-truth depth baseline at a fraction of the foundation model's cost.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在硬件深度失效情况下的室内机器人导航自举感知系统。在走廊环境中，飞行时间相机在反射表面会损失高达78%的深度像素，而仅依赖二维激光雷达则无法感知扫描平面上方的障碍物。我们的系统利用这种失效的自反特性：传感器存留的有效像素可将学习到的单目深度信息校准至公制尺度，从而使系统能够在无需外部数据的情况下自行填补感知缺口。该架构构建了失效感知的层级化传感体系，在传感器正常工作时保持保守策略，在失效时进行填补：激光雷达始终作为几何锚点，硬件深度数据在有效区域被保留，而学习深度仅在需要时介入。在走廊环境和动态行人场景的评估中，选择性融合策略使代价地图的障碍物覆盖率较单一激光雷达方案提升了55-110%。经蒸馏的紧凑学生模型在Jetson Orin Nano平台上以218帧/秒的速度运行，在闭环仿真中实现了9/10的导航成功率且零碰撞，其性能与真实深度基准相当，而计算成本仅为基础模型的极小部分。
tldr: The paper proposes a bootstrap perception system for indoor robot navigation that fuses sparse depth from a faulty ToF sensor, LiDAR, and learned monocular depth to fill gaps, improving obstacle coverage and enabling reliable navigation on a Jetson Orin Nano.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于室内机器人导航的引导感知系统，融合了有故障的ToF传感器的稀疏深度、激光雷达和学习的单目深度来填补数据空缺，提高了障碍物覆盖率，并在Jetson Orin Nano上实现了可靠的导航。

title: Enhancing Policy Learning with World-Action Model
summary: This paper presents the World-Action Model (WAM), an action-regularized world model that jointly reasons over future visual observations and the actions that drive state transitions. Unlike conventional world models trained solely via image prediction, WAM incorporates an inverse dynamics objective into DreamerV2 that predicts actions from latent state transitions, encouraging the learned representations to capture action-relevant structure critical for downstream control. We evaluate WAM on enhancing policy learning across eight manipulation tasks from the CALVIN benchmark. We first pretrain a diffusion policy via behavioral cloning on world model latents, then refine it with model-based PPO inside the frozen world model. Without modifying the policy architecture or training procedure, WAM improves average behavioral cloning success from 59.4% to 71.2% over DreamerV2 and DiWA baselines. After PPO fine-tuning, WAM achieves 92.8% average success versus 79.8% for the baseline, with two tasks reaching 100%, using 8.7x fewer training steps.
summary_zh: 本文提出世界-动作模型（WAM），这是一种通过动作正则化的世界模型，能够联合推理未来视觉观测与驱动状态转换的动作。与传统仅通过图像预测训练的世界模型不同，WAM将逆向动力学目标融入DreamerV2框架，使其能够从潜在状态转换中预测动作，从而促使学习到的表征捕捉对下游控制至关重要的动作相关结构。我们在CALVIN基准测试的八项操作任务上评估了WAM对策略学习的增强效果：首先通过行为克隆在世界模型潜在空间上预训练扩散策略，随后在冻结的世界模型中借助基于模型的PPO进行微调。在不修改策略架构或训练流程的情况下，WAM将行为克隆的平均成功率从DreamerV2和DiWA基线的59.4%提升至71.2%；经过PPO微调后，WAM以仅需基线8.7%的训练步数，实现了92.8%的平均成功率（基线为79.8%），其中两项任务达到100%成功。
tldr: This paper proposes World-Action Model (WAM), which enhances world models by regularizing with an inverse dynamics objective to predict actions from latent transitions, and demonstrates significant improvements for policy learning on robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出世界-动作模型（WAM），通过对潜在状态转换预测动作的正则化来增强世界模型，并在机器人操作任务中显著提升了策略学习效果。

title: HapCompass: A Rotational Haptic Device for Contact-Rich Robotic Teleoperation
summary: The contact-rich nature of manipulation makes it a significant challenge for robotic teleoperation. While haptic feedback is critical for contact-rich tasks, providing intuitive directional cues within wearable teleoperation interfaces remains a bottleneck. Existing solutions, such as non-directional vibrations from handheld controllers, provide limited information, while vibrotactile arrays are prone to perceptual interference. To address these limitations, we propose HapCompass, a novel, low-cost wearable haptic device that renders 2D directional cues by mechanically rotating a single linear resonant actuator (LRA). We evaluated HapCompass's ability to convey directional cues to human operators and showed that it increased the success rate, decreased the completion time and the maximum contact force for teleoperated manipulation tasks when compared to vision-only and non-directional feedback baselines. Furthermore, we conducted a preliminary imitation-learning evaluation, suggesting that the directional feedback provided by HapCompass enhances the quality of demonstration data and, in turn, the trained policy. We release the design of the HapCompass device along with the code that implements our teleoperation interface: https://ripl.github.io/HapCompass/.
summary_zh: 机器人遥操作中，由于涉及大量接触交互，因此面临重大挑战。触觉反馈对于接触密集型任务至关重要，但在可穿戴遥操作界面中提供直观的方向提示仍存在瓶颈。现有解决方案如手持控制器产生的非定向振动，所能提供的信息有限，而振动触觉阵列则容易产生感知干扰。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖、低成本的可穿戴触觉设备HapCompass，它通过机械旋转单个线性谐振致动器来呈现二维方向提示。我们评估了HapCompass向操作者传递方向提示的能力，结果表明，与仅依赖视觉反馈和非定向反馈的基线相比，HapCompass显著提高了遥操作任务的成功率，减少了任务完成时间和最大接触力。此外，我们进行了初步的模仿学习评估，结果显示HapCompass提供的定向反馈提高了演示数据的质量，从而提升了训练策略的效能。我们公开了HapCompass设备的设计方案及遥操作界面的实现代码：https://ripl.github.io/HapCompass/。
tldr: HapCompass is a novel wearable rotational haptic device that improves teleoperation for contact-rich manipulation tasks by providing directional cues, and also shows potential for enhancing imitation learning data quality.
tldr_zh: HapCompass是一种新颖的可穿戴旋转触觉设备，通过提供方向性提示来改善接触式机械臂遥操作任务的性能，并显示出增强模仿学习数据质量的潜力。

title: Reconfiguration of supernumerary robotic limbs for human augmentation
summary: Wearable robots aim to seamlessly adapt to humans and their environment with personalized interactions. Existing supernumerary robotic limbs (SRLs), which enhance the physical capabilities of humans with additional extremities, have thus far been developed primarily for task-specific applications in structured industrial settings, limiting their adaptability to dynamic and unstructured environments. Here, we introduce a novel reconfigurable SRL framework grounded in a quantitative analysis of human augmentation to guide the development of more adaptable SRLs for diverse scenarios. This framework captures how SRL configuration shapes workspace extension and human-robot collaboration. We define human augmentation ratios to evaluate collaborative, visible extended, and non-visible extended workspaces, enabling systematic selection of SRL placement, morphology, and autonomy for a given task. Using these metrics, we demonstrate how quantitative augmentation analysis can guide the reconfiguration and control of SRLs to better match task requirements. We validate the proposed approach through experiments with a reconfigurable SRL composed of origami-inspired modular elements. Our results suggest that reconfigurable SRLs, informed by quantitative human augmentation analysis, offer a new perspective for providing adaptable human augmentation and assistance in everyday environments.
summary_zh: 可穿戴机器人旨在通过个性化交互，无缝适应人类及其所处环境。现有超数机器人肢体通过附加肢体增强人体物理能力，但迄今为止主要针对结构化工业场景中的特定任务开发，限制了其在动态非结构化环境中的适应性。本研究提出一种基于人体增强量化分析的新型可重构SRL框架，以指导开发适用于多样化场景的适应性更强的SRL系统。该框架揭示了SRL配置如何影响工作空间扩展与人机协作，通过定义人体增强比率来评估协作空间、可见扩展空间与非可见扩展空间，从而为特定任务系统化选择SRL的布局、构型与自主性。基于这些量化指标，我们展示了增强分析如何指导SRL的重构与控制，以更精准匹配任务需求。我们通过由折纸启发的模块化元件构成的可重构SRL实验验证了该方法的有效性。研究表明，基于量化人体增强分析的可重构SRL系统，为日常环境中提供适应性人体增强与辅助开辟了新视角。
tldr: The paper introduces a quantitative framework for evaluating and reconfiguring supernumerary robotic limbs to better match task requirements, enabling adaptable human augmentation in unstructured environments through a modular, origami-inspired design.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于评估和重新配置超数机器人肢体的量化框架，以更好地匹配任务需求，通过模块化、折纸启发的设计，实现在非结构化环境中适应性强的人体增强。

title: Semantic Zone-Based Map Management for Stable AI-Integrated Mobile Robots
summary: Recent advances in large AI models (VLMs and LLMs) and joint use of the 3D dense maps, enable mobile robots to provide more powerful and interactive services grounded in rich spatial context. However, deploying both heavy AI models and dense maps on edge robots is challenging under strict memory budgets. When the memory budget is exceeded, required keyframes may not be loaded in time, which can degrade the stability of position estimation and interfering model performance. We proposes a semantic zone-based map management approach to stabilize dense-map utilization under memory constraints. We associate keyframes with semantic indoor regions (e.g., rooms and corridors) and keyframe management at the semantic zone level prioritizes spatially relevant map content while respecting memory constraints. This reduces keyframe loading and unloading frequency and memory usage. We evaluate the proposed approach in large-scale simulated indoor environments and on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano under concurrent SLAM-VLM execution. With Qwen3.5:0.8b, the proposed method improves throughput by 3.3 tokens/s and reduces latency by 21.7% relative to a geometric map-management strategy. Furthermore, while the geometric strategy suffers from out-of-memory failures and stalled execution under memory pressure, the proposed method eliminates both issues, preserving localization stability and enabling robust VLM operation. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach enables efficient dense map utilization for memory constrained, AI-integrated mobile robots. Code is available at: https://github.com/huichangs/rtabmap/tree/segment
summary_zh: 近年来，大型人工智能模型（视觉语言模型与大语言模型）的进步及其与三维稠密地图的协同使用，使移动机器人能够基于丰富的空间上下文提供更强大、更具交互性的服务。然而，在严格的存储容量限制下，在边缘机器人上同时部署重型人工智能模型和稠密地图具有挑战性。当存储容量超出预算时，所需的关键帧可能无法及时加载，这可能导致定位估计的稳定性下降，并干扰模型的性能表现。我们提出一种基于语义分区的地图管理方法，以在存储容量限制下稳定稠密地图的使用。我们将关键帧与语义室内区域（如房间和走廊）相关联，并在语义分区级别进行关键帧管理，以优先考虑空间相关的地图内容，同时满足存储容量限制。这减少了关键帧加载和卸载的频率及存储使用量。我们在大型模拟室内环境及 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 平台上进行了并发 SLAM 与视觉语言模型执行的评估。使用 Qwen3.5:0.8b 模型时，相较于几何地图管理策略，所提方法将吞吐量提高了 3.3 词元/秒，延迟降低了 21.7%。此外，在存储压力下，几何策略出现存储溢出故障和执行停滞，而所提方法则避免了这些问题，保持了定位稳定性，并实现了稳健的视觉语言模型运行。这些结果表明，所提方法能够为存储受限、人工智能集成的移动机器人实现高效的稠密地图利用。代码发布于：https://github.com/huichangs/rtabmap/tree/segment
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic zone-based map management method for memory-constrained mobile robots, which improves stability and performance when running concurrent SLAM and vision-language models on edge devices.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向内存受限移动机器人的语义区域地图管理方法，可提高在边缘设备上同时运行SLAM和视觉语言模型时的稳定性和性能。

title: IMPASTO: Integrating Model-Based Planning with Learned Dynamics Models for Robotic Oil Painting Reproduction
summary: Robotic reproduction of oil paintings using soft brushes and pigments requires force-sensitive control of deformable tools, prediction of brushstroke effects, and multi-step stroke planning, often without human step-by-step demonstrations or faithful simulators. Given only a sequence of target oil painting images, can a robot infer and execute the stroke trajectories, forces, and colors needed to reproduce it? We present IMPASTO, a robotic oil-painting system that integrates learned pixel dynamics models with model-based planning. The dynamics models predict canvas updates from image observations and parameterized stroke actions; a receding-horizon model predictive control optimizer then plans trajectories and forces, while a force-sensitive controller executes strokes on a 7-DoF robot arm. IMPASTO integrates low-level force control, learned dynamics models, and high-level closed-loop planning, learns solely from robot self-play, and approximates human artists' single-stroke datasets and multi-stroke artworks, outperforming baselines in reproduction accuracy. Project website: https://impasto-robopainting.github.io/
summary_zh:
摘要：
使用柔性画笔和颜料对油画进行机器人复现，需要实现对可变形工具的力敏感控制、笔触效果的预测以及多步骤的笔画规划，且通常缺乏人类分步演示或精确的仿真环境。仅给定目标油画图像序列，机器人能否推断并执行复现所需的笔画轨迹、施力与颜色配置？我们提出了IMPASTO系统，这是一个集成了像素动态学习模型与基于模型规划的机器人油画绘制系统。该动态模型能够根据图像观察和参数化笔画动作预测画布更新；随后，通过一个基于模型预测控制的滚动时域优化器规划轨迹与施力策略，并由一个力敏感控制器驱动七自由度机械臂执行笔画。IMPASTO系统融合了底层力控、学习动态模型与高层闭环规划，完全通过机器人自主交互学习实现，能够模拟人类艺术家的单笔画数据集与多笔画艺术作品，在复现精度上超越基线方法。项目网站：https://impasto-robopainting.github.io/
tldr: A robotic oil painting system that integrates learned dynamics models with model-based planning for force-sensitive control of soft brushes to reproduce target images.
tldr_zh: 一个集成学习动力学模型与基于模型规划的机器人油画系统，用于软画笔的力敏控制以复制目标图像。

title: PRISM: A Multi-View Multi-Capability Retail Video Dataset for Embodied Vision-Language Models
summary: A critical gap exists between the general-purpose visual understanding of state-of-the-art physical AI models and the specialized perceptual demands of structured real-world deployment environments. We present PRISM, a 270K-sample multi-view video supervised fine-tuning (SFT) corpus for embodied vision-language-models (VLMs) in real-world retail environments. PRISM is motivated by a simple observation - physical AI systems fail not because of poor visual recognition, but because they do not understand space, physical dynamics and embodied action well enough to operate reliably in the world. To this end, PRISM is grounded in a novel three-dimensional knowledge ontology that spans spatial knowledge, temporal and physical knowledge, and embodied action knowledge. It covers 20+ capability probes across four evaluation dimensions - Embodied Reasoning (ER), Common Sense (CS), Spatial Perception (SP), and Intuitive Physics (IP), and to our knowledge, PRISM is the first dataset to instantiate all three knowledge dimensions within a single real-world deployment domain. The corpus captures data from egocentric, exocentric and 360° viewpoints across five supermarket locations and includes open-ended, chain-of-thought, and multiple-choice supervision. At 4 fps, PRISM spans approximately 11.8M video frames and approximately 730M tokens, placing it among the largest domain-specific video SFT corpora. Fine-tuning on PRISM reduces the error rate across all 20+ probes by 66.6% over the pre-trained baseline, with significant gains in embodied action understanding where the accuracy improves by 36.4%. Our results suggest that ontology-structured, domain specific SFT can meaningfully strengthen embodied VLMs for real-world settings. The PRISM dataset and more details are available at https://dreamvu.ai/prism
summary_zh: 当前最先进的物理AI模型在通用视觉理解能力与结构化真实世界部署环境中的专业感知需求之间，存在显著差距。我们提出了PRISM——一个包含27万样本的多视角视频监督微调（SFT）语料库，专为零售环境中的具身视觉语言模型（VLMs）构建。PRISM的提出源于一个简单观察：物理AI系统的失败并非由于视觉识别能力不足，而是由于对空间、物理动态和具身行动的理解不够充分，导致在真实世界中难以可靠运行。为此，PRISM基于一个新颖的三维知识本体构建，涵盖空间知识、时间与物理知识以及具身行动知识。该语料库覆盖了四大评估维度下的二十余项能力测试——具身推理（ER）、常识（CS）、空间感知（SP）与直觉物理（IP），据我们所知，PRISM是首个在单一真实世界部署领域中同时实现所有三个知识维度的数据集。数据采集自五个超市场景的自我中心、他者中心及360°视角视频，包含开放式、思维链式与多项选择题形式的监督标注。以每秒4帧计，PRISM包含约1180万视频帧和约7.3亿文本标记，成为当前规模最大的领域专用视频SFT语料库之一。基于PRISM的微调使所有二十余项测试的错误率比预训练基线降低了66.6%，其中在具身行动理解方面提升尤为显著，准确率提高了36.4%。我们的结果表明，基于本体结构化、领域专用的SFT能有效增强具身视觉语言模型在真实场景中的适用性。PRISM数据集及更多细节详见https://dreamvu.ai/prism。
tldr: The paper introduces PRISM, a large-scale multi-view video dataset for fine-tuning embodied vision-language models in retail environments, focusing on spatial, physical, and embodied action knowledge.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PRISM，一个用于在零售环境中微调具身视觉语言模型的大规模多视角视频数据集，重点关注空间、物理和具身动作知识。

title: M2H-MX: Multi-Task Dense Visual Perception for Real-Time Monocular Spatial Understanding
summary:
Monocular cameras are attractive for robotic perception due to their low cost and ease of deployment, yet achieving reliable real-time spatial understanding from a single image stream remains challenging. While recent multi-task dense prediction models have improved per-pixel depth and semantic estimation, translating these advances into stable monocular mapping systems is still non-trivial.
  This paper presents M2H-MX, a real-time multi-task perception model for monocular spatial understanding. The model preserves multi-scale feature representations while introducing register-gated global context and controlled cross-task interaction in a lightweight decoder, enabling depth and semantic predictions to reinforce each other under strict latency constraints. Its outputs integrate directly into an unmodified monocular SLAM pipeline through a compact perception-to-mapping interface.
  We evaluate both dense prediction accuracy and in-the-loop system performance. On NYUDv2, M2H-MX-L achieves state-of-the-art results, improving semantic mIoU by 6.6% and reducing depth RMSE by 9.4% over representative multi-task baselines. When deployed in a real-time monocular mapping system on ScanNet, M2H-MX reduces average trajectory error by 60.7% compared to a strong monocular SLAM baseline while producing cleaner metric-semantic maps. These results demonstrate that modern multi-task dense prediction can be reliably deployed for real-time monocular spatial perception in robotic systems.
summary_zh:
单目相机因其低成本和易于部署而在机器人感知领域备受关注，然而从单一图像流中实现可靠的实时空间理解仍具挑战性。尽管近年来多任务密集预测模型在逐像素深度和语义估计方面有所提升，但将这些进展转化为稳定的单目建图系统仍非易事。

本文提出M2H-MX，一种用于单目空间理解的实时多任务感知模型。该模型在保留多尺度特征表示的同时，通过轻量级解码器引入了注册门控的全局上下文和受控的跨任务交互机制，使深度预测与语义预测在严格延迟约束下能够相互增强。其输出结果通过紧凑的感知-建图接口直接集成到未经修改的单目SLAM流程中。

我们评估了模型在密集预测精度和系统闭环性能方面的表现。在NYUDv2数据集上，M2H-MX-L取得了最优结果，相较代表性多任务基线模型，语义mIoU提升6.6%，深度RMSE降低9.4%。在ScanNet数据集的实际单目建图系统中部署时，M2H-MX相比强大的单目SLAM基线将平均轨迹误差降低60.7%，同时生成更清晰的度量-语义地图。这些结果表明，现代多任务密集预测技术能够可靠地应用于机器人系统的实时单目空间感知任务。
tldr: M2H-MX is a real-time multi-task model for monocular depth and semantic prediction designed to improve the performance of monocular SLAM for robotic mapping.
tldr_zh: M2H-MX 是一个用于单目深度和语义预测的实时多任务模型，旨在提升单目SLAM在机器人建图方面的性能。

title: Scaling Whole-Body Human Musculoskeletal Behavior Emulation for Specificity and Diversity
summary: The embodied learning of human motor control requires whole-body neuro-actuated musculoskeletal dynamics, while the internal muscle-driven processes underlying movement remain inaccessible to direct measurement. Computational modeling offers an alternative, but inverse dynamics methods struggled to resolve redundant control from observed kinematics in the high-dimensional, over-actuated system. Forward imitation approaches based on deep reinforcement learning exhibited inadequate tracking performance due to the curse of dimensionality in both control and reward design. Here we introduce a large-scale parallel musculoskeletal computation framework for biomechanically grounded whole-body motion reproduction. By integrating large-scale parallel GPU simulation with adversarial reward aggregation and value-guided flow exploration, the MS-Emulator framework overcomes key optimization bottlenecks in high-dimensional reinforcement learning for musculoskeletal control, which accurately reproduces a broad repertoire of motions in a whole-body human musculoskeletal system actuated by approximately 700 muscles. It achieved high joint angle accuracy and body position alignment for highly dynamic tasks such as dance, cartwheel, and backflip. The framework was also used to explore the musculoskeletal control solution space, identifying distinct musculoskeletal control policies that converge to nearly identical external kinematic and mechanical measurements. This work establishes a tractable computational route to analyzing the specificity and diversity underlying human embodied control of movement. Project page: https://lnsgroup.cc/research/MS-Emulator.
summary_zh: 人体运动控制的具体学习需要全身神经驱动的肌肉骨骼动力学，而运动背后内在的肌肉驱动过程无法直接测量。计算建模提供了一种替代方案，但在高维度、过度驱动的系统中，逆动力学方法难以从观测到的运动学数据中解析出冗余的控制机制。基于深度强化学习的正向模仿方法，由于控制和奖励设计中的维度灾难问题，表现出跟踪性能不足的局限。本文提出了一个大规模并行肌肉骨骼计算框架，用于实现基于生物力学原理的全身运动复现。该框架通过将大规模并行GPU仿真与对抗性奖励聚合及价值引导流探索相结合，克服了肌肉骨骼控制高维强化学习中的关键优化瓶颈，能够在一个由约700块肌肉驱动的全身人体肌肉骨骼系统中，准确复现多种类型的运动。对于舞蹈、侧手翻和后空翻等高动态任务，该框架实现了较高的关节角度精度和身体位置对齐度。此外，该框架还被用于探索肌肉骨骼控制解空间，识别出能够收敛到几乎相同的外部运动学和力学测量结果的不同肌肉骨骼控制策略。这项工作为分析人体运动控制的具体性和多样性，开辟了一条可行的计算路径。项目页面：https://lnsgroup.cc/research/MS-Emulator。
tldr: The paper introduces a large-scale parallel simulation framework called MS-Emulator that uses adversarial reward aggregation and reinforcement learning to accurately reproduce a wide range of dynamic whole-body human motions in a high-dimensional musculoskeletal system actuated by ~700 muscles, and explores the solution space of underlying control policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 MS-Emulator 的大规模并行仿真框架，利用对抗性奖励聚合和强化学习，在一个由约 700 块肌肉驱动的高维肌肉骨骼系统中，准确再现了广泛的动态全身人体运动，并探索了底层控制策略的解空间。

title: MRReP: Mixed Reality-based Hand-drawn Reference Path Editing Interface for Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Autonomous mobile robots operating in human-shared indoor environments often require paths that reflect human spatial intentions, such as avoiding interference with pedestrian flow or maintaining comfortable clearance. However, conventional path planners primarily optimize geometric costs and provide limited support for explicit route specification by human operators. This paper presents MRReP, a Mixed Reality-based interface that enables users to draw a Hand-drawn Reference Path (HRP) directly on the physical floor using hand gestures. The drawn HRP is integrated into the robot navigation stack through a custom Hand-drawn Reference Path Planner, which converts the user-specified point sequence into a global path for autonomous navigation. We evaluated MRReP in a within-subject experiment against a conventional 2D baseline interface. The results demonstrated that MRReP enhanced path specification accuracy, usability, and perceived workload, while enabling more stable path specification in the physical environment. These findings suggest that direct path specification in MR is an effective approach for incorporating human spatial intention into mobile robot navigation. Additional material is available at https://mertcookimg.github.io/mrrep
summary_zh: 在人类共享的室内环境中运行的自主移动机器人通常需要符合人类空间意图的路径，例如避免干扰行人流或保持舒适的间距。然而，传统的路径规划器主要优化几何成本，对人类操作员明确指定路线的支持有限。本文提出了一种基于混合现实（Mixed Reality）的界面MRReP，允许用户通过手势直接在物理地面上绘制手绘参考路径（Hand-drawn Reference Path, HRP）。绘制的HRP通过自定义的手绘参考路径规划器集成到机器人导航栈中，将用户指定的点序列转换为自主导航的全局路径。我们通过一项被试内实验，将MRReP与传统的二维基线界面进行比较评估。结果显示，MRReP提高了路径指定的准确性、可用性和感知任务负荷，同时在物理环境中实现了更稳定的路径指定。这些发现表明，在混合现实中直接指定路径是一种将人类空间意图融入移动机器人导航的有效方法。更多材料可在 https://mertcookimg.github.io/mrrep 查看。
tldr: This paper introduces MRReP, a Mixed Reality interface for drawing reference paths for mobile robot navigation, which improves usability and accuracy compared to a 2D baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MRReP，一种用于为移动机器人导航绘制参考路径的混合现实界面，相比传统2D界面，在可用性和准确性上有所提升。

title: Kernel-SDF: An Open-Source Library for Real-Time Signed Distance Function Estimation using Kernel Regression
summary: Accurate and efficient environment representation is crucial for robotic applications such as motion planning, manipulation, and navigation. Signed distance functions (SDFs) have emerged as a powerful representation for encoding distance to obstacle boundaries, enabling efficient collision-checking and trajectory optimization techniques. However, existing SDF reconstruction methods have limitations when it comes to large-scale uncertainty-aware SDF estimation from streaming sensor data. Voxel-based approaches are limited by fixed resolution and lack uncertainty quantification, neural network methods require significant training time, while Gaussian process (GP) methods struggle with scalability, sign estimation, and uncertainty calibration. In this letter, we develop an open-source library, Kernel-SDF, which uses kernel regression to learn SDF with calibrated uncertainty quantification in real-time. Our approach consists of a front-end that learns a continuous occupancy field via kernel regression, and a back-end that estimates accurate SDF via GP regression using samples from the front-end surface boundaries. Kernel-SDF provides accurate SDF, SDF gradient, SDF uncertainty, and mesh construction in real-time. Evaluation results show that Kernel-SDF achieves superior accuracy compared to existing methods, while maintaining real-time performance, making it suitable for various robotics applications requiring reliable uncertainty-aware geometric information.
summary_zh: 准确高效的环境表示对于机器人运动规划、操作与导航等应用至关重要。有符号距离函数（SDF）作为一种强大的环境表示方法，能够编码障碍物边界的距离信息，从而支持高效的碰撞检测与轨迹优化技术。然而，现有SDF重建方法在基于传感器流数据实现大规模不确定性感知的SDF估计方面存在局限：基于体素的方法受限于固定分辨率且缺乏不确定性量化，神经网络方法需要大量训练时间，而高斯过程（GP）方法则在可扩展性、符号估计和不确定性校准方面存在困难。本文开发了一个开源库Kernel-SDF，利用核回归方法实时学习具有校准不确定性量化的SDF。该方法包含通过核回归学习连续占据场的前端模块，以及利用前端表面边界采样点通过高斯过程回归估计精确SDF的后端模块。Kernel-SDF能够实时提供精确的SDF、SDF梯度、SDF不确定性及网格构建功能。评估结果表明，Kernel-SDF在保持实时性能的同时，达到了优于现有方法的精度，适用于需要可靠不确定性感知几何信息的各类机器人应用场景。
tldr: The paper introduces Kernel-SDF, an open-source library for real-time, uncertainty-aware Signed Distance Function estimation using kernel regression and GP regression, designed for robotics applications like motion planning and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Kernel-SDF，一个用于实时、不确定性感知的符号距离函数估计的开源库，基于核回归和高斯过程回归，专为机器人运动规划和操作等应用设计。

title: Multi-AUV Cooperative Target Tracking Based on Supervised Diffusion-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: In recent years, advances in underwater networking and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) have significantly expanded multi-autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) applications in marine exploration and target tracking. However, current MARL-driven cooperative tracking faces three critical challenges: 1) non-stationarity in decentralized coordination, where local policy updates destabilize teammates' observation spaces, preventing convergence; 2) sparse-reward exploration inefficiency from limited underwater visibility and constrained sensor ranges, causing high-variance learning; and 3) water disturbance fragility combined with handcrafted reward dependency that degrades real-world robustness under unmodeled hydrodynamic conditions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hierarchical MARL architecture comprising four layers: global training scheduling, multi-agent coordination, local decision-making, and real-time execution. This architecture optimizes task allocation and inter-AUV coordination through hierarchical decomposition.
