Building on this foundation, we propose the Supervised Diffusion-Aided MARL (SDA-MARL) algorithm featuring three innovations: 1) a dual-decision architecture with segregated experience pools mitigating nonstationarity through structured experience replay; 2) a supervised learning mechanism guiding the diffusion model's reverse denoising process to generate high-fidelity training samples that accelerate convergence; and 3) disturbance-robust policy learning incorporating behavioral cloning loss to guide the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient network update using high-quality replay actions, eliminating handcrafted reward dependency. The tracking algorithm based on SDA-MARL proposed in this paper achieves superior precision compared to state-of-the-art methods in comprehensive underwater simulations.
summary_zh: 近年来，水下网络与多智能体强化学习（MARL）的进展显著拓展了多自主水下航行器（AUV）在海洋探索与目标追踪领域的应用。然而，当前基于MARL的协同追踪面临三大关键挑战：1）去中心化协调中的非平稳性问题，即局部策略更新导致队友观测空间失稳，阻碍收敛；2）受限于水下能见度与传感器范围，稀疏奖励探索效率低下，引发高方差学习；3）水流扰动敏感性与人工设计奖励依赖并存，导致在未建模水动力条件下实际应用的鲁棒性下降。针对这些挑战，本文提出一种包含全局训练调度、多智能体协调、局部决策与实时执行四层结构的层级化MARL框架。该框架通过层级分解优化任务分配与AUV间协同。在此基础上，我们提出监督扩散辅助多智能体强化学习（SDA-MARL）算法，其具备三大创新点：1）采用双决策架构与分离经验池，通过结构化经验回放缓解非平稳性；2）引入监督学习机制引导扩散模型的反向去噪过程，生成高保真训练样本以加速收敛；3）融合行为克隆损失的扰动鲁棒策略学习，利用高质量回放动作指导深度确定性策略梯度网络更新，消除人工设计奖励依赖。本文提出的基于SDA-MARL的追踪算法在综合水下仿真实验中，相比现有先进方法实现了更优的追踪精度。
tldr: The paper proposes a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture with a supervised diffusion model for multi-AUV cooperative target tracking, addressing challenges in non-stationarity, exploration efficiency, and robustness in underwater environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于监督扩散模型的分层多智能体强化学习架构，用于多自主水下航行器（AUV）协同目标跟踪，旨在解决水下环境中的非平稳性、探索效率低下和鲁棒性问题。

title: Sampling-Horizon Neural Operator Predictors for Nonlinear Control under Delayed Inputs
summary: Modern control systems frequently operate under input delays and sampled state measurements. A common delay-compensation strategy is predictor feedback; however, practical implementations require solving an implicit ODE online, resulting in intractable computational cost. Moreover, predictor formulations typically assume continuously available state measurements, whereas in practice measurements may be sampled, irregular, or temporarily missing due to hardware faults. In this work, we develop two neural-operator predictor-feedback designs for nonlinear systems with delayed inputs and sampled measurements. In the first design, we introduce a sampling-horizon prediction operator that maps the current measurement and input history to the predicted state trajectory over the next sampling interval. In the second design, the neural operator approximates only the delay-compensating predictor, which is then composed with the closed-loop flow between measurements. The first approach requires uniform sampling but yields residual bounds that scale directly with the operator approximation error. In contrast, the second accommodates non-uniform, but bounded sampling schedules at the cost of amplified approximation error, revealing a practical tradeoff between sampling flexibility and approximation sensitivity for the control engineer. For both schemes, we establish semi-global practical stability with explicit neural operator error-dependent bounds. Numerical experiments on a 6-link nonlinear robotic manipulator demonstrate accurate tracking and substantial computational speedup of 25$\times$ over a baseline approach.
summary_zh: 现代控制系统常需在输入延迟和采样状态测量条件下运行。一种常见的延迟补偿策略是预测器反馈；然而，实际应用需要在线求解隐式常微分方程，导致计算成本难以承受。此外，预测器设计通常假设状态测量值可连续获取，而实际应用中，测量值可能因硬件故障而呈现采样化、非均匀或暂时缺失的特点。本研究针对具有延迟输入和采样测量的非线性系统，提出了两种神经算子预测器反馈设计方案。第一种设计中，我们引入一种采样区间预测算子，该算子将当前测量值和输入历史映射到下一采样间隔内的预测状态轨迹。第二种设计中，神经算子仅近似延迟补偿预测器，再与测量间隔内的闭环流组合。第一种方法需要均匀采样，但产生的残差边界直接与算子近似误差成比例缩放。相比之下，第二种方法能适应非均匀但有界的采样方案，但代价是放大近似误差，这为控制工程师揭示了采样灵活性与近似敏感性之间的实践权衡。针对两种方案，我们建立了具有显式神经算子误差相关边界的半全局实际稳定性。在六连杆非线性机器人操纵器上的数值实验表明，相较于基准方法，所提方案实现了精确跟踪，并将计算速度提升了25倍。
tldr: This paper proposes two neural-operator-based predictor-feedback designs for nonlinear control systems with input delays and sampled state measurements, demonstrating application on a 6-link robotic manipulator for improved tracking and computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了两种基于神经算子的预测器-反馈设计，用于处理具有输入延迟和采样测量的非线性控制系统，并在一个6连杆非线性机器人操纵器上进行了验证，展示了精确的跟踪性能和显著的25倍计算加速。

title: Cognitive Friction: A Decision-Theoretic Framework for Bounded Deliberation in Tool-Using Agents
summary: Autonomous tool-using agents in networked environments must decide which information source to query and when to stop querying and act. Without principled bounds on information-acquisition costs, unconstrained agents exhibit systematic failure modes: excessive tool use under congestion, prolonged deliberation under time decay, and brittle behavior under ambiguous evidence. We propose the Triadic Cognitive Architecture (TCA), a decision-theoretic framework that formalizes these failure modes via cognitive friction. By combining nonlinear filtering, congestion-dependent cost dynamics, and HJB optimal stopping, TCA models deliberation as stochastic control over a joint belief-congestion state, explicitly pricing information by tool signal quality and live network load. TCA yields an HJB-inspired stopping boundary and a computable rollout-based approximation of belief-dependent value-of-information with a net-utility halting condition. We validate TCA in two controlled environments (EMDG and NSTG) designed to isolate stopping quality, action selection under congestion, and temporal urgency. TCA improves resource outcomes while reducing time-to-action without degrading accuracy, gaining 36 viability points in EMDG and 33 integrity points in NSTG over greedy baselines. Ablations show that selection and stopping must be optimized jointly, as stopping rules alone recover at most 4 viability points. Sensitivity sweeps over alpha, beta, and lambda_S yield stable accuracy and interpretable trade-offs, and a continuation-value sweep over eta values 0, 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 finds eta equal to zero is optimal under high temporal urgency. Finally, we demonstrate an illustrative instantiation around a black-box LLM on a memorisation-free corpus, where the same stopping principle executes using empirically computable uncertainty and value-of-information proxies.
summary_zh: 网络环境中的自主工具使用智能体必须决定何时查询何种信息源，以及何时停止查询并采取行动。若缺乏对信息获取成本的原则性约束，无限制的智能体会表现出系统性故障模式：在拥塞时过度使用工具、在时间衰减下过度延迟决策、在证据模糊时行为脆弱。我们提出三元认知架构（TCA），这是一种决策理论框架，通过认知摩擦概念形式化上述故障模式。TCA结合非线性滤波、拥塞依赖的成本动力学及HJB最优停止理论，将决策过程建模为对联合信念-拥塞状态的随机控制，并依据工具信号质量与实时网络负载显式地为信息定价。该架构导出了受HJB启发的停止边界，以及基于信仰依赖信息价值与净效用停止条件的可计算滚动近似方法。我们在两个受控环境（EMDG与NSTG）中验证TCA，这些环境专为分离停止质量、拥塞下的行动选择与时间紧迫性而设计。TCA在保持准确率的同时提升资源使用效率并缩短行动耗时，相比贪婪基线在EMDG中提升36个生存点数，在NSTG中提升33个完整点数。消融实验表明，选择与停止机制必须联合优化，仅优化停止规则最多只能恢复4个生存点数。对参数α、β与λ_S的敏感性扫描显示出稳定的准确性与可解释的权衡关系，而η值在0、0.1、0.3和0.5间的延续价值扫描表明，在高度时间紧迫性下η=0为最优解。最后，我们在无记忆语料库中围绕黑盒大语言模型展示了可操作的实例化方案，其中相同停止原则通过经验可计算的不确定性与信息价值代理指标实现执行。
tldr: This paper proposes a decision-theoretic framework, the Triadic Cognitive Architecture (TCA), to model and bound deliberation in tool-using agents, optimizing when to stop querying information sources and act. It validates the approach in controlled environments and shows a demonstration with an LLM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种决策理论框架——三元认知架构（TCA），用于建模和约束工具使用智能体的思考过程，优化其停止查询信息源并采取行动的时机，并在受控环境中进行了验证，还展示了与大型语言模型结合的实例。

title: Distributed Predictive Control Barrier Functions: Towards Scalable Safety Certification in Modular Multi-Agent Systems
summary: We consider safety-critical multi-agent systems with distributed control architectures and potentially varying network topologies. While learning-based distributed control enables scalability and high performance, a lack of formal safety guarantees in the face of unforeseen disturbances and unsafe network topology changes may lead to system failure. To address this challenge, we introduce structured control barrier functions (s-CBFs) as a multi-agent safety framework. The s-CBFs are augmented to a distributed predictive control barrier function (D-PCBF), a predictive, optimization-based safety layer that uses model predictions to guarantee recoverable safety at all times. The proposed approach enables a permissive yet formal plug-and-play protocol, allowing agents to join or leave the network while ensuring safety recovery if a change in network topology requires temporarily unsafe behavior. We validate the formulation through simulations and real-time experiments of a miniature race-car platoon.
summary_zh: 我们研究具有分布式控制架构及可能存在网络拓扑变化的安全关键型多智能体系统。尽管基于学习的分布式控制可实现可扩展性和高性能，但在面对不可预见的干扰及不安全的网络拓扑变化时，缺乏形式化的安全保证可能导致系统失效。为解决这一挑战，我们引入结构化控制屏障函数（s-CBF）作为多智能体安全框架。该s-CBF进一步拓展为分布式预测控制屏障函数（D-PCBF），这是一种基于优化预测的安全层，利用模型预测来始终保证系统具备可恢复的安全性。所提出的方法支持一种宽松且形式化的即插即用协议，允许智能体在网络中加入或退出，同时确保当网络拓扑变化需要暂时采取不安全行为时仍能恢复安全性。我们通过微型赛车队列的仿真与实时实验验证了该框架的有效性。
tldr: Proposes a novel, distributed predictive control barrier function (D-PCBF) framework to guarantee safety for multi-agent systems under changing network topologies, validated with a miniature race-car platoon.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的分布式预测控制屏障函数（D-PCBF）框架，以确保多智能体系统在动态网络拓扑下的安全性，并通过微型赛车编队实验验证。

title: Large Neighborhood Search for Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Path Finding with Precedence Constraints
summary: Many multi-robot applications require tasks to be completed efficiently and in the correct order, so that downstream operations can proceed at the right time. Multi-agent path finding with precedence constraints (MAPF-PC) is a well-studied framework for computing collision-free plans that satisfy ordering relations when task sequences are fixed in advance. In many applications, however, solution quality depends not only on how agents move, but also on which agent performs which task. This motivates the lifted problem of task assignment and path finding with precedence constraints (TAPF-PC), which extends MAPF-PC by jointly optimizing assignment, precedence satisfaction, and routing cost. To address the resulting coupled TAPF-PC search space, we develop a large neighborhood search approach that starts from a feasible MAPF-PC seed and iteratively improves it through reassignment-based neighborhood repair, restoring feasibility within each selected neighborhood. Experiments across multiple benchmark families and scaling regimes show that the best-performing configuration improves 89.1% of instances over fixed-assignment seed solutions, demonstrating that large neighborhood search effectively captures the gains from flexible reassignment under precedence constraints.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
许多多机器人应用要求任务按正确顺序高效完成，以确保下游操作能在适当时机进行。具有优先级约束的多智能体路径规划（MAPF-PC）是一个经过深入研究的框架，可在任务序列预先固定的情况下，计算满足顺序关系的无碰撞路径规划。然而，在众多应用中，解决方案的质量不仅取决于智能体的移动方式，还取决于由哪个智能体执行哪个任务。这促使我们提出具有优先级约束的任务分配与路径规划问题（TAPF-PC），该问题通过联合优化任务分配、优先级满足与路径成本，扩展了MAPF-PC框架。为应对由此产生的耦合TAPF-PC搜索空间，我们开发了一种大邻域搜索方法：该方法从可行的MAPF-PC初始解出发，通过基于重分配的邻域修复进行迭代优化，并在每个选定的邻域内恢复可行性。跨多个基准测试系列与不同规模场景的实验表明，最佳配置方案在89.1%的实例中优于固定分配的初始解，证明了大邻域搜索能有效捕捉优先级约束下灵活重分配带来的性能提升。
tldr: This paper proposes a large neighborhood search algorithm for the joint optimization of task assignment and collision-free path planning for multiple agents, subject to precedence constraints on task completion order.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种大规模邻域搜索算法，用于在任务完成顺序的优先级约束下，联合优化多智能体的任务分配和无碰撞路径规划。

title: Why That Robot? A Qualitative Analysis of Justification Strategies for Robot Color Selection Across Occupational Contexts
summary: As robots increasingly enter the workforce, human-robot interaction (HRI) must address how implicit social biases influence user preferences. This paper investigates how users rationalize their selections of robots varying in skin tone and anthropomorphic features across different occupations. By qualitatively analyzing 4,146 open-ended justifications from 1,038 participants, we map the reasoning frameworks driving robot color selection across four professional contexts. We developed and validated a comprehensive, multidimensional coding scheme via human--AI consensus ($κ= 0.73$). Our results demonstrate that while utilitarian \textit{Functionalism} is the dominant justification strategy (52\%), participants systematically adapted these practical rationales to align with established racial and occupational stereotypes. Furthermore, we reveal that bias frequently operates beneath conscious rationalization: exposure to racial stereotype primes significantly shifted participants' color choices, yet their spoken justifications remained masked by standard affective or task-related reasoning. We also found that demographic backgrounds significantly shape justification strategies, and that robot shape strongly modulates color interpretation. Specifically, as robots become highly anthropomorphic, users increasingly retreat from functional reasoning toward \textit{Machine-Centric} de-racialization. Through these empirical results, we provide actionable design implications to help reduce the perpetuation of societal biases in future workforce robots.
summary_zh: 随着机器人日益进入劳动力市场，人机交互（HRI）必须探讨隐性社会偏见如何影响用户偏好。本文研究了用户在不同职业场景中如何合理化其对不同肤色和拟人化特征机器人的选择。通过对来自1,038名参与者的4,146条开放式理由进行定性分析，我们绘制了在四种职业情境下驱动机器人颜色选择的推理框架。通过人机共识验证（$κ= 0.73$），我们开发并验证了一个多维度的综合编码体系。研究结果表明，尽管功利性功能主义是主导的合理化策略（52%），但参与者系统性地调整了这些实用主义理由，以迎合固有的种族和职业刻板印象。此外，我们发现偏见常在意识合理化之下运作：接触种族刻板印象提示会显著改变参与者的颜色选择，但其口头理由仍被标准的情感或任务相关推理所掩盖。我们还发现，人口背景显著影响合理化策略，且机器人形态强烈调节颜色解读。具体而言，当机器人高度拟人化时，用户逐渐从功能性推理转向以机器为中心的去种族化解释。通过这些实证结果，我们提出了可操作的设计建议，以帮助减少未来劳动力机器人对社会偏见的延续。
tldr: This HRI study analyzes how users rationalize robot skin tone choices across occupations, revealing that practical justifications often mask social biases influenced by stereotypes, demographics, and robot anthropomorphism, with implications for bias-aware robot design.
tldr_zh: 这项人机交互研究分析了用户在不同职业场景下对机器人肤色的选择理由，揭示了实用主义理由常掩盖受刻板印象、人口统计学和拟人化程度影响的社会偏见，并为减少未来工作机器人中的偏见提供了设计启示。

title: OccSim: Multi-kilometer Simulation with Long-horizon Occupancy World Models
summary: Data-driven autonomous driving simulation has long been constrained by its heavy reliance on pre-recorded driving logs or spatial priors, such as HD maps. This fundamental dependency severely limits scalability, restricting open-ended generation capabilities to the finite scale of existing collected datasets. To break this bottleneck, we present OccSim, the first occupancy world model-driven 3D simulator. OccSim obviates the requirement for continuous logs or HD maps; conditioned only on a single initial frame and a sequence of future ego-actions, it can stably generate over 3,000 continuous frames, enabling the continuous construction of large-scale 3D occupancy maps spanning over 4 kilometers for simulation. This represents an >80x improvement in stable generation length over previous state-of-the-art occupancy world models. OccSim is powered by two modules: W-DiT based static occupancy world model and the Layout Generator. W-DiT handles the ultra-long-horizon generation of static environments by explicitly introducing known rigid transformations in architecture design, while the Layout Generator populates the dynamic foreground with reactive agents based on the synthesized road topology. With these designs, OccSim can synthesize massive, diverse simulation streams. Extensive experiments demonstrate its downstream utility: data collected directly from OccSim can pre-train 4D semantic occupancy forecasting models to achieve up to 67% zero-shot performance on unseen data, outperforming previous asset-based simulator by 11%. When scaling the OccSim dataset to 5x the size, the zero-shot performance increases to about 74%, while the improvement over asset-based simulators expands to 22.1%.
summary_zh: 数据驱动的自动驾驶仿真长期受限于对预录驾驶日志或高精度地图等空间先验信息的严重依赖。这种根本性制约严重限制了其可扩展性，使得开放式生成能力被束缚在既有采集数据集的有限规模内。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出首个基于占用世界模型驱动的三维仿真器OccSim。该系统无需依赖连续日志或高精度地图，仅需给定单帧初始画面与未来自车动作序列，即可稳定生成超过3000帧连续画面，实现长达4公里的大规模三维占据地图持续构建。这标志着稳定生成长度相较先前最先进的占用世界模型实现了超过80倍的提升。OccSim由两大核心模块驱动：基于W-DiT的静态占据世界模型与布局生成器。W-DiT通过在架构设计中显式引入已知刚性变换，实现了静态环境的超长程生成；布局生成器则依据合成道路拓扑结构，在动态前景中生成具有反应能力的智能体。基于这些设计，OccSim能够合成海量多样的仿真数据流。大量实验验证了其下游应用价值：直接从OccSim采集的数据可预训练4D语义占据预测模型，在未见数据上实现高达67%的零样本性能表现，超越此前基于预设资产的仿真器11%。当OccSim数据集规模扩大至5倍时，零样本性能提升至约74%，相较于基于预设资产的仿真器优势扩大至22.1%。
tldr: The paper presents OccSim, a long-horizon occupancy world model for autonomous driving simulation that generates large-scale 3D scenes and reactive agents, enabling large-scale 4D semantic occupancy pre-training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自动驾驶仿真的长时占据世界模型OccSim，能够生成大规模3D场景和反应式智能体，用于预训练大规模4D语义占据预测模型。

title: Empirical Validation of the Classification-Verification Dichotomy for AI Safety Gates
summary:
Can classifier-based safety gates maintain reliable oversight as AI systems improve over hundreds of iterations? We provide comprehensive empirical evidence that they cannot. On a self-improving neural controller (d=240), eighteen classifier configurations -- spanning MLPs, SVMs, random forests, k-NN, Bayesian classifiers, and deep networks -- all fail the dual conditions for safe self-improvement. Three safe RL baselines (CPO, Lyapunov, safety shielding) also fail. Results extend to MuJoCo benchmarks (Reacher-v4 d=496, Swimmer-v4 d=1408, HalfCheetah-v4 d=1824). At controlled distribution separations up to delta_s=2.0, all classifiers still fail -- including the NP-optimal test and MLPs with 100% training accuracy -- demonstrating structural impossibility.
  We then show the impossibility is specific to classification, not to safe self-improvement itself. A Lipschitz ball verifier achieves zero false accepts across dimensions d in {84, 240, 768, 2688, 5760, 9984, 17408} using provable analytical bounds (unconditional delta=0). Ball chaining enables unbounded parameter-space traversal: on MuJoCo Reacher-v4, 10 chains yield +4.31 reward improvement with delta=0; on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct during LoRA fine-tuning, 42 chain transitions traverse 234x the single-ball radius with zero safety violations across 200 steps. A 50-prompt oracle confirms oracle-agnosticity. Compositional per-group verification enables radii up to 37x larger than full-network balls. At d<=17408, delta=0 is unconditional; at LLM scale, conditional on estimated Lipschitz constants.
summary_zh:
随着人工智能系统经历数百次迭代改进，基于分类器的安全门控机制能否持续保持可靠监控？我们提供全面的实证证据表明这无法实现。在自改进神经控制器（d=240）实验中，涵盖多层感知机、支持向量机、随机森林、k近邻、贝叶斯分类器和深度网络在内的十八种分类器配置均未能满足安全自改进的双重条件。三种安全强化学习基线方法（CPO、李雅普诺夫、安全屏障）同样失效。该结果在MuJoCo基准测试中（Reacher-v4 d=496、Swimmer-v4 d=1408、HalfCheetah-v4 d=1824）得到进一步验证。在控制分布分离度高达δ_s=2.0的条件下，包括NP最优测试和训练准确率达100%的多层感知机在内的所有分类器依然失效，这证明了结构性不可行性。

随后我们证明这种不可行性仅针对分类方法，而非安全自改进本身。利普希茨球验证器通过可证明的解析边界（无条件δ=0），在维度d∈{84,240,768,2688,5760,9984,17408}范围内实现了零误接受率。球链式验证支持无限制参数空间遍历：在MuJoCo Reacher-v4环境中，10级验证链在δ=0条件下实现+4.31奖励提升；在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型的LoRA微调过程中，42级链式转移实现了单球半径234倍的跨越，且200步迭代全程零安全违规。50轮提示的预言机验证证实了该方法与预言机选择的无关性。组合式分组验证使得验证半径可达全网络球体的37倍。在维度d≤17408时δ=0具有无条件性；在大语言模型尺度下，该条件取决于估计的利普希茨常数。
tldr: The paper empirically demonstrates the failure of classifier-based safety gates in self-improving AI systems and proposes a Lipschitz ball verifier that achieves zero false accepts, enabling safe traversal of high-dimensional parameter spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文通过实证研究证明，在自改进AI系统中，基于分类器的安全门机制会失效，并提出一种利普希茨球验证器，能实现零误报，支持高维参数空间的安全遍历。

title: WorldFlow3D: Flowing Through 3D Distributions for Unbounded World Generation
summary: Unbounded 3D world generation is emerging as a foundational task for scene modeling in computer vision, graphics, and robotics. In this work, we present WorldFlow3D, a novel method capable of generating unbounded 3D worlds. Building upon a foundational property of flow matching - namely, defining a path of transport between two data distributions - we model 3D generation more generally as a problem of flowing through 3D data distributions, not limited to conditional denoising. We find that our latent-free flow approach generates causal and accurate 3D structure, and can use this as an intermediate distribution to guide the generation of more complex structure and high-quality texture - all while converging more rapidly than existing methods. We enable controllability over generated scenes with vectorized scene layout conditions for geometric structure control and visual texture control through scene attributes. We confirm the effectiveness of WorldFlow3D on both real outdoor driving scenes and synthetic indoor scenes, validating cross-domain generalizability and high-quality generation on real data distributions. We confirm favorable scene generation fidelity over approaches in all tested settings for unbounded scene generation. For more, see https://light.princeton.edu/worldflow3d.
summary_zh: 无边界三维世界生成正逐渐成为计算机视觉、图形学与机器人领域中场景建模的基础任务。本研究提出WorldFlow3D——一种能够生成无边界三维世界的新方法。基于流匹配的核心特性（即定义两个数据分布之间的传输路径），我们将三维生成更广义地建模为穿越三维数据分布的流动过程，而非局限于条件去噪范式。我们发现，这种无隐变量的流方法能够生成具有因果关联且结构精确的三维几何，并以此作为中间分布引导生成更复杂的结构和高品质纹理——其收敛速度亦超越现有方法。通过向量化场景布局条件实现几何结构控制，结合场景属性实现视觉纹理控制，我们赋予生成场景高度可控性。WorldFlow3D在真实户外驾驶场景与合成室内场景中均验证了有效性，证实了跨域泛化能力及在真实数据分布上的高质量生成性能。在无边界场景生成的所有测试场景中，本方法均展现出优于现有技术的场景生成保真度。更多内容详见https://light.princeton.edu/worldflow3d。
tldr: WorldFlow3D proposes a novel method for generating unbounded 3D worlds using a flow-based approach, which can be controlled by scene layout and attributes, enabling applications in robotics and scene modeling.
tldr_zh: WorldFlow3D提出了一种基于流的创新方法，用于生成无界3D世界，可通过场景布局和属性进行控制，适用于机器人学和场景建模。

title: Video Models Reason Early: Exploiting Plan Commitment for Maze Solving
summary: Video diffusion models exhibit emergent reasoning capabilities like solving mazes and puzzles, yet little is understood about how they reason during generation. We take a first step towards understanding this and study the internal planning dynamics of video models using 2D maze solving as a controlled testbed. Our investigations reveal two findings. Our first finding is early plan commitment: video diffusion models commit to a high-level motion plan within the first few denoising steps, after which further denoising alters visual details but not the underlying trajectory. Our second finding is that path length, not obstacle density, is the dominant predictor of maze difficulty, with a sharp failure threshold at 12 steps. This means video models can only reason over long mazes by chaining together multiple sequential generations. To demonstrate the practical benefits of our findings, we introduce Chaining with Early Planning, or ChEaP, which only spends compute on seeds with promising early plans and chains them together to tackle complex mazes. This improves accuracy from 7% to 67% on long-horizon mazes and by 2.5x overall on hard tasks in Frozen Lake and VR-Bench across Wan2.2-14B and HunyuanVideo-1.5. Our analysis reveals that current video models possess deeper reasoning capabilities than previously recognized, which can be elicited more reliably with better inference-time scaling.
summary_zh: 视频扩散模型展现出解决迷宫和谜题等涌现推理能力，但其在生成过程中的推理机制仍鲜为人知。我们以二维迷宫求解为受控测试平台，首次尝试解析其内部规划动态，并揭示了两项关键发现。第一项发现是早期规划确定：视频扩散模型在去噪过程的前几步即确定高层运动规划，后续去噪仅改变视觉细节而不会影响底层轨迹。第二项发现是路径长度（而非障碍物密度）是迷宫难度的主导预测因素，当步数达到12步时会出现明显的失败阈值。这意味着视频模型只能通过链接多个连续生成序列来推理长距离迷宫。为展示这些发现的实际应用价值，我们提出了"早期规划链接法"（ChEaP），该方法仅对有前景的早期规划种子进行计算资源分配，并将其链接以解决复杂迷宫。在长视野迷宫任务中，该方法将准确率从7%提升至67%；在Wan2.2-14B和HunyuanVideo-1.5模型上，对Frozen Lake和VR-Bench困难任务的整体性能提升达2.5倍。我们的分析表明，当前视频模型具备比既往认知更深的推理能力，通过优化推理时扩展策略可更可靠地激发这种能力。
tldr: The paper analyzes the internal planning dynamics of video diffusion models for maze solving, finding early plan commitment and a path length difficulty threshold. It proposes a method to chain promising early plans to solve complex mazes, improving accuracy on tasks like Frozen Lake and VR-Bench.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了视频扩散模型在迷宫求解中的内部规划动态，发现其具有早期计划承诺和路径长度难度阈值。它提出了一种方法，通过链接有前景的早期计划来解决复杂迷宫，提高了在Frozen Lake和VR-Bench等任务上的准确性。

title: Design and Aerodynamic Modeling of MetaMorpher: A Hybrid Rotary andFixed-Wing Morphing UAV
summary: In this paper, we present a generalized, comprehensive nonlinear mathematical model and conceptual design for the MetaMorpher, a metamorphic Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) designed to bridge the gap between vertical takeoff and landing agility and fixed-wing cruising efficiency. Building on the successful design of the spincopter platform, this work introduces a simplified mechanical architecture using lightweight materials and a novel wing-folding strategy. Unlike traditional rigid-body approximations, we derive a nonlinear flight dynamics model that enables arbitrary force distributions across a segmented wing structure. This modularity allows for testing different airfoils, mass distributions, and chord lengths in a single environment. As part of this work, various flight modes were specifically tested and analyzed in the Simulink environment. The results show that the model behaves predictably under different structural configurations, demonstrating its reliability as a tool for rapid design evaluation.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通用的、综合性的非线性数学模型及MetaMorpher变结构无人机的概念设计，该无人机旨在弥合垂直起降敏捷性与固定翼巡航效率之间的鸿沟。基于spincopter平台的成功设计，本研究引入了一种采用轻质材料的新型折叠翼策略与简化机械结构。不同于传统的刚体近似方法，我们推导出一种非线性飞行动力学模型，可实现分段式机翼结构上的任意力分布。这种模块化特性允许在单一环境中测试不同翼型、质量分布和翼弦长度。作为本研究的组成部分，我们在Simulink环境中对多种飞行模式进行了专门测试与分析。结果表明，该模型在不同结构配置下均表现出可预测的特性，证明了其作为快速设计评估工具的可靠性。
tldr: Presents a design and aerodynamic model for a morphing UAV capable of switching between rotary and fixed-wing flight modes, focusing on its mechanical architecture and nonlinear flight dynamics simulation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种能够在旋翼和固定翼模式间切换的变形无人机设计及其气动模型，重点关注其机械架构和非线性飞行动力学仿真。

title: Communication Outage-Resistant UUV State Estimation: A Variational History Distillation Approach
summary: The reliable operation of Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) clusters is highly dependent on continuous acoustic communication. However, this communication method is highly susceptible to intermittent interruptions. When communication outages occur, standard state estimators such as the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) will be forced to make open-loop predictions. If the environment contains unmodeled dynamic factors, such as unknown ocean currents, this estimation error will grow rapidly, which may eventually lead to mission failure. To address this critical issue, this paper proposes a Variational History Distillation (VHD) approach. VHD regards trajectory prediction as an approximate Bayesian reasoning process, which links a standard motion model based on physics with a pattern extracted directly from the past trajectory of the UUV. This is achieved by synthesizing ``virtual measurements'' distilled from historical trajectories. Recognizing that the reliability of extrapolated historical trends degrades over extended prediction horizons, an adaptive confidence mechanism is introduced. This mechanism allows the filter to gradually reduce the trust of virtual measurements as the communication outage time is extended. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations in a high-fidelity environment demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a 91\% reduction in prediction Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), reducing the error from approximately 170 m to 15 m during a 40-second communication outage. These results demonstrate that VHD can maintain robust state estimation performance even under complete communication loss.
summary_zh: 无人水下航行器（UUV）集群的可靠运行高度依赖于持续的声学通信。然而，这种通信方式极易受到间歇性中断的影响。当通信中断发生时，标准状态估计器（如无迹卡尔曼滤波器）将被迫进行开环预测。若环境中存在未建模的动态因素（如未知洋流），其估计误差将迅速增大，最终可能导致任务失败。针对这一关键问题，本文提出了一种变分历史蒸馏（VHD）方法。VHD将轨迹预测视为近似贝叶斯推理过程，通过合成从历史轨迹中提炼出的“虚拟测量值”，将基于物理的标准运动模型与从UUV历史轨迹中直接提取的模式相结合。考虑到外推历史趋势的可靠性会随预测时间延长而降低，本文引入了一种自适应置信机制，使滤波器能够随着通信中断时间的延长而逐步降低对虚拟测量值的信任度。在高保真环境下进行的大量蒙特卡洛仿真表明，该方法在40秒通信中断期间将预测均方根误差降低了91%，从约170米减少至15米。这些结果证明，VHD即使在完全通信中断的情况下仍能保持稳健的状态估计性能。
tldr: Proposes a Variational History Distillation (VHD) method for state estimation in UUV clusters during acoustic communication outages, using historical trajectory data to create virtual measurements and an adaptive confidence mechanism.
tldr_zh: 提出一种变分历史蒸馏方法，用于UUV集群在通信中断期间的状态估计，利用历史轨迹数据生成虚拟测量并引入自适应置信度机制。

title: Native-Domain Cross-Attention for Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration Under Large Initial Perturbations
summary: Accurate camera-LiDAR fusion relies on precise extrinsic calibration, which fundamentally depends on establishing reliable cross-modal correspondences under potentially large misalignments. Existing learning-based methods typically project LiDAR points into depth maps for feature fusion, which distorts 3D geometry and degrades performance when the extrinsic initialization is far from the ground truth. To address this issue, we propose an extrinsic-aware cross-attention framework that directly aligns image patches and LiDAR point groups in their native domains. The proposed attention mechanism explicitly injects extrinsic parameter hypotheses into the correspondence modeling process, enabling geometry-consistent cross-modal interaction without relying on projected 2D depth maps. Extensive experiments on the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and robustness. Under large extrinsic perturbations, our approach achieves accurate calibration in 88% of KITTI cases and 99% of nuScenes cases, substantially surpassing the second-best baseline. We have open sourced our code on https://github.com/gitouni/ProjFusion to benefit the community.
summary_zh: 精确的相机-激光雷达融合依赖于精确的外参标定，这本质上取决于在可能存在的较大位姿偏差下建立可靠的跨模态对应关系。现有的基于学习的方法通常将激光雷达点投影为深度图进行特征融合，这种方式会扭曲三维几何结构，并在外参初始值远离真实值的情况下导致性能下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种外参感知的交叉注意力框架，直接在图像块与激光雷达点群的原生域中进行对齐。该注意力机制显式地将外参假设注入到对应关系建模过程中，实现了无需依赖投影二维深度图的几何一致性跨模态交互。在KITTI和nuScenes基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在精度和鲁棒性上均优于现有最先进方法。在大幅度外参扰动下，我们的方法在KITTI数据集中达到88%、在nuScenes数据集中达到99%的准确标定率，显著超越次优基线方法。我们已在https://github.com/gitouni/ProjFusion开源代码以惠及研究社区。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for camera-LiDAR extrinsic calibration that uses a novel cross-attention mechanism in the native domains of each sensor, improving accuracy and robustness under large initial misalignments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种相机-LiDAR外参标定方法，采用新颖的跨注意力机制，在各自传感器的原生域中进行特征对齐，显著提高了在大初始扰动下的标定精度和鲁棒性。

title: Koopman Operator Framework for Modeling and Control of Off-Road Vehicle on Deformable Terrain
summary: This work presents a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven modeling framework for predictive control of autonomous off-road vehicles operating on deformable terrain. Traditional high-fidelity terramechanics models are often too computationally demanding to be directly used in control design. Modern Koopman operator methods can be used to represent the complex terramechanics and vehicle dynamics in a linear form. We develop a framework whereby a Koopman linear system can be constructed using data from simulations of a vehicle moving on deformable terrain. For vehicle simulations, the deformable-terrain terramechanics are modeled using Bekker-Wong theory, and the vehicle is represented as a simplified five-degree-of-freedom (5-DOF) system. The Koopman operators are identified from large simulation datasets for sandy loam and clay using a recursive subspace identification method, where Grassmannian distance is used to prioritize informative data segments during training. The advantage of this approach is that the Koopman operator learned from simulations can be updated with data from the physical system in a seamless manner, making this a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven approach. Prediction results demonstrate stable short-horizon accuracy and robustness under mild terrain-height variations. When embedded in a constrained MPC, the learned predictor enables stable closed-loop tracking of aggressive maneuvers while satisfying steering and torque limits.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种融合物理建模与数据驱动的混合建模框架，用于可变形地形上自主越野车辆的预测控制。传统高保真地面力学模型的计算复杂度通常过高，难以直接用于控制设计。现代Koopman算子方法能够将复杂的地面力学与车辆动力学以线性形式表达。我们开发了一种框架，可利用车辆在可变形地形上运动的仿真数据构建Koopman线性系统。在车辆仿真中，采用Bekker-Wong理论对可变形地形力学进行建模，并将车辆简化为五自由度系统。通过递归子空间辨识方法，分别从沙壤土和黏土的大规模仿真数据集中辨识Koopman算子，其中格拉斯曼距离被用于训练过程中优先选择信息量高的数据段。该方法的优势在于：基于仿真数据学习的Koopman算子可与物理系统采集的数据无缝融合更新，从而形成物理知识与数据驱动相结合的混合建模范式。预测结果表明，在轻度地形起伏条件下，该模型具有稳定的短期预测精度与鲁棒性。当嵌入约束模型预测控制器时，所学预测器能够在满足转向与扭矩限制的前提下，实现对激烈机动动作的稳定闭环轨迹跟踪。
tldr: A hybrid physics-informed data-driven framework using Koopman operators for modeling and predictive control of off-road vehicles on deformable terrain, validated via simulation and MPC.
tldr_zh: 一个基于库普曼算子的混合物理信息与数据驱动框架，用于非铺装路面上越野车辆的建模与预测控制，通过仿真和模型预测控制进行了验证。

title: C-TRAIL: A Commonsense World Framework for Trajectory Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Trajectory planning for autonomous driving increasingly leverages large language models (LLMs) for commonsense reasoning, yet LLM outputs are inherently unreliable, posing risks in safety-critical applications. We propose C-TRAIL, a framework built on a Commonsense World that couples LLM-derived commonsense with a trust mechanism to guide trajectory planning. C-TRAIL operates through a closed-loop Recall, Plan, and Update cycle: the Recall module queries an LLM for semantic relations and quantifies their reliability via a dual-trust mechanism; the Plan module injects trust-weighted commonsense into Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) through a Dirichlet trust policy; and the Update module adaptively refines trust scores and policy parameters from environmental feedback. Experiments on four simulated scenarios in Highway-env and two real-world levelXData datasets (highD, rounD) show that C-TRAIL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing ADE by 40.2%, FDE by 51.7%, and improving SR by 16.9 percentage points on average. The source code is available at https://github.com/ZhihongCui/CTRAIL.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶中的轨迹规划越来越多地利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行常识推理，然而LLM的输出本质上具有不可靠性，在安全关键应用中存在风险。我们提出C-TRAIL框架，该框架构建于常识世界模型之上，通过将LLM衍生的常识与信任机制相结合来指导轨迹规划。C-TRAIL通过闭环的“召回-规划-更新”循环运行：召回模块向LLM查询语义关系，并通过双重信任机制量化其可靠性；规划模块通过狄利克雷信任策略将加权信任的常识注入蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）；更新模块则根据环境反馈自适应调整信任分数与策略参数。在Highway-env的四个仿真场景及两个真实世界levelXData数据集（highD、rounD）上的实验表明，C-TRAIL持续优于现有先进基线方法，平均将ADE降低40.2%、FDE降低51.7%，同时将SR提升16.9个百分点。源代码已发布于https://github.com/ZhihongCui/CTRAIL。
tldr: A framework for autonomous driving trajectory planning that incorporates LLM-based commonsense reasoning with a trust mechanism to guide Monte Carlo Tree Search, improving safety and performance.
tldr_zh: 一个用于自动驾驶轨迹规划的框架，通过信任机制将基于大语言模型的常识推理融入蒙特卡洛树搜索，以提高安全性和性能。

title: Owl-AuraID 1.0: An Intelligent System for Autonomous Scientific Instrumentation and Scientific Data Analysis
summary: Scientific discovery increasingly depends on high-throughput characterization, yet automation is hindered by proprietary GUIs and the limited generalizability of existing API-based systems. We present Owl-AuraID, a software-hardware collaborative embodied agent system that adopts a GUI-native paradigm to operate instruments through the same interfaces as human experts. Its skill-centric framework integrates Type-1 (GUI operation) and Type-2 (data analysis) skills into end-to-end workflows, connecting physical sample handling with scientific interpretation. Owl-AuraID demonstrates broad coverage across ten categories of precision instruments and diverse workflows, including multimodal spectral analysis, microscopic imaging, and crystallographic analysis, supporting modalities such as FTIR, NMR, AFM, and TGA. Overall, Owl-AuraID provides a practical, extensible foundation for autonomous laboratories and illustrates a path toward evolving laboratory intelligence through reusable operational and analytical skills. The code are available at https://github.com/OpenOwlab/AuraID.
summary_zh: 科学发现日益依赖高通量表征，但自动化进程受限于专有图形用户界面及现有基于API系统的有限通用性。我们提出Owl-AuraID——一种软硬件协同的具身智能体系统，采用原生图形用户界面范式，通过与人机专家相同的交互界面操作仪器设备。该系统以技能为核心框架，将第一类（图形界面操作）与第二类（数据分析）技能整合至端到端工作流，实现物理样本处理与科学解读的全链路连接。Owl-AuraID在十类精密仪器及多样化工作流程中展现了广泛适用性，涵盖多模态光谱分析、显微成像与晶体学分析等技术路径，支持傅里叶变换红外光谱、核磁共振、原子力显微镜、热重分析等表征模式。总体而言，该系统为自主实验室提供了实用化、可扩展的基础架构，并通过可复用的操作技能与分析技能，揭示了实验室智能体的演进路径。项目代码已开源：https://github.com/OpenOwlab/AuraID。
tldr: Owl-AuraID is an embodied agent system that automates scientific instrumentation and data analysis by operating instrument GUIs, enabling end-to-end workflows for autonomous laboratories.
tldr_zh: Owl-AuraID是一个通过操作仪器GUI来自动化科学仪器操作和数据分析的具身智能体系统，为自主实验室提供端到端的工作流程支持。

title: MemFactory: Unified Inference & Training Framework for Agent Memory
summary: Memory-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs) are essential for developing capable, long-term AI agents. Recently, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize memory operations, such as extraction, updating, and retrieval, has emerged as a highly promising research direction. However, existing implementations remain highly fragmented and task-specific, lacking a unified infrastructure to streamline the integration, training, and evaluation of these complex pipelines. To address this gap, we present MemFactory, the first unified, highly modular training and inference framework specifically designed for memory-augmented agents. Inspired by the success of unified fine-tuning frameworks like LLaMA-Factory, MemFactory abstracts the memory lifecycle into atomic, plug-and-play components, enabling researchers to seamlessly construct custom memory agents via a "Lego-like" architecture. Furthermore, the framework natively integrates Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune internal memory management policies driven by multi-dimensional environmental rewards. MemFactory provides out-of-the-box support for recent cutting-edge paradigms, including Memory-R1, RMM, and MemAgent. We empirically validate MemFactory on the open-source MemAgent architecture using its publicly available training and evaluation data. Across the evaluation sets, MemFactory improves performance over the corresponding base models on average, with relative gains of up to 14.8%. By providing a standardized, extensible, and easy-to-use infrastructure, MemFactory significantly lowers the barrier to entry, paving the way for future innovations in memory-driven AI agents.
summary_zh: 记忆增强型大语言模型对于开发具备长期能力的智能体至关重要。近期，应用强化学习优化记忆操作——如提取、更新与检索——已成为极具前景的研究方向。然而，现有实现方案仍高度分散且任务特定化，缺乏统一的基础设施来简化这些复杂流程的集成、训练与评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MemFactory——首个专门为记忆增强型智能体设计的统一化、高度模块化的训练与推理框架。受LLaMA-Factory等统一微调框架成功的启发，MemFactory将记忆生命周期抽象为原子化、即插即用的组件，使研究人员能够通过“乐高式”架构无缝构建定制化记忆智能体。此外，该框架原生集成了分组相对策略优化算法，以基于多维环境奖励驱动的内部记忆管理策略进行微调。MemFactory为Memory-R1、RMM、MemAgent等前沿范式提供了开箱即用的支持。我们基于开源MemAgent架构及其公开训练评估数据对MemFactory进行了实证验证。在所有评估集中，MemFactory相较基础模型平均性能均有提升，相对增益最高达14.8%。通过提供标准化、可扩展且易于使用的基础设施，MemFactory显著降低了研究门槛，为记忆驱动型智能体的未来创新铺平了道路。
tldr: This paper introduces MemFactory, a unified framework for training and inference of memory-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs) for AI agents, abstracting memory operations into modular components and integrating reinforcement learning for policy optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MemFactory，一个用于记忆增强大型语言模型训练和推理的统一框架，它将记忆操作抽象为模块化组件，并集成强化学习来优化内部管理策略。

title: PSPA-Bench: A Personalized Benchmark for Smartphone GUI Agent
summary: Smartphone GUI agents execute tasks by operating directly on app interfaces, offering a path to broad capability without deep system integration. However, real-world smartphone use is highly personalized: users adopt diverse workflows and preferences, challenging agents to deliver customized assistance rather than generic solutions. Existing GUI agent benchmarks cannot adequately capture this personalization dimension due to sparse user-specific data and the lack of fine-grained evaluation metrics. To address this gap, we present PSPA-Bench, the benchmark dedicated to evaluating personalization in smartphone GUI agents. PSPA-Bench comprises over 12,855 personalized instructions aligned with real-world user behaviors across 10 representative daily-use scenarios and 22 mobile apps, and introduces a structure-aware process evaluation method that measures agents' personalized capabilities at a fine-grained level. Through PSPA-Bench, we benchmark 11 state-of-the-art GUI agents. Results reveal that current methods perform poorly under personalized settings, with even the strongest agent achieving limited success. Our analysis further highlights three directions for advancing personalized GUI agents: (1) reasoning-oriented models consistently outperform general LLMs, (2) perception remains a simple yet critical capability, and (3) reflection and long-term memory mechanisms are key to improving adaptation. Together, these findings establish PSPA-Bench as a foundation for systematic study and future progress in personalized GUI agents.
summary_zh: 智能手机GUI代理通过直接操作应用程序界面执行任务，为无需深度系统集成即可实现广泛能力提供了途径。然而，现实中的智能手机使用具有高度个性化特征：用户采用多样化的工作流程和偏好，这要求代理能够提供定制化协助而非通用解决方案。由于用户特定数据稀疏且缺乏细粒度评估指标，现有GUI代理基准测试无法充分捕捉个性化维度。为填补这一空白，我们提出了专门用于评估智能手机GUI代理个性化能力的基准测试PSPA-Bench。该基准涵盖10个典型日常使用场景和22个移动应用中超过12，855条符合真实用户行为的个性化指令，并引入结构感知的过程评估方法，在细粒度层面衡量代理的个性化能力。通过PSPA-Bench，我们对11个前沿GUI代理进行了系统性评估。结果表明，当前方法在个性化设置下表现不佳，即使最优代理的成功率也极为有限。我们的分析进一步揭示了提升个性化GUI代理能力的三个方向：（1）推理导向模型持续优于通用大语言模型；（2）感知能力仍是简单但关键的基础；（3）反思与长期记忆机制是提升适应性的核心要素。这些发现共同确立了PSPA-Bench作为个性化GUI代理系统性研究和未来发展的基础框架。
tldr: The paper introduces PSPA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating personalized smartphone GUI agents, assessing them across diverse user scenarios and workflows.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PSPA-Bench，一个用于评估个性化智能手机图形用户界面代理的基准测试，针对多样化的用户场景和工作流程进行评估。

title: Downsides of Smartness Across Edge-Cloud Continuum in Modern Industry
summary: The fast pace of modern AI is rapidly transforming traditional industrial systems into vast, intelligent and potentially unmanned autonomous operational environments driven by AI-based solutions. These solutions leverage various forms of machine learning, reinforcement learning, and generative AI. The introduction of such smart capabilities has pushed the envelope in multiple industrial domains, enabling predictive maintenance, optimized performance, and streamlined workflows. These solutions are often deployed across the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and supported by the Edge-Fog-Cloud computing continuum to enable urgent (i.e., real-time or near real-time) decision-making. Despite the current trend of aggressively adopting these smart industrial solutions to increase profit, quality, and efficiency, large-scale integration and deployment also bring serious hazards that if ignored can undermine the benefits of smart industries. These hazards include unforeseen interoperability side-effects and heightened vulnerability to cyber threats, particularly in environments operating with a plethora of heterogeneous IIoT systems. The goal of this study is to shed light on the potential consequences of industrial smartness, with a particular focus on security implications, including vulnerabilities, side effects, and cyber threats. We distinguish software-level downsides stemming from both traditional AI solutions and generative AI from those originating in the infrastructure layer, namely IIoT and the Edge-Cloud continuum. At each level, we investigate potential vulnerabilities, cyber threats, and unintended side effects. As industries continue to become smarter, understanding and addressing these downsides will be crucial to ensure secure and sustainable development of smart industrial systems.
summary_zh: 现代人工智能的快速发展正迅速将传统工业系统转变为由AI解决方案驱动的大规模、智能化、潜在无人化的自主操作环境。这些解决方案利用多种形式的机器学习、强化学习和生成式人工智能技术。智能能力的引入突破了多个工业领域的边界，实现了预测性维护、性能优化和工作流程的集约化。这些解决方案通常部署于工业物联网（IIoT）中，并依托边缘-雾-云计算连续体支撑，以实现紧急（即实时或近实时）决策。尽管当前业界积极采用这些智能工业解决方案以提升利润、质量和效率，但大规模集成与部署也带来了若被忽视可能削弱智能工业效益的严重风险。这些风险包括不可预见的互操作性副作用，以及日益增加的网络安全威胁风险，特别是在运行大量异构工业物联网系统的环境中尤为突出。本研究旨在阐明工业智能化可能带来的潜在后果，特别聚焦于安全影响，包括系统脆弱性、副作用及网络威胁。我们区分了源自传统AI解决方案与生成式AI的软件层面弊端，以及源自基础设施层（即工业物联网和边缘-云连续体）的弊端。在每个层面，我们深入探究了潜在的脆弱性、网络威胁和非预期副作用。随着工业智能化进程持续深入，理解并应对这些弊端对于确保智能工业系统的安全与可持续发展至关重要。
tldr: This paper surveys security vulnerabilities and unintended side effects in industrial AI systems deployed across the IIoT and Edge-Cloud continuum, focusing on issues arising from both traditional AI, generative AI, and the supporting infrastructure.
tldr_zh: 本文调查了在工业物联网和边缘-云连续体中部署的工业人工智能系统的安全漏洞和意外副作用，重点关注传统人工智能、生成式人工智能以及支持基础设施引发的问题。

title: APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay
summary:
LLM-based autonomous agents lack persistent procedural memory: they re-derive solutions from scratch even when structurally identical tasks have been solved before. We present \textbf{APEX-EM}, a non-parametric online learning framework that accumulates, retrieves, and reuses structured procedural plans without modifying model weights. APEX-EM introduces: (1) a \emph{structured experience representation} encoding the full procedural-episodic trace of each execution -- planning steps, artifacts, iteration history with error analysis, and quality scores; (2) a \emph{Plan-Retrieve-Generate-Iterate-Ingest} (PRGII) workflow with Task Verifiers providing multi-dimensional reward signals; and (3) a \emph{dual-outcome Experience Memory} with hybrid retrieval combining semantic search, structural signature matching, and plan DAG traversal -- enabling cross-domain transfer between tasks sharing no lexical overlap but analogous operational structure. Successful experiences serve as positive in-context examples; failures as negative examples with structured error annotations.
  We evaluate on BigCodeBench~\cite{zhuo2025bigcodebench}, KGQAGen-10k~\cite{zhang2025kgqagen}, and Humanity's Last Exam~\cite{phan2025hle} using Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5. On KGQAGen-10k, APEX-EM achieves 89.6\% accuracy versus 41.3\% without memory (+48.3pp), surpassing the oracle-retrieval upper bound (84.9\%). On BigCodeBench, it reaches 83.3\% SR from a 53.9\% baseline (+29.4pp), exceeding MemRL's~\cite{memrl2025} +11.0pp gain under comparable frozen-backbone conditions (noting backbone differences controlled for in our analysis). On HLE, entity graph retrieval reaches 48.0\% from 25.2\% (+22.8pp). Ablations show component value is task-dependent: rich judge feedback is negligible for code generation but critical for structured queries (+10.3pp), while binary-signal iteration partially compensates for weaker feedback.
summary_zh:
基于大语言模型的自主智能体缺乏持久性程序记忆：即使面对结构完全相同的任务，它们也需从头重新推导解决方案。我们提出\textbf{APEX-EM}——一种非参数化的在线学习框架，能够在不修改模型权重的前提下，实现对结构化程序化方案的积累、检索与复用。APEX-EM包含三大核心创新：（1）构建\textit{结构化经验表征}，完整编码每次执行的全过程轨迹——包括规划步骤、生成产物、迭代历史（含错误分析）及质量评分；（2）设计\textit{“计划-检索-生成-迭代-内化”}（PRGII）工作流，通过任务验证器提供多维度奖励信号；（3）建立\textit{双结果经验记忆库}，采用融合语义检索、结构特征匹配与计划有向图遍历的混合检索机制，实现对无词汇重叠但具有相似操作结构的跨领域任务迁移。成功经验作为正向上下文示例，失败案例则成为带有结构化错误标注的负向示例。

我们在BigCodeBench~\cite{zhuo2025bigcodebench}、KGQAGen-10k~\cite{zhang2025kgqagen}和Humanity's Last Exam~\cite{phan2025hle}三个基准上，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5和Opus 4.5模型进行评估。在KGQAGen-10k中，APEX-EM达到89.6\%的准确率，较无记忆机制的41.3\%提升48.3个百分点，超越最优检索理论上限84.9\%；在BigCodeBench中，其成功率从基准53.9\%提升至83.3\%（+29.4pp），在可比冻结主干条件下超过MemRL~\cite{memrl2025}的+11.0pp增益（需注意主干差异已在分析中控制）；在HLE任务中，实体图检索率从25.2\%提升至48.0\%（+22.8pp）。消融实验表明组件价值具有任务依赖性：丰富判据反馈对代码生成影响微弱，但对结构化查询至关重要（+10.3pp），而二元信号迭代可部分补偿弱反馈场景。
tldr: APEX-EM is a non-parametric online learning framework for LLM-based autonomous agents that builds a structured procedural memory of execution traces, enabling plan reuse and cross-domain transfer without weight updates.
tldr_zh: APEX-EM 是一个用于基于 LLM 的自主智能体的非参数化在线学习框架，通过构建结构化程序执行记忆，实现无需权重更新的计划重用和跨领域迁移。

title: OmniRoam: World Wandering via Long-Horizon Panoramic Video Generation
summary: Modeling scenes using video generation models has garnered growing research interest in recent years. However, most existing approaches rely on perspective video models that synthesize only limited observations of a scene, leading to issues of completeness and global consistency. We propose OmniRoam, a controllable panoramic video generation framework that exploits the rich per-frame scene coverage and inherent long-term spatial and temporal consistency of panoramic representation, enabling long-horizon scene wandering. Our framework begins with a preview stage, where a trajectory-controlled video generation model creates a quick overview of the scene from a given input image or video. Then, in the refine stage, this video is temporally extended and spatially upsampled to produce long-range, high-resolution videos, thus enabling high-fidelity world wandering. To train our model, we introduce two panoramic video datasets that incorporate both synthetic and real-world captured videos. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of visual quality, controllability, and long-term scene consistency, both qualitatively and quantitatively. We further showcase several extensions of this framework, including real-time video generation and 3D reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhengliu02/OmniRoam.
summary_zh: 近年来，利用视频生成模型进行场景建模的研究日益受到关注。然而，现有方法大多依赖透视视频模型，这些模型仅能合成场景的有限观察视角，导致完整性与全局一致性不足。我们提出OmniRoam——一个可控的全景视频生成框架，该框架充分利用全景表示所具备的逐帧场景覆盖广、内在时空连贯性强的特点，实现了长时程的场景漫游。我们的框架包含预览与优化两个阶段：在预览阶段，通过轨迹控制的视频生成模型从给定输入图像或视频中快速生成场景概览；在优化阶段，对该视频进行时间延伸与空间上采样，最终生成长时序、高分辨率的视频，从而支持高保真度的虚拟世界漫游。为训练模型，我们构建了两个包含合成与实拍视频的全景视频数据集。实验表明，无论是定性还是定量评估，我们的框架在视觉质量、可控性与长时场景一致性方面均优于现有先进方法。我们进一步展示了该框架的多种扩展应用，包括实时视频生成与三维重建。相关代码已开源：https://github.com/yuhengliu02/OmniRoam。
tldr: OmniRoam is a framework for generating long-horizon, high-resolution panoramic videos for scene wandering, emphasizing controllability, consistency, and visual quality.
tldr_zh: OmniRoam是一个用于生成可控、长视距、高分辨率全景视频的框架，用于场景漫游，强调可控性、一致性和视觉质量。

title: SkeletonContext: Skeleton-side Context Prompt Learning for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition aims to recognize unseen actions by transferring knowledge from seen categories through semantic descriptions. Most existing methods typically align skeleton features with textual embeddings within a shared latent space. However, the absence of contextual cues, such as objects involved in the action, introduces an inherent gap between skeleton and semantic representations, making it difficult to distinguish visually similar actions. To address this, we propose SkeletonContext, a prompt-based framework that enriches skeletal motion representations with language-driven contextual semantics. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-Modal Context Prompt Module, which leverages a pretrained language model to reconstruct masked contextual prompts under guidance derived from LLMs. This design effectively transfers linguistic context to the skeleton encoder for instance-level semantic grounding and improved cross-modal alignment. In addition, a Key-Part Decoupling Module is incorporated to decouple motion-relevant joint features, ensuring robust action understanding even in the absence of explicit object interactions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SkeletonContext achieves state-of-the-art performance under both conventional and generalized zero-shot settings, validating its effectiveness in reasoning about context and distinguishing fine-grained, visually similar actions.
summary_zh:
摘要：
零样本骨架行为识别旨在通过语义描述，将已见类别的知识迁移至未见行为以实现识别。现有方法大多将骨架特征与文本嵌入对齐至共享潜在空间。然而，由于缺乏动作相关的对象等上下文信息，骨架表征与语义表征之间存在固有鸿沟，导致难以区分视觉相似的行为。为此，我们提出SkeletonContext——一种基于提示的框架，通过语言驱动的上下文语义增强骨骼运动表征。具体而言，我们设计了一种跨模态上下文提示模块，利用预训练语言模型在大型语言模型生成的引导下重构被掩码的上下文提示。该设计将语言上下文有效传递至骨架编码器，实现实例级语义关联并提升跨模态对齐效果。此外，框架引入关键部位解耦模块，分离运动相关关节特征，确保即使在缺乏显式对象交互时仍能实现鲁棒的行为理解。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SkeletonContext在常规与广义零样本设定下均取得最优性能，验证了其在上下文推理与细粒度视觉相似行为区分方面的有效性。
tldr: Proposes SkeletonContext, a prompt-based framework that uses LLMs to enrich skeleton action recognition with contextual semantics for zero-shot learning.
tldr_zh: 提出了SkeletonContext，一个基于提示的框架，利用LLM为基于骨架的动作识别注入上下文语义，用于零样本学习。

title: Storing Less, Finding More: How Novelty Filtering Improves Cross-Modal Retrieval on Edge Cameras
summary: Always-on edge cameras generate continuous video streams where redundant frames degrade cross-modal retrieval by crowding correct results out of top-k search. This paper presents a streaming retrieval architecture: an on-device epsilon-net filter retains only semantically novel frames, building a denoised embedding index; a cross-modal adapter and cloud re-ranker compensate for the compact encoder's weak alignment. A single-pass streaming filter outperforms offline alternatives (k-means, farthest-point, uniform, random) across eight vision-language models (8M-632M) on two egocentric datasets (AEA, EPIC-KITCHENS). Combined, the architecture reaches 45.6% Hit@5 on held-out data using an 8M on-device encoder at an estimated 2.7 mW.
summary_zh: 常开式边缘摄像头产生连续视频流，其中冗余帧会挤占前k搜索的正确结果，从而降低跨模态检索性能。本文提出一种流式检索架构：设备端的epsilon-net滤波器仅保留语义新颖的帧，构建去噪嵌入索引；跨模态适配器与云端重排序器则补偿紧凑编码器的弱对齐能力。在两种第一视角数据集（AEA、EPIC-KITCHENS）上对八种视觉语言模型（8M-632M）的测试表明，单次流式滤波器性能优于离线替代方案（k-means、最远点采样、均匀采样、随机采样）。该架构整体通过仅8M参数的设备端编码器，在预估功耗2.7毫瓦的条件下，在保留数据集上实现了45.6%的Hit@5准确率。
tldr: A streaming architecture for edge cameras uses an on-device novelty filter to reduce redundant frames, improving cross-modal retrieval efficiency with a lightweight encoder and cloud re-ranker.
tldr_zh: 针对边缘摄像头，本文提出一种流式检索架构，通过设备端新颖性过滤器减少冗余帧，利用轻量编码器和云端重排序器提升跨模态检索效率。

title: SeGPruner: Semantic-Geometric Visual Token Pruner for 3D Question Answering
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely adopted for 3D question answering (3D QA). In typical pipelines, visual tokens extracted from multiple viewpoints are concatenated with language tokens and jointly processed by a large language model (LLM) for inference. However, aggregating multi-view observations inevitably introduces severe token redundancy, leading to an overly large visual token set that significantly hinders inference efficiency under constrained token budgets. Visual token pruning has emerged as a prevalent strategy to address this issue. Nevertheless, most existing pruners are primarily tailored to 2D inputs or rely on indirect geometric cues, which limits their ability to explicitly retain semantically critical objects and maintain sufficient spatial coverage for robust 3D reasoning. In this paper, we propose SeGPruner, a semantic-aware and geometry-guided token reduction framework for efficient 3D QA with multi-view images. Specifically, SeGPruner first preserves semantically salient tokens through an attention-based importance module (Saliency-aware Token Selector), ensuring that object-critical evidence is retained. It then complements these tokens with spatially diverse ones via a geometry-guided selector (Geometry-aware Token Diversifier), which jointly considers semantic relevance and 3D geometric distance. This cooperation between saliency preservation and geometry-guided diversification balances object-level evidence and global scene coverage under aggressive token reduction. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and OpenEQA demonstrate that SeGPruner substantially improves inference efficiency, reducing the visual token budget by 91% and inference latency by 86%, while maintaining competitive performance in 3D reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已被广泛应用于三维问答（3D QA）任务。在典型流程中，从多视角提取的视觉标记与语言标记拼接后，由大型语言模型（LLM）进行联合推理处理。然而，聚合多视角观察结果不可避免地会引入严重的标记冗余，导致视觉标记集规模过大，在受限的标记预算下显著影响推理效率。视觉标记剪枝已成为应对这一问题的常见策略。然而，现有剪枝方法大多仅针对二维输入设计或依赖间接几何线索，这限制了其显式保留语义关键对象及维持足够空间覆盖以实现稳健三维推理的能力。本文提出SeGPruner——一种语义感知与几何引导的标记约简框架，用于多视角图像的高效三维问答。具体而言，SeGPruner首先通过基于注意力机制的显著性模块（显著性感知标记选择器）保留语义突出的标记，确保对象关键证据得以留存；随后通过几何引导选择器（几何感知标记多样化器）补充具有空间多样性的标记，该模块综合考虑语义相关性与三维几何距离。在激进标记约简的背景下，这种显著性保持与几何引导多样化机制的协同作用，平衡了对象级证据与全局场景覆盖的需求。在ScanQA和OpenEQA数据集上的大量实验表明，SeGPruner能显著提升推理效率，将视觉标记预算减少91%，推理延迟降低86%，同时在三维推理任务中保持竞争优势。
tldr: The paper introduces SeGPruner, a semantic-geometric token pruning method for efficient 3D Question Answering with multi-view images, balancing object-level evidence and scene coverage to significantly reduce visual tokens and inference latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SeGPruner，一种用于多视图图像高效3D问答的语义-几何令牌剪枝方法，通过平衡对象级证据和场景覆盖，显著减少视觉令牌数量并降低推理延迟。

title: MotionScale: Reconstructing Appearance, Geometry, and Motion of Dynamic Scenes with Scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Realistic reconstruction of dynamic 4D scenes from monocular videos is essential for understanding the physical world. Despite recent progress in neural rendering, existing methods often struggle to recover accurate 3D geometry and temporally consistent motion in complex environments. To address these challenges, we propose MotionScale, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that scales efficiently to large scenes and extended sequences while maintaining high-fidelity structural and motion coherence. At the core of our approach is a scalable motion field parameterized by cluster-centric basis transformations that adaptively expand to capture diverse and evolving motion patterns. To ensure robust reconstruction over long durations, we introduce a progressive optimization strategy comprising two decoupled propagation stages: 1) A background extension stage that adapts to newly visible regions, refines camera poses, and explicitly models transient shadows; 2) A foreground propagation stage that enforces motion consistency through a specialized three-stage refinement process. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MotionScale significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both reconstruction quality and temporal stability. Project page: https://hrzhou2.github.io/motion-scale-web/.
summary_zh: 从单目视频中实现对动态4D场景的真实重建对于理解物理世界至关重要。尽管神经渲染领域近期取得进展，现有方法在复杂环境中仍难以恢复精确的3D几何结构并保持时间一致的运动轨迹。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MotionScale——一种基于4D高斯泼溅的框架，该框架能够高效扩展至大场景与长时序，同时保持高保真的结构与运动一致性。我们的方法核心在于通过聚类中心基变换参数化的可扩展运动场，该运动场能自适应扩展以捕捉多样且持续演化的运动模式。为确保长时程重建的鲁棒性，我们提出包含两个解耦传播阶段的渐进优化策略：1）背景扩展阶段：自适应处理新可见区域、优化相机位姿，并显式建模瞬态阴影；2）前景传播阶段：通过专门设计的三阶段精炼流程强化运动一致性。在具有挑战性的真实场景基准测试中，大量实验表明MotionScale在重建质量和时序稳定性方面均显著优于现有先进方法。项目页面：https://hrzhou2.github.io/motion-scale-web/.
tldr: A novel 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-fidelity, temporally consistent reconstruction of dynamic scenes from monocular video, featuring a scalable motion field and progressive optimization.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的4D高斯泼溅框架，用于从单目视频中对动态场景进行高保真、时间一致性的重建，其特点是可扩展的运动场和渐进式优化策略。

title: LightHarmony3D: Harmonizing Illumination and Shadows for Object Insertion in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity reconstruction of scene geometry and appearance. Building on this capability, inserting external mesh objects into reconstructed 3DGS scenes enables interactive editing and content augmentation for immersive applications such as AR/VR, virtual staging, and digital content creation. However, achieving physically consistent lighting and shadows for mesh insertion remains challenging, as it requires accurate scene illumination estimation and multi-view consistent rendering. To address this challenge, we present LightHarmony3D, a novel framework for illumination-consistent mesh insertion in 3DGS scenes. Central to our approach is our proposed generative module that predicts a full 360° HDR environment map at the insertion location via a single forward pass. By leveraging generative priors instead of iterative optimization, our method efficiently captures dominant scene illumination and enables physically grounded shading and shadows for inserted meshes while maintaining multi-view coherence. Furthermore, we introduce the first dedicated benchmark for mesh insertion in 3DGS, providing a standardized evaluation framework for assessing lighting consistency and photorealism. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world reconstruction datasets demonstrate that LightHarmony3D achieves state-of-the-art realism and multi-view consistency.
summary_zh: 三维高斯溅射（3DGS）能够实现场景几何与外观的高保真重建。基于此能力，将外部网格物体插入重建的3DGS场景中，可为AR/VR、虚拟布景和数字内容创作等沉浸式应用提供交互式编辑与内容增强功能。然而，在网格插入过程中实现物理一致的照明与阴影仍然面临挑战，因为这需要精确的场景光照估计和具备多视图一致性的渲染效果。为解决这一难题，我们提出了LightHarmony3D——一个用于在3DGS场景中实现光照一致性网格插入的创新框架。该方法的核心理念是我们提出的生成模块，该模块能够通过单次前向传播预测插入位置的完整360度高动态范围环境贴图。通过利用生成式先验而非迭代优化，我们的方法能够高效捕捉场景主导光照，为插入的网格提供物理真实的着色与阴影效果，同时保持多视角一致性。此外，我们首次提出了专用于3DGS网格插入的基准测试集，为评估光照一致性与照片真实感提供了标准化框架。在多个真实世界重建数据集上的大量实验表明，LightHarmony3D在真实感与多视角一致性方面均达到了当前最优水平。
tldr: A framework for inserting mesh objects into 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes with physically consistent lighting and shadows, using a generative module to predict HDR environment maps.
tldr_zh: 一种用于在3D高斯泼溅场景中插入网格物体并实现物理一致光照和阴影的框架，采用生成式模块预测HDR环境贴图。

title: Hierarchical Visual Relocalization with Nearest View Synthesis from Feature Gaussian Splatting
summary: Visual relocalization is a fundamental task in the field of 3D computer vision, estimating a camera's pose when it revisits a previously known scene. While point-based hierarchical relocalization methods have shown strong scalability and efficiency, they are often limited by sparse image observations and weak feature matching. In this work, we propose SplatHLoc, a novel hierarchical visual relocalization framework that uses Feature Gaussian Splatting as the scene representation. To address the sparsity of database images, we propose an adaptive viewpoint retrieval method that synthesizes virtual candidates with viewpoints more closely aligned with the query, thereby improving the accuracy of initial pose estimation. For feature matching, we observe that Gaussian-rendered features and those extracted directly from images exhibit different strengths across the two-stage matching process: the former performs better in the coarse stage, while the latter proves more effective in the fine stage. Therefore, we introduce a hybrid feature matching strategy, enabling more accurate and efficient pose estimation. Extensive experiments on both indoor and outdoor datasets show that SplatHLoc enhances the robustness of visual relocalization, setting a new state-of-the-art.
summary_zh: 视觉重定位是三维计算机视觉领域的一项基础任务，旨在估计相机重新访问已知场景时的位姿。尽管基于点的分层重定位方法展现出良好的可扩展性与效率，但其通常受限于稀疏的图像观测与薄弱的特征匹配能力。本研究提出SplatHLoc，一种基于特征高斯泼溅的新型分层视觉重定位框架。针对数据库图像稀疏性问题，我们提出自适应视角检索方法，通过合成与查询视角更接近的虚拟候选视角，从而提高初始位姿估计的准确性。在特征匹配方面，我们观察到高斯渲染特征与直接图像提取特征在两级匹配过程中具有不同优势：前者在粗匹配阶段表现更佳，而后者在精匹配阶段更为有效。为此，我们引入混合特征匹配策略，实现更精准高效的位姿估计。在室内外多个数据集上的大量实验表明，SplatHLoc显著提升了视觉重定位的鲁棒性，创造了新的性能标杆。
tldr: Proposes a novel hierarchical visual relocalization framework using Feature Gaussian Splatting, with adaptive viewpoint synthesis and hybrid feature matching to improve pose estimation accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的分层视觉重定位框架，使用特征高斯泼溅作为场景表示，通过自适应视角检索合成虚拟候选视图和混合特征匹配策略，提高了重定位的精度和鲁棒性。

title: Generating Humanless Environment Walkthroughs from Egocentric Walking Tour Videos
summary: Egocentric "walking tour" videos provide a rich source of image data to develop rich and diverse visual models of environments around the world. However, the significant presence of humans in frames of these videos due to crowds and eye-level camera perspectives mitigates their usefulness in environment modeling applications. We focus on addressing this challenge by developing a generative algorithm that can realistically remove (i.e., inpaint) humans and their associated shadow effects from walking tour videos. Key to our approach is the construction of a rich semi-synthetic dataset of video clip pairs to train this generative model. Each pair in the dataset consists of an environment-only background clip, and a composite clip of walking humans with simulated shadows overlaid on the background. We randomly sourced both foreground and background components from real egocentric walking tour videos around the world to maintain visual diversity. We then used this dataset to fine-tune the state-of-the-art Casper video diffusion model for object and effects inpainting, and demonstrate that the resulting model performs far better than Casper both qualitatively and quantitatively at removing humans from walking tour clips with significant human presence and complex backgrounds. Finally, we show that the resulting generated clips can be used to build successful 3D/4D models of urban locations.
summary_zh: 以自我中心视角拍摄的“步行导览”视频为开发全球环境多样化的视觉模型提供了丰富的图像数据源。然而，由于人群聚集及相机视角与眼睛平齐的特点，这些视频帧中存在大量人物影像，这限制了其在环境建模应用中的实用性。本研究通过开发一种生成式算法应对这一挑战，该算法能够以逼真方式移除（即修复）步行导览视频中的人物及其关联的阴影效果。我们方法的核心在于构建一个丰富的半合成视频片段对数据集，用于训练该生成模型。数据集中的每个片段对包含纯环境背景片段，以及将行走人物与模拟阴影叠加在背景上的合成片段。我们通过随机选取全球真实自我中心步行导览视频中的前景与背景元素，确保视觉多样性。随后利用该数据集对最先进的Casper视频扩散模型进行微调，专注于物体与效果修复，并证明所得到的模型在去除高密度人群及复杂背景步行导览片段中人物时，无论在定性还是定量评估上均显著优于原始Casper模型。最后，我们验证了生成的视频片段可成功用于构建城市区域的3D/4D模型。
tldr: This paper presents a generative model for inpainting humans and their shadows from egocentric walking tour videos to create human-free environment walkthroughs for 3D/4D modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生成模型，用于从第一人称步行视频中修复去除人物及其阴影，从而创建用于3D/4D建模的无人环境漫游视频。

title: Fisheye3R: Adapting Unified 3D Feed-Forward Foundation Models to Fisheye Lenses
summary: Feed-forward foundation models for multi-view 3-dimensional (3D) reconstruction have been trained on large-scale datasets of perspective images; when tested on wide field-of-view images, e.g., from a fisheye camera, their performance degrades. Their error arises from changes in spatial positions of pixels due to a non-linear projection model that maps 3D points onto the 2D image plane. While one may surmise that training on fisheye images would resolve this problem, there are far fewer fisheye images with ground truth than perspective images, which limit generalization. To enable inference on imagery exhibiting high radial distortion, we propose Fisheye3R, a novel adaptation framework that extends these multi-view 3D reconstruction foundation models to natively accommodate fisheye inputs without performance regression on perspective images. To address the scarcity of fisheye images and ground truth, we introduce flexible learning schemes that support self-supervised adaptation using only unlabeled perspective images and supervised adaptation without any fisheye training data. Extensive experiments across three foundation models, including VGGT, $π^3$, and MapAnything, demonstrate that our approach consistently improves camera pose, depth, point map, and field-of-view estimation on fisheye images.
summary_zh: 用于多视图三维重建的前馈基础模型已在透视图像的大规模数据集上进行训练；当应用于广角图像（如鱼眼相机拍摄的图像）时，其性能会下降。这种误差源于非线性投影模型（将三维点映射到二维图像平面）所导致的像素空间位置变化。尽管人们可能认为使用鱼眼图像进行训练可以解决此问题，但带有真实标注的鱼眼图像数量远少于透视图像，这限制了模型的泛化能力。为了实现对具有高径向畸变图像的推理，我们提出了一种名为Fisheye3R的新型适配框架，该框架扩展了这些多视图三维重建基础模型，使其能够原生支持鱼眼图像输入，同时在透视图像上不产生性能衰退。针对鱼眼图像及其真实标注稀缺的问题，我们引入了灵活的学习方案，支持仅使用无标注的透视图像进行自监督适配，以及无需任何鱼眼训练数据的监督式适配。通过对包括VGGT、$π^3$和MapAnything在内的三种基础模型进行大量实验，结果表明我们的方法能持续提升鱼眼图像在相机姿态、深度、点云图和视场角估计方面的性能。
tldr: A framework called Fisheye3R adapts 3D reconstruction foundation models to work with fisheye camera inputs, using novel learning schemes to overcome data scarcity.
tldr_zh: Fisheye3R框架将3D重建基础模型适配到鱼眼相机输入，利用新颖的学习方案克服数据稀缺问题。

title: Evolution Strategies for Deep RL pretraining
summary: Although Deep Reinforcement Learning has proven highly effective for complex decision-making problems, it demands significant computational resources and careful parameter adjustment in order to develop successful strategies. Evolution strategies offer a more straightforward, derivative-free approach that is less computationally costly and simpler to deploy. However, ES generally do not match the performance levels achieved by DRL, which calls into question their suitability for more demanding scenarios. This study examines the performance of ES and DRL across tasks of varying difficulty, including Flappy Bird, Breakout and Mujoco environments, as well as whether ES could be used for initial training to enhance DRL algorithms. The results indicate that ES do not consistently train faster than DRL. When used as a preliminary training step, they only provide benefits in less complex environments (Flappy Bird) and show minimal or no improvement in training efficiency or stability across different parameter settings when applied to more sophisticated tasks (Breakout and MuJoCo Walker).
summary_zh: 尽管深度强化学习在复杂决策问题中已展现出极高效率，但其成功策略的开发需要大量计算资源与精细的参数调整。相比之下，进化策略提供了一种更直接、无需梯度的解决方案，其计算成本更低且部署更为简便。然而，进化策略通常难以达到深度强化学习所能实现的性能水平，这使其在更高要求的场景中的适用性受到质疑。本研究通过在不同难度任务（包括Flappy Bird、Breakout和MuJoCo环境）中比较进化策略与深度强化学习的表现，并探讨了进化策略是否可用于初始训练以提升深度强化学习算法。结果显示，进化策略并未持续展现出比深度强化学习更快的训练速度。当将其作为预训练步骤时，仅在复杂度较低的环境（如Flappy Bird）中产生积极效果；而在更复杂的任务（如Breakout和MuJoCo Walker）中，即使在不同参数设置下，进化策略对训练效率或稳定性的提升也微乎其微甚至并无改善。
tldr: This paper compares Evolution Strategies and Deep Reinforcement Learning for training efficiency and investigates using ES as a pretraining step for DRL, but finds limited benefits in more complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本研究比较了进化策略和深度强化学习的训练效率，并探讨了将ES作为DRL预训练步骤的效果，但发现在更复杂的环境中收益有限。

title: Quality-Controlled Active Learning via Gaussian Processes for Robust Structure-Property Learning in Autonomous Microscopy
summary: Autonomous experimental systems are increasingly used in materials research to accelerate scientific discovery, but their performance is often limited by low-quality, noisy data. This issue is especially problematic in data-intensive structure-property learning tasks such as Image-to-Spectrum (Im2Spec) and Spectrum-to-Image (Spec2Im) translations, where standard active learning strategies can mistakenly prioritize poor-quality measurements. We introduce a gated active learning framework that combines curiosity-driven sampling with a physics-informed quality control filter based on the Simple Harmonic Oscillator model fits, allowing the system to automatically exclude low-fidelity data during acquisition. Evaluations on a pre-acquired dataset of band-excitation piezoresponse spectroscopy (BEPS) data from PbTiO3 thin films with spatially localized noise show that the proposed method outperforms random sampling, standard active learning, and multitask learning strategies. The gated approach enhances both Im2Spec and Spec2Im by handling noise during training and acquisition, leading to more reliable forward and inverse predictions. In contrast, standard active learners often misinterpret noise as uncertainty and end up acquiring bad samples that hurt performance. Given its promising applicability, we further deployed the framework in real-time experiments on BiFeO3 thin films, demonstrating its effectiveness in real autonomous microscopy experiments. Overall, this work supports a shift toward hybrid autonomy in self-driving labs, where physics-informed quality assessment and active decision-making work hand-in-hand for more reliable discovery.
summary_zh: 自主实验系统在材料研究中正日益普及以加速科学发现，但其性能常受限于低质量、高噪声的数据。这一问题在数据密集型结构-性能学习任务中尤为突出，例如图像到光谱（Im2Spec）与光谱到图像（Spec2Im）的转换任务，传统的主动学习策略可能错误地优先选择低质量测量数据。本文提出一种门控主动学习框架，该框架将好奇心驱动的采样与基于简谐振荡器模型拟合的物理信息质量控制过滤器相结合，使系统能够在数据采集过程中自动排除低可信度数据。通过对预先采集的、含空间局部噪声的钛酸铅薄膜带激励压电响应光谱（BEPS）数据集的评估表明，所提方法优于随机采样、标准主动学习及多任务学习策略。门控方法通过在训练和采集阶段处理噪声，增强了Im2Spec和Spec2Im的可靠性，实现了更可靠的正向与逆向预测。相比之下，标准主动学习器常将噪声误判为不确定性，最终采集损害性能的劣质样本。鉴于其良好的应用前景，我们进一步将该框架部署于铁酸铋薄膜的实时实验中，验证了其在真实自主显微镜实验中的有效性。总体而言，这项工作推动了自驱动实验室向混合自主模式的转变，其中物理信息质量评估与主动决策协同工作，以实现更可靠的科学发现。
tldr: This paper introduces a gated active learning framework for autonomous microscopy that combines curiosity-driven sampling with physics-informed quality control to improve data acquisition and reliability in materials science experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文为自主显微学提出了一种门控主动学习框架，将好奇心驱动采样与基于物理的质量控制相结合，以提升材料科学实验中的数据采集效率和可靠性。

title: Optimistic Online LQR via Intrinsic Rewards
summary: Optimism in the face of uncertainty is a popular approach to balance exploration and exploitation in reinforcement learning. Here, we consider the online linear quadratic regulator (LQR) problem, i.e., to learn the LQR corresponding to an unknown linear dynamical system by adapting the control policy online based on closed-loop data collected during operation. In this work, we propose Intrinsic Rewards LQR (IR-LQR), an optimistic online LQR algorithm that applies the idea of intrinsic rewards originating from reinforcement learning and the concept of variance regularization to promote uncertainty-driven exploration. IR-LQR retains the structure of a standard LQR synthesis problem by only modifying the cost function, resulting in an intuitively pleasing, simple, computationally cheap, and efficient algorithm. This is in contrast to existing optimistic online LQR formulations that rely on more complicated iterative search algorithms or solve computationally demanding optimization problems. We show that IR-LQR achieves the optimal worst-case regret rate of $\sqrt{T}$, and compare it to various state-of-the-art online LQR algorithms via numerical experiments carried out on an aircraft pitch angle control and an unmanned aerial vehicle example.
summary_zh: 摘要：面对不确定性时保持乐观是强化学习中平衡探索与利用的常用策略。本文针对在线线性二次调节器（LQR）问题，即通过在线运行期间收集的闭环数据自适应调整控制策略，以学习对应未知线性动态系统的LQR控制器。我们提出了一种基于内在奖励的LQR算法（IR-LQR），该算法融合了强化学习中的内在奖励思想与方差正则化概念，通过乐观估计驱动不确定性探索。IR-LQR通过仅修改成本函数而保持标准LQR综合问题的结构，形成了一种直观简明、计算轻量且高效的算法，这与现有依赖复杂迭代搜索算法或需解决高计算复杂度优化问题的乐观在线LQR方法形成鲜明对比。我们证明IR-LQR能够达到$\sqrt{T}$的最优最坏情况遗憾率，并通过在飞机俯仰角控制与无人机实例上的数值实验，将其与多种先进在线LQR算法进行了对比分析。
tldr: Proposes IR-LQR, an optimistic online LQR algorithm using intrinsic rewards for efficient exploration in unknown linear systems, achieving optimal regret.
tldr_zh: 提出IR-LQR，一种利用内在奖励的乐观在线LQR算法，用于在未知线性系统中进行高效探索，实现了最优遗憾率。

title: Gleanmer: A 6 mW SoC for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Occupancy Mapping
summary: High-fidelity 3D occupancy mapping is essential for many edge-based applications (such as AR/VR and autonomous navigation) but is limited by power constraints. We present Gleanmer, a system on chip (SoC) with an accelerator for GMMap, a 3D occupancy map using Gaussians. Through algorithm-hardware co-optimizations for direct computation and efficient reuse of these compact Gaussians, Gleanmer reduces construction and query energy by up to 63% and 81%, respectively. Approximate computation on Gaussians reduces accelerator area by 38%. Using 16nm CMOS, Gleanmer processes 640x480 images in real time beyond 88 fps during map construction and processes over 540K coordinates per second during map query. To our knowledge, Gleanmer is the first fabricated SoC to achieve real-time 3D occupancy mapping under 6 mW for edge-based applications.
summary_zh: 高保真3D占据建图对于许多边缘应用（如AR/VR与自主导航）至关重要，但常受限于功耗约束。本文提出Gleanmer——一种搭载GMMap加速器的片上系统（SoC），该地图采用高斯模型实现3D占据建图。通过针对紧凑高斯模型的直接计算与高效重用的算法-硬件协同优化，Gleanmer在建图与查询过程中的能耗分别降低最高达63%和81%。基于高斯模型的近似计算使加速器面积减少38%。采用16nm CMOS工艺的Gleanmer可在建图时以超过88帧/秒的速度实时处理640x480图像，并在查询时每秒处理超过54万个坐标点。据我们所知，Gleanmer是首款在6mW功耗下为边缘应用实现实时3D占据建图的已流片SoC。
tldr: This paper presents a low-power SoC for real-time 3D Gaussian occupancy mapping, targeting edge applications like AR/VR and autonomous navigation, with significant energy and area improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于实时3D高斯占用映射的低功耗SoC，针对AR/VR和自主导航等边缘应用，实现了显著的能源和面积优化。

title: AutoWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation with Self-Supervised World Models
summary: Multi-agent traffic simulation is central to developing and testing autonomous driving systems. Recent data-driven simulators have achieved promising results, but rely heavily on supervised learning from labeled trajectories or semantic annotations, making it costly to scale their performance. Meanwhile, large amounts of unlabeled sensor data can be collected at scale but remain largely unused by existing traffic simulation frameworks. This raises a key question: How can a method harness unlabeled data to improve traffic simulation performance? In this work, we propose AutoWorld, a traffic simulation framework that employs a world model learned from unlabeled occupancy representations of LiDAR data. Given world model samples, AutoWorld constructs a coarse-to-fine predictive scene context as input to a multi-agent motion generation model. To promote sample diversity, AutoWorld uses a cascaded Determinantal Point Process framework to guide the sampling processes of both the world model and the motion model. Furthermore, we designed a motion-aware latent supervision objective that enhances AutoWorld's representation of scene dynamics. Experiments on the WOSAC benchmark show that AutoWorld ranks first on the leaderboard according to the primary Realism Meta Metric (RMM). We further show that simulation performance consistently improves with the inclusion of unlabeled LiDAR data, and study the efficacy of each component with ablations. Our method paves the way for scaling traffic simulation realism without additional labeling. Our project page contains additional visualizations and released code.
summary_zh: 多智能体交通仿真对于开发与测试自动驾驶系统至关重要。当前数据驱动的仿真器已取得显著成果，但高度依赖标注轨迹或语义标注的监督学习，导致性能提升成本高昂。与此同时，大量未标注的传感器数据虽可规模化采集，却鲜有被现有交通仿真框架有效利用。这引出一个核心问题：如何利用未标注数据提升交通仿真性能？本研究提出AutoWorld——一种基于未标注激光雷达占据表征学习世界模型的交通仿真框架。通过世界模型采样，AutoWorld构建从粗到细的预测场景上下文，作为多智能体运动生成模型的输入。为提升样本多样性，框架采用级联式行列式点过程引导世界模型与运动模型的采样过程。此外，我们设计了运动感知隐监督目标，以增强AutoWorld对场景动态的表征能力。在WOSAC基准测试中的实验表明，AutoWorld在真实度元指标评估中位居榜首。进一步研究证实，引入未标注激光雷达数据能持续提升仿真性能，各模块有效性通过消融实验得到验证。本方法为无需额外标注即可提升交通仿真真实度开辟了新路径。项目页面包含更多可视化内容及开源代码。
tldr: AutoWorld is a multi-agent traffic simulation framework that uses a self-supervised world model trained on unlabeled LiDAR data to generate realistic traffic scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art realism on the WOSAC benchmark.
tldr_zh: AutoWorld 是一个多智能体交通仿真框架，它使用在未标记 LiDAR 数据上训练的自我监督世界模型来生成逼真的交通场景，在 WOSAC 基准测试中实现了最先进的真实感。

title: World2Rules: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Learning World-Governing Safety Rules for Aviation
summary: Many real-world safety-critical systems are governed by explicit rules that define unsafe world configurations and constrain agent interactions. In practice, these rules are complex and context-dependent, making manual specification incomplete and error-prone. Learning such rules from real-world multimodal data is further challenged by noise, inconsistency, and sparse failure cases. Neural models can extract structure from text and visual data but lack formal guarantees, while symbolic methods provide verifiability yet are brittle when applied directly to imperfect observations. We present World2Rules, a neuro-symbolic framework for learning world-governing safety rules from real-world multimodal aviation data. World2Rules learns from both nominal operational data and aviation crash and incident reports, treating neural models as proposal mechanisms for candidate symbolic facts and inductive logic programming as a verification layer. The framework employs hierarchical reflective reasoning, enforcing consistency across examples, subsets, and rules to filter unreliable evidence, aggregate only mutually consistent components, and prune unsupported hypotheses. This design limits error propagation from noisy neural extractions and yields compact, interpretable first-order logic rules that characterize unsafe world configurations. We evaluate World2Rules on real-world aviation safety data and show that it learns rules that achieve 23.6% higher F1 score than purely neural and 43.2% higher F1 score than single-pass neuro-symbolic baseline, while remaining suitable for safety-critical reasoning and formal analysis.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
许多现实世界中的安全关键系统受明确规则约束，这些规则定义了不安全的世界配置并限制智能体间的交互。实践中，这些规则往往复杂且依赖于上下文，导致人工制定规则既不完备也易出错。从现实世界的多模态数据中学习此类规则，还面临噪声、不一致性和稀疏故障案例的挑战。神经网络模型能从文本和视觉数据中提取结构，但缺乏形式化保证；而符号方法虽具备可验证性，却难以直接应用于不完美的观测数据。本文提出World2Rules，一种从现实世界多模态航空数据中学习世界安全规则的神经符号框架。该框架同时利用正常运营数据和航空事故及事件报告进行学习，将神经网络模型作为候选符号事实的生成机制，并以归纳逻辑编程作为验证层。该框架采用分层反射推理，通过在实例、子集和规则三个层面强制一致性，过滤不可靠证据，仅聚合相互一致的组件，并剔除无支持的假设。这一设计限制了噪声神经提取带来的误差传播，最终生成紧凑、可解释的一阶逻辑规则，用以描述不安全的世界配置。我们在真实航空安全数据上评估World2Rules，结果表明其学习到的规则相比纯神经方法在F1分数上提升23.6%，相比单次神经符号基线方法提升43.2%，同时仍适用于安全关键推理和形式化分析。
tldr: World2Rules is a neuro-symbolic framework that learns safety rules for aviation from multimodal data, using neural models to propose facts and logic programming to verify and combine them into interpretable, formally-analyzable rules.
tldr_zh: World2Rules 是一个神经-符号框架，用于从多模态航空数据中学习安全规则，它利用神经模型提出事实，再通过逻辑编程进行验证和组合，最终生成可解释、可形式化分析的安全规则。

title: Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Small UAS Separation Assurance under GPS Degradation and Spoofing
summary: We address robust separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) under GPS degradation and spoofing via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). In cooperative surveillance, each aircraft (or agent) broadcasts its GPS-derived position; when such position broadcasts are corrupted, the entire observed air traffic state becomes unreliable. We cast this state observation corruption as a zero-sum game between the agents and an adversary: with probability R, the adversary perturbs the observed state to maximally degrade each agent's safety performance.
