summary_zh: 近年来，多模态大模型在通用基准上持续取得进步。然而，在现实内容审核与对抗场景中，主流模型因细粒度视觉感知能力不足及长尾噪声建模不充分，仍普遍存在泛化能力下降与灾难性遗忘问题。本文以玄武VL-2B为案例，探讨如何将通用多模态模型发展为适用于内容生态系统的工业级基础模型。该模型采用紧凑的InternViT-300M + MLP + Qwen3 1.7B架构，在约20亿参数预算内平衡细粒度视觉感知、语言语义对齐与部署成本。为兼顾业务专业化与通用能力保留，我们构建了数据迭代筛选机制，通过预训练、中训练与后训练三阶段渐进式流程进行模型训练。消融实验与离线业务评估表明：玄武VL-2B在七项OpenCompass多模态评测中平均得分达67.90（InternVL 3.5 2B为64.27），在七项独立业务审核任务中平均召回率达94.38%，在对抗性OCR场景的违规文本检测上加权总体召回率达82.82%（优于Gemini-2.5-Pro的76.72%）。实验结果表明，在有限参数规模下，玄武VL-2B在业务对齐、视觉感知、通用能力保留与部署成本间实现了实用化平衡。
tldr: This paper presents Xuanwu VL-2B, a compact 2B-parameter vision-language model optimized for industrial content moderation and adversarial text-in-image scenarios, achieving a balance between specialized business performance, general multimodal capabilities, and deployment cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Xuanwu VL-2B，一个紧凑的20亿参数视觉语言模型，针对工业内容审核和对抗性文本图像场景进行了优化，在业务专业化、通用多模态能力保留和部署成本之间实现了平衡。

title: AEC-Bench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Agentic Systems in Architecture, Engineering, and Construction
summary: The AEC-Bench is a multimodal benchmark for evaluating agentic systems on real-world tasks in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) domain. The benchmark covers tasks requiring drawing understanding, cross-sheet reasoning, and construction project-level coordination. This report describes the benchmark motivation, dataset taxonomy, evaluation protocol, and baseline results across several domain-specific foundation model harnesses. We use AEC-Bench to identify consistent tools and harness design techniques that uniformly improve performance across foundation models in their own base harnesses, such as Claude Code and Codex. We openly release our benchmark dataset, agent harness, and evaluation code for full replicability at https://github.com/nomic-ai/aec-bench under an Apache 2 license.
summary_zh: AEC-Bench是一个用于评估建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域现实任务中智能体系统的多模态基准。该基准涵盖需要图纸理解、跨页推理与施工项目级协调的任务。本报告阐述了该基准的设计动机、数据集分类体系、评估协议，以及基于多个领域特定基础模型框架的基线结果。我们通过AEC-Bench识别出可提升基础模型在原生框架（如Claude Code和Codex）中性能的一致性工具与框架设计方法。我们以Apache 2许可协议在https://github.com/nomic-ai/aec-bench开源发布了基准数据集、智能体框架与评估代码，确保完全可复现性。
tldr: AEC-Bench is a multimodal benchmark for evaluating agentic systems on real-world tasks in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction domain, focusing on drawing understanding, cross-sheet reasoning, and project coordination.
tldr_zh: AEC-Bench是一个多模态基准，用于评估建筑、工程和施工领域中的现实世界任务上的智能体系统，重点关注图纸理解、跨页推理和项目协调。

title: Multi-Layered Memory Architectures for LLM Agents: An Experimental Evaluation of Long-Term Context Retention
summary: Long-horizon dialogue systems suffer from semanticdrift and unstable memory retention across extended sessions. This paper presents a Multi-Layer Memory Framework that decomposes dialogue history into working, episodic, and semantic layers with adaptive retrieval gating and retention regularization. The architecture controls cross-session drift while maintaining bounded context growth and computational efficiency. Experiments on LOCOMO, LOCCO, and LoCoMo show improved performance, achieving 46.85 Success Rate, 0.618 overall F1 with 0.594 multi-hop F1, and 56.90% six-period retention while reducing false memory rate to 5.1% and context usage to 58.40%. Results confirm enhanced long-term retention and reasoning stability under constrained context budgets.
summary_zh: 长程对话系统存在跨多轮会话的语义漂移和记忆保持不稳定问题。本文提出一种多层记忆框架，将对话历史解耦为工作记忆、情景记忆和语义记忆三层，并引入自适应检索门控与保留正则化机制。该架构在控制跨会话语义漂移的同时，实现了有界上下文增长与计算效率的平衡。在LOCOMO、LOCCO和LoCoMo数据集上的实验表明，该框架取得了显著性能提升：成功率46.85，总体F1值0.618（多跳推理F1值0.594），六周期记忆保持率56.90%，同时将错误记忆率降至5.1%，上下文使用率控制在58.40%。实验结果证实了在受限上下文预算下，该框架能有效增强长期记忆保持与推理稳定性。
tldr: This paper proposes a Multi-Layer Memory Framework for LLM agents to improve long-term context retention in dialogue systems, evaluated on dialogue benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于LLM智能体的多层记忆框架，旨在改善对话系统中的长期上下文保留能力，并在多个对话基准上进行了评估。

title: Developing Adaptive Context Compression Techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs) in Long-Running Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often experience performance degradation during long-running interactions due to increasing context length, memory saturation, and computational overhead. This paper presents an adaptive context compression framework that integrates importance-aware memory selection, coherence-sensitive filtering, and dynamic budget allocation to retain essential conversational information while controlling context growth. The approach is evaluated on LOCOMO, LOCCO, and LongBench benchmarks to assess answer quality, retrieval accuracy, coherence preservation, and efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent improvements in conversational stability and retrieval performance while reducing token usage and inference latency compared with existing memory and compression-based approaches. These findings indicate that adaptive context compression provides an effective balance between long-term memory preservation and computational efficiency in persistent LLM interactions
summary_zh:
摘要：
大规模语言模型在长时间运行交互中，常因上下文长度增加、内存饱和及计算开销上升而导致性能下降。本文提出一种自适应上下文压缩框架，该方法通过整合重要性感知记忆选择、连贯性敏感筛选和动态预算分配机制，在控制上下文增长的同时保留关键会话信息。研究在LOCOMO、LOCCO和LongBench基准测试中评估了答案质量、检索准确性、连贯性保持能力及运行效率。实验结果表明，与现有基于记忆和压缩的方法相比，所提方法在减少令牌使用量和降低推理延迟的同时，实现了会话稳定性和检索性能的持续提升。这些发现表明，在持久性大规模语言模型交互中，自适应上下文压缩能够在长期记忆保持与计算效率之间取得有效平衡。
tldr: Proposes an adaptive context compression framework for LLMs to maintain performance in long-running interactions by selectively retaining important information.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于大语言模型的适应性上下文压缩框架，通过在长交互中选择性地保留重要信息来维持模型性能。

title: IMPACT: Influence Modeling for Open-Set Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Open-set anomaly detection (OSAD) is an emerging paradigm designed to utilize limited labeled data from anomaly classes seen in training to identify both seen and unseen anomalies during testing. Current approaches rely on simple augmentation methods to generate pseudo anomalies that replicate unseen anomalies. Despite being promising in image data, these methods are found to be ineffective in time series data due to the failure to preserve its sequential nature, resulting in trivial or unrealistic anomaly patterns. They are further plagued when the training data is contaminated with unlabeled anomalies. This work introduces $\textbf{IMPACT}$, a novel framework that leverages $\underline{\textbf{i}}$nfluence $\underline{\textbf{m}}$odeling for o$\underline{\textbf{p}}$en-set time series $\underline{\textbf{a}}$nomaly dete$\underline{\textbf{ct}}$ion, to tackle these challenges. The key insight is to $\textbf{i)}$ learn an influence function that can accurately estimate the impact of individual training samples on the modeling, and then $\textbf{ii)}$ leverage these influence scores to generate semantically divergent yet realistic unseen anomalies for time series while repurposing high-influential samples as supervised anomalies for anomaly decontamination. Extensive experiments show that IMPACT significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, showing superior accuracy under varying OSAD settings and contamination rates.
summary_zh: 开放集异常检测（OSAD）是一种新兴范式，旨在利用训练中观察到的异常类有限标记数据，以识别测试过程中已见和未见的异常。现有方法依赖简单的数据增强技术生成模拟未见异常的伪异常样本。尽管这类方法在图像数据中表现良好，但由于无法保持时间序列数据固有的时序特性，其在时间序列数据中往往生成无效或不切实际的异常模式，导致检测效果不佳。当训练数据被未标记异常污染时，问题会进一步加剧。本文提出创新框架$\textbf{IMPACT}$，该框架基于$\underline{\textbf{i}}$影响力$\underline{\textbf{m}}$建模实现开放集时间序列$\underline{\textbf{a}}$异常检$\underline{\textbf{ct}}$测，以应对上述挑战。其核心思想在于：$\textbf{一)}$ 学习能够准确估计单个训练样本对模型影响的影响力函数；$\textbf{二)}$ 利用这些影响力分数生成语义差异显著且符合实际的时间序列未见异常，同时将高影响力样本转化为监督异常数据以进行异常净化。大量实验表明，IMPACT在不同开放集异常检测设置及污染率下均显著优于现有最优方法，展现出卓越的检测精度。
tldr: Proposes IMPACT, a framework for open-set anomaly detection in time series data, using influence modeling to generate realistic unseen anomalies and decontaminate training data.
tldr_zh: 提出IMPACT框架，用于时间序列数据的开放集异常检测，利用影响建模生成现实未见异常并净化训练数据。

title: Webscraper: Leverage Multimodal Large Language Models for Index-Content Web Scraping
summary: Modern web scraping struggles with dynamic, interactive websites that require more than static HTML parsing. Current methods are often brittle and require manual customization for each site. To address this, we introduce Webscraper, a framework designed to handle the challenges of modern, dynamic web applications. It leverages a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to autonomously navigate interactive interfaces, invoke specialized tools, and perform structured data extraction in environments where traditional scrapers are ineffective. Webscraper utilizes a structured five-stage prompting procedure and a set of custom-built tools to navigate and extract data from websites following the common ``index-and-content'' architecture. Our experiments, conducted on six news websites, demonstrate that the full Webscraper framework, equipped with both our guiding prompt and specialized tools, achieves a significant improvement in extraction accuracy over the baseline agent Anthropic's Computer Use. We also applied the framework to e-commerce platforms to validate its generalizability.
summary_zh: 现代网络爬虫技术在处理需要超越静态HTML解析的动态交互式网站时面临挑战。现有方法往往脆弱且需针对每个站点进行人工定制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Webscraper框架，专门用于应对现代动态网络应用中的挑战。该框架利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自主导航交互界面、调用专用工具，并在传统爬虫失效的环境中进行结构化数据提取。Webscraper采用结构化五步提示流程与一套定制化工具集，能够遵循常见的“索引-内容”架构对网站进行导航和数据提取。我们在六个新闻网站上进行的实验表明：配备引导提示和专用工具的完整Webscraper框架，其数据提取准确率较基准智能体Anthropic's Computer Use有显著提升。我们还将该框架应用于电子商务平台以验证其泛化能力。
tldr: Introduces Webscraper, a framework using Multimodal LLMs to navigate dynamic websites and extract structured data, improving upon traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 介绍了Webscraper，一种利用多模态大语言模型导航动态网站并提取结构化数据的框架，改进了传统方法。

title: Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification
summary: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) is a model that can effectively handle graph data tasks and has been successfully applied. However, for large-scale graph datasets, GCN still faces the challenge of high computational overhead, especially when the number of convolutional layers in the graph is large. Currently, there are many advanced methods that use various sampling techniques or graph coarsening techniques to alleviate the inconvenience caused during training. However, among these methods, some ignore the multi-granularity information in the graph structure, and the time complexity of some coarsening methods is still relatively high. In response to these issues, based on our previous work, in this paper, we propose a new framework called Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification. Specifically, this method first uses a multi-granularity granular-ball graph coarsening algorithm to coarsen the original graph to obtain many subgraphs. The time complexity of this stage is linear and much lower than that of the exiting graph coarsening methods. Then, subgraphs composed of these granular-balls are randomly sampled to form minibatches for training GCN. Our algorithm can adaptively and significantly reduce the scale of the original graph, thereby enhancing the training efficiency and scalability of GCN. Ultimately, the experimental results of node classification on multiple datasets demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper exhibits superior performance. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/1-141D/.
summary_zh: 图卷积网络（GCN）是一种能够有效处理图数据任务并已成功应用的模型。然而，对于大规模图数据集，GCN仍面临计算开销过高的挑战，尤其在图的卷积层数较多时尤为突出。目前已有多种先进方法通过采样技术或图粗化技术来缓解训练中的不便，但这些方法中，部分忽略了图结构中的多粒度信息，而部分粗化方法的时间复杂度仍然较高。针对这些问题，基于我们先前的工作，本文提出一种名为“高效可扩展的大规模图节点分类粒度球图粗化方法”的新框架。具体而言，该方法首先使用多粒度粒度球图粗化算法对原始图进行粗化，得到多个子图。此阶段的时间复杂度是线性的，远低于现有图粗化方法。随后，由这些粒度球构成的子图被随机采样，形成用于训练GCN的小批量。我们的算法能够自适应地显著缩减原始图规模，从而提升GCN的训练效率与可扩展性。最终，在多个数据集上的节点分类实验结果表明，本文所提方法展现出优越性能。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/1-141D/ 获取。
tldr: This paper proposes a granular-ball graph coarsening method for efficient and scalable training of Graph Convolutional Networks on large-scale graph node classification tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于粒球的大规模图节点分类方法，通过高效的多粒度图粗化来提高图卷积网络的训练效率和可扩展性。

title: Designing FSMs Specifications from Requirements with GPT 4.0
summary: Finite state machines (FSM) are executable formal specifications of reactive systems. These machines are designed based on systems' requirements. The requirements are often recorded in textual documents written in natural languages. FSMs play a crucial role in different phases of the model-driven system engineering (MDE). For example, they serve to automate testing activities. FSM quality is critical: the lower the quality of FSM, the higher the number of faults surviving the testing phase and the higher the risk of failure of the systems in production, which could lead to catastrophic scenarios. Therefore, this paper leverages recent advances in the domain of LLM to propose an LLM-based framework for designing FSMs from requirements. The framework also suggests an expert-centric approach based on FSM mutation and test generation for repairing the FSMs produced by LLMs. This paper also provides an experimental analysis and evaluation of LLM's capacities in performing the tasks presented in the framework and FSM repair via various methods. The paper presents experimental results with simulated data. These results and methods bring a new analysis and vision of LLMs that are useful for further development of machine learning technology and its applications to MDE.
summary_zh: 有限状态机（FSM）是反应式系统的可执行形式化规约，这些机器基于系统需求进行设计。需求通常记录在以自然语言编写的文本文档中。FSM在模型驱动系统工程（MDE）的不同阶段扮演着关键角色，例如用于自动化测试活动。FSM的质量至关重要：其质量越低，测试阶段遗留的缺陷就越多，系统在生产环境中的故障风险也越高，甚至可能引发灾难性场景。因此，本文借助大型语言模型（LLM）领域的最新进展，提出了一种基于LLM的框架，用于从需求自动设计FSM。该框架还提出了一种以专家为中心的方法，通过FSM变异与测试生成来修复LLM生成的FSM。本文通过实验分析和评估了LLM在执行框架内任务以及通过多种方法修复FSM方面的能力，并基于模拟数据展示了实验结果。这些结果与方法为LLM提供了新的分析与视角，有助于推动机器学习技术及其在MDE中应用的进一步发展。
tldr: The paper proposes a framework using LLMs to generate Finite State Machines (FSMs) from natural language requirements, with a subsequent expert-centric mutation and testing approach for repairing the generated FSMs, evaluated in a model-driven engineering context.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个利用LLM从自然语言需求生成有限状态机（FSM）的框架，并采用基于FSM变异和测试生成的专家中心方法进行修复，在模型驱动工程背景下进行了实验评估。

title: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems that translate natural language intent into executable scientific visualization (SciVis) tasks. Despite rapid progress, the community lacks a principled and reproducible benchmark for evaluating these emerging SciVis agents in realistic, multi-step analysis settings. We present SciVisAgentBench, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark for evaluating scientific data analysis and visualization agents. Our benchmark is grounded in a structured taxonomy spanning four dimensions: application domain, data type, complexity level, and visualization operation. It currently comprises 108 expert-crafted cases covering diverse SciVis scenarios. To enable reliable assessment, we introduce a multimodal outcome-centric evaluation pipeline that combines LLM-based judging with deterministic evaluators, including image-based metrics, code checkers, rule-based verifiers, and case-specific evaluators. We also conduct a validity study with 12 SciVis experts to examine the agreement between human and LLM judges. Using this framework, we evaluate representative SciVis agents and general-purpose coding agents to establish initial baselines and reveal capability gaps. SciVisAgentBench is designed as a living benchmark to support systematic comparison, diagnose failure modes, and drive progress in agentic SciVis. The benchmark is available at https://scivisagentbench.github.io/.
summary_zh: 近年来，大语言模型（LLM）的进展推动了代理系统的发展，这些系统能够将自然语言意图转化为可执行的科学可视化（SciVis）任务。尽管进展迅速，但目前研究界仍缺乏一个原则性、可复现的基准，用于在现实多步骤分析场景中评估这些新兴的SciVis代理。我们提出了SciVisAgentBench，这是一个用于评估科学数据分析和可视化代理的综合性、可扩展基准。该基准建立在结构化分类体系之上，涵盖四个维度：应用领域、数据类型、复杂度级别和可视化操作。当前版本包含108个由专家精心设计的案例，覆盖了多样化的SciVis场景。为实现可靠评估，我们引入了一种以多模态结果为核心的评估流程，结合了基于LLM的评判与确定性评估器，包括基于图像的指标、代码检查器、基于规则的验证器以及特定案例评估器。我们还通过12位SciVis专家进行了有效性研究，以检验人类评估者与LLM评估者之间的一致性。利用这一框架，我们对代表性SciVis代理及通用编程代理进行了评估，建立了初始性能基线并揭示了能力差距。SciVisAgentBench被设计为一个持续更新的基准，旨在支持系统化比较、诊断失败模式并推动代理式SciVis的发展。该基准可通过https://scivisagentbench.github.io/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents that perform scientific data analysis and visualization tasks, focusing on systematic assessment rather than robotics.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个用于评估执行科学数据分析和可视化任务的LLM智能体的基准，重点在于系统评估而非机器人应用。

title: "I Just Need GPT to Refine My Prompts": Rethinking Onboarding and Help-Seeking with Generative 3D Modeling Tools
summary: Learning to use feature-rich software is a persistent challenge, but generative AI tools promise to lower this barrier by replacing complex navigation with natural language prompts. We investigated how people approach prompt-based tools for 3D modeling in an observational study with 26 participants (14 casuals, 12 professionals). Consistent with earlier work, participants skipped tutorials and manuals, relying on trial and error. What differed in the generative AI context was how and why they sought support: the prompt box became the entry point for learning, collapsing onboarding into immediate action, while some casual users turned to external LLMs for prompts. Professionals used 3D expertise to refine iterations and critically evaluated outputs, often discarding models that did not meet their standards, whereas casual users settled for "good enough." We contribute empirical insights into how generative AI reshapes help-seeking, highlighting new practices of onboarding, recursive AI-for-AI support, and shifting expertise in interpreting outputs.
summary_zh: 掌握功能丰富的软件一直是一项挑战，然而生成式人工智能工具有望通过自然语言提示取代复杂的操作，从而降低这一门槛。我们通过一项包含26名参与者（14名普通用户、12名专业用户）的观察性研究，探究了人们如何运用基于提示的工具进行三维建模。与先前研究一致，参与者普遍跳过教程和手册，依赖试错法进行探索。在生成式AI环境中，不同之处在于他们寻求支持的方式和动机：提示框成为学习的入口点，将入门过程压缩为即时行动，部分普通用户甚至借助外部大语言模型生成提示。专业用户则运用三维专业知识优化迭代过程，并对输出结果进行严格评估，常会舍弃不符合标准的模型；而普通用户往往满足于“够用即可”。本文通过实证研究揭示了生成式AI如何重塑求助行为，重点关注了新的入门实践模式、递归式AI辅助AI的现象，以及输出结果解读中专业能力的动态转移。
tldr: This study investigates how users, both casual and professional, interact with generative AI tools for 3D modeling, focusing on prompt-based help-seeking, onboarding, and iterative refinement.
tldr_zh: 本研究调查了新手和专业人士如何使用生成式AI工具进行3D建模，重点关注基于提示的求助行为、入门学习以及迭代优化过程。

title: GISTBench: Evaluating LLM User Understanding via Evidence-Based Interest Verification
summary: We introduce GISTBench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models' (LLMs) ability to understand users from their interaction histories in recommendation systems. Unlike traditional RecSys benchmarks that focus on item prediction accuracy, our benchmark evaluates how well LLMs can extract and verify user interests from engagement data. We propose two novel metric families: Interest Groundedness (IG), decomposed into precision and recall components to separately penalize hallucinated interest categories and reward coverage, and Interest Specificity (IS), which assesses the distinctiveness of verified LLM-predicted user profiles. We release a synthetic dataset constructed on real user interactions on a global short-form video platform. Our dataset contains both implicit and explicit engagement signals and rich textual descriptions. We validate our dataset fidelity against user surveys, and evaluate eight open-weight LLMs spanning 7B to 120B parameters. Our findings reveal performance bottlenecks in current LLMs, particularly their limited ability to accurately count and attribute engagement signals across heterogeneous interaction types.
summary_zh: 我们推出GISTBench基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在推荐系统中基于用户交互历史理解用户的能力。与传统侧重于物品预测准确性的推荐系统基准不同，我们的基准测试重点评估大语言模型从交互数据中提取和验证用户兴趣的效果。我们提出两个新颖的指标体系：兴趣可信度（IG）——可分解为精确率和召回率两个维度，分别用于惩罚模型虚构的兴趣类别与奖励兴趣覆盖度；以及兴趣特异性（IS）——用于评估大语言模型生成用户画像的区分度。我们基于全球某短视频平台真实用户交互数据构建并开源了合成数据集，该数据集同时包含隐式和显式交互信号及丰富的文本描述。我们通过用户调查验证了数据集的真实性，并评估了参数规模从70亿到1200亿不等的八个开源大语言模型。研究发现揭示了当前大语言模型的性能瓶颈，尤其体现在准确统计和归因跨异构交互类型信号方面的能力不足。
tldr: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to understand and verify user interests from interaction histories in recommendation systems, introducing new metrics and a synthetic dataset.
tldr_zh: 一个用于评估大语言模型在推荐系统中从用户交互历史中理解和验证用户兴趣能力的基准，引入了新指标和合成数据集。

title: SemLoc: Structured Grounding of Free-Form LLM Reasoning for Fault Localization
summary:
Fault localization identifies program locations responsible for observed failures. Existing techniques rank suspicious code using syntactic spectra--signals derived from execution structure such as statement coverage, control-flow divergence, or dependency reachability. These signals collapse for semantic bugs, where failing and passing executions follow identical code paths and differ only in whether semantic intent is satisfied. Recent LLM-based approaches introduce semantic reasoning but produce stochastic, unverifiable outputs that cannot be systematically cross-referenced across tests or distinguish root causes from cascading effects.
  We present SemLoc, a fault localization framework based on structured semantic grounding. SemLoc converts free-form LLM reasoning into a closed intermediate representation that binds each inferred property to a typed program anchor, enabling runtime checking and attribution to program structure. It executes instrumented programs to construct a semantic violation spectrum--a constraint-by-test matrix--from which suspiciousness scores are derived analogously to coverage-based methods. A counterfactual verification step further prunes over-approximate constraints and isolates primary causal violations.
  We evaluate SemLoc on SemFault-250, a corpus of 250 Python programs with single semantic faults. SemLoc outperforms five coverage-, reduction-, and LLM-based baselines, achieving Top-1 accuracy of 42.8% and Top-3 of 68%, while reducing inspection to 7.6% of executable lines. Counterfactual verification provides an additional 12% accuracy gain and identifies primary causal semantic constraints.
summary_zh:
故障定位旨在识别导致观察到的程序失效的代码位置。现有技术通常基于语法谱对可疑代码进行排序——这些信号源自执行结构，如语句覆盖、控制流分歧或依赖可达性。然而，对于语义错误，这些信号会失效，因为失败和成功的执行路径完全相同，仅在是否满足语义意图上存在差异。近年来基于大语言模型的方法引入了语义推理，但其输出具有随机性和不可验证性，无法在测试间进行系统性交叉引用，也难以区分根本原因与连锁效应。

本文提出SemLoc，一种基于结构化语义锚定的故障定位框架。SemLoc将自由形式的大语言模型推理转换为封闭的中间表示形式，将每个推断出的属性与类型化的程序锚点绑定，从而实现运行时检查并与程序结构关联。该方法通过执行插桩程序构建语义违反谱（即基于测试的约束矩阵），并采用类似于基于覆盖度方法的原理计算可疑度评分。通过反事实验证步骤进一步筛选过度近似约束，并隔离主要的因果性语义违反。

我们在SemFault-250（包含250个单语义错误的Python程序语料库）上评估SemLoc。结果表明，相较于五种基于覆盖度、约简和大语言模型的基线方法，SemLoc表现出更优性能，其Top-1准确率达到42.8%，Top-3准确率达68%，同时将所需检查的可执行代码行数降至7.6%。反事实验证进一步带来12%的准确率提升，并能有效识别主要的因果性语义约束。
tldr: SemLoc is a framework for fault localization in software by grounding free-form LLM reasoning into a structured, verifiable intermediate representation, which it then uses to generate a semantic violation spectrum and score suspicious code. It introduces a novel method to handle semantic bugs where traditional syntactic methods fail, using counterfactual verification to improve accuracy.
tldr_zh: SemLoc 是一个用于软件故障定位的框架，通过将自由形式的LLM推理转化为结构化的、可验证的中间表示，然后生成语义违规谱并计算可疑代码分数。它提出了一种处理语义错误的新方法，传统语法方法在此类错误上失效，并通过反事实验证来提高准确性。

title: WybeCoder: Verified Imperative Code Generation
summary: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has advanced automatic code generation and formal theorem proving, yet software verification has not seen the same improvement. To address this gap, we propose WybeCoder, an agentic code verification framework that enables prove-as-you-generate development where code, invariants, and proofs co-evolve. It builds on a recent framework that combines automatic verification condition generation and SMT solvers with interactive proofs in Lean. To enable systematic evaluation, we translate two benchmarks for functional verification in Lean, Verina and Clever, to equivalent imperative code specifications. On complex algorithms such as Heapsort, we observe consistent performance improvements by scaling our approach, synthesizing dozens of valid invariants and dispatching of dozens of subgoals, resulting in hundreds of lines of verified code, overcoming plateaus reported in previous works. Our best system solves 74% of Verina tasks and 62% of Clever tasks at moderate compute budgets, significantly surpassing previous evaluations and paving a path to automated construction of large-scale datasets of verified imperative code.
summary_zh: 近年来，大语言模型（LLM）在自动代码生成和形式化定理证明领域取得了显著进展，但软件验证技术尚未实现同等水平的提升。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了WybeCoder——一个基于智能体的代码验证框架，实现了代码、不变量与证明协同演化的"边生成边验证"开发模式。该框架建立在近期研究成果之上，将自动验证条件生成、可满足性模理论求解器与Lean交互式证明系统相结合。为建立系统性评估体系，我们将功能验证领域的两个基准测试集Verina和Clever转化为等效的命令式代码规约。在堆排序等复杂算法验证中，我们通过扩展方法实现了持续的性能提升，合成了数十个有效不变量并解决了数十个子目标，最终生成数百行已验证代码，突破了以往研究中遇到的性能瓶颈。在适度计算资源下，我们最优系统以74%的完成率解决Verina任务，以62%的完成率攻克Clever任务，显著超越先前评估结果，为构建大规模已验证命令式代码数据集开辟了自动化路径。
tldr: WybeCoder is an agentic framework for generating and verifying imperative code using LLMs, enabling prove-as-you-generate development and significantly improving performance on benchmarks for functional verification of complex algorithms.
tldr_zh: WybeCoder是一个用于生成和验证命令式代码的智能体框架，利用LLM实现证明与代码同步生成，在复杂算法（如堆排序）的功能验证基准上显著提升了性能。

title: PAR$^2$-RAG: Planned Active Retrieval and Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain brittle on multi-hop question answering (MHQA), where answering requires combining evidence across documents through retrieval and reasoning. Iterative retrieval systems can fail by locking onto an early low-recall trajectory and amplifying downstream errors, while planning-only approaches may produce static query sets that cannot adapt when intermediate evidence changes. We propose \textbf{Planned Active Retrieval and Reasoning RAG (PAR$^2$-RAG)}, a two-stage framework that separates \emph{coverage} from \emph{commitment}. PAR$^2$-RAG first performs breadth-first anchoring to build a high-recall evidence frontier, then applies depth-first refinement with evidence sufficiency control in an iterative loop. Across four MHQA benchmarks, PAR$^2$-RAG consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, compared with IRCoT, PAR$^2$-RAG achieves up to \textbf{23.5\%} higher accuracy, with retrieval gains of up to \textbf{10.5\%} in NDCG.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型在多跳问答任务中仍显脆弱，因为此类任务需要通过对多篇文档的检索与推理进行证据整合。传统迭代检索系统容易因早期陷入低召回轨迹而放大后续错误，而纯规划方法生成的静态查询集难以适应中间证据的动态变化。本文提出\textbf{规划式主动检索与推理增强生成框架（PAR$^2$-RAG）}，该双层框架将\textit{覆盖范围}与\textit{决策执行}分离：首先通过广度优先锚定构建高召回证据边界，随后在迭代循环中采用深度优先优化策略，并辅以证据充分性控制机制。在四个多跳问答基准测试中，PAR$^2$-RAG始终优于现有先进基线模型，相较于IRCoT方法，其准确率最高提升\textbf{23.5\%}，检索效果在NDCG指标上实现\textbf{10.5\%}的增益。
tldr: This paper introduces PAR$^2$-RAG, a two-stage framework for multi-hop question answering that separates evidence coverage from commitment to improve retrieval and reasoning in LLMs, outperforming existing baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PAR$^2$-RAG框架，一种用于多跳问答的两阶段方法，通过分离证据覆盖与确认来改进大型语言模型中的检索和推理性能，在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。

title: CivicShield: A Cross-Domain Defense-in-Depth Framework for Securing Government-Facing AI Chatbots Against Multi-Turn Adversarial Attacks
summary: LLM-based chatbots in government services face critical security gaps. Multi-turn adversarial attacks achieve over 90% success against current defenses, and single-layer guardrails are bypassed with similar rates. We present CivicShield, a cross-domain defense-in-depth framework for government-facing AI chatbots. Drawing on network security, formal verification, biological immune systems, aviation safety, and zero-trust cryptography, CivicShield introduces seven defense layers: (1) zero-trust foundation with capability-based access control, (2) perimeter input validation, (3) semantic firewall with intent classification, (4) conversation state machine with safety invariants, (5) behavioral anomaly detection, (6) multi-model consensus verification, and (7) graduated human-in-the-loop escalation. We present a formal threat model covering 8 multi-turn attack families, map the framework to NIST SP 800-53 controls across 14 families, and evaluate using ablation analysis. Theoretical analysis shows layered defenses reduce attack probability by 1-2 orders of magnitude versus single-layer approaches. Simulation against 1,436 scenarios including HarmBench (416), JailbreakBench (200), and XSTest (450) achieves 72.9% combined detection [69.5-76.0% CI] with 2.9% effective false positive rate after graduated response, while maintaining 100% detection of multi-turn crescendo and slow-drift attacks. The honest drop on real benchmarks versus author-generated scenarios (71.2% vs 76.7% on HarmBench, 47.0% vs 70.0% on JailbreakBench) validates independent evaluation importance. CivicShield addresses an open gap at the intersection of AI safety, government compliance, and practical deployment.
summary_zh: 政府服务中基于大语言模型的聊天机器人面临严重的安全漏洞。针对现有防御措施，多轮对抗性攻击成功率超过90%，单层防护机制被绕过的比率也相似。我们提出CivicShield——一个面向政府AI聊天机器人的跨域深度防御框架。该框架借鉴网络安全、形式化验证、生物免疫系统、航空安全与零信任密码学理念，构建了七层防御体系：（1）基于能力访问控制的零信任基础层，（2）边界输入验证层，（3）意图分类语义防火墙层，（4）具备安全不变量的对话状态机层，（5）行为异常检测层，（6）多模型共识验证层，（7）渐进式人工介入升级机制。我们建立了涵盖8类多轮攻击的形式化威胁模型，将框架映射至NIST SP 800-53标准的14个控制族，并通过消融分析进行评估。理论分析表明，分层防御较单层方案可将攻击概率降低1-2个数量级。在包含HarmBench（416个）、JailbreakBench（200个）和XSTest（450个）在内的1,436个场景模拟测试中，该框架在实施渐进响应后达到72.9%的综合检测率[置信区间69.5-76.0%]，有效误报率仅为2.9%，同时对多轮递进式攻击与慢速漂移攻击保持100%检测率。在真实基准测试与作者生成场景的对比中（HarmBench：71.2% vs 76.7%；JailbreakBench：47.0% vs 70.0%），检测率的客观下降验证了独立评估的重要性。CivicShield填补了人工智能安全、政府合规与实践部署交叉领域的研究空白。
tldr: The paper presents CivicShield, a defense-in-depth framework for securing government-facing AI chatbots against multi-turn adversarial attacks, achieving a 72.9% combined detection rate.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CivicShield，一个用于保护面向政府的AI聊天机器人免受多轮对抗攻击的深度防御框架，综合检测率达到72.9%。

title: Trojan-Speak: Bypassing Constitutional Classifiers with No Jailbreak Tax via Adversarial Finetuning
summary: Fine-tuning APIs offered by major AI providers create new attack surfaces where adversaries can bypass safety measures through targeted fine-tuning. We introduce Trojan-Speak, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers. Our approach uses curriculum learning combined with GRPO-based hybrid reinforcement learning to teach models a communication protocol that evades LLM-based content classification. Crucially, while prior adversarial fine-tuning approaches report more than 25% capability degradation on reasoning benchmarks, Trojan-Speak incurs less than 5% degradation while achieving 99+% classifier evasion for models with 14B+ parameters. We demonstrate that fine-tuned models can provide detailed responses to expert-level CBRN (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear) queries from Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers bug-bounty program. Our findings reveal that LLM-based content classifiers alone are insufficient for preventing dangerous information disclosure when adversaries have fine-tuning access, and we show that activation-level probes can substantially improve robustness to such attacks.
summary_zh: 大型AI提供商提供的微调API创造了新的攻击面，攻击者可通过针对性微调绕过安全措施。我们提出特洛伊语音，这是一种对抗性微调方法，可绕过Anthropic的宪法分类器。该方法结合课程学习与基于GRPO的混合强化学习，使模型掌握一套能够规避基于LLM内容分类的通信协议。关键进展在于：以往对抗性微调方法在推理基准测试中通常导致超过25%的能力退化，而特洛伊语音在实现参数量14B+模型超过99%的分类器规避率的同时，仅造成不足5%的性能退化。我们验证了微调模型能够对Anthropic宪法分类器漏洞悬赏计划中的专业级CBRN（化学、生物、放射性与核）质询提供详尽回答。研究结果表明，当攻击者拥有微调权限时，仅依靠基于LLM的内容分类器不足以防止危险信息泄露，同时我们证明激活层探针能显著提升对此类攻击的防御鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces Trojan-Speak, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses large language model safety classifiers with minimal performance degradation, focusing on content safety and AI security.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Trojan-Speak，一种对抗性微调方法，能以最小的性能损失绕过大型语言模型的安全分类器，专注于内容安全和AI安全。

title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models systematically fail when a salient surface cue conflicts with an unstated feasibility constraint. We study this through a diagnose-measure-bridge-treat framework. Causal-behavioral analysis of the ``car wash problem'' across six models reveals approximately context-independent sigmoid heuristics: the distance cue exerts 8.7 to 38 times more influence than the goal, and token-level attribution shows patterns more consistent with keyword associations than compositional inference. The Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB) -- 500 instances spanning 4 heuristic by 5 constraint families with minimal pairs and explicitness gradients -- demonstrates generality across 14 models: under strict evaluation (10/10 correct), no model exceeds 75%, and presence constraints are hardest (44%). A minimal hint (e.g., emphasizing the key object) recovers +15 pp on average, suggesting the failure lies in constraint inference rather than missing knowledge; 12/14 models perform worse when the constraint is removed (up to -39 pp), revealing conservative bias. Parametric probes confirm that the sigmoid pattern generalizes to cost, efficiency, and semantic-similarity heuristics; goal-decomposition prompting recovers +6 to 9 pp by forcing models to enumerate preconditions before answering. Together, these results characterize heuristic override as a systematic reasoning vulnerability and provide a benchmark for measuring progress toward resolving it.
summary_zh: 当表面显著线索与隐含的可行性约束发生冲突时，大语言模型会出现系统性失效。本研究通过诊断-测量-桥接-处理框架对此进行探究。基于六个模型对"洗车问题"的因果行为分析发现，存在近似上下文独立的S型启发式策略：距离线索的影响比目标线索强8.7至38倍，词元级归因显示其模式更符合关键词关联而非组合推理。启发式覆盖基准测试（HOB）——包含4种启发式策略×5种约束家族共500个实例，涵盖最小对比对和显性梯度——在14个模型中验证了普遍性：在严格评估标准下（10/10正确率），无模型超过75%，存在性约束最难（44%）。提供最小提示（如强调关键对象）可平均提升15个百分点，表明失效源于约束推断而非知识缺失；当约束被移除时，12/14个模型表现更差（最多下降39个百分点），揭示其保守性偏差。参数化探针证实S型模式可推广至成本、效率及语义相似性启发式；目标分解提示通过强制模型在回答前枚举前提条件，可恢复6-9个百分点。这些结果共同揭示了启发式覆盖作为系统推理脆弱性的特征，并为衡量该问题的解决进展提供了基准测试。
tldr: The paper analyzes a systematic reasoning failure in LLMs where salient surface cues override unstated feasibility constraints, using a new benchmark and causal analysis to diagnose and mitigate the problem.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了LLMs中一个系统性推理缺陷，即显著的表面线索会覆盖未明说的可行性约束，通过新的基准和因果分析来诊断和缓解该问题。

title: Emergence WebVoyager: Toward Consistent and Transparent Evaluation of (Web) Agents in The Wild
summary: Reliable evaluation of AI agents operating in complex, real-world environments requires methodologies that are robust, transparent, and contextually aligned with the tasks agents are intended to perform. This study identifies persistent shortcomings in existing AI agent evaluation practices that are particularly acute in web agent evaluation, as exemplified by our audit of WebVoyager, including task-framing ambiguity and operational variability that hinder meaningful and reproducible performance comparisons. To address these challenges, we introduce Emergence WebVoyager, an enhanced version of the WebVoyager benchmark that standardizes evaluation methodology through clear guidelines for task instantiation, failure handling, annotation, and reporting. Emergence WebVoyager achieves an inter-annotator agreement of 95.9\%, indicating improved clarity and reliability in both task formulation and evaluation. Applying this framework to evaluate OpenAI Operator reveals substantial performance variation across domains and task types, with an overall success rate of 68.6\%, substantially lower than the 87\% previously reported by OpenAI, demonstrating the utility of our approach for more rigorous and comparable web agent evaluation.
summary_zh: 对在复杂现实环境中运行的人工智能体进行可靠评估，需要采用稳健、透明且与智能体预期执行任务情境相符的方法论。本研究指出了现有AI智能体评估实践中存在的持续缺陷，这些缺陷在Web智能体评估中尤为突出，正如我们对WebVoyager的审计所揭示的——包括任务框架模糊性与操作可变性等问题，阻碍了有意义且可复现的性能比较。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Emergence WebVoyager，这是WebVoyager基准测试的增强版本，通过制定任务实例化、故障处理、标注与报告等环节的明确准则，实现了评估方法的标准化。Emergence WebVoyager的标注者间一致性达到95.9%，表明其在任务构建与评估环节的清晰度和可靠性均得到提升。应用该框架对OpenAI Operator进行评估，发现其在不同领域和任务类型中存在显著性能差异，整体成功率仅为68.6%，远低于OpenAI先前报告的87%。这一结果验证了本方法能为Web智能体评估提供更严谨、可比较的评估框架的实际效用。
tldr: This paper introduces Emergence WebVoyager, a standardized evaluation framework for web agents, identifying and addressing flaws in current benchmarks to achieve more reliable and transparent performance assessment.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了Emergence WebVoyager，一个用于网络智能体的标准化评估框架，旨在解决现有基准测试的缺陷，以实现更可靠和透明的性能评估。

title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Disaggregated LLM Inference
summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly depends on efficient long-context processing and generation mechanisms, including sparse attention, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and compressed contextual memory, to support complex reasoning. We show that these optimizations can be unified into a four-step memory processing pipeline: Prepare Memory, Compute Relevancy, Retrieval, and Apply to Inference. Through systematic profiling, we identify a 22%-97% memory processing overhead in LLM inference and strong heterogeneity in its computational characteristics. Motivated by this insight, we argue that \textbf{heterogeneous systems} are well-suited to accelerate memory processing and thus end-to-end inference. We demonstrate this approach on a GPU-FPGA system by offloading sparse, irregular, and memory-bounded operations to FPGAs while retaining compute-intensive operations on GPUs. Evaluated on an AMD MI210 GPU and an Alveo U55C FPGA, our system is $1.04\sim2.2\times$ faster and requires $1.11\sim4.7\times$ less energy across multiple LLM inference optimizations than the GPU baseline (similar results hold on NVIDIA A100). These results establish heterogeneous systems as a practical direction for efficient LLM memory processing and inform future heterogeneous hardware design.
summary_zh: 现代大型语言模型日益依赖高效的长上下文处理与生成机制，如稀疏注意力、检索增强生成和压缩上下文记忆，以支持复杂推理。本文指出，这些优化技术可统一为四步记忆处理流程：记忆准备、相关性计算、检索与推理应用。通过系统性能分析，我们发现LLM推理中存在22%至97%的记忆处理开销，且其计算特性具有显著异质性。基于此洞察，我们认为**异构系统**特别适合加速记忆处理，从而提升端到端推理效率。我们在GPU-FPGA混合系统上验证了这一思路，将稀疏、不规则及内存受限的操作卸载至FPGA，同时保留GPU上的计算密集型操作。基于AMD MI210 GPU与Alveo U55C FPGA的测试表明，相较于纯GPU基准方案（在NVIDIA A100上获得类似结论），我们的系统在多种LLM推理优化中实现了1.04至2.2倍的加速，能耗降低1.11至4.7倍。这些结果确立了异构系统作为高效LLM记忆处理的可行方向，并为未来异构硬件设计提供了重要参考。
tldr: This paper proposes a heterogeneous GPU-FPGA system to accelerate the memory processing pipeline (e.g., for sparse attention, RAG) in LLM inference, reducing overhead and energy consumption.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种GPU-FPGA异构系统，用于加速LLM推理中的内存处理流水线（如稀疏注意力、RAG），以降低开销和能耗。

title: Multi-Agent LLMs for Adaptive Acquisition in Bayesian Optimization
summary: The exploration-exploitation trade-off is central to sequential decision-making and black-box optimization, yet how Large Language Models (LLMs) reason about and manage this trade-off remains poorly understood. Unlike Bayesian Optimization, where exploration and exploitation are explicitly encoded through acquisition functions, LLM-based optimization relies on implicit, prompt-based reasoning over historical evaluations, making search behavior difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we present a metric-level study of LLM-mediated search policy learning, studying how LLMs construct and adapt exploration-exploitation strategies under multiple operational definitions of exploration, including informativeness, diversity, and representativeness. We show that single-agent LLM approaches, which jointly perform strategy selection and candidate generation within a single prompt, suffer from cognitive overload, leading to unstable search dynamics and premature convergence. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent framework that decomposes exploration-exploitation control into strategic policy mediation and tactical candidate generation. A strategy agent assigns interpretable weights to multiple search criteria, while a generation agent produces candidates conditioned on the resulting search policy defined as weights. This decomposition renders exploration-exploitation decisions explicit, observable, and adjustable. Empirical results across various continuous optimization benchmarks indicate that separating strategic control from candidate generation substantially improves the effectiveness of LLM-mediated search.
summary_zh: 探索-利用权衡问题是序列决策与黑箱优化的核心，但大型语言模型如何对此进行推理和管理仍缺乏深入理解。与贝叶斯优化中通过采集函数显式编码探索与利用不同，基于LLM的优化依赖于对历史评估的隐式、基于提示的推理，这使得其搜索行为难以分析或控制。本研究针对LLM中介的搜索策略学习开展度量层面的分析，探讨LLM如何在信息性、多样性和代表性等多种探索操作定义下构建并调整探索-利用策略。研究发现，单智能体LLM方法（在单个提示中同时执行策略选择与候选生成）存在认知过载问题，导致搜索动态不稳定并过早收敛。为突破此局限，我们提出一种多智能体框架，将探索-利用控制分解为策略中介与战术候选生成两个环节：策略智能体为多重搜索准则分配可解释的权重，生成智能体则依据权重定义的搜索策略生成候选方案。该分解机制使探索-利用决策过程变得显式化、可观测且可调节。在多个连续优化基准测试中的实证结果表明，将策略控制与候选生成分离能显著提升LLM中介搜索的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-agent LLM framework to decompose and improve the exploration-exploitation trade-off in black-box optimization, making the search policy more explicit and controllable.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个多智能体LLM框架，用于分解和改善黑盒优化中的探索-利用权衡，使搜索策略更加明确和可控。

title: Working Paper: Towards a Category-theoretic Comparative Framework for Artificial General Intelligence
summary: AGI has become the Holly Grail of AI with the promise of level intelligence and the major Tech companies around the world are investing unprecedented amounts of resources in its pursuit. Yet, there does not exist a single formal definition and only some empirical AGI benchmarking frameworks currently exist. The main purpose of this paper is to develop a general, algebraic and category theoretic framework for describing, comparing and analysing different possible AGI architectures. Thus, this Category theoretic formalization would also allow to compare different possible candidate AGI architectures, such as, RL, Universal AI, Active Inference, CRL, Schema based Learning, etc. It will allow to unambiguously expose their commonalities and differences, and what is even more important, expose areas for future research. From the applied Category theoretic point of view, we take as inspiration Machines in a Category to provide a modern view of AGI Architectures in a Category. More specifically, this first position paper provides, on one hand, a first exercise on RL, Causal RL and SBL Architectures in a Category, and on the other hand, it is a first step on a broader research program that seeks to provide a unified formal foundation for AGI systems, integrating architectural structure, informational organization, agent realization, agent and environment interaction, behavioural development over time, and the empirical evaluation of properties. This framework is also intended to support the definition of architectural properties, both syntactic and informational, as well as semantic properties of agents and their assessment in environments with explicitly characterized features. We claim that Category Theory and AGI will have a very symbiotic relation.
summary_zh: 人工通用智能已成为人工智能领域的圣杯，其承诺实现人类水平的智能，全球各大科技公司正以前所未有的资源投入进行追求。然而，目前尚不存在唯一的正式定义，仅有少数经验性的人工通用智能基准框架。本文的主要目的是构建一个通用、代数及范畴论框架，以描述、比较和分析不同可能的人工通用智能架构。因此，这一范畴论形式化框架将能够比较不同可能的人工通用智能候选架构，如强化学习、通用人工智能、主动推理、因果强化学习、基于图式的学习等，并能明确揭示它们的共性与差异，更重要的是，揭示未来研究的领域。从应用范畴论的角度，我们借鉴“范畴中的机器”思想，为“范畴中的人工通用智能架构”提供现代视角。具体而言，本立场性论文一方面首次尝试在范畴中探讨强化学习、因果强化学习及基于图式学习架构，另一方面，它是更广泛研究计划的第一步，旨在为人工通用智能系统提供统一的形式化基础，整合架构结构、信息组织、智能体实现、智能体与环境交互、随时间发展的行为特性，以及属性的经验性评估。该框架还旨在支持定义架构属性（包括句法和信息属性）以及智能体的语义属性，并在具有明确特征的环境中进行评估。我们主张，范畴论与人工通用智能将形成高度共生的关系。
tldr: This paper proposes a category-theoretic framework to formally describe, compare, and analyze different AGI architectures, such as RL and causal RL, as part of a foundational research program for AGI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种范畴论框架，用于形式化描述、比较和分析不同的AGI架构，如RL和因果RL，作为AGI基础研究计划的一部分。

title: Benchmarking PhD-Level Coding in 3D Geometric Computer Vision
summary: AI-assisted coding has rapidly reshaped software practice and research workflows, yet today's models still struggle to produce correct code for complex 3D geometric vision. If models could reliably write such code, the research of our community would change substantially. To measure progress toward that goal, we introduce GeoCodeBench, a PhD-level benchmark that evaluates coding for 3D vision. Each problem is a fill-in-the-function implementation task curated from representative papers at recent venues: we first let a tool propose candidate functions from official repositories, then perform careful human screening to select core 3D geometric components. For every target, we generate diverse, edge-case unit tests, enabling fully automatic, reproducible scoring. We evaluate eight representative open- and closed-source models to reflect the current ecosystem. The best model, GPT-5, attains only 36.6% pass rate, revealing a large gap between current capabilities and dependable 3D scientific coding. GeoCodeBench organizes tasks into a two-level hierarchy: General 3D capability (geometric transformations and mechanics/optics formulation) and Research capability (novel algorithm implementation and geometric logic routing). Scores are positively correlated across these axes, but research-oriented tasks are markedly harder. Context ablations further show that "more paper text" is not always better: cutting off at the Method section statistically outperforms full-paper inputs, highlighting unresolved challenges in long-context scientific comprehension. Together, these findings position GeoCodeBench as a rigorous testbed for advancing from generic coding to trustworthy 3D geometric vision coding.
summary_zh: 人工智能辅助编码已迅速重塑软件实践与研究流程，但现有模型在生成复杂三维几何视觉的正确代码方面仍面临挑战。若模型能够可靠编写此类代码，本领域的研究模式将发生根本性转变。为评估这一目标的进展，我们提出GeoCodeBench——一个博士级评测基准，专注于三维视觉编码能力的评估。该基准中的每个问题均为填充函数实现任务，其内容选自近期顶级会议的典型论文：我们首先通过工具从官方代码库提取候选函数，再经人工严格筛选出核心三维几何组件。针对每个目标函数，我们生成多样化的边界情况单元测试，实现全自动、可复现的评分机制。通过对八个具有代表性的开源与闭源模型进行评估，我们发现当前最佳模型GPT-5的通过率仅为36.6%，这揭示了现有能力与可靠的三维科学编码需求之间存在巨大差距。GeoCodeBench将任务组织为两级体系：通用三维能力（几何变换与力学/光学公式表达）与研究能力（新算法实现与几何逻辑路径规划）。两项能力得分呈正相关，但研究型任务难度显著更高。上下文消融实验进一步表明“更多论文内容”并非总是有利：截取至方法章节的输入在统计上优于完整论文输入，这凸显了模型在长上下文科学理解方面仍存在未解决的挑战。综上，GeoCodeBench为从通用编码向可信赖的三维几何视觉编码的进阶提供了严谨的测试平台。
tldr: This paper introduces GeoCodeBench, a PhD-level benchmark for evaluating AI models' ability to generate correct code for complex 3D geometric computer vision tasks, finding a significant performance gap.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GeoCodeBench，一个用于评估AI模型为复杂3D几何计算机视觉任务生成正确代码能力的博士级基准，发现了显著的性能差距。

title: Conditional Polarization Guidance for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to identify targets that are highly blended with their backgrounds. Recent works have shown that the optical characteristics of polarization cues play a significant role in improving camouflaged object detection. However, most existing polarization-based approaches depend on complex visual encoders and fusion mechanisms, leading to increased model complexity and computational overhead, while failing to fully explore how polarization can explicitly guide hierarchical RGB representation learning. To address these limitations, we propose CPGNet, an asymmetric RGB-polarization framework that introduces a conditional polarization guidance mechanism to explicitly regulate RGB feature learning for camouflaged object detection. Specifically, we design a lightweight polarization interaction module that jointly models these complementary cues and generates reliable polarization guidance in a unified manner. Unlike conventional feature fusion strategies, the proposed conditional guidance mechanism dynamically modulates RGB features using polarization priors, enabling the network to focus on subtle discrepancies between camouflaged objects and their backgrounds. Furthermore, we introduce a polarization edge-guided frequency refinement strategy that enhances high-frequency components under polarization constraints, effectively breaking camouflage patterns. Finally, we develop an iterative feedback decoder to perform coarse-to-fine feature calibration and progressively refine camouflage prediction. Extensive experiments on polarization datasets across multiple tasks, along with evaluations on non-polarization datasets, demonstrate that CPGNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 伪装目标检测（COD）旨在识别与背景高度融合的目标。近年来的研究表明，偏振线索的光学特性在提升伪装目标检测性能方面具有重要作用。然而，现有基于偏振的方法大多依赖复杂的视觉编码器和融合机制，导致模型复杂度与计算开销增加，且未能充分探索偏振信息如何显式引导层次化RGB表征学习。针对这些局限性，我们提出CPGNet——一种非对称的RGB-偏振协同框架，通过引入条件偏振引导机制显式调控面向伪装目标检测的RGB特征学习。具体而言，我们设计了一个轻量级偏振交互模块，以统一的方式联合建模互补线索并生成可靠的偏振引导信息。与传统特征融合策略不同，所提出的条件引导机制利用偏振先验动态调制RGB特征，使网络能够聚焦于伪装目标与背景间的细微差异。此外，我们引入了一种偏振边缘引导的频率优化策略，通过在偏振约束下增强高频分量，有效破解伪装模式。最后，我们开发了迭代反馈解码器，执行从粗到细的特征校准并逐步优化伪装预测结果。在多个任务偏振数据集上的大量实验，以及对非偏振数据集的评估表明，CPGNet在各项指标上均持续优于当前最优方法。
tldr: Proposes CPGNet, an RGB-polarization framework using a conditional polarization guidance mechanism to explicitly regulate RGB features for detecting camouflaged objects, which are highly blended with backgrounds.
tldr_zh: 提出CPGNet，一种RGB-偏振光框架，通过条件偏振引导机制显式调控RGB特征，用于检测与背景高度融合的伪装目标。

title: SurgNavAR: An Augmented Reality Surgical Navigation Framework for Optical See-Through Head Mounted Displays
summary: Augmented reality (AR) devices with head mounted displays (HMDs) facilitate the direct superimposition of 3D preoperative imaging data onto the patient during surgery. To use an HMD-AR device as a stand-alone surgical navigation system, the device should be able to locate the patient and surgical instruments, align preoperative imaging data with the patient, and visualize navigation data in real time during surgery. Whereas some of the technologies required for this are known, integration in such devices is cumbersome and requires specific knowledge and expertise, hampering scientific progress in this field. This work therefore aims to present and evaluate an integrated HMD-based AR surgical navigation framework that is adaptable to diverse surgical applications. The framework tracks 2D patterns as reference markers attached to the patient and surgical instruments. It allows for the calibration of surgical tools using pivot and reference-based calibration techniques. It enables image-to-patient registration using point-based matching and manual positioning. The integrated functionalities of the framework are evaluated on two HMD devices, the HoloLens 2 and Magic Leap 2, with two surgical use cases being evaluated in a phantom setup: AR-guided needle insertion and rib fracture localization. The framework was able to achieve a mean tooltip calibration accuracy of 1 mm, a registration accuracy of 3 mm, and a targeting accuracy below 5 mm on the two surgical use cases. The framework presents an easy-to-use configurable tool for HMD-based AR surgical navigation, which can be extended and adapted to many surgical applications. The framework is publicly available at https://github.com/abdullahthabit/SurgNavAR.
summary_zh: 配备头戴式显示器的增强现实设备能够在手术过程中将三维术前影像数据直接叠加于患者身上。要将头戴式显示增强现实设备作为独立的手术导航系统使用，该设备需具备定位患者及手术器械、将术前影像数据与患者解剖结构对齐、并在术中实时可视化导航数据的能力。尽管相关技术已部分成熟，但将其整合至此类设备中仍过程繁琐且需要特定专业知识，这制约了该领域的科研进展。因此，本研究旨在提出并评估一种基于头戴式显示器的集成化增强现实手术导航框架，该框架可适配多种外科应用场景。该框架通过追踪附着于患者及手术器械上的二维图案作为参考标记物，支持采用枢轴校准与参考基准校准技术进行手术工具标定，并允许通过点匹配和手动定位实现影像与患者的配准。本研究在HoloLens 2和Magic Leap 2两款头戴式显示设备上对框架的集成功能进行了评估，通过仿真实验设置验证了两个外科应用场景：增强现实引导穿刺针置入与肋骨骨折定位。该框架在两项应用中实现了平均1毫米的工具尖端校准精度、3毫米的配准精度以及低于5毫米的目标定位精度。本框架为基于头戴式显示器的增强现实手术导航提供了一种易于使用的可配置工具，其功能可扩展并适用于多种外科应用。该框架已在https://github.com/abdullahthabit/SurgNavAR公开。
tldr: The paper presents SurgNavAR, an integrated Augmented Reality surgical navigation framework for head-mounted displays, enabling tracking, calibration, and registration for procedures like needle insertion and rib fracture localization, achieving sub-5mm accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SurgNavAR，一个用于头戴式显示器的集成增强现实手术导航框架，能够实现跟踪、校准和配准，用于如针插入和肋骨骨折定位等手术，精度可达5毫米以下。

title: SurgTEMP: Temporal-Aware Surgical Video Question Answering with Text-guided Visual Memory for Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
summary: Surgical procedures are inherently complex and risky, requiring extensive expertise and constant focus to well navigate evolving intraoperative scenes. Computer-assisted systems such as surgical visual question answering (VQA) offer promises for education and intraoperative support. Current surgical VQA research largely focuses on static frame analysis, overlooking rich temporal semantics. Surgical video question answering is further challenged by low visual contrast, its highly knowledge-driven nature, diverse analytical needs spanning scattered temporal windows, and the hierarchy from basic perception to high-level intraoperative assessment. To address these challenges, we propose SurgTEMP, a multimodal LLM framework featuring (i) a query-guided token selection module that builds hierarchical visual memory (spatial and temporal memory banks) and (ii) a Surgical Competency Progression (SCP) training scheme. Together, these components enable effective modeling of variable-length surgical videos while preserving procedure-relevant cues and temporal coherence, and better support diverse downstream assessment tasks. To support model development, we introduce CholeVidQA-32K, a surgical video question answering dataset comprising 32K open-ended QA pairs and 3,855 video segments (approximately 128 h total) from laparoscopic cholecystectomy. The dataset is organized into a three-level hierarchy -- Perception, Assessment, and Reasoning -- spanning 11 tasks from instrument/action/anatomy perception to Critical View of Safety (CVS), intraoperative difficulty, skill proficiency, and adverse event assessment. In comprehensive evaluations against state-of-the-art open-source multimodal and video LLMs (fine-tuned and zero-shot), SurgTEMP achieves substantial performance improvements, advancing the state of video-based surgical VQA.
summary_zh: 外科手术过程本身具有高度复杂性和风险性，需要丰富的专业知识和持续专注力以应对不断变化的术中场景。以手术视觉问答（VQA）为代表的计算机辅助系统为教学培训和术中支持提供了新的可能。当前手术VQA研究主要集中于静态帧分析，忽略了丰富的时间语义信息。手术视频问答面临多重挑战：视觉对比度低、高度依赖专业知识、分析需求需覆盖离散的时间窗口，以及从基础感知到高级术中评估的层次化特性。为解决这些问题，我们提出SurgTEMP多模态大语言模型框架，其核心包含（1）构建层次化视觉记忆（空间与时间记忆库）的查询引导令牌选择模块，以及（2）外科能力进阶（SCP）训练策略。这些组件共同实现了对可变长度手术视频的有效建模，在保持手术相关线索与时间连贯性的同时，更好地支持多样化下游评估任务。为推进模型发展，我们构建了CholeVidQA-32K数据集，包含腹腔镜胆囊切除术中32,000个开放式问答对及3,855段视频片段（总计约128小时）。该数据集按“感知-评估-推理”三级架构组织，涵盖从器械/动作/解剖结构识别到安全临界视图（CVS）评估、术中难度判断、操作技能水平评价及不良事件分析等11类任务。在与当前最先进的开源多模态及视频大语言模型（微调与零样本）的综合对比实验中，SurgTEMP实现了显著性能提升，推动了基于视频的手术VQA技术发展。
tldr: Proposes SurgTEMP, a multimodal LLM framework with query-guided visual memory and hierarchical training for surgical video question answering, demonstrated on a new laparoscopic cholecystectomy dataset.
tldr_zh: 提出了 SurgTEMP，一个用于手术视频问答的多模态LLM框架，具有查询引导的视觉记忆和分层训练方案，并在新的腹腔镜胆囊切除术数据集上进行了验证。

title: Better than Average: Spatially-Aware Aggregation of Segmentation Uncertainty Improves Downstream Performance
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is crucial for ensuring the reliability of automated image segmentations in safety-critical domains like biomedical image analysis or autonomous driving. In segmentation, UQ generates pixel-wise uncertainty scores that must be aggregated into image-level scores for downstream tasks like Out-of-Distribution (OoD) or failure detection. Despite routine use of aggregation strategies, their properties and impact on downstream task performance have not yet been comprehensively studied. Global Average is the default choice, yet it does not account for spatial and structural features of segmentation uncertainty. Alternatives like patch-, class- and threshold-based strategies exist, but lack systematic comparison, leading to inconsistent reporting and unclear best practices. We address this gap by (1) formally analyzing properties, limitations, and pitfalls of common strategies; (2) proposing novel strategies that incorporate spatial uncertainty structure and (3) benchmarking their performance on OoD and failure detection across ten datasets that vary in image geometry and structure. We find that aggregators leveraging spatial structure yield stronger performance in both downstream tasks studied. However, the performance of individual aggregators depends heavily on dataset characteristics, so we (4) propose a meta-aggregator that integrates multiple aggregators and performs robustly across datasets.
summary_zh: 不确定性量化对于确保生物医学图像分析或自动驾驶等安全关键领域中自动化图像分割的可靠性至关重要。在分割任务中，不确定性量化会产生像素级的不确定性评分，这些评分必须聚合为图像级评分以供下游任务使用，例如分布外检测或故障识别。尽管聚合策略已被常规应用，但它们的特性及其对下游任务性能的影响尚未得到全面研究。全局平均法是默认选择，但该方法未考虑分割不确定性的空间与结构特征。虽然存在基于图像块、类别和阈值的替代策略，但缺乏系统性的比较，导致结果报告不一致且最佳实践不明确。针对这一不足，本文通过以下方式展开研究：（1）系统分析常用策略的特性、局限性和潜在缺陷；（2）提出融合空间不确定性结构的新型策略；（3）在十个具有不同图像几何结构和特征的数据集上，对分布外检测与故障识别任务中的策略性能进行基准测试。研究发现，利用空间结构的聚合器在两项下游任务中均表现出更强的性能。然而，单个聚合器的性能高度依赖于数据集特征，因此我们（4）提出一种元聚合器，它能够整合多种聚合器并在不同数据集中保持稳健性能。
tldr: This paper studies methods for aggregating pixel-level segmentation uncertainty into image-level scores, finding that spatially-aware aggregation improves performance on downstream tasks like OoD detection and failure prediction across various datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了将像素级分割不确定性聚合为图像级分数的方法，发现空间感知的聚合策略在多个数据集上提高了OoD检测和故障预测等下游任务的性能。

title: GRVS: a Generalizable and Recurrent Approach to Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing novel views from monocular videos of dynamic scenes remains a challenging problem. Scene-specific methods that optimize 4D representations with explicit motion priors often break down in highly dynamic regions where multi-view information is hard to exploit. Diffusion-based approaches that integrate camera control into large pre-trained models can produce visually plausible videos but frequently suffer from geometric inconsistencies across both static and dynamic areas. Both families of methods also require substantial computational resources. Building on the success of generalizable models for static novel view synthesis, we adapt the framework to dynamic inputs and propose a new model with two key components: (1) a recurrent loop that enables unbounded and asynchronous mapping between input and target videos and (2) an efficient use of plane sweeps over dynamic inputs to disentangle camera and scene motion, and achieve fine-grained, six-degrees-of-freedom camera controls. We train and evaluate our model on the UCSD dataset and on Kubric-4D-dyn, a new monocular dynamic dataset featuring longer, higher resolution sequences with more complex scene dynamics than existing alternatives. Our model outperforms four Gaussian Splatting-based scene-specific approaches, as well as two diffusion-based approaches in reconstructing fine-grained geometric details across both static and dynamic regions.
summary_zh: 从动态场景的单目视频中合成新视角仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。基于显式运动先验优化4D表示的场景特定方法，在动态性极高的区域常因难以利用多视图信息而失效。基于扩散的方法将相机控制集成到大型预训练模型中，虽能生成视觉上合理的视频，但常因静态和动态区域的几何不一致性而受限。这两类方法均需大量计算资源。基于静态新视角合成通用模型的成功经验，我们将其框架扩展至动态输入，提出一种包含两个关键组件的新模型：（1）采用循环机制，实现输入与目标视频之间无界异步的映射；（2）通过动态输入的平面扫描技术高效解耦相机与场景运动，从而实现精细的六自由度相机控制。我们在UCSD数据集及新构建的Kubric-4D-dyn单目动态数据集上对模型进行训练与评估。该数据集包含比现有数据更长、分辨率更高的序列，并具有更复杂的场景动态性。实验表明，我们的模型在静态和动态区域的精细几何细节重建方面，均优于四种基于高斯溅射的场景特定方法及两种基于扩散的方法。
tldr: Proposes a generalizable and recurrent model for monocular dynamic view synthesis, achieving fine-grained 6-DoF camera control and outperforming scene-specific and diffusion-based methods on novel datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于单目动态视图合成的通用循环模型，实现了精细的6自由度相机控制，并在新数据集上优于场景特定和基于扩散的方法。

title: Leveraging Synthetic Data for Enhancing Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Detection
summary: In this work, we explore the role of synthetic data in improving the detection of Hand-Object Interactions from egocentric images. Through extensive experimentation and comparative analysis on VISOR, EgoHOS, and ENIGMA-51 datasets, our findings demonstrate the potential of synthetic data to significantly improve HOI detection, particularly when real labeled data are scarce or unavailable. By using synthetic data and only 10% of the real labeled data, we achieve improvements in Overall AP over models trained exclusively on real data, with gains of +5.67% on VISOR, +8.24% on EgoHOS, and +11.69% on ENIGMA-51. Furthermore, we systematically study how aligning synthetic data to specific real-world benchmarks with respect to objects, grasps, and environments, showing that the effectiveness of synthetic data consistently improves with better synthetic-real alignment. As a result of this work, we release a new data generation pipeline and the new HOI-Synth benchmark, which augments existing datasets with synthetic images of hand-object interaction. These data are automatically annotated with hand-object contact states, bounding boxes, and pixel-wise segmentation masks. All data, code, and tools for synthetic data generation are available at: https://fpv-iplab.github.io/HOI-Synth/.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了合成数据在提升第一人称视角图像中手-物交互检测方面的作用。通过对VISOR、EgoHOS和ENIGMA-51数据集的广泛实验与比较分析，我们的研究结果表明，在真实标注数据稀缺或不可得的情况下，合成数据能显著提升手-物交互检测性能。使用合成数据并仅搭配10%的真实标注数据，相较于仅使用真实数据训练的模型，我们在整体平均精度上取得了显著提升：VISOR数据集提升5.67%，EgoHOS数据集提升8.24%，ENIGMA-51数据集提升11.69%。此外，我们系统研究了如何从物体、抓握方式及环境维度将合成数据与特定真实世界基准对齐，证明合成数据效果随着合成-真实对齐度的提升而持续增强。基于本研究成果，我们发布了新型数据生成流程及HOI-Synth基准数据集，该数据集通过手-物交互合成图像对现有数据集进行了增强。所有数据均自动标注了手-物接触状态、边界框及像素级分割掩码。合成数据生成所需的全部数据、代码与工具均公开于：https://fpv-iplab.github.io/HOI-Synth/。
tldr: This paper explores using synthetic data to improve detection of Hand-Object Interactions in egocentric images, releasing a new data generation pipeline and benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文探索利用合成数据增强以自我为中心视角下的手-物交互检测，并发布了一个新的数据生成流水线和基准数据集。

title: Compressive sensing inspired self-supervised single-pixel imaging
summary: Single-pixel imaging (SPI) is a promising imaging modality with distinctive advantages in strongly perturbed environments. Existing SPI methods lack physical sparsity constraints and overlook the integration of local and global features, leading to severe noise vulnerability, structural distortions and blurred details. To address these limitations, we propose SISTA-Net, a compressive sensing-inspired self-supervised method for single-pixel imaging. SISTA-Net unfolds the Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (ISTA) into an interpretable network consisting of a data fidelity module and a proximal mapping module. The fidelity module adopts a hybrid CNN-Visual State Space Model (VSSM) architecture to integrate local and global feature modeling, enhancing reconstruction integrity and fidelity. We leverage deep nonlinear networks as adaptive sparse transforms combined with a learnable soft-thresholding operator to impose explicit physical sparsity in the latent domain, enabling noise suppression and robustness to interference even at extremely low sampling rates. Extensive experiments on multiple simulation scenarios demonstrate that SISTA-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 2.6 dB in PSNR. Real-world far-field underwater tests yield a 3.4 dB average PSNR improvement, validating its robust anti-interference capability.
summary_zh: 单像素成像（SPI）作为一种在强扰动环境中具有独特优势的成像方式，展现出广阔前景。现有单像素成像方法缺乏物理稀疏性约束，且忽视了局部与全局特征的融合，导致其易受噪声干扰、结构失真及细节模糊等问题。为克服这些局限，我们提出SISTA-Net——一种受压缩感知启发的自监督式单像素成像方法。该方法将迭代收缩阈值算法（ISTA）展开为可解释网络，包含数据保真度模块和近端映射模块。保真度模块采用混合CNN-视觉状态空间模型（VSSM）架构，融合局部与全局特征建模，以提升重建完整性与保真度。我们利用深度非线性网络作为自适应稀疏变换，结合可学习的软阈值算子，在潜在域施加显式物理稀疏约束，使其即使在极低采样率下仍能实现噪声抑制与抗干扰鲁棒性。多场景仿真实验表明，SISTA-Net在峰值信噪比（PSNR）指标上超越现有先进方法2.6 dB。实际远场水下测试取得平均PSNR提升3.4 dB，验证了其强大的抗干扰能力。
tldr: This paper introduces SISTA-Net, a compressive sensing-inspired self-supervised network for single-pixel imaging, which improves image reconstruction quality under interference and at low sampling rates by integrating local and global features and using an adaptive sparse transform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种受压缩感知启发的自监督网络SISTA-Net，用于单像素成像，通过整合局部和全局特征并使用自适应稀疏变换，在干扰和低采样率下提高了图像重建质量。

title: CoRe-DA: Contrastive Regression for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Surgical Skill Assessment
summary: Vision-based surgical skill assessment (SSA) enables objective and scalable evaluation of operative performance. Progress in this field is constrained by the high cost and time demands for manual annotation of quantitative skill scores, as well as the poor generalization of existing regression models to new surgical tasks and environments. Meanwhile, appreciable volumes of unlabeled video data are now available, motivating the development of unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods for SSA. We introduce the first benchmark for UDA in SSA regression, spanning four datasets across dry-lab and clinical settings as well as open and robotic surgery. We evaluate eight representative models under challenging domain shifts and propose CoRe-DA, a novel contrastive regression-based adaptation framework. Our method learns domain-invariant representations through relative-score supervision and target-domain self-training. Comprehensive experiments across two UDA settings show that CoRe-DA is superior to state-of-the-art methods, achieving Spearman Correlation Coefficients of 0.46 and 0.41 on dry-lab and clinical target datasets, respectively, without using any labeled target data for training. Overall, CoRe-DA enables scalable SSA with reliable cross-domain generalization, where existing methods underperform. Our code and datasets will be released at https://github.com/anastadimi/CoRe-DA.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的手术技能评估技术能够实现客观且可扩展的术中表现评价。当前该领域的发展受限于人工标注量化技能评分所需的高成本与时间消耗，以及现有回归模型在新手术任务和环境中泛化能力不足的问题。与此同时，大量未标注手术视频数据的积累，推动了无监督领域自适应方法在手术技能评估中的研究应用。本文首次构建了针对手术技能评估回归任务的无监督领域自适应基准测试平台，涵盖干式实验与临床环境下的开放手术和机器人手术四大数据集。通过在挑战性领域偏移场景下评估八种代表性模型，我们提出了一种新颖的对比回归自适应框架CoRe-DA。该框架通过相对评分监督与目标域自训练策略，学习具有领域不变性的特征表示。在两种无监督领域自适应设置下的综合实验表明，CoRe-DA在完全不使用目标域标注数据的情况下，分别在干式实验与临床目标数据集上获得0.46和0.41的斯皮尔曼相关系数，显著优于现有最优方法。整体而言，CoRe-DA实现了现有方法难以达成的可靠跨领域泛化能力，为可扩展的手术技能评估提供了有效解决方案。相关代码与数据集已发布于https://github.com/anastadimi/CoRe-DA。
tldr: The paper introduces a contrastive regression framework for unsupervised domain adaptation in surgical skill assessment, aimed at improving the generalization of regression models across different surgical tasks and environments without labeled target data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于对比回归的无监督域适应框架，用于手术技能评估，旨在提升回归模型在不同手术任务和环境下的泛化能力，而无需目标域的标注数据。

title: Not All Frames Are Equal: Complexity-Aware Masked Motion Generation via Motion Spectral Descriptors
summary: Masked generative models have become a strong paradigm for text-to-motion synthesis, but they still treat motion frames too uniformly during masking, attention, and decoding. This is a poor match for motion, where local dynamic complexity varies sharply over time. We show that current masked motion generators degrade disproportionately on dynamically complex motions, and that frame-wise generation error is strongly correlated with motion dynamics. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce the Motion Spectral Descriptor (MSD), a simple and parameter-free measure of local dynamic complexity computed from the short-time spectrum of motion velocity. Unlike learned difficulty predictors, MSD is deterministic, interpretable, and derived directly from the motion signal itself. We use MSD to make masked motion generation complexity-aware. In particular, MSD guides content-focused masking during training, provides a spectral similarity prior for self-attention, and can additionally modulate token-level sampling during iterative decoding. Built on top of masked motion generators, our method, DynMask, improves motion generation most clearly on dynamically complex motions while also yielding stronger overall FID on HumanML3D and KIT-ML. These results suggest that respecting local motion complexity is a useful design principle for masked motion generation. Project page: https://xiangyue-zhang.github.io/DynMask
summary_zh:
摘要：
掩码生成模型已成为文本到动作合成的强大范式，但它们在掩码、注意力和解码过程中仍过于均匀地对待动作帧。这与动作数据特性不匹配，因为动作的局部动态复杂度随时间急剧变化。研究表明，当前掩码动作生成器在动态复杂动作上性能下降尤为显著，且逐帧生成误差与运动动态高度相关。基于这种不匹配现象，我们提出运动频谱描述符（MSD），这是一种从运动速度短时频谱计算得出的局部动态复杂度度量方法，具有简单、无参数的特点。与基于学习的难度预测器不同，MSD具有确定性、可解释性，且直接源自运动信号本身。我们利用MSD实现掩码动作生成的复杂度感知：在训练阶段，MSD指导聚焦内容的掩码策略；为自注意力机制提供频谱相似性先验；并可在迭代解码过程中额外调节令牌级采样。基于掩码动作生成器构建的DynMask方法，在动态复杂动作上的生成质量提升最为显著，同时在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上获得更优的整体FID指标。这些结果表明，尊重局部动作复杂度是掩码动作生成的重要设计原则。项目页面：https://xiangyue-zhang.github.io/DynMask
tldr: This paper introduces a complexity-aware masked motion generation method for human motion synthesis, using a deterministic spectral descriptor to guide masking, attention, and decoding, improving performance on datasets like HumanML3D and KIT-ML.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种复杂度感知的掩码运动生成方法，用于人体运动合成，使用一种确定性的频谱描述符来指导掩码、注意力机制和解码过程，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML等数据集上提升了性能。

title: Self-Supervised Federated Learning under Data Heterogeneity for Label-Scarce Diatom Classification
summary: Label-scarce visual classification under decentralized and heterogeneous data is a fundamental challenge in pattern recognition, especially when sites exhibit partially overlapping class sets. While self-supervised federated learning (SSFL) offers a promising solution, existing studies commonly assume the same data heterogeneity pattern throughout pre-training and fine-tuning. Moreover, current partitioning schemes often fail to generate pure partially class-disjoint data settings, limiting controllable simulation of real-world label-space heterogeneity. In this work, we introduce SSFL for diatom classification as a representative real-world instance and systematically investigate stage-specific data heterogeneity. We study cross-site variation in unlabeled data volume during pre-training and label-space misalignment during downstream fine-tuning. To study the latter in a controllable setting, we propose PreDi, a partitioning scheme that disentangles label-space heterogeneity into two orthogonal dimensions, namely class Prevalence and class-set size Disparity, enabling separate analysis of their effects. Guided by the resulting insights, we further propose PreP-WFL (Prevalence-based Personalized Weighted Federated Learning) to adaptively strengthen rare-class representations in low-prevalence scenarios. Extensive experiments show that SSFL consistently outperforms local-only training under both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings. The pronounced heterogeneity in unlabeled data volume is associated with improved representation pre-training, whereas under label-space heterogeneity, prevalence dominates performance and disparity has a smaller effect. PreP-WFL effectively mitigates this degradation, with gains increasing as prevalence decreases. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for characterizing label-space heterogeneity in decentralized recognition systems.
summary_zh: 摘要：在分散异构数据下的标签稀缺视觉分类是模式识别领域的一个基本挑战，尤其在站点数据呈现部分重叠类别集时更为显著。虽然自监督联邦学习（SSFL）提供了有前景的解决方案，但现有研究通常默认预训练与微调阶段的数据异构模式完全一致。此外，当前的数据划分方案往往难以生成纯粹的部分类别不相交数据环境，限制了真实世界标签空间异构性的可控模拟。本研究以硅藻分类作为代表性现实场景，系统性地探索了不同阶段特有的数据异构性。我们重点研究了预训练阶段未标记数据量的跨站点差异，以及下游微调阶段标签空间的对齐偏差。为在可控环境中研究后者，我们提出PreDi划分方案，将标签空间异构性解耦为两个正交维度——类别流行度与类别集规模差异，从而支持对其效应进行独立分析。基于此洞见，我们进一步提出基于流行度的个性化加权联邦学习方法（PreP-WFL），以在低流行度场景中自适应增强稀有类别的表征能力。大量实验表明，在同构与异构数据设置下，SSFL始终优于纯本地训练。未标记数据量的显著异构性与表征预训练效果提升相关，而在标签空间异构性中，流行度主导性能表现，类别集规模差异影响较小。PreP-WFL有效缓解了异构性导致的性能下降，且在流行度降低时增益更为显著。这些发现为解析分散式识别系统中标签空间异构性特征提供了机制性依据。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for self-supervised federated learning to address data heterogeneity in label-scarce diatom image classification, introducing a new data partitioning scheme and a personalized learning algorithm to improve performance in low-prevalence scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于解决标签稀缺的硅藻图像分类中数据异质性的自监督联邦学习方法，引入了一种新的数据划分方案和个性化学习算法，以改善低流行率场景下的性能。

title: BigEarthNet.txt: A Large-Scale Multi-Sensor Image-Text Dataset and Benchmark for Earth Observation
summary: Vision-langugage models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in computer vision (CV), yet their performance on remote sensing (RS) data remains limited due to the lack of large-scale, multi-sensor RS image-text datasets with diverse textual annotations. Existing datasets predominantly include aerial Red-Green-Blue imagery, with short or weakly grounded captions, and provide limited diversity in annotation types. To address this limitation, we introduce BigEarthNet$.$txt, a large-scale, multi-sensor image-text dataset designed to advance instruction-driven image-text learning in Earth observation across multiple tasks. BigEarthNet$.$txt contains 464044 co-registered Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar and Sentinel-2 multispectral images with 9.6M text annotations, including: i) geographically anchored captions describing land-use/land-cover (LULC) classes, their spatial relations, and environmental context; ii) visual question answering pairs relevant for different tasks; and iii) referring expression detection instructions for bounding box prediction. Through a comparative statistical analysis, we demonstrate that BigEarthNet$.$txt surpasses existing RS image-text datasets in textual richness and annotation type variety. We further establish a manually-verified benchmark split to evaluate VLMs in RS and CV. The results show the limitations of these models on tasks that involve complex LULC classes, whereas fine-tuning using BigEarthNet$.$txt results in consistent performance gains across all considered tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在计算机视觉领域展现出强大性能，然而由于缺乏具备多样化文本标注的大规模、多传感器遥感图像-文本数据集，其在遥感数据上的性能仍受限。现有数据集主要包含航空红绿蓝影像，其标注文本简短或缺乏地理依据，且标注类型多样性有限。为突破这一局限，我们提出了BigEarthNet$.$txt——一个专为推进多任务对地观测中指令驱动的图像-文本学习而设计的大规模、多传感器图像-文本数据集。该数据集包含464044组配准的哨兵-1合成孔径雷达影像与哨兵-2多光谱影像，共计960万条文本标注，涵盖：1）基于地理实体的描述性标注，包括土地利用/土地覆盖类别、空间关系及环境背景；2）适配不同任务的视觉问答对；3）用于边界框预测的参照表达式检测指令。通过对比统计分析，我们证明BigEarthNet$.$txt在文本丰富度与标注类型多样性上均超越现有遥感图像-文本数据集。此外，我们建立了人工验证的基准划分方案，用于评估视觉语言模型在遥感与计算机视觉领域的表现。结果表明，现有模型在涉及复杂土地利用/土地覆盖类别的任务中存在局限，而使用BigEarthNet$.$txt进行微调后，所有评估任务均取得持续的性能提升。
tldr: Introduces BigEarthNet.txt, a large-scale multi-sensor remote sensing image-text dataset with diverse annotations to advance instruction-driven learning for Earth observation tasks, demonstrating performance gains for vision-language models in this domain.
tldr_zh: 介绍BigEarthNet.txt，一个大规模多传感器遥感图像-文本数据集，用于推进地球观测任务中的指令驱动学习，并展示了视觉语言模型在该领域的性能提升。

title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
summary: The inherent complexity of video understanding makes it difficult to attribute whether performance gains stem from visual perception, linguistic reasoning, or knowledge priors. While many benchmarks have emerged to assess high-level reasoning, the essential criteria that constitute video understanding remain largely overlooked. Instead of introducing yet another benchmark, we take a step back to re-examine the current landscape of video understanding. In this work, we provide Video-Oasis, a sustainable diagnostic suite designed to systematically evaluate existing evaluations and distill spatio-temporal challenges for video understanding. Our analysis reveals two critical findings: (1) 54% of existing benchmark samples are solvable without visual input or temporal context, and (2) on the remaining samples, state-of-the-art models exhibit performance barely exceeding random guessing. To bridge this gap, we investigate which algorithmic design choices contribute to robust video understanding, providing practical guidelines for future research. We hope our work serves as a standard guideline for benchmark construction and the rigorous evaluation of architecture development. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/Video-Oasis.
summary_zh: 视频理解的固有复杂性使得难以确定性能提升是源于视觉感知、语言推理还是先验知识。尽管已有诸多基准测试用于评估高层次推理能力，但构成视频理解的核心标准在很大程度上仍被忽视。本文并未引入新的基准测试，而是重新审视当前视频理解的研究现状。我们提出Video-Oasis——一个可持续诊断套件，旨在系统评估现有评测方法并提炼出视频理解中的时空挑战要素。通过分析我们获得两个关键发现：(1) 现有基准测试中54%的样本无需视觉输入或时序上下文即可求解；(2) 在剩余样本上，最先进模型的性能表现仅略高于随机猜测水平。为弥合这一差距，我们深入探究了哪些算法设计选择有助于实现稳健的视频理解，为未来研究提供实践指导。本研究期望能为基准测试构建与架构开发的严谨评估提供标准范本。代码已发布于https://github.com/sejong-rcv/Video-Oasis。
tldr: The paper introduces Video-Oasis, a diagnostic suite to evaluate existing video understanding benchmarks and models, finding many samples are solvable without visual or temporal context, and provides guidelines for future research.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 Video-Oasis，一个用于评估现有视频理解基准和模型的诊断套件，发现许多样本无需视觉或时间上下文即可解决，并为未来研究提供指导。

title: FlowID : Enhancing Forensic Identification with Latent Flow-Matching Models
summary: Every day, many people die under violent circumstances, whether from crimes, war, migration, or climate disasters. Medico-legal and law enforcement institutions document many portraits of the deceased for evidence, but cannot immediately carry out identification on them. While traditional image editing tools can process these photos for public release, the workflow is lengthy and produces suboptimal results. In this work, we leverage advances in image generation models, which can now produce photorealistic human portraits, to introduce FlowID, an identity-preserving facial reconstruction method. Our approach combines single-image fine-tuning, which adapts the generative model to out-of-distribution injured faces, with attention-based masking that localizes edits to damaged regions while preserving identity-critical features. Together, these components enable the removal of artifacts from violent death while retaining sufficient identity information to support identification. To evaluate our method, we introduce InjuredFaces, a novel benchmark for identity-preserving facial reconstruction under severe facial damage. Beyond serving as an evaluation tool for this work, InjuredFaces provides a standardized resource for the community to study and compare methods addressing facial reconstruction in extreme conditions. Experimental results show that FlowID outperforms state-of-the-art open-source methods while maintaining low memory requirements, making it suitable for local deployment without compromising data privacy.
summary_zh: 每天都有许多人因暴力环境丧生，包括犯罪、战争、迁徙或气候灾害。法医与执法机构为取证记录了大量死者肖像，但无法立即进行身份识别。传统图像编辑工具虽可处理这些照片供公众发布，但流程冗长且效果欠佳。本研究借助当前能生成逼真人像的图像生成模型技术，提出一种身份保持型面部重建方法FlowID。该方法结合单图像微调技术——使生成模型适应分布外损伤面部，以及基于注意力的掩码机制——将编辑区域定位在受损部位同时保留身份关键特征。二者协同工作，既能消除暴力死亡造成的面部伪影，又能保留足够的身份信息以支持识别。为评估本方法，我们建立了InjuredFaces基准测试集，这是首个针对严重面部损伤下身份保持型面部重建的评估基准。除作为本研究评估工具外，InjuredFaces还为学界研究极端条件下面部重建方法提供了标准化资源。实验结果表明，FlowID在保持低内存需求的同时优于现有开源方法，适合本地部署且不损害数据隐私。
tldr: FlowID is a method for identity-preserving facial reconstruction of injured faces, using fine-tuning and attention-based masking to remove artifacts while preserving identity for forensic identification, evaluated on a new InjuredFaces benchmark.
tldr_zh: FlowID 是一种用于受伤人脸的身份保持面部重建方法，它通过微调和基于注意力的掩码技术来去除损伤区域的人工痕迹，同时保留身份信息，以用于法医鉴定，并在新的 InjuredFaces 基准上进行了评估。

title: All-in-One Augmented Reality Guided Head and Neck Tumor Resection
summary: Positive margins are common in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, yet intraoperative re-resection is often imprecise because margin locations are typically communicated verbally from pathology. We present an all-in-one augmented reality (AR) system that relocalizes positive margins from a resected specimen to the resection bed and visualizes them in situ using HoloLens 2 depth sensing and fully automated markerless surface registration. In a silicone phantom study with six medical trainees, markerless registration achieved target registration errors comparable to a marker-based baseline (median 1.8 mm vs. 1.7 mm; maximum < 4 mm). In a margin relocalization task, AR guidance reduced error from verbal guidance (median 14.2 mm) to a few millimeters (median 3.2 mm), with all AR localizations within 5 mm error. These results support the feasibility of markerless AR margin guidance for more precise intraoperative re-excision.
summary_zh: 在头颈部鳞状细胞癌手术中，切缘阳性情况较为常见，但术中二次切除往往不够精确，因为切缘位置通常由病理科口头传达。本研究提出了一种一体化增强现实系统，该系统利用HoloLens 2的深度传感技术与全自动无标记表面配准，能够将切除标本中的阳性切缘重定位至手术切除床并进行原位可视化。在一项涉及六名医学培训人员的硅胶体模研究中，无标记配准实现了与标记基准相当的目标配准误差（中位数1.8毫米对比1.7毫米；最大误差<4毫米）。在切缘重定位任务中，增强现实引导将口头指导的误差（中位数14.2毫米）降低至毫米级（中位数3.2毫米），所有增强现实定位误差均在5毫米以内。这些结果证实了无标记增强现实切缘引导技术可实现更精确的术中二次切除。
tldr: The paper presents an all-in-one augmented reality system using HoloLens 2 to guide the re-resection of head and neck tumors by relocalizing positive margins from a specimen to the patient's resection bed, improving precision over verbal guidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于HoloLens 2的一体化增强现实系统，用于在头颈部肿瘤手术中，将切除标本的阳性切缘重新定位到患者的手术床，以提高再切除的精确度，效果优于传统口头指导。

title: VecAttention: Vector-wise Sparse Attention for Accelerating Long Context Inference
summary: Long-context video understanding and generation pose a significant computational challenge for Transformer-based video models due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. While existing sparse attention methods employ coarse-grained patterns to improve efficiency, they typically incur redundant computation and suboptimal performance. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose \textbf{VecAttention}, a novel framework of vector-wise sparse attention that achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs for video models.
