We observe that video attention maps exhibit a strong vertical-vector sparse pattern, and further demonstrate that this vertical-vector pattern offers consistently better accuracy-sparsity trade-offs compared with existing coarse-grained sparse patterns. Based on this observation, VecAttention dynamically selects and processes only informative vertical vectors through a lightweight important-vector selection that minimizes memory access overhead and an optimized kernel of vector sparse attention. Comprehensive evaluations on video understanding (VideoMME, LongVideoBench, and VCRBench) and generation (VBench) tasks show that VecAttention delivers a 2.65$\times$ speedup over full attention and a 1.83$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art sparse attention methods, with comparable accuracy to full attention. Our code is available at https://github.com/anminliu/VecAttention.
summary_zh: 摘要：基于Transformer的视频模型在处理长视频理解与生成任务时，因自注意力机制具有二次复杂度而面临显著的计算挑战。现有稀疏注意力方法虽采用粗粒度模式以提升效率，但通常存在冗余计算和次优性能的问题。为应对这一挑战，本文提出\textbf{VecAttention}，一种新颖的向量级稀疏注意力框架，可为视频模型实现更优的精度-效率权衡。我们发现视频注意力图谱表现出强烈的垂直向量稀疏模式，并进一步证明该垂直向量模式相较于现有粗粒度稀疏模式，能持续提供更优的精度-稀疏度平衡。基于此观察，VecAttention通过轻量级重要向量选择机制动态筛选并仅处理信息丰富的垂直向量，该机制能最小化内存访问开销，并配合优化的向量稀疏注意力内核实现高效计算。在视频理解（VideoMME、LongVideoBench和VCRBench）与生成（VBench）任务上的全面评估表明，VecAttention相比全注意力机制实现2.65倍加速，相较于当前最先进的稀疏注意力方法获得1.83倍加速，同时保持与全注意力相当的精度。代码已开源：https://github.com/anminliu/VecAttention。
tldr: VecAttention is a vector-wise sparse attention framework for accelerating long-context video models, achieving significant speedups over full attention and other sparse methods with comparable accuracy.
tldr_zh: VecAttention是一种用于加速长上下文视频模型的向量稀疏注意力框架，相比全注意力和其他稀疏方法，在保持准确性的同时实现了显著的加速。

title: Square Superpixel Generation and Representation Learning via Granular Ball Computing
summary: Superpixels provide a compact region-based representation that preserves object boundaries and local structures, and have therefore been widely used in a variety of vision tasks to reduce computational cost. However, most existing superpixel algorithms produce irregularly shaped regions, which are not well aligned with regular operators such as convolutions. Consequently, superpixels are often treated as an offline preprocessing step, limiting parallel implementation and hindering end-to-end optimization within deep learning pipelines. Motivated by the adaptive representation and coverage property of granular-ball computing, we develop a square superpixel generation approach. Specifically, we approximate superpixels using multi-scale square blocks to avoid the computational and implementation difficulties induced by irregular shapes, enabling efficient parallel processing and learnable feature extraction. For each block, a purity score is computed based on pixel-intensity similarity, and high-quality blocks are selected accordingly. The resulting square superpixels can be readily integrated as graph nodes in graph neural networks (GNNs) or as tokens in Vision Transformers (ViTs), facilitating multi-scale information aggregation and structured visual representation. Experimental results on downstream tasks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 超像素提供了一种紧凑的基于区域的表示方法，能够保留物体边界和局部结构，因而被广泛应用于各类视觉任务中以降低计算成本。然而，现有大多数超像素算法生成的区域形状不规则，难以与卷积等规则算子对齐。这导致超像素通常被视为离线预处理步骤，限制了并行实现能力，并阻碍了深度学习流程中的端到端优化。受粒球计算的自适应表示与覆盖特性启发，我们提出了一种方形超像素生成方法。具体而言，我们采用多尺度方形块来逼近超像素，以规避不规则形状带来的计算与实现难题，从而实现高效并行处理与可学习的特征提取。针对每个方形块，我们基于像素强度相似度计算纯度评分，并据此筛选高质量块。生成的方形超像素可直接作为图神经网络中的图节点或视觉Transformer中的令牌，促进多尺度信息聚合与结构化视觉表示。下游任务的实验结果表明，该方法能持续提升性能，验证了其有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating square superpixels using granular-ball computing to enable efficient parallel processing and integration into deep learning pipelines for improved visual representation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用粒度球计算生成方形超像素的方法，以实现高效的并行处理，并融入深度学习流程以改进视觉表示。

title: Assessing Multimodal Chronic Wound Embeddings with Expert Triplet Agreement
summary: Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) is a rare genetic skin disorder for which clinicians greatly benefit from finding similar cases using images and clinical text. However, off-the-shelf foundation models do not reliably capture clinically meaningful features for this heterogeneous, long-tail disease, and structured measurement of agreement with experts is challenging. To address these gaps, we propose evaluating embedding spaces with expert ordinal comparisons (triplet judgments), which are fast to collect and encode implicit clinical similarity knowledge. We further introduce TriDerm, a multimodal framework that learns interpretable wound representations from small cohorts by integrating wound imagery, boundary masks, and expert reports. On the vision side, TriDerm adapts visual foundation models to RDEB using wound-level attention pooling and non-contrastive representation learning. For text, we prompt large language models with comparison queries and recover medically meaningful representations via soft ordinal embeddings (SOE). We show that visual and textual modalities capture complementary aspects of wound phenotype, and that fusing both modalities yields 73.5% agreement with experts, outperforming the best off-the-shelf single-modality foundation model by over 5.6 percentage points. We make the expert annotation tool, model code and representative dataset samples publicly available.
summary_zh: 隐性营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症（RDEB）是一种罕见的遗传性皮肤疾病。临床医生通过图像和临床文本来寻找相似病例能极大获益。然而，现有基础模型无法可靠捕捉这种异质性长尾疾病中具有临床意义的特征，且难以与专家意见进行结构化一致性度量。为解决这些问题，我们提出利用专家序数比较（三元组判断）来评估嵌入空间，该方法能快速收集数据并编码隐含的临床相似性知识。我们进一步开发了TriDerm——一个多模态框架，通过整合伤口图像、边界掩码和专家报告，能够从小规模队列中学习可解释的伤口表征。在视觉方面，TriDerm通过伤口级注意力池化和非对比表征学习技术，使视觉基础模型适应RDEB特定需求。在文本处理上，我们采用大型语言模型处理比较查询，并通过软序数嵌入（SOE）技术重建具有医学意义的表征。实验表明，视觉与文本模态能捕捉伤口表型的互补特征，双模态融合后与专家判断的一致性达到73.5%，较最优单模态基础模型提升超过5.6个百分点。我们已公开专家标注工具、模型代码及代表性数据集样本。
tldr: This paper introduces TriDerm, a multimodal framework for learning clinically meaningful representations of chronic wounds from images and text using expert triplet judgments, tailored to a rare skin disorder. It focuses on adapting vision and language foundation models for medical case similarity, not for robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了TriDerm框架，一种利用专家三元组判断从图像和文本中学习慢性伤口临床意义表示的多模态方法，专门针对一种罕见皮肤病。其重点在于为医疗病例相似性适配视觉和语言基础模型，而非机器人或具身AI。

title: StereoVGGT: A Training-Free Visual Geometry Transformer for Stereo Vision
summary: Driven by the advancement of 3D devices, stereo vision tasks including stereo matching and stereo conversion have emerged as a critical research frontier. Contemporary stereo vision backbones typically rely on either monocular depth estimation (MDE) models or visual foundation models (VFMs). Crucially, these models are predominantly pretrained without explicit supervision of camera poses. Given that such geometric knowledge is indispensable for stereo vision, the absence of explicit spatial constraints constitutes a significant performance bottleneck for existing architectures. Recognizing that the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) operates as a foundation model pretrained on extensive 3D priors, including camera poses, we investigate its potential as a robust backbone for stereo vision tasks. Nevertheless, empirical results indicate that its direct application to stereo vision yields suboptimal performance. We observe that VGGT suffers from a more significant degradation of geometric details during feature extraction. Such characteristics conflict with the requirements of binocular stereo vision, thereby constraining its efficacy for relative tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose StereoVGGT, a feature backbone specifically tailored for stereo vision. By leveraging the frozen VGGT and introducing a training-free feature adjustment pipeline, we mitigate geometric degradation and harness the latent camera calibration knowledge embedded within the model. StereoVGGT-based stereo matching network achieved the $1^{st}$ rank among all published methods on the KITTI benchmark, validating that StereoVGGT serves as a highly effective backbone for stereo vision.
summary_zh: 随着三维设备技术的进步，包括立体匹配和立体转换在内的立体视觉任务已成为关键的研究前沿。当前的立体视觉主干网络通常依赖于单目深度估计（MDE）模型或视觉基础模型（VFMs）。这些模型在预训练阶段通常缺少对相机姿态的显式监督，而几何知识是立体视觉不可或缺的要素，这种显式空间约束的缺失构成了现有架构显著的性能瓶颈。鉴于视觉几何基础变换器（VGGT）是一种在大规模包含相机姿态等三维先验数据上预训练的基础模型，我们探索其作为立体视觉任务鲁棒主干网络的潜力。然而，实验结果表明，直接将其应用于立体视觉任务会导致次优性能。我们观察到，VGGT在特征提取过程中存在几何细节的严重退化，这种特性与双目立体视觉的需求相悖，从而限制了其在相关任务上的有效性。为填补这一差距，我们提出专为立体视觉设计的特征主干网络StereoVGGT。通过利用冻结的VGGT参数并引入无需训练的特征调整流程，我们有效缓解了几何退化问题，并充分挖掘了模型中隐含的相机标定知识。基于StereoVGGT的立体匹配网络在KITTI基准测试中取得了所有已发表方法中的第一名，证实了StereoVGGT作为立体视觉任务高效主干网络的卓越性能。
tldr: The paper proposes StereoVGGT, a training-free visual backbone for stereo vision tasks by adapting a pre-trained 3D-aware transformer to mitigate geometric degradation, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 StereoVGGT，一种用于立体视觉任务的免训练视觉骨干网络，通过适配预训练的3D感知Transformer来缓解几何细节退化，在KITTI基准上取得了SOTA结果。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Prediction: A Unified Framework Harnessing Positional and Semantic Uncertainties
summary: Trajectory prediction seeks to forecast the future motion of dynamic entities, such as vehicles and pedestrians, given a temporal horizon of historical movement data and environmental context. A central challenge in this domain is the inherent uncertainty in real-time maps, arising from two primary sources: (1) positional inaccuracies due to sensor limitations or environmental occlusions, and (2) semantic errors stemming from misinterpretations of scene context. To address these challenges, we propose a novel unified framework that jointly models positional and semantic uncertainties and explicitly integrates them into the trajectory prediction pipeline. Our approach employs a dual-head architecture to independently estimate semantic and positional predictions in a dual-pass manner, deriving prediction variances as uncertainty indicators in an end-to-end fashion. These uncertainties are subsequently fused with the semantic and positional predictions to enhance the robustness of trajectory forecasts. We evaluate our uncertainty-aware framework on the nuScenes real-world driving dataset, conducting extensive experiments across four map estimation methods and two trajectory prediction baselines. Results verify that our method (1) effectively quantifies map uncertainties through both positional and semantic dimensions, and (2) consistently improves the performance of existing trajectory prediction models across multiple metrics, including minimum Average Displacement Error (minADE), minimum Final Displacement Error (minFDE), and Miss Rate (MR). Code will available at https://github.com/JT-Sun/UATP.
summary_zh: 轨迹预测旨在根据历史运动数据和环境上下文的时间范围，预测动态实体（如车辆和行人）的未来运动。该领域的核心挑战在于实时地图中固有的不确定性，这种不确定性主要源于两个方面：（1）由于传感器限制或环境遮挡导致的位置误差；（2）源于场景上下文误读的语义错误。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的统一框架，该框架联合建模位置和语义不确定性，并将其显式地集成到轨迹预测流程中。我们的方法采用双头架构，以双通道方式独立估计语义和位置预测，以端到端的方式推导预测方差作为不确定性指标。这些不确定性随后与语义和位置预测融合，以增强轨迹预测的鲁棒性。我们在nuScenes真实世界驾驶数据集上评估了该不确定性感知框架，并在四种地图估计方法和两种轨迹预测基线上进行了大量实验。结果表明，我们的方法（1）通过位置和语义维度有效量化了地图不确定性，并且（2）在多项指标上持续提升了现有轨迹预测模型的性能，包括最小平均位移误差（minADE）、最小最终位移误差（minFDE）和漏检率（MR）。代码将在https://github.com/JT-Sun/UATP提供。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework for trajectory prediction that jointly models and integrates positional and semantic uncertainties to improve forecasting robustness, evaluated on the autonomous driving dataset nuScenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于轨迹预测的统一框架，联合建模并整合了位置和语义不确定性以提高预测鲁棒性，并在自动驾驶数据集nuScenes上进行了评估。

title: HSFM: Hard-Set-Guided Feature-Space Meta-Learning for Robust Classification under Spurious Correlations
summary: Deep neural networks often rely on spurious features to make predictions, which makes them brittle under distribution shift and on samples where the spurious correlation does not hold (e.g., minority-group examples). Recent studies have shown that, even in such settings, the feature extractor of an Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM)-trained model can learn rich and informative representations, and that much of the failure may be attributed to the classifier head. In particular, retraining a lightweight head while keeping the backbone frozen can substantially improve performance on shifted distributions and minority groups. Motivated by this observation, we propose a bilevel meta-learning method that performs augmentation directly in feature space to improve spurious correlation handling in the classifier head. Our method learns support-side feature edits such that, after a small number of inner-loop updates on the edited features, the classifier achieves lower loss on hard examples and improved worst-group performance. By operating at the backbone output rather than in pixel space or through end-to-end optimization, the method is highly efficient and stable, requiring only a few minutes of training on a single GPU. We further validate our method with CLIP-based visualizations, showing that the learned feature-space updates induce semantically meaningful shifts aligned with spurious attributes.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络常依赖伪相关特征进行预测，这使得它们在分布偏移及伪相关关系不成立的样本（如少数群体样本）上表现脆弱。最近研究表明，即便在此类场景下，经验风险最小化（ERM）训练模型的特征提取器仍能学习到丰富且信息量大的表征，而大部分失败可能归因于分类器头部。具体而言，在保持主干网络冻结的情况下重训练轻量级分类器头部，能显著提升模型在分布偏移和少数群体样本上的性能。基于此观察，我们提出一种双层元学习方法，直接在特征空间中进行数据增强以改善分类器头部对伪相关关系的处理能力。该方法通过学习支持侧的特征编辑，使得分类器在编辑后的特征上进行少量内循环更新后，能够在困难样本上获得更低损失并提升最差群体性能。通过作用于主干网络输出端而非像素空间或端到端优化，该方法具备高效率和稳定性，仅需在单GPU上训练数分钟。我们进一步通过基于CLIP的可视化方法验证了本方法，结果表明所学习的特征空间更新能诱发与伪相关属性对齐的语义意义偏移。
tldr: This paper proposes a feature-space meta-learning method, HSFM, to improve classifier robustness against spurious correlations by learning to edit backbone features, which is efficient and demonstrates improved worst-group performance on image classification tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种特征空间元学习方法HSFM，通过学习编辑骨干网络的特征来提高分类器对抗伪相关性的鲁棒性，该方法高效且在图像分类任务上展示了改进的最差组性能。

title: Self-Consistency for LLM-Based Motion Trajectory Generation and Verification
summary: Self-consistency has proven to be an effective technique for improving LLM performance on natural language reasoning tasks in a lightweight, unsupervised manner. In this work, we study how to adapt self-consistency to visual domains. Specifically, we consider the generation and verification of LLM-produced motion graphics trajectories. Given a prompt (e.g., "Move the circle in a spiral path"), we first sample diverse motion trajectories from an LLM, and then identify groups of consistent trajectories via clustering. Our key insight is to model the family of shapes associated with a prompt as a prototype trajectory paired with a group of geometric transformations (e.g., rigid, similarity, and affine). Two trajectories can then be considered consistent if one can be transformed into the other under the warps allowable by the transformation group. We propose an algorithm that automatically recovers a shape family, using hierarchical relationships between a set of candidate transformation groups. Our approach improves the accuracy of LLM-based trajectory generation by 4-6%. We further extend our method to support verification, observing 11% precision gains over VLM baselines. Our code and dataset are available at https://majiaju.io/trajectory-self-consistency .
summary_zh: 自洽性已被证明是一种轻量级、无监督提升大语言模型在自然语言推理任务上性能的有效技术。本文研究如何将自洽性方法适配到视觉领域。具体而言，我们探讨大语言模型生成的运动图形轨迹的生成与验证问题。给定一个提示（例如“让圆沿螺旋路径移动”），我们首先从大语言模型中采样多样化的运动轨迹，然后通过聚类识别出具有一致性的轨迹组。我们的核心思路是将提示所对应的形状族建模为一个原型轨迹与一组几何变换（如刚性、相似和仿射变换）的组合。若两条轨迹在变换组允许的形变下可相互转换，则视为彼此一致。我们提出一种算法，利用候选变换组间的层级关系自动重构形状族。该方法将基于大语言模型的轨迹生成准确率提升了4-6%。我们进一步扩展该方法以支持验证任务，相比视觉语言模型基线实现了11%的精确度提升。相关代码与数据集已公开于https://majiaju.io/trajectory-self-consistency。
tldr: This paper adapts self-consistency techniques from LLMs to improve the generation and verification of motion graphics trajectories based on natural language prompts, using geometric transformations to define shape families for consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文将LLM的自一致性技术应用于视觉领域，通过几何变换定义形状族来提升基于自然语言提示的运动图形轨迹生成与验证的准确性。

title: GazeCLIP: Gaze-Guided CLIP with Adaptive-Enhanced Fine-Grained Language Prompt for Deepfake Attribution and Detection
summary: Current deepfake attribution or deepfake detection works tend to exhibit poor generalization to novel generative methods due to the limited exploration in visual modalities alone. They tend to assess the attribution or detection performance of models on unseen advanced generators, coarsely, and fail to consider the synergy of the two tasks. To this end, we propose a novel gaze-guided CLIP with adaptive-enhanced fine-grained language prompts for fine-grained deepfake attribution and detection (DFAD). Specifically, we conduct a novel and fine-grained benchmark to evaluate the DFAD performance of networks on novel generators like diffusion and flow models. Additionally, we introduce a gaze-aware model based on CLIP, which is devised to enhance the generalization to unseen face forgery attacks. Built upon the novel observation that there are significant distribution differences between pristine and forged gaze vectors, and the preservation of the target gaze in facial images generated by GAN and diffusion varies significantly, we design a visual perception encoder to employ the inherent gaze differences to mine global forgery embeddings across appearance and gaze domains. We propose a gaze-aware image encoder (GIE) that fuses forgery gaze prompts extracted via a gaze encoder with common forged image embeddings to capture general attribution patterns, allowing features to be transformed into a more stable and common DFAD feature space. We build a language refinement encoder (LRE) to generate dynamically enhanced language embeddings via an adaptive-enhanced word selector for precise vision-language matching. Extensive experiments on our benchmark show that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art by 6.56% ACC and 5.32% AUC in average performance under the attribution and detection settings, respectively. Codes will be available on GitHub.
summary_zh: 当前深度伪造溯源或检测方法由于仅局限于视觉模态的探索，往往在面对新型生成方法时表现出泛化能力不足。这些方法通常粗略评估模型在未见过的先进生成器上的溯源或检测性能，未能充分考虑两项任务之间的协同作用。为此，我们提出一种新颖的视线引导CLIP框架，结合自适应增强的细粒度语言提示，用于细粒度深度伪造溯源与检测。具体而言，我们构建了一个新颖且细粒度的基准测试，以评估网络在扩散模型与流模型等新型生成器上的深度伪造溯源与检测性能。此外，我们引入了一种基于CLIP的视线感知模型，旨在增强对未见过的面部伪造攻击的泛化能力。基于一项新发现——真实图像与伪造图像的视线向量分布存在显著差异，且GAN与扩散模型生成的面部图像中目标视线的保留程度差异明显——我们设计了一个视觉感知编码器，利用固有的视线差异挖掘跨外观与视线域的全局伪造嵌入特征。我们提出了一种视线感知图像编码器，通过融合视线编码器提取的伪造视线提示与常见的伪造图像嵌入，以捕捉通用的溯源模式，使特征能够转换至更稳定、通用的深度伪造溯源与检测特征空间。我们还构建了一个语言精炼编码器，通过自适应增强的词语选择器生成动态增强的语言嵌入，以实现精准的视觉-语言匹配。在基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的模型在溯源与检测设置下的平均性能分别以6.56%的准确率和5.32%的AUC值优于当前最先进方法。相关代码将在GitHub上公开。
tldr: This paper presents GazeCLIP, a method for deepfake detection and attribution using gaze-guided visual features and adaptive language prompts, tested on a novel benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GazeCLIP，一种利用视线引导的视觉特征和自适应语言提示进行深度伪造检测和归因的方法，并在一个新基准上进行了测试。

title: Unbiased Model Prediction Without Using Protected Attribute Information
summary: The problem of bias persists in the deep learning community as models continue to provide disparate performance across different demographic subgroups. Therefore, several algorithms have been proposed to improve the fairness of deep models. However, a majority of these algorithms utilize the protected attribute information for bias mitigation, which severely limits their application in real-world scenarios. To address this concern, we have proposed a novel algorithm, termed as \textbf{Non-Protected Attribute-based Debiasing (NPAD)} algorithm for bias mitigation, that does not require the protected attribute information. The proposed NPAD algorithm utilizes the auxiliary information provided by the non-protected attributes to optimize the model for bias mitigation. Further, two different loss functions, \textbf{Debiasing via Attribute Cluster Loss (DACL)} and \textbf{Filter Redundancy Loss (FRL)} have been proposed to optimize the model for fairness goals. Multiple experiments are performed on the LFWA and CelebA datasets for facial attribute prediction, and a significant reduction in bias across different gender and age subgroups is observed.
summary_zh: 深度学习领域中的偏见问题依然存在，模型在不同人口统计子组间的性能表现持续存在差异。因此，已有多种算法被提出以提升深度学习模型的公平性。然而，这些算法大多依赖于使用受保护属性信息来缓解偏见，这极大地限制了其在现实场景中的应用。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种新型算法——**基于非保护属性的去偏（NPAD）**算法，该算法无需依赖受保护属性信息即可实现偏见缓解。所提出的NPAD算法利用非保护属性提供的辅助信息，通过优化模型来减轻偏见。此外，本文还设计了两种不同的损失函数——**基于属性聚类损失的去偏（DACL）**与**过滤冗余损失（FRL）**，以优化模型并实现公平性目标。在LFWA和CelebA数据集上进行的人脸属性预测多项实验表明，该算法在不同性别与年龄子组中均能显著降低模型偏见。
tldr: The paper proposes a new algorithm for debiasing deep learning models without using protected attribute information, using non-protected attribute data and novel loss functions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的算法，无需使用受保护属性信息，通过非保护属性数据和新型损失函数来减轻深度学习模型的偏见。

title: CCDNet: Learning to Detect Camouflage against Distractors in Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared target detection (IRSTD) tasks have critical applications in areas like wilderness rescue and maritime search. However, detecting infrared targets is challenging due to their low contrast and tendency to blend into complex backgrounds, effectively camouflaging themselves. Additionally, other objects with similar features (distractors) can cause false alarms, further degrading detection performance. To address these issues, we propose a novel \textbf{C}amouflage-aware \textbf{C}ounter-\textbf{D}istraction \textbf{Net}work (CCDNet) in this paper. We design a backbone with Weighted Multi-branch Perceptrons (WMPs), which aggregates self-conditioned multi-level features to accurately represent the target and background. Based on these rich features, we then propose a novel Aggregation-and-Refinement Fusion Neck (ARFN) to refine structures/semantics from shallow/deep features maps, and bidirectionally reconstruct the relations between the targets and the backgrounds, highlighting the targets while suppressing the complex backgrounds to improve detection accuracy. Furthermore, we present a new Contrastive-aided Distractor Discriminator (CaDD), enforcing adaptive similarity computation both locally and globally between the real targets and the backgrounds to more precisely discriminate distractors, so as to reduce the false alarm rate. Extensive experiments on infrared image datasets confirm that CCDNet outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 红外目标检测任务在野外救援与海上搜救等领域具有关键应用价值。然而，由于红外目标对比度低且易与复杂背景相融合，形成有效伪装，检测工作面临巨大挑战。此外，具有相似特征的其他物体（干扰物）可能引发误报，进一步降低检测性能。为解决这些问题，本文提出一种新型的**伪装感知反干扰网络**（CCDNet）。我们设计了基于加权多分支感知器的主干网络，通过聚合自调节的多层次特征来精确表征目标与背景。基于这些丰富的特征，我们进一步提出一种新颖的聚合优化融合模块，用于从浅层/深层特征图中优化结构/语义信息，并双向重构目标与背景间的关联关系，在抑制复杂背景的同时突出目标特征以提升检测精度。此外，我们还提出一种对比辅助干扰物判别器，通过在局部和全局范围内对真实目标与背景进行自适应相似度计算，从而更精准地识别干扰物，有效降低误报率。在红外图像数据集上的大量实验表明，CCDNet的性能优于当前最先进的其他方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel network for infrared small target detection by focusing on camouflage-aware feature extraction and distractor discrimination, which is tested on infrared image datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的网络用于红外小目标检测，通过关注伪装感知特征提取和干扰物辨别，并在红外图像数据集上进行了验证。

title: SparseDriveV2: Scoring is All You Need for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end multi-modal planning has been widely adopted to model the uncertainty of driving behavior, typically by scoring candidate trajectories and selecting the optimal one. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: scoring a large static trajectory vocabulary, or scoring a small set of dynamically generated proposals. While static vocabularies often suffer from coarse discretization of the action space, dynamic proposals provide finer-grained precision and have shown stronger empirical performance on existing benchmarks. However, it remains unclear whether dynamic generation is fundamentally necessary, or whether static vocabularies can already achieve comparable performance when they are sufficiently dense to cover the action space. In this work, we start with a systematic scaling study of Hydra-MDP, a representative scoring-based method, revealing that performance consistently improves as trajectory anchors become denser, without exhibiting saturation before computational constraints are reached. Motivated by this observation, we propose SparseDriveV2 to push the performance boundary of scoring-based planning through two complementary innovations: (1) a scalable vocabulary representation with a factorized structure that decomposes trajectories into geometric paths and velocity profiles, enabling combinatorial coverage of the action space, and (2) a scalable scoring strategy with coarse factorized scoring over paths and velocity profiles followed by fine-grained scoring on a small set of composed trajectories. By combining these two techniques, SparseDriveV2 achieves 92.0 PDMS and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM, with 89.15 Driving Score and 70.00 Success Rate on Bench2Drive with a lightweight ResNet-34 as backbone. Code and model are released at https://github.com/swc-17/SparseDriveV2.
summary_zh: 端到端多模态规划已广泛用于建模驾驶行为的不确定性，通常通过对候选轨迹进行评分并选择最优轨迹来实现。现有方法主要分为两类：对大型静态轨迹词典进行评分，或对少量动态生成的提案进行评分。静态词典常因动作空间的离散化过于粗略而受限，动态提案则能提供更精细的精度，并在现有基准测试中表现出更强的实证性能。然而，动态生成是否从根本上具有必要性，或者当静态词典足够密集以覆盖动作空间时能否达到可比性能，这一问题仍未明确。本研究首先对基于评分的代表性方法 Hydra-MDP 进行了系统性规模扩展研究，结果表明：在计算约束达到之前，随着轨迹锚点密度增加，性能持续提升且未出现饱和现象。受此启发，我们提出 SparseDriveV2，通过两项互补的创新来突破基于评分规划的性能边界：（1）采用可扩展的因子化词典表示，将轨迹分解为几何路径和速度曲线，实现对动作空间的组合覆盖；（2）设计可扩展的评分策略，先对路径和速度曲线进行粗粒度因子化评分，再对少量组合轨迹进行细粒度评分。结合这两项技术，SparseDriveV2 在轻量化 ResNet-34 骨干网络下，于 NAVSIM 数据集上实现了 92.0 PDMS 和 90.1 EPDMS 的指标，在 Bench2Drive 数据集上获得 89.15 驾驶评分和 70.00 成功率。代码与模型发布于 https://github.com/swc-17/SparseDriveV2。
tldr: This paper proposes a dense static trajectory scoring method for end-to-end autonomous driving planning, which outperforms dynamic proposal methods on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶规划的密集静态轨迹评分方法，在标准基准测试中超越了动态提案方法的性能。

title: Dual-Imbalance Continual Learning for Real-World Food Recognition
summary: Visual food recognition in real-world dietary logging scenarios naturally exhibits severe data imbalance, where a small number of food categories appear frequently while many others occur rarely, resulting in long-tailed class distributions. In practice, food recognition systems often operate in a continual learning setting, where new categories are introduced sequentially over time. However, existing studies typically assume that each incremental step introduces a similar number of new food classes, which rarely happens in real world where the number of newly observed categories can vary significantly across steps, leading to highly uneven learning dynamics. As a result, continual food recognition exhibits a dual imbalance: imbalanced samples within each food class and imbalanced numbers of new food classes to learn at each incremental learning step. In this work, we introduce DIME, a Dual-Imbalance-aware Adapter Merging framework for continual food recognition. DIME learns lightweight adapters for each task using parameter-efficient fine-tuning and progressively integrates them through a class-count guided spectral merging strategy. A rank-wise threshold modulation mechanism further stabilizes the merging process by preserving dominant knowledge while allowing adaptive updates. The resulting model maintains a single merged adapter for inference, enabling efficient deployment without accumulating task-specific modules. Experiments on realistic long-tailed food benchmarks under our step-imbalanced setup show that the proposed method consistently improves by more than 3% over the strongest existing continual learning baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoyanzhang1/DIME.
summary_zh: 现实世界饮食记录场景中的视觉食物识别天然呈现严重的数据不平衡问题，即少量食物类别频繁出现而多数类别则极少出现，从而形成长尾类分布。在实际应用中，食物识别系统通常运行于持续学习环境中，新类别会随时间推移而陆续出现。然而现有研究通常假设每个增量阶段引入的新食物类别数量相近，这与现实情况严重不符——新观察到的类别数量在不同阶段可能存在显著差异，导致学习动态呈现高度不均衡性。因此，持续食物识别面临双重不平衡挑战：各食物类别内部的样本数量不平衡，以及每个增量学习阶段需学习的新食物类别数量不平衡。本文提出DIME框架，一种面向持续食物识别的双重不平衡感知适配器融合方法。该框架通过参数高效微调技术为每个任务学习轻量级适配器，并基于类别数量引导的光谱融合策略进行渐进式集成。通过秩阈值调制机制进一步稳定融合过程，在保留主导知识的同时实现自适应更新。最终模型仅需维护单个融合适配器即可完成推理，无需累积任务特定模块即可实现高效部署。在步长不平衡设置下的现实长尾食物基准测试表明，该方法相较于现有最强持续学习基线模型获得超过3%的稳定性能提升。代码已发布于https://github.com/xiaoyanzhang1/DIME。
tldr: This paper introduces DIME, a framework for continual visual food recognition that addresses dual data imbalance issues (within-class and step-imbalanced new classes) using lightweight adapters and a class-count guided spectral merging strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DIME框架，用于解决持续食物识别中的双重数据不平衡问题，通过轻量级适配器和类计数引导的光谱融合策略来应对类内和步间新类别的不平衡。

title: Enhancing Box and Block Test with Computer Vision for Post-Stroke Upper Extremity Motor Evaluation
summary: Standard clinical assessments of upper-extremity motor function after stroke either rely on ordinal scoring, which lacks sensitivity, or time-based task metrics, which do not capture movement quality. In this work, we present a computer vision-based framework for analysis of upper-extremity movement during the Box and Block Test (BBT) through world-aligned joint angles of fingers, arm, and trunk without depth sensors or calibration objects. We apply this framework to a dataset of 136 BBT recordings collected from 48 healthy individuals and 7 individuals post stroke. Using unsupervised dimensionality reduction of joint-angle features, we analyze movement patterns without relying on expert clinical labels. The resulting embeddings show separation between healthy movement patterns and stroke-related movement deviations. Importantly, some patients with the same BBT scores can be separated with different postural patterns. These results show that world-aligned joint angles can capture meaningful information of upper-extremity functions beyond standard time-based BBT scores, with no effort from the clinician other than monocular video recordings of the patient using a phone or camera. This work highlights the potential of a camera-based, calibration-free framework to measure movement quality in clinical assessments without changing the widely adopted clinical routine.
summary_zh: 对脑卒中后上肢运动功能的标准临床评估通常依赖于序数评分法（缺乏敏感性）或基于时间的任务指标（无法捕捉运动质量）。本研究提出一种基于计算机视觉的框架，通过世界坐标系对齐的指关节、手臂和躯干角度，在没有深度传感器或校准物体的情况下，分析盒块测试（BBT）中的上肢运动。我们将该框架应用于从48名健康个体和7名脑卒中后患者收集的136次BBT录像数据集。通过关节角度特征的无监督降维，我们在不依赖临床专家标签的情况下分析了运动模式。所得嵌入结果显示健康运动模式与脑卒中相关运动偏差之间存在明显区分。重要的是，部分具有相同BBT评分的患者可通过不同姿势模式进行区分。这些结果表明，世界坐标系对齐的关节角度能够捕捉超出标准时间型BBT评分之外的上肢功能信息，临床医生仅需使用手机或摄像机对患者进行单目视频录制即可实现。本研究彰显了基于摄像头的无校准框架在临床评估中测量运动质量的潜力，且无需改变广泛采用的临床常规流程。
tldr: This paper presents a computer vision framework for analyzing upper-extremity motor function during the Box and Block Test using monocular video, focusing on post-stroke rehabilitation assessment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于计算机视觉的框架，用于分析单目视频中的上肢运动功能，专注于脑卒中后康复评估。

title: TrajectoryMover: Generative Movement of Object Trajectories in Videos
summary: Generative video editing has enabled several intuitive editing operations for short video clips that would previously have been difficult to achieve, especially for non-expert editors. Existing methods focus on prescribing an object's 3D or 2D motion trajectory in a video, or on altering the appearance of an object or a scene, while preserving both the video's plausibility and identity. Yet a method to move an object's 3D motion trajectory in a video, i.e., moving an object while preserving its relative 3D motion, is currently still missing. The main challenge lies in obtaining paired video data for this scenario. Previous methods typically rely on clever data generation approaches to construct plausible paired data from unpaired videos, but this approach fails if one of the videos in a pair can not easily be constructed from the other. Instead, we introduce TrajectoryAtlas, a new data generation pipeline for large-scale synthetic paired video data and a video generator TrajectoryMover fine-tuned with this data. We show that this successfully enables generative movement of object trajectories. Project page: https://chhatrekiran.github.io/trajectorymover
summary_zh:
摘要：
生成式视频编辑为短视频片段提供了多种直观的编辑功能，这些功能在以往难以实现，尤其对于非专业编辑者而言。现有方法侧重于规定视频中物体的三维或二维运动轨迹，或改变物体及场景的外观，同时保持视频的合理性与身份一致性。然而，目前仍缺乏一种能够移动物体在视频中的三维运动轨迹的方法，即在保持其相对三维运动关系的同时移动物体。其主要挑战在于如何获取适用于该场景的成对视频数据。以往方法通常依赖巧妙的数据生成策略，从非成对视频中构建合理的成对数据，但若成对视频中的一方难以通过另一方生成，该方法便会失效。为此，我们提出TrajectoryAtlas——一个用于大规模合成成对视频数据的新数据生成流程，并基于此数据微调出视频生成器TrajectoryMover。研究表明，该方法成功实现了对物体轨迹的生成式移动。项目页面：https://chhatrekiran.github.io/trajectorymover
tldr: This paper introduces a method for editing object motion trajectories in videos, focusing on generating synthetic paired data and a video generator to manipulate 3D object movement.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种编辑视频中物体运动轨迹的方法，专注于生成合成配对数据和一个视频生成器来操纵3D物体运动。

title: Is the Modality Gap a Bug or a Feature? A Robustness Perspective
summary: Many modern multi-modal models (e.g. CLIP) seek an embedding space in which the two modalities are aligned. Somewhat surprisingly, almost all existing models show a strong modality gap: the distribution of images is well-separated from the distribution of texts in the shared embedding space. Despite a series of recent papers on this topic, it is still not clear why this gap exists nor whether closing the gap in post-processing will lead to better performance on downstream tasks. In this paper we show that under certain conditions, minimizing the contrastive loss yields a representation in which the two modalities are separated by a global gap vector that is orthogonal to their embeddings. We also show that under these conditions the modality gap is monotonically related to robustness: decreasing the gap does not change the clean accuracy of the models but makes it less likely that a model will change its output when the embeddings are perturbed. Our experiments show that for many real-world VLMs we can significantly increase robustness by a simple post-processing step that moves one modality towards the mean of the other modality, without any loss of clean accuracy.
summary_zh: 许多现代多模态模型（如CLIP）致力于寻找一个对齐两种模态的嵌入空间。令人意外的是，几乎所有现有模型都表现出明显的模态间隙：在共享嵌入空间中，图像的分布与文本的分布存在显著分离。尽管近期有一系列论文探讨此问题，但这一间隙的成因仍未明确，后处理中消除该间隙是否有助于提升下游任务性能亦无定论。本文研究表明，在特定条件下，最小化对比损失会生成一种表征，其中两种模态由一个全局间隙向量分隔，该向量与它们的嵌入表示正交。研究还发现，在此条件下，模态间隙与模型鲁棒性呈单调相关：缩小间隙不会改变模型在原始数据上的准确性，但会降低嵌入表示受到扰动时模型输出变化的可能性。实验表明，对于许多现实中的视觉语言模型，通过一种简单的后处理步骤——将一种模态的表示向另一模态的均值方向移动，即可显著增强鲁棒性，且不损失原始准确性。
tldr: This paper analyzes the modality gap in multi-modal models like CLIP, showing it is a byproduct of contrastive loss and can enhance robustness. It suggests a simple post-processing step to move one modality's embeddings towards the other's mean, improving robustness without affecting clean accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了CLIP等多模态模型中的模态间隙，证明其是对比损失优化的结果，并证明其能增强模型鲁棒性。研究提出一种简单的后处理步骤，将一种模态的嵌入向另一种模态的均值移动，可在不影响准确率的前提下提升鲁棒性。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Noise Pretraining for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: The approximation and convergence properties of implicit neural representations (INRs) are known to be highly sensitive to parameter initialization strategies. While several data-driven initialization methods demonstrate significant improvements over standard random sampling, the reasons for their success -- specifically, whether they encode classical statistical signal priors or more complex features -- remain poorly understood. In this study, we explore this phenomenon through a series of experimental analyses leveraging noise pretraining. We pretrain INRs on diverse noise classes (e.g., Gaussian, Dead Leaves, Spectral) and measure their ability to both fit unseen signals and encode priors for an inverse imaging task (denoising). Our analyses on image and video data reveal a surprising finding: simply pretraining on unstructured noise (Uniform, Gaussian) dramatically improves signal fitting capacity compared to all other baselines. However, unstructured noise also yields poor deep image priors for denoising. In contrast, we also find that noise with the classic $1/|f^α|$ spectral structure of natural images achieves an excellent balance of signal fitting and inverse imaging capabilities, performing on par with the best data-driven initialization methods. This finding enables more efficient INR training in applications lacking sufficient prior domain-specific data. For more details, visit project page at https://kushalvyas.github.io/noisepretraining.html
summary_zh: 隐式神经表示（INR）的逼近与收敛性质对参数初始化策略极为敏感。尽管多种数据驱动的初始化方法已证明其相比于标准随机采样有显著提升，但其成功原因——特别是它们是否编码了经典的统计信号先验，还是更复杂的特征——仍然缺乏深入理解。在本研究中，我们通过一系列利用噪声预训练的实验分析来探讨这一现象。我们在多种噪声类别（如高斯噪声、枯叶噪声、谱噪声）上对INR进行预训练，并评估它们拟合未知信号及在逆成像任务（去噪）中编码先验的能力。通过对图像和视频数据的分析，我们发现了一个令人惊讶的结论：与所有其他基线方法相比，仅在无结构噪声（均匀分布噪声、高斯噪声）上进行预训练即可显著提升信号拟合能力。然而，无结构噪声在去噪任务中作为深度图像先验的表现则较差。与此相反，我们还发现，具有经典自然图像谱结构$1/|f^α|$的噪声在信号拟合与逆成像能力之间达到了极佳的平衡，其性能与最佳数据驱动初始化方法相当。这一发现为缺乏足够先验领域特定数据的应用提供了更高效的INR训练途径。更多详情请访问项目页面：https://kushalvyas.github.io/noisepretraining.html。
tldr: This paper investigates initialization strategies for Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) and finds that pretraining on unstructured noise improves signal fitting, while structured spectral noise provides good priors for inverse imaging tasks like denoising.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了隐式神经表示（INR）的初始化策略，发现用无结构噪声预训练可提高信号拟合能力，而用具有自然图像频谱结构的噪声预训练则能为逆成像任务提供良好先验。

title: UltraG-Ray: Physics-Based Gaussian Ray Casting for Novel Ultrasound View Synthesis
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in ultrasound has gained attention as a technique for generating anatomically plausible views beyond the acquired frames, offering new capabilities for training clinicians or data augmentation. However, current methods struggle with complex tissue and view-dependent acoustic effects. Physics-based NVS aims to address these limitations by including the ultrasound image formation process into the simulation. Recent approaches combine a learnable implicit scene representation with an ultrasound-specific rendering module, yet a substantial gap between simulation and reality remains. In this work, we introduce UltraG-Ray, a novel ultrasound scene representation based on a learnable 3D Gaussian field, coupled to an efficient physics-based module for B-mode synthesis. We explicitly encode ultrasound-specific parameters, such as attenuation and reflection, into a Gaussian-based spatial representation and realize image synthesis within a novel ray casting scheme. In contrast to previous methods, this approach naturally captures view-dependent attenuation effects, thereby enabling the generation of physically informed B-mode images with increased realism. We compare our method to state-of-the-art and observe consistent gains in image quality metrics (up to 15% increase on MS-SSIM), demonstrating clear improvement in terms of realism of the synthesized ultrasound images.
summary_zh: 超声图像新颖视角合成技术作为一种能够生成超越采集帧的解剖学合理视图的方法而受到关注，它为临床医生培训或数据增强提供了新能力。然而，当前方法在处理复杂组织及视角依赖的声学效应时仍面临困难。基于物理学的视角合成技术旨在通过将超声成像形成过程纳入仿真来解决这些局限性。近期研究将可学习的隐式场景表示与超声专用渲染模块相结合，但仿真与真实图像之间仍存在显著差距。本研究提出了一种基于可学习三维高斯场的新型超声场景表示方法——UltraG-Ray，并与高效的物理基础B模式合成模块相结合。我们明确将超声特有参数（如衰减和反射）编码进基于高斯分布的空间表示中，并通过创新的光线投射方案实现图像合成。与先前方法相比，该方案能自然捕捉视角依赖的衰减效应，从而生成具有更高真实感的物理信息B模式图像。与现有前沿技术相比，我们的方法在图像质量指标上实现持续提升（MS-SSIM最高提升15%），证明合成超声图像的真实感得到显著改善。
tldr: This paper introduces UltraG-Ray, a novel view synthesis method for ultrasound images using a learnable 3D Gaussian field and a physics-based ray casting module to improve realism.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UltraG-Ray，一种用于超声图像的新视角合成方法，它使用可学习的3D高斯场和基于物理的射线投射模块来提高合成图像的真实感。

title: GenFusion: Feed-forward Human Performance Capture via Progressive Canonical Space Updates
summary: We present a feed-forward human performance capture method that renders novel views of a performer from a monocular RGB stream. A key challenge in this setting is the lack of sufficient observations, especially for unseen regions. Assuming the subject moves continuously over time, we take advantage of the fact that more body parts become observable by maintaining a canonical space that is progressively updated with each incoming frame. This canonical space accumulates appearance information over time and serves as a context bank when direct observations are missing in the current live frame. To effectively utilize this context while respecting the deformation of the live state, we formulate the rendering process as probabilistic regression. This resolves conflicts between past and current observations, producing sharper reconstructions than deterministic regression approaches. Furthermore, it enables plausible synthesis even in regions with no prior observations. Experiments on in-domain (4D-Dress) and out-of-distribution (MVHumanNet) datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种前馈式人体性能捕捉方法，能够通过单目RGB视频流渲染表演者的新视角。该场景下的核心挑战在于观测数据不足，尤其对于未观测区域。基于表演者持续运动的假设，我们通过维护一个随每帧输入渐进更新的规范空间，利用更多身体部位随时间逐步可观测的特性。该规范空间随时间累积外观信息，在当前直播帧缺乏直接观测时充当上下文信息库。为在尊重实时形变状态的同时有效利用此上下文，我们将渲染过程构建为概率回归模型。该方法解决了历史观测与当前观测之间的冲突，相比确定性回归方法能生成更清晰的重建结果，即使在无先验观测区域也能实现合理合成。在域内数据集（4D-Dress）和域外分布数据集（MVHumanNet）上的实验验证了本方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper presents a feed-forward method for human performance capture from a monocular RGB stream, using progressive canonical space updates and probabilistic regression to render novel views and handle unseen regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种前馈式人类表现捕捉方法，通过渐进式规范空间更新和概率回归，从单目RGB流中渲染新视角并处理未观测区域。

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical AI for Industrial Defect Classification in Welding Images
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical machine learning offers a promising direction for advancing automated quality control in industrial settings. In this study, we investigate two hybrid quantum-classical approaches for classifying defects in aluminium TIG welding images and benchmarking their performance against a conventional deep learning model. A convolutional neural network is used to extract compact and informative feature vectors from weld images, effectively reducing the higher-dimensional pixel space to a lower-dimensional feature space. Our first quantum approach encodes these features into quantum states using a parameterized quantum feature map composed of rotation and entangling gates. We compute a quantum kernel matrix from the inner products of these states, defining a linear system in a higher-dimensional Hilbert space corresponding to the support vector machine (SVM) optimization problem and solving it using a Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS). We also examine the effect of the quantum kernel condition number on classification performance. In our second method, we apply angle encoding to the extracted features in a variational quantum circuit and use a classical optimizer for model training. Both quantum models are tested on binary and multiclass classification tasks and the performance is compared with the classical CNN model. Our results show that while the CNN model demonstrates robust performance, hybrid quantum-classical models perform competitively. This highlights the potential of hybrid quantum-classical approaches for near-term real-world applications in industrial defect detection and quality assurance.
summary_zh: 混合量子-经典机器学习为工业环境中自动化质量控制的推进提供了有前景的方向。本研究探索了两种混合量子-经典方法，用于铝合金TIG焊接图像中的缺陷分类，并与传统深度学习模型进行性能对比。我们采用卷积神经网络从焊接图像中提取紧凑且信息丰富的特征向量，有效将高维像素空间降至低维特征空间。第一种量子方法通过由旋转门和纠缠门构成的参数化量子特征映射，将这些特征编码为量子态，并根据这些态的内积计算量子核矩阵，在对应支持向量机优化问题的高维希尔伯特空间中构建线性系统，并使用变分量子线性求解器进行求解。我们还研究了量子核条件数对分类性能的影响。第二种方法则在变分量子电路中对提取的特征进行角度编码，并采用经典优化器进行模型训练。两种量子模型均在二元及多分类任务上进行测试，其性能与经典CNN模型进行对比。结果表明，虽然CNN模型展现出稳健性能，但混合量子-经典模型仍具备竞争优势。这凸显了混合量子-经典方法在工业缺陷检测与质量保证等近期实际应用中的潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes hybrid quantum-classical models for industrial defect classification in welding images, using quantum kernels and variational circuits, and benchmarks them against a classical CNN.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于焊接图像工业缺陷分类的混合量子经典模型，使用量子核和变分电路，并与经典CNN模型进行性能比较。

title: Stepper: Stepwise Immersive Scene Generation with Multiview Panoramas
summary: The synthesis of immersive 3D scenes from text is rapidly maturing, driven by novel video generative models and feed-forward 3D reconstruction, with vast potential in AR/VR and world modeling. While panoramic images have proven effective for scene initialization, existing approaches suffer from a trade-off between visual fidelity and explorability: autoregressive expansion suffers from context drift, while panoramic video generation is limited to low resolution. We present Stepper, a unified framework for text-driven immersive 3D scene synthesis that circumvents these limitations via stepwise panoramic scene expansion. Stepper leverages a novel multi-view 360° diffusion model that enables consistent, high-resolution expansion, coupled with a geometry reconstruction pipeline that enforces geometric coherence. Trained on a new large-scale, multi-view panorama dataset, Stepper achieves state-of-the-art fidelity and structural consistency, outperforming prior approaches, thereby setting a new standard for immersive scene generation.
summary_zh: 基于新型视频生成模型与前馈式三维重建技术的推动，从文本生成沉浸式三维场景的合成技术正迅速走向成熟，在增强现实/虚拟现实及世界建模领域展现出巨大潜力。全景图像虽已证明对场景初始化具有良好效果，但现有方法始终面临视觉保真度与场景可探索性之间的权衡问题：自回归扩展方法易受上下文偏移影响，而全景视频生成技术则受限于低分辨率。本文提出Stepper框架，该统一框架通过渐进式全景场景扩展技术，规避了上述局限性。Stepper采用一种新颖的多视角360°扩散模型，实现高分辨率且内容连贯的扩展，同时结合几何重建流程确保几何一致性。通过在全新构建的大规模多视角全景数据集上进行训练，Stepper在视觉保真度与结构一致性方面达到当前最优水平，超越了现有方法，从而为沉浸式场景生成确立了新标准。
tldr: Stepper is a framework for text-driven immersive 3D scene generation using stepwise panoramic expansion and a multi-view diffusion model to achieve high fidelity and geometric consistency.
tldr_zh: Stepper 是一个用于文本驱动沉浸式3D场景生成的框架，通过逐步全景扩展和多视图扩散模型实现高保真度和几何一致性。

title: Reward-Based Online LLM Routing via NeuralUCB
summary: This study investigates the use of NeuralUCB for cost-aware large language model (LLM) routing. Existing routing approaches can be broadly grouped into supervised routing methods and partial-feedback methods, each with different tradeoffs in efficiency and adaptivity. We implement a NeuralUCB-based routing policy and evaluate it on RouterBench under a simulated online setting. Experimental results show that the proposed method consistently outperforms random and min-cost baselines in utility reward. Compared with the max-quality reference, our method achieves substantially lower inference cost while maintaining competitive reward. These findings suggest that NeuralUCB is a promising approach for cost-aware LLM routing, while also highlighting remaining challenges in action discrimination and exploration.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于神经置信上界（NeuralUCB）的、成本感知大语言模型（LLM）路由方法。现有路由策略大致可分为监督路由和部分反馈方法两类，它们在效率与适应性之间存在不同权衡。我们设计了一种基于NeuralUCB的路由策略，并在模拟在线环境下的RouterBench平台上进行评估。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在效用奖励方面持续优于随机路由和最低成本基线。相较于最高质量参考模型，该方法在保持竞争力奖励的同时显著降低了推理成本。这些发现表明，NeuralUCB是实现成本感知LLM路由的有效途径，同时也揭示了在动作区分和探索方面仍存在的挑战。
tldr: This paper proposes a NeuralUCB-based method for online, cost-aware routing of large language models (LLMs) to balance reward and inference cost.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于NeuralUCB的在线、成本感知的大语言模型路由方法，以平衡奖励与推理成本。

title: PASM: Population Adaptive Symbolic Mixture-of-Experts Model for Cross-location Hurricane Evacuation Decision Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of evacuation behavior is critical for disaster preparedness, yet models trained in one region often fail elsewhere. Using a multi-state hurricane evacuation survey, we show this failure goes beyond feature distribution shift: households with similar characteristics follow systematically different decision patterns across states. As a result, single global models overfit dominant responses, misrepresent vulnerable subpopulations, and generalize poorly across locations. We propose Population-Adaptive Symbolic Mixture-of-Experts (PASM), which pairs large language model guided symbolic regression with a mixture-of-experts architecture. PASM discovers human-readable closed-form decision rules, specializes them to data-driven subpopulations, and routes each input to the appropriate expert at inference time. On Hurricanes Harvey and Irma data, transferring from Florida and Texas to Georgia with 100 calibration samples, PASM achieves a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.607, compared to XGBoost (0.404), TabPFN (0.333), GPT-5-mini (0.434), and meta-learning baselines MAML and Prototypical Networks (MCC $\leq$ 0.346). The routing mechanism assigns distinct formula archetypes to subpopulations, so the resulting behavioral profiles are directly interpretable. A fairness audit across four demographic axes finds no statistically significant disparities after Bonferroni correction. PASM closes more than half the cross-location generalization gap while keeping decision rules transparent enough for real-world emergency planning.
summary_zh: 疏散行为的准确预测对灾害应对准备至关重要，但特定区域训练的模型常在其他地区失效。通过多州飓风疏散调查，我们发现这种失效不仅源于特征分布偏移：具有相似特征的家庭在不同州会遵循系统性差异的决策模式。因此，单一全局模型会过度拟合主导响应模式，错误表征弱势亚群体，并难以实现跨地域泛化。本文提出种群自适应符号专家混合模型（PASM），将大语言模型引导的符号回归与专家混合架构相结合。PASM能发现人类可读的闭合形式决策规则，将其适配至数据驱动的亚群体，并在推理时自动将输入路由至对应专家。在哈维和厄玛飓风数据中，使用100个校准样本从佛罗里达州和德克萨斯州迁移至佐治亚州时，PASM获得0.607的马修斯相关系数，优于XGBoost（0.404）、TabPFN（0.333）、GPT-5-mini（0.434）以及元学习基线MAML和原型网络（MCC ≤ 0.346）。路由机制为不同亚群体分配差异化的公式原型，使生成的行为特征谱可直接解释。经四项人口统计维度公平性审计及Bonferroni校正后，未发现统计学显著差异。PASM在保持决策规则足够透明以支持实际应急规划的同时，将跨地域泛化差距缩小超半数。
tldr: A paper proposing a Population-Adaptive Symbolic Mixture-of-Experts (PASM) model for predicting cross-location hurricane evacuation decisions, using LLM-guided symbolic regression to improve interpretability and generalizability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人口自适应符号混合专家（PASM）模型，用于预测跨区域飓风疏散决策。该模型利用LLM引导的符号回归，旨在提升模型的解释性和泛化能力。

title: Big2Small: A Unifying Neural Network Framework for Model Compression
summary: With the development of foundational models, model compression has become a critical requirement. Various model compression approaches have been proposed such as low-rank decomposition, pruning, quantization, ergodic dynamic systems, and knowledge distillation, which are based on different heuristics. To elevate the field from fragmentation to a principled discipline, we construct a unifying mathematical framework for model compression grounded in measure theory. We further demonstrate that each model compression technique is mathematically equivalent to a neural network subject to a regularization. Building upon this mathematical and structural equivalence, we propose an experimentally-verified data-free model compression framework, termed \textit{Big2Small}, which translates Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) from data domain to the domain of network parameters. \textit{Big2Small} trains compact INRs to encode the weights of larger models and reconstruct the weights during inference. To enhance reconstruction fidelity, we introduce Outlier-Aware Preprocessing to handle extreme weight values and a Frequency-Aware Loss function to preserve high-frequency details. Experiments on image classification and segmentation demonstrate that \textit{Big2Small} achieves competitive accuracy and compression ratios compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 随着基础模型的发展，模型压缩已成为一项关键需求。基于不同启发式思路，研究者提出了多种模型压缩方法，如低秩分解、剪枝、量化、遍历动态系统和知识蒸馏等。为将这一领域从碎片化研究提升至系统化理论体系，我们构建了一个基于测度论的统一数学模型框架，并进一步证明每种模型压缩技术在数学上均等价于带有正则化约束的神经网络。基于这种数学与结构上的等价性，我们提出了一种经过实验验证的无数据模型压缩框架——\textit{Big2Small}，该框架将隐式神经表征从数据域转换至网络参数域。\textit{Big2Small}训练紧凑的隐式神经表征来编码大型模型权重，并在推理阶段重建权重参数。为提升重建保真度，我们引入了异常值感知预处理机制以处理极端权重值，并采用频率感知损失函数以保留高频细节。在图像分类和分割任务上的实验表明，相较于现有先进基线方法，\textit{Big2Small}在精度与压缩率方面均取得了具有竞争力的结果。
tldr: The paper proposes a unified mathematical framework for model compression using Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) to encode the weights of larger models, achieving competitive results on image classification and segmentation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的模型压缩统一框架，用于编码大型模型的权重，在图像分类和分割任务上取得了与现有技术相当的压缩比和精度。

title: Training-Free Dynamic Upcycling of Expert Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on a wide range of specialized tasks, exhibiting strong problem-solving capabilities. However, training these models is prohibitively expensive, and they often lack domain-specific expertise because they rely on general knowledge datasets. Expertise finetuning can address this issue; however, it often leads to overspecialization, and developing a single multi-domain expert remains difficult due to diverging objectives. Furthermore, multitask training is challenging due to interference and catastrophic forgetting. Existing work proposes combining the expertise of dense models within a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, although this approach still requires multitask finetuning. To address these issues, we introduce Dynamic Upcycling MoE (DUME), a novel approach that reuses dense experts trained on different domains to construct a unified MoE model. Our method builds a single multitask model that preserves the capabilities of the original dense experts without requiring additional training. DUME is both cost-efficient and scalable: by leveraging the closed-form solution of ridge regression, it eliminates the need for further optimization and enables experts to be added dynamically while maintaining the model's original performance. We demonstrate that DUME consistently outperforms baseline approaches in both causal language modeling and reasoning settings. Finally, we also show that the DUME model can be fine-tuned to further improve performance. We show that, in the causal language modeling setting, DUME can retain up to 97.6% of a dense expert model specialized in one particular domain, and that it can also surpass it in the reasoning setting, where it can achieve 102.1% of the dense expert performance. Our code is available at: github.com/gensyn-ai/dume.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在广泛的专业任务上表现出卓越性能，展现出强大的问题解决能力。然而，训练这些模型成本极高，且由于依赖通用知识数据集，它们通常缺乏特定领域的专业知识。专家微调虽能解决这一问题，但往往导致过度专业化；同时，由于目标分歧，开发单一的多领域专家模型仍十分困难。此外，多任务训练因任务干扰和灾难性遗忘而充满挑战。现有研究提出通过混合专家（MoE）架构整合密集模型的专业能力，但此方法仍需进行多任务微调。针对这些问题，我们提出动态升级混合专家（DUME），这是一种创新方法，通过复用在不同领域训练的密集专家模型来构建统一的MoE模型。该方法能在不额外训练的前提下，构建单一的多任务模型并保留原始密集专家的能力。DUME兼具成本效益与可扩展性：通过利用岭回归的闭式解，无需进一步优化即可动态添加专家，同时保持模型原始性能。我们证明，在因果语言建模与推理任务中，DUME均持续优于基线方法。最后，我们还展示了DUME模型可通过微调进一步提升性能：在因果语言建模任务中，它能保留特定领域密集专家模型高达97.6%的性能；在推理任务中，其表现甚至可超越原密集专家模型，达到后者性能的102.1%。代码已开源：github.com/gensyn-ai/dume。
tldr: The paper introduces Dynamic Upcycling MoE (DUME), a method to combine pre-trained dense language models into a Mixture of Experts without additional training, preserving specialized capabilities while enabling multi-domain performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了动态升级混合专家模型（DUME），一种无需训练即可将预训练稠密语言模型组合成混合专家模型的方法，保留了特定领域的专业能力，同时实现多领域性能。

title: mlr3mbo: Bayesian Optimization in R
summary: We present mlr3mbo, a comprehensive and modular toolbox for Bayesian optimization in R. mlr3mbo supports single- and multi-objective optimization, multi-point proposals, batch and asynchronous parallelization, input and output transformations, and robust error handling. While it can be used for many standard Bayesian optimization variants in applied settings, researchers can also construct custom BO algorithms from its flexible building blocks. In addition to an introduction to the software, its design principles, and its building blocks, the paper presents two extensive empirical evaluations of the software on the surrogate-based benchmark suite YAHPO Gym. To identify robust default configurations for both numeric and mixed-hierarchical optimization regimes, and to gain further insights into the respective impacts of individual settings, we run a coordinate descent search over the mlr3mbo configuration space and analyze its results. Furthermore, we demonstrate that mlr3mbo achieves state-of-the-art performance by benchmarking it against a wide range of optimizers, including HEBO, SMAC3, Ax, and Optuna.
summary_zh: 本文介绍mlr3mbo——一个用于R语言贝叶斯优化的综合性模块化工具箱。该工具支持单目标与多目标优化、多点建议、批处理与异步并行化、输入输出转换以及鲁棒的错误处理机制。在应用场景中，它可用于多种标准贝叶斯优化变体，同时研究人员也可基于其灵活构件构建自定义优化算法。除介绍软件功能、设计原则与模块架构外，本文还通过基于代理模型的基准测试套件YAHPO Gym对软件进行了两项大规模实证评估。为确定数值优化与混合分层优化场景中的稳健默认配置，并深入探究各参数设置的具体影响，我们在mlr3mbo配置空间上运行坐标下降搜索并系统分析其结果。此外，通过与HEBO、SMAC3、Ax、Optuna等多种优化器的广泛基准测试对比，验证了mlr3mbo具备业界领先的性能表现。
tldr: This paper introduces mlr3mbo, a modular R toolbox for Bayesian optimization with support for single- and multi-objective tasks, parallelization, and custom algorithm construction. It demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on a benchmark suite and analyzes robust default configurations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 mlr3mbo，这是一个用于贝叶斯优化的模块化 R 工具箱，支持单目标和多目标优化、并行化及自定义算法构建。论文在基准套件上展示了其先进性能，并分析了稳健的默认配置。

title: Total Variation Guarantees for Sampling with Stochastic Localization
summary: Motivated by the success of score-based generative models, a number of diffusion-based algorithms have recently been proposed for the problem of sampling from a probability measure whose unnormalized density can be accessed. Among them, Grenioux et al. introduced SLIPS, a sampling algorithm based on Stochastic Localization. While SLIPS exhibits strong empirical performance, no rigorous convergence analysis has previously been provided. In this work, we close this gap by establishing the first guarantee for SLIPS in total variation distance. Under minimal assumptions on the target, our bound implies that the number of steps required to achieve an $\varepsilon$-guarantee scales linearly with the dimension, up to logarithmic factors. The analysis leverages techniques from the theory of score-based generative models and further provides theoretical insights into the empirically observed optimal choice of discretization points.
summary_zh: 受基于分数的生成模型成功的启发，近期针对从可访问未归一化密度概率测度中采样的任务，已提出一系列基于扩散的算法。其中，Grenioux 等人提出了 SLIPS，一种基于随机定位的采样算法。尽管 SLIPS 展现出强大的实证性能，但此前一直缺乏严格的收敛性分析。本研究填补了这一空白，首次为 SLIPS 在总变差距离上建立了收敛保证。在目标分布满足最低限度假设的条件下，我们的结论表明，实现 $\varepsilon$-精度保证所需的步数随维度呈线性增长（忽略对数因子）。该分析利用了基于分数的生成模型理论中的技术，并进一步为实证中观察到的离散化点最优选择提供了理论见解。
tldr: This paper provides the first rigorous convergence analysis for the SLIPS sampling algorithm, a diffusion-based method using stochastic localization, proving linear scaling with dimension under minimal assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本文首次对基于随机定位的采样算法SLIPS进行了严格的收敛性分析，证明在最小假设下，实现误差保证所需的步骤数随维度线性增长。

title: Learning Surrogate LPV State-Space Models with Uncertainty Quantification
summary: The Linear Parameter-Varying (LPV) framework enables the construction of surrogate models of complex nonlinear and high-dimensional systems, facilitating efficient stability and performance analysis together with controller design. Despite significant advances in data-driven LPV modelling, existing approaches do not quantify the uncertainty of the obtained LPV models. Consequently, assessing model reliability for analysis and control or detecting operation outside the training regime requires extensive validation and user expertise. This paper proposes a Bayesian approach for the joint estimation of LPV state-space models together with their scheduling, providing a characterization of model uncertainty and confidence bounds on the predicted model response directly from input-output data. Both aleatoric uncertainty due to measurement noise and epistemic uncertainty arising from limited training data and structural bias are considered. The resulting model preserves the LPV structure required for controller synthesis while enabling computationally efficient simulation and uncertainty propagation. The approach is demonstrated on the surrogate modelling of a two-dimensional nonlinear interconnection of mass-spring-damper systems.
summary_zh: 线性变参数（LPV）框架能够构建复杂非线性高维系统的代理模型，有助于高效进行稳定性与性能分析以及控制器设计。尽管数据驱动的LPV建模已取得显著进展，但现有方法未能量化所获LPV模型的不确定性。因此，评估模型在分析与控制中的可靠性或检测训练工况外运行情况，仍需大量验证过程和用户专业知识。本文提出一种贝叶斯方法，用于联合估计LPV状态空间模型及其调度变量，直接从输入输出数据中提供模型不确定性的表征及预测模型响应的置信区间。该方法同时考虑了测量噪声引起的偶然不确定性，以及有限训练数据和结构偏差导致的认知不确定性。所得模型既保持了控制器综合所需的LPV结构，又能实现计算高效的仿真与不确定性传播。本研究通过二维非线性质量-弹簧-阻尼器系统互联的代理建模案例，验证了所提方法的有效性。
tldr: Proposes a Bayesian method for estimating Linear Parameter-Varying state-space models with uncertainty quantification for improved reliability in control applications.
tldr_zh: 提出一种贝叶斯方法，用于估计具有不确定性量化的线性变参数状态空间模型，以提高控制应用中的可靠性。

title: AP-DRL: A Synergistic Algorithm-Hardware Framework for Automatic Task Partitioning of Deep Reinforcement Learning on Versal ACAP
summary:
Deep reinforcement learning has demonstrated remarkable success across various domains. However, the tight coupling between training and inference processes makes accelerating DRL training an essential challenge for DRL optimization. Two key issues hinder efficient DRL training: (1) the significant variation in computational intensity across different DRL algorithms and even among operations within the same algorithm complicates hardware platform selection, while (2) DRL's wide dynamic range could lead to substantial reward errors with conventional FP16+FP32 mixed-precision quantization. While existing work has primarily focused on accelerating DRL for specific computing units or optimizing inference-stage quantization, we propose AP-DRL to address the above challenges.
  AP-DRL is an automatic task partitioning framework that harnesses the heterogeneous architecture of AMD Versal ACAP (integrating CPUs, FPGAs, and AI Engines) to accelerate DRL training through intelligent hardware-aware optimization. Our approach begins with bottleneck analysis of CPU, FPGA, and AIE performance across diverse DRL workloads, informing the design principles for AP-DRL's inter-component task partitioning and quantization optimization. The framework then addresses the challenge of platform selection through design space exploration-based profiling and ILP-based partitioning models that match operations to optimal computing units based on their computational characteristics. For the quantization challenge, AP-DRL employs a hardware-aware algorithm coordinating FP32 (CPU), FP16 (FPGA/DSP), and BF16 (AI Engine) operations by leveraging Versal ACAP's native support for these precision formats. Comprehensive experiments indicate that AP-DRL can achieve speedup of up to 4.17$\times$ over programmable logic and up to 3.82$\times$ over AI Engine baselines while maintaining training convergence.
summary_zh:
深度强化学习已在多个领域展现出卓越成效。然而，训练与推理过程的紧密耦合使得加速DRL训练成为DRL优化的核心挑战。两大关键问题阻碍了高效的DRL训练：(1)不同DRL算法乃至同一算法内部各操作间计算强度的显著差异，使硬件平台选择变得复杂；同时(2)DRL宽动态范围的特性可能导致传统FP16+FP32混合精度量化产生显著奖励误差。尽管现有研究主要聚焦于特定计算单元的DRL加速或推理阶段量化优化，我们提出AP-DRL框架以应对上述挑战。

AP-DRL是一种自动任务划分框架，利用AMD Versal ACAP的异构架构（集成CPU、FPGA与AI引擎）通过智能硬件感知优化来加速DRL训练。我们首先对不同DRL工作负载在CPU、FPGA和AI引擎上的性能进行瓶颈分析，由此形成AP-DRL跨组件任务划分与量化优化的设计原则。该框架通过基于设计空间探索的性能剖析和基于整数线性规划的划分模型，依据操作的计算特征将其匹配至最优计算单元，从而解决平台选择难题。针对量化挑战，AP-DRL采用硬件感知算法，利用Versal ACAP原生支持的精度格式，协调FP32（CPU）、FP16（FPGA/DSP）和BF16（AI引擎）的混合精度运算。综合实验表明，AP-DRL在保持训练收敛性的同时，相比可编程逻辑基准可实现最高4.17倍的加速，相比AI引擎基准可实现最高3.82倍的加速。
tldr: This paper proposes a hardware-aware framework (AP-DRL) for automatic task partitioning and quantization of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) training on heterogeneous AMD Versal ACAP platforms. It does not address robotics or embodied AI applications, focusing instead on optimizing DRL algorithms for general acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个面向AMD Versal ACAP异构平台、用于深度强化学习训练自动任务划分和量化的硬件感知框架（AP-DRL），其关注点在于算法加速，未涉及机器人或具身AI的具体应用。

title: Lie Generator Networks for Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations
summary: Linear dynamical systems are fully characterized by their eigenspectra, accessible directly from the generator of the dynamics. For nonlinear systems governed by partial differential equations, no equivalent theory exists. We introduce Lie Generator Network-Koopman (LGN-KM), a neural operator that lifts nonlinear dynamics into a linear latent space and learns the continuous-time Koopman generator ($L_k$) through a decomposition $L_k = S - D_k$, where $S$ is skew-symmetric representing conservative inter-modal coupling, and $D_k$ is a positive-definite diagonal encoding modal dissipation. This architectural decomposition enforces stability and enables interpretability through direct spectral access to the learned dynamics. On two-dimensional Navier--Stokes turbulence, the generator recovers the known dissipation scaling and a complete multi-branch dispersion relation from trajectory data alone with no physics supervision. Independently trained models at different flow regimes recover matched gauge-invariant spectral structure, exposing a gauge freedom in the Koopman lifting. Because the generator is provably stable, it enables guaranteed long-horizon stability, continuous-time evaluation at arbitrary time, and physics-informed cross-viscosity model transfer.
summary_zh: 线性动力系统完全由其本征谱表征，该谱可直接从动力学生成元中获取。对于由偏微分方程控制的非线性系统，尚无等效理论存在。本文提出Lie生成元网络-库普曼（LGN-KM）方法，该神经算子将非线性动力学提升至线性隐空间，并通过分解 $L_k = S - D_k$ 学习连续时间库普曼生成元（$L_k$），其中 $S$ 为斜对称矩阵表示保守的模态间耦合，$D_k$ 为正定对角矩阵编码模态耗散。此架构分解保证了稳定性，并通过对学习动力学的直接谱访问实现可解释性。在二维纳维-斯托克斯湍流中，该生成元仅从轨迹数据无需物理监督即可恢复已知的耗散标度律和完整多分支色散关系。在不同流动状态下独立训练的模型恢复出匹配的规范不变谱结构，揭示了库普曼提升过程中的规范自由度。由于该生成元具有可证明的稳定性，它能确保长期稳定性、支持任意时间点的连续时间评估，并实现基于物理信息的跨粘度模型迁移。
tldr: A neural operator learns a stable, linear Koopman generator for nonlinear PDEs, enabling interpretable spectral analysis and long-horizon stability for fluid dynamics.
tldr_zh: 一种神经算子学习非线性偏微分方程的稳定线性Koopman生成器，实现对流体动力学的可解释谱分析和长时程稳定性。

title: Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projections for Exact Integral Conservation in High-Dimensional PINNs
summary: Enforcing exact macroscopic conservation laws, such as mass and energy, in neural partial differential equation (PDE) solvers is computationally challenging in high dimensions. Traditional discrete projections rely on deterministic quadrature that scales poorly and restricts mesh-free formulations like PINNs. Furthermore, high-order operators incur heavy memory overhead, and generic optimization often lacks convergence guarantees for non-convex conservation manifolds. To address this, we propose the Stochastic Dimension Implicit Functional Projection (SDIFP) framework. Instead of projecting discrete vectors, SDIFP applies a global affine transformation to the continuous network output. This yields closed-form solutions for integral constraints via detached Monte Carlo (MC) quadrature, bypassing spatial grid dependencies. For scalable training, we introduce a doubly-stochastic unbiased gradient estimator (DS-UGE). By decoupling spatial sampling from differential operator subsampling, the DS-UGE reduces memory complexity from $\mathcal{O}(M \times N_{\mathcal{L}})$ to $\mathcal{O}(N \times |\mathcal{I}|)$. SDIFP mitigates sampling variance, preserves solution regularity, and maintains $\mathcal{O}(1)$ inference efficiency, providing a scalable, mesh-free approach for solving conservative high-dimensional PDEs.
summary_zh: 在高维环境中，神经偏微分方程（PDE）求解器精确满足宏观守恒定律（如质量与能量守恒）在计算上具有挑战性。传统离散投影方法依赖于确定性求积，其扩展性差，且限制了无网格形式（如PINNs）的构建。此外，高阶算子带来沉重的内存开销，而通用优化方法在非凸守恒流形上往往缺乏收敛保证。为解决此问题，我们提出随机维度隐式函数投影（SDIFP）框架。SDIFP不对离散向量进行投影，而是对连续网络输出施加全局仿射变换。通过分离式蒙特卡洛（MC）求积方法，该框架为积分约束提供闭式解，从而绕过空间网格依赖性。为实现可扩展训练，我们提出双随机无偏梯度估计器（DS-UGE）。通过将空间采样与微分算子子采样解耦，DS-UGE将内存复杂度从$\mathcal{O}(M \times N_{\mathcal{L}})$降低至$\mathcal{O}(N \times |\mathcal{I}|)$。SDIFP能有效降低采样方差，保持解的正则性，同时维持$\mathcal{O}(1)$的推理效率，为求解保守高维PDE提供了一种可扩展的无网格方法。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel method, SDIFP, for enforcing exact integral conservation laws in high-dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for solving PDEs, using a continuous global affine transformation and a doubly-stochastic gradient estimator to improve scalability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为SDIFP的新方法，用于在解决高维PDE的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）中强制执行精确的积分守恒定律，该方法通过连续全局仿射变换和双随机梯度估计器来提高可扩展性。

title: Predictor-Based Output-Feedback Control of Linear Systems with Time-Varying Input and Measurement Delays via Neural-Approximated Prediction Horizons
summary: Due to simplicity and strong stability guarantees, predictor feedback methods have stood as a popular approach for time delay systems since the 1950s. For time-varying delays, however, implementation requires computing a prediction horizon defined by the inverse of the delay function, which is rarely available in closed form and must be approximated. In this work, we formulate the inverse delay mapping as an operator learning problem and study predictor feedback under approximation of the prediction horizon. We propose two approaches: (i) a numerical method based on time integration of an equivalent ODE, and (ii) a data-driven method using neural operators to learn the inverse mapping. We show that both approaches achieve arbitrary approximation accuracy over compact sets, with complementary trade-offs in computational cost and scalability. Building on these approximations, we then develop an output-feedback predictor design for systems with delays in both the input and the measurement. We prove that the resulting closed-loop system is globally exponentially stable when the prediction horizon is approximated with sufficiently small error. Lastly, numerical experiments validate the proposed methods and illustrate their trade-offs between accuracy and computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 由于结构简单且具备强稳定性保证，预测器反馈方法自20世纪50年代以来一直是时滞系统的主流设计方法。然而，对于时变时滞系统，其实现需要计算由时滞函数反函数定义的预测时域。该反函数通常难以获得闭合形式解析解，必须通过近似方法实现。本文中将时滞反函数映射构建为算子学习问题，并研究预测时域近似条件下的预测器反馈设计。我们提出两种方法：(1) 基于等效常微分方程时间积分的数值方法；(2) 利用神经算子学习反函数映射的数据驱动方法。研究证明两种方法在紧集上均能达到任意精度逼近，且在计算成本与可扩展性方面具有互补特性。基于这些近似方法，我们进一步针对输入和测量均存在时滞的系统，开发了输出反馈预测器设计方案。理论证明当预测时域近似误差足够小时，所得闭环系统具有全局指数稳定性。最后，数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性，并揭示了其在精度与计算效率之间的权衡关系。
tldr: This paper proposes neural-operator and numerical methods to approximate the prediction horizon for output-feedback control of linear systems with time-varying input and measurement delays, ensuring stability with sufficient approximation accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本研究针对具有时变输入和测量延迟的线性系统，提出基于神经算子和数值方法来近似预测时域，用于输出反馈预测控制，并在近似误差足够小时保证了闭环系统的全局指数稳定性。

title: Efficient Bilevel Optimization with KFAC-Based Hypergradients
summary: Bilevel optimization (BO) is widely applicable to many machine learning problems. Scaling BO, however, requires repeatedly computing hypergradients, which involves solving inverse Hessian-vector products (IHVPs). In practice, these operations are often approximated using crude surrogates such as one-step gradient unrolling or identity/short Neumann expansions, which discard curvature information. We build on implicit function theorem-based algorithms and propose to incorporate Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (KFAC), yielding curvature-aware hypergradients with a better performance efficiency trade-off than Conjugate Gradient (CG) or Neumann methods and consistently outperforming unrolling. We evaluate this approach across diverse tasks, including meta-learning and AI safety problems. On models up to BERT, we show that curvature information is valuable at scale, and KFAC can provide it with only modest memory and runtime overhead. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/liaodisen/NeuralBo.
summary_zh: 双层优化（BO）广泛应用于诸多机器学习问题中。然而，大规模扩展BO需要反复计算超梯度，这涉及求解逆Hessian-向量积（IHVPs）。在实际应用中，这些操作通常通过粗糙的近似方法进行估算，如单步梯度展开或恒等/短Neumann展开，这些方法会丢弃曲率信息。本研究基于隐函数定理算法，提出引入Kronecker分解近似曲率（KFAC）方法，从而获得具有曲率感知能力的超梯度。该方法在性能与效率的权衡上优于共轭梯度法（CG）或Neumann方法，且始终优于梯度展开法。我们在包括元学习和AI安全问题的多种任务上评估了该方法的有效性。在BERT级规模的模型实验中，我们证明了曲率信息在大规模场景中具有重要价值，而KFAC仅需适度的内存和运行时开销即可提供此类信息。我们的实现代码已发布于https://github.com/liaodisen/NeuralBo。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve the efficiency of bilevel optimization by incorporating KFAC approximations for hypergradient calculation, showing benefits over existing methods on tasks like meta-learning and AI safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过使用 KFAC 近似计算超梯度，来提高双层优化的效率，在元学习和 AI 安全等任务上比现有方法表现更好。

title: ARCS: Autoregressive Circuit Synthesis with Topology-Aware Graph Attention and Spec Conditioning
summary: This paper presents ARCS (Autoregressive Circuit Synthesis), a system for amortized analog circuit generation that produces complete, SPICE-simulatable designs (topology and component values) in milliseconds rather than the minutes required by search-based methods. A hybrid pipeline combining two learned generators (a graph VAE and a flow-matching model) with SPICE-based ranking achieves 99.9% simulation validity (reward 6.43/8.0) across 32 topologies using only 8 SPICE evaluations, 40x fewer than genetic algorithms. For single-model inference, a topology-aware Graph Transformer with Best-of-3 candidate selection reaches 85% simulation validity in 97ms, over 600x faster than random search. The key technical contribution adapts Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to multi-topology circuit reinforcement learning, resolving a critical failure mode of REINFORCE (cross-topology reward distribution mismatch) through per-topology advantage normalization. This improves simulation validity by +9.6 percentage points over REINFORCE in only 500 RL steps (10x fewer). Grammar-constrained decoding additionally guarantees 100% structural validity by construction via topology-aware token masking.
summary_zh: 本文提出ARCS（自回归电路综合系统），一种用于分摊模拟电路生成的系统，能够在毫秒级时间内生成完整、可进行SPICE仿真的设计（拓扑结构与元件参数），而基于搜索的方法通常需要数分钟。该系统采用混合流水线架构，结合两个学习生成器（图变分自编码器与流匹配模型）和基于SPICE的排序机制，仅需8次SPICE评估即可在32种拓扑结构上实现99.9%的仿真有效性（奖励值6.43/8.0），相比遗传算法减少40倍评估次数。在单模型推理场景中，采用拓扑感知图变换器配合三佳候选选择策略，仅需97毫秒即可达到85%的仿真有效性，速度比随机搜索提升600倍以上。核心技术创新在于将组相对策略优化（GRPO）适配于多拓扑电路强化学习，通过逐拓扑优势归一化解决了REINFORCE算法的关键失效模式（跨拓扑奖励分布失配问题），仅用500步强化学习（减少10倍步数）就将仿真有效性较REINFORCE提升9.6个百分点。此外，通过语法约束解码配合拓扑感知令牌掩码机制，从结构层面确保了100%的架构有效性。
tldr: This paper presents ARCS, an autoregressive system for rapidly generating analog circuit designs using a hybrid pipeline of learned generators and SPICE-based ranking, with a key technical contribution of adapting Group Relative Policy Optimization to multi-topology circuit reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ARCS，一个用于快速生成模拟电路设计的自回归系统，它结合了学习的生成器和SPICE评估的混合流水线，其关键技术贡献是将组相对策略优化（GRPO）应用于多拓扑电路强化学习。

title: An Explicit Surrogate for Gaussian Mixture Flow Matching with Wasserstein Gap Bounds
summary: We study training-free flow matching between two Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) using explicit velocity fields that transport one mixture into the other over time. Our baseline approach constructs component-wise Gaussian paths with affine velocity fields satisfying the continuity equation, which yields to a closed-form surrogate for the pairwise kinetic transport cost. In contrast to the exact Gaussian Wasserstein cost, which relies on matrix square-root computations, the surrogate admits a simple analytic expression derived from the kinetic energy of the induced flow. We then analyze how closely this surrogate approximates the exact cost. We prove second-order agreement in a local commuting regime and derive an explicit cubic error bound in the local commuting regime. To handle nonlocal regimes, we introduce a path-splitting strategy that localizes the covariance evolution and enables piecewise application of the bound. We finally compare the surrogate with an exact construction based on the Gaussian Wasserstein geodesic and summarize the results in a practical regime map showing when the surrogate is accurate and the exact method is preferable.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种免训练流匹配方法，用于在两个高斯混合模型（GMM）之间建立基于显式速度场的传输过程，该速度场随时间将一个混合模型转化为另一个混合模型。我们提出的基线方法构建了基于分量间的高斯路径，其仿射速度场满足连续性方程，从而导出成对动力学传输成本的闭式替代形式。与依赖矩阵平方根运算的精确高斯Wasserstein成本不同，该替代成本基于诱导流动的动能推导出简洁的解析表达式。随后我们分析了该替代成本对精确成本的逼近程度。我们证明了在局部可交换条件下二者具有二阶一致性，并推导出局部可交换条件下的显式三次误差界。针对非局部情形，我们引入路径分割策略以局部化协方差演化，从而能够分段应用该误差界。最后，我们将替代成本与基于高斯Wasserstein测地线的精确构造方法进行对比，并将结果总结为实用区域图，展示了替代成本具有准确性的适用场景以及精确方法更优的适用条件。
tldr: Presents a training-free flow matching method for Gaussian mixture models with an explicit surrogate kinetic transport cost, analyzing its approximation error and providing a regime map for its use.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于高斯混合模型的免训练流匹配方法，具有显式代理动力传输成本，分析了其近似误差，并提供了使用指南的机制图。

title: A Pontryagin Method of Model-based Reinforcement Learning via Hamiltonian Actor-Critic
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) improves sample efficiency by leveraging learned dynamics models for policy optimization. However, the effectiveness of methods such as actor-critic is often limited by compounding model errors, which degrade long-horizon value estimation. Existing approaches, such as Model-Based Value Expansion (MVE), partially mitigate this issue through multi-step rollouts, but remain sensitive to rollout horizon selection and residual model bias. Motivated by the Pontryagin Maximum Principle (PMP), we propose Hamiltonian Actor-Critic (HAC), a model-based approach that eliminates explicit value function learning by directly optimizing a Hamiltonian defined over the learned dynamics and reward for deterministic systems. By avoiding value approximation, HAC reduces sensitivity to model errors while admitting convergence guarantees. Extensive experiments on continuous control benchmarks, in both online and offline RL settings, demonstrate that HAC outperforms model-free and MVE-based baselines in control performance, convergence speed, and robustness to distributional shift, including out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. In offline settings with limited data, HAC matches or exceeds state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its strong sample efficiency.
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过利用学习得到的动力学模型进行策略优化，从而提高了样本效率。然而，诸如演员-评论家等方法的效果常因累积模型误差而受限，这种误差会损害长期价值估计的准确性。现有方法，如基于模型的价值扩展（MVE），通过多步推演部分缓解了这一问题，但仍对推演步长的选择及残留模型偏差较为敏感。受庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）启发，我们提出哈密顿演员-评论家（HAC）——一种基于模型的方法，它通过直接优化由学习得到的动力学和确定性系统奖励所定义的哈密顿量，从而避免显式的价值函数学习。通过避开价值近似，HAC降低了对模型误差的敏感性，同时具有收敛性保证。在连续控制基准测试中，无论是在线还是离线强化学习设置下的大量实验表明，HAC在控制性能、收敛速度以及对分布偏移（包括分布外（OOD）场景）的鲁棒性上均优于无模型和基于MVE的基线方法。在数据有限的离线设置中，HAC达到或超越了当前最先进方法的水平，突显了其强大的样本效率。
tldr: Proposes Hamiltonian Actor-Critic (HAC), a model-based RL method using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle to avoid value function learning, improving sample efficiency and robustness to model error on continuous control benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出基于庞特里亚金最大原理的汉密尔顿演员-评论家方法，通过避免价值函数学习改进模型误差鲁棒性，在连续控制基准中提升了样本效率。

title: Beyond Symbolic Control: Societal Consequences of AI-Driven Workforce Displacement and the Imperative for Genuine Human Oversight Architectures
summary: The accelerating displacement of human labor by artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic systems represents a structural transformation whose societal consequences extend far beyond conventional labor market analysis. This paper presents a systematic multi-domain examination of the likely effects on economic structure, psychological well-being, political stability, education, healthcare, and geopolitical order. We identify a critical and underexamined dimension of this transition: the governance gap between nominal human oversight of AI systems -- where humans occupy positions of formal authority over AI decisions -- and genuine human oversight, where those humans possess the cognitive access, technical capability, and institutional authority to meaningfully understand, evaluate, and override AI outputs. We argue that this distinction, largely absent from current governance frameworks including the EU AI Act and NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, represents the primary architectural failure mode in deployed AI governance. The societal consequences of labor displacement intensify this problem by concentrating consequential AI decision-making among an increasingly narrow class of technical and capital actors. We propose five architectural requirements for genuine human oversight systems and characterize the governance window -- estimated at 10-15 years -- before current deployment trajectories risk path-dependent social, economic, and institutional lock-in.
summary_zh: 人工智能与机器人系统对人力劳动的加速替代是一场结构性变革，其社会影响远超传统劳动力市场分析的范畴。本文对经济结构、心理健康、政治稳定、教育体系、医疗保健及地缘政治秩序可能产生的效应进行了系统性跨领域研究，揭示了这一转型进程中一个关键但未受充分审视的维度：名义上人类对AI系统的监督——即人类在形式上拥有对AI决策的权威地位——与真正意义上人类监督之间的治理鸿沟。真正的监督要求监督者具备认知可及性、技术能力与制度授权，以切实理解、评估并否决AI的输出结果。我们认为，当前包括《欧盟人工智能法案》和《美国国家标准与技术研究院人工智能风险管理框架1.0》在内的治理框架普遍忽视了这一关键区别，这构成了已部署AI治理体系的主要架构性缺陷。劳动力替代的社会后果将重要的AI决策权日益集中于少数技术精英与资本持有者手中，从而加剧了这一问题。我们提出了实现真正人类监督体系的五项架构性要求，并界定了治理窗口期——预计为10至15年——若当前部署轨迹持续发展，社会、经济与制度将面临路径依赖式的固化风险。
tldr: This paper analyzes the societal consequences of AI-driven workforce displacement, highlighting a critical gap between nominal and genuine human oversight in AI governance, and proposes architectural requirements to address this gap before societal lock-in occurs.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了人工智能驱动的劳动力替代所带来的社会后果，强调了人工智能治理中名义上与真正的人类监督之间的关键差距，并提出了在产生社会锁定效应之前解决这一差距的架构要求。

title: Architecting Secure AI Agents: Perspectives on System-Level Defenses Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
summary: AI agents, predominantly powered by large language models (LLMs), are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, in which malicious instructions embedded in untrusted data can trigger dangerous agent actions.
