These conditions are often violated in practice, creating a gap between theoretical guarantees and real-world applicability. In contrast, this work directly addresses unbounded density ratios and integrates them into importance weighting for effective covariate shift adaptation. We propose a three-step estimation method that leverages unlabeled data from both the source and target distributions: (1) estimating a relative density ratio; (2) applying a truncation operation to control its unboundedness; and (3) transforming the truncated estimate back into the standard density ratio. The estimated density ratio is then employed as importance weights for regression under covariate shift. We establish rigorous, non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for both the proposed density ratio estimator and the resulting regression function estimator, demonstrating optimal or near-optimal convergence rates. Our findings offer new theoretical insights into density ratio estimation and learning under covariate shift, extending classical learning theory to more practical and challenging scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文聚焦于无界密度比估计问题——这一统计学习中尚未充分研究但至关重要的挑战——及其在协变量偏移适应中的应用。现有文献大多假设密度比要么一致有界，要么虽无界但精确已知。这些条件在实践中常被违背，导致理论保证与现实应用之间存在差距。与此不同，本工作直接处理无界密度比，并将其整合到重要性加权中以实现有效的协变量偏移适应。我们提出一种三步估计方法，利用来自源分布和目标分布的无标签数据：(1) 估计相对密度比；(2) 应用截断操作以控制其无界性；(3) 将截断估计量转换回标准密度比。所估计的密度比随后被用作协变量偏移下回归的重要性权重。我们为提出的密度比估计量及由此得到的回归函数估计量建立了严格的非渐近收敛保证，证明了其达到最优或接近最优的收敛速度。我们的研究为密度比估计及协变量偏移下的学习提供了新的理论见解，将经典学习理论扩展到更实用且更具挑战性的场景中。
tldr: Proposes a method for estimating unbounded density ratios using unlabeled data, with a truncation step to handle unboundedness, and applies it for covariate shift adaptation in regression with theoretical guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用无标签数据估计无界密度比的方法，通过截断操作处理无界性，并应用于协变量偏移适应的回归问题，同时提供了理论保证。

title: Disentangled Graph Prompting for Out-Of-Distribution Detection
summary: When testing data and training data come from different distributions, deep neural networks (DNNs) will face significant safety risks in practical applications. Therefore, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection techniques, which can identify OOD samples at test time and alert the system, are urgently needed. Existing graph OOD detection methods usually characterize fine-grained in-distribution (ID) patterns from multiple perspectives, and train end-to-end graph neural networks (GNNs) for prediction. However, due to the unavailability of OOD data during training, the absence of explicit supervision signals could lead to sub-optimal performance of end-to-end encoders. To address this issue, we follow the pre-training+prompting paradigm to utilize pre-trained GNN encoders, and propose Disentangled Graph Prompting (DGP), to capture fine-grained ID patterns with the help of ID graph labels. Specifically, we design two prompt generators that respectively generate class-specific and class-agnostic prompt graphs by modifying the edge weights of an input graph. We also design several effective losses to train the prompt generators and prevent trivial solutions. We conduct extensive experiments on ten datasets to demonstrate the superiority of our proposed DGP, which achieves a relative AUC improvement of 3.63% over the best graph OOD detection baseline. Ablation studies and hyper-parameter experiments further show the effectiveness of DGP. Code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/DGP.
summary_zh: 当测试数据与训练数据来源不同分布时，深度神经网络在实际应用中会面临显著的安全风险。因此，亟需开发能够在测试时识别分布外样本并向系统发出警报的分布外检测技术。现有的图分布外检测方法通常从多视角刻画细粒度的分布内模式，并训练端到端的图神经网络进行预测。然而，由于训练过程中无法获取分布外数据，缺乏显式监督信号可能导致端到端编码器的性能欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们遵循预训练+提示调优范式，利用预训练的图神经网络编码器，并提出了解耦图提示方法，以借助分布内图标签捕获细粒度分布内模式。具体而言，我们设计了两种提示生成器，分别通过修改输入图的边权重来生成类特定与类无关的提示图。同时设计了多种有效损失函数来训练提示生成器并避免平凡解。我们在十个数据集上进行了大量实验，证明所提出的解耦图提示方法的优越性，其分布外检测性能相对最佳基线实现了3.63%的AUC提升。消融实验与超参数研究进一步验证了该方法的有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/DGP。
tldr: This paper proposes Disentangled Graph Prompting (DGP), a pre-training and prompting method for improving out-of-distribution detection on graph-structured data using graph neural networks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种解构图提示（DGP）方法，通过预训练和提示范式，利用图标签信息改进图神经网络在分布外检测上的性能。

title: Central limit theorems for the outputs of fully convolutional neural networks with time series input
summary: Deep learning is widely deployed for time series learning tasks such as classification and forecasting. Despite the empirical successes, only little theory has been developed so far in the time series context. In this work, we prove that if the network inputs are generated from short-range dependent linear processes, the outputs of fully convolutional neural networks (FCNs) with global average pooling (GAP) are asymptotically Gaussian and the limit is attained if the length of the observed time series tends to infinity. The proof leverages existing tools from the theoretical time series literature. Based on our theory, we propose a generalization of the GAP layer by considering a global weighted pooling step with slowly varying, learnable coefficients.
summary_zh: 深度学习被广泛应用于分类和预测等时间序列学习任务中。尽管取得了显著的经验成果，但目前在时间序列领域仅有少量理论发展。本研究证明，当网络输入由短程相关线性过程生成时，采用全局平均池化（GAP）的全卷积神经网络（FCN）输出具有渐近高斯性，且当观测时间序列长度趋于无穷时达到极限。该证明借鉴了理论时间序列文献中的现有工具。基于我们的理论，我们提出了一种全局加权池化层的扩展方案，通过采用具有缓慢变化、可学习系数的全局加权池化步骤来实现。
tldr: This paper provides a theoretical proof that fully convolutional neural networks (FCNs) with global average pooling (GAP) produce asymptotically Gaussian outputs when trained on short-range dependent linear time series data.
tldr_zh: 该论文从理论上证明，当使用短程依赖的线性时间序列数据时，带有全局平均池化的全卷积神经网络的输出是渐近高斯的，并提出了一种基于可学习系数的广义加权池化层。

title: Capturing Multivariate Dependencies of EV Charging Events: From Parametric Copulas to Neural Density Estimation
summary: Accurate event-based modeling of electric vehicle (EV) charging is essential for grid reliability and smart-charging design. While traditional statistical methods capture marginal distributions, they often fail to model the complex, non-linear dependencies between charging variables, specifically arrival times, durations, and energy demand. This paper addresses this gap by introducing the first application of Vine copulas and Copula Density Neural Estimation framework (CODINE) to the EV domain. We evaluate these high-capacity dependence models across three diverse real-world datasets. Our results demonstrate that by explicitly focusing on modeling the joint dependence structure, Vine copulas and CODINE outperform established parametric families and remain highly competitive against state-of-the-art benchmarks like conditional Gaussian Mixture Model Networks. We show that these methods offer superior preservation of tail behaviors and correlation structures, providing a robust framework for synthetic charging event generation in varied infrastructure contexts.
summary_zh: 电动汽车（EV）充电的精准事件建模对于电网可靠性和智能充电设计至关重要。传统统计方法虽能捕捉边际分布，但往往难以模拟充电变量间复杂的非线性依赖关系，特别是到达时间、充电时长和能量需求之间的交互作用。本文首次将 Vine Copula 和 Copula 密度神经估计框架（CODINE）引入电动汽车领域，以弥补这一不足。我们在三个不同的真实世界数据集上评估了这些高容量依赖模型。结果表明，通过专注于对联合依赖结构进行建模，Vine Copula 和 CODINE 的表现超越了现有参数化模型族，并在与条件高斯混合模型网络等先进基准的比较中保持了高度竞争力。我们证明这些方法能更好地保留尾部行为和相关结构，为不同基础设施场景下的合成充电事件生成提供了稳健的框架。
tldr: This paper applies Vine copulas and a neural density estimation framework to model the complex dependencies between electric vehicle charging variables, demonstrating superior performance for synthetic event generation.
tldr_zh: 本文应用 Vine copulas 和神经密度估计框架来建模电动汽车充电变量之间的复杂依赖关系，在合成事件生成方面展现出优越性能。

title: Deep Learning-Assisted Improved Differential Fault Attacks on Lightweight Stream Ciphers
summary: Lightweight cryptographic primitives are widely deployed in resource-constraint environment, particularly in the Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Due to their public accessibility, these devices are vulnerable to physical attacks, especially fault attacks. Recently, deep learning-based cryptanalytic techniques have demonstrated promising results; however, their application to fault attacks remains limited, particularly for stream ciphers. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of deep learning assisted differential fault attack on three lightweight stream ciphers, namely ACORNv3, MORUSv2 and ATOM, under a relaxed fault model, where a single-bit bit-flipping fault is injected at an unknown location. We train multilayer perceptron (MLP) models to identify the fault locations. Experimental results show that the trained models achieve high identification accuracies of 0.999880, 0.999231 and 0.823568 for ACORNv3, MORUSv2 and ATOM, respectively, and outperform traditional signature-based methods. For the secret recovery process, we introduce a threshold-based method to optimize the number of fault injections required to recover the secret information. The results show that the initial state of ACORN can be recovered with 21 to 34 faults; while MORUS requires 213 to 248 faults, with at most 6 bits of guessing. Both attacks reduce the attack complexity compared to existing works. For ATOM, the results show that it possesses a higher security margin, as majority of state bits in the Non-linear Feedback Shift Register (NFSR) can only be recovered under a precise control model. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first experimental results of differential fault attacks on ATOM.
summary_zh: 轻量级密码原语广泛应用于资源受限环境，特别是物联网设备中。由于其公开可访问性，这些设备易受物理攻击，尤其是故障攻击。近年来，基于深度学习的密码分析技术已展现出良好效果，但在故障攻击中的应用仍显不足，尤其针对流密码领域。本研究探索了在宽松故障模型下对三种轻量级流密码（ACORNv3、MORUSv2和ATOM）实施深度学习辅助差分故障攻击的可行性，该模型允许在未知位置注入单比特翻转故障。我们训练多层感知机（MLP）模型以识别故障位置，实验结果表明：训练后的模型对ACORNv3、MORUSv2和ATOM的识别准确率分别达到0.999880、0.999231和0.823568，性能优于传统基于特征的方法。在密钥恢复阶段，我们引入基于阈值的方法来优化恢复秘密信息所需的故障注入次数。结果显示：ACORN的初始状态可通过21至34次故障恢复；MORUS需213至248次故障并最多猜测6比特密钥；两种攻击均较现有方案降低了攻击复杂度。对于ATOM，研究表明其具有更高的安全裕度，非线性反馈移位寄存器中的大多数状态位仅能在精确控制模型下恢复。据我们所知，本研究首次提供了针对ATOM差分故障攻击的实验结果。
tldr: This paper uses deep learning (MLP models) to improve differential fault attacks on lightweight stream ciphers, evaluating them on three specific ciphers and showing improved efficiency over traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本研究使用深度学习（MLP模型）来改进对轻量级流密码的差分故障攻击，评估了三种具体密码，并展示了相比传统方法更高的攻击效率。

title: Finite-time analysis of Multi-timescale Stochastic Optimization Algorithms
summary: We present a finite-time analysis of two smoothed functional stochastic approximation algorithms for simulation-based optimization. The first is a two time-scale gradient-based method, while the second is a three time-scale Newton-based algorithm that estimates both the gradient and the Hessian of the objective function $J$. Both algorithms involve zeroth order estimates for the gradient/Hessian. Although the asymptotic convergence of these algorithms has been established in prior work, finite-time guarantees of two-timescale stochastic optimization algorithms in zeroth order settings have not been provided previously. For our Newton algorithm, we derive mean-squared error bounds for the Hessian estimator and establish a finite-time bound on $\min\limits_{0 \le m \le T} \mathbb{E}\| \nabla J(θ(m)) \|^2$, showing convergence to first-order stationary points. The analysis explicitly characterizes the interaction between multiple time-scales and the propagation of estimation errors. We further identify step-size choices that balance dominant error terms and achieve near-optimal convergence rates. We also provide corresponding finite-time guarantees for the gradient algorithm under the same framework. The theoretical results are further validated through experiments on the Continuous Mountain Car environment.
summary_zh: 本文针对两种基于仿真的光滑泛函随机逼近算法进行了有限时间分析。第一种是基于梯度的双时间尺度算法，第二种是基于牛顿法的三时间尺度算法，后者同时估计目标函数 $J$ 的梯度与海森矩阵。两种算法均采用零阶估计方法对梯度及海森矩阵进行估计。虽然已有研究证明了这些算法的渐近收敛性，但在零阶设定下，双时间尺度随机优化算法的有限时间收敛性保证尚未得到充分探讨。对于牛顿算法，我们推导了海森估计量的均方误差界，并建立了 $\min\limits_{0 \le m \le T} \mathbb{E}\| \nabla J(θ(m)) \|^2$ 的有限时间收敛界，证明其能够收敛至一阶稳定点。该分析明确刻画了多时间尺度间的交互作用与估计误差的传播机制。我们进一步给出了步长选择方案，以平衡主要误差项并实现接近最优的收敛速率。同时，我们在同一框架下为梯度算法提供了相应的有限时间收敛性保证。理论结果通过连续山地车环境中的实验得到了进一步验证。
tldr: This paper presents a finite-time convergence analysis for two multi-timescale stochastic optimization algorithms (gradient and Newton-based) using zeroth-order estimates.
tldr_zh: 本文对两种使用零阶估计的多时间尺度随机优化算法（梯度法和牛顿法）进行了有限时间收敛性分析。

title: LGFNet: Local-Global Fusion Network with Fidelity Gap Delta Learning for Multi-Source Aerodynamics
summary: The precise fusion of computational fluid dynamic (CFD) data, wind tunnel tests data, and flight tests data in aerodynamic area is essential for obtaining comprehensive knowledge of both localized flow structures and global aerodynamic trends across the entire flight envelope. However, existing methodologies often struggle to balance high-resolution local fidelity with wide-range global dependency, leading to either a loss of sharp discontinuities or an inability to capture long-range topological correlations. We propose Local-Global Fusion Network (LGFNet) for multi-scale feature decomposition to extract this dual-natured aerodynamic knowledge. To this end, LGFNet combines a spatial perception layer that integrates a sliding window mechanism with a relational reasoning layer based on self-attention, simultaneously reinforcing the continuity of fine-grained local features (e.g., shock waves) and capturing long-range flow information. Furthermore, the fidelity gap delta learning (FGDL) strategy is proposed to treat CFD data as a "low-frequency carrier" to explicitly approximate nonlinear discrepancies. This approach prevents unphysical smoothing while inheriting the foundational physical trends from the simulation baseline. Experiments demonstrate that LGFNet achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both accuracy and uncertainty reduction across diverse aerodynamic scenarios.
summary_zh: 空气动力学领域计算流体动力学（CFD）数据、风洞试验数据与飞行试验数据的精确融合，对于全面获取全飞行包线内局部流动结构与整体气动趋势的认知至关重要。然而，现有方法往往难以平衡高分辨率局部保真度与宽范围全局关联性，易导致尖锐不连续特征的丢失或长程拓扑关联的遗漏。本文提出局部-全局融合网络（LGFNet），通过多尺度特征分解机制提取这种双重特性的气动知识。该网络结合了集成滑动窗口机制的空间感知层与基于自注意力的关系推理层，在强化细粒度局部特征（如激波）连续性的同时，捕获长程流动信息。此外，所提出的保真度间隙增量学习（FGDL）策略将CFD数据视为"低频载体"，显式逼近非线性差异。该方法在继承仿真基线物理趋势的基础上，避免了非物理平滑现象。实验表明，LGFNet在多种气动场景中均实现了精度与不确定性降低的先进性能。
tldr: Proposes a Local-Global Fusion Network (LGFNet) with a fidelity gap delta learning strategy for fusing multi-source aerodynamic data, aiming to balance local fidelity and global trends.
tldr_zh: 提出了局部-全局融合网络（LGFNet）及保真度差距增量学习策略，用于融合多源气动数据，旨在平衡局部高保真与全局趋势。

title: From Physics to Surrogate Intelligence: A Unified Electro-Thermo-Optimization Framework for TSV Networks
summary: High-density through-substrate vias (TSVs) enable 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration but introduce significant signal-integrity and thermal-reliability challenges due to electrical coupling, insertion loss, and self-heating. Conventional full-wave finite-element method (FEM) simulations provide high accuracy but become computationally prohibitive for large design-space exploration. This work presents a scalable electro-thermal modeling and optimization framework that combines physics-informed analytical modeling, graph neural network (GNN) surrogates, and full-wave sign-off validation. A multi-conductor analytical model computes broadband S-parameters and effective anisotropic thermal conductivities of TSV arrays, achieving $5\%-10\%$ relative Frobenius error (RFE) across array sizes up to $15x15$. A physics-informed GNN surrogate (TSV-PhGNN), trained on analytical data and fine-tuned with HFSS simulations, generalizes to larger arrays with RFE below $2\%$ and nearly constant variance. The surrogate is integrated into a multi-objective Pareto optimization framework targeting reflection coefficient, insertion loss, worst-case crosstalk (NEXT/FEXT), and effective thermal conductivity. Millions of TSV configurations can be explored within minutes, enabling exhaustive layout and geometric optimization that would be infeasible using FEM alone. Final designs are validated with Ansys HFSS and Mechanical, showing strong agreement. The proposed framework enables rapid electro-thermal co-design of TSV arrays while reducing per-design evaluation time by more than six orders of magnitude.
summary_zh: 高密度硅通孔（TSV）技术可实现2.5D/3D异构集成，但由于电气耦合、插入损耗和自热效应，也带来了显著的信号完整性与热可靠性挑战。传统的全波有限元法仿真精度高，但在大规模设计空间探索中计算成本过高。本文提出一种可扩展的电-热建模与优化框架，结合了物理信息解析建模、图神经网络代理模型和全波签核验证。通过多导体解析模型计算TSV阵列的宽带S参数和等效各向异性热导率，在15x15规模的阵列中相对弗罗贝尼乌斯误差保持在5%–10%范围内。基于物理信息的图神经网络代理模型（TSV-PhGNN）通过解析数据训练并辅以HFSS仿真微调，可推广至更大规模阵列，其相对弗罗贝尼乌斯误差低于2%且方差近乎恒定。该代理模型被集成到多目标帕累托优化框架中，以优化反射系数、插入损耗、最坏情况串扰（近端/远端串扰）和等效热导率为目标。该框架可在数分钟内探索数百万种TSV配置，实现传统有限元法难以完成的详尽布局与几何优化。最终设计经Ansys HFSS与Mechanical验证，结果高度吻合。所提出的框架能够实现TSV阵列的快速电-热协同设计，同时将单个设计的评估时间降低了六个数量级以上。
tldr: This paper presents a scalable electro-thermal modeling and optimization framework using physics-informed GNN surrogates for the design of through-substrate via (TSV) networks in integrated circuits, drastically accelerating design exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于集成电路中硅通孔网络设计的可扩展电热建模与优化框架，该框架使用物理信息图神经网络代理，极大地加速了设计探索过程。

title: Biomimetic PINNs for Cell-Induced Phase Transitions: UQ-R3 Sampling with Causal Gating
summary: Nonconvex multi-well energies in cell-induced phase transitions give rise to sharp interfaces, fine-scale microstructures, and distance-dependent inter-cell coupling, all of which pose significant challenges for physics-informed learning. Existing methods often suffer from over-smoothing in near-field patterns. To address this, we propose biomimetic physics-informed neural networks (Bio-PINNs), a variational framework that encodes temporal causality into explicit spatial causality via a progressive distance gate. Furthermore, Bio-PINNs leverage a deformation-uncertainty proxy for the interfacial length scale to target microstructure-prone regions, providing a computationally efficient alternative to explicit second-derivative regularization. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting uncertainty-driven ``retain-resample-release" adaptive collocation strategy, which ensures persistent coverage under gating and establishing a quantitative near-to-far growth bound. Across single- and multi-cell benchmarks, diverse separations, and various regularization regimes, Bio-PINNs consistently recover sharp transition layers and tether morphologies, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art adaptive and ungated baselines.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
细胞诱导相变中的非凸多势阱能量会导致尖锐界面、细尺度微观结构以及依赖于距离的细胞间耦合，这些均对物理信息学习构成重大挑战。现有方法在近场模式中往往存在过度平滑的问题。为此，我们提出仿生物理信息神经网络（Bio-PINNs），这是一种通过渐进式距离门控将时间因果性编码为显式空间因果性的变分框架。此外，Bio-PINNs利用界面长度尺度的变形-不确定性代理来针对易产生微观结构的区域，为显式二阶导数正则化提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。我们为所提出的不确定性驱动“保留-重采样-释放”自适应配点策略提供了理论保证，该策略确保在门控下的持续覆盖，并建立了定量的近场至远场增长边界。在单细胞与多细胞基准测试、不同间距以及多种正则化机制下，Bio-PINNs均能稳定恢复尖锐的过渡层和束缚形态，显著优于当前最先进的自适应与非门控基线方法。
tldr: The paper proposes a biomimetic physics-informed neural network framework for cell-induced phase transitions, focusing on addressing over-smoothing in near-field patterns through causal gating and uncertainty-driven adaptive sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于细胞诱导相变的仿生物理信息神经网络框架，通过因果门控和不确定性驱动的自适应采样来解决近场模式中的过平滑问题。

title: Adaptive Delayed-Update Cyclic Algorithm for Variational Inequalities
summary: Cyclic block coordinate methods are a fundamental class of first-order algorithms, widely used in practice for their simplicity and strong empirical performance. Yet, their theoretical behavior remains challenging to explain, and setting their step sizes -- beyond classical coordinate descent for minimization -- typically requires careful tuning or line-search machinery. In this work, we develop $\texttt{ADUCA}$ (Adaptive Delayed-Update Cyclic Algorithm), a cyclic algorithm addressing a broad class of Minty variational inequalities with monotone Lipschitz operators. $\texttt{ADUCA}$ is parameter-free: it requires no global or block-wise Lipschitz constants and uses no per-epoch line search, except at initialization. A key feature of the algorithm is using operator information delayed by a full cycle, which makes the algorithm compatible with parallel and distributed implementations, and attractive due to weakened synchronization requirements across blocks. We prove that $\texttt{ADUCA}$ attains (near) optimal global oracle complexity as a function of target error $ε>0,$ scaling with $1/ε$ for monotone operators, or with $\log^2(1/ε)$ for operators that are strongly monotone.
summary_zh: 循环块坐标法是一类基础的一阶算法，因其简单性和强大的实证性能而在实践中广泛应用。然而，其理论行为仍难以解释，且步长设置——超越经典的最小化坐标下降法——通常需要仔细调参或线搜索机制。本研究开发了$\texttt{ADUCA}$（自适应延迟更新循环算法），该循环算法用于处理一类具有单调Lipschitz算子的Minty型变分不等式问题。$\texttt{ADUCA}$具有无参数特性：它不需要全局或分块Lipschitz常数，除初始化阶段外无需每轮线搜索。该算法的关键特点是使用了延迟一个完整周期的算子信息，这使得算法能够兼容并行和分布式实现，并因减弱了跨块同步需求而更具吸引力。我们证明，$\texttt{ADUCA}$在目标误差$ε>0$的函数上达到了（近似）最优的全局预言复杂度：对于单调算子其缩放为$1/ε$，对于强单调算子则缩放为$\log^2(1/ε)$。
tldr: The paper proposes a parameter-free cyclic algorithm for variational inequalities with monotone operators, featuring delayed updates for parallel/distributed computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种参数自由的循环算法，用于求解单调算子的变分不等式问题，其延迟更新机制便于并行与分布式计算。

title: How much of persistent homology is topology? A quantitative decomposition for spin model phase transitions
summary: Point-cloud persistent homology (PH) -- computing alpha or Rips complexes on spin-position point clouds -- has been widely applied to detect phase transitions in classical spin models since Donato et al. (2016), with subsequent studies attributing the detection to the topological content of the persistence diagram. We ask a simple question that has not been posed: what fraction of the PH signal is genuinely topological? We introduce f_topo, a quantitative decomposition that separates the density-driven and topological contributions to any PH statistic by comparing real spin configurations against density-matched shuffled null models. Across the 2D Ising model (system sizes L = 16-128, ten temperatures) and Potts models (q = 3, 5), we find that H_0 statistics -- total persistence, persistence entropy, feature count -- are 94-100% density-driven (f_topo < 0.07). The density-matched shuffled null detects T_c at the identical location and with comparable peak height as real configurations, showing that density alone is sufficient for phase transition detection. However, H_1 statistics are partially topological: the topological fraction grows with system size as delta(TP_{H_1}) ~ L^{0.53} and follows a finite-size scaling collapse delta(T, L) = L^{0.53} g(tL^{1/nu}) with collapse quality CV = 0.27. The longest persistence bar is strongly topological (f_topo > 1) and scales with the correlation length. A scale-resolved analysis reveals that the topological excess shifts from large-scale to small-scale features as L increases. We propose that the TDA-for-phase-transitions community adopt shuffled null models as standard practice, and that H_1 rather than H_0 statistics be used when genuine topological information is sought.
summary_zh: 点云持续同调（PH）——通过计算自旋位置点云上的阿尔法复形或里普斯复形——自Donato等人（2016）的研究以来，已被广泛应用于检测经典自旋模型中的相变，后续研究将这种检测能力归因于持续图的拓扑内容。我们提出一个尚未被探讨的简单问题：PH信号中究竟有多少比例是真正具有拓扑性的？我们引入f_topo这一量化分解方法，通过将真实自旋构型与密度匹配的随机重排零模型进行比较，分离出任何PH统计量中密度驱动与拓扑贡献的成分。在二维伊辛模型（系统尺寸L=16-128，十个温度）和波茨模型（q=3,5）中，我们发现H_0统计量（总持续值、持续熵、特征数量）有94-100%由密度驱动（f_topo<0.07）。密度匹配的随机重排零模型能够在与真实构型完全相同的位置检测到相变临界温度T_c，且峰值高度相当，表明仅凭密度信息就足以实现相变检测。然而，H_1统计量则具有部分拓扑性：其拓扑分数随系统尺寸增大呈δ(TP_{H_1})~L^{0.53}增长，并遵循有限尺寸标度坍缩规律δ(T,L)=L^{0.53}g(tL^{1/ν})，坍缩质量CV=0.27。最长的持续条形特征具有显著拓扑性（f_topo>1），且与关联长度标度相关。尺度分辨分析显示，随着L增大，拓扑超额贡献会从大尺度特征向小尺度特征转移。我们建议相变拓扑数据分析（TDA）领域将随机重排零模型作为标准实践工具，并在寻求真实拓扑信息时使用H_1而非H_0统计量。
tldr: This paper presents a quantitative decomposition (f_topo) to separate density-driven and topological contributions in persistent homology signals from spin models, finding that most phase transition detection signals are density-driven rather than topological.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种量化分解方法（f_topo），用于分离自旋模型中持续同源性信号的密度驱动和拓扑贡献，发现大多数相变检测信号是密度驱动的，而非拓扑性的。

title: Data-informed lifting line theory
summary: We present a data-driven framework that extends the predictive capability of classical lifting-line theory (LLT) to a wider aerodynamic regime by incorporating higher-fidelity aerodynamic data from panel method simulations. A neural network architecture with a convolutional layer followed by fully connected layers is developed, comprising two parallel subnetworks to separately process spanwise collocation points and global geometric/aerodynamic inputs such as angle of attack, chord, twist, airfoil distribution, and sweep. Among several configurations tested, this architecture is most effective in learning corrections to LLT outputs. The trained model captures higher-order three-dimensional effects in spanwise lift and drag distributions in regimes where LLT is inaccurate, such as low aspect ratios and high sweep, and generalizes well to wing configurations outside both the LLT regime and the training data range. The method retains LLT's computational efficiency, enabling integration into aerodynamic optimization loops and early-stage aircraft design studies. This approach offers a practical path for embedding high-fidelity corrections into low-order methods and may be extended to other aerodynamic prediction tasks, such as propeller performance.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种数据驱动框架，通过融合面元法模拟获得的高精度气动数据，将经典升力线理论（LLT）的预测能力拓展至更广泛的气动工况。研究构建了一种包含卷积层与全连接层的神经网络架构，采用两个并行子网络分别处理展向配置点数据以及全局几何/气动输入参数（如攻角、弦长、扭角、翼型分布和后掠角）。在多种测试构型中，该架构对于学习LLT输出的修正效果最为显著。训练后的模型在LLT失效工况（如低展弦比、高后掠角）下能准确捕捉展向升阻力分布的高阶三维效应，并对超出LLT适用范围及训练数据分布的机翼构型具有良好的泛化能力。该方法保持了LLT的计算效率，可集成至气动优化循环与飞机早期设计研究中。该技术为在低阶方法中嵌入高精度修正提供了可行路径，并可拓展至螺旋桨性能预测等其他气动预测任务。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven enhancement of classical lifting-line theory for aerodynamics using neural networks, focusing on wing design and optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，利用神经网络增强经典升力线理论，专注于机翼设计和优化。

title: From Astronomy to Astrology: Testing the Illusion of Zodiac-Based Personality Prediction with Machine Learning
summary: Astrology has long been used to interpret human personality, estimate compatibility, and guide social decision-making. Zodiac-based systems in particular remain culturally influential across much of the world, including in South Asian societies where astrological reasoning can shape marriage matching, naming conventions, ritual timing, and broader life planning. Despite this persistence, astrology has never established either a physically plausible mechanism or a statistically reliable predictive foundation. In this work, we examine zodiac-based personality prediction using a controlled machine-learning framework. We construct a synthetic dataset in which individuals are assigned zodiac signs and personality labels drawn from a shared pool of 100 broadly human traits. Each sign is associated with a subset of 10 common descriptors, intentionally overlapping with those assigned to other signs, thereby reproducing the ambiguity characteristic of practical astrological systems. We then train Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and neural-network classifiers to infer personality labels from zodiac-based features and nuisance covariates. Across all experiments, predictive performance remains at or near random expectation, while shuffled-label controls yield comparable accuracies. We argue that the apparent success of astrology arises not from measurable predictive structure, but from trait universality, category overlap, cognitive biases such as the Barnum effect and confirmation bias, and the interpretive flexibility of astrologers and pundits. We conclude that zodiac-based systems do not provide reliable information for predicting human behavior and instead function as culturally durable narrative frameworks. This paper is intended as a humorous academic exercise.
summary_zh: 占星学长久以来被用于解读人类性格、评估兼容性以及指导社会决策。基于星座的预测体系尤其在全球多地的文化中具有影响力，包括南亚社会，其中占星逻辑常被用于婚姻匹配、命名习俗、仪式择时及更广泛的人生规划。尽管这种传统持续存在，占星学始终未能确立一个物理上可信的机制或统计上可靠的预测基础。本研究采用受控的机器学习框架检验基于星座的性格预测。我们构建了一个合成数据集，其中个体被分配星座标签和从100项广泛人类特征池中抽取的性格标签，每个星座与10个通用描述词的子集关联，这些描述词有意与其他星座的标签重叠，从而再现了实际占星体系中常见的模糊性特征。随后，我们训练逻辑回归、随机森林和神经网络分类器，尝试从星座特征及干扰协变量中推断性格标签。所有实验结果显示，预测性能始终处于或接近随机期望水平，而随机标签对照组也产生相似的准确度。我们认为，占星学表面上的成功并非源自可测量的预测结构，而是源于特质的普遍性、类别重叠、巴纳姆效应和确认偏误等认知偏差，以及占星师与评论者解读的灵活性。我们得出结论：基于星座的体系无法为预测人类行为提供可靠信息，其本质是文化上具有持久性的叙事框架。本文旨在进行一次幽默的学术探讨。
tldr: The paper uses machine learning to humorously debunk zodiac-based personality prediction, finding no predictive power beyond random chance and attributing astrology's perceived success to cognitive biases and trait universality.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用机器学习进行幽默地论证，指出星座性格预测没有预测能力，其表面的成功源于认知偏差和特质的普遍性。

title: Transfer Learning in Bayesian Optimization for Aircraft Design
summary: The use of transfer learning within Bayesian optimization addresses the disadvantages of the so-called \textit{cold start} problem by using source data to aid in the optimization of a target problem. We present a method that leverages an ensemble of surrogate models using transfer learning and integrates it in a constrained Bayesian optimization framework. We identify challenges particular to aircraft design optimization related to heterogeneous design variables and constraints. We propose the use of a partial-least-squares dimension reduction algorithm to address design space heterogeneity, and a \textit{meta} data surrogate selection method to address constraint heterogeneity. Numerical benchmark problems and an aircraft conceptual design optimization problem are used to demonstrate the proposed methods. Results show significant improvement in convergence in early optimization iterations compared to standard Bayesian optimization, with improved prediction accuracy for both objective and constraint surrogate models.
summary_zh: 在贝叶斯优化中应用迁移学习，通过利用源数据辅助目标问题的优化，能够有效缓解所谓的“冷启动”问题。本文提出一种方法，该方法采用集成代理模型结合迁移学习，并将其整合到约束贝叶斯优化框架中。我们识别出飞机设计优化中特有的挑战，这些挑战涉及异构设计变量和约束条件。为此，我们提出使用偏最小二乘降维算法应对设计空间异构性，并采用一种“元”数据代理选择方法处理约束异构性。通过数值基准测试和一个飞机概念设计优化问题对所提方法进行了验证。结果表明，与标准贝叶斯优化相比，所提方法在优化早期迭代中收敛性显著提升，且目标函数与约束代理模型的预测精度均得到改善。
tldr: Proposes a transfer learning method for Bayesian optimization using an ensemble of surrogate models to address the cold start problem, applied to heterogeneous design spaces in aircraft conceptual design optimization.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于贝叶斯优化的迁移学习方法，利用代理模型集成解决冷启动问题，并应用于飞机概念设计中的异构设计空间优化。

title: \texttt{ReproMIA}: A Comprehensive Analysis of Model Reprogramming for Proactive Membership Inference Attacks
summary: The pervasive deployment of deep learning models across critical domains has concurrently intensified privacy concerns due to their inherent propensity for data memorization. While Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) serve as the gold standard for auditing these privacy vulnerabilities, conventional MIA paradigms are increasingly constrained by the prohibitive computational costs of shadow model training and a precipitous performance degradation under low False Positive Rate constraints. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a novel perspective by leveraging the principles of model reprogramming as an active signal amplifier for privacy leakage. Building upon this insight, we present \texttt{ReproMIA}, a unified and efficient proactive framework for membership inference. We rigorously substantiate, both theoretically and empirically, how our methodology proactively induces and magnifies latent privacy footprints embedded within the model's representations. We provide specialized instantiations of \texttt{ReproMIA} across diverse architectural paradigms, including LLMs, Diffusion Models, and Classification Models. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across more than ten benchmarks and a variety of model architectures demonstrate that \texttt{ReproMIA} consistently and substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a transformative leap in performance specifically within low-FPR regimes, such as an average of 5.25\% AUC and 10.68\% TPR@1\%FPR increase over the runner-up for LLMs, as well as 3.70\% and 12.40\% respectively for Diffusion Models.
summary_zh: 深度学习模型在关键领域的广泛部署，因其固有的数据记忆倾向而加剧了隐私担忧。虽然成员推断攻击（MIA）作为审计这些隐私漏洞的黄金标准，但传统的MIA范式日益受到影子模型训练过高计算成本以及低误报率约束下性能急剧下降的限制。为克服这些挑战，我们引入了一种新颖的视角，利用模型重编程原理作为隐私泄露的主动信号放大器。基于这一见解，我们提出了\texttt{ReproMIA}，一个统一且高效的前瞻性成员推断框架。我们从理论和实证两方面严格验证了该方法如何主动诱发并放大模型表征中潜在的隐私足迹。我们为\texttt{ReproMIA}在多种架构范式（包括大语言模型、扩散模型和分类模型）中提供了专门的实例化方案。在超过十个基准测试和多种模型架构上的综合实验评估表明，\texttt{ReproMIA}始终显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，特别是在低误报率场景下实现了性能的跨越式提升：例如，在大语言模型上，其平均AUC较次优方法提高5.25%，TPR@1\%FPR提高10.68%；在扩散模型上则分别提高3.70%和12.40%。
tldr: The paper introduces ReproMIA, a novel proactive membership inference attack framework that uses model reprogramming to amplify privacy leakage signals, achieving superior performance across diverse model architectures (LLMs, Diffusion Models, etc.) in low false-positive rate regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 ReproMIA 的新型主动成员推理攻击框架，该方法利用模型重编程来放大隐私泄露信号，在多种模型架构上实现了卓越的性能，尤其是在低误报率情况下。

title: Symmetrizing Bregman Divergence on the Cone of Positive Definite Matrices: Which Mean to Use and Why
summary: This work uncovers variational principles behind symmetrizing the Bregman divergences induced by generic mirror maps over the cone of positive definite matrices. We show that computing the canonical means for this symmetrization can be posed as minimizing the desired symmetrized divergences over a set of mean functionals defined axiomatically to satisfy certain properties. For the forward symmetrization, we prove that the arithmetic mean over the primal space is canonical for any mirror map over the positive definite cone. For the reverse symmetrization, we show that the canonical mean is the arithmetic mean over the dual space, pulled back to the primal space. Applying this result to three common mirror maps used in practice, we show that the canonical means for reverse symmetrization, in those cases, turn out to be the arithmetic, log-Euclidean and harmonic means. Our results improve understanding of existing symmetrization practices in the literature, and can be seen as a navigational chart to help decide which mean to use when.
summary_zh: 本工作揭示了在正定矩阵锥上由通用镜像映射诱导的Bregman散度对称化背后的变分原理。我们证明，计算这种对称化对应的典范均值可转化为在一组满足特定公理化性质的均值泛函集合上，最小化目标对称化散度。对于正向对称化，我们证明原空间的算术均值是正定锥上任意镜像映射的典范选择。对于反向对称化，则表明典范均值是定义在对偶空间上的算术均值在原空间中的拉回映射。将这一结果应用于实践中常用的三种镜像映射时，我们证明反向对称化对应的典范均值分别为算术均值、对数欧几里得均值与调和均值。本研究深化了对现有文献中对称化实践的理解，其成果可视为指导实践中如何选择均值方法的导航图。
tldr: This paper analyzes the mathematical principles for symmetrizing Bregman divergences on positive definite matrices, identifying canonical means for different symmetrization schemes.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了在正定矩阵锥上对称化Bregman散度的数学原理，为不同的对称化方案确定了规范均值。

title: Functional Force-Aware Retargeting from Virtual Human Demos to Soft Robot Policies
summary: We introduce SoftAct, a framework for teaching soft robot hands to perform human-like manipulation skills by explicitly reasoning about contact forces. Leveraging immersive virtual reality, our system captures rich human demonstrations, including hand kinematics, object motion, dense contact patches, and detailed contact force information. Unlike conventional approaches that retarget human joint trajectories, SoftAct employs a two-stage, force-aware retargeting algorithm. The first stage attributes demonstrated contact forces to individual human fingers and allocates robot fingers proportionally, establishing a force-balanced mapping between human and robot hands. The second stage performs online retargeting by combining baseline end-effector pose tracking with geodesic-weighted contact refinements, using contact geometry and force magnitude to adjust robot fingertip targets in real time. This formulation enables soft robotic hands to reproduce the functional intent of human demonstrations while naturally accommodating extreme embodiment mismatch and nonlinear compliance. We evaluate SoftAct on a suite of contact-rich manipulation tasks using a custom non-anthropomorphic pneumatic soft robot hand. SoftAct's controller reduces fingertip trajectory tracking RMSE by up to 55 percent and reduces tracking variance by up to 69 percent compared to kinematic and learning-based baselines. At the policy level, SoftAct achieves consistently higher success in zero-shot real-world deployment and in simulation. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling contact geometry and force distribution is essential for effective skill transfer to soft robotic hands, and cannot be recovered through kinematic imitation alone. Project videos and additional details are available at https://soft-act.github.io/.
summary_zh: 我们提出了SoftAct框架，旨在通过显式推理接触力来教授软体机器人手执行类人操作技能。该框架利用沉浸式虚拟现实技术，捕捉丰富的人类示范数据，包括手部运动学、物体运动、密集接触斑块及详细的接触力信息。与传统重定向人类关节轨迹的方法不同，SoftAct采用两阶段力感知重定向算法：第一阶段将示范的接触力归因于各个人类手指，并按比例分配至机器人手指，从而建立人手机械臂间的力平衡映射；第二阶段通过结合基线末端执行器姿态跟踪与测地加权接触优化进行在线重定向，利用接触几何和力幅值实时调整机器人指尖目标位置。这种设计使软体机器人手能够复现人类示范的功能意图，同时自然适应极端形态差异和非线性柔顺性。我们在定制非拟人气动软体机器人手上，通过一系列接触密集型操作任务对SoftAct进行评估。相比运动学及基于学习的基线方法，SoftAct控制器将指尖轨迹跟踪均方根误差降低最高达55%，跟踪方差减少最高达69%。在策略层面，SoftAct在零样本真实世界部署和仿真中均实现了更高的成功率。这些结果表明，显式建模接触几何与力分布对于向软体机器人手的有效技能迁移至关重要，仅通过运动学模仿无法实现同等效果。项目视频及更多细节详见https://soft-act.github.io/。
tldr: SoftAct introduces a force-aware retargeting method using VR human demonstrations to teach contact-rich manipulation skills to non-anthropomorphic soft robot hands, outperforming kinematic baselines.
tldr_zh: SoftAct 提出了一种基于力感知的示教重定向方法，利用VR人类演示来教非拟人化软体机器人手完成接触丰富的操作任务，性能优于运动学基线。

title: Collaborative Task and Path Planning for Heterogeneous Robotic Teams using Multi-Agent PPO
summary: Efficient robotic extraterrestrial exploration requires robots with diverse capabilities, ranging from scientific measurement tools to advanced locomotion. A robotic team enables the distribution of tasks over multiple specialized subsystems, each providing specific expertise to complete the mission. The central challenge lies in efficiently coordinating the team to maximize utilization and the extraction of scientific value. Classical planning algorithms scale poorly with problem size, leading to long planning cycles and high inference costs due to the combinatorial growth of possible robot-target allocations and possible trajectories. Learning-based methods are a viable alternative that move the scaling concern from runtime to training time, setting a critical step towards achieving real-time planning. In this work, we present a collaborative planning strategy based on Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) to coordinate a team of heterogeneous robots to solve a complex target allocation and scheduling problem. We benchmark our approach against single-objective optimal solutions obtained through exhaustive search and evaluate its ability to perform online replanning in the context of a planetary exploration scenario.
summary_zh: 高效的外星机器人探索需要具备多样能力的机器人，涵盖从科学测量工具到先进运动系统在内的多种功能。机器人团队能够将任务分配至多个专业化子系统，每个子系统凭借其特定专长协同完成使命。核心挑战在于如何高效协调团队运作，以最大化资源利用率和科学价值产出。经典规划算法在问题规模扩大时性能急剧下降，由于机器人目标分配方案与可行轨迹的组合式增长，导致规划周期过长且推理成本高昂。基于学习的方法是一种可行的替代方案，它将规模扩展的压力从运行时转移至训练阶段，为实现实时规划迈出了关键一步。本研究提出了一种基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的协同规划策略，用于协调异构机器人团队解决复杂的目标分配与调度问题。我们通过穷举搜索获得的单目标最优解对本方法进行基准测试，并在行星探索场景中评估其在线重规划能力。
tldr: This paper presents a Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) based collaborative planning strategy for coordinating heterogeneous robot teams in planetary exploration, benchmarking it against optimal solutions and evaluating online replanning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的协作规划策略，用于协调行星探索任务中的异构机器人团队，并与穷举搜索的最优解进行了基准测试，评估了其在线重规划能力。

title: SMASH: Mastering Scalable Whole-Body Skills for Humanoid Ping-Pong with Egocentric Vision
summary: Existing humanoid table tennis systems remain limited by their reliance on external sensing and their inability to achieve agile whole-body coordination for precise task execution. These limitations stem from two core challenges: achieving low-latency and robust onboard egocentric perception under fast robot motion, and obtaining sufficiently diverse task-aligned strike motions for learning precise yet natural whole-body behaviors. In this work, we present \methodname, a modular system for agile humanoid table tennis that unifies scalable whole-body skill learning with onboard egocentric perception, eliminating the need for external cameras during deployment. Our work advances prior humanoid table-tennis systems in three key aspects. First, we achieve agile and precise ball interaction with tightly coordinated whole-body control, rather than relying on decoupled upper- and lower-body behaviors. This enables the system to exhibit diverse strike motions, including explosive whole-body smashes and low crouching shots. Second, by augmenting and diversifying strike motions with a generative model, our framework benefits from scalable motion priors and produces natural, robust striking behaviors across a wide workspace. Third, to the best of our knowledge, we demonstrate the first humanoid table-tennis system capable of consecutive strikes using onboard sensing alone, despite the challenges of low-latency perception, ego-motion-induced instability, and limited field of view. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate stable and precise ball exchanges under high-speed conditions, validating scalable, perception-driven whole-body skill learning for dynamic humanoid interaction tasks.
summary_zh: 现有仿人形机器人乒乓球系统仍受限于对外部感知的依赖，且无法为实现精确任务执行而达成灵巧的全身协调。这些局限源于两大核心挑战：在快速机器人运动下实现低延迟、鲁棒的机载自我中心感知，以及获取足够多样化且任务对齐的击球动作，以学习精确而自然的全身行为。本文提出\methodname，一个用于敏捷仿人形乒乓球运动的模块化系统。该系统将可扩展的全身技能学习与机载自我中心感知相统一，从而在部署时无需依赖外部摄像头。我们的研究在以下三个关键方面推进了现有仿人形乒乓球系统：首先，通过高度协调的全身控制而非解耦的上半身与下半身行为，实现了敏捷精准的击球交互。这使得系统能够展现多样化的击球动作，包括爆发性全身扣杀和低位蹲姿击球。其次，通过生成模型增强并丰富击球动作多样性，我们的框架从可扩展的运动先验中受益，能在广阔工作空间内产生自然且鲁棒的击球行为。最后，据我们所知，我们首次实现了仅依赖机载感知即可完成连续击球的仿人形乒乓球系统，克服了低延迟感知、自我运动引发的不稳定性及有限视野等挑战。大量真实世界实验表明，系统能在高速条件下实现稳定精准的连续对打，验证了可扩展的感知驱动全身技能学习在动态仿人形交互任务中的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents SMASH, a system for humanoid table tennis that combines scalable whole-body skill learning with onboard egocentric vision, achieving agile, precise ball control and consecutive strikes without external sensing.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了SMASH系统，它将可扩展的全身技能学习与机载自我中心视觉相结合，用于人形机器人乒乓球，实现了无需外部传感器的高敏捷性、精确击球和连续对打。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation under Distribution Shift with Bounded Extremum Seeking
summary: Reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, but learned policies often degrade in performance when test conditions differ from the training distribution. This limitation is especially important in contact-rich tasks such as pushing and pick-and-place, where changes in goals, contact conditions, or robot dynamics can drive the system out-of-distribution at inference time. In this paper, we investigate a hybrid controller that combines reinforcement learning with bounded extremum seeking to improve robustness under such conditions. In the proposed approach, deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) policies are trained under standard conditions on the robotic pushing and pick-and-place tasks, and are then combined with bounded ES during deployment. The RL policy provides fast manipulation behavior, while bounded ES ensures robustness of the overall controller to time variations when operating conditions depart from those seen during training. The resulting controller is evaluated under several out-of-distribution settings, including time-varying goals and spatially varying friction patches.
summary_zh: 强化学习在机器人操控任务中表现出优异性能，但测试条件与训练分布存在差异时，学习所得策略往往会出现性能退化。这一局限在接触密集型任务中尤为突出，例如物体推送和抓放操作——目标条件、接触状态或机器人动力学的变化都可能在推理阶段使系统脱离训练分布。本文研究了一种混合控制器，将强化学习与有界极值搜索相结合，以提升此类条件下的鲁棒性。该方法在标准条件下通过深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）算法训练机器人推送和抓放任务策略，并在部署阶段与有界极值搜索结合使用。强化学习策略提供快速操控行为，而有界极值搜索则确保当操作条件偏离训练场景时，整体控制器对时变因素保持鲁棒性。研究通过在多种非训练分布场景下的测试评估该控制器性能，包括时变目标与空间摩擦分布变化等工况。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid controller that combines deep reinforcement learning (DDPG) with bounded extremum seeking to improve robustness in robotic manipulation tasks like pushing and pick-and-place under distribution shifts, such as varying goals and friction.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合控制器，结合深度强化学习（DDPG）和有界极值搜索，以提高在推和抓放等机器人操作任务中对分布偏移（如目标变化和摩擦变化）的鲁棒性。

title: BAT: Balancing Agility and Stability via Online Policy Switching for Long-Horizon Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Despite recent advances in control, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning, developing a unified framework that can achieve agile, precise, and robust whole-body behaviors, particularly in long-horizon tasks, remains challenging. Existing approaches typically follow two paradigms: coupled whole-body policies for global coordination and decoupled policies for modular precision. However, without a systematic method to integrate both, this trade-off between agility, robustness, and precision remains unresolved. In this work, we propose BAT, an online policy-switching framework that dynamically selects between two complementary whole-body RL controllers to balance agility and stability across different motion contexts. Our framework consists of two complementary modules: a switching policy learned via hierarchical RL with an expert guidance from sliding-horizon policy pre-evaluation, and an option-aware VQ-VAE that predicts option preference from discrete motion token sequences for improved generalization. The final decision is obtained via confidence-weighted fusion of two modules. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot demonstrate that BAT enables versatile long-horizon loco-manipulation and outperforms prior methods across diverse tasks.
summary_zh: 尽管在控制、强化学习和模仿学习领域近期取得了进展，但构建一个能够实现敏捷、精确且鲁棒全身行为的统一框架——尤其是在长时程任务中——仍然面临挑战。现有方法通常遵循两种范式：用于全局协调的耦合全身策略，以及用于模块化精度的解耦策略。然而，由于缺乏系统性的整合方法，敏捷性、鲁棒性与精度之间的权衡问题仍未得到解决。在本研究中，我们提出了BAT框架，这是一种在线策略切换机制，能够动态选择两个互补的全身强化学习控制器，以在不同运动场景下平衡敏捷性与稳定性。该框架包含两个互补模块：通过分层强化学习结合滑动时域策略预评估专家指导学习的切换策略，以及能够从离散运动序列中预测选项偏好的选项感知VQ-VAE，以提升泛化能力。最终决策通过两个模块的置信度加权融合得出。在宇树G1仿人机器人上进行的大量仿真与实物实验表明，BAT能够实现多样化的长时程移动操作任务，并在多种任务中超越现有方法。
tldr: Proposes BAT, an online policy-switching framework using hierarchical RL and a VQ-VAE to dynamically select between two whole-body RL controllers, balancing agility and stability for long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks on a humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 提出BAT框架，通过分层强化学习和VQ-VAE在线切换两个互补的全身RL控制器，在仿人机器人上实现敏捷与稳定的平衡，以完成长时序的移动操作任务。

title: How to Train your Tactile Model: Tactile Perception with Multi-fingered Robot Hands
summary: Rapid deployment of new tactile sensors is essential for scalable robotic manipulation, especially in multi-fingered hands equipped with vision-based tactile sensors. However, current methods for inferring contact properties rely heavily on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which, while effective on known sensors, require large, sensor-specific datasets. Furthermore, they require retraining for each new sensor due to differences in lens properties, illumination, and sensor wear. Here we introduce TacViT, a novel tactile perception model based on Vision Transformers, designed to generalize on new sensor data. TacViT leverages global self-attention mechanisms to extract robust features from tactile images, enabling accurate contact property inference even on previously unseen sensors. This capability significantly reduces the need for data collection and retraining, accelerating the deployment of new sensors. We evaluate TacViT on sensors for a five-fingered robot hand and demonstrate its superior generalization performance compared to CNNs. Our results highlight TacViTs potential to make tactile sensing more scalable and practical for real-world robotic applications.
summary_zh: 新型触觉传感器的快速部署对于可扩展机器人操作至关重要，尤其在配备视觉触觉传感器的多指灵巧手中。然而，当前推断接触特性的方法主要依赖卷积神经网络，尽管在已知传感器上表现良好，但需要大量传感器专用数据集。此外，由于镜头特性、光照条件和传感器磨损的差异，每种新传感器都需要重新训练。本文提出TacViT，一种基于视觉变换器的新型触觉感知模型，旨在实现对新传感器数据的泛化能力。TacViT利用全局自注意力机制从触觉图像中提取稳健特征，即使在未接触过的传感器上也能实现精准的接触特性推断。这一能力显著降低了数据收集和重新训练的需求，加速了新传感器的部署进程。我们在五指机器人手传感器上评估TacViT，并证明其相较于卷积神经网络具有更优越的泛化性能。研究结果凸显了TacViT在推动触觉感知技术向实际机器人应用规模化、实用化发展方面的潜力。
tldr: Introduces TacViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for tactile perception that generalizes across different vision-based tactile sensors on multi-fingered robot hands, reducing data collection and retraining needs.
tldr_zh: 提出了 TacViT，一种基于 Vision Transformer 的触觉感知模型，能够在多指机器人手上跨不同视觉触觉传感器泛化，减少数据收集和重新训练需求。

title: SoftHand Model-W: A 3D-Printed, Anthropomorphic, Underactuated Robot Hand with Integrated Wrist and Carpal Tunnel
summary: This paper presents the SoftHand Model-W: a 3D-printed, underactuated, anthropomorphic robot hand based on the Pisa/IIT SoftHand, with an integrated antagonistic tendon mechanism and 2 degree-of-freedom tendon-driven wrist. These four degrees-of-acuation provide active flexion and extension to the five fingers, and active flexion/extension and radial/ulnar deviation of the palm through the wrist, while preserving the synergistic and self-adaptive features of such SoftHands. A carpal tunnel-inspired tendon routing allows remote motor placement in the forearm, reducing distal inertia and maintaining a compact form factor. The SoftHand-W is mounted on a 6-axis robot arm and tested with two reorientation tasks requiring coordination between the hand and arm's pose: cube stacking and in-plane disc rotation. Results comparing task time, arm joint travel, and configuration changes with and without wrist actuation show that adding the wrist reduces compensatory and reconfiguration movements of the arm for a quicker task-completion time. Moreover, the wrist enables pick-and-place operations that would be impossible otherwise. Overall, the SoftHand Model-W demonstrates how proximal degrees of freedom are key to achieving versatile, human-like manipulation in real world robotic applications, with a compact design enabling deployment in research and assistive settings.
summary_zh: 本文介绍SoftHand Model-W：这是一款基于Pisa/IIT SoftHand的3D打印欠驱动拟人机器人手，集成了对抗式腱绳机构与双自由度腱驱动腕关节。其四个驱动自由度通过主动屈伸控制五指运动，并实现腕部带动手掌的主动屈伸及桡尺偏转，同时保留了此类软体手的协同性与自适应特性。受腕管结构启发的腱绳布局将驱动电机置于前臂远端，既降低了末端惯性又保持了紧凑外形。该软体手搭载于六轴机械臂上，通过立方体堆叠与平面圆盘旋转两项需手-臂姿态协调的再定向任务进行测试。对比腕部驱动启用与禁用状态下的任务耗时、关节行程及构型变化数据表明，腕关节的加入减少了机械臂的补偿性运动与重配置动作，从而缩短任务完成时间。此外，腕部关节实现了原本无法完成的抓放操作。总体而言，SoftHand Model-W通过紧凑型设计证明了近端自由度是实现现实机器人应用中多功能拟人化操作的关键要素，适用于研究及辅助场景的部署需求。
tldr: This paper introduces the SoftHand Model-W, a 3D-printed, underactuated robotic hand with an integrated wrist, and demonstrates through manipulation tasks that the wrist reduces compensatory arm movements and expands task capabilities.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SoftHand Model-W，一款3D打印、欠驱动的机械手，集成腕部，通过操作任务证明腕部减少了手臂的补偿运动并扩展了任务能力。

title: A Physical Imitation Learning Pipeline for Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion Assisted by Parallel Elastic Joint
summary: Due to brain-body co-evolution, animals' intrinsic body dynamics play a crucial role in energy-efficient locomotion, which shares control effort between active muscles and passive body dynamics -- a principle known as Embodied Physical Intelligence. In contrast, robot bodies are often designed with one centralised controller that typically suppress the intrinsic body dynamics instead of exploiting it. We introduce Physical Imitation Learning (PIL), which distils a Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy into physically implementable body responses that can be directly offloaded to passive Parallel Elastic Joints (PEJs), enabling therefore the body to imitate part of the controlled behaviour. Meanwhile, the residual policy commands the motors to recover the RL policy's performance. The results is an overall reduced energy consumption thanks to outsourcing parts of the control policy to the PEJs. Here we show in simulated quadrupeds, that our PIL approach can offloads up to 87% of mechanical power to PEJs on flat terrain and 18% on rough terrain. Because the body design is distilled from -- rather than jointly optimised with -- the control policy, PIL realises brain-body co-design without expanding the search space with body design parameters, providing a computationally efficient route to task-specific Embodied Physical Intelligence applicable to a wide range of joint-based robot morphologies.
summary_zh: 受脑体协同进化影响，动物内在的躯体动力学在高效节能运动中发挥着关键作用，其将控制任务分配给主动肌肉与被动躯体动力学共同承担——这一原理被称为"具身物理智能"。相比之下，机器人躯体的设计通常采用集中式控制器，这类控制器往往会抑制而非利用其内在躯体动力学。本研究提出物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，通过将强化学习（RL）控制策略提炼为可直接卸载至被动并联弹性关节（PEJ）的物理可执行躯体响应，使机器人躯体能够模仿部分受控行为。同时，剩余策略通过控制电机来恢复强化学习策略的完整性能。由于将部分控制策略外包给并联弹性关节执行，最终实现了整体能耗的降低。我们在四足机器人仿真实验中证明，该物理模仿学习方法在平坦地形上可将高达87%的机械功率卸载至并联弹性关节，在复杂地形上仍可实现18%的功率卸载。由于躯体设计是从控制策略中提炼而来，而非与控制策略联合优化，物理模仿学习实现了脑体协同设计，且无需扩展躯体设计参数的搜索空间，为面向特定任务的具身物理智能提供了一条适用于各类关节型机器人形态的高效计算路径。
tldr: The paper introduces Physical Imitation Learning (PIL), a method to distill a Reinforcement Learning policy for quadruped locomotion into passive Parallel Elastic Joints to reduce energy consumption by offloading control effort.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，将强化学习策略提炼到被动平行弹性关节中，为四足机器人实现节能运动，将部分控制任务卸载到身体结构上。

title: Multi-Camera View Scaling for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning
summary: The generalization ability of imitation learning policies for robotic manipulation is fundamentally constrained by the diversity of expert demonstrations, while collecting demonstrations across varied environments is costly and difficult in practice. In this paper, we propose a practical framework that exploits inherent scene diversity without additional human effort by scaling camera views during demonstration collection. Instead of acquiring more trajectories, multiple synchronized camera perspectives are used to generate pseudo-demonstrations from each expert trajectory, which enriches the training distribution and improves viewpoint invariance in visual representations. We analyze how different action spaces interact with view scaling and show that camera-space representations further enhance diversity. In addition, we introduce a multiview action aggregation method that allows single-view policies to benefit from multiple cameras during deployment. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate significant gains in data efficiency and generalization compared to single-view baselines. Our results suggest that scaling camera views provides a practical and scalable solution for imitation learning, which requires minimal additional hardware setup and integrates seamlessly with existing imitation learning algorithms. The website of our project is https://yichen928.github.io/robot_multiview.
summary_zh: 机器人模仿学习策略的泛化能力从根本上受限于专家示教数据的多样性，而实际中收集不同环境下的示教数据成本高昂且困难重重。本文提出一种实用框架，通过在示教收集中扩展相机视角，无需额外人力即可利用固有的场景多样性。该框架不增加轨迹采集数量，而是使用多个同步的相机视角，从每条专家轨迹生成伪示教数据，从而丰富训练分布并提升视觉表征的视角不变性。我们分析了不同动作空间与视角扩展的交互关系，并证明相机空间表征能进一步增强多样性。此外，我们提出了一种多视角动作聚合方法，使单视角策略在部署时也能受益于多相机系统。在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中的大量实验表明，相比单视角基线方法，本框架在数据效率和泛化能力上均取得显著提升。研究结果表明，扩展相机视角为模仿学习提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，该方法仅需最低限度的额外硬件配置，并能与现有模仿学习算法无缝集成。项目网站为：https://yichen928.github.io/robot_multiview。
tldr: The paper proposes a framework for robot imitation learning that uses multiple synchronized camera views to generate pseudo-demonstrations from a single trajectory, improving data efficiency and generalization with minimal hardware changes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种机器人模仿学习框架，利用多个同步相机视角从单一轨迹生成伪演示，以最小的硬件改动提高了数据效率和泛化能力。

title: Learning Humanoid Navigation from Human Data
summary: We present EgoNav, a system that enables a humanoid robot to traverse diverse, unseen environments by learning entirely from 5 hours of human walking data, with no robot data or finetuning. A diffusion model predicts distributions of plausible future trajectories conditioned on past trajectory, a 360 deg visual memory fusing color, depth, and semantics, and video features from a frozen DINOv3 backbone that capture appearance cues invisible to depth sensors. A hybrid sampling scheme achieves real-time inference in 10 denoising steps, and a receding-horizon controller selects paths from the predicted distribution. We validate EgoNav through offline evaluations, where it outperforms baselines in collision avoidance and multi-modal coverage, and through zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid across unseen indoor and outdoor environments. Behaviors such as waiting for doors to open, navigating around crowds, and avoiding glass walls emerge naturally from the learned prior. We will release the dataset and trained models. Our website: https://egonav.weizhuowang.com
summary_zh: 我们推出EgoNav系统，该系统仅通过5小时人类行走数据学习，无需机器人数据或微调，即可使人形机器人在多样化、未见过的环境中自主穿行。该系统采用扩散模型预测未来可行轨迹的概率分布，条件输入包括历史轨迹、融合彩色、深度与语义信息的360度视觉记忆，以及从冻结DINOv3骨干网络提取的视频特征——这些特征能捕捉深度传感器无法检测的外观线索。通过混合采样策略在10步去噪过程中实现实时推理，并结合滚动时域控制器从预测分布中选取路径。我们在离线评估中验证了EgoNav的性能，其在避障和多模态覆盖能力上均超越基线模型；同时在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行了零样本部署测试，成功穿越未见过的室内外环境。系统自然涌现出等待开门、绕行人群、规避玻璃墙等行为，这些能力均源于学习到的先验知识。我们将公开数据集与训练模型。项目网站：https://egonav.weizhuowang.com
tldr: The EgoNav system enables a humanoid robot to navigate unseen environments by learning from human walking data, using a diffusion model for trajectory prediction and a visual memory system, validated on a physical humanoid.
tldr_zh: EgoNav系统通过从人类行走数据中学习，使人形机器人能够在未见过的环境中导航，使用了用于轨迹预测的扩散模型和视觉记忆系统，并在物理人形机器人上进行了验证。

title: Hierarchical Motion Planning and Control under Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics via Predicted Reachability
summary: Autonomous motion planning under unknown nonlinear dynamics requires learning system properties while navigating toward a target. In this work, we develop a hierarchical planning-control framework that enables online motion synthesis with limited prior system knowledge. The state space is partitioned into polytopes and approximates the unknown nonlinear system using a piecewise-affine (PWA) model. The local affine models are identified once the agent enters the corresponding polytopes. To reduce computational complexity, we introduce a non-uniform adaptive state space partition strategy that refines the partition only in task-relevant regions. The resulting PWA system is abstracted into a directed weighted graph, whose edge existence is incrementally verified using reach control theory and predictive reachability conditions. Certified edges are weighted using provable time-to-reach bounds, while uncertain edges are assigned information-theoretic weights to guide exploration. The graph is updated online as new data becomes available, and high-level planning is performed by graph search, while low-level affine feedback controllers are synthesized to execute the plan. Furthermore, the conditions of classical reach control theory are often difficult to satisfy in underactuated settings. We therefore introduce relaxed reachability conditions to extend the framework to such systems. Simulations demonstrate effective exploration-exploitation trade-offs with formal reachability guarantees.
summary_zh: 在非线性动力学未知的情况下进行自主运动规划，需要同时学习系统特性并朝着目标导航。本研究开发了一种分层规划-控制框架，能够在先验系统知识有限的情况下实现在线运动合成。通过将状态空间划分为多面体单元，并采用分段仿射模型来逼近未知非线性系统。当智能体进入相应多面体时，局部仿射模型才被识别。为降低计算复杂度，我们引入了一种非均匀自适应状态空间划分策略，仅在任务相关区域进行细化划分。将所得分段仿射系统抽象为有向加权图，其中边的存在性通过可达控制理论和预测可达性条件进行增量验证。已验证边采用可证明的时间-到达边界加权，而未确定边则赋予信息论权重以引导探索。该图随新数据获取而在线更新，高层规划通过图搜索实现，同时合成底层仿射反馈控制器以执行规划。此外，经典可达控制理论的条件在欠驱动场景下往往难以满足，为此我们引入放宽的可达性条件以扩展该框架的适用范围。仿真实验表明，该框架在具有形式化可达性保证的前提下，有效实现了探索与利用的平衡。
tldr: Presents a hierarchical planning-control framework for autonomous agents with unknown nonlinear dynamics, using piecewise-affine models, reachability analysis, and online graph-based planning with formal guarantees.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于具有未知非线性动力学自主智能体的分层规划控制框架，使用分段仿射模型、可达性分析和具有形式保证的在线图规划。

title: DreamControl-v2: Simpler and Scalable Autonomous Humanoid Skills via Trainable Guided Diffusion Priors
summary: Developing robust autonomous loco-manipulation skills for humanoids remains an open problem in robotics. While RL has been applied successfully to legged locomotion, applying it to complex, interaction-rich manipulation tasks is harder given long-horizon planning challenges for manipulation. A recent approach along these lines is DreamControl, which addresses these issues by leveraging off-the-shelf human motion diffusion models as a generative prior to guide RL policies during training. In this paper, we investigate the impact of DreamControl's motion prior and propose an improved framework that trains a guided diffusion model directly in the humanoid robot's motion space, aggregating diverse human and robot datasets into a unified embodiment space. We demonstrate that our approach captures a wider range of skills due to the larger training data mixture and establishes a more automated pipeline by removing the need for manual filtering interventions. Furthermore, we show that scaling the generation of reference trajectories is important for achieving robust downstream RL policies. We validate our approach through extensive experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree-G1.
summary_zh: 开发稳健的仿人机器人自主移动操控技能仍是机器人学领域的开放难题。虽然强化学习在足式运动控制中已成功应用，但将其应用于复杂、交互密集的操控任务仍面临挑战，主要源于操控任务所需的长时程规划难题。近期提出的DreamControl方法通过利用现成的人类运动扩散模型作为生成先验，在训练过程中引导强化学习策略，从而应对这些挑战。本文深入探究了DreamControl运动先验的作用机制，并提出一种改进框架：直接在仿人机器人运动空间训练引导扩散模型，将多样化的人类与机器人数据集聚合到统一的具身化空间。实验证明，得益于更丰富的训练数据融合，我们的方法能够掌握更广泛的技能，并通过消除人工筛选干预实现了更高程度的自动化流程。此外，研究还表明扩展参考轨迹的生成规模对于构建稳健的下游强化学习策略至关重要。我们通过在仿真环境及真实Unitree-G1机器人上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: Proposes DreamControl-v2, which trains a guided diffusion model in a humanoid's motion space using mixed human and robot data to generate diverse reference trajectories, enabling robust RL policies for complex loco-manipulation skills.
tldr_zh: 提出DreamControl-v2，通过在类人机器人的运动空间中使用混合人类和机器人数据训练引导扩散模型，以生成多样化的参考轨迹，从而为复杂的移动操作技能实现稳健的强化学习策略。

title: Long-Horizon Geometry-Aware Navigation among Polytopes via MILP-MPC and Minkowski-Based CBFs
summary: Autonomous navigation in complex, non-convex environments remains challenging when robot dynamics, control limits, and exact robot geometry must all be taken into account. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical planning and control framework that bridges long-horizon guidance and geometry-aware safety guarantees for a polytopic robot navigating among polytopic obstacles. At the high level, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is embedded within a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework to generate a nominal trajectory around polytopic obstacles while modeling the robot as a point mass for computational tractability. At the low level, we employ a control barrier function (CBF) based on the exact signed distance in the Minkowski-difference space as a safety filter to explicitly enforce the geometric constraints of the robot shape, and further extend its formulation to a high-order CBF (HOCBF). We demonstrate the proposed framework in U-shaped and maze-like environments under single- and double-integrator dynamics. The results show that the proposed architecture mitigates the topology-induced local-minimum behavior of purely reactive CBF-based navigation while enabling safe, real-time, geometry-aware navigation.
summary_zh: 在复杂非凸环境中，当机器人动力学特性、控制限制以及精确几何结构均需被纳入考量时，自主导航仍面临严峻挑战。本文提出一种分层规划与控制框架，为多面体机器人在多面体障碍物环境中的导航任务，搭建了长时程轨迹引导与几何感知安全保证之间的桥梁。高层规划中，我们将混合整数线性规划嵌入模型预测控制框架，通过在计算中将机器人简化为质点以保证处理效率，从而生成围绕多面体障碍物的标称轨迹。底层控制中，我们采用基于闵可夫斯基差分空间精确符号距离的控制屏障函数作为安全滤波器，以显式强化机器人几何形状约束，并进一步将其扩展为高阶控制屏障函数。我们在单积分与双积分动力学模型下，通过U形与迷宫状环境验证所提框架的有效性。实验结果表明，该架构既能缓解纯反应式控制屏障函数导航因环境拓扑结构导致的局部极小值问题，又能实现实时、安全且几何感知的自主导航。
tldr: A hierarchical framework for robotic navigation uses MILP-MPC for long-horizon trajectory planning and Minkowski-based CBFs for geometry-aware safety guarantees, enabling robots to navigate complex, non-convex environments.
tldr_zh: 一种用于机器人导航的分层框架，结合MILP-MPC进行长时程轨迹规划和基于Minkowski的CBF实现几何感知安全保证，使机器人能在复杂非凸环境中安全导航。

title: Benchmarking Interaction, Beyond Policy: a Reproducible Benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation
summary: We propose Question-Asking Navigation (QAsk-Nav), the first reproducible benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation (CoIN) that enables an explicit, separate assessment of embodied navigation and collaborative question asking. CoIN tasks an embodied agent with reaching a target specified in free-form natural language under partial observability, using only egocentric visual observations and interactive natural-language dialogue with a human, where the dialogue can help to resolve ambiguity among visually similar object instances. Existing CoIN benchmarks are primarily focused on navigation success and offer no support for consistent evaluation of collaborative interaction. To address this limitation, QAsk-Nav provides (i) a lightweight question-asking protocol scored independently of navigation, (ii) an enhanced navigation protocol with realistic, diverse, high-quality target descriptions, and (iii) an open-source dataset, that includes 28,000 quality-checked reasoning and question-asking traces for training and analysis of interactive capabilities of CoIN models. Using the proposed QAsk-Nav benchmark, we develop Light-CoNav, a lightweight unified model for collaborative navigation that is 3x smaller and 70x faster than existing modular methods, while outperforming state-of-the-art CoIN approaches in generalization to unseen objects and environments. Project page at https://benchmarking-interaction.github.io/
summary_zh: 我们提出问答式导航（QAsk-Nav），这是首个可复现的协作式实例物体导航（CoIN）基准，能够对具身导航与协作式提问进行明确、独立的评估。CoIN任务要求具身智能体在部分可观测环境下，仅通过自我中心视角的视觉观察和与人类的交互式自然语言对话，到达以自由形式自然语言描述的目标位置；其中对话可帮助分辨视觉相似物体实例间的歧义。现有CoIN基准主要关注导航成功率，未能提供对协作交互的一致评估支持。为解决这一局限，QAsk-Nav提供：（i）独立于导航评分的轻量化提问协议；（ii）具有真实、多样、高质量目标描述的增强导航协议；（iii）包含28,000条质量校验的推理与提问轨迹的开源数据集，用于训练与分析CoIN模型的交互能力。基于提出的QAsk-Nav基准，我们开发了轻量化统一协作导航模型Light-CoNav，其体积比现有模块化方法缩小3倍，速度提升70倍，并在泛化至未见过的物体和环境时超越了当前最先进的CoIN方法。项目页面详见https://benchmarking-interaction.github.io/。
tldr: This paper introduces a new benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation (CoIN) that separately evaluates navigation and interactive question-asking abilities, along with a lightweight model for the task.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于协作实例对象导航的新基准，可独立评估导航和交互问答能力，并附带一个用于该任务的轻量级模型。

title: Compact Keyframe-Optimized Multi-Agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Efficient multi-agent 3D mapping is essential for robotic teams operating in unknown environments, but dense representations hinder real-time exchange over constrained communication links. In multi-agent Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), systems typically rely on a centralized server to merge and optimize the local maps produced by individual agents. However, sharing these large map representations, particularly those generated by recent methods such as Gaussian Splatting, becomes a bottleneck in real-world scenarios with limited bandwidth. We present an improved multi-agent RGB-D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that reduces communication load while preserving map fidelity. First, we incorporate a compaction step into our SLAM system to remove redundant 3D Gaussians, without degrading the rendering quality. Second, our approach performs centralized loop closure computation without initial guess, operating in two modes: a pure rendered-depth mode that requires no data beyond the 3D Gaussians, and a camera-depth mode that includes lightweight depth images for improved registration accuracy and additional Gaussian pruning. Evaluation on both synthetic and real-world datasets shows up to 85-95\% reduction in transmitted data compared to state-of-the-art approaches in both modes, bringing 3D Gaussian multi-agent SLAM closer to practical deployment in real-world scenarios. Code: https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam
summary_zh: 高效的多智能体三维地图构建对于在未知环境中运行的机器人团队至关重要，但密集的表征方式制约了其在有限通信链路上的实时交互。在多智能体同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）系统中，通常依赖中央服务器对各智能体生成的局部地图进行融合与优化。然而，共享这些大规模地图表征——尤其是由高斯溅射等近期方法生成的类型——在带宽受限的实际场景中成为性能瓶颈。本文提出了一种改进的多智能体RGB-D高斯溅射SLAM框架，能够在保持地图精度的同时显著降低通信负载。首先，我们在SLAM系统中引入了压缩步骤，可在不降低渲染质量的前提下去除冗余的三维高斯元素。其次，该方法实现了无需初始猜测的集中式闭环检测计算，提供两种运行模式：纯渲染深度模式仅需三维高斯数据；相机深度模式则通过引入轻量级深度图像来提升配准精度，并进一步优化高斯元素剪枝。在合成数据集与真实场景数据集上的实验表明，该框架在两种模式下相比现有先进方法最高可减少85-95%的数据传输量，推动三维高斯多智能体SLAM向实际场景部署迈出关键一步。代码：https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam
tldr: Improves multi-agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM by compressing the 3D map representation to reduce communication bandwidth, enabling more efficient multi-robot mapping in unknown environments.
tldr_zh: 改进多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM，通过压缩3D地图表示以减少通信带宽，在多机器人未知环境建图中实现更高效率。

title: StretchBot: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive Guidance with Assistive Robots
summary: Assistive robots have growing potential to support physical wellbeing in home and healthcare settings, for example, by guiding users through stretching or rehabilitation routines. However, existing systems remain largely scripted, which limits their ability to adapt to user state, environmental context, and interaction dynamics. In this work, we present StretchBot, a hybrid neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive assistive guidance. The system combines multimodal perception with knowledge-graph-grounded large language model reasoning to support context-aware adjustments during short stretching sessions while maintaining a structured routine. To complement the system description, we report an exploratory pilot comparison between scripted and adaptive guidance with three participants. The pilot findings suggest that the adaptive condition improved perceived adaptability and contextual relevance, while scripted guidance remained competitive in smoothness and predictability. These results provide preliminary evidence that structured actionable knowledge can help ground language-model-based adaptation in embodied assistive interaction, while also highlighting the need for larger, longitudinal studies to evaluate robustness, generalizability, and long-term user experience.
summary_zh: 辅助机器人在家庭和医疗场景中支持用户身体健康的潜力日益增长，例如通过引导用户进行拉伸或康复训练。然而，现有系统大多仍依赖预设脚本，限制了其适应用户状态、环境背景及交互动态的能力。本研究提出了StretchBot——一种基于混合神经符号系统的自适应辅助指导机器人教练。该系统结合多模态感知与基于知识图谱的大语言模型推理，能够在短期拉伸训练中实现情境感知的实时调整，同时保持训练流程的结构性。在系统描述之外，我们通过一项探索性先导研究比较了脚本化与自适应指导模式（涉及三名参与者）。先导研究表明：自适应模式在感知适应性与情境相关性方面表现更优，而脚本化指导在流程流畅性与可预测性方面仍具竞争力。这些结果为结构化可操作知识有助于在具身辅助交互中实现基于语言模型的自适应提供了初步证据，同时也凸显了需要更大规模、更长期的纵向研究来评估系统的鲁棒性、泛化能力及长期用户体验。
tldr: StretchBot is a neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive assistive guidance, combining multimodal perception, knowledge graphs, and LLM reasoning to adjust stretching routines based on user state and context.
tldr_zh: StretchBot是一个用于自适应辅助指导的神经符号机器人教练，结合了多模态感知、知识图谱和LLM推理，根据用户状态和上下文调整拉伸程序。

title: Sampling-based Task and Kinodynamic Motion Planning under Semantic Uncertainty
summary: This paper tackles the problem of integrated task and kinodynamic motion planning in uncertain environments. We consider a robot with nonlinear dynamics tasked with a Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces ($\ltlf$) specification operating in a partially observable environment. Specifically, the uncertainty is in the semantic labels of the environment. We show how the problem can be modeled as a Partially Observable Stochastic Hybrid System that captures the robot dynamics, $\ltlf$ task, and uncertainty in the environment state variables. We propose an anytime algorithm that takes advantage of the structure of the hybrid system, and combines the effectiveness of decision-making techniques and sampling-based motion planning. We prove the soundness and asymptotic optimality of the algorithm. Results show the efficacy of our algorithm in uncertain environments, and that it consistently outperforms baseline methods.
summary_zh: 本文研究了不确定环境下任务与运动学的综合规划问题。我们考虑一个具有非线性动力学的机器人，其任务是在部分可观测环境中执行有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑（$\ltlf$）规范。具体而言，环境的不确定性体现在语义标签的模糊性上。我们展示了如何将问题建模为部分可观测随机混合系统，该系统能够同时描述机器人动力学、$\ltlf$任务规范以及环境状态变量的不确定性。我们提出了一种基于混合系统结构的实时算法，该算法结合了决策制定技术的有效性与基于采样的运动规划方法。我们证明了该算法的可靠性与渐近最优性。实验结果表明，我们的算法在不确定环境中具有显著效能，且始终优于基准方法。
tldr: The paper proposes an anytime algorithm for integrated task and kinodynamic motion planning under semantic uncertainty, modeling the problem as a Partially Observable Stochastic Hybrid System and proving soundness and asymptotic optimality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在语义不确定性下进行任务和动力学运动规划集成的方法，将问题建模为部分可观测随机混合系统，并证明了算法的可靠性和渐近最优性。

title: Behavioral Score Diffusion: Model-Free Trajectory Planning via Kernel-Based Score Estimation from Data
summary: Diffusion-based trajectory optimization has emerged as a powerful planning paradigm, but existing methods require either learned score networks trained on large datasets or analytical dynamics models for score computation. We introduce \emph{Behavioral Score Diffusion} (BSD), a training-free and model-free trajectory planner that computes the diffusion score function directly from a library of trajectory data via kernel-weighted estimation. At each denoising step, BSD retrieves relevant trajectories using a triple-kernel weighting scheme -- diffusion proximity, state context, and goal relevance -- and computes a Nadaraya-Watson estimate of the denoised trajectory. The diffusion noise schedule naturally controls kernel bandwidths, creating a multi-scale nonparametric regression: broad averaging of global behavioral patterns at high noise, fine-grained local interpolation at low noise. This coarse-to-fine structure handles nonlinear dynamics without linearization or parametric assumptions. Safety is preserved by applying shielded rollout on kernel-estimated state trajectories, identical to existing model-based approaches. We evaluate BSD on four robotic systems of increasing complexity (3D--6D state spaces) in a parking scenario. BSD with fixed bandwidth achieves 98.5\% of the model-based baseline's average reward across systems while requiring no dynamics model, using only 1{,}000 pre-collected trajectories. BSD substantially outperforms nearest-neighbor retrieval (18--63\% improvement), confirming that the diffusion denoising mechanism is essential for effective data-driven planning.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的轨迹优化已成为一种强大的规划范式，但现有方法需要依赖在大型数据集上训练的学习型评分网络，或依靠解析动力学模型进行评分计算。本文提出一种免训练且免模型的轨迹规划器——行为评分扩散（BSD），它通过核加权估计直接从轨迹数据集中计算扩散评分函数。在每次去噪步骤中，BSD利用三重核加权方案（扩散邻近度、状态上下文与目标相关性）检索相关轨迹，并计算去噪轨迹的纳达拉亚-瓦特森估计。扩散噪声调度自然控制核带宽，形成一种多尺度非参数回归：在强噪声下对全局行为模式进行广泛平均，在弱噪声下进行细粒度的局部插值。这种从粗到精的结构无需线性化或参数化假设即可处理非线性动力学。通过在内核估计状态轨迹上应用屏蔽式滚算（与现有基于模型的方法相同），系统安全性得到保障。我们在停车场景中针对四个复杂度递增的机器人系统（3D-6D状态空间）评估BSD。结果表明：在仅使用1,000条预收集轨迹且无需动力学模型的情况下，采用固定带宽的BSD可达到基于模型基线平均奖励的98.5%。BSD显著优于最近邻检索方法（提升18-63%），证实了扩散去噪机制对数据驱动规划的有效性至关重要。
tldr: Presents Behavioral Score Diffusion, a model-free, training-free trajectory planner for robots that uses kernel-based score estimation directly from a trajectory library, eliminating the need for learned models or analytical dynamics, and demonstrates effectiveness in robotic parking scenarios.
tldr_zh: 提出行为分数扩散，一种用于机器人的无模型、免训练轨迹规划器，通过基于核的分数估计直接从轨迹库中规划，无需学习模型或解析动力学，并在机器人停车场景中证明了其有效性。

title: A Dual-Stream Transformer Architecture for Illumination-Invariant TIR-LiDAR Person Tracking
summary: Robust person tracking is a critical capability for autonomous mobile robots operating in diverse and unpredictable environments. While RGB-D tracking has shown high precision, its performance severely degrades under challenging illumination conditions, such as total darkness or intense backlighting. To achieve all-weather robustness, this paper proposes a novel Thermal-Infrared and Depth (TIR-D) tracking architecture that leverages the standard sensor suite of SLAM-capable robots, namely LiDAR and TIR cameras. A major challenge in TIR-D tracking is the scarcity of annotated multi-modal datasets. To address this, we introduce a sequential knowledge transfer strategy that evolves structural priors from a large-scale thermal-trained model into the TIR-D domain. By employing a differential learning rate strategy -- referred to as ``Fine-grained Differential Learning Rate Strategy'' -- we effectively preserve pre-trained feature extraction capabilities while enabling rapid adaptation to geometric depth cues. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed TIR-D tracker achieves superior performance, with an Average Overlap (AO) of 0.700 and a Success Rate (SR) of 58.7\%, significantly outperforming conventional RGB-transfer and single-modality baselines. Our approach provides a practical and resource-efficient solution for robust human-following in all-weather robotics applications.
summary_zh: 稳健的人员跟踪是自主移动机器人在多样且不可预测环境中运行的关键能力。尽管RGB-D跟踪已展现出高精度，但在极端光照条件下（如完全黑暗或强烈逆光），其性能会严重下降。为实现全天候鲁棒性，本文提出一种新颖的热红外与深度（TIR-D）跟踪架构，该架构利用了具备SLAM能力的机器人标准传感器套件——即激光雷达和热红外相机。TIR-D跟踪面临的主要挑战在于缺乏带标注的多模态数据集。为此，我们引入一种顺序知识迁移策略，将大规模热红外训练模型中的结构先验知识逐步迁移至TIR-D领域。通过采用差异学习率策略——称为“细粒度差异学习率策略”——我们有效保留了预训练特征提取能力，同时快速适应几何深度信息。实验结果表明，所提出的TIR-D跟踪器以0.700的平均重叠度（AO）和58.7%的成功率（SR）实现了卓越性能，显著优于传统的RGB迁移方法和单模态基线。该方法为全天候机器人应用中稳健的人体跟随提供了实用且资源高效的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes a thermal-infrared and depth (TIR-D) tracker for robust all-weather person tracking on mobile robots, using sequential knowledge transfer and a differential learning rate strategy to adapt a pre-trained model to LiDAR data.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于移动机器人的热红外与深度（TIR-D）人员跟踪器，通过序列知识迁移和差异化学习率策略，将预训练模型适配到LiDAR数据，以实现全天候的鲁棒跟踪。

title: Real Time Local Wind Inference for Robust Autonomous Navigation
summary: This thesis presents a solution that enables aerial robots to reason about surrounding wind flow fields in real time using on board sensors and embedded flight hardware. The core novelty of this research is the fusion of range measurements with sparse in situ wind measurements to predict surrounding flow fields. We aim to address two fundamental questions: first, the sufficiency of topographical data for accurate wind prediction in dense urban environments; and second, the utility of learned wind models for motion planning with an emphasis on energy efficiency and obstacle avoidance. Drawing on tools from deep learning, fluid mechanics, and optimal control, we establish a framework for local wind prediction using navigational LiDAR, and then incorporate local wind model priors into a receding-horizon optimal controller to study how local wind knowledge affects energy use and robustness during autonomous navigation. Through simulated demonstrations in diverse urban wind scenarios we evaluate the predictive capabilities of the wind predictor, and quantify improvements to autonomous urban navigation in terms of crash rates and energy consumption when local wind information is integrated into the motion planning. Sub-scale free flight experiments in an open-air wind tunnel demonstrate that these algorithms can run in real time on an embedded flight computer with sufficient bandwidth for stable control of a small aerial robot. Philosophically, this thesis contributes a new paradigm for localized wind inference and motion planning in unknown windy environments. By enabling robots to rapidly assess local wind conditions without prior environmental knowledge, this research accelerates the introduction of aerial robots into increasingly challenging environments.
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种解决方案，使空中机器人能够利用机载传感器与嵌入式飞行硬件实时推断周围风流场。本研究的核心创新在于融合距离测量与稀疏原位风场测量数据以预测周边流场。我们旨在解决两个根本性问题：第一，在密集城市环境中地形数据对于精准风场预测的充分性；第二，学习型风场模型在运动规划中的应用价值，重点关注能量效率与障碍物规避。本研究整合深度学习、流体力学与最优控制领域的工具，建立了基于导航激光雷达的局地风场预测框架，进而将局地风场先验模型纳入滚动时域最优控制器，以探究局地风场认知如何影响自主导航过程中的能量消耗与系统鲁棒性。通过在多样化城市风场场景中的仿真验证，我们评估了风场预测器的性能，并量化了将局地风场信息融入运动规划后对城市自主导航在碰撞率与能耗方面的改善效果。露天风洞中的亚尺度自由飞行实验表明，这些算法能够在嵌入式飞行计算机上实时运行，其带宽足以支持小型空中机器人的稳定控制。从学理层面，本研究贡献了一种适用于未知风环境的局地风场推断与运动规划新范式。通过使机器人在无需先验环境知识的条件下快速评估局地风场状况，该研究推动了空中机器人向更具挑战性环境的应用拓展。
tldr: This thesis develops a method for aerial robots to predict local wind fields in real-time using onboard sensors and uses this information to improve energy-efficient and robust motion planning for autonomous navigation in urban environments.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出了一种方法，使空中机器人能够使用机载传感器实时预测局部风场，并利用该信息改进城市环境中自主导航的能量效率和鲁棒性运动规划。

title: Flow-based Policy With Distributional Reinforcement Learning in Trajectory Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven highly effective in addressing complex control and decision-making tasks. However, in most traditional RL algorithms, the policy is typically parameterized as a diagonal Gaussian distribution, which constrains the policy from capturing multimodal distributions, making it difficult to cover the full range of optimal solutions in multi-solution problems, and the return is reduced to a mean value, losing its multimodal nature and thus providing insufficient guidance for policy updates. In response to these problems, we propose a RL algorithm termed flow-based policy with distributional RL (FP-DRL). This algorithm models the policy using flow matching, which offers both computational efficiency and the capacity to fit complex distributions. Additionally, it employs a distributional RL approach to model and optimize the entire return distribution, thereby more effectively guiding multimodal policy updates and improving agent performance.
