Experimental trails on MuJoCo benchmarks demonstrate that the FP-DRL algorithm achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in most MuJoCo control tasks while exhibiting superior representation capability of the flow policy.
summary_zh: 强化学习在解决复杂控制与决策任务中已被证明具有极高效率。然而在多数传统强化学习算法中，策略通常被参数化为对角高斯分布，这种形式限制了策略捕捉多模态分布的能力，难以覆盖多解问题中的全部最优解，同时回报被简化为单一均值，丧失了其多模态特性，从而无法为策略更新提供充分指导。针对这些问题，我们提出了一种基于流匹配策略与分布强化学习相结合的算法（FP-DRL）。该算法通过流匹配技术对策略进行建模，兼具计算效率与拟合复杂分布的能力；同时采用分布强化学习方法对完整回报分布进行建模与优化，从而更有效地指导多模态策略更新并提升智能体性能。在MuJoCo基准测试中的实验表明，FP-DRL算法在多数MuJoCo控制任务中达到了最先进的性能水平，同时展现出流策略优越的表征能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning algorithm that combines a flow-based policy for fitting complex distributions with distributional RL for optimizing the entire return distribution, achieving state-of-the-art results on MuJoCo control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习算法，结合基于流的策略以拟合复杂分布和分布式RL以优化整个回报分布，在MuJoCo控制任务中实现了最先进的性能。

title: EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation
summary: We introduce EgoSim, a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and persistently updates the underlying 3D scene state for continuous simulation. Existing egocentric simulators either lack explicit 3D grounding, causing structural drift under viewpoint changes, or treat the scene as static, failing to update world states across multi-stage interactions. EgoSim addresses both limitations by modeling 3D scenes as updatable world states. We generate embodiment interactions via a Geometry-action-aware Observation Simulation model, with spatial consistency from an Interaction-aware State Updating module. To overcome the critical data bottleneck posed by the difficulty in acquiring densely aligned scene-interaction training pairs, we design a scalable pipeline that extracts static point clouds, camera trajectories, and embodiment actions from in-the-wild large-scale monocular egocentric videos. We further introduce EgoCap, a capture system that enables low-cost real-world data collection with uncalibrated smartphones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoSim significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of visual quality, spatial consistency, and generalization to complex scenes and in-the-wild dexterous interactions, while supporting cross-embodiment transfer to robotic manipulation. Codes and datasets will be open soon. The project page is at egosimulator.github.io.
summary_zh: 我们提出EgoSim——一种闭环的以自我为中心的世界模拟器，能够生成空间一致的交互视频，并持续更新底层三维场景状态以实现连续模拟。现有的以自我为中心模拟器要么缺乏明确的三维基础，导致视角变化下的结构漂移；要么将场景视为静态，无法在多阶段交互中更新世界状态。EgoSim通过将三维场景建模为可更新的世界状态，解决了这两类局限。我们通过几何动作感知的观测模拟模型生成具身交互，其空间一致性由交互感知状态更新模块保障。针对密集对齐的场景-交互训练数据获取困难所形成的关键数据瓶颈，我们设计了一种可扩展的流程，能够从野外大规模单目以自我为中心视频中提取静态点云、相机轨迹与具身动作。我们还开发了EgoCap采集系统，支持使用未校准智能手机进行低成本现实世界数据采集。大量实验表明，EgoSim在视觉质量、空间一致性、对复杂场景及野外灵巧交互的泛化能力方面显著优于现有方法，同时支持跨具身迁移至机器人操作任务。代码与数据集即将开源，项目页面位于egosimulator.github.io。
tldr: EgoSim is a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and updates underlying 3D scene states, supporting cross-embodiment transfer to robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: EgoSim是一个闭环的以自我为中心的世界模拟器，可生成空间一致的交互视频并更新底层3D场景状态，支持跨具身智能体转移至机器人操控。

title: A ROS 2 Wrapper for Florence-2: Multi-Mode Local Vision-Language Inference for Robotic Systems
summary: Foundation vision-language models are becoming increasingly relevant to robotics because they can provide richer semantic perception than narrow task-specific pipelines. However, their practical adoption in robot software stacks still depends on reproducible middleware integrations rather than on model quality alone. Florence-2 is especially attractive in this regard because it unifies captioning, optical character recognition, open-vocabulary detection, grounding and related vision-language tasks within a comparatively manageable model size. This article presents a ROS 2 wrapper for Florence-2 that exposes the model through three complementary interaction modes: continuous topic-driven processing, synchronous service calls and asynchronous actions. The wrapper is designed for local execution and supports both native installation and Docker container deployment. It also combines generic JSON outputs with standard ROS 2 message bindings for detection-oriented tasks. A functional validation is reported together with a throughput study on several GPUs, showing that local deployment is feasible with consumer grade hardware. The repository is publicly available here: https://github.com/JEDominguezVidal/florence2_ros2_wrapper
summary_zh: 基础视觉语言模型因其能提供比狭窄任务特定流水线更丰富的语义感知，正逐渐成为机器人学领域的重要工具。然而，这些模型在机器人软件栈中的实际应用，不仅取决于模型质量，还依赖于可复现的中间件集成。在这方面，Florence-2 模型尤为引人注目，它将图像描述、光学字符识别、开放词汇检测、定位及相关视觉语言任务统一于相对可控的模型规模内。本文介绍了一种基于 ROS 2 的 Florence-2 封装器，该封装器通过三种互补的交互模式提供服务：持续话题驱动处理、同步服务调用和异步动作执行。该封装器设计用于本地运行，同时支持原生安装和 Docker 容器部署，并为面向检测的任务提供通用 JSON 输出与标准 ROS 2 消息绑定的结合方案。研究通过功能验证及多款 GPU 的吞吐量测试表明，该封装器可在消费级硬件上实现本地部署。项目代码库已公开：https://github.com/JEDominguezVidal/florence2_ros2_wrapper
tldr: A ROS 2 wrapper for the Florence-2 vision-language model, enabling local, multi-modal perception tasks (captioning, detection, grounding) to be integrated into robotic systems via topic, service, and action interfaces.
tldr_zh: 为 Florence-2 视觉语言模型开发了一个 ROS 2 包装器，通过话题、服务和动作接口，支持将本地多模态感知任务（如描述、检测、接地）集成到机器人系统中。

title: Stein Variational Uncertainty-Adaptive Model Predictive Control
summary: We propose a Stein variational distributionally robust controller for nonlinear dynamical systems with latent parametric uncertainty. The method is an alternative to conservative worst-case ambiguity-set optimization with a deterministic particle-based approximation of a task-dependent uncertainty distribution, enabling the controller to concentrate on parameter sensitivities that most strongly affect closed-loop performance. Our method yields a controller that is robust to latent parameter uncertainty by coupling optimal control with Stein variational inference, and avoiding restrictive parametric assumptions on the uncertainty model while preserving computational parallelism. In contrast to classical DRO, which can sacrifice nominal performance through worst-case design, we find our approach achieves robustness by shaping the control law around relevant uncertainty that are most critical to the task objective. The proposed framework therefore reconciles robust control and variational inference in a single decision-theoretic formulation for broad classes of control systems with parameter uncertainty. We demonstrate our approach on representative control problems that empirically illustrate improved performance-robustness tradeoffs over nominal, ensemble, and classical distributionally robust baselines.
summary_zh: 针对存在潜在参数不确定性的非线性动力系统，我们提出一种基于斯坦变分的分布鲁棒控制器。该方法摒弃了传统保守的、最坏情况下的模糊集优化，转而采用任务相关不确定性分布的确定性粒子近似，使控制器能够聚焦于对闭环性能影响最显著的系统参数敏感性。通过将最优控制与斯坦变分推理相结合，所提出的方法在保持计算并行性的同时，避免了对不确定性模型的限制性参数假设，从而生成对潜在参数不确定性具备鲁棒性的控制器。与经典分布鲁棒优化方法（通常会因最坏情况设计而牺牲标称性能）不同，我们的方法通过围绕对任务目标最关键的特定不确定性来构建控制律，从而实现鲁棒性。该框架首次将鲁棒控制与变分推理统一于适用于广泛参数不确定控制系统的单一决策理论表述中。我们在代表性控制问题上验证了该方法的有效性，实证结果表明其在性能与鲁棒性权衡方面优于标称控制、集成控制及经典分布鲁棒基线方法。
tldr: The paper proposes a Stein variational distributionally robust controller for nonlinear dynamical systems with latent parametric uncertainty, which shapes the control law around task-relevant uncertainties to improve the performance-robustness trade-off.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于具有潜在参数不确定性的非线性动力系统的Stein变分分布鲁棒控制器，通过围绕任务相关的关键不确定性塑造控制律，以改善性能与鲁棒性的权衡。

title: Neural-Assisted in-Motion Self-Heading Alignment
summary: Autonomous platforms operating in the oceans require accurate navigation to successfully complete their mission. In this regard, the initial heading estimation accuracy and the time required to achieve it play a critical role. The initial heading is traditionally estimated by model-based approaches employing orientation decomposition. However, methods such as the dual vector decomposition and optimized attitude decomposition achieve satisfactory heading accuracy only after long alignment times. To allow rapid and accurate initial heading estimation, we propose an end-to-end, model-free, neural-assisted framework using the same inputs as the model-based approaches. Our proposed approach was trained and evaluated on real-world dataset captured by an autonomous surface vehicle. Our approach shows a significant accuracy improvement over the model-based approaches achieving an average absolute error improvement of 53%. Additionally, our proposed approach was able to reduce the alignment time by up to 67%. Thus, by employing our proposed approach, the reduction in alignment time and improved accuracy allow for a shorter deployment time of an autonomous platform and increased navigation accuracy during the mission.
summary_zh: 在海洋中运行的自主平台需要精确导航以成功完成任务。在这方面，初始航向估计的准确性及其所需时间起着关键作用。传统上，初始航向通过基于模型的方法进行估计，这类方法采用方向分解。然而，诸如双矢量分解和优化姿态分解等方法只有在较长的对准时间后才能达到满意的航向精度。为实现快速且准确的初始航向估计，我们提出了一种端到端、无模型、神经辅助的框架，其使用与基于模型的方法相同的输入。我们提出的方法通过在自主水面船捕获的真实数据集上进行训练和评估验证。实验结果表明，该方法相比于基于模型的方法在精度上有显著提升，平均绝对误差降低了53%。此外，所提方法能够将对准时间最多减少67%。因此，通过采用本文提出的方法，对准时间的缩短和精度的提高使得自主平台的部署时间更短，并在任务期间提升了导航精度。
tldr: Proposes a neural network model to improve the speed and accuracy of initial heading estimation for autonomous marine vehicles, using real-world data from an autonomous surface vehicle.
tldr_zh: 提出一种神经网络模型，用于提高自主海洋航行器初始航向估计的速度和准确性，并使用了自主水面航行器的真实世界数据进行验证。

title: Infinite-Horizon Ergodic Control via Kernel Mean Embeddings
summary: This paper derives an infinite-horizon ergodic controller based on kernel mean embeddings for long-duration coverage tasks on general domains. While existing kernel-based ergodic control methods provide strong coverage guarantees on general coverage domains, their practical use has been limited to sub-ergodic, finite-time horizons due to intractable computational scaling, prohibiting its use for long-duration coverage. We resolve this scaling by deriving an infinite-horizon ergodic controller equipped with an extended kernel mean embedding error visitation state that recursively records state visitation. This extended state decouples past visitation from future control synthesis and expands ergodic control to infinite-time settings. In addition, we present a variation of the controller that operates on a receding-horizon control formulation with the extended error state. We demonstrate theoretical proof of asymptotic convergence of the derived controller and show preservation of ergodic coverage guarantees for a class of 2D and 3D coverage problems.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的无限时遍历控制器，用于处理一般域上的长期覆盖任务。现有的基于核的遍历控制方法虽然在一般覆盖域上提供了强有力的覆盖保证，但由于计算复杂度难以处理，其实际应用仅限于次遍历的有限时域，无法适用于长期覆盖任务。我们通过引入一种扩展的核均值嵌入误差访问状态来解决这一扩展性问题，该状态递归记录状态访问历史。这种扩展状态将过去的访问与未来的控制合成解耦，并将遍历控制推广到无限时域场景。此外，我们提出了一种基于扩展误差状态、采用滚动时域控制框架的控制器变体。我们通过理论证明推导出控制器的渐近收敛性，并在一系列二维和三维覆盖问题中验证了其遍历覆盖保证的保持性。
tldr: This paper introduces an infinite-horizon ergodic controller using kernel mean embeddings to solve the computational scaling problem for long-duration coverage tasks, with proofs of asymptotic convergence and demonstrations on 2D/3D problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的无限时域遍历控制器，用于解决长期覆盖任务中的计算复杂度问题，并在2D/3D问题上证明了渐近收敛性。

title: LiPS: Lightweight Panoptic Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Robotics
summary: Panoptic segmentation is a key enabler for robotic perception, as it unifies semantic understanding with object-level reasoning. However, the increasing complexity of state-of-the-art models makes them unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained platforms such as mobile robots. We propose a novel approach called LiPS that addresses the challenge of efficient-to-compute panoptic segmentation with a lightweight design that retains query-based decoding while introducing a streamlined feature extraction and fusion pathway. It aims at providing a strong panoptic segmentation performance while substantially lowering the computational demands. Evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LiPS attains accuracy comparable to much heavier baselines, while providing up to 4.5 higher throughput, measured in frames per second, and requiring nearly 6.8 times fewer computations. This efficiency makes LiPS a highly relevant bridge between modern panoptic models and real-world robotic applications.
summary_zh: 全景分割作为机器人感知的关键赋能技术，将语义理解与物体级推理统一于一体。然而，现有先进模型日益增长的复杂性使其难以部署在移动机器人等资源受限平台上。我们提出一种名为LiPS的新型方法，通过轻量化设计解决高效全景分割的挑战——在保留基于查询的解码机制的同时，引入精简的特征提取与融合路径。该方法旨在提供强大的全景分割性能，同时显著降低计算需求。在标准基准测试上的评估表明，LiPS实现了与计算量更大的基线模型相当的精度，同时帧率吞吐量提升达4.5倍，计算量减少近6.8倍。这种高效性使LiPS成为连接现代全景分割模型与真实世界机器人应用的重要桥梁。
tldr: The paper proposes LiPS, a lightweight panoptic segmentation model designed for efficient deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms, achieving performance comparable to heavier models with significantly higher throughput and lower computational cost.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 LiPS 的轻量级全景分割模型，专为资源受限的机器人平台高效部署而设计，在吞吐量和计算成本方面显著优于现有模型，同时保持相当的准确率。

title: Certificate-Driven Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Path Finding with Inheritable Factorization
summary:
Multi-agent coordination in automated warehouses and logistics is commonly modeled as the Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) problem. Closed-loop MAPF algorithms improve scalability by planning only the next movement and replanning online, but this finite-horizon viewpoint can be shortsighted and makes it difficult to preserve global guarantees and exploit compositional structure. This issue is especially visible in Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search (ACCBS), which applies Conflict-Based Search (CBS) over dynamically extended finite horizons but, under finite computational budgets, may terminate with short active prefixes in dense instances.
  We introduce certificate trajectories and their associated fleet budget as a general mechanism for filtering closed-loop updates. A certificate provides a conflict-free fallback plan and a monotone upper bound on the remaining cost; accepting only certificate-improving updates yields completeness. The same budget information induces a budget-limited factorization that enables global, inheritable decomposition across timesteps. Instantiating the framework on ACCBS yields Certificate-Driven Conflict-Based Search (CDCBS). Experiments on benchmark maps show that CDCBS achieves more consistent solution quality than ACCBS, particularly in dense settings, while the proposed factorization reduces effective group size.
summary_zh:
自动化仓库与物流中的多智能体协同问题通常被建模为多智能体路径规划问题。闭环MAPF算法通过仅规划下一动作并在线重规划来提高可扩展性，但这种有限视野的视角可能缺乏远见，难以保持全局保证并利用组合结构。这一问题在"随时闭环冲突搜索"算法中尤为明显，该算法在动态扩展的有限视野上应用冲突搜索方法，但在有限计算预算下，可能在高密度场景中以较短的活跃前缀终止规划。

我们引入证书轨迹及其关联的舰队预算作为筛选闭环更新的通用机制。证书提供了无冲突的备用方案及剩余成本的单调上界；仅接受能改善证书的更新可确保算法完备性。同样的预算信息可导出预算约束的因子分解，实现跨时间步的全局可继承分解。将该框架应用于ACCBS算法，我们提出了证书驱动的冲突搜索算法。在基准地图上的实验表明，CDCBS在保证解质量一致性方面优于ACCBS，尤其在高密度场景中，同时所提出的因子分解机制有效降低了协作组规模。
tldr: This paper introduces a certificate-driven framework for improving the online planning and scalability of multi-agent path finding, specifically enhancing the Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search algorithm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种证书驱动的框架，用于改进多智能体路径规划中的在线规划和可扩展性，特别增强了Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search算法。

title: ReinDriveGen: Reinforcement Post-Training for Out-of-Distribution Driving Scene Generation
summary: We present ReinDriveGen, a framework that enables full controllability over dynamic driving scenes, allowing users to freely edit actor trajectories to simulate safety-critical corner cases such as front-vehicle collisions, drifting cars, vehicles spinning out of control, pedestrians jaywalking, and cyclists cutting across lanes. Our approach constructs a dynamic 3D point cloud scene from multi-frame LiDAR data, introduces a vehicle completion module to reconstruct full 360° geometry from partial observations, and renders the edited scene into 2D condition images that guide a video diffusion model to synthesize realistic driving videos. Since such edited scenarios inevitably fall outside the training distribution, we further propose an RL-based post-training strategy with a pairwise preference model and a pairwise reward mechanism, enabling robust quality improvement under out-of-distribution conditions without ground-truth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReinDriveGen outperforms existing approaches on edited driving scenarios and achieves state-of-the-art results on novel ego viewpoint synthesis.
summary_zh: 本文提出ReinDriveGen框架，该框架实现了对动态驾驶场景的完全可控性，允许用户自由编辑交通参与者的运动轨迹，以模拟前车碰撞、车辆漂移、失控旋转、行人乱穿马路、自行车横穿车道等安全关键场景。我们的方法从多帧激光雷达数据构建动态三维点云场景，引入车辆补全模块以根据部分观测数据重建完整360°几何结构，并将编辑后的场景渲染为二维条件图像，以引导视频扩散模型生成逼真的驾驶视频。由于此类编辑场景不可避免地超出训练数据分布，我们进一步提出基于强化学习的后训练策略，该策略结合成对偏好模型与成对奖励机制，能够在无真值监督的情况下，针对分布外场景实现稳健的质量提升。大量实验表明，ReinDriveGen在编辑驾驶场景任务中优于现有方法，并在新型自车视角合成任务中取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning post-training framework for generating out-of-distribution driving scenarios, such as collisions and pedestrian jaywalking, using a video diffusion model guided by edited 3D scene point clouds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，用于生成分布外驾驶场景（如碰撞、行人乱穿马路等），通过编辑3D点云场景来指导视频扩散模型生成逼真视频。

title: ReMoGen: Real-time Human Interaction-to-Reaction Generation via Modular Learning from Diverse Data
summary: Human behaviors in real-world environments are inherently interactive, with an individual's motion shaped by surrounding agents and the scene. Such capabilities are essential for applications in virtual avatars, interactive animation, and human-robot collaboration. We target real-time human interaction-to-reaction generation, which generates the ego's future motion from dynamic multi-source cues, including others' actions, scene geometry, and optional high-level semantic inputs. This task is fundamentally challenging due to (i) limited and fragmented interaction data distributed across heterogeneous single-person, human-human, and human-scene domains, and (ii) the need to produce low-latency yet high-fidelity motion responses during continuous online interaction. To address these challenges, we propose ReMoGen (Reaction Motion Generation), a modular learning framework for real-time interaction-to-reaction generation. ReMoGen leverages a universal motion prior learned from large-scale single-person motion datasets and adapts it to target interaction domains through independently trained Meta-Interaction modules, enabling robust generalization under data-scarce and heterogeneous supervision. To support responsive online interaction, ReMoGen performs segment-level generation together with a lightweight Frame-wise Segment Refinement module that incorporates newly observed cues at the frame level, improving both responsiveness and temporal coherence without expensive full-sequence inference. Extensive experiments across human-human, human-scene, and mixed-modality interaction settings show that ReMoGen produces high-quality, coherent, and responsive reactions, while generalizing effectively across diverse interaction scenarios.
summary_zh: 现实环境中的人类行为本质上是交互式的，个体的运动受到周围智能体与场景的塑造。这种能力对于虚拟化身、交互式动画和人机协作等应用至关重要。本研究聚焦于实时的人类交互-反应生成任务，即从动态多源线索（包括他人动作、场景几何结构及可选的高层语义输入）中生成自身未来运动。该任务面临两大根本挑战：（一）交互数据有限且分散于异质的单人、人-人及人-场景领域；（二）需要在连续在线交互过程中产生低延迟、高保真的运动响应。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ReMoGen（反应运动生成）——一个用于实时交互-反应生成的模块化学习框架。该框架通过从大规模单人运动数据中学习的通用运动先验，借助独立训练的元交互模块适应目标交互领域，从而在数据稀缺和异质监督条件下实现稳健泛化。为支持响应式在线交互，ReMoGen采用分段式生成策略，并结合轻量级帧级分段优化模块，该模块能在帧级别整合新观测到的线索，在不依赖高成本全序列推理的情况下，同步提升系统响应能力与时间连贯性。在人-人、人-场景及多模态交互场景中进行的大量实验表明，ReMoGen能够生成高质量、连贯且响应迅速的反应动作，并在多样化的交互场景中展现出良好的泛化能力。
tldr: Proposes a modular framework for real-time human motion generation from multi-source interaction cues, using a universal motion prior and domain-specific modules for generalization in data-scarce settings, with potential applications in human-robot collaboration.
tldr_zh: 提出一个模块化框架，用于从多源交互线索中实时生成人体运动，利用通用运动先验和特定领域模块实现数据稀缺环境下的泛化，适用于人机协作等领域。

title: A 4D Representation for Training-Free Agentic Reasoning from Monocular Laparoscopic Video
summary: Spatiotemporal reasoning is a fundamental capability for artificial intelligence (AI) in soft tissue surgery, paving the way for intelligent assistive systems and autonomous robotics. While 2D vision-language models show increasing promise at understanding surgical video, the spatial complexity of surgical scenes suggests that reasoning systems may benefit from explicit 4D representations. Here, we propose a framework for equipping surgical agents with spatiotemporal tools based on an explicit 4D representation, enabling AI systems to ground their natural language reasoning in both time and 3D space. Leveraging models for point tracking, depth, and segmentation, we develop a coherent 4D model with spatiotemporally consistent tool and tissue semantics. A Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) then acts as an agent on tools derived from the explicit 4D representation (e.g., trajectories) without any fine-tuning. We evaluate our method on a new dataset of 134 clinically relevant questions and find that the combination of a general purpose reasoning backbone and our 4D representation significantly improves spatiotemporal understanding and allows for 4D grounding. We demonstrate that spatiotemporal intelligence can be "assembled" from 2D MLLMs and 3D computer vision models without additional training. Code, data, and examples are available at https://tum-ai.github.io/surg4d/
summary_zh: 时空推理是人工智能在软组织手术中的一项核心能力，为智能辅助系统与自主机器人技术铺平了道路。虽然二维视觉语言模型在理解手术视频方面展现出日益广阔的前景，但手术场景的空间复杂性表明，推理系统可能受益于显式的四维表征。本文提出一个框架，基于显式四维表征为手术智能体配备时空推理工具，使人工智能系统能够将其自然语言推理建立在时间与三维空间的双重基础上。利用点跟踪、深度估计与分割模型，我们构建了一个具有时空一致性的工具与组织语义的连贯四维模型。随后，一个多模态大语言模型作为智能体，直接基于显式四维表征（如轨迹）导出的工具进行推理，无需任何微调。我们在包含134个临床相关问题的新数据集上评估了所提方法，发现通用推理主干与四维表征的结合显著提升了时空理解能力，并实现了四维语义关联。实验证明，时空智能无需额外训练即可从二维多模态大语言模型与三维计算机视觉模型中“组装”实现。代码、数据及示例详见 https://tum-ai.github.io/surg4d/。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for surgical AI agents using a 4D representation (3D space + time) built from 2D video and computer vision models, enabling training-free natural language reasoning for spatiotemporal tasks in soft tissue surgery.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于手术AI智能体的框架，该框架利用从2D视频和计算机视觉模型构建的4D表示（3D空间+时间），实现了在软组织手术中对时空任务进行免训练的自然语言推理。

title: Towards Viewpoint-Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving with 3D Foundation Model Priors
summary: Robust trajectory planning under camera viewpoint changes is important for scalable end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing models often depend heavily on the camera viewpoints seen during training. We investigate an augmentation-free approach that leverages geometric priors from a 3D foundation model. The method injects per-pixel 3D positions derived from depth estimates as positional embeddings and fuses intermediate geometric features through cross-attention. Experiments on the VR-Drive camera viewpoint perturbation benchmark show reduced performance degradation under most perturbation conditions, with clear improvements under pitch and height perturbations. Gains under longitudinal translation are smaller, suggesting that more viewpoint-agnostic integration is needed for robustness to camera viewpoint changes.
summary_zh: 在相机视角变化下进行稳健的轨迹规划对于可扩展的端到端自动驾驶具有重要意义。然而，现有模型往往严重依赖训练期间所见的相机视角。本研究探索了一种免增强方法，该方法利用来自三维基础模型的几何先验知识。该技术通过注入从深度估计中提取的像素级三维位置作为位置编码，并借助交叉注意力机制融合中间几何特征。在VR-Drive相机视角扰动基准测试中的实验表明，在大多数扰动条件下模型性能下降幅度减小，尤其在俯仰角与高度扰动场景下改善明显。纵向平移条件下的增益相对较小，这表明需要更具视角无关性的集成方法以实现对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve the robustness of end-to-end autonomous driving models to camera viewpoint changes by integrating 3D geometric priors from a foundation model, without data augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过集成来自基础模型的3D几何先验知识来提升端到端自动驾驶模型对相机视角变化的鲁棒性，且无需数据增强。

title: Safe learning-based control via function-based uncertainty quantification
summary: Uncertainty quantification is essential when deploying learning-based control methods in safety-critical systems. This is commonly realized by constructing uncertainty tubes that enclose the unknown function of interest, e.g., the reward and constraint functions or the underlying dynamics model, with high probability. However, existing approaches for uncertainty quantification typically rely on restrictive assumptions on the unknown function, such as known bounds on functional norms or Lipschitz constants, and struggle with discontinuities. In this paper, we model the unknown function as a random function from which independent and identically distributed realizations can be generated, and construct uncertainty tubes via the scenario approach that hold with high probability and rely solely on the sampled realizations. We integrate these uncertainty tubes into a safe Bayesian optimization algorithm, which we then use to safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.
summary_zh: 在安全关键系统中部署基于学习的控制方法时，不确定性量化至关重要。这通常通过构建不确定性管来实现，该管以高概率包围目标未知函数，如奖励函数、约束函数或底层动力学模型。然而，现有的不确定性量化方法通常依赖于对未知函数的严格假设，例如函数范数或李普希茨常数的已知界限，且难以处理不连续性。本文中，我们将未知函数建模为随机函数，可从中生成独立同分布的实现样本，并利用场景方法构建仅依赖于采样实现的不确定性管，确保其以高概率成立。我们将这些不确定性管集成到一种安全贝叶斯优化算法中，并应用于真实Furuta摆的控制参数安全调优。
tldr: The paper proposes a method for safe learning-based control using function-based uncertainty quantification via a scenario approach, and applies it to safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于场景方法的安全学习控制方法，通过函数不确定性量化，并应用于真实Furuta摆的安全控制参数调整。

title: Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations
summary: Successor Features (SF) combined with Generalized Policy Improvement (GPI) provide a robust framework for transfer learning in Reinforcement Learning (RL) by decoupling environment dynamics from reward functions. However, standard SF learning methods typically rely on semi-gradient Temporal Difference (TD) updates. When combined with non-linear function approximation, semi-gradient methods lack robust convergence guarantees and can lead to instability, particularly in the multi-task setting where accurate feature estimation is critical for effective GPI. Inspired by Full Gradient DQN, we propose Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations Q-Learning (FG-SFRQL), an algorithm that optimizes the successor features by minimizing the full Mean Squared Bellman Error. Unlike standard approaches, our method computes gradients with respect to parameters in both the online and target networks. We provide a theoretical proof of almost-sure convergence for FG-SFRQL and demonstrate empirically that minimizing the full residual leads to superior sample efficiency and transfer performance compared to semi-gradient baselines in both discrete and continuous domains.
summary_zh: 后继特征与广义策略改进相结合，通过将环境动态与奖励函数解耦，为强化学习中的迁移学习提供了稳健框架。然而，标准后继特征学习方法通常依赖于半梯度时序差分更新。当与非线性函数逼近结合使用时，半梯度方法缺乏可靠的收敛保证，并可能导致不稳定，特别是在多任务场景中——此时准确的特征估计对广义策略改进至关重要。受全梯度深度Q网络启发，我们提出全梯度后继特征表示Q学习算法，该算法通过最小化全均方贝尔曼误差来优化后继特征。与标准方法不同，本方法同时计算在线网络和目标网络参数的梯度。我们为全梯度后继特征表示Q学习提供了几乎必然收敛的理论证明，并通过实验验证：在离散和连续领域中，相较于半梯度基线方法，最小化全残差能带来更优的样本效率和迁移性能。
tldr: Proposes FG-SFRQL, a method for learning successor features using full gradient updates, offering theoretical convergence guarantees and improved sample efficiency/transfer for multi-task RL.
tldr_zh: 提出FG-SFRQL方法，通过全梯度更新学习后继特征，提供理论收敛保证，在离散和连续域中展现出比半梯度基线更优的样本效率和迁移性能。

title: Data-Driven Reachability Analysis via Diffusion Models with PAC Guarantees
summary: We present a data-driven framework for reachability analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems that requires no explicit model. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model learns the time-evolving state distribution of a dynamical system from trajectory data alone. The predicted reachable set takes the form of a sublevel set of a nonconformity score derived from the reconstruction error, with the threshold calibrated via the Learn Then Test procedure so that the probability of excluding a reachable state is bounded with high probability. Experiments on three nonlinear systems, a forced Duffing oscillator, a planar quadrotor, and a high-dimensional reaction-diffusion system, confirm that the empirical miss rate remains below the Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) bound while scaling to state dimensions beyond the reach of classical grid-based and polynomial methods.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的非线性动态系统可达性分析框架，该框架无需显式模型。通过去噪扩散概率模型，仅依据轨迹数据即可学习动态系统随时间演化的状态分布。预测的可达集采用重构误差导出的非一致性分数的子水平集形式，其阈值通过"学习后测试"程序进行校准，以确保排除可达状态的概率在高置信度下受控。在三个非线性系统——受迫杜芬振子、平面四旋翼飞行器以及高维反应扩散系统上的实验表明，该框架在扩展到超出传统网格法和多项式方法处理能力的高维状态空间时，其经验漏报率仍能保持在概率近似正确界限以下。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven framework for reachability analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems using diffusion models, with PAC guarantees, tested on systems like a planar quadrotor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的数据驱动框架，用于非线性动力系统的可达性分析，具有PAC保证，并在平面四旋翼等系统上进行了验证。

title: ProOOD: Prototype-Guided Out-of-Distribution 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is central to autonomous driving, yet current methods are vulnerable to long-tailed class bias and out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, often overconfidently assigning anomalies to rare classes. We present ProOOD, a lightweight, plug-and-play method that couples prototype-guided refinement with training-free OOD scoring. ProOOD comprises (i) prototype-guided semantic imputation that fills occluded regions with class-consistent features, (ii) prototype-guided tail mining that strengthens rare-class representations to curb OOD absorption, and (iii) EchoOOD, which fuses local logit coherence with local and global prototype matching to produce reliable voxel-level OOD scores. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that ProOOD achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-distribution 3D occupancy prediction and OOD detection. On SemanticKITTI, it surpasses baselines by +3.57% mIoU overall and +24.80% tail-class mIoU; on VAA-KITTI, it improves AuPRCr by +19.34 points, with consistent gains across benchmarks. These improvements yield more calibrated occupancy estimates and more reliable OOD detection in safety-critical urban driving. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/7uHeng/ProOOD.
summary_zh: 三维语义占据预测是自动驾驶的核心任务，然而现有方法容易受到长尾类别偏差和分布外（OOD）输入的影响，常常将异常数据过度自信地归类为罕见类别。本文提出ProOOD，一种轻量级即插即用方法，通过原型引导优化与免训练的OOD评分机制相结合。ProOOD包含三个核心模块：（1）原型引导的语义填补，利用类别一致特征填充被遮挡区域；（2）原型引导的尾部挖掘，强化罕见类别表征以抑制OOD吸收；（3）EchoOOD模块，融合局部逻辑一致性与局部全局原型匹配，生成可靠的体素级OOD评分。在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，ProOOD在分布内三维占据预测和OOD检测方面均达到最先进性能。在SemanticKITTI数据集上，其整体mIoU超越基线方法3.57%，尾部类别mIoU提升24.80%；在VAA-KITTI数据集上，AuPRCr指标提升19.34分，且在多个基准测试中均保持稳定增益。这些改进为安全关键的城市驾驶场景提供了更精准的占据估计和更可靠的OOD检测能力。源代码已公开于https://github.com/7uHeng/ProOOD。
tldr: ProOOD improves 3D semantic occupancy prediction and OOD detection for autonomous driving by using prototype-guided refinement and a novel training-free OOD scoring method.
tldr_zh: ProOOD通过原型引导的精炼和一种无需训练的新颖OOD评分方法，提升了自动驾驶中的3D语义占用预测和OOD检测性能。

title: An Integrated Soft Robotic System for Measuring Vital Signs in Search and Rescue Environments
summary: Robots are frequently utilized in search-and-rescue operations. In recent years, significant advancements have been made in the field of victim assessment. However, there are still open issues regarding heart rate measurement, and no studies have been found that assess pressure in post-disaster scenarios. This work designs a soft gripper and integrates it into a mobile robotic system, thereby creating a device capable of measuring the pulse and blood pressure of victims in post-disaster environments. The gripper is designed to envelop the victim's arm and inflate like a sphygmomanometer, facilitated by a specialized portability system. The utilization of different signal processing algorithms has enabled the attainment of a pulse bias of \qty{4}{\bpm} and a bias of approximately \qty{5}{\mmHg} for systolic and diastolic pressures. The findings, in conjunction with the other statistical data and the validation of homoscedasticity in the error terms, prove the system's capacity to accurately determine heart rate and blood pressure, thereby rendering it suitable for search and rescue operations. Finally, a post-disaster has been employed as a test to validate the functionality of the entire system and to demonstrate its capacity to adapt to various victim positions, its measurement speed, and its safety for victims.
summary_zh: 机器人在搜救行动中已得到广泛应用。近年来，遇险者评估领域取得了显著进展。然而，心率测量方面仍存在未解决的问题，且尚未发现针对灾后场景压力评估的研究。本研究设计了一种软体抓取器，并将其集成到移动机器人系统中，从而创建了一种能够在灾后环境中测量遇险者脉搏和血压的装置。该抓取器设计用于包裹遇险者手臂，并借助专用便携系统实现类似血压计的充气功能。通过采用不同的信号处理算法，系统实现了脉搏测量误差为4次/分钟，收缩压与舒张压测量误差约为5毫米汞柱。研究结果结合其他统计数据及误差项同方差性的验证，证明了该系统能够准确测定心率和血压，从而适用于搜救行动。最后，通过模拟灾后场景测试验证了整套系统的功能，并展示了其适应不同遇险者体位的能力、测量速度以及对遇险者的安全性。
tldr: This paper presents a soft gripper integrated into a mobile robotic system for measuring pulse and blood pressure of victims in search-and-rescue scenarios, achieving clinically relevant accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种集成到移动机器人系统中的软体抓取器，用于在搜救场景中测量受害者的脉搏和血压，并达到了临床相关的精度。

title: A Dual-Action Fabric-Based Soft Robotic Glove for Ergonomic Hand Rehabilitation
summary: Hand impairment following neurological disorders substantially limits independence in activities of daily living, motivating the development of effective assistive and rehabilitation strategies. Soft robotic gloves have attracted growing interest in this context, yet persistent challenges in customization, ergonomic fit, and flexion-extension actuation constrain their clinical utility. Here, we present a dual-action fabric-based soft robotic glove incorporating customized actuators aligned with individual finger joints. The glove comprises five independently controlled dual-action actuators supporting finger flexion and extension, together with a dedicated thumb abduction actuator. Leveraging computer numerical control heat sealing technology, we fabricated symmetrical-chamber actuators that adopt a concave outer surface upon inflation, thereby maximizing finger contact area and improving comfort. Systematic characterization confirmed that the actuators generate sufficient joint moment and fingertip force for ADL-relevant tasks, and that the complete glove system produces adequate grasping force for common household objects. A preliminary study with ten healthy subjects demonstrated that active glove assistance significantly reduces forearm muscle activity during object manipulation. A pilot feasibility study with three individuals with cervical spinal cord injury across seven functional tasks indicated that glove assistance promotes more natural grasp patterns and reduces reliance on tenodesis grasp, although at the cost of increased task completion time attributable to the current actuation interface. This customizable, ergonomic design represents a practical step toward personalized hand rehabilitation and assistive robotics.
summary_zh: 神经系统疾病导致的手部功能障碍严重限制了日常生活的独立性，这推动了对有效辅助与康复策略的研究。在此背景下，软体机器人手套日益受到关注，但定制化、人体工学适配以及屈伸驱动等方面的持续挑战制约了其临床实用性。本文提出一种基于纺织材料的双作用软体机器人手套，其搭载的定制化执行器与手指各关节一一对应。该手套包含五个独立控制的双作用执行器，分别支持手指屈曲与伸展，并配备专用的拇指外展执行器。利用计算机数控热封技术，我们制造了具有对称腔室的执行器，其在充气时呈现凹形外表面，从而最大化手指接触面积并提升舒适度。系统性能测试表明，执行器能产生满足日常生活相关任务所需的关节力矩与指尖力，完整手套系统对常见家用物品可产生足够的抓握力。一项针对十名健康受试者的初步研究表明，在操作物体时，手套的主动辅助能显著降低前臂肌肉活动度。针对三名颈脊髓损伤患者开展的七项功能任务的初步可行性研究显示，手套辅助能促进更自然的抓握模式并减少对肌腱固定式抓握的依赖，但由于当前驱动接口的限制，任务完成时间有所增加。这种可定制化且符合人体工学的设计，为个性化手部康复与辅助机器人技术迈出了实用化的一步。
tldr: A customizable soft robotic glove with dual-action actuators assists hand rehabilitation and grasp tasks, reducing forearm muscle activity and enabling more natural grasp patterns.
tldr_zh: 一款基于织物的可定制软体机器人手套，具有双重驱动执行器，用于辅助手部康复和抓握任务，减少前臂肌肉活动，实现更自然的抓握模式。

title: Reachability-Aware Time Scaling for Path Tracking
summary: This paper studies tracking of collision-free waypoint paths produced by an offline planner for a planar double-integrator system with bounded speed and acceleration. Because sampling-based planners must route around obstacles, the resulting waypoint paths can contain sharp turns and high-curvature regions, so one-step reachability under acceleration limits becomes critical even when the path geometry is collision-free. We build on a pure-pursuit-style, reachability-guided quadratic-program (QP) tracker with a one-step acceleration margin. Offline, we evaluate this margin along a spline fitted to the waypoint path and update a scalar speed-scaling profile so that the required one-step acceleration remains below the available bound. Online, the same look-ahead tracking structure is used to track the scaled reference.
summary_zh: 本文研究针对具有有界速度与加速度的平面双积分器系统，对离线规划器生成的无碰撞航点路径进行跟踪的问题。基于采样的规划器在避障过程中形成的航点路径可能包含急转弯与高曲率区域，因此即使路径几何形状本身无碰撞，在加速度限制下的单步可达性仍至关重要。我们基于一种纯追踪式、具有单步加速度裕度的可达性引导二次规划跟踪器，离线阶段通过对拟合航点路径的样条曲线评估该裕度，并更新标量速度缩放曲线，使所需单步加速度始终低于可用界限。在线阶段，采用相同的前瞻跟踪结构对缩放后的参考路径进行跟踪。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for scaling the speed profile of a pre-planned waypoint path to ensure that a planar double-integrator system can track it without violating acceleration constraints, using a reachability-guided quadratic-program tracker.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，通过可达性引导的二次规划跟踪器，对预先规划的路径点路径进行速度缩放，以确保平面双积分器系统能在不违反加速度约束的情况下进行跟踪。

title: Play-Testing REMind: Evaluating an Educational Robot-Mediated Role-Play Game
summary: This paper presents REMind, an innovative educational robot-mediated role-play game designed to support anti-bullying bystander intervention among children. REMind invites players to observe a bullying scenario enacted by social robots, reflect on the perspectives of the characters, and rehearse defending strategies by puppeteering a robotic avatar. We evaluated REMind through a mixed-methods play-testing study with 18 children aged 9--10. The findings suggest that the experience supported key learning goals related to self-efficacy, perspective-taking, understanding outcomes of defending, and intervention strategies. These results highlight the promise of Robot-Mediated Applied Drama (RMAD) as a novel pedagogical framework to support Social-Emotional Learning.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了REMind，这是一款创新的教育机器人中介角色扮演游戏，旨在支持儿童反欺凌旁观者干预。REMind通过社交机器人演绎的欺凌情境，邀请玩家观察并反思角色立场，同时通过操控机器人化身来演练防御策略。我们通过混合方法对18名9至10岁儿童进行游戏测试研究，评估了REMind的效果。研究结果表明，该体验有助于提升与自我效能、观点采择、理解防御行为后果及干预策略相关的关键学习目标。这些发现凸显了机器人中介应用戏剧作为一种支持社会情感学习的新型教学框架的潜力。
tldr: Paper introduces REMind, an educational role-play game using social robots to teach anti-bullying bystander intervention to children, evaluated in a study with 9-10 year olds.
tldr_zh: 论文介绍了REMind，一种利用社交机器人进行反欺凌旁观者干预教育的角色扮演游戏，并在一项针对9-10岁儿童的研究中进行了评估。

title: Neural Harmonic Textures for High-Quality Primitive Based Neural Reconstruction
summary: Primitive-based methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting have recently become the state-of-the-art for novel-view synthesis and related reconstruction tasks. Compared to neural fields, these representations are more flexible, adaptive, and scale better to large scenes. However, the limited expressivity of individual primitives makes modeling high-frequency detail challenging. We introduce Neural Harmonic Textures, a neural representation approach that anchors latent feature vectors on a virtual scaffold surrounding each primitive. These features are interpolated within the primitive at ray intersection points. Inspired by Fourier analysis, we apply periodic activations to the interpolated features, turning alpha blending into a weighted sum of harmonic components. The resulting signal is then decoded in a single deferred pass using a small neural network, significantly reducing computational cost. Neural Harmonic Textures yield state-of-the-art results in real-time novel view synthesis while bridging the gap between primitive- and neural-field-based reconstruction. Our method integrates seamlessly into existing primitive-based pipelines such as 3DGUT, Triangle Splatting, and 2DGS. We further demonstrate its generality with applications to 2D image fitting and semantic reconstruction.
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于图元的方法（如3D高斯泼溅）近年来已成为新视角合成及相关重建任务的前沿技术。与神经场相比，这类表征方式更具灵活性、适应性，并能更好地扩展至大场景。然而，单个图元的有限表达能力使其难以建模高频细节。我们提出神经谐波纹理，这是一种将潜在特征向量锚定于每个图元外围虚拟支架的神经表征方法。这些特征在光线交点处由图元内部插值生成。受傅里叶分析启发，我们对插值后的特征施加周期性激活，将透明度混合转换为谐波分量的加权和。随后通过小型神经网络在单次延迟计算中解码生成信号，显著降低了计算成本。神经谐波纹理在实时新视角合成中取得了领先成果，同时弥合了基于图元与基于神经场的重建方法之间的差距。该方法可无缝集成到现有图元流程中，如3DGUT、三角泼溅和2DGS。我们进一步通过二维图像拟合和语义重建应用证明了其通用性。
tldr: This paper introduces Neural Harmonic Textures, a neural representation that combines primitive-based methods with neural fields to improve high-frequency detail modeling in novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为神经谐波纹理的神经表示方法，通过结合基于基元的方法和神经场，在新型视图合成和3D重建中更好地建模高频细节。

title: Lightweight Prompt-Guided CLIP Adaptation for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Leveraging the rich semantic features of vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP for monocular depth estimation tasks is a promising direction, yet often requires extensive fine-tuning or lacks geometric precision. We present a parameter-efficient framework, named MoA-DepthCLIP, that adapts pretrained CLIP representations for monocular depth estimation with minimal supervision. Our method integrates a lightweight Mixture-of-Adapters (MoA) module into the pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT-B/32) backbone combined with selective fine-tuning of the final layers. This design enables spatially-aware adaptation, guided by a global semantic context vector and a hybrid prediction architecture that synergizes depth bin classification with direct regression. To enhance structural accuracy, we employ a composite loss function that enforces geometric constraints. On the NYU Depth V2 benchmark, MoA-DepthCLIP achieves competitive results, significantly outperforming the DepthCLIP baseline by improving the $δ_1$ accuracy from 0.390 to 0.745 and reducing the RMSE from 1.176 to 0.520. These results are achieved while requiring substantially few trainable parameters, demonstrating that lightweight, prompt-guided MoA is a highly effective strategy for transferring VLM knowledge to fine-grained monocular depth estimation tasks.
summary_zh:
摘要：
利用CLIP等视觉语言模型（VLM）的丰富语义特征进行单目深度估计任务，是一个极具前景的研究方向，但通常需要大量微调或缺乏几何精度。我们提出了一种参数高效的框架——MoA-DepthCLIP，该框架能够以最小监督的方式，将预训练的CLIP表征迁移至单目深度估计任务中。我们的方法通过在预训练的视觉Transformer（ViT-B/32）骨干网络中集成轻量级混合适配器模块，并配合对最后几层的选择性微调来实现。该设计由全局语义上下文向量和混合预测架构引导，实现空间感知的自适应，并协同利用深度分类与直接回归进行预测。为提升结构准确性，我们采用了一种复合损失函数以强化几何约束。在NYU Depth V2基准测试中，MoA-DepthCLIP取得了具有竞争力的结果，显著超越了DepthCLIP基线模型：将$δ_1$准确率从0.390提升至0.745，同时将RMSE从1.176降低至0.520。这些结果是在所需可训练参数大幅减少的情况下实现的，表明轻量级、提示引导的混合适配器是一种将VLM知识迁移至细粒度单目深度估计任务的高效策略。
tldr: Proposes MoA-DepthCLIP, a lightweight, prompt-guided adaptation of CLIP for monocular depth estimation using a Mixture-of-Adapters and hybrid prediction, achieving strong performance on NYU Depth V2 with few parameters.
tldr_zh: 提出MoA-DepthCLIP，一种轻量级、提示引导的CLIP自适应方法，用于单目深度估计，通过混合适配器和混合预测实现，在NYU Depth V2上取得优异性能且参数少。

title: Automated Framework to Evaluate and Harden LLM System Instructions against Encoding Attacks
summary: System Instructions in Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly used to enforce safety policies, define agent behavior, and protect sensitive operational context in agentic AI applications. These instructions may contain sensitive information such as API credentials, internal policies, and privileged workflow definitions, making system instruction leakage a critical security risk highlighted in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Without incurring the overhead costs of reasoning models, many LLM applications rely on refusal-based instructions that block direct requests for system instructions, implicitly assuming that prohibited information can only be extracted through explicit queries. We introduce an automated evaluation framework that tests whether system instructions remain confidential when extraction requests are re-framed as encoding or structured output tasks. Across four common models and 46 verified system instructions, we observe high attack success rates (> 0.7) for structured serialization where models refuse direct extraction requests but disclose protected content in the requested serialization formats. We further demonstrate a mitigation strategy based on one-shot instruction reshaping using a Chain-of-Thought reasoning model, indicating that even subtle changes in wording and structure of system instructions can significantly reduce attack success rate without requiring model retraining.
summary_zh: 大语言模型中的系统指令常用于强化安全策略、定义智能体行为，以及在自主AI应用中保护敏感操作上下文。这些指令可能包含API凭证、内部策略和特权工作流定义等敏感信息，使得系统指令泄露成为OWASP大语言模型应用十大安全风险中的关键隐患。为规避推理模型的高成本开销，当前许多大语言模型应用依赖基于拒绝的指令机制来拦截直接获取系统指令的请求，其隐含假设是受保护信息仅能通过显式查询提取。本文提出一种自动化评估框架，用于测试当提取请求被重构为编码或结构化输出任务时，系统指令的保密性是否仍能维持。通过对四种常见模型和46条已验证系统指令的实验，我们观察到在结构化序列化场景中，攻击成功率始终较高（>0.7）：模型虽拒绝直接提取请求，却会以要求的序列化格式泄露受保护内容。我们进一步提出基于单样本指令重构的缓解策略，该策略利用思维链推理模型实现，结果表明即使仅对系统指令的措辞和结构进行细微调整，也能在不重新训练模型的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。
tldr: This paper presents an automated framework to test and improve the security of LLM system instructions against attacks that extract sensitive information through encoding or structured output tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种自动化框架，用于测试和增强LLM系统指令的安全性，以抵御通过编码或结构化输出任务提取敏感信息的攻击。

title: Omni-SimpleMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: AI agents increasingly operate over extended time horizons, yet their ability to retain, organize, and recall multimodal experiences remains a critical bottleneck. Building effective lifelong memory requires navigating a vast design space spanning architecture, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, and data pipelines; this space is too large and interconnected for manual exploration or traditional AutoML to explore effectively. We deploy an autonomous research pipeline to discover Omni-SimpleMem, a unified multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents. Starting from a naïve baseline (F1=0.117 on LoCoMo), the pipeline autonomously executes ${\sim}50$ experiments across two benchmarks, diagnosing failure modes, proposing architectural modifications, and repairing data pipeline bugs, all without human intervention in the inner loop. The resulting system achieves state-of-the-art on both benchmarks, improving F1 by +411% on LoCoMo (0.117$\to$0.598) and +214% on Mem-Gallery (0.254$\to$0.797) relative to the initial configurations. Critically, the most impactful discoveries are not hyperparameter adjustments: bug fixes (+175%), architectural changes (+44%), and prompt engineering (+188% on specific categories) each individually exceed the cumulative contribution of all hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating capabilities fundamentally beyond the reach of traditional AutoML. We provide a taxonomy of six discovery types and identify four properties that make multimodal memory particularly suited for autoresearch, offering guidance for applying autonomous research pipelines to other AI system domains. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem.
summary_zh: AI智能体在越来越长的时间跨度内运行，但其保留、组织与回忆多模态体验的能力仍是一个关键瓶颈。构建有效的终身记忆系统需探索一个广阔的设计空间，涵盖架构、检索策略、提示工程与数据管道；这一空间过于庞大且相互关联，难以通过手动探索或传统AutoML进行有效探索。本研究部署了一个自主研究流程，以发现Omni-SimpleMem——一个用于终身AI智能体的统一多模态记忆框架。从一个简单基线开始（在LoCoMo基准上F1分数为0.117），该流程在两个基准测试中自主执行了约50次实验，诊断失败模式、提出架构改进方案并修复数据管道错误，且所有内部循环均无需人工干预。最终系统在两项基准测试中均达到最优水平：相较于初始配置，在LoCoMo上将F1分数提升了411%（0.117→0.598），在Mem-Gallery上提升了214%（0.254→0.797）。关键发现是，最具影响力的改进并非来自超参数调整：错误修复（+175%）、架构调整（+44%）及特定类别的提示工程优化（+188%）各自对性能提升的贡献均超过所有超参数调优的累积效果，这证明了其能力已远超传统AutoML范畴。本研究提出了六种发现类型的分类体系，并归纳了使多模态记忆系统特别适合自主研究的四个特性，为将自主研究流程应用于其他AI系统领域提供指导。代码已发布于https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem。
tldr: This paper presents Omni-SimpleMem, a multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents, autonomously discovered and optimized through an automated research pipeline, achieving state-of-the-art results on agent memory benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Omni-SimpleMem，这是一个通过自动化研究流程自主发现和优化的终身AI智能体多模态记忆框架，在智能体记忆基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models
summary: Large Vision Language Models show impressive performance across image and video understanding tasks, yet their computational cost grows rapidly with the number of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods mitigate this issue through empirical approaches while overlooking the internal mechanism of attention. In this paper, we propose a novel training free token pruning framework grounded in the dual form perspective of attention. We reformulate attention as an implicit linear layer whose weight matrix is the sum of rank 1 outer products, each generated by a single token's key value pair. Token pruning thus reduces to selecting an optimal subset of these rank 1 updates that best approximates the original dual weight matrix. Extending this perspective to standard softmax attention in LVLMs, we derive a novel metric quantifying both a token's information magnitude and information duplication. To efficiently select the subset with the proposed metric, we introduce Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade off between performance and efficiency, while providing another perspective on existing pruning approaches.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在图像和视频理解任务中展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其计算成本随视觉标记数量的增加而迅速增长。现有的标记剪枝方法通过经验性策略缓解这一问题，却往往忽视了注意力机制的内在机理。本文基于注意力对偶形式的视角，提出一种无需训练的新型标记剪枝框架。我们将注意力重新表述为一个隐式线性层，其权重矩阵由多个秩为1的外积求和构成，每个外积由单个标记的键值对生成。标记剪枝因此转化为从这些秩1更新中选择一个最优子集，以最佳逼近原始对偶权重矩阵。将此视角延伸至大型视觉语言模型中的标准软注意力机制，我们推导出一种新的量化指标，可同时衡量标记的信息量级与信息冗余度。为基于该指标高效选取子集，我们提出了渐进式分块最大边际相关性算法。大量实验表明，我们的方法在性能与效率之间实现了更优的平衡，同时为现有剪枝方法提供了新的理论视角。
tldr: The paper proposes a training-free token pruning method for Large Vision-Language Models by viewing attention as an implicit linear layer and selecting tokens to best approximate its dual weight matrix, aiming to improve efficiency with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种无需训练的大型视觉语言模型令牌剪枝方法，从注意力对偶形式的角度将令牌剪枝转化为选择最优的秩1更新子集，以提高模型效率。

title: Executing as You Generate: Hiding Execution Latency in LLM Code Generation
summary: Current LLM-based coding agents follow a serial execution paradigm: the model first generates the complete code, then invokes an interpreter to execute it. This sequential workflow leaves the executor idle during generation and the generator idle during execution, resulting in unnecessary end-to-end latency. We observe that, unlike human developers, LLMs produce code tokens sequentially without revision, making it possible to execute code as it is being generated. We formalize this parallel execution paradigm, modeling it as a three-stage pipeline of generation, detection, and execution, and derive closed-form latency bounds that characterize its speedup potential and operating regimes. We then present Eager, a concrete implementation featuring AST-based chunking, dynamic batching with gated execution, and early error interruption. We evaluate Eager across four benchmarks, seven LLMs, and three execution environments. Results show that Eager reduces the non-overlapped execution latency by up to 99.9% and the end-to-end latency by up to 55% across seven LLMs and four benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有基于大型语言模型的编码代理遵循串行执行范式：模型先生成完整代码，再调用解释器执行。这种顺序工作流导致生成阶段执行器闲置、执行阶段生成器闲置，从而产生不必要的端到端延迟。我们观察到，与人类开发者不同，大型语言模型无需修改即可顺序生成代码令牌，这使得在代码生成过程中同步执行成为可能。我们将这种并行执行范式形式化，将其建模为生成、检测与执行的三阶段流水线，并通过闭式延迟边界刻画其加速潜力与运行区间。随后提出具体实现方案Eager，该方案具备基于抽象语法树的代码块划分、带门控执行的动态批处理以及早期错误中断等核心机制。我们在四个基准测试集、七种大型语言模型及三种执行环境中对Eager进行评估。实验结果表明，在七种大型语言模型与四个基准测试中，Eager将非重叠执行延迟降低最高达99.9%，端到端延迟降低最高达55%。
tldr: Introduces a parallel execution paradigm and system called 'Eager' to reduce latency in LLM-based code generation by executing code as it is generated, rather than waiting for the full generation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种名为'Eager'的并行执行范式和系统，通过在生成代码时执行代码（而非等待完整生成）来降低LLM代码生成的整体延迟。

title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
summary: Agentic applications based on large language models increasingly rely on multi-step interaction loops involving planning, action execution, and environment feedback. While such systems are now deployed at scale, improving them post-deployment remains challenging. Agent trajectories are voluminous and non-deterministic, and reviewing each one, whether through human review or auxiliary LLMs, is slow and cost-prohibitive. We propose a lightweight, signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories. Our approach computes cheap, broadly applicable signals from live interactions and attaches them as structured attributes for trajectory triage, identifying interactions likely to be informative without affecting online agent behavior. We organize signals into a coarse-grained taxonomy spanning interaction (misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, satisfaction), execution (failure, loop), and environment (exhaustion), designed for computation without model calls. In a controlled annotation study on $τ$-bench, a widely used benchmark for tool-augmented agent evaluation, we show that signal-based sampling achieves an 82\% informativeness rate compared to 74\% for heuristic filtering and 54\% for random sampling, with a 1.52x efficiency gain per informative trajectory. The advantage is robust across reward strata and task domains, confirming that signals provide genuine per-trajectory informativeness gains rather than merely oversampling obvious failures. These results show that lightweight signals can serve as practical sampling infrastructure for agentic systems, and suggest a path toward preference data construction and post-deployment optimization.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体应用日益依赖包含规划、动作执行与环境反馈的多步交互循环。尽管此类系统已大规模部署，但其部署后的改进仍面临挑战：智能体轨迹数据量庞大且具有不确定性，通过人工审查或辅助大语言模型逐条分析的方式效率低下且成本高昂。我们提出一种轻量级、基于信号的智能体交互轨迹分类框架。该方法从实时交互中计算廉价且广泛适用的信号，并将其作为结构化属性附加至轨迹以实现分类，从而在不影响在线智能体行为的前提下识别可能蕴含信息的交互。我们将信号组织为粗粒度分类体系，涵盖交互（失准、停滞、脱离、满意度）、执行（失败、循环）及环境（资源耗尽）等维度，设计时无需模型调用即可完成计算。在广泛使用的工具增强智能体评估基准$τ$-bench上进行的受控标注研究表明：基于信号采样的信息获取率达82%，显著优于启发式过滤的74%和随机采样的54%，且每条信息轨迹的获取效率提升1.52倍。该优势在不同奖励层级与任务领域中均保持稳健，证实信号能真实提升单条轨迹的信息价值，而非仅对明显失败案例的过采样。这些结果表明，轻量级信号可作为智能体系统的实用采样基础设施，并为偏好数据构建与部署后优化提供可行路径。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight signal-based framework for efficiently sampling and triaging informative trajectories in agentic interaction loops, improving post-deployment optimization without online overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于信号的轻量级框架，用于高效采样和分类智能体交互轨迹中的关键信息，从而在不影响在线行为的情况下改进部署后优化。

title: The Geometry of Compromise: Unlocking Generative Capabilities via Controllable Modality Alignment
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP learn a shared embedding space for images and text, yet their representations remain geometrically separated, a phenomenon known as the modality gap. This gap limits tasks requiring cross-modal interchangeability, such as captioning and joint clustering. Existing post-processing approaches can partially improve cross-modal compatibility; however, we show through geometric analysis that they primarily reduce the global centroid offset while leaving the underlying distributional mismatch intact. We decompose the modality gap into a Centroid Gap and a Distribution Gap, and demonstrate that the Distribution Gap is the true predictor of cross-modal task quality ($R^2 = 0.986$), whereas the commonly used Raw Gap is misleading ($R^2 = 0.691$). Motivated by this observation, we propose TPC-CMA (Three-Phase Curriculum for Cross-Modal Alignment), a fine-tuning framework that explicitly reduces both components. The proposed CMA jointly mitigates centroid offsets and reshapes the distributional structure, while a three-phase curriculum with gradient-aware scheduling progressively introduces alignment during training to enable stable optimization. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-modal alignment. With $α_{\text{target}}{=}0.05$, the modality gap is reduced by 66.6\% with only 4.84\% accuracy drop. Under stronger alignment ($α_{\text{target}}{=}0.5$), the gap is reduced by 82.3\%, clustering ARI improves from 0.318 to 0.516, and captioning CIDEr increases by 57.1\% over the original model. Our code and pre-trained models will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 如CLIP等视觉语言模型（VLMs）学习了一个图像与文本的共享嵌入空间，但其表征在几何上仍存在分离现象，即所谓的模态鸿沟。该鸿沟限制了需要跨模态互换性的任务，如图片描述和联合聚类。现有的后处理方法可以部分改善跨模态兼容性；然而，通过几何分析我们发现，这些方法主要减少了全局质心偏移，而未能解决内在的分布不匹配问题。本文将模态鸿沟分解为质心鸿沟与分布鸿沟，并证明分布鸿沟是跨模态任务质量的真实预测指标（决定系数 $R^2 = 0.986$），而常用的原始鸿沟则具有误导性（$R^2 = 0.691$）。基于此发现，我们提出TPC-CMA（面向跨模态对齐的三阶段课程学习框架），这是一种显式减少两个分量的微调方法。该框架通过联合优化质心偏移和重构分布结构来改善对齐，同时采用梯度感知调度的三阶段课程学习策略，在训练过程中逐步引入对齐目标以实现稳定优化。实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了跨模态对齐效果。在 $α_{\text{目标}}{=}0.05$ 的设置下，模态鸿沟降低了66.6%，而准确率仅下降4.84%。在更强对齐条件下（$α_{\text{目标}}{=}0.5$），模态鸿沟减少82.3%，聚类调整兰德指数从0.318提升至0.516，图片描述的CIDEr分数相比原始模型提高了57.1%。我们的代码与预训练模型将在论文录用后公开。
tldr: This paper proposes a fine-tuning framework to close the modality gap in Vision-Language Models by decomposing it into centroid and distribution gaps, significantly improving cross-modal alignment for tasks like captioning and clustering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种微调框架，将视觉-语言模型中的模态鸿沟分解为质心鸿沟和分布鸿沟，通过减少两者来显著提升跨模态对齐能力，在图像描述和聚类等任务上取得改进。

title: Hybrid Energy-Based Models for Physical AI: Provably Stable Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: Energy-based models (EBMs) implement inference as gradient descent on a learned Lyapunov function, yielding interpretable, structure-preserving alternatives to black-box neural ODEs and aligning naturally with physical AI. Yet their use in system identification remains limited, and existing architectures lack formal stability guarantees that globally preclude unstable modes. We address this gap by introducing an EBM framework for system identification with stable, dissipative, absorbing invariant dynamics. Unlike classical global Lyapunov stability, absorbing invariance expands the class of stability-preserving architectures, enabling more flexible and expressive EBMs. We extend EBM theory to nonsmooth activations by establishing negative energy dissipation via Clarke derivatives and deriving new conditions for radial unboundedness, exposing a stability-expressivity tradeoff in standard EBMs. To overcome this, we introduce a hybrid architecture with a dynamical visible layer and static hidden layers, prove absorbing invariance under mild assumptions, and show that these guarantees extend to port-Hamiltonian EBMs. Experiments on metric-deformed multi-well and ring systems validate the approach, showcasing how our hybrid EBM architecture combines expressivity with sound and provable safety guarantees by design.
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于能量的模型（EBMs）通过在学习得到的李雅普诺夫函数上执行梯度下降来实现推理，从而为黑箱神经常微分方程提供了可解释、结构保持的替代方案，并与物理人工智能自然契合。然而，其在系统辨识中的应用仍较为有限，且现有架构缺乏能够全局排除不稳定模式的形式稳定性保证。本文通过提出一种具有稳定、耗散、吸收不变动态的系统辨识EBM框架，弥补了这一不足。与经典的全局李雅普诺夫稳定性不同，吸收不变性扩展了保持稳定性的架构类别，从而实现了更灵活、表达能力更强的EBMs。我们通过基于克拉克导数建立负能量耗散并推导径向无界的新条件，将EBM理论拓展至非光滑激活函数，揭示了标准EBMs中稳定性与表达性之间的权衡。为克服这一局限，我们引入一种具有动态可见层与静态隐藏层的混合架构，证明其在温和假设下具备吸收不变性，并指出这些保证可推广至端口-哈密顿EBMs。在度量形变多势阱与环形系统上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，展示了我们的混合EBM架构如何通过设计，将表达能力与可靠且可证明的安全性保障相结合。
tldr: The paper introduces a hybrid energy-based model framework for identifying port-Hamiltonian dynamical systems with formal stability guarantees, using absorbing invariance to expand the class of stable architectures while preserving expressivity.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于识别端口哈密顿动力系统的混合能量基模型框架，该框架具有形式化稳定性保证，通过吸收不变性扩展了稳定架构的类别，同时保持了表达能力。

title: Open-Set Supervised 3D Anomaly Detection: An Industrial Dataset and a Generalisable Framework for Unknown Defects
summary: Although self-supervised 3D anomaly detection assumes that acquiring high-precision point clouds is computationally expensive, in real manufacturing scenarios it is often feasible to collect a limited number of anomalous samples. Therefore, we study open-set supervised 3D anomaly detection, where the model is trained with only normal samples and a small number of known anomalous samples, aiming to identify unknown anomalies at test time. We present Open-Industry, a high-quality industrial dataset containing 15 categories, each with five real anomaly types collected from production lines. We first adapt general open-set anomaly detection methods to accommodate 3D point cloud inputs better. Building upon this, we propose Open3D-AD, a point-cloud-oriented approach that leverages normal samples, simulated anomalies, and partially observed real anomalies to model the probability density distributions of normal and anomalous data. Then, we introduce a simple Correspondence Distributions Subsampling to reduce the overlap between normal and non-normal distributions, enabling stronger dual distributions modeling. Based on these contributions, we establish a comprehensive benchmark and evaluate the proposed method extensively on Open-Industry as well as established datasets including Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet. Benchmark results and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of Open3D-AD and further reveal the potential of open-set supervised 3D anomaly detection.
summary_zh: 尽管自监督三维异常检测通常假设获取高精度点云计算成本高昂，但在实际制造场景中，采集有限数量的异常样本往往是可行的。因此，我们研究开放集监督式三维异常检测，该模型仅使用正常样本和少量已知异常样本进行训练，旨在测试阶段识别未知异常。我们提出Open-Industry数据集——一个包含15个类别的高质量工业数据集，每个类别涵盖从生产线上收集的五种真实异常类型。我们首先将通用开放集异常检测方法进行调整，以更好地适应三维点云输入。在此基础上，我们提出Open3D-AD方法：一种面向点云的技术，通过利用正常样本、模拟异常和部分观测到的真实异常，对正常与异常数据的概率密度分布进行建模。随后，我们引入一种简单的对应分布子采样策略，以减小正常与非正常分布之间的重叠，从而实现更强大的双分布建模。基于这些贡献，我们建立了完整的基准测试体系，并在Open-Industry及现有数据集（包括Real3D-AD和Anomaly-ShapeNet）上对所提方法进行了广泛评估。基准测试结果与消融实验证明了Open3D-AD的有效性，并进一步揭示了开放集监督式三维异常检测的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a dataset and a method for supervised 3D anomaly detection using point clouds, focusing on identifying unknown defects in industrial manufacturing scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于工业制造场景下，基于点云的有监督3D异常检测的数据集和方法，旨在识别未知缺陷。

title: PDA: Text-Augmented Defense Framework for Robust Vision-Language Models against Adversarial Image Attacks
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are vulnerable to adversarial image perturbations. Existing works based on adversarial training against task-specific adversarial examples are computationally expensive and often fail to generalize to unseen attack types. To address these limitations, we introduce Paraphrase-Decomposition-Aggregation (PDA), a training-free defense framework that leverages text augmentation to enhance VLM robustness under diverse adversarial image attacks. PDA performs prompt paraphrasing, question decomposition, and consistency aggregation entirely at test time, thus requiring no modification on the underlying models. To balance robustness and efficiency, we instantiate PDA as invariants that reduce the inference cost while retaining most of its robustness gains. Experiments on multiple VLM architectures and benchmarks for visual question answering, classification, and captioning show that PDA achieves consistent robustness gains against various adversarial perturbations while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, establishing a generic, strong and practical defense framework for VLMs during inference.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）易受对抗性图像扰动的影响。现有基于任务特定对抗样本的对抗训练方法计算成本高昂，且通常难以泛化至未见过的攻击类型。针对这些局限性，我们提出一种无需训练的多功能防御框架——复述-分解-聚合（PDA）。该框架通过文本增强技术，在多样化对抗性图像攻击下提升视觉语言模型的鲁棒性。PDA框架在测试阶段完全通过提示复述、问题分解和一致性聚合实现防御，无需修改底层模型。为平衡鲁棒性与效率，我们将PDA实例化为轻量化变体，在保持绝大部分鲁棒性增益的同时显著降低推理成本。在视觉问答、分类和描述生成等任务的多基准测试中，针对多种视觉语言模型架构的实验表明，PDA能够持续提升模型对抗各类扰动的鲁棒性，同时保持具有竞争力的清洁样本准确率，为视觉语言模型在推理阶段提供了通用、强效且实用的防御框架。
tldr: Proposes a training-free defense framework (PDA) that uses text augmentation at inference to improve the robustness of Vision-Language Models against adversarial image attacks, evaluated on VQA, classification, and captioning tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种免训练的防御框架（PDA），通过文本增强提高视觉语言模型在推理阶段对对抗性图像攻击的鲁棒性，并在视觉问答、分类和字幕生成等任务上进行了评估。

title: Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment
summary: 2D assembly diagrams are often abstract and hard to follow, creating a need for intelligent assistants that can monitor progress, detect errors, and provide step-by-step guidance. In mixed reality settings, such systems must recognize completed and ongoing steps from the camera feed and align them with the diagram instructions. Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise for this task, but face a depiction gap because assembly diagrams and video frames share few visual features. To systematically assess this gap, we construct IKEA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,623 questions across 6 task types on 29 IKEA furniture products, and evaluate 19 VLMs (2B-38B) under three alignment strategies. Our key findings: (1) assembly instruction understanding is recoverable via text, but text simultaneously degrades diagram-to-video alignment; (2) architecture family predicts alignment accuracy more strongly than parameter count; (3) video understanding remains a hard bottleneck unaffected by strategy. A three-level mechanistic analysis further reveals that diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces, and that adding text shifts models from visual to text-driven reasoning. These results identify visual encoding as the primary target for improving cross-depiction robustness. Project page: https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/
summary_zh: 二维组装图通常较为抽象且难以理解，这催生了对于智能辅助系统的需求，这类系统能够监测组装进度、检测错误并提供分步指导。在混合现实环境中，此类系统必须从摄像头画面中识别已完成和进行中的步骤，并将其与图示说明对齐。视觉语言模型在该任务中展现出潜力，但由于组装图与视频帧之间共享的视觉特征极少，面临着表征鸿沟的挑战。为系统评估这一差距，我们构建了IKEA-Bench基准测试集，涵盖29款宜家家具产品的6类任务共计1623个问题，并在三种对齐策略下评估了19个参数量级从2B到38B的视觉语言模型。主要发现包括：（1）通过文本可恢复组装指令理解，但文本会同时削弱图示与视频的对齐能力；（2）模型架构家族对对齐准确性的预测力强于参数数量；（3）视频理解仍是难以突破的瓶颈，且不受策略影响。三级机制分析进一步表明，图示与视频在视觉Transformer的子空间中占据分离区域，而添加文本会使模型从视觉驱动转向文本驱动推理。这些结果表明视觉编码是提升跨表征鲁棒性的核心优化方向。项目页面：https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/
tldr: The paper introduces IKEA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models on aligning abstract 2D assembly diagrams with real-world video frames, finding that visual encoding is the primary bottleneck for cross-depiction robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了IKEA-Bench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在将抽象2D组装图与真实世界视频帧对齐方面性能的基准，发现视觉编码是跨描绘鲁棒性的主要瓶颈。

title: TTA-Vid: Generalized Test-Time Adaptation for Video Reasoning
summary: Recent video reasoning models have shown strong results on temporal and multimodal understanding, yet they depend on large-scale supervised data and multi-stage training pipelines, making them costly to train and difficult to adapt to new domains. In this work, we leverage the paradigm of Test-Time Reinforcement Learning on video-language data to allow for adapting a pretrained model to incoming video samples at test-time without explicit labels. The proposed test-time adaptation for video approach (TTA-Vid) combines two components that work simultaneously: (1) a test-time adaptation that performs step-by-step reasoning at inference time on multiple frame subsets. We then use a batch-aware frequency-based reward computed across different frame subsets as pseudo ground truth to update the model. It shows that the resulting model trained on a single batch or even a single sample from a dataset, is able to generalize at test-time to the whole dataset and even across datasets. Because the adaptation occurs entirely at test time, our method requires no ground-truth annotations or dedicated training splits. Additionally, we propose a multi-armed bandit strategy for adaptive frame selection that learns to prioritize informative frames, guided by the same reward formulation. Our evaluation shows that TTA-Vid yields consistent improvements across various video reasoning tasks and is able to outperform current state-of-the-art methods trained on large-scale data. This highlights the potential of test-time reinforcement learning for temporal multimodal understanding.
summary_zh: 最近的视频推理模型在时序和多模态理解上取得了显著成果，但其依赖大规模监督数据与多阶段训练流程，导致训练成本高昂且难以适应新领域。本研究利用视频语言数据的测试时强化学习范式，使预训练模型能够在无明确标注的情况下，针对输入视频样本在测试阶段进行自适应调整。所提出的视频测试时自适应方法（TTA-Vid）融合了两个协同工作的组件：（1）通过测试时自适应机制，在推理阶段对多组帧子集执行逐步推理，并利用跨帧子集计算的批次感知频率奖励作为伪真值来更新模型。实验表明，仅使用单批次甚至单样本数据训练的模型，能够在测试阶段泛化至整个数据集乃至跨数据集场景。由于自适应过程完全在测试时进行，该方法无需真实标注或专用训练数据分割。此外，我们提出一种基于多臂老虎机策略的自适应帧选择方法，该策略通过相同奖励机制引导模型优先学习信息量丰富的帧。评估结果显示，TTA-Vid在多种视频推理任务中持续提升性能，并能够超越当前基于大规模数据训练的最先进方法，这证明了测试时强化学习在时序多模态理解领域的应用潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes TTA-Vid, a test-time reinforcement learning method for adapting pretrained video-language models to unlabeled video samples at inference time, using batch-aware rewards and adaptive frame selection.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出TTA-Vid方法，这是一种测试时强化学习范式，用于在推理时让预训练的视频-语言模型适应无标签的视频样本，利用批感知奖励和自适应帧选择策略。

title: STAR: Mitigating Cascading Errors in Spatial Reasoning via Turn-point Alignment and Segment-level DPO
summary: Structured spatial navigation is a core benchmark for Large Language Models (LLMs) spatial reasoning. Existing paradigms like Visualization-of-Thought (VoT) are prone to cascading errors in complex topologies. To solve this, we propose STAR, a two-stage framework grounded on topological anchors, and introduce the RedMaze-23K dataset with human-inspired turnpoint annotations. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to help models internalize spatial semantics and prune redundant paths. The second adopts Spatial-aware Segment-level Direct Preference Optimization (SDPO) to refine self-correction in long-horizon navigation. Experiments show STAR achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models: its 32B variant outperforms DeepSeek-V3 (29.27% vs. 25.00%) and reaches 82.4% of GPT-4's performance.
summary_zh: 结构化空间导航是评估大语言模型空间推理能力的核心基准。现有范式如思维可视化在复杂拓扑结构中容易产生级联误差。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于拓扑锚点的两阶段框架STAR，并构建了包含人类启发性转向点标注的RedMaze-23K数据集。第一阶段通过监督微调使模型内化空间语义并剪除冗余路径；第二阶段采用空间感知分段直接偏好优化，提升长视野导航中的自我校正能力。实验表明，STAR在开源模型中达到最先进性能：其320亿参数版本以29.27%的准确率超越DeepSeek-V3（25.00%），达到GPT-4性能的82.4%。
tldr: The paper proposes a two-stage framework (STAR) to improve spatial reasoning in LLMs for navigation tasks, using supervised fine-tuning and a novel spatial-aware DPO to mitigate cascading errors in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个两阶段框架（STAR）来提升大语言模型在导航任务中的空间推理能力，通过有监督微调和一种新颖的空间感知DPO来缓解复杂环境中的级联错误。

title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment
summary: A fundamental challenge in science and engineering is the simulation-to-experiment gap. While we often possess prior knowledge of physical laws, these physical laws can be too difficult to solve exactly for complex systems. Such systems are commonly modeled using simulators, which impose computational approximations. Meanwhile, experimental measurements more faithfully represent the real world, but experimental data typically consists of observations that only partially reflect the system's full underlying state. We propose a data-driven distribution alignment framework that bridges this simulation-to-experiment gap by pre-training a generative model on fully observed (but imperfect) simulation data, then aligning it with partial (but real) observations of experimental data. While our method is domain-agnostic, we ground our approach in the physical sciences by introducing Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA). This method aligns a generative model of atomic positions -- initially trained on a simulated Boltzmann distribution -- with the distribution of experimental observations. We prove that our method recovers the target observable distribution, even with multiple, potentially correlated observables. We also empirically validate our framework on synthetic, molecular, and experimental protein data, demonstrating that it can align generative models with diverse observables. Our code is available at https://kaityrusnelson.com/ada/.
summary_zh: 科学和工程领域的一个根本性挑战在于模拟与实验之间的差距。尽管我们通常对物理定律拥有先验知识，但这些物理定律在求解复杂系统时往往过于困难，难以精确解析。此类系统通常使用模拟器进行建模，但模拟器会引入计算近似。与此同时，实验测量能更真实地反映现实世界，但实验数据通常仅包含部分反映系统完整底层状态的观测结果。我们提出了一种数据驱动的分布对齐框架，该框架通过在完全观测（但不完美）的模拟数据上预训练生成模型，再将其与部分（但真实）的实验观测数据进行对齐，从而弥合这一模拟与实验的差距。尽管我们的方法适用于不同领域，但我们在物理科学中引入了对抗性分布对齐（ADA）来具体实现该方法。该方法将原子位置的生成模型（最初基于模拟的玻尔兹曼分布训练）与实验观测数据的分布进行对齐。我们证明，即使存在多个潜在相关的观测变量，我们的方法也能恢复目标观测分布。我们还在合成数据、分子数据以及实验蛋白质数据上进行了实证验证，结果表明该方法能够将生成模型与多样化的观测数据对齐。相关代码可在 https://kaityrusnelson.com/ada/ 获取。
tldr: The paper proposes a domain-agnostic method, Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA), to bridge the simulation-to-experiment gap by aligning generative models pre-trained on simulation data with partial experimental observations, validated on synthetic, molecular, and experimental protein data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种领域无关的方法，即对抗性分布对齐，通过将预训练在模拟数据上的生成模型与部分实验观测数据对齐，以弥合仿真到实验的鸿沟，并在合成、分子和实验蛋白质数据上进行了验证。

title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation has become a primary mechanism for transferring reasoning and domain expertise from frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, deployable students. However, the dominant paradigm remains \textit{off-policy}: students train on static teacher-generated data and never encounter their own errors during learning. This train--test mismatch, an instance of \textit{exposure bias}, causes prediction errors to compound autoregressively at inference time. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) addresses this by letting the student generate its own trajectories and receive teacher feedback on these self-generated outputs, grounding distillation in the theory of interactive imitation learning. Despite rapid growth spanning divergence minimization, reward-guided learning, and self-play, the OPD literature remains fragmented with no unified treatment. This survey provides the first comprehensive overview of OPD for LLMs. We introduce a unified $f$-divergence framework over on-policy samples and organize the landscape along three orthogonal dimensions: \emph{feedback signal} (logit-based, outcome-based, or self-play), \emph{teacher access} (white-box, black-box, or teacher-free), and \emph{loss granularity} (token-level, sequence-level, or hybrid). We systematically analyze representative methods, examine industrial deployments, and identify open problems including distillation scaling laws, uncertainty-aware feedback, and agent-level distillation.
summary_zh: 知识蒸馏已成为将前沿大语言模型的推理能力与领域专长迁移至小型可部署模型的主要机制。然而，当前主流范式仍以离线策略为主：学生模型在静态的教师生成数据上进行训练，在学习过程中从未接触自身错误。这种训练与推理的错位（即暴露偏差的一种表现）会导致预测误差在自回归推理过程中不断累积。在线策略蒸馏通过让学生模型生成自身轨迹并接收教师对这些自生成输出的反馈，将蒸馏过程建立在交互式模仿学习理论基础上，从而解决了上述问题。尽管该领域在散度最小化、奖励引导学习和自我博弈等方向快速发展，但相关研究仍处于碎片化状态，缺乏统一的理论框架。本文首次系统综述了大语言模型的在线策略蒸馏方法：我们引入了基于在线策略样本的f-散度统一框架，并沿三个正交维度梳理研究脉络：反馈信号（基于逻辑值、基于结果或自我博弈）、教师访问权限（白盒、黑盒或无教师）以及损失粒度（词元级、序列级或混合级）。我们系统分析了代表性方法，考察了工业部署实践，并指出包括蒸馏缩放定律、不确定性感知反馈和智能体级蒸馏在内的开放性问题。
tldr: This survey paper introduces a unified framework for On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in LLMs, categorizing methods by feedback signal, teacher access, and loss granularity to address exposure bias in knowledge transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了大型语言模型中的策略蒸馏方法，提出了一个统一的框架，按反馈信号、教师访问和损失粒度对方法进行分类，以解决知识转移中的暴露偏差问题。

title: Internal State-Based Policy Gradient Methods for Partially Observable Markov Potential Games
summary: This letter studies multi-agent reinforcement learning in partially observable Markov potential games. Solving this problem is challenging due to partial observability, decentralized information, and the curse of dimensionality. First, to address the first two challenges, we leverage the common information framework, which allows agents to act based on both shared and local information. Second, to ensure tractability, we study an internal state that compresses accumulated information, preventing it from growing unboundedly over time. We then implement an internal state-based natural policy gradient method to find Nash equilibria of the Markov potential game. Our main contribution is to establish a non-asymptotic convergence bound for this method. Our theoretical bound decomposes into two interpretable components: a statistical error term that also arises in standard Markov potential games, and an approximation error capturing the use of finite-state controllers. Finally, simulations across multiple partially observable environments demonstrate that the proposed method using finite-state controllers achieves consistent improvements in performance compared to the setting where only the current observation is used.
summary_zh: 本文研究了部分可观测马尔可夫势博弈中的多智能体强化学习问题。由于部分可观测性、信息分散性以及维度灾难的存在，解决该问题具有挑战性。首先，为应对前两个挑战，我们利用共同信息框架，使智能体能够基于共享信息和局部信息做出决策。其次，为确保计算可行性，我们研究了一种压缩累积信息的内部状态表示方法，防止其随时间无限增长。随后，我们实现了基于内部状态的自然策略梯度算法来求解马尔可夫势博弈的纳什均衡。本文的主要贡献在于为该算法建立了非渐近收敛界。我们的理论界可分解为两个可解释的组成部分：标准马尔可夫势博弈中存在的统计误差项，以及表征有限状态控制器使用效果的近似误差项。最后，通过在多个部分可观测环境中的仿真实验表明，与仅使用当前观测信息的设定相比，采用有限状态控制器的所提方法在性能上实现了持续提升。
tldr: Proposes a natural policy gradient method for multi-agent reinforcement learning in partially observable Markov potential games, using an internal state compression mechanism and establishing a non-asymptotic convergence bound.
tldr_zh: 针对部分可观测马尔可夫势博弈，提出一种基于内部状态的自然策略梯度方法，使用内部状态压缩机制并建立了非渐近收敛界。

title: MVNN: A Measure-Valued Neural Network for Learning McKean-Vlasov Dynamics from Particle Data
summary: Collective behaviors that emerge from interactions are fundamental to numerous biological systems. To learn such interacting forces from observations, we introduce a measure-valued neural network that infers measure-dependent interaction (drift) terms directly from particle-trajectory observations. The proposed architecture generalizes standard neural networks to operate on probability measures by learning cylindrical features, using an embedding network that produces scalable distribution-to-vector representations. On the theory side, we establish well-posedness of the resulting dynamics and prove propagation-of-chaos for the associated interacting-particle system. We further show universal approximation and quantitative approximation rates under a low-dimensional measure-dependence assumption. Numerical experiments on first and second order systems, including deterministic and stochastic Motsch-Tadmor dynamics, two-dimensional attraction-repulsion aggregation, Cucker-Smale dynamics, and a hierarchical multi-group system, demonstrate accurate prediction and strong out-of-distribution generalization.
summary_zh: 集体行为源于个体间的相互作用，是众多生物系统的核心特征。为了从观测数据中学习此类相互作用力，我们提出了一种测度值神经网络，该网络能够直接从粒子轨迹观测数据中推断出依赖于测度的相互作用（漂移）项。该架构通过嵌入网络学习柱面特征，生成可扩展的分布到向量表示，从而将标准神经网络推广至概率测度空间。在理论层面，我们证明了所推导动力系统的适定性，并对相关相互作用粒子系统验证了混沌传播定理。在低维测度依赖假设下，我们进一步证明了该方法的普适逼近能力与定量逼近速率。通过一阶与二阶系统（包括确定性及随机的Motsch-Tadmor动力学、二维吸引-排斥聚集系统、Cucker-Smale动力学以及分层多群组系统）的数值实验，验证了该方法具有精确预测能力与强大的分布外泛化性能。
tldr: The paper introduces a measure-valued neural network (MVNN) to learn interaction dynamics in collective systems from particle trajectory data, proving theoretical guarantees and demonstrating strong generalization across various simulated multi-particle systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种测度值神经网络（MVNN），用于从粒子轨迹数据中学习集体系统的交互动力学，证明了理论保证，并在多个模拟的多粒子系统中展示了强大的泛化能力。

title: VRUD: A Drone Dataset for Complex Vehicle-VRU Interactions within Mixed Traffic
summary: The Operational Design Domain (ODD) of urbanoriented Level 4 (L4) autonomous driving, especially for autonomous robotaxis, confronts formidable challenges in complex urban mixed traffic environments. These challenges stem mainly from the high density of Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) and their highly uncertain and unpredictable interaction behaviors. However, existing open-source datasets predominantly focus on structured scenarios such as highways or regulated intersections, leaving a critical gap in data representing chaotic, unstructured urban environments. To address this, this paper proposes an efficient, high-precision method for constructing drone-based datasets and establishes the Vehicle-Vulnerable Road User Interaction Dataset (VRUD), as illustrated in Figure 1. Distinct from prior works, VRUD is collected from typical "Urban Villages" in Shenzhen, characterized by loose traffic supervision and extreme occlusion. The dataset comprises 4 hours of 4K/30Hz recording, containing 11,479 VRU trajectories and 1,939 vehicle trajectories. A key characteristic of VRUD is its composition: VRUs account for about 87% of all traffic participants, significantly exceeding the proportions in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, unlike datasets that only provide raw trajectories, we extracted 4,002 multi-agent interaction scenarios based on a novel Vector Time to Collision (VTTC) threshold, supported by standard OpenDRIVE HD maps. This study provides valuable, rare edge-case resources for enhancing the safety performance of ADS in complex, unstructured urban environments. To facilitate further research, we have made the VRUD dataset open-source at: https://zzi4.github.io/VRUD/.
