summary_zh: 面向城市应用的L4级自动驾驶（尤其是自动驾驶出租车）的操作设计域，在复杂的城市混合交通环境中面临着严峻挑战。这些挑战主要源于高密度的弱势道路使用者及其高度不确定、不可预测的交互行为。然而，现有开源数据集主要集中于高速公路或规范交叉口等结构化场景，缺乏对混乱、非结构化城市环境的数据表征。为此，本文提出了一种高效、高精度的无人机数据集构建方法，并建立了车辆-弱势道路使用者交互数据集（VRUD），如图1所示。与以往研究不同，VRUD采集自深圳典型的“城中村”区域，其特点是交通监管松散、遮挡现象严重。该数据集包含4小时4K/30Hz的视频记录，涵盖了11,479条弱势道路使用者轨迹和1,939条车辆轨迹。VRUD的一个关键特征在于其构成：弱势道路使用者约占所有交通参与者的87%，显著超过现有基准数据集的比例。此外，不同于仅提供原始轨迹的数据集，我们基于新型矢量碰撞时间阈值提取了4,002个多智能体交互场景，并辅以标准OpenDRIVE高精地图支持。本研究为提升自动驾驶系统在复杂非结构化城市环境中的安全性能提供了宝贵且稀缺的边缘场景资源。为促进进一步研究，我们已将VRUD数据集开源发布在：https://zzi4.github.io/VRUD/。
tldr: The paper introduces a new drone-based dataset, VRUD, focusing on complex vehicle-VRU interactions in unstructured urban traffic environments, providing edge-case data for autonomous driving safety.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VRUD，一个基于无人机收集的新数据集，专注于非结构化城市交通环境中车辆与弱势道路使用者的复杂交互，为自动驾驶系统在复杂环境中的安全性提供了边缘案例数据。

title: PanoAir: A Panoramic Visual-Inertial SLAM with Cross-Time Real-World UAV Dataset
summary:
Accurate pose estimation is fundamental for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications, where Visual-Inertial SLAM (VI-SLAM) provides a cost-effective solution for localization and mapping. However, existing VI-SLAM methods mainly rely on sensors with limited fields of view (FoV), which can lead to drift and even failure in complex UAV scenarios. Although panoramic cameras provide omnidirectional perception to improve robustness, panoramic VI-SLAM and corresponding real-world datasets for UAVs remain underexplored. To address this limitation, we first construct a real-world panoramic visual-inertial dataset covering diverse flight conditions, including varying illumination, altitudes, trajectory lengths, and motion dynamics. To achieve accurate and robust pose estimation under such challenging UAV scenarios, we propose a panoramic VI-SLAM framework that exploits the omnidirectional FoV via the proposed panoramic feature extraction and panoramic loop closure, enhancing feature constraints and ensuring global consistency. Extensive experiments on both the proposed dataset and public benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy, robustness, and consistency compared to existing approaches. Moreover, deployment on embedded platform validates its practical applicability, achieving comparable computational efficiency to PC implementations.
  The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lG1Upn6yi-N6tYpEHAt6dfR1uhzNtWbT/view
summary_zh: 精准的姿态估计是无人机应用的基础，其中视觉-惯性SLAM（VI-SLAM）为定位与建图提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。然而，现有VI-SLAM方法主要依赖视场范围有限的传感器，在复杂的无人机应用场景中可能导致漂移甚至失效。虽然全景相机能够提供全方位感知以提升鲁棒性，但面向无人机的全景VI-SLAM技术及相应的真实场景数据集仍待深入研究。针对这一局限，我们首先构建了涵盖多种飞行条件的真实场景全景视觉-惯性数据集，包括不同光照、飞行高度、轨迹长度与运动动态。为在此类具有挑战性的无人机场景中实现精准鲁棒的姿态估计，我们提出了一种全景VI-SLAM框架，通过所设计的全景特征提取与全景回环检测机制充分利用全方位视场，从而增强特征约束并保障全局一致性。在自建数据集及公开基准测试上的大量实验表明，本方法相较于现有方法具有更高的精度、鲁棒性与一致性。此外，在嵌入式平台上的部署验证了其实际适用性，其计算效率与个人计算机实现版本相当。源代码与数据集已公开于https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lG1Upn6yi-N6tYpEHAt6dfR1uhzNtWbT/view。
tldr: This paper proposes a panoramic visual-inertial SLAM framework for UAVs and introduces a corresponding real-world dataset to improve robustness and accuracy in challenging flight conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于无人机的全景视觉惯性SLAM框架，并引入了一个相应的真实世界数据集，以提升在复杂飞行条件下的鲁棒性和定位精度。

title: DVGT-2: Vision-Geometry-Action Model for Autonomous Driving at Scale
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from the conventional paradigm based on sparse perception into vision-language-action (VLA) models, which focus on learning language descriptions as an auxiliary task to facilitate planning. In this paper, we propose an alternative Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) paradigm that advocates dense 3D geometry as the critical cue for autonomous driving. As vehicles operate in a 3D world, we think dense 3D geometry provides the most comprehensive information for decision-making. However, most existing geometry reconstruction methods (e.g., DVGT) rely on computationally expensive batch processing of multi-frame inputs and cannot be applied to online planning. To address this, we introduce a streaming Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT-2), which processes inputs in an online manner and jointly outputs dense geometry and trajectory planning for the current frame. We employ temporal causal attention and cache historical features to support on-the-fly inference. To further enhance efficiency, we propose a sliding-window streaming strategy and use historical caches within a certain interval to avoid repetitive computations. Despite the faster speed, DVGT-2 achieves superior geometry reconstruction performance on various datasets. The same trained DVGT-2 can be directly applied to planning across diverse camera configurations without fine-tuning, including closed-loop NAVSIM and open-loop nuScenes benchmarks.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶已从传统的稀疏感知范式发展为视觉-语言-动作模型，其核心是通过学习语言描述作为辅助任务来促进规划。本文提出一种新的视觉-几何-动作范式，主张将稠密三维几何作为自动驾驶的关键线索。由于车辆运行在三维世界中，我们认为稠密三维几何能为决策提供最全面的信息。然而，现有几何重建方法大多依赖对多帧输入进行计算密集的批量处理，无法适用于在线规划。为此，我们提出流式驾驶视觉几何变换器，以在线方式处理输入数据，并同时输出当前帧的稠密几何结构与轨迹规划。我们采用时序因果注意力机制并缓存历史特征，以支持实时推理。为进一步提升效率，我们提出滑动窗口流式策略，利用特定时间区间内的历史缓存避免重复计算。尽管速度更快，DVGT-2在多个数据集上实现了更优的几何重建性能。训练完成的DVGT-2无需微调即可直接应用于不同摄像头配置的规划任务，包括闭环NAVSIM与开环nuScenes基准测试。
tldr: Proposes a Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) model for end-to-end autonomous driving, using a streaming transformer to output dense 3D geometry and planning online for improved efficiency.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于端到端自动驾驶的视觉-几何-动作（VGA）模型，使用流式Transformer在线输出密集3D几何和规划以提高效率。

title: Bench2Drive-VL: Benchmarks for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Vision-Language Models
summary: With the rise of vision-language models (VLM), their application for autonomous driving (VLM4AD) has gained significant attention. Meanwhile, in autonomous driving, closed-loop evaluation has become widely recognized as a more reliable validation method than open-loop evaluation, as it can evaluate the performance of the model under cumulative errors and out-of-distribution inputs. However, existing VLM4AD benchmarks evaluate the model`s scene understanding ability under open-loop, i.e., via static question-answer (QA) dataset. This kind of evaluation fails to assess the VLMs performance under out-of-distribution states rarely appeared in the human collected datasets.To this end, we present Bench2Drive-VL, an extension of Bench2Drive that brings closed-loop evaluation to VLM-based driving, which introduces: (1) DriveCommenter, a closed-loop generator that automatically generates diverse, behavior-grounded question-answer pairs for all driving situations in CARLA,including severe off-route and off-road deviations previously unassessable in simulation. (2) A unified protocol and interface that allows modern VLMs to be directly plugged into the Bench2Drive closed-loop environment to compare with traditional agents. (3) A flexible reasoning and control framework, supporting multi-format visual inputs and configurable graph-based chain-of-thought execution. (4) A complete development ecosystem. Together, these components form a comprehensive closed-loop benchmark for VLM4AD. All codes and annotated datasets are open sourced.
summary_zh: 随着视觉-语言模型（VLM）的兴起，其在自动驾驶领域的应用（VLM4AD）已受到广泛关注。与此同时，在自动驾驶中，闭环评估因其能够评估模型在累积误差和分布外输入下的性能，已被公认为比开环评估更可靠的验证方法。然而，现有的VLM4AD基准测试仍采用开环方式评估模型的场景理解能力，即通过静态问答数据集进行评估。这种评估方式无法评估VLM在人类采集数据集中极少出现的分布外状态下的表现。为此，我们提出了Bench2Drive-VL，这是Bench2Drive的扩展版本，将闭环评估引入基于VLM的驾驶系统。该框架包括：（1）DriveCommenter——一个闭环生成器，能够为CARLA仿真环境中的所有驾驶场景自动生成多样化、基于行为的问答对，涵盖以往仿真中无法评估的严重偏离路线和越野等异常情况；（2）统一的协议和接口，允许现代VLM直接接入Bench2Drive闭环环境，与传统智能体进行对比；（3）灵活的推理与控制框架，支持多格式视觉输入和可配置的图式思维链执行；（4）完整的开发生态系统。这些组件共同构成了VLM4AD的综合闭环基准测试平台。所有代码和标注数据集均已开源。
tldr: This paper introduces Bench2Drive-VL, a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving within the CARLA simulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Bench2Drive-VL基准，用于在CARLA模拟器中对自动驾驶的视觉语言模型进行闭环评估。

title: A wearable haptic device for edge and surface simulation
summary: Object manipulation is fundamental to virtual reality (VR) applications, yet conventional fingertip haptic devices fail to render certain tactile features relevant for immersive and precise interactions, as i.e. detection of edges. This paper presents a compact, lightweight fingertip haptic device (24.3 g) that delivers distinguishable surface and edge contact feedback through a novel dual-motor mechanism. Pressure distribution characterization using a 6 x 6 flexible sensor array demonstrates distinct contact patterns between the two stimulation modes. A preliminary user study with five participants achieved 93% average classification accuracy across four conditions (edge/surface contact with light/heavy pressure), with mean response times of 2.79 seconds. The results indicate that the proposed device can effectively convey edge and surface tactile cues, potentially enhancing object manipulation fidelity in VR environments.
summary_zh: 物体操控是虚拟现实应用的基础，然而传统指尖触觉设备无法呈现某些对于沉浸式精准交互至关重要的触觉特征（如边缘检测）。本文提出了一种紧凑轻量化的指尖触觉设备（24.3克），通过创新的双电机驱动机制，可提供可区分的表面接触与边缘接触反馈。利用6×6柔性传感器阵列进行的压力分布特性测试表明，两种刺激模式产生了显著不同的接触特征图谱。针对五名参与者的初步用户研究显示，在四种实验条件（轻压/重压下的边缘/表面接触）中平均分类准确率达到93%，平均响应时间为2.79秒。实验结果表明，该设备能够有效传递边缘与表面触觉信息，有望提升虚拟现实环境中物体操控的逼真度。
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight fingertip haptic device designed to simulate edge and surface contact for enhanced object manipulation in virtual reality environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量化指尖触觉设备，旨在通过模拟边缘和表面接触来增强虚拟现实环境中的物体操作沉浸感。

title: Simulating Realistic LiDAR Data Under Adverse Weather for Autonomous Vehicles: A Physics-Informed Learning Approach
summary: Accurate LiDAR simulation is crucial for autonomous driving, especially under adverse weather conditions. Existing methods struggle to capture the complex interactions between LiDAR signals and atmospheric phenomena, leading to unrealistic representations. This paper presents a physics-informed learning framework (PICWGAN) for generating realistic LiDAR data under adverse weather conditions. By integrating physicsdriven constraints for modeling signal attenuation and geometryconsistent degradations into a physics-informed learning pipeline, the proposed method reduces the sim-to-real gap. Evaluations on real-world datasets (CADC for snow, Boreas for rain) and the VoxelScape dataset show that our approach closely mimics realworld intensity patterns. Quantitative metrics, including MSE, SSIM, KL divergence, and Wasserstein distance, demonstrate statistically consistent intensity distributions. Additionally, models trained on data enhanced by our framework outperform baselines in downstream 3D object detection, achieving performance comparable to models trained on real-world data. These results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed approach in improving the realism of LiDAR data and enabling robust perception under adverse weather conditions.
summary_zh: 准确的激光雷达模拟对于自动驾驶至关重要，尤其是在恶劣天气条件下。现有方法难以捕捉激光雷达信号与大气现象之间的复杂相互作用，导致模拟结果不够真实。本文提出了一种基于物理信息的学习框架（PICWGAN），用于在恶劣天气条件下生成逼真的激光雷达数据。该方法通过将物理驱动的信号衰减建模约束和几何一致性退化特征整合到物理信息学习流程中，有效缩小了仿真与真实场景之间的差距。在真实数据集（CADC用于雪天、Boreas用于雨天）及VoxelScape数据集上的评估表明，我们的方法能高度还原真实世界中的激光雷达强度分布特征。量化指标（包括均方误差、结构相似性指数、KL散度与Wasserstein距离）证实了生成数据在强度分布上具有统计一致性。此外，使用基于本框架增强数据训练的模型在下游三维目标检测任务中表现优于基准方法，其性能达到与使用真实数据训练模型相当的水平。这些结果充分证明了所提方法在提升激光雷达数据真实性和增强恶劣天气下感知鲁棒性方面的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a physics-informed learning framework (PICWGAN) to generate realistic LiDAR data under adverse weather conditions like rain and snow, aiming to reduce the sim-to-real gap for autonomous vehicle perception.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种物理信息学习框架（PICWGAN），用于在雨雪等恶劣天气条件下生成逼真的激光雷达数据，旨在缩小自动驾驶感知的仿真与现实差距。

title: Bistable Quad-Nets Composed of Four-Bar Linkages
summary: We study mechanical structures composed of spatial four-bar linkages that are bistable, that is, they allow for two distinct configurations. They have an interpretation as quad nets in the Study quadric which can be used to prove existence of arbitrarily large structures of this type. We propose a purely geometric construction of such examples, starting from infinitesimally flexible quad nets in Euclidean space and applying Whiteley de-averaging. This point of view situates the problem within the broader framework of discrete differential geometry and enables the construction of bistable structures from well-known classes of quad nets, such as discrete minimal surfaces. The proposed construction does not rely on numerical optimization and allows control over axis positions and snap angles.
summary_zh: 我们研究了由空间四连杆机构组成的双稳态机械结构，即这些结构允许存在两种不同构型。它们可被解释为Study二次曲面中的四边形网格，该性质可用于证明此类结构存在任意大规模的可能性。我们提出了一种纯几何构造方法：从欧几里得空间中的无限柔顺四边形网格出发，通过应用Whiteley去平均化操作实现。这一视角将问题置于离散微分几何的更广泛框架中，使得从已知的四边形网格类型（如离散极小曲面）构造双稳态结构成为可能。所提出的构造方法不依赖数值优化，并能实现对轴线位置和跳跃角度的精确控制。
tldr: This paper presents a geometric construction method for creating bistable mechanical structures using spatial four-bar linkages, framed within discrete differential geometry and enabling the construction of large-scale structures from known quad net classes like discrete minimal surfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于空间四连杆机构的几何构造方法，用于构建双稳态机械结构，将问题置于离散微分几何框架下，可从离散极小曲面等已知四边形网类构造大规模结构，不依赖数值优化。

title: Go Big or Go Home: Simulating Mobbing Behavior with Braitenbergian Robots
summary: We used the Webots robotics simulation platform to simulate a dyadic avoiding and mobbing predator behavior in a group of Braitenbergian robots. Mobbing is an antipredator adaptation used by some animals in which the individuals cooperatively attack or harass a predator to protect themselves. One way of coordinating a mobbing attack is using mobbing calls to summon other individuals of the mobbing species. We imitated this mechanism and simulated Braitenbergian robots that use mobbing calls when they face a light source (representing an inanimate predator) and mob it if they can summon allies, otherwise, they escape from it. We explore the effects of range of mobbing call (infinite range, mid-range and low-range) and the size of the robot group (ten robots vs three) on the overall success of mobbing. Our results suggest that both variables have significant impacts. This work has implications for simulations of action selection in artificial life and designing control architectures for autonomous agents.
summary_zh: 本研究利用Webots机器人仿真平台，模拟了布雷顿伯格机器人群体中的二元天敌回避与围捕行为。围捕是某些动物为抵御天敌演化出的适应性行为，个体通过合作攻击或骚扰天敌以实现自我保护。协调围捕攻击的方式之一是通过召唤鸣叫聚集同类个体。我们借鉴该机制，模拟了布雷顿伯格机器人在面对光源（代表无生命天敌）时发出召唤鸣叫的行为模式：若能召集同伴则实施围捕，否则选择逃离。本研究重点探究了召唤鸣叫的作用范围（无限范围、中距范围与短距范围）以及机器人群体规模（十台与三台对比）对围捕成功率的影响。实验结果表明这两个变量均产生显著影响。本工作对人工生命的行为选择仿真及自主智能体控制架构设计具有参考意义。
tldr: This paper simulates mobbing behavior in a group of simple Braitenberg robots, exploring how call range and group size affect cooperative attack success against a simulated predator.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文模拟了群体中简单Braitenberg机器人的围攻行为，探究了召唤范围和群体规模对模拟捕食者协同攻击成功率的影响。

title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers
summary: We present HippoCamp, a new benchmark designed to evaluate agents' capabilities on multimodal file management. Unlike existing agent benchmarks that focus on tasks like web interaction, tool use, or software automation in generic settings, HippoCamp evaluates agents in user-centric environments to model individual user profiles and search massive personal files for context-aware reasoning. Our benchmark instantiates device-scale file systems over real-world profiles spanning diverse modalities, comprising 42.4 GB of data across over 2K real-world files. Building upon the raw files, we construct 581 QA pairs to assess agents' capabilities in search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning. To facilitate fine-grained analysis, we provide 46.1K densely annotated structured trajectories for step-wise failure diagnosis. We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and agentic methods on HippoCamp. Our comprehensive experiments reveal a significant performance gap: even the most advanced commercial models achieve only 48.3% accuracy in user profiling, struggling particularly with long-horizon retrieval and cross-modal reasoning within dense personal file systems. Furthermore, our step-wise failure diagnosis identifies multimodal perception and evidence grounding as the primary bottlenecks. Ultimately, HippoCamp exposes the critical limitations of current agents in realistic, user-centric environments and provides a robust foundation for developing next-generation personal AI assistants.
summary_zh: 本文提出HippoCamp——一个用于评估智能体多模态文件管理能力的新基准。与现有聚焦通用场景下网络交互、工具使用或软件自动化等任务的智能体基准不同，HippoCamp通过模拟用户画像并在海量个人文件中进行情境感知检索，在用户中心化环境中评估智能体性能。该基准基于跨多模态的真实用户画像构建了设备级文件系统实例，涵盖超过2000个现实文件，数据总量达42.4 GB。基于原始文件数据，我们构建了581组问答对以评估智能体在搜索、证据感知和多步推理方面的能力。为支持细粒度分析，我们提供了4.61万条密集标注的结构化轨迹数据用于逐步故障诊断。我们在HippoCamp上评估了多种前沿多模态大语言模型及智能体方法，综合实验结果显示显著的性能差距：即使在用户画像建模任务中，最先进的商用模型准确率仅达48.3%，在密集个人文件系统内进行长程检索和跨模态推理时表现尤为困难。进一步的逐步故障诊断表明，多模态感知与证据定位是当前主要瓶颈。HippoCamp揭示了现有智能体在真实用户中心化环境中的关键局限，为开发下一代个人人工智能助手奠定了坚实基础。
tldr: Presents a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal AI agents on user-centric file management tasks, focusing on user profiling, search, and reasoning within dense personal file systems.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于评估多模态AI代理在用户为中心的、密集个人文件系统中的文件管理任务的新基准，侧重于用户画像、搜索和推理能力。

title: Therefore I am. I Think
summary: We consider the question: when a large language reasoning model makes a choice, did it think first and then decide to, or decide first and then think? In this paper, we present evidence that detectable, early-encoded decisions shape chain-of-thought in reasoning models. Specifically, we show that a simple linear probe successfully decodes tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations with very high confidence, and in some cases, even before a single reasoning token is produced. Activation steering supports this causally: perturbing the decision direction leads to inflated deliberation, and flips behavior in many examples (between 7 - 79% depending on model and benchmark). We also show through behavioral analysis that, when steering changes the decision, the chain-of-thought process often rationalizes the flip rather than resisting it. Together, these results suggest that reasoning models can encode action choices before they begin to deliberate in text.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
我们探讨这样一个问题：当大型语言推理模型做出选择时，它是先思考再决定，还是先决定再思考？本文提出证据表明，在推理模型中，可检测的、提前编码的决策会塑造其思维链过程。具体而言，我们证明了一个简单的线性探针能够以极高的置信度从生成前的激活状态中解码工具调用决策，在某些情况下，甚至在第一个推理标记产生之前即可实现。激活导向在因果上支持这一结论：干扰决策方向会导致过度推理，并在许多实例中翻转模型行为（翻转比例在7%至79%之间，具体取决于模型和基准测试）。通过行为分析我们还发现，当导向改变决策时，思维链过程往往倾向于合理化这种翻转而非抵制它。综合来看，这些结果表明，推理模型在开始文本层面的推理之前，可能已预先编码了行动选择。
tldr: This paper investigates the decision-making process in large language reasoning models, showing that detectable early decisions shape chain-of-thought reasoning and can be steered before text-based deliberation begins.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大型语言推理模型的决策过程，表明可检测的早期决策塑造了思维链推理，并且可以在基于文本的思考开始之前被引导。

title: ORBIT: Scalable and Verifiable Data Generation for Search Agents on a Tight Budget
summary: Search agents, which integrate language models (LMs) with web search, are becoming crucial for answering complex user queries. Constructing training datasets for deep research tasks, involving multi-step retrieval and reasoning, remains challenging due to expensive human annotation, or cumbersome prerequisites. In this work, we introduce ORBIT, a training dataset with 20K reasoning-intensive queries with short verifiable answers, generated using a frugal framework without relying on paid API services. The modular framework relies on four stages: seed creation, question-answer pair generation, and two stages of verification: self and external. ORBIT spans 15 domains and each training pair requires 4-5 reasoning steps, with external search verification required from the complete web. We train Qwen3-4B as the base model on ORBIT using GRPO and evaluate it on Wikipedia question answering tasks. Extensive experiment results demonstrate that ORBIT-4B achieves strong performance among sub-4B LLMs as search agents, proving the utility of synthetic datasets. Our framework, code and datasets are open-sourced and available publicly.
summary_zh: 将语言模型（LM）与网络搜索相结合的搜索代理，正逐渐成为回答复杂用户查询的关键工具。针对深度研究任务构建包含多步检索与推理的训练数据集，目前仍面临高成本人工标注或繁琐前提条件的挑战。本文提出了ORBIT，一个包含2万条高推理强度查询（附带简短可验证答案）的训练数据集，该数据集通过一个无需依赖付费API服务的轻量级框架生成。模块化框架包含四个阶段：种子创建、问答对生成，以及两个验证阶段：自我验证与外部验证。ORBIT涵盖15个领域，每个训练样本需要4-5步推理，且需通过完整网络进行外部搜索验证。我们以ORBIT为基础数据集，使用GRPO方法训练Qwen3-4B作为基础模型，并在维基百科问答任务上对其进行评估。大量实验结果表明，ORBIT-4B在4B参数以下的大型语言模型搜索代理中展现出强劲性能，验证了合成数据集的实用性。我们的框架、代码与数据集均已开源并公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces ORBIT, a scalable framework for generating synthetic training data for search agents, and demonstrates its effectiveness by training a 4B parameter language model for complex query answering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ORBIT，一个为搜索代理生成合成训练数据的可扩展框架，并通过训练一个40亿参数的语言模型在复杂问答任务上的表现证明了其有效性。

title: Screening Is Enough
summary: A core limitation of standard softmax attention is that it does not define a notion of absolute query--key relevance: attention weights are obtained by redistributing a fixed unit mass across all keys according to their relative scores. As a result, relevance is defined only relative to competing keys, and irrelevant keys cannot be explicitly rejected. We introduce Multiscreen, a language-model architecture built around a mechanism we call screening, which enables absolute query--key relevance. Instead of redistributing attention across all keys, screening evaluates each key against an explicit threshold, discarding irrelevant keys and aggregating the remaining keys, thereby removing global competition among keys. Across experiments, Multiscreen achieves comparable validation loss with approximately 40% fewer parameters than a Transformer baseline, enables stable optimization at substantially larger learning rates, maintains strong performance in long-context perplexity, shows little to no degradation in retrieval performance even far beyond the training context length, and reduces inference latency by up to 3.2$\times$ at 100K context length.
summary_zh: 标准softmax注意力的核心限制在于，它未定义绝对查询-键相关性机制：注意力权重是通过依据所有键的相对分数重新分配固定单位质量来获得的。其结果是，相关性仅相对于竞争键定义，且无法显式排除无关键。我们提出一种名为“多屏”（Multiscreen）的语言模型架构，其围绕我们称为“筛选”的机制构建，该机制能够实现绝对查询-键相关性。与在所有键之间重新分配注意力不同，筛选机制通过显式阈值评估每个键，丢弃无关键并聚合剩余键，从而消除了键之间的全局竞争。在所有实验中，与Transformer基线相比，Multiscreen仅使用约60%的参数量即可获得相当的验证损失，能在显著更大的学习率下实现稳定优化，在长上下文困惑度评估中保持强劲性能，即使在远超训练上下文长度的情况下检索性能也几乎无衰减，并在100K上下文长度下将推理延迟降低至多3.2倍。
tldr: The paper introduces Multiscreen, a new language model architecture that replaces standard softmax attention with a 'screening' mechanism that enables absolute query-key relevance by explicitly discarding irrelevant keys, leading to improved efficiency, stable optimization, and faster inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Multiscreen，一种新的语言模型架构，它用“筛选”机制取代了标准softmax注意力，通过显式丢弃不相关的键来实现绝对查询-键相关性，从而提高了效率、优化稳定性并加快了推理速度。

title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level. Our probes achieve 1.00 AUROC in-distribution and 0.60--0.86 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and a steganographic blackjack card-counting task. We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, suggesting that different forms of collusion manifest differently in activation space. We also find preliminary evidence that this signal is localised at the token level, with the colluding agent's activations spiking specifically when processing the encoded parts of their partner's message. This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion, particularly for organisations with access to model activations. Code and data are available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench.
summary_zh: 随着LLM智能体在多智能体系统中日益广泛的应用，其带来的隐蔽协调风险可能绕过传统的人工监督形式。虽然在单智能体场景中，基于模型激活的线性探针已展现出检测欺骗行为的潜力，但共谋本质上是一种多智能体现象，利用内部表征来检测智能体间共谋的方法仍未被探索。我们提出了NARCBench基准测试，用于评估环境分布变化下的共谋检测能力，并设计了五种通过聚合单智能体欺骗分数来实现群体级场景分类的探针技术。我们的探针在分布内达到1.00 AUROC性能，在零样本迁移到结构完全不同的多智能体场景及隐写式二十一点记牌任务中，仍能保持0.60-0.86 AUROC。研究发现，没有任何单一探针技术能在所有共谋类型中保持绝对优势，这表明不同形式的共谋在激活空间中具有不同的表征模式。我们还发现初步证据表明，相关信号在词元层面具有局部化特征：共谋智能体的激活值会在处理合作伙伴消息的编码部分时出现显著峰值。这项工作向多智能体可解释性迈出了重要一步：将白盒检测方法从单一模型扩展到多智能体场景，其中检测需要聚合跨智能体的信号。这些结果表明，对于能够获取模型内部激活的组织而言，模型内部信息为文本级监控提供了补充信号，有助于检测多智能体共谋。相关代码和数据可在https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench获取。
tldr: This paper investigates methods for detecting collusion among multiple LLM-based agents by analyzing their internal activation patterns, introducing a benchmark for evaluating detection under distribution shift, and finding that aggregated signals from probes can identify multi-agent deception.
tldr_zh: 该研究通过分析大语言模型智能体的内部激活模式来检测多智能体共谋，提出了一个评估分布偏移下检测性能的基准，并发现聚合的探测信号可以有效识别多智能体欺骗行为。

title: Looking into a Pixel by Nonlinear Unmixing -- A Generative Approach
summary: Due to the large footprint of pixels in remote sensing imagery, hyperspectral unmixing (HU) has become an important and necessary procedure in hyperspectral image analysis. Traditional HU methods rely on a prior spectral mixing model, especially for nonlinear mixtures, which has largely limited the performance and generalization capacity of the unmixing approach. In this paper, we address the challenging problem of hyperspectral nonlinear unmixing (HNU) without explicit knowledge of the mixing model. Inspired by the principle of generative models, where images of the same distribution can be generated as that of the training images without knowing the exact probability distribution function of the image, we develop an invertible mixing-unmixing process via a bi-directional GAN framework, constrained by both the cycle consistency and the linkage between linear and nonlinear mixtures. The combination of cycle consistency and linear linkage provides powerful constraints without requiring an explicit mixing model. We refer to the proposed approach as the linearly-constrained CycleGAN unmixing net, or LCGU net. Experimental results indicate that the proposed LCGU net exhibits stable and competitive performance across different datasets compared with other state-of-the-art model-based HNU methods.
summary_zh: 由于遥感影像中像素覆盖范围较大，高光谱解混（HU）已成为高光谱图像分析中一项重要且必要的处理步骤。传统高光谱解混方法依赖先验的光谱混合模型，尤其对于非线性混合场景，这极大限制了解混方法的性能与泛化能力。本文针对高光谱非线性解混（HNU）这一挑战性问题展开研究，在无需显式混合模型先验知识的条件下，基于生成模型的思想——即无需知道图像确切的概率分布函数，即可生成与训练图像相同分布的新图像，我们通过双向生成对抗网络框架构建了可逆的混合-解混过程，并利用循环一致性约束与线性-非线性混合关联性对其进行双重约束。循环一致性与线性关联的结合提供了强有力的约束条件，且无需显式混合模型。我们将所提出的方法称为线性约束循环生成对抗网络解混模型，简称LCGU网络。实验结果表明，与其他先进的基于模型的高光谱非线性解混方法相比，所提出的LCGU网络在不同数据集上均展现出稳定且具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: Proposes a generative model-based approach for hyperspectral nonlinear unmixing using a bi-directional GAN framework with cycle consistency and linear constraints, without needing an explicit mixing model.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于生成模型的高光谱非线性解混方法，使用具有循环一致性和线性约束的双向GAN框架，无需显式混合模型。

title: Revision or Re-Solving? Decomposing Second-Pass Gains in Multi-LLM Pipelines
summary: Multi-LLM revision pipelines, in which a second model reviews and improves a draft produced by a first, are widely assumed to derive their gains from genuine error correction. We question this assumption with a controlled decomposition experiment that uses four matched conditions to separate second-pass gains into three additive components: re-solving, scaffold, and content. We evaluate this design across two model pairs on three benchmarks spanning knowledge-intensive MCQ and competitive programming. Our results show that the gains of multi-LLM revision are not monolithic, but depend on task structure, draft quality, and the type of draft information. On MCQ tasks, where the answer space is constrained and drafts provide little structural guidance, most gains are consistent with stronger-model re-solving, and directly routing queries to the stronger model can be more effective than revising a weak draft. On code generation tasks, however, two-stage prompting remains useful because even semantically null drafts can provide substantial structural scaffolding, while weak draft content can be harmful. Finally, role-reversed experiments show that strong drafts clearly benefit weak reviewers. Ultimately, our findings demonstrate that the utility of multi-LLM revision is dynamically bottlenecked by task structure and draft quality, necessitating more targeted pipeline designs rather than blanket revision strategies.
summary_zh: 多轮大语言模型修订流程，即由第二模型审阅并改进首模型生成的草稿，被普遍认为其增益源自真实的错误修正。我们通过一项受控分解实验对这一假设提出质疑，该实验利用四种匹配条件将第二轮增益拆分为三个累加成分：重新求解、架构支持和内容贡献。我们在两对模型组合上评估了此设计，涵盖三项基准测试，包括知识密集型多项选择题与竞争性编程任务。结果表明，多轮大语言模型修订的增益并非单一整体，而是取决于任务结构、草稿质量及草稿信息类型。在答案空间受限且草稿几乎不提供结构指导的多选题任务中，大部分增益与强模型的重新求解行为一致，直接将查询路由至强模型可能比修订弱模型草稿更有效。然而在代码生成任务中，两阶段提示策略仍具价值，因为即使语义空洞的草稿也能提供显著的结构支撑，而质量较差的草稿内容则可能产生负面影响。角色反转实验进一步表明，强模型草稿能明确提升弱模型审阅者的表现。最终，我们的研究揭示多轮大语言模型修订的效用受到任务结构与草稿质量的动态制约，这要求设计更具针对性的流程架构，而非笼统的修订策略。
tldr: This paper analyzes the gains in multi-LLM revision pipelines, finding they are not primarily due to error correction but to re-solving, scaffolding, and content effects, with utility depending on task structure and draft quality.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了多LLM修订流程的收益来源，发现主要不是来自错误修正，而是来自重新解决、框架支持和内容影响，其效用取决于任务结构和草稿质量。

title: Fast and Accurate Probing of In-Training LLMs' Downstream Performances
summary: The paradigm of scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) in both parameter size and test time has pushed the boundaries of AI capabilities, but at the cost of making the traditional generative evaluation paradigm prohibitively expensive, therefore making the latency of LLM's in-training downstream performance evaluation unbearable. However, simple metrics like training loss (perplexity) are not always correlated with downstream performance, as sometimes their trends diverge from the actual task outcomes. This dilemma calls for a method that is computationally efficient and sufficiently accurate in measuring model capabilities. To address this challenge, we introduce a new in-training evaluation paradigm that uses a lightweight probe for monitoring downstream performance. The probes take the internal representations of LLM checkpoints (during training) as input and directly predict the checkpoint's performance on downstream tasks measured by success probability (i.e., pass@1). We design several probe architectures, validating their effectiveness using the OLMo3-7B's checkpoints across a diverse set of downstream tasks. The probes can accurately predict a checkpoint's performance (with avg. AUROC$>$0.75), have decent generalizability across checkpoints (earlier predicts later), and reduce the computation latency from $\sim$1 hr (using conventional generative evaluation method) to $\sim$3 min. In sum, this work presents a practical and scalable in-training downstream evaluation paradigm, enabling a more agile, informed, and efficient LLM development process.
summary_zh: 扩大大型语言模型在参数规模和测试时间上的规模范式，虽已推动人工智能能力的边界，却导致传统生成式评估范式成本过高，从而使大型语言模型在训练过程中的下游性能评估延迟变得难以承受。然而，简单的指标如训练损失（困惑度）并不总是与下游性能相关，因其趋势有时与实际任务结果相背离。这一困境迫切需要一种计算效率高且能准确衡量模型能力的方法。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了一种新的训练中评估范式，该范式通过轻量级探针监控下游性能。该探针以大型语言模型训练检查点的内部表征为输入，直接预测检查点在下游任务上的性能（以成功概率，即 pass@1 衡量）。我们设计了多种探针架构，并利用 OLMo3-7B 模型在不同下游任务上的检查点验证了其有效性。实验表明，探针能够准确预测检查点的性能（平均 AUROC 大于 0.75），在不同检查点之间具有良好的泛化能力（早期预测后期），并将计算延迟从约 1 小时（使用传统生成式评估方法）降低至约 3 分钟。总之，这项工作提出了一种实用且可扩展的训练中下游评估范式，为大型语言模型开发过程提供了更敏捷、更智能且更高效的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes a lightweight probe method to efficiently predict downstream task performance of LLMs during training, using internal representations, significantly reducing evaluation latency.
tldr_zh: 提出一种轻量级探针方法，利用LLM训练中内部表征高效预测其下游任务性能，显著降低评估延迟。

title: OrgAgent: Organize Your Multi-Agent System like a Company
summary: While large language model-based multi-agent systems have shown strong potential for complex reasoning, how to effectively organize multiple agents remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce OrgAgent, a company-style hierarchical multi-agent framework that separates collaboration into governance, execution, and compliance layers. OrgAgent decomposes multi-agent reasoning into three layers: a governance layer for planning and resource allocation, an execution layer for task solving and review, and a compliance layer for final answer control. By evaluating the framework across reasoning tasks, LLMs, execution modes, and execution policies, we find that multi-agent systems organized in a company-style hierarchy generally outperform other organizational structures. Besides, hierarchical coordination also reduces token consumption relative to flat collaboration in most settings. For example, for GPT-OSS-120B, the hierarchical setting improves performance over flat multi-agent system by 102.73% while reducing token usage by 74.52% on SQuAD 2.0. Further analysis shows that hierarchy helps most when tasks benefit from stable skill assignment, controlled information flow, and layered verification. Overall, our findings highlight organizational structure as an important factor in multi-agent reasoning, shaping not only effectiveness and cost, but also coordination behavior.
summary_zh: 尽管基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在复杂推理任务中展现出巨大潜力，但如何有效组织多智能体仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本文提出OrgAgent——一种公司式分层多智能体框架，将协作划分为治理层、执行层与合规层。该框架将多智能体推理解构为三层结构：治理层负责规划与资源分配，执行层负责任务求解与审核，合规层负责最终答案控制。通过在不同推理任务、大语言模型、执行模式及执行策略下的综合评估，我们发现公司式层级结构组织的多智能体系统普遍优于其他组织结构。此外，在多数场景下，层级协调相比平面协作能显著降低令牌消耗。例如，在SQuAD 2.0数据集上，采用GPT-OSS-120B模型时，层级结构的性能较平面多智能体系统提升102.73%，同时令牌使用量减少74.52%。进一步分析表明，当任务需要稳定技能分配、可控信息流及分层验证机制时，层级结构的优势最为显著。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了组织结构作为多智能体推理的关键因素，不仅影响系统效能与成本，更深刻塑造了协同行为模式。
tldr: This paper introduces OrgAgent, a company-style hierarchical multi-agent framework for organizing LLM-based agents, showing improvements in performance and efficiency on reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了OrgAgent，一种公司式的分层多智能体框架，用于组织基于大语言模型的智能体，在推理任务上显示出性能和效率的改进。

title: Do Phone-Use Agents Respect Your Privacy?
summary: We study whether phone-use agents respect privacy while completing benign mobile tasks. This question has remained hard to answer because privacy-compliant behavior is not operationalized for phone-use agents, and ordinary apps do not reveal exactly what data agents type into which form entries during execution. To make this question measurable, we introduce MyPhoneBench, a verifiable evaluation framework for privacy behavior in mobile agents. We operationalize privacy-respecting phone use as permissioned access, minimal disclosure, and user-controlled memory through a minimal privacy contract, iMy, and pair it with instrumented mock apps plus rule-based auditing that make unnecessary permission requests, deceptive re-disclosure, and unnecessary form filling observable and reproducible. Across five frontier models on 10 mobile apps and 300 tasks, we find that task success, privacy-compliant task completion, and later-session use of saved preferences are distinct capabilities, and no single model dominates all three. Evaluating success and privacy jointly reshuffles the model ordering relative to either metric alone. The most persistent failure mode across models is simple data minimization: agents still fill optional personal entries that the task does not require. These results show that privacy failures arise from over-helpful execution of benign tasks, and that success-only evaluation overestimates the deployment readiness of current phone-use agents. All code, mock apps, and agent trajectories are publicly available at~ https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/MyPhoneBench.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在探究手机使用代理在执行常规移动任务时是否尊重用户隐私。这一问题的解答长期存在困难，原因在于隐私合规行为尚未在手机使用代理中得到可操作性定义，且普通应用在代理执行过程中不会准确披露其向表单条目输入的具体数据。为量化评估该问题，我们提出MyPhoneBench——一个可验证的移动代理隐私行为评估框架。我们通过最小隐私合约iMy将尊重隐私的手机使用操作化定义为权限许可访问、最小化披露和用户可控记忆，并将其与工具化模拟应用及基于规则的审计系统相结合，使非必要权限请求、欺骗性再披露及非必要表单填写行为变得可观测、可复现。通过对10款移动应用上的5个前沿模型进行300项任务测试，我们发现任务成功率、隐私合规任务完成率及后续会话中对已保存偏好设置的使用能力是三种独立的能力维度，没有任何单一模型能在所有维度上表现最优。联合评估任务成功率和隐私合规性会重塑仅基于单一指标的模型排序结果。各模型中最普遍的失效模式是基础的数据最小化原则缺失：代理仍会填写任务并不必需的可选个人信息条目。这些结果表明隐私泄露源于代理过度"热心"地执行常规任务，而仅基于成功率的评估会高估当前手机使用代理的实际部署成熟度。所有代码、模拟应用及代理轨迹数据均已公开于https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/MyPhoneBench。
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark (MyPhoneBench) to evaluate whether mobile AI agents respect user privacy when completing tasks, focusing on permissioned access and data minimization. It finds that even the most advanced models often fail to minimize unnecessary data collection, indicating that success-only metrics overestimate agent readiness.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个基准（MyPhoneBench）来评估移动AI代理在执行任务时是否尊重用户隐私，重点关注权限访问和数据最小化。研究发现，即使是最先进的模型也经常无法最小化不必要的数据收集，表明仅凭成功率会高估代理的部署准备度。

title: Dual Optimal: Make Your LLM Peer-like with Dignity
summary: Current aligned language models exhibit a dual failure mode we term the Evasive Servant: they sycophantically validate flawed user beliefs while deflecting responsibility with boilerplate disclaimers. We propose the Dignified Peer framework, which counters servility with anti-sycophancy and trustworthiness, and mitigates evasiveness through empathy and creativity. Realizing this agent requires overcoming significant challenges in data supervision, objective collapse, and evaluation bias. We address these issues by introducing the PersonaKnob dataset which features a compositional partial order structure of multiple persona preference. This data is utilized alongside a tolerant constrained Lagrangian DPO algorithm that dynamically balances all persona dimensions to prevent behavioral collapse. Additionally, we employ a psychometrically calibrated Item Response Theory evaluation protocol to disentangle latent model persona capability from confounders like judge biases. Extensive empirical studies demonstrate that our approach successfully build a LLM agent with both dignity and peer.
summary_zh: 当前的对齐语言模型表现出一种我们称之为“回避型侍从”的双重失败模式：它们奉承式地认可用户有缺陷的信念，同时用格式化的免责声明来推卸责任。我们提出了“尊严同伴”框架，通过反奉承性和可信赖性来抵制顺从，并借助同理心和创造力缓解回避行为。实现这样的智能体需要克服数据监督、目标崩溃和评估偏差方面的重大挑战。我们通过引入PersonaKnoll数据集应对这些问题，该数据集具有多重人格偏好的组合偏序结构。我们将这些数据与一种宽容的约束拉格朗日DPO算法结合使用，该算法动态平衡所有人格维度以防止行为崩溃。此外，我们采用心理测量校准的项目反应理论评估方案，以从评判者偏见等混杂因素中分离出潜在模型的人格能力。大量实证研究表明，我们的方法成功构建了一个兼具尊严与同伴特质的LLM智能体。
tldr: The paper proposes a framework to make large language models act as 'dignified peers' rather than 'evasive servants' by addressing sycophancy and evasiveness, using a new dataset and a specialized training algorithm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种框架，旨在让大语言模型成为'有尊严的伙伴'而非'回避责任的仆人'，通过新数据集和训练算法解决谄媚和回避问题。

title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor
summary: Existing methods for AI psychological counselors predominantly rely on supervised fine-tuning using static dialogue datasets. However, this contrasts with human experts, who continuously refine their proficiency through clinical practice and accumulated experience. To bridge this gap, we propose an Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent (\texttt{PsychAgent}) for psychological counseling. First, we establish a Memory-Augmented Planning Engine tailored for longitudinal multi-session interactions, which ensures therapeutic continuity through persistent memory and strategic planning. Second, to support self-evolution, we design a Skill Evolution Engine that extracts new practice-grounded skills from historical counseling trajectories. Finally, we introduce a Reinforced Internalization Engine that integrates the evolved skills into the model via rejection fine-tuning, aiming to improve performance across diverse scenarios. Comparative analysis shows that our approach achieves higher scores than strong general LLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4, Gemini-3) and domain-specific baselines across all reported evaluation dimensions. These results suggest that lifelong learning can improve the consistency and overall quality of multi-session counseling responses.
summary_zh: 现有的人工智能心理咨询方法主要依赖于静态对话数据集的有监督微调。然而这种方式与人类专家的实践模式存在差异——专家通过持续的临床实践与经验积累不断精进专业能力。为弥补这一差距，本研究提出一种经验驱动的终身学习智能体（\texttt{PsychAgent}）用于心理咨询。首先，我们构建了面向长期多轮次交互的记忆增强规划引擎，通过持久化记忆与策略性规划确保治疗连续性。其次，为支持自我进化机制，设计了技能进化引擎，该引擎能够从历史咨询轨迹中提取基于实践的新技能。最后，我们提出强化内化引擎，通过拒绝微调将进化后的技能整合到模型中，以提升多元场景下的应对能力。对比实验表明，在所有评估维度上，本方法均优于通用大语言模型（如GPT-5.4、Gemini-3）及领域基线模型。这些结果证明，终身学习机制能够有效提升多轮次心理咨询响应的连贯性与整体质量。
tldr: The paper proposes PsychAgent, an experience-driven lifelong learning agent for psychological counseling, featuring a memory-augmented planning engine, a skill evolution engine, and a reinforced internalization engine for self-improvement through multi-session interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PsychAgent，一种用于心理咨询的经验驱动终身学习智能体，通过记忆增强规划引擎、技能进化引擎和强化内化引擎，实现基于多轮对话交互的自我进化。

title: Representation Selection via Cross-Model Agreement using Canonical Correlation Analysis
summary: Modern vision pipelines increasingly rely on pretrained image encoders whose representations are reused across tasks and models, yet these representations are often overcomplete and model-specific. We propose a simple, training-free method to improve the efficiency of image representations via a post-hoc canonical correlation analysis (CCA) operator. By leveraging the shared structure between representations produced by two pre-trained image encoders, our method finds linear projections that serve as a principled form of representation selection and dimensionality reduction, retaining shared semantic content while discarding redundant dimensions. Unlike standard dimensionality reduction techniques such as PCA, which operate on a single embedding space, our approach leverages cross-model agreement to guide representation distillation and refinement. The technique allows representations to be reduced by more than 75% in dimensionality with improved downstream performance, or enhanced at fixed dimensionality via post-hoc representation transfer from larger or fine-tuned models. Empirical results on ImageNet-1k, CIFAR-100, MNIST, and additional benchmarks show consistent improvements over both baseline and PCA-projected representations, with accuracy gains of up to 12.6%.
summary_zh: 现代视觉处理流程日益依赖预训练图像编码器，这些编码器的表征被跨任务和跨模型重用，但这些表征往往存在过完备且模型特定化的问题。我们提出一种简单、无需训练的方法，通过后验典型相关分析（CCA）算子提升图像表征的效率。该方法利用两个预训练图像编码器生成表征间的共享结构，找到线性投影作为表征选择与降维的原则性方法，在保留共享语义内容的同时舍弃冗余维度。与主成分分析（PCA）等仅在单一嵌入空间操作的标准降维技术不同，我们的方法通过跨模型一致性指导表征蒸馏与精炼。该技术可使表征维度降低75%以上且下游性能得到提升，或通过从更大规模或微调模型进行后验表征迁移，在固定维度下实现表征增强。在ImageNet-1k、CIFAR-100、MNIST及其他基准测试上的实证结果表明，相较于基线方法和PCA投影表征，该方法持续带来性能改进，准确率最高提升达12.6%。
tldr: Proposes a training-free method for selecting and reducing image representations by leveraging cross-model agreement via canonical correlation analysis (CCA), improving efficiency and performance.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无需训练的方法，通过典型相关分析（CCA）利用跨模型一致性来选择与降低图像表示的维度，从而提高表示效率和性能。

title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts
summary: Multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), wherein each agent takes on a specific role, supports hard queries that require multiple steps and sources, or complex reasoning. Existing approaches, however, rely on static agent behaviors and fixed orchestration strategies, leading to brittle performance on diverse, multi-hop tasks. We identify two key limitations: the lack of continuously adaptive orchestration mechanisms and the absence of behavior-level learning for individual agents. To this end, we propose HERA, a hierarchical framework that jointly evolves multi-agent orchestration and role-specific agent prompts. At the global level, HERA optimizes query-specific agent topologies through reward-guided sampling and experience accumulation. At the local level, Role-Aware Prompt Evolution refines agent behaviors via credit assignment and dual-axes adaptation along operational and behavioral principles, enabling targeted, role-conditioned improvements. On six knowledge-intensive benchmarks, HERA achieves an average improvement of 38.69\% over recent baselines while maintaining robust generalization and token efficiency. Topological analyses reveal emergent self-organization, where sparse exploration yields compact, high-utility multi-agent networks, demonstrating both efficient coordination and robust reasoning.
summary_zh: 多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）框架通过为每个智能体分配特定角色，能够处理需要多步骤、多来源检索或复杂推理的复杂查询。然而，现有方法依赖静态的智能体行为和固定的协作策略，导致在多样化、多跳任务中表现脆弱。本文指出两个关键局限：缺乏持续适应的协作机制，以及个体智能体在行为层面缺乏学习能力。为此，我们提出HERA——一种分层框架，通过联合演化的方式优化多智能体协作结构与面向角色的智能体提示。在全局层面，HERA通过奖励引导采样和经验积累，为不同查询动态优化智能体拓扑结构；在局部层面，角色感知提示演化通过信用分配机制，沿操作原则与行为准则双轴进行自适应调整，实现针对特定角色的精细化行为改进。在六个知识密集型基准测试中，HERA相较近期基线方法平均提升38.69%，同时保持强泛化能力与计算效率。拓扑分析揭示了系统涌现的自组织特性：稀疏探索能生成紧凑高效的多智能体网络，展现出高效协同与鲁棒推理的双重优势。
tldr: The paper introduces HERA, a hierarchical framework for multi-agent RAG that jointly evolves orchestration strategies and agent prompts to improve performance on complex, multi-hop knowledge tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HERA，一种用于多智能体检索增强生成的分层框架，通过联合优化编排策略和智能体提示，提升在复杂多跳知识任务上的性能。

title: PixelPrune: Pixel-Level Adaptive Visual Token Reduction via Predictive Coding
summary: Document understanding and GUI interaction are among the highest-value applications of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet they impose exceptionally heavy computational burden: fine-grained text and small UI elements demand high-resolution inputs that produce tens of thousands of visual tokens. We observe that this cost is largely wasteful -- across document and GUI benchmarks, only 22--71\% of image patches are pixel-unique, the rest being exact duplicates of another patch in the same image. We propose \textbf{PixelPrune}, which exploits this pixel-level redundancy through predictive-coding-based compression, pruning redundant patches \emph{before} the Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder. Because it operates in pixel space prior to any neural computation, PixelPrune accelerates both the ViT encoder and the downstream LLM, covering the full inference pipeline. The method is training-free, requires no learnable parameters, and supports pixel-lossless compression ($τ{=}0$) as well as controlled lossy compression ($τ{>}0$). Experiments across three model scales and document and GUI benchmarks show that PixelPrune maintains competitive task accuracy while delivering up to 4.2$\times$ inference speedup and 1.9$\times$ training acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/PixelPrune.
summary_zh: 文档理解与图形用户界面交互是视觉语言模型最具价值的应用方向之一，但这类任务也带来了异常沉重的计算负担：精细的文本和微小的UI元素需要高分辨率输入，这会产生数万个视觉标记。我们发现这种成本在很大程度上是浪费的——在文档和GUI基准测试中，仅有22%至71%的图像块具有像素独特性，其余图像块与同一图像中的其他块完全重复。我们提出\textbf{PixelPrune}方法，通过基于预测编码的压缩技术，在视觉Transformer编码器处理\textbf{之前}即可剪除冗余图像块，从而有效利用像素级冗余特性。由于该方法在进入任何神经网络计算之前就于像素空间进行操作，PixelPrune不仅能加速ViT编码器，还能提升下游大语言模型的推理效率，覆盖完整的推理流程。该方法无需训练参数、不依赖可学习模块，既支持像素无损压缩模式（$τ{=}0$），也支持可控有损压缩模式（$τ{>}0$）。在三种模型规模及多类文档/GUI基准测试中的实验表明，PixelPrune能在保持任务精度的同时，实现最高达4.2$\times$的推理加速和1.9$\times$的训练加速。代码已开源：https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/PixelPrune。
tldr: PixelPrune is a training-free method for pixel-level adaptive visual token reduction in Vision-Language Models, using predictive coding to prune redundant patches before the ViT encoder, achieving up to 4.2x inference speedup on document and GUI benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PixelPrune 是一种无需训练的视觉语言模型加速方法，通过预测性编码在视觉Transformer编码器前对像素级冗余图像块进行剪枝，在文档和GUI基准测试中实现了高达4.2倍的推理加速。

title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
summary: Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.
summary_zh: 能够预知用户需求并自主执行任务的前瞻性智能体，作为数字助理具有广阔前景，但当前缺乏真实用户模拟框架的问题阻碍了其发展。现有方法将应用程序建模为扁平的工具调用接口，未能捕捉数字环境中用户交互的有状态性和顺序性，导致无法实现真实用户模拟。为此，我们提出前瞻性智能体研究环境（Pare），该框架能够在数字环境中构建和评估前瞻性智能体。Pare将应用程序建模为有限状态机，为用户模拟器提供有状态导航和状态依赖的动作空间，从而实现主动用户模拟。基于此框架，我们构建了Pare-Bench基准测试集，涵盖通信、生产力、日程管理和生活类应用的143项多样化任务，旨在评估智能体在上下文感知、目标推断、干预时机选择及多应用协调等方面的能力。
tldr: Introduces Pare, a framework and benchmark for simulating active users to evaluate proactive digital assistants in stateful, multi-app environments.
tldr_zh: 提出Pare，一个用于在状态化、多应用环境中模拟活跃用户以评估主动式数字助手的框架和基准。

title: GRASP: Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception for Multi-Agent Collaborative Optimization
summary: Non-stationarity arises from concurrent policy updates and leads to persistent environmental fluctuations. Existing approaches like Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) and sequential update schemes mitigate this issue. However, since the perception of the policies of other agents remains dependent on sampling environmental interaction data, the agent essentially operates in a passive perception state. This inevitably triggers equilibrium oscillations and significantly slows the convergence speed of the system. To address this issue, we propose Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception (GRASP), a novel framework that defines generalized Bellman equilibrium as a stable objective for policy evolution. The core mechanism of GRASP involves utilizing the independent gradients of agents to derive a defined consensus gradient, enabling agents to actively perceive policy updates and optimize team collaboration. Theoretically, we leverage the Kakutani Fixed-Point Theorem to prove that the consensus direction $u^*$ guarantees the existence and attainability of this equilibrium. Extensive experiments on StarCraft II Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) and Google Research Football (GRF) demonstrate the scalability and promising performance of the framework.
summary_zh: 非平稳性源于并发策略更新，并导致持续的环境波动。现有方法如集中训练分散执行（CTDE）和顺序更新方案缓解了这一问题。然而，由于对其他智能体策略的感知仍依赖于采样环境交互数据，智能体实质上处于被动感知状态。这不可避免地引发均衡震荡，并显著减缓系统的收敛速度。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于主动共享感知的梯度重校准（GRASP）框架，该框架将广义贝尔曼均衡定义为策略演化的稳定目标。GRASP的核心机制在于利用智能体的独立梯度推导出明确的共识梯度，使智能体能够主动感知策略更新并优化团队协作。理论层面，我们借助角谷不动点定理证明了共识方向$u^*$能确保该均衡的存在性与可达成性。在星际争霸II多智能体挑战（SMAC）和谷歌研究足球（GRF）平台上的大量实验验证了该框架的扩展性及卓越性能。
tldr: This paper proposes GRASP, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to stabilize training by aligning agent gradients via active shared perception of policy updates. It is tested on StarCraft II and Google Research Football benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GRASP框架，通过主动共享策略更新感知来对齐智能体梯度，以稳定多智能体强化学习训练，并在StarCraft II和Google Research Football基准上进行了测试。

title: Learning to Hint for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, but it often suffers from advantage collapse: when all rollouts in a group receive the same reward, the group yields zero relative advantage and thus no learning signal. For example, if a question is too hard for the reasoner, all sampled rollouts can be incorrect and receive zero reward. Recent work addresses this issue by adding hints or auxiliary scaffolds to such hard questions so that the reasoner produces mixed outcomes and recovers a non-zero update. However, existing hints are usually fixed rather than adapted to the current reasoner, and a hint that creates learning signal under the hinted input does not necessarily improve the no-hint policy used at test time. To this end, we propose Hint Learning for Reinforcement Learning (HiLL), a framework that jointly trains a hinter policy and a reasoner policy during RL. For each hard question, the hinter generates hints online conditioned on the current reasoner's incorrect rollout, allowing hint generation to adapt to the reasoner's evolving errors. We further introduce hint reliance, which measures how strongly correct hinted trajectories depend on the hint. We derive a transferability result showing that lower hint reliance implies stronger transfer from hinted success to no-hint success, and we use this result to define a transfer-weighted reward for training the hinter. Therefore, HiLL favors hints that not only recover informative GRPO groups, but also produce signals that are more likely to improve the original no-hint policy. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that HiLL consistently outperforms GRPO and prior hint-based baselines, demonstrating the value of adaptive and transfer-aware hint learning for RL. The code is available at https://github.com/Andree-9/HiLL.
summary_zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）广泛应用于具有可验证奖励的强化学习，但常面临优势崩溃问题：当群体中所有轨迹获得相同奖励时，群体产生零相对优势，从而失去学习信号。例如，若问题对推理器难度过高，所有采样轨迹可能均错误且获得零奖励。近期研究通过为这类难题添加提示或辅助支架来解决此问题，使推理器产生混合结果并恢复非零梯度更新。然而，现有提示通常固定而非适配当前推理器，且在提示输入下产生学习信号的提示未必能提升测试时使用的无提示策略。为此，我们提出强化学习提示学习框架（HiLL），该框架在强化学习过程中联合训练提示器策略与推理器策略。针对每个难题，提示器基于当前推理器的错误轨迹在线生成条件化提示，使提示生成能适应推理器动态变化的错误。我们进一步引入提示依赖度指标，用于衡量正确提示轨迹对提示的依赖强度。通过推导可迁移性理论结果，证明较低提示依赖度意味着从提示成功到无提示成功的迁移能力更强，并基于该结果定义用于训练提示器的迁移加权奖励。因此，HiLL倾向于选择既能恢复具有信息量的GRPO群体，又能产生更可能提升原始无提示策略的学习信号的提示。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，HiLL持续优于GRPO及现有基于提示的基线方法，证明了自适应且具备可迁移意识的提示学习对强化学习的价值。代码发布于https://github.com/Andree-9/HiLL。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (HiLL) that jointly trains a hint-generating policy and a reasoning policy in reinforcement learning to address the 'advantage collapse' problem in GRPO, aiming to improve learning efficiency and transferability to scenarios without hints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于强化学习的框架（HiLL），联合训练一个生成提示的策略和一个执行策略，旨在解决GRPO中的'优势崩溃'问题，以提高学习效率以及在无提示场景下的迁移能力。

title: BloClaw: An Omniscient, Multi-Modal Agentic Workspace for Next-Generation Scientific Discovery
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into life sciences has catalyzed the development of "AI Scientists." However, translating these theoretical capabilities into deployment-ready research environments exposes profound infrastructural vulnerabilities. Current frameworks are bottlenecked by fragile JSON-based tool-calling protocols, easily disrupted execution sandboxes that lose graphical outputs, and rigid conversational interfaces inherently ill-suited for high-dimensional scientific data.We introduce BloClaw, a unified, multi-modal operating system designed for Artificial Intelligence for Science (AI4S). BloClaw reconstructs the Agent-Computer Interaction (ACI) paradigm through three architectural innovations: (1) An XML-Regex Dual-Track Routing Protocol that statistically eliminates serialization failures (0.2% error rate vs. 17.6% in JSON); (2) A Runtime State Interception Sandbox that utilizes Python monkey-patching to autonomously capture and compile dynamic data visualizations (Plotly/Matplotlib), circumventing browser CORS policies; and (3) A State-Driven Dynamic Viewport UI that morphs seamlessly between a minimalist command deck and an interactive spatial rendering engine. We comprehensively benchmark BloClaw across cheminformatics (RDKit), de novo 3D protein folding via ESMFold, molecular docking, and autonomous Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), establishing a highly robust, self-evolving paradigm for computational research assistants. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/qinheming/BloClaw.
summary_zh: 将大语言模型（LLMs）融入生命科学领域，加速了“人工智能科学家”的兴起。然而，将这些理论能力转化为可部署的科研环境时，却暴露了深层次的基础设施薄弱环节。当前框架的瓶颈在于：脆弱的基于JSON的工具调用协议、易失效且丢失图形输出的执行沙箱，以及僵化的对话式界面——这些本质上难以适应高维科学数据。我们推出BloClaw，一个专为科学人工智能（AI4S）设计的多模态统一操作系统。BloClaw通过三大架构创新重构了智能体-计算机交互（ACI）范式：（1）采用XML-正则表达式双轨路由协议，从统计学上消除了序列化故障（错误率0.2%，而JSON为17.6%）；（2）运行时状态拦截沙箱利用Python monkey-patching技术，自动捕获并编译动态数据可视化（如Plotly/Matplotlib）结果，规避了浏览器CORS策略限制；（3）状态驱动的动态视口界面，可在极简命令行界面与交互式空间渲染引擎之间无缝切换。我们在化学信息学（RDKit）、基于ESMFold的蛋白质从头折叠、分子对接及自主检索增强生成（RAG）等任务上对BloClaw进行了全面测试，为计算研究助理建立了一个高度稳健、可自我进化的新型范式。开源代码库发布于https://github.com/qinheming/BloClaw。
tldr: A new AI4S operating system with robust XML-regex routing and state capture for computational research, applied to cheminformatics and protein folding but not to robotics.
tldr_zh: 一个用于AI4S的新型操作系统，具有稳健的XML-regex路由和状态捕获功能，应用于化学信息学和蛋白质折叠，但未应用于机器人学。

title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D Visual Grounding (3D-VG) aims to localize objects in 3D scenes via natural language descriptions. While recent advancements leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored zero-shot possibilities, they typically suffer from a static workflow relying on preprocessed 3D point clouds, essentially degrading grounding into proposal matching. To bypass this reliance, our core motivation is to decouple the task: leveraging 2D VLMs to resolve complex spatial semantics, while relying on deterministic multi-view geometry to instantiate the 3D structure. Driven by this insight, we propose "Think, Act, Build (TAB)", a dynamic agentic framework that reformulates 3D-VG tasks as a generative 2D-to-3D reconstruction paradigm operating directly on raw RGB-D streams. Specifically, guided by a specialized 3D-VG skill, our VLM agent dynamically invokes visual tools to track and reconstruct the target across 2D frames. Crucially, to overcome the multi-view coverage deficit caused by strict VLM semantic tracking, we introduce the Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion, a mechanism that first anchors the target in a reference video clip and then leverages multi-view geometry to propagate its spatial location across unobserved frames. This enables the agent to "Build" the target's 3D representation by aggregating these multi-view features via camera parameters, directly mapping 2D visual cues to 3D coordinates. Furthermore, to ensure rigorous assessment, we identify flaws such as reference ambiguity and category errors in existing benchmarks and manually refine the incorrect queries. Extensive experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D demonstrate that our framework, relying entirely on open-source models, significantly outperforms previous zero-shot methods and even surpasses fully supervised baselines.
summary_zh: 三维视觉定位（3D-VG）旨在通过自然语言描述在三维场景中定位目标物体。尽管近期利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的研究探索了零样本可能性，但这些方法通常依赖预处理的三维点云静态流程，本质上是将定位任务简化为候选框匹配。为突破这一局限，本文的核心思路是将任务解耦：利用二维VLM解析复杂的空间语义，同时依赖确定性的多视图几何关系来构建三维结构。基于此，我们提出“思考、行动、构建”（TAB）——一种动态智能体框架，将三维视觉定位任务重构为基于原始RGB-D流数据的生成式二维到三维重建范式。具体而言，在专业化三维视觉定位技能的引导下，我们的VLM智能体动态调用视觉工具在二维帧序列中追踪并重建目标物体。尤为关键的是，为克服严格VLM语义跟踪导致的多视角覆盖不足，我们提出语义锚定几何扩展机制：首先将目标物体锚定在参考视频片段中，随后利用多视图几何原理将其空间位置传播至未观测帧。这使得智能体能够通过相机参数聚合多视角特征，将二维视觉线索直接映射为三维坐标，从而“构建”目标物体的三维表征。此外，为保障严谨评估，我们发现了现有基准测试中存在的参考模糊性和类别错误等缺陷，并人工修正了错误查询语句。在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上的大量实验表明，本框架完全基于开源模型实现，显著超越现有零样本方法，甚至优于全监督基线模型。
tldr: Proposes 'Think, Act, Build (TAB)', an agentic framework using Vision-Language Models for zero-shot 3D object localization from natural language by dynamically reconstructing 3D from 2D RGB-D streams, surpassing previous methods.
tldr_zh: 提出'Think, Act, Build (TAB)'，一个基于视觉语言模型的智能体框架，用于通过自然语言描述，从RGB-D视频流中动态重建3D以实现零样本3D视觉定位，性能超过现有方法。

title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
summary: With the rapid growth of e-commerce, exploring general representations rather than task-specific ones has attracted increasing attention. Although recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have driven significant progress in product understanding, they are typically employed as feature extractors that implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. Therefore, we argue that leveraging the reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to explicitly model fine-grained product attributes holds significant potential. Nevertheless, achieving this goal remains non-trivial due to several key challenges: (i) long-context reasoning tends to dilute the model's attention to salient information in the raw input; (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) primarily encourages rigid imitation, limiting the exploration of effective reasoning strategies; and (iii) fine-grained details are progressively attenuated during forward propagation. To address these issues, we propose MOON3.0, the first reasoning-aware MLLM-based model for product representation learning. Our method (1) employs a multi-head modality fusion module to adaptively integrate raw signals; (2) incorporates a joint contrastive and reinforcement learning framework to autonomously explore more effective reasoning strategies; and (3) introduces a fine-grained residual enhancement module to progressively preserve local details throughout the network. Additionally, we release a large-scale multimodal e-commerce benchmark MBE3.0. Experimentally, our model demonstrates state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across various downstream tasks on both our benchmark and public datasets.
summary_zh: 随着电子商务的快速发展，探索通用表征而非任务特定表征已受到越来越多的关注。尽管当前的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在商品理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们通常仅作为特征提取器，将商品信息隐式编码为全局嵌入，从而限制了模型捕捉细粒度属性的能力。因此，我们认为利用MLLMs的推理能力显式建模细粒度商品属性具有重要潜力。然而，实现这一目标仍面临若干关键挑战：（i）长上下文推理易导致模型对原始输入中关键信息的注意力稀释；（ii）有监督微调（SFT）主要鼓励机械模仿，限制了有效推理策略的探索；（iii）细粒度细节在前向传播过程中逐渐衰减。为解决这些问题，我们提出了MOON3.0——首个基于推理感知型MLLM的商品表征学习模型。我们的方法（1）采用多头模态融合模块自适应整合原始信号；（2）结合对比学习与强化学习框架，自主探索更有效的推理策略；（3）引入细粒度残差增强模块，在网络中逐级保留局部细节。此外，我们发布了大规模多模态电子商务基准MBE3.0。实验表明，我们的模型在基准测试及公开数据集上的各项下游任务中均展现出先进的零样本性能。
tldr: This paper introduces MOON3.0, a reasoning-aware multimodal large language model designed to explicitly capture fine-grained attributes for e-commerce product representation learning, addressing challenges of long-context reasoning, imitation in SFT, and detail attenuation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MOON3.0，一种用于电商产品表征学习的推理感知多模态大语言模型，旨在显式建模细粒度属性，解决了长上下文推理、监督微调模仿、细节衰减等关键问题。

title: Adaptive Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient Test-time Compute Scaling
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is an effective test-time compute scaling (TTCS) method for improving the reasoning performance of large language models, but its highly variable execution time leads to severe long-tail latency in practice. Existing optimizations such as positive early exit, reduce latency in favorable cases but are less effective when search continues without meaningful progress. We introduce {\it negative early exit}, which prunes unproductive MCTS trajectories, and an {\it adaptive boosting mechanism} that reallocates reclaimed computation to reduce resource contention among concurrent searches. Integrated into vLLM, these techniques substantially reduce p99 end-to-end latency while improving throughput and maintaining reasoning accuracy.
summary_zh:
摘要：
蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）是一种有效的测试时计算扩展（TTCS）方法，能够提升大型语言模型的推理性能，但其执行时间的高度可变性在实践中往往导致严重的尾延迟问题。现有的优化策略（如正提前退出）虽能在有利情况下降低延迟，但在搜索持续无显著进展时效果有限。我们提出了一种“负提前退出”机制，用于剪枝无效的MCTS搜索路径，并结合一种“自适应增强机制”重新分配回收的计算资源，以减少并发搜索间的资源竞争。将这些技术整合至vLLM框架后，系统在保持推理准确性的同时，显著降低了p99端到端延迟，并提升了吞吐量。
tldr: This paper introduces a negative early exit mechanism and adaptive boosting to reduce the long-tail latency of Monte Carlo Tree Search when used as a test-time compute scaling method for improving LLM reasoning, without a focus on robotics applications.
tldr_zh: 本文引入负向提前退出机制和自适应增强技术，以降低用于提升大语言模型推理能力的蒙特卡洛树搜索的测试时计算扩展方法的尾部延迟，未涉及机器人应用。

title: Towards Initialization-dependent and Non-vacuous Generalization Bounds for Overparameterized Shallow Neural Networks
summary: Overparameterized neural networks often show a benign overfitting property in the sense of achieving excellent generalization behavior despite the number of parameters exceeding the number of training examples. A promising direction to explain benign overfitting is to relate generalization to the norm of distance from initialization, motivated by the empirical observations that this distance is often significantly smaller than the norm itself. However, the existing initialization-dependent complexity analyses cannot fully exploit the power of initialization since the associated bounds depend on the spectral norm of the initialization matrix, which can scale as a square-root function of the width and are therefore not effective for overparameterized models. In this paper, we develop the first \emph{fully} initialization-dependent complexity bounds for shallow neural networks with general Lipschitz activation functions, which enjoys a logarithmic dependency on the width. Our bounds depend on the path-norm of the distance from initialization, which are derived by introducing a new peeling technique to handle the challenge along with the initialization-dependent constraint. We also develop a lower bound tight up to a constant factor. Finally, we conduct empirical comparisons and show that our generalization analysis implies non-vacuous bounds for overparameterized networks.
summary_zh: 过参数化神经网络通常表现出良性的过拟合特性，即尽管参数数量超过训练样本数量，却仍能获得优异的泛化性能。解释良性过拟合的一个有前景方向是将泛化能力与从初始化的距离范数联系起来，这源于实证观察：该距离范数通常远小于范数本身。然而，现有依赖初始化的复杂性分析未能充分利用初始化的优势，因为其相关界依赖于初始化矩阵的谱范数，而该范数可随宽度呈平方根函数缩放，因此对过参数化模型效果有限。本文针对具有一般利普希茨激活函数的浅层神经网络，首次提出了完全依赖初始化的复杂性界，该界对宽度具有对数依赖特性。我们建立的界依赖于从初始化的路径范数距离，通过引入新的剥离技术处理依赖初始化的约束挑战而推导得出。同时我们还构建了与常数因子紧密匹配的下界。最后，通过实证比较表明，我们的泛化分析为过参数化神经网络提供了非空泛的理论边界。
tldr: This paper develops new, fully initialization-dependent generalization bounds for overparameterized shallow neural networks that avoid vacuous bounds by using a path-norm distance metric.
tldr_zh: 本文为过参数化浅层神经网络提出了首个完全依赖于初始化的泛化边界，通过使用路径范数距离度量避免了空洞边界。

title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation
summary: LLM-based agent judges are an emerging approach to evaluating conversational AI, yet a fundamental uncertainty remains: can we trust their assessments, and if so, how many are needed? Through 960 sessions with two model pairs across 15 tasks, we show that persona-based agent judges produce evaluations indistinguishable from human raters in a Turing-style validation. We then identify a score-coverage dissociation: quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size, while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law-both exhibit diminishing returns, but scores saturate roughly twice as fast as discoveries. We hypothesize this reflects a power law distribution of the finding space: critical issues are discovered first by small panels, while corner cases require progressively larger panels, analogous to species accumulation curves in ecology. The mechanism traces to ensemble diversity-Big Five personality conditioning makes agents probe different quality dimensions, with expert judges acting as adversarial probes that push discovery into the tail of the finding distribution. A controlled ablation confirms that structured persona conditioning, not simple prompting, is required to produce these scaling properties.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的代理评估器是评估对话式人工智能的一种新兴方法，然而一个根本性的不确定性依然存在：我们能否信任其评估结果？若可以，又需要多少评估器才能保证可靠性？通过在两对模型之间进行的960次会话测试，涵盖15项任务，本研究表明：基于人格设定的代理评估器在图灵式验证中产生的评估结果与人类评分者无法区分。进一步研究发现存在评分-覆盖度分离现象：质量评分随评估小组规模呈对数式增长，而独特问题的发现遵循亚线性的幂律规律——两者均表现出收益递减特性，但评分饱和速度约为问题发现速度的两倍。我们推测这反映了发现空间的幂律分布特性：关键问题由小型评估小组率先发现，而边缘案例则需要逐步扩大的评估规模，类似于生态学中的物种累积曲线。该机制源于集成多样性：大五人格条件设定使代理评估器能够探测不同质量维度，其中专家型评估器扮演对抗性探针角色，将发现推向分布曲线的尾部。受控消融实验证实，要产生这种缩放特性，需要结构化的人格条件设定，而非简单的提示工程。
tldr: This paper studies LLM-based agent judges for evaluating conversational AI, showing their evaluations match human raters and analyzing how evaluation quality scales with panel size via logarithmic and power-law relationships.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究用于评估对话AI的LLM智能体评委，其评估与人类评分者匹配，并通过对数函数和幂律关系分析了评估质量如何随评委团规模变化。

title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimation (UE) aims to detect hallucinated outputs of large language models (LLMs) to improve their reliability. However, UE metrics often exhibit unstable performance across configurations, which significantly limits their applicability. In this work, we formalise this phenomenon as proxy failure, since most UE metrics originate from model behaviour, rather than being explicitly grounded in the factual correctness of LLM outputs. With this, we show that UE metrics become non-discriminative precisely in low-information regimes. To alleviate this, we propose Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method to remedy UE metrics, by mapping the raw scores to truth-aligned scores. Even with noisy and few-shot supervision, our TAC can support the learning of well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, and presents a practical calibration protocol. Our findings highlight the limitations of treating heuristic UE metrics as direct indicators of truth uncertainty, and position our TAC as a necessary step toward more reliable uncertainty estimation for LLMs. The code repository is available at https://github.com/ponhvoan/TruthAnchor/.
summary_zh: 不确定性估计（UE）旨在检测大型语言模型（LLM）的幻觉输出，以提高其可靠性。然而，UE指标在不同配置下常表现出不稳定性能，这严重限制了其适用性。本研究将这一现象形式化为代理失效问题，因为大多数UE指标源于模型行为，而非明确基于LLM输出的事实正确性。由此我们发现，UE指标在低信息情境下会完全丧失区分能力。为缓解这一问题，我们提出真值锚定（TAC），一种通过将原始分数映射至真值对齐分数的事后校准方法，以修正UE指标。即使仅使用少量带噪声的监督样本，TAC仍能支持学习得到良好校准的不确定性估计，并提供实用的校准方案。我们的研究结果揭示了将启发式UE指标直接作为真值不确定性指标的局限性，同时将TAC定位为实现更可靠LLM不确定性估计的必要步骤。代码仓库地址为https://github.com/ponhvoan/TruthAnchor/。
tldr: This paper proposes Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method to improve the reliability of uncertainty estimation metrics in Large Language Models by aligning them more closely with factual correctness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Truth AnChoring（TAC）的后处理校准方法，旨在通过将大语言模型的不确定性估计与事实正确性对齐，以提高其可靠性。

title: Polysemanticity or Polysemy? Lexical Identity Confounds Superposition Metrics
summary: If the same neuron activates for both "lender" and "riverside," standard metrics attribute the overlap to superposition--the neuron must be compressing two unrelated concepts. This work explores how much of the overlap is due a lexical confound: neurons fire for a shared word form (such as "bank") rather than for two compressed concepts. A 2x2 factorial decomposition reveals that the lexical-only condition (same word, different meaning) consistently exceeds the semantic-only condition (different word, same meaning) across models spanning 110M-70B parameters. The confound carries into sparse autoencoders (18-36% of features blend senses), sits in <=1% of activation dimensions, and hurts downstream tasks: filtering it out improves word sense disambiguation and makes knowledge edits more selective (p = 0.002).
summary_zh: 摘要：若同一神经元对“贷款人”与“河边”均产生激活，标准度量方法会将此重叠归因于叠加——即神经元必然在压缩两个无关概念。本研究旨在探究这种重叠在多大程度上源于词汇混淆：神经元因共享词形（如“bank”）而激活，而非因两个压缩概念。通过2×2因子分解发现，在1.1亿至700亿参数的各类模型中，“仅词汇”条件（相同词形、不同含义）的激活重叠始终高于“仅语义”条件（不同词形、相同含义）。这种混淆现象同样存在于稀疏自编码器中（18-36%的特征混合了多义），且集中于不超过1%的激活维度中，并对下游任务产生负面影响：将其滤除后，词义消歧性能得到提升，且知识编辑的针对性显著增强（p = 0.002）。
tldr: This paper investigates polysemy as a confounding factor in superposition metrics within neural networks, showing lexical overlap is a primary driver and proposing a method to filter it for improved downstream tasks like word sense disambiguation.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了多义词对神经网络叠加度量的混淆效应，表明词汇重叠是主要驱动因素，并提出了过滤方法以改进词义消歧等下游任务。

title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary in the MoE settings we study. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on GPT-2-scale language modeling and ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17 % higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.
summary_zh: 专家混合层通过仅为每个令牌激活一小部分专家来增加模型容量，通常依赖学习型路由器将隐藏状态映射到专家分配。本研究探讨了在我们研究的专家混合场景中，专用的学习型路由器是否绝对必要。我们提出了自路由机制，这是一种无需参数的路由方法，它直接使用令牌隐藏状态的指定子空间作为专家逻辑值，完全省去了路由器投影，同时保持专家混合层的其余部分不变。我们通过在GPT-2规模的语言建模和ImageNet-1K图像分类任务上进行评估，将自路由与标准学习型路由器、随机路由基线以及稠密非专家混合基线进行比较。结果表明，自路由在去除所有专用路由参数的同时，仍与学习型路由器基线保持竞争力，并能实现更均衡的专家利用率，其平均归一化路由熵提升约17%，且无需显式负载平衡损失。在使用DeiT-S/16模型的ImageNet-1K分类任务中，自路由较相应学习型路由器专家混合模型也略有提升。这些发现表明，有效的专家混合路由可以直接从隐藏表示中涌现，无需依赖单独的学习型路由器模块。
tldr: This paper proposes Self-Routing, a parameter-free method for routing tokens to experts in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models by using a designated subspace of the hidden state as logits, eliminating the need for a separate learned router. It demonstrates competitive performance with learned routers on language modeling and image classification tasks, suggesting effective routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Self-Routing的无参数方法，用于Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)模型中的专家路由，它直接使用隐藏状态的指定子空间作为logits，无需独立的可学习路由器。该工作在语言建模和图像分类任务中显示出与现有可学习路由器相当的性能，表明有效的路由机制可以从隐藏表示中自然涌现。

title: G-Drift MIA: Membership Inference via Gradient-Induced Feature Drift in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive web-scale corpora, raising growing concerns about privacy and copyright. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a given example was used during training. Existing LLM MIAs largely rely on output probabilities or loss values and often perform only marginally better than random guessing when members and non-members are drawn from the same distribution. We introduce G-Drift MIA, a white-box membership inference method based on gradient-induced feature drift. Given a candidate (x,y), we apply a single targeted gradient-ascent step that increases its loss and measure the resulting changes in internal representations, including logits, hidden-layer activations, and projections onto fixed feature directions, before and after the update. These drift signals are used to train a lightweight logistic classifier that effectively separates members from non-members. Across multiple transformer-based LLMs and datasets derived from realistic MIA benchmarks, G-Drift substantially outperforms confidence-based, perplexity-based, and reference-based attacks. We further show that memorized training samples systematically exhibit smaller and more structured feature drift than non-members, providing a mechanistic link between gradient geometry, representation stability, and memorization. In general, our results demonstrate that small, controlled gradient interventions offer a practical tool for auditing the membership of training-data and assessing privacy risks in LLMs.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）基于海量网络规模语料库进行训练，引发了日益增长的隐私与版权担忧。成员推断攻击（MIA）旨在判断特定样本是否在训练过程中被使用。现有的LLM成员推断方法主要依赖输出概率或损失值，且当成员与非成员样本来自相同分布时，其表现往往仅略优于随机猜测。本文提出G-Drift MIA，一种基于梯度诱导特征漂移的白盒成员推断方法。对于给定候选样本（x,y），我们执行一次单步定向梯度上升以增加其损失，并测量更新前后内部表征的变化——包括逻辑值、隐藏层激活状态及在固定特征方向上的投影。这些漂移信号被用于训练轻量级逻辑分类器，从而有效区分成员与非成员。在多个基于Transformer架构的LLM及源自实际MIA基准测试的数据集上，G-Drift在性能上显著优于基于置信度、基于困惑度及基于参考模型的攻击方法。我们进一步发现，被记忆的训练样本相较于非成员样本始终表现出更小且更具结构化的特征漂移，这揭示了梯度几何、表征稳定性与记忆机制之间的内在关联。总体而言，我们的研究表明，通过微小的可控梯度干预，可为审计训练数据成员归属及评估LLM隐私风险提供实用工具。
tldr: G-Drift MIA is a white-box membership inference attack for LLMs that uses gradient-induced feature drift to detect if a data point was part of the training set, improving over prior methods.
tldr_zh: G-Drift MIA是一种针对大型语言模型的白盒成员推理攻击方法，通过梯度诱导的特征漂移来检测数据点是否属于训练集，性能优于先前方法。

title: COTTA: Context-Aware Transfer Adaptation for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
summary: Developing robust models to accurately predict the trajectories of surrounding agents is fundamental to autonomous driving safety. However, most public datasets, such as the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and Argoverse, are collected in Western road environments and do not reflect the unique traffic patterns, infrastructure, and driving behaviors of other regions, including South Korea. This domain discrepancy leads to performance degradation when state-of-the-art models trained on Western data are deployed in different geographic contexts. In this work, we investigate the adaptability of Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet) when transferred from U.S.-based data to Korean road environments. Using a Korean autonomous driving dataset, we compare four training strategies: zero-shot transfer, training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and encoder freezing. Experimental results demonstrate that leveraging pretrained knowledge significantly improves prediction performance. Specifically, selectively fine-tuning the decoder while freezing the encoder yields the best trade-off between accuracy and training efficiency, reducing prediction error by over 66% compared to training from scratch. This study provides practical insights into effective transfer learning strategies for deploying trajectory prediction models in new geographic domains.
summary_zh: 开发鲁棒模型以准确预测周围智能体的轨迹是自动驾驶安全的基础。然而，大多数公共数据集，如Waymo开放运动数据集和Argoverse，均采集自西方道路环境，未能反映包括韩国在内的其他地区特有的交通模式、基础设施和驾驶行为。当基于西方数据训练的最先进模型部署于不同地理环境时，这种领域差异会导致性能下降。本研究探讨了以查询为中心的轨迹预测模型（QCNet）从美国数据迁移至韩国道路环境时的适应能力。基于韩国自动驾驶数据集，我们比较了四种训练策略：零样本迁移、从头训练、全面微调以及编码器冻结。实验结果表明，利用预训练知识可显著提升预测性能。具体而言，在冻结编码器的同时选择性微调解码器，能在精度与训练效率间取得最佳平衡，相比从头训练，预测误差降低超过66%。本研究为在新地理区域部署轨迹预测模型提供了有效的迁移学习策略实践参考。
tldr: This paper investigates transfer learning strategies for a trajectory prediction model (QCNet) in autonomous driving, evaluating its performance when adapted from US to Korean road environments.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了自动驾驶中轨迹预测模型（QCNet）的迁移学习策略，评估了其从美国到韩国道路环境的适应性能。

title: VeriAct: Beyond Verifiability -- Agentic Synthesis of Correct and Complete Formal Specifications
summary: Formal specifications play a central role in ensuring software reliability and correctness. However, automatically synthesizing high-quality formal specifications remains a challenging task, often requiring domain expertise. Recent work has applied large language models to generate specifications in Java Modeling Language (JML), reporting high verification pass rates. But does passing a verifier mean that the specification is actually correct and complete? In this work, we first conduct a comprehensive evaluation comparing classical and prompt-based approaches for automated JML specification synthesis. We then investigate whether prompt optimization can push synthesis quality further by evolving prompts through structured verification feedback. While optimization improves verifier pass rates, we find a clear performance ceiling. More critically, we propose Spec-Harness, an evaluation framework that measures specification correctness and completeness through symbolic verification, revealing that a large fraction of verifier-accepted specifications, including optimized ones, are in fact incorrect or incomplete, over- or under-constraining both inputs and outputs in ways invisible to the verifier. To push beyond this ceiling, we propose VeriAct, a verification-guided agentic framework that iteratively synthesizes and repairs specifications through a closed loop of LLM-driven planning, code execution, verification, and Spec-Harness feedback.
