Our experiments on two benchmark datasets show that VeriAct outperforms both prompt-based and prompt-optimized baselines, producing specifications that are not only verifiable but also correct and complete.
summary_zh: 形式化规约在确保软件可靠性与正确性方面起着核心作用。然而，自动合成高质量的形式化规约仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，通常需要领域专业知识。近期研究将大型语言模型应用于生成Java建模语言（JML）规约，并报告了较高的验证通过率。但通过验证器是否意味着规约实际上正确且完整？本研究首先对传统方法与基于提示的自动JML规约合成方法进行了全面对比评估，随后探究了通过结构化验证反馈优化提示能否进一步提升合成质量。尽管优化提高了验证通过率，但我们发现了明显的性能瓶颈。更关键的是，我们提出了Spec-Harness评估框架，通过符号验证衡量规约的正确性与完整性，结果显示包括优化版本在内的大量验证通过规约实际上存在错误或不完整，其对输入输出的过度约束或约束不足是验证器无法察觉的。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出了VeriAct——一种验证引导的智能体框架，通过大型语言模型驱动的规划、代码执行、验证和Spec-Harness反馈形成的闭环，迭代合成并修复规约。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，VeriAct在基于提示和提示优化的基线方法上均表现出优越性，所生成的规约不仅可验证，而且具备正确性与完整性。
tldr: This paper introduces VeriAct, an agentic framework that uses LLMs and verification feedback to iteratively synthesize correct and complete formal software specifications, which is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍VeriAct，一种利用LLM和验证反馈迭代合成正确且完整的软件形式化规范的智能体框架，与机器人学或具身智能无直接关联。

title: Hierarchical Apprenticeship Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Evolving Rewards
summary: While apprenticeship learning has shown promise for inducing effective pedagogical policies directly from student interactions in e-learning environments, most existing approaches rely on optimal or near-optimal expert demonstrations under a fixed reward. Real-world student interactions, however, are often inherently imperfect and evolving: students explore, make errors, revise strategies, and refine their goals as understanding develops. In this work, we argue that imperfect student demonstrations are not noise to be discarded, but structured signals-provided their relative quality is ranked. We introduce HALIDE, Hierarchical Apprenticeship Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Evolving Rewards, which not only leverages sub-optimal student demonstrations, but ranks them within a hierarchical learning framework. HALIDE models student behavior at multiple levels of abstraction, enabling inference of higher-level intent and strategy from suboptimal actions while explicitly capturing the temporal evolution of student reward functions. By integrating demonstration quality into hierarchical reward inference,HALIDE distinguishes transient errors from suboptimal strategies and meaningful progress toward higher-level learning goals. Our results show that HALIDE more accurately predicts student pedagogical decisions than approaches that rely on optimal trajectories, fixed rewards, or unranked imperfect demonstrations.
summary_zh: 尽管学徒学习已展现出直接根据学生在电子学习环境中的交互来推导有效教学策略的潜力，但现有方法大多依赖于固定奖励下的最优或近似最优专家示范。然而，现实中的学生交互往往天然存在不完美且动态演变的特性：学生通过探索、试错、调整策略、并在理解深化过程中不断修正目标来学习。本文主张，不完美的学生演示数据并非应被丢弃的噪声，而是具备结构性的信号——前提是这些数据的相对质量能够被排序。我们提出了一种基于演化奖励的分层不完美演示学徒学习方法（HALIDE），该方法不仅能利用次优的学生演示数据，还将其纳入分层学习框架中进行质量排序。HALIDE通过多层抽象模型解析学生行为，既能从次优行动中推断更高层的学习意图与策略，又能显式捕捉学生奖励函数随时间演化的过程。通过将演示质量整合到分层奖励推断中，HALIDE能够有效区分暂时性失误与系统性次优策略，并识别出学生向高层次学习目标迈进的有效进展。实验结果表明，相较于依赖最优轨迹、固定奖励或未排序不完美演示的方法，HALIDE能更精准地预测学生教学决策。
tldr: Proposes HALIDE, a hierarchical apprenticeship learning method that uses ranked, imperfect demonstrations with evolving rewards, specifically for modeling and predicting student pedagogical decisions in e-learning environments.
tldr_zh: 提出了HALIDE，一种层次化的学徒学习方法，利用有排序的不完美演示和演化的奖励，专门用于建模和预测学生在电子学习环境中的教学决策。

title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation
summary: Single-agent large language model (LLM) systems struggle to simultaneously support diverse conversational functions and maintain safety in behavioral health communication. We propose a safety-aware, role-orchestrated multi-agent LLM framework designed to simulate supportive behavioral health dialogue through coordinated, role-differentiated agents. Conversational responsibilities are decomposed across specialized agents, including empathy-focused, action-oriented, and supervisory roles, while a prompt-based controller dynamically activates relevant agents and enforces continuous safety auditing. Using semi-structured interview transcripts from the DAIC-WOZ corpus, we evaluate the framework with scalable proxy metrics capturing structural quality, functional diversity, and computational characteristics. Results illustrate clear role differentiation, coherent inter-agent coordination, and predictable trade-offs between modular orchestration, safety oversight, and response latency when compared to a single-agent baseline. This work emphasizes system design, interpretability, and safety, positioning the framework as a simulation and analysis tool for behavioral health informatics and decision-support research rather than a clinical intervention.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在行为健康沟通中，单智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统往往难以同时支持多样化的对话功能并保障交互安全性。为此，我们提出一种具备安全感知能力、基于角色编排的多智能体LLM框架，旨在通过协调有序、角色分化的智能体模拟支持性行为健康对话。该框架将对话职责分解至多个专业化智能体，包括共情导向型、行动导向型及监督型角色，同时借助基于提示的控制器动态激活相关智能体并执行持续的安全审核机制。基于DAIC-WOZ语料库中的半结构化访谈转录数据，我们通过可扩展的代理指标评估该框架，这些指标涵盖结构质量、功能多样性与计算特性。实验结果表明，与单智能体基线相比，该框架表现出明确的角色分化、连贯的智能体间协调，并在模块化编排、安全监督与响应延迟之间实现了可预测的权衡。本研究聚焦系统设计、可解释性与安全性，将该框架定位为行为健康信息学与决策支持研究的模拟分析工具，而非临床干预手段。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-agent LLM framework for simulating behavioral health dialogues, with role-differentiated agents and safety oversight, evaluated on conversation quality and computational metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模拟行为健康对话的多智能体LLM框架，通过角色分工和持续安全审计，评估了对话质量与计算效率。

title: MAC-Attention: a Match-Amend-Complete Scheme for Fast and Accurate Attention Computation
summary: Long-context decoding in LLMs is IO-bound: each token re-reads an ever-growing KV cache. Prior accelerations cut bytes via compression, which lowers fidelity, or selection/eviction, which restricts what remains accessible, and both can degrade delayed recall and long-form generation. We introduce MAC-Attention, a fidelity- and access-preserving alternative that accelerates decoding by reusing prior attention computations for semantically similar recent queries. It starts with a match stage that performs pre-RoPE L2 matching over a short local window; an amend stage rectifies the reused attention by recomputing a small band near the match boundary; and a complete stage fuses the rectified results with fresh attention computed on the KV tail through a numerically stable merge. On a match hit, the compute and bandwidth complexity is constant regardless of context length. The method is model-agnostic and composes with IO-aware kernels, paged-KV managers, and MQA/GQA. Across LongBench v2 (120K), RULER (120K), and LongGenBench (16K continuous generation), compared to the latest FlashInfer library, MAC-Attention reduces KV accesses by up to 99%, cuts token generation latency by over 60% at 128K, and achieves over 14.3x attention-phase speedups, up to 2.6x end-to-end, while maintaining full-attention quality. By reusing computation, MAC-Attention delivers long-context inference that is both fast and faithful. Code is available here: https://github.com/YJHMITWEB/MAC-Attention.git
summary_zh: 大型语言模型的长上下文解码是输入/输出瓶颈：每个生成的标记都需要重新读取一个不断增长的键值缓存。先前的研究通过压缩（降低保真度）或选择/淘汰（限制可访问内容）来减少字节读取，但二者都可能削弱模型的延迟回忆和长文本生成能力。本文提出MAC-Attention方法，这一替代方案在保持保真度与访问能力的同时，通过为语义相似的近期查询复用先前的注意力计算来加速解码。该方法包含三个核心阶段：匹配阶段在局部短窗口内执行旋转位置编码前的L2距离匹配；修正阶段通过在匹配边界附近重新计算窄带注意力来修正复用结果；融合阶段通过数值稳定的合并操作，将修正后的注意力与新计算的键值缓存尾部注意力进行融合。当匹配成功时，其计算与带宽复杂度将保持恒定，与上下文长度无关。该方法具有模型无关性，可与输入/输出感知内核、分页键值管理器以及多查询/分组查询注意力机制协同工作。在LongBench v2（120K）、RULER（120K）和LongGenBench（16K连续生成）的测试中，相较于最新的FlashInfer库，MAC-Attention将键值缓存访问量降低最高达99%，在128K上下文长度下减少标记生成延迟超过60%，注意力阶段加速比达14.3倍，端到端加速比最高达2.6倍，同时保持与完整注意力机制相当的质量。通过计算复用，MAC-Attention实现了既快速又忠实的长上下文推理。代码已开源：https://github.com/YJHMITWEB/MAC-Attention.git
tldr: The paper introduces MAC-Attention, a method to accelerate long-context LLM inference by reusing prior attention computations, reducing KV cache accesses and latency while maintaining output quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出MAC-Attention方法，通过重用先前的注意力计算来加速长上下文LLM推理，减少KV缓存访问和延迟，同时保持输出质量。

title: Explainable AI for Blind and Low-Vision Users: Navigating Trust, Modality, and Interpretability in the Agentic Era
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is critical for ensuring trust and accountability, yet its development remains predominantly visual. For blind and low-vision (BLV) users, the lack of accessible explanations creates a fundamental barrier to the independent use of AI-driven assistive technologies. This problem intensifies as AI systems shift from single-query tools into autonomous agents that take multi-step actions and make consequential decisions across extended task horizons, where a single undetected error can propagate irreversibly before any feedback is available. This paper investigates the unique XAI requirements of the BLV community through a comprehensive analysis of user interviews and contemporary research. By examining usage patterns across environmental perception and decision support, we identify a significant modality gap. Empirical evidence suggests that while BLV users highly value conversational explanations, they frequently experience "self-blame" for AI failures. The paper concludes with a research agenda for accessible Explainable AI in agentic systems, advocating for multimodal interfaces, blame-aware explanation design, and participatory development.
summary_zh: 可解释人工智能（XAI）对于确保技术可信度与问责性至关重要，但当前发展仍以视觉化解释为主导。对于视障与低视力用户而言，缺乏可访问的解释方式已成为其独立使用人工智能辅助技术的基本障碍。随着人工智能系统从单一查询工具向自主智能体演进——这些系统能在长期任务中执行多步骤行动并做出关键决策，使得未被发现的单一错误可能在获得反馈前造成不可逆影响——该问题愈发严峻。本文通过综合分析用户访谈与前沿研究，深入探讨了视障群体对可解释人工智能的特殊需求。通过考察环境感知与决策支持两大场景的使用模式，我们发现了显著的解释模态鸿沟。实证研究表明，视障用户虽高度重视对话式解释，却常因人工智能故障产生"自我归责"倾向。本文最终提出面向自主智能体系统的可访问可解释人工智能研究框架，倡导发展多模态交互界面、归责感知型解释设计以及参与式开发范式。
tldr: This paper investigates the need for accessible explainable AI (XAI) for blind and low-vision users, particularly as AI systems evolve into autonomous agents, highlighting a modality gap and proposing a research agenda for blame-aware, multimodal explanation design.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了为盲人和低视力用户开发可访问可解释AI（XAI）的需求，特别是在AI系统向自主代理演进时，揭示了模态鸿沟，并提出了一个旨在实现多模态、体谅用户归因的解释设计的研究议程。

title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
summary: Tool-integrated LLMs can retrieve, compute, and take real-world actions via external tools, but reliability remains a key bottleneck. We argue that failures stem from both tool-use accuracy (how well an agent invokes a tool) and intrinsic tool accuracy (the tool's own correctness), while most prior work emphasizes the former. We introduce OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides lightweight plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites and continuous monitoring. We also release a public web demo where users can run predefined agents and tools and contribute test cases, enabling reliability reports to evolve as tools change. OpenTools includes the core framework, an initial tool set, evaluation pipelines, and a contribution protocol. Experiments and evaluations show improved end-to-end reproducibility and task performance; community-contributed, higher-quality task-specific tools deliver 6%-22% relative gains over an existing toolbox across multiple agent architectures on downstream tasks and benchmarks, highlighting the importance of intrinsic tool accuracy.
summary_zh:
摘要：
工具集成的大型语言模型（LLM）能够通过外部工具检索、计算并执行现实世界行动，但其可靠性仍是关键瓶颈。我们认为，故障源于工具使用准确性（智能体调用工具的能力）和工具内在准确性（工具自身的正确性）两方面，而以往研究多侧重于前者。我们推出了OpenTools——一个社区驱动的工具集，它通过标准化工具模式、提供轻量级即插即用封装器，并结合自动化测试套件与持续监控来评估工具。同时，我们发布了公开网络演示平台，用户可在其中运行预定义的智能体与工具，并贡献测试用例，使得可靠性报告能随工具更新而动态演进。OpenTools包含核心框架、初始工具集、评估流程及贡献规范。实验与评估结果表明，该系统提升了端到端可复现性与任务性能；在多个下游任务和基准测试中，社区贡献的高质量专用工具相较于现有工具集，在多种智能体架构上实现了6%-22%的相对性能提升，凸显了工具内在准确性的重要性。
tldr: This paper introduces OpenTools, a community-driven framework for enhancing the reliability of tool-using AI agents by standardizing schemas, providing wrappers, and enabling automated evaluation and monitoring of tool performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了OpenTools，一个社区驱动的框架，旨在通过标准化工具模式、提供轻量级包装器以及实现对工具性能的自动化评估和监控，来提高使用工具的AI代理的可靠性。

title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Models
summary: The field of computer vision has experienced significant advancements through scalable vision encoders and multimodal pre-training frameworks. However, existing approaches often treat vision encoders and large language models (LLMs) as independent modules, limiting the integration of hierarchical visual features. In this work, we propose HIVE (Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders), a novel framework that enhances vision-language alignment by introducing hierarchical cross-attention between the vision encoder and LLM. Unlike conventional methods that flatten image embeddings, HIVE enables structured feature fusion across multiple layers, improving gradient flow and representation learning. To optimize this interaction, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that progressively aligns the vision encoder with the LLM, ensuring stable optimization and effective multimodal fusion. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that HIVE achieves superior performance not only in image classification but also on various vision-language tasks, outperforming self-attention-based methods in benchmarks such as MME, GQA, OK-VQA, and ScienceQA. Our results highlight the benefits of hierarchical feature integration, paving the way for more efficient and expressive vision-language models.
summary_zh: 通过可扩展的视觉编码器和多模态预训练框架，计算机视觉领域取得了显著进步。然而，现有方法通常将视觉编码器与大型语言模型视为独立模块，限制了层级视觉特征的整合。本研究提出HIVE（视觉编码器层级预训练框架），该创新框架通过在视觉编码器与大型语言模型之间引入层级交叉注意力机制，增强了视觉-语言的对齐能力。与传统方法中扁平化图像嵌入的方式不同，HIVE实现了跨多层的结构化特征融合，从而优化了梯度流与表征学习。为提升交互效率，我们设计了三阶段渐进式训练策略，逐步对齐视觉编码器与大型语言模型，确保稳定的优化过程与有效的多模态融合。实验评估表明，HIVE不仅在图像分类任务中表现优异，在MME、GQA、OK-VQA和ScienceQA等基准测试的多项视觉-语言任务上也超越了基于自注意力机制的方法，突显了层级特征整合的优势，为构建更高效、表达能力更强的视觉-语言模型开辟了新路径。
tldr: A novel hierarchical pre-training framework for vision encoders and LLMs, using hierarchical cross-attention and a three-stage training strategy to improve vision-language alignment and performance on various vision-language benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的视觉编码器与LLMs的分层预训练框架，利用分层交叉注意力和三阶段训练策略来增强视觉语言对齐，在多种视觉语言基准测试中取得了更好的性能。

title: TRACE: High-Fidelity 3D Scene Editing via Tangible Reconstruction and Geometry-Aligned Contextual Video Masking
summary: We present TRACE, a mesh-guided 3DGS editing framework that achieves automated, high-fidelity scene transformation. By anchoring video diffusion with explicit 3D geometry, TRACE uniquely enables fine-grained, part-level manipulatio--such as local pose shifting or component replacemen--while preserving the structural integrity of the central subject, a capability largely absent in existing editing methods. Our approach comprises three key stages: (1) Multi-view 3D-Anchor Synthesis, which leverages a sparse-view editor trained on our MV-TRACE datase--the first multi-view consistent dataset dedicated to scene-coherent object addition and modificatio--to generate spatially consistent 3D-anchors; (2) Tangible Geometry Anchoring (TGA), which ensures precise spatial synchronization between inserted meshes and the 3DGS scene via two-phase registration; and (3) Contextual Video Masking (CVM), which integrates 3D projections into an autoregressive video pipeline to achieve temporally stable, physically-grounded rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TRACE consistently outperforms existing methods especially in editing versatility and structural integrity.
summary_zh: 本文提出TRACE，一种基于网格引导的3DGS编辑框架，实现了自动化、高保真的场景转换。通过将视频扩散模型与显式三维几何结构锚定，TRACE首次实现了细粒度的部件级操控（如局部位姿调整或组件替换），同时保持核心主体的结构完整性，这是现有编辑方法普遍缺失的能力。该框架包含三个关键阶段：（1）多视角三维锚点合成：利用基于MV-TRACE数据集训练的稀疏视角编辑器——首个专用于场景连贯物体添加与修改的多视角一致性数据集——生成空间一致的三维锚点；（2）实体几何锚定：通过两阶段配准确保插入网格与3DGS场景的精确空间同步；（3）上下文视频掩蔽：将三维投影整合至自回归视频生成流程，实现时间稳定、物理真实的渲染效果。大量实验表明，TRACE在编辑多样性与结构完整性方面持续优于现有方法。
tldr: TRACE is a framework for automated, high-fidelity 3D scene editing using 3D Gaussian Splatting, enabling part-level manipulations like pose shifting and object replacement while maintaining structural integrity through geometry anchoring and contextual video masking.
tldr_zh: TRACE是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的自动化、高保真3D场景编辑框架，通过几何锚定和上下文视频掩码技术，实现局部姿态调整和组件替换等细粒度操作，同时保持主体结构完整性。

title: True (VIS) Lies: Analyzing How Generative AI Recognizes Intentionality, Rhetoric, and Misleadingness in Visualization Lies
summary: This study investigates the ability of multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify and interpret misleading visualizations, and recognize these observations along with their underlying causes and potential intentionality. Our analysis leverages concepts from visualization rhetoric and a newly developed taxonomy of authorial intents as explanatory lenses. We formulated three research questions and addressed them experimentally using a dataset of 2,336 COVID-19-related tweets, half of which contain misleading visualizations, and supplemented it with real-world examples of perceptual, cognitive, and conceptual errors drawn from VisLies, the IEEE VIS community event dedicated to showcasing deceptive and misleading visualizations. To ensure broad coverage of the current LLM landscape, we evaluated 16 state-of-the-art models. Among them, 15 are open-weight models, spanning a wide range of model sizes, architectural families, and reasoning capabilities. The selection comprises small models, namely Nemotron-Nano-V2-VL (12B parameters), Mistral-Small-3.2 (24B), DeepSeek-VL2 (27B), Gemma3 (27B), and GTA1 (32B); medium-sized models, namely Qianfan-VL (70B), Molmo (72B), GLM-4.5V (108B), LLaVA-NeXT (110B), and Pixtral-Large (124B); and large models, namely Qwen3-VL (235B), InternVL3.5 (241B), Step3 (321B), Llama-4-Maverick (400B), and Kimi-K2.5 (1000B). In addition, we employed OpenAI GPT-5.4, a frontier proprietary model. To establish a human perspective on these tasks, we also conducted a user study with visualization experts to assess how people perceive rhetorical techniques and the authorial intentions behind the same misleading visualizations. This allows comparison between model and expert behavior, revealing similarities and differences that provide insights into where LLMs align with human judgment and where they diverge.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多模态大语言模型在识别和解释误导性可视化图表方面的能力，以及对其观察结果、潜在原因和可能意图的认知。我们运用可视化修辞学概念和新提出的作者意图分类体系作为分析框架，提出了三个研究问题，并基于包含2,336条COVID-19相关推文的数据集（其中半数含有误导性可视化）展开实验研究，同时辅以从IEEE VIS社区活动"VisLies"（专门展示欺骗性可视化案例）中提取的真实世界感知、认知和概念性错误案例。为全面覆盖当前大语言模型生态，我们评估了16个前沿模型，其中15个为开源权重模型，涵盖不同规模、架构家族和推理能力。具体包括：小规模模型——Nemotron-Nano-V2-VL（120亿参数）、Mistral-Small-3.2（240亿）、DeepSeek-VL2（270亿）、Gemma3（270亿）和GTA1（320亿）；中等规模模型——Qianfan-VL（700亿）、Molmo（720亿）、GLM-4.5V（1080亿）、LLaVA-NeXT（1100亿）和Pixtral-Large（1240亿）；大规模模型——Qwen3-VL（2350亿）、InternVL3.5（2410亿）、Step3（3210亿）、Llama-4-Maverick（4000亿）和Kimi-K2.5（10000亿）。此外，我们还采用了前沿专有模型OpenAI GPT-5.4。为建立人类视角的参照基准，我们同时开展了可视化专家用户研究，评估人类对相同误导性可视化中修辞手法及作者意图的感知。通过对比模型与专家行为模式，揭示了二者的相似性与差异性，从而深入理解大语言模型在哪些方面与人类判断保持一致，在哪些方面存在分歧。
tldr: This paper evaluates multimodal LLMs' ability to identify and interpret misleading visualizations, focusing on recognizing intent, rhetoric, and errors in data visualizations, using a dataset of tweets and expert comparison.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了多模态大语言模型识别和解释误导性可视化的能力，重点关注数据可视化中的意图、修辞和错误识别，使用了推特数据集和专家对比。

title: ProTPS: Prototype-Guided Text Prompt Selection for Continual Learning
summary: For continual learning, text-prompt-based methods leverage text encoders and learnable prompts to encode semantic features for sequentially arrived classes over time. A common challenge encountered by existing works is how to learn unique text prompts, which implicitly carry semantic information of new classes, so that the semantic features of newly arrived classes do not overlap with those of trained classes, thereby mitigating the catastrophic forgetting problem. To address this challenge, we propose a novel approach Prototype-guided Text Prompt Selection (ProTPS)'' to intentionally increase the training flexibility thus encouraging the learning of unique text prompts. Specifically, our ProTPS learns class-specific vision prototypes and text prompts. Vision prototypes guide the selection and learning of text prompts for each class. We first evaluate our ProTPS in both class incremental (CI) setting and cross-datasets continual (CDC) learning setting. Because our ProTPS achieves performance close to the upper bounds, we further collect a real-world dataset with 112 marine species collected over a span of six years, named Marine112, to bring new challenges to the community. Marine112 is authentically suited for the class and domain incremental (CDI) learning setting and is under natural long-tail distribution. The results under three settings show that our ProTPS performs favorably against the recent state-of-the-art methods. The implementation code and Marine112 dataset will be released upon the acceptance of our paper.
summary_zh: 在持续学习中，基于文本提示的方法利用文本编码器和可学习提示词对随时间顺序到达的类别进行语义特征编码。现有研究普遍面临的一个挑战是如何学习独特的文本提示词——这些提示词隐式承载新类别的语义信息，使得新到达类别的语义特征与已训练类别不发生重叠，从而缓解灾难性遗忘问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种新方法"原型引导文本提示选择"（ProTPS），旨在通过增强训练灵活性来促进独特文本提示词的学习。具体而言，我们的ProTPS同步学习类别特定的视觉原型和文本提示词，其中视觉原型引导每个类别的文本提示词选择与学习过程。我们首先在类增量学习和跨数据集持续学习设定下评估ProTPS的性能。由于该方法取得了接近理论上限的表现，我们进一步构建了包含六年间采集的112种海洋生物的真实世界数据集Marine112，旨在为该领域带来新的挑战。该数据集天然适用于类与域增量学习场景，且呈现自然长尾分布。在三种设定下的实验结果表明，ProTPS相比当前最先进方法具有显著优势。本论文的代码实现与Marine112数据集将在录用后公开发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for continual learning that uses vision prototypes to guide the selection and learning of text prompts, aiming to create unique semantic representations for new classes to prevent catastrophic forgetting. It is evaluated on image classification tasks and a new dataset of marine species.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种持续学习方法，利用视觉原型指导文本提示的选择和学习，旨在为新的类别创建独特的语义表示以防止灾难性遗忘。该方法在图像分类任务和一个新的海洋物种数据集上进行了评估。

title: A global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving
summary: We introduce CROWD (City Road Observations With Dashcams), a manually curated dataset of ordinary, minute scale, temporally contiguous, unedited, front facing urban dashcam segments screened and segmented from publicly available YouTube videos. CROWD is designed to support cross-domain robustness and interaction analysis by prioritising routine driving and explicitly excluding crashes, crash aftermath, and other edited or incident-focused content. The release contains 51,753 segment records spanning 20,275.56 hours (42,032 videos), covering 7,103 named inhabited places in 238 countries and territories across all six inhabited continents (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America and Oceania), with segment level manual labels for time of day (day or night) and vehicle type. To lower the barrier for benchmarking, we provide per-segment CSV files of machine-generated detections for all 80 MS-COCO classes produced with YOLOv11x, together with segment-local multi-object tracks (BoT-SORT); e.g. person, bicycle, motorcycle, car, bus, truck, traffic light, stop sign, etc. CROWD is distributed as video identifiers with segment boundaries and derived annotations, enabling reproducible research without redistributing the underlying videos.
summary_zh: 我们推出CROWD（车载摄像头城市道路观测数据集），这是一个经过人工筛选和分段处理的数据集，由从公开YouTube视频中提取的普通、分钟级、时间连续、未经剪辑、面向前方的城市行车记录仪片段构成。CROWD通过优先选择日常驾驶场景，并明确排除事故、事故后果及其他经过剪辑或专注于突发事件的内容，旨在支持跨域鲁棒性分析与交互研究。该数据集包含51,753条片段记录，总时长20,275.56小时（对应42,032个视频），涵盖六大洲（非洲、亚洲、欧洲、北美洲、南美洲和大洋洲）238个国家与地区的7,103个命名聚居地，每条片段均提供时段（白天/夜晚）和车辆类型的人工标注标签。为降低基准测试门槛，我们额外提供每段视频的CSV文件，包含基于YOLOv11x模型生成的80个MS-COCO类别检测结果（如行人、自行车、摩托车、汽车、公交车、卡车、交通信号灯、停车标志等）以及片段级多目标跟踪数据（BoT-SORT）。CROWD以视频标识符配合片段边界及衍生注释的形式发布，在避免直接分发原始视频的前提下确保研究可复现性。
tldr: This paper introduces CROWD, a large-scale global dataset of continuous urban dashcam driving videos, curated from YouTube to provide routine driving scenes with manual and machine-generated annotations for object detection and tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了CROWD，一个大规模的全球城市行车记录仪连续视频数据集，从YouTube筛选并标注，提供日常驾驶场景，包含手动和机器生成的目标检测与跟踪标注。

title: ONE-SHOT: Compositional Human-Environment Video Synthesis via Spatial-Decoupled Motion Injection and Hybrid Context Integration
summary: Recent advances in Video Foundation Models (VFMs) have revolutionized human-centric video synthesis, yet fine-grained and independent editing of subjects and scenes remains a critical challenge. Recent attempts to incorporate richer environment control through rigid 3D geometric compositions often encounter a stark trade-off between precise control and generative flexibility. Furthermore, the heavy 3D pre-processing still limits practical scalability. In this paper, we propose ONE-SHOT, a parameter-efficient framework for compositional human-environment video generation. Our key insight is to factorize the generative process into disentangled signals. Specifically, we introduce a canonical-space injection mechanism that decouples human dynamics from environmental cues via cross-attention. We also propose Dynamic-Grounded-RoPE, a novel positional embedding strategy that establishes spatial correspondences between disparate spatial domains without any heuristic 3D alignments. To support long-horizon synthesis, we introduce a Hybrid Context Integration mechanism to maintain subject and scene consistency across minute-level generations. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, offering superior structural control and creative diversity for video synthesis. Our project has been available on: https://martayang.github.io/ONE-SHOT/.
summary_zh: 近期，视频基础模型在人物中心视频合成领域取得了革命性进展，但对主体与场景进行细粒度独立编辑仍是一项关键挑战。当前通过刚性三维几何组合引入更丰富环境控制的尝试，往往面临精确控制与生成灵活性之间的显著权衡。此外，繁重的三维预处理过程仍制约着实际应用的扩展性。本文提出ONE-SHOT——一个参数高效的组合式人物-环境视频生成框架。我们的核心见解在于将生成过程分解为解耦的信号流。具体而言，我们引入规范化空间注入机制，通过交叉注意力实现人物动态与环境线索的解耦。同时提出动态接地旋转位置编码，这是一种新颖的位置嵌入策略，可在无需启发式三维对齐的情况下，建立不同空间域之间的空间对应关系。为支持长时序合成，我们引入混合上下文集成机制，确保在分钟级生成过程中保持主体与场景的一致性。实验表明，本方法显著优于现有先进技术，为视频合成提供了更优越的结构控制与创作多样性。项目已发布于：https://martayang.github.io/ONE-SHOT/。
tldr: Proposes a parameter-efficient framework for compositional human-environment video synthesis, focusing on disentangling human dynamics and environmental cues for fine-grained control without 3D pre-processing.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于组合式人与环境视频合成的高效参数框架，通过分离人体动态和环境线索实现精细控制，无需3D预处理。

title: Diff3R: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Uncertainty-aware Differentiable Optimization
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) present two main directions: feed-forward models offer fast inference in sparse-view settings, while per-scene optimization yields high-quality renderings but is computationally expensive. To combine the benefits of both, we introduce Diff3R, a novel framework that explicitly bridges feed-forward prediction and test-time optimization. By incorporating a differentiable 3DGS optimization layer directly into the training loop, our network learns to predict an optimal initialization for test-time optimization rather than a conventional zero-shot result. To overcome the computational cost of backpropagating through the optimization steps, we propose computing gradients via the Implicit Function Theorem and a scalable, matrix-free PCG solver tailored for 3DGS optimization. Additionally, we incorporate a data-driven uncertainty model into the optimization process by adaptively controlling how much the parameters are allowed to change during optimization. This approach effectively mitigates overfitting in under-constrained regions and increases robustness against input outliers. Since our proposed optimization layer is model-agnostic, we show that it can be seamlessly integrated into existing feed-forward 3DGS architectures for both pose-given and pose-free methods, providing improvements for test-time optimization.
summary_zh: 近年来，三维高斯泼溅技术（3DGS）呈现出两大主流方向：前馈模型在稀疏视角场景中能够实现快速推理，而逐场景优化方法虽能生成高质量渲染结果，但计算成本高昂。为融合二者的优势，本文提出Diff3R——一种创新性框架，通过显式桥接前馈预测与测试时优化。通过将可微分3DGS优化层直接嵌入训练循环，我们的网络能够学习预测适用于测试时优化的最优初始化参数，而非传统零样本推理结果。为克服优化步骤反向传播带来的计算负担，我们提出基于隐函数定理的梯度计算方法，并开发了专为3DGS优化设计的可扩展无矩阵预处理共轭梯度求解器。此外，我们在优化过程中引入数据驱动的不确定性模型，通过自适应控制参数在优化过程中的可变范围，有效缓解欠约束区域的过拟合问题，并增强模型对输入异常值的鲁棒性。由于该优化层具有模型无关性，我们证明其可无缝集成到现有前馈式3DGS架构中，既适用于已知相机位姿的场景，也适用于未知位姿的方法，为测试时优化提供了系统性改进。
tldr: Diff3R is a novel framework that bridges feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction and computationally expensive test-time optimization by incorporating a differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization layer into training. It learns to predict an optimal initialization for test-time optimization, integrates an uncertainty model to prevent overfitting, and is model-agnostic, providing improvements for existing pose-given and pose-free methods.
tldr_zh: Diff3R 是一个新颖框架，通过在训练循环中引入一个可微分的 3D 高斯泼溅优化层，桥接了前馈式 3D 场景重建和计算密集型的测试时优化。它学习为测试时优化预测一个最优初始化，并集成了一个不确定性模型以防止过拟合，且是模型无关的，能为现有方法提供改进。

title: Forecasting Motion in the Wild
summary: Visual intelligence requires anticipating the future behavior of agents, yet vision systems lack a general representation for motion and behavior. We propose dense point trajectories as visual tokens for behavior, a structured mid-level representation that disentangles motion from appearance and generalizes across diverse non-rigid agents, such as animals in-the-wild. Building on this abstraction, we design a diffusion transformer that models unordered sets of trajectories and explicitly reasons about occlusion, enabling coherent forecasts of complex motion patterns. To evaluate at scale, we curate 300 hours of unconstrained animal video with robust shot detection and camera-motion compensation. Experiments show that forecasting trajectory tokens achieves category-agnostic, data-efficient prediction, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and generalizes to rare species and morphologies, providing a foundation for predictive visual intelligence in the wild.
summary_zh: 视觉智能需要预测智能体的未来行为，然而视觉系统一直缺乏通用的运动与行为表征。我们提出将密集点轨迹作为行为视觉标记——这是一种解耦运动与外观的结构化中层表征，可泛化应用于各类非刚性智能体（如野外动物）。基于这一抽象表示，我们设计了一种扩散变换器，能够对无序轨迹集合进行建模，并显式推理遮挡关系，从而实现对复杂运动模式的连贯预测。为进行大规模评估，我们构建了300小时无约束动物视频数据集，采用鲁棒的镜头检测与相机运动补偿技术。实验表明，轨迹标记预测方法实现了类别无关的数据高效预测，其性能超越当前最优基线，并能泛化至稀有物种与形态结构，为野外环境中的预测性视觉智能奠定了重要基础。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for forecasting future motion of agents (e.g., animals) in the wild using dense point trajectories as a mid-level representation and a diffusion transformer model.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用密集点轨迹作为中间表示和扩散Transformer模型，来预测野外智能体（如动物）未来运动的方法。

title: ACT Now: Preempting LVLM Hallucinations via Adaptive Context Integration
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from severe hallucination issues. Existing mitigation strategies predominantly rely on isolated, single-step states to enhance visual focus or suppress strong linguistic priors. However, these static approaches neglect dynamic context changes across the generation process and struggles to correct inherited information loss. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Context inTegration (ACT), a training-free inference intervention method that mitigates hallucination through the adaptive integration of contextual information. Specifically, we first propose visual context exploration, which leverages spatio-temporal profiling to adaptively amplify attention heads responsible for visual exploration. To further facilitate vision-language alignment, we propose semantic context aggregation that marginalizes potential semantic queries to effectively aggregate visual evidence, thereby resolving the information loss caused by the discrete nature of token prediction. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLMs demonstrate that ACT significantly reduces hallucinations and achieves competitive results on both discriminative and generative benchmarks, acting as a robust and highly adaptable solution without compromising fundamental generation capabilities.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）普遍面临严重的幻觉问题。现有的缓解策略主要依赖于孤立的单步状态来增强视觉聚焦或抑制强语言先验。然而，这些静态方法忽略了生成过程中动态上下文的变化，且难以纠正固有的信息损失。为克服这一局限，我们提出自适应上下文集成（ACT）——一种无需训练、通过自适应整合上下文信息来缓解幻觉的推理干预方法。具体而言，我们首先提出视觉上下文探索，该方法利用时空分析自适应放大负责视觉探索的注意力头。为进一步促进视觉-语言对齐，我们提出语义上下文聚合，通过对潜在语义查询进行边缘化来有效整合视觉证据，从而解决由词元预测离散性导致的信息丢失问题。基于多种LVLMs的大量实验表明，ACT能显著减少幻觉，在判别性和生成性基准测试中均取得优异结果，是一种不损害基础生成能力的鲁棒且适应性强的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes Adaptive Context Integration (ACT), a training-free inference intervention method that reduces hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models by adaptively amplifying visual attention and aggregating semantic context.
tldr_zh: 提出自适应上下文集成方法ACT，这是一种无需训练的推理干预方法，通过自适应放大视觉注意力和聚合语义上下文来减少大视觉语言模型中的幻觉。

title: DLWM: Dual Latent World Models enable Holistic Gaussian-centric Pre-training in Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-based autonomous driving has gained much attention due to its low costs and excellent performance. Compared with dense BEV (Bird's Eye View) or sparse query models, Gaussian-centric method is a comprehensive yet sparse representation by describing scene with 3D semantic Gaussians. In this paper, we introduce DLWM, a novel paradigm with Dual Latent World Models specifically designed to enable holistic gaussian-centric pre-training in autonomous driving using two stages. In the first stage, DLWM predicts 3D Gaussians from queries by self-supervised reconstructing multi-view semantic and depth images. Equipped with fine-grained contextual features, in the second stage, two latent world models are trained separately for temporal feature learning, including Gaussian-flow-guided latent prediction for downstream occupancy perception and forecasting tasks, and ego-planning-guided latent prediction for motion planning. Extensive experiments in SurroundOcc and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that DLWM shows significant performance gains across Gaussian-centric 3D occupancy perception, 4D occupancy forecasting and motion planning tasks.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的自动驾驶技术因其低成本与卓越性能而备受关注。与稠密鸟瞰图或稀疏查询模型相比，以高斯分布为核心的方法通过三维语义高斯模型描述场景，形成了一种全面而稀疏的表示体系。本文提出DLWM——一种基于双潜在世界模型的新型范式，专门设计用于通过两阶段实现自动驾驶领域中以高斯分布为核心的整体预训练。在第一阶段，DLWM通过自监督重构多视角语义与深度图像，从查询中预测三维高斯分布。在获得细粒度上下文特征后，第二阶段分别训练两个潜在世界模型以进行时序特征学习：包括为下游占据感知与预测任务设计的高斯流引导潜在预测模型，以及为运动规划设计的自车规划引导潜在预测模型。在SurroundOcc和nuScenes基准测试中的大量实验表明，DLWM在以高斯分布为核心的三维占据感知、四维占据预测和运动规划任务中均展现出显著的性能提升。
tldr: This paper introduces DLWM, a dual latent world model framework for autonomous driving that uses Gaussian-centric representations to perform 3D occupancy perception, forecasting, and motion planning via self-supervised and task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DLWM，一种用于自动驾驶的双重潜在世界模型框架，通过高斯中心表示，利用自监督和任务特定训练执行3D占用感知、预测和运动规划。

title: EmoScene: A Dual-space Dataset for Controllable Affective Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved high visual fidelity, yet precise control over scene semantics and fine-grained affective tone remains challenging. Human visual affect arises from the rapid integration of contextual meaning, including valence, arousal, and dominance, with perceptual cues such as color harmony, luminance contrast, texture variation, curvature, and spatial layout. However, current text-to-image models rarely represent affective and perceptual factors within a unified representation, which limits their ability to synthesize scenes with coherent and nuanced emotional intent. To address this gap, we construct EmoScene, a large-scale dual-space emotion dataset that jointly encodes affective dimensions and perceptual attributes, with contextual semantics provided as supporting annotations. EmoScene contains 1.2M images across more than three hundred real-world scene categories, each annotated with discrete emotion labels, continuous VAD values, perceptual descriptors and textual captions. Multi-space analyses reveal how discrete emotions occupy the VAD space and how affect systematically correlates with scene-level perceptual factors. To benchmark EmoScene, we provide a lightweight reference baseline that injects dual-space controls into a frozen diffusion backbone via shallow cross-attention modulation, serving as a reproducible probe of affect controllability enabled by dual-space supervision.
summary_zh: 文本到图像扩散模型在视觉保真度方面已取得较高成就，但在场景语义与细粒度情感基调的精确控制上仍面临挑战。人类视觉情感产生于语境意义（包括情感效价、唤醒度与支配度）与感知线索（如色彩协调性、亮度对比度、纹理变化、曲率特征和空间布局）的快速整合过程。然而，当前文本到图像模型很少在统一表征中同时体现情感维度与感知要素，这限制了其合成具有连贯且细腻情感意图场景的能力。为弥补这一缺陷，我们构建了EmoScene——一个大规模双空间情感数据集，该数据集联合编码情感维度与感知属性，并以辅助标注形式提供语境语义信息。EmoScene包含超过三百个真实场景类别的120万张图像，每张图像均标注有离散情感标签、连续VAD值、感知描述符及文本描述。多空间分析揭示了离散情感在VAD空间中的分布规律，以及情感如何与场景级感知因素形成系统性关联。为建立EmoScene基准，我们提出了一种轻量级参考基线方案：通过浅层交叉注意力调制将双空间控制注入冻结的扩散模型主干，以此作为可复现的探测手段，验证双空间监督范式对情感可控性的赋能效果。
tldr: Introduces EmoScene, a large-scale dual-space dataset for controllable affective image generation, correlating emotional dimensions with perceptual scene attributes to improve text-to-image models' emotional control.
tldr_zh: 介绍EmoScene，一个用于可控情感图像生成的大规模双空间数据集，将情感维度与场景感知属性相关联，以改进文本到图像模型的情感控制能力。

title: ProCap: Projection-Aware Captioning for Spatial Augmented Reality
summary: Spatial augmented reality (SAR) directly projects digital content onto physical scenes using projectors, creating immersive experience without head-mounted displays. However, for SAR to support intelligent interaction, such as reasoning about the scene or answering user queries, it must semantically distinguish between the physical scene and the projected content. Standard Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle with this virtual-physical ambiguity, often confusing the two contexts. To address this issue, we introduce ProCap, a novel framework that explicitly decouples projected content from physical scenes. ProCap employs a two-stage pipeline: first it visually isolates virtual and physical layers via automated segmentation; then it uses region-aware retrieval to avoid ambiguous semantic context due to projection distortion. To support this, we present RGBP (RGB + Projections), the first large-scale SAR semantic benchmark dataset, featuring 65 diverse physical scenes and over 180,000 projections with dense, decoupled annotations. Finally, we establish a dual-captioning evaluation protocol using task-specific tokens to assess physical scene and projection descriptions independently. Our experiments show that ProCap provides a robust semantic foundation for future SAR research. The source code, pre-trained models and the RGBP dataset are available on the project page: https://ZimoCao.github.io/ProCap/.
summary_zh: 空间增强现实（SAR）利用投影仪将数字内容直接投射至物理场景，无需头戴式显示设备即可营造沉浸式体验。然而，要使SAR支持智能交互（如场景推理或用户问答），系统必须能够从语义层面区分物理场景与投射内容。标准的视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理这种虚实模糊性时面临挑战，常混淆两种语境。为解决此问题，我们提出ProCap——一种显式解耦投射内容与物理场景的新型框架。该框架采用两阶段流程：首先通过自动分割在视觉层面分离虚拟层与物理层；随后利用区域感知检索技术避免因投影变形导致的语义语境歧义。为支持此研究，我们构建了首个大规模SAR语义基准数据集RGBP（RGB+投射数据），包含65个多样化物理场景及超过18万条投射数据，并配备解耦的密集标注。此外，我们建立了基于任务特定标记的双重描述评估协议，可独立评估物理场景与投射内容的描述质量。实验表明，ProCap为未来SAR研究提供了坚实的语义基础。项目源代码、预训练模型及RGBP数据集可通过项目页面获取：https://ZimoCao.github.io/ProCap/。
tldr: ProCap is a framework and dataset for spatial augmented reality (SAR) that uses a two-stage pipeline to visually separate and semantically caption projected content from physical scenes, addressing ambiguity in standard Vision-Language Models.
tldr_zh: ProCap 是一个面向空间增强现实（SAR）的框架和数据集，采用两阶段流程从视觉上分离投影内容与物理场景并进行语义描述，以解决标准视觉语言模型中的虚拟-物理歧义问题。

title: Shape Representation using Gaussian Process mixture models
summary: Traditional explicit 3D representations, such as point clouds and meshes, demand significant storage to capture fine geometric details and require complex indexing systems for surface lookups, making functional representations an efficient, compact, and continuous alternative. In this work, we propose a novel, object-specific functional shape representation that models surface geometry with Gaussian Process (GP) mixture models. Rather than relying on computationally heavy neural architectures, our method is lightweight, leveraging GPs to learn continuous directional distance fields from sparsely sampled point clouds. We capture complex topologies by anchoring local GP priors at strategic reference points, which can be flexibly extracted using any structural decomposition method (e.g. skeletonization, distance-based clustering). Extensive evaluations on the ShapeNetCore and IndustryShapes datasets demonstrate that our method can efficiently and accurately represent complex geometries.
summary_zh: 传统显式三维表示（如点云和网格）需要大量存储空间来捕捉精细几何细节，且依赖复杂索引系统进行表面查找，这使得函数式表示成为一种高效、紧凑且连续的表达方式。本研究提出了一种新颖的、面向特定物体的函数式形状表示方法，采用高斯过程混合模型对表面几何进行建模。与依赖计算密集型神经架构的方法不同，本方法通过轻量化的高斯过程从稀疏采样的点云中学习连续方向距离场。我们通过在策略性参考点处锚定局部高斯过程先验来捕捉复杂拓扑结构，这些参考点可通过任意结构分解方法（如骨架化、基于距离的聚类）灵活提取。在ShapeNetCore和IndustryShapes数据集上的广泛实验表明，本方法能够高效且精确地表示复杂几何形状。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight, object-specific functional shape representation using Gaussian Process mixture models to learn continuous directional distance fields from sparse point clouds, efficiently capturing complex geometries.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用高斯过程混合模型的轻量级、对象特定功能形状表示方法，从稀疏点云中学习连续方向距离场，以高效捕捉复杂几何结构。

title: Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud based Human Motion Capture
summary: Point cloud-based motion capture leverages rich spatial geometry and privacy-preserving sensing, but learning robust representations from noisy, unstructured point clouds remains challenging. Existing approaches face a struggle trade-off between point-based methods (geometrically detailed but noisy) and skeleton-based ones (robust but oversimplified). We address the fundamental challenge: how to construct an effective representation for human motion capture that can balance expressiveness and robustness. In this paper, we propose Sparkle, a structured representation unifying skeletal joints and surface anchors with explicit kinematic-geometric factorization. Our framework, SparkleMotion, learns this representation through hierarchical modules embedding geometric continuity and kinematic constraints. By explicitly disentangling internal kinematic structure from external surface geometry, SparkleMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance not only in accuracy but crucially in robustness and generalization under severe domain shifts, noise, and occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate our superiority across diverse sensor types and challenging real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 摘要：基于点云的运动捕捉技术利用丰富的空间几何特征和隐私保护型传感方式，但如何从带噪声的非结构化点云中学习鲁棒表征仍然面临挑战。现有方法在基于点云的方法（几何细节丰富但噪声敏感）与基于骨架的方法（鲁棒但过度简化）之间难以取得平衡。本文致力于解决这一核心问题：如何构建能够兼顾表达力与鲁棒性的人体运动捕捉表征。我们提出Sparkle表征——一种通过显式运动学-几何因子分解将骨骼关节点与表面锚点统一的结构化表征。我们的框架SparkleMotion通过嵌入几何连续性与运动学约束的层级化模块学习该表征。通过显式解耦内部运动学结构与外部表面几何特征，SparkleMotion不仅在精度上达到先进水平，更在剧烈域偏移、噪声和遮挡条件下的鲁棒性与泛化能力上取得关键突破。大量实验验证了我们在多种传感器类型及复杂现实场景中的综合优势。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel structured representation and framework for human motion capture from point clouds, aiming to balance geometric detail and robustness for handling noise and domain shifts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的结构化表示和框架，用于从点云中捕捉人体运动，旨在平衡几何细节和鲁棒性，以处理噪声和域偏移。

title: MotionGrounder: Grounded Multi-Object Motion Transfer via Diffusion Transformer
summary: Motion transfer enables controllable video generation by transferring temporal dynamics from a reference video to synthesize a new video conditioned on a target caption. However, existing Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based methods are limited to single-object videos, restricting fine-grained control in real-world scenes with multiple objects. In this work, we introduce MotionGrounder, a DiT-based framework that firstly handles motion transfer with multi-object controllability. Our Flow-based Motion Signal (FMS) in MotionGrounder provides a stable motion prior for target video generation, while our Object-Caption Alignment Loss (OCAL) grounds object captions to their corresponding spatial regions. We further propose a new Object Grounding Score (OGS), which jointly evaluates (i) spatial alignment between source video objects and their generated counterparts and (ii) semantic consistency between each generated object and its target caption. Our experiments show that MotionGrounder consistently outperforms recent baselines across quantitative, qualitative, and human evaluations.
summary_zh: 运动迁移技术通过将参考视频中的时序动态转移到目标文本描述的视频生成中，实现可控视频合成。然而，现有基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的方法局限于处理单一对象视频，难以对现实场景中多对象视频进行细粒度控制。本研究提出MotionGrounder——首个基于DiT框架、具备多对象可控能力的运动迁移系统。该框架中设计的流式运动信号（FMS）为目标视频生成提供了稳定的运动先验，而对象-文本对齐损失（OCAL）则将对象描述文本与其对应空间区域进行锚定。我们进一步提出新的对象定位评分（OGS），该指标联合评估（i）源视频对象与生成对象间的空间对齐度，以及（ii）各生成对象与目标文本描述的语义一致性。实验表明，MotionGrounder在定量评估、定性分析和人工评价中均持续优于现有基线方法。
tldr: MotionGrounder is a Diffusion Transformer-based framework for multi-object motion transfer in video generation, enabling fine-grained control of multiple objects through stable motion priors and object-caption alignment.
tldr_zh: MotionGrounder 是一个基于扩散Transformer的框架，用于视频生成中的多物体运动迁移，通过稳定的运动先验和物体-描述对齐，实现对多物体的细粒度控制。

title: Continual Vision-Language Learning for Remote Sensing: Benchmarking and Analysis
summary: Current remote sensing vision-language models (RS VLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in image interpretation but rely on static training data, limiting their ability to accommodate continuously emerging sensing modalities and downstream tasks. This exposes a fundamental challenge: enabling RS VLMs to continually adapt without catastrophic forgetting. Despite its practical importance, the continual learning capability of RS VLMs remains underexplored, and no dedicated benchmark currently exists. In this work, we present CLeaRS, a comprehensive benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing. CLeaRS comprises 10 curated subsets with over 207k image-text pairs, spanning diverse interpretation tasks, sensing modalities, and application scenarios. We further define three evaluation protocols: long-horizon, modality-incremental, and task-incremental settings, to systematically assess continual adaptation. Extensive benchmarking of diverse vision-language models reveals catastrophic forgetting across all settings. Moreover, representative continual learning methods, when adapted to RS VLMs, exhibit limited effectiveness in handling task, instruction, and modality transitions. Our findings underscore the need for developing continual learning methods tailored to RS VLMs.
summary_zh: 当前遥感视觉语言模型在图像解译方面展现出卓越性能，但依赖静态训练数据，限制了其适应持续涌现的新型感知模态与下游任务的能力。这揭示了一个根本性挑战：如何使遥感视觉语言模型实现持续适应而不发生灾难性遗忘。尽管该问题具有重要实际意义，遥感视觉语言模型的持续学习能力仍未被充分探索，且目前缺乏专门的评测基准。本研究提出CLeaRS——一个面向遥感领域的综合性持续视觉语言学习基准。CLeaRS包含10个精选子集，涵盖超过20.7万组图像-文本对，涉及多种解译任务、感知模态和应用场景。我们进一步定义了三类评估协议：长周期评估、模态增量评估与任务增量评估，以系统化衡量持续适应能力。通过对多种视觉语言模型进行广泛测试，发现所有评估场景下均存在灾难性遗忘现象。此外，当代表性持续学习方法适配至遥感视觉语言模型时，在处理任务、指令与模态转换方面表现出有限效能。我们的研究结果强调，亟需开发针对遥感视觉语言模型特性设计的持续学习方法。
tldr: Introduces a benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing, showing catastrophic forgetting in current models and highlighting the need for tailored continual learning methods.
tldr_zh: 为遥感领域提出一个持续视觉-语言学习基准，展示当前模型的灾难性遗忘问题，并强调需要专门针对性的持续学习方法。

title: Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies
summary: Spatial consistency is a fundamental property of the visual world and a key requirement for models that aim to understand physical reality. Despite recent advances, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to reason about 3D geometry across multiple views. Rather than asking models to describe scene attributes, we introduce a more challenging task: given two views of the same scene, identify the object that violates 3D motion consistency. We propose a simple and scalable method for generating realistic, spatially inconsistent image pairs from multi-view scenes, enabling systematic evaluation of this capability. Our results show that state-of-the-art MLLMs significantly underperform human observers and exhibit substantial variability across different scene attributes, revealing a fragile and incomplete understanding of 3D structure. We hope our findings underscore the need for approaches that develop a more deeply grounded understanding of the physical world.
summary_zh: 空间一致性是视觉世界的基本属性，也是旨在理解物理现实的模型的关键要求。尽管近期取得了进展，但多模态大语言模型在跨多视角进行三维几何推理时仍面临困难。不同于要求模型描述场景属性，我们引入了一项更具挑战性的任务：给定同一场景的两个视角，识别违反三维运动一致性的物体。我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的方法，用于从多视角场景中生成真实且空间不一致的图像对，从而系统评估该能力。实验结果表明，当前最先进的多模态大语言模型显著落后于人类观察者，且在不同场景属性上表现出巨大差异，揭示其对三维结构的理解是脆弱且不完整的。我们希望这些发现能强调需要开发更深入理解物理世界的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models' ability to identify spatial inconsistencies between two views of a scene, finding they perform poorly.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个评估多模态大语言模型在识别多视角场景中空间不一致性方面能力的基准，发现其表现不佳。

title: An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models
summary: Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 7515 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. Code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 手术视频理解是推动计算机辅助手术发展的关键前提。尽管视觉语言模型最近已被应用于手术领域，但现有手术视觉语言数据集在捕捉和评估复杂的交织时空动态方面存在不足。由于手动标注成本高昂或使用大语言模型生成易出错，创建能准确反映手术视频中细粒度时空关系的大规模数据集颇具挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SurgSTU-Pipeline——一种确定性生成流程，通过时空连续性过滤技术，可靠地创建用于细粒度时空多模态理解的手术数据集。将该流程应用于公开手术数据集，我们构建了SurgSTU数据集，包含7515个视频片段及密集扩展的15万个细粒度时空问答样本。综合评估表明，虽然当前先进的通用视觉语言模型在零样本设置下表现欠佳，但通过上下文学习可以提升其时空理解能力。在SurgSTU训练数据集上微调的视觉语言模型在所有时空任务中均取得最优性能，验证了该数据集对提升手术视频时空理解能力的有效性。代码将公开发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a pipeline and dataset (SurgSTU) to enhance fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding of vision-language models in surgical videos, improving VLM performance through in-context learning and fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种流程和数据集（SurgSTU），以增强手术视频中视觉语言模型的细粒度时空理解能力，通过上下文学习和微调提升VLM性能。

title: PrivHAR-Bench: A Graduated Privacy Benchmark Dataset for Video-Based Action Recognition
summary: Existing research on privacy-preserving Human Activity Recognition (HAR) typically evaluates methods against a binary paradigm: clear video versus a single privacy transformation. This limits cross-method comparability and obscures the nuanced relationship between privacy strength and recognition utility. We introduce \textit{PrivHAR-Bench}, a multi-tier benchmark dataset designed to standardize the evaluation of the \textit{Privacy-Utility Trade-off} in video-based action recognition. PrivHAR-Bench applies a graduated spectrum of visual privacy transformations: from lightweight spatial obfuscation to cryptographic block permutation, to a curated subset of 15 activity classes selected for human articulation diversity. Each of the 1,932 source videos is distributed across 9 parallel tiers of increasing privacy strength, with additional background-removed variants to isolate the contribution of human motion features from contextual scene bias. We provide lossless frame sequences, per-frame bounding boxes, estimated pose keypoints with joint-level confidence scores, standardized group-based train/test splits, and an evaluation toolkit computing recognition accuracy and privacy metrics. Empirical validation using R3D-18 demonstrates a measurable and interpretable degradation curve across tiers, with within-tier accuracy declining from 88.8\% (clear) to 53.5\% (encrypted, background-removed) and cross-domain accuracy collapsing to 4.8\%, establishing PrivHAR-Bench as a controlled benchmark for comparing privacy-preserving HAR methods under standardized conditions. The dataset, generation pipeline, and evaluation code are publicly available.
summary_zh: 现有关于隐私保护人体活动识别（HAR）的研究通常在二元范式下评估方法：即清晰视频与单一隐私转换的对比。这限制了不同方法间的可比性，并模糊了隐私强度与识别效用间的微妙关系。我们引入了 \textit{PrivHAR-Bench}——一个多层级基准数据集，旨在标准化基于视频的动作识别中 \textit{隐私-效用权衡} 的评估。PrivHAR-Bench 应用了渐进式的视觉隐私转换谱系：从轻量级空间模糊化到加密块置换，并针对人体关节活动多样性精选了15个动作类别。总计1,932个源视频均被处理为9个并行层级，隐私强度逐级递增，并额外提供背景去除版本以隔离人体运动特征与场景背景偏差的影响。我们提供无损帧序列、逐帧边界框、带有关节置信度分数的估计姿态关键点、标准化的分组训练/测试划分，以及计算识别准确率与隐私指标的评估工具包。使用R3D-18模型进行的实证验证显示，各层级间存在可测量且可解释的性能衰减曲线：层内准确率从88.8%（清晰视频）下降至53.5%（加密且背景去除版本），而跨域准确率骤降至4.8%，这确立了PrivHAR-Bench作为在标准化条件下比较隐私保护HAR方法的可控基准。数据集、生成流程及评估代码均已公开。
tldr: This paper introduces PrivHAR-Bench, a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the privacy-utility trade-off in video-based human action recognition, featuring a graduated spectrum of visual privacy transformations on a curated set of activity videos.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PrivHAR-Bench，这是一个用于评估视频行为识别中隐私-效用权衡的基准数据集，它对一组精选的活动视频应用了从轻微到加密的渐进式隐私保护变换。

title: TP-Seg: Task-Prototype Framework for Unified Medical Lesion Segmentation
summary: Building a unified model with a single set of parameters to efficiently handle diverse types of medical lesion segmentation has become a crucial objective for AI-assisted diagnosis. Existing unified segmentation approaches typically rely on shared encoders across heterogeneous tasks and modalities, which often leads to feature entanglement, gradient interference, and suboptimal lesion discrimination. In this work, we propose TP-Seg, a task-prototype framework for unified medical lesion segmentation. On one hand, the task-conditioned adapter effectively balances shared and task-specific representations through a dual-path expert structure, enabling adaptive feature extraction across diverse medical imaging modalities and lesion types. On the other hand, the prototype-guided task decoder introduces learnable task prototypes as semantic anchors and employs a cross-attention mechanism to achieve fine-grained modeling of task-specific foreground and background semantics. Without bells and whistles, TP-Seg consistently outperforms specialized, general and unified segmentation methods across 8 different medical lesion segmentation tasks covering multiple imaging modalities, demonstrating strong generalization, scalability and clinical applicability.
summary_zh: 构建一个具有单一参数集的统一模型以高效处理多种类型的医学病灶分割，已成为AI辅助诊断的关键目标。现有的统一分割方法通常依赖于跨异构任务和模态的共享编码器，这往往导致特征纠缠、梯度干扰和病灶识别能力欠佳。本研究提出TP-Seg，一种用于统一医学病灶分割的任务原型框架。一方面，任务条件适配器通过双路径专家结构有效平衡共享与任务特定表征，实现跨多模态医学影像和病灶类型的自适应特征提取；另一方面，原型引导的任务解码器引入可学习的任务原型作为语义锚点，并采用交叉注意力机制实现对任务特定前景与背景语义的细粒度建模。无需复杂修饰，TP-Seg在涵盖多种成像模态的8个不同医学病灶分割任务中，持续超越专用模型、通用模型及统一分割方法，展现出强大的泛化能力、可扩展性和临床适用性。
tldr: Proposes TP-Seg, a task-prototype framework for unified medical lesion segmentation, using task-conditioned adapters and prototype-guided decoders to improve performance across diverse imaging modalities and lesion types.
tldr_zh: 提出了TP-Seg，一个用于统一医学病灶分割的任务原型框架，通过任务条件适配器和原型引导的解码器来提升跨多种影像模态和病灶类型的性能。

title: CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) require continual learning to adapt to non-stationary real-world data. However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating modern foundation models: many still rely on models without large-scale pre-training, and prevailing benchmarks typically partition a single dataset into sub-tasks, resulting in high task redundancy and negligible forgetting on pre-trained Video-LLMs. To address these limitations, we propose CL-VISTA, a benchmark tailored for continual video understanding of Video-LLMs. By curating 8 diverse tasks spanning perception, understanding, and reasoning, CL-VISTA induces substantial distribution shifts that effectively expose catastrophic forgetting. To systematically assess CL methods, we establish a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising 6 distinct protocols across 3 critical dimensions: performance, computational efficiency, and memory footprint. Notably, the performance dimension incorporates a general video understanding assessment to assess whether CL methods genuinely enhance foundational intelligence or merely induce task-specific overfitting. Extensive benchmarking of 10 mainstream CL methods reveals a fundamental trade-off: no single approach achieves universal superiority across all dimensions. Methods that successfully mitigate catastrophic forgetting tend to compromise generalization or incur prohibitive computational and memory overheads. We hope CL-VISTA provides critical insights for advancing continual learning in multimodal foundation models.
summary_zh: 视频大语言模型需要持续学习以应对现实世界中非平稳的数据流。然而，现有基准测试在评估现代基础模型方面存在不足：许多仍依赖未经过大规模预训练的模型，且主流基准通常将单一数据集分割为子任务，导致任务冗余度高，并在预训练视频大语言模型上表现出可忽略的遗忘现象。为突破这些局限，我们提出CL-VISTA——一个专为视频大语言模型持续视频理解而设计的基准测试。通过精心构建涵盖感知、理解与推理的8个多样化任务，CL-VISTA引发显著的分布偏移，从而有效暴露灾难性遗忘问题。为系统评估持续学习方法，我们建立了一套包含6种不同协议的全面评估框架，涵盖性能、计算效率与内存占用三大关键维度。值得注意的是，性能维度引入了通用视频理解评估，以检验持续学习方法是否真正提升基础智能而非仅导致任务特定过拟合。对10种主流持续学习方法的广泛测试揭示了一个根本性权衡：没有任何方法能在所有维度上实现普遍优越性。成功缓解灾难性遗忘的方法往往需以牺牲泛化能力为代价，或承受高昂的计算与内存开销。我们希望CL-VISTA能为推进多模态基础模型的持续学习研究提供关键见解。
tldr: The paper introduces CL-VISTA, a benchmark for evaluating continual learning in Video Large Language Models across diverse tasks, revealing trade-offs between forgetting mitigation, generalization, and computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CL-VISTA，一个用于评估视频大语言模型持续学习能力的基准，旨在揭示不同方法在缓解遗忘、泛化能力和计算开销之间的权衡。

title: DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient 3D scene reconstruction from everyday images with real-time, high-fidelity rendering, greatly advancing VR/AR applications. Fisheye cameras, with their wider field of view (FOV), promise high-quality reconstructions from fewer inputs and have recently attracted much attention. However, since 3DGS relies on rasterization, most subsequent works involving fisheye camera inputs first undistort images before training, which introduces two problems: 1) Black borders at image edges cause information loss and negate the fisheye's large FOV advantage; 2) Undistortion's stretch-and-interpolate resampling spreads each pixel's value over a larger area, diluting detail density -- causes 3DGS overfitting these low-frequency zones, producing blur and floating artifacts. In this work, we integrate fisheye camera model into the original 3DGS framework, enabling native fisheye image input for training without preprocessing. Despite correct modeling, we observed that the reconstructed scenes still exhibit floaters at image edges: Distortion increases toward the periphery, and 3DGS's original per-iteration random-selecting-view optimization ignores the cross-view correlations of a Gaussian, leading to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that degrade reconstruction quality. To address this, we introduce a feature-overlap-driven cross-view joint optimization strategy that establishes consistent geometric and photometric constraints across views-a technique equally applicable to existing pinhole-camera-based pipelines. Our DirectFisheye-GS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance on public datasets.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)实现了从日常图像中进行高效3D场景重建，具备实时高保真渲染能力，极大推动了VR/AR应用发展。鱼眼相机因其更宽的视场角，能够以更少的输入实现高质量重建，近期受到广泛关注。然而，由于3DGS依赖栅格化技术，大多数涉及鱼眼相机输入的后续研究在训练前会先对图像进行去畸变处理，这引发了两个问题：1) 图像边缘的黑边会导致信息丢失，抵消鱼眼大视场角的优势；2) 去畸变过程中的拉伸-插值重采样会将每个像素值分散到更大区域，降低细节密度——导致3DGS过度拟合这些低频区域，产生模糊和漂浮伪影。本研究将鱼眼相机模型整合到原始3DGS框架中，实现了无需预处理的原始鱼眼图像输入训练。尽管建模正确，我们观察到重建场景在图像边缘仍存在漂浮物：畸变随边缘区域增大而增强，而3DGS原有的每轮迭代随机选视角优化策略忽略了高斯分布跨视角相关性，导致产生极端形状（如超大或过度拉长）从而降低重建质量。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种特征重叠驱动的跨视角联合优化策略，建立跨视角间一致的几何与光度约束——该技术同样适用于现有基于针孔相机的处理流程。我们的DirectFisheye-GS在公开数据集上达到或超越了当前最优性能水平。
tldr: This paper proposes DirectFisheye-GS, a method that integrates a fisheye camera model into 3D Gaussian Splatting for 3D scene reconstruction, enabling native fisheye input and a cross-view joint optimization strategy to reduce artifacts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DirectFisheye-GS，将鱼眼相机模型集成到3D高斯泼溅中进行场景重建，支持原生鱼眼图像输入，并引入跨视图联合优化策略以减少伪影。

title: TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
summary: Referring image segmentation aims to segment specific targets based on a natural text expression. Recently, parameter-efficient tuning (PET) has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing PET-based methods often suffer from the fact that visual features can't emphasize the text-referred target instance but activate co-category yet unrelated objects. We analyze and quantify this problem, terming it the `non-target activation' (NTA) issue. To address this, we propose a novel framework, TALENT, which utilizes target-aware efficient tuning for PET-based RIS. Specifically, we first propose a Rectified Cost Aggregator (RCA) to efficiently aggregate text-referred features. Then, to calibrate `NTA' into accurate target activation, we adopt a Target-aware Learning Mechanism (TLM), including contextual pairwise consistency learning and target-centric contrastive learning. The former uses the sentence-level text feature to achieve a holistic understanding of the referent and constructs a text-referred affinity map to optimize the semantic association of visual features. The latter further enhances target localization to discover the distinct instance while suppressing associations with other unrelated ones. The two objectives work in concert and address `NTA' effectively. Extensive evaluations show that TALENT outperforms existing methods across various metrics (e.g., 2.5\% mIoU gains on G-Ref val set). Our codes will be released at: https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT.
summary_zh: 指向性图像分割旨在根据自然语言表达分割特定目标。近年来，参数高效调优（PET）已成为一种颇具前景的研究范式。然而，现有基于PET的方法常面临视觉特征难以聚焦文本所指目标实例，反而激活同类但无关物体的问题。我们对此现象进行了分析与量化，并将其定义为“非目标激活”（NTA）问题。为解决该问题，我们提出了新型框架TALENT，通过目标感知高效调优实现基于PET的指向性图像分割。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种校正成本聚合器（RCA）以高效聚合文本相关特征；随后，为将“非目标激活”校准为目标精准激活，我们引入了目标感知学习机制（TLM），包含上下文配对一致性学习与目标中心对比学习。前者利用句子级文本特征实现对指代目标的整体理解，并构建文本指代关联图以优化视觉特征的语义关联；后者则进一步强化目标定位能力，在凸显特定实例的同时抑制与其他无关对象的关联。二者协同作用，有效解决了“非目标激活”问题。大量实验表明，TALENT在多项指标上均优于现有方法（例如在G-Ref验证集上mIoU指标提升2.5%）。代码已发布于：https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT。
tldr: Proposes TALENT, a target-aware parameter-efficient tuning method for referring image segmentation that addresses the 'non-target activation' issue using a rectified cost aggregator and a target-aware learning mechanism.
tldr_zh: 提出了TALENT方法，一种用于参考图像分割的目标感知参数高效微调方法，通过修正成本聚合器和目标感知学习机制来解决'非目标激活'问题。

title: Fluently Lying: Adversarial Robustness Can Be Substrate-Dependent
summary: The primary tools used to monitor and defend object detectors under adversarial attack assume that when accuracy degrades, detection count drops in tandem. This coupling was assumed, not measured. We report a counterexample observed on a single model: under standard PGD, EMS-YOLO, a spiking neural network (SNN) object detector, retains more than 70% of its detections while mAP collapses from 0.528 to 0.042. We term this count-preserving accuracy collapse Quality Corruption (QC), to distinguish it from the suppression that dominates untargeted evaluation. Across four SNN architectures and two threat models (l-infinity and l-2), QC appears only in one of the four detectors tested (EMS-YOLO). On this model, all five standard defense components fail to detect or mitigate QC, suggesting the defense ecosystem may rely on a shared assumption calibrated on a single substrate. These results provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that adversarial failure modes can be substrate-dependent.
summary_zh: 用于监控和防御对抗攻击下目标检测器的主要工具，默认准确率下降时检测数量会同步减少。这种关联性是被假设而非实际测量的。我们报告在单个模型上观察到的反例：在标准PGD攻击下，脉冲神经网络目标检测器EMS-YOLO的检测数量保留了70%以上，而mAP指标却从0.528骤降至0.042。我们将这种数量保持而精度崩溃的现象称为“质量腐化”，以区别于在非定向评估中占主导的“抑制效应”。通过对四种SNN架构和两种威胁模型（l-无穷和l-2范数）的测试，质量腐化仅出现在四种检测器中的一种（EMS-YOLO）上。在该模型上，所有五种标准防御组件均未能检测或缓解质量腐化，这表明防御生态系统可能依赖于针对单一基础模型校准的共享假设。据我们所知，这些结果首次证明了对抗性失效模式可能具有基础模型依赖性。
tldr: This paper investigates adversarial failure modes in Spiking Neural Network (SNN) object detectors, identifying a 'Quality Corruption' effect where detection count remains high but accuracy collapses, and finds this phenomenon to be substrate-dependent.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了脉冲神经网络（SNN）目标检测器中的对抗性故障模式，发现一种'质量腐败'现象，即检测数量保持高位但准确率崩溃，且该现象具有底物依赖性。

title: Reliev3R: Relieving Feed-forward Reconstruction from Multi-View Geometric Annotations
summary: With recent advances, Feed-forward Reconstruction Models (FFRMs) have demonstrated great potential in reconstruction quality and adaptiveness to multiple downstream tasks. However, the excessive reliance on multi-view geometric annotations, e.g. 3D point maps and camera poses, makes the fully-supervised training scheme of FFRMs difficult to scale up. In this paper, we propose Reliev3R, a weakly-supervised paradigm for training FFRMs from scratch without cost-prohibitive multi-view geometric annotations. Relieving the reliance on geometric sensory data and compute-exhaustive structure-from-motion preprocessing, our method draws 3D knowledge directly from monocular relative depths and image sparse correspondences given by zero-shot predictions of pretrained models. At the core of Reliev3R, we design an ambiguity-aware relative depth loss and a trigonometry-based reprojection loss to facilitate supervision for multi-view geometric consistency. Training from scratch with the less data, Reliev3R catches up with its fully-supervised sibling models, taking a step towards low-cost 3D reconstruction supervisions and scalable FFRMs.
summary_zh: 近年来，前馈重建模型在重建质量与对多下游任务的适应性方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这类模型对多视图几何标注（如三维点云图与相机位姿）的过度依赖，使得其全监督训练方案难以大规模扩展。本文提出Reliev3R——一种弱监督训练范式，可在无需昂贵多视图几何标注的情况下从头训练前馈重建模型。该方法通过消除对几何传感数据与计算密集的运动恢复结构预处理流程的依赖，直接利用预训练模型零样本预测生成的单目相对深度与图像稀疏对应关系来提取三维知识。Reliev3R的核心在于设计了模糊感知相对深度损失与基于三角关系的重投影损失，从而为多视图几何一致性提供有效的监督信号。在数据量更少的情况下，通过从头训练，Reliev3R达到了与全监督基准模型相当的性能，为低成本三维重建监督与可扩展的前馈重建模型迈出了重要一步。
tldr: A weakly-supervised training method for feed-forward 3D reconstruction models that reduces reliance on costly multi-view geometric annotations by using zero-shot predictions from pretrained models.
tldr_zh: 一种用于前馈式3D重建模型的弱监督训练方法，通过使用预训练模型的零样本预测，减少对昂贵多视图几何标注的依赖。

title: AceTone: Bridging Words and Colors for Conditional Image Grading
summary: Color affects how we interpret image style and emotion. Previous color grading methods rely on patch-wise recoloring or fixed filter banks, struggling to generalize across creative intents or align with human aesthetic preferences. In this study, we propose AceTone, the first approach that supports multimodal conditioned color grading within a unified framework. AceTone formulates grading as a generative color transformation task, where a model directly produces 3D-LUTs conditioned on text prompts or reference images. We develop a VQ-VAE based tokenizer which compresses a $3\times32^3$ LUT vector to 64 discrete tokens with $ΔE<2$ fidelity. We further build a large-scale dataset, AceTone-800K, and train a vision-language model to predict LUT tokens, followed by reinforcement learning to align outputs with perceptual fidelity and aesthetics. Experiments show that AceTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both text-guided and reference-guided grading tasks, improving LPIPS by up to 50% over existing methods. Human evaluations confirm that AceTone's results are visually pleasing and stylistically coherent, demonstrating a new pathway toward language-driven, aesthetic-aligned color grading.
summary_zh: 色彩影响着我们对图像风格与情感的理解。现有调色方法多依赖分块重着色或固定滤镜库，难以适应多样化创作意图或契合人类审美偏好。本研究提出首个支持多模态条件调色的统一框架AceTone，将调色任务构建为生成式色彩转换过程，通过模型直接生成基于文本提示或参考图像的3D-LUT。我们开发了基于VQ-VAE的编码器，将$3\times32^3$维LUT向量压缩至64个离散表征单元，在$ΔE<2$的色彩保真度下实现高效编码。进一步构建大规模数据集AceTone-800K，训练视觉语言模型预测LUT表征单元，并引入强化学习机制使输出结果同时满足感知保真度与美学要求。实验表明，AceTone在文本引导与参考引导的调色任务中均达到最优性能，较现有方法将LPIPS指标提升超50%。人工评估证实AceTone生成结果兼具视觉美感与风格一致性，为语言驱动、审美对齐的智能调色开辟了新路径。
tldr: AceTone introduces a multimodal framework for color grading that generates 3D-LUTs conditioned on text or reference images, using a VQ-VAE tokenizer and vision-language model trained with reinforcement learning for aesthetic alignment.
tldr_zh: AceTone 提出了一种多模态色彩分级框架，能够根据文本或参考图像生成 3D-LUT，采用了 VQ-VAE 分词器和视觉语言模型，并结合强化学习进行美学对齐训练。

title: RT-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Reflection and Transmittance Primitives
summary: Gaussian Splatting is a powerful tool for reconstructing diffuse scenes, but it struggles to simultaneously model specular reflections and the appearance of objects behind semi-transparent surfaces. These specular reflections and transmittance are essential for realistic novel view synthesis, and existing methods do not properly incorporate the underlying physical processes to simulate them. To address this issue, we propose RT-GS, a unified framework that integrates a microfacet material model and ray tracing to jointly model specular reflection and transmittance in Gaussian Splatting. We accomplish this by using separate Gaussian primitives for reflections and transmittance, which allow modeling distant reflections and reconstructing objects behind transparent surfaces concurrently. We utilize a differentiable ray tracing framework to obtain the specular reflection and transmittance appearance. Our experiments demonstrate that our method successfully produces reflections and recovers objects behind transparent surfaces in complex environments, achieving significant qualitative improvements over prior methods where these specular light interactions are prominent.
summary_zh: 高斯溅射是重建漫射场景的有力工具，但在同时建模镜面反射与半透明表面后方物体外观时存在困难。这些镜面反射与透射现象对于实现逼真的新视角合成至关重要，而现有方法未能充分结合底层物理过程进行模拟。为解决此问题，我们提出RT-GS这一统一框架，通过集成微表面材质模型与光线追踪技术，在高斯溅射中实现镜面反射与透射的联合建模。我们采用分离的高斯基元分别处理反射与透射现象，从而实现对远处反射的建模与透明表面后方物体的同步重建。通过可微分光线追踪框架，我们精确获取镜面反射与透射的外观表现。实验结果表明，本方法在复杂环境中成功生成反射效果并重建透明表面后的物体，在镜面光交互作用显著的场景中，较现有方法实现了质的提升。
tldr: RT-GS introduces a new method for 3D scene reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting, which separately models specular reflections and light transmittance through transparent surfaces via a differentiable ray-tracing framework to improve novel view synthesis.
tldr_zh: RT-GS提出了一种基于高斯泼溅的3D场景重建新方法，通过可微分光线追踪框架分别建模镜面反射和光线在半透明表面的透射，以提升新视角合成的质量。

title: RegFormer: Transferable Relational Grounding for Efficient Weakly-Supervised Human-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Weakly-supervised Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is essential for scalable scene understanding, as it learns interactions from only image-level annotations. Due to the lack of localization signals, prior works typically rely on an external object detector to generate candidate pairs and then infer their interactions through pairwise reasoning. However, this framework often struggles to scale due to the substantial computational cost incurred by enumerating numerous instance pairs. In addition, it suffers from false positives arising from non-interactive combinations, which hinder accurate instance-level HOI reasoning. To address these issues, we introduce Relational Grounding Transformer (RegFormer), a versatile interaction recognition module for efficient and accurate HOI reasoning. Under image-level supervision, RegFormer leverages spatially grounded signals as guidance for the reasoning process and promotes locality-aware interaction learning. By learning localized interaction cues, our module distinguishes humans, objects, and their interactions, enabling direct transfer from image-level interaction reasoning to precise and efficient instance-level reasoning without additional training. Our extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that RegFormer effectively learns spatial cues for instance-level interaction reasoning, operates with high efficiency, and even achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Our code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/RegFormer.
summary_zh: 弱监督人物-物体交互检测对于可扩展的场景理解至关重要，它仅通过图像级标注学习交互关系。由于缺乏定位信号，先前研究通常依赖外部物体检测器生成候选对象对，再通过成对推理推断其交互关系。然而，这种框架在枚举大量实例对时会产生巨大计算成本，导致可扩展性受限。此外，非交互组合产生的误检会阻碍准确的实例级交互推理。为解决这些问题，我们提出关系定位变换器——这是一种高效的交互识别模块，能够实现准确的人物-物体交互推理。在图像级监督下，该模块利用空间定位信号引导推理过程，促进局部感知的交互学习。通过学习局部化的交互线索，我们的模块能够区分人物、物体及其交互关系，实现从图像级交互推理到精准高效的实例级推理的直接迁移，无需额外训练。大量实验与分析表明，我们的模块能有效学习实例级交互推理的空间线索，以高效率运行，其性能甚至可与全监督模型相媲美。代码已开源。
tldr: RegFormer is a weakly-supervised transformer model for efficient Human-Object Interaction detection that learns to ground interaction cues spatially, enabling direct transfer to instance-level reasoning without extra training.
tldr_zh: RegFormer是一种用于弱监督人-物交互检测的高效Transformer模型，它学习空间定位交互线索，无需额外训练即可直接迁移到实例级推理。

title: PET-DINO: Unifying Visual Cues into Grounding DINO with Prompt-Enriched Training
summary: Open-Set Object Detection (OSOD) enables recognition of novel categories beyond fixed classes but faces challenges in aligning text representations with complex visual concepts and the scarcity of image-text pairs for rare categories. This results in suboptimal performance in specialized domains or with complex objects. Recent visual-prompted methods partially address these issues but often involve complex multi-modal designs and multi-stage optimizations, prolonging the development cycle. Additionally, effective training strategies for data-driven OSOD models remain largely unexplored. To address these challenges, we propose PET-DINO, a universal detector supporting both text and visual prompts. Our Alignment-Friendly Visual Prompt Generation (AFVPG) module builds upon an advanced text-prompted detector, addressing the limitations of text representation guidance and reducing the development cycle. We introduce two prompt-enriched training strategies: Intra-Batch Parallel Prompting (IBP) at the iteration level and Dynamic Memory-Driven Prompting (DMD) at the overall training level. These strategies enable simultaneous modeling of multiple prompt routes, facilitating parallel alignment with diverse real-world usage scenarios. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PET-DINO exhibits competitive zero-shot object detection capabilities across various prompt-based detection protocols. These strengths can be attributed to inheritance-based philosophy and prompt-enriched training strategies, which play a critical role in building an effective generic object detector. Project page: https://fuweifuvtoo.github.io/pet-dino.
summary_zh: 开放集目标检测（OSOD）能够识别超出固定类别的新颖类别，但面临着将文本表示与复杂视觉概念对齐的挑战，以及稀有类别图像-文本对的稀缺性问题。这导致在专业领域或处理复杂对象时性能表现不佳。近期的视觉提示方法部分解决了这些问题，但通常涉及复杂的多模态设计和多阶段优化，延长了开发周期。此外，针对数据驱动的OSOD模型的有效训练策略仍很大程度上未被探索。为应对这些挑战，我们提出PET-DINO——一种同时支持文本和视觉提示的通用检测器。我们提出的对齐友好视觉提示生成（AFVPG）模块基于先进的文本提示检测器，解决了文本表示引导的局限性，并缩短了开发周期。我们引入了两种提示增强的训练策略：迭代级的批内并行提示（IBP）和整体训练级的动态记忆驱动提示（DMD）。这些策略能够同时建模多种提示路径，促进与多样化现实应用场景的并行对齐。综合实验表明，PET-DINO在各种基于提示的检测协议中展现出具有竞争力的零样本目标检测能力。这些优势可归因于基于继承的设计理念和提示增强的训练策略，它们对构建有效的通用目标检测器起到关键作用。项目页面：https://fuweifuvtoo.github.io/pet-dino。
tldr: PET-DINO is a universal object detector for open-set detection that supports both text and visual prompts, using novel prompt-enriched training strategies to improve zero-shot capabilities.
tldr_zh: PET-DINO是一个支持文本和视觉提示的通用开放集目标检测器，通过新颖的提示增强训练策略提升零样本能力。

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Incentivizing Divergent Thinking in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent studies have demonstrated that Reinforcement Learning (RL), notably Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), can intrinsically elicit and enhance the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, despite the promise, the underlying mechanisms that drive the effectiveness of RL models as well as their limitations remain underexplored. In this paper, we highlight a fundamental behavioral distinction between RL and base models, where the former engages in deeper yet narrow reasoning, while base models, despite less refined along individual path, exhibit broader and more diverse thinking patterns. Through further analysis of training dynamics, we show that GRPO is prone to diversity collapse, causing models to prematurely converge to a limited subset of reasoning strategies while discarding the majority of potential alternatives, leading to local optima and poor scalability. To address this, we propose Multi-Group Policy Optimization (MUPO), a simple yet effective approach designed to incentivize divergent thinking across multiple solutions, and demonstrate its effectiveness on established benchmarks. Project page: https://xytian1008.github.io/MUPO/
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近期研究表明，强化学习（RL），尤其是组相对策略优化（GRPO），能够从本质上激发并增强视觉语言模型（VLMs）的推理能力。然而，尽管前景广阔，驱动强化学习模型有效性的内在机制及其局限性仍缺乏深入探索。本文揭示了强化学习模型与基础模型之间存在的基本行为差异：前者倾向于深入而狭窄的推理，而基础模型尽管在单一路径上的推理不够精细，却展现出更广泛且多样化的思维模式。通过对训练动态的进一步分析，我们发现GRPO容易陷入多样性崩溃，导致模型过早收敛至有限的推理策略子集，而丢弃了大部分潜在替代方案，从而陷入局部最优且可扩展性较差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多组策略优化（MUPO），这是一种简单而有效的方法，旨在激励针对多个解决方案的多样化思维，并在已有基准测试中验证了其有效性。项目页面：https://xytian1008.github.io/MUPO/
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve the diversity of reasoning in Vision-Language Models trained with RL, which is prone to premature convergence on narrow strategies, and suggests a new approach for encouraging multiple solution paths.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，用于改善基于强化学习训练的视觉语言模型推理的多样性，这类模型易过早收敛于狭窄的策略，并提出一种新方法来鼓励模型探索多种解决方案路径。

title: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge: Strong MLLMs Meet SAM3 for Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: This report presents our winning solution to the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge. The track studies referring video object segmentation under motion-centric language expressions, where the model must jointly understand appearance, temporal behavior, and object interactions. To address this problem, we build a fully training-free pipeline that combines strong multimodal large language models with SAM3. Our method contains three stages. First, Gemini-3.1 Pro decomposes each target event into instance-level grounding targets, selects the frame where the target is most clearly visible, and generates a discriminative description. Second, SAM3-agent produces a precise seed mask on the selected frame, and the official SAM3 tracker propagates the mask through the whole video. Third, a refinement stage uses Qwen3.5-Plus and behavior-level verification to correct ambiguous or semantically inconsistent predictions. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our method ranks first on the PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text test set, achieving a Final score of 0.909064 and a J&F score of 0.7897. The code is available at https://github.com/Moujuruo/MeViSv2_Track_Solution_2026.
summary_zh: 本报告介绍了我们在第五届PVUW MeViS-Text挑战赛中的获胜方案。该赛道研究以运动为中心的语言表达下的视频目标分割任务，模型需要同时理解外观特征、时序行为及目标间交互关系。为解决此问题，我们构建了一个完全无需训练的流程，将强大的多模态大语言模型与SAM3相结合。我们的方法包含三个阶段：首先，Gemini-3.1 Pro将每个目标事件分解为实例级定位目标，选择目标最清晰可见的帧，并生成判别性描述；其次，SAM3代理在选定帧上生成精确的初始掩膜，并由官方SAM3跟踪器将掩膜传播至整个视频；最后，通过Qwen3.5-Plus结合行为级验证的优化阶段，对模糊或语义不一致的预测结果进行修正。在不进行任务特定微调的情况下，我们的方法在PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text测试集上排名第一，最终得分为0.909064，J&F得分为0.7897。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/Moujuruo/MeViSv2_Track_Solution_2026。
tldr: Winning, training-free method for referring video object segmentation uses MLLMs to decompose motion-centric language, SAM3 for segmentation and tracking, and refinement with LLM-based verification.
tldr_zh: 这是一个针对视频指代分割的获奖方案，无需训练，通过多模态大模型分解运动语言描述，结合SAM3进行分割与跟踪，并利用LLM进行验证和精修。

title: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompt: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge
summary: In the Complex Video Object Segmentation task, researchers are required to track and segment specific targets within cluttered environments, which rigorously tests a method's capability for target comprehension and environmental adaptability. Although SAM3, the current state-of-the-art solution, exhibits unparalleled segmentation performance and robustness on conventional targets, it underperforms on tiny and semantic-dominated objects. The root cause of this limitation lies in SAM3's insufficient comprehension of these specific target types. To address this issue, we propose TEP: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompts.
