As a training-free approach, TEP leverages external tracking models and Multimodal Large Language Models to introduce tracking-enhanced prompts, thereby alleviating the difficulty SAM3 faces in understanding these challenging targets. Our method achieved first place (56.91%) on the test set of the PVUW Challenge 2026: Complex Video Object Segmentation Track.
summary_zh: 在复杂视频目标分割任务中，研究人员需在杂乱环境中对特定目标进行跟踪与分割，这对算法的目标理解能力与环境适应能力提出了严苛考验。当前最先进的解决方案SAM3在常规目标上展现出卓越的分割性能与鲁棒性，但在微小目标及语义主导型目标上表现欠佳，其根本原因在于对这些特定目标类型的理解能力不足。为解决此问题，我们提出TEP：通过跟踪增强提示改进复杂视频目标分割。作为一种无需训练的方法，TEP借助外部跟踪模型与多模态大语言模型引入跟踪增强提示，从而缓解SAM3在处理这类挑战性目标时的理解困境。我们的方法在PVUW 2026挑战赛：复杂视频目标分割赛道的测试集上取得了第一名的成绩（56.91%）。
tldr: This paper introduces TEP, a training-free method using external tracking models and Multimodal Large Language Models to generate tracking-enhanced prompts, improving the segmentation of tiny and semantic-dominated objects in complex video object segmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TEP，一种无需训练的方法，利用外部跟踪模型和多模态大语言模型生成跟踪增强提示，以改进复杂视频目标分割中微小和语义主导物体的分割性能。

title: Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar
summary: Side-scan sonar (SSS) mine classification is a challenging maritime vision problem characterized by extreme data scarcity and a large domain gap from natural images. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and general-purpose vision foundation models have shown strong performance in general vision and several specialized domains, their use in SSS remains largely unexplored. We present Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain SSL pipeline for SSS mine classification, using SIGReg, a regularization-based SSL loss, to pretrain on only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images. In the binary mine vs. non-mine setting, Mine-JEPA achieves an F1 score of 0.935, outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.922), a foundation model pretrained on 1.7B images. For 3-class mine-like object classification, Mine-JEPA reaches 0.820 with synthetic data augmentation, again outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.810). We further observe that applying in-domain SSL to foundation models degrades performance by 10--13 percentage points, suggesting that stronger pretrained models do not always benefit from additional domain adaptation. In addition, Mine-JEPA with a compact ViT-Tiny backbone achieves competitive performance while using 4x fewer parameters than DINOv3. These results suggest that carefully designed in-domain self-supervised learning is a viable alternative to much larger foundation models in data-scarce maritime sonar imagery.
summary_zh: 侧扫声纳水雷分类是海洋视觉领域一项极具挑战性的任务，其特点是数据极度匮乏且与自然图像存在显著领域差异。尽管自监督学习与通用视觉基础模型在通用视觉及若干专业领域已展现出强大性能，但其在侧扫声纳领域的应用仍鲜有探索。本文提出Mine-JEPA——首个面向侧扫声纳水雷分类的领域内自监督学习框架，通过基于正则化的自监督损失函数SIGReg，仅使用1170张未标记声纳图像进行预训练。在二分类（水雷/非水雷）场景中，Mine-JEPA取得0.935的F1分数，优于在17亿图像上预训练的基础模型DINOv3微调版本（0.922）。针对三类水雷状物体分类任务，Mine-JEPA结合合成数据增强达到0.820的F1分数，同样超越微调DINOv3模型（0.810）。研究进一步发现，对基础模型施加领域内自监督学习会导致性能下降10-13个百分点，表明更强的预训练模型未必能从额外的领域适应中获益。此外，采用紧凑型ViT-Tiny架构的Mine-JEPA在参数量比DINOv3减少4倍的同时仍保持竞争优势。这些结果表明，在数据稀缺的海洋声纳图像领域，精心设计的领域内自监督学习可作为超大规模基础模型的有效替代方案。
tldr: This paper introduces Mine-JEPA, an in-domain self-supervised learning pipeline for classifying mine-like objects in side-scan sonar imagery, achieving competitive performance with a compact model despite extreme data scarcity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Mine-JEPA，一种用于侧扫声纳图像中水雷样物体分类的域内自监督学习管道，在数据极其稀缺的情况下，使用紧凑模型实现了具有竞争力的性能。

title: mmAnomaly: Leveraging Visual Context for Robust Anomaly Detection in the Non-Visual World with mmWave Radar
summary: mmWave radar enables human sensing in non-visual scenarios-e.g., through clothing or certain types of walls-where traditional cameras fail due to occlusion or privacy limitations. However, robust anomaly detection with mmWave remains challenging, as signal reflections are influenced by material properties, clutter, and multipath interference, producing complex, non-Gaussian distortions. Existing methods lack contextual awareness and misclassify benign signal variations as anomalies. We present mmAnomaly, a multi-modal anomaly detection framework that combines mmWave radar with RGBD input to incorporate visual context. Our system extracts semantic cues-such as scene geometry and material properties-using a fast ResNet-based classifier, and uses a conditional latent diffusion model to synthesize the expected mmWave spectrum for the given visual context. A dual-input comparison module then identifies spatial deviations between real and generated spectra to localize anomalies. We evaluate mmAnomaly on two multi-modal datasets across three applications: concealed weapon localization, through-wall intruder localization, and through-wall fall localization. The system achieves up to 94% F1 score and sub-meter localization error, demonstrating robust generalization across clothing, occlusions, and cluttered environments. These results establish mmAnomaly as an accurate and interpretable framework for context-aware anomaly detection in mmWave sensing.
summary_zh: 毫米波雷达能够在非视觉场景下实现人体感知，例如穿透衣物或某些类型的墙壁，而传统摄像头因遮挡或隐私限制无法在此类场景中发挥作用。然而，毫米波信号反射易受材料特性、环境杂波和多径干扰的影响，导致复杂且非高斯分布的信号畸变，这使得基于毫米波雷达的稳健异常检测仍然面临挑战。现有方法缺乏上下文感知能力，常将良性信号变化误判为异常。本文提出了mmAnomaly，一种多模态异常检测框架，通过融合毫米波雷达与RGBD输入来整合视觉上下文信息。该系统采用基于快速ResNet的分类器提取语义线索（如场景几何结构与材料属性），并利用条件潜在扩散模型为给定视觉场景生成预期的毫米波频谱。随后，通过双输入比较模块计算真实频谱与生成频谱之间的空间偏差，从而定位异常。我们在两个多模态数据集上针对三项应用对mmAnomaly进行了评估：隐蔽武器定位、穿墙入侵者定位和穿墙跌倒定位。该系统实现了最高94%的F1分数和亚米级定位误差，在衣物遮挡、复杂遮挡和杂乱环境等场景下均表现出稳健的泛化能力。这些结果证实了mmAnomaly可作为毫米波传感领域中具备上下文感知能力、准确且可解释的异常检测框架。
tldr: mmAnomaly is a multi-modal framework that uses RGBD visual context and a conditional latent diffusion model to guide mmWave radar for robust anomaly detection in non-visual scenarios, such as locating concealed weapons or through-wall intruders.
tldr_zh: mmAnomaly 是一个多模态框架，它利用 RGBD 视觉上下文和条件潜在扩散模型来引导毫米波雷达，用于非视觉场景（如定位隐藏武器或穿墙入侵者）的鲁棒异常检测。

title: UCMNet: Uncertainty-Aware Context Memory Network for Under-Display Camera Image Restoration
summary: Under-display cameras (UDCs) allow for full-screen designs by positioning the imaging sensor underneath the display. Nonetheless, light diffraction and scattering through the various display layers result in spatially varying and complex degradations, which significantly reduce high-frequency details. Current PSF-based physical modeling techniques and frequency-separation networks are effective at reconstructing low-frequency structures and maintaining overall color consistency. However, they still face challenges in recovering fine details when dealing with complex, spatially varying degradation. To solve this problem, we propose a lightweight \textbf{U}ncertainty-aware \textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{M}emory \textbf{Network} (\textbf{UCMNet}), for UDC image restoration. Unlike previous methods that apply uniform restoration, UCMNet performs uncertainty-aware adaptive processing to restore high-frequency details in regions with varying degradations. The estimated uncertainty maps, learned through an uncertainty-driven loss, quantify spatial uncertainty induced by diffraction and scattering, and guide the Memory Bank to retrieve region-adaptive context from the Context Bank. This process enables effective modeling of the non-uniform degradation characteristics inherent to UDC imaging. Leveraging this uncertainty as a prior, UCMNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks with 30\% fewer parameters than previous models. Project page: \href{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet/}{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet}.
summary_zh: 屏下摄像头通过将成像传感器置于显示屏下方实现了全面屏设计。然而，光线穿过不同显示层时产生的衍射和散射会导致空间上复杂多变的图像退化，显著削弱高频细节。当前基于点扩散函数的物理建模技术和频域分离网络能有效重建低频结构并保持整体色彩一致性，但在处理复杂且空间变化的退化时，恢复精细细节仍面临挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种轻量化的**不确定性感知上下文记忆网络**，用于屏下摄像头图像恢复。与先前采用均匀恢复的方法不同，该网络通过不确定性感知的自适应处理来恢复不同退化区域的高频细节。通过不确定性驱动损失学习得到的不确定性图可量化衍射与散射引发的空间不确定性，并引导记忆库从上下文库中检索区域自适应内容，从而有效建模屏下摄像成像固有的非均匀退化特性。借助该不确定性先验，该网络以比先前模型少30%的参数，在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。项目页面：https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet/。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight uncertainty-aware network (UCMNet) for under-display camera image restoration, which adaptively processes regions with varying degradations to recover fine details, achieving state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种轻量级不确定性感知网络（UCMNet），用于屏下摄像头图像恢复，通过自适应处理不同退化区域来恢复精细细节，以更少的参数实现了最先进的性能。

title: Dynamic Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Features Selection for RGB-D Based Indoor Scene Recognition
summary: Multi-modality of color and depth, i.e., RGB-D, is of great importance in recent research of indoor scene recognition. In this kind of data representation, depth map is able to describe the 3D structure of scenes and geometric relations among objects. Previous works showed that local features of both modalities are vital for promotion of recognition accuracy. However, the problem of adaptive selection and effective exploitation on these key local features remains open in this field. In this paper, a dynamic graph model is proposed with adaptive node selection mechanism to solve the above problem. In this model, a dynamic graph is built up to model the relations among objects and scene, and a method of adaptive node selection is proposed to take key local features from both modalities of RGB and depth for graph modeling. After that, these nodes are grouped by three different levels, representing near or far relations among objects. Moreover, the graph model is updated dynamically according to attention weights. Finally, the updated and optimized features of RGB and depth modalities are fused together for indoor scene recognition. Experiments are performed on public datasets including SUN RGB-D and NYU Depth v2. Extensive results demonstrate that our method has superior performance when comparing to state-of-the-arts methods, and show that the proposed method is able to exploit crucial local features from both modalities of RGB and depth.
summary_zh: 颜色与深度的多模态（即RGB-D）在室内场景识别的近期研究中具有重要意义。在此类数据表示中，深度图能够描述场景的三维结构及物体间的几何关系。先前的研究表明，两种模态的局部特征对提升识别精度至关重要。然而，如何自适应地选择并有效利用这些关键局部特征仍是该领域尚未解决的问题。本文提出一种带有自适应节点选择机制的动态图模型来解决上述问题。该模型通过构建动态图来建模物体与场景之间的关联关系，并提出一种自适应节点选择方法，从RGB和深度两种模态中提取关键局部特征用于图建模。随后，这些节点被划分为三个不同层级，以表征物体间的远近关系。此外，图模型会根据注意力权重进行动态更新。最终，将更新优化后的RGB与深度模态特征融合，实现室内场景识别。我们在SUN RGB-D和NYU Depth v2等公开数据集上进行了实验。大量结果表明，与现有先进方法相比，本方法具有更优性能，并证明其能够有效利用RGB和深度两种模态中的关键局部特征。
tldr: This paper proposes a dynamic graph neural network with adaptive node selection to fuse RGB and depth features for indoor scene recognition, achieving state-of-the-art results on SUN RGB-D and NYU Depth v2.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有自适应节点选择的动态图神经网络，用于融合RGB和深度特征进行室内场景识别，在SUN RGB-D和NYU Depth v2数据集上取得了最优性能。

title: VADMamba++: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection via Hybrid Modeling in Grayscale Space
summary: VADMamba pioneered the introduction of Mamba to Video Anomaly Detection (VAD), achieving high accuracy and fast inference through hybrid proxy tasks. Nevertheless, its heavy reliance on optical flow as auxiliary input and inter-task fusion scoring constrains its applicability to a single proxy task. In this paper, we introduce VADMamba++, an efficient VAD method based on the Gray-to-RGB paradigm that enforces a Single-Channel to Three-Channel reconstruction mapping, designed for a single proxy task and operating without auxiliary inputs. This paradigm compels inferring color appearances from grayscale structures, allowing anomalies to be more effectively revealed through dual inconsistencies between structure and chromatic cues. Specifically, VADMamba++ reconstructs grayscale frames into the RGB space to simultaneously discriminate structural geometry and chromatic fidelity, thereby enhancing sensitivity to explicit visual anomalies. We further design a hybrid modeling backbone that integrates Mamba, CNN, and Transformer modules to capture diverse normal patterns while suppressing the appearance of anomalies. Furthermore, an intra-task fusion scoring strategy integrates explicit future-frame prediction errors with implicit quantized feature errors, further improving accuracy under a single task setting. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that VADMamba++ outperforms state-of-the-art methods while meeting performance and efficiency, especially under a strict single-task setting with only frame-level inputs.
summary_zh: VADMamba首次将Mamba模型引入视频异常检测领域，通过混合代理任务实现了高精度与快速推理。然而，其严重依赖光流作为辅助输入及任务间融合评分策略，限制了其在单一代理任务中的应用。本文提出VADMamba++，一种基于灰度到RGB范式的高效视频异常检测方法。该范式通过强制单通道到三通道的重建映射机制，专为单一代理任务设计且无需辅助输入。该范式迫使模型从灰度结构推断色彩外观，使异常能够通过结构线索与色彩线索间的双重不一致性更有效地暴露。具体而言，VADMamba++将灰度帧重构至RGB空间，以同时判别结构几何与色彩保真度，从而增强对显式视觉异常的敏感性。我们进一步设计了融合Mamba、CNN与Transformer模块的混合建模主干网络，以捕获多样化的正常模式并抑制异常特征的出现。此外，任务内融合评分策略整合了显式的未来帧预测误差与隐式的量化特征误差，在单一任务设置下进一步提升检测精度。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，VADMamba++在满足性能与效率要求的同时优于现有先进方法，尤其在仅使用帧级输入的严格单任务设置下表现突出。
tldr: VADMamba++ is a video anomaly detection method that uses a Gray-to-RGB reconstruction task and a hybrid Mamba-CNN-Transformer backbone to identify anomalies without auxiliary inputs like optical flow.
tldr_zh: VADMamba++ 是一种视频异常检测方法，使用灰阶到RGB的重建任务和混合 Mamba-CNN-Transformer 主干网络，在无需光流等辅助输入的情况下识别异常。

title: Label-efficient underwater species classification with semi-supervised learning on frozen foundation model embeddings
summary: Automated species classification from underwater imagery is bottlenecked by the cost of expert annotation, and supervised models trained on one dataset rarely transfer to new conditions. We investigate whether semi-supervised methods operating on frozen foundation model embeddings can close this annotation gap with minimal labeling effort. Using DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings with no fine-tuning, we propagate a small set of labeled seeds through unlabeled data via nearest-neighbor-based self-training and evaluate on the AQUA20 benchmark (20 marine species). With fewer than 5% of the training labels, self-training on frozen embeddings closes much of the gap to a fully supervised ConvNeXt baseline trained on the entire labeled dataset; at full supervision, the gap narrows to a few percentage points, with several species exceeding the supervised baseline. Class separability in the embedding space, measured by ROC-AUC, is high even at extreme label scarcity, indicating that the frozen representations capture discriminative structure well before decision boundaries can be reliably estimated. Our approach requires no training, no domain-specific data engineering, and no underwater-adapted models, establishing a practical, immediately deployable baseline for label-efficient marine species recognition. All results are reported on the held-out test set over 100 random seed initializations.
summary_zh: 摘要：水下图像自动物种分类受限于专家标注成本，且基于单一数据集训练的监督模型难以迁移至新环境。本研究探讨基于冻结基础模型嵌入的半监督方法能否以最少标注量弥补这一差距。我们使用未经微调的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入表示，通过基于最近邻的自训练方法将少量标注样本信息传播至未标注数据，并在AQUA20基准数据集（20种海洋物种）上评估效果。结果显示：仅使用不足5%的训练标注量，基于冻结嵌入的自训练方法即可大幅缩小与全监督ConvNeXt基线模型（使用完整标注数据训练）的差距；在完全监督条件下，两者差距缩小至几个百分点，部分物种分类效果甚至超过监督基线。通过ROC-AUC度量的嵌入空间类别可分性在极端标注稀缺条件下仍保持较高水平，表明冻结表示在决策边界可被可靠估计之前已能有效捕捉判别性结构。该方法无需训练过程、无需领域特定数据工程、亦无需水下适配模型，为标签高效的海洋物种识别提供了一个实用且可即时部署的基线。所有结果均通过对100次随机种子初始化的保留测试集计算得出。
tldr: A semi-supervised learning method using frozen DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings achieves label-efficient marine species classification, nearly matching the performance of a fully supervised baseline on the AQUA20 benchmark with only 5% of the labels.
tldr_zh: 该研究使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入，通过半监督学习方法，仅用5%的标注数据，在AQUA20海洋物种分类基准上实现了接近全监督基线的性能。

title: Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe): Domain-Agnostic Fine-Grained Mask Discovery with Feature Calibration and Self-Supervised Upsampling
summary: Unsupervised segmentation approaches have increasingly leveraged foundation models (FM) to improve salient object discovery. However, these methods often falter in scenes with complex, multi-component morphologies, where fine-grained structural detail is indispensable. Many state-of-the-art unsupervised segmentation pipelines rely on mask discovery approaches that utilize coarse, patch-level representations. These coarse representations inherently suppress the fine-grained detail required to resolve such complex morphologies. To overcome this limitation, we propose Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe), an unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework for easy fine-grained mask discovery across challenging real-world scenes. EASe utilizes novel Semantic-Aware Upsampling with Channel Excitation (SAUCE) to excite low-resolution FM feature channels for selective calibration and attends across spatially-encoded image and FM features to recover full-resolution semantic representations. Finally, EASe segments the aggregated features into multi-granularity masks using a novel training-free Cue-Attentive Feature Aggregator (CAFE) which leverages SAUCE attention scores as a semantic grouping signal. EASe, together with SAUCE and CAFE, operate directly at pixel-level feature representations to enable accurate fine-grained dense semantic mask discovery. Our evaluation demonstrates superior performance of EASe over previous state-of-the-arts (SOTAs) across major standard benchmarks and diverse datasets with complex morphologies. Code is available at https://ease-project.github.io
summary_zh: 无监督分割方法日益借助基础模型来提升显著对象发现能力。然而这些方法在处理具有复杂多组件形态的场景时常显乏力，而此类场景中的细粒度结构细节至关重要。当前多数先进的无监督分割流程依赖于基于粗糙块级表示的掩码发现方法，这类粗糙表征本质上压制了解析复杂形态所需的细粒度细节。为克服此局限，我们提出激发、关注与分割框架——一种面向复杂真实场景、易于实现细粒度掩码发现的无监督领域无关语义分割框架。该框架通过新型语义感知通道激发上采样技术，对低分辨率基础模型特征通道进行选择性校准激发，并利用空间编码的图像与基础模型特征进行跨维度关注，以恢复全分辨率语义表征。最后，框架通过创新的免训练线索关注特征聚合器，将聚合特征分割为多粒度掩码，该聚合器以语义感知通道激发上采样的关注分数作为语义分组信号。该框架及其核心技术组件直接在像素级特征表征上操作，实现了精确的细粒度稠密语义掩码发现。实验评估表明，在主要标准基准测试及包含复杂形态的多样化数据集中，该框架均优于以往先进方法。代码发布于https://ease-project.github.io。
tldr: This paper introduces EASe, a novel unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework that uses a novel upsampling and attention mechanism to enable fine-grained mask discovery in complex scenes with intricate morphologies, significantly improving performance on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EASe，一种新颖的、与领域无关的无监督语义分割框架，它利用新的上采样和注意力机制，在具有复杂形态的场景中实现细粒度掩码发现，显著提升了在标准基准测试上的性能。

title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation
summary: Cameras capture scene-referred linear raw images, which are processed by onboard image signal processors (ISPs) into display-referred 8-bit sRGB outputs. Although raw data is more faithful for low-level vision tasks, collecting large-scale raw datasets remains a major bottleneck, as existing datasets are limited and tied to specific camera hardware. Generative models offer a promising way to address this scarcity -- however, existing diffusion frameworks are designed to synthesize photo-finished sRGB images rather than physically consistent linear representations. This paper presents RawGen, to our knowledge the first diffusion-based framework enabling text-to-raw generation for arbitrary target cameras, alongside sRGB-to-raw inversion. RawGen leverages the generative priors of large-scale sRGB diffusion models to synthesize physically meaningful linear outputs, such as CIE XYZ or camera-specific raw representations, via specialized processing in latent and pixel spaces. To handle unknown and diverse ISP pipelines and photo-finishing effects in diffusion-model training data, we build a many-to-one inverse-ISP dataset where multiple sRGB renditions of the same scene generated using diverse ISP parameters are anchored to a common scene-referred target. Fine-tuning a conditional denoiser and specialized decoder on this dataset allows RawGen to obtain camera-centric linear reconstructions that effectively invert the rendering pipeline. We demonstrate RawGen's superior performance over traditional inverse-ISP methods that assume a fixed ISP. Furthermore, we show that augmenting training pipelines with RawGen's scalable, text-driven synthetic data can benefit downstream low-level vision tasks.
summary_zh: 相机捕捉到的是场景参考的线性原始图像，这些图像由机载图像信号处理器（ISP）处理为显示参考的8位sRGB输出。尽管原始数据在低级视觉任务中更为忠实，但收集大规模原始数据集仍是一个主要瓶颈，因为现有数据集有限且依赖于特定相机硬件。生成模型为解决这一稀缺性问题提供了有前景的途径——然而，现有扩散框架旨在合成经过后期处理的sRGB图像，而非物理一致的线性表示。本文提出的RawGen，据我们所知，是首个基于扩散的框架，能够为任意目标相机实现文本到原始图像的生成，以及sRGB到原始图像的逆转换。RawGen利用大规模sRGB扩散模型的生成先验，通过潜空间和像素空间中的专门处理，合成具有物理意义的线性输出，如CIE XYZ或相机特定的原始表示。为了处理扩散模型训练数据中未知且多样化的ISP流水线和后期处理效果，我们构建了一个多对一逆ISP数据集，其中使用不同ISP参数生成的同一场景的多个sRGB渲染版本被锚定到共同的场景参考目标。在此数据集上微调解码器和专用解码器，使RawGen能够获得以相机为中心的线性重建，有效逆渲染流水线。我们展示了RawGen优于传统假设固定ISP的逆ISP方法的性能。此外，我们证明，利用RawGen可扩展的、文本驱动的合成数据增强训练流水线，可以有益于下游低级视觉任务。
tldr: RawGen is a diffusion-based framework for text-to-raw image generation and sRGB-to-raw inversion, designed to synthesize physically consistent linear camera representations for arbitrary cameras.
tldr_zh: RawGen 是一种基于扩散的框架，用于从文本生成原始图像和将 sRGB 图像反转为原始图像，旨在为任意相机合成物理上一致的线性相机表示。

title: LLM REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head
summary: We present RELISH (REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head), a novel, lightweight architecture designed for text regression with large language models. Rather than decoding numeric targets as text or aggregating multiple generated outputs, RELISH predicts scalar values directly from frozen LLM representations by iteratively refining a learned latent state through cross-attention over token-level representations, and then mapping the final state to a point estimate with a linear regressor. Across five datasets, four LLM backbones, and two LLM training regimes, RELISH consistently outperforms prior baselines from all three major LLM regression families, including autoregressive decoding, regression-aware inference, and existing predictive head methods. Despite these gains, RELISH remains highly parameter-efficient, requiring only 3.4-3.7M trainable parameters across frozen LLM backbones (only 0.01-0.04% additional overhead), far less than LoRA-based alternatives that grow with model size (0.26-0.42%).
summary_zh: 本文提出RELISH（基于潜态迭代回归头的回归模型），一种专为大型语言模型文本回归任务设计的轻量级新颖架构。该方法摒弃了将数值目标解码为文本或聚合多个生成输出的传统思路，而是通过跨注意力机制在词元级表征上迭代优化学习到的潜态，直接从冻结的LLM表征中预测标量值，最后通过线性回归器将最终潜态映射为点估计。在五个数据集、四种LLM基础架构和两种LLM训练模式下，RELISH在三大主流LLM回归方法（包括自回归解码、回归感知推理和现有预测头方法）中均持续优于先前基线模型。尽管性能显著提升，RELISH仍保持极高的参数效率——在冻结的LLM基础架构上仅需训练340-370万参数（仅增加0.01-0.04%的额外开销），远低于随模型规模增长的基于LoRA的替代方案（0.26-0.42%）。
tldr: A new lightweight architecture for text regression with LLMs that directly predicts scalar values from frozen representations via an iterative latent state refinement, outperforming prior methods with high parameter efficiency.
tldr_zh: 一种用于大语言模型文本回归的新颖轻量级架构，通过迭代精炼的潜在状态直接从冻结的表示中预测标量值，以高参数效率超越了现有方法。

title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibiting test-time scaling behavior, such as extended reasoning traces and self-verification, have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex, long-term reasoning tasks. However, the robustness of these reasoning behaviors remains underexplored. To investigate this, we conduct a systematic evaluation of multiple reasoning models across three scenarios: (1) problems augmented with lengthy, irrelevant context; (2) multi-turn conversational settings with independent tasks; and (3) problems presented as a subtask within a complex task. We observe an interesting phenomenon: reasoning models tend to produce much shorter reasoning traces (up to 50%) for the same problem under different context conditions compared to the traces produced when the problem is presented in isolation. A finer-grained analysis reveals that this compression is associated with a decrease in self-verification and uncertainty management behaviors, such as double-checking. While this behavioral shift does not compromise performance on straightforward problems, it might affect performance on more challenging tasks. We hope our findings draw additional attention to both the robustness of reasoning models and the problem of context management for LLMs and LLM-based agents.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
展现出测试时扩展行为（如延长推理轨迹和自我验证）的大型语言模型（LLM）在复杂长期推理任务中表现卓越。然而，这些推理行为的稳健性仍缺乏深入探究。为此，我们对多种推理模型在三种场景下进行系统评估：（1）添加冗长无关上下文的问题；（2）包含独立任务的多轮对话场景；（3）作为复杂任务子任务呈现的问题。我们观察到一个有趣现象：与问题独立呈现时相比，推理模型在不同上下文条件下针对同一问题生成的推理轨迹显著缩短（可达50%）。细粒度分析表明，这种压缩与自我验证及不确定性管理行为（如重复检查）的减少相关。尽管该行为转变不影响简单问题的解决效果，但可能对更具挑战性的任务产生性能影响。我们希望本研究能进一步引起对推理模型稳健性、以及LLM与基于LLM的智能体上下文管理问题的关注。
tldr: This paper finds that LLM-based reasoning models produce significantly shorter reasoning traces when problems are embedded in various contexts, linked to reduced self-verification behaviors, raising concerns about the robustness of these models in different settings.
tldr_zh: 本研究发现，LLM推理模型在问题置于不同上下文情境（如冗长无关信息、多轮对话）时会生成更短的推理轨迹，这与自我验证行为减少有关，对模型在复杂任务中的稳健性提出了问题。

title: Model-Based Learning of Near-Optimal Finite-Window Policies in POMDPs
summary: We study model-based learning of finite-window policies in tabular partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). A common approach to learning under partial observability is to approximate unbounded history dependencies using finite action-observation windows. This induces a finite-state Markov decision process (MDP) over histories, referred to as the superstate MDP. Once a model of this superstate MDP is available, standard MDP algorithms can be used to compute optimal policies, motivating the need for sample-efficient model estimation. Estimating the superstate MDP model is challenging because trajectories are generated by interaction with the original POMDP, creating a mismatch between the sampling process and target model. We propose a model estimation procedure for tabular POMDPs and analyze its sample complexity. Our analysis exploits a connection between filter stability and concentration inequalities for weakly dependent random variables. As a result, we obtain tight sample complexity guarantees for estimating the superstate MDP model from a single trajectory. Combined with value iteration, this yields approximately optimal finite-window policies for the POMDP.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在表格化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中基于模型的有界窗口策略学习问题。在部分可观测条件下，一种常见的学习方法是利用有限的动作-观测窗口来近似无界的历史依赖关系。这种方法构建了一个基于历史记录的有限状态马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），称为超状态MDP。一旦获得该超状态MDP的模型，即可使用标准MDP算法计算最优策略，这凸显了对样本高效模型估计的需求。超状态MDP模型的估计具有挑战性，因为轨迹是通过与原始POMDP交互生成的，这导致采样过程与目标模型之间存在不匹配。我们提出了一种针对表格化POMDP的模型估计方法，并分析了其样本复杂度。我们的分析利用了滤波稳定性与弱相关随机变量集中不等式之间的联系。由此，我们获得了从单条轨迹中估计超状态MDP模型的严格样本复杂度保证。结合值迭代方法，这为POMDP提供了近似最优的有限窗口策略。
tldr: The paper proposes a sample-efficient model-based learning method for finite-window policies in tabular POMDPs, analyzing its sample complexity and providing guarantees for finding near-optimal policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于表格POMDP中有限窗口策略的样本高效、基于模型的学习方法，分析了其样本复杂度，并提供了寻找近似最优策略的保证。

title: EmbedPart: Embedding-Driven Graph Partitioning for Scalable Graph Neural Network Training
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used for learning on graph-structured data, but scaling GNN training to massive graphs remains challenging. To enable scalable distributed training, graphs are divided into smaller partitions that are distributed across multiple machines such that inter-machine communication is minimized and computational load is balanced. In practice, existing partitioning approaches face a fundamental trade-off between partitioning overhead and partitioning quality. We propose EmbedPart, an embedding-driven partitioning approach that achieves both speed and quality. Instead of operating directly on irregular graph structures, EmbedPart leverages node embeddings produced during the actual GNN training workload and clusters these dense embeddings to derive a partitioning. EmbedPart achieves more than 100x speedup over Metis while maintaining competitive partitioning quality and accelerating distributed GNN training. Moreover, EmbedPart naturally supports graph updates and fast repartitioning, and can be applied to graph reordering to improve data locality and accelerate single-machine GNN training. By shifting partitioning from irregular graph structures to dense embeddings, EmbedPart enables scalable and high-quality graph data optimization.
summary_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）被广泛应用于图结构数据的学习，但将GNN训练扩展至大规模图仍面临挑战。为实现可扩展的分布式训练，图被划分为更小的分区并分布在多台机器上，以最小化机器间通信并平衡计算负载。在实际应用中，现有的分区方法在划分开销与划分质量之间面临根本性的权衡。本文提出EmbedPart，一种基于嵌入驱动的分区方法，兼顾速度与质量。EmbedPart不直接操作于不规则的图结构，而是利用GNN实际训练过程中产生的节点嵌入，通过聚类这些密集嵌入来推导分区。与Metis相比，EmbedPart在保持竞争力分区质量的同时实现了超过100倍的加速，并加速了分布式GNN训练。此外，EmbedPart天然支持图更新与快速重新分区，并可应用于图重排序以改善数据局部性并加速单机GNN训练。通过将分区从不规则图结构转向密集嵌入，EmbedPart实现了可扩展且高质量的图数据优化。
tldr: Proposes a fast graph partitioning method using node embeddings to accelerate distributed GNN training.
tldr_zh: 提出一种使用节点嵌入的快速图划分方法，以加速分布式图神经网络的训练。

title: Differentially Private Manifold Denoising
summary: We introduce a differentially private manifold denoising framework that allows users to exploit sensitive reference datasets to correct noisy, non-private query points without compromising privacy. The method follows an iterative procedure that (i) privately estimates local means and tangent geometry using the reference data under calibrated sensitivity, (ii) projects query points along the privately estimated subspace toward the local mean via corrective steps at each iteration, and (iii) performs rigorous privacy accounting across iterations and queries using $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy (DP). Conceptually, this framework brings differential privacy to manifold methods, retaining sufficient geometric signal for downstream tasks such as embedding, clustering, and visualization, while providing formal DP guarantees for the reference data. Practically, the procedure is modular and scalable, separating DP-protected local geometry (means and tangents) from budgeted query-point updates, with a simple scheduler allocating privacy budget across iterations and queries. Under standard assumptions on manifold regularity, sampling density, and measurement noise, we establish high-probability utility guarantees showing that corrected queries converge toward the manifold at a non-asymptotic rate governed by sample size, noise level, bandwidth, and the privacy budget. Simulations and case studies demonstrate accurate signal recovery under moderate privacy budgets, illustrating clear utility-privacy trade-offs and providing a deployable DP component for manifold-based workflows in regulated environments without reengineering privacy systems.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种差分隐私流形降噪框架，允许用户在不泄露隐私的前提下，利用敏感参考数据集对含噪的非隐私查询点进行校正。该方法采用迭代流程：（i）在校准敏感度下使用参考数据对局部均值与切向几何结构进行隐私化估计；（ii）通过逐迭代的校正步骤，将查询点沿隐私估计子空间向局部均值方向投影；（iii）基于$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私（DP）机制对迭代过程与查询操作进行严格的隐私核算。从概念上，该框架将差分隐私引入流形方法，在保留足够几何信号以支持嵌入、聚类、可视化等下游任务的同时，为参考数据提供严格的差分隐私保障。在实践层面，该流程具有模块化与可扩展性，将受DP保护的局部几何结构（均值与切向空间）与按预算分配的查询点更新分离，并通过简易调度器实现隐私预算在迭代与查询间的分配。在流形正则性、采样密度与测量噪声的标准假设下，我们建立了高概率效用保证，证明校正后的查询点能以受样本量、噪声水平、带宽及隐私预算共同控制的非渐近速率收敛至流形。仿真与案例研究表明，在适度隐私预算下能实现精确的信号恢复，清晰展现了效用与隐私的权衡关系，为受监管环境中基于流形的工作流程提供了可部署的差分隐私模块，且无需重构隐私系统。
tldr: This paper introduces a differentially private framework for manifold denoising, which privately corrects noisy query points using sensitive reference data, with utility guarantees for tasks like embedding and clustering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于流形去噪的差分隐私框架，能够利用敏感参考数据私有地校正噪声查询点，并为嵌入、聚类等下游任务提供效用保证。

title: Optimal Brain Decomposition for Accurate LLM Low-Rank Approximation
summary: Low-rank decomposition has emerged as an important problem in Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning and inference. Through Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the weight matrix can be factorized into low-rank spaces optimally. Previously, a common practice was to decompose the weight in the activation-whitened space, and then achieve satisfying results. In this work, we propose Optimal Brain Decomposition LLM (OBD-LLM), which studies the decomposition problem in the model space by utilizing second-order Hessian information. Through a rigorous Kronecker-factorization of the Hessian, we show that the decomposition needs to consider both input and output information of the layer, and achieves much better decomposition results compared to input only method. Our loss-aware decomposition method involves a bi-directional whitening on the weight matrix. As a result, OBD-LLM is a closed-form solution for the optimal decomposition of weights in the language model. Remarkably, we achieve ~20-40\% better results than previous state-of-the-art decomposition methods, the SVD-LLM.
summary_zh: 低秩分解已成为大型语言模型（LLM）微调与推理中的一个重要问题。通过奇异值分解（SVD），权重矩阵可以被最优地分解到低秩空间中。此前常见的做法是在激活白化空间中进行权重分解，并以此获得满意的结果。本研究中，我们提出基于最优脑分解的LLM（OBD-LLM），该方法利用二阶Hessian信息在模型空间中对分解问题进行系统性研究。通过严格的Hessian矩阵Kronecker分解，我们证明分解过程需要同时考虑神经网络层的输入与输出信息，相比仅使用输入信息的方法可获得更优的分解结果。我们的损失感知分解方法包含对权重矩阵的双向白化操作。因此，OBD-LLM为语言模型中的权重最优分解提供了闭式解。值得注意的是，我们的方法比当前最先进的分解方法SVD-LLM实现了约20-40%的性能提升。
tldr: This paper proposes a new method for low-rank decomposition of LLM weights using Hessian information, claiming significant improvements over previous SVD-based techniques.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用Hessian信息对LLM权重进行低秩分解的新方法，相比之前的SVD方法声称有显著提升。

title: Deconfounding Scores and Representation Learning for Causal Effect Estimation with Weak Overlap
summary: Overlap, also known as positivity, is a key condition for causal treatment effect estimation. Many popular estimators suffer from high variance and become brittle when features differ strongly across treatment groups. This is especially challenging in high dimensions: the curse of dimensionality can make overlap implausible. To address this, we propose a class of feature representations called deconfounding scores, which preserve both identification and the target of estimation; the classical propensity and prognostic scores are two special cases. We characterize the problem of finding a representation with better overlap as minimizing an overlap divergence under a deconfounding score constraint. We then derive closed-form expressions for a class of deconfounding scores under a broad family of generalized linear models with Gaussian features and show that prognostic scores are overlap-optimal within this class. We conduct extensive experiments to assess this behavior empirically.
summary_zh: 重叠性（亦称正性）是因果处理效应估计的关键条件。当处理组间的特征差异显著时，许多常用估计方法会出现高方差问题且变得不稳定。这在维数较高时尤为困难：维数灾难可能使重叠性假设难以成立。为解决这一问题，我们提出一类称为去混淆评分的特征表示方法，它们既能保持识别性，又能保留估计目标；经典的倾向评分与预后评分是其中的两个特例。我们将寻找具有更好重叠性的表示问题，刻画为在去混淆评分约束下最小化重叠性散度的优化问题。随后，我们推导出在具有高斯特征的广义线性模型大家族下，一类去混淆评分的封闭形式表达式，并证明在此类模型中预后评分具有重叠性最优性。我们通过大量实验对该性质进行了实证评估。
tldr: This paper introduces 'deconfounding scores', a class of feature representations for improving causal effect estimation in high-dimensional data by addressing the weak overlap problem, with a focus on theoretical properties under generalized linear models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种称为‘去混淆分数’的特征表示方法，旨在通过解决高维数据中的弱重叠问题来改进因果效应估计，重点研究了广义线性模型下的理论特性。

title: ActivityNarrated: An Open-Ended Narrative Paradigm for Wearable Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable HAR has improved steadily, but most progress still relies on closed-set classification, which limits real-world use. In practice, human activity is open-ended, unscripted, personalized, and often compositional, unfolding as narratives rather than instances of fixed classes. We argue that addressing this gap does not require simply scaling datasets or models. It requires a fundamental shift in how wearable HAR is formulated, supervised, and evaluated. This work shows how to model open-ended activity narratives by aligning wearable sensor data with natural-language descriptions in an open-vocabulary setting. Our framework has three core components. First, we introduce a naturalistic data collection and annotation pipeline that combines multi-position wearable sensing with free-form, time-aligned narrative descriptions of ongoing behavior, allowing activity semantics to emerge without a predefined vocabulary. Second, we define a retrieval-based evaluation framework that measures semantic alignment between sensor data and language, enabling principled evaluation without fixed classes while also subsuming closed-set classification as a special case. Third, we present a language-conditioned learning architecture that supports sensor-to-text inference over variable-length sensor streams and heterogeneous sensor placements. Experiments show that models trained with fixed-label objectives degrade sharply under real-world variability, while open-vocabulary sensor-language alignment yields robust and semantically grounded representations. Once this alignment is learned, closed-set activity recognition becomes a simple downstream task. Under cross-participant evaluation, our method achieves 65.3% Macro-F1, compared with 31-34% for strong closed-set HAR baselines. These results establish open-ended narrative modeling as a practical and effective foundation for real-world wearable HAR.
summary_zh: 可穿戴式人体活动识别技术虽已稳步提升，但当前进展仍主要依赖于封闭集合分类范式，这限制了其在真实场景中的应用。实际上，人类活动具有开放性、非预设性、个性化及组合性特征，通常以连续叙事的形式展开而非固定类别的孤立实例。我们认为弥合这一差距并非简单地扩大数据集或模型规模，而是需要从根本上改变可穿戴活动识别的建模方式、监督范式与评估体系。本研究展示了如何在开放词汇环境下，通过将可穿戴传感器数据与自然语言描述对齐来建模开放式活动叙事。我们的框架包含三个核心组成部分：首先，提出一种自然主义数据采集与标注流程，通过多位置穿戴式传感与自由形式的时间对齐叙事描述相结合，使活动语义能够脱离预定义词汇表自然呈现；其次，构建基于检索的评估框架，通过衡量传感器数据与语言描述之间的语义对齐程度，实现无需固定类别的规范化评估，同时将封闭集合分类作为其特例纳入；最后，设计一种语言条件学习架构，支持对可变长度传感器流及异构传感器布局进行传感器到文本的推理。实验表明，基于固定标签目标训练的模型在真实场景变化下性能急剧下降，而开放词汇的传感器-语言对齐方法则能产生鲁棒且语义扎根的表征。一旦掌握这种对齐能力，封闭集合活动识别便简化为简单的下游任务。在跨受试者评估中，本方法获得65.3%的宏平均F1分数，显著优于强封闭集合基线模型31-34%的性能表现。这些结果验证了开放式叙事建模作为现实世界可穿戴活动识别实用且有效的理论基础。
tldr: This paper introduces ActivityNarrated, a framework for open-ended wearable human activity understanding using free-form narrative descriptions and open-vocabulary sensor-language alignment instead of closed-set classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ActivityNarrated框架，用于开放式的可穿戴人体活动理解，它使用自由形式的叙事描述和开放词汇的传感器-语言对齐，而不是封闭集分类。

title: Exploring Silent Data Corruption as a Reliability Challenge in LLM Training
summary:
As Large Language Models (LLMs) scale in size and complexity, the consequences of failures during training become increasingly severe. A major challenge arises from Silent Data Corruption (SDC): hardware-induced faults that bypass system-level detection mechanisms. SDC may behave like benign numerical noise, but can also cause harmful gradient corruption that leads to loss spikes, divergence, or stalled progress.
  This work provides a controlled study of how intermittent SDC affects LLM pretraining. Using targeted fault injection at the level of GPU matrix-multiply instructions, we characterize the sensitivity of different bit positions, kernel functions, and execution stages. Our analysis shows that locally originating faults can produce impactful corruption, including NaN propagation, short-lived spikes in loss, gradient norm, and attention logits, as well as persistent parameter divergence. Building on the observed corruption signatures, we propose a lightweight detection method that identifies potentially harmful parameter updates. Experiments on LLaMA models with 60M, 350M, and 1.3B parameters demonstrate that recomputing the most recent training step upon detection can effectively mitigate the impact of these events.
summary_zh:
随着大规模语言模型（LLM）在规模和复杂度上的不断提升，训练过程中发生故障的后果日益严重。一个主要挑战来自静默数据损坏（SDC）：即硬件引发的、能绕过系统级检测机制的故障。SDC的表现可能类似良性数值噪声，但也可能引发有害的梯度破坏，导致损失值激增、训练发散或进程停滞。

本研究通过受控实验，探究了间歇性SDC对LLM预训练的影响。通过在GPU矩阵乘法指令级别进行针对性故障注入，我们分析了不同比特位置、核函数和执行阶段对故障的敏感性。研究发现，局部产生的故障可能引发显著的数据破坏，包括NaN值传播、损失值、梯度范数和注意力对数概率的短期突增，以及持久性的参数发散。

基于观测到的故障特征，我们提出了一种轻量级检测方法，用于识别可能有害的参数更新。在参数规模为6000万、3.5亿和13亿的LLaMA模型上的实验表明，通过检测触发后重新计算最近训练步骤的方法，能有效缓解此类事件的影响。
tldr: This paper studies the impact of Silent Data Corruption (SDC) hardware faults during LLM pretraining, characterizing their effects and proposing a lightweight detection and mitigation method through step recomputation.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型预训练中无声数据损坏硬件故障的影响，表征了其效应，并提出了通过重新计算步骤的轻量级检测与缓解方法。

title: Inverse-Free Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes
summary: Gaussian processes (GPs) offer appealing properties but are costly to train at scale. Sparse variational GP (SVGP) approximations reduce cost yet still rely on Cholesky decompositions of kernel matrices, ill-suited to low-precision, massively parallel hardware. While one can construct valid variational bounds that rely only on matrix multiplications (matmuls) via an auxiliary matrix parameter, optimising them with off-the-shelf first-order methods is challenging. We make the inverse-free approach practical by proposing a better-conditioned bound and deriving a matmul-only natural-gradient update for the auxiliary parameter, markedly improving stability and convergence. We further provide simple heuristics, such as step-size schedules and stopping criteria, that make the overall optimisation routine fit seamlessly into existing workflows. Across regression and classification benchmarks, we demonstrate that our method 1) serves as a drop-in replacement in SVGP-based models (e.g., deep GPs), 2) recovers similar performance to traditional methods, and 3) can be faster than baselines when well tuned.
summary_zh: 高斯过程(GPs)具有吸引人的特性，但大规模训练成本高昂。稀疏变分高斯过程(SVGP)近似降低了计算成本，但仍依赖于核矩阵的Cholesky分解，这不适用于低精度、大规模并行硬件。虽然可以通过辅助矩阵参数构建仅依赖矩阵乘法运算的有效变分边界，但使用现成的一阶优化方法进行优化仍具挑战性。我们通过提出条件更优的边界，并为辅助参数推导出仅需矩阵乘法的自然梯度更新，显著提升了稳定性和收敛性，从而使免逆矩阵方法具备实用性。我们还提供了简单的启发式策略，如步长调度和停止准则，使整体优化流程能无缝融入现有工作流。在回归和分类基准测试中，我们证明所提方法：1)可作为基于SVGP模型（如深度高斯过程）的即插即用替代方案；2)能恢复与传统方法相近的性能；3)经过充分调优后速度可优于基线方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to train Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes (SVGP) using only matrix multiplications, improving stability and convergence on standard GP regression and classification benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅使用矩阵乘法训练稀疏变分高斯过程的方法，改进了标准高斯过程回归和分类基准上的稳定性和收敛性。

title: Predicting Dynamics of Ultra-Large Complex Systems by Inferring Governing Equations
summary: Predicting the behavior of ultra-large complex systems, from climate to biological and technological networks, is a central unsolved challenge. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: equation discovery methods provide interpretability but fail to scale, while neural networks scale but operate as black boxes and often lose reliability over long times. Here, we introduce the Sparse Identification Graph Neural Network, a framework that overcome this divide by allowing to infer the governing equations of large networked systems from data. By defining symbolic discovery as edge-level information, SIGN decouples the scalability of sparse identification from network size, enabling efficient equation discovery even in large systems. SIGN allows to study networks with over 100,000 nodes while remaining robust to noise, sparse sampling, and missing data. Across diverse benchmark systems, including coupled chaotic oscillators, neural dynamics, and epidemic spreading, it recovers governing equations with high precision and sustains accurate long-term predictions. Applied to a data set of time series of temperature measurements in 71,987 sea surface positions, SIGN identifies a compact predictive network model and captures large-scale sea surface temperature conditions up to two years in advance. By enabling equation discovery at previously inaccessible scales, SIGN opens a path toward interpretable and reliable prediction of real-world complex systems.
summary_zh: 预测超大规模复杂系统——从气候到生物及技术网络——的行为是一项尚未解决的重大挑战。现有方法面临一个根本性权衡：方程发现方法可提供可解释性但难以扩展，而神经网络虽可扩展却如同黑箱，且长期预测的可靠性往往下降。本文提出稀疏识别图神经网络，该框架通过从数据中推断大型网络系统的控制方程，成功克服了这一矛盾。通过将符号发现定义为边层级信息，SIGN将稀疏识别的可扩展性与网络规模解耦，从而即使在大规模系统中也能实现高效的方程发现。SIGN能够研究超过10万个节点的网络，并保持对噪声、稀疏采样及数据缺失的鲁棒性。在耦合混沌振荡器、神经动力学和流行病传播等多种基准系统中，SIGN均能以高精度恢复控制方程，并维持准确的长期预测。将该方法应用于包含71,987个海面位置温度测量时间序列的数据集，SIGN识别出一个紧凑的预测网络模型，并提前两年准确捕捉大规模海面温度变化趋势。通过实现以往难以企及规模的方程发现，SIGN为现实世界复杂系统的可解释性与可靠预测开辟了新路径。
tldr: The paper introduces a framework for discovering interpretable governing equations from data in large-scale networked systems, such as climate and biological networks, enabling long-term prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从大型网络系统（如气候和生物网络）数据中发现可解释控制方程的框架，从而实现长期预测。

title: Scenario theory for multi-criteria data-driven decision making
summary: The scenario approach provides a powerful data-driven framework for designing solutions under uncertainty with rigorous probabilistic robustness guarantees. Existing theory, however, primarily addresses assessing robustness with respect to a single appropriateness criterion for the solution based on a dataset, whereas many practical applications - including multi-agent decision problems - require the simultaneous consideration of multiple criteria and the assessment of their robustness based on multiple datasets, one per criterion. This paper develops a general scenario theory for multi-criteria data-driven decision making. A central innovation lies in the collective treatment of the risks associated with violations of individual criteria, which yields substantially more accurate robustness certificates than those derived from a naive application of standard results. In turn, this approach enables a sharper quantification of the robustness level with which all criteria are simultaneously satisfied. The proposed framework applies broadly to multi-criteria data-driven decision problems, providing a principled, scalable, and theoretically grounded methodology for design under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 场景法为不确定性条件下的解决方案设计提供了一个强大的数据驱动框架，并具备严格的概率鲁棒性保证。然而，现有理论主要侧重于基于单一数据集评估解决方案在单一适用性准则下的鲁棒性，而许多实际应用——包括多智能体决策问题——需要同时考虑多个准则，并基于多个数据集（每个准则对应一个数据集）评估其鲁棒性。本文提出了一种适用于多准则数据驱动决策的通用场景理论。其核心创新在于对违反各准则风险的综合处理，相比简单应用标准结果的方法，该方法能获得显著更精确的鲁棒性保证。进而，这一方法能够更精确地量化所有准则同时满足的鲁棒性水平。所提出的框架广泛适用于多准则数据驱动决策问题，为不确定性条件下的设计提供了一种原理清晰、可扩展且理论严谨的方法论。
tldr: Develops a general scenario theory for multi-criteria data-driven decision making, providing more accurate robustness certificates than naive applications of standard results by collectively treating risks across multiple criteria.
tldr_zh: 发展了用于多准则数据驱动决策制定的通用场景理论，通过对多个准则的风险进行集体处理，提供了比标准结果直接应用更精确的鲁棒性保证。

title: Learning from Many and Adapting to the Unknown in Open-set Test Streams
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) generalize across tasks via reusable representations and flexible reasoning, yet remain brittle in real deployment under evolving tasks and continual distribution shift. A common approach is Test-Time Adaptation (TTA), existing ones of which updates models with hand-designed unsupervised objectives over the full parameter space and mostly overlook preserving shared source knowledge and the reliability of adaptation signals. Drawing on molecular signaling cascades of memory updating in Drosophila, we propose Synapse Consolidation (SyCo), a parameter-efficient LLM adaptation method that updates low-rank adapters through Rac1 and MAPK pathways under the guidance of a structured TTA objective driven by problem understanding, process understanding, and source-domain guardrail. Rac1 confines plasticity to a tail-gradient subspace that is less critical for source knowledge, enabling rapid specialization while preserving source representations. MAPK uses a tiered controller to suppress noisy updates and consolidate useful adaptations under non-stationary streams. To model real deployments with multiple sources and continually emerging tasks, we introduce Multi-source Open-set Adaptation (MOA) setting, where a model is trained on multiple labeled source tasks and then adapts on open, non-stationary unlabeled test streams that mix seen and unseen tasks with partial overlap in label and intent space. Across 18 NLP datasets and the MOA setting, SyCo consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 78.31\% on unseen-task adaptation and 85.37\% on unseen-data shifts.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）通过可复用的表征和灵活的推理能力实现跨任务泛化，但在实际部署中面临任务持续演变与分布动态偏移时仍显脆弱。测试时自适应（TTA）是当前常用方法，但现有方案大多通过全参数空间的手工设计无监督目标更新模型，且普遍忽视对共享源知识的保护以及自适应信号的可信度。受果蝇记忆更新的分子信号级联机制启发，我们提出突触巩固（SyCo）方法——一种参数高效的LLM自适应方案，通过Rac1和MAPK通路在结构化TTA目标驱动下更新低秩适配器，该目标由问题理解、过程理解与源域防护机制共同构建。Rac1将可塑性限制在对源知识影响较小的尾梯度子空间，在保护源表征的同时实现快速任务特化；MAPK采用分层控制器抑制噪声更新，并在非平稳数据流中巩固有效适应。为模拟多源任务与持续涌现任务的真实部署场景，我们提出多源开放集自适应（MOA）设定：模型先在多个带标注的源任务上训练，随后在开放、非平稳的无标注测试流上进行自适应，测试流混合了已知与未知任务，其标签与意图空间存在部分重叠。在18个NLP数据集及MOA设定下的实验表明，SyCo始终优于现有强基线方法，在未知任务适应中达到78.31%的准确率，在未知数据分布偏移中达到85.37%的准确率。
tldr: The paper proposes Synapse Consolidation (SyCo), a parameter-efficient LLM adaptation method for open-set test streams, inspired by biological memory mechanisms, and evaluated on NLP tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种受生物记忆机制启发的、参数高效的LLM适应方法SyCo，用于开放集测试流，并在NLP任务上进行了评估。

title: Learning Shared Representations for Multi-Task Linear Bandits
summary: Multi-task representation learning is an approach that learns shared latent representations across related tasks, facilitating knowledge transfer and improving sample efficiency. This paper introduces a novel approach to multi-task representation learning in linear bandits. We consider a setting with T concurrent linear bandit tasks, each with feature dimension d, that share a common latent representation of dimension r \ll min{d,T}$, capturing their underlying relatedness. We propose a new Optimism in the Face of Uncertainty Linear (OFUL) algorithm that leverages shared low-rank representations to enhance decision-making in a sample-efficient manner. Our algorithm first collects data through an exploration phase, estimates the shared model via spectral initialization, and then conducts OFUL based learning over a newly constructed confidence set. We provide theoretical guarantees for the confidence set and prove that the unknown reward vectors lie within the confidence set with high probability. We derive cumulative regret bounds and show that the proposed approach achieves \tilde{O}(\sqrt{drNT}), a significant improvement over solving the T tasks independently, resulting in a regret of \tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{N}). We performed numerical simulations to validate the performance of our algorithm for different problem sizes.
summary_zh: 多任务表征学习是一种在相关任务间学习共享潜在表征的方法，有助于知识迁移并提升样本效率。本文针对线性赌博机问题提出了一种新颖的多任务表征学习方法。我们考虑一个包含T个并发的线性赌博机任务的环境，每个任务的特征维度为d，这些任务共享一个维度为r \ll min{d,T}的公共潜在表征以捕捉其内在关联性。我们提出了一种新型的“面对不确定性的线性乐观”（OFUL）算法，该算法利用共享的低秩表征以样本高效的方式增强决策能力。我们的算法首先通过探索阶段收集数据，通过谱初始化估计共享模型，随后基于新构建的置信集进行OFUL学习。我们为置信集提供了理论保证，并证明未知奖励向量以高概率位于置信集内。我们推导了累积遗憾界，表明所提方法能达到 \tilde{O}(\sqrt{drNT}) 的遗憾水平，较独立求解T个任务获得的 \tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{N}) 遗憾有显著提升。我们通过数值模拟验证了算法在不同问题规模下的性能表现。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-task linear bandit algorithm that learns shared low-rank representations to improve sample efficiency and regret bounds across related tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多任务线性老虎机算法，通过共享低维表征来提升多个相关任务的样本效率和遗憾上界。

title: MF-QAT: Multi-Format Quantization-Aware Training for Elastic Inference
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is typically performed for a single target numeric format, while practical deployments often need to choose numerical precision at inference time based on hardware support or runtime constraints. We study multi-format QAT, where a single model is trained to be robust across multiple quantization formats. We find that multi-format QAT can match single-format QAT at each target precision, yielding one model that performs well overall across different formats, even formats that were not seen during training. To enable practical deployment, we propose the Slice-and-Scale conversion procedure for both MXINT and MXFP that converts a high-precision representation into lower-precision formats without re-training. Building on this, we introduce a pipeline that (i) trains a model with multi-format QAT, (ii) stores a single anchor format checkpoint (MXINT8/MXFP8), and (iii) allows on-the-fly conversion to lower MXINT or MXFP formats at runtime with negligible-or no-additional accuracy degradation. Together, these components provide a practical path to elastic precision scaling and allow selecting the runtime format at inference time across diverse deployment targets.
summary_zh: 量化感知训练（QAT）通常针对单一目标数值格式进行，而实际部署中往往需要根据硬件支持或运行时约束在推理时选择数值精度。本研究探讨了多格式QAT，即训练单个模型使其在多种量化格式下均保持鲁棒性。研究发现，多格式QAT能够在各目标精度上匹配单格式QAT的性能，从而得到一个在不同格式（甚至包括训练时未见的格式）下整体表现良好的模型。为实现实际部署，本文针对MXINT和MXFP格式提出了"切片-缩放"转换流程，该流程可将高精度表征转换为低精度格式而无需重新训练。在此基础上，我们提出一套完整流程：（i）采用多格式QAT训练模型，（ii）存储单一锚点格式检查点（MXINT8/MXFP8），（iii）支持在运行时动态转换为更低精度的MXINT或MXFP格式，且精度损失可忽略不计甚至为零。这些组件共同构成了弹性精度扩展的实用路径，使得在多样化部署目标中能够根据推理需求灵活选择运行时格式。
tldr: This paper introduces MF-QAT, a method for training a single model to be robust to multiple quantization formats, enabling elastic precision scaling at inference time without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MF-QAT方法，通过训练单个模型使其对多种量化格式具有鲁棒性，从而在推理时无需重新训练即可实现弹性精度缩放。

title: Phase space integrity in neural network models of Hamiltonian dynamics: A Lagrangian descriptor approach
summary: We propose Lagrangian Descriptors (LDs) as a diagnostic framework for evaluating neural network models of Hamiltonian systems beyond conventional trajectory-based metrics. Standard error measures quantify short-term predictive accuracy but provide little insight into global geometric structures such as orbits and separatrices. Existing evaluation tools in dissipative systems are inadequate for Hamiltonian dynamics due to fundamental differences in the systems. By constructing probability density functions weighted by LD values, we embed geometric information into a statistical framework suitable for information-theoretic comparison. We benchmark physically constrained architectures (SympNet, HénonNet, Generalized Hamiltonian Neural Networks) against data-driven Reservoir Computing across two canonical systems. For the Duffing oscillator, all models recover the homoclinic orbit geometry with modest data requirements, though their accuracy near critical structures varies. For the three-mode nonlinear Schrödinger equation, however, clear differences emerge: symplectic architectures preserve energy but distort phase-space topology, while Reservoir Computing, despite lacking explicit physical constraints, reproduces the homoclinic structure with high fidelity. These results demonstrate the value of LD-based diagnostics for assessing not only predictive performance but also the global dynamical integrity of learned Hamiltonian models.
summary_zh: 我们提出了拉格朗日描述子作为一种诊断框架，用于评估哈密顿系统的神经网络模型，超越传统基于轨迹的度量标准。常规误差测量量化短期预测精度，但无法揭示全局几何结构（如轨道和分界线）。由于系统本质差异，耗散系统中现有的评估工具不适用于哈密顿动力学。通过构建以LD值加权的概率密度函数，我们将几何信息嵌入适用于信息论比较的统计框架。在两个经典系统中，我们以物理约束架构（SympNet、HénonNet、广义哈密顿神经网络）为基准，与数据驱动的储层计算进行对比。对于杜芬振子，所有模型均能以中等数据需求恢复同宿轨道几何结构，但其在临界结构附近的精度存在差异。然而对于三模非线性薛定谔方程，显著差异显现：辛架构虽能保持能量守恒，但扭曲了相空间拓扑结构；而储层计算尽管缺乏显式物理约束，却能高保真地复现同宿轨道结构。这些结果证明，基于LD的诊断方法不仅能够评估预测性能，还能有效评判所学哈密顿模型的全局动力学完整性，具有重要价值。
tldr: Proposes Lagrangian Descriptors as a diagnostic tool for evaluating neural network models of Hamiltonian dynamical systems, focusing on preserving global geometric structures rather than just short-term prediction error.
tldr_zh: 提出拉格朗日描述符作为诊断工具，用于评估哈密顿系统的神经网络模型，重点关注其保持全局几何结构的能力，而非仅短期预测误差。

title: A Cross-graph Tuning-free GNN Prompting Framework
summary: GNN prompting aims to adapt models across tasks and graphs without requiring extensive retraining. However, most existing graph prompt methods still require task-specific parameter updates and face the issue of generalizing across graphs, limiting their performance and undermining the core promise of prompting. In this work, we introduce a Cross-graph Tuning-free Prompting Framework (CTP), which supports both homogeneous and heterogeneous graphs, can be directly deployed to unseen graphs without further parameter tuning, and thus enables a plug-and-play GNN inference engine. Extensive experiments on few-shot prediction tasks show that, compared to SOTAs, CTP achieves an average accuracy gain of 30.8% and a maximum gain of 54%, confirming its effectiveness and offering a new perspective on graph prompt learning.
summary_zh: GNN提示学习旨在使模型能够适应不同任务与图结构，而无需进行大规模重新训练。然而，现有的大多数图提示方法仍需要针对特定任务更新参数，并面临跨图泛化问题，这限制了其性能，也削弱了提示学习的核心优势。本文提出了一种跨图免调优提示框架（CTP），该框架同时支持同质图与异质图，能够无需额外参数调整直接部署至未见过的图数据，从而构建即插即用的GNN推理引擎。在小样本预测任务上的大量实验表明，CTP相较于当前最优方法平均准确率提升30.8%，最高提升达54%，验证了其有效性，并为图提示学习提供了新的研究视角。
tldr: The paper introduces a tuning-free GNN prompting framework (CTP) for cross-graph transfer learning, achieving high accuracy gains on few-shot prediction tasks without requiring task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需调参的图神经网络提示框架（CTP），用于跨图迁移学习，在无需任务特定微调的情况下，在少样本预测任务上实现了显著的准确率提升。

title: Gradient-Based Data Valuation Improves Curriculum Learning for Game-Theoretic Motion Planning
summary: We demonstrate that gradient-based data valuation produces curriculum orderings that significantly outperform metadata-based heuristics for training game-theoretic motion planners. Specifically, we apply TracIn gradient-similarity scoring to GameFormer on the nuPlan benchmark and construct a curriculum that weights training scenarios by their estimated contribution to validation loss reduction. Across three random seeds, the TracIn-weighted curriculum achieves a mean planning ADE of $1.704\pm0.029$\,m, significantly outperforming the metadata-based interaction-difficulty curriculum ($1.822\pm0.014$\,m; paired $t$-test $p=0.021$, Cohen's $d_z=3.88$) while exhibiting lower variance than the uniform baseline ($1.772\pm0.134$\,m). Our analysis reveals that TracIn scores and scenario metadata are nearly orthogonal (Spearman $ρ=-0.014$), indicating that gradient-based valuation captures training dynamics invisible to hand-crafted features. We further show that gradient-based curriculum weighting succeeds where hard data selection fails: TracIn-curated 20\% subsets degrade performance by $2\times$, whereas full-data curriculum weighting with the same scores yields the best results. These findings establish gradient-based data valuation as a practical tool for improving sample efficiency in game-theoretic planning.
summary_zh: 本文证明了基于梯度的数据估值方法所产生的课程排序，在训练博弈论运动规划器时显著优于基于元数据的启发式方法。具体而言，我们将TracIn梯度相似度评分应用于nuPlan基准测试中的GameFormer模型，并构建了一种课程学习策略，通过各训练场景对验证损失减少的预估贡献来加权。在三次随机种子实验中，TracIn加权课程实现了平均规划ADE为$1.704\pm0.029$米，显著优于基于元数据的交互难度课程（$1.822\pm0.014$米；配对$t$检验$p=0.021$，科恩$d_z=3.88$），同时表现出比均匀基线（$1.772\pm0.134$米）更低的方差。分析表明，TracIn得分与场景元数据近乎正交（斯皮尔曼$ρ=-0.014$），说明基于梯度的估值能捕捉手工特征无法识别的训练动态。我们进一步发现，基于梯度的课程加权在硬数据筛选失效时仍能成功：使用TracIn筛选的20%数据子集会导致性能下降$2$倍，而采用相同得分的全数据课程加权则能获得最佳结果。这些发现确立了基于梯度的数据估值作为提升博弈论规划中样本效率的有效工具。
tldr: The paper demonstrates that gradient-based data valuation (TracIn) for constructing curricula significantly outperforms metadata-based heuristics for training a game-theoretic motion planner on the nuPlan autonomous driving benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，在训练nuPlan自动驾驶基准上的博弈论运动规划器时，使用基于梯度的数据估值（TracIn）构建课程显著优于基于元数据的启发式方法。

title: Breaking Data Symmetry is Needed For Generalization in Feature Learning Kernels
summary: Grokking occurs when a model achieves high training accuracy but generalization to unseen test points happens long after that. This phenomenon was initially observed on a class of algebraic problems, such as learning modular arithmetic (Power et al., 2022). We study grokking on algebraic tasks in a class of feature learning kernels via the Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) algorithm (Radhakrishnan et al., 2024), which iteratively updates feature matrices through the Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) of an estimator in order to learn task-relevant features. Our main experimental finding is that generalization occurs only when a certain symmetry in the training set is broken. Furthermore, we empirically show that RFM generalizes by recovering the underlying invariance group action inherent in the data. We find that the learned feature matrices encode specific elements of the invariance group, explaining the dependence of generalization on symmetry.
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
当模型在训练集上达到高精度后，经过较长时间才在未见过的测试点上实现泛化时，便会出现“顿悟”现象。这一现象最初在一类代数问题（如学习模运算）中被观察到（Power et al., 2022）。本研究通过递归特征机（RFM）算法（Radhakrishnan et al., 2024）在一类特征学习核中的代数任务上探究“顿悟”现象。该算法通过迭代更新估计器的平均梯度外积（AGOP）来调整特征矩阵，从而学习任务相关的特征。我们的主要实验发现是：仅当训练集中的某种对称性被打破时，泛化才会发生。此外，实验表明，RFM通过恢复数据中固有的不变性群作用来实现泛化。我们发现，学习到的特征矩阵编码了该不变性群的特定元素，从而解释了泛化对对称性的依赖。
tldr: The paper studies grokking in algebraic tasks using feature learning kernels, finding generalization requires breaking data symmetry and recovering the underlying invariance group.
tldr_zh: 本文通过特征学习核研究代数任务中的顿悟现象，发现泛化需要打破数据对称性并恢复数据中固有的不变性群作用。

title: Informed Machine Learning with Knowledge Landmarks
summary: Informed Machine Learning has emerged as a viable generalization of Machine Learning (ML) by building a unified conceptual and algorithmic setting for constructing models on a unified basis of knowledge and data. Physics-informed ML involving physics equations is one of the developments within Informed Machine Learning. This study proposes a novel direction of Knowledge-Data ML, referred to as KD-ML, where numeric data are integrated with knowledge tidbits expressed in the form of granular knowledge landmarks. We advocate that data and knowledge are complementary in several fundamental ways: data are precise (numeric) and local, usually confined to some region of the input space, while knowledge is global and formulated at a higher level of abstraction. The knowledge can be represented as information granules and organized as a collection of input-output information granules called knowledge landmarks. In virtue of this evident complementarity, we develop a comprehensive design process of the KD-ML model and formulate an original augmented loss function L, which additively embraces the component responsible for optimizing the model based on available numeric data, while the second component, playing the role of a granular regularizer, so that it adheres to the granular constraints (knowledge landmarks). We show the role of the hyperparameter positioned in the loss function, which balances the contribution and guiding role of data and knowledge, and point to some essential tendencies associated with the quality of data (noise level) and the level of granularity of the knowledge landmarks. Experiments on two physics-governed benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed KD model consistently outperforms data-driven ML models.
summary_zh: 知情机器学习通过为基于知识与数据统一构建模型建立统一的概念和算法框架，已成为机器学习的一种可行泛化范式。其中涉及物理方程的物理知情机器学习是知情机器学习领域的重要发展方向。本研究提出了一种被称为知识-数据机器学习的新方向，简称KD-ML，其核心思想是将数值数据与以粒度知识地标形式表达的知识片段进行融合。我们主张数据与知识在若干根本层面具有互补性：数据具有精确性（数值化）和局部性，通常局限于输入空间的特定区域；而知识则具有全局性，并在更高抽象层次上形成。知识可表示为信息粒，并组织成被称为知识地标的输入-输出信息粒集合。基于这种显著的互补特性，我们开发了KD-ML模型的综合设计流程，并构建了创新的增广损失函数L。该函数通过加法结构整合了两个核心组件：第一个组件负责基于现有数值数据优化模型，第二个组件则作为粒度正则化器，确保模型遵循粒度约束（知识地标）。我们阐释了损失函数中超参数的作用——该参数平衡了数据与知识的贡献及引导作用，并指出了与数据质量（噪声水平）及知识地标粒度层次相关的关键趋势。在两个物理规律主导的基准测试实验中表明，所提出的KD模型始终优于数据驱动的机器学习模型。
tldr: This paper introduces a Knowledge-Data Machine Learning (KD-ML) framework that integrates numeric data with granular knowledge landmarks using a novel augmented loss function, demonstrating improved performance on physics-governed benchmarks over data-driven models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识-数据机器学习（KD-ML）框架，该框架通过新颖的增强损失函数，将数值数据与粒状知识地标相结合，在物理基准测试中表现优于纯数据驱动的模型。

title: Offline Constrained RLHF with Multiple Preference Oracles
summary: We study offline constrained reinforcement learning from human feedback with multiple preference oracles. Motivated by applications that trade off performance with safety or fairness, we aim to maximize target population utility subject to a minimum protected group welfare constraint. From pairwise comparisons collected under a reference policy, we estimate oracle-specific rewards via maximum likelihood and analyze how statistical uncertainty propagates through the dual program. We cast the constrained objective as a KL-regularized Lagrangian whose primal optimizer is a Gibbs policy, reducing learning to a convex dual problem. We propose a dual-only algorithm that ensures high-probability constraint satisfaction and provide the first finite-sample performance guarantees for offline constrained preference learning. Finally, we extend our theoretical analysis to accommodate multiple constraints and general f-divergence regularization.
summary_zh: 我们研究了基于多偏好预测器的离线约束强化学习，该方法从人类反馈中获取数据。针对需要在性能与安全性或公平性之间权衡的应用场景，我们的目标是在满足最低受保护群体福利约束的前提下，最大化目标群体效用。通过从参考策略下收集的成对比较数据，我们采用最大似然法估计各预测器对应的奖励函数，并分析统计不确定性在双重规划中的传播机制。我们将约束目标转化为KL正则化的拉格朗日函数，其原始优化器为吉布斯策略，从而将学习问题简化为凸对偶问题。我们提出了一种纯对偶算法，确保以高概率满足约束条件，并首次为离线约束偏好学习提供了有限样本性能保证。最后，我们将理论分析扩展到可容纳多重约束及广义f-散度正则化的框架。
tldr: This paper introduces a theoretical framework and algorithm for offline constrained reinforcement learning from human feedback with multiple preference oracles, focusing on maximizing utility subject to protected group welfare constraints and providing finite-sample guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多个偏好预言机的离线约束强化学习人类反馈框架和算法，旨在最大化目标群体效用，同时确保受保护群体福利的最低约束，并提供了有限样本性能保证。

title: Finite-Time Analysis of Projected Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation
summary: We study the finite-time convergence of projected linear two-time-scale stochastic approximation with constant step sizes and Polyak--Ruppert averaging. We establish an explicit mean-square error bound, decomposing it into two interpretable components, an approximation error determined by the constrained subspace and a statistical error decaying at a sublinear rate, with constants expressed through restricted stability margins and a coupling invertibility condition. These constants cleanly separate the effect of subspace choice (approximation errors) from the effect of the averaging horizon (statistical errors). We illustrate our theoretical results through a number of numerical experiments on both synthetic and reinforcement learning problems.
summary_zh: 我们研究了带恒定步长和Polyak--Ruppert平均的投影线性双时间尺度随机逼近算法的有限时间收敛性。通过建立明确的均方误差界，将其分解为两个可解释的分量：一是由约束子空间决定的近似误差，二是以次线性速率衰减的统计误差，其中相关常数通过受限稳定裕度和耦合可逆性条件表示。这些常数清晰地将子空间选择的影响（近似误差）与平均时长的影响（统计误差）分离开来。我们通过在合成问题与强化学习问题上的数值实验验证了理论结果。
tldr: The paper provides a finite-time analysis of projected two-time-scale stochastic approximation with constant step sizes and Polyak-Ruppert averaging, deriving explicit error bounds with constants related to stability margins. The theoretical results are validated with experiments on both synthetic and reinforcement learning problems.
tldr_zh: 本文对具有恒定步长和Polyak-Ruppert平均的投影两时间尺度随机逼近进行了有限时间分析，推导出与稳定性裕度相关的显式误差界。理论结果通过在合成和强化学习问题上的实验进行了验证。

title: ParetoBandit: Budget-Paced Adaptive Routing for Non-Stationary LLM Serving
summary:
Production LLM serving often relies on multi-model portfolios spanning a ~530x cost range, where routing decisions trade off quality against cost. This trade-off is non-stationary: providers revise pricing, model quality can regress silently, and new models must be integrated without downtime. We present ParetoBandit, an open-source adaptive router built on cost-aware contextual bandits that is the first to simultaneously enforce dollar-denominated budgets, adapt online to such shifts, and onboard new models at runtime.
  ParetoBandit closes these gaps through three mechanisms. An online primal-dual budget pacer enforces a per-request cost ceiling over an open-ended stream, replacing offline penalty tuning with closed-loop control. Geometric forgetting on sufficient statistics enables rapid adaptation to price and quality shifts while bootstrapping from offline priors. A hot-swap registry lets operators add or remove models at runtime, with a brief forced-exploration phase for each newcomer, after which UCB selection discovers its quality-cost niche from live traffic alone.
  We evaluate ParetoBandit across four deployment scenarios on 1,824 prompts routed through a three-model portfolio. Across seven budget ceilings, mean per-request cost never exceeds the target by more than 0.4%. When conditions shift, the system adapts: an order-of-magnitude price cut on the costliest model yields up to +0.071 quality lift, and a silent quality regression is detected and rerouted within budget. A cold-started model reaches meaningful adoption within ~142 steps without breaching the cost ceiling. The router discriminates rather than blindly adopting: expensive models are budget-gated and low-quality models rejected after bounded exploration. End-to-end routing latency is 9.8ms on CPU -- less than 0.4% of typical inference time -- with the routing decision itself taking just 22.5us.
summary_zh:
生产级大语言模型服务常依赖覆盖约530倍成本区间的多模型组合，其路由决策需在质量与成本间进行权衡。这种权衡具有非静态特性：服务商会调整定价策略，模型质量可能发生静默退化，新模型需在不中断服务的前提下完成集成。我们提出ParetoBandit——一个基于成本感知上下文赌博机的开源自适应路由器，它首次实现了三个目标的同步达成：强制执行美元计价的预算约束，在线适应动态变化，以及运行时无缝集成新模型。

ParetoBandit通过三大机制解决上述挑战。在线原始对偶预算调节器在开放式请求流中对单次请求实施成本上限管控，以闭环控制替代离线惩罚调参；基于充分统计量的几何衰减机制能快速适应价格与质量波动，同时利用离线先验知识进行初始化；热插拔注册表允许运营者在运行时动态增删模型，每个新模型经过短期强制探索阶段后，仅通过实时流量即可利用UCB选择机制发现其质量-成本生态位。

我们在包含三个模型的组合上使用1,824条提示词对ParetoBandit进行四类部署场景评估。在七种预算上限设置下，单请求平均成本超支幅度始终不超过0.4%。当环境变化时，系统展现出强大适应能力：最昂贵模型价格下降一个数量级时可带来最高0.071的质量提升，静默质量退化现象能在预算内被检测并重路由。冷启动模型仅需约142步即可实现有效部署且未突破成本上限。路由器具备智能判别能力：昂贵模型受预算门控约束，低质量模型在有限探索后即被弃用。端到端路由延迟在CPU上仅需9.8毫秒（不足典型推理时间的0.4%），其中路由决策本身仅消耗22.5微秒。
tldr: Presents ParetoBandit, an adaptive router for LLM serving that uses cost-aware contextual bandits to enforce budgets, adapt to non-stationary price/quality shifts, and onboard new models at runtime.
tldr_zh: 提出了ParetoBandit，一种用于LLM服务的自适应路由器，它使用成本感知的上下文赌博机来执行预算、适应非平稳的价格/质量变化，并支持运行时集成新模型。

title: Focal plane wavefront control with model-based reinforcement learning
summary: The direct imaging of potentially habitable exoplanets is one prime science case for high-contrast imaging instruments on extremely large telescopes. Most such exoplanets orbit close to their host stars, where their observation is limited by fast-moving atmospheric speckles and quasi-static non-common-path aberrations (NCPA). Conventional NCPA correction methods often use mechanical mirror probes, which compromise performance during operation. This work presents machine-learning-based NCPA control methods that automatically detect and correct both dynamic and static NCPA errors by leveraging sequential phase diversity. We extend previous work in reinforcement learning for AO to focal plane control. A new model-based RL algorithm, Policy Optimization for NCPAs (PO4NCPA), interprets the focal-plane image as input data and, through sequential phase diversity, determines phase corrections that optimize both non-coronagraphic and post-coronagraphic PSFs without prior system knowledge. Further, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach by numerically simulating static NCPA errors on a ground-based telescope and an infrared imager affected by water-vapor-induced seeing (dynamic NCPAs). Simulations show that PO4NCPA robustly compensates static and dynamic NCPAs. In static cases, it achieves near-optimal focal-plane light suppression with a coronagraph and near-optimal Strehl without one. With dynamics NCPA, it matches the performance of the modal least-squares reconstruction combined with a 1-step delay integrator in these metrics. The method remains effective for the ELT pupil, vector vortex coronagraph, and under photon and background noise. PO4NCPA is model-free and can be directly applied to standard imaging as well as to any coronagraph. Its sub-millisecond inference times and performance also make it suitable for real-time low-order correction of atmospheric turbulence beyond HCI.
summary_zh: 对潜在宜居系外行星的直接成像，是超大型望远镜上高对比度成像仪器的一个核心科学目标。大多数此类系外行星都围绕其宿主恒星近距离运行，其观测受到快速移动的大气散斑和准静态非共路像差（NCPA）的限制。传统的NCPA校正方法通常使用机械镜面探针，这会在操作过程中影响性能。本研究提出了一种基于机器学习的NCPA控制方法，该方法利用序列相位多样性自动检测并校正动态和静态NCPA误差。我们将之前强化学习在自适应光学（AO）中的应用扩展到焦平面控制。一种新的基于模型的强化学习算法——NCPA策略优化（PO4NCPA），将焦平面图像作为输入数据，并通过序列相位多样性，确定能够同时优化非日冕和日冕后点扩散函数（PSF）的相位校正，而无需事先了解系统知识。此外，我们通过数值模拟地面望远镜上受水汽视宁效应（动态NCPA）影响的静态NCPA误差和红外成像仪，证明了该方法的有效性。模拟结果表明，PO4NCPA能够稳健地补偿静态和动态NCPA。在静态情况下，使用日冕仪时，它能在焦平面实现接近最优的光抑制；不使用日冕仪时，则能实现接近最优的斯特列尔比。对于动态NCPA，它在这些指标上的表现与模态最小二乘重构结合一步延迟积分器相当。该方法对于ELT光瞳、矢量涡旋日冕仪，以及在光子和背景噪声下，仍然有效。PO4NCPA是无模型的，可以直接应用于标准成像以及任何日冕仪。其亚毫秒级的推理时间和性能也使其适用于高对比度成像以外的实时大气湍流低阶校正。
tldr: This paper proposes a model-based reinforcement learning method called PO4NCPA for correcting optical aberrations in astronomical imaging systems, which is applied to telescopes and does not involve robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种名为PO4NCPA的基于模型的强化学习方法，用于校正天文成像系统中的光学像差，应用于望远镜，不涉及机器人学或具身智能体。

title: LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequences using SHallow REcurrent Decoders (LAPIS-SHRED)
summary: Reconstructing full spatio-temporal dynamics from sparse observations in both space and time remains a central challenge in complex systems, as measurements can be spatially incomplete and can be also limited to narrow temporal windows. Yet approximating the complete spatio-temporal trajectory is essential for mechanistic insight and understanding, model calibration, and operational decision-making. We introduce LAPIS-SHRED (LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequence using SHallow REcurrent Decoders), a modular architecture that reconstructs and/or forecasts complete spatiotemporal dynamics from sparse sensor observations confined to short temporal windows. LAPIS-SHRED operates through a three-stage pipeline: (i) a SHRED model is pre-trained entirely on simulation data to map sensor time-histories into a structured latent space, (ii) a temporal sequence model, trained on simulation-derived latent trajectories, learns to propagate latent states forward or backward in time to span unobserved temporal regions from short observational time windows, and (iii) at deployment, only a short observation window of hyper-sparse sensor measurements from the true system is provided, from which the frozen SHRED model and the temporal model jointly reconstruct or forecast the complete spatiotemporal trajectory. The framework supports bidirectional inference, inherits data assimilation and multiscale reconstruction capabilities from its modular structure, and accommodates extreme observational constraints including single-frame terminal inputs. We evaluate LAPIS-SHRED on six experiments spanning complex spatio-temporal physics: turbulent flows, multiscale propulsion physics, volatile combustion transients, and satellite-derived environmental fields, highlighting a lightweight, modular architecture suited for operational settings where observation is constrained by physical or logistical limitations.
summary_zh: 在复杂系统中，从时空稀疏观测中重建完整的时空动态仍是一个核心挑战，因为测量数据可能在空间上不完整，且局限于狭窄的时间窗口。然而，近似完整的时空轨迹对于机理洞察与理解、模型校准以及操作决策至关重要。本文提出LAPIS-SHRED（基于浅层递归解码器的短时序潜在相位推断），这是一种模块化架构，能够从局限于短时间窗口的稀疏传感器观测中重建和/或预测完整的时空动态。LAPIS-SHRED通过三阶段流程实现：（i）SHRED模型完全基于模拟数据预训练，将传感器时间序列映射到结构化的潜在空间；（ii）基于模拟数据生成的潜在轨迹训练的时间序列模型，学习在时间上向前或向后传播潜在状态，从而从短观测时间窗口跨越未观测的时间区域；（iii）在部署阶段，仅需提供真实系统中超稀疏传感器测量的短时观测窗口，通过冻结的SHRED模型与时间序列模型协同工作，重建或预测完整的时空轨迹。该框架支持双向推断，从其模块化结构中继承了数据同化和多尺度重建能力，并适应极端观测约束，包括单帧终端输入。我们在涵盖复杂时空物理的六个实验中对LAPIS-SHRED进行了评估：湍流、多尺度推进物理、不稳定燃烧瞬态以及卫星反演环境场，展示了一种适用于物理或条件限制下观测场景的轻量级模块化架构。
tldr: This paper introduces LAPIS-SHRED, a modular framework for reconstructing or forecasting complete spatiotemporal dynamics from sparse sensor data confined to short time windows, evaluated on complex physical systems like turbulent flows and combustion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LAPIS-SHRED，一种用于从短时间窗口内的稀疏传感器数据中重建或预测完整时空动态的模块化框架，并在湍流、燃烧等复杂物理系统中进行了评估。

title: The Recipe Matters More Than the Kitchen:Mathematical Foundations of the AI Weather Prediction Pipeline
summary: AI weather prediction has advanced rapidly, yet no unified mathematical framework explains what determines forecast skill. Existing theory addresses specific architectural choices rather than the learning pipeline as a whole, while operational evidence from 2023-2026 demonstrates that training methodology, loss function design, and data diversity matter at least as much as architecture selection. This paper makes two interleaved contributions. Theoretically, we construct a framework rooted in approximation theory on the sphere, dynamical systems theory, information theory, and statistical learning theory that treats the complete learning pipeline (architecture, loss function, training strategy, data distribution) rather than architecture alone. We establish a Learning Pipeline Error Decomposition showing that estimation error (loss- and data-dependent) dominates approximation error (architecture-dependent) at current scales. We develop a Loss Function Spectral Theory formalizing MSE-induced spectral blurring in spherical harmonic coordinates, and derive Out-of-Distribution Extrapolation Bounds proving that data-driven models systematically underestimate record-breaking extremes with bias growing linearly in record exceedance. Empirically, we validate these predictions via inference across ten architecturally diverse AI weather models using NVIDIA Earth2Studio with ERA5 initial conditions, evaluating six metrics across 30 initialization dates spanning all seasons. Results confirm universal spectral energy loss at high wavenumbers for MSE-trained models, rising Error Consensus Ratios showing that the majority of forecast error is shared across architectures, and linear negative bias during extreme events. A Holistic Model Assessment Score provides unified multi-dimensional evaluation, and a prescriptive framework enables mathematical evaluation of proposed pipelines before training.
summary_zh: 人工智能天气预报已取得长足进展，但目前缺乏统一的数学框架来解释决定预报技能的关键因素。现有理论研究主要针对特定架构选择，而非将学习流程视为整体；而2023-2026年的业务实践表明，训练方法、损失函数设计和数据多样性至少与架构选择同等重要。本文提出两项交织的贡献：理论上，我们构建了一个根植于球面近似理论、动力系统理论、信息论和统计学习理论的框架，该框架涵盖完整学习流程（架构、损失函数、训练策略、数据分布）而非仅关注架构。通过建立学习流程误差分解，证明在当前规模下估计误差（依赖损失函数与数据）已超过近似误差（依赖架构）的主导地位。我们提出的损失函数谱理论形式化描述了球谐坐标系中均方误差引发的谱模糊效应，并推导出分布外推边界，证明数据驱动模型会系统性低估突破历史极值的极端事件，其偏差随极值超越幅度呈线性增长。实证方面，我们通过NVIDIA Earth2Studio平台使用ERA5初始条件对十种架构各异的人工智能天气模型进行推理验证，在涵盖所有季节的30个初始化日期上评估六项指标。结果证实：均方误差训练的模型普遍存在高波数谱能量损失，不断上升的误差共识比率表明多数预报误差在不同架构间具有共性，极端事件期间存在线性负偏差。我们提出的整体模型评估分数实现了统一的多维度评估，并建立了一套规范框架，可在训练前对拟采用的学习流程进行数学评估。
tldr: This paper develops a mathematical framework for analyzing AI weather prediction pipelines, showing that training methodology and data diversity are more critical for forecast skill than model architecture alone.
tldr_zh: 本文为AI天气预报管线构建了一个数学框架，证明训练方法和数据多样性比模型架构本身对预测能力更为关键。

title: $\texttt{YC-Bench}$: Benchmarking AI Agents for Long-Term Planning and Consistent Execution
summary: As LLM agents tackle increasingly complex tasks, a critical question is whether they can maintain strategic coherence over long horizons: planning under uncertainty, learning from delayed feedback, and adapting when early mistakes compound. We introduce $\texttt{YC-Bench}$, a benchmark that evaluates these capabilities by tasking an agent with running a simulated startup over a one-year horizon spanning hundreds of turns. The agent must manage employees, select task contracts, and maintain profitability in a partially observable environment where adversarial clients and growing payroll create compounding consequences for poor decisions. We evaluate 12 models, both proprietary and open source, across 3 seeds each. Only three models consistently surpass the starting capital of \$200K, with Claude Opus 4.6 achieving the highest average final funds at \$1.27 M, followed by GLM-5 at \$1.21 M at 11$\times$ lower inference cost. Scratchpad usage, the sole mechanism for persisting information across context truncation, is the strongest predictor of success, and adversarial client detection is the primary failure mode, accounting for $47\%$ of bankruptcies. Our analysis reveals that frontier models still fail through distinct failure modes such as over-parallelization, demonstrating the capability gaps for long-horizon performance. $\texttt{YC-Bench}$ is open-source, reproducible, and configurable.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型智能体处理的任务日益复杂，一个关键问题在于它们能否在长周期任务中保持战略连贯性：在不确定性下进行规划、从延迟反馈中学习，并在早期错误产生连锁影响时及时调整。为此，我们提出基准测试系统$\texttt{YC-Bench}$，通过模拟为期一年、涉及数百个决策回合的初创公司运营任务，系统评估智能体在上述方面的能力。该任务要求智能体在部分可观测环境中管理员工、选择任务合约并维持盈利能力，其中对抗性客户与不断增长的薪资支出使得决策失误会引发连锁后果。我们对12个专有与开源模型进行各3次随机种子的评估，仅三个模型能持续突破20万美元的初始资本——Claude Opus 4.6以平均127万美元的最终资金表现最佳，随后是GLM-5（平均121万美元），其推理成本仅为前者的1/11。跨上下文截断时唯一的信息持久化机制——草稿纸使用记录——是预测任务成功的最强指标，而对抗性客户识别失败是主要的失误模式，导致47%的破产案例。我们的分析表明，前沿模型仍会因特定失误模式（如过度并行化）而失败，揭示了长周期任务能力存在的差距。$\texttt{YC-Bench}$具有开源、可复现及可配置的特点。
tldr: Presents YC-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon planning and execution of AI agents in a simulated startup environment, finding current models struggle with strategic coherence and failure modes like adversarial client detection.
tldr_zh: 提出了YC-Bench，一个用于评估AI代理在模拟初创公司环境中进行长期规划和执行的基准测试，发现当前模型在战略连贯性和敌对客户检测等失败模式上存在不足。

title: CliffSearch: Structured Agentic Co-Evolution over Theory and Code for Scientific Algorithm Discovery
summary: Scientific algorithm discovery is iterative: hypotheses are proposed, implemented, stress-tested, and revised.
