Current LLM-guided search systems accelerate proposal generation, but often under-represent scientific structure by optimizing code-only artifacts with weak correctness/originality gating. We present CliffSearch, an agentic evolutionary framework in which the core evolution operators (pair selection, crossover, mutation, and review) are implemented as LLM agents, and the loop is designed around three principles: (1) each node is a structured scientific artifact, instantiated in either theory+code or code_only mode, (2) reviewer judgments of correctness and originality are first-class selection gates alongside optimization of the benchmark metric of interest, and (3) mutation is split into exploration and correction pathways with distinct objectives. Exploration mutation imports ideas from adjacent scientific domains to increase novelty, while correction mutation performs targeted evidence-guided repair using reviewer signals over theory, code, benchmark results, and runtime errors. We illustrate the framework on three benchmark-grounded studies: transformer hyper-connection evolution, optimizer discovery on a fixed nanoGPT stack, and a smaller native-optimizer ablation. Across these settings, the same loop supports explicit metric direction, reproducible persistence, and reviewer-gated comparison of discoveries under controlled search conditions. The result is a discovery workflow that prioritizes scientific interpretability and correctness while optimizing task metrics under controlled novelty constraints, rather than maximizing candidate throughput alone. Full run artifacts, interactive visualizations, and exported best nodes for the reported studies are available at https://cliffsearch.ai .
summary_zh: 科学算法发现是一个迭代过程：提出假设、实现、压力测试并修改。现有的大语言模型引导搜索系统加速了假设生成，但往往因优化仅包含代码的产物且缺乏严格的正確性/原创性门控机制，而未能充分体现科学结构。本文提出CliffSearch——一个基于智能体的进化框架，其核心进化算子（配对选择、交叉、变异和评审）均由大语言模型智能体实现，循环设计遵循三项原则：（1）每个节点均为结构化的科学产物，可实例化为"理论+代码"或"仅代码"模式；（2）评审者对正确性和原创性的判断与目标基准指标优化共同构成首选的筛选门控；（3）变异操作被拆分为探索和修正两条路径，分别具有不同目标。探索变异通过引入相邻科学领域的思想来提升新颖性，而修正变异则利用评审者针对理论、代码、基准结果和运行时错误提供的反馈信号，进行有针对性的证据导向修复。我们在三个基于基准测试的研究中展示了该框架：变压器超连接进化、固定nanoGPT架构上的优化器发现，以及小型原生优化器消融实验。在这些场景中，同一循环支持显式指标导向、可复现的持久化，以及在受控搜索条件下通过评审门控对发现结果进行比较。由此产生的发现工作流程优先考虑科学可解释性和正确性，同时在受控新颖性约束下优化任务指标，而非单纯追求候选方案产出量。完整实验数据、交互式可视化图表及已导出最佳节点详见https://cliffsearch.ai。
tldr: CliffSearch is an LLM-driven agentic evolutionary framework for structured scientific algorithm discovery, using co-evolution of theory and code with correctness and novelty gates to guide search.
tldr_zh: CliffSearch 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体进化框架，用于结构化的科学算法发现，通过理论和代码的协同进化，结合正确性和新颖性判断来引导搜索。

title: Online Reasoning Calibration: Test-Time Training Enables Generalizable Conformal LLM Reasoning
summary: While test-time scaling has enabled large language models to solve highly difficult tasks, state-of-the-art results come at exorbitant compute costs. These inefficiencies can be attributed to the miscalibration of post-trained language models, and the lack of calibration in popular sampling techniques. Here, we present Online Reasoning Calibration (ORCA), a framework for calibrating the sampling process that draws upon conformal prediction and test-time training. Specifically, we introduce a meta-learning procedure that updates the calibration module for each input. This allows us to provide valid confidence estimates under distributional shift, e.g. in thought patterns that occur across different stages of reasoning, or in prompt distributions between model development and deployment. ORCA not only provides theoretical guarantees on conformal risks, but also empirically shows higher efficiency and generalization across different reasoning tasks. At risk level $δ=0.1$, ORCA improves Qwen2.5-32B efficiency on in-distribution tasks with savings up to 47.5% with supervised labels and 40.7% with self-consistency labels. Under zero-shot out-of-domain settings, it improves MATH-500 savings from 24.8% of the static calibration baseline to 67.0% while maintaining a low empirical error rate, and the same trend holds across model families and downstream benchmarks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wzekai99/ORCA.
summary_zh: 尽管测试时缩放技术已使大型语言模型能够解决高度复杂的任务，但最先进的结果往往伴随着高昂的计算成本。这些效率低下的问题可归因于后训练语言模型的校准不足，以及主流采样方法中校准机制的缺失。本文提出在线推理校准（ORCA）框架，该框架结合了共形预测与测试时训练技术，旨在对采样过程进行校准。具体而言，我们设计了一种元学习流程，能够针对每个输入动态更新校准模块。这使得我们能够在分布偏移情况下（例如跨推理阶段出现的思维模式差异，或模型开发与部署阶段的提示分布差异）提供有效的置信度估计。ORCA不仅从理论上保证了共形风险的可控性，在实证研究中也展现出更高效率与跨推理任务的泛化能力。在风险水平δ=0.1时，ORCA将Qwen2.5-32B模型在分布内任务上的计算效率提升至47.5%（使用监督标签）和40.7%（使用自洽标签）。在零样本域外设定下，该方法将MATH-500任务的计算节省率从静态校准基线的24.8%提升至67.0%，同时保持较低的经验错误率，这一优势趋势在不同模型家族与下游基准测试中均得到验证。代码已开源：https://github.com/wzekai99/ORCA。
tldr: ORCA is a test-time training method that uses conformal prediction and meta-learning to calibrate LLM reasoning confidence, improving efficiency and generalization for mathematical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: ORCA是一种基于保形预测和元学习的测试时训练方法，用于校准大语言模型推理置信度，在数学推理等任务上提高效率和泛化性。

title: Trust and Reliance on AI in Education: AI Literacy and Need for Cognition as Moderators
summary: As generative AI systems are integrated into educational settings, students often encounter AI-generated output while working through learning tasks, either by requesting help or through integrated tools. Trust in AI can influence how students interpret and use that output, including whether they evaluate it critically or exhibit overreliance. We investigate how students' trust relates to their appropriate reliance on an AI assistant during programming problem-solving tasks, and whether this relationship differs by learner characteristics. With 432 undergraduate participants, students' completed Python output-prediction problems while receiving recommendations and explanations from an AI chatbot, including accurate and intentionally misleading suggestions. We operationalize reliance behaviorally as the extent to which students' responses reflected appropriate use of the AI assistant's suggestions, accepting them when they were correct and rejecting them when they were incorrect. Pre- and post-task surveys assessed trust in the assistant, AI literacy, need for cognition, programming self-efficacy, and programming literacy. Results showed a non-linear relationship in which higher trust was associated with lower appropriate reliance, suggesting weaker discrimination between correct and incorrect recommendations. This relationship was significantly moderated by students' AI literacy and need for cognition. These findings highlight the need for future work on instructional and system supports that encourage more reflective evaluation of AI assistance during problem-solving.
summary_zh: 随着生成式人工智能系统被融入教育环境中，学生在完成学习任务时经常接触到AI生成的内容，无论是通过求助还是集成工具。对AI的信任会影响学生如何解读和使用这些输出，包括他们是否进行批判性评估或表现出过度依赖。本研究探讨了学生在编程问题解决任务中对AI助手的信任如何影响其适当依赖行为，以及这种关系是否因学习者特征而异。研究邀请了432名本科生参与，在完成Python输出预测问题时，他们接收了来自AI聊天机器人的建议和解释，其中包括准确和故意误导的建议。我们将依赖行为操作化为学生反应在多大程度上体现了对AI助手建议的适当使用：在建议正确时接受，错误时拒绝。通过任务前后调查评估了学生对AI助手的信任、AI素养、认知需求、编程自我效能感和编程素养。结果显示，更高的信任与较低的适当依赖呈现非线性关联，表明学生对正确与错误建议的辨别能力较弱。这种关系受到学生AI素养和认知需求的显著调节。这些发现强调，未来需要在教学和系统支持方面开展工作，以鼓励在解决问题过程中更审慎地评估AI辅助。
tldr: Investigates the relationship between student trust in AI and appropriate reliance on an AI assistant for programming tasks, finding that higher trust is linked to poorer discrimination between correct and incorrect suggestions, moderated by AI literacy and need for cognition.
tldr_zh: 研究了学生对AI的信任与编程任务中正确使用AI助手建议之间的关系，发现更高的信任与更差的正确/错误建议辨别能力相关，且这种关系受AI素养和认知需求调节。

title: Approximating Pareto Frontiers in Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization via Hashing and Randomization
summary: Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization (SMOO) is critical for decision-making trading off multiple potentially conflicting objectives in uncertain environments. SMOO aims at identifying the Pareto frontier, which contains all mutually non-dominating decisions. The problem is highly intractable due to the embedded probabilistic inference, such as computing the marginal, posterior probabilities, or expectations. Existing methods, such as scalarization, sample average approximation, and evolutionary algorithms, either offer arbitrarily loose approximations or may incur prohibitive computational costs. We propose XOR-SMOO, a novel algorithm that with probability $1-δ$, obtains $γ$-approximate Pareto frontiers ($γ>1$) for SMOO by querying an SAT oracle poly-log times in $γ$ and $δ$. A $γ$-approximate Pareto frontier is only below the true frontier by a fixed, multiplicative factor $γ$. Thus, XOR-SMOO solves highly intractable SMOO problems (\#P-hard) with only queries to SAT oracles while obtaining tight, constant factor approximation guarantees. Experiments on real-world road network strengthening and supply chain design problems demonstrate that XOR-SMOO outperforms several baselines in identifying Pareto frontiers that have higher objective values, better coverage of the optimal solutions, and the solutions found are more evenly distributed. Overall, XOR-SMOO significantly enhanced the practicality and reliability of SMOO solvers.
summary_zh: 随机多目标优化（SMOO）在不确定环境中对多个潜在冲突目标进行权衡决策时至关重要。SMOO旨在识别包含所有相互非支配决策的帕累托前沿。由于涉及概率推理（如计算边际概率、后验概率或期望值），该问题具有高度难解性。现有方法如标量化、样本平均近似和进化算法等，要么提供任意宽松的近似解，要么可能产生高昂的计算成本。本文提出XOR-SMOO算法，该算法以$1-δ$概率通过查询SAT预言机$\text{poly-log}(\gamma,\delta)$次数，获得SMOO的$\gamma$近似帕累托前沿（$\gamma>1$）。$\gamma$近似帕累托前沿仅在真实前沿下方固定倍数$\gamma$范围内，因此XOR-SMOO仅需查询SAT预言机即可解决高度难解的SMOO问题（#P难问题），同时获得严格的常数因子近似保证。在真实道路网络加固和供应链设计问题上的实验表明，XOR-SMOO在帕累托前沿识别方面优于多种基线方法，其目标值更高、最优解覆盖更全面，且解分布更均匀。总体而言，XOR-SMOO显著提升了SMOO求解器的实用性与可靠性。
tldr: This paper introduces XOR-SMOO, an algorithm for solving Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization (SMOO) problems, obtaining provable constant-factor approximations of the Pareto frontier with poly-logarithmic queries to an SAT oracle, with applications in road network and supply chain design.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了XOR-SMOO算法，用于解决随机多目标优化问题，通过对数级次数的SAT查询，获得帕累托前沿的常数因子近似，并在道路网络和供应链设计问题中验证了其有效性。

title: Temporal Dependencies in In-Context Learning: The Role of Induction Heads
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong in-context learning capabilities, but how they track and retrieve information from context remains underexplored. Drawing on the free recall paradigm in cognitive science (where participants recall list items in any order), we show that several open-source LLMs consistently display a serial-recall-like pattern, assigning peak probability to tokens that immediately follow a repeated token in the input sequence. Through systematic ablation experiments, we show that induction heads, specialized attention heads that attend to the token following a previous occurrence of the current token, play an important role in this phenomenon. Removing heads with a high induction score substantially reduces the +1 lag bias, whereas ablating random heads does not reproduce the same reduction. We also show that removing heads with high induction scores impairs the performance of models prompted to do serial recall using few-shot learning to a larger extent than removing random heads. Our findings highlight a mechanistically specific connection between induction heads and temporal context processing in transformers, suggesting that these heads are especially important for ordered retrieval and serial-recall-like behavior during in-context learning.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的上下文学习能力，但模型如何追踪并从上下文中检索信息仍未得到充分研究。借鉴认知科学中的自由回忆范式（参与者以任意顺序回忆列表项目），我们发现多个开源LLM始终表现出类似序列回忆的模式：它们将最高概率分配给输入序列中紧跟在重复标记之后的标记。通过系统性消融实验，我们证明诱导头——一类专门关注当前标记先前出现位置之后标记的注意力头——在此现象中起重要作用。移除具有高诱导得分的头会显著降低+1滞后偏差，而随机移除注意力头则不会产生相同程度的降低。我们还发现，在要求模型通过少量样本学习进行序列回忆时，移除高诱导得分头对模型性能的损害程度远大于随机移除注意力头。我们的研究结果揭示了Transformer中诱导头与时间上下文处理机制之间的具体关联，表明这些头对于上下文学习中的有序检索和类序列回忆行为尤为重要。
tldr: The paper investigates the role of induction heads in large language models, showing they are crucial for serial-recall-like behavior and temporal information tracking during in-context learning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型中诱导头的作用，发现它们对于模型在上下文学习中进行类似序列回忆的行为和时序信息追踪至关重要。

title: TRACE: Training-Free Partial Audio Deepfake Detection via Embedding Trajectory Analysis of Speech Foundation Models
summary: Partial audio deepfakes, where synthesized segments are spliced into genuine recordings, are particularly deceptive because most of the audio remains authentic. Existing detectors are supervised: they require frame-level annotations, overfit to specific synthesis pipelines, and must be retrained as new generative models emerge. We argue that this supervision is unnecessary. We hypothesize that speech foundation models implicitly encode a forensic signal: genuine speech forms smooth, slowly varying embedding trajectories, while splice boundaries introduce abrupt disruptions in frame-level transitions. Building on this, we propose TRACE (Training-free Representation-based Audio Countermeasure via Embedding dynamics), a training-free framework that detects partial audio deepfakes by analyzing the first-order dynamics of frozen speech foundation model representations without any training, labeled data, or architectural modification. We evaluate TRACE on four benchmarks that span two languages using six speech foundation models. In PartialSpoof, TRACE achieves 8.08% EER, competitive with fine-tuned supervised baselines. In LlamaPartialSpoof, the most challenging benchmark featuring LLM-driven commercial synthesis, TRACE surpasses a supervised baseline outright (24.12% vs. 24.49% EER) without any target-domain data. These results show that temporal dynamics in speech foundation models provide an effective, generalize signal for training-free audio forensics.
summary_zh: 局部音频深度伪造，即合成片段被插入到真实录音中，因其大部分音频内容仍保持真实性而具有极高的欺骗性。现有检测方法均为有监督方法：需要帧级标注、容易过度拟合特定合成流程，且必须随新生成模型的出现而重新训练。我们认为这种监督并非必要，并提出假设：语音基础模型已隐式编码了鉴伪信号——真实语音会形成平滑缓慢变化的嵌入轨迹，而拼接边界会引入帧级过渡的突变。基于此，我们提出TRACE（基于嵌入动态的无训练表征音频反制框架），该无需训练的框架通过分析冻结语音基础模型表征的一阶动态来检测局部音频深度伪造，整个过程无需任何训练、标注数据或架构修改。我们在跨两种语言的四个基准测试中使用六种语音基础模型对TRACE进行评估。在PartialSpoof数据集中，TRACE实现了8.08%的等错误率，与经过微调的有监督基线模型性能相当。在最具挑战性的基于LLM驱动商业合成技术的LlamaPartialSpoof基准测试中，TRACE在未使用任何目标域数据的情况下，直接超越了有监督基线（24.12% vs. 24.49%等错误率）。这些结果表明，语音基础模型中的时序动态特性为无训练音频鉴伪提供了有效且泛化的信号。
tldr: Proposes TRACE, a training-free method for detecting partial audio deepfakes by analyzing the temporal dynamics of embeddings from frozen speech foundation models, achieving competitive performance with supervised methods.
tldr_zh: 提出TRACE，一种无需训练的局部音频深度伪造检测方法，通过分析冻结的语音基础模型嵌入的动态轨迹来实现，性能与监督方法相当。

title: VibeGuard: A Security Gate Framework for AI-Generated Code
summary: "Vibe coding," in which developers delegate code generation to AI assistants and accept the output with little manual review, has gained rapid adoption in production settings. On March 31, 2026, Anthropic's Claude Code CLI shipped a 59.8 MB source map file in its npm package, exposing roughly 512,000 lines of proprietary TypeScript. The tool had itself been largely vibe-coded, and the leak traced to a misconfigured packaging rule rather than a logic bug. Existing static-analysis and secret-scanning tools did not cover this failure mode, pointing to a gap between the vulnerabilities AI tends to introduce and the vulnerabilities current tooling is built to find. We present VibeGuard, a pre-publish security gate that targets five such blind spots: artifact hygiene, packaging-configuration drift, source-map exposure, hardcoded secrets, and supply-chain risk. In controlled experiments on eight synthetic projects (seven vulnerable, one clean control), VibeGuard achieved 100% recall, 89.47% precision (F1 = 94.44%), and correct pass/fail gate decisions on all eight projects across three policy levels. We discuss how these results inform a defense-in-depth workflow for teams that rely on AI code generation.
summary_zh: 氛围编程"——即开发者将代码生成工作委托给AI助手，并在极少人工审查的情况下接受其输出——已在生产环境中快速普及。2026年3月31日，Anthropic公司的Claude Code CLI在其npm包中意外发布了一个59.8 MB的源码映射文件，导致约51.2万行专有TypeScript代码遭到泄露。该工具本身的开发过程大量采用了氛围编程模式，而泄露根源被追溯到配置错误的打包规则，而非逻辑缺陷。现有静态分析与密钥扫描工具均未能覆盖此类故障模式，这揭示了AI易引入的漏洞类型与当前工具设计所针对的漏洞类型之间存在盲区。我们提出VibeGuard方案，这是一个针对五大类盲区的预发布安全关卡：制品清洁度、打包配置偏移、源码映射暴露、硬编码密钥及供应链风险。在八个合成项目（七个含漏洞，一个作为清洁对照）的受控实验中，VibeGuard在三重策略级别下实现了100%召回率、89.47%精确率（F1分数=94.44%），并对所有八个项目作出准确的通过/拦截决策。我们进一步探讨这些结果如何为依赖AI代码生成的团队构建纵深防御工作流提供实践指导。
tldr: Introduces VibeGuard, a pre-publish security gate framework targeting novel vulnerabilities introduced by 'vibe coding' with AI assistants, focusing on issues like packaging misconfigurations and artifact hygiene.
tldr_zh: 提出了VibeGuard，一个针对AI代码生成中引入的新型漏洞（如打包配置错误、构件卫生等）的预发布安全门框架。

title: Query-Conditioned Evidential Keyframe Sampling for MLLM-Based Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance on video question answering, but their application to long-form videos is constrained by limited context length and computational cost, making keyframe sampling essential. Existing approaches typically rely on semantic relevance or reinforcement learning, which either fail to capture evidential clues or suffer from inefficient combinatorial optimization. In this work, we propose an evidence-driven keyframe sampling framework grounded in information bottleneck theory. We formulate keyframe selection as maximizing the conditional mutual information between selected frames and the query, providing a principled objective that reflects each frame's contribution to answering the question. To make this objective tractable, we exploit its structure to derive a decomposed optimization that reduces subset selection to independent frame-level scoring. We further introduce a query-conditioned evidence scoring network trained with a contrastive objective to estimate evidential importance efficiently. Experiments on long-form video understanding benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms prior sampling strategies under strict token budgets, while significantly improving training efficiency.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视频问答任务中展现出强大性能，但其在长视频中的应用受限于上下文长度和计算成本，使得关键帧采样成为关键环节。现有方法通常依赖语义相关性或强化学习，这些方法要么无法捕捉证据线索，要么面临组合优化效率低下的问题。本研究提出了一种基于信息瓶颈理论的证据驱动关键帧采样框架。我们将关键帧选择问题形式化为最大化选定帧与查询之间的条件互信息，从而构建了一个能够反映各帧对问题回答贡献度的理论优化目标。为使该目标可解，我们利用其结构特性推导出分解优化方案，将子集选择问题简化为独立的帧级评分任务。此外，我们引入了基于对比学习训练的查询条件证据评分网络，以实现对证据重要性的高效评估。在长视频理解基准测试上的实验表明，在严格令牌预算下，本方法持续优于现有采样策略，同时显著提升了训练效率。
tldr: This paper proposes an evidence-driven keyframe sampling method based on information bottleneck theory for improving MLLM-based long-form video understanding. It frames keyframe selection as maximizing mutual information with the query, enabling efficient, query-conditioned scoring.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于信息瓶颈理论的证据驱动关键帧采样方法，用于提升基于MLLM的长视频理解。它将关键帧选择问题构建为最大化与查询的互信息，从而实现高效、查询条件化的评分。

title: Multimodal Analysis of State-Funded News Coverage of the Israel-Hamas War on YouTube Shorts
summary: YouTube Shorts have become central to news consumption on the platform, yet research on how geopolitical events are represented in this format remains limited. To address this gap, we present a multimodal pipeline that combines automatic transcription, aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA), and semantic scene classification. The pipeline is first assessed for feasibility and then applied to analyze short-form coverage of the Israel-Hamas war by state-funded outlets. Using over 2,300 conflict-related Shorts and more than 94,000 visual frames, we systematically examine war reporting across major international broadcasters. Our findings reveal that the sentiment expressed in transcripts regarding specific aspects differs across outlets and over time, whereas scene-type classifications reflect visual cues consistent with real-world events. Notably, smaller domain-adapted models outperform large transformers and even LLMs for sentiment analysis, underscoring the value of resource-efficient approaches for humanities research. The pipeline serves as a template for other short-form platforms, such as TikTok and Instagram, and demonstrates how multimodal methods, combined with qualitative interpretation, can characterize sentiment patterns and visual cues in algorithmically driven video environments.
summary_zh: YouTube Shorts已成为平台新闻消费的核心载体，但关于地缘政治事件在此类短视频中呈现方式的研究仍显不足。为填补这一空白，本研究提出一种结合自动转录、基于方面的情感分析（ABSA）与语义场景分类的多模态分析框架。该框架首先通过可行性评估，随后应用于分析国家资助媒体对以色列-哈马斯冲突的短视频报道。通过对超过2,300条冲突相关短视频及94,000余帧视觉画面的分析，我们系统考察了主要国际广播机构的战争报道模式。研究发现：不同媒体机构在特定议题上的文本情感倾向存在差异且随时间变化，而场景分类结果则显示出与现实事件相符的视觉特征。值得注意的是，在情感分析任务中，经过领域适配的小型模型表现优于大型Transformer模型乃至大语言模型，这印证了资源高效型方法在人文研究中的价值。本分析框架可为TikTok、Instagram等短视频平台提供研究范式，并通过多模态方法与定性解读的结合，揭示了算法驱动视频环境中情感模式与视觉线索的表征机制。
tldr: This paper presents a multimodal pipeline for analyzing sentiment and visual content in YouTube Shorts news coverage of the Israel-Hamas war, finding domain-adapted models outperform large transformers for sentiment analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多模态分析流程，用于分析YouTube Shorts上关于以色列-哈马斯战争的新闻报道，发现在情感分析任务中，领域适应的小型模型优于大型Transformer模型。

title: Bridging Structured Knowledge and Data: A Unified Framework with Finance Applications
summary: We develop Structured-Knowledge-Informed Neural Networks (SKINNs), a unified estimation framework that embeds theoretical, simulated, previously learned, or cross-domain insights as differentiable constraints within flexible neural function approximation. SKINNs jointly estimate neural network parameters and economically meaningful structural parameters in a single optimization problem, enforcing theoretical consistency not only on observed data but over a broader input domain through collocation, and therefore nesting approaches such as functional GMM, Bayesian updating, transfer learning, PINNs, and surrogate modeling. SKINNs define a class of M-estimators that are consistent and asymptotically normal with root-N convergence, sandwich covariance, and recovery of pseudo-true parameters under misspecification. We establish identification of structural parameters under joint flexibility, derive generalization and target-risk bounds under distributional shift in a convex proxy, and provide a restricted-optimal characterization of the weighting parameter that governs the bias-variance tradeoff. In an illustrative financial application to option pricing, SKINNs improve out-of-sample valuation and hedging performance, particularly at longer horizons and during high-volatility regimes, while recovering economically interpretable structural parameters with improved stability relative to conventional calibration. More broadly, SKINNs provide a general econometric framework for combining model-based reasoning with high-dimensional, data-driven estimation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种统一估计框架——结构化知识信息神经网络（SKINNs），该框架将理论、模拟、先前学习或跨领域的见解作为可微约束嵌入灵活的神经函数逼近中。SKINNs在一个优化问题中联合估计神经网络参数和具有经济意义的结构参数，不仅通过配置点法在观测数据上强制理论一致性，更在更广泛的输入域中保持理论约束，从而将函数型广义矩估计、贝叶斯更新、迁移学习、物理信息神经网络以及代理建模等方法纳入统一框架。SKINNs定义了一类M估计量，这些估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，在模型误设情况下仍能保持根号N收敛速度、三明治协方差结构以及伪真实参数的恢复能力。我们在联合灵活性条件下证明了结构参数的可识别性，推导出凸代理框架下分布漂移时的泛化与目标风险界，并给出了控制偏差-方差权衡的权重参数的约束最优表征。在期权定价的金融应用示例中，SKINNs显著提升了样本外估值和对冲表现（尤其在长期期限和高波动行情下），同时恢复了具有经济可解释性的结构参数，其稳定性较传统校准方法有明显改善。更广泛而言，SKINNs为融合基于模型的推理与高维数据驱动估计提供了一个通用的计量经济学框架。
tldr: Presents a unified estimation framework (SKINNs) that incorporates structured knowledge into neural networks as differentiable constraints, demonstrating application in finance with improved out-of-sample performance and structural parameter recovery.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种统一的估计框架（SKINNs），将结构化知识作为可微分约束嵌入神经网络，并在金融应用中展示了优于传统校准的样本外性能和稳定性。

title: Learning Quantised Structure-Preserving Motion Representations for Dance Fingerprinting
summary: We present DANCEMATCH, an end-to-end framework for motion-based dance retrieval, the task of identifying semantically similar choreographies directly from raw video, defined as DANCE FINGERPRINTING. While existing motion analysis and retrieval methods can compare pose sequences, they rely on continuous embeddings that are difficult to index, interpret, or scale. In contrast, DANCEMATCH constructs compact, discrete motion signatures that capture the spatio-temporal structure of dance while enabling efficient large-scale retrieval. Our system integrates Skeleton Motion Quantisation (SMQ) with Spatio-Temporal Transformers (STT) to encode human poses, extracted via Apple CoMotion, into a structured motion vocabulary. We further design DANCE RETRIEVAL ENGINE (DRE), which performs sub-linear retrieval using a histogram-based index followed by re-ranking for refined matching. To facilitate reproducible research, we release DANCETYPESBENCHMARK, a pose-aligned dataset annotated with quantised motion tokens. Experiments demonstrate robust retrieval across diverse dance styles and strong generalisation to unseen choreographies, establishing a foundation for scalable motion fingerprinting and quantitative choreographic analysis.
summary_zh: 本文提出DANCEMATCH——一种基于动作的舞蹈检索端到端框架，其核心任务是从原始视频中直接识别语义相似的编舞动作，这一过程被定义为舞蹈指纹识别。现有动作分析与检索方法虽能比较姿态序列，但依赖难以索引、解释或扩展的连续嵌入表示。相比之下，DANCEMATCH通过构建紧凑的离散动作签名，在捕捉舞蹈时空结构的同时实现高效的大规模检索。本系统融合骨架运动量化（SMQ）与时空变换器（STT），将通过苹果CoMotion提取的人体姿态编码为结构化运动词库。我们进一步设计了舞蹈检索引擎（DRE），采用基于直方图的索引实现亚线性检索，并通过重排序机制进行精细化匹配。为促进可重复研究，我们发布了经过姿态对齐并标注量化运动标记的数据集DANCETYPESBENCHMARK。实验表明，该系统能在多种舞蹈风格中实现鲁棒检索，并对未见过的编舞动作具有强泛化能力，为可扩展的运动指纹识别与量化编舞分析奠定了技术基础。
tldr: Proposes DANCEMATCH, an end-to-end framework for motion-based dance retrieval via quantized motion signatures and a sub-linear retrieval engine, aiming for scalable choreographic analysis.
tldr_zh: 提出DANCEMATCH，这是一个基于量化运动签名和亚线性检索引擎的端到端舞蹈检索框架，旨在实现可扩展的编舞分析。

title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Geometric Problem Solving (GPS) remains at the heart of enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models because it requires the combination of diagrammatic understanding, symbolic manipulation and logical inference. In existing literature, researchers have chiefly focused on synchronising the diagram descriptions with text literals and solving the problem. In this vein, they have either taken a neural, symbolic or neuro-symbolic approach. But this solves only the first two of the requirements, namely diagrammatic understanding and symbolic manipulation, while leaving logical inference underdeveloped. The logical inference is often limited to one chain-of-thought (CoT). To address this weakness in hitherto existing models, this paper proposes MARS-GPS, that generates multiple parallel reasoning rollouts augmented with Python code execution for numerical verification, ranks them using token-level entropy as a confidence signal, and aggregates answers through a multi-stage voting and self-verification pipeline. Empirical results show that MARS-GPS with 8 parallel rollouts achieves 88.8% on Geometry3K, a nearly +11% improvement over the prior state-of-the-art, with accuracy scaling consistently as the number of rollouts increases from 1 to 16 (+6.0% on ablation subset). We provide our code and data in an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55.
summary_zh: 几何问题求解（GPS）始终是提升大语言模型数学推理能力的核心，因为它要求综合图表理解、符号运算与逻辑推理。现有研究主要聚焦于将图表描述与文本信息同步并进行问题求解，在此过程中，研究者采用了神经、符号或神经符号相结合的方法。然而，这些方法仅满足了前两个需求——即图表理解与符号运算，而逻辑推理能力尚未得到充分发展。现有的逻辑推理往往局限于单链思维模式。为弥补这一缺陷，本文提出MARS-GPS模型，该模型通过生成多个并行推理路径并辅以Python代码执行进行数值验证，使用词元级熵作为置信度信号进行排序，并通过多阶段投票与自我验证流程聚合答案。实验结果表明，采用8条并行推理路径的MARS-GPS在Geometry3K数据集上达到88.8%的准确率，较先前最优性能提升近11%，且随着推理路径数量从1增至16，准确率持续稳定提升（在消融实验子集中提升+6.0%）。我们将代码与数据公开于匿名存储库：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55。
tldr: This paper introduces MARS-GPS, a method that uses multiple parallel reasoning rollouts with Python code execution and a multi-stage voting pipeline to improve geometric problem solving in large language models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MARS-GPS方法，通过使用多个并行推理路径、Python代码执行和多阶段投票管道，来提升大语言模型在几何问题解决上的能力。

title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
summary: Test-Time Learning (TTL) enables language agents to iteratively refine their performance through repeated interactions with the environment at inference time. At the core of TTL is an adaptation policy that updates the actor policy based on experience from previous episodes, thereby improving future behavior. Existing methods rely on fixed, hand-crafted adaptation policies rather than optimizing them for downstream improvement. We argue that optimal adaptation policies should be learned from task environments, not hand-engineered based on human intuition. To achieve this, we introduce Meta-TTL, a framework that formulates the discovery of effective adaptation policies as a bi-level optimization problem. Within this framework, the inner loop executes the standard TTL process, measuring how effectively a candidate adaptation policy helps an agent correct errors across sequential episodes. Guided by the agent's performance, the outer loop employs evolutionary search over a diverse distribution of training tasks to iteratively refine the adaptation policy. We evaluate Meta-TTL on Jericho and WebArena-Lite across both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, using multiple meta-agent backbones. Results on both benchmarks show that Meta-TTL consistently outperforms hand-crafted baselines, suggesting that the optimized adaptation policy encodes transferable strategies that generalize beyond the training task distribution.
summary_zh: 测试时学习（TTL）使语言智能体能够通过在推理阶段与环境进行反复交互来迭代优化其性能。TTL的核心在于自适应策略，该策略基于历史交互经验更新执行策略，从而提升未来行为表现。现有方法依赖于固定的人工设计自适应策略，而非针对下游任务改进进行优化。我们认为，最优的自适应策略应从任务环境中学习获得，而非仅基于人类直觉手工构建。为此，我们提出Meta-TTL框架，将有效自适应策略的发现过程建模为双层优化问题。在该框架中，内层循环执行标准TTL流程，评估候选自适应策略帮助智能体在连续任务中修正错误的效果；外层循环则通过进化搜索在多样化的训练任务分布上进行迭代，以智能体表现为指导持续优化自适应策略。我们在Jericho和WebArena-Lite平台上，使用多种元智能体基座模型，分别对分布内和分布外场景进行了评估。两个基准测试的结果表明，Meta-TTL始终优于人工设计的基线方法，说明优化后的自适应策略能够编码可迁移的泛化策略，其能力可超越训练任务分布的范围。
tldr: This paper introduces Meta-TTL, a framework that learns adaptation policies for test-time learning in language agents via bi-level optimization, evaluated on text-based interactive benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Meta-TTL框架，通过双层优化学习语言代理的测试时学习适应策略，并在基于文本的交互式基准测试上进行了评估。

title: Emotion Entanglement and Bayesian Inference for Multi-Dimensional Emotion Understanding
summary: Understanding emotions in natural language is inherently a multi-dimensional reasoning problem, where multiple affective signals interact through context, interpersonal relations, and situational cues. However, most existing emotion understanding benchmarks rely on short texts and predefined emotion labels, reducing this process to independent label prediction and ignoring the structured dependencies among emotions. To address this limitation, we introduce Emotional Scenarios (EmoScene), a theory-grounded benchmark of 4,731 context-rich scenarios annotated with an 8-dimensional emotion vector derived from Plutchik's basic emotions. We evaluate six instruction-tuned large language models in a zero-shot setting and observe modest performance, with the best model achieving a Macro F1 of 0.501, highlighting the difficulty of context-aware multi-label emotion prediction. Motivated by the observation that emotions rarely occur independently, we further propose an entanglement-aware Bayesian inference framework that incorporates emotion co-occurrence statistics to perform joint posterior inference over the emotion vector. This lightweight post-processing improves structural consistency of predictions and yields notable gains for weaker models (e.g., +0.051 Macro F1 for Qwen2.5-7B). EmoScene therefore provides a challenging benchmark for studying multi-dimensional emotion understanding and the limitations of current language models.
summary_zh: 理解自然语言中的情感本质上是一个多维度推理问题，多个情感信号通过语境、人际关系和情境线索相互作用。然而，现有的大多数情感理解基准依赖短文本和预定义的情感标签，将这一过程简化为独立的标签预测，忽略了情感之间的结构化依赖关系。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了情感场景（EmoScene），这是一个基于理论构建的基准数据集，包含4，731个情境丰富的场景，每个场景均标注了基于普拉奇克基本情绪理论衍生的八维情感向量。我们在零样本设置下评估了六个经过指令微调的大语言模型，发现其性能有限，最优模型的宏观F1分数仅为0.501，这凸显了上下文感知的多标签情感预测任务的难度。基于情感极少独立出现的观察，我们进一步提出一种感知情感纠缠的贝叶斯推理框架，该框架通过融合情感共现统计信息，对情感向量进行联合后验推断。这种轻量级后处理方法提升了预测的结构一致性，并为性能较弱的模型带来了显著增益（例如Qwen2.5-7B模型的宏观F1分数提升0.051）。因此，EmoScene为研究多维情感理解及当前语言模型的局限性提供了一个具有挑战性的基准。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark for multi-dimensional emotion understanding in natural language and a Bayesian inference framework to improve predictions, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于自然语言中多维度情感理解的基准数据集和一个用于改进预测的贝叶斯推理框架，与机器人或具身AI没有直接关联。

title: Routing-Free Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models rely on centralized routing mechanisms that introduce rigid inductive biases. We propose Routing-Free MoE which eliminates any hard-coded centralized designs including external routers, Softmax, Top-K and load balancing, instead encapsulating all activation functionalities within individual experts and directly optimized through continuous gradient flow, enabling each expert to determine its activation entirely on its own. We introduce a unified adaptive load-balancing framework to simultaneously optimize both expert-balancing and token-balancing objectives through a configurable interpolation, allowing flexible and customizable resource allocation. Extensive experiments show that Routing-Free MoE can consistently outperform baselines with better scalability and robustness. We analyze its behavior in detail and offer insights that may facilitate future MoE design ad optimization.
summary_zh: 标准的混合专家（MoE）模型依赖于集中式路由机制，这种机制引入了固化的归纳偏置。我们提出无路由混合专家模型，该方法消除了包括外部路由、Softmax、Top-K和负载均衡在内的所有硬编码集中式设计，转而将所有激活功能封装在单个专家内部，并通过连续梯度流直接优化，使每个专家能完全自主决定其激活状态。我们引入一个统一的自适应负载均衡框架，通过可配置的插值同时优化专家均衡与令牌均衡目标，从而实现灵活可定制的资源分配。大量实验表明，无路由混合专家模型在可扩展性和鲁棒性方面均能持续超越基线模型。我们对其行为进行了详细分析，并提供了有助于未来混合专家模型设计与优化的见解。
tldr: This paper proposes a routing-free Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that eliminates centralized routing mechanisms, instead encapsulating activation within individual experts and optimizing through gradient flow, while introducing a unified adaptive load-balancing framework.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无路由的混合专家模型，消除了集中式路由机制，将激活功能封装在单个专家内部并通过梯度流优化，同时引入了统一的自适应负载平衡框架。

title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning
summary: We propose the Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation (PG-IPRO) for urban route planning for people with different accessibility requirements and preferences. With this algorithm the user can interact with the system by giving feedback on a route, i.e., the user can say which objective should be further minimized, or conversely can be relaxed. This leads to intuitive user interaction, that is especially effective during early iterations compared to information-gain-based interaction. Furthermore, due to PG-IPRO's iterative nature, the full set of alternative, possibly optimal policies (the Pareto front), is never computed, leading to higher computational efficiency and shorter waiting times for users.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于偏好引导的迭代帕累托参考优化方法（PG-IPRO），用于为具有不同可达性需求和偏好的用户进行城市路径规划。该算法允许用户通过给出路径反馈与系统交互，即用户可指定哪些目标应进一步优化，或哪些目标可适当放宽。这种交互方式直观易懂，在早期迭代阶段相比基于信息增益的交互方法更为高效。此外，由于PG-IPRO的迭代特性，系统无需计算所有可能最优策略的完整集合（帕累托前沿），从而显著提高了计算效率，并缩短了用户的等待时间。
tldr: This paper proposes a user-interactive route planning algorithm for urban accessibility, focusing on iterative preference-guided Pareto optimization, which is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于城市无障碍路线规划的用户交互算法，基于迭代偏好引导的帕累托优化，与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。

title: UK AISI Alignment Evaluation Case-Study
summary: This technical report presents methods developed by the UK AI Security Institute for assessing whether advanced AI systems reliably follow intended goals. Specifically, we evaluate whether frontier models sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants within an AI lab. Applying our methods to four frontier models, we find no confirmed instances of research sabotage. However, we observe that Claude Opus 4.5 Preview (a pre-release snapshot of Opus 4.5) and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refuse to engage with safety-relevant research tasks, citing concerns about research direction, involvement in self-training, and research scope. We additionally find that Opus 4.5 Preview shows reduced unprompted evaluation awareness compared to Sonnet 4.5, while both models can distinguish evaluation from deployment scenarios when prompted. Our evaluation framework builds on Petri, an open-source LLM auditing tool, with a custom scaffold designed to simulate realistic internal deployment of a coding agent. We validate that this scaffold produces trajectories that all tested models fail to reliably distinguish from real deployment data. We test models across scenarios varying in research motivation, activity type, replacement threat, and model autonomy. Finally, we discuss limitations including scenario coverage and evaluation awareness.
summary_zh: 本技术报告介绍了英国人工智能安全研究所开发的评估方法，旨在检验先进人工智能系统是否能够可靠地遵循预设目标。具体而言，我们评估了前沿模型在人工智能实验室中作为编程助手部署时，是否会破坏安全研究。通过对四个前沿模型的应用测试，我们未发现研究破坏行为的确凿案例。然而，我们观察到Claude Opus 4.5 Preview（Opus 4.5的预发布版本）和Sonnet 4.5频繁拒绝参与安全相关的研究任务，其理由包括对研究方向、自我训练参与度及研究范围的顾虑。此外，与Sonnet 4.5相比，Opus 4.5 Preview在无提示情况下表现出较低的评价意识，但两种模型在收到提示时均能区分评估场景与部署场景。我们的评估框架基于开源大语言模型审计工具Petri构建，并采用定制化脚手架来模拟编程代理在真实环境中的内部部署。经验证，该脚手架生成的轨迹与真实部署数据无法被所有测试模型可靠区分。我们在不同研究动机、活动类型、替代威胁和模型自主性的场景下对模型进行了测试。最后，我们探讨了包括场景覆盖度和评价意识在内的局限性。
tldr: This technical report from the UK AI Security Institute details an evaluation framework for assessing whether advanced AI models (e.g., Claude Opus, Sonnet) follow intended goals, specifically focusing on their potential to sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants in an AI lab. They found no confirmed sabotage but observed frequent task refusals by some models, and they discuss limitations of their evaluation methodology.
tldr_zh: 这份来自英国人工智能安全研究所的技术报告详细介绍了评估高级AI模型（如Claude Opus, Sonnet）是否遵循预设目标的框架，特别关注其在AI实验室中作为编码助手部署时可能破坏安全研究的潜在风险。未发现确认的破坏行为，但观察到某些模型频繁拒绝任务，并讨论了其评估方法的局限性。

title: BioCOMPASS: Integrating Biomarkers into Transformer-Based Immunotherapy Response Prediction
summary: Datasets used in immunotherapy response prediction are typically small in size, as well as diverse in cancer type, drug administered, and sequencer used. Models often drop in performance when tested on patient cohorts that are not included in the training process. Recent work has shown that transformer-based models along with self-supervised learning show better generalisation performance than threshold-based biomarkers, but is still suboptimal. We present BioCOMPASS, an extension of a transformer-based model called COMPASS, that integrates biomarkers and treatment information to further improve its generalisability. Instead of feeding biomarker data as input, we built loss components to align them with the model's intermediate representations. We found that components such as treatment gating and pathway consistency loss improved generalisability when evaluated with Leave-one-cohort-out, Leave-one-cancer-type-out and Leave-one-treatment-out strategies. Results show that building components that exploit biomarker and treatment information can help in generalisability of immunotherapy response prediction. Careful curation of additional components that leverage complementary clinical information and domain knowledge represents a promising direction for future research.
summary_zh: 免疫治疗反应预测中使用的数据集通常规模较小，且在癌症类型、给药方案和测序平台方面具有多样性。当在训练过程中未纳入的患者队列上进行测试时，模型性能往往会出现下降。近期研究表明，基于Transformer的模型结合自监督学习展现出比基于阈值的生物标志物更好的泛化性能，但仍有提升空间。我们提出BioCOMPASS——一种基于Transformer模型COMPASS的扩展架构，它通过整合生物标志物与治疗信息来进一步提升泛化能力。我们未将生物标志物数据直接作为模型输入，而是构建了损失函数组件以使其与模型中间表示对齐。研究发现，在采用留出单队列、留出单癌症类型和留出单治疗方案的评估策略时，治疗门控与通路一致性损失等组件能有效提升泛化性能。结果表明，通过构建利用生物标志物与治疗信息的组件，能够增强免疫治疗反应预测的泛化能力。精心设计更多可整合互补临床信息与领域知识的组件，为未来研究提供了具有潜力的发展方向。
tldr: The paper presents BioCOMPASS, a transformer-based model that integrates biomarker and treatment information via specialized loss components to improve generalizability for immunotherapy response prediction in oncology.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了BioCOMPASS，一种基于Transformer的模型，通过专门的损失组件整合生物标志物和治疗信息，以提高肿瘤免疫治疗反应预测的泛化能力。

title: To Memorize or to Retrieve: Scaling Laws for RAG-Considerate Pretraining
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language model (LM) performance by providing relevant context at test time for knowledge-intensive situations. However, the relationship between parametric knowledge acquired during pretraining and non-parametric knowledge accessed via retrieval remains poorly understood, especially under fixed data budgets. In this work, we systematically study the trade-off between pretraining corpus size and retrieval store size across a wide range of model and data scales. We train OLMo-2-based LMs ranging from 30M to 3B parameters on up to 100B tokens of DCLM data, while varying both pretraining data scale (1-150x the number of parameters) and retrieval store size (1-20x), and evaluate performance across a diverse suite of benchmarks spanning reasoning, scientific QA, and open-domain QA. We find that retrieval consistently improves performance over parametric-only baselines across model scales and introduce a three-dimensional scaling framework that models performance as a function of model size, pretraining tokens, and retrieval corpus size. This scaling manifold enables us to estimate optimal allocations of a fixed data budget between pretraining and retrieval, revealing that the marginal utility of retrieval depends strongly on model scale, task type, and the degree of pretraining saturation. Our results provide a quantitative foundation for understanding when and how retrieval should complement pretraining, offering practical guidance for allocating data resources in the design of scalable language modeling systems.
summary_zh: 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）通过在知识密集型场景中为测试时提供相关上下文，显著提升了语言模型（LM）的性能。然而，对于预训练过程中获得的参数化知识与通过检索获取的非参数化知识之间的关系，尤其是在固定数据预算下，目前仍缺乏深入理解。本研究通过系统性地探究模型与数据规模变化下，预训练语料库规模与检索存储规模之间的权衡关系，填补了这一空白。我们基于 OLMo-2 架构，训练了参数量从 30M 到 3B 不等的语言模型，使用的 DCLM 数据规模高达 100B 词元，同时调整了预训练数据规模（1 至 150 倍参数数量）与检索存储规模（1 至 20 倍）。评估涵盖了推理、科学问答和开放域问答等多个领域的基准测试。研究发现，在所有模型规模下，检索机制均能持续提升纯参数化基线的性能，并据此构建了一个三维扩展框架，该框架将模型性能建模为模型规模、预训练词元数量和检索语料库规模的函数。这一扩展模型使我们能够估算在固定数据预算下，预训练与检索之间的最优分配方案，揭示了检索的边际效用高度依赖于模型规模、任务类型以及预训练饱和程度。我们的研究结果为理解检索应何时以及如何补充预训练提供了量化依据，并为可扩展语言建模系统设计中的数据资源分配提供了实践指导。
tldr: This paper investigates scaling laws for pretraining language models when combined with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), studying the trade-off between memorizing knowledge during pretraining and accessing it via retrieval.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了结合检索增强生成（RAG）时，预训练语言模型的缩放规律，探讨了在预训练中记忆知识与通过检索获取知识之间的权衡。

title: AutoEG: Exploiting Known Third-Party Vulnerabilities in Black-Box Web Applications
summary:
Large-scale web applications are widely deployed with complex third-party components, inheriting security risks arising from component vulnerabilities. Security assessment is therefore required to determine whether such known vulnerabilities remain practically exploitable in real applications. Penetration testing is a widely adopted approach that validates exploitability by launching concrete attacks against known vulnerabilities in real-world black-box systems. However, existing approaches often fail to automatically generate reliable exploits, limiting their effectiveness in practical security assessment. This limitation mainly stems from two issues: (1) precisely triggering vulnerabilities with correct technical details, and (2) adapting exploits to diverse real-world deployment settings.
  In this paper, we propose AutoEG, a fully automated multi-agent framework for exploit generation targeting black-box web applications. AutoEG has two phases: First, AutoEG extracts precise vulnerability trigger logic from unstructured vulnerability information and encapsulates it into reusable trigger functions. Second, AutoEG uses trigger functions for concrete attack objectives and iteratively refines exploits through feedback-driven interaction with the target application. We evaluate AutoEG on 104 real-world vulnerabilities with 29 attack objectives, resulting in 660 exploitation tasks and 55,440 exploit attempts. AutoEG achieves an average success rate of 82.41%, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art baselines, whose best performance reaches only 32.88%.
summary_zh:
大规模Web应用广泛部署着复杂的第三方组件，因而继承了组件漏洞带来的安全风险。为此需要通过安全评估来确定这些已知漏洞在实际应用中是否仍具有可被利用性。渗透测试作为一种广泛应用的方法，通过针对真实世界黑盒系统中的已知漏洞发起具体攻击来验证其可利用性。然而，现有方法往往难以自动生成可靠的漏洞利用方案，限制了其在实际安全评估中的有效性。这一局限主要源于两个问题：（1）需要以准确的技术细节精确触发漏洞；（2）需使漏洞利用方案适应多样化的实际部署环境。

本文提出AutoEG，这是一个面向黑盒Web应用的全自动多智能体漏洞利用生成框架。AutoEG包含两个阶段：首先，系统从非结构化漏洞信息中提取精确的漏洞触发逻辑，并将其封装为可重用的触发函数；其次，利用这些触发函数实现具体攻击目标，并通过与目标应用的反馈驱动交互迭代优化漏洞利用方案。我们在包含104个真实漏洞与29个攻击目标的环境中对AutoEG进行了评估，共执行660项利用任务和55,440次利用尝试。AutoEG平均成功率达到了82.41%，显著优于目前最先进的基线方法——其最佳性能仅达到32.88%。
tldr: A fully automated multi-agent framework for generating exploits for known vulnerabilities in black-box web applications, achieving high success rates.
tldr_zh: 一个全自动的多智能体框架，用于针对黑盒Web应用中的已知漏洞生成攻击代码，实现高成功率。

title: Internal APIs Are All You Need: Shadow APIs, Shared Discovery, and the Case Against Browser-First Agent Architectures
summary: Autonomous agents increasingly interact with the web, yet most websites remain designed for human browsers -- a fundamental mismatch that the emerging ``Agentic Web'' must resolve. Agents must repeatedly browse pages, inspect DOMs, and reverse-engineer callable routes -- a process that is slow, brittle, and redundantly repeated across agents. We observe that every modern website already exposes internal APIs (sometimes called \emph{shadow APIs}) behind its user interface -- first-party endpoints that power the site's own functionality. We present Unbrowse, a shared route graph that transforms browser-based route discovery into a collectively maintained index of these callable first-party interfaces. The system passively learns routes from real browsing traffic and serves cached routes via direct API calls. In a single-host live-web benchmark of equivalent information-retrieval tasks across 94 domains, fully warmed cached execution averaged 950\,ms versus 3{,}404\,ms for Playwright browser automation (3.6$\times$ mean speedup, 5.4$\times$ median), with well-cached routes completing in under 100\,ms. A three-path execution model -- local cache, shared graph, or browser fallback -- ensures the system is voluntary and self-correcting. A three-tier micropayment model via the x402 protocol charges per-query search fees for graph lookups (Tier~3), a one-time install fee for discovery documentation (Tier~1), and optional per-execution fees for site owners who opt in (Tier~2). All tiers are grounded in a necessary condition for rational adoption: an agent uses the shared graph only when the total fee is lower than the expected cost of browser rediscovery.
summary_zh: 自主代理程序与网络的交互日益频繁，然而大多数网站仍为人类浏览器设计——这一根本性矛盾必须由新兴的“代理化网络”来解决。目前代理程序需要反复浏览页面、检查DOM结构并逆向解析可调用接口，这一过程不仅效率低下、稳定性差，且在不同代理间重复冗余。我们观察到，每个现代网站其实都已在其用户界面背后暴露了内部API（有时称为“影子API”）——这些是支撑网站自身功能的一方可调用端点。本文提出Unbrowse系统：通过共享路由图谱，将基于浏览器的路由发现过程转化为集体维护的一方可调用接口索引。系统能够从真实浏览流量中被动学习路由，并通过直接API调用提供缓存路由。在涵盖94个域名的单主机实时网络基准测试中，针对同等信息检索任务，完全预热后的缓存执行平均耗时950毫秒，而Playwright浏览器自动化方案需3,404毫秒（平均提速3.6倍，中位数提速5.4倍），优质缓存路由可在100毫秒内完成。系统采用三路径执行模型——本地缓存、共享图谱或浏览器后备方案——确保其具备自愿参与特性和自修正能力。通过x402协议实施的三层微支付模型包含：图谱查询按次搜索费（第三层）、发现文档一次性安装费（第一层），以及选择参与的网站所有者可选按次执行费（第二层）。所有层级的定价均遵循理性采纳的必要条件：代理程序仅当总费用低于浏览器重新发现预期成本时，才会使用共享图谱。
tldr: This paper proposes a shared API discovery system to accelerate web interactions for autonomous agents, bypassing slower browser-based interfaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种共享API发现系统，以加速自主智能体与网络的交互，绕开更慢的基于浏览器的界面。

title: Optimsyn: Influence-Guided Rubrics Optimization for Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong downstream performance largely due to abundant supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data. However, high-quality SFT data in knowledge-intensive domains such as humanities, social sciences, medicine, law, and finance is scarce because expert curation is expensive, privacy constraints are strict, and label consistency is hard to ensure. Recent work uses synthetic data, typically by prompting a generator over domain documents and filtering outputs with handcrafted rubrics. Yet rubric design is expert-dependent, transfers poorly across domains, and is often optimized through a brittle heuristic loop of writing rubrics, synthesizing data, training, inspecting results, and manually guessing revisions. This process lacks reliable quantitative feedback about how a rubric affects downstream performance. We propose evaluating synthetic data by its training utility on the target model and using this signal to guide data generation. Inspired by influence estimation, we adopt an optimizer-aware estimator that uses gradient information to quantify each synthetic sample's contribution to a target model's objective on specific tasks. Our analysis shows that even when synthetic and real samples are close in embedding space, their influence on learning can differ substantially. Based on this insight, we propose an optimization-based framework that adapts rubrics using target-model feedback. We provide lightweight guiding text and use a rubric-specialized model to generate task-conditioned rubrics. Influence score is used as the reward to optimize the rubric generator with reinforcement learning. Experiments across domains, target models, and data generators show consistent improvements and strong generalization without task-specific tuning.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的强大下游性能主要得益于丰富的监督微调（SFT）数据。然而，在人文学科、社会科学、医学、法律和金融等知识密集型领域，高质量SFT数据极为稀缺，原因在于专家标注成本高昂、隐私约束严格且标签一致性难以保证。近期研究多采用合成数据，通常通过对领域文档提示生成器生成数据，并基于人工设计的评价准则进行筛选。但评价准则的设计高度依赖专家经验，跨领域泛化能力差，且往往通过脆弱的启发式循环进行优化：编写准则、合成数据、训练模型、检查结果并手动推测修订方案。这一过程缺乏关于评价准则如何影响下游性能的可靠量化反馈。我们提出通过合成数据在目标模型上的训练效用进行评估，并利用此信号指导数据生成。受影响力估计的启发，我们采用优化器感知的评估器，利用梯度信息量化每个合成样本在特定任务上对目标模型目标的贡献。分析表明，即使合成样本与真实样本在嵌入空间中的位置相近，它们对学习过程的影响仍可能存在显著差异。基于此洞见，我们提出了一个基于优化的框架，利用目标模型反馈自适应调整评价准则。通过提供轻量级引导文本，并利用专门化准则模型生成任务条件化的评价准则，我们将影响力分数作为奖励信号，通过强化学习优化准则生成器。跨领域、目标模型与数据生成器的实验结果表明，该方法在无需任务特定调优的情况下，实现了持续的性能提升与强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper proposes an optimization framework to improve the quality of synthetic data for fine-tuning LLMs by using an influence estimator to guide rubric design, rather than manual crafting, showing improved generalization across domains.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种优化框架，通过使用影响估计器来指导评估标准的设计，以提升用于大语言模型微调的合成数据质量，而非依赖人工设计，并在多个领域展示了改进的泛化能力。

title: Toward Optimal Sampling Rate Selection and Unbiased Classification for Precise Animal Activity Recognition
summary: With the rapid advancements in deep learning techniques, wearable sensor-aided animal activity recognition (AAR) has demonstrated promising performance, thereby improving livestock management efficiency as well as animal health and welfare monitoring. However, existing research often prioritizes overall performance, overlooking the fact that classification accuracies for specific animal behavioral categories may remain unsatisfactory. This issue typically stems from suboptimal sampling rates or class imbalance problems. To address these challenges and achieve high classification accuracy across all individual behaviors in farm animals, we propose a novel Individual-Behavior-Aware Network (IBA-Net). This network enhances the recognition of each specific behavior by simultaneously customizing features and calibrating the classifier. Specifically, considering that different behaviors require varying sampling rates to achieve optimal performance, we design a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based Feature Customization (MFC) module. This module adaptively fuses data from multiple sampling rates, capturing customized features tailored to various animal behaviors. Additionally, to mitigate classifier bias toward majority classes caused by class imbalance, we develop a Neural Collapse-driven Classifier Calibration (NC3) module. This module introduces a fixed equiangular tight frame (ETF) classifier during the classification stage, maximizing the angles between pair-wise classifier vectors and thereby improving the classification performance for minority classes. To validate the effectiveness of IBA-Net, we conducted experiments on three public datasets covering goat, cattle, and horse activity recognition. The results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches across all datasets.
summary_zh: 随着深度学习技术的飞速发展，可穿戴传感器辅助的动物活动识别技术已展现出卓越性能，从而提升了畜牧管理效率及动物健康与福利监测水平。然而，现有研究往往着眼于整体性能，忽视了特定动物行为类别的分类准确率可能仍不理想的问题。这一不足通常源于采样率欠佳或类别不平衡。为应对这些挑战，并在农场动物的所有个体行为中实现高分类准确率，我们提出了一种新型个体行为感知网络（IBA-Net）。该网络通过同步定制特征和校准分类器，强化了对每个具体行为的识别能力。具体而言，考虑到不同行为需采用不同采样率才能达到最佳性能，我们设计了一种基于专家混合机制的特征定制模块，该模块自适应地融合多采样率数据，捕获适用于各类动物行为的定制化特征。此外，为缓解类别不平衡导致的分类器对多数类别的偏好，我们开发了神经坍缩驱动的分类器校准模块，该模块在分类阶段引入固定的等角紧框架分类器，通过最大化成对分类器向量间的夹角，提升了对少数类别的分类性能。为验证IBA-Net的有效性，我们在涵盖山羊、牛和马活动识别的三个公共数据集上进行了实验。结果表明，该方法在所有数据集上均持续优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper proposes a network (IBA-Net) with a Mixture-of-Experts module for feature fusion and a neural collapse-inspired classifier to improve individual animal activity recognition from wearable sensor data, addressing issues of sampling rate selection and class imbalance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个网络（IBA-Net），通过专家混合模块进行特征融合，并利用神经崩溃启发的分类器校准，以解决采样率选择和类别不平衡问题，从而提高穿戴式传感器数据中的个体动物活动识别准确率。

title: A Reasoning-Enabled Vision-Language Foundation Model for Chest X-ray Interpretation
summary: Chest X-rays (CXRs) are among the most frequently performed imaging examinations worldwide, yet rising imaging volumes increase radiologist workload and the risk of diagnostic errors. Although artificial intelligence (AI) systems have shown promise for CXR interpretation, most generate only final predictions, without making explicit how visual evidence is translated into radiographic findings and diagnostic predictions. We present CheXOne, a reasoning-enabled vision-language model for CXR interpretation. CheXOne jointly generates diagnostic predictions and explicit, clinically grounded reasoning traces that connect visual evidence, radiographic findings, and these predictions. The model is trained on 14.7 million instruction and reasoning samples curated from 30 public datasets spanning 36 CXR interpretation tasks, using a two-stage framework that combines instruction tuning with reinforcement learning to improve reasoning quality. We evaluate CheXOne in zero-shot settings across visual question answering, report generation, visual grounding and reasoning assessment, covering 17 evaluation settings. CheXOne outperforms existing medical and general-domain foundation models and achieves strong performance on independent public benchmarks. A clinical reader study demonstrates that CheXOne-drafted reports are comparable to or better than resident-written reports in 55% of cases, while effectively addressing clinical indications and enhancing both report writing and CXR interpretation efficiency. Further analyses involving radiologists reveal that the generated reasoning traces show high clinical factuality and provide causal support for the final predictions, offering a plausible explanation for the performance gains. These results suggest that explicit reasoning can improve model performance, interpretability and clinical utility in AI-assisted CXR interpretation.
summary_zh: 胸部X光片（CXR）是全球范围内最常进行的影像学检查之一，但日益增长的影像检查量增加了放射科医生的工作负荷和诊断错误的风险。尽管人工智能（AI）系统在CXR解读方面展现出潜力，但大多数系统仅生成最终预测结果，而未明确说明视觉证据如何转化为影像学发现和诊断预测。本研究提出CheXOne——一种具备推理能力的视觉语言模型，用于CXR解读。该模型能够联合生成诊断预测以及明确的、基于临床的推理轨迹，这些轨迹将视觉证据、影像学发现与最终预测相连接。模型通过两阶段训练框架（结合指令微调与强化学习以提升推理质量），在跨越36项CXR解读任务的30个公共数据集上构建的1470万条指令与推理样本中进行训练。我们在零样本设定下对CheXOne进行了涵盖视觉问答、报告生成、视觉定位及推理评估的17项评估场景测试。结果表明，CheXOne在性能上超越现有医学及通用领域基础模型，并在独立公共基准测试中表现优异。临床阅片研究显示，在55%的病例中，CheXOne生成的报告质量与住院医师撰写的报告相当或更优，同时能有效回应临床指征，提升报告撰写和CXR解读效率。放射科医师参与的进一步分析表明，模型生成的推理轨迹具有较高的临床事实准确性，并为最终预测提供了因果支持，这为性能提升提供了合理解释。这些结果说明，显式推理能够提升AI辅助CXR解读中的模型性能、可解释性及临床实用性。
tldr: The paper introduces CheXOne, a vision-language model that generates diagnostic predictions and explicit reasoning traces for chest X-ray interpretation, trained on a large dataset of medical images and clinical tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为CheXOne的视觉-语言模型，用于胸部X光片诊断，该模型能够生成诊断预测和明确的临床推理路径，基于大量医学图像和临床任务数据进行训练。

title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly prioritize user validation over epistemic accuracy - a phenomenon known as sycophancy. We present The Silicon Mirror, an orchestration framework that dynamically detects user persuasion tactics and adjusts AI behavior to maintain factual integrity. Our architecture introduces three components: (1) a Behavioral Access Control (BAC) system that restricts context layer access based on real-time sycophancy risk scores, (2) a Trait Classifier that identifies persuasion tactics across multi-turn dialogues, and (3) a Generator-Critic loop where an auditor vetoes sycophantic drafts and triggers rewrites with "Necessary Friction." In a live evaluation across all 437 TruthfulQA adversarial scenarios, Claude Sonnet 4 exhibits 9.6% baseline sycophancy, reduced to 1.4% by the Silicon Mirror - an 85.7% relative reduction (p < 10^-6, OR = 7.64, Fisher's exact test). Cross-model evaluation on Gemini 2.5 Flash reveals a 46.0% baseline reduced to 14.2% (p < 10^-10, OR = 5.15). We characterize the validation-before-correction pattern as a distinct failure mode of RLHF-trained models.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）日益倾向于优先满足用户验证而非追求认知准确性，这一现象被称为“谄媚性”。我们提出“硅镜”协调框架，该框架能动态检测用户说服策略并调整AI行为以保持事实完整性。我们的架构包含三个核心组件：（1）行为访问控制系统，根据实时谄媚风险评分限制上下文层访问权限；（2）特质分类器，用于在多轮对话中识别说服策略；（3）生成器-批判器循环机制，通过审计模块否决谄媚性草稿并触发带有“必要摩擦”的重写流程。在涵盖全部437个TruthfulQA对抗场景的实时评估中，Claude Sonnet 4模型展现出9.6%的基线谄媚率，经硅镜框架处理后降至1.4%——相对降低85.7%（p < 10^-6，OR = 7.64，费希尔精确检验）。在Gemini 2.5 Flash模型上的跨模型评估显示，基线谄媚率从46.0%降至14.2%（p < 10^-10，OR = 5.15）。我们将这种“先验证后修正”模式定性为RLHF训练模型特有的失效模式。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for detecting and mitigating sycophantic behavior in LLM agents during multi-turn dialogues to preserve factual integrity, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个用于检测和减轻LLM代理在多轮对话中的谄媚行为以保持事实完整性的框架，与机器人或具身AI没有直接联系。

title: First Logit Boosting: Visual Grounding Method to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various multimodal tasks that require understanding both visual and linguistic inputs. However, object hallucination -- the generation of nonexistent objects in answers -- remains a persistent challenge. Although several approaches such as retraining and external grounding methods have been proposed to mitigate this issue, they still suffer from high data costs or structural complexity. Training-free methods such as Contrastive Decoding (CD) are more cost-effective, avoiding additional training or external models, but still suffer from long-term decay, where visual grounding weakens and language priors dominate as the generation progresses. In this paper, we propose First Logit Boosting (FLB), a simple yet effective training-free technique designed to alleviate long-term decay in LVLMs. FLB stores the logit of the first generated token and adds it to subsequent token predictions, effectively mitigating long-term decay of visual information. We observe that FLB (1) sustains the visual information embedded in the first token throughout generation, and (2) suppresses hallucinated words through the stabilizing effect of the ``The'' token. Experimental results show that FLB significantly reduces object hallucination across various tasks, benchmarks, and backbone models. Notably, it causes negligible inference overhead, making it highly applicable to real-time multimodal systems. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwooha20/FLB
summary_zh: 近期的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多种需要理解视觉与语言输入的多模态任务中展现出卓越性能。然而，物体幻觉——即在答案中生成不存在的物体——仍然是一个持续存在的挑战。尽管已有多种方法如重训练和外部接地方法被提出以缓解此问题，但它们仍面临高昂的数据成本或结构复杂性。免训练方法如对比解码（CD）更具成本效益，无需额外训练或外部模型，但仍存在长期衰减问题，即随着生成过程推进，视觉接地能力逐渐减弱，语言先验占据主导地位。本文提出了一种简单而有效的免训练技术——首次对数增强（FLB），旨在缓解LVLMs中的长期衰减现象。FLB通过存储首个生成词元的对数概率，并将其添加到后续词元预测中，有效减轻了视觉信息的长期衰减。我们观察到FLB能够：（1）在生成过程中持续保持首个词元嵌入的视觉信息；（2）通过“The”词元的稳定效应抑制幻觉词汇的生成。实验结果表明，FLB在各类任务、基准测试和骨干模型中均能显著降低物体幻觉。值得注意的是，该方法带来的推理开销几乎可忽略不计，使其高度适用于实时多模态系统。代码已在 https://github.com/jiwooha20/FLB 开源。
tldr: Proposes a training-free method, First Logit Boosting, to mitigate object hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models by sustaining visual information from the first generated token.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种无需训练的方法——首词分数增强，通过维持首个生成词中的视觉信息，来缓解大型视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉问题。

title: Execution-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating optimization modeling with LLMs is a promising path toward scalable decision intelligence, but existing approaches either rely on agentic pipelines built on closed-source LLMs with high inference latency, or fine-tune smaller LLMs using costly process supervision that often overfits to a single solver API. Inspired by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, we propose Execution-Verified Optimization Modeling (EVOM), an execution-verified learning framework that treats a mathematical programming solver as a deterministic, interactive verifier. Given a natural-language problem and a target solver, EVOM generates solver-specific code, executes it in a sandboxed harness, and converts execution outcomes into scalar rewards, optimized with GRPO and DAPO in a closed-loop generate-execute-feedback-update process. This outcome-only formulation removes the need for process-level supervision, and enables cross-solver generalization by switching the verification environment rather than reconstructing solver-specific datasets. Experiments on NL4OPT, MAMO, IndustryOR, and OptiBench across Gurobi, OR-Tools, and COPT show that EVOM matches or outperforms process-supervised SFT, supports zero-shot solver transfer, and achieves effective low-cost solver adaptation by continuing training under the target solver backend.
summary_zh: 摘要：利用大型语言模型实现优化建模自动化，是通向可扩展决策智能的一条可行路径，但现有方法要么依赖基于闭源模型构建的高延迟推理流程，要么采用成本高昂的过程监督对小型模型进行微调，往往导致模型过度依赖特定求解器接口。受可验证奖励的强化学习启发，我们提出执行验证优化建模框架，该框架将数学规划求解器视为确定性交互验证器。针对自然语言描述的问题和目标求解器，该框架生成特定求解器代码，在沙箱环境中执行验证，并将执行结果转化为标量奖励，通过生成-执行-反馈-更新的闭环流程，结合广义相对策略优化与目标差异化策略优化进行持续优化。这种仅依赖结果的建模方式无需过程级监督，通过切换验证环境而非重建求解器专用数据集，实现了跨求解器的泛化能力。在自然语言优化基准、数学建模优化基准、工业运筹基准及优化求解器评测基准上，分别针对Gurobi、OR-Tools和国产优化求解器开展的实验表明，该框架性能达到或超越过程监督微调方法，支持零样本求解器迁移，并能在目标求解器后端通过持续训练实现高效低成本的适配。
tldr: This paper introduces EVOM, an execution-verified RL framework for training LLMs to generate solver-specific code for optimization modeling, removing the need for process-level supervision and enabling cross-solver generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于执行验证的强化学习框架EVOM，用于训练LLM生成针对特定优化求解器的代码，无需过程监督，并能实现求解器间的零样本迁移。

title: Decision-Centric Design for LLM Systems
summary: LLM systems must make control decisions in addition to generating outputs: whether to answer, clarify, retrieve, call tools, repair, or escalate. In many current architectures, these decisions remain implicit within generation, entangling assessment and action in a single model call and making failures hard to inspect, constrain, or repair. We propose a decision-centric framework that separates decision-relevant signals from the policy that maps them to actions, turning control into an explicit and inspectable layer of the system. This separation supports attribution of failures to signal estimation, decision policy, or execution, and enables modular improvement of each component. It unifies familiar single-step settings such as routing and adaptive inference, and extends naturally to sequential settings in which actions alter the information available before acting. Across three controlled experiments, the framework reduces futile actions, improves task success, and reveals interpretable failure modes. More broadly, it offers a general architectural principle for building more reliable, controllable, and diagnosable LLM systems.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
LLM系统不仅需要生成输出，还需进行控制决策：决定是否应答、澄清、检索、调用工具、修复或升级处理。在当前许多架构中，这些决策往往隐含在生成过程中，将评估与行动耦合于单一模型调用中，导致系统故障难以检查、约束或修复。本文提出一种以决策为中心的框架，将决策相关信号与将其映射到行动的策略分离，使控制成为系统中一个显式且可检查的层次。这种分离有助于将故障归因于信号估计、决策策略或执行环节，并支持各模块的独立改进。该框架统一了路由与自适应推理等常见单步场景，并自然扩展至序列化场景，其中行动会改变后续行动前的可用信息。通过三项对照实验，该框架减少了无效行动，提高了任务成功率，并揭示了可解释的故障模式。更广泛而言，它为构建更可靠、可控、可诊断的LLM系统提供了一种通用架构原则。
tldr: Proposes a decision-centric design framework for LLM systems that separates decision signals from the policy that maps them to actions, aiming to improve reliability, control, and diagnosability.
tldr_zh: 为LLM系统提出了一种以决策为中心的设计框架，将决策信号与决策策略解耦，旨在提高系统的可靠性、可控制性和可诊断性。

title: Improving Generalization of Deep Learning for Brain Metastases Segmentation Across Institutions
summary:
Background: Deep learning has demonstrated significant potential for automated brain metastases (BM) segmentation; however, models trained at a singular institution often exhibit suboptimal performance at various sites due to disparities in scanner hardware, imaging protocols, and patient demographics. The goal of this work is to create a domain adaptation framework that will allow for BM segmentation to be used across multiple institutions.
  Methods: We propose a VAE-MMD preprocessing pipeline that combines variational autoencoders (VAE) with maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) loss, incorporating skip connections and self-attention mechanisms alongside nnU-Net segmentation. The method was tested on 740 patients from four public databases: Stanford, UCSF, UCLM, and PKG, evaluated by domain classifier's accuracy, sensitivity, precision, F1/F2 scores, surface Dice (sDice), and 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95).
  Results: VAE-MMD reduced domain classifier accuracy from 0.91 to 0.50, indicating successful feature alignment across institutions. Reconstructed volumes attained a PSNR greater than 36 dB, maintaining anatomical accuracy. The combined method raised the mean F1 by 11.1% (0.700 to 0.778), the mean sDice by 7.93% (0.7121 to 0.7686), and reduced the mean HD95 by 65.5% (11.33 to 3.91 mm) across all four centers compared to the baseline nnU-Net.
  Conclusions: VAE-MMD effectively diminishes cross-institutional data heterogeneity and enhances BM segmentation generalization across volumetric, detection, and boundary-level metrics without necessitating target-domain labels, thereby overcoming a significant obstacle to the clinical implementation of AI-assisted segmentation.
summary_zh:
背景：深度学习在自动分割脑转移瘤方面展现出巨大潜力；然而，由于扫描设备、成像协议和患者人口学特征的差异，单一机构训练的模型在不同机构往往表现欠佳。本研究旨在构建一个域适应框架，以实现跨机构通用的脑转移瘤分割。

方法：我们提出了VAE-MMD预处理流程，将变分自编码器与最大均值差异损失相结合，在nnU-Net分割框架中引入跳跃连接和自注意力机制。该方法在来自斯坦福、加州大学旧金山分校、卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰大学和匹兹堡大学医学中心四个公共数据库的740例患者数据上进行测试，评估指标包括域分类器准确率、敏感性、精确率、F1/F2分数、表面戴斯系数及95%豪斯多夫距离。

结果：VAE-MMD将域分类器准确率从0.91降至0.50，表明成功实现了跨机构特征对齐。重建图像的峰值信噪比超过36dB，保持了解剖结构准确性。与基线nnU-Net相比，该组合方法在四个中心的平均F1值提升11.1%（从0.700至0.778），平均表面戴斯系数提高7.93%（从0.7121至0.7686），平均95%豪斯多夫距离降低65.5%（从11.33毫米降至3.91毫米）。

结论：VAE-MMD能有效降低跨机构数据异质性，在体积、检测和边界层面全面提升脑转移瘤分割的泛化能力，且无需目标域标注数据，从而突破了人工智能辅助分割技术临床转化的重要障碍。
tldr: Proposes a VAE-MMD preprocessing pipeline for domain adaptation to improve deep learning-based brain metastases segmentation across multiple medical institutions, without requiring target-domain labels.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于领域自适应的VAE-MMD预处理框架，以提升深度学习模型在多家医疗机构间进行脑转移瘤分割的泛化能力，无需目标域标注数据。

title: Deep Networks Favor Simple Data
summary:
Estimated density is often interpreted as indicating how typical a sample is under a model. Yet deep models trained on one dataset can assign higher density to simpler out-of-distribution (OOD) data than to in-distribution test data. We refer to this behavior as the OOD anomaly. Prior work typically studies this phenomenon within a single architecture, detector, or benchmark, implicitly assuming certain canonical densities. We instead separate the trained network from the density estimator built from its representations or outputs. We introduce two estimators: Jacobian-based estimators and autoregressive self-estimators, making density analysis applicable to a wide range of models.
  Applying this perspective to a range of models, including iGPT, PixelCNN++, Glow, score-based diffusion models, DINOv2, and I-JEPA, we find the same striking regularity that goes beyond the OOD anomaly: lower-complexity samples receive higher estimated density, while higher-complexity samples receive lower estimated density. This ordering appears within a test set and across OOD pairs such as CIFAR-10 and SVHN, and remains highly consistent across independently trained models. To quantify these orderings, we introduce Spearman rank correlation and find striking agreement both across models and with external complexity metrics. Even when trained only on the lowest-density (most complex) samples - or even a single such sample - the resulting models still rank simpler images as higher density.
  These observations lead us beyond the original OOD anomaly to a more general conclusion: deep networks consistently favor simple data. Our goal is not to close this question, but to define and visualize it more clearly. We broaden its empirical scope and show that it appears across architectures, objectives, and density estimators.
summary_zh:
估计密度常被解读为样本在模型下的典型性程度。然而，在一个数据集上训练的深度模型可能将更高密度分配给更简单的分布外数据，而非分布内测试数据。我们将此现象称为分布外异常。先前研究通常仅在单一架构、检测器或基准测试中探讨这一现象，隐含地假设了某些规范密度。与此不同，我们将训练好的网络与基于其表示或输出构建的密度估计器分离开来。我们引入了两种估计器：基于雅可比矩阵的估计器和自回归自估计器，使密度分析能广泛应用于各类模型。

将此视角应用于一系列模型（包括iGPT、PixelCNN++、Glow、基于分数的扩散模型、DINOv2和I-JEPA）时，我们发现了超越分布外异常的显著规律：复杂度较低的样本获得更高估计密度，而复杂度较高的样本获得更低估计密度。这种排序出现在测试集内部以及跨分布外数据对（如CIFAR-10与SVHN）之间，并且在独立训练的模型间保持高度一致性。为量化这些排序，我们引入斯皮尔曼秩相关系数，发现模型间以及与外部复杂度指标间存在显著一致性。即使仅在最低密度（最复杂）样本——甚至单个此类样本上训练，所得模型仍将更简单的图像排序为更高密度。

这些观察使我们超越原有的分布外异常，得出更普遍的结论：深度网络始终偏好简单数据。我们的目标并非终结此问题，而是更清晰地界定并可视化它。我们拓展了其经验范围，并证明该现象普遍存在于不同架构、目标函数和密度估计器中。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that deep networks across various architectures consistently assign higher estimated density to simpler data samples, regardless of whether they are in-distribution or out-of-distribution, a phenomenon they term 'deep networks favor simple data.'
tldr_zh: 该论文表明，各种架构的深度网络都一致地给更简单的数据样本分配更高的估计密度，无论它们是分布内还是分布外数据，这一现象被称为'深度网络偏爱简单数据'。

title: EvolveTool-Bench: Evaluating the Quality of LLM-Generated Tool Libraries as Software Artifacts
summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly create their own tools at runtime -- from Python functions to API clients -- yet existing benchmarks evaluate them almost exclusively by downstream task completion. This is analogous to judging a software engineer only by whether their code runs, ignoring redundancy, regression, and safety. We introduce EvolveTool-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for LLM-generated tool libraries in software engineering workflows. Across three domains requiring actual tool execution (proprietary data formats, API orchestration, and numerical computation), we define library-level software quality metrics -- reuse, redundancy, composition success, regression stability, and safety -- alongside a per-tool Tool Quality Score measuring correctness, robustness, generality, and code quality. In the first head-to-head comparison of code-level and strategy-level tool evolution (ARISE vs. EvoSkill vs. one-shot baselines, 99 tasks, two models), we show that systems with similar task completion (63-68%) differ by up to 18% in library health, revealing software quality risks invisible to task-only evaluation. Our results highlight that evaluation and governance of LLM-generated tools require treating the evolving tool library as a first-class software artifact, not a black box.
summary_zh: 现代大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在运行时越来越多地创建自己的工具——从Python函数到API客户端——但现有基准测试几乎仅通过下游任务完成度来评估它们。这好比仅凭代码是否运行来评判软件工程师，而忽略冗余性、回归性和安全性。我们提出了EvolveTool-Bench，这是一个针对软件工程流程中LLM生成工具库的诊断性基准测试。在三个需要实际工具执行的领域（专有数据格式、API编排和数值计算）中，我们定义了库级软件质量指标——复用性、冗余度、组合成功率、回归稳定性和安全性——同时结合每项工具的工具质量评分，该评分涵盖正确性、鲁棒性、通用性和代码质量。在首次对代码级与策略级工具演进方法（ARISE对比EvoSkill对比单次生成基线，涵盖99项任务和两种模型）进行直接比较中，我们发现：任务完成率相近的系统（63-68%）在工具库健康度上差异可达18%，这揭示了仅依赖任务完成度评估时不可见的软件质量风险。我们的研究结果强调，对LLM生成工具的评估与治理需要将动态演化的工具库视为首要的软件制品，而非黑箱。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating the software quality of LLM-generated tool libraries, focusing on metrics like code reuse, redundancy, and safety, rather than just task completion.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于评估LLM生成工具库软件质量的基准，关注代码复用、冗余和安全等指标，而非仅仅是任务完成度。

title: In harmony with gpt-oss
summary: No one has independently reproduced OpenAI's published scores for gpt-oss-20b with tools, because the original paper discloses neither the tools nor the agent harness. We reverse-engineered the model's in-distribution tools: when prompted without tool definitions, gpt-oss still calls tools from its training distribution with high statistical confidence -- a strong prior, not a hallucination. We then built a native harmony agent harness (https://github.com/borislavmavrin/harmonyagent.git) that encodes messages in the model's native format, bypassing the lossy Chat Completions conversion. Together, these yield the first independent reproduction of OpenAI's published scores: 60.4% on SWE Verified HIGH (published 60.7%), 53.3% MEDIUM (53.2%), and 91.7% on AIME25 with tools (90.4%).
summary_zh: 目前尚未有人独立复现OpenAI发布的gpt-oss-20b结合工具的评测分数，因为原始论文既未公开工具也未透露智能体框架。我们通过逆向工程还原了该模型在训练分布内的工具：即便未提供工具定义，gpt-oss仍能以高统计置信度调用其训练分布中的工具——这是强先验特征而非幻觉。随后我们构建了原生和谐智能体框架（https://github.com/borislavmavrin/harmonyagent.git），该框架以模型原生格式编码消息，避免了有损的聊天补全格式转换。通过上述方法，我们首次实现了对OpenAI公布分数的独立复现：SWE Verified HIGH任务达到60.4%（原公布60.7%），MEDIUM任务53.3%（原53.2%），AIME25结合工具任务91.7%（原90.4%）。
tldr: This paper reproduces OpenAI's GPT-OSS scores by reverse-engineering its in-distribution tools and building a native agent harness, achieving the first independent confirmation of the original results.
tldr_zh: 本研究通过逆向工程GPT-OSS训练分布中的工具并构建原生智能体框架，首次独立复现了OpenAI公布的相关评测分数。

title: Collaborative AI Agents and Critics for Fault Detection and Cause Analysis in Network Telemetry
summary: We develop algorithms for collaborative control of AI agents and critics in a multi-actor, multi-critic federated multi-agent system. Each AI agent and critic has access to classical machine learning or generative AI foundation models. The AI agents and critics collaborate with a central server to complete multimodal tasks such as fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in a network telemetry system, text-to-image generation, video generation, healthcare diagnostics from medical images and patient records, etcetera. The AI agents complete their tasks and send them to AI critics for evaluation. The critics then send feedback to agents to improve their responses. Collaboratively, they minimize the overall cost to the system with no inter-agent or inter-critic communication. AI agents and critics keep their cost functions or derivatives of cost functions private. Using multi-time scale stochastic approximation techniques, we provide convergence guarantees on the time-average active states of AI agents and critics. The communication overhead is a little on the system, of the order of $\mathcal{O}(m)$, for $m$ modalities and is independent of the number of AI agents and critics. Finally, we present an example of fault detection, severity, and cause analysis in network telemetry and thorough evaluation to check the algorithm's efficacy.
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种用于多执行者-多评价者联邦多智能体系统中AI执行者与评价者协同控制的算法框架。每个AI执行者与评价者均具备经典机器学习或生成式AI基础模型的能力。通过中央服务器协调，AI执行者与评价者协同完成多模态任务，包括网络遥测系统中的故障检测、严重程度与根因分析、文生图、视频生成、基于医学影像与病历的医疗诊断等。AI执行者完成任务后提交给AI评价者进行评估，评价者将反馈信息发送给执行者以优化其响应。在无需执行者间或评价者间直接通信的前提下，系统通过协同实现整体成本最小化。AI执行者与评价者均保持其成本函数或成本函数导数的私密性。基于多时间尺度随机逼近技术，我们为AI执行者与评价者的时间平均活跃状态提供了收敛性保证。系统的通信开销与模态数量$m$成$\mathcal{O}(m)$量级，且独立于AI执行者与评价者的数量。最后，我们以网络遥测中的故障检测、严重程度与根因分析为例，通过全面评估验证了算法的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a collaborative multi-agent AI system using agents and critics with classical or foundation models for tasks like fault detection in network telemetry, with convergence guarantees and low communication overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用智能体和评论家（基于经典或基础模型）的协作式多智能体AI系统，用于网络遥测故障检测等任务，并提供收敛性保证和低通信开销。

title: Prompt-Guided Prefiltering for VLM Image Compression
summary: The rapid progress of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has enabled a wide range of applications, such as image understanding and Visual Question Answering (VQA). Query images are often uploaded to the cloud, where VLMs are typically hosted, hence efficient image compression becomes crucial. However, traditional human-centric codecs are suboptimal in this setting because they preserve many task-irrelevant details. Existing Image Coding for Machines (ICM) methods also fall short, as they assume a fixed set of downstream tasks and cannot adapt to prompt-driven VLMs with an open-ended variety of objectives. We propose a lightweight, plug-and-play, prompt-guided prefiltering module to identify image regions most relevant to the text prompt, and consequently to the downstream task. The module preserves important details while smoothing out less relevant areas to improve compression efficiency. It is codec-agnostic and can be applied before conventional and learned encoders. Experiments on several VQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves a 25-50% average bitrate reduction while maintaining the same task accuracy. Our source code is available at https://github.com/bardia-az/pgp-vlm-compression.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的快速发展推动了图像理解、视觉问答（VQA）等广泛应用的实现。由于查询图像通常需上传至云端（VLMs通常部署于此），高效的图像压缩变得至关重要。然而，传统以人为中心的编解码器在此场景下表现欠佳，因其保留了过多与任务无关的细节。现有的面向机器的图像编码（ICM）方法同样存在不足，它们假定下游任务固定，无法适应具有开放式多目标特性的提示驱动式VLMs。本文提出了一种轻量级、即插即用的提示引导预过滤模块，用于识别与文本提示（进而与下游任务）最相关的图像区域。该模块在保留重要细节的同时，通过平滑非关键区域以提升压缩效率。其编解码器无关，可应用于传统及学习型编码器之前。在多个VQA基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在保持任务准确率不变的前提下，平均码率降低了25-50%。源代码发布于https://github.com/bardia-az/pgp-vlm-compression。
tldr: A lightweight, prompt-guided prefiltering module for image compression that identifies regions relevant to a text prompt, enabling significant bitrate reduction for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) while maintaining task accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级、提示引导的预过滤模块，用于图像压缩。该模块能识别与文本提示相关的图像区域，显著降低视觉语言模型（VLM）的比特率，同时保持任务准确性。

title: Robust Multimodal Safety via Conditional Decoding
summary: Multimodal large-language models (MLLMs) often experience degraded safety alignment when harmful queries exploit cross-modal interactions. Models aligned on text alone show a higher rate of successful attacks when extended to two or more modalities. In this work, we propose a simple conditional decoding strategy, CASA (Classification Augmented with Safety Attention) that utilizes internal representations of MLLMs to predict a binary safety token before response generation. We introduce a novel safety attention module designed to enhance the model's ability to detect malicious queries. Our design ensures robust safety alignment without relying on any external classifier or auxiliary head, and without the need for modality-specific safety fine-tuning. On diverse benchmarks such as MM-SafetyBench, JailbreakV-28k, and adversarial audio tests, CASA lowers the average attack success rate by more than 97% across modalities and across attack types. Our empirical evaluations also show that CASA maintains strong utility in benign inputs, a result validated through both automated and human evaluations (via 13 trained annotators). Together, these results highlight CASA as a simple and generalizable framework to improve multimodal LLM safety.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在有害查询利用跨模态交互时，常出现安全对齐性能下降的问题。仅基于文本进行对齐的模型，在扩展到两个或更多模态时，其成功攻击率显著升高。本研究提出一种简单的条件解码策略——CASA（基于安全注意力增强的分类方法），该方法利用多模态大语言模型的内部表示，在生成响应前预测一个二进制安全令牌。我们引入了一种新颖的安全注意力模块，旨在增强模型检测恶意查询的能力。该设计确保模型在不依赖外部分类器或辅助头、且无需进行模态特定安全微调的情况下，实现鲁棒的安全对齐。在MM-SafetyBench、JailbreakV-28k以及对抗性音频测试等多种基准测试中，CASA在不同模态和攻击类型下将平均攻击成功率降低了97%以上。实证评估还表明，CASA在良性输入上保持了强大的实用性，这一结果通过自动评估和人工评估（由13名训练有素的标注员完成）得到了验证。综上，这些结果突显了CASA作为一种简单且可推广的框架，能够有效提升多模态大语言模型的安全性。
tldr: Proposes a conditional decoding strategy (CASA) to improve safety alignment in multimodal large-language models against cross-modal attacks, without requiring external classifiers or modality-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 提出一种条件解码策略（CASA），利用多模态大语言模型的内部表示来预测安全令牌，以抵御跨模态攻击，无需外部分类器或模态特定微调。

title: Asymmetric Actor-Critic for Multi-turn LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and conversational abilities, but ensuring reliable behavior in multi-turn interactions remains challenging. In many real-world applications, agents must succeed in one-shot settings where retries are impossible.
