Existing approaches either rely on reflection or post-hoc evaluation, which require additional attempts, or assume fully trainable models that cannot leverage proprietary LLMs. We propose an asymmetric actor-critic framework for reliable conversational agents. A powerful proprietary LLM acts as the actor, while a smaller open-source critic provides runtime supervision, monitoring the actor's actions and intervening within the same interaction trajectory. Unlike training-based actor-critic methods, our framework supervises a fixed actor operating in open-ended conversational environments. The design leverages a generation-verification asymmetry: while high-quality generation requires large models, effective oversight can often be achieved by smaller ones. We further introduce a data generation pipeline that produces supervision signals for critic fine-tuning without modifying the actor. Experiments on $τ$-bench and UserBench show that our approach significantly improves reliability and task success over strong single-agent baselines. Moreover, lightweight open-source critics rival or surpass larger proprietary models in the critic role, and critic fine-tuning yields additional gains over several state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的推理和对话能力，但在多轮交互中确保其行为可靠性仍具挑战性。在许多实际应用中，智能体必须在无法重试的单次场景中获得成功。现有方法要么依赖需要额外尝试的反思或事后评估机制，要么假设使用完全可训练的模型而无法利用专有大语言模型。我们提出一种用于可靠对话智能体的非对称行动者-评判者框架：由强大的专有大语言模型担任行动者，同时由较小的开源评判者实施运行时监督，监控行动者行为并在同一交互轨迹中进行干预。与传统基于训练的"行动者-评判者"方法不同，本框架对开放式对话环境中运行的固定行动者进行监督。该设计利用了生成与验证的不对称性：高质量生成需要大模型，而有效监督往往可由较小模型实现。我们进一步提出数据生成流程，可在不修改行动者的前提下为评判者微调提供监督信号。在τ-bench和UserBench上的实验表明，该方法较之强大的单智能体基线系统，显著提升了可靠性与任务成功率。此外，轻量级开源评判者在监督角色中的表现可与大型专有模型媲美甚至超越，且评判者微调相比多种前沿方法带来了额外性能提升。
tldr: A framework using a large proprietary LLM as an actor and a smaller open-source LLM as a critic to supervise and improve reliability in multi-turn conversational agents, without needing to retrain the actor.
tldr_zh: 提出一个非对称行动者-批评者框架，使用大型专有LLM作为行动者，小型开源LLM作为批评者，在无需重新训练行动者的前提下监督并提升多轮对话代理的可靠性。

title: SANA I2I: A Text Free Flow Matching Framework for Paired Image to Image Translation with a Case Study in Fetal MRI Artifact Reduction
summary: We propose SANA-I2I, a text-free high-resolution image-to-image generation framework that extends the SANA family by removing textual conditioning entirely. In contrast to SanaControlNet, which combines text and image-based control, SANA-I2I relies exclusively on paired source-target images to learn a conditional flow-matching model in latent space. The model learns a conditional velocity field that maps a target image distribution to another one, enabling supervised image translation without reliance on language prompts. We evaluate the proposed approach on the challenging task of fetal MRI motion artifact reduction. To enable paired training in this application, where real paired data are difficult to acquire, we adopt a synthetic data generation strategy based on the method proposed by Duffy et al., which simulates realistic motion artifacts in fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Experimental results demonstrate that SANA-I2I effectively suppresses motion artifacts while preserving anatomical structure, achieving competitive performance few inference steps. These results highlight the efficiency and suitability of our proposed flow-based, text-free generative models for supervised image-to-image tasks in medical imaging.
summary_zh: 本文提出SANA-I2I——一种无需文本的高分辨率图像到图像生成框架，该框架通过完全移除文本条件约束扩展了SANA系列模型。与同时结合文本和图像控制的SanaControlNet不同，SANA-I2I仅依赖成对的源图像-目标图像在潜空间中学习条件流匹配模型。该模型通过学习条件速度场将一个目标图像分布映射到另一个分布，从而在不依赖语言提示的情况下实现有监督的图像转换。我们在胎儿磁共振成像运动伪影消除这一挑战性任务上评估了所提方法。针对该应用中真实配对数据难以获取的问题，我们采用基于Duffy等人所提方法的合成数据生成策略，通过模拟胎儿磁共振成像中的真实运动伪影构建训练数据。实验结果表明，SANA-I2I能在保持解剖结构的同时有效抑制运动伪影，仅需少量推理步骤即可获得具有竞争力的性能。这些结果凸显了我们提出的基于流模型的无文本生成方法在医学影像有监督图像转换任务中的高效性与适用性。
tldr: This paper proposes SANA-I2I, a text-free flow-matching framework for paired image-to-image translation, and applies it to reduce motion artifacts in fetal MRI scans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SANA-I2I，一个用于配对图像到图像转换的无文本流匹配框架，并将其应用于胎儿MRI中的运动伪影减少任务。

title: Improvisational Games as a Benchmark for Social Intelligence of AI Agents: The Case of Connections
summary: We formally introduce a improvisational wordplay game called Connections to explore reasoning capabilities of AI agents. Playing Connections combines skills in knowledge retrieval, summarization and awareness of cognitive states of other agents. We show how the game serves as a good benchmark for social intelligence abilities of language model based agents that go beyond the agents' own memory and deductive reasoning and also involve gauging the understanding capabilities of other agents. Finally, we show how through communication with other agents in a constrained environment, AI agents must demonstrate social awareness and intelligence in games involving collaboration.
summary_zh: 我们正式引入一种名为"关联"的即兴文字游戏，用以探索人工智能智能体的推理能力。参与"关联"游戏需要综合运用知识检索、信息概括及对其他智能体认知状态的感知能力。研究表明，该游戏可作为评估基于语言模型的智能体社会智能能力的有效基准，这不仅涉及智能体自身的记忆与演绎推理能力，更包含对其他智能体理解能力的评估。最后，我们展示了在受限环境中通过与其他智能体交流，人工智能智能体必须在涉及协作的游戏中展现出社会意识与智能。
tldr: This paper introduces the word game 'Connections' as a benchmark for assessing the social intelligence of AI agents, focusing on skills like gauging other agents' cognitive states and collaborative reasoning in a constrained communication environment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍词语游戏'Connections'作为评估AI智能体社交智能的基准，重点考察智能体在约束性通信环境中评估其他智能体认知状态和进行协作推理的能力。

title: Softmax gradient policy for variance minimization and risk-averse multi armed bandits
summary: Algorithms for the Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) problem play a central role in sequential decision-making and have been extensively explored both theoretically and numerically. While most classical approaches aim to identify the arm with the highest expected reward, we focus on a risk-aware setting where the goal is to select the arm with the lowest variance, favoring stability over potentially high but uncertain returns. To model the decision process, we consider a softmax parameterization of the policy; we propose a new algorithm to select the minimal variance (or minimal risk) arm and prove its convergence under natural conditions. The algorithm constructs an unbiased estimate of the objective by using two independent draws from the current's arm distribution. We provide numerical experiments that illustrate the practical behavior of these algorithms and offer guidance on implementation choices. The setting also covers general risk-aware problems where there is a trade-off between maximizing the average reward and minimizing its variance.
summary_zh: 多臂赌博机（MAB）问题的算法在序列决策中具有核心地位，其理论与数值方法已得到广泛探索。虽然大多数经典方法旨在识别期望奖励最高的臂，本文聚焦于风险感知场景，其目标在于选择方差最小的臂，更倾向于稳定性而非潜在高但不确定的收益。为建模决策过程，我们采用策略的softmax参数化方法；提出一种新算法来选择最小方差（或最小风险）臂，并在自然条件下证明其收敛性。该算法通过从当前臂的分布中抽取两个独立样本，构建目标的无偏估计。我们提供了数值实验以展示算法在实际中的表现，并为实现选择提供指导。该设置同样适用于一般风险感知问题，其中需要在最大化平均奖励与最小化方差之间进行权衡。
tldr: The paper proposes a softmax gradient policy algorithm for a risk-averse Multi-Armed Bandit problem, focusing on selecting the arm with the lowest variance (i.e., minimal risk) rather than the highest expected reward, with theoretical convergence guarantees.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于风险厌恶多臂赌博机问题的softmax梯度策略算法，专注于选择方差最小（即风险最低）的臂，而非期望奖励最高的臂，并提供了理论收敛保证。

title: QUEST: A robust attention formulation using query-modulated spherical attention
summary: The Transformer model architecture has become one of the most widely used in deep learning and the attention mechanism is at its core. The standard attention formulation uses a softmax operation applied to a scaled dot product between query and key vectors. We explore the role played by norms of the queries and keys, which can cause training instabilities when they arbitrarily increase. We demonstrate how this can happen even in simple Transformer models, in the presence of easy-to-learn spurious patterns in the data. We propose a new attention formulation, QUEry-modulated Spherical aTtention (QUEST), that constrains the keys to a hyperspherical latent space, while still allowing individual tokens to flexibly control the sharpness of the attention distribution. QUEST can be easily used as a drop-in replacement for standard attention. We focus on vision applications while also exploring other domains to highlight the method's generality. We show that (1) QUEST trains without instabilities and (2) produces models with improved performance (3) that are robust to data corruptions and adversarial attacks.
summary_zh: Transformer模型架构已成为深度学习领域应用最为广泛的架构之一，其核心在于注意力机制。标准注意力公式采用softmax函数处理查询向量与键向量的缩放点积结果。本文探讨了查询向量与键向量范数所起的作用，这些范数在无限制增长时会导致训练过程不稳定。我们证明了即使在简单的Transformer模型中，当数据中存在易于学习的虚假模式时，这种情况也可能发生。我们提出了一种新的注意力计算公式——查询调制球形注意力（QUEST），该方法将键向量约束在超球面潜在空间中，同时仍允许各词元灵活控制注意力分布的锐度。QUEST可直接作为标准注意力的替代方案使用。我们以视觉应用为主要研究领域，同时探索其他领域以凸显该方法的通用性。实验表明：（1）QUEST能够实现稳定训练；（2）所构建的模型性能得到提升；（3）模型对数据污染和对抗攻击具有鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a new attention mechanism, QUEST, which addresses training instability and improves performance in Transformer models, primarily demonstrated in vision applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的注意力机制QUEST，旨在解决Transformer模型中的训练不稳定问题并提升性能，主要在视觉应用中进行验证。

title: Making Sense of AI Agents Hype: Adoption, Architectures, and Takeaways from Practitioners
summary: To support practitioners in understanding how agentic systems are designed in real-world industrial practice, we present a review of practitioner conference talks on AI agents. We analyzed 138 recorded talks to examine how companies adopt agent-based architectures (Objective 1), identify recurring architectural strategies and patterns (Objective 2), and analyze application domains and technologies used to implement and operate LLM-driven agentic systems (Objective 3).
summary_zh: 为帮助从业者了解自主智能体系统在真实工业实践中的设计方式，我们对人工智能领域从业者会议演讲进行了系统性综述。通过分析138个录制的演讲内容，本文旨在探究企业如何采用基于智能体的系统架构（目标1），识别其中反复出现的架构策略与设计模式（目标2），并深入分析实现与运行大语言模型驱动型自主系统的应用领域及相关技术生态（目标3）。
tldr: A review of practitioner conference talks on AI agents, focusing on adoption, architectural strategies, application domains, and technologies used in real-world industrial implementations of LLM-driven agentic systems.
tldr_zh: 对AI智能体的实践者会议演讲进行回顾，重点研究公司在工业实践中如何采用基于智能体的架构、识别常见的架构策略与模式，并分析用于实现和运行LLM驱动智能体系统的应用领域和技术。

title: Agentic AI and Occupational Displacement: A Multi-Regional Task Exposure Analysis of Emerging Labor Market Disruption
summary: This paper extends the Acemoglu-Restrepo task exposure framework to address the labor market effects of agentic artificial intelligence systems: autonomous AI agents capable of completing entire occupational workflows rather than discrete tasks. Unlike prior automation technologies that substitute for individual subtasks, agentic AI systems execute end-to-end workflows involving multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and autonomous decision-making, substantially expanding occupational displacement risk beyond what existing task-level analyses capture. We introduce the Agentic Task Exposure (ATE) score, a composite measure computed algorithmically from O*NET task data using calibrated adoption parameters--not a regression estimate--incorporating AI capability scores, workflow coverage factors, and logistic adoption velocity. Applying the ATE framework across five major US technology regions (Seattle-Tacoma, San Francisco Bay Area, Austin, New York, and Boston) over a 2025-2030 horizon, we find that 93.2% of the 236 analyzed occupations across six information-intensive SOC groups (financial, legal, healthcare, healthcare support, sales, and administrative/clerical) cross the moderate-risk threshold (ATE >= 0.35) in Tier 1 regions by 2030, with credit analysts, judges, and sustainability specialists reaching ATE scores of 0.43-0.47. We simultaneously identify seventeen emerging occupational categories benefiting from reinstatement effects, concentrated in human-AI collaboration, AI governance, and domain-specific AI operations roles. Our findings carry implications for workforce transition policy, regional economic planning, and the temporal dynamics of labor market adjustment
summary_zh: 本文拓展了Acemoglu-Restrepo的任务暴露框架，用以研究具有自主性的人工智能系统对劳动力市场的影响——这类自主AI代理能够完成完整的职业工作流程而非独立任务。与先前仅替代单一子任务的自动化技术不同，自主AI系统可执行涉及多步推理、工具调用和自主决策的端到端工作流程，从而将职业替代风险扩展到现有任务层面分析无法涵盖的范围。我们提出"自主任务暴露指数"这一复合度量指标，该指数通过校准采纳参数（而非回归估计）从O*NET任务数据中算法计算得出，融合了AI能力评分、工作流覆盖因子和逻辑采纳速度等多重维度。将ATE框架应用于2025-2030年间美国五大技术区域（西雅图-塔科马、旧金山湾区、奥斯汀、纽约和波士顿），研究发现：在六个信息密集型SOC职业群组（金融、法律、医疗保健、医疗辅助、销售及行政/文职）的236个职业中，93.2%的职业将于2030年前在一级区域跨入中度风险阈值（ATE≥0.35），其中信用分析师、法官和可持续发展专家的ATE指数达到0.43-0.47。同时，我们识别出十七个受益于岗位重塑效应的新兴职业类别，主要集中在人机协作、AI治理和特定领域AI运营等方向。本研究对劳动力转型政策、区域经济规划以及劳动力市场调整的时序动态具有重要启示。
tldr: This paper analyzes the labor market disruption caused by agentic AI systems capable of executing entire workflows, introducing a new metric to quantify occupational exposure across different US regions.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了能够执行完整工作流程的智能体AI系统对劳动力市场造成的破坏，引入了一种新指标来量化不同美国地区的职业暴露风险。

title: Unified Architecture Metamodel of Information Systems Developed by Generative AI
summary: The rapid development of AI and LLMs has driven new methods of SDLC, in which a large portion of code, technical, and business documentation is generated automatically. However, since there is no single architectural framework that can provide consistent, repeatable transformations across different representation layers of information systems, such systems remain fragmented in their system representation. This study explores the problem of creating a unified architecture for LLM-oriented applications based on selected architectural frameworks by SMEs. A framework structure is proposed that covers some key types of architectural diagrams and supports a closed cycle of transformations, such as: "Code to Documentation to Code". The key architectural diagrams are split equally between main architectural layers: high-layer (business and domain understanding), middle-layer (system architecture), and low-layer (developer-layer architecture). Each architectural layer still contains some abstraction layers, which make it more flexible and better fit the requirements of design principles and architectural patterns. The conducted experiments demonstrated the stable quality of generated documentation and code when using a structured architectural context in the form of architectural diagrams. The results confirm that the proposed unified architecture metamodel can serve as an effective interface between humans and models, improving the accuracy, stability, and repeatability of LLM generation. However, the selected set of architectural diagrams should be optimised to avoid redundancy between some diagrams, and some diagrams should be updated to represent extra contextual orchestration. This work demonstrates measurable improvements for a new generation of intelligent tools that automate the SDLC and enable a comprehensive architecture compatible with AI-driven development.
summary_zh: 人工智能与大语言模型的快速发展催生了软件开发生命周期的新方法，其中大量代码、技术文档与业务文档已实现自动生成。然而，由于缺乏统一的架构框架为信息系统的不同表示层提供一致、可重复的转换机制，此类系统在体系表征上仍呈现碎片化状态。本研究基于领域专家选定的架构框架，探讨了构建面向大语言模型应用统一架构的问题。提出了一种框架结构，该结构涵盖若干关键类型的架构图，并支持“代码到文档再到代码”的闭环转换流程。关键架构图均衡分布于主要架构层：高层（业务与领域理解）、中层（系统架构）及低层（开发者层架构）。每个架构层仍包含若干抽象层，这使其更灵活地适应设计原则与架构模式的要求。实验表明，以架构图形式提供的结构化架构上下文能够稳定生成文档与代码的质量。结果证实，所提出的统一架构元模型可作为人与模型间的有效接口，提升大语言模型生成的准确性、稳定性与可重复性。但所选架构图集合需优化以避免图示间的冗余，部分图示还需更新以体现额外的上下文编排。本工作为新一代自动化软件开发生命周期的智能工具展示了可量化的改进，这些工具能够实现与人工智能驱动开发相兼容的全面架构。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified architecture metamodel for LLM-driven software development, using structured architectural diagrams to improve the consistency and repeatability of generated code and documentation within the SDLC.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于LLM驱动软件开发统一架构元模型，利用结构化架构图来提高软件开发生命周期中生成代码和文档的一致性与可重复性。

title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation
summary: Human memory adapts through selective forgetting: experiences become less accessible over time but can be reactivated by reinforcement or contextual cues. In contrast, memory-augmented LLM agents rely on "always-on" retrieval and "flat" memory storage, causing high interference and latency as histories grow. We introduce Oblivion, a memory control framework that casts forgetting as decay-driven reductions in accessibility, not explicit deletion. Oblivion decouples memory control into read and write paths. The read path decides when to consult memory, based on agent uncertainty and memory buffer sufficiency, avoiding redundant always-on access. The write path decides what to strengthen, by reinforcing memories contributing to forming the response. Together, this enables hierarchical memory organization that maintains persistent high-level strategies while dynamically loading details as needed. We evaluate on both static and dynamic long-horizon interaction benchmarks. Results show that Oblivion dynamically adapts memory access and reinforcement, balancing learning and forgetting under shifting contexts, highlighting that memory control is essential for effective LLM-agentic reasoning. The source code is available at https://github.com/nec-research/oblivion.
summary_zh: 人类记忆通过选择性遗忘进行适应：经历会随时间推移而变得不易访问，但可通过强化或情境线索重新激活。相比之下，记忆增强型大语言模型智能体依赖"始终在线"检索和"扁平化"记忆存储，导致历史增长时产生高干扰和延迟。我们提出Oblivion记忆控制框架，将遗忘视为可访问性随衰减降低的过程，而非显式删除。Oblivion将记忆控制解耦为读取与写入路径：读取路径基于智能体不确定性和记忆缓冲区充足性，决定何时查询记忆，避免冗余的始终在线访问；写入路径通过强化对生成响应有贡献的记忆，决定需要巩固的内容。两者结合实现了分层记忆组织，既能维持持久的高层策略，又能动态加载所需细节。我们在静态与动态长程交互基准测试中进行评估，结果表明Oblivion能动态适应记忆访问与强化机制，在情境变化中平衡学习与遗忘过程，证明记忆控制对实现高效大语言模型智能体推理至关重要。源代码发布于https://github.com/nec-research/oblivion。
tldr: Introduces Oblivion, a framework for adaptive memory control in LLM agents via decay-based accessibility, dynamic read/write paths, and hierarchical organization to improve long-horizon reasoning.
tldr_zh: 提出Oblivion框架，通过基于衰减的可访问性、动态读写路径和分层组织，实现LLM智能体的自适应记忆控制，以提升长时程推理能力。

title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large language models applied to clinical prediction exhibit case-level heterogeneity: simple cases yield consistent outputs, while complex cases produce divergent predictions under minor prompt changes. Existing single-agent strategies sample from one role-conditioned distribution, and multi-agent frameworks use fixed roles with flat majority voting, discarding the diagnostic signal in disagreement. We propose CAMP (Case-Adaptive Multi-agent Panel), where an attending-physician agent dynamically assembles a specialist panel tailored to each case's diagnostic uncertainty. Each specialist evaluates candidates via three-valued voting (KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL), enabling principled abstention outside one's expertise. A hybrid router directs each diagnosis through strong consensus, fallback to the attending physician's judgment, or evidence-based arbitration that weighs argument quality over vote counts. On diagnostic prediction and brief hospital course generation from MIMIC-IV across four LLM backbones, CAMP consistently outperforms strong baselines while consuming fewer tokens than most competing multi-agent methods, with voting records and arbitration traces offering transparent decision audits.
summary_zh:
摘要：
应用于临床预测的大语言模型表现出病例层面的异质性：简单病例能产生一致输出，而复杂病例在轻微提示变化下会产生分歧预测。现有单智能体策略从单一角色条件分布中采样，多智能体框架则采用固定角色与简单多数投票机制，忽视了分歧中的诊断信号。我们提出CAMP（病例自适应多智能体专家组），通过主治医师智能体根据每个病例的诊断不确定性动态组建专科专家小组。每位专家通过三值投票（采纳/拒绝/中立）评估候选方案，实现在专业领域外进行原则性弃权。混合路由机制将每个诊断导向强共识路径，或回退至主治医师判断，或启动基于证据的仲裁——该仲裁侧重论证质量而非票数统计。在基于MIMIC-IV数据集的诊断预测和简要病程生成任务中，跨越四种大语言模型架构，CAMP在消耗词元数少于多数竞争性多智能体方法的同时持续超越强基线模型，其投票记录与仲裁轨迹为决策过程提供了透明审计路径。
tldr: A multi-agent LLM framework for clinical diagnosis adaptively assembles specialist panels and uses a hybrid arbitration mechanism to handle case complexity, improving prediction accuracy and transparency.
tldr_zh: 一个用于临床诊断的多智能体LLM框架，根据病例复杂性自适应地组建专家小组，并使用混合仲裁机制来提高预测准确性和透明度。

title: PHASOR: Anatomy- and Phase-Consistent Volumetric Diffusion for CT Virtual Contrast Enhancement
summary: Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) is pivotal for highlighting tissue perfusion and vascularity, yet its clinical ubiquity is impeded by the invasive nature of contrast agents and radiation risks. While virtual contrast enhancement (VCE) offers an alternative to synthesizing CECT from non-contrast CT (NCCT), existing methods struggle with anatomical heterogeneity and spatial misalignment, leading to inconsistent enhancement patterns and incorrect details. This paper introduces PHASOR, a volumetric diffusion framework for high-fidelity CT VCE. By treating CT volumes as coherent sequences, we leverage a video diffusion model to enhance structural coherence and volumetric accuracy. To ensure anatomy-phase consistent synthesis, we introduce two complementary modules. First, anatomy-routed mixture-of-experts (AR-MoE) anchors distinct enhancement patterns to anatomical semantics, with organ-specific memory to capture salient details. Second, intensity-phase aware representation alignment (IP-REPA) highlights intricate contrast signals while mitigating the impact of imperfect spatial alignment. Extensive experiments across three datasets demonstrate that PHASOR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both synthesis quality and enhancement accuracy.
summary_zh: 对比增强计算机断层扫描（CECT）对于凸显组织灌注与血管分布至关重要，但其临床普及受到造影剂侵入性和辐射风险的限制。虚拟对比增强（VCE）技术虽能通过非增强CT（NCCT）合成CECT作为替代方案，现有方法却因解剖结构异质性与空间错位问题，导致增强模式不一致与细节失真。本文提出PHASOR——一种基于体扩散的高保真CT虚拟对比增强框架。通过将CT体积数据视为连贯序列，我们利用视频扩散模型提升结构连贯性与三维空间精度。为确保解剖结构与增强相位的协同生成，我们引入两个互补模块：其一，解剖路由专家混合模块（AR-MoE）将不同增强模式锚定于解剖语义，通过器官特异性记忆单元捕获关键细节；其二，强度相位感知表征对齐模块（IP-REPA）在弱化空间配准误差影响的同时强化精细对比度信号。基于三个数据集的广泛实验表明，PHASOR在合成质量与增强精度上均显著优于现有最优方法。
tldr: Proposes PHASOR, a volumetric diffusion model for generating virtual contrast-enhanced CT scans from non-contrast CT, using anatomy- and phase-aware modules to improve synthesis fidelity.
tldr_zh: 提出PHASOR，一种用于从非对比CT生成虚拟增强CT的体扩散模型，通过解剖结构和相位感知模块来提高合成保真度。

title: Foundation Model-guided Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-Labeling for Partially Labeled Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Automated medical image segmentation has achieved remarkable progress with fully labeled data. However, site-specific clinical priorities and the high cost of manual annotation often yield scans with only a subset of organs labeled, leading to the partially labeled problem that degrades performance. To address this issue, we propose IPnP, an Iteratively Prompting and Pseudo-labeling framework, for partially labeled medical image segmentation. IPnP iteratively generates and refines pseudo-labels for unlabeled organs through collaboration between a trainable segmentation network (specialist) and a frozen foundation model (generalist), progressively recovering full-organ supervision. On the public dataset AMOS with the simulated partial-label setting, IPnP consistently improves segmentation performance over prior methods and approaches the performance of the fully labeled reference. We further evaluate on a private, partially labeled dataset of 210 head-and-neck cancer patients and demonstrate our effectiveness in real-world clinical settings.
summary_zh: 在拥有完整标注数据的情况下，自动医学图像分割已取得显著进展。然而，特定临床站点的优先需求与高昂的人工标注成本，常导致仅部分器官被标注的扫描图像出现，从而产生部分标注问题并降低分割性能。为解决此问题，我们提出一种适用于部分标注医学图像分割的迭代提示与伪标签框架IPnP。该框架通过可训练的分割网络（专家模型）与冻结的基础模型（通才模型）协同工作，迭代生成并优化未标注器官的伪标签，逐步恢复全器官监督。在模拟部分标注设置的公共数据集AMOS上，IPnP相较于现有方法持续提升分割性能，并接近完全标注基准的水平。我们进一步在包含210例头颈癌患者的私有部分标注数据集上进行评估，验证了本方法在真实临床场景中的有效性。
tldr: Proposes an iterative prompting and pseudo-labeling framework (IPnP) for partially labeled medical image segmentation, using a frozen foundation model and a trainable segmentation network to recover full-organ supervision.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于部分标注医学图像分割的迭代提示和伪标签框架（IPnP），通过冻结的基础模型和可训练的分割网络协作，逐步恢复全器官监督。

title: Sub-metre Lunar DEM Generation and Validation from Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Multi-View Imagery Using Open-Source Photogrammetry
summary: High-resolution digital elevation models (DEMs) of the lunar surface are essential for surface mobility planning, landing site characterization, and planetary science. The Orbiter High Resolution Camera (OHRC) on board Chandrayaan-2 has the best ground sampling capabilities of any lunar orbital imaging currently in use by acquiring panchromatic imagery at a resolution of roughly 20-30 cm per pixel. This work presents, for the first time, the generation of sub-metre DEMs from OHRC multi-view imagery using an exclusively open-source pipeline. Candidate stereo pairs are identified from non-paired OHRC archives through geometric analysis of image metadata, employing baseline-to-height (B/H) ratio computation and convergence angle estimation. Dense stereo correspondence and ray triangulation are then applied to generate point clouds, which are gridded into DEMs at effective spatial resolutions between approximately 24 and 54 cm across five geographically distributed lunar sites. Absolute elevation consistency is established through Iterative Closest Point (ICP) alignment against Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Narrow Angle Camera (NAC) Digital Terrain Models, followed by constant-bias offset correction. Validation against NAC reference terrain yields a vertical RMSE of 5.85 m (at native OHRC resolution), and a horizontal accuracy of less than 30 cm assessed by planimetric feature matching.
summary_zh: 月球表面的高分辨率数字高程模型对表面移动规划、着陆点特征描述及行星科学研究至关重要。月船二号搭载的轨道器高分辨率相机通过获取分辨率约20-30厘米/像素的全色影像，具备当前所有在轨月球成像设备中最优的地面采样能力。本研究首次采用全开源流程，利用OHRC多视角影像生成了亚米级数字高程模型。通过对图像元数据进行几何分析，采用基线高度比计算和收敛角估计方法，从非配对OHRC影像档案中筛选出候选立体像对。随后应用密集立体匹配与光线三角测量生成点云数据，在五个地理分布各异的月球区域将其网格化为空间分辨率介于24至54厘米之间的数字高程模型。通过迭代最近点算法将生成数据与月球勘测轨道飞行器窄角相机数字地形模型进行配准，并实施恒定偏差偏移校正，从而建立绝对高程一致性。以窄角相机参考地形为基准进行验证，结果显示垂直方向均方根误差为5.85米（基于原始OHRC分辨率），而通过平面特征匹配评估的水平精度优于30厘米。
tldr: This paper describes a method for generating high-resolution (sub-meter) lunar digital elevation models (DEMs) using open-source photogrammetry on imagery from the Chandrayaan-2 orbiter, validated against existing lunar terrain data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用开源摄影测量技术处理月船2号轨道器影像，生成高分辨率（亚米级）月球数字高程模型的方法，并利用现有月球地形数据进行了验证。

title: Maximizing T2-Only Prostate Cancer Localization from Expected Diffusion Weighted Imaging
summary: Multiparametric MRI is increasingly recommended as a first-line noninvasive approach to detect and localize prostate cancer, requiring at minimum diffusion-weighted (DWI) and T2-weighted (T2w) MR sequences. Early machine learning attempts using only T2w images have shown promising diagnostic performance in segmenting radiologist-annotated lesions. Such uni-modal T2-only approaches deliver substantial clinical benefits by reducing costs and expertise required to acquire other sequences. This work investigates an arguably more challenging application using only T2w at inference, but to localize individual cancers based on independent histopathology labels. We formulate DWI images as a latent modality (readily available during training) to classify cancer presence at local Barzell zones, given only T2w images as input. In the resulting expectation-maximization algorithm, a latent modality generator (implemented using a flow matching-based generative model) approximates the latent DWI image posterior distribution in the E-steps, while in M-steps a cancer localizer is simultaneously optimized with the generative model to maximize the expected likelihood of cancer presence. The proposed approach provides a novel theoretical framework for learning from a privileged DWI modality, yielding superior cancer localization performance compared to approaches that lack training DWI images or existing frameworks for privileged learning and incomplete modalities. The proposed T2-only methods perform competitively or better than baseline methods using multiple input sequences (e.g., improving the patient-level F1 score by 14.4\% and zone-level QWK by 5.3\% over the T2w+DWI baseline). We present quantitative evaluations using internal and external datasets from 4,133 prostate cancer patients with histopathology-verified labels.
summary_zh: 多参数磁共振成像作为一种无创性一线检测和定位前列腺癌的方法正日益受到推荐，该方法至少需要扩散加权（DWI）序列和T2加权（T2w）序列。早期仅使用T2w图像的机器学习尝试在分割放射科医生标注的病灶方面已显示出良好的诊断性能。这种仅用T2w单模态的方法因降低获取其他序列的成本及专业要求而具有显著临床价值。本研究探讨了一项更具挑战性的应用：仅使用T2w图像进行推理，但需根据独立组织病理学标签定位个体癌症病灶。我们将DWI图像构建为潜在模态（训练阶段可获取），使得仅输入T2w图像即可对局部Barzell分区是否存在癌症进行分类。在所构建的期望最大化算法中，潜在模态生成器（采用基于流匹配的生成模型实现）在E步骤中近似潜在DWI图像后验分布，而M步骤中癌症定位器与生成模型同步优化，以最大化癌症存在的期望似然概率。该研究提出了一个新颖的理论框架，通过利用DWI作为特权模态进行学习，在癌症定位性能上优于缺乏训练DWI图像的方法及现有特权学习与不完整模态框架。相较于需要多序列输入的基线方法（如T2w+DWI基线），我们提出的仅T2w方法性能相当或更优（患者级F1分数提升14.4%，分区级QWK指标提升5.3%）。我们使用来自4,133名前列腺癌患者、经组织病理学验证的内部和外部数据集进行了定量评估。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for localizing prostate cancer using only T2-weighted MRI at inference by learning from a latent DWI modality during training, improving performance over multi-sequence baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅使用T2加权MRI在推理时定位前列腺癌的方法，通过在训练中学习潜在的DWI模态，其性能优于多序列基线。

title: Autoregressive Appearance Prediction for 3D Gaussian Avatars
summary: A photorealistic and immersive human avatar experience demands capturing fine, person-specific details such as cloth and hair dynamics, subtle facial expressions, and characteristic motion patterns. Achieving this requires large, high-quality datasets, which often introduce ambiguities and spurious correlations when very similar poses correspond to different appearances. Models that fit these details during training can overfit and produce unstable, abrupt appearance changes for novel poses. We propose a 3D Gaussian Splatting avatar model with a spatial MLP backbone that is conditioned on both pose and an appearance latent. The latent is learned during training by an encoder, yielding a compact representation that improves reconstruction quality and helps disambiguate pose-driven renderings. At driving time, our predictor autoregressively infers the latent, producing temporally smooth appearance evolution and improved stability. Overall, our method delivers a robust and practical path to high-fidelity, stable avatar driving.
summary_zh: 一种具有照片级真实感和沉浸感的人体化身体验需要捕捉细微的个人化细节，如服装与头发动态、微妙的面部表情以及特征性运动模式。实现这一目标需要大规模高质量数据集，然而当高度相似的姿态对应不同外观时，数据集往往会引入歧义与虚假相关性。在训练中拟合这些细节的模型容易过拟合，导致在新姿态下产生不稳定、突兀的外观变化。我们提出一种基于三维高斯泼溅的化身模型，其以姿态和外观隐向量为条件的空间MLP主干网络。该隐向量通过编码器在训练过程中学习得到，形成紧凑表征以提升重建质量，并帮助消除姿态驱动渲染的歧义。在驱动阶段，我们的预测器通过自回归方式推断隐向量，产生时间上平滑的外观演变并增强稳定性。总体而言，我们的方法为高保真度、稳定化的化身驱动提供了一条稳健且实用的技术路径。
tldr: The paper proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting avatar model with an autoregressive appearance predictor to improve stability and detail for human avatars, but does not involve robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种3D高斯泼溅化身模型，通过自回归外观预测器来改善人类化身的稳定性和细节，但未涉及机器人或具身智能体。

title: JAMMEval: A Refined Collection of Japanese Benchmarks for Reliable VLM Evaluation
summary: Reliable evaluation is essential for the development of vision-language models (VLMs). However, Japanese VQA benchmarks have undergone far less iterative refinement than their English counterparts. As a result, many existing benchmarks contain issues such as ambiguous questions, incorrect answers, and instances that can be solved without visual grounding, undermining evaluation reliability and leading to misleading conclusions in model comparisons. To address these limitations, we introduce JAMMEval, a refined collection of Japanese benchmarks for reliable VLM evaluation. It is constructed by systematically refining seven existing Japanese benchmark datasets through two rounds of human annotation, improving both data quality and evaluation reliability. In our experiments, we evaluate open-weight and proprietary VLMs on JAMMEval and analyze the capabilities of recent models on Japanese VQA. We further demonstrate the effectiveness of our refinement by showing that the resulting benchmarks yield evaluation scores that better reflect model capability, exhibit lower run-to-run variance, and improve the ability to distinguish between models of different capability levels. We release our dataset and code to advance reliable evaluation of VLMs.
summary_zh: 可靠的评估对于视觉语言模型（VLM）的发展至关重要。然而，日文VQA基准测试的迭代完善程度远不及英文基准。这导致许多现有基准存在歧义性问题、错误答案以及无需视觉基础即可解决的实例，这些缺陷削弱了评估的可靠性，并在模型比较中引致误导性结论。为应对这些局限，我们提出JAMMEval——一套经过精细化构建的日文基准测试集，旨在实现可靠的VLM评估。该数据集通过两轮人工标注系统性地完善了七个现有日文基准数据集，从而提升了数据质量与评估可靠性。在实验中，我们利用JAMMEval对开源权重及专有VLMs进行评估，并分析了当前模型在日文VQA任务上的能力表现。进一步通过实验证明：优化后的基准测试能够产生更准确反映模型能力的评估分数、降低多次运行的方差，并提升区分不同能力水平模型的效能。我们将公开数据集与代码，以推动VLMs的可靠评估发展。
tldr: This paper introduces JAMMEval, a refined collection of Japanese benchmark datasets for evaluating Vision-Language Models, focusing on improved data quality and evaluation reliability through human annotation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了JAMMEval，一个经过精炼的日语视觉语言模型基准测试集，通过人工标注提升数据质量和评估可靠性，旨在促进VLMs的可靠评估。

title: Disentangling to Re-couple: Resolving the Similarity-Controllability Paradox in Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Subject-Driven Text-to-Image (T2I) Generation aims to preserve a subject's identity while editing its context based on a text prompt. A core challenge in this task is the "similarity-controllability paradox", where enhancing textual control often degrades the subject's fidelity, and vice-versa. We argue this paradox stems from the ambiguous role of text prompts, which are often tasked with describing both the subject and the desired modifications, leading to conflicting signals for the model. To resolve this, we propose DisCo, a novel framework that first Disntangles and then re-Couples visual and textual information. First, our textual-visual decoupling module isolates the sources of information: subject identity is extracted exclusively from the reference image with the entity word of the subject, while the text prompt is simplified to contain only the modification command, where the subject refers to general pronouns, eliminating descriptive ambiguity. However, this strict separation can lead to unnatural compositions between the subject and its contexts. We address this by designing a dedicated reward signal and using reinforcement learning to seamlessly recouple the visually-defined subject and the textually-generated context. Our approach effectively resolves the paradox, enabling simultaneous high-fidelity subject preservation and precise textual control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing highly realistic and coherent images.
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
主体驱动的文本到图像（T2I）生成旨在基于文本提示编辑主体上下文的同时，保持其身份一致性。此任务的核心挑战在于“相似性与可控性悖论”，即增强文本控制往往会降低主体保真度，反之亦然。我们认为，该悖论源于文本提示的模糊性：文本提示通常同时承担描述主体与所需修改的双重任务，从而向模型传递冲突信号。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种新颖框架DisCo，该框架首先对视觉与文本信息进行解耦，再将其重新耦合。首先，通过文本-视觉解耦模块分离信息源：主体身份仅从参考图像中提取，并辅以其实体词，而文本提示则简化为仅包含修改指令（其中主体指代通用代词），从而消除描述模糊性。然而，这种严格分离可能导致主体与其上下文之间的不自然组合。为此，我们设计了一种专用奖励信号，并利用强化学习将视觉定义的主体与文本生成的上下文无缝重耦合。我们的方法有效解决了上述悖论，在实现高保真主体保留的同时，确保了精确的文本控制。大量实验表明，该方法在生成高度真实且连贯的图像方面达到了当前最优性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a method (DisCo) to resolve the similarity-controllability paradox in subject-driven text-to-image generation by disentangling subject identity from modification prompts, then recoupling them using reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法（DisCo），通过解耦主题身份和修改提示，再使用强化学习重新耦合它们，以解决主题驱动文本到图像生成中的相似性与可控性悖论。

title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation
summary: Adapting pretrained language models (LMs) into vision-language models (VLMs) can degrade their native linguistic capability due to representation shift and cross-modal interference introduced during multimodal adaptation. Such loss is difficult to recover, even with targeted task-specific fine-tuning using standard objectives. Prior recovery approaches typically introduce additional modules that act as intermediate alignment layers to maintain or isolate modality-specific subspaces, which increases architectural complexity, adds parameters at inference time, and limits flexibility across models and settings. We propose LinguDistill, an adapter-free distillation method that restores linguistic capability by utilizing the original frozen LM as a teacher. We overcome the key challenge of enabling vision-conditioned teacher supervision by introducing layer-wise KV-cache sharing, which exposes the teacher to the student's multimodal representations without modifying the architecture of either model. We then selectively distill the teacher's strong linguistic signal on language-intensive data to recover language capability, while preserving the student's visual grounding on multimodal tasks. As a result, LinguDistill recovers $\sim$10% of the performance lost on language and knowledge benchmarks, while maintaining comparable performance on vision-heavy tasks. Our findings demonstrate that linguistic capability can be recovered without additional modules, providing an efficient and practical solution to modality-specific degradation in multimodal models.
summary_zh: 摘要：将预训练语言模型（LMs）适配为视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可能会因其在多模态适应过程中引入的表征偏移和跨模态干扰而削弱其原有的语言能力。这种能力损失很难恢复，即使采用针对性的任务特定微调及标准目标函数也难奏效。现有的恢复方法通常引入额外模块作为中间对齐层来维持或隔离模态特定子空间，但这会提高架构复杂度、增加推理时的参数量，并限制模型与设置间的灵活性。我们提出LinguDistill——一种无需适配器的蒸馏方法，通过将原始冻结的语言模型作为教师来恢复语言能力。我们通过引入分层KV缓存共享解决了关键挑战，使教师模型能够接触学生模型的多模态表征，而无需修改任一模型的架构。随后，我们在语言密集型数据上选择性地蒸馏教师模型的强语言信号以恢复语言能力，同时保持学生在多模态任务中的视觉基础能力。实验结果表明，LinguDistill在语言与知识基准测试中恢复了约10%的性能损失，并在视觉密集型任务中保持了可比性能。我们的研究证明，语言能力可以在不引入额外模块的情况下得以恢复，为多模态模型中模态特定性能退化问题提供了一种高效实用的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes LinguDistill, an adapter-free method to recover linguistic ability in vision-language models that degrades during multimodal adaptation, using the original language model as a teacher via layer-wise KV-cache sharing.
tldr_zh: 提出LinguDistill，一种无需适配器的方法，通过层间KV缓存共享技术，利用原始语言模型作为教师，恢复视觉语言模型在适应过程中受损的语言能力。

title: Video Patch Pruning: Efficient Video Instance Segmentation via Early Token Reduction
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated state-ofthe-art performance in several benchmarks, yet their high computational costs hinders their practical deployment. Patch Pruning offers significant savings, but existing approaches restrict token reduction to deeper layers, leaving early-stage compression unexplored. This limits their potential for holistic efficiency. In this work, we present a novel Video Patch Pruning framework (VPP) that integrates temporal prior knowledge to enable efficient sparsity within early ViT layers. Our approach is motivated by the observation that prior features extracted from deeper layers exhibit strong foreground selectivity. Therefore we propose a fully differentiable module for temporal mapping to accurately select the most relevant patches in early network stages. Notably, the proposed method enables a patch reduction of up to 60% in dense prediction tasks, exceeding the capabilities of conventional image-based patch pruning, which typically operate around a 30% patch sparsity. VPP excels the high-sparsity regime, sustaining remarkable performance even when patch usage is reduced below 55%. Specifically, it preserves stable results with a maximal performance drop of 0.6% on the Youtube-VIS 2021 dataset.
summary_zh: 视觉变换器（ViT）在多个基准测试中均展现出最先进的性能，但其高计算成本阻碍了实际应用。块剪枝提供了显著的节省潜力，然而现有方法将令牌削减限制在较深层，尚未探索早期阶段的压缩，从而限制了整体效率提升的空间。本文提出了一种新颖的视频块剪枝框架（VPP），该框架通过整合时间先验知识，在ViT早期层中实现高效的稀疏化。这一方法的灵感来源于我们观察到从深层提取的先验特征表现出强烈的前景选择性。因此，我们设计了一个全可微分的时间映射模块，用于在网络早期阶段精确选择最相关的图像块。值得注意的是，该方法在密集预测任务中实现了高达60%的图像块削减，超越了传统基于图像的块剪枝方法——后者通常只能达到约30%的图像块稀疏度。VPP尤其在高稀疏度场景下表现卓越，即使图像块使用率降至55%以下，仍能保持优异的性能。具体而言，在Youtube-VIS 2021数据集上，该方法能保持稳定结果，最大性能下降仅0.6%。
tldr: This paper proposes a Video Patch Pruning (VPP) method to improve the efficiency of Vision Transformers for video instance segmentation by aggressively reducing redundant tokens in early layers, achieving high sparsity with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视频补丁剪枝（VPP）方法，通过利用时序先验知识在早期网络层进行大幅度的冗余令牌削减，以极小的性能损失显著提升了视频实例分割任务中视觉Transformer的效率。

title: Multicentric thrombus segmentation using an attention-based recurrent network with gradual modality dropout
summary: Detecting and delineating tiny targets in 3D brain scans is a central yet under-addressed challenge in medical imaging.In ischemic stroke, for instance, the culprit thrombus is small, low-contrast, and variably expressed across modalities(e.g., susceptibility-weighted T2 blooming, diffusion restriction on DWI/ADC), while real-world multi-center dataintroduce domain shifts, anisotropy, and frequent missing sequences. We introduce a methodology that couples an attention-based recurrent segmentation network (UpAttLLSTM), a training schedule that progressively increases the difficulty of hetero-modal learning, with gradual modality dropout, UpAttLLSTM aggregates context across slices via recurrent units (2.5D) and uses attention gates to fuse complementary cues across available sequences, making it robust to anisotropy and class imbalance. Gradual modality dropout systematically simulates site heterogeneity,noise, and missing modalities during training, acting as both augmentation and regularization to improve multi-center generalization. On a monocentric cohort, our approach detects thrombi in >90% of cases with a Dice score of 0.65. In a multi-center setting with missing modalities, it achieves-80% detection with a Dice score around 0.35. Beyond stroke, the proposed methodology directly transfers to other small-lesion tasks in 3D medical imaging where targets are scarce, subtle, and modality-dependent
summary_zh: 在医学影像领域，检测并描绘三维脑部扫描中的微小目标是一项核心但尚未得到充分解决的挑战。以缺血性中风为例，致病血栓往往体积小、对比度低，且在不同模态影像（如磁敏感加权成像的T2透亮效应、弥散加权成像/表观弥散系数上的弥散受限）中表现各异，而现实世界中的多中心数据还会引入域偏移、各向异性以及频繁的序列缺失问题。我们提出一种方法，将基于注意力的循环分割网络与渐进式异模态学习训练策略相结合，逐步实施模态丢弃机制。该网络通过循环单元实现跨切片上下文聚合，并利用注意力门融合不同可用序列间的互补信息，从而有效应对各向异性与类别不平衡问题。渐进式模态丢弃在训练过程中系统模拟了临床场景中的站点异质性、噪声及模态缺失，兼具数据增强与正则化功能，提升了多中心泛化能力。在单中心数据集中，本方法对血栓的检测率超过90%，戴斯相似系数达0.65；在包含模态缺失的多中心环境中，仍能保持约80%的检出率，戴斯系数稳定在0.35左右。该框架不仅适用于中风检测，还可直接推广至其他三维医学影像中的微小病灶识别任务，尤其适用于目标稀少、特征细微且模态依赖性的应用场景。
tldr: This paper proposes a medical imaging method for segmenting small thrombi in 3D brain scans using an attention-based recurrent network with gradual modality dropout to handle missing data and improve generalization across multi-center datasets.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种医学影像方法，用于分割3D脑部扫描中的微小血栓，利用基于注意力的循环网络和渐进式模态丢弃技术，以处理缺失数据并提升跨多中心数据集的泛化能力。

title: Revisiting Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval with Pre-Trained Vision Transformers
summary: Building on existing approaches, we revisit Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval, a task that consists of iteratively retrieving images containing objects of a class-of-interest, specified by a user-provided query. Starting from a large unlabeled image collection, the aim is to rapidly identify diverse instances of an object category relying solely on the initial query and the user's Relevance Feedback, with no prior labels. The retrieval process is formulated as a binary classification task, where the system continuously learns to distinguish between relevant and non-relevant images to the query, through iterative user interaction. This interaction is guided by an Active Learning loop: at each iteration, the system selects informative samples for user annotation, thereby refining the retrieval performance. This task is particularly challenging in multi-object datasets, where the object of interest may occupy only a small region of the image within a complex, cluttered scene. Unlike object-centered settings where global descriptors often suffice, multi-object images require more adapted, localized descriptors. In this work, we formulate and revisit the Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval task by leveraging pre-trained ViT representations, and addressing key design questions, including which object instances to consider in an image, what form the annotations should take, how Active Selection should be applied, and which representation strategies best capture the object's features. We compare several representation strategies across multi-object datasets highlighting trade-offs between capturing the global context and focusing on fine-grained local object details. Our results offer practical insights for the design of effective interactive retrieval pipelines based on Active Learning for object class retrieval.
summary_zh: 基于现有方法，我们重新审视了人在回路目标检索任务——该任务通过用户提供的查询指令，迭代检索包含特定类别目标物的图像。该流程从大规模无标注图像库出发，目标是在仅依赖初始查询和用户相关性反馈且无先验标注的条件下，快速识别目标类别的多样化实例。我们将检索过程构建为二分类任务，系统通过迭代式用户交互持续学习区分与查询相关/非相关的图像。这一交互由主动学习循环引导：在每轮迭代中，系统选择信息量丰富的样本供用户标注，从而优化检索性能。该任务在多目标数据集中尤为挑战，因为目标物体可能仅占据复杂杂乱场景中的微小区域。与全局描述符通常即可胜任的单目标场景不同，多目标图像需要更适配的局部化描述符。本研究通过利用预训练ViT表征重新构建并探索人在回路目标检索任务，重点解决了以下核心设计问题：图像中应考虑哪些目标实例、标注应采用何种形式、如何实施主动选择策略，以及何种表征策略最能有效捕捉目标特征。我们在多目标数据集上对比了多种表征策略，揭示了全局上下文捕捉与细粒度局部目标细节聚焦之间的权衡关系。实验结果为基于主动学习的目标类别检索系统构建高效交互式检索流程提供了实用见解。
tldr: This paper revisits Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval, using pre-trained Vision Transformers and Active Learning to iteratively retrieve images containing a user-specified object class from unlabeled collections, with a focus on handling multi-object, cluttered scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文重新审视人机交互式对象检索任务，利用预训练的视觉转换器和主动学习，从无标签数据集中迭代检索用户指定类别的物体图像，重点处理多物体、复杂场景的挑战。

title: A Benchmark of State-Space Models vs. Transformers and BiLSTM-based Models for Historical Newspaper OCR
summary:
End-to-end OCR for historical newspapers remains challenging, as models must handle long text sequences, degraded print quality, and complex layouts. While Transformer-based recognizers dominate current research, their quadratic complexity limits efficient paragraph-level transcription and large-scale deployment. We investigate linear-time State-Space Models (SSMs), specifically Mamba, as a scalable alternative to Transformer-based sequence modeling for OCR.
  We present to our knowledge, the first OCR architecture based on SSMs, combining a CNN visual encoder with bi-directional and autoregressive Mamba sequence modeling, and conduct a large-scale benchmark comparing SSMs with Transformer- and BiLSTM-based recognizers. Multiple decoding strategies (CTC, autoregressive, and non-autoregressive) are evaluated under identical training conditions alongside strong neural baselines (VAN, DAN, DANIEL) and widely used off-the-shelf OCR engines (PERO-OCR, Tesseract OCR, TrOCR, Gemini).
  Experiments on historical newspapers from the Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg, with newly released >99% verified gold-standard annotations, and cross-dataset tests on Fraktur and Antiqua lines, show that all neural models achieve low error rates (~2% CER), making computational efficiency the main differentiator. Mamba-based models maintain competitive accuracy while halving inference time and exhibiting superior memory scaling (1.26x vs 2.30x growth at 1000 chars), reaching 6.07% CER at the severely degraded paragraph level compared to 5.24% for DAN, while remaining 2.05x faster.
  We release code, trained models, and standardized evaluation protocols to enable reproducible research and guide practitioners in large-scale cultural heritage OCR.
summary_zh:
历史报纸的端到端光学字符识别（OCR）依然面临挑战，因为模型必须处理长文本序列、印刷质量退化及复杂版面布局。尽管基于Transformer的识别器主导了当前研究，但其二次复杂度限制了高效的段落级转录与大规模部署。本研究探索了线性时间状态空间模型作为基于Transformer的OCR序列建模的可扩展替代方案，重点关注Mamba架构。

我们提出了首个基于SSM的OCR架构，该架构结合了CNN视觉编码器与双向自回归Mamba序列建模，并通过大规模基准测试对比了SSM与基于Transformer及BiLSTM的识别器。在相同训练条件下，我们评估了多种解码策略（CTC、自回归与非自回归），同时引入强神经基线模型（VAN、DAN、DANIEL）和广泛使用的现成OCR引擎（PERO-OCR、Tesseract OCR、TrOCR、Gemini）作为对比。

基于卢森堡国家图书馆历史报纸数据（新发布且经过>99%验证的黄金标准标注），以及对哥特体与罗马体文本行的跨数据集测试，实验表明所有神经模型均实现了低错误率（约2%字符错误率），使得计算效率成为关键区分指标。基于Mamba的模型在保持竞争力准确率的同时，将推理时间缩短一半，并展现出更优的内存扩展性（处理1000字符时内存增长为1.26倍，而基准模型为2.30倍）。在严重退化的段落级识别任务中，Mamba模型达到6.07%字符错误率，优于DAN模型的5.24%，同时推理速度提升2.05倍。

我们公开了代码、训练模型及标准化评估协议，以促进可重复研究，并为大规模文化遗产OCR实践提供指导。
tldr: This paper benchmarks linear-time State-Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba against Transformers and BiLSTMs for OCR on historical newspapers, finding SSMs offer competitive accuracy with significantly better efficiency and memory scaling for long sequences.
tldr_zh: 本文针对历史报纸OCR，对线性时间状态空间模型（如Mamba）与Transformer和BiLSTM模型进行了基准测试，发现SSM在保持竞争力的准确率的同时，显著提高了长序列处理的效率和内存扩展性。

title: When AI and Experts Agree on Error: Intrinsic Ambiguity in Dermatoscopic Images
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), into dermatological diagnosis demonstrates substantial clinical potential. While existing literature predominantly benchmarks algorithmic performance against human experts, our study adopts a novel perspective by investigating the intrinsic complexity of dermatoscopic images. Through rigorous experimentation with multiple CNN architectures, we isolated a subset of images systematically misclassified across all models-a phenomenon statistically proven to exceed random chance. To determine if these failures stem from algorithmic biases or inherent visual ambiguity, expert dermatologists independently evaluated these challenging cases alongside a control group. The results revealed a collapse in human diagnostic performance on the AI-misclassified images. First, agreement with ground-truth labels plummeted, with Cohen's kappa dropping to a mere 0.08 for the difficult images, compared to a 0.61 for the control group. Second, we observed a severe deterioration in expert consensus; inter-rater reliability among physicians fell from moderate concordance (Fleiss kappa = 0.456) on control images to only modest agreement (Fleiss kappa = 0.275) on difficult cases. We identified image quality as a primary driver of these dual systematic failures. To promote transparency and reproducibility, all data, code, and trained models have been made publicly available
summary_zh: 人工智能，尤其是卷积神经网络在皮肤病学诊断中的整合展现出显著的临床潜力。现有文献主要将算法性能与人类专家进行对标，而本研究则采用新颖视角，探究皮肤镜图像的内在复杂性。通过对多种卷积神经网络架构的严谨实验，我们分离出一组在所有模型中被系统性误分类的图像子集——这一现象在统计学上被证实超出随机误差范围。为确定这些失败案例源于算法偏差还是固有的视觉模糊性，皮肤科专家对具有挑战性的病例组及对照组进行了独立评估。结果显示，在人工智能误分类的图像上，人类诊断性能出现了显著下降。首先，诊断与金标准标签的一致性大幅降低：困难图像组的Cohen's kappa系数仅为0.08，而对照组为0.61。其次，专家共识度严重恶化：医生间的评估者间信度从对照组的中等一致性（Fleiss kappa = 0.456）降至困难病例组的微弱一致性（Fleiss kappa = 0.275）。研究确认图像质量是造成这两类系统性失败的主要驱动因素。为促进透明度和可重复性，所有数据、代码及训练模型均已公开。
tldr: The paper investigates intrinsic ambiguity in dermatoscopic images, where AI models and human experts consistently misdiagnose a subset of images due to poor image quality, not just algorithmic bias.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了皮肤镜图像的内在模糊性，指出由于图像质量差，导致AI模型和人类专家都会对一部分图像做出系统性误诊，而不仅仅是算法偏差。

title: KG-CMI: Knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction for medical visual question answering
summary: Medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) is a crucial multimodal task in clinical decision support and telemedicine. Recent methods fail to fully leverage domain-specific medical knowledge, making it difficult to accurately associate lesion features in medical images with key diagnostic criteria. Additionally, classification-based approaches typically rely on predefined answer sets. Treating Med-VQA as a simple classification problem limits its ability to adapt to the diversity of free-form answers and may overlook detailed semantic information in those answers. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction (KG-CMI) framework, which consists of a fine-grained cross-modal feature alignment (FCFA) module, a knowledge graph embedding (KGE) module, a cross-modal interaction representation (CMIR) module, and a free-form answer enhanced multi-task learning (FAMT) module. The KG-CMI learns cross-modal feature representations for images and texts by effectively integrating professional medical knowledge through a graph, establishing associations between lesion features and disease knowledge. Moreover, FAMT leverages auxiliary knowledge from open-ended questions, improving the model's capability for open-ended Med-VQA. Experimental results demonstrate that KG-CMI outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on three Med-VQA datasets, i.e., VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and OVQA. Additionally, we conduct interpretability experiments to further validate the framework's effectiveness.
summary_zh: 医学视觉问答在临床决策支持与远程医疗中是一项关键的多模态任务。现有方法未能充分利用领域特定的医学知识，导致难以准确关联医学图像中的病灶特征与关键诊断标准。此外，基于分类的方法通常依赖于预定义的答案集合，将医学视觉问答视为简单的分类问题限制了其适应自由形式答案多样性的能力，并可能忽略答案中的细节语义信息。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种知识图谱增强的跨模态交互框架，该框架包含细粒度跨模态特征对齐模块、知识图谱嵌入模块、跨模态交互表示模块以及自由形式答案增强的多任务学习模块。该框架通过图谱有效整合专业医学知识，学习图像与文本的跨模态特征表示，从而建立病灶特征与疾病知识之间的关联。此外，多任务学习模块利用开放式问题的辅助知识，提升了模型在开放式医学视觉问答任务中的性能。实验结果表明，该框架在三个医学视觉问答数据集上均优于现有先进方法。我们还进行了可解释性实验，进一步验证了该框架的有效性。
tldr: A knowledge graph enhanced cross-Mamba interaction framework for medical visual question answering, integrating domain-specific knowledge to improve performance on free-form and diagnostic questions.
tldr_zh: 用于医学视觉问答的知识图增强型交叉Mamba交互框架，整合领域特定知识以提升自由回答和诊断问题上的表现。

title: HarassGuard: Detecting Harassment Behaviors in Social Virtual Reality with Vision-Language Models
summary: Social Virtual Reality (VR) platforms provide immersive social experiences but also expose users to serious risks of online harassment. Existing safety measures are largely reactive, while proactive solutions that detect harassment behavior during an incident often depend on sensitive biometric data, raising privacy concerns. In this paper, we present HarassGuard, a vision-language model (VLM) based system that detects physical harassment in social VR using only visual input. We construct an IRB-approved harassment vision dataset, apply prompt engineering, and fine-tune VLMs to detect harassment behavior by considering contextual information in social VR. Experimental results demonstrate that HarassGuard achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines (i.e., LSTM/CNN, Transformer), reaching an accuracy of up to 88.09% in binary classification and 68.85% in multi-class classification. Notably, HarassGuard matches these baselines while using significantly fewer fine-tuning samples (200 vs. 1,115), offering unique advantages in contextual reasoning and privacy-preserving detection.
summary_zh: 社交虚拟现实（VR）平台能够提供沉浸式社交体验，但同时也使用户面临严重的在线骚扰风险。现有的安全措施大多为被动反应型，而能够在事件发生过程中主动检测骚扰行为的解决方案通常依赖敏感的生物识别数据，引发了隐私担忧。本文提出HarassGuard——一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的系统，该系统仅通过视觉输入即可检测社交VR中的物理骚扰行为。我们构建了一个经IRB批准的骚扰视觉数据集，运用提示工程并对VLM进行微调，使其能够通过分析社交VR中的上下文信息来识别骚扰行为。实验结果表明，与现有先进基线模型（如LSTM/CNN、Transformer）相比，HarassGuard在二元分类任务中达到最高88.09%的准确率，在多分类任务中达到68.85%的准确率，展现出竞争性性能。值得注意的是，HarassGuard在使用显著更少的微调样本量（200个对比1,115个）的情况下，仍能达到与基线模型相当的性能，同时在上下文推理和隐私保护检测方面具有独特优势。
tldr: HarassGuard is a vision-language model system for detecting physical harassment in social Virtual Reality using only visual input, trained on a custom dataset and achieving competitive performance with few samples.
tldr_zh: HarassGuard 是一个基于视觉语言模型的系统，仅使用视觉输入来检测社交虚拟现实中的物理骚扰行为，在少量样本上实现竞争性性能。

title: TF-SSD: A Strong Pipeline via Synergic Mask Filter for Training-free Co-salient Object Detection
summary: Co-salient Object Detection (CoSOD) aims to segment salient objects that consistently appear across a group of related images. Despite the notable progress achieved by recent training-based approaches, they still remain constrained by the closed-set datasets and exhibit limited generalization. However, few studies explore the potential of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to address CoSOD, which demonstrate a strong generalized ability and robust saliency understanding. In this paper, we investigate and leverage VFMs for CoSOD, and further propose a novel training-free method, TF-SSD, through the synergy between SAM and DINO. Specifically, we first utilize SAM to generate comprehensive raw proposals, which serve as a candidate mask pool. Then, we introduce a quality mask generator to filter out redundant masks, thereby acquiring a refined mask set. Since this generator is built upon SAM, it inherently lacks semantic understanding of saliency. To this end, we adopt an intra-image saliency filter that employs DINO's attention maps to identify visually salient masks within individual images. Moreover, to extend saliency understanding across group images, we propose an inter-image prototype selector, which computes similarity scores among cross-image prototypes to select masks with the highest score. These selected masks serve as final predictions for CoSOD. Extensive experiments show that our TF-SSD outperforms existing methods (e.g., 13.7\% gains over the recent training-free method). Codes are available at https://github.com/hzz-yy/TF-SSD.
summary_zh: 协同显著目标检测（CoSOD）旨在分割一组相关图像中持续出现的显著目标。尽管近年来基于训练的方法取得了显著进展，但它们仍受限于闭集数据集，并表现出有限的泛化能力。然而，目前少有研究探索视觉基础模型（VFMs）在解决CoSOD问题上的潜力，这些模型展现出强大的泛化能力和稳健的显著性理解能力。本文研究并利用VFMs进行CoSOD，并进一步提出一种新颖的无训练方法TF-SSD，通过SAM与DINO的协同作用实现。具体而言，我们首先利用SAM生成全面的原始提议，构建候选掩码池。随后，引入一个质量掩码生成器来过滤冗余掩码，从而获得精炼的掩码集。由于该生成器基于SAM构建，其本身缺乏对显著性的语义理解。为此，我们采用图像内显著性滤波器，利用DINO的注意力图识别单个图像中的视觉显著掩码。此外，为将显著性理解扩展到图像组层面，我们提出跨图像原型选择器，通过计算跨图像原型间的相似度得分来选择得分最高的掩码。这些被选中的掩码作为CoSOD的最终预测结果。大量实验表明，我们的TF-SSD优于现有方法（例如，在近期无训练方法基础上提升13.7%）。代码已在https://github.com/hzz-yy/TF-SSD开源。
tldr: A novel training-free Co-salient Object Detection method (TF-SSD) that leverages Vision Foundation Models (SAM and DINO) to synergistically generate and filter masks for salient object segmentation across related images, without requiring task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的无训练协同显著性目标检测方法（TF-SSD），它利用视觉基础模型（SAM和DINO）协同生成和过滤掩码，无需特定任务训练即可在相关图像组中分割显著性目标。

title: Learnability-Guided Diffusion for Dataset Distillation
summary: Training machine learning models on massive datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Dataset distillation addresses this by creating a small synthetic dataset that achieves the same performance as the full dataset. Recent methods use diffusion models to generate distilled data, either by promoting diversity or matching training gradients. However, existing approaches produce redundant training signals, where samples convey overlapping information. Empirically, disjoint subsets of distilled datasets capture 80-90% overlapping signals. This redundancy stems from optimizing visual diversity or average training dynamics without accounting for similarity across samples, leading to datasets where multiple samples share similar information rather than complementary knowledge. We propose learnability-driven dataset distillation, which constructs synthetic datasets incrementally through successive stages. Starting from a small set, we train a model and generate new samples guided by learnability scores that identify what the current model can learn from, creating an adaptive curriculum. We introduce Learnability-Guided Diffusion (LGD), which balances training utility for the current model with validity under a reference model to generate curriculum-aligned samples. Our approach reduces redundancy by 39.1%, promotes specialization across training stages, and achieves state-of-the-art results on ImageNet-1K (60.1%), ImageNette (87.2%), and ImageWoof (72.9%). Our code is available on our project page https://jachansantiago.github.io/learnability-guided-distillation/.
summary_zh: 在大规模数据集上训练机器学习模型成本高昂且耗时。数据集蒸馏技术通过创建一个小型合成数据集来解决这一问题，该数据集能达到与完整数据集相同的性能。近期方法利用扩散模型生成蒸馏数据，其策略侧重于提升多样性或匹配训练梯度。然而，现有方法会产生冗余的训练信号，即样本传递的信息存在重叠。实验表明，蒸馏数据集的不相交子集捕获了80%-90%的重叠信号。这种冗余源于优化视觉多样性或平均训练动态时未考虑样本间相似性，导致多个样本共享相似信息而非互补知识。我们提出可学习性驱动的数据集蒸馏方法，通过连续阶段逐步构建合成数据集。该方法从少量样本开始，训练模型并基于可学习性分数生成新样本——这些分数用于识别当前模型可从中学习的内容，从而形成自适应课程。我们引入可学习性引导扩散方法，该方法通过平衡当前模型的训练效用与参考模型下的有效性，生成与课程进度对齐的样本。我们的方法将冗余度降低了39.1%，促进了训练阶段间的专业化分工，并在ImageNet-1K（60.1%）、ImageNette（87.2%）和ImageWoof（72.9%）数据集上实现了最先进的结果。代码已发布于项目页面：https://jachansantiago.github.io/learnability-guided-distillation/。
tldr: This paper proposes a learnability-guided diffusion method for dataset distillation that reduces redundancy by generating synthetic datasets incrementally, achieving state-of-the-art results on image classification benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于可学习性引导的扩散方法用于数据集蒸馏，通过增量生成合成数据集来减少冗余，在图像分类基准上取得了最先进的性能。

title: PC-SAM: Patch-Constrained Fine-Grained Interactive Road Segmentation in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
summary: Road masks obtained from remote sensing images effectively support a wide range of downstream tasks. In recent years, most studies have focused on improving the performance of fully automatic segmentation models for this task, achieving significant gains. However, current fully automatic methods are still insufficient for identifying certain challenging road segments and often produce false positive and false negative regions. Moreover, fully automatic segmentation does not support local segmentation of regions of interest or refinement of existing masks. Although the SAM model is widely used as an interactive segmentation model and performs well on natural images, it shows poor performance in remote sensing road segmentation and cannot support fine-grained local refinement. To address these limitations, we propose PC-SAM, which integrates fully automatic road segmentation and interactive segmentation within a unified framework. By carefully designing a fine-tuning strategy, the influence of point prompts is constrained to their corresponding patches, overcoming the inability of the original SAM to perform fine local corrections and enabling fine-grained interactive mask refinement. Extensive experiments on several representative remote sensing road segmentation datasets demonstrate that, when combined with point prompts, PC-SAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fully automatic models in road mask segmentation, while also providing flexible local mask refinement and local road segmentation. The code will be available at https://github.com/Cyber-CCOrange/PC-SAM.
summary_zh: 从遥感影像中获取的道路掩膜能够有效支持多种下游任务。近年来，大多数研究聚焦于提升该任务全自动分割模型的性能，并取得了显著进展。然而，当前的全自动方法在识别某些具有挑战性的道路段时仍显不足，常出现误判正例和误判负例区域。此外，全自动分割无法支持对感兴趣区域的局部分割或对现有掩膜的精细化修正。尽管SAM模型作为交互式分割模型被广泛应用，在自然图像上表现优异，但在遥感道路分割任务中效果欠佳，难以支持细粒度的局部优化。为解决上述局限，我们提出了PC-SAM，该模型将全自动道路分割与交互式分割整合于统一框架中。通过精心设计的微调策略，将点提示的影响范围约束在对应图像块内，克服了原始SAM无法进行精细局部修正的缺陷，实现了细粒度的交互式掩膜优化。在多个具有代表性的遥感道路分割数据集上的大量实验表明，PC-SAM结合点提示后，在道路掩膜分割任务中显著优于当前最先进的全自动模型，同时具备灵活的局部掩膜优化及局部道路分割能力。代码将在https://github.com/Cyber-CCOrange/PC-SAM开源。
tldr: Proposes PC-SAM, a method for fine-grained interactive segmentation of roads in remote sensing images, by constraining the influence of prompts to local patches for improved mask refinement and local correction.
tldr_zh: 提出PC-SAM，一种针对高分辨率遥感图像中道路进行细粒度交互式分割的方法，通过将提示影响限制在局部块内，以改进掩膜细化和局部修正。

title: ARGS: Auto-Regressive Gaussian Splatting via Parallel Progressive Next-Scale Prediction
summary: Auto-regressive frameworks for next-scale prediction of 2D images have demonstrated strong potential for producing diverse and sophisticated content by progressively refining a coarse input. However, extending this paradigm to 3D object generation remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce auto-regressive Gaussian splatting (ARGS), a framework for making next-scale predictions in parallel for generation according to levels of detail. We propose a Gaussian simplification strategy and reverse the simplification to guide next-scale generation. Benefiting from the use of hierarchical trees, the generation process requires only \(\mathcal{O}(\log n)\) steps, where \(n\) is the number of points. Furthermore, we propose a tree-based transformer to predict the tree structure auto-regressively, allowing leaf nodes to attend to their internal ancestors to enhance structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively generates multi-scale Gaussian representations with controllable levels of detail, visual fidelity, and a manageable time consumption budget.
summary_zh: 用于二维图像下一尺度预测的自回归框架已展现出通过逐步细化粗糙输入生成多样化和复杂内容的强大潜力。然而，将这一范式扩展到三维物体生成领域仍基本处于探索空白。本文提出自回归高斯溅射（ARGS）框架，该框架依据细节层次并行进行下一尺度预测以生成三维内容。我们提出一种高斯简化策略，并通过逆转简化过程来指导下一尺度生成。得益于层次化树结构的使用，生成过程仅需 \(\mathcal{O}(\log n)\) 步，其中 \(n\) 为点数。此外，我们提出一种基于树结构的变换器，以自回归方式预测树结构，使叶节点能够关注其内部祖先节点，从而增强结构一致性。大量实验证明，我们的方法能有效生成具有可控细节层次、视觉保真度和可管理时间消耗的多尺度高斯表示。
tldr: A novel auto-regressive framework for generating 3D Gaussian splatting representations with controllable levels of detail, using a tree-based transformer and parallel next-scale prediction.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的自回归框架，用于生成具有可控细节层次的3D高斯泼溅表示，采用基于树的Transformer和并行下一尺度预测。

title: Out of Sight, Out of Track: Adversarial Attacks on Propagation-based Multi-Object Trackers via Query State Manipulation
summary: Recent Tracking-by-Query-Propagation (TBP) methods have advanced Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) by enabling end-to-end (E2E) pipelines with long-range temporal modeling. However, this reliance on query propagation introduces unexplored architectural vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks. We present FADE, a novel attack framework designed to exploit these specific vulnerabilities. FADE employs two attack strategies targeting core TBP mechanisms: (i) Temporal Query Flooding: Generates spurious temporally consistent track queries to exhaust the tracker's limited query budget, forcing it to terminate valid tracks. (ii) Temporal Memory Corruption: Directly attacks the query updater's memory by severing temporal links via state de-correlation and erasing the learned feature identity of matched tracks. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable pipeline to optimize these attacks for physical-world realizability by leveraging simulations of advanced perception sensor spoofing. Experiments on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks demonstrate that FADE is highly effective against state-of-the-art TBP trackers, causing significant identity switches and track terminations.
summary_zh: 最近的基于查询传播的跟踪方法（TBP）通过结合长时序建模的端到端流程，推动了多目标跟踪技术的发展。然而，这种对查询传播的依赖也给对抗攻击带来了尚未被探索的架构脆弱性。我们提出了一种名为FADE的新型攻击框架，专门针对这些特定漏洞进行攻击。FADE采用两种攻击策略，分别针对TBP的核心机制：一是时序查询泛洪攻击，即生成虚假的、时序一致的跟踪查询，以耗尽跟踪器有限的查询预算，迫使其终止有效跟踪轨迹；二是时序记忆破坏攻击，通过状态解相关切断时序链接，并消除匹配轨迹已学习到的特征身份，从而直接攻击查询更新器的记忆模块。此外，我们还提出了一种可微分的优化流程，通过模拟先进感知传感器欺骗技术，将这些攻击方法优化为物理世界可实现的攻击形式。在MOT17和MOT20基准测试上的实验表明，FADE对当前最先进的TBP跟踪器具有高效攻击效果，能够引发显著的身份切换和轨迹终止现象。
tldr: This paper presents FADE, an adversarial attack framework that exploits vulnerabilities in query propagation for multi-object tracking (MOT), causing identity switches and track terminations, and demonstrates its potential for physical-world realizability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FADE，一种针对基于查询传播的多目标跟踪方法（MOT）的对抗性攻击框架，通过破坏时间关联和消耗查询资源，导致身份切换和轨迹中断，并展示了其在物理世界实现的潜力。

title: VLM-in-the-Loop: A Plug-In Quality Assurance Module for ECG Digitization Pipelines
summary: ECG digitization could unlock billions of archived clinical records, yet existing methods collapse on real-world images despite strong benchmark numbers. We introduce \textbf{VLM-in-the-Loop}, a plug-in quality assurance module that wraps any digitization backend with closed-loop VLM feedback via a standardized interface, requiring no modification to the underlying digitizer. The core mechanism is \textbf{tool grounding}: anchoring VLM assessment in quantitative evidence from domain-specific signal analysis tools. In a controlled ablation on 200 records with paired ground truth, tool grounding raises verdict consistency from 71\% to 89\% and doubles fidelity separation ($Δ$PCC 0.03 $\rightarrow$ 0.08), with the effect replicating across three VLMs (Claude Opus~4, GPT-4o, Gemini~2.5 Pro), confirming a pattern-level rather than model-specific gain. Deployed across four backends, the module improves every one: 29.4\% of borderline leads improved on our pipeline; 41.2\% of failed limb leads recovered on ECG-Digitiser; valid leads per image doubled on Open-ECG-Digitizer (2.5 $\rightarrow$ 5.8). On 428 real clinical HCM images, the integrated system reaches 98.0\% Excellent quality. Both the plug-in architecture and tool-grounding mechanism are domain-parametric, suggesting broader applicability wherever quality criteria are objectively measurable.
summary_zh: 心电图的数字化处理有望解锁数十亿份存档临床记录，但现有方法在真实世界图像上的表现与基准测试结果存在显著差距。本文提出**VLM-in-the-Loop**系统，这是一种插件式质量保障模块，通过标准化接口为任何数字化后端系统提供闭环视觉语言模型反馈，无需修改底层数字化程序。其核心机制是**工具基础化**：通过领域专用信号分析工具提供的定量证据，为视觉语言模型评估建立事实依据。在包含200条配对真值数据的对照实验中，工具基础化将判定一致性从71%提升至89%，并使保真度分离指标翻倍（ΔPCC从0.03增至0.08），该效果在三个视觉语言模型（Claude Opus~4、GPT-4o、Gemini~2.5 Pro）中均得到复现，证实这是模式层面而非模型特定的增益。部署于四个后端系统时，该模块均带来性能提升：在自主流程中优化了29.4%的临界导联；在ECG-Digitiser中恢复了41.2%的失败肢体导联；在Open-ECG-Digitizer中每张图像的有效导联数量翻倍（从2.5增至5.8）。在428张真实临床肥厚型心肌病图像测试中，集成系统达到98.0%的优质率。该插件架构与工具基础化机制均具备领域参数化特性，表明其可广泛应用于任何具有客观质量评估标准的领域。
tldr: This paper proposes VLM-in-the-Loop, a plug-in module using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and tool grounding for quality assurance in ECG digitization pipelines, showing improved performance across multiple backends and datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 VLM-in-the-Loop，一个利用视觉语言模型和工具基础的插件模块，用于心电图数字化流程的质量保证，在多个后端和数据集上均表现出性能提升。

title: Camouflage-aware Image-Text Retrieval via Expert Collaboration
summary: Camouflaged scene understanding (CSU) has attracted significant attention due to its broad practical implications. However, in this field, robust image-text cross-modal alignment remains under-explored, hindering deeper understanding of camouflaged scenarios and their related applications. To this end, we focus on the typical image-text retrieval task, and formulate a new task dubbed ``camouflage-aware image-text retrieval'' (CA-ITR). We first construct a dedicated camouflage image-text retrieval dataset (CamoIT), comprising $\sim$10.5K samples with multi-granularity textual annotations. Benchmark results conducted on CamoIT reveal the underlying challenges of CA-ITR for existing cutting-edge retrieval techniques, which are mainly caused by objects' camouflage properties as well as those complex image contents. As a solution, we propose a camouflage-expert collaborative network (CECNet), which features a dual-branch visual encoder: one branch captures holistic image representations, while the other incorporates a dedicated model to inject representations of camouflaged objects. A novel confidence-conditioned graph attention (C\textsuperscript{2}GA) mechanism is incorporated to exploit the complementarity across branches. Comparative experiments show that CECNet achieves $\sim$29% overall CA-ITR accuracy boost, surpassing seven representative retrieval models. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/jiangyao-scu/CA-ITR.
summary_zh: 伪装场景理解因其广泛的实际应用价值而备受关注。然而，在该领域中，稳健的图像-文本跨模态对齐研究仍显不足，这制约了对伪装场景及其相关应用的深入理解。为此，我们聚焦于典型的图像-文本检索任务，提出了一项名为“伪装感知图像-文本检索”的新任务。我们首先构建了专用的伪装图像-文本检索数据集（CamoIT），该数据集包含约10.5K个样本，并配备多粒度文本标注。在CamoIT上的基准测试表明，现有前沿检索技术面对CA-ITR任务时存在根本性挑战，这主要源于目标的伪装特性及复杂的图像内容。作为解决方案，我们提出了一种伪装专家协同网络，其核心是采用双分支视觉编码器架构：一个分支捕获整体图像表征，另一个分支则引入专用模型以融入伪装目标的表征信息。我们还设计了一种新颖的置信度条件图注意力机制，以挖掘双分支间的互补特性。对比实验表明，CECNet实现了约29%的CA-ITR整体准确率提升，性能优于七种代表性检索模型。数据集与代码将在https://github.com/jiangyao-scu/CA-ITR公开。
tldr: Proposes a new camouflage-aware image-text retrieval task and dataset (CamoIT), with a dual-branch model (CECNet) incorporating a dedicated camouflage object encoder and a graph attention mechanism to improve cross-modal alignment in camouflaged scenes.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个新的伪装感知图像-文本检索任务和数据集（CamoIT），并设计了一个双分支模型（CECNet），该模型包含一个专门的伪装对象编码器和一个图注意力机制，以改善伪装场景下的跨模态对齐。

title: Neural Reconstruction of LiDAR Point Clouds under Jamming Attacks via Full-Waveform Representation and Simultaneous Laser Sensing
summary: LiDAR sensors are critical for autonomous driving perception, yet remain vulnerable to spoofing attacks. Jamming attacks inject high-frequency laser pulses that completely blind LiDAR sensors by overwhelming authentic returns with malicious signals. We discover that while point clouds become randomized, the underlying full-waveform data retains distinguishable signatures between attack and legitimate signals. In this work, we propose PULSAR-Net, capable of reconstructing authentic point clouds under jamming attacks by leveraging previously underutilized intermediate full-waveform representations and simultaneous laser sensing in modern LiDAR systems. PULSAR-Net adopts a novel U-Net architecture with axial spatial attention mechanisms specifically designed to identify attack-induced signals from authentic object returns in the full-waveform representation. To address the lack of full-waveform representations in existing LiDAR datasets under jamming attacks, we introduce a physics-aware dataset generation pipeline that synthesizes realistic full-waveform representations under jamming attacks. Despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, PULSAR-Net achieves reconstruction rates of 92% and 73% for vehicles obscured by jamming attacks in real-world static and driving scenarios, respectively.
summary_zh: 激光雷达（LiDAR）传感器是自动驾驶感知系统的关键组件，但易受到欺骗攻击。干扰攻击通过注入高频激光脉冲，利用恶意信号掩盖真实回波，使激光雷达传感器完全失效。研究发现，尽管点云数据因此变得随机化，但其底层全波形数据仍能保留攻击信号与真实信号之间的可区分特征。本文提出PULSAR-Net，通过利用现代激光雷达系统中先前未被充分利用的中间全波形表示与同步激光传感技术，实现在干扰攻击下重建真实点云。PULSAR-Net采用新型U-Net架构，结合轴向空间注意力机制，专门设计用于在全波形表示中识别攻击信号与真实目标回波。针对现有激光雷达数据集在干扰攻击下缺乏全波形表示的问题，我们引入物理感知的数据集生成流程，合成干扰攻击下逼真的全波形表示。尽管仅使用合成数据训练，PULSAR-Net在现实静态场景与动态驾驶场景中，对受干扰攻击遮蔽的车辆点云重建率分别达到92%和73%。
tldr: This paper introduces PULSAR-Net, a neural network that reconstructs authentic LiDAR point clouds under jamming attacks by analyzing full-waveform data. It focuses on securing autonomous driving perception against spoofing attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PULSAR-Net，一种通过分析全波形数据在干扰攻击下重建真实LiDAR点云的神经网络，专注于保护自动驾驶感知系统免受欺骗攻击。

title: Omni-MMSI: Toward Identity-attributed Social Interaction Understanding
summary: We introduce Omni-MMSI, a new task that requires comprehensive social interaction understanding from raw audio, vision, and speech input. The task involves perceiving identity-attributed social cues (e.g., who is speaking what) and reasoning about the social interaction (e.g., whom the speaker refers to). This task is essential for developing AI assistants that can perceive and respond to human interactions. Unlike prior studies that operate on oracle-preprocessed social cues, Omni-MMSI reflects realistic scenarios where AI assistants must perceive and reason from raw data. However, existing pipelines and multi-modal LLMs perform poorly on Omni-MMSI because they lack reliable identity attribution capabilities, which leads to inaccurate social interaction understanding. To address this challenge, we propose Omni-MMSI-R, a reference-guided pipeline that produces identity-attributed social cues with tools and conducts chain-of-thought social reasoning. To facilitate this pipeline, we construct participant-level reference pairs and curate reasoning annotations on top of the existing datasets. Experiments demonstrate that Omni-MMSI-R outperforms advanced LLMs and counterparts on Omni-MMSI. Project page: https://sampson-lee.github.io/omni-mmsi-project-page.
summary_zh: 我们提出Omni-MMSI任务，这是一项需要从原始音频、视觉及语音输入中全面理解社会交互的新任务。该任务涉及感知基于身份识别的社交线索（例如，谁在说什么）并推理社会交互行为（例如，说话者所指的对象）。这项任务对于开发能够感知并响应人类交互的AI助手至关重要。与以往依赖预处理的社交线索研究不同，Omni-MMSI反映了现实场景中AI助手必须从原始数据中感知与推理的挑战。然而，现有技术流程和多模态大语言模型在Omni-MMSI上表现不佳，因其缺乏可靠的身份识别能力，导致对社会交互的理解不准确。为解决这一难题，我们提出Omni-MMSI-R——一种基于参考引导的技术流程，通过工具生成具有身份识别特征的社交线索，并进行链式思维的社会推理。为支持该流程，我们在现有数据集基础上构建了参与者级别的参考对，并整理了相应的推理标注。实验表明，Omni-MMSI-R在Omni-MMSI任务上显著优于先进的大语言模型及其他同类方法。项目页面：https://sampson-lee.github.io/omni-mmsi-project-page。
tldr: The paper introduces a new multi-modal task and pipeline for understanding identity-attributed social interactions from raw audio, visual, and speech data, focusing on AI assistant perception and reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一项新的多模态任务和流程，用于从原始的音频、视觉和语音数据中理解身份归属的社交互动，侧重于AI助手的感知与推理能力。

title: Feature-level Site Leakage Reduction for Cross-Hospital Chest X-ray Transfer via Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Cross-hospital failure in chest X-ray models is often attributed to domain shift, yet most work assumes invariance without measuring it. This paper studies how to measure site leakage directly and how that measurement changes conclusions about transfer methods. We study multi-site self-supervised learning (SSL) and feature-level adversarial site confusion for cross-hospital transfer. We pretrain a ResNet-18 on NIH and CheXpert without pathology labels. We then freeze the encoder and train a linear pneumonia classifier on NIH only, evaluating transfer to RSNA. We quantify site leakage using a post hoc linear probe that predicts acquisition site from frozen backbone features $f$ and projection features $z$. Across 3 random seeds, multi-site SSL improves RSNA AUC from 0.6736 $\pm$ 0.0148 (ImageNet initialization) to 0.7804 $\pm$ 0.0197. Adding adversarial site confusion on $f$ reduces measured leakage but does not reliably improve AUC and increases variance. On $f$, site probe accuracy drops from 0.9890 $\pm$ 0.0021 (SSL-only) to 0.8504 $\pm$ 0.0051 (CanonicalF), where chance is 0.50. On $z$, probe accuracy drops from 0.8912 $\pm$ 0.0092 to 0.7810 $\pm$ 0.0250. These results show that measuring leakage changes how transfer methods should be interpreted: multi-site SSL drives transfer, while adversarial confusion exposes the limits of invariance assumptions.
summary_zh: 胸部X光模型的跨医院故障通常归因于域偏移，但大多数研究在未测量域偏移的情况下即假设其不变性。本文研究如何直接测量站点泄漏，以及该测量如何改变对迁移方法的结论。我们针对跨医院迁移研究了多站点自监督学习及特征级对抗性站点混淆方法。我们使用NIH和CheXpert数据集（无病理标签）对ResNet-18进行预训练，随后冻结编码器，仅在NIH数据上训练线性肺炎分类器，并在RSNA数据上评估迁移效果。通过事后线性探测法量化站点泄漏，该方法利用冻结骨干网络特征$f$和投影特征$z$预测采集站点。在3个随机种子实验中，多站点自监督学习将RSNA的AUC从0.6736 $\pm$ 0.0148（ImageNet初始化）提升至0.7804 $\pm$ 0.0197。在特征$f$上添加对抗性站点混淆虽降低了泄漏测量值，但未能稳定提升AUC，反而增加了方差。在特征$f$上，站点探测准确率从0.9890 $\pm$ 0.0021（仅自监督学习）降至0.8504 $\pm$ 0.0051（CanonicalF方法），随机基线为0.50；在特征$z$上，准确率从0.8912 $\pm$ 0.0092降至0.7810 $\pm$ 0.0250。这些结果表明，泄漏测量改变了迁移方法的解释逻辑：多站点自监督学习驱动了迁移性能，而对抗性混淆则揭示了不变性假设的局限性。
tldr: This paper investigates cross-hospital chest X-ray model transfer by measuring and reducing feature-level site leakage using self-supervised learning and adversarial training, finding that multi-site SSL improves transfer while adversarial methods reduce measurable leakage but not necessarily performance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究通过自我监督学习和对抗性训练，测量并减少跨医院胸片模型的特征级站点泄露，发现多站点SSL能提升转移性能，而对抗性方法可减少可测量的泄露但不一定提升性能。

title: PRISM: Differentiable Analysis-by-Synthesis for Fixel Recovery in Diffusion MRI
summary: Diffusion MRI microstructure fitting is nonconvex and often performed voxelwise, which limits fiber peak recovery in narrow crossings. This work introduces PRISM, a differentiable analysis-by-synthesis framework that fits an explicit multi-compartment forward model end-to-end over spatial patches. The model combines cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), gray matter, up to K white-matter fiber compartments (stick-and-zeppelin), and a restricted compartment, with explicit fiber directions and soft model selection via repulsion and sparsity priors. PRISM supports a fast MSE objective and a Rician negative log-likelihood (NLL) that jointly learns sigma without oracle information. A lightweight nuisance calibration module (smooth bias field and per-measurement scale/offset) is included for robustness and regularized to identity in clean-data tests. On synthetic crossing-fiber data (SNR=30; five methods, 16 crossing angles), PRISM achieves 3.5 degrees best-match angular error with 95% recall, which is 1.9x lower than the best baseline (MSMT-CSD, 6.8 degrees, 83% recall); in NLL mode with learned sigma, error drops to 2.3 degrees with 99% recall, resolving crossings down to 20 degrees. On the DiSCo1 phantom (NLL mode), PRISM improves connectivity correlation over CSD baselines at all four tracking angles (best r=.934 at 25 degrees vs. .920 for MSMT-CSD). Whole-brain HCP fitting (~741k voxels, MSE mode) completes in ~12 min on a single GPU with near-identical results across random seeds.
summary_zh: 扩散磁共振成像（dMRI）的微结构拟合通常是非凸的，且多以体素为单位进行，这限制了其在狭窄交叉区域中的纤维峰恢复能力。本文提出PRISM，一种可微分的分析-合成框架，通过空间块对显式的多室前向模型进行端到端拟合。该模型整合了脑脊液（CSF）、灰质、最多K个白质纤维室（stick-and-zeppelin）以及一个受限室，具备明确的纤维方向，并通过排斥性和稀疏性先验实现软模型选择。PRISM支持快速均方误差（MSE）目标函数，以及一种无需先验信息即可联合学习sigma的莱斯负对数似然（NLL）函数。为提高鲁棒性，模型包含一个轻量级的干扰校准模块（平滑偏置场及每次测量的尺度/偏移），并在清洁数据测试中正则化为恒等变换。在合成交叉纤维数据（信噪比=30；五种方法，16个交叉角度）上，PRISM实现了3.5度的最佳匹配角误差和95%的召回率，比最佳基线方法（MSMT-CSD，误差6.8度，召回率83%）降低1.9倍；在NLL模式下通过学习sigma，误差降至2.3度且召回率达99%，能解析低至20度的交叉角度。在DiSCo1体模（NLL模式）中，PRISM在所有四个追踪角度上均优于CSD基线方法，连接相关性得到提升（最佳结果在25度时r=0.934，而MSMT-CSD为0.920）。在全脑HCP拟合（约74.1万个体素，MSE模式）中，使用单GPU仅需约12分钟完成，且不同随机种子的结果近乎一致。
tldr: A novel differentiable analysis-by-synthesis framework for recovering fiber directions in diffusion MRI, improving angular accuracy and connectivity correlation in crossing-fiber scenarios.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的可微分分析合成框架，用于在扩散 MRI 中恢复纤维方向，在交叉纤维场景中提高了角度精度和连接相关性。

title: Pupil Design for Computational Wavefront Estimation
summary: Establishing a precise connection between imaged intensity and the incident wavefront is essential for emerging applications in adaptive optics, holography, computational microscopy, and non-line-of-sight imaging.
