由于获得了优于$n^{-1/d}$的逐点估计精度，我们证明了重构度量测度空间与真实潜在流形之间的格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离量级为$n^{-1/d}$。该结果与经验测度的瓦瑟斯坦收敛速率相匹配，表明我们重构的图度量渐近等价于掌握了采样点间完整的成对距离矩阵。我们的证明建立在一个非常普适的框架中，涵盖含噪成对距离的一般模型、稀疏随机几何图以及未知连接概率函数等多种情形。
tldr: The paper introduces a new method called ORDER for reconstructing a Riemannian manifold from noisy distance data, achieving theoretical precision that surpasses the previously fundamental volumetric barrier for dimensions d>5, which improves the convergence rate of the reconstructed metric measure space.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为ORDER的新方法，用于从有噪距离数据中重建黎曼流形，其理论精度超过了之前基本容积障碍的限制（对于维度d>5），从而改善了重建度量测度空间的收敛速度。

title: MambaVoiceCloning: Efficient and Expressive Text-to-Speech via State-Space Modeling and Diffusion Control
summary: MambaVoiceCloning (MVC) asks whether the conditioning path of diffusion-based TTS can be made fully SSM-only at inference, removing all attention and explicit RNN-style recurrence layers across text, rhythm, and prosody, while preserving or improving quality under controlled conditions. MVC combines a gated bidirectional Mamba text encoder, a Temporal Bi-Mamba supervised by a lightweight alignment teacher discarded after training, and an Expressive Mamba with AdaLN modulation, yielding linear-time O(T) conditioning with bounded activation memory and practical finite look-ahead streaming. Unlike prior Mamba-TTS systems that remain hybrid at inference, MVC removes attention-based duration and style modules under a fixed StyleTTS2 mel-diffusion-vocoder backbone. Trained on LJSpeech/LibriTTS and evaluated on VCTK, CSS10 (ES/DE/FR), and long-form Gutenberg passages, MVC achieves modest but statistically reliable gains over StyleTTS2, VITS, and Mamba-attention hybrids in MOS/CMOS, F0 RMSE, MCD, and WER, while reducing encoder parameters to 21M and improving throughput by 1.6x. Diffusion remains the dominant latency source, but SSM-only conditioning improves memory footprint, stability, and deployability.
summary_zh:
摘要：
MambaVoiceCloning (MVC) 探究了基于扩散的文本转语音系统中，条件路径在推理时能否完全仅由状态空间模型构成，即在文本、节奏和韵律处理中去除所有注意力机制和显式的RNN式循环层，同时在受控条件下保持或提升语音质量。MVC融合了门控双向Mamba文本编码器、一个由轻量对齐教师在训练后丢弃所监督的时序双向Mamba模块，以及采用AdaLN调制的表达性Mamba模块，实现了线性时间复杂度O(T)的条件处理，具有有限激活内存占用和实用的有限前瞻流式能力。与此前推理阶段仍保持混合架构的Mamba-TTS系统不同，MVC在固定StyleTTS2梅尔谱扩散声码器主干框架下，移除了基于注意力的时长与风格模块。通过在LJSpeech/LibriTTS数据集上训练，并在VCTK、CSS10（西班牙语/德语/法语）及长篇Gutenberg段落上进行评估，MVC在MOS/CMOS、基频均方根误差、梅尔倒谱失真和词错误率等指标上，相比StyleTTS2、VITS及Mamba-注意力混合系统取得了有限但统计显著的提升，同时将编码器参数量降至2100万，吞吐量提升1.6倍。扩散过程仍是延迟的主要来源，但纯SSM条件路径显著改善了内存占用、系统稳定性和部署可行性。
tldr: The paper proposes a text-to-speech model using state-space models and diffusion control, aiming for efficient and expressive speech synthesis, but it is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用状态空间模型和扩散控制的文本转语音模型，旨在实现高效和富有表现力的语音合成，但与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。

title: Autonomous Adaptive Solver Selection for Chemistry Integration via Reinforcement Learning
summary: The computational cost of stiff chemical kinetics remains a dominant bottleneck in reacting-flow simulation, yet hybrid integration strategies are typically driven by hand-tuned heuristics or supervised predictors that make myopic decisions from instantaneous local state. We introduce a constrained reinforcement learning (RL) framework that autonomously selects between an implicit BDF integrator (CVODE) and a quasi-steady-state (QSS) solver during chemistry integration. Solver selection is cast as a Markov decision process. The agent learns trajectory-aware policies that account for how present solver choices influence downstream error accumulation, while minimizing computational cost under a user-prescribed accuracy tolerance enforced through a Lagrangian reward with online multiplier adaptation. Across sampled 0D homogeneous reactor conditions, the RL-adaptive policy achieves a mean speedup of approximately $3\times$, with speedups ranging from $1.11\times$ to $10.58\times$, while maintaining accurate ignition delays and species profiles for a 106-species \textit{n}-dodecane mechanism and adding approximately $1\%$ inference overhead. Without retraining, the 0D-trained policy transfers to 1D counterflow diffusion flames over strain rates $10$--$2000~\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, delivering consistent $\approx 2.2\times$ speedup relative to CVODE while preserving near-reference temperature accuracy and selecting CVODE at only $12$--$15\%$ of space-time points. Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of the proposed reinforcement learning framework to learn problem-specific integration strategies while respecting accuracy constraints, thereby opening a pathway toward adaptive, self-optimizing workflows for multiphysics systems with spatially heterogeneous stiffness.
summary_zh: 刚性化学动力学的计算成本始终是反应流模拟中的主要瓶颈，而传统混合积分策略通常依赖于手动调优的启发式方法或仅根据瞬时局部状态进行短视决策的监督预测器。本文提出了一种约束强化学习框架，能够在化学积分过程中自主选择隐式BDF积分器（CVODE）与准稳态求解器。该框架将求解器选择问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程：智能体学习考虑当前求解器选择对下游误差累积影响的轨迹感知策略，同时通过在线乘子自适应拉格朗日奖励机制，在用户指定的精度容差下最小化计算成本。在零维均质反应器的采样工况中，强化学习自适应策略实现了约$3\times$的平均加速比（加速范围$1.11\times$至$10.58\times$），并准确保持了106组分正十二烷机理的点火延迟与组分分布，仅增加约$1\%$的推理开销。未经重新训练，该零维训练策略可迁移至应变率$10$--$2000~\mathrm{s}^{-1}$的一维对冲扩散火焰，在保持接近参考温度精度的前提下，实现相对CVODE稳定约$2.2\times$的加速效果，且仅在$12$--$15\%$的时空点选择CVODE求解器。整体研究表明，所提出的强化学习框架能够学习满足精度约束的特定问题积分策略，为具有空间异构刚度的多物理场系统开辟了自适应、自优化工作流程的新路径。
tldr: A reinforcement learning framework is developed to autonomously select between numerical solvers for stiff chemical kinetics, achieving speedups while maintaining accuracy, and demonstrating transfer from 0D to 1D reactor simulations.
tldr_zh: 本研究开发了一个强化学习框架，用于在化学动力学刚性数值积分中自主选择求解器，在保持精度的同时实现了计算加速，并在0D到1D反应器模拟中展示了方法的迁移能力。

title: Learning to Shuffle: Block Reshuffling and Reversal Schemes for Stochastic Optimization
summary: Shuffling strategies for stochastic gradient descent (SGD), including incremental gradient, shuffle-once, and random reshuffling, are supported by rigorous convergence analyses for arbitrary within-epoch permutations. In particular, random reshuffling is known to improve optimization constants relative to cyclic and shuffle-once schemes. However, existing theory offers limited guidance on how to design new data-ordering schemes that further improve optimization constants or stability beyond random reshuffling. In this paper, we design a pipeline using a large language model (LLM)-guided program evolution framework to discover an effective shuffling rule for without-replacement SGD. Abstracting from this instance, we identify two fundamental structural components: block reshuffling and paired reversal. We analyze these components separately and show that block reshuffling strictly reduces prefix-gradient variance constants within the unified shuffling framework, yielding provable improvements over random reshuffling under mild conditions. Separately, we show that paired reversal symmetrizes the epoch map and cancels the leading order-dependent second-order term, reducing order sensitivity from quadratic to cubic in the step size. Numerical experiments with the discovered algorithm validate the theory and demonstrate consistent gains over standard shuffling schemes across convex and nonconvex benchmarks.
summary_zh: 随机梯度下降（SGD）的洗牌策略（包括增量梯度法、单次洗牌和随机重洗牌）已通过任意周期内置换的严格收敛性分析得到理论支持。特别地，随机重洗牌相比循环洗牌和单次洗牌策略具有更好的优化常数。然而，现有理论对于如何设计能进一步提升优化常数或稳定性的新数据排序方案缺乏有效指导。本文设计了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序进化框架的流程，以发现无放回SGD的高效洗牌规则。通过该实例的抽象，我们识别出两个基本结构组件：块重洗牌与配对反转。我们分别对这两个组件进行分析，证明在统一的洗牌框架下，块重洗牌能严格降低前缀梯度方差常数，从而在温和条件下实现相较于随机重洗牌的可证明改进。同时，我们证明配对反转能使周期映射对称化，并抵消主导的序相关二阶项，将阶数敏感性从步长的二次方降低至三次方。采用所发现算法进行的数值实验验证了理论结果，并在凸与非凸基准测试中均展现出相较于标准洗牌方案的稳定优势。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to discover improved data shuffling schemes for SGD using an LLM-guided program evolution framework, analyzing structural components like block reshuffling and paired reversal for provable optimization improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用LLM引导的程序进化框架来发现改进的SGD数据洗牌方案的方法，分析了块重排和配对反转等结构组件，以证明其优化改进效果。

title: Hierarchical Discrete Flow Matching for Graph Generation
summary: Denoising-based models, including diffusion and flow matching, have led to substantial advances in graph generation. Despite this progress, such models remain constrained by two fundamental limitations: a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of nodes and a large number of function evaluations required during generation. In this work, we introduce a novel hierarchical generative framework that reduces the number of node pairs that must be evaluated and adopts discrete flow matching to significantly decrease the number of denoising iterations. We empirically demonstrate that our approach more effectively captures graph distributions while substantially reducing generation time.
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于去噪的模型，包括扩散模型和流匹配模型，在图生成领域取得了显著进展。尽管取得了这些进展，此类模型仍受限于两个基本约束：计算成本随节点数量呈二次方增长，且生成过程中需要大量函数评估。本研究提出了一种新颖的分层生成框架，该框架通过减少必须评估的节点对数量，并采用离散流匹配方法显著降低去噪迭代次数。实验证明，我们的方法在更有效地捕捉图分布的同时，大幅减少了生成时间。
tldr: A hierarchical generative framework for graph generation using discrete flow matching, aiming to reduce computational cost and number of denoising steps.
tldr_zh: 一种用于图生成的分层生成框架，采用离散流匹配，旨在降低计算成本和去噪步数。

title: Risk-Aware Batch Testing for Performance Regression Detection
summary:
Performance regression testing is essential in large-scale continuous-integration (CI) systems, yet executing full performance suites for every commit is prohibitively expensive. Prior work on performance regression prediction and batch testing has shown independent benefits, but each faces practical limitations: predictive models are rarely integrated into CI decision-making, and conventional batching strategies ignore commit-level heterogeneity.
  We unify these strands by introducing a risk-aware framework that integrates machine-learned commit risk with adaptive batching. Using Mozilla Firefox as a case study, we construct a production-derived dataset of human-confirmed regressions aligned chronologically with Autoland, and fine-tune ModernBERT, CodeBERT, and LLaMA-3.1 variants to estimate commit-level performance regression risk, achieving up to 0.694 ROC-AUC with CodeBERT. The risk scores drive a family of risk-aware batching strategies, including Risk-Aged Priority Batching and Risk-Adaptive Stream Batching, evaluated through realistic CI simulations.
  Across thousands of historical Firefox commits, our best overall configuration, Risk-Aged Priority Batching with linear aggregation (RAPB-la), yields a Pareto improvement over Mozilla's production-inspired baseline. RAPB-la reduces total test executions by 32.4%, decreases mean feedback time by 3.8%, maintains mean time-to-culprit at approximately the baseline level, reduces maximum time-to-culprit by 26.2%, and corresponds to an estimated annual infrastructure cost savings of approximately $491K under our cost model. These results demonstrate that risk-aware batch testing can reduce CI resource consumption while improving diagnostic timeliness. To support reproducibility and future research, we release a complete replication package containing all datasets, fine-tuning pipelines, and implementations of our batching algorithms.
summary_zh:
性能回归测试在大规模持续集成（CI）系统中至关重要，但为每次提交执行完整的性能测试套件成本高昂且难以实现。先前关于性能回归预测和批量测试的研究虽已显示出各自优势，但均存在实际局限：预测模型很少被整合到CI决策流程中，而传统的批量策略则忽略了提交层面的异构性。

本研究通过引入一个风险感知框架将这两条路径相统一，该框架将机器学习得出的提交风险与自适应批量处理相结合。以Mozilla Firefox为案例，我们构建了一个基于实际生产数据、与Autoland时间线对齐且经人工确认的回归数据集，并对ModernBERT、CodeBERT及LLaMA-3.1的变体模型进行微调以评估提交级别的性能回归风险，其中CodeBERT模型的ROC-AUC最高达到0.694。这些风险评分驱动了一系列风险感知批量策略，包括风险时效优先级批处理和风险自适应流批处理，并通过真实的CI仿真进行评估。

在对数千个历史Firefox提交的实验中，我们最优的整体配置——采用线性聚合的风险时效优先级批处理（RAPB-la）——相比Mozilla基于生产环境的基线实现了帕累托改进。RAPB-la将总测试执行次数减少32.4%，平均反馈时间缩短3.8%，在保持平均归因时间与基线水平相当的同时，将最大归因时间降低26.2%，根据我们的成本模型估算，每年可节约约49.1万美元的基础设施成本。这些结果表明，风险感知批量测试能够在降低CI资源消耗的同时提升诊断时效性。为支持研究复现与未来工作，我们开源了完整的复现资源包，包含所有数据集、微调流水线及批量算法的实现代码。
tldr: This paper introduces a risk-aware batch testing framework for software CI systems, using ML models to predict performance regression risk from code commits and then applying adaptive batching strategies to reduce testing resources while improving diagnostic speed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于软件持续集成系统的风险感知批量测试框架，利用机器学习模型从代码提交中预测性能回归风险，并应用自适应批处理策略以减少测试资源并提高诊断速度。

title: Measuring the Representational Alignment of Neural Systems in Superposition
summary: Comparing the internal representations of neural networks is a central goal in both neuroscience and machine learning. Standard alignment metrics operate on raw neural activations, implicitly assuming that similar representations produce similar activity patterns. However, neural systems frequently operate in superposition, encoding more features than they have neurons via linear compression. We derive closed-form expressions showing that superposition systematically deflates Representational Similarity Analysis, Centered Kernel Alignment, and linear regression, causing networks with identical feature content to appear dissimilar. The root cause is that these metrics are dependent on cross-similarity between two systems' respective superposition matrices, which under assumption of random projection usually differ significantly, not on the latent features themselves: alignment scores conflate what a system represents with how it represents it. Under partial feature overlap, this confound can invert the expected ordering, making systems sharing fewer features appear more aligned than systems sharing more. Crucially, the apparent misalignment need not reflect a loss of information; compressed sensing guarantees that the original features remain recoverable from the lower-dimensional activity, provided they are sparse. We therefore argue that comparing neural systems in superposition requires extracting and aligning the underlying features rather than comparing the raw neural mixtures.
summary_zh: 比较神经网络的内部表征是神经科学和机器学习领域的核心目标。标准对齐指标基于原始神经活动进行分析，其隐含假设是相似表征会产生相似的活动模式。然而，神经系统常在叠加状态下运行，通过线性压缩编码比神经元数量更多的特征。我们推导出闭式表达式，证明叠加会系统性地降低表征相似性分析、中心核对齐和线性回归等方法的有效性，导致具有相同特征内容的网络显得不相似。根本原因在于这些指标依赖于两个系统各自叠加矩阵之间的交叉相似性——在随机投影假设下这些矩阵通常存在显著差异，而非基于潜在特征本身：对齐分数混淆了系统"表征什么"与"如何表征"这两个维度。在特征部分重叠的情况下，这种混淆甚至可能颠倒预期顺序，使共享特征较少的系统显得比共享特征更多的系统更相似。关键的是，这种表面对齐偏差并不必然反映信息损失；压缩感知理论保证，只要原始特征具有稀疏性，仍可从低维活动中恢复出原有特征。因此我们认为，比较叠加状态下的神经系统需要提取并对其底层特征进行对齐，而非直接比较原始的神经混合信号。
tldr: This paper introduces a methodological critique of standard neural representation alignment metrics, showing they are confounded by the presence of superposition (compressed feature representation) in neural systems, and argues for comparing latent features instead of raw activity.
tldr_zh: 本文批判了标准的神经表征对齐度量方法，指出当神经系统中存在叠加（压缩特征表示）现象时，这些度量会产生混淆，并主张比较底层特征而非原始神经活动。

title: Lead Zirconate Titanate Reservoir Computing for Classification of Written and Spoken Digits
summary: In this paper we extend our earlier work of (Rietman et al. 2022) presenting an application of physical Reservoir Computing (RC) to the classification of handwritten and spoken digits. We utilize an unpoled cube of Lead Zirconate Titanate (PZT) as a computational substrate to process these datasets. Our results demonstrate that the PZT reservoir achieves 89.0% accuracy on MNIST handwritten digits, representing a 2.4 percentage point improvement over logistic regression baselines applied to the same preprocessed data. However, for the AudioMNIST spoken digits dataset, the reservoir system (88.2% accuracy) performs equivalently to baseline methods (88.1% accuracy), suggesting that reservoir computing provides the greatest benefits for classification tasks of intermediate difficulty where linear methods underperform but the problem remains learnable. PZT is a well-known material already used in semiconductor applications, presenting a low-power computational substrate that can be integrated with digital algorithms. Our findings indicate that physical reservoirs excel when the task difficulty exceeds the capability of simple linear classifiers but remains within the computational capacity of the reservoir dynamics.
summary_zh: 本文在 (Rietman et al. 2022) 先前工作的基础上，进一步研究了物理储层计算在手写数字和语音数字分类任务中的应用。我们采用未经极化处理的锆钛酸铅立方体作为计算基底来处理这些数据集。实验结果表明，在MNIST手写数字数据集上，该PZT储层系统实现了89.0%的分类准确率，相较于相同预处理数据上的逻辑回归基线提升了2.4个百分点。然而，在AudioMNIST语音数字数据集上，储层系统（88.2%准确率）与基线方法（88.1%准确率）表现相当，这表明储层计算在中等难度分类任务中效益最为显著——这类任务中线性方法表现欠佳，但问题本身仍具备可学习性。PZT作为已在半导体领域广泛应用的材料，其低功耗特性使其可作为计算基底与数字算法实现集成。我们的研究结果表明，当任务难度超出简单线性分类器的能力范围，但仍在储层动力学计算能力之内时，物理储层系统将展现出显著优势。
tldr: The paper applies physical reservoir computing using Lead Zirconate Titanate for classifying handwritten (MNIST) and spoken (AudioMNIST) digits, showing benefits for tasks of intermediate complexity.
tldr_zh: 该论文利用钛酸锆铅材料进行物理储备池计算，用于手写和语音数字识别，展示了其对中等复杂度任务的适用性。

title: Lévy-Flow Models: Heavy-Tail-Aware Normalizing Flows for Financial Risk Management
summary: We introduce Lévy-Flows, a class of normalizing flow models that replace the standard Gaussian base distribution with Lévy process-based distributions, specifically Variance Gamma (VG) and Normal-Inverse Gaussian (NIG). These distributions naturally capture heavy-tailed behavior while preserving exact likelihood evaluation and efficient reparameterized sampling. We establish theoretical guarantees on tail behavior, showing that for regularly varying bases the tail index is preserved under asymptotically linear flow transformations, and that identity-tail Neural Spline Flow architectures preserve the base distribution's tail shape exactly outside the transformation region. Empirically, we evaluate on S&P 500 daily returns and additional assets, demonstrating substantial improvements in density estimation and risk calibration. VG-based flows reduce test negative log-likelihood by 69% relative to Gaussian flows and achieve exact 95% VaR calibration, while NIG-based flows provide the most accurate Expected Shortfall estimates. These results show that incorporating Lévy process structure into normalizing flows yields significant gains in modeling heavy-tailed data, with applications to financial risk management.
summary_zh: 本文介绍Lévy流，这是一类将标准高斯基分布替换为基于莱维过程的分布（具体为方差伽马VG与正态逆高斯NIG）的正则化流模型。这些分布能自然捕捉重尾特征，同时保持精确似然评估与高效重参数化采样能力。我们从理论上证明了尾部行为的性质：对于正则变化基分布，尾部指数在渐近线性流变换下保持不变；对于恒等尾神经样条流架构，在变换区域外能精确保持基分布的尾部形态。在实证研究中，我们基于标普500日收益率及其他资产数据评估模型，发现其在密度估计与风险校准方面有显著提升。基于VG的流模型相比高斯流将测试负对数似然降低69%，并实现精确的95%在险价值校准；基于NIG的流模型则能提供最准确的期望损失估计。这些结果表明，将莱维过程结构融入正则化流可显著提升对重尾数据的建模能力，在金融风险管理中具有应用价值。
tldr: Proposes Lévy-Flow models, a new class of normalizing flows using heavy-tailed Lévy process base distributions (VG, NIG) for improved density estimation and risk calibration in financial data.
tldr_zh: 提出 Lévy-Flow 模型，一种使用重尾 Lévy 过程基础分布（VG, NIG）的新标准化流，用于金融数据中改进的密度估计和风险校准。

title: Predicting Wave Reflection and Transmission in Heterogeneous Media via Fourier Operator-Based Transformer Modeling
summary: We develop a machine learning (ML) surrogate model to approximate solutions to Maxwell's equations in one dimension, focusing on scenarios involving a material interface that reflects and transmits electro-magnetic waves. Derived from high-fidelity Finite Volume (FV) simulations, our training data includes variations of the initial conditions, as well as variations in one material's speed of light, allowing for the model to learn a range of wave-material interaction behaviors. The ML model autoregressively learns both the physical and frequency embeddings in a vision transformer-based framework. By incorporating Fourier transforms in the latent space, the wave number spectra of the solutions aligns closely with the simulation data. Prediction errors exhibit an approximately linear growth over time with a sharp increase at the material interface. Test results show that the ML solution has adequate relative errors below $10\%$ in over $75$ time step rollouts, despite the presence of the discontinuity and unknown material properties.
summary_zh: 我们开发了一种机器学习（ML）代理模型，用于近似一维麦克斯韦方程组的解，重点关注涉及反射和透射电磁波的材料界面场景。基于高保真有限体积（FV）模拟生成的训练数据，包含了初始条件的变化以及材料中光速的变化，使模型能够学习一系列波与材料相互作用的动态行为。该机器学习模型在基于视觉Transformer的框架中自回归地学习物理嵌入和频率嵌入。通过在潜在空间中引入傅里叶变换，所得解的波数谱与模拟数据高度吻合。预测误差随时间呈近似线性增长，并在材料界面处出现急剧上升。测试结果表明，即使存在非连续性和未知材料特性，该机器学习模型在超过75个时间步的推演中仍能保持低于$10\%$的相对误差。
tldr: This paper presents a Fourier operator-based transformer model for predicting wave reflection and transmission in heterogeneous media, trained on 1D Maxwell's equations simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于傅里叶算子的Transformer模型，用于预测异质介质中的波反射与透射，该模型基于一维麦克斯韦方程组的模拟数据进行训练。

title: Efficient Software Vulnerability Detection Using Transformer-based Models
summary: Detecting software vulnerabilities is critical to ensuring the security and reliability of modern computer systems. Deep neural networks have shown promising results on vulnerability detection, but they lack the capability to capture global contextual information on vulnerable code. To address this limitation, we explore the application of transformers for C/C++ vulnerability detection. We use program slices that encapsulate key syntactic and semantic features of program code, such as API function calls, array usage, pointer manipulations, and arithmetic expressions. By leveraging transformers' capability to capture both local and global contextual information on vulnerable code, our work can identify vulnerabilities accurately. Combined with data balancing and hyperparameter fine-tuning, our work offers a robust and efficient approach to identifying vulnerable code with moderate resource usage and training time.
summary_zh: 软件漏洞检测对于保障现代计算机系统的安全性和可靠性至关重要。深度学习模型在漏洞检测方面已展现出良好效果，但其在捕获漏洞代码的全局上下文信息方面仍存在不足。为突破这一局限，本研究探索将Transformer模型应用于C/C++程序漏洞检测。我们采用包含程序代码关键语法与语义特征的程序切片作为输入数据，这些特征涵盖API函数调用、数组使用、指针操作及算术表达式等。通过发挥Transformer模型同时捕获漏洞代码局部与全局上下文信息的能力，我们的方法能够实现精准的漏洞识别。结合数据平衡策略与超参数优化技术，本研究在适度资源消耗与训练时间的条件下，提供了一种鲁棒且高效的漏洞代码检测方案。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for software vulnerability detection in C/C++ code using transformers to capture global contextual information from program slices, aiming to improve accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用Transformer模型检测C/C++代码漏洞的方法，通过程序切片捕获全局上下文信息，旨在提高准确性和效率。

title: Speeding Up Mixed-Integer Programming Solvers with Sparse Learning for Branching
summary: Machine learning is increasingly used to improve decisions within branch-and-bound algorithms for mixed-integer programming. Many existing approaches rely on deep learning, which often requires very large training datasets and substantial computational resources for both training and deployment, typically with GPU parallelization. In this work, we take a different path by developing interpretable models that are simple but effective. We focus on approximating strong branching (SB) scores, a highly effective yet computationally expensive branching rule. Using sparse learning methods, we build models with fewer than 4% of the parameters of a state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN) while achieving competitive accuracy. Relative to SCIP's built-in branching rules and the GNN-based model, our CPU-only models are faster than the default solver and the GPU-accelerated GNN. The models are simple to train and deploy, and they remain effective with small training sets, which makes them practical in low-resource settings. Extensive experiments across diverse problem classes demonstrate the efficiency of this approach.
summary_zh: 机器学习正越来越多地被应用于改进混合整数规划中分支定界算法的决策过程。现有方法大多依赖深度学习，这通常需要大量训练数据集和显著的计算资源，包括训练和部署阶段，并通常依赖于GPU并行化。本研究另辟蹊径，开发了简洁而高效的可解释模型。我们重点关注近似强分支（SB）分数的计算，这是一种高效但计算成本高昂的分支规则。通过稀疏学习方法，我们构建的模型参数少于当前最先进图神经网络（GNN）的4%，同时保持了相近的准确性。相较于SCIP内置的分支规则以及基于GNN的模型，我们仅使用CPU的模型在求解速度上不仅超越了默认求解器，也超越了GPU加速的GNN。这些模型训练和部署简单，在小型训练集上依然有效，使其在资源有限的环境中具有实用价值。通过跨多个问题类别的广泛实验，验证了该方法的效率。
tldr: This paper proposes a sparse learning approach to approximate strong branching scores for mixed-integer programming solvers, achieving competitive accuracy with far fewer parameters and faster CPU-only inference than GPU-accelerated GNN baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种稀疏学习方法来近似混合整数规划求解器中的强分支评分，使用比图神经网络基线少得多的参数，并在仅CPU推理上实现了更快的速度，同时保持竞争力的准确性。

title: Cross-Modal Visuo-Tactile Object Perception
summary: Estimating physical properties is critical for safe and efficient autonomous robotic manipulation, particularly during contact-rich interactions. In such settings, vision and tactile sensing provide complementary information about object geometry, pose, inertia, stiffness, and contact dynamics, such as stick-slip behavior. However, these properties are only indirectly observable and cannot always be modeled precisely (e.g., deformation in non-rigid objects coupled with nonlinear contact friction), making the estimation problem inherently complex and requiring sustained exploitation of visuo-tactile sensory information during action. Existing visuo-tactile perception frameworks have primarily emphasized forceful sensor fusion or static cross-modal alignment, with limited consideration of how uncertainty and beliefs about object properties evolve over time. Inspired by human multi-sensory perception and active inference, we propose the Cross-Modal Latent Filter (CMLF) to learn a structured, causal latent state-space of physical object properties. CMLF supports bidirectional transfer of cross-modal priors between vision and touch and integrates sensory evidence through a Bayesian inference process that evolves over time. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that CMLF improves the efficiency and robustness of latent physical properties estimation under uncertainty compared to baseline approaches. Beyond performance gains, the model exhibits perceptual coupling phenomena analogous to those observed in humans, including susceptibility to cross-modal illusions and similar trajectories in learning cross-sensory associations. Together, these results constitutes a significant step toward generalizable, robust and physically consistent cross-modal integration for robotic multi-sensory perception.
summary_zh: 在安全高效的自主机器人操作中，物体物理属性的估计至关重要，尤其在接触密集的交互场景中。在此类情境下，视觉与触觉感知能够提供关于物体几何形态、位姿、惯性、刚度以及接触动力学（如粘滑行为）的互补信息。然而，这些属性仅能被间接观测，且难以始终精确建模（例如非刚性物体的形变与非线性接触摩擦的耦合效应），使得估计问题本质上极为复杂，需要在动作执行过程中持续利用视触觉传感信息。现有的视触觉感知框架主要侧重于强制的传感器融合或静态跨模态对齐，较少考虑物体属性相关的不确定性和认知如何随时间演化。受人类多感官感知与主动推理机制的启发，我们提出跨模态潜在滤波器（CMLF），用于学习物理物体属性的结构化因果潜在状态空间。CMLF支持视觉与触觉间跨模态先验知识的双向迁移，并通过随时间演化的贝叶斯推理过程整合感官证据。实际机器人实验表明，与基线方法相比，CMLF在不确定条件下显著提升了潜在物理属性估计的效率和鲁棒性。除性能提升外，该模型展现出与人类感知类似的跨模态耦合现象，包括对跨模态错觉的敏感性以及学习跨感官关联的相似轨迹。这些成果共同为推动机器人多感官感知实现通用、鲁棒且物理一致的跨模态融合迈出了重要一步。
tldr: The paper proposes a Cross-Modal Latent Filter (CMLF) for robots to estimate physical object properties like geometry and stiffness by integrating vision and touch through Bayesian inference, improving estimation robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于机器人的跨模态潜在滤波器（CMLF），通过贝叶斯推理整合视觉和触觉，以估计物体的几何、刚度等物理属性，提高了估计的鲁棒性。

title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
summary: General-purpose world models promise scalable policy evaluation, optimization, and planning, yet achieving the required level of robustness remains challenging. Unlike policy learning, which primarily focuses on optimal actions, a world model must be reliable over a much broader range of suboptimal actions, which are often insufficiently covered by action-labeled interaction data. To address this challenge, we propose World Action Verifier (WAV), a framework that enables world models to identify their own prediction errors and self-improve. The key idea is to decompose action-conditioned state prediction into two factors -- state plausibility and action reachability -- and verify each separately. We show that these verification problems can be substantially easier than predicting future states due to two underlying asymmetries: the broader availability of action-free data and the lower dimensionality of action-relevant features. Leveraging these asymmetries, we augment a world model with (i) a diverse subgoal generator obtained from video corpora and (ii) a sparse inverse model that infers actions from a subset of state features. By enforcing cycle consistency among generated subgoals, inferred actions, and forward rollouts, WAV provides an effective verification mechanism in under-explored regimes, where existing methods typically fail. Across nine tasks spanning MiniGrid, RoboMimic, and ManiSkill, our method achieves 2x higher sample efficiency while improving downstream policy performance by 18%.
summary_zh: 通用世界模型能够实现可扩展的策略评估、优化与规划，然而要达到所需的鲁棒性水平仍面临挑战。与策略学习主要关注最优动作不同，世界模型必须在更广泛的次优动作范围内保持可靠性，而现有带动作标签的交互数据往往未能充分覆盖这些动作。为应对这一挑战，我们提出世界行动验证器（WAV）框架，使世界模型能够识别自身预测错误并实现自我改进。其核心思想是将动作条件状态预测分解为两个因素——状态合理性与动作可达性——并分别进行验证。研究表明，由于两类内在不对称性（无动作数据的广泛可得性以及动作相关特征的低维特性），这些验证问题比预测未来状态要简单得多。利用这些不对称性，我们为世界模型增加了两个模块：（1）从视频语料库中提取的多样化子目标生成器；（2）能够从状态特征子集中推断动作的稀疏逆模型。通过在生成子目标、推断动作与正向推演之间强制实施循环一致性，WAV为现有方法通常失效的未充分探索区域提供了有效的验证机制。在涵盖MiniGrid、RoboMimic和ManiSkill的九项任务中，我们的方法实现了2倍的样本效率提升，同时将下游策略性能提高了18%。
tldr: The paper proposes WAV, a self-improving world model framework for robotic tasks that uses forward-inverse asymmetry and cycle consistency to improve sample efficiency and policy performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WAV，一种用于机器人任务的自改进世界模型框架，利用前向-逆向不对称性和循环一致性来提高样本效率和策略性能。

title: A virtual-variable-length method for robust inverse kinematics of multi-segment continuum robots
summary: This paper proposes a new, robust method to solve the inverse kinematics (IK) of multi-segment continuum manipulators. Conventional Jacobian-based solvers, especially when initialized from neutral/rest configurations, often exhibit slow convergence and, in certain conditions, may fail to converge (deadlock). The Virtual-Variable-Length (VVL) method proposed here introduces fictitious variations of segments' length during the solution iteration, conferring virtual axial degrees of freedom that alleviate adverse behaviors and constraints, thus enabling or accelerating convergence. Comprehensive numerical experiments were conducted to compare the VVL method against benchmark Jacobian-based and Damped Least Square IK solvers. Across more than $1.8\times 10^6$ randomized trials covering manipulators with two to seven segments, the proposed approach achieved up to a 20$\%$ increase in convergence success rate over the benchmark and a 40-80$\%$ reduction in average iteration count under equivalent accuracy thresholds ($10^{-4}-10^{-8}$). While deadlocks are not restricted to workspace boundaries and may occur at arbitrary poses, our empirical study identifies boundary-proximal configurations as a frequent cause of failed convergence and the VVL method mitigates such occurrences over a statistical sample of test cases.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种求解多段连续体机械臂逆运动学的新鲁棒方法。基于雅可比矩阵的传统求解器在从中性/静止构型初始化时，常表现出收敛速度缓慢的问题，且在某些条件下可能无法收敛（死锁）。本文提出的虚拟变长度方法通过在求解迭代过程中引入虚拟的节段长度变化，赋予系统虚拟的轴向自由度，从而缓解不良行为与约束，实现或加速收敛。通过全面的数值实验，将虚拟变长度方法与基于雅可比矩阵的基准求解器及阻尼最小二乘逆运动学求解器进行对比。在涵盖二至七节段机械臂的超过180万次随机试验中，所提方法在相同精度阈值（10^{-4}-10^{-8}）下，相比基准方法收敛成功率最高提升20%，平均迭代次数减少40-80%。死锁问题并不局限于工作空间边界，也可能出现在任意位姿；我们的实证研究发现接近边界的构型是导致收敛失败的常见原因，而虚拟变长度方法在大量测试案例中有效减少了此类情况的发生。
tldr: This paper proposes a Virtual-Variable-Length (VVL) method for robust inverse kinematics of multi-segment continuum robots, improving convergence success rates and reducing iteration counts compared to standard solvers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多段连续体机器人逆运动学的虚拟变长方法，相比标准求解器，显著提高了收敛成功率并减少了迭代次数。

title: UAV-Track VLA: Embodied Aerial Tracking via Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Embodied visual tracking is crucial for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) executing complex real-world tasks. In dynamic urban scenarios with complex semantic requirements, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show great promise due to their cross-modal fusion and continuous action generation capabilities. To benchmark multimodal tracking in such environments, we construct a dedicated evaluation benchmark and a large-scale dataset encompassing over 890K frames, 176 tasks, and 85 diverse objects. Furthermore, to address temporal feature redundancy and the lack of spatial geometric priors in existing VLA models, we propose an improved VLA tracking model, UAV-Track VLA. Built upon the $π_{0.5}$ architecture, our model introduces a temporal compression net to efficiently capture inter-frame dynamics. Additionally, a parallel dual-branch decoder comprising a spatial-aware auxiliary grounding head and a flow matching action expert is designed to decouple cross-modal features and generate fine-grained continuous actions. Systematic experiments in the CARLA simulator validate the superior end-to-end performance of our method. Notably, in challenging long-distance pedestrian tracking tasks, UAV-Track VLA achieves a 61.76\% success rate and 269.65 average tracking frames, significantly outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, it demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization in unseen environments and reduces single-step inference latency by 33.4\% (to 0.0571s) compared to the original $π_{0.5}$, enabling highly efficient, real-time UAV control. Data samples and demonstration videos are available at: https://github.com/Hub-Tian/UAV-Track\_VLA.
summary_zh: 具身视觉跟踪对于无人机执行复杂现实任务至关重要。在具有复杂语义需求的动态城市场景中，视觉-语言-动作模型因其跨模态融合与连续动作生成能力展现出巨大潜力。为在此类环境中建立多模态跟踪基准，我们构建了专用评估基准和包含超过89万帧图像、176项任务及85种多样物体的大规模数据集。此外，为解决现有VLA模型存在的时序特征冗余和空间几何先验缺失问题，我们提出改进型VLA跟踪模型UAV-Track VLA。该模型基于$π_{0.5}$架构，引入时序压缩网络以高效捕获帧间动态特征，并设计由空间感知辅助定位头与流匹配动作专家组成的并行双分支解码器，实现跨模态特征解耦和细粒度连续动作生成。在CARLA仿真器中的系统实验验证了本方法卓越的端到端性能。在极具挑战性的长距离行人跟踪任务中，UAV-Track VLA达到61.76%的成功率与269.65的平均跟踪帧数，显著优于现有基线模型。此外，该方法在未见过的新环境中展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，相比原始$π_{0.5}$模型将单步推理延迟降低33.4%（至0.0571秒），实现了高效实时的无人机控制。数据样本与演示视频详见：https://github.com/Hub-Tian/UAV-Track\_VLA。
tldr: This paper proposes UAV-Track VLA, a Vision-Language-Action model for embodied aerial tracking by UAVs, featuring a temporal compression net and a dual-branch decoder to improve performance and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UAV-Track VLA，一种用于无人机具身化空中跟踪的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过引入时间压缩网络和双分支解码器来提高性能和效率。

title: ROS 2-Based LiDAR Perception Framework for Mobile Robots in Dynamic Production Environments, Utilizing Synthetic Data Generation, Transformation-Equivariant 3D Detection and Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Adaptive robots in dynamic production environments require robust perception capabilities, including 6D pose estimation and multi-object tracking. To address limitations in real-world data dependency, noise robustness, and spatiotemporal consistency, a LiDAR framework based on the Robot Operating System integrating a synthetic-data-trained Transformation-Equivariant 3D Detection with multi-object-tracking leveraging center poses is proposed. Validated across 72 scenarios with motion capture technology, overall results yield an Intersection over Union of 62.6% for standalone pose estimation, rising to 83.12% with multi-object-tracking integration. Our LiDAR-based framework achieves 91.12% of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy, advancing robustness and versatility of LiDAR-based perception systems for industrial mobile manipulators.
summary_zh: 动态生产环境中的自适应机器人需具备强大的感知能力，包括六维位姿估计与多目标跟踪。为克服现实数据依赖性、噪声鲁棒性及时空一致性方面的局限，本研究提出一种基于机器人操作系统的激光雷达框架，该框架集成基于合成数据训练的变换等变三维检测方法，并利用中心位姿实现多目标跟踪。通过运动捕捉技术在72种场景中进行验证，独立位姿估计的交并比达到62.6%，结合多目标跟踪后提升至83.12%。本激光雷达框架实现了91.12%的高阶跟踪精度，提升了工业移动机械臂激光雷达感知系统的鲁棒性与多功能性。
tldr: This paper presents a ROS 2-based LiDAR perception framework for mobile robots, featuring synthetic data training and transformation-equivariant 3D detection with multi-object tracking, and validates it in industrial production environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于ROS 2的移动机器人激光雷达感知框架，采用合成数据训练和变换等变的3D检测与多目标跟踪，并在工业动态生产环境中进行了验证。

title: CompassAD: Intent-Driven 3D Affordance Grounding in Functionally Competing Objects
summary: When told to "cut the apple," a robot must choose the knife over nearby scissors, despite both objects affording the same cutting function. In real-world scenes, multiple objects may share identical affordances, yet only one is appropriate under the given task context. We call such cases confusing pairs. However, existing 3D affordance methods largely sidestep this challenge by evaluating isolated single objects, often with explicit category names provided in the query. We formalize Multi-Object Affordance Grounding under Intent-Driven Instructions, a new 3D affordance setting that requires predicting a per-point affordance mask on the correct object within a cluttered multi-object point cloud, conditioned on implicit natural language intent. To study this problem, we construct CompassAD, the first benchmark centered on implicit intent in confusable multi-object scenes. It comprises 30 confusing object pairs spanning 16 affordance types, 6,422 scenes, and 88K+ query-answer pairs. Furthermore, we propose CompassNet, a framework that incorporates two dedicated modules tailored to this task. Instance-bounded Cross Injection (ICI) constrains language-geometry alignment within object boundaries to prevent cross-object semantic leakage. Bi-level Contrastive Refinement (BCR) enforces discrimination at both geometric-group and point levels, sharpening distinctions between target and confusable surfaces. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results on both seen and unseen queries, and deployment on a robotic manipulator confirms effective transfer to real-world grasping in confusing multi-object scenes.
summary_zh: 当被告知“切苹果”时，机器人必须选择刀具而非附近的剪刀，尽管二者均提供切割功能。在现实场景中，多个物体可能共享相同的功能属性，但仅有一个适合特定任务情境。我们称此类情况为混淆对。然而，现有3D功能感知方法主要通过评估孤立单物体来规避这一挑战，且查询中常提供显式类别名称。我们提出“意图驱动指令下的多物体功能感知定位”——一种新的3D功能感知设定，要求根据隐式自然语言意图，在杂乱的多物体点云中，针对正确物体预测逐点功能掩码。为研究此问题，我们构建了CompassAD基准，这是首个专注于可混淆多物体场景中隐式意图的基准数据集，包含30个混淆物体对、16种功能类型、6，422个场景及8.8万余条查询-应答对。此外，我们提出CompassNet框架，集成了两个专为此任务设计的模块：实例边界交叉注入（ICI）将语言-几何对齐约束在物体边界内，防止跨物体语义泄露；双层对比优化（BCR）在几何组层级和点层级实施区分机制，强化目标表面与易混淆表面的差异。大量实验表明，该方法在处理已见及未见查询时均达到先进水平，在机器人操作器上的部署进一步验证了其在真实世界混淆多物体场景中抓取任务的有效迁移能力。
tldr: This paper introduces a new 3D affordance grounding task and benchmark (CompassAD) for selecting the correct object from functionally competing alternatives based on implicit natural language instructions, and demonstrates its application on a robotic manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的 3D 功能感知接地任务和基准（CompassAD），用于根据隐含的自然语言指令从功能竞争的对象中选择正确的物体，并在机器人操作器上演示了其应用。

title: Bridging Discrete Planning and Continuous Execution for Redundant Robot
summary: Voxel-grid reinforcement learning is widely adopted for path planning in redundant manipulators due to its simplicity and reproducibility. However, direct execution through point-wise numerical inverse kinematics on 7-DoF arms often yields step-size jitter, abrupt joint transitions, and instability near singular configurations. This work proposes a bridging framework between discrete planning and continuous execution without modifying the discrete planner itself. On the planning side, step-normalized 26-neighbor Cartesian actions and a geometric tie-breaking mechanism are introduced to suppress unnecessary turns and eliminate step-size oscillations. On the execution side, a task-priority damped least-squares (TP-DLS) inverse kinematics layer is implemented. This layer treats end-effector position as a primary task, while posture and joint centering are handled as subordinate tasks projected into the null space, combined with trust-region clipping and joint velocity constraints. On a 7-DoF manipulator in random sparse, medium, and dense environments, this bridge raises planning success in dense scenes from about 0.58 to 1.00, shortens representative path length from roughly 1.53 m to 1.10 m, and while keeping end-effector error below 1 mm, reduces peak joint accelerations by over an order of magnitude, substantially improving the continuous execution quality of voxel-based RL paths on redundant manipulators.
summary_zh: 体素网格强化学习因其简洁性和可复现性，在冗余机械臂路径规划中得到了广泛应用。然而，在7自由度机械臂上直接通过逐点数值逆运动学执行路径时，常出现步长抖动、关节突变及奇异位形附近的不稳定问题。本文提出了一种在离散规划与连续执行之间搭建桥梁的框架，无需修改离散规划器本身。在规划侧，引入了步长归一化的26邻域笛卡尔动作及几何平局决胜机制，以抑制不必要的转向并消除步长振荡。在执行侧，设计了一个任务优先级阻尼最小二乘逆运动学层，该层将末端执行器位置作为主任务，姿态调整与关节居中则通过零空间投影作为次级任务处理，同时结合信任域截断与关节速度约束。在随机稀疏、中等密度及高密度环境下对7自由度机械臂进行的测试表明，该桥梁框架将高密度场景中的规划成功率从约0.58提升至1.00，典型路径长度从约1.53米缩短至1.10米，并在保持末端执行器误差低于1毫米的同时，将关节峰值加速度降低超过一个数量级，显著提升了基于体素强化学习的路径在冗余机械臂上的连续执行质量。
tldr: Proposes a framework to bridge discrete RL path planning and continuous execution for redundant manipulators, improving planning success and reducing jitter/instability via improved Cartesian actions and a task-priority inverse kinematics layer.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种桥接冗余机械臂离散规划与连续执行的框架，通过改进的笛卡尔动作和任务优先级逆运动学层，显著提高了密集场景中的规划成功率并减少了执行抖动和不稳定性。

title: Posterior Optimization with Clipped Objective for Bridging Efficiency and Stability in Generative Policy Learning
summary: Expressive generative models have advanced robotic manipulation by capturing complex, multi-modal action distributions over temporally extended trajectories. However, fine-tuning these policies via RL remains challenging due to instability and sample inefficiency. We introduce Posterior Optimization with Clipped Objective (POCO), a principled RL framework that formulates policy improvement as a posterior inference problem tailored for temporal action chunks. Through an Expectation-Maximization procedure, POCO distills a reward-weighted implicit posterior into the policy without likelihood estimation. Furthermore, POCO adopts an offline-to-online paradigm that anchors online exploration to pre-trained priors, and its model-agnostic design scales to fine-tune large VLA models without architectural modifications. Evaluations across 7 simulation benchmarks and 4 contact-rich real-world tasks demonstrate that POCO prevents catastrophic policy collapse, outperforms SOTA baselines, and achieves a 96.7% success rate on real-world tasks. Videos are available at our project website https://cccedric.github.io/poco/.
summary_zh: 富有表现力的生成模型通过捕捉复杂、多模态的时序扩展动作分布，推动了机器人操作技术的发展。然而，由于不稳定性与样本效率低下，通过强化学习对这些策略进行微调仍然具有挑战性。我们提出一种具有理论依据的强化学习框架——剪裁目标后验优化方法（POCO），它将策略改进过程构建为一个针对时序动作块的后验推理问题。通过期望最大化算法，POCO无需进行似然估计，即可将奖励加权的隐式后验提炼到策略中。此外，POCO采用离线到在线相结合的训练范式，将在线探索锚定于预训练先验分布，其模型无关的架构设计可适用于大规模视觉语言动作模型的微调，而无需修改模型结构。在7个模拟基准测试和4个接触密集型真实任务中的评估表明，POCO能够有效避免策略崩溃问题，其性能优于当前最先进的基线方法，并在真实任务中取得了96.7%的成功率。演示视频详见项目网站https://cccedric.github.io/poco/。
tldr: POCO is a new RL framework for fine-tuning generative robot manipulation policies, addressing instability and sample inefficiency through a posterior inference formulation and offline-to-online learning, showing high success in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: POCO是一种用于微调生成式机器人操作策略的新RL框架，通过后验推断公式和离线到在线学习解决不稳定性与样本低效问题，在真实世界任务中实现了高成功率。

title: Preferential Bayesian Optimization with Crash Feedback
summary: Bayesian optimization is a popular black-box optimization method for parameter learning in control and robotics. It typically requires an objective function that reflects the user's optimization goal. However, in practical applications, this objective function is often inaccessible due to complex or unmeasurable performance metrics. Preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO) overcomes this limitation by leveraging human feedback through pairwise comparisons, eliminating the need for explicit performance quantification. When applying PBO to hardware systems, such as in quadcopter control, crashes can cause time-consuming experimental resets, wear and tear, or otherwise undesired outcomes. Standard PBO methods cannot incorporate feedback from such crashed experiments, resulting in the exploration of parameters that frequently lead to experimental crashes. We thus introduce CrashPBO, a user-friendly mechanism that enables users to both express preferences and report crashes during the optimization process. Benchmarking on synthetic functions shows that this mechanism reduces crashes by 63% and increases data efficiency. Through experiments on three robotics platforms, we demonstrate the wide applicability and transferability of CrashPBO, highlighting that it provides a flexible, user-friendly framework for parameter learning with human feedback on preferences and crashes.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化是控制与机器人领域参数学习中广泛使用的黑盒优化方法，其通常需要反映用户优化目标的目标函数。然而在实际应用中，由于性能指标复杂或不可测，该目标函数往往难以获取。基于偏好的贝叶斯优化（PBO）通过利用人类对参数对的比较反馈，克服了这一限制，从而避免了对性能的显式量化需求。将PBO应用于硬件系统（如四旋翼飞行器控制）时，系统崩溃可能导致耗时的实验重置、设备损耗或其他不良后果。传统PBO方法无法整合此类崩溃实验的反馈，导致频繁探索引发实验崩溃的参数。为此，我们提出CrashPBO——一种用户友好机制，允许用户在优化过程中既表达偏好，又报告系统崩溃。基于合成函数的基准测试表明，该机制可减少63%的崩溃发生率并提升数据利用效率。通过在三个机器人平台上的实验，我们验证了CrashPBO的广泛适用性与可迁移性，证明其为结合人类偏好与崩溃反馈的参数学习提供了灵活、用户友好的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces CrashPBO, an extension of Preferential Bayesian Optimization that allows users to provide feedback on preferences and crashes, reducing crashes by 63% and improving data efficiency, demonstrated on three robotics platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出CrashPBO，这是一种扩展的偏好贝叶斯优化方法，允许用户提供偏好和系统崩溃的反馈，在三个机器人平台上演示显示能减少63%的崩溃并提高数据效率。

title: OpenGo: An OpenClaw-Based Robotic Dog with Real-Time Skill Switching
summary: Adaptation to complex tasks and multiple scenarios remains a significant challenge for a single robot agent. The ability to acquire organize, and switch between a wide range of skills in real time, particularly in dynamic environments, has become a fundamental requirement for embodied intelligence. We introduce OpenGo, an OpenClaw-powered embodied robotic dog capable of switching skills in real time according to the scene and task instructions. Specifically, the agent is equipped with (1) a customizable skill library with easy skill import and autonomous skill validation, (2) a dispatcher that selects and invokes different skills according to task prompts or language instructions, and (3) a self-learning framework that fine-tunes skills based on task completion and human feedback. We deploy the agent in Unitree's Go2 robotic dog and validate its capabilities in self-checking and switching of skills autonomously. In addition, by integrating Feishu-platform communication, we enable natural-language guidance and human feedback, allowing inexperienced users to control the robotic dog through simple instructions.
summary_zh: 单一机器人代理适应复杂任务和多场景的能力仍面临重大挑战。在动态环境中实时获取、组织并灵活切换多样化技能，已成为具身智能的基础要求。本文提出OpenGo系统——一种基于OpenClaw架构的具身机器狗，能够根据场景与任务指令实时切换技能。具体而言，该系统具备以下特征：（1）可定制化技能库支持便捷的技能导入与自主技能验证；（2）调度器模块可根据任务提示或语言指令选择调用不同技能；（3）基于任务完成度与人类反馈的自学习框架，实现技能参数微调。我们将该代理部署于宇树科技的Go2机器狗平台，验证了其在自主技能核验与切换方面的能力。此外，通过集成飞书平台通信模块，系统支持自然语言引导与人工反馈机制，使非专业用户能通过简单指令操控机器狗。
tldr: OpenGo is a robotic dog system with a real-time skill-switching framework, integrating a skill library, a dispatcher for task prompts, and a self-learning module for fine-tuning, validated on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: OpenGo是一种基于OpenClaw的机器人狗系统，具备实时技能切换能力，集成了可定制的技能库、根据任务指令的调度器以及基于反馈的自学习框架，在Unitree Go2机器人上进行了验证。

title: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Finetuning with Feasible Action Neighborhood Prior
summary: In real-world robotic manipulation, states typically admit a neighborhood of near-equivalent actions. That is, for each state, there exist a feasible action neighborhood (FAN) rather than a single correct action, within which motions yield indistinguishable progress. However, prevalent VLA training methodologies are directly inherited from linguistic settings and do not exploit the FAN property, thus leading to poor generalization and low sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce a FAN-guided regularizer that shapes the model's output distribution to align with the geometry of FAN. Concretely, we introduce a Gaussian prior that promotes locally smooth and unimodal predictions around the preferred direction and magnitude. In extensive experiments across both reinforced finetuning (RFT) and supervised finetuning (SFT), our method achieves significant improvement in sample efficiency, and success rate in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. By aligning with the intrinsic action tolerance of physical manipulation, FAN-guided regularization provides a principled and practical method for sample-efficient, and generalizable VLA adaptation.
summary_zh: 在现实世界的机器人操作中，状态通常存在一个由近似等效动作构成的邻域。也就是说，对于每个状态，存在一个可行的动作邻域（FAN）而非单一正确动作，在该邻域内运动产生的进展难以区分。然而，当前主流的视觉语言动作模型训练方法直接沿袭自语言设定，未能利用FAN特性，导致泛化能力差且样本效率低下。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种FAN引导的正则化方法，通过调整模型输出分布以匹配FAN的几何特性。具体而言，我们引入高斯先验，促使模型在优选方向与幅值附近产生局部平滑且单峰分布的预测。在强化微调和监督微调的广泛实验中，该方法在样本效率、分布内与分布外场景的成功率方面均取得显著提升。通过与物理操作固有的动作容错性保持对齐，FAN引导的正则化为实现样本高效、泛化能力强的视觉语言动作模型适应提供了原则性且实用的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces a Feasible Action Neighborhood (FAN) regularizer to improve the sample efficiency and generalization of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种可行动作邻域（FAN）正则化方法，用于提高视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中的样本效率和泛化能力。

title: AnchorVLA: Anchored Diffusion for Efficient End-to-End Mobile Manipulation
summary: A central challenge in mobile manipulation is preserving multiple plausible action models while remaining reactive during execution. A bottle in a cluttered scene can often be approached and grasped in multiple valid ways. Robust behavior depends on preserving this action diversity while remaining reactive as the scene evolves. Diffusion policies are appealing because they model multimodal action distributions rather than collapsing to one solution. But in practice, full iterative denoising is costly at control time. Action chunking helps amortize inference, yet it also creates partially open-loop behavior, allowing small mismatches to accumulate into drift. We present AnchorVLA, a diffusion-based VLA policy for mobile manipulation built on the core insight that when sampling begins near a plausible solution manifold, extensive denoising is unnecessary to recover multimodal, valid actions. AnchorVLA combines a lightweight VLA adaptation backbone with an anchored diffusion action head, which denoises locally around anchor trajectories using a truncated diffusion schedule. This retains multimodal action generation while reducing inference cost for closed-loop control. Crucially, to mitigate chunking-induced drift, we introduce a test-time self-correction mechanism via a lightweight residual correction module that makes high-frequency, per-step adjustments during rollout. Across diverse mobile manipulation tasks, AnchorVLA improves success and stability under disturbances and distribution shifts while maintaining low-latency inference. The source code is made available at https://github.com/jason-lim26/AnchorVLA.
summary_zh: 移动操作中的一个核心挑战在于如何保持多种可行的动作模型，同时在执行过程中保持响应能力。在杂乱场景中，一个瓶子往往可以通过多种有效方式被接近并抓取。鲁棒的行为依赖于在场景变化时保持这种动作多样性，同时保持反应性。扩散策略因其能够建模多模态动作分布，而非坍缩到单一解决方案，因而具有吸引力。但在实践中，完整的迭代去噪在控制时成本高昂。动作分块有助于分摊推理成本，但这也引入了部分开环行为，使得微小的误差积累导致漂移。我们提出AnchorVLA，这是一种基于扩散的视觉语言动作（VLA）策略，用于移动操作，其核心思想是：当采样起始于接近一个合理解流形时，无需进行大量去噪即可恢复多模态的有效动作。AnchorVLA将轻量级的VLA适配骨干网络与一个锚定扩散动作头相结合，后者通过截断的扩散计划，在锚定轨迹附近进行局部去噪。这既保留了多模态动作生成能力，又降低了用于闭环控制的推理成本。重要的是，为了减轻分块导致的漂移，我们引入了一个通过轻量级残差校正模块实现的测试时自校正机制，该机制在执行过程中进行高频的每步调整。在多种移动操作任务中，AnchorVLA在干扰和分布偏移下提高了成功率和稳定性，同时保持了低延迟推理。源代码已发布于https://github.com/jason-lim26/AnchorVLA。
tldr: This paper introduces AnchorVLA, a diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action model for mobile manipulation that reduces inference cost via anchored diffusion and improves robustness to drift with a test-time self-correction mechanism.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AnchorVLA，一种用于移动操作的基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作模型，它通过锚定扩散降低推理成本，并通过测试时自校正机制提高对漂移的鲁棒性。

title: MorphoGuard: A Morphology-Based Whole-Body Interactive Motion Controller
summary: Whole-body control (WBC) has demonstrated significant advantages in complex interactive movements of high-dimensional robotic systems. However, when a robot is required to handle dynamic multi-contact combinations along a single kinematic chain-such as pushing open a door with its elbow while grasping an object-it faces major obstacles in terms of complex contact representation and joint configuration coupling. To address this, we propose a new control approach that explicitly manages arbitrary contact combinations, aiming to endow robots with whole-body interactive capabilities. We develop a morphology-constrained WBC network (MorphoGuard)-which is trained on a self-constructed dual-arm physical and simulation platform. A series of model recommendation experiments are designed to systematically investigate the impact of backbone architecture, fusion strategy, and model scale on network performance. To evaluate the control performance, we adopt a multi-object interaction task as the benchmark, requiring the model to simultaneously manipulate multiple target objects to specified positions. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a contact point management error of approximately 1 cm, demonstrating its effectiveness in whole-body interactive control.
summary_zh: 全身控制（WBC）在高维机器人系统的复杂交互运动中展现出显著优势。然而，当机器人需在单一运动链上处理动态多接触组合时——例如用肘部推开门的同时抓取物体——其在复杂接触表示与关节配置耦合方面面临重大挑战。为此，我们提出一种新的控制方法，能显式管理任意接触组合，旨在赋予机器人全身交互能力。我们开发了一种形态约束的全身控制网络（MorphoGuard），该网络在自建的双臂物理与仿真平台上进行训练。通过设计一系列模型推荐实验，系统研究了骨干架构、融合策略和模型规模对网络性能的影响。为评估控制性能，我们采用多物体交互任务作为基准测试，要求模型同时操控多个目标物体至指定位置。实验结果表明，所提方法实现了约1厘米的接触点管理误差，验证了其在全身交互控制中的有效性。
tldr: The paper proposes MorphoGuard, a morphology-constrained whole-body control network to manage complex multi-contact interactions for high-dimensional robotic systems, validated on a dual-arm platform with a multi-object interaction benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MorphoGuard，一种基于形态学的全身控制网络，用于管理高维机器人系统的复杂多接触交互，并在双臂平台和物体交互任务上进行了验证。

title: Low-Burden LLM-Based Preference Learning: Personalizing Assistive Robots from Natural Language Feedback for Users with Paralysis
summary: Physically Assistive Robots (PARs) require personalized behaviors to ensure user safety and comfort. However, traditional preference learning methods, like exhaustive pairwise comparisons, cause severe physical and cognitive fatigue for users with profound motor impairments. To solve this, we propose a low-burden, offline framework that translates unstructured natural language feedback directly into deterministic robotic control policies. To safely bridge the gap between ambiguous human speech and robotic code, our pipeline uses Large Language Models (LLMs) grounded in the Occupational Therapy Practice Framework (OTPF). This clinical reasoning decodes subjective user reactions into explicit physical and psychological needs, which are then mapped into transparent decision trees. Before deployment, an automated "LLM-as-a-Judge" verifies the code's structural safety. We validated this system in a simulated meal preparation study with 10 adults with paralysis. Results show our natural language approach significantly reduces user workload compared to traditional baselines. Additionally, independent clinical experts confirmed the generated policies are safe and accurately reflect user preferences.
summary_zh: 物理辅助机器人(PARs)需要个性化行为以确保用户安全与舒适度。然而传统偏好学习方法（如穷举式成对比较）会令重度运动功能障碍用户承受严重的生理与认知负荷。为此，我们提出一种低负担的离线框架，将非结构化自然语言反馈直接转换为确定性机器人控制策略。为安全弥合模糊人类语言与机器人代码之间的鸿沟，该框架采用基于作业治疗实践框架(OTPF)的大型语言模型(LLM)。这种临床推理机制将用户主观反应解码为明确的生理与心理需求，进而映射为透明决策树。在部署前，自动化的“LLM-as-a-Judge”机制会验证代码的结构安全性。我们通过10名瘫痪成人参与的模拟备餐研究验证了该系统。结果表明，与传统基线方法相比，我们的自然语言方法显著降低了用户工作负荷。此外，独立临床专家确认生成策略的安全性，并能准确反映用户偏好。
tldr: This paper proposes a low-burden framework using LLMs to translate unstructured natural language feedback from users with paralysis into deterministic robotic control policies for assistive robots, validated in a simulated meal preparation task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种低负担的框架，利用大型语言模型将瘫痪用户的无结构自然语言反馈转化为辅助机器人的确定性控制策略，并在模拟备餐任务中得到验证。

title: Learning When to See and When to Feel: Adaptive Vision-Torque Fusion for Contact-Aware Manipulation
summary: Vision-based policies have achieved a good performance in robotic manipulation due to the accessibility and richness of visual observations. However, purely visual sensing becomes insufficient in contact-rich and force-sensitive tasks where force/torque (F/T) signals provide critical information about contact dynamics, alignment, and interaction quality. Although various strategies have been proposed to integrate vision and F/T signals, including auxiliary prediction objectives, mixture-of-experts architectures, and contact-aware gating mechanisms, a comparison of these approaches remains lacking. In this work, we provide a comparison study of different F/T-vision integration strategies within diffusion-based manipulation policies. In addition, we propose an adaptive integration strategy that ignores F/T signals during non-contact phases while adaptively leveraging both vision and torque information during contact. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the strongest baseline by 14% in success rate, highlighting the importance of contact-aware multimodal fusion for robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的策略因其观察的可获取性和丰富性，在机器人操作任务中表现良好。然而，在接触密集和力敏感型任务中，仅依赖视觉传感已显不足，此时力/力矩（F/T）信号能够提供关于接触动态、对准状态和交互质量的关键信息。尽管已有多种策略被提出用于融合视觉与F/T信号，包括辅助预测目标、专家混合架构以及接触感知的门控机制，但这些方法之间的对比研究仍显缺乏。本研究在基于扩散模型的操作策略框架内，对不同的F/T-视觉融合策略进行了比较分析。此外，我们提出一种自适应融合策略，该策略在非接触阶段忽略F/T信号，而在接触阶段自适应地同时利用视觉和力矩信息。实验结果表明，我们的方法在任务成功率上比最强基线高出14%，凸显了接触感知的多模态融合在机器人操作中的重要性。
tldr: This paper compares strategies for integrating vision and force/torque (F/T) signals in diffusion-based robotic manipulation policies and proposes an adaptive, contact-aware fusion method that outperforms baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了基于扩散的机器人操作策略中视觉与力/力矩信号的融合方法，并提出了一种在接触阶段自适应融合视觉与扭矩信息的策略，其成功率显著优于基线。

title: Soft MPCritic: Amortized Model Predictive Value Iteration
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) and model predictive control (MPC) offer complementary strengths, yet combining them at scale remains computationally challenging. We propose soft MPCritic, an RL-MPC framework that learns in (soft) value space while using sample-based planning for both online control and value target generation. soft MPCritic instantiates MPC through model predictive path integral control (MPPI) and trains a terminal Q-function with fitted value iteration, aligning the learned value function with the planner and implicitly extending the effective planning horizon. We introduce an amortized warm-start strategy that recycles planned open-loop action sequences from online observations when computing batched MPPI-based value targets. This makes soft MPCritic computationally practical, while preserving solution quality. soft MPCritic plans in a scenario-based fashion with an ensemble of dynamic models trained for next-step prediction accuracy. Together, these ingredients enable soft MPCritic to learn effectively through robust, short-horizon planning on classic and complex control tasks. These results establish soft MPCritic as a practical and scalable blueprint for synthesizing MPC policies in settings where policy extraction and direct, long-horizon planning may fail.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）与模型预测控制（MPC）各具互补优势，但将它们大规模结合仍然面临计算挑战。本文提出软MPCritic框架，这是一种在（软）值空间中进行学习的RL-MPC架构，同时利用基于采样的规划实现在线控制与值目标生成。该框架通过模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）实例化MPC，并采用拟合值迭代方法训练终端Q函数，从而使学习到的值函数与规划器对齐，并隐式地扩展了有效规划范围。我们引入了一种摊销预热策略，在计算基于MCPI的批量值目标时，通过复用从在线观测中规划的开环动作序列，显著提升了计算效率，同时保证了求解质量。软MPCritic采用基于场景的规划方式，并集成了一组经过训练以优化单步预测精度的动态模型。以上设计的结合，使得软MPCritic能够在经典及复杂控制任务中，通过鲁棒的短视域规划实现高效学习。实验结果表明，软MPCritic为在策略提取和直接长视域规划可能失效的场景中，提供了一种实用且可扩展的MPC策略合成框架。
tldr: This paper introduces Soft MPCritic, a method that combines Reinforcement Learning with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to learn value functions and improve long-horizon control performance in complex tasks, including high-dimensional and contact-rich environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种将强化学习与模型预测控制相结合的方法，通过在学习价值函数的同时利用样本进行规划，旨在解决复杂控制任务中的长时程规划问题，并成功应用于高维度和接触丰富的环境中。

title: Stop Wandering: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Metacognitive Reasoning
summary: Training-free Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) agents powered by foundation models can follow instructions and explore 3D environments. However, existing approaches rely on greedy frontier selection and passive spatial memory, leading to inefficient behaviors such as local oscillation and redundant revisiting. We argue that this stems from a lack of metacognitive capabilities: the agent cannot monitor its exploration progress, diagnose strategy failures, or adapt accordingly. To address this, we propose MetaNav, a metacognitive navigation agent integrating spatial memory, history-aware planning, and reflective correction. Spatial memory builds a persistent 3D semantic map. History-aware planning penalizes revisiting to improve efficiency. Reflective correction detects stagnation and uses an LLM to generate corrective rules that guide future frontier selection. Experiments on GOAT-Bench, HM3D-OVON, and A-EQA show that MetaNav achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing VLM queries by 20.7%, demonstrating that metacognitive reasoning significantly improves robustness and efficiency.
summary_zh: 基于基础模型的免训练视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体能够遵循指令并探索三维环境。然而，现有方法依赖于贪婪的边界选择与被动式空间记忆，导致局部振荡与重复访问等低效行为。我们认为这源于智能体缺乏元认知能力：无法监控其探索进度、诊断策略失败或进行相应调整。为解决这一问题，我们提出MetaNav——一种集成空间记忆、历史感知规划与反思性校正的元认知导航智能体。空间记忆构建了持久化的三维语义地图；历史感知规划通过惩罚重复访问以提升效率；反思性校正机制能够检测停滞状态，并利用大语言模型生成指导未来边界选择的修正规则。在GOAT-Bench、HM3D-OVON与A-EQA数据集上的实验表明，MetaNav在将视觉语言模型查询量降低20.7%的同时，实现了最先进的性能，这证明元认知推理能显著提升导航的鲁棒性与效率。
tldr: This paper introduces MetaNav, a metacognitive Vision-Language Navigation agent that integrates spatial memory, history-aware planning, and reflective correction to improve efficiency and reduce VLM queries.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MetaNav，一种具有元认知能力的视觉语言导航智能体，通过整合空间记忆、历史感知规划和反思性校正，提高了导航效率并减少了视觉语言模型的查询次数。

title: Hi-LOAM: Hierarchical Implicit Neural Fields for LiDAR Odometry and Mapping
summary: LiDAR Odometry and Mapping (LOAM) is a pivotal technique for embodied-AI applications such as autonomous driving and robot navigation. Most existing LOAM frameworks are either contingent on the supervision signal, or lack of the reconstruction fidelity, which are deficient in depicting details of large-scale complex scenes. To overcome these limitations, we propose a multi-scale implicit neural localization and mapping framework using LiDAR sensor, called Hi-LOAM. Hi-LOAM receives LiDAR point cloud as the input data modality, learns and stores hierarchical latent features in multiple levels of hash tables based on an octree structure, then these multi-scale latent features are decoded into signed distance value through shallow Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs) in the mapping procedure. For pose estimation procedure, we rely on a correspondence-free, scan-to-implicit matching paradigm to estimate optimal pose and register current scan into the submap. The entire training process is conducted in a self-supervised manner, which waives the model pre-training and manifests its generalizability when applied to diverse environments. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate the superior performance, in terms of the effectiveness and generalization capabilities, of our Hi-LOAM compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: LiDAR里程计与建图（LOAM）是自动驾驶和机器人导航等具身AI应用中的关键技术。当前大多数LOAM框架或依赖监督信号，或缺乏场景重建的精细度，难以准确刻画大规模复杂场景的细节。为突破这些局限，我们提出一种基于激光雷达的多尺度隐式神经定位与建图框架Hi-LOAM。该框架以激光雷达点云作为输入数据模态，通过八叉树结构在多层哈希表中学习并存储分层潜在特征，随后在映射过程中通过浅层多层感知机将这些多尺度潜在特征解码为带符号距离值。在姿态估计过程中，我们采用基于无对应关系的扫描-隐式匹配范式来估计最优姿态，并将当前扫描帧注册至局部地图中。整个训练过程以自监督方式实现，无需模型预训练，展现其在不同环境下的强泛化能力。通过在多个真实场景与合成数据集上的大量实验表明，Hi-LOAM在算法效能与泛化能力方面均优于现有先进方法。
tldr: Proposes a self-supervised, hierarchical implicit neural representation for LiDAR odometry and mapping, using a correspondence-free scan-to-implicit matching paradigm for pose estimation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于激光雷达里程计和建图的自监督、分层隐式神经表示方法，使用无对应扫描到隐式匹配范式进行姿态估计。

title: 3-D Relative Localization for Multi-Robot Systems with Angle and Self-Displacement Measurements
summary: Realizing relative localization by leveraging inter-robot local measurements is a challenging problem, especially in the presence of measurement noise. Motivated by this challenge, in this paper we propose a novel and systematic 3-D relative localization framework based on inter-robot interior angle and self-displacement measurements. Initially, we propose a linear relative localization theory comprising a distributed linear relative localization algorithm and sufficient conditions for localizability. According to this theory, robots can determine their neighbors' relative positions and orientations in a purely linear manner. Subsequently, in order to deal with measurement noise, we present an advanced Maximum a Posterior (MAP) estimator by addressing three primary challenges existing in the MAP estimator. Firstly, it is common to formulate the MAP problem as an optimization problem, whose inherent non-convexity can result in local optima. To address this issue, we reformulate the linear computation process of the linear relative localization algorithm as a Weighted Total Least Squares (WTLS) optimization problem on manifolds. The optimal solution of the WTLS problem is more accurate, which can then be used as initial values when solving the optimization problem associated with the MAP problem, thereby reducing the risk of falling into local optima. The second challenge is the lack of knowledge of the prior probability density of the robots' relative positions and orientations at the initial time, which is required as an input for the MAP estimator. To deal with it, we combine the WTLS with a Neural Density Estimator (NDE). Thirdly, to prevent the increasing size of the relative positions and orientations to be estimated as the robots continuously move when solving the MAP problem, a marginalization mechanism is designed, which ensures that the computational cost remains constant.
summary_zh: 基于机器人间的局部测量实现相对定位是一个具有挑战性的问题，尤其是在存在测量噪声的情况下。受此挑战启发，本文提出了一种基于机器人间夹角与自身位移测量的新型系统化三维相对定位框架。首先，我们提出了一种线性相对定位理论，包含分布式线性相对定位算法及局部可定位性的充分条件。依据该理论，机器人能以纯线性方式确定邻居的相对位置与姿态。随后，为处理测量噪声，我们提出了一种改进的最大后验概率估计器，通过解决最大后验概率估计器中存在的三个主要挑战：首先，通常将最大后验概率问题转化为优化问题，但其固有的非凸性可能导致局部最优解。为解决此问题，我们将线性相对定位算法的线性计算过程重构为流形上的加权总体最小二乘优化问题。该加权总体最小二乘问题的最优解具有更高精度，可作为求解最大后验概率关联优化问题的初始值，从而降低陷入局部最优的风险。第二个挑战是缺乏初始时刻机器人相对位置与姿态的先验概率密度知识，而这正是最大后验概率估计器所需的输入。为此，我们将加权总体最小二乘与神经密度估计器相结合。第三，为解决在求解最大后验概率问题时机器人持续运动导致待估计的相对位置与姿态维度不断增加的问题，设计了边缘化机制，确保计算成本保持恒定。
tldr: Proposes a novel 3-D relative localization framework for multi-robot systems using inter-robot angle and self-displacement measurements, addressing noise via a Maximum a Posteriori estimator combined with a Weighted Total Least Squares approach and a Neural Density Estimator.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于机器人间内角与自位移测量的多机器人三维相对定位框架，通过结合最大后验估计、加权总体最小二乘与神经密度估计器处理测量噪声。

title: AURA: Multimodal Shared Autonomy for Real-World Urban Navigation
summary: Long-horizon navigation in complex urban environments relies heavily on continuous human operation, which leads to fatigue, reduced efficiency, and safety concerns. Shared autonomy, where a Vision-Language AI agent and a human operator collaborate on maneuvering the mobile machine, presents a promising solution to address these issues. However, existing shared autonomy methods often require humans and AI to operate within the same action space, leading to high cognitive overhead. We present Assistive Urban Robot Autonomy (AURA), a new multi-modal framework that decomposes urban navigation into high-level human instruction and low-level AI control. AURA incorporates a Spatial-Aware Instruction Encoder to align various human instructions with visual and spatial context. To facilitate training, we construct MM-CoS, a large-scale dataset comprising teleoperation and vision-language descriptions. Experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that AURA effectively follows human instructions, reduces manual operation effort, and improves navigation stability, while enabling online adaptation. Moreover, under similar takeover conditions, our shared autonomy framework reduces the frequency of takeovers by more than 44%. Demo video and more detail are provided in the project page.
summary_zh: 在复杂的城市环境中进行长距离导航主要依赖持续的人工操作，这不仅导致操作人员疲劳、效率降低，还带来安全隐患。共享自主性——即视觉-语言人工智能代理与人类操作员协同操控移动机器人的方式——为应对这些问题提供了可行方案。然而，现有的共享自主方法通常要求人类与AI在同一动作空间内操作，导致认知负荷较高。本文提出辅助城市机器人自主系统（AURA），这是一种新型多模态框架，将城市导航任务分解为高层人类指令与低层AI控制两个层次。AURA采用空间感知指令编码器，将多样化的人类指令与视觉和空间环境信息进行对齐。为支持训练，我们构建了大规模数据集MM-CoS，其中包含远程操作数据和视觉-语言描述。仿真与实地实验表明，AURA能有效遵循人类指令，减少人工操作负担，提高导航稳定性，并具备在线适应能力。此外，在相似接管条件下，本共享自主框架将接管频率降低了超过44%。项目页面中提供了演示视频及更多细节。
tldr: AURA is a multimodal shared autonomy framework that decomposes urban navigation into high-level human instructions and low-level AI control, using a Spatial-Aware Instruction Encoder and a large-scale dataset to reduce manual operation and takeover frequency in real-world navigation.
tldr_zh: AURA是一个多模态共享自主框架，将城市导航分解为高层人类指令和低层AI控制，通过空间感知指令编码器和大型数据集，减少现实世界导航中的手动操作和接管频率。

title: Robust Autonomous Control of a Magnetic Millirobot in In Vitro Cardiac Flow
summary: Untethered magnetic millirobots offer significant potential for minimally invasive cardiac therapies; however, achieving reliable autonomous control in pulsatile cardiac flow remains challenging. This work presents a vision-guided control framework enabling precise autonomous navigation of a magnetic millirobot in an in vitro heart phantom under physiologically relevant flow conditions. The system integrates UNet-based localization, A* path planning, and a sliding mode controller with a disturbance observer (SMC-DOB) designed for multi-coil electromagnetic actuation. Although drag forces are estimated using steady-state CFD simulations, the controller compensates for transient pulsatile disturbances during closed-loop operation. In static fluid, the SMC-DOB achieved sub-millimeter accuracy (root-mean-square error, RMSE = 0.49 mm), outperforming PID and MPC baselines. Under moderate pulsatile flow (7 cm/s peak, 20 cP), it reduced RMSE by 37% and peak error by 2.4$\times$ compared to PID. It further maintained RMSE below 2 mm (0.27 body lengths) under elevated pulsatile flow (10 cm/s peak, 20 cP) and under low-viscosity conditions (4.3 cP, 7 cm/s peak), where baseline controllers exhibited unstable or failed tracking. These results demonstrate robust closed-loop magnetic control under time-varying cardiac flow disturbances and support the feasibility of autonomous millirobot navigation for targeted drug delivery.
summary_zh: 无线磁控微型机器人在微创心脏治疗领域展现出巨大潜力，然而在脉动性心脏血流中实现可靠的自主控制仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种视觉引导控制框架，能够在生理相关血流条件下实现磁控微型机器人在体外心脏模型中的精确自主导航。该系统集成了基于UNet的定位模块、A*路径规划算法以及专为多线圈电磁驱动设计的带干扰观测器的滑模控制器（SMC-DOB）。虽然阻力估算采用了稳态计算流体力学模拟，但控制器在闭环运行期间能有效补偿瞬态脉动干扰。在静态流体中，SMC-DOB实现了亚毫米级精度（均方根误差RMSE=0.49毫米），其性能优于PID和MPC基准控制器。在中等脉动流条件下（峰值流速7厘米/秒，粘度20厘泊），该控制器较PID控制将均方根误差降低37%，峰值误差减少2.4倍。在增强脉动流（峰值流速10厘米/秒，粘度20厘泊）和低粘度环境（4.3厘泊，峰值流速7厘米/秒）中，基准控制器出现不稳定或跟踪失败时，SMC-DOB仍能将均方根误差维持在2毫米（0.27倍体长）以内。这些结果证明了在时变心脏血流干扰下实现鲁棒闭环磁控的可行性，为靶向药物递送中微型机器人的自主导航应用提供了技术支撑。
tldr: This paper presents a vision-guided control framework for autonomous navigation of a magnetic millirobot in a cardiac flow phantom, using localization, path planning, and a robust sliding mode controller to compensate for pulsatile disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于心脏血流模型中磁性微机器人自主导航的视觉引导控制框架，该方法集成了定位、路径规划和鲁棒的滑模控制器，以补偿脉冲式扰动。

title: Distal-Stable Beam for Continuum Robots
summary: Continuum robots are well suited for constrained environments but suffer from low distal stiffness, resulting in large posture errors under external loads. In this paper, we propose a novel structural primitive, the Distal-Stable Beam, which achieves a strong stiffness gradient through purely geometric design, maintaining compliance in the intermediate section while ensuring high distal rigidity. The structure consists of two parallel rods and one convergent rod constrained by guide disks, introducing geometric coupling that suppresses deformation modes and preserves distal posture. Experiments show that the distal stiffness is 12 times higher than at the center, corresponding to an approximately 100-fold improvement over a conventional cantilever beam. The proposed mechanism enables simultaneous compliance and distal stability without active stiffness modulation, providing a new design approach for continuum robots requiring both safety and precision.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人非常适合在受限环境中工作，但存在远端刚度不足的问题，导致在外部载荷下产生较大的位姿误差。本文提出一种新型结构单元——远端稳定梁，通过纯几何设计实现强刚度梯度，在保持中间段柔顺性的同时确保远端高刚性。该结构由两根平行杆和一根收敛杆通过导向盘约束构成，其几何耦合效应能抑制变形模式并保持远端位姿。实验表明，远端刚度达到中心区域的12倍，较传统悬臂梁提升约100倍。该机构无需主动刚度调节即可实现柔顺性与远端稳定性的统一，为同时要求安全性和精度的连续体机器人提供了新的设计思路。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel structural design called the Distal-Stable Beam for continuum robots, which uses a geometric coupling mechanism to achieve high distal stiffness while maintaining compliance elsewhere, improving precision under load.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于连续体机器人的新型结构设计——远端稳定梁，通过几何耦合机制实现高远端刚度，同时保持其他部分的柔顺性，从而提高了负载下的精度。

title: Neural Robust Control on Lie Groups Using Contraction Methods (Extended Version)
summary: In this paper, we propose a learning framework for synthesizing a robust controller for dynamical systems evolving on a Lie group. A robust control contraction metric (RCCM) and a neural feedback controller are jointly trained to enforce contraction conditions on the Lie group manifold. Sufficient conditions are derived for the existence of such an RCCM and neural controller, ensuring that the geometric constraints imposed by the manifold structure are respected while establishing a disturbance-dependent tube that bounds the output trajectories. As a case study, a feedback controller for a quadrotor is designed using the proposed framework. Its performance is evaluated using numerical simulations and compared with a geometric controller.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于在李群上演化的动力系统合成鲁棒控制器的学习框架。通过联合训练鲁棒控制收缩度量与神经反馈控制器，以在李群流形上强制满足收缩条件。研究推导了该鲁棒控制收缩度量与神经控制器存在的充分条件，在确保流形结构所施加的几何约束得到满足的同时，建立起能够约束输出轨迹的扰动依赖型管道。作为案例研究，基于该框架设计了四旋翼飞行器的反馈控制器，并通过数值模拟评估其性能，同时与几何控制器进行了对比分析。
tldr: A learning framework for robust controller synthesis on Lie group dynamical systems, using contraction metrics and neural networks, demonstrated on quadrotor control.
tldr_zh: 提出一个基于李群和收缩方法的鲁棒控制学习框架，结合神经网络控制器，以四旋翼飞行器为例进行了验证。

title: ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Exploratory Demonstration Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agentic Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) significantly enhances the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), yet applying it to multi-turn agentic tasks remains challenging due to the long-horizon nature of interactions and the stochasticity of environmental feedback. We identify a structural failure mode in agentic exploration: suboptimal actions elicit noisy observations into misleading contexts, which further weaken subsequent decision-making, making recovery increasingly difficult. This cumulative feedback loop of errors renders standard exploration strategies ineffective and susceptible to the model's reasoning and the environment's randomness. To mitigate this issue, we propose ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Explorative Demonstration RL, shifting exploration from passive selection to active intervention. ProCeedRL employs a process-level critic to monitor interactions in real time, incorporating reflection-based demonstrations to guide agents in stopping the accumulation of errors. We find that this approach significantly exceeds the model's saturated exploration performance, demonstrating substantial exploratory benefits. By learning from exploratory demonstrations and on-policy samples, ProCeedRL significantly improves exploration efficiency and achieves superior performance on complex deep search and embodied tasks.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）显著增强了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但由于交互过程的长时程特性与环境反馈的随机性，将其应用于多轮次代理任务仍具挑战性。我们识别出代理探索中的一种结构性失效模式：次优行动会引发环境反馈的噪声，进而形成误导性上下文，进一步削弱后续决策能力，导致任务恢复愈加困难。这种错误累积的反馈循环使得标准探索策略在模型推理与环境随机性影响下表现不佳。为缓解此问题，我们提出ProCeedRL：基于过程批判与探索性示范的强化学习，将探索从被动选择转变为主动干预。ProCeedRL采用过程级批判器实时监控交互过程，融入基于反思的示范来引导代理及时停止错误累积。研究发现，该方法显著超越了模型已饱和的探索性能，展现出显著的探索优势。通过从探索性示范与同策略样本中学习，ProCeedRL显著提升了探索效率，并在复杂深度搜索与具身任务中实现了卓越性能。
tldr: Proposes ProCeedRL, a reinforcement learning method with a process-level critic and exploratory demonstrations to improve long-horizon, multi-turn reasoning in LLM-based agents, tested on complex embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了ProCeedRL，一种结合过程批评器和探索性演示的强化学习方法，用于改进基于LLM的智能体在长时程、多回合推理任务中的表现，并在复杂的具身任务上进行了测试。

title: Robust Embodied Perception in Dynamic Environments via Disentangled Weight Fusion
summary: Embodied perception systems face severe challenges of dynamic environment distribution drift when they continuously interact in open physical spaces. However, the existing domain incremental awareness methods often rely on the domain id obtained in advance during the testing phase, which limits their practicability in unknown interaction scenarios. At the same time, the model often overfits to the context-specific perceptual noise, which leads to insufficient generalization ability and catastrophic forgetting. To address these limitations, we propose a domain-id and exemplar-free incremental learning framework for embodied multimedia systems, which aims to achieve robust continuous environment adaptation. This method designs a disentangled representation mechanism to remove non-essential environmental style interference, and guide the model to focus on extracting semantic intrinsic features shared across scenes, thereby eliminating perceptual uncertainty and improving generalization. We further use the weight fusion strategy to dynamically integrate the old and new environment knowledge in the parameter space, so as to ensure that the model adapts to the new distribution without storing historical data and maximally retains the discrimination ability of the old environment. Extensive experiments on multiple standard benchmark datasets show that the proposed method significantly reduces catastrophic forgetting in a completely exemplar-free and domain-id free setting, and its accuracy is better than the existing state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 具身感知系统在开放物理空间中持续交互时，面临动态环境分布漂移的严峻挑战。然而，现有的领域增量感知方法往往依赖测试阶段预先获取的领域标识，这限制了其在未知交互场景中的实用性。同时，模型常会过拟合于特定场景的感知噪声，导致泛化能力不足和灾难性遗忘。针对这些局限，我们提出一种面向具身多媒体系统的无领域标识与无样本增量学习框架，旨在实现鲁棒的持续环境适应。该方法设计了解耦表征机制以消除非必要的环境风格干扰，并引导模型专注于提取跨场景共享的语义本质特征，从而消除感知不确定性并提升泛化能力。我们进一步采用权重融合策略，在参数空间动态整合新旧环境知识，确保模型在不存储历史数据的情况下适应新分布，并最大限度保留旧环境的判别能力。在多个标准基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在完全无样本且无领域标识的设置下显著降低了灾难性遗忘，其准确率优于现有先进方法。
tldr: Proposes a domain-id and exemplar-free incremental learning framework for embodied perception systems to robustly adapt to dynamic environments without catastrophic forgetting, using disentangled representations and weight fusion.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种无需域标识和示例的增量学习框架，通过解耦表征和权重融合，使具身感知系统能鲁棒地适应动态环境，避免灾难性遗忘。

title: PTC-Depth: Pose-Refined Monocular Depth Estimation with Temporal Consistency
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has been widely adopted in the perception systems of autonomous vehicles and mobile robots. However, existing approaches often struggle to maintain temporal consistency in depth estimation across consecutive frames. This inconsistency not only causes jitter but can also lead to estimation failures when the depth range changes abruptly. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a consistency-aware monocular depth estimation framework that leverages wheel odometry from a mobile robot to achieve stable and coherent depth predictions over time. Specifically, we estimate camera pose and sparse depth from triangulation using optical flow between consecutive frames. The sparse depth estimates are used to update a recursive Bayesian estimate of the metric scale, which is then applied to rescale the relative depth predicted by a pre-trained depth estimation foundation model. The proposed method is evaluated on the KITTI, TartanAir, MS2, and our own dataset, demonstrating robust and accurate depth estimation performance.
summary_zh: 单目深度估计（MDE）已广泛应用于自动驾驶汽车和移动机器人的感知系统中。然而，现有方法在连续帧间往往难以保持深度估计的时间一致性。这种不一致性不仅会导致深度图抖动，还可能因深度范围突变引发估计失败。为应对这些挑战，本文提出一种一致性感知的单目深度估计框架，通过引入移动机器人的轮式里程计数据，实现随时间推移稳定且连贯的深度预测。具体而言，我们利用连续帧间的光流信息，通过三角测量法估计相机位姿与稀疏深度点。这些稀疏深度估计值被用于更新度量尺度的递归贝叶斯估计，进而对预训练深度估计基础模型预测的相对深度进行尺度重标定。本方法在KITTI、TartanAir、MS2及自制数据集上进行了验证，结果表明其具有鲁棒且精确的深度估计性能。
tldr: Proposes a monocular depth estimation method that uses wheel odometry and recursive Bayesian scale estimation to achieve temporal consistency in depth predictions for mobile robots.
tldr_zh: 提出一种利用轮式里程计和递归贝叶斯尺度估计的单目深度估计方法，以实现移动机器人深度预测的时间一致性。

title: Riemannian and Symplectic Geometry for Hierarchical Text-Driven Place Recognition
summary: Text-to-point-cloud localization enables robots to understand spatial positions through natural language descriptions, which is crucial for human-robot collaboration in applications such as autonomous driving and last-mile delivery. However, existing methods employ pooled global descriptors for similarity retrieval, which suffer from severe information loss and fail to capture discriminative scene structures.
