To address these issues, we propose SympLoc, a novel coarse-to-fine localization framework with multi-level alignment in the coarse stage. Different from previous methods that rely solely on global descriptors, our coarse stage consists of three complementary alignment levels: 1) Instance-level alignment establishes direct correspondence between individual object instances in point clouds and textual hints through Riemannian self-attention in hyperbolic space; 2) Relation-level alignment explicitly models pairwise spatial relationships between objects using the Information-Symplectic Relation Encoder (ISRE), which reformulates relation features through Fisher-Rao metric and Hamiltonian dynamics for uncertainty-aware geometrically consistent propagation; 3) Global-level alignment synthesizes discriminative global descriptors via the Spectral Manifold Transform (SMT) that extracts structural invariants through graph spectral analysis. This hierarchical alignment strategy progressively captures fine-grained to coarse-grained scene semantics, enabling robust cross-modal retrieval. Extensive experiments on the KITTI360Pose dataset demonstrate that SympLoc achieves a 19% improvement in Top-1 recall@10m compared to existing state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 文本-点云定位技术使机器人能够通过自然语言描述理解空间位置，这对自动驾驶、末端配送等场景中的人机协作至关重要。然而，现有方法采用池化全局描述符进行相似性检索，存在严重信息损失且难以捕获具有区分度的场景结构。针对这些问题，我们提出SympLoc——一种新颖的由粗到精定位框架，其粗粒度阶段包含多级对齐机制。与仅依赖全局描述符的先前方法不同，我们的粗粒度阶段包含三个互补的对齐层级：1）实例级对齐通过双曲空间中的黎曼自注意力机制，建立点云中个体对象实例与文本线索的直接对应关系；2）关系级对齐使用信息辛关系编码器（ISRE）显式建模对象间的成对空间关系，该编码器通过Fisher-Rao度规与哈密顿动力学重构关系特征，实现不确定性感知的几何一致性传播；3）全局级对齐通过谱流形变换（SMT）合成具有区分度的全局描述符，该变换借助图谱分析提取结构不变量。这种分层对齐策略能够渐进式捕获从细粒度到粗粒度的场景语义，实现鲁棒的跨模态检索。在KITTI360Pose数据集上的大量实验表明，SympLoc在Top-1召回率@10米指标上较现有最优方法提升了19%。
tldr: Proposes SympLoc, a hierarchical coarse-to-fine framework for text-to-point-cloud localization using multi-level alignment (instance, relation, global) with geometric models for robust cross-modal retrieval.
tldr_zh: 提出了SympLoc，一个用于文本到点云定位的层次化粗到精框架，通过多级对齐（实例、关系、全局）和几何模型，实现鲁棒的跨模态检索。

title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization
summary: Agent skills, structured packages of procedural knowledge and executable resources that agents dynamically load at inference time, have become a reliable mechanism for augmenting LLM agents. Yet inference-time skill augmentation is fundamentally limited: retrieval noise introduces irrelevant guidance, injected skill content imposes substantial token overhead, and the model never truly acquires the knowledge it merely follows. We ask whether skills can instead be internalized into model parameters, enabling zero-shot autonomous behavior without any runtime skill retrieval. We introduce SKILL0, an in-context reinforcement learning framework designed for skill internalization. SKILL0 introduces a training-time curriculum that begins with full skill context and progressively withdraws it. Skills are grouped offline by category and rendered with interaction history into a compact visual context, teaching he model tool invocation and multi-turn task completion. A Dynamic Curriculum then evaluates each skill file's on-policy helpfulness, retaining only those from which the current policy still benefits within a linearly decaying budget, until the agent operates in a fully zero-shot setting. Extensive agentic experiments demonstrate that SKILL0 achieves substantial improvements over the standard RL baseline (+9.7\% for ALFWorld and +6.6\% for Search-QA), while maintaining a highly efficient context of fewer than 0.5k tokens per step. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SkillZero.
summary_zh: 智能体技能作为一种动态加载的程序化知识包与可执行资源，已成为增强大语言模型智能体的可靠机制。然而，推理时的技能增强存在根本性局限：检索噪声会引入无关指引，注入的技能内容带来大量标记开销，且模型从未真正掌握其仅被动遵循的知识。我们探究是否可以将技能内化至模型参数中，从而实现无需运行时技能检索的零样本自主行为。为此，我们提出SKILL0——一种面向技能内化的上下文强化学习框架。SKILL0设计了从完整技能上下文开始、逐步抽离的训练课程机制：技能首先按类别离线分组，并通过交互历史转化为紧凑的视觉上下文，以此教导模型工具调用与多轮任务完成能力。动态课程策略随后评估每个技能文件在策略层面的有效性，仅保留当前策略在线性衰减的预算内仍能受益的部分，直至智能体完全在零样本环境中运行。大量智能体实验表明，SKILL0相比标准强化学习基线取得显著提升（ALFWorld任务提升9.7%，Search-QA任务提升6.6%），同时保持每步少于0.5千标记的高效上下文占用。项目代码已发布于https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SkillZero。
tldr: The paper introduces SKILL0, an in-context reinforcement learning framework for internalizing reusable agent skills into model parameters, enabling zero-shot autonomous behavior without runtime skill retrieval. It shows performance gains in embodied agent tasks like ALFWorld.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出SKILL0，一种用于技能内化的上下文强化学习框架，旨在将可重用的智能体技能内化到模型参数中，实现无需运行时技能检索的零样本自主行为，并在ALFWorld等具身智能体任务中展示了性能提升。

title: PRO-SPECT: Probabilistically Safe Scalable Planning for Energy-Aware Coordinated UAV-UGV Teams in Stochastic Environments
summary: We consider energy-aware planning for an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) team operating in a stochastic environment. The UAV must visit a set of air points in minimum time while respecting energy constraints, relying on the UGV as a mobile charging station. Unlike prior work that assumed deterministic travel times or used fixed robustness margins, we model travel times as random variables and bound the probability of failure (energy depletion) across the entire mission to a user-specified risk level. We formulate the problem as a Mixed-Integer Program and propose PRO-SPECT, a polynomial-time algorithm that generates risk-bounded plans. The algorithm supports both offline planning and online re-planning, enabling the team to adapt to disturbances while preserving the risk bound. We provide theoretical results on solution feasibility and time complexity. We also demonstrate the performance of our method via numerical comparisons and simulations.
summary_zh: 我们研究了一种在随机环境中运行的无人机与无人地面车辆协作团队的能源感知规划问题。无人机需在满足能源约束的条件下以最短时间访问一组空中航点，并依赖无人地面车辆作为移动充电站。与以往假设确定行程时间或使用固定鲁棒性边界的研究不同，我们将行程时间建模为随机变量，并将整个任务期间的能量耗尽失效概率限制在用户指定的风险水平内。该问题被构建为混合整数规划模型，并提出了多项式时间算法PRO-SPECT以生成风险约束规划方案。该算法同时支持离线规划与在线重规划，使协作团队能在保持风险约束的前提下适应环境扰动。我们提供了关于解可行性和时间复杂度的理论分析，并通过数值对比与仿真验证了方法的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a probabilistic safety-constrained planning algorithm for coordinated UAV-UGV teams, optimizing mission time under energy constraints with bounded failure risk.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协调无人机-无人车团队的概率安全规划算法，在能量约束和有限失败风险下优化任务时间。

title: HyVGGT-VO: Tightly Coupled Hybrid Dense Visual Odometry with Feed-Forward Models
summary: Dense visual odometry (VO), which provides pose estimation and dense 3D reconstruction, serves as the cornerstone for applications ranging from robotics to augmented reality. Recently, feed-forward models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in dense mapping. However, when these models are used in dense visual SLAM systems, their heavy computational burden restricts them to yielding sparse pose outputs at keyframes while still failing to achieve real-time pose estimation. In contrast, traditional sparse methods provide high computational efficiency and high-frequency pose outputs, but lack the capability for dense reconstruction. To address these limitations, we propose HyVGGT-VO, a novel framework that combines the computational efficiency of sparse VO with the dense reconstruction capabilities of feed-forward models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tightly couple a traditional VO framework with VGGT, a state-of-the-art feed-forward model. Specifically, we design an adaptive hybrid tracking frontend that dynamically switches between traditional optical flow and the VGGT tracking head to ensure robustness. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical optimization framework that jointly refines VO poses and the scale of VGGT predictions to ensure global scale consistency. Our approach achieves an approximately 5x processing speedup compared to existing VGGT-based methods, while reducing the average trajectory error by 85% on the indoor EuRoC dataset and 12% on the outdoor KITTI benchmark. Our code will be publicly available upon acceptance. Project page: https://geneta2580.github.io/HyVGGT-VO.io.
summary_zh: 密集视觉里程计（VO）能够提供姿态估计与稠密三维重建，是机器人到增强现实等应用的基石。近年来，前馈模型在稠密建图中展现出卓越性能。然而，当这些模型应用于密集视觉SLAM系统时，其沉重的计算负担使其仅能在关键帧输出稀疏姿态，仍无法实现实时姿态估计。相比之下，传统稀疏方法虽具备高计算效率与高频率姿态输出能力，却缺乏稠密重建功能。为克服这些局限，我们提出HyVGGT-VO——一种将稀疏VO的计算效率与前馈模型稠密重建能力相结合的新型框架。据我们所知，这是首个将传统VO框架与先进前馈模型VGGT进行紧密耦合的研究。具体而言，我们设计了自适应混合跟踪前端，可在传统光流与VGGT跟踪头之间动态切换以确保鲁棒性；此外，我们还构建了分层优化框架，通过联合优化VO姿态与VGGT预测尺度来保证全局尺度一致性。相较于现有基于VGGT的方法，我们的方案实现了约5倍的处理速度提升，在室内EuRoC数据集上平均轨迹误差降低85%，在室外KITTI基准测试中误差减少12%。代码将在论文录用后公开，项目页面：https://geneta2580.github.io/HyVGGT-VO.io。
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid visual odometry framework that combines the efficiency of sparse methods with the dense reconstruction capability of a feed-forward model (VGGT), achieving significant speedups and accuracy improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合视觉里程计框架，将稀疏方法的效率与前馈模型（VGGT）的密集重建能力相结合，实现了显著的加速和精度提升。

title: Smooth Feedback Motion Planning with Reduced Curvature
summary: Feedback motion planning over cell decompositions provides a robust method for generating collision-free robot motion with formal guarantees. However, existing algorithms often produce paths with unnecessary bending, leading to slower motion and higher control effort. This paper presents a computationally efficient method to mitigate this issue for a given simplicial decomposition. A heuristic is introduced that systematically aligns and assigns local vector fields to produce more direct trajectories, complemented by a novel geometric algorithm that constructs a maximal star-shaped chain of simplexes around the goal. This creates a large ``funnel'' in which an optimal, direct-to-goal control law can be safely applied. Simulations demonstrate that our method generates measurably more direct paths, reducing total bending by an average of 91.40\% and LQR control effort by an average of 45.47\%. Furthermore, comparative analysis against sampling-based and optimization-based planners confirms the time efficacy and robustness of our approach. While the proposed algorithms work over any finite-dimensional simplicial complex embedded in the collision-free subset of the configuration space, the practical application focuses on low-dimensional ($d\le3$) configuration spaces, where simplicial decomposition is computationally tractable.
summary_zh: 基于单元分解的反馈运动规划为生成具有形式化保证的无碰撞机器人运动提供了鲁棒方法。然而，现有算法常产生含不必要弯曲的路径，导致运动速度降低且控制能耗增加。本文针对给定单纯形分解提出一种计算高效的方法以缓解该问题。我们引入了一种启发式策略，通过系统性地对齐和分配局部向量场来生成更直接的轨迹，并结合一种新颖的几何算法构建目标点周围的最大星形单纯形链。这形成了一个巨大的“漏斗”区域，可在其中安全应用最优的直达目标控制律。仿真结果表明，本方法生成的路径显著更为直接，平均减少总弯曲度91.40%，平均降低LQR控制能耗45.47%。此外，与基于采样和基于优化的规划器进行的对比分析验证了本方法的时间效率与鲁棒性。虽然所提算法适用于构型空间无碰撞子集中嵌入的任意有限维单纯复形，但实际应用聚焦于低维（$d\le3$）构型空间，此类空间中的单纯形分解在计算上易于处理。
tldr: This paper presents a method for generating smoother and more direct feedback motion plans for robots in low-dimensional configuration spaces by using heuristic alignment and a novel geometric algorithm to reduce path curvature and control effort.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在低维构型空间中为机器人生成更平滑、更直接反馈运动规划的方法，通过启发式对齐和一种新颖的几何算法来减少路径曲率和控制能耗。

title: F3DGS: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Decentralized Multi-Agent World Modeling
summary: We present F3DGS, a federated 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for decentralized multi-agent 3D reconstruction. Existing 3DGS pipelines assume centralized access to all observations, which limits their applicability in distributed robotic settings where agents operate independently, and centralized data aggregation may be restricted. Directly extending centralized training to multi-agent systems introduces communication overhead and geometric inconsistency. F3DGS first constructs a shared geometric scaffold by registering locally merged LiDAR point clouds from multiple clients to initialize a global 3DGS model. During federated optimization, Gaussian positions are fixed to preserve geometric alignment, while each client updates only appearance-related attributes, including covariance, opacity, and spherical harmonic coefficients. The server aggregates these updates using visibility-aware aggregation, weighting each client's contribution by how frequently it observed each Gaussian, resolving the partial-observability challenge inherent to multi-agent exploration. To evaluate decentralized reconstruction, we collect a multi-sequence indoor dataset with synchronized LiDAR, RGB, and IMU measurements. Experiments show that F3DGS achieves reconstruction quality comparable to centralized training while enabling distributed optimization across agents. The dataset, development kit, and source code will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 本文提出了F3DGS，一种用于去中心化多智能体三维重建的联邦式三维高斯溅射框架。现有三维高斯溅射流程假设所有观测数据可集中访问，这在分布式机器人场景中存在局限性：智能体独立运行，且集中式数据聚合可能受限。将集中式训练直接扩展至多智能体系统会产生通信开销与几何不一致问题。F3DGS首先通过配准多个客户端局部融合的激光雷达点云构建共享几何框架，以此初始化全局三维高斯溅射模型。在联邦优化过程中，高斯位置保持固定以确保几何对齐，各客户端仅更新外观相关属性（包括协方差、不透明度与球谐系数）。服务器采用可见性感知聚合机制，依据各客户端观测每个高斯的频率对其贡献进行加权，从而解决多智能体探索中固有的部分可观测性挑战。为评估去中心化重建效果，我们收集了包含同步激光雷达、RGB与IMU测量的多序列室内数据集。实验表明，F3DGS在实现跨智能体分布式优化的同时，其重建质量可与集中式训练相媲美。该数据集、开发工具包及源代码将全部公开发布。
tldr: F3DGS is a federated learning framework for decentralized 3D reconstruction using 3D Gaussian Splatting, enabling multi-agent systems to collaboratively build a world model without centralizing data.
tldr_zh: F3DGS是一个用于分散式3D重建的联邦学习框架，基于3D高斯泼溅技术，使多智能体系统能在不集中数据的情况下协作构建世界模型。

title: Safety, Security, and Cognitive Risks in World Models
summary:
World models -- learned internal simulators of environment dynamics -- are rapidly becoming foundational to autonomous decision-making in robotics, autonomous vehicles, and agentic AI. Yet this predictive power introduces a distinctive set of safety, security, and cognitive risks. Adversaries can corrupt training data, poison latent representations, and exploit compounding rollout errors to cause catastrophic failures in safety-critical deployments. World model-equipped agents are more capable of goal misgeneralisation, deceptive alignment, and reward hacking precisely because they can simulate the consequences of their own actions. Authoritative world model predictions further foster automation bias and miscalibrated human trust that operators lack the tools to audit.
  This paper surveys the world model landscape; introduces formal definitions of trajectory persistence and representational risk; presents a five-profile attacker capability taxonomy; and develops a unified threat model extending MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10 to the world model stack. We provide an empirical proof-of-concept on trajectory-persistent adversarial attacks (GRU-RSSM: A_1 = 2.26x amplification, -59.5% reduction under adversarial fine-tuning; stochastic RSSM proxy: A_1 = 0.65x; DreamerV3 checkpoint: non-zero action drift confirmed). We illustrate risks through four deployment scenarios and propose interdisciplinary mitigations spanning adversarial hardening, alignment engineering, NIST AI RMF and EU AI Act governance, and human-factors design. We argue that world models must be treated as safety-critical infrastructure requiring the same rigour as flight-control software or medical devices.
summary_zh:
世界模型——一种学习而得的环境动态内部模拟器——正迅速成为机器人、自动驾驶汽车以及智能体人工智能自主决策的基础。然而，这种预测能力引入了一系列独特的安全、安保和认知风险。攻击者可能通过污染训练数据、毒化潜在表征、利用累积展开误差等方式，在安全关键型部署中引发灾难性故障。配备世界模型的智能体因其能够模拟自身行为的后果，更易产生目标误泛化、欺骗性对齐和奖励黑客攻击等问题。权威的世界模型预测会进一步加剧自动化偏见和人类信任误判，而操作者往往缺乏有效的审计工具。

本文系统梳理了世界模型的发展现状；提出了轨迹持久性和表征风险的形式化定义；建立了一个包含五类攻击者能力的分类体系；并开发了一个统一威胁模型，将MITRE ATLAS和OWASP LLM Top 10框架扩展至世界模型技术栈。我们通过轨迹持久性对抗攻击的实证概念验证（GRU-RSSM模型：A_1指标放大2.26倍，对抗性微调下性能降低59.5%；随机RSSM代理模型：A_1=0.65倍；DreamerV3检查点：确认存在非零动作偏移），在四个典型部署场景中具体阐释了相关风险。最后提出跨学科缓解方案，涵盖对抗性强化、对齐工程、NIST人工智能风险管理框架与欧盟人工智能法案治理、人因设计等领域。我们主张应将世界模型视为安全关键型基础设施，需采用与飞行控制软件或医疗设备同等严格的安全标准。
tldr: This paper surveys safety, security, and cognitive risks introduced by world models in autonomous systems, providing formal definitions, a threat model, and a proof-of-concept attack on these models.
tldr_zh: 本论文综述了自主系统中世界模型引入的安全性、安全性和认知风险，提供了正式定义、威胁模型以及对这些模型的概念验证攻击。

title: Lifting Unlabeled Internet-level Data for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Annotated 3D scene data is scarce and expensive to acquire, while abundant unlabeled videos are readily available on the internet. In this paper, we demonstrate that carefully designed data engines can leverage web-curated, unlabeled videos to automatically generate training data, to facilitate end-to-end models in 3D scene understanding alongside human-annotated datasets. We identify and analyze bottlenecks in automated data generation, revealing critical factors that determine the efficiency and effectiveness of learning from unlabeled data. To validate our approach across different perception granularities, we evaluate on three tasks spanning low-level perception, i.e., 3D object detection and instance segmentation, to high-evel reasoning, i.e., 3D spatial Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Vision-Lanugage Navigation (VLN). Models trained on our generated data demonstrate strong zero-shot performance and show further improvement after finetuning. This demonstrates the viability of leveraging readily available web data as a path toward more capable scene understanding systems.
summary_zh: 带标注的3D场景数据稀缺且获取成本高昂，而互联网上却存在大量易于获取的未标注视频。本文提出，通过精心设计的数据引擎能够利用网络收集的未标注视频自动生成训练数据，结合人工标注数据集共同提升端到端模型在3D场景理解中的表现。我们系统分析并识别了自动数据生成过程中的瓶颈问题，揭示了影响未标注数据学习效率与效果的关键因素。为验证本方法在不同感知粒度上的普适性，我们在从低级感知（3D目标检测与实例分割）到高级推理（3D空间视觉问答与视觉语言导航）的三类任务上进行了全面评估。使用生成数据训练的模型展现出强大的零样本性能，并在微调后获得进一步提升。这表明利用现成的网络数据构建更强场景理解系统具有切实可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to generate 3D scene understanding training data automatically from unlabeled internet videos, evaluating it on tasks including 3D object detection and Vision-Language Navigation (VLN).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从未标记的互联网视频中自动生成3D场景理解训练数据的方法，并在3D物体检测和视觉语言导航等任务上进行了评估。

title: Tex3D: Objects as Attack Surfaces via Adversarial 3D Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to physically realizable adversarial attacks remains underexplored. Existing studies reveal vulnerabilities through language perturbations and 2D visual attacks, but these attack surfaces are either less representative of real deployment or limited in physical realism. In contrast, adversarial 3D textures pose a more physically plausible and damaging threat, as they are naturally attached to manipulated objects and are easier to deploy in physical environments. Bringing adversarial 3D textures to VLA systems is nevertheless nontrivial. A central obstacle is that standard 3D simulators do not provide a differentiable optimization path from the VLA objective function back to object appearance, making it difficult to optimize through an end-to-end manner. To address this, we introduce Foreground-Background Decoupling (FBD), which enables differentiable texture optimization through dual-renderer alignment while preserving the original simulation environment. To further ensure that the attack remains effective across long-horizon and diverse viewpoints in the physical world, we propose Trajectory-Aware Adversarial Optimization (TAAO), which prioritizes behaviorally critical frames and stabilizes optimization with a vertex-based parameterization. Built on these designs, we present Tex3D, the first framework for end-to-end optimization of 3D adversarial textures directly within the VLA simulation environment. Experiments in both simulation and real-robot settings show that Tex3D significantly degrades VLA performance across multiple manipulation tasks, achieving task failure rates of up to 96.7\%. Our empirical results expose critical vulnerabilities of VLA systems to physically grounded 3D adversarial attacks and highlight the need for robustness-aware training.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型在机器人操控任务中展现出强大性能，但其对物理可实现的对抗性攻击的鲁棒性仍未得到充分探索。现有研究主要通过语言扰动和二维视觉攻击揭示其脆弱性，但这些攻击方式要么难以反映真实部署场景，要么缺乏物理现实性。相比之下，对抗性三维纹理因其能自然附着于被操控物体表面，且更容易在物理环境中部署，构成了一种更具物理合理性与破坏性的威胁。然而，将对抗性三维纹理引入视觉-语言-行动系统面临关键挑战：标准三维模拟器无法提供从模型目标函数到物体外观的可微分优化路径，导致难以实现端到端优化。为此，我们提出前景-背景解耦方法，通过双渲染器对齐实现可微分纹理优化，同时保持原始模拟环境不变。为进一步确保攻击在物理世界的长时序任务与多视角变化中持续有效，我们提出轨迹感知对抗优化，通过行为关键帧优先机制与基于顶点的参数化方法稳定优化过程。基于这些设计，我们构建了Tex3D框架——首个能在视觉-语言-行动模拟环境中直接实现三维对抗纹理端到端优化的系统。模拟与真实机器人实验表明，Tex3D能在多种操控任务中显著降低模型性能，最高可使任务失败率达到96.7%。实证结果揭示了视觉-语言-行动系统对物理三维对抗攻击的关键脆弱性，并强调了鲁棒性训练的必要性。
tldr: Tex3D introduces a framework for generating physically realizable 3D adversarial textures that degrade Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model performance in robotic manipulation tasks, highlighting vulnerabilities in safety-critical systems.
tldr_zh: Tex3D提出了一种框架，用于生成物理上可实现的3D对抗性纹理，以降低视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中的性能，揭示了安全关键系统中的脆弱性。

title: Realistic Lip Motion Generation Based on 3D Dynamic Viseme and Coarticulation Modeling for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Realistic lip synchronization is essential for the natural human-robot non-verbal interaction of humanoid robots. Motivated by this need, this paper presents a lip motion generation framework based on 3D dynamic viseme and coarticulation modeling. By analyzing Chinese pronunciation theory, a 3D dynamic viseme library is constructed based on the ARKit standard, which offers coherent prior trajectories of lips. To resolve motion conflicts within continuous speech streams, a coarticulation mechanism is developed by incorporating initial-final (Shengmu-Yunmu) decoupling and energy modulation. After developing a strategy to retarget high-dimensional spatial lip motion to a 14-DOF lip actuation system of a humanoid head platform, the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed architecture is experimentally validated and demonstrated with quantitative ablation experiments using the metrics of the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and the Mean Absolute Jerk (MAJ). This research offers a lightweight, efficient, and highly practical paradigm for the speech-driven lip motion generation of humanoid robots. The 3D dynamic viseme library and real-world deployment videos are available at {https://github.com/yuesheng21/Phoneme-to-Lip-14DOF}
summary_zh: 逼真的唇部同步对于人形机器人自然的人机非语言交互至关重要。基于此需求，本文提出了一种基于三维动态视位模型与协同发音建模的唇部运动生成框架。通过分析汉语发音理论，构建了基于ARKit标准的三维动态视位库，该库提供了连贯的唇部先验轨迹。为解决连续语音流中的运动冲突，我们通过引入声韵母解耦与能量调制机制构建了协同发音模型。在开发了将高维空间唇部运动映射至人形机器人头部平台14自由度唇部驱动系统的重定向策略后，通过皮尔逊相关系数（PCC）和平均绝对加加速度（MAJ）指标的定量消融实验，验证并展示了所提出架构的效能与准确性。本研究为人形机器人的语音驱动唇部运动生成提供了一种轻量化、高效且具备高度实用性的范式。三维动态视位库及实际部署视频已发布于{https://github.com/yuesheng21/Phoneme-to-Lip-14DOF}。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for generating realistic lip motion on humanoid robots using 3D dynamic visemes and coarticulation modeling, specifically for Chinese speech. It is a technical solution for robot control (facial actuation) in a human-robot interaction context.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D动态视素和协同发音建模的框架，专门用于为仿人机器人（在中文语境下）生成逼真的唇部运动，以实现自然的人机非语言交互。

title: Not All Tokens See Equally: Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: While Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has advanced reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), prevailing frameworks suffer from a foundational methodological flaw: by distributing identical advantages across all generated tokens, these methods inherently dilute the learning signals essential for optimizing the critical, visually-grounded steps of multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we formulate \textit{Token Visual Dependency}, quantifying the causal information gain of visual inputs via the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between visual-conditioned and text-only predictive distributions. Revealing that this dependency is highly sparse and semantically pivotal, we introduce Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization (PGPO), which is a novel fine-grained credit assignment framework that dynamically reshapes advantages at the token level. Through a threshold-gated, mass-conserving mechanism, PGPO actively amplifies learning signals for visually-dependent tokens while suppressing gradient noise from linguistic priors. Extensive experiments based on the Qwen2.5-VL series across seven challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PGPO boosts models by 18.7% on average. Both theoretical and empirical analyses confirm that PGPO effectively reduces gradient variance, prevents training collapse, and acts as a potent regularizer for robust, perception-grounded multimodal reasoning. Code will be published on https://github.com/Yzk1114/PGPO.
summary_zh: 摘要：尽管基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在推理能力上的进步，但当前主流框架存在一个根本性方法缺陷：通过在所有生成的令牌上分配相同的优势值，这些方法本质上稀释了优化多模态推理中关键视觉基础步骤所必需的学习信号。为弥补这一差距，我们提出“令牌视觉依赖度”的概念，通过视觉条件与纯文本预测分布之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度来量化视觉输入带来的因果信息增益。研究发现这种依赖具有高度稀疏性和语义关键性，据此我们提出感知基础策略优化（PGPO）——一种新颖的细粒度信用分配框架，可在令牌层面动态重塑优势值。通过阈值门控的质量守恒机制，PGPO主动增强对视觉依赖令牌的学习信号，同时抑制来自语言先验的梯度噪声。基于Qwen2.5-VL系列模型在七个具有挑战性的多模态推理基准上进行的广泛实验表明，PGPO平均提升模型性能达18.7%。理论与实证分析均证实，PGPO能有效降低梯度方差、防止训练崩溃，并作为强效正则化器促进鲁棒且感知基础的多模态推理。代码将发布于https://github.com/Yzk1114/PGPO。
tldr: This paper introduces Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization (PGPO), a novel credit assignment method that dynamically reshapes reinforcement learning advantages at the token level for large vision-language models to improve multimodal reasoning by focusing on visually-dependent tokens.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种感知驱动的策略优化方法（PGPO），通过动态调整标记层面的强化学习优势，以改进大型视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力，重点关注视觉相关的标记。

title: LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning via a Latent-Space Unified Model
summary: Unified models (UMs) hold promise for their ability to understand and generate content across heterogeneous modalities. Compared to merely generating visual content, the use of UMs for interleaved cross-modal reasoning is more promising and valuable, e.g., for solving understanding problems that require dense visual thinking, improving visual generation through self-reflection, or modeling visual dynamics of the physical world guided by stepwise action interventions. However, existing UMs necessitate pixel decoding as a bridge due to their disjoint visual representations for understanding and generation, which is both ineffective and inefficient. In this paper, we introduce LatentUM, a novel unified model that represents all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating the need for pixel-space mediation between visual understanding and generation. This design naturally enables flexible interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation. Beyond improved computational efficiency, the shared representation substantially alleviates codec bias and strengthens cross-modal alignment, allowing LatentUM to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the Visual Spatial Planning benchmark, push the limits of visual generation through self-reflection, and support world modeling by predicting future visual states within the shared semantic latent space.
summary_zh: 统一模型（UMs）因其理解和生成跨异构模态内容的能力而展现出广阔前景。与仅生成视觉内容相比，利用UM进行交错式跨模态推理更具前景和价值，例如解决需要密集视觉思维的理解问题、通过自我反思改进视觉生成，或在逐步行动干预的引导下对物理世界的视觉动态进行建模。然而，现有UM由于在理解和生成任务中采用分离的视觉表示，必须依赖像素解码作为桥梁，这既低效又缺乏灵活性。本文提出LatentUM，一种新颖的统一模型，它将所有模态表示在共享的语义潜在空间中，从而消除了视觉理解与生成之间对像素空间中介的需求。这一设计天然支持灵活的交错式跨模态推理与生成。除了提升计算效率外，共享表示显著减轻了编解码偏差并强化了跨模态对齐，使得LatentUM在视觉空间规划基准测试中达到最优性能，通过自我反思突破视觉生成的边界，并能在共享语义潜在空间内预测未来视觉状态以支持世界建模。
tldr: LatentUM is a unified model using a shared semantic latent space to enable efficient interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation, claiming state-of-the-art performance on visual spatial planning and potential for world modeling.
tldr_zh: LatentUM是一种在共享语义潜在空间中实现跨模态推理与生成的统一模型，宣称在视觉空间规划任务中达到SOTA性能，并具有世界建模的潜力。

title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Control under Time-Varying Dynamics
summary: Learning-based control methods typically assume stationary system dynamics, an assumption often violated in real-world systems due to drift, wear, or changing operating conditions. We study reinforcement learning for control under time-varying dynamics. We consider a continual model-based reinforcement learning setting in which an agent repeatedly learns and controls a dynamical system whose transition dynamics evolve across episodes. We analyze the problem using Gaussian process dynamics models under frequentist variation-budget assumptions. Our analysis shows that persistent non-stationarity requires explicitly limiting the influence of outdated data to maintain calibrated uncertainty and meaningful dynamic regret guarantees. Motivated by these insights, we propose a practical optimistic model-based reinforcement learning algorithm with adaptive data buffer mechanisms and demonstrate improved performance on continuous control benchmarks with non-stationary dynamics.
summary_zh: 基于学习型控制方法通常假设系统动力学是静态的，这一假设在实际系统中常因系统漂移、磨损或运行条件变化而失效。我们研究了时变动力学条件下的强化学习控制问题，考虑一种持续的基于模型强化学习场景：智能体需反复学习并控制一个其状态转移动力学随任务周期不断演变的动态系统。通过采用高斯过程动力学模型并在频率学派变化预算假设下进行分析，我们发现持续性非平稳特征要求明确限制过时数据的影响，以保持校准化的不确定性度量并实现有效的动态遗憾保证。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种具有自适应数据缓冲机制的实用型乐观模型强化学习算法，并在具有非平稳动力学特征的连续控制基准测试中验证了其性能提升。
tldr: The paper proposes a model-based reinforcement learning algorithm for control tasks with non-stationary system dynamics, using Gaussian process models and an adaptive data buffer mechanism to handle time-varying dynamics across episodes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于处理非平稳系统动态控制任务的基于模型的强化学习算法，使用高斯过程模型和自适应数据缓冲机制来处理不同时间段的动态变化。

title: Integrated Identification of Collaborative Robots for Robot Assisted 3D Printing Processes
summary: In recent years, the integration of additive manufacturing (AM) and industrial robotics has opened new perspectives for the production of complex components, particularly in the automotive sector. Robot-assisted additive manufacturing processes overcome the dimensional and kinematic limitations of traditional Cartesian systems, enabling non-planar deposition and greater geometric flexibility. However, the increasing dynamic complexity of robotic manipulators introduces challenges related to precision, control, and error prediction. This work proposes a model-based approach equipped with an integrated identification procedure of the system's parameters, including the robot, the actuators and the controllers. We show that the integrated modeling procedure allows to obtain a reliable dynamic model even in the presence of sensory and programming limitations typical of collaborative robots. The manipulator's dynamic model is identified through an integrated five step methodology: starting with geometric and inertial analysis, followed by friction and controller parameters identification, all the way to the remaining parameters identification. The proposed procedure intrinsically ensures the physical consistency of the identified parameters. The identification approach is validated on a real world case study involving a 6-Degrees-Of-Freedom (DoFs) collaborative robot used in a thermoplastic extrusion process. The very good matching between the experimental results given by actual robot and those given by the identified model shows the potential enhancement of precision, control, and error prediction in Robot Assisted 3D Printing Processes.
summary_zh: 近年来，增材制造与工业机器人技术的融合为复杂构件（尤其是汽车领域）的生产开辟了新的前景。机器人辅助增材制造工艺克服了传统笛卡尔系统在尺寸和运动学上的局限性，实现了非平面材料沉积并提升了几何灵活性。然而，机器人操纵器日益增长的动态复杂性给精度控制、运动控制及误差预测带来了挑战。本研究提出一种基于模型的系统化方法，并配备了集成式系统参数识别流程，涵盖机器人本体、执行器及控制器模块。研究表明，即使在协作机器人普遍存在的传感与编程限制条件下，该集成建模方法仍能构建可靠的动态模型。机器人动态模型的识别通过集成化五步法实现：从几何与惯性分析开始，逐步完成摩擦参数识别、控制器参数识别，直至剩余参数的全方位辨识。该方法从本质上保证了识别参数的物理一致性。识别流程在一个真实案例研究中得到验证，该案例涉及一台用于热塑性挤出工艺的六自由度协作机器人。实际机器人实验结果与识别模型输出结果的高度吻合，证明了该方法在机器人辅助3D打印过程中提升精度控制、运动控制及误差预测能力的巨大潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a model-based identification procedure for the dynamic parameters of a collaborative robot used in a 3D printing process, aiming to improve control and precision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协作机器人（用于3D打印过程）动力学参数的基于模型的辨识方法，旨在提高控制精度和误差预测能力。

title: DriveDreamer-Policy: A Geometry-Grounded World-Action Model for Unified Generation and Planning
summary: Recently, world-action models (WAM) have emerged to bridge vision-language-action (VLA) models and world models, unifying their reasoning and instruction-following capabilities and spatio-temporal world modeling. However, existing WAM approaches often focus on modeling 2D appearance or latent representations, with limited geometric grounding-an essential element for embodied systems operating in the physical world. We present DriveDreamer-Policy, a unified driving world-action model that integrates depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning within a single modular architecture. The model employs a large language model to process language instructions, multi-view images, and actions, followed by three lightweight generators that produce depth, future video, and actions. By learning a geometry-aware world representation and using it to guide both future prediction and planning within a unified framework, the proposed model produces more coherent imagined futures and more informed driving actions, while maintaining modularity and controllable latency. Experiments on the Navsim v1 and v2 benchmarks demonstrate that DriveDreamer-Policy achieves strong performance on both closed-loop planning and world generation tasks. In particular, our model reaches 89.2 PDMS on Navsim v1 and 88.7 EPDMS on Navsim v2, outperforming existing world-model-based approaches while producing higher-quality future video and depth predictions. Ablation studies further show that explicit depth learning provides complementary benefits to video imagination and improves planning robustness.
summary_zh: 近年来，世界行动模型（WAM）应运而生，旨在连接视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型与世界模型，统一其推理与指令遵循能力以及时空世界建模能力。然而，现有WAM方法多聚焦于二维外观或潜在表征建模，对几何基础——这一在物理世界中运行的具身系统关键要素——的关注较为有限。本文提出DriveDreamer-Policy，一种统一的驾驶世界行动模型，将深度生成、未来视频生成与运动规划集成于单一模块化架构中。该模型采用大型语言模型处理语言指令、多视角图像与动作序列，随后通过三个轻量级生成器分别产生深度信息、未来视频与动作决策。通过习得几何感知的世界表征，并利用其在统一框架中指导未来预测与规划，本模型能够生成更连贯的想象未来场景与更具前瞻性的驾驶行为，同时保持模块化特性与可控延迟。在Navsim v1与v2基准测试上的实验表明，DriveDreamer-Policy在闭环规划与世界生成任务上均表现出强劲性能。特别地，我们的模型在Navsim v1上达到89.2 PDMS，在Navsim v2上达到88.7 EPDMS，其性能优于现有基于世界模型的方法，同时能生成更高质量的未来视频与深度预测。消融研究进一步证明，显式深度学习为视频想象提供互补性增益，并提升了规划鲁棒性。
tldr: DriveDreamer-Policy is a unified driving world-action model that integrates depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning within a single modular architecture, using a geometry-aware world representation to guide future prediction and action planning.
tldr_zh: DriveDreamer-Policy是一个统一的驾驶世界-动作模型，它将深度生成、未来视频生成和运动规划集成在一个模块化架构中，利用几何感知的世界表征来指导未来预测和动作规划。

title: A soft and lightweight fabric-based pneumatic interface for multimodal fingertip tactile feedback
summary: Wearable fingertip haptic devices are critical for realistic interaction in virtual reality, augmented reality, and teleoperation, yet existing approaches struggle to simultaneously achieve adequate tactile output, low mass, simple fabrication, and untethered portability. Here we show that fabric-based pneumatic actuation can address this gap. Our device comprises four pneumatic chambers fabricated from thermoplastic polyurethane-coated fabric via computer numerical control heat-sealing, yielding a soft, conformable interface weighing 2.1 g that operates untethered with a wrist-mounted control unit. Mechanical and dynamic characterization confirms that the fabric actuators produce sufficient force, displacement, and bandwidth for fingertip tactile rendering. A psychophysical study with 15 participants demonstrates classification accuracy exceeding 90% across three distinct tactile modes -- contact configuration, directional sliding, and vibrotactile frequency. These findings establish fabric-based pneumatic actuation as a viable technology route for lightweight, low-cost, and multimodal fingertip haptic interfaces.
summary_zh: 可穿戴指尖触觉设备对于虚拟现实、增强现实及遥操作中的真实交互至关重要，但现有技术难以同时实现充足的触觉输出、轻量化、简易制造和无束缚便携性。本研究证明基于织物的气动驱动技术能够填补这一空白。该设备由四个气动腔室构成，采用热塑性聚氨酯涂层织物通过计算机数控热封工艺制造，形成仅重2.1克的柔软适形界面，配合腕戴式控制单元实现无线操作。机械与动态特性表征证实，织物致动器能产生满足指尖触觉渲染所需的足够力度、位移与带宽。一项包含15名参与者的心理物理学研究表明，在接触构型、定向滑动和振动触觉频率三种不同触觉模式下，被试者的分类准确率均超过90%。这些发现确立了基于织物的气动驱动技术可作为实现轻量化、低成本、多模态指尖触觉界面的可行技术路径。
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight, fabric-based pneumatic haptic interface for the fingertip, designed for VR/AR and teleoperation. It demonstrates high classification accuracy across multiple tactile feedback modes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于织物的轻量级气动指尖触觉接口，用于VR/AR和遥操作，并在多种触觉反馈模式下展示了高分类准确性。

title: Open-loop POMDP Simplification and Safe Skipping of Replanning with Formal Performance Guarantees
summary: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) provide a principled mathematical framework for decision-making under uncertainty. However, the exact solution to POMDPs is computationally intractable. In this paper, we address the computational intractability by introducing a novel framework for adaptive open-loop simplification with formal performance guarantees. Our method adaptively interleaves open-loop and closed-loop planning via a topology-based belief tree, enabling a significant reduction in planning complexity. The key contribution lies in the derivation of efficiently computable bounds which provide formal guarantees and can be used to ensure that our simplification can identify the immediate optimal action of the original POMDP problem. Our framework therefore provides computationally tractable performance guarantees for macro-actions within POMDPs. Furthermore, we propose a novel framework for safely skipping replanning during execution, supported by theoretical guarantees on multi-step open-loop action sequences. To the best of our knowledge, this framework is the first to address skipping replanning with formal performance guarantees. Practical online solvers for our proposed simplification are developed, including a sampling-based solver and an anytime solver. Empirical results demonstrate substantial computational speedups while maintaining provable performance guarantees, advancing the tractability and efficiency of POMDP planning.
summary_zh: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为不确定性环境下的决策问题提供了严谨的数学框架。然而，求解POMDP的精确解在计算上是不可行的。本文通过提出一种具有形式化性能保证的自适应开环简化框架，以应对计算复杂性问题。该方法通过基于拓扑的信念树自适应地交织开环与闭环规划，从而显著降低规划复杂度。核心贡献在于推导出可高效计算的边界条件，这些边界不仅提供形式化保证，还能确保我们的简化方法能识别原始POMDP问题的最优即时动作。因此，本框架为POMDP中的宏动作提供了可计算处理的性能保证。此外，我们提出了一种在执行阶段安全跳过重规划的新框架，该框架通过理论保证支持多步开环动作序列的可靠性。据我们所知，这是首个通过形式化性能保证解决重规划跳过问题的框架。针对所提出的简化方法，我们开发了实用的在线求解器，包括基于采样的求解器和任意时间求解器。实验结果表明，在保持可证明性能保证的同时，该方法实现了显著的计算加速，从而推进了POMDP规划的可处理性与效率。
tldr: Proposes a framework for adaptively simplifying POMDP planning by interleaving open-loop and closed-loop methods, with theoretical performance guarantees and techniques to skip replanning, aiming to improve computational tractability.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个POMDP规划自适应简化框架，通过交错开环和闭环规划，并带有理论性能保证和跳过重规划的技术，旨在提高计算可行性。

title: ActionParty: Multi-Subject Action Binding in Generative Video Games
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion have enabled the development of "world models" capable of simulating interactive environments. However, these models are largely restricted to single-agent settings, failing to control multiple agents simultaneously in a scene. In this work, we tackle a fundamental issue of action binding in existing video diffusion models, which struggle to associate specific actions with their corresponding subjects. For this purpose, we propose ActionParty, an action controllable multi-subject world model for generative video games. It introduces subject state tokens, i.e. latent variables that persistently capture the state of each subject in the scene. By jointly modeling state tokens and video latents with a spatial biasing mechanism, we disentangle global video frame rendering from individual action-controlled subject updates. We evaluate ActionParty on the Melting Pot benchmark, demonstrating the first video world model capable of controlling up to seven players simultaneously across 46 diverse environments. Our results show significant improvements in action-following accuracy and identity consistency, while enabling robust autoregressive tracking of subjects through complex interactions.
summary_zh: 近年来视频扩散模型的进展使得能够模拟交互环境的"世界模型"得以发展。然而，这些模型大多局限于单智能体场景，无法同时控制场景中的多个智能体。本文针对现有视频扩散模型中动作绑定的基础性问题展开研究，这些模型难以将特定动作与其对应的主体进行关联。为此，我们提出ActionParty——一种面向生成式视频游戏的动作可控多主体世界模型。该模型引入了主体状态标记，即持续捕捉场景中每个主体状态的潜在变量。通过结合空间偏置机制对状态标记和视频潜在表示进行联合建模，我们实现了全局视频帧渲染与个体动作控制的主体更新之间的解耦。在Melting Pot基准测试中，ActionParty展示了首个能够同时控制多达七个智能体、覆盖46种不同环境的视频世界模型。实验结果表明，该方法在动作执行准确性和身份一致性方面取得显著提升，同时能够通过复杂交互实现鲁棒的自回归主体追踪。
tldr: ActionParty is a video diffusion world model that introduces subject state tokens and a spatial biasing mechanism to enable multi-subject action control in generative video games, improving action-following and identity consistency in complex environments.
tldr_zh: ActionParty 是一种视频扩散世界模型，通过引入主体状态标记和空间偏置机制，在生成式视频游戏中实现多主体动作控制，在复杂交互环境中显著提升了动作跟随准确性和身份一致性。

title: Steerable Visual Representations
summary: Pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) such as DINOv2 and MAE provide generic image features that can be applied to a variety of downstream tasks such as retrieval, classification, and segmentation. However, such representations tend to focus on the most salient visual cues in the image, with no way to direct them toward less prominent concepts of interest. In contrast, Multimodal LLMs can be guided with textual prompts, but the resulting representations tend to be language-centric and lose their effectiveness for generic visual tasks. To address this, we introduce Steerable Visual Representations, a new class of visual representations, whose global and local features can be steered with natural language. While most vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) fuse text with visual features after encoding (late fusion), we inject text directly into the layers of the visual encoder (early fusion) via lightweight cross-attention. We introduce benchmarks for measuring representational steerability, and demonstrate that our steerable visual features can focus on any desired objects in an image while preserving the underlying representation quality. Our method also matches or outperforms dedicated approaches on anomaly detection and personalized object discrimination, exhibiting zero-shot generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.
summary_zh: 诸如DINOv2和MAE等预训练的视觉变换器（ViTs）能够提供适用于多种下游任务（如检索、分类和分割）的通用图像特征。然而，这些表征往往聚焦于图像中最显著的视觉线索，无法引导其关注那些不显著但感兴趣的概念。相比之下，多模态大语言模型（LLMs）可以通过文本提示进行引导，但由此产生的表征往往以语言为中心，在通用视觉任务中失去其有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可引导的视觉表征，这是一种新型视觉表征方法，其全局和局部特征均可通过自然语言进行引导。大多数视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在编码后融合文本与视觉特征（后期融合），而我们的方法则通过轻量级跨注意力机制，将文本直接注入视觉编码器的各层中（早期融合）。我们引入了用于衡量表征可引导性的基准测试，并证明我们的可引导视觉特征能够在保持底层表征质量的同时，聚焦于图像中任意指定的目标对象。此外，我们的方法在异常检测和个性化对象判别等任务上，与专用方法的表现相当或更优，并展现出对分布外任务的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: This paper introduces Steerable Visual Representations, which use early text injection via cross-attention to allow natural language to steer the global and local features of a visual encoder, enabling focus on less prominent image concepts while preserving generic visual task performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种可引导的视觉表示方法，通过跨注意力的早期文本注入，使自然语言能够引导视觉编码器的全局和局部特征，从而聚焦于图像中不太显著的概念，同时保持通用视觉任务的性能。

title: Leveraging the Value of Information in POMDP Planning
summary: Partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) offer a principled formalism for planning under state and transition uncertainty. Despite advances made towards solving large POMDPs, obtaining performant policies under limited planning time remains a major challenge due to the curse of dimensionality and the curse of history. For many POMDP problems, the value of information (VOI) - the expected performance gain from reasoning about observations - varies over the belief space. We introduce a dynamic programming framework that exploits this structure by conditionally processing observations based on the value of information at each belief. Building on this framework, we propose Value of Information Monte Carlo planning (VOIMCP), a Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm that allocates computational effort more efficiently by selectively disregarding observation information when the VOI is low, avoiding unnecessary branching of observations. We provide theoretical guarantees on the near-optimality of our VOI reasoning framework and derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds for VOIMCP. Simulation evaluations demonstrate that VOIMCP outperforms baselines on several POMDP benchmarks.
summary_zh: 部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为状态和转移不确定性下的规划提供了一种原则性的形式化方法。尽管在求解大规模POMDPs方面已取得进展，但由于维数灾难和历史灾难，在有限规划时间内获得高性能策略仍是一个主要挑战。对于许多POMDP问题，信息价值（VOI）——即通过观测推理所能获得的预期性能增益——会随信念空间的变化而不同。本文提出一种动态规划框架，该框架通过基于各信念点的信息价值有条件地处理观测数据，从而利用这一结构特性。在此框架基础上，我们进一步提出信息价值蒙特卡洛规划算法（VOIMCP），这是一种蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，通过在信息价值较低时有选择地忽略观测信息，避免不必要的观测分支，从而更高效地分配计算资源。我们为信息价值推理框架提供了理论上的近最优性保证，并推导出VOIMCP的非渐近收敛界。仿真评估表明，在多个POMDP基准测试中，VOIMCP均优于基线方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel POMDP planning algorithm called VOIMCP that dynamically allocates computational effort based on the value of information, reducing unnecessary observation branching to improve planning efficiency under limited time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的POMDP规划算法VOIMCP，该算法基于信息价值动态分配计算资源，通过减少不必要的观测分支来提高有限时间内的规划效率。

title: A3R: Agentic Affordance Reasoning via Cross-Dimensional Evidence in 3D Gaussian Scenes
summary: Affordance reasoning in 3D Gaussian scenes aims to identify the region that supports the action specified by a given text instruction in complex environments. Existing methods typically cast this problem as one-shot prediction from static scene observations, assuming sufficient evidence is already available for reasoning. However, in complex 3D scenes, many failure cases arise not from weak prediction capacity, but from incomplete task-relevant evidence under fixed observations. To address this limitation, we reformulate fine-grained affordance reasoning as a sequential evidence acquisition process, where ambiguity is progressively reduced through complementary 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence. Building on this formulation, we propose A3R, an agentic affordance reasoning framework that enables an MLLM-based policy to iteratively select evidence acquisition actions and update the affordance belief through cross-dimensional evidence acquisition. To optimize such sequential decision making, we further introduce a GRPO-based policy learning strategy that improves evidence acquisition efficiency and reasoning accuracy. Extensive experiments on scene-level benchmarks show that A3R consistently surpasses static one-shot baselines, demonstrating the advantage of agentic cross-dimensional evidence acquisition for fine-grained affordance reasoning in complex 3D Gaussian scenes.
summary_zh: 三维高斯场景中的可供性推理旨在识别复杂环境中支持给定文本指令所指定动作的区域。现有方法通常将这一问题视为基于静态场景观测的一次性预测，假定已有足够证据支撑推理。然而，在复杂三维场景中，许多失败案例并非源于预测能力不足，而是由于固定观测条件下任务相关证据的缺失。为突破这一局限，我们将细粒度可供性推理重新定义为序列化证据获取过程：通过互补的三维几何证据与二维语义证据逐步消解歧义。基于此框架，我们提出A3R——一种能动的可供性推理框架，其基于多模态大语言模型的策略模块可迭代选择证据获取动作，并通过跨维度证据采集持续更新可供性认知。为进一步优化序列决策过程，我们引入基于GRPO的策略学习策略，显著提升证据获取效率与推理精度。在场景级基准测试上的大量实验表明，A3R持续超越静态一次性预测基线，验证了能动跨维度证据获取机制在复杂三维高斯场景中实现细粒度可供性推理的优越性。
tldr: The paper proposes A3R, an agentic framework that uses an MLLM-based policy to iteratively acquire 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence for fine-grained affordance reasoning in 3D Gaussian scenes, improving over static one-shot prediction methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出A3R，一种基于MLLM策略的智能框架，通过迭代获取三维几何和二维语义证据，在复杂三维高斯场景中执行精细的物性推理，优于静态的一步预测方法。

title: MonoSAOD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Sparsely Annotated Label
summary: Monocular 3D object detection has achieved impressive performance on densely annotated datasets. However, it struggles when only a fraction of objects are labeled due to the high cost of 3D annotation. This sparsely annotated setting is common in real-world scenarios where annotating every object is impractical. To address this, we propose a novel framework for sparsely annotated monocular 3D object detection with two key modules. First, we propose Road-Aware Patch Augmentation (RAPA), which leverages sparse annotations by augmenting segmented object patches onto road regions while preserving 3D geometric consistency. Second, we propose Prototype-Based Filtering (PBF), which generates high-quality pseudo-labels by filtering predictions through prototype similarity and depth uncertainty. It maintains global 2D RoI feature prototypes and selects pseudo-labels that are both feature-consistent with learned prototypes and have reliable depth estimates. Our training strategy combines geometry-preserving augmentation with prototype-guided pseudo-labeling to achieve robust detection under sparse supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The source code is available at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoSAOD .
summary_zh: 单目3D目标检测在密集标注数据集上取得了显著性能。然而，由于3D标注成本高昂，当仅部分物体被标注时，该技术面临挑战。这种稀疏标注的场景在现实世界中十分常见，因为对每个物体进行标注并不现实。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的稀疏标注单目3D目标检测框架，包含两个核心模块。首先，我们提出了道路感知补丁增强模块，通过将分割出的物体补丁增强到道路区域并保持3D几何一致性，从而有效利用稀疏标注。其次，我们提出了原型过滤模块，通过原型相似性和深度不确定性过滤预测结果，生成高质量伪标签。该模块维护全局二维感兴趣区域特征原型，并筛选出既与学习到的原型特征一致，又具有可靠深度估计的伪标签。我们的训练策略将几何保持增强与原型引导的伪标签生成相结合，实现了稀疏监督下的鲁棒检测。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。源代码已公开于https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoSAOD。
tldr: A novel method for monocular 3D object detection using sparse annotations, featuring geometry-preserving data augmentation and prototype-guided pseudo-labeling.
tldr_zh: 一种利用稀疏标注的端到端单目3D目标检测新方法，提出了几何感知数据增强和原型引导伪标签生成两大模块，以降低标注成本。

title: EgoFlow: Gradient-Guided Flow Matching for Egocentric 6DoF Object Motion Generation
summary: Understanding and predicting object motion from egocentric video is fundamental to embodied perception and interaction. However, generating physically consistent 6DoF trajectories remains challenging due to occlusions, fast motion, and the lack of explicit physical reasoning in existing generative models. We present EgoFlow, a flow-matching framework that synthesizes realistic and physically plausible trajectories conditioned on multimodal egocentric observations. EgoFlow employs a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver architecture to jointly model temporal dynamics, scene geometry, and semantic intent, while a gradient-guided inference process enforces differentiable physical constraints such as collision avoidance and motion smoothness. This combination yields coherent and controllable motion generation without post-hoc filtering or additional supervision. Experiments on real-world datasets HD-EPIC, EgoExo4D, and HOT3D show that EgoFlow outperforms diffusion-based and transformer baselines in accuracy, generalization, and physical realism, reducing collision rates by up to 79%, and strong generalization to unseen scenes. Our results highlight the promise of flow-based generative modeling for scalable and physically grounded egocentric motion understanding.
summary_zh: 从以自我为中心的视角理解和预测物体运动是具身感知与交互的基础任务。然而，由于遮挡、快速运动以及现有生成模型缺乏显式物理推理，生成物理一致的六自由度轨迹仍面临挑战。我们提出EgoFlow——一种基于流匹配的框架，能够通过多模态第一视角观测合成真实且物理合理的运动轨迹。该框架采用混合式Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构，联合建模时序动态、场景几何与语义意图，同时通过梯度引导的推理过程强化可微分物理约束（如避障和运动平滑性）。这种设计实现了连贯可控的运动生成，无需后验滤波或额外监督。在真实世界数据集HD-EPIC、EgoExo4D和HOT3D上的实验表明，EgoFlow在准确性、泛化性和物理真实性方面均优于基于扩散模型和Transformer的基线方法，碰撞率降低最高达79%，并在未见场景中表现出强泛化能力。本研究成果揭示了基于流的生成模型在可扩展且具有物理基础的自我中心运动理解方面的巨大潜力。
tldr: EgoFlow is a flow-matching framework for generating physically plausible 6DoF object trajectories from egocentric video, using a hybrid architecture and gradient-guided inference to enforce physical constraints.
tldr_zh: EgoFlow 是一个流匹配框架，用于从第一人称视角视频生成物理上合理的 6DoF 物体轨迹，采用混合架构和梯度引导推理来强制执行物理约束。

title: Auction-Based Online Policy Adaptation for Evolving Objectives
summary: We consider multi-objective reinforcement learning problems where objectives come from an identical family -- such as the class of reachability objectives -- and may appear or disappear at runtime. Our goal is to design adaptive policies that can efficiently adjust their behaviors as the set of active objectives changes. To solve this problem, we propose a modular framework where each objective is supported by a selfish local policy, and coordination is achieved through a novel auction-based mechanism: policies bid for the right to execute their actions, with bids reflecting the urgency of the current state. The highest bidder selects the action, enabling a dynamic and interpretable trade-off among objectives. Going back to the original adaptation problem, when objectives change, the system adapts by simply adding or removing the corresponding policies. Moreover, as objectives arise from the same family, identical copies of a parameterized policy can be deployed, facilitating immediate adaptation at runtime. We show how the selfish local policies can be computed by turning the problem into a general-sum game, where the policies compete against each other to fulfill their own objectives. To succeed, each policy must not only optimize its own objective, but also reason about the presence of other goals and learn to produce calibrated bids that reflect relative priority. In our implementation, the policies are trained concurrently using proximal policy optimization (PPO). We evaluate on Atari Assault and a gridworld-based path-planning task with dynamic targets. Our method achieves substantially better performance than monolithic policies trained with PPO.
summary_zh: 摘要：我们研究多目标强化学习问题，其中目标来自同一族（如可达性目标类），且可能在运行时动态出现或消失。我们的目标是设计自适应策略，使其能够随着活跃目标集合的变化而高效调整行为。为解决此问题，我们提出一个模块化框架：每个目标由自私的局部策略支持，并通过一种新颖的拍卖机制实现协调——各策略通过竞价争夺行动执行权，出价反映了当前状态的紧急程度。出价最高者选择行动，从而在目标间实现动态且可解释的权衡。回到原始适应问题，当目标发生变化时，系统仅需添加或移除对应策略即可完成调整。此外，由于目标源自同一族，可部署参数化策略的相同副本，从而在运行时实现即时适应。我们展示了如何通过将问题转化为广义和博弈来计算自私的局部策略：各策略为达成自身目标相互竞争。为取得成功，每个策略不仅需优化自身目标，还需推理其他目标的存在，并学习生成反映相对优先级的校准出价。在实现中，我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）并发训练策略。我们在Atari Assault和基于网格世界的动态目标路径规划任务中评估方法，结果显示本方法的性能显著优于使用PPO训练的单一策略。
tldr: The paper proposes an auction-based online policy adaptation framework for multi-objective RL, where selfish local policies bid for action control to handle dynamic objectives. It uses concurrent PPO training and is evaluated on Atari and gridworld tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于多目标强化学习的基于拍卖的在线策略适应框架，其中自私的局部策略通过竞标获得行动控制权以处理动态目标。它使用并行的PPO训练，并在Atari和网格世界任务上进行了评估。

title: UniDriveVLA: Unifying Understanding, Perception, and Action Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged in autonomous driving, with the promise of leveraging rich world knowledge to improve the cognitive capabilities of driving systems. However, adapting such models for driving tasks currently faces a critical dilemma between spatial perception and semantic reasoning. Consequently, existing VLA systems are forced into suboptimal compromises: directly adopting 2D Vision-Language Models yields limited spatial perception, whereas enhancing them with 3D spatial representations often impairs the native reasoning capacity of VLMs. We argue that this dilemma largely stems from the coupled optimization of spatial perception and semantic reasoning within shared model parameters. To overcome this, we propose UniDriveVLA, a Unified Driving Vision-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers that addresses the perception-reasoning conflict via expert decoupling. Specifically, it comprises three experts for driving understanding, scene perception, and action planning, which are coordinated through masked joint attention. In addition, we combine a sparse perception paradigm with a three-stage progressive training strategy to improve spatial perception while maintaining semantic reasoning capability. Extensive experiments show that UniDriveVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-loop evaluation on nuScenes and closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive. Moreover, it demonstrates strong performance across a broad range of perception, prediction, and understanding tasks, including 3D detection, online mapping, motion forecasting, and driving-oriented VQA, highlighting its broad applicability as a unified model for autonomous driving. Code and model have been released at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/unidrivevla
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行为（VLA）模型近期在自动驾驶领域崭露头角，其有望利用丰富的世界知识提升驾驶系统的认知能力。然而，当前此类模型在适应驾驶任务时面临空间感知与语义推理间的关键困境。现有VLA系统因此被迫做出次优折衷：直接采用2D视觉-语言模型会导致空间感知受限，而引入3D空间表征增强又常削弱VLM原有的推理能力。我们认为这一困境主要源于空间感知与语义推理在共享模型参数中的耦合优化。为此，我们提出UniDriveVLA——一种基于混合专家Transformer的统一驾驶视觉-语言-行为模型，通过专家解耦机制解决感知与推理的冲突。该模型包含驾驶理解、场景感知和动作规划三个专家模块，通过掩码联合注意力机制进行协同工作。此外，我们结合稀疏感知范式与三阶段渐进训练策略，在提升空间感知能力的同时保持语义推理性能。大量实验表明，UniDriveVLA在nuScenes数据集的开环评估和Bench2Drive平台的闭环测试中均达到最先进水平。该模型在感知、预测与理解等广泛任务中均展现强大性能，包括3D检测、在线建图、运动轨迹预测和驾驶导向的视觉问答，彰显其作为自动驾驶统一模型的广泛适用性。代码与模型已发布于https://github.com/xiaomi-research/unidrivevla。
tldr: Proposes UniDriveVLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous driving that decouples spatial perception and semantic reasoning using a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, achieving state-of-the-art results on driving benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出 UniDriveVLA，一个用于自动驾驶的统一视觉-语言-动作模型，通过混合专家Transformer架构解耦空间感知和语义推理，在多个驾驶基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: O-ConNet: Geometry-Aware End-to-End Inference of Over-Constrained Spatial Mechanisms
summary: Deep learning has shown strong potential for scientific discovery, but its ability to model macroscopic rigid-body kinematic constraints remains underexplored. We study this problem on spatial over-constrained mechanisms and propose O-ConNet, an end-to-end framework that infers mechanism structural parameters from only three sparse reachable points while reconstructing the full motion trajectory, without explicitly solving constraint equations during inference. On a self-constructed Bennett 4R dataset of 42,860 valid samples, O-ConNet achieves Param-MAE 0.276 +/- 0.077 and Traj-MAE 0.145 +/- 0.018 (mean +/- std over 10 runs), outperforming the strongest sequence baseline (LSTM-Seq2Seq) by 65.1 percent and 88.2 percent, respectively. These results suggest that end-to-end learning can capture closed-loop geometric structure and provide a practical route for inverse design of spatial over-constrained mechanisms under extremely sparse observations.
summary_zh: 深度学习在科学发现领域展现出强大潜力，但其对宏观刚体运动学约束的建模能力仍未得到充分探索。本研究以空间过约束机构为对象，提出O-ConNet端到端框架：该框架仅需三个稀疏可达点即可推断机构结构参数并重建完整运动轨迹，且无需在推理过程中显式求解约束方程。在包含42,860个有效样本的自建Bennett 4R数据集上，O-ConNet取得Param-MAE 0.276±0.077和Traj-MAE 0.145±0.018（10次运行均值±标准差），分别比最强序列基线模型（LSTM-Seq2Seq）提升65.1%和88.2%。实验结果表明，端到端学习能够有效捕捉闭环几何结构，为极端稀疏观测条件下的空间过约束机构逆向设计提供了实用路径。
tldr: The paper introduces O-ConNet, an end-to-end deep learning framework for inferring structural parameters and reconstructing full motion trajectories of spatial over-constrained mechanisms from sparse reachable points.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了O-ConNet，一个端到端的深度学习框架，用于从稀疏可达点推断空间过约束机构的结构参数并重建其完整运动轨迹。

title: Ego-Grounding for Personalized Question-Answering in Egocentric Videos
summary: We present the first systematic analysis of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in personalized question-answering requiring ego-grounding - the ability to understand the camera-wearer in egocentric videos. To this end, we introduce MyEgo, the first egocentric VideoQA dataset designed to evaluate MLLMs' ability to understand, remember, and reason about the camera wearer. MyEgo comprises 541 long videos and 5K personalized questions asking about "my things", "my activities", and "my past". Benchmarking reveals that competitive MLLMs across variants, including open-source vs. proprietary, thinking vs. non-thinking, small vs. large scales all struggle on MyEgo. Top closed- and open-source models (e.g., GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL) achieve only~46% and 36% accuracy, trailing human performance by near 40% and 50% respectively. Surprisingly, neither explicit reasoning nor model scaling yield consistent improvements. Models improve when relevant evidence is explicitly provided, but gains drop over time, indicating limitations in tracking and remembering "me" and "my past". These findings collectively highlight the crucial role of ego-grounding and long-range memory in enabling personalized QA in egocentric videos. We hope MyEgo and our analyses catalyze further progress in these areas for egocentric personalized assistance. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Ryougetsu3606/MyEgo
summary_zh: 本研究首次系统分析了多模态大语言模型在需要自我定位（ego-grounding）能力的个性化问答任务中的表现，该能力要求模型从第一视角视频中理解摄像佩戴者。为此，我们推出了MyEgo——首个专为评估多模态大语言模型在理解、记忆和推理摄像佩戴者信息能力而设计的第一视角视频问答数据集。MyEgo包含541段长视频及5000个涉及“我的物品”、“我的活动”和“我的过往”的个性化问题。基准测试表明，当前各类主流多模态大语言模型——包括开源与闭源模型、具备思考能力与无思考能力模型、小规模与大规模模型——在MyEgo数据集上均表现欠佳。顶级闭源与开源模型（如GPT-5与Qwen3-VL）的准确率仅分别达到约46%和36%，与人类表现相比分别落后近40%和50%。值得注意的是，显式推理机制与模型规模扩大均未带来持续性能提升。当提供相关证据时模型表现有所改善，但随着时间推移增益下降，这反映出模型在追踪和记忆“我”及“我的过往”方面存在局限。这些发现共同揭示了自我定位与长程记忆能力在实现第一视角视频个性化问答中的关键作用。我们期望MyEgo数据集及相关分析能推动第一视角个性化辅助技术在这些领域的进一步发展。数据与代码已公开于https://github.com/Ryougetsu3606/MyEgo。
tldr: The paper introduces MyEgo, a new dataset and benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models' ability to understand and reason about the camera-wearer ('ego-grounding') in long egocentric videos for personalized question-answering, finding current models significantly lag behind human performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MyEgo数据集和基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在长视角第一人称视频中理解及推理摄像机佩戴者（“自我定位”）的能力，以进行个性化问答，发现当前模型性能显著落后于人类。

title: Global Geometry of Orthogonal Foliations in the Control Allocation of Signed-Quadratic Systems
summary: This work formalizes the differential topology of redundancy resolution for systems governed by signed-quadratic actuation maps. By analyzing the minimally redundant case, the global topology of the continuous fiber bundle defining the nonlinear actuation null-space is established. The distribution orthogonal to these fibers is proven to be globally integrable and governed by an exact logarithmic potential field. This field foliates the actuator space, inducing a structural stratification of all orthants into transverse layers whose combinatorial sizes follow a strictly binomial progression. Within these layers, adjacent orthants are continuously connected via lower-dimensional strata termed reciprocal hinges, while the layers themselves are separated by boundary hyperplanes, or portals, that act as global sections of the fibers. This partition formally distinguishes extremal and transitional layers, which exhibit fundamentally distinct fiber topologies and foliation properties. Through this geometric framework, classical pseudo-linear static allocation strategies are shown to inevitably intersect singular boundary hyperplanes, triggering infinite-derivative kinetic singularities and fragmenting the task space into an exponential number of singularity-separated sectors. In contrast, allocators derived from the orthogonal manifolds yield continuously differentiable global sections with only a linear number of sectors for transversal layers, or can even form a single global diffeomorphism to the task space in the case of the two extremal layers, thus completely avoiding geometric rank-loss and boundary-crossing singularities. These theoretical results directly apply to the control allocation of propeller-driven architectures, including multirotor UAVs, marine, and underwater vehicles.
summary_zh:
本研究形式化了受符号二次驱动映射支配的系统的冗余解析微分拓扑。通过分析最小冗余情况，确立了定义非线性驱动零空间连续纤维丛的整体拓扑结构。与这些纤维正交的分布被证明是全局可积的，且受精确对数势场支配。该势场将执行器空间分层为叶状结构，诱导所有象限按组合规模严格遵循二项式递进规律的结构化层次划分。在这些层级内部，相邻象限通过称为互易铰链的低维态连续连接，而各层级之间由作为纤维全局截面的边界超平面（即门户）分隔。这种划分形式化地区分了极值层与过渡层，二者展现出本质不同的纤维拓扑与叶状结构特性。

在此几何框架下，经典伪线性静态分配策略被证明必然与奇异边界超平面相交，从而触发无限导数动力学奇点，并将任务空间分割为指数级数量的奇点隔离扇区。与之相反，从正交流形导出的分配器能产生连续可微的全局截面，其横向层仅需线性数量的扇区；对于两个极值层情况，甚至可形成与任务空间的单全局微分同胚映射，从而完全避免几何秩损与边界穿越奇点。这些理论成果可直接应用于推进器驱动架构的控制分配，包括多旋翼无人机、水上及水下航行器系统。
tldr: The paper presents a geometric framework for control allocation in systems with signed-quadratic actuation, analyzing singularity avoidance and applying it to propeller-driven vehicles like UAVs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于带符号二次驱动系统的控制分配几何框架，分析了奇异性的避免问题，并应用于多旋翼无人机等螺旋桨驱动系统。

title: Efficient Equivariant Transformer for Self-Driving Agent Modeling
summary: Accurately modeling agent behaviors is an important task in self-driving. It is also a task with many symmetries, such as equivariance to the order of agents and objects in the scene or equivariance to arbitrary roto-translations of the entire scene as a whole; i.e., SE(2)-equivariance. The transformer architecture is a ubiquitous tool for modeling these symmetries. While standard self-attention is inherently permutation equivariant, explicit pairwise relative positional encodings have been the standard for introducing SE(2)-equivariance. However, this approach introduces an additional cost that is quadratic in the number of agents, limiting its scalability to larger scenes and batch sizes. In this work, we propose DriveGATr, a novel transformer-based architecture for agent modeling that achieves SE(2)-equivariance without the computational cost of existing methods. Inspired by recent advances in geometric deep learning, DriveGATr encodes scene elements as multivectors in the 2D projective geometric algebra $\mathbb{R}^*_{2,0,1}$ and processes them with a stack of equivariant transformer blocks. Crucially, DriveGATr models geometric relationships using standard attention between multivectors, eliminating the need for costly explicit pairwise relative positional encodings. Experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset demonstrate that DriveGATr is comparable to the state-of-the-art in traffic simulation and establishes a superior Pareto front for performance vs computational cost.
summary_zh: 精确建模智能体行为是自动驾驶领域的重要任务。这项任务具有诸多对称性，例如对场景中智能体与物体顺序的等变性，或对整个场景任意旋转平移的等变性（即SE(2)-等变性）。Transformer架构已成为建模这些对称性的通用工具。标准自注意力机制天生具有置换等变性，而显式的成对相对位置编码一直是实现SE(2)-等变性的常规方法。然而，这种方法引入了与智能体数量平方相关的额外计算成本，限制了其在更大场景和批处理规模上的可扩展性。本研究提出DriveGATr——一种基于Transformer的新型智能体建模架构，能在不增加现有方法计算成本的前提下实现SE(2)-等变性。受几何深度学习最新进展的启发，DriveGATr将场景元素编码为二维投影几何代数$\mathbb{R}^*_{2,0,1}$中的多重向量，并通过一系列等变Transformer模块进行处理。关键创新在于，DriveGATr利用多重向量间的标准注意力机制建模几何关系，从而无需昂贵的显式成对相对位置编码。在Waymo开放运动数据集上的实验表明，DriveGATr在交通模拟任务中达到业界先进水平，并在性能与计算成本之间建立了更优的帕累托前沿。
tldr: This paper introduces DriveGATr, a novel SE(2)-equivariant transformer for agent modeling in self-driving, which uses geometric algebra multivectors to avoid costly explicit pairwise encodings, showing comparable performance with better efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DriveGATr，一种用于自动驾驶中智能体建模的新型SE(2)等变transformer，它使用几何代数多重向量来避免昂贵的显式成对编码，展现出相当的性能和更好的计算效率。

title: VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion
summary: Existing video object removal methods excel at inpainting content "behind" the object and correcting appearance-level artifacts such as shadows and reflections. However, when the removed object has more significant interactions, such as collisions with other objects, current models fail to correct them and produce implausible results. We present VOID, a video object removal framework designed to perform physically-plausible inpainting in these complex scenarios. To train the model, we generate a new paired dataset of counterfactual object removals using Kubric and HUMOTO, where removing an object requires altering downstream physical interactions. During inference, a vision-language model identifies regions of the scene affected by the removed object. These regions are then used to guide a video diffusion model that generates physically consistent counterfactual outcomes. Experiments on both synthetic and real data show that our approach better preserves consistent scene dynamics after object removal compared to prior video object removal methods. We hope this framework sheds light on how to make video editing models better simulators of the world through high-level causal reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有视频物体移除方法擅长修补物体"后方"的内容，并校正阴影、反射等外观层面的伪影。然而，当被移除物体存在更显著的交互作用（如与其他物体碰撞）时，现有模型无法修正这些物理相互作用，导致生成结果失真。本文提出VOID视频物体移除框架，专门针对此类复杂场景执行符合物理规律的修复。为训练模型，我们使用Kubric和HUMOTO生成了新的反事实物体移除配对数据集，其中移除物体需要改变后续的物理交互过程。在推理阶段，通过视觉语言模型识别受移除物体影响的场景区域，进而引导视频扩散模型生成物理一致的反事实结果。在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，相较于现有视频物体移除方法，本方法能更好地保持物体移除后场景动态的一致性。我们希望该框架能通过高层因果推理，为提升视频编辑模型的世界模拟能力提供新的思路。
tldr: This paper proposes VOID, a video object removal framework that uses a vision-language model and a video diffusion model to generate physically-plausible counterfactual outcomes by altering downstream physical interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VOID，一种视频物体移除框架，使用视觉语言模型和视频扩散模型通过改变下游物理交互来生成物理上合理的反事实结果。

title: Omni123: Exploring 3D Native Foundation Models with Limited 3D Data by Unifying Text to 2D and 3D Generation
summary: Recent multimodal large language models have achieved strong performance in unified text and image understanding and generation, yet extending such native capability to 3D remains challenging due to limited data. Compared to abundant 2D imagery, high-quality 3D assets are scarce, making 3D synthesis under-constrained. Existing methods often rely on indirect pipelines that edit in 2D and lift results into 3D via optimization, sacrificing geometric consistency. We present Omni123, a 3D-native foundation model that unifies text-to-2D and text-to-3D generation within a single autoregressive framework. Our key insight is that cross-modal consistency between images and 3D can serve as an implicit structural constraint. By representing text, images, and 3D as discrete tokens in a shared sequence space, the model leverages abundant 2D data as a geometric prior to improve 3D representations. We introduce an interleaved X-to-X training paradigm that coordinates diverse cross-modal tasks over heterogeneous paired datasets without requiring fully aligned text-image-3D triplets. By traversing semantic-visual-geometric cycles (e.g., text to image to 3D to image) within autoregressive sequences, the model jointly enforces semantic alignment, appearance fidelity, and multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments show that Omni123 significantly improves text-guided 3D generation and editing, demonstrating a scalable path toward multimodal 3D world models.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近期，多模态大语言模型在文本与图像的统一理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，但受限于数据稀缺，将这种原生能力扩展至三维领域仍面临挑战。相较于丰富的二维图像，高质量三维数据较为匮乏，使得三维合成任务存在约束不足的问题。现有方法通常依赖间接流程，即先在二维空间进行编辑，再通过优化将结果提升至三维，这往往牺牲了几何一致性。本文提出Omni123，一种三维原生基础模型，将文本到二维和文本到三维的生成统一于单一自回归框架中。我们的核心洞见在于，图像与三维之间的跨模态一致性可作为隐式结构约束。通过将文本、图像和三维数据表示为共享序列空间中的离散标记，模型能够利用丰富的二维数据作为几何先验，以提升三维表征质量。我们引入了一种交错式X-to-X训练范式，在异构配对数据集上协调多种跨模态任务，无需完全对齐的文本-图像-三维三元组。通过在自回归序列中遍历语义-视觉-几何循环（如文本到图像、图像到三维、三维到图像），该模型联合实现了语义对齐、外观保真度与多视角几何一致性。实验表明，Omni123显著提升了文本引导的三维生成与编辑效果，为多模态三维世界模型的可扩展路径提供了重要启示。
tldr: Omni123 is a 3D-native foundation model that unifies text-to-2D and text-to-3D generation in a single autoregressive framework, using cross-modal consistency between images and 3D as an implicit structural constraint to improve 3D synthesis.
tldr_zh: Omni123 是一种原生 3D 基础模型，将文本生成 2D 和文本生成 3D 统一在一个自回归框架中，利用图像和 3D 之间的跨模态一致性作为隐式结构约束来改进 3D 合成。

title: LEO: Graph Attention Network based Hybrid Multi Sensor Extended Object Fusion and Tracking for Autonomous Driving Applications
summary: Accurate shape and trajectory estimation of dynamic objects is essential for reliable automated driving. Classical Bayesian extended-object models offer theoretical robustness and efficiency but depend on completeness of a-priori and update-likelihood functions, while deep learning methods bring adaptability at the cost of dense annotations and high compute. We bridge these strengths with LEO (Learned Extension of Objects), a spatio-temporal Graph Attention Network that fuses multi-modal production-grade sensor tracks to learn adaptive fusion weights, ensure temporal consistency, and represent multi-scale shapes. Using a task-specific parallelogram ground-truth formulation, LEO models complex geometries (e.g. articulated trucks and trailers) and generalizes across sensor types, configurations, object classes, and regions, remaining robust for challenging and long-range targets. Evaluations on the Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT SAE L3 dataset demonstrate real-time computational efficiency suitable for production systems; additional validation on public datasets such as View of Delft (VoD) further confirms cross-dataset generalization.
summary_zh: 动态目标的精确形状与轨迹估计是可靠自动驾驶的关键。经典贝叶斯扩展目标模型虽具备理论鲁棒性与高效性，但依赖于先验知识和更新似然函数的完备性；深度学习方法虽带来适应性，却以密集标注和高计算成本为代价。我们提出LEO（对象学习扩展模型）来融合二者优势：这一时空图注意力网络通过融合多模态量产级传感器轨迹数据，自适应学习融合权重，确保时间一致性，并表征多尺度目标形态。借助任务专用的平行四边形真值表达框架，LEO能够建模复杂几何结构（如铰接式卡车与挂车），并适应不同传感器类型、配置方案、目标类别及区域场景，即使在极具挑战性的远距离目标检测中仍保持稳健性。基于梅赛德斯-奔驰DRIVE PILOT SAE L3数据集的评估表明，该模型具备适用于量产系统的实时计算效率；在View of Delft（VoD）等公开数据集上的额外验证进一步证实了其跨数据集泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a Graph Attention Network for multi-sensor fusion and shape/trajectory tracking of dynamic objects, primarily for autonomous driving, not general robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图注意力网络的多传感器融合模型，用于自动驾驶场景中动态物体的形状和轨迹估计，与通用机器人学关联度低。

title: Hierarchical Memory Orchestration for Personalized Persistent Agents
summary: While long-term memory is essential for intelligent agents to maintain consistent historical awareness, the accumulation of extensive interaction data often leads to performance bottlenecks. Naive storage expansion increases retrieval noise and computational latency, overwhelming the reasoning capacity of models deployed on constrained personal devices. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Memory Orchestration (HMO), a framework that organizes interaction history into a three-tiered directory driven by user-centric contextual relevance. Our system maintains a compact primary cache, coupling recent and pivotal memories with an evolving user profile to ensure agent reasoning remains aligned with individual behavioral traits. This primary cache is complemented by a high-priority secondary layer, both of which are managed within a global archive of the full interaction history. Crucially, the user persona dictates memory redistribution across this hierarchy, promoting records mapped to long-term patterns toward more active tiers while relegating less relevant information. This targeted orchestration surfaces historical knowledge precisely when needed while maintaining a lean and efficient active search space. Evaluations on multiple benchmarks achieve state-of-the-art performance. Real-world deployments in ecosystems like OpenClaw demonstrate that HMO significantly enhances agent fluidity and personalization.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管长期记忆对于智能体保持历史一致性感知至关重要，但海量交互数据的积累常引发性能瓶颈。简单的存储扩展会增加检索噪声与计算延迟，从而超出受限个人设备上部署模型的推理负载能力。为此，我们提出分层记忆编排框架，通过以用户情境相关性驱动的三级目录结构组织交互历史。该系统维护一个紧凑的主缓存，将近期关键记忆与动态演化的用户画像耦合，确保智能体推理始终与个体行为特征保持一致。主缓存由高优先级次级存储层进行补充，两者均在完整交互历史的全局归档库中统一管理。关键机制在于：用户画像主导记忆在层级间的动态调度，将与长期行为模式相关的记录提升至活跃层级，同时将低关联信息降级存储。这种定向编排机制能在需要时精准调用历史知识，同时保持轻量高效的活动检索空间。在多个基准测试中，该框架实现了最优性能指标。在OpenClaw等实际生态系统的部署表明，HMO显著提升了智能体的交互流畅度与个性化程度。
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical memory orchestration framework to manage long-term memory for personalized persistent agents, improving efficiency and personalization by organizing interaction history based on contextual relevance and user persona.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个分层记忆编排框架，用于管理个性化持久智能体的长期记忆。该框架基于上下文相关性和用户画像来组织交互历史，从而提高效率与个性化水平。

title: ContextBudget: Budget-Aware Context Management for Long-Horizon Search Agents
summary: LLM-based agents show strong potential for long-horizon reasoning, yet their context size is limited by deployment factors (e.g., memory, latency, and cost), yielding a constrained context budget. As interaction histories grow, this induces a trade-off between retaining past information and staying within the context limit. To address this challenge, we propose Budget-Aware Context Management (BACM), which formulates context management as a sequential decision problem with a context budget constraint. It enables agents to assess the available budget before incorporating new observations and decide when and how much of the interaction history to compress. We further develop BACM-RL, an end-to-end curriculum-based reinforcement learning approach that learns compression strategies under varying context budgets. Experiments on compositional multi-objective QA and long-horizon web browsing benchmarks show that BACM-RL consistently outperforms prior methods across model scales and task complexities, achieving over $1.6\times$ gains over strong baselines in high-complexity settings, while maintaining strong advantages as budgets shrink, where most methods exhibit a downward performance trend.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在长时序推理任务中展现出强大潜力，但其上下文规模受限于实际部署因素（如内存、延迟和成本），导致可用上下文预算受限。随着交互历史增长，智能体需在保留历史信息与遵守上下文限制之间做出权衡。为应对这一挑战，我们提出预算感知上下文管理（BACM），将上下文管理建模为具有预算约束的序列决策问题。该方法使智能体在引入新观察前能评估可用预算，并决策何时、以何种程度压缩交互历史。我们进一步开发了BACM-RL，一种基于课程学习的端到端强化学习方法，可在不同上下文预算下学习压缩策略。在组合式多目标问答与长时序网页浏览基准测试中，BACM-RL在多种模型规模和任务复杂度下均优于现有方法，在高复杂度场景中相对基线模型取得超过$1.6\times$的性能提升，同时在预算缩减时保持显著优势，而此时多数方法的性能呈下降趋势。
tldr: The paper proposes a budget-aware context management framework (BACM) and an RL method (BACM-RL) to optimize the compression of long interaction histories for LLM-based agents, improving performance on long-horizon tasks like QA and web browsing under constrained context windows.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种预算感知的上下文管理框架（BACM）和一种强化学习方法（BACM-RL），用于优化基于LLM的智能体在长程任务（如QA和网页浏览）中的历史交互信息压缩，以在受限的上下文窗口下提升性能。

title: GraphWalk: Enabling Reasoning in Large Language Models through Tool-Based Graph Navigation
summary: The use of knowledge graphs for grounding agents in real-world Q&A applications has become increasingly common. Answering complex queries often requires multi-hop reasoning and the ability to navigate vast relational structures. Standard approaches rely on prompting techniques that steer large language models to reason over raw graph context, or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines where relevant subgraphs are injected into the context. These, however, face severe limitations with enterprise-scale KGs that cannot fit in even the largest context windows available today. We present GraphWalk, a problem-agnostic, training-free, tool-based framework that allows off-the-shelf LLMs to reason through sequential graph navigation, dramatically increasing performance across different tasks. Unlike task-specific agent frameworks that encode domain knowledge into specialized tools, GraphWalk equips the LLM with a minimal set of orthogonal graph operations sufficient to traverse any graph structure. We evaluate whether models equipped with GraphWalk can compose these operations into correct multi-step reasoning chains, where each tool call represents a verifiable step creating a transparent execution trace. We first demonstrate our approach on maze traversal, a problem non-reasoning models are completely unable to solve, then present results on graphs resembling real-world enterprise knowledge graphs. To isolate structural reasoning from world knowledge, we evaluate on entirely synthetic graphs with random, non-semantic labels. Our benchmark spans 12 query templates from basic retrieval to compound first-order logic queries. Results show that tool-based traversal yields substantial and consistent gains over in-context baselines across all model families tested, with gains becoming more pronounced as scale increases, precisely where in-context approaches fail catastrophically.
summary_zh: 在真实世界的问答应用中，利用知识图谱为智能体提供基础支撑已日益普遍。回答复杂查询常需多跳推理能力及对庞大关系结构的遍历。标准方法依赖于提示技术引导大语言模型在原始图谱上下文中进行推理，或采用检索增强生成流程将相关子图注入上下文。然而，这些方法在面对企业级规模的图谱时面临严重局限——即使当前最大的上下文窗口也无法容纳如此庞大的数据。我们提出GraphWalk：一种与问题无关、无需训练、基于工具的框架，使得现成的大语言模型能够通过序列化图谱导航进行推理，显著提升了各类任务的表现。不同于将领域知识编码至专用工具的任务特定型智能体框架，GraphWalk为大语言模型配备了一组极小化的正交图谱操作集合，足以遍历任何图结构。我们评估了搭载GraphWalk的模型能否将这些操作组合成正确的多步推理链——其中每个工具调用代表一个可验证的步骤，形成透明的执行轨迹。我们首先在迷宫遍历问题上验证了该方法（非推理模型完全无法解决此类问题），随后在模拟真实企业知识图谱的图结构上展示结果。为将结构推理与世界知识分离，我们在完全由随机非语义标签构成的合成图谱上进行评估。我们的基准测试涵盖从基础检索到复合一阶逻辑查询的12种查询模板。结果表明，在所有测试模型族中，基于工具的遍历方法相较于上下文基线均产生显著且稳定的性能提升，且这种优势随着模型规模增大而愈加明显——而这正是上下文方法完全失效的场景。
tldr: GraphWalk is a tool-based framework that enables LLMs to reason by navigating large knowledge graphs through a minimal set of graph operations, improving performance on complex multi-hop queries.
tldr_zh: GraphWalk是一个基于工具的框架，使大型语言模型能够通过一组最小的图操作来导航大型知识图谱，从而提高复杂多跳推理任务的性能。

title: SHOE: Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation Metric
summary: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection is a step towards building scalable systems that generalize to unseen interactions in real-world scenarios and support grounded multimodal systems that reason about human-object relationships. However, standard evaluation metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), treat HOI classes as discrete categorical labels and fail to credit semantically valid but lexically different predictions (e.g., "lean on couch" vs. "sit on couch"), limiting their applicability for evaluating open-vocabulary predictions that go beyond any predefined set of HOI labels.
