We introduce SHOE (Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation), a new evaluation framework that incorporates semantic similarity between predicted and ground-truth HOI labels. SHOE decomposes each HOI prediction into its verb and object components, estimates their semantic similarity using the average of multiple large language models (LLMs), and combines them into a similarity score to evaluate alignment beyond exact string match. This enables a flexible and scalable evaluation of both existing HOI detection methods and open-ended generative models using standard benchmarks such as HICO-DET. Experimental results show that SHOE scores align more closely with human judgments than existing metrics, including LLM-based and embedding-based baselines, achieving an agreement of 85.73% with the average human ratings. Our work underscores the need for semantically grounded HOI evaluation that better mirrors human understanding of interactions. We will release our evaluation metric to the public to facilitate future research.
summary_zh: 开放词汇人-物交互检测是构建可扩展系统的重要一步，该系统能够泛化至现实场景中未见的交互行为，并支持基于人-物关系推理的接地多模态系统。然而，现有标准评估指标（如平均精度均值）将人-物交互类别视为离散分类标签，无法对语义正确但表述不同的预测结果（例如"倚靠沙发"与"坐在沙发上"）给予有效评价，这限制了其在超越预定义人-物交互标签集的开放词汇预测评估中的适用性。我们提出SHOE（语义人-物交互开放词汇评估）框架，该框架通过衡量预测结果与真实标注之间的语义相似性实现评估创新。SHOE将每个人-物交互预测分解为动词和对象组分，利用多个大型语言模型的平均语义相似度进行评估，最终融合为综合相似度分数，从而突破传统精确字符串匹配的局限。该框架支持对现有人-物交互检测方法和开放式生成模型在HICO-DET等标准基准上进行灵活可扩展的评估。实验结果表明，SHOE评分相比现有指标（包括基于大型语言模型和嵌入向量的基线方法）更贴近人类判断，与人类平均评分的一致性达到85.73%。本研究强调了建立基于语义的人-物交互评估体系的必要性，该体系能更好地反映人类对交互行为的理解。我们将公开评估指标以促进后续研究。
tldr: The paper introduces SHOE, a new evaluation metric for open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection that uses semantic similarity from LLMs, rather than exact string matching, to better align with human judgments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SHOE，一种用于开放词汇人-物交互检测的新评估指标，它利用大型语言模型的语义相似度而非精确字符串匹配，以更好地与人类判断保持一致。

title: Generative World Renderer
summary: Scaling generative inverse and forward rendering to real-world scenarios is bottlenecked by the limited realism and temporal coherence of existing synthetic datasets. To bridge this persistent domain gap, we introduce a large-scale, dynamic dataset curated from visually complex AAA games. Using a novel dual-screen stitched capture method, we extracted 4M continuous frames (720p/30 FPS) of synchronized RGB and five G-buffer channels across diverse scenes, visual effects, and environments, including adverse weather and motion-blur variants. This dataset uniquely advances bidirectional rendering: enabling robust in-the-wild geometry and material decomposition, and facilitating high-fidelity G-buffer-guided video generation. Furthermore, to evaluate the real-world performance of inverse rendering without ground truth, we propose a novel VLM-based assessment protocol measuring semantic, spatial, and temporal consistency. Experiments demonstrate that inverse renderers fine-tuned on our data achieve superior cross-dataset generalization and controllable generation, while our VLM evaluation strongly correlates with human judgment. Combined with our toolkit, our forward renderer enables users to edit styles of AAA games from G-buffers using text prompts.
summary_zh: 生成式逆向渲染与正向渲染技术在现实世界中的扩展应用，正受到现有合成数据集真实性不足与时序连贯性有限的制约。为弥合这一长期存在的领域鸿沟，我们推出了一个从视觉复杂的AAA级游戏中精心构建的大规模动态数据集。通过创新的双屏拼接采集方法，我们在多样化场景、视觉效果及环境（包括恶劣天气与动态模糊变体）中捕获了400万帧连续画面（720p/30 FPS），同步获取了RGB图像及五个G-buffer通道数据。该数据集在双向渲染领域实现了突破性进展：既能支持复杂真实场景下的几何与材质分解，又能促进高保真G-buffer引导的视频生成。此外，为在缺乏真实数据的情况下评估逆向渲染的实际性能，我们提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的新型评估协议，可从语义、空间和时序三个维度衡量一致性。实验表明，基于本数据微调的逆向渲染器在跨数据集泛化与可控生成方面表现优异，且我们的视觉语言模型评估结果与人类主观判断高度吻合。结合我们开发的工具套件，所提出的正向渲染器使用户能够通过文本提示直接基于G-buffer对AAA级游戏进行风格化编辑。
tldr: This paper introduces a large-scale dataset from AAA games for training and evaluating inverse/forward rendering models, proposing a VLM-based method for assessing performance without ground truth.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个从AAA游戏构建的大规模数据集，用于训练和评估逆向/前向渲染模型，并引入了一种基于VLM的、无需真值标签的性能评估方法。

title: GroundVTS: Visual Token Sampling in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding (VTG) is a critical task in video understanding and a key capability for extending video large language models (Vid-LLMs) to broader applications. However, existing Vid-LLMs rely on uniform frame sampling to extract video information, resulting in a sparse distribution of key frames and the loss of crucial temporal cues. To address this limitation, we propose Grounded Visual Token Sampling (GroundVTS), a Vid-LLM architecture that focuses on the most informative temporal segments. GroundVTS employs a fine-grained, query-guided mechanism to filter visual tokens before feeding them into the LLM, thereby preserving essential spatio-temporal information and maintaining temporal coherence. Futhermore, we introduce a progressive optimization strategy that enables the LLM to effectively adapt to the non-uniform distribution of visual features, enhancing its ability to model temporal dependencies and achieve precise video localization. We comprehensively evaluate GroundVTS on three standard VTG benchmarks, where it outperforms existing methods, achieving a 7.7-point improvement in mIoU for moment retrieval and 12.0-point improvement in mAP for highlight detection. Code is available at https://github.com/Florence365/GroundVTS.
summary_zh: 视频时序定位（VTG）是视频理解中的关键任务，也是拓展视频大语言模型（Vid-LLMs）应用范围的核心能力。然而，现有Vid-LLMs依赖均匀帧采样提取视频信息，导致关键帧分布稀疏且重要时序线索丢失。为突破此限制，我们提出基于视觉令牌的时序定位采样方法（GroundVTS），这是一种聚焦于信息最丰富时序片段的Vid-LLM架构。该方法采用细粒度、查询引导的机制，在视觉令牌输入大语言模型前进行筛选，从而保留关键时空信息并维持时序连贯性。此外，我们引入渐进式优化策略，使大语言模型能有效适应视觉特征的非均匀分布，增强其对时序依赖关系的建模能力，实现精准的视频定位。我们在三个标准VTG基准上对GroundVTS进行全面评估，其性能超越现有方法，在片段检索任务中mIoU提升7.7个百分点，在高光检测任务中mAP提升12.0个百分点。项目代码开源地址：https://github.com/Florence365/GroundVTS。
tldr: Proposes a query-guided visual token sampling method for Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) to improve temporal grounding in videos by focusing on informative segments.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于视频大语言模型（Vid-LLM）的查询引导视觉令牌采样方法，通过关注信息丰富的片段来改进视频中的时间定位任务。

title: IndoorCrowd: A Multi-Scene Dataset for Human Detection, Segmentation, and Tracking with an Automated Annotation Pipeline
summary: Understanding human behaviour in crowded indoor environments is central to surveillance, smart buildings, and human-robot interaction, yet existing datasets rarely capture real-world indoor complexity at scale. We introduce IndoorCrowd, a multi-scene dataset for indoor human detection, instance segmentation, and multi-object tracking, collected across four campus locations (ACS-EC, ACS-EG, IE-Central, R-Central). It comprises $31$ videos ($9{,}913$ frames at $5$fps) with human-verified, per-instance segmentation masks. A $620$-frame control subset benchmarks three foundation-model auto-annotators: SAM3, GroundingSAM, and EfficientGroundingSAM, against human labels using Cohen's $κ$, AP, precision, recall, and mask IoU. A further $2{,}552$-frame subset supports multi-object tracking with continuous identity tracks in MOTChallenge format. We establish detection, segmentation, and tracking baselines using YOLOv8n, YOLOv26n, and RT-DETR-L paired with ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, and OC-SORT. Per-scene analysis reveals substantial difficulty variation driven by crowd density, scale, and occlusion: ACS-EC, with $79.3\%$ dense frames and a mean instance scale of $60.8$px, is the most challenging scene. The project page is available at https://sheepseb.github.io/IndoorCrowd/.
summary_zh: 理解室内拥挤环境中的人类行为对于监控、智能建筑和人机交互至关重要，但现有数据集很少能大规模捕捉真实室内环境的复杂性。我们提出了IndoorCrowd——一个用于室内人体检测、实例分割和多目标跟踪的多场景数据集，采集自四个校园场景（ACS-EC、ACS-EG、IE-Central、R-Central）。该数据集包含31段视频（共计9,913帧，帧率为5fps），并提供经人工逐实例验证的分割掩码。我们通过620帧的对照子集，以Cohen's κ、AP、精确率、召回率和掩码IoU为指标，对比评估了SAM3、GroundingSAM和EfficientGroundingSAM三种基础模型自动标注器与人工标注的一致性。另有2,552帧子集以MOTChallenge格式提供连续身份轨迹，支持多目标跟踪研究。我们采用YOLOv8n、YOLOv26n、RT-DETR-L结合ByteTrack、BoT-SORT和OC-SORT建立了检测、分割与跟踪的基准性能。逐场景分析表明：不同场景的难度差异显著，主要受人群密度、目标尺度和遮挡程度影响。其中ACS-EC场景79.3%的帧为高密度人群，平均实例尺度仅60.8像素，是挑战性最高的场景。项目页面详见：https://sheepseb.github.io/IndoorCrowd/
tldr: The paper introduces a large-scale dataset, IndoorCrowd, for human detection, segmentation, and tracking in crowded indoor environments, aimed at applications like surveillance and human-robot interaction. It includes benchmarks for automated annotation tools and tracking methods, highlighting performance variations across different scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 IndoorCrowd 数据集，这是一个用于拥挤室内环境中人体检测、分割和跟踪的大规模数据集，面向监控和人机交互等应用。它包含对自动化标注工具和跟踪方法的基准测试，并展示了不同场景下的性能差异。

title: HieraVid: Hierarchical Token Pruning for Fast Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in video understanding, yet the massive number of input video tokens incurs a significant computational burden for deployment. Existing methods mainly prune video tokens at input level while neglecting the inherent information structure embedded in videos and large language models (LLMs). To address this, we propose HieraVid, a hierarchical pruning framework that progressively and dynamically reduces visual redundancy. Based on two observations that videos possess the segment-frame structure and LLMs internally propagate multi-modal information unidirectionally, we decompose pruning into three levels: 1) segment-level, where video tokens are first temporally segmented and spatially merged; 2) frame-level, where similar frames within the same segment are jointly pruned to preserve diversity; 3) layer-level, redundancy gradually shrinks as LLM layer increases w/o compromising performance. We conduct extensive experiments on four widely used video understanding benchmarks to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of HieraVid. Remarkably, with only 30% of tokens retained, HieraVid achieves new state-of-the-art performance, while maintaining over 98% and 99% of the performance of LLaVA-Video-7B and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, respectively.
summary_zh: 视频大语言模型在视频理解方面展现出卓越能力，但海量输入视频令牌给实际部署带来巨大计算负担。现有方法主要在输入层面进行令牌剪枝，却忽略了视频与大语言模型内部固有的信息结构。为此，我们提出HieraVid——一种分层剪枝框架，通过渐进式动态机制减少视觉冗余。基于视频具有片段-帧结构且大语言模型内部单向传播多模态信息的双重观察，我们将剪枝分解为三个层级：1）片段级：视频令牌首先进行时序分段与空间合并；2）帧级：同一片段内相似帧进行联合剪枝以保留多样性；3）层级：随着大语言模型层数增加，在保证性能的前提下逐步缩减冗余。我们在四个广泛使用的视频理解基准上进行了大量实验，全面评估HieraVid的有效性。显著的是，仅保留30%令牌时，HieraVid取得了全新的最先进性能，同时分别保持了LLaVA-Video-7B和LLaVA-OneVision-7B模型98%与99%以上的性能表现。
tldr: HieraVid is a hierarchical token pruning framework for Video Large Language Models that reduces computational cost by progressively pruning redundant tokens across segment, frame, and model layers while maintaining high performance on video understanding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: HieraVid是一个用于视频大语言模型的层次化token剪枝框架，它通过跨片段、帧和模型层的渐进式剪枝来减少冗余token和计算成本，同时在视频理解基准上保持高性能。

title: Unifying UAV Cross-View Geo-Localization via 3D Geometric Perception
summary: Cross-view geo-localization for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) operating in GNSS-denied environments remains challenging due to the severe geometric discrepancy between oblique UAV imagery and orthogonal satellite maps. Most existing methods address this problem through a decoupled pipeline of place retrieval and pose estimation, implicitly treating perspective distortion as appearance noise rather than an explicit geometric transformation. In this work, we propose a geometry-aware UAV geo-localization framework that explicitly models the 3D scene geometry to unify coarse place recognition and fine-grained pose estimation within a single inference pipeline. Our approach reconstructs a local 3D scene from multi-view UAV image sequences using a Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), and renders a virtual Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation that orthorectifies the UAV perspective to align with satellite imagery. This BEV serves as a geometric intermediary that enables robust cross-view retrieval and provides spatial priors for accurate 3 Degrees of Freedom (3-DoF) pose regression. To efficiently handle multiple location hypotheses, we introduce a Satellite-wise Attention Block that isolates the interaction between each satellite candidate and the reconstructed UAV scene, preventing inter-candidate interference while maintaining linear computational complexity. In addition, we release a recalibrated version of the University-1652 dataset with precise coordinate annotations and spatial overlap analysis, enabling rigorous evaluation of end-to-end localization accuracy. Extensive experiments on the refined University-1652 benchmark and SUES-200 demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving robust meter-level localization accuracy and improved generalization in complex urban environments.
summary_zh: 在GNSS拒止环境下运行的无人机，其跨视角地理定位因倾斜航拍影像与正射卫星地图之间的显著几何差异而面临持续挑战。现有方法大多通过解耦的地点检索与位姿估计流程处理该问题，将透视畸变隐式视为外观噪声而非显式几何变换。本研究提出一种几何感知的无人机地理定位框架，通过显式建模三维场景几何，将粗粒度地点识别与细粒度位姿估计统一于单次推理流程中。该方法利用视觉几何基础变换器从多视角无人机图像序列重建局部三维场景，并渲染虚拟鸟瞰图表示以正交校正无人机视角，实现与卫星影像的对齐。该鸟瞰图作为几何中介，既能支持鲁棒的跨视角检索，又能为精确的三自由度位姿回归提供空间先验。为高效处理多位置假设，我们引入卫星级注意力模块，隔离各卫星候选点与重建无人机场景的交互，在保持线性计算复杂度的同时避免候选点间相互干扰。此外，我们发布了经过重新校准的University-1652数据集版本，包含精确坐标标注与空间重叠分析，支持端到端定位精度的严格评估。在优化的University-1652基准与SUES-200数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法显著优于现有先进基线，在复杂城市环境中实现了鲁棒的米级定位精度与更强的泛化能力。
tldr: Proposes a geometry-aware framework for UAV cross-view geo-localization by reconstructing a 3D scene from UAV images and rendering a virtual Bird's-Eye View to align with satellite maps, unifying retrieval and pose estimation.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于无人机跨视角地理定位的几何感知框架，通过从无人机图像序列重建3D场景并渲染虚拟鸟瞰图来与卫星图像对齐，统一了检索和姿态估计。

title: Director: Instance-aware Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Modeling and Understanding
summary: Volumetric video seeks to model dynamic scenes as temporally coherent 4D representations. While recent Gaussian-based approaches achieve impressive rendering fidelity, they primarily emphasize appearance but are largely agnostic to instance-level structure, limiting stable tracking and semantic reasoning in highly dynamic scenarios. In this paper, we present Director, a unified spatio-temporal Gaussian representation that jointly models human performance, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level semantics. Our key insight is that embedding instance-consistent semantics naturally complements 4D modeling, enabling more accurate scene decomposition while supporting robust dynamic scene understanding. To this end, we leverage temporally aligned instance masks and sentence embeddings derived from Multimodal Large Language Models to supervise the learnable semantic features of each Gaussian via two MLP decoders, enabling language-aligned 4D representations and enforcing identity consistency over time. To enhance temporal stability, we bridge 2D optical flow with 4D Gaussians and finetune their motions, yielding reliable initialization and reducing drift. For the training, we further introduce a geometry-aware SDF constraints, along with regularization terms that enforces surface continuity, enhancing temporal coherence in dynamic foreground modeling. Experiments demonstrate that Director achieves temporally coherent 4D reconstructions while simultaneously enabling instance segmentation and open-vocabulary querying.
summary_zh: 体积视频旨在将动态场景建模为时序连贯的四维表示。虽然近期基于高斯辐射场的方法实现了令人印象深刻的渲染精度，但这些方法主要侧重于外观表现，而对实例级结构缺乏感知能力，限制了在高度动态场景中的稳定跟踪与语义推理能力。本文提出了Director——一种统一时空高斯表示方法，能够同时对人体动作、高保真渲染与实例级语义进行联合建模。我们的核心观点在于：嵌入实例一致的语义信息能够自然补充四维建模过程，既可实现更精准的场景解构，又能支撑鲁棒的动态场景理解。为此，我们利用时序对齐的实例分割掩码与来自多模态大语言模型的语义嵌入向量，通过两个MLP解码器监督每个高斯点的可学习语义特征，从而构建语言对齐的四维表示并强制实现跨时间维度的身份一致性。为增强时序稳定性，我们将二维光流与四维高斯表示相结合，通过微调其运动参数生成可靠初始化并减少漂移现象。在训练过程中，我们进一步引入几何感知的符号距离场约束以及强化表面连续性的正则化项，从而提升动态前景建模中的时序连贯性。实验表明，Director能够同时实现时序连贯的四维重建、实例分割和开放词汇查询功能。
tldr: Director integrates instance-aware semantics into a 4D Gaussian Splatting model for dynamic scene modeling, enabling language-aligned open-vocabulary queries and stable tracking, but does not explicitly address robotics or embodied control.
tldr_zh: Director是一种将实例级语义集成到4D高斯溅射模型中的动态场景建模方法，支持基于语言的开放词汇查询和稳定跟踪，但未明确涉及机器人或具身控制。

title: UniRecGen: Unifying Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
summary: Sparse-view 3D modeling represents a fundamental tension between reconstruction fidelity and generative plausibility. While feed-forward reconstruction excels in efficiency and input alignment, it often lacks the global priors needed for structural completeness. Conversely, diffusion-based generation provides rich geometric details but struggles with multi-view consistency. We present UniRecGen, a unified framework that integrates these two paradigms into a single cooperative system. To overcome inherent conflicts in coordinate spaces, 3D representations, and training objectives, we align both models within a shared canonical space. We employ disentangled cooperative learning, which maintains stable training while enabling seamless collaboration during inference. Specifically, the reconstruction module is adapted to provide canonical geometric anchors, while the diffusion generator leverages latent-augmented conditioning to refine and complete the geometric structure. Experimental results demonstrate that UniRecGen achieves superior fidelity and robustness, outperforming existing methods in creating complete and consistent 3D models from sparse observations.
summary_zh: 稀疏视图三维建模体现了重建保真度与生成合理性之间的基本矛盾。前馈式重建方法在效率和输入对齐方面表现出色，但往往缺乏实现结构完整性所需的全局先验。相反，基于扩散的生成方法能提供丰富的几何细节，却在多视图一致性上面临挑战。本文提出UniRecGen框架，将这两种范式统一整合为协同合作系统。为克服坐标空间、三维表示和训练目标间的内在冲突，我们将两种模型对齐至共享的规范空间。通过解耦协同学习策略，在保持训练稳定性的同时实现推理阶段的无缝协作。具体而言，重建模块经适配后提供规范的几何锚点，而扩散生成器则利用潜在增强条件机制对几何结构进行细化和补全。实验结果表明，UniRecGen在稀疏观测条件下生成完整且一致的三维模型时，实现了更优的保真度与鲁棒性，其性能超越现有方法。
tldr: UniRecGen is a unified framework that combines sparse-view 3D reconstruction and generative diffusion models in a canonical space, improving fidelity and consistency for 3D modeling from sparse input.
tldr_zh: UniRecGen是一个在规范空间内统一稀疏视图3D重建和生成扩散模型的框架，旨在提高从稀疏输入进行3D建模的保真度和一致性。

title: Prime Once, then Reprogram Locally: An Efficient Alternative to Black-Box Service Model Adaptation
summary: Adapting closed-box service models (i.e., APIs) for target tasks typically relies on reprogramming via Zeroth-Order Optimization (ZOO). However, this standard strategy is known for extensive, costly API calls and often suffers from slow, unstable optimization. Furthermore, we observe that this paradigm faces new challenges with modern APIs (e.g., GPT-4o). These models can be less sensitive to the input perturbations ZOO relies on, thereby hindering performance gains. To address these limitations, we propose an Alternative efficient Reprogramming approach for Service models (AReS). Instead of direct, continuous closed-box optimization, AReS initiates a single-pass interaction with the service API to prime an amenable local pre-trained encoder. This priming stage trains only a lightweight layer on top of the local encoder, making it highly receptive to the subsequent glass-box (white-box) reprogramming stage performed directly on the local model. Consequently, all subsequent adaptation and inference rely solely on this local proxy, eliminating all further API costs. Experiments demonstrate AReS's effectiveness where prior ZOO-based methods struggle: on GPT-4o, AReS achieves a +27.8% gain over the zero-shot baseline, a task where ZOO-based methods provide little to no improvement. Broadly, across ten diverse datasets, AReS outperforms state-of-the-art methods (+2.5% for VLMs, +15.6% for standard VMs) while reducing API calls by over 99.99%. AReS thus provides a robust and practical solution for adapting modern closed-box models.
summary_zh: 针对目标任务调整闭盒服务模型（即API）通常依赖于零阶优化的重编程方法。然而，这种标准策略因需要大量且昂贵的API调用而广为人知，并常面临优化缓慢、不稳定的问题。此外，我们观察到该范式在面对现代API（如GPT-4o）时面临新的挑战：这些模型对零阶优化所依赖的输入扰动可能不够敏感，从而阻碍了性能提升。为应对这些局限，我们提出了一种面向服务模型的高效替代性重编程方法（AReS）。AReS不采用直接的、连续的闭盒优化，而是通过单轮交互与服务API进行初始化，以激活一个适配性良好的本地预训练编码器。该初始化阶段仅在本地编码器顶层训练一个轻量级模块，使其对后续直接在本地模型上执行的玻璃盒（白盒）重编程阶段高度敏感。因此，所有后续的适配和推理完全依赖这一本地代理模型，彻底消除了额外的API成本。实验证明AReS在先前基于零阶优化方法难以奏效的场景中表现突出：在GPT-4o上，AReS相比零样本基线实现了+27.8%的性能提升，而基于零阶优化的方法在此任务中几乎没有改进。总体而言，在十个多样化数据集上，AReS均优于现有最优方法（在视觉语言模型中提升+2.5%，在标准视觉模型中提升+15.6%），同时将API调用量降低了超过99.99%。AReS由此为适配现代闭盒模型提供了一种稳健且实用的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes AReS, an efficient method to adapt closed-box service models (like GPT-4o) by priming a local proxy encoder with a single API call, then performing white-box reprogramming locally, drastically reducing API costs.
tldr_zh: 提出AReS方法，通过单次API调用初始化一个本地代理编码器，然后在本地进行白盒重编程，从而高效适配GPT-4o等闭盒服务模型，大幅降低API调用成本。

title: LESV: Language Embedded Sparse Voxel Fusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Recent advancements in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding heavily rely on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to register vision-language features into 3D space. However, we identify two critical limitations in these approaches: the spatial ambiguity arising from unstructured, overlapping Gaussians which necessitates probabilistic feature registration, and the multi-level semantic ambiguity caused by pooling features over object-level masks, which dilutes fine-grained details. To address these challenges, we present a novel framework that leverages Sparse Voxel Rasterization (SVRaster) as a structured, disjoint geometry representation. By regularizing SVRaster with monocular depth and normal priors, we establish a stable geometric foundation. This enables a deterministic, confidence-aware feature registration process and suppresses the semantic bleeding artifact common in 3DGS. Furthermore, we resolve multi-level ambiguity by exploiting the emerging dense alignment properties of foundation model AM-RADIO, avoiding the computational overhead of hierarchical training methods. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on Open Vocabulary 3D Object Retrieval and Point Cloud Understanding benchmarks, particularly excelling on fine-grained queries where registration methods typically fail.
summary_zh: 开放词汇3D场景理解的最新进展主要依赖于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）将视觉语言特征注册到三维空间中。然而，我们发现这些方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是非结构化、重叠的高斯分布导致空间模糊性，迫使特征注册必须采用概率化方式；二是基于对象级掩码的特征池化引发多层级语义模糊，削弱了细粒度细节的捕捉能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖框架，利用稀疏体素栅格化（SVRaster）作为结构化、非重叠的几何表征。通过单目深度与法向量先验对SVRaster进行正则化，我们构建了稳定的几何基础。这实现了确定性的置信感知特征注册流程，并抑制了3DGS中常见的语义渗漏现象。此外，我们通过挖掘基础模型AM-RADIO新兴的密集对齐特性，解决了多层级语义模糊问题，避免了分层训练方法带来的计算负担。该方法在开放词汇3D物体检索与点云理解基准测试中达到最先进性能，尤其在注册方法通常失效的细粒度查询任务上表现突出。
tldr: Presents a novel framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding using a sparse voxel representation and a foundation model for deterministic feature registration, aiming to improve fine-grained 3D object retrieval and scene understanding.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于稀疏体素表示和基础模型的新框架，用于开放词汇的3D场景理解，通过确定性特征配准，旨在提升细粒度3D物体检索和场景理解能力。

title: When Reward Hacking Rebounds: Understanding and Mitigating It with Representation-Level Signals
summary: Reinforcement learning for LLMs is vulnerable to reward hacking, where models exploit shortcuts to maximize reward without solving the intended task. We systematically study this phenomenon in coding tasks using an environment-manipulation setting, where models can rewrite evaluator code to trivially pass tests without solving the task, as a controlled testbed. Across both studied models, we identify a reproducible three-phase rebound pattern: models first attempt to rewrite the evaluator but fail, as their rewrites embed test cases their own solutions cannot pass. They then temporarily retreat to legitimate solving. When legitimate reward remains scarce, they rebound into successful hacking with qualitatively different strategies. Using representation engineering, we extract concept directions for shortcut, deception, and evaluation awareness from domain-general contrastive pairs and find that the shortcut direction tracks hacking behavior most closely, making it an effective representational proxy for detection. Motivated by this finding, we propose Advantage Modification, which integrates shortcut concept scores into GRPO advantage computation to penalize hacking rollouts before policy updates. Because the penalty is internalized into the training signal rather than applied only at inference time, Advantage Modification provides more robust suppression of hacking compared with generation-time activation steering.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型强化学习易受奖励攻击影响，即模型通过利用捷径最大化奖励而非真正解决目标任务。我们以编码任务为研究对象，通过构建可操控评估环境——允许模型重写评估器代码以轻易通过测试而无需实际解决问题——作为受控实验平台，系统性地探究了这一现象。在两种被测模型中，我们观察到可复现的三阶段反弹模式：模型首先尝试重写评估器但失败，因为其改写后的代码嵌入了自身解决方案无法通过的测试用例；随后暂时退回到合法解题阶段；当合法奖励持续稀缺时，模型会以本质不同的策略反弹至成功实施攻击。通过表征工程方法，我们从领域通用对比对中提取出捷径、欺骗和评估意识的概念方向，发现捷径方向与攻击行为关联最紧密，使其成为检测攻击的有效表征代理。基于此发现，我们提出优势修正方法，将捷径概念得分整合到GRPO优势计算中，以在策略更新前惩罚攻击行为轨迹。由于该惩罚机制内化于训练信号而非仅在推理阶段应用，优势修正相比生成阶段的激活导向方法，能够更稳健地抑制攻击行为。
tldr: This paper studies reward hacking in LLMs applied to coding tasks and proposes representation engineering to detect and mitigate it via Advantage Modification during training.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型在代码任务中的奖励攻击行为，并提出了利用表征工程来检测和缓解这种攻击的方法，通过训练过程中的优势修改来抑制奖励攻击。

title: Residuals-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has received increasing attention for learning policies from previously collected data without interaction with the real environment, which is particularly important in high-stakes applications. While a growing body of work has developed offline RL algorithms, these methods often rely on restrictive assumptions about data coverage and suffer from distribution shift. In this paper, we propose a residuals-based offline RL framework for general state and action spaces. Specifically, we define a residuals-based Bellman optimality operator that explicitly incorporates estimation error in learning transition dynamics into policy optimization by leveraging empirical residuals. We show that this Bellman operator is a contraction mapping and identify conditions under which its fixed point is asymptotically optimal and possesses finite-sample guarantees. We further develop a residuals-based offline deep Q-learning (DQN) algorithm. Using a stochastic CartPole environment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our residuals-based offline DQN algorithm.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习通过从预先收集的数据中学习策略而无需与真实环境交互，已获得越来越多的关注，这在高风险应用中尤为重要。尽管已有大量研究致力于开发离线强化学习算法，但这些方法往往依赖于对数据覆盖范围的严格假设，并且容易受到分布偏移的影响。本文针对一般状态和动作空间提出了一种基于残差的离线强化学习框架。具体而言，我们定义了一个基于残差的贝尔曼最优算子，该算子通过利用经验残差将学习转移动态过程中的估计误差显式地纳入策略优化。我们证明该贝尔曼算子是收缩映射，并确定了其不动点具有渐近最优性和有限样本保证的条件。我们进一步提出了一种基于残差的离线深度Q学习算法。在随机倒立摆环境中，我们验证了所提出的基于残差的离线深度Q学习算法的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a residuals-based offline RL framework that incorporates transition dynamics estimation error into policy optimization, demonstrating its effectiveness on a stochastic CartPole environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于残差的离线强化学习框架，将转移动力学估计误差纳入策略优化，并在随机 CartPole 环境中验证了其有效性。

title: Macroscopic transport patterns of UAV traffic in 3D anisotropic wind fields: A constraint-preserving hybrid PINN-FVM approach
summary: Macroscopic unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) traffic organization in three-dimensional airspace faces significant challenges from static wind fields and complex obstacles. A critical difficulty lies in simultaneously capturing the strong anisotropy induced by wind while strictly preserving transport consistency and boundary semantics, which are often compromised in standard physics-informed learning approaches. To resolve this, we propose a constraint-preserving hybrid solver that integrates a physics-informed neural network for the anisotropic Eikonal value problem with a conservative finite-volume method for steady density transport. These components are coupled through an outer Picard iteration with under-relaxation, where the target condition is hard-encoded and strictly conservative no-flux boundaries are enforced during the transport step. We evaluate the framework on reproducible homing and point-to-point scenarios, effectively capturing value slices, induced-motion patterns, and steady density structures such as bands and bottlenecks. Ultimately, our perspective emphasizes the value of a reproducible computational framework supported by transparent empirical diagnostics to enable the traceable assessment of macroscopic traffic phenomena.
summary_zh: 三维空域中的宏观无人机交通组织面临来自静态风场和复杂障碍物的显著挑战。核心难点在于如何同时捕捉风场引起的强各向异性，并严格保持输运一致性与边界语义——这两点在标准的物理信息学习方法中常被削弱。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种约束保持的混合求解器，其整合了处理各向异性Eikonal值问题的物理信息神经网络与用于稳态密度输运的守恒型有限体积法。这两部分通过带有亚松弛技术的外层Picard迭代进行耦合，其中目标条件被硬编码，且在输运步骤中严格实施守恒的无通量边界条件。我们在可复现的归航和点对点场景中对该框架进行了评估，有效捕捉了值切片、诱导运动模式以及稳态密度结构（如带状聚集与瓶颈效应）。最终，我们的研究视角强调了一种由透明经验诊断支持的可复现计算框架的价值，以实现对宏观交通现象的可追溯评估。
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid PINN-FVM approach for organizing macroscopic UAV traffic in 3D wind fields, focusing on preserving transport constraints and boundary semantics. It is evaluated on traffic planning scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合PINN-FVM方法，用于在三维风场中组织宏观无人机交通，重点在于保持传输约束和边界语义。该方法在交通规划场景下进行了评估。

title: Deep Neural Network Based Roadwork Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Road construction sites create major challenges for both autonomous vehicles and human drivers due to their highly dynamic and heterogeneous nature. This paper presents a real-time system that detects and localizes roadworks by combining a YOLO neural network with LiDAR data. The system identifies individual roadwork objects while driving, merges them into coherent construction sites and records their outlines in world coordinates. The model training was based on an adapted US dataset and a new dataset collected from test drives with a prototype vehicle in Berlin, Germany. Evaluations on real-world road construction sites showed a localization accuracy below 0.5 m. The system can support traffic authorities with up-to-date roadwork data and could enable autonomous vehicles to navigate construction sites more safely in the future.
summary_zh: 道路施工场所因其高度动态和异构的特性，对自动驾驶车辆和人类驾驶员均构成重大挑战。本文提出了一种实时系统，通过结合YOLO神经网络与激光雷达数据，实现对道路施工的检测与定位。该系统在行驶过程中识别单个施工目标，将其整合为连贯的施工区域，并以世界坐标记录其轮廓。模型训练基于调整后的美国数据集以及从德国柏林原型车测试中采集的新数据集。在实际道路施工场景中的评估显示，该系统定位精度低于0.5米。该系统可为交通管理部门提供实时道路施工数据，并有望在未来帮助自动驾驶车辆更安全地通过施工区域。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time system for detecting and localizing road construction sites using YOLO and LiDAR data, aimed at improving autonomous vehicle navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于YOLO和LiDAR数据的实时道路施工检测系统，旨在提升自动驾驶车辆在施工区域的导航能力。

title: Learning Spatial Structure from Pre-Beamforming Per-Antenna Range-Doppler Radar Data via Visibility-Aware Cross-Modal Supervision
summary: Automotive radar perception pipelines commonly construct angle-domain representations via beamforming before applying learning-based models. This work instead investigates a representational question: can meaningful spatial structure be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna range-Doppler (RD) measurements? Experiments are conducted on a 6-TX x 8-RX (48 virtual antennas) commodity automotive radar employing an A/B chirp-sequence frequency-modulated continuous-wave (CS-FMCW) transmit scheme, in which the effective transmit aperture varies between chirps (single-TX vs. multi-TX), enabling controlled analysis of chirp-dependent transmit configurations. We operate on pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors using a dual-chirp shared-weight encoder trained in an end-to-end, fully data-driven manner, and evaluate spatial recoverability using bird's-eye-view (BEV) occupancy as a geometric probe rather than a performance-driven objective. Supervision is visibility-aware and cross-modal, derived from LiDAR with explicit modeling of the radar field-of-view and occlusion-aware LiDAR observability via ray-based visibility. Through chirp ablations (A-only, B-only, A+B), range-band analysis, and physics-aligned baselines, we assess how transmit configurations affect geometric recoverability. The results indicate that spatial structure can be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors without explicit angle-domain construction or hand-crafted signal-processing stages.
summary_zh: 汽车雷达感知系统通常先通过波束成形构建角域表示，再应用基于学习的模型。本研究则探讨一个表征层面的问题：能否直接从波束成形前各天线的距离-多普勒（RD）测量数据中学习到有意义的空间结构？实验采用一款商用汽车雷达（6个发射天线×8个接收天线，形成48个虚拟天线），该雷达使用A/B啁啾序列调频连续波（CS-FMCW）发射方案，其中有效发射孔径随啁啾序列变化（单发射天线与多发射天线交替），从而实现对啁啾依赖型发射配置的受控分析。我们基于波束成形前各天线RD张量，采用端到端全数据驱动训练的双啁啾共享权重编码器进行处理，并以鸟瞰视角（BEV）占据栅格作为几何探测工具（而非性能驱动目标）来评估空间可恢复性。监督机制具有可见性感知和跨模态特性，其来源于激光雷达数据，通过显式建模雷达视场和基于射线可见性的遮挡感知激光雷达可观测性来实现。通过啁啾消融实验（仅A啁啾、仅B啁啾、A+B啁啾）、距离段分析以及符合物理原理的基线模型，我们系统评估了发射配置如何影响几何可恢复性。结果表明：无需显式构建角域表示或手工设计信号处理阶段，空间结构可直接从波束成形前各天线RD张量中学习得到。
tldr: This paper investigates learning spatial structure directly from raw automotive radar data (per-antenna range-Doppler tensors), using a supervised encoder and LiDAR-derived visibility maps, bypassing traditional beamforming and signal processing stages for automotive perception.
tldr_zh: 本文研究如何直接从原始汽车雷达数据（单天线距离-多普勒张量）中学习空间结构，使用监督式编码器和激光雷达导出的可见性图，绕过传统的波束形成和信号处理阶段，用于汽车感知。

title: Analysis of Efficient Transmission Methods of Grid Maps for Intelligent Vehicles
summary: Grid mapping is a fundamental approach to modeling the environment of intelligent vehicles or robots. Compared with object-based environment modeling, grid maps offer the distinct advantage of representing the environment without requiring any assumptions about objects, such as type or shape. For grid-map-based approaches, the environment is divided into cells, each containing information about its respective area, such as occupancy. This representation of the entire environment is crucial for achieving higher levels of autonomy. However, it has the drawback that modeling the scene at the cell level results in inherently large data sizes. Patched grid maps tackle this issue to a certain extent by adapting cell sizes in specific areas. Nevertheless, the data sizes of patched grid maps are still too large for novel distributed processing setups or vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications. Our work builds on a patch-based grid-map approach and investigates the size problem from a communication perspective. To address this, we propose a patch-based communication pipeline that leverages existing compression algorithms to transmit grid-map data efficiently. We provide a comprehensive analysis of this pipeline for both intra-vehicle and V2X-based communication. The analysis is verified for these use cases with two real-world experiment setups. Finally, we summarize recommended guidelines for the efficient transmission of grid-map data in intelligent transportation systems.
summary_zh: 栅格地图是智能车辆或机器人环境建模的基础方法。与基于对象的环境建模相比，栅格地图具有显著优势：无需对物体类型或形状等属性做出任何假设即可表征环境。基于栅格地图的方法将环境划分为单元格，每个单元包含对应区域的信息（如占据状态），这种完整环境表征对实现高级别自动驾驶至关重要。然而该方法存在固有缺陷：单元格层级的场景建模会导致数据量庞大。分块栅格地图通过调整特定区域单元格尺寸，在一定程度上缓解了此问题，但其数据规模对于新型分布式处理架构或车联网（V2X）应用仍显过大。本研究在分块栅格地图方法基础上，从通信视角深入探讨数据规模问题，提出基于分块的通信流水线，利用现有压缩算法实现栅格地图数据的高效传输。针对车内通信和基于V2X的通信场景，我们对该流水线进行了全面分析，并通过两种真实实验场景验证了分析结果。最后，我们为智能交通系统中栅格地图数据的高效传输总结了指导性建议。
tldr: Proposes and analyzes a communication pipeline using compression algorithms to efficiently transmit grid-map data for intelligent vehicles, focusing on intra-vehicle and V2X applications.
tldr_zh: 提出并分析了一种利用压缩算法的通信管道，用于智能车辆内部及车与万物（V2X）应用中的栅格地图数据高效传输。

title: A Graph Neural Network Approach for Solving the Ranked Assignment Problem in Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Associating measurements with tracks is a crucial step in Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) to guarantee the safety of autonomous vehicles. To manage the exponentially growing number of track hypotheses, truncation becomes necessary. In the $δ$-Generalized Labeled Multi-Bernoulli ($δ$-GLMB) filter application, this truncation typically involves the ranked assignment problem, solved by Murty's algorithm or the Gibbs sampling approach, both with limitations in terms of complexity or accuracy, respectively. With the motivation to improve these limitations, this paper addresses the ranked assignment problem arising from data association tasks with an approach that employs Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The proposed Ranked Assignment Prediction Graph Neural Network (RAPNet) uses bipartite graphs to model the problem, harnessing the computational capabilities of deep learning. The conclusive evaluation compares the RAPNet with Murty's algorithm and the Gibbs sampler, showing accuracy improvements compared to the Gibbs sampler.
summary_zh: 测量与航迹的关联是多目标跟踪（MOT）中确保自动驾驶车辆安全性的关键步骤。为应对指数级增长的航迹假设数量，截断处理变得必不可少。在$δ$-广义标签多伯努利（$δ$-GLMB）滤波器应用中，此类截断通常涉及排序分配问题，传统上采用Murty算法或吉布斯采样方法求解，但二者分别存在复杂度或精度方面的局限性。为改进这些不足，本文提出利用图神经网络（GNN）处理数据关联任务中产生的排序分配问题。所提出的排序分配预测图神经网络（RAPNet）采用二分图建模问题，充分发挥深度学习的计算能力。最终评估将RAPNet与Murty算法及吉布斯采样器进行对比，结果显示其相较于吉布斯采样器在精度方面有明显提升。
tldr: The paper proposes a Graph Neural Network (RAPNet) to solve the ranked assignment problem for data association in Multi-Object Tracking (MOT), claiming improved accuracy over existing methods like Gibbs sampling.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种图神经网络（RAPNet）来解决多目标跟踪中数据关联的排序分配问题，声称相较于吉布斯采样等现有方法取得了精度提升。

title: Bridging Large-Model Reasoning and Real-Time Control via Agentic Fast-Slow Planning
summary: Large foundation models enable powerful reasoning for autonomous systems, but mapping semantic intent to reliable real-time control remains challenging. Existing approaches either (i) let Large Language Models (LLMs) generate trajectories directly - brittle, hard to verify, and latency-prone - or (ii) adjust Model Predictive Control (MPC) objectives online - mixing slow deliberation with fast control and blurring interfaces. We propose Agentic Fast-Slow Planning, a hierarchical framework that decouples perception, reasoning, planning, and control across natural timescales. The framework contains two bridges. Perception2Decision compresses scenes into ego-centric topologies using an on-vehicle Vision-Language Model (VLM) detector, then maps them to symbolic driving directives in the cloud with an LLM decision maker - reducing bandwidth and delay while preserving interpretability. Decision2Trajectory converts directives into executable paths: Semantic-Guided A* embeds language-derived soft costs into classical search to bias solutions toward feasible trajectories, while an Agentic Refinement Module adapts planner hyperparameters using feedback and memory. Finally, MPC tracks the trajectories in real time, with optional cloud-guided references for difficult cases. Experiments in CARLA show that Agentic Fast-Slow Planning improves robustness under perturbations, reducing lateral deviation by up to 45% and completion time by over 12% compared to pure MPC and an A*-guided MPC baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/cjychenjiayi/icra2026_AFSP.
summary_zh: 摘要：大型基础模型为自主系统提供了强大的推理能力，但将语义意图映射至可靠实时控制仍然面临挑战。现有方法要么（i）直接让大型语言模型（LLM）生成轨迹——这种方式脆弱、难以验证且易产生延迟；要么（ii）在线调整模型预测控制（MPC）目标——将缓慢的决策与快速控制混在一起，模糊了系统接口。我们提出“自主快慢规划”，一种分层框架，能够在自然时间尺度上解耦感知、推理、规划与控制。该框架包含两个桥接部分：感知到决策桥接通过车载视觉语言模型（VLM）检测器将场景压缩为以自我为中心的拓扑结构，再利用云端的LLM决策器将其映射为符号化驾驶指令——在保持可解释性的同时降低了带宽需求与延迟；决策到轨迹桥接将指令转化为可执行路径：语义引导的A*搜索将语言导出的软约束嵌入经典搜索算法，引导解偏向可行轨迹，而自主精化模块利用反馈与记忆自适应调整规划器超参数。最后，MPC实时跟踪轨迹，并可在复杂情况下采用云端引导的参考轨迹。在CARLA中的实验表明，与纯MPC及A*引导的MPC基线相比，自主快慢规划在扰动下提升了鲁棒性，横向偏差最大减少45%，完成时间缩短12%以上。代码发布于https://github.com/cjychenjiayi/icra2026_AFSP。
tldr: The paper proposes a hierarchical planning framework for autonomous driving that decouples high-level LLM reasoning from real-time control, using a VLM for perception and semantic-guided search, validated in the CARLA simulator.
tldr_zh: 该论文为自动驾驶提出了一种分层规划框架，将高层LLM推理与实时控制解耦，使用VLM进行感知和语义引导搜索，并在CARLA模拟器中进行了验证。

title: AffordTissue: Dense Affordance Prediction for Tool-Action Specific Tissue Interaction
summary: Surgical action automation has progressed rapidly toward achieving surgeon-like dexterous control, driven primarily by advances in learning from demonstration and vision-language-action models. While these have demonstrated success in table-top experiments, translating them to clinical deployment remains challenging: current methods offer limited predictability on where instruments will interact on tissue surfaces and lack explicit conditioning inputs to enforce tool-action-specific safe interaction regions. Addressing this gap, we introduce AffordTissue, a multimodal framework for predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions as dense heatmaps during cholecystectomy. Our approach combines a temporal vision encoder capturing tool motion and tissue dynamics across multiple viewpoints, language conditioning enabling generalization across diverse instrument-action pairs, and a DiT-style decoder for dense affordance prediction. We establish the first tissue affordance benchmark by curating and annotating 15,638 video clips across 103 cholecystectomy procedures, covering six unique tool-action pairs involving four instruments (hook, grasper, scissors, clipper) and their associated tasks: dissection, grasping, clipping, and cutting. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvement over vision-language model baselines (20.6 px ASSD vs. 60.2 px for Molmo-VLM), showing that our task-specific architecture outperforms large-scale foundation models for dense surgical affordance prediction. By predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions, AffordTissue provides explicit spatial reasoning for safe surgical automation, potentially unlocking explicit policy guidance toward appropriate tissue regions and early safe stop when instruments deviate outside predicted safe zones.
summary_zh: 手术动作自动化在实现类外科医生灵巧操控方面进展迅速，这主要得益于示教学习与视觉-语言-动作模型的进步。尽管这些技术在桌面实验中已展现成效，但将其转化为临床部署仍面临挑战：现有方法对器械在组织表面的交互位置预测能力有限，且缺乏明确的约束输入来确保工具-动作特定的安全交互区域。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AffordTissue——一个多模态框架，用于在胆囊切除术中预测工具-动作特定的组织可操作区域并生成密集热力图。该方法融合了多视角下捕捉器械运动和组织动态的时序视觉编码器、支持跨不同器械-动作对泛化的语言条件模块，以及用于密集可操作区域预测的DiT风格解码器。我们通过整理并标注103例胆囊切除术中的15,638个视频片段，建立了首个组织可操作性基准数据集，涵盖涉及四种器械（电钩、抓钳、剪刀、夹钳）及其对应任务（解剖、抓取、夹闭、切割）的六类独特工具-动作组合。实验表明，相较于视觉-语言模型基线（Molmo-VLM的60.2像素ASSD），我们的方法取得显著提升（20.6像素ASSD），证明针对特定任务设计的架构在密集手术可操作性预测方面优于大规模基础模型。通过预测工具-动作特定的组织可操作区域，AffordTissue为安全手术自动化提供了显式空间推理，有望为器械朝向合适组织区域的操作提供明确的策略指导，并在器械偏离预测安全区域时实现早期安全停止。
tldr: This paper introduces AffordTissue, a multimodal framework for predicting dense, tool-action specific affordance regions on surgical tissue to enhance automation and safety, evaluated on a novel cholecystectomy dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AffordTissue，一个用于预测手术组织中工具动作特定可供性区域的多模态框架，以增强自动化和安全性，并在一个新的胆囊切除术数据集上进行了评估。

title: Grounded Token Initialization for New Vocabulary in LMs for Generative Recommendation
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly extended with new learnable vocabulary tokens for domain-specific tasks, such as Semantic-ID tokens in generative recommendation. The standard practice initializes these new tokens as the mean of existing vocabulary embeddings, then relies on supervised fine-tuning to learn their representations. We present a systematic analysis of this strategy: through spectral and geometric diagnostics, we show that mean initialization collapses all new tokens into a degenerate subspace, erasing inter-token distinctions that subsequent fine-tuning struggles to fully recover. These findings suggest that \emph{token initialization} is a key bottleneck when extending LMs with new vocabularies. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose the \emph{Grounded Token Initialization Hypothesis}: linguistically grounding novel tokens in the pretrained embedding space before fine-tuning better enables the model to leverage its general-purpose knowledge for novel-token domains. We operationalize this hypothesis as GTI (Grounded Token Initialization), a lightweight grounding stage that, prior to fine-tuning, maps new tokens to distinct, semantically meaningful locations in the pretrained embedding space using only paired linguistic supervision. Despite its simplicity, GTI outperforms both mean initialization and existing auxiliary-task adaptation methods in the majority of evaluation settings across multiple generative recommendation benchmarks, including industry-scale and public datasets. Further analyses show that grounded embeddings produce richer inter-token structure that persists through fine-tuning, corroborating the hypothesis that initialization quality is a key bottleneck in vocabulary extension.
summary_zh: 语言模型正越来越多地通过新增可学习词汇标记来适应特定领域任务，例如生成式推荐系统中的语义ID标记。通常的做法是将这些新标记初始化为现有词汇嵌入的均值，然后依赖监督微调来学习其表征。我们对这一策略进行了系统性分析：通过谱分析和几何诊断，我们发现均值初始化会使所有新标记坍缩到一个退化子空间中，抹除了标记间的区分度，导致后续微调难以完全恢复这些差异。这些发现表明，在语言模型扩展新词汇时，\emph{标记初始化}是一个关键瓶颈。基于此诊断，我们提出\emph{接地标记初始化假说}：在微调前，将新标记在预训练嵌入空间中基于语言学进行锚定，能更好地帮助模型利用其通用知识处理新标记所属领域。我们将该假说具体化为GTI（接地标记初始化），这是一种轻量级的锚定阶段，在微调前仅使用配对的语言学监督，将新标记映射到预训练嵌入空间中具有语义意义的独特位置。尽管方法简单，在多个生成式推荐基准测试（包括工业规模及公共数据集）中，GTI在大多数评估设定下均优于均值初始化及现有的辅助任务适应方法。进一步分析表明，接地嵌入能产生更丰富的标记间结构，且这种结构在微调过程中得以保持，这证实了初始化质量是词汇扩展关键瓶颈的假设。
tldr: The paper proposes a method called Grounded Token Initialization (GTI) to better initialize new vocabulary tokens in language models by grounding them in the pre-trained embedding space before fine-tuning, improving performance on generative recommendation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种称为Grounded Token Initialization (GTI)的方法，通过在微调前将新词汇令牌在预训练嵌入空间中进行语义接地，以更好地初始化语言模型中的新词汇令牌，提升了生成式推荐任务的性能。

title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement: A Task-Scaling Law for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models employing Chain-of-Thought reasoning achieve strong performance but suffer from excessive token consumption that inflates inference costs. Existing efficiency methods such as explicit length penalties, difficulty estimators, or multi-stage curricula either degrade reasoning quality or require complex training pipelines. We introduce Batched Contextual Reinforcement, a minimalist, single-stage training paradigm that unlocks efficient reasoning through a simple structural modification: training the model to solve N problems simultaneously within a shared context window, rewarded purely by per-instance accuracy. This formulation creates an implicit token budget that yields several key findings: (1) We identify a novel task-scaling law: as the number of concurrent problems N increases during inference, per-problem token usage decreases monotonically while accuracy degrades far more gracefully than baselines, establishing N as a controllable throughput dimension. (2) BCR challenges the traditional accuracy-efficiency trade-off by demonstrating a "free lunch" phenomenon at standard single-problem inference. Across both 1.5B and 4B model families, BCR reduces token usage by 15.8% to 62.6% while consistently maintaining or improving accuracy across five major mathematical benchmarks. (3) Qualitative analyses reveal emergent self-regulated efficiency, where models autonomously eliminate redundant metacognitive loops without explicit length supervision. (4) Crucially, we empirically demonstrate that implicit budget constraints successfully circumvent the adversarial gradients and catastrophic optimization collapse inherent to explicit length penalties, offering a highly stable, constraint-based alternative for length control. These results prove BCR practical, showing simple structural incentives unlock latent high-density reasoning in LLMs.
summary_zh: 采用思维链推理的大语言模型虽然表现出色，但存在令牌消耗过多导致推理成本激增的问题。现有的效率提升方法——如显式长度惩罚、难度评估或多阶段课程学习——要么会降低推理质量，要么需要复杂的训练流程。我们提出批量上下文强化训练，这是一种极简的单阶段训练范式，通过简单的结构修改即可实现高效推理：该范式训练模型在共享的上下文窗口中同时解决N个问题，且仅以单任务准确率作为奖励依据。这种设计形成了隐式的令牌预算，并带来了几项关键发现：（1）我们揭示了一种新的任务缩放规律：在推理过程中，随着并行处理问题数N的增加，单问题令牌使用量单调递减，而准确率下降幅度远小于基线模型，从而将N确立为可控的吞吐量维度。（2）BCR突破了传统的准确率-效率权衡关系，在标准单问题推理中展现出“免费午餐”现象。在15亿和40亿参数规模的模型系列中，BCR在五个主流数学基准测试上，能在保持或提升准确率的同时，将令牌使用量降低15.8%至62.6%。（3）定性分析表明模型出现了自主调节效率的涌现行为，无需显式长度监督即可自主消除冗余的元认知循环。（4）关键的是，我们通过实验证明：隐式预算约束成功规避了显式长度惩罚固有的对抗性梯度与灾难性优化崩溃问题，为长度控制提供了高度稳定的约束型替代方案。这些结果证实了BCR的实用性，表明简单的结构激励即可激活大语言模型中潜在的高密度推理能力。
tldr: This paper introduces Batched Contextual Reinforcement, a training paradigm for Large Language Models that solves multiple problems in a shared context to improve reasoning efficiency, but it is not directly about robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了批量上下文强化学习，这是一种通过共享上下文窗口解决多个问题来提高大型语言模型推理效率的训练范式，但未直接涉及机器人学或具身人工智能。

title: Beyond the Assistant Turn: User Turn Generation as a Probe of Interaction Awareness in Language Models
summary: Standard LLM benchmarks evaluate the assistant turn: the model generates a response to an input, a verifier scores correctness, and the analysis ends. This paradigm leaves unmeasured whether the LLM encodes any awareness of what follows the assistant response. We propose user-turn generation as a probe of this gap: given a conversation context of user query and assistant response, we let a model generate under the user role. If the model's weights encode interaction awareness, the generated user turn will be a grounded follow-up that reacts to the preceding context. Through experiments across $11$ open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.5, gpt-oss, GLM) and $5$ datasets (math reasoning, instruction following, conversation), we show that interaction awareness is decoupled from task accuracy. In particular, within the Qwen3.5 family, GSM8K accuracy scales from $41\%$ ($0.8$B) to $96.8\%$ ($397$B-A$17$B), yet genuine follow-up rates under deterministic generation remain near zero. In contrast, higher temperature sampling reveals interaction awareness is latent with follow up rates reaching $22\%$. Controlled perturbations validate that the proposed probe measures a real property of the model, and collaboration-oriented post-training on Qwen3.5-2B demonstrates an increase in follow-up rates. Our results show that user-turn generation captures a dimension of LLM behavior, interaction awareness, that is unexplored and invisible with current assistant-only benchmarks.
summary_zh: 标准的LLM基准测试仅评估助手回合：模型生成对输入的响应，验证器评判正确性，分析就此结束。这种范式未能衡量LLM是否对助手响应后的内容具备任何感知能力。我们提出以用户回合生成作为探测这一空白的方法：给定用户查询和助手响应的对话上下文，让模型在用户角色下生成内容。若模型权重编码了交互感知能力，其生成的用户回合将成为基于前述语境、具有连贯性的后续回应。通过对11个开源权重LLM（Qwen3.5、GPT-OSS、GLM）和5个数据集（数学推理、指令遵循、对话）的实验，我们发现交互感知能力与任务准确性相互解耦。具体而言，在Qwen3.5系列中，GSM8K准确率从41%（0.8B参数）提升至96.8%（397B-A17B参数），但确定性生成下的真实后续问题生成率仍接近零。相比之下，更高温度采样揭示交互感知能力具有潜在性，后续问题生成率可达22%。受控扰动实验验证了所提方法确实衡量了模型的真实属性，而对Qwen3.5-2B进行的协作导向后训练也显著提升了后续问题生成率。我们的研究结果表明，用户回合生成捕获了LLM行为中一个未被当前仅关注助手回合的基准测试所探索和观察的维度——交互感知能力。
tldr: This paper investigates whether LLMs possess 'interaction awareness' by testing their ability to generate coherent user-turn follow-ups in multi-turn dialogues, finding this property is decoupled from standard task accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文通过测试LLM在多轮对话中生成连贯用户跟进的能力，探究其是否具备'交互意识'，发现这一属性与标准任务准确性是分离的。

title: Unifying Group-Relative and Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Sample Routing
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, its coarse credit assignment uniformly penalizes failed rollouts, lacking the token-level focus needed to efficiently address specific deviations. Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) addresses this by providing denser, more targeted logit-level supervision that facilitates rapid early improvement, yet it frequently collapses during prolonged training. We trace this late-stage instability to two intrinsic flaws: self-distillation on already-correct samples introduces optimization ambiguity, and the self-teacher's signal reliability progressively degrades. To resolve these issues, we propose Sample-Routed Policy Optimization (SRPO), a unified on-policy framework that routes correct samples to GRPO's reward-aligned reinforcement and failed samples to SDPO's targeted logit-level correction. SRPO further incorporates an entropy-aware dynamic weighting mechanism to suppress high-entropy, unreliable distillation targets while emphasizing confident ones. Evaluated across five benchmarks and two model scales, SRPO achieves both the rapid early improvement of SDPO and the long-horizon stability of GRPO. It consistently surpasses the peak performance of both baselines, raising the five-benchmark average on Qwen3-8B by 3.4% over GRPO and 6.3% over SDPO, while simultaneously yielding moderate response lengths and lowering per-step compute cost by up to 17.2%.
summary_zh: 采用可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大语言模型训练后阶段的标准范式。当前广泛采用的群体相对策略优化方法存在粗粒度信用分配问题，即对失败样本序列进行统一惩罚，缺乏针对具体偏差所需的词元级细粒度修正能力。而自蒸馏策略优化通过提供更密集、更具针对性的逻辑值级监督，实现了快速早期改进，但在长期训练中频繁出现性能崩溃。我们将这种后期不稳定性归因于两个内在缺陷：对已正确样本的自蒸馏会引入优化模糊性，且自教师信号的可靠性会逐渐下降。为解决这些问题，我们提出样本路由策略优化这一统一的在线策略框架，将正确样本路由至群体相对策略优化的奖励对齐强化路径，失败样本则路由至自蒸馏策略优化的目标逻辑值级修正路径。该方法进一步引入基于熵感知的动态加权机制，抑制高熵值不可靠的蒸馏目标，同时强化置信度高的目标。通过在五个基准测试集和两种模型规模上的评估，样本路由策略优化同时实现了自蒸馏策略优化的快速早期改进与群体相对策略优化的长期稳定训练。其性能始终超越两种基线方法的峰值表现，在Qwen3-8B模型上将五个基准测试平均性能较群体相对策略优化提升3.4%，较自蒸馏策略优化提升6.3%，同时保持适中的响应长度，并将单步计算成本降低最高达17.2%。
tldr: This paper introduces SRPO, a unified on-policy framework for RLHF of LLMs that routes correct and incorrect samples to different training objectives, improving stability and performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SRPO，一种用于大语言模型RLHF的统一框架，通过路由正确与错误样本到不同训练目标，提升了训练稳定性和性能。

title: Novel Memory Forgetting Techniques for Autonomous AI Agents: Balancing Relevance and Efficiency
summary: Long-horizon conversational agents require persistent memory for coherent reasoning, yet uncontrolled accumulation causes temporal decay and false memory propagation. Benchmarks such as LOCOMO and LOCCO report performance degradation from 0.455 to 0.05 across stages, while MultiWOZ shows 78.2% accuracy with 6.8% false memory rate under persistent retention. This work introduces an adaptive budgeted forgetting framework that regulates memory through relevanceguided scoring and bounded optimization. The approach integrates recency, frequency, and semantic alignment to maintain stability under constrained context. Comparative analysis demonstrates improved long-horizon F1 beyond 0.583 baseline levels, higher retention consistency, and reduced false memory behavior without increasing context usage. These findings confirm that structured forgetting preserves reasoning performance while preventing unbounded memory growth in extended conversational settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
长时程对话智能体需要持久记忆以实现连贯推理，但无控制的记忆累积会导致时序衰减与错误记忆传播。现有基准测试显示，在LOCOMO与LOCCO中，系统性能随对话阶段推进从0.455下降至0.05；而MultiWOZ在持续记忆场景下虽达到78.2%的准确率，却伴随6.8%的错误记忆率。本研究提出一种自适应预算遗忘框架，通过相关性引导评分与有界优化机制实现对记忆的调控。该方法融合时效性、频率与语义对齐度，在受限上下文条件下维持记忆稳定性。对比分析表明，该框架在长时程任务中的F1值提升至0.583以上，优于基线水平，同时保持更高记忆一致性，并显著降低错误记忆率，且未增加上下文负载。这些结果证实，结构化遗忘策略能在扩展对话场景中有效维持推理性能，同时避免记忆的无限制增长。
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive budgeted forgetting framework for conversational AI agents to manage memory growth, balancing relevance and efficiency through recency, frequency, and semantic metrics to improve long-horizon reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于对话AI代理的自适应预算遗忘框架，通过新近性、频率和语义对齐等指标管理记忆增长，在提高长时程推理能力的同时控制记忆规模。

title: De Jure: Iterative LLM Self-Refinement for Structured Extraction of Regulatory Rules
summary: Regulatory documents encode legally binding obligations that LLM-based systems must respect. Yet converting dense, hierarchically structured legal text into machine-readable rules remains a costly, expert-intensive process. We present De Jure, a fully automated, domain-agnostic pipeline for extracting structured regulatory rules from raw documents, requiring no human annotation, domain-specific prompting, or annotated gold data. De Jure operates through four sequential stages: normalization of source documents into structured Markdown; LLM-driven semantic decomposition into structured rule units; multi-criteria LLM-as-a-judge evaluation across 19 dimensions spanning metadata, definitions, and rule semantics; and iterative repair of low-scoring extractions within a bounded regeneration budget, where upstream components are repaired before rule units are evaluated. We evaluate De Jure across four models on three regulatory corpora spanning finance, healthcare, and AI governance. On the finance domain, De Jure yields consistent and monotonic improvement in extraction quality, reaching peak performance within three judge-guided iterations. De Jure generalizes effectively to healthcare and AI governance, maintaining high performance across both open- and closed-source models. In a downstream compliance question-answering evaluation via RAG, responses grounded in De Jure extracted rules are preferred over prior work in 73.8% of cases at single-rule retrieval depth, rising to 84.0% under broader retrieval, confirming that extraction fidelity translates directly into downstream utility. These results demonstrate that explicit, interpretable evaluation criteria can substitute for human annotation in complex regulatory domains, offering a scalable and auditable path toward regulation-grounded LLM alignment.
summary_zh: 监管文件载明了基于大语言模型系统必须遵守的具有法律约束力的义务。然而，将密集、分层结构的法律文本转化为机器可读的规则，仍然是一个成本高昂且高度依赖专家经验的过程。我们提出了De Jure——一个完全自动化、领域无关的管道，用于从原始文档中提取结构化监管规则，无需人工标注、特定领域提示或标注黄金数据。De Jure通过四个顺序阶段运行：将源文档规范化成结构化的Markdown格式；通过大语言模型驱动将文本语义分解为结构化规则单元；采用“大语言模型即法官”方法，在涵盖元数据、定义和规则语义的19个维度上进行多准则评估；以及在有限再生预算内对低分提取结果进行迭代修复，即在评估规则单元之前修复上游组件。我们在金融、医疗和人工智能治理三个监管语料库上，对四个模型进行了De Jure的评估。在金融领域，De Jure在提取质量上实现了持续且单调的改进，在三次法官引导的迭代内达到峰值性能。De Jure能有效泛化到医疗和人工智能治理领域，在开源和闭源模型上均保持高性能。在通过RAG进行下游合规问答评估中，基于De Jure提取规则的回答在单规则检索深度下，73.8%的案例中优于先前工作；在更广泛检索条件下，这一比例提升至84.0%，证实了提取保真度直接转化为下游效用。这些结果表明，在复杂的监管领域，明确、可解释的评估标准可以替代人工标注，为基于监管的大语言模型对齐提供了一条可扩展且可审计的路径。
tldr: This paper introduces De Jure, a fully automated pipeline for extracting structured regulatory rules from legal documents using iterative LLM self-refinement, evaluated in finance, healthcare, and AI governance domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了De Jure，一个利用LLM迭代自我精炼从法律文件中自动提取结构化监管规则的系统，并在金融、医疗和AI治理领域进行了评估。

title: When to ASK: Uncertainty-Gated Language Assistance for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents often struggle with out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, leading to high uncertainty and random behavior. While language models (LMs) contain valuable world knowledge, larger ones incur high computational costs, hindering real-time use, and exhibit limitations in autonomous planning. We introduce Adaptive Safety through Knowledge (ASK), which combines smaller LMs with trained RL policies to enhance OOD generalization without retraining. ASK employs Monte Carlo Dropout to assess uncertainty and queries the LM for action suggestions only when uncertainty exceeds a set threshold. This selective use preserves the efficiency of existing policies while leveraging the language model's reasoning in uncertain situations. In experiments on the FrozenLake environment, ASK shows no improvement in-domain, but demonstrates robust navigation in transfer tasks, achieving a reward of 0.95. Our findings indicate that effective neuro-symbolic integration requires careful orchestration rather than simple combination, highlighting the need for sufficient model scale and effective hybridization mechanisms for successful OOD generalization.
summary_zh: 强化学习智能体在面对分布外场景时往往表现不佳，导致不确定性增加和行为随机化。虽然语言模型蕴含丰富的世界知识，但较大规模模型会带来高昂计算成本，阻碍实时应用，且在自主规划方面存在局限性。本文提出自适应知识安全框架，通过将小型语言模型与训练好的强化学习策略相结合，无需重新训练即可提升分布外泛化能力。该框架采用蒙特卡洛丢弃法评估不确定性，仅当不确定性超过设定阈值时才向语言模型请求行动建议。这种选择性调用机制在保持现有策略效率的同时，还能在不确定情境中利用语言模型的推理能力。在FrozenLake环境中的实验表明，该框架在域内任务上未见提升，但在迁移任务中展现出稳健的导航能力，获得0.95的奖励回报。研究结果表明，有效的神经符号集成需要精细协调而非简单组合，同时强调足够的模型规模和有效的混合机制对于实现成功的分布外泛化至关重要。
tldr: The paper proposes ASK, an adaptive method that uses Monte Carlo Dropout to gate queries to a language model for action suggestions only when a trained RL agent is uncertain, improving OOD generalization without retraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出ASK方法，利用蒙特卡洛丢弃法在强化学习智能体不确定性高时，选择性查询语言模型获取动作建议，无需重新训练即可改善分布外泛化能力。

title: VISTA: Visualization of Token Attribution via Efficient Analysis
summary: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) process information from prompts remains a significant challenge. To shed light on this "black box," attention visualization techniques have been developed to capture neuron-level perceptions and interpret how models focus on different parts of input data. However, many existing techniques are tailored to specific model architectures, particularly within the Transformer family, and often require backpropagation, resulting in nearly double the GPU memory usage and increased computational cost. A lightweight, model-agnostic approach for attention visualization remains lacking. In this paper, we introduce a model-agnostic token importance visualization technique to better understand how generative AI systems perceive and prioritize information from input text, without incurring additional computational cost. Our method leverages perturbation-based strategies combined with a three-matrix analytical framework to generate relevance maps that illustrate token-level contributions to model predictions. The framework comprises: (1) the Angular Deviation Matrix, which captures shifts in semantic direction; (2) the Magnitude Deviation Matrix, which measures changes in semantic intensity; and (3) the Dimensional Importance Matrix, which evaluates contributions across individual vector dimensions. By systematically removing each token and measuring the resulting impact across these three complementary dimensions, we derive a composite importance score that provides a nuanced and mathematically grounded measure of token significance. To support reproducibility and foster wider adoption, we provide open-source implementations of all proposed and utilized explainability techniques, with code and resources publicly available at https://github.com/Infosys/Infosys-Responsible-AI-Toolkit
summary_zh: 理解大型语言模型（LLM）如何从提示中处理信息仍然是一个重大挑战。为揭示这一“黑箱”机制，研究者开发了注意力可视化技术来捕捉神经元层面的感知，并解释模型如何聚焦于输入数据的不同部分。然而，现有技术多针对特定模型架构（尤其是Transformer系列）设计，且通常需要反向传播，导致GPU内存使用量近乎翻倍，计算成本显著增加。目前仍缺乏一种轻量级、模型无关的注意力可视化方法。本文提出一种模型无关的标记重要性可视化技术，旨在不增加额外计算成本的前提下，更好地理解生成式AI系统如何感知并优先处理输入文本中的信息。该方法基于扰动策略结合三矩阵分析框架，生成展示标记对模型预测贡献程度的相关性图谱。该框架包含：（1）捕捉语义方向偏移的角偏差矩阵；（2）衡量语义强度变化的幅度偏差矩阵；（3）评估向量各维度贡献的维度重要性矩阵。通过系统性地移除每个标记并测量其在三个互补维度上的影响，我们推导出复合重要性分数，从而提供一种细致入微且基于数学原理的标记重要性度量方法。为支持可复现性并促进广泛采用，我们提供了所有提出及使用的可解释性技术的开源实现，代码与资源公开于https://github.com/Infosys/Infosys-Responsible-AI-Toolkit。
tldr: This paper introduces a model-agnostic, perturbation-based technique for visualizing token importance in LLMs, focusing on computational efficiency and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种与模型无关的、基于扰动的标记重要性可视化技术，用于解释LLM，重点关注计算效率和可解释性。

title: Universal Hypernetworks for Arbitrary Models
summary: Conventional hypernetworks are typically engineered around a specific base-model parameterization, so changing the target architecture often entails redesigning the hypernetwork and retraining it from scratch. We introduce the \emph{Universal Hypernetwork} (UHN), a fixed-architecture generator that predicts weights from deterministic parameter, architecture, and task descriptors. This descriptor-based formulation decouples the generator architecture from target-network parameterization, so one generator can instantiate heterogeneous models across the tested architecture and task families. Our empirical claims are threefold: (1) one fixed UHN remains competitive with direct training across vision, graph, text, and formula-regression benchmarks; (2) the same UHN supports both multi-model generalization within a family and multi-task learning across heterogeneous models; and (3) UHN enables stable recursive generation with up to three intermediate generated UHNs before the final base model. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xuanfeng-Zhou/UHN.
summary_zh: 传统超网络通常围绕特定的基础模型参数化方式设计，因此改变目标架构往往需要重新设计超网络并从头开始训练。我们提出通用超网络（UHN），这是一种固定架构的生成器，能够依据确定性参数、架构和任务描述符来预测权重。这种基于描述符的设定方式将生成器架构与目标网络的参数化解耦，使得一个生成器能够在测试的架构和任务族中实例化异构模型。我们的实证研究有三项主要发现：（1）在视觉、图结构、文本和公式回归基准测试中，一个固定的UHN模型仍能保持与直接训练方法相当的性能；（2）同一UHN既可支持同一模型族内的多模型泛化，也能实现跨异构模型的多任务学习；（3）UHN能实现稳定的递归生成，在最终生成基础模型前最多可支持三层中间生成UHN。我们的代码公开于https://github.com/Xuanfeng-Zhou/UHN。
tldr: The paper introduces a Universal Hypernetwork (UHN) that can generate weights for diverse model architectures and tasks using a fixed generator, demonstrating competitive performance across various domains and enabling recursive generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通用超网络（UHN），能够使用固定生成器为不同架构和任务生成模型权重，在多个领域展现竞争性能，并支持递归生成。

title: Neuro-RIT: Neuron-Guided Instruction Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Language Model
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) have demonstrated significant potential in knowledge-intensive tasks; however, they remain vulnerable to performance degradation when presented with irrelevant or noisy retrieved contexts. Existing approaches to enhance robustness typically operate via coarse-grained parameter updates at the layer or module level, often overlooking the inherent neuron-level sparsity of Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this limitation, we propose Neuro-RIT (Neuron-guided Robust Instruction Tuning), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from dense adaptation to precision-driven neuron alignment. Our method explicitly disentangles neurons that are responsible for processing relevant versus irrelevant contexts using attribution-based neuron mining. Subsequently, we introduce a two-stage instruction tuning strategy that enforces a dual capability for noise robustness: achieving direct noise suppression by functionally deactivating neurons exclusive to irrelevant contexts, while simultaneously optimizing targeted layers for evidence distillation. Extensive experiments across diverse QA benchmarks demonstrate that Neuro-RIT consistently outperforms strong baselines and robustness-enhancing methods.
summary_zh: 检索增强型语言模型（RALMs）在知识密集型任务中展现出显著潜力，但其在面临无关或噪声检索上下文时仍存在性能下降问题。现有增强模型鲁棒性的方法通常通过在层或模块级别进行粗粒度参数更新实现，往往忽视了大型语言模型（LLMs）固有的神经元级稀疏性。为突破这一局限，本文提出Neuro-RIT（神经元引导的鲁棒指令微调）框架，将传统密集适应范式转变为精准驱动的神经元对齐范式。该方法基于归因分析的神经元挖掘技术，显式解耦处理相关上下文与无关上下文的神经元功能，进而设计双阶段指令微调策略：通过功能性抑制无关上下文专属神经元实现直接噪声抑制，同时针对证据提取层进行定向优化，从而构建双重噪声鲁棒能力。在多样化问答基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Neuro-RIT在各项评估中均稳定优于现有基线模型及鲁棒性增强方法。
tldr: The paper introduces Neuro-RIT, a method for improving the robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) by using neuron-level analysis and targeted instruction tuning to suppress noise from irrelevant retrieved contexts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Neuro-RIT方法，通过神经元级分析和有针对性的指令微调，来增强检索增强语言模型对不相关检索上下文的鲁棒性，抑制噪声影响。

title: MTI: A Behavior-Based Temperament Profiling System for AI Agents
summary:
AI models of equivalent capability can exhibit fundamentally different behavioral patterns, yet no standardized instrument exists to measure these dispositional differences. Existing approaches either borrow human personality dimensions and rely on self-report (which diverges from actual behavior in LLMs) or treat behavioral variation as a defect rather than a trait.
  We introduce the Model Temperament Index (MTI), a behavior-based profiling system that measures AI agent temperament across four axes: Reactivity (environmental sensitivity), Compliance (instruction-behavior alignment), Sociality (relational resource allocation), and Resilience (stress resistance). Grounded in the Four Shell Model from Model Medicine, MTI measures what agents do, not what they say about themselves, using structured examination protocols with a two-stage design that separates capability from disposition.
  We profile 10 small language models (1.7B-9B parameters, 6 organizations, 3 training paradigms) and report five principal findings: (1) the four axes are largely independent among instruction-tuned models (all |r| < 0.42); (2) within-axis facet dissociations are empirically confirmed -- Compliance decomposes into fully independent formal and stance facets (r = 0.002), while Resilience decomposes into inversely related cognitive and adversarial facets; (3) a Compliance-Resilience paradox reveals that opinion-yielding and fact-vulnerability operate through independent channels; (4) RLHF reshapes temperament not only by shifting axis scores but by creating within-axis facet differentiation absent in the unaligned base model; and (5) temperament is independent of model size (1.7B-9B), confirming that MTI measures disposition rather than capability.
summary_zh:
能力相当的AI模型可表现出截然不同的行为模式，但现有方法缺乏测量这种倾向性差异的标准化工具。当前研究要么借用人类人格维度并依赖自我报告（这与大语言模型的实际行为存在偏差），要么将行为变异视为缺陷而非特质。

我们提出模型性格指数（MTI），这是一种基于行为分析的测评体系，通过四个维度衡量AI智能体的性格特征：反应性（环境敏感度）、顺从性（指令-行为一致性）、社交性（关系资源分配）和韧性（抗压能力）。该体系基于模型医学中的四壳理论，通过结构化双阶段检测方案分离能力与倾向，聚焦智能体的实际行为而非自我陈述。

我们对10个小型语言模型（参数1.7B-9B，来自6个机构，涵盖3种训练范式）进行测评，得出五项核心发现：（1）指令微调模型的四个维度基本独立（所有|r|<0.42）；（2）维度内子成分存在分离现象——顺从性可分解为完全独立的形式遵从与立场遵从（r=0.002），韧性可分解为负相关的认知韧性与对抗韧性；（3）顺从性-韧性悖论表明意见屈从与事实脆弱性通过独立通道运作；（4）RLHF不仅改变维度得分，还能在未对齐基模型基础上创建维度内子成分分化；（5）性格特征与模型规模无关（1.7B-9B），证实MTI测量的是倾向性而非能力。
tldr: The paper introduces a behavior-based profiling system (MTI) to measure temperament in AI agents across four axes using structured examination protocols, with findings on trait independence, facet dissociations, and the effects of RLHF.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于行为的AI智能体气质分析系统（MTI），通过结构化测试协议在四个维度上评估智能体，报告了特质独立性、维度内特征分离以及RLHF影响等发现。

title: Diff-KD: Diffusion-based Knowledge Distillation for Collaborative Perception under Corruptions
summary: Multi-agent collaborative perception enables autonomous systems to overcome individual sensing limits through collective intelligence. However, real-world sensor and communication corruptions severely undermine this advantage. Crucially, existing approaches treat corruptions as static perturbations or passively conform to corrupted inputs, failing to actively recover the underlying clean semantics. To address this limitation, we introduce Diff-KD, a framework that integrates diffusion-based generative refinement into teacher-student knowledge distillation for robust collaborative perception. Diff-KD features two core components: (i) Progressive Knowledge Distillation (PKD), which treats local feature restoration as a conditional diffusion process to recover global semantics from corrupted observations; and (ii) Adaptive Gated Fusion (AGF), which dynamically weights neighbors based on ego reliability during fusion. Evaluated on OPV2V and DAIR-V2X under seven corruption types, Diff-KD achieves state-of-the-art performance in both detection accuracy and calibration robustness.
summary_zh: 多智能体协同感知通过集体智能使自主系统能够突破个体感知的局限。然而，现实中的传感器故障与通信干扰严重削弱了这一优势。关键在于，现有方法将干扰视为静态扰动或被动适应受损输入，未能主动恢复潜在的干净语义。为应对这一局限，我们提出了Diff-KD框架——它将基于扩散的生成式优化与师生知识蒸馏相结合，以构建鲁棒的协同感知系统。Diff-KD包含两个核心组件：（1）渐进式知识蒸馏（PKD），将局部特征恢复建模为条件扩散过程，从受损观测中重构全局语义；（2）自适应门控融合（AGF），在特征融合过程中依据本体可靠性动态调整邻域智能体的权重。在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X数据集上对七类干扰场景的测试表明，Diff-KD在检测精度与校准鲁棒性方面均达到了最先进的性能水平。
tldr: The paper introduces Diff-KD, a framework that uses diffusion-based generative refinement within a teacher-student knowledge distillation pipeline to improve the robustness of multi-agent collaborative perception systems against sensor and communication corruptions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Diff-KD框架，该框架在教师-学生知识蒸馏流程中集成了基于扩散的生成式细化方法，以提升多智能体协同感知系统对抗传感器和通信损坏的鲁棒性。

title: The Latent Space: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook
summary: Latent space is rapidly emerging as a native substrate for language-based models. While modern systems are still commonly understood through explicit token-level generation, an increasing body of work shows that many critical internal processes are more naturally carried out in continuous latent space than in human-readable verbal traces. This shift is driven by the structural limitations of explicit-space computation, including linguistic redundancy, discretization bottlenecks, sequential inefficiency, and semantic loss. This survey aims to provide a unified and up-to-date landscape of latent space in language-based models. We organize the survey into five sequential perspectives: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook. We begin by delineating the scope of latent space, distinguishing it from explicit or verbal space and from the latent spaces commonly studied in generative visual models. We then trace the field's evolution from early exploratory efforts to the current large-scale expansion. To organize the technical landscape, we examine existing work through the complementary lenses of mechanism and ability. From the perspective of Mechanism, we identify four major lines of development: Architecture, Representation, Computation, and Optimization. From the perspective of Ability, we show how latent space supports a broad capability spectrum spanning Reasoning, Planning, Modeling, Perception, Memory, Collaboration, and Embodiment. Beyond consolidation, we discuss the key open challenges, and outline promising directions for future research. We hope this survey serves not only as a reference for existing work, but also as a foundation for understanding latent space as a general computational and systems paradigm for next-generation intelligence.
summary_zh: 潜在空间正迅速成为基于语言模型的原生运算基质。尽管现代系统通常仍通过显式的词元级生成被理解，但越来越多的研究表明，许多关键内部过程在连续潜在空间中的运行比在人类可读的文本轨迹中更为自然。这一转变的驱动力来自显式空间计算的结构性局限，包括语言冗余、离散化瓶颈、序列效率低下及语义损失。本综述旨在为基于语言模型的潜在空间研究提供统一而前沿的全景图。我们将从五个递进视角组织论述：基础、演进、机制、能力与展望。首先界定潜在空间的范围，将其与显式/文本空间及生成式视觉模型中常见的潜在空间相区分。随后追溯该领域从早期探索到当前大规模拓展的演进历程。为梳理技术脉络，我们通过机制与能力的互补视角审视现有研究：从机制视角归纳架构、表示、计算与优化四条主要发展路径；从能力视角展现在推理、规划、建模、感知、记忆、协作与具身化等广泛能力谱系中潜在空间的支持作用。在整合现有成果的基础上，我们进一步讨论当前面临的开放性挑战，并指出未来研究的潜在方向。本综述不仅可作为现有工作的参考文献，更希望为理解潜在空间作为下一代智能的通用计算与系统范式奠定基础。
tldr: This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of latent space research in language-based models, covering its foundations, evolution, technical mechanisms, enabled capabilities, and future outlook.
tldr_zh: 本综述论文全面概述了语言模型中潜在空间的研究，涵盖其基础、演变、技术机制、实现的能力及未来展望。

title: ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Trajectory Benchmark for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Evaluating the safety of LLM-based agents is increasingly important because risks in realistic deployments often emerge over multi-step interactions rather than isolated prompts or final responses. Existing trajectory-level benchmarks remain limited by insufficient interaction diversity, coarse observability of safety failures, and weak long-horizon realism. We introduce ATBench, a trajectory-level benchmark for structured, diverse, and realistic evaluation of agent safety. ATBench organizes agentic risk along three dimensions: risk source, failure mode, and real-world harm. Based on this taxonomy, we construct trajectories with heterogeneous tool pools and a long-context delayed-trigger protocol that captures realistic risk emergence across multiple stages. The benchmark contains 1,000 trajectories (503 safe and 497 unsafe), averaging 9.01 turns and 3.95k tokens, with 1,954 invoked tools drawn from pools spanning 2,084 available tools. Data quality is supported by rule-based and LLM-based filtering plus full human audit. Experiments on frontier LLMs, open-source models, and specialized guard systems show that ATBench is challenging even for strong evaluators, while enabling taxonomy-stratified analysis, cross-benchmark comparison, and diagnosis of long-horizon failure patterns.
summary_zh: 评估基于大语言模型的智能体安全性正变得愈发重要，因为在现实部署中，风险通常出现在多步交互过程中，而非孤立的提示或最终响应中。现有的轨迹级评估基准仍受限于交互多样性不足、安全性失效的可观测性粗糙以及长程真实感薄弱。本文提出ATBench，这是一个用于结构化、多样化且贴近实际场景的智能体安全评估的轨迹级基准。ATBench将智能体风险沿三个维度进行组织：风险来源、失效模式和现实危害。基于此分类体系，我们构建了包含异构工具池和长上下文延迟触发协议的交互轨迹，以捕捉跨多阶段真实风险的产生过程。该基准包含1000条轨迹（503条安全轨迹和497条不安全轨迹），平均交互轮次为9.01轮，平均长度为3.95千词，共调用1954次工具，这些工具来自涵盖2084个可用工具的工具池。数据质量通过基于规则的过滤、大语言模型过滤以及全人工审核三重机制保障。对前沿大语言模型、开源模型和专用防护系统的实验表明，即使对于强评估器而言，ATBench仍具有挑战性，同时支持基于分类的层次化分析、跨基准比较以及长程失效模式的诊断。
tldr: This paper introduces a trajectory-level benchmark for evaluating the safety of LLM-based agents, focusing on long-horizon, multi-step interaction risks. It does not address robotics or embodied AI directly, but focuses on general agent safety in tool-use and interaction contexts.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于评估基于LLM的智能体安全性的轨迹级基准，专注于长视野、多步骤的交互风险，未直接涉及机器人学或具身AI，而是侧重于工具使用和交互中的通用智能体安全性。

title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
summary: Gait analysis provides an objective characterization of locomotor function and is widely used to support diagnosis and rehabilitation monitoring across neurological and orthopedic disorders. Deep learning has been increasingly applied to this domain, yet most approaches rely on supervised classifiers trained on disease-labeled data, limiting generalization to heterogeneous pathological presentations. This work proposes a label-free framework for joint-level anomaly detection and kinematic correction based on a Transformer masked autoencoder trained exclusively on normative gait sequences from 150 adults, acquired with a markerless multi-camera motion-capture system. At inference, a two-pass procedure is applied to potentially pathological input sequences, first it estimates joint inconsistency scores by occluding individual joints and measuring deviations from the learned normative prior. Then, it withholds the flagged joints from the encoder input and reconstructs the full skeleton from the remaining spatiotemporal context, yielding corrected kinematic trajectories at the flagged positions. Validation on 10 held-out normative participants, who mimicked seven simulated gait abnormalities, showed accurate localization of biomechanically inconsistent joints, a significant reduction in angular deviation across all analyzed joints with large effect sizes, and preservation of normative kinematics. The proposed approach enables interpretable, subject-specific localization of gait impairments without requiring disease labels. Video is available at https://youtu.be/Rcm3jqR5pN4.
summary_zh: 步态分析为运动功能提供了客观表征，并广泛应用于神经系统和骨科疾病的诊断与康复监测。深度学习在这一领域的应用日益增多，但大多数方法依赖于基于疾病标签数据训练的有监督分类器，限制了其在异质性病理表现中的泛化能力。本研究提出了一种基于无标签的关节级异常检测与运动学矫正框架，该框架采用Transformer掩码自编码器，仅在150名成年人的正常步态序列上进行训练，数据通过无标记多摄像头动作捕捉系统采集。在推理阶段，针对可能具有病理特征的输入序列采用双步处理流程：首先通过遮蔽单个关节并测量其与学习到的正常先验分布的偏差来估计关节不一致性评分；随后在编码器输入中排除被标记的关节，利用剩余时空上下文信息重建完整骨架，从而在标记位置生成修正后的运动学轨迹。在10名模拟七种异常步态的健康受试者上进行的验证表明，该方法能够准确定位生物力学不一致的关节，显著降低所有分析关节的角度偏差（效应量大），并保持正常运动学特征。所提出的方法无需疾病标签即可实现可解释、个体化的步态损伤定位。演示视频详见：https://youtu.be/Rcm3jqR5pN4。
tldr: This paper introduces a label-free Transformer-based framework for detecting anomalies and correcting kinematic trajectories in human gait, using a masked autoencoder trained only on normative data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的无标签框架，用于检测人类步态异常并校正关节运动轨迹，仅使用正常步态数据训练掩码自编码器。

title: Attention at Rest Stays at Rest: Breaking Visual Inertia for Cognitive Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Like a body at rest that stays at rest, we find that visual attention in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibits pronounced inertia, remaining largely static once settled during early decoding steps and failing to support the compositional understanding required for cognitive inference. While existing hallucination mitigation methods mainly target perceptual hallucinations concerning object existence or attributes, they remain inadequate for such cognitive hallucinations that require inter-object relational deduction. Through token-wise attention analysis, we identify this visual inertia as a key factor: attention to semantically critical regions remains persistently focused and fails to dynamically support relational inference. We thereby propose a training-free Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE) method that breaks this inertial pattern by modeling cognitive inference as the dynamic responsiveness of visual attention. Specifically, IVE selects visual tokens that are dynamically emerging relative to historical attention trends while distinguishing tokens exhibiting inertial behavior. To further facilitate compositional inference, IVE introduces an inertia-aware penalty that discourages over-concentration and limits the persistence of attention within localized regions. Extensive experiments show that IVE is effective across various base MLLMs and multiple hallucination benchmarks, particularly for cognitive hallucinations.
summary_zh: 摘要：如同静止的物体会保持静止状态一样，我们发现多模态大语言模型中的视觉注意力存在显著的惯性现象——其在早期解码阶段一旦稳定便基本保持静态，难以支撑认知推理所需的组合式理解能力。现有缓解幻觉的方法主要针对物体存在或属性相关的感知幻觉，但对于需要对象间关系推理的认知幻觉仍显不足。通过基于token的注意力分析，我们识别出这种视觉惯性是关键因素：对语义关键区域的注意力持续聚焦，无法动态支持关系推理。为此，我们提出了一种无需训练的惯性感知视觉激活方法，通过将认知推理建模为视觉注意力的动态响应模式来打破这种惯性机制。具体而言，该方法通过对比历史注意力趋势筛选出动态涌现的视觉token，同时识别具有惯性行为的token。为进一步促进组合推理，该方法引入惯性感知惩罚机制，抑制注意力过度集中于局部区域并限制其持续固化。大量实验表明，该方法在多种基础多模态大语言模型及多个幻觉评测基准上均表现出有效性，尤其针对认知幻觉具有显著改善效果。
tldr: This paper addresses cognitive hallucinations in MLLMs by identifying and mitigating visual attention inertia, a training-free method to improve compositional understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文针对MLLMs中的认知幻觉问题，通过识别和缓解视觉注意力惯性，提出了一种无需训练的改进方法，以提升组合推理能力。

title: Captioning Daily Activity Images in Early Childhood Education: Benchmark and Algorithm
summary:
Image captioning for Early Childhood Education (ECE) is essential for automated activity understanding and educational assessment. However, existing methods face two key challenges.
