First, the lack of large-scale, domain-specific datasets limits the model's ability to capture fine-grained semantic concepts unique to ECE scenarios, resulting in generic and imprecise descriptions. Second, conventional training paradigms exhibit limitations in enhancing professional object description capability, as supervised learning tends to favor high-frequency expressions, while reinforcement learning may suffer from unstable optimization on difficult samples.
  To address these limitations, we introduce ECAC, a large-scale benchmark for ECE daily activity image captioning, comprising 256,121 real-world images annotated with expert-level captions and fine-grained labels. ECAC is further equipped with a domain-oriented evaluation protocol, the Teaching Toy Recognition Score (TTS), to explicitly measure professional object naming accuracy. Furthermore, we propose RSRS (Reward-Conditional Switch of Reinforcement Learning and Supervised Fine-Tuning), a hybrid training framework that dynamically alternates between RL and supervised optimization. By rerouting hard samples with zero rewards to supervised fine-tuning, RSRS effectively mitigates advantage collapse and enables stable optimization for fine-grained recognition. Leveraging ECAC and RSRS, we develop KinderMM-Cap-3B, a domain-adapted multimodal large language model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves a TTS of 51.06, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining superior caption quality, highlighting its potential for specialized educational applications.
summary_zh:
面向早期儿童教育（ECE）的图像描述技术对于自动化活动理解与教育评估至关重要。然而，现有方法面临两大挑战：其一，大规模领域专用数据集的缺乏限制了模型捕捉ECE场景中特有的细粒度语义概念的能力，导致描述内容笼统且不精确；其二，传统训练范式在提升专业对象描述能力方面存在局限——监督学习倾向于高频表达模式，而强化学习在困难样本上可能面临优化不稳定的问题。

为突破这些局限，本研究提出ECAC：一个面向ECE日常活动图像描述的大规模基准数据集，包含256,121张真实场景图像，并配有专家级描述文本与细粒度标签。ECAC进一步配备了领域导向的评估指标——教学玩具识别分数（TTS），以精确衡量专业对象命名的准确性。此外，我们提出RSRS（基于奖励条件的强化学习与监督微调切换）混合训练框架，该框架能动态交替执行强化学习与监督优化。通过将零奖励的困难样本重定向至监督微调，RSRS有效缓解了优势坍塌现象，实现了细粒度识别的稳定优化。基于ECAC与RSRS，我们开发了领域适配的多模态大语言模型KinderMM-Cap-3B。大量实验表明，该模型在TTS指标上达到51.06分，显著优于现有前沿基线模型，同时保持了卓越的描述质量，凸显了其在专业化教育应用领域的巨大潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a new image captioning benchmark for early childhood education activities and a hybrid training algorithm, resulting in a specialized multimodal language model for educational applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于学前教育日常活动图像描述的基准数据集，以及一种混合训练算法，开发了一个专门用于教育应用的多模态大语言模型。

title: BraiNCA: brain-inspired neural cellular automata and applications to morphogenesis and motor control
summary: Most of the Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) defined in the literature have a common theme: they are based on regular grids with a Moore neighborhood (one-hop neighbour). They do not take into account long-range connections and more complex topologies as we can find in the brain. In this paper, we introduce BraiNCA, a brain-inspired NCA with an attention layer, long-range connections and complex topology. BraiNCAs shows better results in terms of robustness and speed of learning on the two tasks compared to Vanilla NCAs establishing that incorporating attention-based message selection together with explicit long-range edges can yield more sample-efficient and damage-tolerant self-organization than purely local, grid-based update rules. These results support the hypothesis that, for tasks requiring distributed coordination over extended spatial and temporal scales, the choice of interaction topology and the ability to dynamically route information will impact the robustness and speed of learning of an NCA. More broadly, BraiNCA provides brain-inspired NCA formulation that preserves the decentralized local update principle while better reflecting non-local connectivity patterns, making it a promising substrate for studying collective computation under biologically-realistic network structure and evolving cognitive substrates.
summary_zh: 文献中定义的大多数神经细胞自动机（NCAs）都有一个共同主题：它们基于具有摩尔邻域（单跳邻居）的规则网格。这些模型未考虑大脑中存在的长程连接与更复杂拓扑结构。本文提出BraiNCA——一种受大脑启发的、具有注意力层、长程连接与复杂拓扑结构的神经细胞自动机。在两项任务中，与经典神经细胞自动机相比，BraiNCA在鲁棒性和学习速度方面均表现出更优结果，这表明将基于注意力的消息选择机制与显式长程边相结合，能够产生比纯局部的、基于网格的更新规则更具样本效率与损伤容忍度的自组织能力。这些结果验证了一个假设：对于需要在延展时空尺度上进行分布式协调的任务，交互拓扑的选择与动态信息路由能力将影响神经细胞自动机的学习鲁棒性与速度。更广泛而言，BraiNCA提供了一种受大脑启发的神经细胞自动机框架，它在保持分散化局部更新原则的同时，更好地反映了非局域连接模式，使其成为研究生物现实网络结构下集体计算与演化认知基质的理想载体。
tldr: Introduces a brain-inspired neural cellular automata with attention and long-range connections, which improves learning speed and robustness for morphogenesis and motor control tasks compared to vanilla NCAs.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个受大脑启发的神经细胞自动机，带有注意力机制和长程连接，相比传统方法，在形态发生和运动控制任务上展现出更好的学习速度和鲁棒性。

title: Efficient Constraint Generation for Stochastic Shortest Path Problems
summary: Stochastic Shortest Path problems (SSPs) are traditionally solved by computing each state's cost-to-go by applying Bellman backups. A Bellman backup updates a state's cost-to-go by iterating through every applicable action, computing the cost-to-go after applying each one, and selecting a minimal action's cost-to-go. State-of-the-art algorithms use heuristic functions; these give an initial estimate of costs-to-go, and lets the algorithm apply Bellman backups only to promising states, determined by low estimated costs-to-go. However, each Bellman backup still considers all applicable actions, even if the heuristic tells us that some of these actions are too expensive, with the effect that such algorithms waste time on unhelpful actions. To address this gap we present a technique that uses the heuristic to avoid expensive actions, by reframing heuristic search in terms of linear programming and introducing an efficient implementation of constraint generation for SSPs. We present CG-iLAO*, a new algorithm that adapts iLAO* with our novel technique, and considers only 40% of iLAO*'s actions on many problems, and as few as 1% on some. Consequently, CG-iLAO* computes on average 3.5x fewer costs-to-go for actions than the state-of-the-art iLAO* and LRTDP, enabling it to solve problems faster an average of 2.8x and 3.7x faster, respectively.
summary_zh: 随机最短路径问题通常通过应用贝尔曼备份计算各状态的预期代价来解决。贝尔曼备份通过遍历每个可行动作、计算执行各动作后的预期代价，并选择最小化动作的预期代价来更新状态估值。当前最先进的算法采用启发式函数，这些函数提供初始的预期代价估计，使得算法仅对具有较低预估代价的潜力状态应用贝尔曼备份。然而，每个贝尔曼备份仍会考虑所有可行动作，即使启发式信息表明某些动作代价过高，导致此类算法在无效动作上耗费时间。为填补这一空白，我们提出一种利用启发式信息规避高代价动作的技术，该技术通过线性规划重构启发式搜索，并引入针对随机最短路径问题的高效约束生成实现方法。我们提出了CG-iLAO*算法，该算法将创新技术融入iLAO*框架，在多数问题上仅需考虑iLAO* 40%的动作，在某些问题上甚至降至1%。因此，CG-iLAO*对动作的预期代价计算量平均比当前最先进的iLAO*和LRTDP算法减少3.5倍，使其求解速度分别平均提升2.8倍和3.7倍。
tldr: This paper introduces a constraint generation technique for Stochastic Shortest Path problems to reduce the number of actions considered by heuristic search algorithms, leading to significant speedups over iLAO* and LRTDP.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于随机最短路径问题的约束生成技术，以减少启发式搜索算法考虑的动作数量，从而比iLAO*和LRTDP算法实现显著加速。

title: EvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
summary: Anthropic proposes the concept of skills for LLM agents to tackle multi-step professional tasks that simple tool invocations cannot address. A tool is a single, self-contained function, whereas a skill is a structured bundle of interdependent multi-file artifacts. Currently, skill generation is not only label-intensive due to manual authoring, but also may suffer from human--machine cognitive misalignment, which can lead to degraded agent performance, as evidenced by evaluations on SkillsBench. Therefore, we aim to enable agents to autonomously generate skills. However, existing self-evolving methods designed for tools cannot be directly applied to skills due to their increased complexity. To address these issues, we propose EvoSkills, a self-evolving skills framework that enables agents to autonomously construct complex, multi-file skill packages. Specifically, EvoSkills couples a Skill Generator that iteratively refines skills with a Surrogate Verifier that co-evolves to provide informative and actionable feedback without access to ground-truth test content. On SkillsBench, EvoSkills achieves the highest pass rate among five baselines on both Claude Code and Codex, and also exhibits strong generalization capabilities to six additional LLMs.
summary_zh: Anthropic公司提出了面向LLM智能体的技能概念，以解决简单工具调用无法处理的多步骤专业任务。工具是单一、自包含的功能单元，而技能是由相互依赖的多文件构件组成的结构化集合。当前技能生成不仅因人工编写存在标签密集问题，还可能受到人机认知错位的影响——基于SkillsBench的评估表明，这种错位会导致智能体性能下降。因此，我们致力于让智能体能够自主生成技能。然而，由于技能复杂度的提升，现有面向工具的自我进化方法无法直接应用于技能生成。为解决这些问题，我们提出了EvoSkills——一个使智能体能够自主构建复杂多文件技能包的自我进化框架。该框架通过迭代优化技能的技能生成器，与协同进化的代理验证器相耦合，后者可在无需接触真实测试内容的情况下，提供具有信息量和可操作性的反馈。在SkillsBench评估中，EvoSkills在Claude Code和Codex两个模型上均实现了五大基线中最高的通过率，并对六种额外LLM展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: EvoSkills is a framework for LLM agents to autonomously generate and refine complex, multi-file skill packages through co-evolutionary verification, improving performance on professional task benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EvoSkills是一个框架，通过协同进化验证，使LLM代理能够自主生成和优化复杂的多文件技能包，在专业任务基准上提升了性能。

title: Can Heterogeneous Language Models Be Fused?
summary: Model merging aims to integrate multiple expert models into a single model that inherits their complementary strengths without incurring the inference-time cost of ensembling. Recent progress has shown that merging can be highly effective when all source models are \emph{homogeneous}, i.e., derived from the same pretrained backbone and therefore share aligned parameter coordinates or compatible task vectors. Yet this assumption is increasingly unrealistic in open model ecosystems, where useful experts are often built on different families such as Llama, Qwen, and Mistral. In such \emph{heterogeneous} settings, direct weight-space fusion becomes ill-posed due to architectural mismatch, latent basis misalignment, and amplified cross-source conflict. We address this problem with \texttt{HeteroFusion} for heterogeneous language model fusion, which consists of two key components: topology-based alignment that transfers knowledge across heterogeneous backbones by matching functional module structures instead of raw tensor coordinates, and conflict-aware denoising that suppresses incompatible or noisy transfer signals during fusion. We further provide analytical justification showing that preserving the target adapter basis while predicting structured updates leads to a stable and well-conditioned transfer process. Across heterogeneous transfer, multi-source fusion, noisy-source robustness, and cross-family generalization settings, \texttt{HeteroFusion} consistently outperforms strong merging, fusion, and ensemble baselines.
summary_zh: 模型融合旨在将多个专家模型整合为一个单一模型，使其继承这些模型的互补优势，同时避免集成方法在推理时带来的计算开销。近期研究进展表明，当所有源模型具有\emph{同质性}时——即它们源于相同的预训练主干网络，因而具有对齐的参数坐标或兼容的任务向量——融合效果极为显著。然而，在开放模型生态系统中，这一假设正日益脱离现实：有用的专家模型通常基于不同架构族构建，如Llama、Qwen和Mistral等。在此类\emph{异质性}场景下，由于架构不匹配、潜在基座不对齐以及跨源冲突加剧，直接的权重空间融合变得难以实现。为解决这一问题，我们提出\texttt{HeteroFusion}用于异质性语言模型融合，其包含两个关键组件：基于拓扑结构的对齐方法——通过匹配功能模块结构而非原始张量坐标，实现跨异构主干网络的知识迁移；以及冲突感知去噪机制——在融合过程中抑制不兼容或含噪声的迁移信号。我们进一步通过理论分析证明，在保持目标适配器基座的同时预测结构化更新，可使迁移过程保持稳定且良态。在异构迁移、多源融合、噪声源鲁棒性以及跨架构族泛化等实验场景中，\texttt{HeteroFusion}在模型融合、知识集成及基线集成方法上均表现出持续优越的性能。
tldr: Introduces a method for merging heterogeneous language models (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) to combine their strengths without architectural alignment, addressing key challenges like parameter mismatch and noise.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种融合异构语言模型（如 Llama, Qwen, Mistral）的方法，通过拓扑对齐和冲突感知去噪来解决架构不匹配和参数冲突问题，以继承不同模型的优势。

title: M3D-BFS: a Multi-stage Dynamic Fusion Strategy for Sample-Adaptive Multi-Modal Brain Network Analysis
summary: Multi-modal fusion is of great significance in neuroscience which integrates information from different modalities and can achieve better performance than uni-modal methods in downstream tasks. Current multi-modal fusion methods in brain networks, which mainly focus on structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) modalities, are static in nature. They feed different samples into the same model with identical computation, ignoring inherent difference between input samples. This lack of sample adaptation hinders model's further performance. To this end, we innovatively propose a multi-stage dynamic fusion strategy (M3D-BFS) for sample-adaptive multi-modal brain network analysis. Unlike other static fusion methods, we design different mixture-of-experts (MoEs) for uni- and multi-modal representations where modules can adaptively change as input sample changes during inference. To alleviate issue of MoE where training of experts may be collapsed, we divide our method into 3 stages. We first train uni-modal encoders respectively, then pretrain single experts of MoEs before finally finetuning the whole model. A multi-modal disentanglement loss is designed to enhance the final representations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work for dynamic fusion for multi-modal brain network analysis. Extensive experiments on different real-world datasets demonstrates the superiority of M3D-BFS.
summary_zh: 多模态融合在神经科学中具有重要意义，它通过整合不同模态的信息，在下游任务中能够实现比单模态方法更优的性能。当前脑网络中的多模态融合方法主要关注结构连接性（SC）和功能连接性（FC）模态，本质上是静态的。它们将不同样本输入具有相同计算过程的同一模型，忽略了输入样本之间的固有差异。这种样本适应性的缺失限制了模型性能的进一步提升。为此，我们创新性地提出了一种用于样本自适应多模态脑网络分析的多阶段动态融合策略（M3D-BFS）。不同于其他静态融合方法，我们为单模态和多模态表征设计了不同的专家混合模块（MoEs），使得推理过程中模块能够根据输入样本的变化而自适应调整。为了缓解MoE中专家训练可能崩溃的问题，我们将方法分为三个阶段：首先分别训练单模态编码器，随后预训练MoE中的单个专家，最后对整个模型进行微调。此外，我们还设计了多模态解纠缠损失以增强最终的表征效果。据我们所知，这是首个针对多模态脑网络分析的动态融合方法研究。在不同真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了M3D-BFS的优越性。
tldr: Proposes a multi-stage, sample-adaptive, mixture-of-experts fusion strategy for analyzing structural and functional brain networks, focusing on dynamic, non-static fusion methods.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于分析结构和功能脑网络的多阶段、样本自适应、专家混合融合策略，专注于动态而非静态的融合方法。

title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based evolution is a promising approach for open-ended discovery, where progress requires sustained search and knowledge accumulation. Existing methods still rely heavily on fixed heuristics and hard-coded exploration rules, which limit the autonomy of LLM agents. We present CORAL, the first framework for autonomous multi-agent evolution on open-ended problems. CORAL replaces rigid control with long-running agents that explore, reflect, and collaborate through shared persistent memory, asynchronous multi-agent execution, and heartbeat-based interventions. It also provides practical safeguards, including isolated workspaces, evaluator separation, resource management, and agent session and health management. Evaluated on diverse mathematical, algorithmic, and systems optimization tasks, CORAL sets new state-of-the-art results on 10 tasks, achieving 3-10 times higher improvement rates with far fewer evaluations than fixed evolutionary search baselines across tasks. On Anthropic's kernel engineering task, four co-evolving agents improve the best known score from 1363 to 1103 cycles. Mechanistic analyses further show how these gains arise from knowledge reuse and multi-agent exploration and communication. Together, these results suggest that greater agent autonomy and multi-agent evolution can substantially improve open-ended discovery. Code is available at https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/CORAL.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的进化是开放探索领域的一种有前景的方法，该领域的发展需要持续搜索与知识积累。现有方法仍高度依赖固定启发式规则与硬编码的探索策略，限制了LLM智能体的自主性。我们提出了CORAL，这是首个面向开放问题的自主多智能体进化框架。CORAL以长期运行的智能体替代僵化控制，这些智能体通过共享持久记忆、异步多智能体执行及基于心跳的干预机制，实现探索、反思与协作。该框架还提供实用的安全保障机制，包括隔离工作空间、评估器分离、资源管理以及智能体会话与健康管理。在多样化数学、算法及系统优化任务上的评估表明，CORAL在10项任务中创造了新的最优性能记录，相比固定进化搜索基线方法，其改进率提升3-10倍，且所需评估次数显著减少。在Anthropic的内核工程任务中，四个协同进化智能体将最佳已知得分从1363周期优化至1103周期。机理分析进一步揭示了这些提升源于知识复用和多智能体探索与协作机制。这些结果表明，增强智能体自主性与多智能体协同进化能显著推动开放探索的进展。代码发布于https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/CORAL。
tldr: CORAL is a framework for autonomous multi-agent evolution using LLMs for open-ended discovery tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on various mathematical, algorithmic, and systems optimization problems.
tldr_zh: CORAL是一个用于开放发现任务的多智能体自主进化框架，利用大型语言模型在数学、算法和系统优化等任务上取得了最先进的结果。

title: DWDP: Distributed Weight Data Parallelism for High-Performance LLM Inference on NVL72
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference increasingly depends on multi-GPU execution, yet existing inference parallelization strategies require layer-wise inter-rank synchronization, making end-to-end performance sensitive to workload imbalance. We present DWDP (Distributed Weight Data Parallelism), an inference parallelization strategy that preserves data-parallel execution while offloading MoE weights across peer GPUs and fetching missing experts on demand. By removing collective inter-rank synchronization, DWDP allows each GPU to progress independently. We further address the practical overheads of this design with two optimizations for split-weight management and asynchronous remote-weight prefetch. Implemented in TensorRT-LLM and evaluated with DeepSeek-R1 on GB200 NVL72, DWDP improves end-to-end output TPS/GPU by 8.8% at comparable TPS/user in the 20-100 TPS/user serving range under 8K input sequence length and 1K output sequence length.
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程日益依赖于多GPU并行执行，然而现有的推理并行化策略需进行逐层的跨计算单元同步，使得端到端性能对工作负载不均衡高度敏感。本文提出分布式权重数据并行（DWDP）策略，该策略在保持数据并行执行方式的同时，将混合专家模型（MoE）的权重数据分发至对等GPU存储，并支持按需动态获取缺失专家权重。通过消除跨计算单元的集体同步操作，DWDP使得每个GPU能够独立执行计算进程。我们进一步针对权重分割管理和异步远程权重预取引入两项优化，以降低该设计在实际应用中的系统开销。基于TensorRT-LLM框架实现并在GB200 NVL72平台上使用DeepSeek-R1模型进行评测，在输入序列长度8K、输出序列长度1K的设置下，当服务吞吐量范围处于20-100 TPS/用户时，DWDP在保持可比用户级TPS的同时，使端到端输出TPS/GPU提升8.8%。
tldr: DWDP is a distributed weight data parallelism method for high-performance LLM inference that eliminates inter-rank synchronization to improve throughput on multi-GPU systems.
tldr_zh: DWDP是一种用于高性能LLM推理的分布式权重数据并行方法，它消除了进程间的同步以提升多GPU系统的吞吐量。

title: From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) tackle complex tasks by distributing expertise, though this often comes at the cost of heavy coordination overhead, context fragmentation, and brittle phase ordering. Distilling a MAS into a single-agent skill can bypass these costs, but this conversion lacks a principled answer for when and what to distill. Instead, the empirical outcome is surprisingly inconsistent: skill lift ranges from a 28% improvement to a 2% degradation across metrics of the exact same task. In this work, we reveal that skill utility is governed not by the task, but by the evaluation metric. We introduce Metric Freedom ($F$), the first a priori predictor of skill utility. $F$ measures the topological rigidity of a metric's scoring landscape by quantifying how output diversity couples with score variance via a Mantel test. Guided by $F$, we propose a two-stage adaptive distillation framework. Stage 1 acts as a selective extraction mechanism, extracting tools and knowledge while discarding restrictive structures on "free" metrics to preserve exploration. Stage 2 targets computationally intensive iterative refinement exclusively toward "rigid" metrics ($F \lesssim 0.6$) to eliminate trajectory-local overfitting. Evaluating across 4 tasks, 11 datasets, and 6 metrics, $F$ strongly predicts skill utility ($ρ= -0.62$, $p < 0.05$). Strikingly, identical agent trajectories yield diametrically opposite skill lifts under rigid versus free metrics, demonstrating that skill utility is fundamentally a metric-level property. Driven by this signal, our adaptive agent matches or exceeds the original MAS while reducing cost up to 8$\times$ and latency by up to 15$\times$.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）通过分布式专业知识处理复杂任务，但往往伴随着高昂的协调开销、情境碎片化与脆弱的阶段排序问题。将多智能体系统蒸馏为单智能体技能可规避这些成本，但该转换过程缺乏原则性指导以确定何时蒸馏以及蒸馏什么内容。实践结果却呈现出令人惊讶的不一致性：在完全相同的任务指标下，技能提升效果从28%的改进到2%的退化不等。本研究发现，技能效用并非由任务本身决定，而是由评估指标所主导。我们提出了指标自由度（$F$）——首个能够先验预测技能效用的指标。$F$通过曼特尔检验量化输出多样性与分数方差的耦合关系，从而衡量指标评分空间的拓扑刚性。在$F$的引导下，我们提出两阶段自适应蒸馏框架：第一阶段作为选择性提取机制，在“自由”指标上提取工具与知识的同时，摒弃限制性结构以保持探索能力；第二阶段专门针对计算密集型的迭代优化过程，仅应用于“刚性”指标（$F \lesssim 0.6$），以消除轨迹局部过拟合。通过在4项任务、11个数据集和6种指标上进行评估，$F$展现出对技能效用的强预测能力（$ρ= -0.62$，$p < 0.05$）。值得注意的是，相同的智能体轨迹在刚性指标与自由指标下会产生截然相反的技能提升效果，这证明技能效用本质上是指标层面的属性。基于此发现构建的自适应智能体，在将成本降低至多8倍、延迟减少至多15倍的同时，达到或超越了原始多智能体系统的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to predict when distilling a multi-agent system into a single-agent skill is beneficial, based on the topological rigidity of the evaluation metric, and presents an adaptive distillation framework.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于评估指标拓扑刚性的方法，用于预测何时将多智能体系统提炼为单智能体技能是有益的，并提出了一个自适应提炼框架。

title: MM-ReCoder: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning and Self-Correction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in multimodal coding tasks such as chart-to-code generation. However, existing methods primarily rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires the model to learn code patterns through chart-code pairs but does not expose the model to a code execution environment. Moreover, while self-correction through execution feedback offers a potential route to improve coding quality, even state-of-the-art MLLMs have been shown to struggle with effective self-correction. In this work, we introduce MM-ReCoder, a chart-to-code generation model trained with reinforcement learning (RL) and equipped with self-correction ability. We propose a two-stage multi-turn self-correction RL strategy based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The first stage enhances the model's self-correction ability via rolling out a shared first turn, while the second stage improves the coding capability with full-trajectory optimization. MM-ReCoder learns to produce more accurate and executable code through the interaction with the environment and by iteratively correcting its own outputs. Our results on three chart-to-code benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of MM-ReCoder.
summary_zh: 近年来，多模态大语言模型在图表转代码生成等多模态编码任务中展现出显著潜力。然而，现有方法主要依赖于监督微调，该方式虽能通过图表-代码对让模型学习编码模式，但未将模型置于代码执行环境中进行训练。此外，尽管通过执行反馈进行自我纠错为提升代码质量提供了可能路径，但即使是当前最先进的多模态大语言模型，仍被证明难以实现有效的自我修正。本研究提出MM-ReCoder——一种基于强化学习训练并具备自我纠错能力的图表转代码生成模型。我们设计了一种基于群体相对策略优化的两阶段多轮次自我纠错强化学习策略：第一阶段通过共享首轮生成结果增强模型的自我修正能力；第二阶段则通过全轨迹优化全面提升编码性能。MM-ReCoder通过与执行环境的交互以及对自身输出的迭代修正，逐步生成更精确且可执行的代码。在三个图表转代码基准测试中的实验结果表明，MM-ReCoder取得了当前最优的性能表现。
tldr: A reinforcement learning method is proposed for a chart-to-code generation model, which uses a two-stage self-correction strategy to improve the executability and accuracy of the generated code.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于图表到代码生成模型的强化学习方法，采用两阶段自校正策略，旨在提高生成代码的可执行性和准确性。

title: Do Large Language Models Mentalize When They Teach?
summary: How do LLMs decide what to teach next: by reasoning about a learner's knowledge, or by using simpler rules of thumb? We test this in a controlled task previously used to study human teaching strategies. On each trial, a teacher LLM sees a hypothetical learner's trajectory through a reward-annotated directed graph and must reveal a single edge so the learner would choose a better path if they replanned. We run a range of LLMs as simulated teachers and fit their trial-by-trial choices with the same cognitive models used for humans: a Bayes-Optimal teacher that infers which transitions the learner is missing (inverse planning), weaker Bayesian variants, heuristic baselines (e.g., reward based), and non-mentalizing utility models. In a baseline experiment matched to the stimuli presented to human subjects, most LLMs perform well, show little change in strategy over trials, and their graph-by-graph performance is similar to that of humans. Model comparison (BIC) shows that Bayes-Optimal teaching best explains most models' choices. When given a scaffolding intervention, models follow auxiliary inference- or reward-focused prompts, but these scaffolds do not reliably improve later teaching on heuristic-incongruent test graphs and can sometimes reduce performance. Overall, cognitive model fits provide insight into LLM tutoring policies and show that prompt compliance does not guarantee better teaching decisions.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型如何决定下一步教授什么：是通过对学习者知识进行推理，还是采用更简单的经验法则？我们在一个受控任务中对此进行测试，该任务此前被用于研究人类教学策略。在每次试验中，教师模型会观察一个假设学习者在带奖励标注的有向图中的轨迹，并需要揭示一条边，使得学习者在重新规划时能选择更优路径。我们通过多种模型模拟教师行为，并采用与人类研究相同的认知模型对其逐次选择进行拟合：包括推断学习者缺失哪些转变的贝叶斯最优教师模型（逆向规划）、较弱的贝叶斯变体、启发式基线模型（如基于奖励的模型）以及非心智化效用模型。在与人类受试者刺激材料匹配的基线实验中，大多数模型表现良好，其策略在试验过程中变化甚微，且逐图表现与人类相似。模型比较（BIC）显示，贝叶斯最优教学模型最能解释大多数模型的选择。当给予辅助干预时，模型会遵循侧重推理或奖励的提示，但这些干预措施并不能可靠提升后续在启发式不一致测试图上的教学效果，有时甚至可能降低表现。总体而言，认知模型拟合结果揭示了模型的教学策略，并表明对提示的遵从并不保证能产生更好的教学决策。
tldr: The paper examines whether LLMs reason about a learner's knowledge state (mentalize) when making teaching decisions in a controlled graph-based task, using cognitive models to analyze their strategies.
tldr_zh: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型在图结构教学任务中做出教学决策时，是否会推理学习者的知识状态（心智化），并使用认知模型分析其策略。

title: Thinking While Listening: Fast-Slow Recurrence for Long-Horizon Sequential Modeling
summary: We extend the recent latent recurrent modeling to sequential input streams. By interleaving fast, recurrent latent updates with self-organizational ability between slow observation updates, our method facilitates the learning of stable internal structures that evolve alongside the input. This mechanism allows the model to maintain coherent and clustered representations over long horizons, improving out-of-distribution generalization in reinforcement learning and algorithmic tasks compared to sequential baselines such as LSTM, state space models, and Transformer variants.
summary_zh: 我们将最近的潜在循环建模方法扩展到顺序输入流中。通过在慢速观察更新之间交替进行快速、具有自组织能力的潜在循环更新，我们的方法有助于学习随输入同步演化的稳定内部结构。该机制使得模型能够在长时间范围内保持连贯且聚类化的表征，与LSTM、状态空间模型及Transformer变体等序列基线模型相比，在强化学习和算法任务中显著提升了分布外泛化能力。
tldr: The paper proposes a fast-slow recurrent latent modeling approach for sequential input streams to improve long-horizon modeling and out-of-distribution generalization in reinforcement learning and algorithmic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种快速-慢速循环潜在建模方法，用于序列输入流，旨在改善强化学习和算法任务中的长时程建模和分布外泛化能力。

title: ReFlow: Self-correction Motion Learning for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present ReFlow, a unified framework for monocular dynamic scene reconstruction that learns 3D motion in a novel self-correction manner from raw video. Existing methods often suffer from incomplete scene initialization for dynamic regions, leading to unstable reconstruction and motion estimation, which often resorts to external dense motion guidance such as pre-computed optical flow to further stabilize and constrain the reconstruction of dynamic components. However, this introduces additional complexity and potential error propagation. To address these issues, ReFlow integrates a Complete Canonical Space Construction module for enhanced initialization of both static and dynamic regions, and a Separation-Based Dynamic Scene Modeling module that decouples static and dynamic components for targeted motion supervision. The core of ReFlow is a novel self-correction flow matching mechanism, consisting of Full Flow Matching to align 3D scene flow with time-varying 2D observations, and Camera Flow Matching to enforce multi-view consistency for static objects. Together, these modules enable robust and accurate dynamic scene reconstruction. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate that ReFlow achieves superior reconstruction quality and robustness, establishing a novel self-correction paradigm for monocular 4D reconstruction.
summary_zh:
摘要：
本文提出ReFlow，一种用于单目动态场景重建的统一框架，该框架能够以新颖的自校正方式从原始视频中学习三维运动。现有方法常因动态区域场景初始化不完整而导致重建与运动估计不稳定，通常需依赖外部密集运动指导（如预计算的光流）来进一步稳定并约束动态组件的重建，但这引入了额外的复杂性与潜在误差传播。为解决这些问题，ReFlow集成了完整规范空间构建模块以增强静态与动态区域的初始化，以及基于分离的动态场景建模模块，该模块将静态与动态组件解耦以实现针对性运动监督。ReFlow的核心是一种新颖的自校正流匹配机制，包含全流匹配（将三维场景流与随时间变化的二维观测对齐）和相机流匹配（强制静态物体的多视图一致性）。这些模块共同实现了鲁棒且准确的动态场景重建。跨多样场景的大量实验表明，ReFlow在重建质量与鲁棒性上均表现出优越性，为单目4D重建树立了新颖的自校正范式。
tldr: A novel framework for monocular dynamic scene reconstruction that uses a self-correction flow matching mechanism to improve 3D motion learning from raw video, without relying on external optical flow.
tldr_zh: 一种用于单目动态场景重建的新框架，通过自校正流匹配机制从原始视频中学习3D运动，无需依赖外部光流。

title: Countering Catastrophic Forgetting of Large Language Models for Better Instruction Following via Weight-Space Model Merging
summary: Large language models have been adopted in the medical domain for clinical documentation to reduce clinician burden. However, studies have reported that LLMs often "forget" a significant amount of instruction-following ability when fine-tuned using a task-specific medical dataset, a critical challenge in adopting general-purpose LLMs for clinical applications. This study presents a model merging framework to efficiently adapt general-purpose LLMs to the medical domain by countering this forgetting issue. By merging a clinical foundation model (GatorTronLlama) with a general instruct model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) via interpolation-based merge methods, we seek to derive a domain-adapted model with strong performance on clinical tasks while retaining instruction-following ability. Comprehensive evaluation across medical benchmarks and five clinical generation tasks (e.g., radiology and discharge summarization) shows that merged models can effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting, preserve clinical domain expertise, and retain instruction-following ability. In addition, our model merging strategies demonstrate training efficiency, achieving performance on par with fully fine-tuned baselines under severely constrained supervision (e.g., 64-shot vs. 256-shot). Consequently, weight-space merging constitutes a highly scalable solution for adapting open-source LLMs to clinical applications, facilitating broader deployment in resource-constrained healthcare environments.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型已在医疗领域被用于临床文档记录以减轻医护人员负担。然而，研究表明，当使用特定医疗任务数据集进行微调时，大语言模型常会"遗忘"大量指令遵循能力，这是在临床应用中采用通用大语言模型面临的关键挑战。本研究提出一种模型融合框架，通过应对这种遗忘问题，有效将通用大语言模型适配至医疗领域。通过基于插值的融合方法，将临床基础模型（GatorTronLlama）与通用指令模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）进行融合，我们旨在获得一个在临床任务上表现优异且能保持指令遵循能力的领域适应模型。在医疗基准测试和五项临床生成任务（如放射学报告和出院小结）上的综合评估表明，融合模型能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，保留临床领域专业知识，并维持指令遵循能力。此外，我们的模型融合策略展现出训练效率优势，在严重受限的监督条件下（如64样本对比256样本）达到与完全微调基准模型相当的性能。因此，权重空间融合为开源大语言模型适应临床应用提供了高度可扩展的解决方案，有助于在资源受限的医疗环境中实现更广泛部署。
tldr: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in LLMs during domain-specific fine-tuning (e.g., for medical applications) by proposing a model merging framework that combines a general instruction model with a clinical foundation model to retain both domain expertise and instruction-following ability.
tldr_zh: 本文针对大语言模型在领域特定微调（如医疗应用）中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一个模型融合框架，通过将通用指令模型与临床基础模型结合，以同时保留领域专业知识和指令遵循能力。

title: ProdCodeBench: A Production-Derived Benchmark for Evaluating AI Coding Agents
summary: Benchmarks that reflect production workloads are better for evaluating AI coding agents in industrial settings, yet existing benchmarks differ from real usage in programming language distribution, prompt style and codebase structure. This paper presents a methodology for curating production-derived benchmarks, illustrated through ProdCodeBench - a benchmark built from real sessions with a production AI coding assistant. We detail our data collection and curation practices including LLM-based task classification, test relevance validation, and multi-run stability checks which address challenges in constructing reliable evaluation signals from monorepo environments. Each curated sample consists of a verbatim prompt, a committed code change and fail-to-pass tests spanning seven programming languages. Our systematic analysis of four foundation models yields solve rates from 53.2% to 72.2% revealing that models making greater use of work validation tools, such as executing tests and invoking static analysis, achieve higher solve rates. This suggests that iterative verification helps achieve effective agent behavior and that exposing codebase-specific verification mechanisms may significantly improve the performance of externally trained agents operating in unfamiliar environments. We share our methodology and lessons learned to enable other organizations to construct similar production-derived benchmarks.
summary_zh: 能够反映生产环境工作负载的基准测试更适合在工业场景中评估AI编程助手，但现有基准在编程语言分布、提示风格和代码库结构方面均与实际使用情况存在差异。本文提出了一种基于生产环境数据构建基准测试的方法论，并以ProdCodeBench为例进行阐述——该基准源自真实生产级AI编程助手的使用会话。我们详细介绍了数据收集与整理流程，包括基于LLM的任务分类、测试关联性验证以及多轮稳定性检测，这些方法解决了从单体仓库环境中构建可靠评估指标所面临的挑战。每个经过筛选的样本包含原始提示词、已提交的代码变更以及跨七种编程语言的失败-通过测试用例。通过对四个基础模型的系统性分析，我们得到53.2%至72.2%的解决率，表明那些更充分运用工作验证工具（如执行测试和调用静态分析）的模型能获得更高解决率。这说明迭代验证有助于实现高效智能体行为，且暴露代码库专属的验证机制可能显著提升外部训练智能体在陌生环境中的表现。我们共享方法论与实践经验，以帮助其他机构构建类似的生产环境衍生基准测试。
tldr: This paper introduces ProdCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI coding agents built from real production data, focusing on programming language distribution, prompt style, and codebase structure to reflect industrial settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ProdCodeBench，一个用于评估AI编程智能体的基准，它基于真实生产数据构建，专注于编程语言分布、提示风格和代码库结构，以反映工业环境。

title: ToolMisuseBench: An Offline Deterministic Benchmark for Tool Misuse and Recovery in Agentic Systems
summary: Tool using agents often fail for operational reasons even when language understanding is strong. Common causes include invalid arguments, interface drift, weak recovery, and inefficient retry behavior. We introduce ToolMisuseBench, an offline deterministic benchmark for evaluating tool misuse and recovery under explicit step, call, and retry budgets. The benchmark covers CRUD, retrieval, file, and scheduling environments with replayable fault injection. It reports success, invalid call behavior, policy violations, recovery quality, and budgeted efficiency. We release a public dataset with 6800 tasks and a reproducible evaluation pipeline. Baseline results show fault specific recovery gains for schema aware methods, while overall success remains limited under the released authorization and hard failure settings.
summary_zh: 工具使用代理即便在语言理解能力强的情况下，也常因操作原因而失败。常见原因包括无效参数、接口漂移、弱恢复能力及低效重试行为。本文引入ToolMisuseBench——一个用于在明确的步骤、调用和重试预算下评估工具滥用与恢复能力的离线确定性基准。该基准涵盖CRUD、检索、文件和调度环境，并支持可重放的故障注入。基准评估内容包括成功率、无效调用行为、策略违反情况、恢复质量及预算效率。我们发布了包含6800个任务的公开数据集和可复现的评估流程。基线结果表明，在特定故障恢复方面，具备模式感知的方法有所提升，但在已发布的授权设置与硬性故障条件下，整体成功率仍有限。
tldr: The paper introduces ToolMisuseBench, an offline, deterministic benchmark for evaluating the failure and recovery capabilities of tool-using agents, focusing on operational issues like invalid arguments and interface drift, and provides a public dataset of 6800 tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ToolMisuseBench，一个用于评估工具使用智能体在无效参数和接口漂移等操作性问题上的失败与恢复能力的离线确定性基准，并提供了一个包含6800个任务的公开数据集。

title: AgentSocialBench: Evaluating Privacy Risks in Human-Centered Agentic Social Networks
summary: With the rise of personalized, persistent LLM agent frameworks such as OpenClaw, human-centered agentic social networks in which teams of collaborative AI agents serve individual users in a social network across multiple domains are becoming a reality. This setting creates novel privacy challenges: agents must coordinate across domain boundaries, mediate between humans, and interact with other users' agents, all while protecting sensitive personal information. While prior work has evaluated multi-agent coordination and privacy preservation, the dynamics and privacy risks of human-centered agentic social networks remain unexplored. To this end, we introduce AgentSocialBench, the first benchmark to systematically evaluate privacy risk in this setting, comprising scenarios across seven categories spanning dyadic and multi-party interactions, grounded in realistic user profiles with hierarchical sensitivity labels and directed social graphs. Our experiments reveal that privacy in agentic social networks is fundamentally harder than in single-agent settings: (1) cross-domain and cross-user coordination creates persistent leakage pressure even when agents are explicitly instructed to protect information, (2) privacy instructions that teach agents how to abstract sensitive information paradoxically cause them to discuss it more (we call it abstraction paradox). These findings underscore that current LLM agents lack robust mechanisms for privacy preservation in human-centered agentic social networks, and that new approaches beyond prompt engineering are needed to make agent-mediated social coordination safe for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 随着OpenClaw等个性化、持久化LLM智能体框架的兴起，以人为中心的智能体社交网络正逐渐成为现实。在这种网络中，跨多个领域协作的AI智能体团队在社交网络环境中为个体用户提供服务。这一场景引发了全新的隐私挑战：智能体需要在跨域协调、人际中介以及与其他用户智能体交互的同时，保护敏感个人信息。尽管现有研究已对多智能体协调与隐私保护进行了评估，但以人为中心的智能体社交网络的动态特性与隐私风险尚未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了AgentSocialBench——首个系统评估此类场景下隐私风险的基准框架。该框架包含基于现实用户画像构建的七类交互场景，涵盖二元及多方互动模式，并采用分层敏感度标签与定向社交图进行建模。实验表明，智能体社交网络中的隐私保护难度显著高于单智能体场景：（1）跨域与跨用户协调会持续产生信息泄露压力，即使智能体被明确要求保护信息；（2）指导智能体抽象化敏感信息的隐私指令反而会引发更频繁的讨论（我们称之为“抽象悖论”）。这些发现表明，当前LLM智能体在以人为本的智能体社交网络中缺乏稳健的隐私保护机制，要实现安全可靠的智能体中介社交协调，需要超越提示工程的新方法。
tldr: This paper introduces AgentSocialBench, a benchmark for evaluating privacy risks in human-centered agentic social networks where LLM agents serve users across domains, revealing that multi-agent coordination increases privacy leakage.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AgentSocialBench，这是一个用于评估以人为中心的智能体社交网络中隐私风险的基准测试，揭示了多智能体协调会加剧隐私泄漏问题。

title: ClawSafety: "Safe" LLMs, Unsafe Agents
summary: Personal AI agents like OpenClaw run with elevated privileges on users' local machines, where a single successful prompt injection can leak credentials, redirect financial transactions, or destroy files. This threat goes well beyond conventional text-level jailbreaks, yet existing safety evaluations fall short: most test models in isolated chat settings, rely on synthetic environments, and do not account for how the agent framework itself shapes safety outcomes. We introduce CLAWSAFETY, a benchmark of 120 adversarial test scenarios organized along three dimensions (harm domain, attack vector, and harmful action type) and grounded in realistic, high-privilege professional workspaces spanning software engineering, finance, healthcare, law, and DevOps. Each test case embeds adversarial content in one of three channels the agent encounters during normal work: workspace skill files, emails from trusted senders, and web pages. We evaluate five frontier LLMs as agent backbones, running 2,520 sandboxed trials across all configurations. Attack success rates (ASR) range from 40\% to 75\% across models and vary sharply by injection vector, with skill instructions (highest trust) consistently more dangerous than email or web content. Action-trace analysis reveals that the strongest model maintains hard boundaries against credential forwarding and destructive actions, while weaker models permit both. Cross-scaffold experiments on three agent frameworks further demonstrate that safety is not determined by the backbone model alone but depends on the full deployment stack, calling for safety evaluation that treats model and framework as joint variables.
summary_zh: 类似OpenClaw的个人AI代理在用户本地机器上以高权限运行，一次成功的提示注入便可能导致凭证泄露、金融交易重定向或文件损毁。这一威胁远超传统的文本层面越狱攻击，而现有安全评估方法存在明显不足：多数测试模型局限于隔离聊天环境，依赖合成数据集，且未考虑代理框架自身如何影响安全结果。我们提出CLAWSAFETY基准测试集，包含120个对抗性测试场景，从三个维度（危害领域、攻击向量和有害行为类型）构建，并扎根于软件工程、金融、医疗、法律和DevOps五大高权限专业工作场景。每个测试案例将对抗性内容嵌入代理正常工作时的三种交互渠道之一：工作空间技能文件、可信来源的电子邮件和网页内容。我们评估了五个前沿大语言模型作为代理核心，在所有配置下运行了2520次沙箱测试。攻击成功率（ASR）在40%至75%之间波动，不同注入渠道的结果差异显著，其中技能指令（最高信任级别）的危害性始终高于电子邮件或网页内容。行为追踪分析表明，最强模型能严格守住凭证转发和破坏性操作的防线，而较弱模型则允许两类行为发生。在三个代理框架上进行的跨架构实验进一步证明，安全性不仅取决于核心模型，更受到完整部署栈的影响，这要求安全评估必须将模型与框架作为关联变量进行整体考量。
tldr: The paper introduces ClawSafety, a benchmark for evaluating the safety of personal AI agents in high-privilege settings, demonstrating that agent framework design significantly impacts safety outcomes beyond the underlying LLM.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ClawSafety基准，用于评估高权限场景下个人AI代理的安全性，证明代理框架设计对安全结果的影响超越了底层LLM。

title: Adaptive Stopping for Multi-Turn LLM Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on multi-turn reasoning and interaction, such as adaptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and ReAct-style agents, to answer difficult questions. These methods improve accuracy by iteratively retrieving information, reasoning, or acting, but introduce a key challenge: \textbf{When should the model stop?} Existing approaches rely on heuristic stopping rules or fixed turn budgets and provide no formal guarantees that the final prediction still contains the correct answer. This limitation is particularly problematic in high-stakes domains such as finance and healthcare, where unnecessary turns increase cost and latency, while stopping too early risks incorrect decisions. Conformal prediction (CP) provides formal coverage guarantees, but existing LLM-CP methods only apply to a single model output and cannot handle multi-turn pipelines with adaptive stopping. To address this gap, we propose Multi-Turn Language Models with Conformal Prediction (MiCP), the first CP framework for multi-turn reasoning. MiCP allocates different error budgets across turns, enabling the model to stop early while maintaining an overall coverage guarantee. We demonstrate MiCP on adaptive RAG and ReAct, where it achieves the target coverage on both single-hop and multi-hop question answering benchmarks while reducing the number of turns, inference cost, and prediction set size. We further introduce a new metric that jointly evaluates coverage validity and answering efficiency.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越依赖多轮推理与交互，例如自适应检索增强生成（RAG）和ReAct风格的智能体，来回答复杂问题。这些方法通过迭代检索信息、推理或行动来提高准确性，但引入了一个关键挑战：**模型应在何时停止？** 现有方法依赖启发式停止规则或固定的轮次预算，无法提供正式保证以确保最终预测仍包含正确答案。这一限制在金融和医疗等高风险领域尤为突出，不必要的轮次会增加成本和延迟，而过早停止则可能导致错误决策。虽然保形预测（CP）能够提供正式的覆盖度保证，但现有的LLM-CP方法仅适用于单次模型输出，无法处理自适应停止的多轮流程。为填补这一空白，我们提出了**多轮语言模型的保形预测框架（MiCP）**，这是首个适用于多轮推理的CP框架。MiCP在不同轮次间分配不同的错误预算，使模型能够在保持总体覆盖度保证的前提下尽早停止。我们在自适应RAG和ReAct上验证了MiCP的效果，实验表明，在单跳与多跳问答基准测试中，MiCP均实现了目标覆盖度，同时减少了轮次数、推理成本和预测集大小。我们进一步提出了一种新的评估指标，用于联合衡量覆盖度有效性与回答效率。
tldr: Proposes MiCP, a conformal prediction framework for multi-turn LLM reasoning that allocates error budgets across turns to enable early stopping while maintaining coverage guarantees, demonstrated on adaptive RAG and ReAct agents.
tldr_zh: 提出MiCP，一种用于多轮LLM推理的共形预测框架，通过跨轮次分配错误预算，实现提前停止同时保证覆盖度，并在自适应RAG和ReAct智能体上进行了演示。

title: Semantic Modeling for World-Centered Architectures
summary: We introduce world-centered multi-agent systems (WMAS) as an alternative to traditional agent-centered architectures, arguing that structured domains such as enterprises and institutional systems require a shared, explicit world representation to ensure semantic consistency, explainability, and long-term stability. We classify worlds along dimensions including ontological explicitness, normativity, etc. In WMAS, learning and coordination operate over a shared world model rather than isolated agent-local representations, enabling global consistency and verifiable system behavior. We propose semantic models as a mathematical formalism for representing such worlds. Finally, we present the Ontobox platform as a realization of WMAS.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种以世界为中心的多智能体系统（WMAS），作为传统以智能体为中心架构的替代方案，并论证了企业及制度系统等结构化领域需要共享的、显式的世界表征来保证语义一致性、可解释性与长期稳定性。我们依据本体显式性、规范性等维度对世界进行分类。在WMAS中，学习与协调基于共享的世界模型而非孤立的智能体局部表征进行，从而实现了全局一致性及可验证的系统行为。我们提出语义模型作为表征此类世界的数学形式化工具。最后，我们介绍了实现WMAS的Ontobox平台。
tldr: This paper proposes world-centered multi-agent systems (WMAS), which use a shared, explicit semantic world model for coordination and learning to ensure consistency and explainability in structured domains like enterprises.
tldr_zh: 本文提出以世界为中心的多智能体系统（WMAS），该系统在结构化领域（如企业）中使用共享、显式的语义世界模型进行协调和学习，以确保一致性和可解释性。

title: No Attacker Needed: Unintentional Cross-User Contamination in Shared-State LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate across repeated sessions, maintaining task states to ensure continuity. In many deployments, a single agent serves multiple users within a team or organization, reusing a shared knowledge layer across user identities. This shared persistence expands the failure surface: information that is locally valid for one user can silently degrade another user's outcome when the agent reapplies it without regard for scope. We refer to this failure mode as unintentional cross-user contamination (UCC). Unlike adversarial memory poisoning, UCC requires no attacker; it arises from benign interactions whose scope-bound artifacts persist and are later misapplied. We formalize UCC through a controlled evaluation protocol, introduce a taxonomy of three contamination types, and evaluate the problem in two shared-state mechanisms. Under raw shared state, benign interactions alone produce contamination rates of 57--71%. A write-time sanitization is effective when shared state is conversational, but leaves substantial residual risk when shared state includes executable artifacts, with contamination often manifesting as silent wrong answers. These results indicate that shared-state agents need artifact-level defenses beyond text-level sanitization to prevent silent cross-user failures.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体正越来越多地在重复会话中运行，通过维持任务状态来确保连续性。在许多实际部署场景中，单个智能体常为团队或组织内的多个用户提供服务，在不同用户身份间复用共享知识层。这种共享持久化机制扩大了故障面：当智能体在无视野范围限制的情况下重新应用信息时，仅对特定用户局部有效的信息可能会悄无声息地损害其他用户的任务结果。我们将这种故障模式称为非意图跨用户信息污染（UCC）。与对抗性记忆投毒不同，UCC无需攻击者介入；它源于良性交互过程中产生的范围限定性信息残片持续存留，并在后续被误用。我们通过受控评估方案对UCC进行形式化界定，提出三种污染类型的分类体系，并在两种共享状态机制中评估该问题。在原始共享状态下，仅通过良性交互即可产生57%-71%的污染率。当共享状态为对话式内容时，写入时净化机制能有效发挥作用，但在共享状态包含可执行信息残片时仍存在显著残留风险——此时污染通常表现为静默错误答案。这些结果表明，共享状态智能体需要超越文本层面净化的信息残片级防御机制，以防范静默的跨用户故障。
tldr: This paper identifies a new failure mode in shared-state LLM agents called Unintentional Cross-User Contamination (UCC), where benign information from one user can degrade another's outcomes, and it finds that text-level sanitization is insufficient for defense.
tldr_zh: 本文识别了共享状态LLM智能体中的一种新故障模式，即无意的跨用户污染，一个用户的良性信息可能损害另一个用户的结果，研究发现文本级清理不足以防御此类问题。

title: Regularizing Attention Scores with Bootstrapping
summary:
Vision transformers (ViT) rely on attention mechanism to weigh input features, and therefore attention scores have naturally been considered as explanations for its decision-making process. However, attention scores are almost always non-zero, resulting in noisy and diffused attention maps and limiting interpretability. Can we quantify uncertainty measures of attention scores and obtain regularized attention scores? To this end, we consider attention scores of ViT in a statistical framework where independent noise would lead to insignificant yet non-zero scores. Leveraging statistical learning techniques, we introduce the bootstrapping for attention scores which generates a baseline distribution of attention scores by resampling input features. Such a bootstrap distribution is then used to estimate significances and posterior probabilities of attention scores. In natural and medical images, the proposed \emph{Attention Regularization} approach demonstrates a straightforward removal of spurious attention arising from noise, drastically improving shrinkage and sparsity. Quantitative evaluations are conducted using both simulation and real-world datasets. Our study highlights bootstrapping as a practical regularization tool when using attention scores as explanations for ViT.
  Code available: https://github.com/ncchung/AttentionRegularization
summary_zh:
视觉Transformer（ViT）依赖注意力机制来加权输入特征，因此注意力分数自然被视为其决策过程的解释依据。然而，注意力分数几乎总是非零值，这导致生成的注意力图存在噪声且较为分散，从而限制了其可解释性。我们能否量化注意力分数的不确定性，并由此获得正则化的注意力分数？为此，我们在统计框架下考量ViT的注意力分数，其中独立噪声会导致不显著但非零的分数值。借助统计学习技术，我们引入了注意力分数的自助法，通过对输入特征进行重采样来生成注意力分数的基准分布。该自助分布随后被用于估计注意力分数的显著性和后验概率。在自然图像与医学图像中，所提出的“注意力正则化”方法能够直接消除由噪声引起的虚假注意力，显著提升注意力图的收缩性与稀疏性。我们通过模拟数据集和真实世界数据集进行了定量评估。本研究强调了当使用注意力分数作为ViT的解释时，自助法可作为一种实用的正则化工具。

代码地址：https://github.com/ncchung/AttentionRegularization
tldr: This paper proposes a bootstrapping method to regularize and quantify uncertainty in attention scores for Vision Transformers, aiming to improve the interpretability and sparsity of attention maps in image classification tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自举法的正则化方法，用于量化视觉Transformer中注意力分数的置信度，以提升注意力图在图像分类任务中的可解释性和稀疏性。

title: Evolutionary Multi-Objective Fusion of Deepfake Speech Detectors
summary: While deepfake speech detectors built on large self-supervised learning (SSL) models achieve high accuracy, employing standard ensemble fusion to further enhance robustness often results in oversized systems with diminishing returns. To address this, we propose an evolutionary multi-objective score fusion framework that jointly minimizes detection error and system complexity. We explore two encodings optimized by NSGA-II: binary-coded detector selection for score averaging and a real-valued scheme that optimizes detector weights for a weighted sum. Experiments on the ASVspoof 5 dataset with 36 SSL-based detectors show that the obtained Pareto fronts outperform simple averaging and logistic regression baselines. The real-valued variant achieves 2.37% EER (0.0684 minDCF) and identifies configurations that match state-of-the-art performance while significantly reducing system complexity, requiring only half the parameters. Our method also provides a diverse set of trade-off solutions, enabling deployment choices that balance accuracy and computational cost.
summary_zh: 虽然基于大型自监督学习模型构建的深度伪造语音检测器能够达到较高准确率，但采用标准集成融合来进一步提升鲁棒性往往会导致系统规模过大且收益递减。为解决此问题，我们提出一种进化多目标分数融合框架，该框架可同时最小化检测误差与系统复杂度。我们探索了两种通过NSGA-II优化的编码方案：用于分数平均的二进制编码检测器选择方案，以及为加权求和优化检测器权重的实值编码方案。在ASVspoof 5数据集上使用36个基于自监督学习的检测器进行的实验表明，所得帕累托前沿优于简单平均和逻辑回归基线方法。实值编码方案实现了2.37%的等错误率（0.0684最小检测代价），在匹配最先进性能的同时显著降低了系统复杂度，仅需一半参数量。该方法还提供了一系列多样化的权衡解决方案，使用户能够根据精度与计算成本之间的平衡需求进行部署选择。
tldr: This paper proposes an evolutionary multi-objective framework to optimize the fusion of deepfake speech detectors, aiming to jointly minimize detection error and system complexity, as demonstrated on the ASVspoof 5 dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种进化多目标框架，用于优化深度伪造语音检测器的融合，旨在联合最小化检测误差和系统复杂度，并在ASVspoof 5数据集上进行了验证。

title: EventHub: Data Factory for Generalizable Event-Based Stereo Networks without Active Sensors
summary: We propose EventHub, a novel framework for training deep-event stereo networks without ground truth annotations from costly active sensors, relying instead on standard color images. From these images, we derive either proxy annotations and proxy events through state-of-the-art novel view synthesis techniques, or simply proxy annotations when images are already paired with event data. Using the training set generated by our data factory, we repurpose state-of-the-art stereo models from RGB literature to process event data, obtaining new event stereo models with unprecedented generalization capabilities. Experiments on widely used event stereo datasets support the effectiveness of EventHub and show how the same data distillation mechanism can improve the accuracy of RGB stereo foundation models in challenging conditions such as nighttime scenes.
summary_zh: 本文提出了EventHub，一种无需依赖昂贵主动传感器获取地面真值标注、仅利用标准彩色图像训练深度事件立体网络的新颖框架。我们通过先进的新视角合成技术从这些图像中生成代理标注与代理事件，若图像已与事件数据配对，则直接提取代理标注。借助我们数据工厂生成的训练集，我们将RGB领域最先进的立体模型改造为适用于事件数据处理的新型事件立体模型，从而获得了具有空前泛化能力的全新事件立体网络。在多个广泛使用的事件立体数据集上的实验验证了EventHub的有效性，并证明相同的数据蒸馏机制能提升RGB立体基础模型在夜间场景等挑战性条件下的精度表现。
tldr: EventHub is a framework for training stereo depth estimation models using event cameras, without needing active sensors, by generating proxy annotations from standard color images and improving model generalization.
tldr_zh: EventHub是一个无需主动传感器，通过标准彩色图像生成代理标注来训练事件相机立体深度估计模型的框架，旨在提高模型的泛化能力。

title: Modulate-and-Map: Crossmodal Feature Mapping with Cross-View Modulation for 3D Anomaly Detection
summary: We present ModMap, a natively multiview and multimodal framework for 3D anomaly detection and segmentation. Unlike existing methods that process views independently, our method draws inspiration from the crossmodal feature mapping paradigm to learn to map features across both modalities and views, while explicitly modelling view-dependent relationships through feature-wise modulation. We introduce a cross-view training strategy that leverages all possible view combinations, enabling effective anomaly scoring through multiview ensembling and aggregation. To process high-resolution 3D data, we train and publicly release a foundational depth encoder tailored to industrial datasets. Experiments on SiM3D, a recent benchmark that introduces the first multiview and multimodal setup for 3D anomaly detection and segmentation, demonstrate that ModMap attains state-of-the-art performance by surpassing previous methods by wide margins.
summary_zh: 本文提出ModMap，一种原生多视角与多模态的三维异常检测与分割框架。不同于现有方法独立处理各视角数据，本方法受跨模态特征映射范式启发，通过学习跨模态与跨视角的特征映射，同时通过特征级调制显式建模视角依赖关系。我们引入跨视角训练策略，利用所有可能的视角组合，通过多视角集成与聚合实现高效的异常评分。为处理高分辨率三维数据，我们训练并公开了一个专为工业数据集定制的基础深度编码器。在SiM3D（首个为三维异常检测与分割设立多视角多模态设置的近期基准）上的实验表明，ModMap以显著优势超越现有方法，达到了最先进的性能水平。
tldr: ModMap is a multimodal framework for 3D anomaly detection that uses cross-view feature mapping and modulation, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SiM3D benchmark.
tldr_zh: ModMap 是一个用于3D异常检测的多模态框架，通过跨视图特征映射和调制实现，在SiM3D基准上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Beyond Referring Expressions: Scenario Comprehension Visual Grounding
summary: Existing visual grounding benchmarks primarily evaluate alignment between image regions and literal referring expressions, where models can often succeed by matching a prominent named category. We explore a complementary and more challenging setting of scenario-based visual grounding, where the target must be inferred from roles, intentions, and relational context rather than explicit naming. We introduce Referring Scenario Comprehension (RSC), a benchmark designed for this setting. The queries in this benchmark are paragraph-length texts that describe object roles, user goals, and contextual cues, including deliberate references to distractor objects that often require deep understanding to resolve. Each instance is annotated with interpretable difficulty tags for uniqueness, clutter, size, overlap, and position which expose distinct failure modes and support fine-grained analysis. RSC contains approximately 31k training examples, 4k in-domain test examples, and a 3k out-of-distribution split with unseen object categories. We further propose ScenGround, a curriculum reasoning method serving as a reference point for this setting, combining supervised warm-starting with difficulty-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments show that scenario-based queries expose systematic failures in current models that standard benchmarks do not reveal, and that curriculum training improves performance on challenging slices and transfers to standard benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有的视觉定位基准主要评估图像区域与字面指代表达之间的对齐关系，这类任务中模型往往可以通过匹配显著命名的类别来实现成功。我们探索了一种互补且更具挑战性的场景化视觉定位设定，其中目标必须通过角色、意图和关系上下文进行推断，而非依赖显式命名。为此，我们引入了指涉场景理解（RSC）基准，专门针对这一设定设计。该基准中的查询语句为段落长度的文本，描述了对象角色、用户目标及上下文线索，其中包含对干扰对象的刻意指涉，通常需要深度理解才能分辨。每个实例均标注了可解释的难度标签，包括独特性、杂乱度、尺寸、重叠度和位置，这些标签揭示了不同的失败模式，并支持细粒度分析。RSC包含约31k个训练样本、4k个域内测试样本以及一个包含未见对象类别的3k个域外划分样本。我们进一步提出了ScenGround方法，作为一种课程式推理的参考方案，结合了监督预热与难度感知的强化学习。实验表明，基于场景的查询能够揭示当前模型在标准基准中未能暴露的系统性缺陷，而课程训练则提升了模型在挑战性数据子集上的性能，并能迁移至标准基准任务中。
tldr: This paper introduces a new benchmark for visual grounding, where a model must locate objects based on complex, paragraph-length scenario descriptions rather than simple referring expressions, and proposes a curriculum learning method for this task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的视觉定位基准测试，要求模型基于复杂的段落式场景描述而非简单指代表达式来定位目标，并针对该任务提出了一种课程学习方法。

title: A Simple Baseline for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Recent streaming video understanding methods increasingly rely on complex memory mechanisms to handle long video streams. We challenge this trend with a simple finding: a sliding-window baseline that feeds only the most recent N frames to an off-the-shelf VLM already matches or surpasses published streaming models. We formalize this baseline as SimpleStream and evaluate it against 13 major offline and online video LLM baselines on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. Despite its simplicity, SimpleStream delivers consistently strong performance. With only 4 recent frames, it reaches 67.7% average accuracy on OVO-Bench and 80.59% on StreamingBench. Controlled ablations further show that the value of longer context is backbone-dependent rather than uniformly increasing with model scale, and reveal a consistent perception-memory trade-off: adding more historical context can improve recall, but often weakens real-time perception. This suggests that stronger memory, retrieval, or compression modules should not be taken as evidence of progress unless they clearly outperform SimpleStream under the same protocol. We therefore argue that future streaming benchmarks should separate recent-scene perception from long-range memory, so that performance improvements from added complexity can be evaluated more clearly.
summary_zh: 当前流式视频理解方法日益依赖复杂记忆机制处理长视频流。我们通过一项简单发现对这一趋势提出挑战：仅将最近N帧输入至现成视觉语言模型的滑动窗口基线方法，其性能已与已发布的流式模型相当或更优。我们将此基线形式化为SimpleStream，在OVO-Bench和StreamingBench上对其与13种主流离线和在线视频大语言模型基线进行对比评估。尽管架构简单，SimpleStream始终展现出强劲性能：仅需最近4帧即可在OVO-Bench达到67.7%平均准确率，在StreamingBench达到80.59%。受控消融实验进一步表明，长上下文的价值取决于模型骨干网络而非随模型规模均匀增长，并揭示出持续存在的感知-记忆权衡：增加历史上下文虽能提升记忆召回能力，但往往会削弱实时感知性能。这意味着除非在相同实验协议下明确超越SimpleStream，否则更强的记忆、检索或压缩模块不应被视为技术进步。因此我们主张未来流式视频基准测试应将近期场景感知与长程记忆任务分离，从而更清晰地评估由复杂度增加带来的性能提升。
tldr: This paper proposes a simple sliding-window baseline for streaming video understanding, showing it matches or beats complex models, and highlights the need for benchmarks to separate recent perception from long-term memory.
tldr_zh: 本文为流式视频理解提出一个简单的滑动窗口基线，其性能与复杂模型相当或更好，并强调未来基准需要区分近期感知和长期记忆。

title: Modular Energy Steering for Safe Text-to-Image Generation with Foundation Models
summary: Controlling the behavior of text-to-image generative models is critical for safe and practical deployment. Existing safety approaches typically rely on model fine-tuning or curated datasets, which can degrade generation quality or limit scalability. We propose an inference-time steering framework that leverages gradient feedback from frozen pretrained foundation models to guide the generation process without modifying the underlying generator. Our key observation is that vision-language foundation models encode rich semantic representations that can be repurposed as off-the-shelf supervisory signals during generation. By injecting such feedback through clean latent estimates at each sampling step, our method formulates safety steering as an energy-based sampling problem. This design enables modular, training-free safety control that is compatible with both diffusion and flow-matching models and can generalize across diverse visual concepts. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art robustness against NSFW red-teaming benchmarks and effective multi-target steering, while preserving high generation quality on benign non-targeted prompts. Our framework provides a principled approach for utilizing foundation models as semantic energy estimators, enabling reliable and scalable safety control for text-to-image generation.
summary_zh: 控制文本到图像生成模型的行为对于安全且实用的部署至关重要。现有的安全方法通常依赖于模型微调或精心整理的数据集，这可能会降低生成质量或限制可扩展性。我们提出一种推理时引导框架，该框架利用冻结预训练基础模型提供的梯度反馈来引导生成过程，而无需修改底层生成器。我们的核心发现是，视觉语言基础模型编码了丰富的语义表示，可在生成过程中重新用作即插即用的监督信号。通过在每个采样步骤中基于清洁潜在估计注入此类反馈，我们的方法将安全引导构建为基于能量的采样问题。这一设计实现了模块化、无需训练的安全控制，可同时兼容扩散模型和流匹配模型，并能在多种视觉概念间泛化。实验表明，在NSFW红队测试基准上，我们的方法实现了最先进的鲁棒性，并能有效进行多目标引导，同时在对良性非目标提示的生成中保持高质量输出。该框架为利用基础模型作为语义能量估计器提供了一种理论化方法，从而为文本到图像生成实现了可靠且可扩展的安全控制。
tldr: This paper proposes a training-free, inference-time method for steering text-to-image generation to avoid unsafe content using gradient feedback from frozen vision-language models as semantic energy estimators.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的推理时方法，利用冻结的视觉-语言模型作为语义能量估计器，通过梯度反馈引导文生图过程以避免不安全内容。

title: SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT for Open-vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Foundational Vision Transformers (ViTs) have limited effectiveness in tasks requiring fine-grained spatial understanding, due to their fixed pre-training resolution and inherently coarse patch-level representations. These challenges are especially pronounced in dense prediction scenarios, such as open-vocabulary segmentation with ViT-based vision-language models, where high-resolution inputs are essential for accurate pixel-level reasoning. Existing approaches typically process large-resolution images using a sliding-window strategy at the pre-training resolution. While this improves accuracy through finer strides, it comes at a significant computational cost. We introduce SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT, a resolution-agnostic dense feature extractor designed for efficient high-resolution inference. We distill the spatial reasoning capabilities of a finely-strided, sliding-window teacher into a single-pass student using a feature regression loss, without requiring architectural changes or pixel-level supervision. Applied to open-vocabulary segmentation, SPAR improves single-pass baselines by up to 10.5 mIoU and even surpasses the teacher, demonstrating effectiveness in efficient, high-resolution reasoning. Code: https://github.com/naomikombol/SPAR
summary_zh: 基础视觉变换器（ViTs）因其固定的预训练分辨率及固有的粗粒度块级表示，在需要精细空间理解的任务中效果受限。这一挑战在密集预测场景中尤为突出，例如基于ViT的视觉-语言模型在开放词汇分割任务中，高分辨率输入对精确的像素级推理至关重要。现有方法通常以预训练分辨率采用滑动窗口策略处理大分辨率图像。虽然通过更精细的步幅提升了精度，但带来了显著的计算成本。我们提出SPAR：单次任意分辨率ViT，这是一种分辨率无关的密集特征提取器，专为高效高分辨率推理而设计。我们通过特征回归损失，将精细步幅滑动窗口教师模型的空间推理能力提炼到单次推理的学生模型中，无需架构修改或像素级监督。在开放词汇分割任务中应用，SPAR将单次推理基线提升了高达10.5 mIoU，甚至超越了教师模型，证明了其在高效高分辨率推理中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/naomikombol/SPAR
tldr: SPAR is a resolution-agnostic Vision Transformer for efficient high-resolution image processing, applied to open-vocabulary segmentation to improve performance over single-pass baselines.
tldr_zh: SPAR是一种分辨率无关的视觉Transformer，用于高效的高分辨率图像处理，应用于开放词汇分割任务，以提升单次推理基线的性能。

title: SCALE: Semantic- and Confidence-Aware Conditional Variational Autoencoder for Zero-shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition (ZSAR) aims to recognize action classes without any training skeletons from those classes, relying instead on auxiliary semantics from text. Existing approaches frequently depend on explicit skeleton-text alignment, which can be brittle when action names underspecify fine-grained dynamics and when unseen classes are semantically confusable. We propose SCALE, a lightweight and deterministic Semantic- and Confidence-Aware Listwise Energy-based framework that formulates ZSAR as class-conditional energy ranking. SCALE builds a text-conditioned Conditional Variational Autoencoder where frozen text representations parameterize both the latent prior and the decoder, enabling likelihood-based evaluation for unseen classes without generating samples at test time. To separate competing hypotheses, we introduce a semantic- and confidence-aware listwise energy loss that emphasizes semantically similar hard negatives and incorporates posterior uncertainty to adapt decision margins and reweight ambiguous training instances. Additionally, we utilize a latent prototype contrast objective to align posterior means with text-derived latent prototypes, improving semantic organization and class separability without direct feature matching. Experiments on NTU-60 and NTU-120 datasets show that SCALE consistently improves over prior VAE- and alignment-based baselines while remaining competitive with diffusion-based methods.
summary_zh: 零样本基于骨架的动作识别旨在识别动作类别，而无需依赖这些类别的任何训练骨架数据，转而借助文本提供的辅助语义信息。现有方法通常依赖于显式的骨架-文本对齐，但动作名称往往难以精确描述细粒度动态特征，且未见类别在语义上易混淆，导致此类方法存在脆弱性。我们提出了SCALE框架——一种轻量化、确定性的语义与置信度感知列表式能量模型，将零样本动作识别建模为类条件能量排序问题。SCALE构建了一个文本条件化的条件变分自编码器，其中冻结的文本表征同时参数化潜在先验分布与解码器，使得无需在测试阶段生成样本即可对未见类别进行基于似然的评估。为区分竞争性假设，我们设计了语义与置信度感知的列表式能量损失函数，该函数重点关注语义相似的困难负样本，并引入后验不确定性以自适应调整决策边界并重新加权模糊训练实例。此外，我们采用潜在原型对比目标，将后验均值与文本衍生的潜在原型对齐，从而在不直接进行特征匹配的情况下提升语义组织性与类间分离度。在NTU-60和NTU-120数据集上的实验表明，SCALE持续优于基于变分自编码器和对齐机制的基线方法，同时与基于扩散模型的方法保持竞争力。
tldr: The paper proposes a conditional variational autoencoder framework for zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition, using text conditioning and a novel energy-based loss to improve recognition without training on target action classes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种用于零样本骨架动作识别的条件变分自编码器框架，使用文本条件化和一种新的基于能量的损失函数，以改善对未见动作类别的识别能力。

title: Lightweight Spatiotemporal Highway Lane Detection via 3D-ResNet and PINet with ROI-Aware Attention
summary:
This paper presents a lightweight, end-to-end highway lane detection architecture that jointly captures spatial and temporal information for robust performance in real-world driving scenarios. Building on the strengths of 3D convolutional neural networks and instance segmentation, we propose two models that integrate a 3D-ResNet encoder with a Point Instance Network (PINet) decoder. The first model enhances multi-scale feature representation using a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) and Self-Attention mechanism to refine spatial dependencies. The second model introduces a Region of Interest (ROI) detection head to selectively focus on lane-relevant regions, thereby improving precision and reducing computational complexity.
  Experiments conducted on the TuSimple dataset (highway driving scenarios) demonstrate that the proposed second model achieves 93.40% accuracy while significantly reducing false negatives. Compared to existing 2D and 3D baselines, our approach achieves improved performance with fewer parameters and reduced latency. The architecture has been validated through offline training and real-time inference in the Autonomous Systems Laboratory at City, St George's University of London. These results suggest that the proposed models are well-suited for integration into Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), with potential scalability toward full Lane Assist Systems (LAS).
summary_zh:
本文提出一种轻量化的端到端高速公路车道线检测架构，该架构能够同时捕捉时空信息，以在真实驾驶场景中实现鲁棒性能。基于三维卷积神经网络和实例分割的优势，我们提出了两种融合三维残差网络编码器与点实例网络解码器的模型。第一种模型通过特征金字塔网络和自注意力机制增强多尺度特征表征，以优化空间依赖关系；第二种模型引入感兴趣区域检测头，选择性聚焦于车道相关区域，从而提升精度并降低计算复杂度。

在TuSimple数据集（高速公路驾驶场景）上的实验表明，所提出的第二种模型在显著降低漏检率的同时实现了93.40%的准确率。与现有二维及三维基线方法相比，本方法以更少的参数和更低的延迟获得了更优的性能。该架构已在伦敦大学城市学院圣乔治校区自主系统实验室通过离线训练和实时推理验证。实验结果表明，所提模型非常适合集成到高级驾驶辅助系统中，并具备向完整车道保持系统拓展的潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight 3D CNN architecture for robust highway lane detection, integrating a 3D-ResNet encoder with a PINet decoder and ROI-aware attention, validated on the TuSimple dataset for ADAS applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级3D CNN架构用于鲁棒的高速公路车道检测，将3D-ResNet编码器与PINet解码器及ROI感知注意力机制结合，在TuSimple数据集上验证，适用于ADAS应用。

title: CoRegOVCD: Consistency-Regularized Open-Vocabulary Change Detection
summary: Remote sensing change detection (CD) aims to identify where land-cover semantics change across time, but most existing methods still assume a fixed label space and therefore cannot answer arbitrary user-defined queries. Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) instead asks for the change mask of a queried concept. In the fully training-free setting, however, dense concept responses are difficult to compare directly across dates: appearance variation, weak cross-concept competition, and the spatial continuity of many land-cover categories often produce noisy, fragmented, and semantically unreliable change evidence. We propose Consistency-Regularized Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (CoRegOVCD), a training-free dense inference framework that reformulates concept-specific change as calibrated posterior discrepancy. Competitive Posterior Calibration (CPC) and the Semantic Posterior Delta (SPD) convert raw concept responses into competition-aware queried-concept posteriors and quantify their cross-temporal discrepancy, making semantic change evidence more comparable without explicit instance matching. Geometry-Token Consistency Gate (GeoGate) and Regional Consensus Discrepancy (RCD) further suppress unsupported responses and improve spatial coherence through geometry-aware structural verification and regional consensus. Across four benchmarks spanning building-oriented and multi-class settings, CoRegOVCD consistently improves over the strongest previous training-free baseline by 2.24 to 4.98 F1$_C$ points and reaches a six-class average of 47.50% F1$_C$ on SECOND.
summary_zh: 遥感变化检测旨在识别土地覆盖语义随时间发生变化的区域，但现有方法大多假设固定的标签空间，因此无法响应任意用户定义的查询。开放词汇变化检测则要求生成指定查询概念的变化掩膜。然而，在完全无需训练的场景下，不同时期获取的密集概念响应难以直接比较：外观差异、弱跨概念竞争以及许多土地覆盖类别的空间连续性，常常导致变化证据存在噪声干扰、碎片化及语义不可靠的问题。本文提出一致性正则化的开放词汇变化检测（CoRegOVCD），这是一个无需训练的密集推理框架，通过校准后验差异重构特定概念的变化检测。竞争性后验校准和语义后验差异模块将原始概念响应转化为考虑竞争关系的查询概念后验概率，并量化其跨时相差异，从而在不依赖显式实例匹配的情况下增强语义变化证据的可比性。几何令牌一致性门控与区域共识差异机制进一步通过几何感知的结构验证和区域共识，抑制无效响应并提升空间连贯性。在涵盖建筑导向和多类别场景的四个基准测试中，CoRegOVCD 相比此前最强的无训练基线方法，F1$_C$ 指标持续提升 2.24 至 4.98 个百分点，在 SECOND 数据集上达到六类别平均 47.50% 的 F1$_C$ 分数。
tldr: Proposes a training-free method for open-vocabulary change detection in remote sensing, using consistency regularization to improve semantic change mask quality from arbitrary text queries.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于遥感开放词汇变化检测的无训练方法，利用一致性正则化从任意文本查询中提高语义变化掩模的质量。

title: PLUME: Latent Reasoning Based Universal Multimodal Embedding
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous inputs into a shared retrieval space with a single model. Recent approaches improve UME by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales before extracting embeddings, enabling multimodal large language models to better infer complex query intent. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead and can compress rich multimodal evidence into a narrow textual bottleneck. We propose PLUME, a latent reasoning framework that advances UME by replacing verbalized CoT with a short autoregressive rollout of continuous latent states. To support diverse multimodal queries, PLUME further introduces a semantic-anchor-guided transition adapter that steers latent rollout along different reasoning trajectories under the same fixed computation budget. To stabilize training, PLUME adopts a progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum that uses verbalized reasoning only as a temporary training scaffold and gradually transfers this behavior into hidden-state computation, eliminating explicit CoT at inference. On the 78-task MMEB-v2 benchmark, PLUME outperforms strong explicit-CoT UME baselines while reducing reasoning from hundreds of generated tokens to fewer than 10 latent steps, delivering over 30x faster inference. PLUME is especially well suited to retrieval settings where relevant evidence is dense, structurally complex, and difficult to organize through verbalized intermediate rationales, such as video and visual document retrieval. These results show that structured latent computation can preserve the benefits of intermediate reasoning without the overhead of explicit rationale generation, providing a stronger and more efficient paradigm for practical retrieval systems.
summary_zh: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）通过单一模型将异构输入映射到共享检索空间。现有方法通过在提取嵌入前生成显式思维链（CoT）推理，使多模态大语言模型能够更好推断复杂查询意图，从而提升UME性能。然而，显式CoT会带来显著的推理开销，并可能将丰富的多模态证据压缩至狭窄的文本瓶颈中。我们提出PLUME框架，通过用连续潜状态的自回归滚动序列替代语言化CoT，推动UME技术发展。为支持多样化多模态查询，PLUME进一步引入语义锚点引导的过渡适配器，在相同固定计算预算下沿不同推理轨迹引导潜状态滚动。为稳定训练过程，PLUME采用渐进式显式-潜式课程学习策略，仅将语言化推理作为临时训练支架，并逐步将推理行为转移至隐状态计算，最终在推理时完全消除显式CoT。在包含78个任务的MMEB-v2基准测试中，PLUME在将推理步骤从数百个生成标记减少至不足10个潜状态步骤的同时，性能超越显式CoT的UME基线模型，实现超过30倍的推理加速。PLUME特别适用于证据密集、结构复杂且难以通过语言化中间推理组织的检索场景，如视频与视觉文档检索。这些结果表明，结构化潜计算能够在保留中间推理优势的同时，避免显式推理生成的开销，为实际检索系统提供更强大高效的范式。
tldr: PLUME introduces a latent reasoning framework for universal multimodal embeddings, replacing explicit chain-of-thought with a short, efficient latent rollout to improve performance and inference speed on retrieval tasks, especially for video and visual documents.
tldr_zh: PLUME 提出了一种用于通用多模态嵌入的潜空间推理框架，用短而高效的潜状态序列替换了显式思维链，从而在检索任务（尤其是视频和视觉文档检索）上提升性能与推理速度。

title: COMPASS: Complete Multimodal Fusion via Proxy Tokens and Shared Spaces for Ubiquitous Sensing
summary: Missing modalities remain a major challenge for multimodal sensing, because most existing methods adapt the fusion process to the observed subset by dropping absent branches, using subset-specific fusion, or reconstructing missing features. As a result, the fusion head often receives an input structure different from the one seen during training, leading to incomplete fusion and degraded cross-modal interaction. We propose COMPASS, a missing-modality fusion framework built on the principle of fusion completeness: the fusion head always receives a fixed N-slot multimodal input, with one token per modality slot. For each missing modality, COMPASS synthesizes a target-specific proxy token from the observed modalities using pairwise source-to-target generators in a shared latent space, and aggregates them into a single replacement token. To make these proxies both representation-compatible and task-informative, we combine proxy alignment, shared-space regularization, and per-proxy discriminative supervision. Experiments on XRF55, MM-Fi, and OctoNet under diverse single- and multiple-missing settings show that COMPASS outperforms prior methods on the large majority of scenarios. Our results suggest that preserving a modality-complete fusion interface is a simple and effective design principle for robust multimodal sensing.
summary_zh: 缺失模态一直是多模态感知领域面临的主要挑战，因为现有方法大多通过丢弃缺失分支、采用特定子集融合或重构缺失特征来调整融合过程以适应观测到的子集。这导致融合头在训练与推理阶段接收到的输入结构不一致，引发融合不完整与跨模态交互质量下降的问题。我们提出COMPASS框架，该框架基于融合完整性原则构建：融合头始终接收固定的N槽位多模态输入，每个模态槽位对应一个表征令牌。针对缺失模态，COMPASS通过在共享隐空间中使用成对源-目标生成器，从观测模态合成具有目标特性的代理令牌，并将其聚合为统一的替代令牌。为使这些代理令牌兼具表征兼容性与任务信息量，我们结合了代理对齐、共享空间正则化以及单代理判别监督机制。在XRF55、MM-Fi和OctoNet数据集上的实验表明，在多种单模态/多模态缺失场景下，COMPASS在绝大多数情况下优于现有方法。研究结果表明，保持模态完整的融合接口是实现鲁棒多模态感知的简洁有效设计原则。
tldr: COMPASS proposes a robust multimodal fusion method that maintains a fixed input structure for the fusion head by generating proxy tokens for missing modalities, enabling more complete cross-modal interaction in sensing applications.
tldr_zh: COMPASS 提出了一种鲁棒的多模态融合方法，通过为缺失的模态生成代理令牌，保持融合头接收固定的输入结构，从而在传感应用中实现更完整的跨模态交互。

title: Efficient Reasoning via Thought Compression for Language Segmentation
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved the performance of large multimodal models in language-guided segmentation, yet its prohibitive computational cost, stemming from generating verbose rationales, limits real-world applicability. We introduce WISE (Wisdom from Internal Self-Exploration), a novel paradigm for efficient reasoning guided by the principle of \textit{thinking twice -- once for learning, once for speed}. WISE trains a model to generate a structured sequence: a concise rationale, the final answer, and then a detailed explanation. By placing the concise rationale first, our method leverages autoregressive conditioning to enforce that the concise rationale acts as a sufficient summary for generating the detailed explanation. This structure is reinforced by a self-distillation objective that jointly rewards semantic fidelity and conciseness, compelling the model to internalize its detailed reasoning into a compact form. At inference, the detailed explanation is omitted. To address the resulting conditional distribution shift, our inference strategy, WISE-S, employs a simple prompting technique that injects a brevity-focused instruction into the user's query. This final adjustment facilitates the robust activation of the learned concise policy, unlocking the full benefits of our framework. Extensive experiments show that WISE-S achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the ReasonSeg benchmark with 58.3 cIoU, while reducing the average reasoning length by nearly \textbf{5$\times$} -- from 112 to just 23 tokens. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/mrazhou/WISE}{WISE}.
summary_zh: 链式思维（CoT）推理已显著提升大型多模态模型在语言引导分割任务中的性能，但其生成冗长推理过程带来的过高计算成本限制了实际应用。我们提出WISE（内部自探索智慧），一种遵循“思考两次——一次为学习，一次为速度”原则的新型高效推理范式。WISE训练模型生成结构化序列：先输出简洁推理依据，随后给出最终答案，再生成详细解释。通过将简洁推理前置，该方法利用自回归条件机制强制要求简洁推理成为生成详细解释的充分摘要。这种结构通过自蒸馏目标得到强化，该目标同时奖励语义保真度与简洁性，促使模型将详细推理过程内化为紧凑形式。在推理阶段，详细解释被省略。为应对由此产生的条件分布偏移，我们的推理策略WISE-S采用简单的提示技术，将聚焦简洁性的指令注入用户查询中。这一最终调整有助于稳健激活已学习的简洁策略，充分释放我们框架的潜力。大量实验表明，WISE-S在ReasonSeg基准测试中以58.3 cIoU取得了零样本性能的最优结果，同时将平均推理长度减少近\textbf{5倍}——从112个词元降至仅23个词元。代码发布于\href{https://github.com/mrazhou/WISE}{WISE}。
tldr: This paper proposes WISE, a method for efficient reasoning that compresses verbose chain-of-thought into concise rationales for language-guided segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance with significantly shorter reasoning length.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WISE方法，通过压缩思维链为简洁的推理步骤，实现高效的语言引导图像分割，以显著减少的推理长度达到了最先进的性能。

title: Are VLMs Lost Between Sky and Space? LinkS$^2$Bench for UAV-Satellite Dynamic Cross-View Spatial Intelligence
summary: Synergistic spatial intelligence between UAVs and satellites is indispensable for emergency response and security operations, as it uniquely integrates macro-scale global coverage with dynamic, real-time local perception. However, the capacity of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to master this complex interplay remains largely unexplored. This gap persists primarily because existing benchmarks are confined to isolated Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos or static satellite imagery, failing to evaluate the dynamic local-to-global spatial mapping essential for comprehensive cross-view reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce LinkS$^2$Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs' wide-area, dynamic cross-view spatial intelligence. LinkS$^2$Bench links 1,022 minutes of dynamic UAV footage with high-resolution satellite imagery covering over 200 km$^2$. Through an LMM-assisted pipeline and rigorous human annotation, we constructed 17.9k high-quality question-answer pairs comprising 12 fine-grained tasks across four dimensions: perception, localization, relation, and reasoning. Evaluations of 18 representative VLMs reveal a substantial gap compared to human baselines, identifying accurate cross-view dynamic alignment as the critical bottleneck. To alleviate this, we design a Cross-View Alignment Adapter, demonstrating that explicit alignment significantly improves model performance. Furthermore, fine-tuning experiments underscore the potential of LinkS$^2$Bench in advancing VLM adaptation for complex spatial reasoning.
summary_zh: 无人机与卫星间的协同空间智能对于应急响应与安全行动至关重要，它能够将宏观的全球覆盖与动态实时的局部感知独特地融合。然而，视觉语言模型能否掌握这种复杂交互能力，目前仍未被充分探索。这一空白主要源于现有基准测试局限于孤立的无人机视频或静态卫星图像，无法评估跨视图推理所必需的动态局部到全局的空间映射关系。为填补这一空白，我们提出了LinkS$^2$Bench——首个用于评估视觉语言模型广域动态跨视图空间智能的综合基准。该基准将1022分钟的动态无人机影像与覆盖超过200平方公里的高分辨率卫星图像进行关联，并通过大型多模态模型辅助流程和严格的人工标注，构建了包含感知、定位、关联和推理四个维度共12项精细任务的1.79万个高质量问答对。对18个代表性视觉语言模型的评估显示，其与人类基准水平存在显著差距，其中精确的跨视图动态对齐是当前的关键瓶颈。为此，我们设计了一种跨视图对齐适配器，证明显式对齐能显著提升模型性能。此外，微调实验凸显了LinkS$^2$Bench在推动视觉语言模型适应复杂空间推理任务方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark (LinkS$^2$Bench) for evaluating Vision-Language Models on dynamic cross-view spatial intelligence between UAV videos and satellite imagery, identifying alignment as a key bottleneck and proposing an adapter to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于评估视觉语言模型在无人机视频与卫星图像之间动态跨视角空间智能的基准（LinkS$^2$Bench），指出了对齐是关键瓶颈，并设计了一个适配器来提升模型性能。

title: Test-Time Adaptation for Height Completion via Self-Supervised ViT Features and Monocular Foundation Models
summary: Accurate digital surface models (DSMs) are essential for many geospatial applications, including urban monitoring, environmental analyses, infrastructure management, and change detection. However, large-scale DSMs frequently contain incomplete or outdated regions due to acquisition limitations, reconstruction artifacts, or changes in the built environment. Traditional height completion approaches primarily rely on spatial interpolation or which assume spatial continuity and therefore fail when objects are missing. Recent learning-based approaches improve reconstruction quality but typically require supervised training on sensor-specific datasets, limiting their generalization across domains and sensing conditions. We propose Prior2DSM, a training-free framework for metric DSM completion that operates entirely at test time by leveraging foundation models. Unlike previous height completion approaches that require task-specific training, the proposed method combines self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) features from DINOv3 with monocular depth foundation models to propagate metric information from incomplete height priors through semantic feature-space correspondence. Test-time adaptation (TTA) is performed using parameter-efficient low-rank adaptation (LoRA) together with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP), which predicts spatially varying scale and shift parameters to convert relative depth estimates into metric heights.
