Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over interpolation based methods, prior-based rescaling height approaches, and state-of-the-art monocular depth estimation models. Prior2DSM reduces reconstruction error while preserving structural fidelity, achieving up to a 46% reduction in RMSE compared to linear fitting of MDE, and further enables DSM updating and coupled RGB-DSM generation.
summary_zh: 精确的数字表面模型（DSM）对城市监测、环境分析、基础设施管理和变化检测等众多地理空间应用至关重要。然而，由于数据获取限制、重建伪影或建成环境变化等原因，大范围DSM常包含不完整或过时的区域。传统的高度补全方法主要依赖空间插值或假设空间连续性，因此在物体缺失时往往失效。近年基于学习的方法提升了重建质量，但通常需要针对特定传感器数据进行监督训练，这限制了其在跨领域和不同传感条件下的泛化能力。本文提出Prior2DSM——一种无需训练的度量DSM补全框架，该框架完全在测试阶段通过利用基础模型实现。与以往需要任务特定训练的高度补全方法不同，本方法将DINOv3的自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）特征与单目深度基础模型相结合，通过语义特征空间对应关系，从不完整的高度先验中传播度量信息。测试时自适应（TTA）采用参数高效的低秩自适应（LoRA）与轻量级多层感知机（MLP）相结合，通过预测空间变化的尺度与偏移参数，将相对深度估计转换为度量高度。实验表明，该方法在基于插值的方法、基于先验的尺度调整高度方法以及最先进的单目深度估计模型上均取得持续改进。Prior2DSM在保持结构保真度的同时降低了重建误差，相较于MDE线性拟合的均方根误差最高可降低46%，并进一步实现了DSM更新与RGB-DSM耦合生成能力。
tldr: A training-free framework for metric digital surface model completion using test-time adaptation with DINOv3 features and monocular depth foundation models to convert relative depth into metric heights, improving reconstruction accuracy.
tldr_zh: 一种用于完成数字表面模型的免训练框架，通过测试时自适应结合DINOv3特征和单目深度基础模型，将相对深度转换为度量高度，提高了重建精度。

title: ProDiG: Progressive Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Aerial to Ground Reconstruction
summary: Generating ground-level views and coherent 3D site models from aerial-only imagery is challenging due to extreme viewpoint changes, missing intermediate observations, and large scale variations. Existing methods either refine renderings post-hoc, often producing geometrically inconsistent results, or rely on multi-altitude ground-truth, which is rarely available. Gaussian Splatting and diffusion-based refinements improve fidelity under small variations but fail under wide aerial-to-ground gaps. To address these limitations, we introduce ProDiG (Progressive Altitude Gaussian Splatting), a diffusion-guided framework that progressively transforms aerial 3D representations toward ground-level fidelity. ProDiG synthesizes intermediate-altitude views and refines the Gaussian representation at each stage using a geometry-aware causal attention module that injects epipolar structure into reference-view diffusion. A distance-adaptive Gaussian module dynamically adjusts Gaussian scale and opacity based on camera distance, ensuring stable reconstruction across large viewpoint gaps. Together, these components enable progressive, geometrically grounded refinement without requiring additional ground-truth viewpoints. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ProDiG produces visually realistic ground-level renderings and coherent 3D geometry, significantly outperforming existing approaches in terms of visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to extreme viewpoint changes.
summary_zh: 摘要：仅依靠航空影像生成地面视角和连贯的3D场景模型极具挑战，原因在于极端视角变化、中间观测缺失以及尺度差异巨大。现有方法要么通过后处理优化渲染结果，但常产生几何不一致的输出；要么依赖多高度真实数据，而这类数据往往难以获取。高斯溅射和基于扩散的细化方法在小尺度变化下能提升保真度，但在广域空对地视角转换中仍存在不足。为解决这些限制，我们提出ProDiG（渐进式高度高斯溅射）——一种扩散引导的框架，能够逐步将航空3D表示转化为具有地面视角保真度的模型。该框架通过合成中间高度视角，并在每个阶段利用几何感知因果注意力模块细化高斯表示，该模块将极几何结构注入参考视图的扩散过程中。同时，距离自适应高斯模块根据相机距离动态调整高斯尺度与透明度，确保在大视角差异下实现稳定重建。这些组件共同实现了无需额外地面真实视角的渐进式几何优化。在合成数据集与真实场景数据集上的大量实验表明，ProDiG能生成视觉逼真的地面视角渲染结果与连贯的3D几何结构，在视觉质量、几何一致性和极端视角变化鲁棒性方面均显著优于现有方法。
tldr: ProDiG is a diffusion-guided framework for progressively generating ground-level 3D views and coherent 3D models from aerial-only imagery, addressing large viewpoint changes without ground-truth data.
tldr_zh: ProDiG是一个扩散引导的框架，用于从仅有的空中图像逐步生成地面级3D视图和连贯的3D模型，无需地面真实数据即可处理大视角变化。

title: MTLSI-Net: A Linear Semantic Interaction Network for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Dense Prediction
summary: Multi-task dense prediction aims to perform multiple pixel-level tasks simultaneously. However, capturing global cross-task interactions remains non-trivial due to the quadratic complexity of standard self-attention on high-resolution features. To address this limitation, we propose a Multi-Task Linear Semantic Interaction Network (MTLSI-Net), which facilitates cross-task interaction through linear attention. Specifically, MTLSI-Net incorporates three key components: a Multi-Task Multi-scale Query Linear Fusion Block, which captures cross-task dependencies across multiple scales with linear complexity using a shared global context matrix; a Semantic Token Distiller that compresses redundant features into compact semantic tokens, distilling essential cross-task knowledge; and a Cross-Window Integrated attention Block that injects global semantics into local features via a dual-branch architecture, preserving both global consistency and spatial precision. These components collectively enable the network to capture comprehensive cross-task interactions at linear complexity with reduced parameters. Extensive experiments on NYUDv2 and PASCAL-Context demonstrate that MTLSI-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness and efficiency in multi-task learning.
summary_zh: 多任务密集预测旨在同时执行多个像素级任务。然而，由于高分辨率特征上标准自注意力机制具有二次复杂度，捕捉全局跨任务交互仍具挑战性。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种多任务线性语义交互网络（MTLSI-Net），通过线性注意力机制促进跨任务交互。具体而言，MTLSI-Net包含三个核心组件：多任务多尺度查询线性融合模块，利用共享全局上下文矩阵以线性复杂度捕获多尺度跨任务依赖关系；语义令牌蒸馏器，将冗余特征压缩为紧凑的语义令牌，提炼关键的跨任务知识；以及跨窗口集成注意力模块，通过双分支架构将全局语义注入局部特征，同时保持全局一致性与空间精度。这些组件共同使网络能够以线性复杂度和更少参数实现全面的跨任务交互。在NYUDv2和PASCAL-Context数据集上的大量实验表明，MTLSI-Net达到了最先进的性能，验证了其在多任务学习中的有效性和高效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-task dense prediction model with linear attention for efficient cross-task interaction across multiple scales, achieving state-of-the-art results on vision datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多任务密集预测的线性语义交互网络，通过线性注意力机制高效捕捉跨任务依赖性，在多个视觉数据集上达到了最先进的性能。

title: Interactive Tracking: A Human-in-the-Loop Paradigm with Memory-Augmented Adaptation
summary: Existing visual trackers mainly operate in a non-interactive, fire-and-forget manner, making them impractical for real-world scenarios that require human-in-the-loop adaptation. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Interactive Tracking, a new paradigm that allows users to guide the tracker at any time using natural language commands. To support research in this direction, we make three main contributions. First, we present InteractTrack, the first large-scale benchmark for interactive tracking, containing 150 videos with dense bounding box annotations and timestamped language instructions. Second, we propose a comprehensive evaluation protocol and evaluate 25 representative trackers, showing that state-of-the-art methods fail in interactive scenarios; strong performance on conventional benchmarks does not transfer. Third, we introduce Interactive Memory-Augmented Tracking (IMAT), a new baseline that employs a dynamic memory mechanism to learn from user feedback and update tracking behavior accordingly. Our benchmark, protocol, and baseline establish a foundation for developing more intelligent, adaptive, and collaborative tracking systems, bridging the gap between automated perception and human guidance. The full benchmark, tracking results, and analysis are available at https://github.com/NorahGreen/InteractTrack.git.
summary_zh: 现有视觉跟踪器主要采用非交互式、即发即弃的工作模式，这在需要人机协同适应的实际应用场景中难以适用。为突破这一局限，我们提出了交互式跟踪新范式，允许用户随时通过自然语言指令引导跟踪器。为支持该方向的研究，我们作出三项核心贡献：首先，构建了首个大规模交互式跟踪基准InteractTrack，包含150段带有密集边界框标注和时间戳语言指令的视频数据。其次，设计了一套完整的评估方案，并对25个代表性跟踪器进行测试，结果表明先进方法在交互场景中普遍失效，传统基准测试的优异表现无法有效迁移。第三，提出交互式记忆增强跟踪框架（IMAT），该基线模型采用动态记忆机制从用户反馈中学习并相应调整跟踪行为。我们构建的基准数据集、评估方案和基线模型为开发更智能、自适应、可协作的跟踪系统奠定了基础，弥合了自动感知与人工引导之间的鸿沟。完整基准数据、跟踪结果及分析报告可通过https://github.com/NorahGreen/InteractTrack.git获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a new paradigm for visual object tracking called Interactive Tracking, where users can guide the tracker with natural language commands, and proposes a corresponding benchmark and baseline method.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为交互式跟踪的新视觉目标跟踪范式，允许用户使用自然语言指令随时引导跟踪器，并提出了相应的基准和基线方法。

title: NearID: Identity Representation Learning via Near-identity Distractors
summary: When evaluating identity-focused tasks such as personalized generation and image editing, existing vision encoders entangle object identity with background context, leading to unreliable representations and metrics. We introduce the first principled framework to address this vulnerability using Near-identity (NearID) distractors, where semantically similar but distinct instances are placed on the exact same background as a reference image, eliminating contextual shortcuts and isolating identity as the sole discriminative signal. Based on this principle, we present the NearID dataset (19K identities, 316K matched-context distractors) together with a strict margin-based evaluation protocol. Under this setting, pre-trained encoders perform poorly, achieving Sample Success Rates (SSR), a strict margin-based identity discrimination metric, as low as 30.7% and often ranking distractors above true cross-view matches. We address this by learning identity-aware representations on a frozen backbone using a two-tier contrastive objective enforcing the hierarchy: same identity > NearID distractor > random negative. This improves SSR to 99.2%, enhances part-level discrimination by 28.0%, and yields stronger alignment with human judgments on DreamBench++, a human-aligned benchmark for personalization. Project page: https://gorluxor.github.io/NearID/
summary_zh: 在评估个性化生成和图像编辑等身份导向任务时，现有视觉编码器往往将对象身份与背景信息相纠缠，导致不可靠的表征与度量。我们首次提出一种基于近身份干扰项（NearID）的理论框架以解决这一缺陷，该方法将语义相似但不同的实例置于与参考图像完全相同的背景之上，从而消除上下文捷径，使身份信息成为唯一的判别信号。基于此原理，我们构建了包含近身份干扰项的数据集（涵盖1.9万个身份实体、31.6万组背景匹配的干扰样本），并配套设计了严格的基于边界值的评估流程。在此设定下，预训练编码器表现欠佳：其样本成功率（SSR，一种严格的基于边界值的身份判别指标）低至30.7%，且常出现将干扰项排序高于真实跨视角匹配样本的情况。为改进此问题，我们在冻结骨干网络的基础上，通过双层对比学习目标来习得身份感知表征，该目标强制构建"同一身份 > 近身份干扰项 > 随机负样本"的层次关系。该方法将SSR提升至99.2%，使局部判别能力增强28.0%，并在以人类对齐为目标的个性化基准测试集DreamBench++中展现出更优的人类评判一致性。项目页面：https://gorluxor.github.io/NearID/
tldr: This paper introduces a framework and dataset for learning identity-aware visual representations by using near-identity distractors to isolate object identity from background context, which improves performance on tasks like personalized generation and image editing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用近身份干扰物从背景中分离对象身份的学习框架和数据集，以改进个性化生成和图像编辑等任务的性能。

title: MAVFusion: Efficient Infrared and Visible Video Fusion via Motion-Aware Sparse Interaction
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion combines the object saliency from infrared images with the texture details from visible images to produce semantically rich fusion results. However, most existing methods are designed for static image fusion and cannot effectively handle frame-to-frame motion in videos. Current video fusion methods improve temporal consistency by introducing interactions across frames, but they often require high computational cost. To mitigate these challenges, we propose MAVFusion, an end-to-end video fusion framework featuring a motion-aware sparse interaction mechanism that enhances efficiency while maintaining superior fusion quality. Specifically, we leverage optical flow to identify dynamic regions in multi-modal sequences, adaptively allocating computationally intensive cross-modal attention to these sparse areas to capture salient transitions and facilitate inter-modal information exchange. For static background regions, a lightweight weak interaction module is employed to maintain structural and appearance integrity. By decoupling the processing of dynamic and static regions, MAVFusion simultaneously preserves temporal consistency and fine-grained details while significantly accelerating inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAVFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple infrared and visible video benchmarks, achieving a speed of 14.16\,FPS at $640 \times 480$ resolution. The source code will be available at https://github.com/ixilai/MAVFusion.
summary_zh: 红外与可见光视频融合旨在将红外图像的显著目标信息与可见光图像的纹理细节相结合，生成语义丰富的融合结果。然而，现有方法多针对静态图像融合设计，难以有效处理视频中的帧间运动。当前视频融合方法虽通过引入跨帧交互提升时序一致性，但往往需要高昂的计算成本。为应对这些挑战，本文提出一种端到端的视频融合框架MAVFusion，其采用运动感知稀疏交互机制，在保持优异融合质量的同时显著提升效率。具体而言，我们利用光流识别多模态序列中的动态区域，将计算密集的跨模态注意力自适应分配至这些稀疏区域，以捕捉显著运动变化并促进模态间信息交互；对于静态背景区域，则采用轻量级弱交互模块维持结构与外观完整性。通过解耦动态与静态区域的处理方式，MAVFusion在保持时序一致性与细节精细度的同时，大幅提升了推理速度。大量实验表明，MAVFusion在多个红外与可见光视频基准数据集上达到先进性能，在$640 \times 480$分辨率下实现14.16帧/秒的实时处理速度。源代码将发布于https://github.com/ixilai/MAVFusion。
tldr: Proposes a motion-aware video fusion method that efficiently combines infrared and visible images, focusing computational resources on dynamic regions using optical flow for improved temporal consistency and speed.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于运动感知的视频融合方法，通过光流识别动态区域，高效融合红外与可见光图像，提升时间一致性和处理速度。

title: SHARC: Reference point driven Spherical Harmonic Representation for Complex Shapes
summary: We propose SHARC, a novel framework that synthesizes arbitrary, genus-agnostic shapes by means of a collection of Spherical Harmonic (SH) representations of distance fields. These distance fields are anchored at optimally placed reference points in the interior volume of the surface in a way that maximizes learning of the finer details of the surface. To achieve this, we employ a cost function that jointly maximizes sparsity and centrality in terms of positioning, as well as visibility of the surface from their location. For each selected reference point, we sample the visible distance field to the surface geometry via ray-casting and compute the SH coefficients using the Fast Spherical Harmonic Transform (FSHT). To enhance geometric fidelity, we apply a configurable low-pass filter to the coefficients and refine the output using a local consistency constraint based on proximity. Evaluation of SHARC against state-of-the-art methods demonstrates that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in both reconstruction accuracy and time efficiency without sacrificing model parsimony. The source code is available at https://github.com/POSE-Lab/SHARC.
summary_zh: 我们提出了SHARC，一种新颖的框架，通过球面谐波（SH）距离场表示集合来合成任意、无亏格约束的形状。这些距离场锚定在表面内部体积中经过优化布置的参考点上，以最大化对表面细节的学习能力。为实现这一目标，我们采用一种成本函数，联合优化参考点位置的稀疏性、中心性以及从该位置到表面的可见性。针对每个选定的参考点，我们通过光线投射采样到表面几何的可见距离场，并利用快速球面谐波变换（FSHT）计算SH系数。为提升几何保真度，我们对系数应用可配置的低通滤波器，并基于邻近性通过局部一致性约束优化输出结果。SHARC与前沿方法的对比评估表明，该方法在保持模型简洁性的同时，在重建精度和时间效率上均优于现有方法。源代码发布于https://github.com/POSE-Lab/SHARC。
tldr: SHARC is a novel framework for synthesizing arbitrary 3D shapes using collections of Spherical Harmonic representations anchored at optimized reference points, aiming to improve reconstruction accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: SHARC是一个新颖的框架，通过使用固定在优化参考点上的球谐函数表示集合来合成任意三维形状，旨在提高重建精度和效率。

title: ProVG: Progressive Visual Grounding via Language Decoupling for Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to localize objects in remote sensing imagery according to natural language expressions. Previous methods typically rely on sentence-level vision-language alignment, which struggles to exploit fine-grained linguistic cues, such as \textit{spatial relations} and \textit{object attributes}, that are crucial for distinguishing objects with similar characteristics. Importantly, these cues play distinct roles across different grounding stages and should be leveraged accordingly to provide more explicit guidance. In this work, we propose \textbf{ProVG}, a novel RSVG framework that improves localization accuracy by decoupling language expressions into global context, spatial relations, and object attributes. To integrate these linguistic cues, ProVG employs a simple yet effective progressive cross-modal modulator, which dynamically modulates visual attention through a \textit{survey-locate-verify} scheme, enabling coarse-to-fine vision-language alignment. In addition, ProVG incorporates a cross-scale fusion module to mitigate the large-scale variations in remote sensing imagery, along with a language-guided calibration decoder to refine cross-modal alignment during prediction. A unified multi-task head further enables ProVG to support both referring expression comprehension and segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks, \textit{i.e.}, RRSIS-D and RISBench, demonstrate that ProVG consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 遥感视觉定位旨在根据自然语言描述在遥感图像中定位目标物体。先前方法通常依赖句子级的视觉-语言对齐，难以充分利用细粒度语言线索（如空间关系和物体属性）来区分特征相似的物体。需要指出的是，这些语言线索在不同定位阶段具有不同的作用，应当相应地进行利用以提供更明确的指导。本文提出\textbf{ProVG}——一种新型遥感视觉定位框架，通过将语言描述解耦为全局上下文、空间关系和物体属性来提升定位精度。为整合这些语言线索，ProVG采用简单而有效的渐进式跨模态调制器，通过“概览-定位-验证”机制动态调节视觉注意力，实现从粗到细的视觉-语言对齐。此外，ProVG引入跨尺度融合模块以缓解遥感图像中大幅度的尺度变化，并采用语言引导的校准解码器在预测阶段优化跨模态对齐。统一的多任务头进一步使ProVG能够同时支持指代表达式理解和分割任务。在RRSIS-D和RISBench两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ProVG始终优于现有方法，取得了新的最优性能。
tldr: Proposes ProVG, a progressive visual grounding framework for remote sensing imagery that decouples language into global context, spatial relations, and object attributes to improve localization accuracy via a survey-locate-verify scheme.
tldr_zh: 提出ProVG框架，用于遥感图像的渐进式视觉定位，通过解耦语言为全局上下文、空间关系和物体属性，采用调查-定位-验证方案提升定位精度。

title: GeoAI Agency Primitives
summary: We present ongoing research on agency primitives for GeoAI assistants -- core capabilities that connect Foundation models to the artifact-centric, human-in-the-loop workflows where GIS practitioners actually work. Despite advances in satellite image captioning, visual question answering, and promptable segmentation, these capabilities have not translated into productivity gains for practitioners who spend most of their time producing vector layers, raster maps, and cartographic products. The gap is not model capability alone but the absence of an agency layer that supports iterative collaboration. We propose a vocabulary of $9$ primitives for such a layer -- including navigation, perception, geo-referenced memory, and dual modeling -- along with a benchmark that measures human productivity. Our goal is a vocabulary that makes agentic assistance in GIS implementable, testable, and comparable.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了关于GeoAI智能体代理原语的持续研究——这些核心能力将基础模型与以人工制品为中心、人机协同的工作流程相连接，这正是GIS从业者的实际工作场景。尽管卫星图像描述、视觉问答和可提示分割等技术已取得进展，但未能显著提升从业者的工作效率——他们的大部分时间仍消耗在矢量图层、栅格地图和制图产品的生产中。这一差距不仅源于模型能力不足，更在于缺乏支持迭代协作的代理层。我们为此提出包含$9$种核心原语的架构体系（涵盖导航、感知、地理参照记忆及双重建模等能力），并建立了衡量人类工作效率的基准测试框架。我们的目标是构建一套可实施、可测试、可比较的代理原语体系，以推动GIS领域智能化辅助的实现。
tldr: The paper proposes a set of 9 agency primitives to bridge the gap between foundation models and human-in-the-loop GIS workflows, aiming to translate AI capabilities into tangible productivity gains for GIS practitioners.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一套包含9个智能体基元的集合，旨在弥合基础模型与人在回路的地理信息系统（GIS）工作流之间的鸿沟，以将AI能力转化为GIS从业者的实际生产力提升。

title: MAR-MAER: Metric-Aware and Ambiguity-Adaptive Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated significant success in the realm of text-to-image generation. However, they usually face two major challenges. Firstly, the generated images may not always meet the quality standards expected by humans. Furthermore, these models face difficulty when dealing with ambiguous prompts that could be interpreted in several valid ways. To address these issues, we introduce MAR-MAER, an innovative hierarchical autoregressive framework. It combines two main components. It is a metric-aware embedding regularization method. The other one is a probabilistic latent model used for handling ambiguous semantics. Our method utilizes a lightweight projection head, which is trained with an adaptive kernel regression loss function. This aligns the model's internal representations with human-preferred quality metrics, such as CLIPScore and HPSv2. As a result, the embedding space that is learned more accurately reflects human judgment. We are also introducing a conditional variational module. This approach incorporates an aspect of controlled randomness within the hierarchical token generation process. This capability allows the model to produce a diverse array of coherent images based on ambiguous or open-ended prompts. We conducted extensive experiments using COCO and a newly developed Ambiguous-Prompt Benchmark. The results show that MAR-MAER achieves excellent performance in both metric consistency and semantic flexibility. It exceeds the baseline Hi-MAR model's performance, showing an improvement of +1.6 in CLIPScore and +5.3 in HPSv2. For unclear inputs, it produces a notably wider range of outputs. These findings have been confirmed through both human evaluation and automated metrics.
summary_zh: 自回归模型在文本到图像生成领域已展现出显著成就。然而，这类模型通常面临两大挑战：其一，生成图像的质量可能无法始终满足人类预期标准；其二，当处理存在多种合理解释的模糊提示时，模型往往难以应对。为解决这些问题，我们提出MAR-MAER——一种创新的分层自回归框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：一是基于度量感知的嵌入正则化方法，二是用于处理模糊语义的概率隐变量模型。我们的方法通过轻量级投影头与自适应核回归损失函数相结合进行训练，使模型内部表征与人类偏好的质量评估指标（如CLIPScore和HPSv2）对齐，从而让学习到的嵌入空间更精准地反映人类判断。我们还引入了条件变分模块，在分层令牌生成过程中融入可控随机性机制，使模型能够基于模糊或开放式的提示生成多样化且语义连贯的图像。通过在COCO数据集及新构建的模糊提示基准上的大量实验表明，MAR-MAER在度量一致性与语义灵活性方面均表现优异：相较于基线Hi-MAR模型，CLIPScore提升1.6分，HPSv2提升5.3分；对于模糊输入能生成显著更多样化的输出。这些结论已通过人工评估与自动化指标得到双重验证。
tldr: The paper introduces a hierarchical autoregressive framework for text-to-image generation that improves image quality and handles ambiguous prompts better, using metric-aware embedding regularization and a conditional variational module.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于文本到图像生成的分层自回归框架，通过度量感知的嵌入正则化和条件变分模块来提升图像质量并更好地处理模糊提示。

title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance
summary: This work investigates the fundamental fragility of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations. While modern VLMs excel at semantic tasks such as recognizing objects in canonical orientations and describing complex scenes, they exhibit systematic failures at a more fundamental level: lack of robust spatial invariance and equivariance required to reliably determine object identity under simple rotations, scaling, and identity transformations. We demonstrate this limitation through a systematic evaluation across diverse visual domains, including symbolic sketches, natural photographs, and abstract art. Performance drops sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, and this behavior is observed across architectures, model capacities, and prompting strategies. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between semantic understanding and spatial reasoning in current VLMs, highlighting the need for stronger geometric grounding in future multimodal systems.
summary_zh: 本文研究了最先进的视觉-语言模型在基础几何变换下的根本脆弱性。尽管现代视觉-语言模型在处理典型方向物体识别和复杂场景描述等语义任务上表现优异，但在更基础的层面却存在系统性缺陷：缺乏可靠的空间不变性与等变性，无法在简单旋转、缩放和恒等变换下稳定识别物体。我们通过对符号化草图、自然摄影和抽象艺术等多样化视觉域的系统性评估验证了这一局限。随着语义内容稀疏化，模型性能急剧下降，且该现象在不同架构、模型容量及提示策略中普遍存在。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了当前视觉-语言模型在语义理解与空间推理能力间的系统性差距，凸显了未来多模态系统需加强几何基础的必要性。
tldr: The paper investigates the fragility of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations, revealing a systematic gap between their semantic understanding and spatial reasoning capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在基本几何变换下的脆弱性，揭示了其语义理解与空间推理能力之间的系统性差距。

title: Semantic Segmentation of Textured Non-manifold 3D Meshes using Transformers
summary: Textured 3D meshes jointly represent geometry, topology, and appearance, yet their irregular structure poses significant challenges for deep-learning-based semantic segmentation. While a few recent methods operate directly on meshes without imposing geometric constraints, they typically overlook the rich textural information also provided by such meshes. We introduce a texture-aware transformer that learns directly from raw pixels associated with each mesh face, coupled with a new hierarchical learning scheme for multi-scale feature aggregation. A texture branch summarizes all face-level pixels into a learnable token, which is fused with geometrical descriptors and processed by a stack of Two-Stage Transformer Blocks (TSTB), which allow for both a local and a global information flow. We evaluate our model on the Semantic Urban Meshes (SUM) benchmark and a newly curated cultural-heritage dataset comprising textured roof tiles with triangle-level annotations for damage types. Our method achieves 81.9\% mF1 and 94.3\% OA on SUM and 49.7\% mF1 and 72.8\% OA on the new dataset, substantially outperforming existing approaches.
summary_zh: 带纹理的三维网格共同表征了几何结构、拓扑关系与外观信息，但其不规则结构对基于深度学习的语义分割提出了重大挑战。尽管近期少数方法能在不施加几何约束的条件下直接处理网格数据，但通常忽略了此类网格所提供的丰富纹理信息。本文提出一种纹理感知的Transformer模型，该模型可直接从网格面片关联的原始像素中学习，并结合新颖的多尺度特征聚合分层学习框架。纹理分支将所有面片级像素归纳为可学习的表征标记，与几何描述符融合后，通过堆叠的双阶段Transformer模块进行处理，实现局部与全局信息流的双向交互。我们在语义城市网格基准数据集以及新构建的文化遗产数据集上进行评估，后者包含带有三角形级损伤类型标注的纹理屋顶瓦片。实验结果表明，本方法在语义城市网格数据集上达到81.9%的平均F1分数与94.3%的总体准确率，在新数据集上达到49.7%的平均F1分数与72.8%的总体准确率，显著优于现有方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a texture-aware transformer and hierarchical learning scheme for semantic segmentation of textured 3D meshes, applied to urban and cultural heritage datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种纹理感知的Transformer和分层学习方案，用于纹理3D网格的语义分割，应用于城市和文化遗产数据集。

title: Language-Pretraining-Induced Bias: A Strong Foundation for General Vision Tasks
summary: The ratio of outlier parameters in language pre-training models and vision pre-training models differs significantly, making cross-modality (language and vision) inherently more challenging than cross-domain adaptation. As a result, many prior studies have focused on cross-domain transfer rather than attempting to bridge language and vision modalities, assuming that language pre-trained models are unsuitable for downstream visual tasks due to disparate parameter spaces. Contrary to this assumption, we show that adding a bridge training stage as a modality adaptation learner can effectively align Large Language Model (LLM) parameters with vision tasks. Specifically, we propose a simple yet powerful solution random label bridge training that requires no manual labeling and helps LLM parameters adapt to vision foundation tasks. Moreover, our findings reveal that partial bridge training is often advantageous, as certain layers in LLMs exhibit strong foundational properties that remain beneficial even without fine-tuning for visual tasks. This surprising discovery opens up new avenues for leveraging language pre-trained parameters directly within vision models and highlights the potential of partial bridge training as a practical pathway to cross-modality adaptation.
summary_zh:
摘要：
语言预训练模型与视觉预训练模型中的离群参数比例存在显著差异，使得跨模态（语言与视觉）自适应本质上比跨领域适应更具挑战性。因此，许多先前研究集中于跨领域迁移而非尝试弥合语言与视觉模态，其假设语言预训练模型因参数空间差异而不适用于下游视觉任务。与此假设相反，我们证明通过增加一个桥接训练阶段作为模态适应学习器，能够有效将大语言模型参数与视觉任务对齐。具体而言，我们提出一种简单而高效的解决方案——随机标签桥接训练，该方法无需人工标注即可帮助大语言模型参数适应视觉基础任务。此外，我们的研究发现部分桥接训练常具有优势，因为大语言模型中的某些层展现出强大的基础特性，即使未经视觉任务微调仍能保持有益效果。这一意外发现为在视觉模型中直接利用语言预训练参数开辟了新途径，并凸显了部分桥接训练作为跨模态适应的实用路径的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a 'random label bridge training' method to adapt language-pretrained LLM parameters for visual tasks, finding that partial adaptation of layers can be effective.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种'随机标签桥接训练'方法，使语言预训练的大语言模型参数适应视觉任务，并发现部分层的不完全适应也有效果。

title: STRIVE: Structured Spatiotemporal Exploration for Reinforcement Learning in Video Question Answering
summary: We introduce STRIVE (SpatioTemporal Reinforcement with Importance-aware Variant Exploration), a structured reinforcement learning framework for video question answering. While group-based policy optimization methods have shown promise in large multimodal models, they often suffer from low reward variance when responses exhibit similar correctness, leading to weak or unstable advantage estimates. STRIVE addresses this limitation by constructing multiple spatiotemporal variants of each input video and performing joint normalization across both textual generations and visual variants. By expanding group comparisons beyond linguistic diversity to structured visual perturbations, STRIVE enriches reward signals and promotes more stable and informative policy updates. To ensure exploration remains semantically grounded, we introduce an importance-aware sampling mechanism that prioritizes frames most relevant to the input question while preserving temporal coverage. This design encourages robust reasoning across complementary visual perspectives rather than overfitting to a single spatiotemporal configuration. Experiments on six challenging video reasoning benchmarks including VideoMME, TempCompass, VideoMMMU, MMVU, VSI-Bench, and PerceptionTest demonstrate consistent improvements over strong reinforcement learning baselines across multiple large multimodal models. Our results highlight the role of structured spatiotemporal exploration as a principled mechanism for stabilizing multimodal reinforcement learning and improving video reasoning performance.
summary_zh: 我们提出STRIVE（时空重要性感知变体探索强化学习框架），一种用于视频问答的结构化强化学习框架。尽管基于组群的策略优化方法在多模态大模型中展现出潜力，但当多个回答在正确性上表现相似时，这些方法往往面临奖励方差不足的问题，导致优势估计微弱或不稳定。STRIVE通过为每个输入视频构建多个时空变体，并在文本生成与视觉变体间进行联合归一化处理，有效解决了这一局限。通过将组间比较从语言多样性扩展到结构化视觉扰动，STRIVE丰富了奖励信号，促进了更稳定、信息量更大的策略更新。为确保探索过程保持语义一致性，我们引入重要性感知采样机制，优先选择与输入问题最相关的视频帧，同时保持时间覆盖的完整性。该设计鼓励模型在互补的视觉视角间进行鲁棒推理，而非过度拟合单一时空配置。在VideoMME、TempCompass、VideoMMMU、MMVU、VSI-Bench和PerceptionTest六个具有挑战性的视频推理基准测试中，实验结果表明STRIVE在多种多模态大模型上均能持续超越现有强化学习基线方法。我们的研究结果凸显了结构化时空探索作为稳定多模态强化学习、提升视频推理性能的原则性机制的重要作用。
tldr: STRIVE is a structured reinforcement learning framework for video question answering that uses spatiotemporal variants of input videos to stabilize policy updates and improve performance on video reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: STRIVE 是一个用于视频问答的结构化强化学习框架，通过构建输入视频的时空变体来稳定策略更新，并在多个视频推理基准测试上提升了性能。

title: Control-DINO: Feature Space Conditioning for Controllable Image-to-Video Diffusion
summary: Video models have recently been applied with success to problems in content generation, novel view synthesis, and, more broadly, world simulation. Many applications in generation and transfer rely on conditioning these models, typically through perceptual, geometric, or simple semantic signals, fundamentally using them as generative renderers. At the same time, high-dimensional features obtained from large-scale self-supervised learning on images or point clouds are increasingly used as a general-purpose interface for vision models. The connection between the two has been explored for subject specific editing, aligning and training video diffusion models, but not in the role of a more general conditioning signal for pretrained video diffusion models. Features obtained through self-supervised learning like DINO, contain a lot of entangled information about style, lighting and semantics of the scene. This makes them great at reconstruction tasks but limits their generative capabilities. In this paper, we show how we can use the features for tasks such as video domain transfer and video-from-3D generation. We introduce a lightweight architecture and training strategy that decouples appearance from other features that we wish to preserve, enabling robust control for appearance changes such as stylization and relighting. Furthermore, we show that low spatial resolution can be compensated by higher feature dimensionality, improving controllability in generative rendering from explicit spatial representations.
summary_zh: 视频模型近期在内容生成、新视角合成以及更广泛的世界模拟问题上取得了显著成功。生成与迁移中的许多应用依赖于对这些模型进行条件控制，通常通过感知信号、几何信息或简单的语义信号来实现，本质上将其用作生成式渲染器。与此同时，从大规模图像或点云自监督学习中获取的高维特征，正日益成为视觉模型的通用接口。这两者之间的联系已在特定主题编辑、视频扩散模型对齐与训练中得到探索，但尚未作为预训练视频扩散模型的通用条件信号发挥作用。通过DINO等自监督学习获得的特征，包含了场景风格、光照和语义的大量纠缠信息，这使得它们在重建任务中表现出色，但也限制了其生成能力。本文展示了如何利用这些特征完成视频域迁移和基于3D的视频生成等任务。我们提出了一种轻量级架构与训练策略，能够将外观特征与希望保留的其他特征进行解耦，从而实现对风格化与重光照等外观变化的稳健控制。此外，我们还证明低空间分辨率可通过更高特征维度进行补偿，从而提升了基于显式空间表示的生成式渲染的可控性。
tldr: Proposes Control-DINO, a lightweight architecture for video domain transfer and 3D-to-video generation by decoupling appearance from semantic features in a pretrained video diffusion model for improved controllability.
tldr_zh: 提出Control-DINO，一种轻量级架构，通过在预训练视频扩散模型中解耦外观与语义特征，实现视频域迁移和3D到视频生成，以提高可控性。

title: End-to-End Shared Attention Estimation via Group Detection with Feedback Refinement
summary: This paper proposes an end-to-end shared attention estimation method via group detection. Most previous methods estimate shared attention (SA) without detecting the actual group of people focusing on it, or assume that there is a single SA point in a given image. These issues limit the applicability of SA detection in practice and impact performance. To address them, we propose to simultaneously achieve group detection and shared attention estimation using a two step process: (i) the generation of SA heatmaps relying on individual gaze attention heatmaps and group membership scalars estimated in a group inference; (ii) a refinement of the initial group memberships allowing to account for the initial SA heatmaps, and the final prediction of the SA heatmap. Experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms other methods in group detection and shared attention estimation. Additional analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed components. Code: https://github.com/chihina/sagd-CVPRW2026.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通过群体检测的端到端共享注意力估计方法。大多数现有方法在估计共享注意力时并未检测实际关注该注意力的群体，或假设给定图像中仅存在单个共享注意力点。这些问题限制了共享注意力检测在实际应用中的适用性并影响了其性能。为解决这些问题，我们提出通过两步流程同时实现群体检测与共享注意力估计：（i）基于群体推理中估计的个体注视注意力热图与群体成员标量，生成共享注意力热图；（ii）通过初始共享注意力热图优化初始群体成员分配，并最终预测共享注意力热图。实验表明，本方法在群体检测和共享注意力估计任务上均优于其他方法。进一步分析验证了所提出组件的有效性。代码地址：https://github.com/chihina/sagd-CVPRW2026。
tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end method for shared attention estimation and group detection in images, using a two-step process with feedback refinement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过组检测实现端到端共享注意力估计的方法，采用包含反馈细化的两步流程。

title: Can Video Diffusion Models Predict Past Frames? Bidirectional Cycle Consistency for Reversible Interpolation
summary: Video frame interpolation aims to synthesize realistic intermediate frames between given endpoints while adhering to specific motion semantics. While recent generative models have improved visual fidelity, they predominantly operate in a unidirectional manner, lacking mechanisms to self-verify temporal consistency. This often leads to motion drift, directional ambiguity, and boundary misalignment, especially in long-range sequences. Inspired by the principle of temporal cycle-consistency in self-supervised learning, we propose a novel bidirectional framework that enforces symmetry between forward and backward generation trajectories. Our approach introduces learnable directional tokens to explicitly condition a shared backbone on temporal orientation, enabling the model to jointly optimize forward synthesis and backward reconstruction within a single unified architecture. This cycle-consistent supervision acts as a powerful regularizer, ensuring that generated motion paths are logically reversible. Furthermore, we employ a curriculum learning strategy that progressively trains the model from short to long sequences, stabilizing dynamics across varying durations. Crucially, our cyclic constraints are applied only during training; inference requires a single forward pass, maintaining the high efficiency of the base model. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in imaging quality, motion smoothness, and dynamic control on both 37-frame and 73-frame tasks, outperforming strong baselines while incurring no additional computational overhead.
summary_zh: 视频帧插值旨在合成给定端点之间逼真的中间帧，同时遵循特定的运动语义。尽管近期的生成模型已提升了视觉保真度，但它们大多以单向方式运行，缺乏自我验证时序一致性的机制。这通常会导致运动漂移、方向模糊和边界错位，尤其在长序列中更为明显。受自监督学习中时序循环一致性原理的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的双向框架，该框架强制前向生成轨迹与后向生成轨迹之间的对称性。我们引入可学习的方向令牌，以在共享骨干网络中对时序方向进行显式条件约束，使得模型能够在单一统一架构中联合优化前向合成与后向重建。这种循环一致性监督充当了强大的正则化器，确保生成的运动路径在逻辑上可逆。此外，我们采用课程学习策略，从短序列到长序列逐步训练模型，以稳定不同时长下的动态效果。关键在于，我们的循环约束仅在训练过程中应用；推断时仅需一次前向计算，从而保持了基础模型的高效率。大量实验表明，我们的方法在37帧和73帧任务中，于图像质量、运动平滑度和动态控制方面均实现了最先进的性能，在未引入额外计算开销的情况下超越了强基线模型。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel bidirectional framework for video frame interpolation that uses cycle consistency and directional tokens to improve temporal consistency and reduce motion drift, achieving state-of-the-art results without extra inference cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的双向视频帧插值框架，利用循环一致性和方向性标记来改善时间一致性并减少运动漂移，在不增加推理成本的情况下实现了最先进的性能。

title: DynaVid: Learning to Generate Highly Dynamic Videos using Synthetic Motion Data
summary: Despite recent progress, video diffusion models still struggle to synthesize realistic videos involving highly dynamic motions or requiring fine-grained motion controllability. A central limitation lies in the scarcity of such examples in commonly used training datasets. To address this, we introduce DynaVid, a video synthesis framework that leverages synthetic motion data in training, which is represented as optical flow and rendered using computer graphics pipelines. This approach offers two key advantages. First, synthetic motion offers diverse motion patterns and precise control signals that are difficult to obtain from real data. Second, unlike rendered videos with artificial appearances, rendered optical flow encodes only motion and is decoupled from appearance, thereby preventing models from reproducing the unnatural look of synthetic videos. Building on this idea, DynaVid adopts a two-stage generation framework: a motion generator first synthesizes motion, and then a motion-guided video generator produces video frames conditioned on that motion. This decoupled formulation enables the model to learn dynamic motion patterns from synthetic data while preserving visual realism from real-world videos. We validate our framework on two challenging scenarios, vigorous human motion generation and extreme camera motion control, where existing datasets are particularly limited. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DynaVid improves the realism and controllability in dynamic motion generation and camera motion control.
summary_zh: 尽管近期取得进展，视频扩散模型在合成涉及高度动态运动或需要精细运动可控性的真实视频时仍然面临挑战。核心限制在于常用训练数据集中此类样本的稀缺性。为此，我们提出DynaVid——一种在训练中利用合成运动数据的视频合成框架，该数据以光流形式表示并通过计算机图形管线渲染。该方法具有两大关键优势：首先，合成运动能提供从真实数据中难以获取的多样化运动模式与精确控制信号；其次，与具有人工外观的渲染视频不同，渲染光流仅编码运动信息且与外观解耦，从而避免模型重现合成视频的非自然观感。基于此构想，DynaVid采用两阶段生成框架：运动生成器首先生成运动，随后由运动引导的视频生成器根据该运动生成视频帧。这种解耦设计使模型能够从合成数据中学习动态运动模式，同时保持真实世界视频的视觉真实性。我们在现有数据集尤为受限的两种挑战性场景（激烈人体运动生成与极端相机运动控制）中验证了框架的有效性。大量实验表明，DynaVid在动态运动生成与相机运动控制方面显著提升了真实感与可控性。
tldr: Proposes DynaVid, a two-stage video generation framework that uses synthetic optical flow data to train models for generating highly dynamic, controllable videos with realistic motion.
tldr_zh: 提出 DynaVid，一个利用合成光流数据进行训练的两阶段视频生成框架，用于生成具有高度动态和可控性、运动逼真的视频。

title: TOL: Textual Localization with OpenStreetMap
summary: Natural language provides an intuitive way to express spatial intent in geospatial applications. While existing localization methods often rely on dense point cloud maps or high-resolution imagery, OpenStreetMap (OSM) offers a compact and freely available map representation that encodes rich semantic and structural information, making it well suited for large-scale localization. However, text-to-OSM (T2O) localization remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we formulate the T2O global localization task, which aims to estimate accurate 2 degree-of-freedom (DoF) positions in urban environments from textual scene descriptions without relying on geometric observations or GNSS-based initial location. To support the proposed task, we introduce TOL, a large-scale benchmark spanning multiple continents and diverse urban environments. TOL contains approximately 121K textual queries paired with OSM map tiles and covers about 316 km of road trajectories across Boston, Karlsruhe, and Singapore. We further propose TOLoc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework that explicitly models the semantics of surrounding objects and their directional information. In the coarse stage, direction-aware features are extracted from both textual descriptions and OSM tiles to construct global descriptors, which are used to retrieve candidate locations for the query. In the fine stage, the query text and top-1 retrieved tile are jointly processed, where a dedicated alignment module fuses textual descriptor and local map features to regress the 2-DoF pose. Experimental results demonstrate that TOLoc achieves strong localization performance, outperforming the best existing method by 6.53%, 9.93%, and 8.31% at 5m, 10m, and 25m thresholds, respectively, and shows strong generalization to unseen environments. Dataset, code and models will be publicly available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/TOL.
summary_zh: 自然语言为地理空间应用中的空间意图表达提供了直观方式。现有定位方法通常依赖密集点云地图或高分辨率影像，而OpenStreetMap（OSM）提供了一种紧凑且可免费获取的地图表征，能够编码丰富的语义和结构信息，使其特别适用于大规模定位任务。然而，文本到OSM（T2O）的定位研究仍处于探索阶段。本文系统阐述了T2O全局定位任务，旨在不依赖几何观测或GNSS初始位置的情况下，通过文本场景描述在城市环境中实现精确的二自由度（2-DoF）位置估计。为支持该任务，我们构建了TOL——一个横跨多个大洲、涵盖多样化城市环境的大规模基准数据集。TOL包含约12.1万条文本查询与OSM地图瓦片的配对数据，覆盖波士顿、卡尔斯鲁厄和新加坡等地总计约316公里的道路轨迹。我们进一步提出TOLoc分层定位框架，该框架显式建模周边物体的语义信息及其方向关系。在粗定位阶段，从文本描述和OSM瓦片中提取方向感知特征以构建全局描述符，用于检索查询的候选位置；在精定位阶段，联合处理查询文本与检索到的Top-1瓦片，通过专门设计的对齐模块融合文本描述符与局部地图特征，最终回归出2-DoF位姿。实验结果表明，TOLoc在5米、10米和25米误差阈值下分别以6.53%、9.93%和8.31%的显著优势超越现有最佳方法，并在未见环境中展现出强大的泛化能力。数据集、代码与模型将在https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/TOL公开。
tldr: The paper introduces TOL, a benchmark for global localization using natural language descriptions and OpenStreetMap data, and proposes TOLoc, a framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance on this text-to-map localization task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TOL，一个利用自然语言描述和OpenStreetMap数据进行全局定位的基准，并提出了TOLoc框架，在该文本到地图定位任务上实现了最先进的性能。

title: LivingWorld: Interactive 4D World Generation with Environmental Dynamics
summary: We introduce LivingWorld, an interactive framework for generating 4D worlds with environmental dynamics from a single image. While recent advances in 3D scene generation enable large-scale environment creation, most approaches focus primarily on reconstructing static geometry, leaving scene-scale environmental dynamics such as clouds, water, or smoke largely unexplored. Modeling such dynamics is challenging because motion must remain coherent across an expanding scene while supporting low-latency user feedback. LivingWorld addresses this challenge by progressively constructing a globally coherent motion field as the scene expands. To maintain global consistency during expansion, we introduce a geometry-aware alignment module that resolves directional and scale ambiguities across views. We further represent motion using a compact hash-based motion field, enabling efficient querying and stable propagation of dynamics throughout the scene. This representation also supports bidirectional motion propagation during rendering, producing long and temporally coherent 4D sequences without relying on expensive video-based refinement. On a single RTX 5090 GPU, generating each new scene expansion step requires 9 seconds, followed by 3 seconds for motion alignment and motion field updates, enabling interactive 4D world generation with globally coherent environmental dynamics. Video demonstrations are available at cvsp-lab.github.io/LivingWorld.
summary_zh: 本文提出LivingWorld——一种从单张图像生成具有环境动态的4D交互式世界的框架。尽管当前三维场景生成技术已能实现大规模环境创建，但现有方法多专注于静态几何重建，鲜有研究场景尺度的环境动态（如云层、水流、烟雾等）。此类动态建模的挑战在于：运动需在场景扩展过程中保持全局连贯性，同时需支持低延迟用户交互。LivingWorld通过渐进式构建全局连贯运动场应对这一挑战。为保持扩展过程中的全局一致性，我们引入几何感知对齐模块，以消除多视角间的方向与尺度歧义。我们进一步采用基于哈希的紧凑运动场表示法，实现高效动态查询与稳定传播。该表示法还支持渲染过程中的双向运动传播，无需依赖高成本的视频优化即可生成长时域连贯的4D序列。在单张RTX 5090显卡上，每个新场景扩展步骤仅需9秒生成时间，运动对齐与运动场更新仅需3秒，实现了具有全局连贯环境动态的交互式4D世界生成。视频演示详见cvsp-lab.github.io/LivingWorld。
tldr: LivingWorld is an interactive framework for generating 4D worlds with coherent environmental dynamics (e.g., clouds, water) from a single image, using a progressive geometry-aware motion field.
tldr_zh: LivingWorld是一个交互式框架，用于从单张图像生成具有连贯环境动态（如云、水）的4D世界，采用渐进式几何感知运动场。

title: Reinforcing Consistency in Video MLLMs with Structured Rewards
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding. However, seemingly plausible outputs often suffer from poor visual and temporal grounding: a model may fabricate object existence, assign incorrect attributes, or collapse repeated events while still producing a globally reasonable caption or answer. We study this failure mode through a compositional consistency audit that decomposes a caption into supporting factual and temporal claims, investigating whether a correct high-level prediction is actually backed by valid lower-level evidence. Our top-down audit reveals that even correct root relational claims often lack reliable attribute and existence support. This indicates that standard sentence-level supervision is a weak proxy for faithful video understanding. Furthermore, when turning to reinforcement learning (RL) for better alignment, standard sentence-level rewards often prove too coarse to accurately localize specific grounding failures. To address this, we replace generic sentence-level rewards with a structured reward built from factual and temporal units. Our training objective integrates three complementary components: (1) an instance-aware scene-graph reward for factual objects, attributes, and relations; (2) a temporal reward for event ordering and repetition; and (3) a video-grounded VQA reward for hierarchical self-verification. Across temporal, general video understanding, and hallucination-oriented benchmarks, this objective yields consistent gains on open-source backbones. These results suggest that structured reward shaping is a practical route to more faithful video understanding.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解领域取得了显著进展。然而，看似合理的输出往往存在视觉与时间定位的缺陷：模型可能捏造物体存在、分配错误属性，或在保留整体合理描述或答案的同时压缩重复事件。我们通过组合一致性审查来研究这种失效模式——将描述分解为支持性事实主张与时间主张，探究正确的高层预测是否实际得到有效底层证据支持。自上而下的审查表明，即使正确的核心关系主张也常缺乏可靠的属性与存在性支撑，这说明传统句子级监督仅是视频忠实理解的薄弱代理。进一步转向强化学习以提升对齐效果时，传统句子级奖励因粒度粗糙而难以准确定位具体定位失误。为此，我们以结构化奖励替代通用句子级奖励，该奖励由事实单元与时间单元构成。我们的训练目标整合了三个互补组件：(1) 面向事实对象、属性与关系的实例感知场景图奖励；(2) 用于事件排序与重复的时间奖励；(3) 支持层级自验证的视频指代视觉问答奖励。在时序理解、通用视频理解及幻觉检测等多个基准测试中，该方法在开源骨干网络上实现了持续性能提升。这些结果表明，结构化奖励塑造是实现更忠实视频理解的有效路径。
tldr: This paper proposes a structured reward method to improve the factual and temporal consistency of video Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), addressing issues like hallucination and event collapse through a combination of scene-graph, temporal, and VQA rewards.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种结构化奖励方法，通过结合场景图、时序和视频问答奖励来提升视频多模态大语言模型的事实与时序一致性，旨在减少幻觉和事件坍缩等问题。

title: IGLOSS: Image Generation for Lidar Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: This paper presents a new method for the zero-shot open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) of 3D automotive lidar data. To circumvent the recognized image-text modality gap that is intrinsic to approaches based on Vision Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP, our method relies instead on image generation from text, to create prototype images. Given a 3D network distilled from a 2D Vision Foundation Model (VFM), we then label a point cloud by matching 3D point features with 2D image features of these prototypes. Our method is state-of-the-art for OVSS on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI. Code, pre-trained models, and generated images are available at https://github.com/valeoai/IGLOSS.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于三维汽车激光雷达数据零样本开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）的新方法。为规避基于视觉语言模型（VLM）如CLIP等方法固有的图像-文本模态差异问题，本方法转而借助文本生成图像技术来创建原型图像。通过使用从二维视觉基础模型（VFM）蒸馏得到的三维网络，我们将三维点云特征与这些原型图像的二维特征进行匹配，从而实现点云标注。本方法在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上的OVSS任务中达到先进水平。相关代码、预训练模型及生成图像已在https://github.com/valeoai/IGLOSS发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation of 3D automotive lidar data using image generation from text to create prototypes, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用文本到图像生成创建原型的方法，用于自动驾驶激光雷达数据的零样本开放词汇语义分割，在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Human Pose Estimation in Trampoline Gymnastics: Improving Performance Using a New Synthetic Dataset
summary: Trampoline gymnastics involves extreme human poses and uncommon viewpoints, on which state-of-the art pose estimation models tend to under-perform. We demonstrate that this problem can be addressed by fine-tuning a pose estimation model on a dataset of synthetic trampoline poses (STP). STP is generated from motion capture recordings of trampoline routines. We develop a pipeline to fit noisy motion capture data to a parametric human model, then generate multiview realistic images. We use this data to fine-tune a ViTPose model, and test it on real multi-view trampoline images. The resulting model exhibits accuracy improvements in 2D which translates to improved 3D triangulation. In 2D, we obtain state-of-the-art results on such challenging data, bridging the performance gap between common and extreme poses. In 3D, we reduce the MPJPE by 12.5 mm with our best model, which represents an improvement of 19.6% compared to the pretrained ViTPose model.
summary_zh: 蹦床体操涉及人体极端姿态与非常规视角，现有先进姿态估计模型在此类数据上往往表现不佳。本文证明，通过在合成蹦床姿态数据集（STP）上对姿态估计模型进行微调可有效解决该问题。STP数据源自蹦床成套动作的运动捕捉记录，我们构建了一套数据处理流程：首先将含噪声的运动捕捉数据拟合至参数化人体模型，继而生成多视角逼真图像。利用该数据对ViTPose模型进行微调后，在真实多视角蹦床图像上进行测试。实验结果表明，优化后的模型在二维姿态估计精度上显著提升，并进一步改善了三维三角测量精度。在二维估计任务中，我们在此类挑战性数据上取得了当前最优结果，弥合了常规姿态与极端姿态之间的性能差距；在三维估计任务中，最佳模型将MPJPE误差降低了12.5毫米，相比预训练ViTPose模型实现了19.6%的性能提升。
tldr: The paper proposes a synthetic dataset (STP) to improve human pose estimation for extreme poses in trampoline gymnastics, fine-tuning a ViTPose model to achieve better 2D and 3D accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种合成数据集（STP）来改进蹦床体操中极端人体姿态的估计，通过对ViTPose模型进行微调，实现了更好的2D和3D姿态估计精度。

title: Sparse Spectral LoRA: Routed Experts for Medical VLMs
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) excel on general benchmarks but often lack robustness in medical imaging, where heterogeneous supervision induces cross-dataset interference and sensitivity to data regime (i.e., how the supervisory signals are mixed). In realistic clinical workflows, data and tasks arrive sequentially, so naive continual training further leads to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose MedQwen, a parameter-efficient medical VLM that couples a spectrally routed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with a theoretically grounded scaling rule that aligns low-rank updates with a full-rank, fully fine-tuned MoE, without changing the base architecture. Concretely, we initialize each expert from non-overlapping singular value decomposition (SVD) segments of the pretrained weight and introduce a residual compensation and scaling scheme to enable stable expert specialization and consistent routing under distribution shift. Across 23 medical datasets covering visual question answering, report generation, radiology classification, and hallucination mitigation, MedQwen achieves strong, reliable performance: it approaches full fine-tuning on zero-shot classification with 339$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, and reduces sequential forgetting to $\sim$5\% where strong baselines degrade by $>$20-50\%.
summary_zh: 大规模视觉语言模型（VLMs）在通用基准测试中表现优异，但在医学影像领域往往缺乏鲁棒性——异构监督会引发跨数据集干扰，并对数据机制（即监督信号如何混合）表现出敏感性。在实际临床工作流中，数据和任务按序到达，简单的持续训练会进一步导致灾难性遗忘。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MedQwen，一种参数高效的医学视觉语言模型。该模型将谱路由的专家混合模块（MoE）与理论支撑的缩放规则相结合，使低秩更新能够与完整参数、全微调的MoE对齐，且无需改变基础架构。具体而言，我们基于预训练权重的非重叠奇异值分解（SVD）片段初始化各专家，并引入残差补偿与缩放机制，以确保在分布偏移下实现稳定的专家专业化与一致的路由决策。在涵盖视觉问答、报告生成、放射学分类和幻觉缓解的23个医学数据集上，MedQwen展现出强劲且稳定的性能：其在零样本分类任务上以仅需全微调参数量1/339的可训练参数达到接近全微调的效果，并将顺序学习中的遗忘率降至约5%，而基线模型的性能衰退达20%至50%以上。
tldr: The paper proposes a parameter-efficient method for fine-tuning vision-language models on medical imaging tasks, using a spectrally routed Mixture-of-Experts and a novel low-rank scaling rule to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于医疗影像任务的参数高效视觉-语言模型微调方法，通过谱路由的专家混合和一种新颖的低秩缩放规则来缓解灾难性遗忘。

title: go-$m$HC: Direct Parameterization of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections via Generalized Orthostochastic Matrices
summary: Doubly stochastic matrices enable learned mixing across residual streams, but parameterizing the set of doubly stochastic matrices (the Birkhoff polytope) exactly and efficiently remains an open challenge. Existing exact methods scale factorially with the number of streams ($d$), while Kronecker-factorized approaches are efficient but expressivity-limited. We introduce a novel exact parameterization grounded in the theory of generalized orthostochastic matrices, which scales as $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ and exposes a single hyperparameter $s$ which continuously interpolates between a computationally efficient boundary and the fully expressive Birkhoff polytope. Building on Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections ($m$HC), a framework for learned dynamic layer connectivity, we instantiate this parameterization in go-$m$HC. Our method composes naturally with Kronecker-factorized methods, substantially recovering expressivity at similar FLOP costs. Spectral analysis indicates that go-$m$HC fills the Birkhoff polytope far more completely than Kronecker-factorized baselines. On synthetic stream-mixing tasks, go-$m$HC achieves the minimum theoretical loss while converging up to $10\times$ faster. We validate our approach in a 30M parameter GPT-style language model. The expressivity, efficiency, and exactness of go-$m$HC offer a practical avenue for scaling $d$ as a new dimension of model capacity.
summary_zh: 双重随机矩阵能够实现跨残差流的学习式混合，但精确且高效地参数化双重随机矩阵集合（即伯克霍夫多胞体）仍是一个开放难题。现有精确方法随流数量（$d$）呈阶乘级增长，而克罗内克分解方法虽高效但表达能力受限。我们基于广义正交随机矩阵理论提出一种新颖的精确参数化方法，其计算复杂度为$\mathcal{O}(d^3)$，并引入单个超参数$s$，可在计算效率边界与完全表达能力的伯克霍夫多胞体之间实现连续插值。依托流形约束超连接（$m$HC）——一种用于学习动态层连接性的框架，我们在go-$m$HC中实现了该参数化。本方法能自然地与克罗内克分解方法结合，在相近FLOP成本下显著恢复表达能力。谱分析表明go-$m$HC比克罗内克分解基线更完整地覆盖伯克霍夫多胞体。在合成流混合任务中，go-$m$HC达到理论最小损失，同时收敛速度提升高达$10$倍。我们在3000万参数的GPT风格语言模型中验证了该方法的有效性。go-$m$HC的精确性、高效性与表达力为将$d$扩展为模型容量的新维度提供了实用途径。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel, exact parameterization for doubly stochastic matrices (go-$m$HC) that improves the expressivity and efficiency of learned mixing in dynamic layer connectivity for models like GPT-style language models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的双随机矩阵参数化方法（go-$m$HC），提高了GPT风格语言模型等动态层连接学习的表达性和效率。

title: Ouroboros: Dynamic Weight Generation for Recursive Transformers via Input-Conditioned LoRA Modulation
summary: Recursive transformers reuse a shared weight block across multiple depth steps, trading parameters for compute. A core limitation: every step applies the same transformation, preventing the model from composing distinct operations across depth. We present Ouroboros, a system that attaches a compact Controller hypernetwork to a recursive transformer block. The Controller observes the current hidden state, produces a per-step diagonal modulation vector, and applies it to frozen SVD-initialized LoRA bases, making each recurrence step input-dependent. We combine this with gated recurrence (bias-initialized to 88% retention) and per-step LayerNorm for stable deep iteration. On Qwen2.5-3B split into a Prelude/Recurrent/Coda architecture (17 of 36 layers retained), Ouroboros reduces training loss by 43.4% over the unmodified 17-layer baseline, recovering 51.3% of the performance gap caused by layer removal. The full system adds only 9.2M trainable parameters (Controller, gate, and per-step norms) yet outperforms equivalently-sized static per-step LoRA by 1.44 loss points at depth 1 and remains ahead across all tested depths (1, 4, 8, 16) and ranks (8, 32, 64). We also find that gated recurrence is essential: without it, recursive layer application makes the model strictly worse. These gains are measured on the training distribution; on held-out text, the Controller does not yet improve over the baseline, a limitation we attribute to frozen downstream layers and discuss in detail. Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/ouroboros
summary_zh: 递归变换器在多个深度步骤中重复使用共享权重块，以参数数量换取计算量。其核心局限在于：每个步骤应用相同的变换，阻碍了模型在不同深度组合不同操作的能力。本文提出Ouroboros系统，将紧凑的控制器超网络附加到递归变换器块上。该控制器观察当前隐藏状态，生成每步对角调制向量，并将其应用于冻结的SVD初始化LoRA基座，使每次递归步骤具备输入依赖性。我们结合门控递归机制（偏置初始化为88%保留率）和每步LayerNorm，实现了稳定的深度迭代。在将Qwen2.5-3B模型拆分为前奏/递归/终曲架构（保留36层中的17层）的实验中，Ouroboros相比未修改的17层基线将训练损失降低43.4%，恢复了因层移除导致的性能差距的51.3%。完整系统仅增加920万个可训练参数（控制器、门控及每步归一化层），但在深度1时优于同等规模静态每步LoRA方法1.44个损失点，并在所有测试深度（1、4、8、16）和秩（8、32、64）上保持领先。研究发现门控递归机制不可或缺：移除该机制后，递归层应用反而导致模型性能下降。上述成果在训练分布上测得；在保留文本数据上，控制器尚未超越基线性能，我们将此局限归因于下游冻结层结构，并在文中展开详细讨论。代码地址：https://github.com/RightNow-AI/ouroboros
tldr: Proposes Ouroboros, a system using a hypernetwork to dynamically modulate weights in a recursive transformer via input-conditioned LoRA, improving performance on text modeling.
tldr_zh: 提出Ouroboros系统，通过基于输入调节的LoRA，使用超网络动态调节递归Transformer的权重，以提升文本建模性能。

title: Learn by Surprise, Commit by Proof
summary: We propose LSCP, a self-gated post-training framework for autonomous knowledge acquisition: learning only what a model does not already know, verified against what it does know, at a strength proportional to conviction, with no external oracle. When a passage produces anomalously high per-token loss, LSCP flags it, generates a Q&A chain that forces the model to articulate its own knowledge and identify gaps, then adjusts AdamW's $β_2$ proportionally to conviction depth k (the number of self-verification steps the passage survives) via $β_2 = 0.999 \cdot r^k$. The entire learning intensity is governed by a single parameter $r$. Beyond new knowledge, this process sharpens weakly encoded existing knowledge, which is a primary source of hallucination. The framework is self-extinguishing: as the model learns, per-token loss on learned passages decreases toward the surprisal threshold and the system progressively converges to standard AdamW. This models biological memory consolidation: temporary information in the context window is selectively consolidated into parametric weights, the model's long-term memory. Experiments on the reference model (Qwen3-14B) and across six models (8B--32B, four families) show that standard fine-tuning produces rote memorization (perturbation gap (the ratio of paraphrase to original perplexity) of 11.6 +- 0.2 x baseline) while all LSCP conditions learn semantically (2.7--3.0x). The r=1.0 condition (identical optimizer, nearly identical data, only Q&A format differs) confirms that the training data format, not $β_2$ gating, is the primary mechanism preventing memorization; gating instead protects neighboring knowledge from contamination by corrupt content (93 +- 7% accuracy on adjacent questions at r=0.98 vs. 90% baseline).
summary_zh: 我们提出LSCP——一种用于自主知识获取的自门控后训练框架：该框架仅学习模型未知的知识，并通过模型已知知识进行验证，学习强度与置信度成正比，且无需外部监督。当某段文本出现异常高的逐标记损失时，LSCP会将其标记，生成一个问答链以迫使模型阐明自身知识并识别知识缺口，随后通过公式$β_2 = 0.999 \cdot r^k$依据置信深度k（即该文本通过自我验证的步数）按比例调整AdamW的$β_2$参数。整个学习强度仅由单一参数$r$控制。除获取新知识外，该过程还能强化编码较弱的既有知识——这正是幻觉产生的主要来源。该框架具备自终止特性：随着模型学习，已学文本的逐标记损失逐渐降至惊奇阈值以下，系统最终收敛至标准AdamW。该机制模拟了生物记忆巩固过程：将上下文窗口中的临时信息选择性固化至参数权重（即模型的长时记忆）。在基准模型（Qwen3-14B）及六种模型（8B-32B参数，覆盖四个架构系列）上的实验表明：标准微调会导致机械记忆（扰动差距——意译文本与原文本困惑度比值——达基线值的11.6±0.2倍），而所有LSCP设置均实现语义级学习（2.7-3.0倍）。当$r=1.0$时（优化器相同、数据几乎一致，仅问答格式不同）证实：防止机械记忆的主要机制是训练数据格式而非$β_2$门控；门控机制的作用在于保护邻近知识免受干扰内容污染（相邻问题准确率在$r=0.98$时达93±7%，而基线为90%）。
tldr: This paper proposes LSCP, a self-gated post-training framework that allows models to autonomously learn and consolidate new knowledge, verified through self-verification steps, which improves semantic understanding and reduces memorization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LSCP，一种自门控后训练框架，使模型能通过自我验证步骤自主学习和巩固新知识，从而提升语义理解并减少机械记忆。

title: The Rank and Gradient Lost in Non-stationarity: Sample Weight Decay for Mitigating Plasticity Loss in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) suffers from plasticity loss severely due to the nature of non-stationarity, which impairs the ability to adapt to new data and learn continually. Unfortunately, our understanding of how plasticity loss arises, dissipates, and can be dissolved remains limited to empirical findings, leaving the theoretical end underexplored.To address this gap, we study the plasticity loss problem from the theoretical perspective of network optimization. By formally characterizing the two culprit factors in online RL process: the non-stationarity of data distributions and the non-stationarity of targets induced by bootstrapping, our theory attributes the loss of plasticity to two mechanisms: the rank collapse of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) Gram matrix and the $Θ(\frac{1}{k})$ decay of gradient magnitude. The first mechanism echoes prior empirical findings from the theoretical perspective and sheds light on the effects of existing methods, e.g., network reset, neuron recycle, and noise injection. Against this backdrop, we focus primarily on the second mechanism and aim to alleviate plasticity loss by addressing the gradient attenuation issue, which is orthogonal to existing methods. We propose Sample Weight Decay -- a lightweight method to restore gradient magnitude, as a general remedy to plasticity loss for deep RL methods based on experience replay. In experiments, we evaluate the efficacy of \methodName upon TD3, \myadded{Double DQN} and SAC with SimBa architecture in MuJoCo, \myadded{ALE} and DeepMind Control Suite tasks. The results demonstrate that \methodName effectively alleviates plasticity loss and consistently improves learning performance across various configurations of deep RL algorithms, UTD, network architectures, and environments, achieving SOTA performance on challenging DMC Humanoid tasks.
summary_zh: 摘要：深度强化学习因其非平稳性本质而严重遭受可塑性损失，这削弱了其适应新数据与持续学习的能力。遗憾的是，目前关于可塑性损失如何产生、消散及消解的理解仍局限于实证发现，理论层面尚未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们从网络优化的理论视角研究了可塑性损失问题。通过形式化分析在线强化学习过程中的两个关键因素——数据分布的非平稳性和自举法引起的目标非平稳性，我们的理论将可塑性损失归因于两种机制：神经正切核格拉姆矩阵的秩崩塌以及梯度幅度的 $Θ(\frac{1}{k})$ 衰减。第一种机制从理论视角呼应了先前的实证发现，并揭示了现有方法（如网络重置、神经元循环和噪声注入）的作用机制。在此背景下，我们主要聚焦于第二种机制，旨在通过解决梯度衰减问题来缓解可塑性损失，这与现有方法形成互补。我们提出样本权重衰减——一种轻量级的梯度幅度恢复方法，作为基于经验回放的深度强化学习算法应对可塑性损失的通用解决方案。实验中，我们在MuJoCo、ALE及DeepMind控制套件任务中，结合SimBa架构评估了该方法在TD3、Double DQN和SAC算法上的有效性。结果表明，该方法能有效缓解可塑性损失，并在深度强化学习算法、UTD配置、网络架构和环境的多种组合中持续提升学习性能，在具有挑战性的DMC Humanoid任务中达到了当前最优水平。
tldr: This paper proposes Sample Weight Decay, a method to address plasticity loss in deep RL by theoretically analyzing gradient decay and NTK rank collapse, and demonstrates improved performance on standard RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出样本权重衰减方法，通过理论分析梯度衰减和NTK秩崩溃来解决深度强化学习中的可塑性丧失问题，并在标准RL基准测试中展示了性能提升。

title: DDCL-INCRT: A Self-Organising Transformer with Hierarchical Prototype Structure (Theoretical Foundations)
summary:
Modern neural networks of the transformer family require the practitioner to decide, before training begins, how many attention heads to use, how deep the network should be, and how wide each component should be. These decisions are made without knowledge of the task, producing architectures that are systematically larger than necessary: empirical studies find that a substantial fraction of heads and layers can be removed after training without performance loss.
  This paper introduces DDCL-INCRT, an architecture that determines its own structure during training. Two complementary ideas are combined. The first, DDCL (Deep Dual Competitive Learning), replaces the feedforward block with a dictionary of learned prototype vectors representing the most informative directions in the data. The prototypes spread apart automatically, driven by the training objective, without explicit regularisation. The second, INCRT (Incremental Transformer), controls the number of heads: starting from one, it adds a new head only when the directional information uncaptured by existing heads exceeds a threshold.
  The main theoretical finding is that these two mechanisms reinforce each other: each new head amplifies prototype separation, which in turn raises the signal triggering the next addition. At convergence, the network self-organises into a hierarchy of heads ordered by representational granularity. This hierarchical structure is proved to be unique and minimal, the smallest architecture sufficient for the task, under the stated conditions. Formal guarantees of stability, convergence, and pruning safety are established throughout.
  The architecture is not something one designs. It is something one derives.
summary_zh:
现代Transformer家族神经网络要求在训练开始前就决定使用多少注意力头、网络深度及各组件的宽度。这些决策在未知具体任务的情况下作出，导致产生的架构通常比实际需求更大：实证研究表明，训练后大量注意力头和网络层可被移除而不影响性能。  
本文提出DDCL-INCRT架构，可在训练过程中自主确定其结构。该架构融合了两个互补思想：其一是深度双重竞争学习（DDCL），用学习到的原型向量字典替代前馈模块，这些原型向量代表数据中最具信息量的方向。原型向量在训练目标驱动下自动分离，无需显式正则化。其二是增量Transformer（INCRT），通过从单个注意力头开始，仅当现有头未捕捉的方向信息超过阈值时才添加新头来控制注意力头数量。  
核心理论发现是这两种机制相互促进：每个新增注意力头会增强原型分离，而原型分离又会提升触发下一次添加的信号强度。收敛时，网络自组织成按表征粒度排序的层次化注意力头结构。研究证明，在给定条件下，这种层次结构具有唯一性和最小性，即形成满足任务需求的最小架构。文中建立了关于稳定性、收敛性和剪枝安全性的形式化保障。  
该架构并非设计所得，而是推导所生。
tldr: Introduces DDCL-INCRT, a transformer architecture that self-organizes its internal structure (number of heads, depth) during training, deriving a minimal, hierarchical, and provably stable network.
tldr_zh: 提出了DDCL-INCRT，一种在训练过程中自组织其内部结构（注意力头数量、深度）的Transformer架构，可推导出最小、分层且可证明稳定的网络。

title: Towards Intrinsically Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification in Industrial Data-Driven Models via Diffusion Sampler
summary: In modern process industries, data-driven models are important tools for real-time monitoring when key performance indicators are difficult to measure directly. While accurate predictions are essential, reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is equally critical for safety, reliability, and decision-making, but remains a major challenge in current data-driven approaches. In this work, we introduce a diffusion-based posterior sampling framework that inherently produces well-calibrated predictive uncertainty via faithful posterior sampling, eliminating the need for post-hoc calibration. In extensive evaluations on synthetic distributions, the Raman-based phenylacetic acid soft sensor benchmark, and a real ammonia synthesis case study, our method achieves practical improvements over existing UQ techniques in both uncertainty calibration and predictive accuracy. These results highlight diffusion samplers as a principled and scalable paradigm for advancing uncertainty-aware modeling in industrial applications.
summary_zh: 在现代过程工业中，当关键性能指标难以直接测量时，数据驱动模型是实现实时监控的重要工具。虽然精确预测至关重要，但可靠的不确定性量化对于安全性、可靠性和决策制定同样关键，而当前数据驱动方法在这一领域仍面临重大挑战。本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的后验采样框架，该框架通过真实的后验采样自然生成校准良好的预测不确定性，无需进行事后校准。通过对合成分布、基于拉曼光谱的苯乙酸软测量基准以及实际氨合成案例的广泛评估，本方法在不确定性校准和预测准确性方面均优于现有不确定性量化技术，实现了实际性能的提升。这些结果表明，扩散采样器为工业应用中不确定性感知建模的推进提供了一种原理清晰且可扩展的范式。
tldr: Introduces a diffusion-based posterior sampling framework for inherently calibrated uncertainty quantification in data-driven models for industrial applications, evaluated on synthetic distributions and real chemical process benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于扩散的后验采样框架，用于工业数据驱动模型的内在校准不确定性量化，并在合成分布和真实化学过程基准上进行了评估。

title: Physics Informed Reinforcement Learning with Gibbs Priors for Topology Control in Power Grids
summary: Topology control for power grid operation is a challenging sequential decision making problem because the action space grows combinatorially with the size of the grid and action evaluation through simulation is computationally expensive. We propose a physics-informed Reinforcement Learning framework that combines semi-Markov control with a Gibbs prior, that encodes the system's physics, over the action space. The decision is only taken when the grid enters a hazardous regime, while a graph neural network surrogate predicts the post action overload risk of feasible topology actions. These predictions are used to construct a physics-informed Gibbs prior that both selects a small state-dependent candidate set and reweights policy logits before action selection. In this way, our method reduces exploration difficulty and online simulation cost while preserving the flexibility of a learned policy. We evaluate the approach in three realistic benchmark environments of increasing difficulty. Across all settings, the proposed method achieves a strong balance between control quality and computational efficiency: it matches oracle-level performance while being approximately $6\times$ faster on the first benchmark, reaches $94.6\%$ of oracle reward with roughly $200\times$ lower decision time on the second one, and on the most challenging benchmark improves over a PPO baseline by up to $255\%$ in reward and $284\%$ in survived steps while remaining about $2.5\times$ faster than a strong specialized engineering baseline. These results show that our method provides an effective mechanism for topology control in power grids.
summary_zh: 电网运行中的拓扑控制是一个具有挑战性的序列决策问题，因为动作空间随电网规模呈组合式增长，且通过仿真进行动作评估的计算成本高昂。本文提出一种融合物理信息的强化学习框架，将半马尔可夫控制与动作空间上的吉布斯先验相结合，该先验编码了系统的物理规律。仅当电网进入危险状态时才触发决策机制，同时通过图神经网络代理模型预测可行拓扑动作的过载风险。这些预测结果用于构建物理信息化的吉布斯先验，该先验既能在动作选择前筛选出与状态相关的小规模候选动作集，又能对策略逻辑值进行重新加权。通过这种方式，我们的方法在保留学习策略灵活性的同时，有效降低了探索难度与在线仿真成本。我们在三个难度递增的真实基准环境中对该方法进行评估。在所有场景中，所提方法在控制质量与计算效率间取得了良好平衡：在第一个基准测试中达到与最优基准相当的性能且计算速度提升约6倍；在第二个基准中以约200倍更低的决策时间实现94.6%的最优基准奖励；在最具挑战性的基准测试中，相较于PPO基线模型，奖励提升达255%，安全运行步数增加284%，同时仍比专业工程基准快约2.5倍。这些结果表明，我们的方法为电网拓扑控制提供了有效机制。
tldr: Proposes a physics-informed reinforcement learning framework using Gibbs priors and a GNN surrogate for computationally efficient topology control in power grids, reducing simulation cost while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种物理信息强化学习框架，结合吉布斯先验和图神经网络代理，用于高效管理电网拓扑结构，旨在降低仿真成本并保持控制性能。

title: Graph Neural Operator Towards Edge Deployability and Portability for Sparse-to-Dense, Real-Time Virtual Sensing on Irregular Grids
summary: Accurate sensing of spatially distributed physical fields typically requires dense instrumentation, which is often infeasible in real-world systems due to cost, accessibility, and environmental constraints. Physics-based solvers address this through direct numerical integration of governing equations, but their computational latency and power requirements preclude real-time use in resource-constrained monitoring and control systems. Here we introduce VIRSO (Virtual Irregular Real-Time Sparse Operator), a graph-based neural operator for sparse-to-dense reconstruction on irregular geometries, and a variable-connectivity algorithm, Variable KNN (V-KNN), for mesh-informed graph construction. Unlike prior neural operators that treat hardware deployability as secondary, VIRSO reframes inference as measurement: the combination of both spectral and spatial analysis provides accurate reconstruction without the high latency and power consumption of previous graph-based methodologies with poor scalability, presenting VIRSO as a potential candidate for edge-constrained, real-time virtual sensing. We evaluate VIRSO on three nuclear thermal-hydraulic benchmarks of increasing geometric and multiphysics complexity, across reconstruction ratios from 47:1 to 156:1. VIRSO achieves mean relative $L_2$ errors below 1%, outperforming other benchmark operators while using fewer parameters. The full 10-layer configuration reduces the energy-delay product (EDP) from ${\approx}206$ J$\cdot$ms for the graph operator baseline to $10.1$ J$\cdot$ms on an NVIDIA H200. Implemented on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, all configurations of VIRSO provide sub-10 W power consumption and sub-second latency. These results establish the edge-feasibility and hardware-portability of VIRSO and present compute-aware operator learning as a new paradigm for real-time sensing in inaccessible and resource-constrained environments.
summary_zh: 对空间分布式物理场的精确感知通常需要密集的仪器部署，但由于成本、可达性和环境限制，这在现实系统中往往难以实现。基于物理的求解器通过直接数值积分控制方程来应对这一问题，但其计算延迟和功耗需求阻碍了其在资源受限的监测与控制系统中的实时应用。本文提出VIRSO（虚拟不规则实时稀疏算子），一种基于图的神经算子，用于不规则几何结构上的稀疏到密集重建，并引入一种可变连接性算法——可变K近邻（V-KNN），用于构建网格感知的图结构。与先前将硬件部署性视为次要的神经算子不同，VIRSO将推理重构为一种测量过程：结合频谱和空间分析，可在不依赖高延迟、高功耗且扩展性差的前期图方法基础上实现精确重建，使VIRSO成为边缘受限实时虚拟传感的潜在候选方案。我们在三个几何与多物理场复杂度递增的核热工水力基准测试中评估VIRSO，重建比从47:1到156:1不等。VIRSO实现了平均相对$L_2$误差低于1%，且使用更少参数，性能优于其他基准算子。完整10层配置将能量延迟积（EDP）从图算子基准的${\approx}206$ J$\cdot$ms降至NVIDIA H200上的$10.1$ J$\cdot$ms。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano平台上部署时，所有VIRSO配置均实现低于10 W的功耗和亚秒级延迟。这些结果证实了VIRSO的边缘可行性与硬件可移植性，并提出以计算感知的算子学习作为不可达及资源受限环境中实时传感的新范式。
tldr: Proposes VIRSO, a graph-based neural operator for real-time, sparse-to-dense virtual sensing on irregular grids, focusing on computational efficiency and edge deployment for physical system monitoring.
tldr_zh: 提出VIRSO，一种基于图神经网络的算子，用于在非规则网格上进行实时稀疏到密集的虚拟传感，重点针对物理系统监控的计算效率和边缘部署。

title: Learning in Prophet Inequalities with Noisy Observations
summary: We study the prophet inequality, a fundamental problem in online decision-making and optimal stopping, in a practical setting where rewards are observed only through noisy realizations and reward distributions are unknown. At each stage, the decision-maker receives a noisy reward whose true value follows a linear model with an unknown latent parameter, and observes a feature vector drawn from a distribution. To address this challenge, we propose algorithms that integrate learning and decision-making via lower-confidence-bound (LCB) thresholding. In the i.i.d.\ setting, we establish that both an Explore-then-Decide strategy and an $\varepsilon$-Greedy variant achieve the sharp competitive ratio of $1 - 1/e$, under a mild condition on the optimal value. For non-identical distributions, we show that a competitive ratio of $1/2$ can be guaranteed against a relaxed benchmark. Moreover, with limited window access to past rewards, the tight ratio of $1/2$ against the optimal benchmark is achieved.
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们研究预言家不等式这一在线决策与最优停止中的基础问题，考虑实际场景中奖励仅通过噪声观测呈现且奖励分布未知的情形。在每个阶段，决策者接收到的噪声奖励真实值遵循一个含有未知隐参数的线性模型，并可观测到从分布中抽取的特征向量。针对此挑战，我们提出通过置信下界阈值策略将学习与决策相结合的算法。在独立同分布设定下，我们证明在最优值满足温和条件时，“先探索后决策”策略及其$\varepsilon$-贪婪变体均能获得$1 - 1/e$的尖锐竞争比。对于非同分布情形，我们证明针对松弛基准可保证$1/2$的竞争比。此外，在仅能有限获取历史奖励信息的窗口约束下，算法针对最优基准仍能达到$1/2$的紧竞争比。
tldr: This paper studies the prophet inequality problem with unknown reward distributions and noisy observations, proposing LCB-based algorithms to achieve competitive ratios for online decision-making.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在未知奖励分布和噪声观察情况下的先知不等式问题，提出了基于LCB的算法，以实现在线决策的竞争比率。

title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Adaptive Control of a Turbofan Engine
summary: This paper investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for multivariable control of a two-spool turbofan engine. A physics-based component-level model is developed to generate training data and validate the controllers. A meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition is developed, with a cost function designed to accurately capture both spool-speed dynamics and the engine pressure ratio (EPR), enabling the construction of a single Koopman model suitable for multiple control objectives. Using the identified time-varying Koopman model, two controllers are developed: an adaptive Koopman-based model predictive controller (AKMPC) with a disturbance observer and a Koopman-based feedback linearization controller (K-FBLC), which serves as a benchmark. The controllers are evaluated for two control strategies, namely configurations of spool speeds and EPR, under both sea-level and varying flight conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed identification approach enables accurate predictions of both spool speeds and EPR, allowing the Koopman model to be reused flexibly across different control formulations. While both control strategies achieve comparable performance in steady conditions, the AKMPC exhibits superior robustness compared with the K-FBLC under varying flight conditions due to its ability to compensate for model mismatch. Moreover, the EPR control strategy improves the thrust response. The study highlights the applicability of Koopman-based control and demonstrates the advantages of the AKMPC-based framework for robust turbofan engine control.
summary_zh: 本文研究基于Koopman算子的双转子涡扇发动机多变量控制方法。首先建立基于物理原理的部件级模型用于生成训练数据及验证控制器性能。提出一种基于元启发式扩展动态模态分解的方法，其损失函数设计旨在精确捕捉转子转速动态与发动机压力比特性，从而构建适用于多控制目标的统一Koopman模型。基于所识别的时变Koopman模型，开发了两种控制器：配备扰动观测器的自适应Koopman模型预测控制器（AKMPC），以及作为基准的基于Koopman的反馈线性化控制器（K-FBLC）。在稳态海平面与动态飞行条件下，分别评估了两种控制策略（即转子转速配置与压力比控制）下的控制器性能。结果表明，所提出的辨识方法能同时精确预测转子转速与发动机压力比，使得Koopman模型可在不同控制架构中灵活复用。尽管两种控制策略在稳态条件下性能相当，但AKMPC凭借其补偿模型失配的能力，在动态飞行条件下表现出优于K-FBLC的鲁棒性。此外，压力比控制策略能够提升推力响应性能。本研究验证了基于Koopman的控制方法在涡扇发动机控制中的适用性，并证明了AKMPC框架在增强发动机控制鲁棒性方面的优势。
tldr: This paper applies Koopman operator theory to identify and control a turbofan engine, developing an adaptive MPC and a feedback linearization controller, and demonstrates robustness under varying flight conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文应用Koopman算子理论进行涡扇发动机的辨识与控制，开发了自适应模型预测控制器和反馈线性化控制器，并展示了在变化飞行条件下的鲁棒性。

title: Cognitive Energy Modeling for Neuroadaptive Human-Machine Systems using EEG and WGAN-GP
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive insight into the brain's cognitive and emotional dynamics. However, modeling how these states evolve in real time and quantifying the energy required for such transitions remains a major challenge. The Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP) offers a principled probabilistic framework to model the most efficient evolution between the brain states, interpreted as a measure of cognitive energy cost. While generative models such as GANs have been widely used to augment EEG data, it remains unclear whether synthetic EEG preserves the underlying dynamical structure required for transition-based analysis. In this work, we address this gap by using SBP-derived transport cost as a metric to evaluate whether GAN-generated EEG retains the distributional geometry necessary for energy-based modeling of cognitive state transitions. We compare transition energies derived from real and synthetic EEG collected during Stroop tasks and demonstrate strong agreement across group and participant-level analyses. These results indicate that synthetic EEG preserves the transition structure required for SBP-based modeling, enabling its use in data-efficient neuroadaptive systems. We further present a framework in which SBP-derived cognitive energy serves as a control signal for adaptive human-machine systems, supporting real-time adjustment of system behavior in response to user cognitive and affective state.
summary_zh: 脑电图（EEG）为研究大脑的认知与情绪动态提供了非侵入性观测手段。然而，如何实时建模这些状态之间的演化过程，并量化其转换所需的能量，仍是一个重要挑战。薛定谔桥问题（SBP）为大脑状态间最有效演化路径的建模提供了理论严谨的概率框架，其能量消耗可被解释为认知能量成本。尽管生成对抗网络（GAN）等生成模型已广泛用于扩充脑电数据，但合成脑电数据是否保留了基于状态转移分析所需的内在动力学结构仍不明确。本研究通过引入SBP导出的传输代价作为度量指标，评估GAN生成的脑电数据是否保留了基于认知状态转换的能量建模所需的分布几何特性。我们基于Stroop任务采集的真实与合成脑电数据计算转换能量，并在群体和个体层面分析中展现出一致性。结果表明，合成脑电数据保留了SBP建模所需的转移结构，可应用于数据高效型神经自适应系统。我们进一步提出一个框架，将SBP推导的认知能量作为自适应人机系统的控制信号，以实现根据用户认知与情感状态实时调整系统行为。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to model cognitive energy using EEG and the Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP), and uses WGAN-GP to generate synthetic EEG data that preserves the cognitive state transition structure for neuroadaptive human-machine systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用脑电图和薛定谔桥问题建模认知能量的框架，并使用WGAN-GP生成保留认知状态转换结构的合成脑电图数据，用于神经自适应人机系统。

title: CRIT: Graph-Based Automatic Data Synthesis to Enhance Cross-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Real-world reasoning often requires combining information across modalities, connecting textual context with visual cues in a multi-hop process. Yet, most multimodal benchmarks fail to capture this ability: they typically rely on single images or set of images, where answers can be inferred from a single modality alone. This limitation is mirrored in the training data, where interleaved image-text content rarely enforces complementary, multi-hop reasoning. As a result, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate and produce reasoning traces poorly grounded in visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce CRIT, a new dataset and benchmark built with a graph-based automatic pipeline for generating complex cross-modal reasoning tasks. CRIT consists of diverse domains ranging from natural images, videos, and text-rich sources, and includes a manually verified test set for reliable evaluation. Experiments on this benchmark reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle on such reasoning tasks. Models trained on CRIT show significant gains in cross-modal multi-hop reasoning, including strong improvements on SPIQA and other standard multimodal benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现实世界中的推理常常需要跨模态整合信息，在多步骤过程中将文本语境与视觉线索相连接。然而，现有的大多数多模态基准测试未能捕捉这种能力：它们通常依赖单张图像或图像集合，答案往往仅从单一模态即可推断。这种局限性同样反映在训练数据中，其中交错排列的图文内容很少能强制模型进行互补性的多步骤推理。因此，视觉语言模型经常产生幻觉，并生成缺乏视觉证据支撑的推理轨迹。为填补这一空白，我们提出了CRIT——一个基于图结构的自动化流程构建的新数据集与基准测试，专门用于生成复杂的跨模态推理任务。CRIT涵盖自然图像、视频和文本密集型资源等多种领域，并包含经过人工验证的测试集以确保评估可靠性。在该基准测试上的实验表明，即使是当前最先进的模型在此类推理任务上也表现困难。使用CRIT训练的模型在跨模态多步骤推理能力上取得显著提升，包括在SPIQA及其他标准多模态基准测试中实现大幅性能改进。
tldr: Introduces CRIT, a graph-based automatic pipeline for generating a dataset and benchmark focused on cross-modal multi-hop reasoning to improve Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
tldr_zh: 提出了CRIT，一种基于图的全自动流程，用于生成专注于跨模态多跳推理的数据集和基准，旨在改进视觉语言模型（VLM）。
