Using training data generated through this exact optimization pipeline, we show that an 8B-parameter LLM can be fine-tuned to jointly perform solution generation and infeasibility detection. We further utilize LLM outputs as warm starts for downstream local search, providing a practical way to accelerate optimization even when the LLM outputs are imperfect. Experiments show that our fine-tuned model improves overall accuracy by up to 30\% over GPT-5.2; meanwhile LLM-guided warm starts provide up to $2\times$ speedup compared with starting from scratch in downstream local search.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在NP难组合优化问题中的应用日益受到关注，但现有方法大多侧重于可行实例的求解生成，并未明确处理不可行性检测问题。本文提出一种感知不可行性的框架，该框架结合了可验证数据集构建、监督微调以及LLM辅助的下游搜索。针对子图嵌入问题，我们引入了一种新的数学规划建模方法，并配合可证明的零阶段不可行性筛查机制，从而能够规模化构建训练实例——这些实例被标记为具备结构化验证证书的可行案例或可验证的不可行案例。通过这一精确优化流程生成训练数据，我们证明了仅需80亿参数的LLM经过微调即可同时实现解生成与不可行性检测。我们进一步将LLM的输出作为下游局部搜索的初始化起点，为加速优化过程提供了实用路径——即使LLM的输出存在瑕疵。实验表明，经过微调的模型整体准确率较GPT-5.2提升达30%；同时，在局部搜索中，LLM引导的初始化起点相比从零开始搜索可获得高达2倍的加速效果。
tldr: This paper proposes an infeasibility-aware LLM framework for combinatorial optimization problems, focusing on detecting infeasibility and improving solution generation and downstream search for NP-hard problems, specifically the minor-embedding problem.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对组合优化问题的不可行性感知大语言模型框架，专注于检测不可行性，并改进了NP难问题（特别是次要嵌入问题）的解决方案生成和下游搜索。

title: A Multi-Agent Human-LLM Collaborative Framework for Closed-Loop Scientific Literature Summarization
summary: Scientific discovery is slowed by fragmented literature that requires excessive human effort to gather, analyze, and understand. AI tools, including autonomous summarization and question answering, have been developed to aid in understanding scientific literature. However, these tools lack the structured, multi-step approach necessary for extracting deep insights from scientific literature. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for literature analysis, but remain unreliable due to hallucinations and incomplete extraction. We introduce Elhuyar, a multi-agent, human-in-the-loop system that integrates LLMs, structured AI, and human scientists to extract, analyze, and iteratively refine insights from scientific literature. The framework distributes tasks among specialized agents for filtering papers, extracting data, fitting models, and summarizing findings, with human oversight ensuring reliability. The system generates structured reports with extracted data, visualizations, model equations, and text summaries, enabling deeper inquiry through iterative refinement. Deployed in materials science, it analyzed literature on tungsten under helium-ion irradiation, showing experimentally correlated exponential helium bubble growth with irradiation dose and temperature, offering insight for plasma-facing materials (PFMs) in fusion reactors. This demonstrates how AI-assisted literature review can uncover scientific patterns and accelerate discovery.
summary_zh: 科学发现因文献碎片化而受阻，这需要耗费大量人力进行收集、分析与理解。尽管已开发出包括自主摘要与问答在内的AI工具以辅助科研文献理解，但这些工具缺乏从科学文献中提取深层洞见所必需的结构化、多步骤分析方法。大语言模型（LLMs）为文献分析提供了新的可能性，但因存在幻觉与信息提取不完整等问题，其可靠性仍显不足。本文提出Elhuyar系统——一个融合LLMs、结构化AI与科研人员的人机协同多智能体框架，通过迭代精炼实现科学文献的提取、分析与洞见深化。该框架将任务分配给专精于文献筛选、数据提取、模型拟合与结论总结的智能体，并由人类监督确保可靠性。系统可生成包含提取数据、可视化图表、模型方程与文本总结的结构化报告，通过迭代优化支持深度探究。在材料科学领域的部署应用中，该系统分析了氦离子辐照下钨材料的文献，揭示了氦气泡生长与辐照剂量、温度呈指数相关的实验规律，为聚变反应堆面向等离子体材料（PFMs）研究提供了新见解。本研究表明，AI辅助的文献综述能够有效揭示科学规律并加速科学发现。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-agent, human-in-the-loop framework that uses LLMs and structured AI to assist in the scientific literature review process, demonstrated for materials science, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个多智能体、人机协作的框架，利用大语言模型和结构化人工智能辅助科学文献综述，并以材料科学为例进行了演示，与机器人学或具身人工智能无直接关联。

title: When AI Gets it Wong: Reliability and Risk in AI-Assisted Medication Decision Systems
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into healthcare and pharmacy workflows, supporting tasks such as medication recommendations, dosage determination, and drug interaction detection. While these systems often demonstrate strong performance under standard evaluation metrics, their reliability in real-world decision-making remains insufficiently understood. In high-risk domains such as medication management, even a single incorrect recommendation can result in severe patient harm. This paper examines the reliability of AI-assisted medication systems by focusing on system failures and their potential clinical consequences. Rather than evaluating performance solely through aggregate metrics, this work shifts attention towards how errors occur and what happens when AI systems produce incorrect outputs. Through a series of controlled, simulated scenarios involving drug interactions and dosage decisions, we analyse different types of system failures, including missed interactions, incorrect risk flagging, and inappropriate dosage recommendations. The findings highlight that AI errors in medication-related contexts can lead to adverse drug reactions, ineffective treatment, or delayed care, particularly when systems are used without sufficient human oversight. Furthermore, the paper discusses the risks of over-reliance on AI recommendations and the challenges posed by limited transparency in decision-making processes. This work contributes a reliability-focused perspective on AI evaluation in healthcare, emphasising the importance of understanding failure behavior and real-world impact. It highlights the need to complement traditional performance metrics with risk-aware evaluation approaches, particularly in safety-critical domains such as pharmacy practice.
summary_zh: 人工智能系统正日益融入医疗保健和药房工作流程，支持药物推荐、剂量确定和药物相互作用检测等任务。尽管这些系统在标准评估指标下常表现出色，但其在现实世界决策中的可靠性仍未被充分理解。在药物管理等高危领域，即使仅出现一次错误推荐，也可能导致患者严重伤害。本文通过聚焦系统故障及其潜在临床后果，研究了人工智能辅助药物系统的可靠性。与单纯依赖聚合指标评估性能不同，本研究将关注点转向错误如何发生以及人工智能系统产生错误输出时的后果。通过一系列涉及药物相互作用和剂量决策的受控模拟场景，我们分析了不同类型的系统故障，包括遗漏药物相互作用、错误风险标记和不适当的剂量推荐。研究结果表明，在与药物相关的场景中，人工智能错误可能导致药物不良反应、治疗无效或延误治疗，尤其是在缺乏充分人工监督的情况下使用系统时。此外，本文还讨论了过度依赖人工智能推荐的风险，以及决策过程透明度不足带来的挑战。本研究为医疗保健领域的人工智能评估提供了一个以可靠性为中心的视角，强调了理解系统故障行为和现实世界影响的重要性。这项工作指出，需要以风险感知的评估方法补充传统性能指标，特别是在药房实践等安全关键领域。
tldr: This paper examines the reliability and failure modes of AI systems for medication recommendations, highlighting clinical risks and the need for risk-aware evaluation in healthcare, without a robotics focus.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了用于药物推荐的AI系统的可靠性及故障模式，强调临床风险及在医疗保健领域进行风险感知评估的必要性，不涉及机器人技术。

title: Better Rigs, Not Bigger Networks: A Body Model Ablation for Gaussian Avatars
summary: Recent 3D Gaussian splatting methods built atop SMPL achieve remarkable visual fidelity while continually increasing the complexity of the overall training architecture. We demonstrate that much of this complexity is unnecessary: by replacing SMPL with the Momentum Human Rig (MHR), estimated via SAM-3D-Body, a minimal pipeline with no learned deformations or pose-dependent corrections achieves the highest reported PSNR and competitive or superior LPIPS and SSIM on PeopleSnapshot and ZJU-MoCap. To disentangle pose estimation quality from body model representational capacity, we perform two controlled ablations: translating SAM-3D-Body meshes to SMPL-X, and translating the original dataset's SMPL poses into MHR both retrained under identical conditions. These ablations confirm that body model expressiveness has been a primary bottleneck in avatar reconstruction, with both mesh representational capacity and pose estimation quality contributing meaningfully to the full pipeline's gains.
summary_zh: 基于SMPL的近期3D高斯喷洒方法在不断提升整体训练架构复杂度的同时，实现了卓越的视觉保真度。我们证明这种复杂性大多是不必要的：通过使用经SAM-3D-Body估计的动量人体骨架（MHR）替代SMPL，一个无需学习形变或姿态依赖校正的极简流程，在PeopleSnapshot和ZJU-MoCap数据集上取得了当前最高的PSNR记录，并实现了具有竞争力或更优的LPIPS与SSIM指标。为厘清姿态估计质量与人体模型表示能力的影响，我们进行了两项对照实验：将SAM-3D-Body网格转换为SMPL-X格式，以及将原始数据集的SMPL姿态转换为MHR格式，两者均在相同条件下重新训练。这些实验证实，人体模型表达能力始终是虚拟化身重建的主要瓶颈，其中网格表示能力与姿态估计质量共同构成了完整流程性能提升的关键因素。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that a simpler 3D Gaussian avatar pipeline, using a more expressive body model (MHR) and improved pose estimation, outperforms complex methods, suggesting body model representational capacity is a key bottleneck.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，通过使用更具表现力的身体模型（MHR）和更好的姿态估计，一个更简单的3D高斯化身管道能超越复杂方法，表明身体模型的表现力是主要瓶颈。

title: All Substitution Is Local
summary: When does consulting one information source raise the value of another, and when does it diminish it? We study this question for Bayesian decision-makers facing finite actions. The interaction decomposes into two opposing forces: a complement force, measuring how one source moves beliefs to where the other becomes more useful, and a substitute force, measuring how much the current decision is resolved. Their balance obeys a localization principle: substitution requires an observation to cross a decision boundary, though crossing alone does not guarantee it. Whenever posteriors remain inside the current decision region, the substitute force vanishes, and sources are guaranteed to complement each other, even when one source cannot, on its own, change the decision. The results hold for arbitrarily correlated sources and are formalized in Lean 4. Substitution is confined to the thin boundaries where decisions change. Everywhere else, information cooperates. Code and proofs: https://github.com/nidhishs/all-substitution-is-local.
summary_zh: 何时咨询一个信息源会提升另一个信息源的价值，何时又会削弱它？我们针对面临有限行动的贝叶斯决策者研究这一问题。信息源间的相互作用可分解为两种对立力量：互补力（衡量一个信息源如何推动信念至使另一信息源更有用的位置）和替代力（衡量当前决策被解决的程度）。二者的平衡遵循局部化原理：替代需要观测跨越决策边界，但仅跨越本身并不保证替代发生。只要后验概率保持在当前决策区域内，替代力便会消失，且信息源之间必然相互补充——即便单个信息源无法独立改变决策。该结论适用于任意相关性的信息源，并在Lean 4中形式化验证。替代现象仅局限于决策发生改变的狭窄边界上，除此之外，信息皆协同作用。代码与证明：https://github.com/nidhishs/all-substitution-is-local。
tldr: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of information complementarity and substitution for Bayesian decision-makers, showing that substitution only occurs when observations cross decision boundaries, with proofs formalized in Lean 4.
tldr_zh: 本文对贝叶斯决策者的信息互补性和替代性进行了理论分析，表明替代性仅发生在观测跨越决策边界时，并使用 Lean 4 对证明进行了形式化验证。

title: GRAZE: Grounded Refinement and Motion-Aware Zero-Shot Event Localization
summary: American football practice generates video at scale, yet the interaction of interest occupies only a brief window of each long, untrimmed clip. Reliable biomechanical analysis, therefore, depends on spatiotemporal localization that identifies both the interacting entities and the onset of contact. We study First Point of Contact (FPOC), defined as the first frame in which a player physically touches a tackle dummy, in unconstrained practice footage with camera motion, clutter, multiple similarly equipped athletes, and rapid pose changes around impact. We present GRAZE, a training-free pipeline for FPOC localization that requires no labeled tackle-contact examples. GRAZE uses Grounding DINO to discover candidate player-dummy interactions, refines them with motion-aware temporal reasoning, and uses SAM2 as an explicit pixel-level verifier of contact rather than relying on detection confidence alone. This separation between candidate discovery and contact confirmation makes the approach robust to cluttered scenes and unstable grounding near impact. On 738 tackle-practice videos, GRAZE produces valid outputs for 97.4% of clips and localizes FPOC within $\pm$ 10 frames on 77.5% of all clips and within $\pm$ 20 frames on 82.7% of all clips. These results show that frame-accurate contact onset localization in real-world practice footage is feasible without task-specific training.
summary_zh: 美式橄榄球训练会产生大量视频，但关键互动行为仅出现在每段未经剪辑的长视频中的短暂片段。因此，可靠的生物力学分析依赖于时空定位技术，以识别互动实体和接触起始点。本研究聚焦于"首次接触点"（FPOC），即在无约束训练镜头中球员首次触碰到擒抱假人的帧画面，这类视频普遍存在摄像机运动、场景杂乱、多名装备相似运动员以及撞击瞬间姿态快速变化等挑战。我们提出GRAZE——一种无需训练、无需标注擒抱接触样本的FPOC定位流程。该方法首先利用Grounding DINO发现候选的球员-假人互动，通过运动感知时序推理进行优化，并采用SAM2作为显式的像素级接触验证器，而非单纯依赖检测置信度。这种候选发现与接触确认的分离机制，使方法能有效应对复杂场景和撞击点附近不稳定的定位问题。在738段擒抱训练视频中，GRAZE对97.4%的片段生成有效输出，其中77.5%的片段FPOC定位误差在±10帧内，82.7%的片段误差在±20帧内。这些结果表明，无需任务特定训练即可在真实训练影像中实现帧级精度的接触起始点定位。
tldr: A training-free pipeline for localizing the first point of contact between a player and a tackle dummy in American football practice videos, using a combination of object detection, motion-aware reasoning, and pixel-level verification.
tldr_zh: 一种无需训练的流程，用于在美式足球训练视频中定位球员与假人首次接触的瞬间，结合了目标检测、运动感知推理和像素级验证。

title: RIFT: A RubrIc Failure Mode Taxonomy and Automated Diagnostics
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used in LLM benchmarks and training pipelines for open-ended, less verifiable tasks. While prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of rubrics using downstream signals such as reinforcement learning outcomes, there remains no principled way to diagnose rubric quality issues from such aggregated or downstream signals alone. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT: RubrIc Failure mode Taxonomy, a taxonomy for systematically characterizing failure modes in rubric composition and design. RIFT consists of eight failure modes organized into three high-level categories: Reliability Failures, Content Validity Failures, and Consequential Validity Failures. RIFT is developed using grounded theory by iteratively annotating rubrics drawn from five diverse benchmarks spanning general instruction following, code generation, creative writing, and expert-level deep research, until no new failure modes are identified. We evaluate the consistency of the taxonomy by measuring agreement among independent human annotators, observing fair agreement overall (87% pairwise agreement and 0.64 average Cohen's kappa). Finally, to support scalable diagnosis, we propose automated rubric quality metrics and show that they align with human failure-mode annotations, achieving up to 0.86 F1.
summary_zh: 基于量规的评估方法广泛用于开放式、可验证性较低任务的大语言模型基准测试与训练流程。已有研究通过强化学习结果等下游信号证明了量规的有效性，但仅凭此类聚合或下游信号仍缺乏诊断量规质量问题的系统性方法。为填补这一空白，我们提出RIFT（量规失效模式分类法）：一种用于系统化描述量规构建与设计缺陷的分类体系。RIFT涵盖八类失效模式，归为三大高层类别：可靠性失效、内容效度失效与结果效度失效。该分类体系基于扎根理论构建，通过迭代标注来自五大跨领域基准（涵盖通用指令遵循、代码生成、创意写作及专家级深度研究）的量规样本，直至不再发现新的失效模式。我们通过测量独立标注者间的一致性评估分类体系的稳定性，观察到整体一致性较高（配对一致率87%，平均科恩卡帕系数0.64）。最后，为支持规模化诊断，我们提出自动化的量规质量评估指标，并证明其与人工失效模式标注结果具有一致性，最高F1值达到0.86。
tldr: The paper introduces RIFT, a taxonomy for diagnosing failure modes in rubrics used for evaluating large language models, along with automated metrics for quality assessment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了RIFT，这是一个用于诊断大型语言模型评估准则中失败模式的分类法，以及用于质量评估的自动化指标。

title: CogBias: Measuring and Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts. While prior work has shown that LLMs exhibit cognitive biases behaviorally, whether these biases correspond to identifiable internal representations and can be mitigated through targeted intervention remains an open question. We define LLM cognitive bias as systematic, reproducible deviations from correct answers in tasks with computable ground-truth baselines, and introduce LLM CogBias, a benchmark organized around four families of cognitive biases: Judgment, Information Processing, Social, and Response. We evaluate three LLMs and find that cognitive biases emerge systematically across all four families, with magnitudes and debiasing responses that are strongly family-dependent: prompt-level debiasing substantially reduces Response biases but backfires for Judgment biases. Using linear probes under a contrastive design, we show that these biases are encoded as linearly separable directions in model activation space. Finally, we apply activation steering to modulate biased behavior, achieving 26--32\% reduction in bias score (fraction of biased responses) while preserving downstream capability on 25 benchmarks (Llama: negligible degradation; Qwen: up to $-$19.0pp for Judgment biases). Despite near-orthogonal bias representations across models (mean cosine similarity 0.01), steering reduces bias at similar rates across architectures ($r(246)$=.621, $p$<.001), suggesting shared functional organization.
summary_zh: 大语言模型正日益被部署在高风险决策场景中。尽管先前的研究已表明大语言模型在行为上表现出认知偏差，但这些偏差是否对应可识别的内部表征，以及能否通过针对性干预进行缓解，仍是待解问题。我们定义大语言模型认知偏差为在可计算真实基准任务中系统性、可复现地偏离正确答案的现象，并构建了LLM CogBias基准测试集，该基准围绕四大认知偏差族组织：判断偏差、信息处理偏差、社会偏差与反应偏差。通过对三个大语言模型的评估，我们发现认知偏差在四大偏差族中均系统性出现，其偏差程度与去偏差干预效果具有显著的族依赖性：提示级去偏差能显著减少反应偏差，但对判断偏差会产生反效果。通过对比设计下的线性探测，我们证明这些偏差在模型激活空间中编码为线性可分离的方向向量。最后，我们应用激活导向技术调节偏差行为，在保留25个下游基准能力的同时实现了26%至32%的偏差分数（偏差响应比例）降低（Llama模型性能退化可忽略；Qwen模型在判断偏差任务上最多下降19.0个百分点）。尽管不同模型间的偏差表征近似正交（平均余弦相似度0.01），激活导向在不同架构中仍能实现相近的偏差降低率（$r(246)$=.621, $p$<.001），这暗示着模型间存在共享的功能组织结构。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark for measuring cognitive biases in LLMs, shows biases are encoded as linearly separable directions in activation space, and uses activation steering to reduce bias scores while preserving general capability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个衡量大语言模型认知偏见的基准，表明偏见在激活空间中可线性分离，并通过激活导向技术在不显著损害通用能力的情况下减少偏见。

title: From Automation to Augmentation: A Framework for Designing Human-Centric Work Environments in Society 5.0
summary: Society 5.0 and Industry 5.0 call for human-centric technology integration, yet the concept lacks an operational definition that can be measured, optimized, or evaluated at the firm level. This paper addresses three gaps. First, existing models of human-AI complementarity treat the augmentation function phi(D) as exogenous -- dependent only on the stock of AI deployed -- ignoring that two firms with identical technology investments achieve radically different augmentation outcomes depending on how the workplace is organized around the human-AI interaction. Second, no multi-dimensional instrument exists linking workplace design choices to augmentation productivity. Third, the Society 5.0 literature proposes human-centricity as a normative aspiration but provides no formal criterion for when it is economically optimal. We make four contributions. (1) We endogenize the augmentation function as phi(D, W), where W is a five-dimensional workplace design vector -- AI interface design, decision authority allocation, task orchestration, learning loop architecture, and psychosocial work environment -- and prove that human-centric design is profit-maximizing when the workforce's augmentable cognitive capital exceeds a critical threshold. (2) We conduct a PRISMA-guided systematic review of 120 papers (screened from 6,096 records) to map the evidence base for each dimension. (3) We provide secondary empirical evidence from Colombia's EDIT manufacturing survey (N=6,799 firms) showing that management practice quality amplifies the return to technology investment (interaction coefficient 0.304, p<0.01). (4) We propose the Workplace Augmentation Design Index (WADI), a 36-item theory-grounded instrument for diagnosing human-centricity at the firm level. Decision authority allocation emerges as the binding constraint for Society 5.0 transitions, and task orchestration as the most under-researched dimension
summary_zh: 社会5.0与工业5.0倡导以人为中心的技术融合，但这一概念缺乏可在企业层面进行测量、优化或评估的操作性定义。本文致力于填补三个研究空白：首先，现有的人机互补模型将增强函数φ(D)视为外生变量——仅依赖于已部署的人工智能存量，却忽略了拥有相同技术投资的两家企业可能因工作场所围绕人机交互的组织方式不同而产生截然不同的增强效果。其次，目前缺乏将工作场所设计选择与增强生产力相连接的多维测量工具。第三，社会5.0文献虽提出以人为中心作为规范性愿景，但未就其经济最优化的实现条件提供正式标准。本研究作出四项贡献：（1）我们将增强函数内生化构建为φ(D, W)，其中W代表包含五个维度的工作场所设计向量——人工智能交互界面设计、决策权分配、任务编排、学习循环架构及心理社会环境，并证明当员工可增强的认知资本超过临界阈值时，以人为本的设计能实现利润最大化。（2）通过PRISMA框架对120篇文献（从6,096条记录中筛选）进行系统性综述，绘制了各维度的证据图谱。（3）基于哥伦比亚EDIT制造业调查（N=6,799家企业）的二手实证数据表明，管理实践质量会放大技术投资回报率（交互系数0.304，p<0.01）。（4）我们提出包含36个条目的工作场所增强设计指数，该理论驱动的测量工具可用于诊断企业层面的人本化程度。研究发现，决策权分配是社会5.0转型的关键制约因素，而任务编排则是当前研究最薄弱的维度。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for designing human-centric work environments in Society 5.0, endogenizing the AI augmentation function and providing a systematic review and index for workplace design, with empirical evidence from a manufacturing survey.
tldr_zh: 本文为设计社会5.0中以人为本的工作环境提出了一个框架，将AI增强功能内生化，并提供了系统性的综述和工作场所设计指数，同时基于制造业调查提供了实证证据。

title: Crashing Waves vs. Rising Tides: Preliminary Findings on AI Automation from Thousands of Worker Evaluations of Labor Market Tasks
summary: We propose that AI automation is a continuum between: (i) crashing waves where AI capabilities surge abruptly over small sets of tasks, and (ii) rising tides where the increase in AI capabilities is more continuous and broad-based. We test for these effects in preliminary evidence from an ongoing evaluation of AI capabilities across over 3,000 broad-based tasks derived from the U.S. Department of Labor O*NET categorization that are text-based and thus LLM-addressable. Based on more than 17,000 evaluations by workers from these jobs, we find little evidence of crashing waves (in contrast to recent work by METR), but substantial evidence that rising tides are the primary form of AI automation. AI performance is high and improving rapidly across a wide range of tasks. We estimate that, in 2024-Q2, AI models successfully complete tasks that take humans approximately 3-4 hours with about a 50% success rate, increasing to about 65% by 2025-Q3. If recent trends in AI capability growth persist, this pace of AI improvement implies that LLMs will be able to complete most text-related tasks with success rates of, on average, 80%-95% by 2029 at a minimally sufficient quality level. Achieving near-perfect success rates at this quality level or comparable success rates at superior quality would require several additional years. These AI capability improvements would impact the economy and labor market as organizations adopt AI, which could have a substantially longer timeline.
summary_zh: 我们提出，人工智能自动化是一个连续统：一端是"冲击浪潮"，即人工智能能力在特定任务集上骤然提升；另一端是"涨潮模式"，即人工智能能力的提升更为持续且广泛。我们通过对美国劳工部O*NET分类体系中3000多项基于文本的可由大语言模型处理的任务进行持续评估，基于来自相关岗位工作者超过17000份评估数据的初步证据进行检验，发现几乎没有证据支持"冲击浪潮"效应（这与METR近期研究结论相反），但有充分证据表明"涨潮模式"是人工智能自动化的主要形式。人工智能在广泛任务中表现优异且提升迅速。我们估算，在2024年第二季度，人工智能模型能以约50%的成功率完成人类需耗时3-4小时的任务，到2025年第三季度该成功率将提升至约65%。若当前人工智能能力增长趋势持续，这种进步速度意味着到2029年，大语言模型将能以最低合格质量标准完成80%-95%的文本相关任务。若要在同等质量水平达到接近完美的成功率，或在更高质量标准下实现相当的成功率，则仍需数年时间。随着企业逐步应用人工智能，这些能力提升将对经济和劳动力市场产生影响，而这一过程可能将经历更长的时间周期。
tldr: This study analyzes AI automation as a continuum between 'crashing waves' (abrupt, task-specific surges) and 'rising tides' (continuous, broad-based improvement), finding strong evidence for the latter in text-based tasks across thousands of labor market categories.
tldr_zh: 本研究将AI自动化描述为'崩溃波浪'（突发性、任务特定激增）和'上涨潮汐'（持续性、广泛性改进）之间的连续体，发现在数千个劳动市场分类的文本任务中，'上涨潮汐'是主要形式。

title: IDEA2: Expert-in-the-loop competency question elicitation for collaborative ontology engineering
summary: Competency question (CQ) elicitation represents a critical but resource-intensive bottleneck in ontology engineering. This foundational phase is often hampered by the communication gap between domain experts, who possess the necessary knowledge, and ontology engineers, who formalise it. This paper introduces IDEA2, a novel, semi-automated workflow that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) within a collaborative, expert-in-the-loop process to address this challenge. The methodology is characterised by a core iterative loop: an initial LLM-based extraction of CQs from requirement documents, a co-creational review and feedback phase by domain experts on an accessible collaborative platform, and an iterative, feedback-driven reformulation of rejected CQs by an LLM until consensus is achieved. To ensure transparency and reproducibility, the entire lifecycle of each CQ is tracked using a provenance model that captures the full lineage of edits, anonymised feedback, and generation parameters. The workflow was validated in 2 real-world scenarios (scientific data, cultural heritage), demonstrating that IDEA2 can accelerate the requirements engineering process, improve the acceptance and relevance of the resulting CQs, and exhibit high usability and effectiveness among domain experts. We release all code and experiments at https://github.com/KE-UniLiv/IDEA2
summary_zh: 能力问题（CQ）的提取在知识工程中是一个至关重要但资源密集的瓶颈环节。这一基础阶段常因领域专家（掌握必要知识）与知识工程师（进行知识形式化）之间的沟通障碍而受阻。本文提出了一种新颖的半自动化工作流——IDEA2，它通过整合大型语言模型于专家参与循环的协作流程中来应对这一挑战。该方法的核心特点是采用迭代循环：首先基于LLM从需求文档中提取初始能力问题；随后领域专家在易用的协作平台上进行共同审阅与反馈；最后LLM根据反馈对未通过审核的能力问题进行迭代式重述直至达成共识。为确保透明度和可重复性，每个能力问题的完整生命周期均通过溯源模型进行追踪，记录其全部编辑历史、匿名反馈及生成参数。该工作流已在两个实际应用场景（科学数据、文化遗产）中进行了验证，结果表明IDEA2能够加速需求工程进程，提高最终能力问题的接受度与相关性，并在领域专家中展现出高可用性和有效性。所有代码与实验已发布于https://github.com/KE-UniLiv/IDEA2。
tldr: Proposes a semi-automated workflow using LLMs to elicit competency questions for collaborative ontology engineering, validated in non-robotics domains.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种半自动化工作流，利用大语言模型在协作式本体工程中引出能力问题，并在非机器人领域进行了验证。

title: The Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework: A Validation Architecture for Simulated Potential Outcomes
summary: The fundamental problem of causal inference - that the counterfactual outcome for any individual is never observed - has shaped the entire methodology of the field. Every existing approach substitutes assumptions for missing data: ignorability, parallel trends, exclusion restrictions. None produces the counterfactual itself. This paper proposes the Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework (DTCF): rather than estimating the counterfactual statistically, we simulate it using a digital twin and subject the simulation to a hierarchical validation regime. We formalize the digital twin simulator as a stochastic mapping within the potential outcomes framework and introduce a hierarchy of twin fidelity assumptions - from marginal fidelity through joint fidelity to structural fidelity - each unlocking a progressively richer class of estimands. The central contribution is threefold. First, a five-level validation architecture converts the unfalsifiable claim that the simulator produces correct counterfactuals into falsifiable tests against observable data. Second, a formal decomposition separates causal quantities into those that are marginally validated (ATE, CATE, QTE - testable through observable-arm comparison) and those that are copula-dependent (the ITE distribution, probability of benefit/harm, variance of treatment effects - permanently reliant on the unobservable within-individual dependence structure). Third, bounding, sensitivity, and uncertainty quantification tools make the copula dependence explicit. The DTCF does not resolve the fundamental problem of causal inference. What it provides is a framework in which marginal causal claims become increasingly testable, joint causal claims become explicitly assumption-indexed, and the gap between the two is formally characterized.
summary_zh: 因果推断的根本问题——任何个体的反事实结果永远无法观测——塑造了该领域的方法论体系。现有方法均以假设填补缺失数据：可忽略性、平行趋势、排除限制。但无一能直接产生反事实本身。本文提出数字孪生反事实框架（DTCF）：不再通过统计方法估计反事实，而是借助数字孪生进行模拟，并使模拟结果接受分层验证机制的检验。我们将数字孪生模拟器形式化为潜在结果框架内的随机映射，并构建了孪生保真度假设的层级结构——从边际保真度、联合保真度到结构保真度，每一层级都能解锁更丰富的估计量类别。本研究的核心贡献体现在三方面：首先，通过五级验证架构，将模拟器产生正确反事实这一不可证伪的主张，转化为可基于观测数据进行证伪的检验；其次，通过形式化分解将因果量区分为边际验证型（如平均处理效应、条件平均处理效应、分位数处理效应——可通过观测组间比较进行检验）和联结函数依赖型（如个体处理效应分布、获益/损害概率、处理效应方差——始终依赖于不可观测的个体内依赖结构）；最后，通过边界分析、敏感性分析和不确定性量化工具显式刻画联结函数依赖关系。数字孪生反事实框架并未解决因果推断的根本问题，而是构建了一个新型方法论框架：在该框架中，边际因果主张的可检验性不断增强，联合因果主张被明确标注其假设依据，而二者之间的理论鸿沟得到了形式化表征。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework for causal inference, which uses simulated digital twins and a hierarchical validation regime to produce and assess counterfactual outcomes, rather than relying on statistical assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的数字孪生反事实框架，用于因果推断。该方法利用模拟的数字孪生和分层验证机制来生成和评估反事实结果，而非依赖于统计假设。

title: Look Twice: Training-Free Evidence Highlighting in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Answering questions about images often requires combining visual understanding with external knowledge. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural framework for this setting, but they often struggle to identify the most relevant visual and textual evidence when answering knowledge-intensive queries. In such scenarios, models must integrate visual cues with retrieved textual evidence that is often noisy or only partially relevant, while also localizing fine-grained visual information in the image. In this work, we introduce Look Twice (LoT), a training-free inference-time framework that improves how pretrained MLLMs utilize multimodal evidence. Specifically, we exploit the model attention patterns to estimate which visual regions and retrieved textual elements are relevant to a query, and then generate the answer conditioned on this highlighted evidence. The selected cues are highlighted through lightweight prompt-level markers that encourage the model to re-attend to the relevant evidence during generation. Experiments across multiple knowledge-based VQA benchmarks show consistent improvements over zero-shot MLLMs. Additional evaluations on vision-centric and hallucination-oriented benchmarks further demonstrate that visual evidence highlighting alone improves model performance in settings without textual context, all without additional training or architectural modifications. Source code will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 在图像相关问题的回答中，通常需要将视觉理解与外部知识相结合。多模态大语言模型为此提供了天然框架，但在处理知识密集型查询时，这些模型往往难以识别最相关的视觉与文本证据。在此类场景下，模型需要整合视觉线索与检索到的文本证据——这些文本证据往往存在噪声或仅部分相关——同时还需对图像中的细粒度视觉信息进行定位。本研究提出一种无需训练的推理时框架“二次观察”，该框架通过改进预训练多模态大语言模型对多模态证据的利用方式，提升其推理能力。具体而言，我们利用模型的注意力模式来估计哪些视觉区域与检索到的文本元素与查询相关，随后基于这些高亮证据生成答案。通过轻量级的提示级标记对选定线索进行高亮处理，促使模型在生成过程中重新关注相关证据。在多个基于知识的视觉问答基准测试中，该框架相比零样本多模态大语言模型实现了持续的性能提升。在面向视觉中心任务和幻觉检测的附加评估中进一步表明，仅通过视觉证据高亮机制即可在无文本上下文的环境中提升模型性能，且无需额外训练或架构调整。源代码将公开发布。
tldr: A training-free inference framework that uses model attention to highlight relevant visual/textual evidence for multimodal question answering, improving performance on knowledge-based VQA tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无需训练、基于注意力的推理框架，通过高亮多模态证据来提升模型在知识密集型视觉问答任务中的表现。

title: Sven: Singular Value Descent as a Computationally Efficient Natural Gradient Method
summary: We introduce Sven (Singular Value dEsceNt), a new optimization algorithm for neural networks that exploits the natural decomposition of loss functions into a sum over individual data points, rather than reducing the full loss to a single scalar before computing a parameter update. Sven treats each data point's residual as a separate condition to be satisfied simultaneously, using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of the loss Jacobian to find the minimum-norm parameter update that best satisfies all conditions at once. In practice, this pseudoinverse is approximated via a truncated singular value decomposition, retaining only the $k$ most significant directions and incurring a computational overhead of only a factor of $k$ relative to stochastic gradient descent. This is in comparison to traditional natural gradient methods, which scale as the square of the number of parameters. We show that Sven can be understood as a natural gradient method generalized to the over-parametrized regime, recovering natural gradient descent in the under-parametrized limit. On regression tasks, Sven significantly outperforms standard first-order methods including Adam, converging faster and to a lower final loss, while remaining competitive with LBFGS at a fraction of the wall-time cost. We discuss the primary challenge to scaling, namely memory overhead, and propose mitigation strategies. Beyond standard machine learning benchmarks, we anticipate that Sven will find natural application in scientific computing settings where custom loss functions decompose into several conditions.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种名为Sven（奇异值下降法）的神经网络优化新算法，该算法利用损失函数自然分解为各数据点损失之和的特性，而非在计算参数更新前将整体损失归约为单一标量。Sven将每个数据点的残差视为需同时满足的独立条件，通过损失函数雅可比矩阵的摩尔-彭罗斯伪逆，寻找能最佳同时满足所有条件的最小范数参数更新。实际计算中，该伪逆通过截断奇异值分解进行近似，仅保留前$k$个最重要的方向，其计算开销相对于随机梯度下降仅增加$k$倍。相比之下，传统自然梯度法的计算复杂度随参数数量呈平方级增长。我们证明Sven可被理解为一种推广至过参数化机制的自然梯度法，并在欠参数化极限条件下退化为自然梯度下降。在回归任务中，Sven显著优于包括Adam在内的标准一阶优化方法，不仅收敛速度更快且最终损失值更低，同时以远少于LBFGS的挂钟时间成本达到与之相当的性能。我们讨论了算法扩展的主要挑战——内存开销，并提出相应的缓解策略。除标准机器学习基准测试外，我们预计Sven将在科学计算领域获得天然应用，特别是针对那些可分解为多个条件的定制损失函数场景。
tldr: Sven is a new optimization algorithm for neural networks that treats each data point's residual as a separate condition, using a truncated SVD of the loss Jacobian to approximate the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse for efficient updates, outperforming first-order methods like Adam on regression tasks.
tldr_zh: Sven是一种新的神经网络优化算法，它将每个数据点的残差视为独立条件，使用损失函数Jacobian矩阵的截断SVD来近似Moore-Penrose伪逆以实现高效更新，在回归任务上优于Adam等一阶方法。

title: Large-scale Codec Avatars: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Large-scale Avatar Pretraining
summary: High-quality 3D avatar modeling faces a critical trade-off between fidelity and generalization. On the one hand, multi-view studio data enables high-fidelity modeling of humans with precise control over expressions and poses, but it struggles to generalize to real-world data due to limited scale and the domain gap between the studio environment and the real world. On the other hand, recent large-scale avatar models trained on millions of in-the-wild samples show promise for generalization across a wide range of identities, yet the resulting avatars are often of low-quality due to inherent 3D ambiguities. To address this, we present Large-Scale Codec Avatars (LCA), a high-fidelity, full-body 3D avatar model that generalizes to world-scale populations in a feedforward manner, enabling efficient inference. Inspired by the success of large language models and vision foundation models, we present, for the first time, a pre/post-training paradigm for 3D avatar modeling at scale: we pretrain on 1M in-the-wild videos to learn broad priors over appearance and geometry, then post-train on high-quality curated data to enhance expressivity and fidelity. LCA generalizes across hair styles, clothing, and demographics while providing precise, fine-grained facial expressions and finger-level articulation control, with strong identity preservation. Notably, we observe emergent generalization to relightability and loose garment support to unconstrained inputs, and zero-shot robustness to stylized imagery, despite the absence of direct supervision.
summary_zh: 高质量三维虚拟化身建模面临着保真度与泛化性之间的关键权衡。一方面，多视角影棚数据能够实现对人类表情和姿态精确控制的高保真建模，但由于数据规模有限以及影棚环境与现实世界之间的领域差异，其难以泛化至真实世界数据。另一方面，近期基于数百万野外样本训练的大规模虚拟化身模型展现出跨广泛身份泛化的潜力，但由于三维固有的模糊性，生成的形象往往质量较低。为此，我们提出大规模编解码虚拟化身（LCA），这是一种高保真、全身三维虚拟化身模型，能够以前馈方式泛化至世界规模人群，实现高效推理。受大型语言模型和视觉基础模型成功的启发，我们首次提出了大规模三维虚拟化身建模的预训练/后训练范式：首先在百万级野外视频上进行预训练以学习外观与几何的广泛先验知识，随后在高质量精选数据上进行后训练以增强表现力与保真度。LCA能够泛化处理不同发型、服饰和人口特征，同时提供精细的面部表情与手指级关节控制，并保持强烈的身份一致性。值得注意的是，尽管缺乏直接监督，我们观察到模型对重光照适应性和宽松服装支持的无约束输入具有涌现泛化能力，并对风格化图像具备零样本鲁棒性。
tldr: A method for creating high-fidelity 3D human avatars by pretraining on in-the-wild videos and then fine-tuning on high-quality data, enabling generalization across diverse people with precise expression control.
tldr_zh: 提出一种通过在海量野外视频上预训练，再用高质量数据微调来创建高保真3D人体化身的方法，能够泛化到不同人物，并实现精细的表情控制。

title: AdamFlow: Adam-based Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Surface Registration in Medical Imaging
summary: Surface registration plays an important role for anatomical shape analysis in medical imaging. Existing surface registration methods often face a trade-off between efficiency and robustness. Local point matching methods are computationally efficient, but vulnerable to noise and initialisation. Methods designed for global point set alignment tend to incur a high computational cost. To address the challenge, here we present a fast surface registration method, which formulates surface meshes as probability measures and surface registration as a distributional optimisation problem. The discrepancy between two meshes is measured using an efficient sliced Wasserstein distance with log-linear computational complexity. We propose a novel optimisation method, AdamFlow, which generalises the well-known Adam optimisation method from the Euclidean space to the probability space for minimising the sliced Wasserstein distance. We theoretically analyse the asymptotic convergence of AdamFlow and empirically demonstrate its superior performance in both affine and non-rigid surface registration across various anatomical structures.
summary_zh: 表面配准在医学影像的解剖形状分析中扮演着重要角色。现有的表面配准方法往往需要在效率和鲁棒性之间进行权衡：局部点匹配方法计算效率高，但易受噪声和初始化的影响；而为全局点集对齐设计的方法往往会产生较高的计算成本。为解决这一挑战，本文提出一种快速表面配准方法，将表面网格表示为概率测度，并将表面配准转化为分布优化问题。两个网格之间的差异通过计算效率高的切片瓦瑟斯坦距离进行度量，该距离具有对数线性的计算复杂度。我们提出一种新型优化方法——AdamFlow，将著名的Adam优化方法从欧几里得空间推广到概率空间，以最小化切片瓦瑟斯坦距离。我们从理论上分析了AdamFlow的渐近收敛性，并通过实验验证了该方法在不同解剖结构的仿射和非刚性表面配准中均具有优越性能。
tldr: Presents AdamFlow, a fast surface registration method for medical imaging that formulates registration as a distributional optimization problem using a sliced Wasserstein distance and a novel optimizer generalizing Adam to the probability space.
tldr_zh: 提出AdamFlow，一种用于医学成像的快速表面配准方法，将配准表述为使用切片Wasserstein距离和一种将Adam优化器推广到概率空间的新颖优化器的分布优化问题。

title: Reflection Generation for Composite Image Using Diffusion Model
summary: Image composition involves inserting a foreground object into the background while synthesizing environment-consistent effects such as shadows and reflections. Although shadow generation has been extensively studied, reflection generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on reflection generation. We inject the prior information of reflection placement and reflection appearance into foundation diffusion model. We also divide reflections into two types and adopt type-aware model design. To support training, we construct the first large-scale object reflection dataset DEROBA. Experiments demonstrate that our method generates reflections that are physically coherent and visually realistic, establishing a new benchmark for reflection generation.
summary_zh: 图像合成涉及将前景对象插入背景中，同时生成环境一致的效果，如阴影和反射。尽管阴影生成已被广泛研究，反射生成在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。本文聚焦于反射生成。我们将反射位置与反射外观的先验信息注入基础扩散模型，并将反射分为两种类型，采用类型感知的模型设计。为支持训练，我们构建了首个大规模物体反射数据集DEROBA。实验表明，该方法能生成物理一致且视觉真实的反射效果，为反射生成建立了新的基准。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating realistic reflections in composite images using a diffusion model, creating a new dataset and benchmark for reflection generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用扩散模型为合成图像生成真实反射的方法，创建了首个大型物体反射数据集，并设立了新的反射生成基准。

title: DenOiS: Dual-Domain Denoising of Observation and Solution in Ultrasound Image Reconstruction
summary: Medical imaging aims to recover underlying tissue properties, using inexact (simplified/linearized) imaging models and often from inaccurate and incomplete measurements. Analytical reconstruction methods rely on hand-crafted regularization, sensitive to noise assumptions and parameter tuning. Among deep learning alternatives, plug-and-play (PnP) approaches learn regularization while incorporating imaging physics during inference, outperforming purely data-driven methods. The performance of all these approaches, however, still strongly depends on measurement quality and imaging model accuracy. In this work, we propose DenOiS, a framework that denoises both input observations and resulting solution in their respective domains. It consists of an observation refinement strategy that corrects degraded measurements while compensating for imaging model simplifications, and a diffusion-based PnP reconstruction approach that remains robust under missing measurements. DenOiS enables generalization to real data from training only in simulations, resulting in high-fidelity image reconstruction with noisy observations and inexact imaging models. We demonstrate this for speed-of-sound imaging as a challenging setting of quantitative ultrasound image reconstruction.
summary_zh: 医学成像旨在利用不精确（简化/线性化）的成像模型，从通常不准确且不完备的测量数据中恢复潜在的组织特性。解析重建方法依赖于手工设计的正则化，对噪声假设和参数调整较为敏感。在深度学习方法中，即插即用（PnP）方法通过学习正则化，并在推理过程中融入成像物理模型，其性能优于纯数据驱动的方法。然而，所有这些方法的性能仍强烈依赖于测量质量和成像模型的准确性。本文提出DenOiS框架，该框架分别在输入观测域和求解域对数据进行去噪处理。它包含一种观测优化策略，用于校正退化测量数据并补偿成像模型的简化，以及一种基于扩散的PnP重建方法，该方法在缺失测量条件下仍保持鲁棒性。DenOiS能够仅通过模拟训练实现对真实数据的泛化，从而在噪声观测和不精确成像模型条件下实现高保真图像重建。我们以声速成像这一定量超声图像重建的挑战性场景为例，验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper proposes DenOiS, a dual-domain denoising framework for reconstructing high-fidelity ultrasound images from noisy, incomplete data using an observation refinement strategy and a diffusion-based plug-and-play approach.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出DenOiS，一个用于超声图像重建的双域去噪框架。它通过观察精炼策略和基于扩散的即插即用方法，从噪声、不完整的数据中重建高保真图像。

title: Center-Aware Detection with Swin-based Co-DETR Framework for Cervical Cytology
summary: Automated analysis of Pap smear images is critical for cervical cancer screening but remains challenging due to dense cell distribution and complex morphology. In this paper, we present our winning solution for the RIVA Cervical Cytology Challenge, achieving 1st place in Track B and 2nd place in Track A. Our approach leverages a powerful baseline, integrating the Co-DINO framework with a Swin-Large backbone for robust multi-scale feature extraction. To address the dataset's unique fixed-size bounding box annotations, we formulate the detection task as a center-point prediction problem. Tailoring our approach to this formulation, we introduce a center-preserving data augmentation strategy and an analytical geometric box optimization to effectively absorb localization jitter. Finally, we apply track-specific loss tuning to adapt the loss weights for each task. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted optimizations improve detection performance, providing an effective pipeline for cytology image analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YanKong0408/Center-DETR.
summary_zh: 巴氏涂片图像的自动化分析对宫颈癌筛查至关重要，但由于细胞分布密集且形态复杂，这一问题仍面临挑战。本文介绍了我们在RIVA宫颈细胞学挑战赛中的优胜方案，该方案在赛道B中获得第一名，在赛道A中获得第二名。我们的方法基于一个强大的基准模型，通过集成Co-DINO框架与Swin-Large主干网络实现了鲁棒的多尺度特征提取。针对该数据集独特的固定尺寸边界框标注，我们将检测任务重新定义为心点预测问题。在此基础上，我们专门设计了保持中心位置的数据增强策略，并引入基于几何分析的边框优化以有效吸收定位抖动。最后，我们根据具体赛道任务对损失权重进行针对性调优。实验表明，我们的定向优化策略显著提升了检测性能，为细胞学图像分析提供了一套高效流程。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/YanKong0408/Center-DETR。
tldr: This paper presents a center-aware object detection method using a Swin Transformer and Co-DETR framework, specifically designed for medical cytology image analysis of cervical cells to aid in cancer screening.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Swin Transformer和Co-DETR框架的中心感知目标检测方法，专门用于宫颈细胞医学细胞学图像分析，以辅助癌症筛查。

title: FlowSlider: Training-Free Continuous Image Editing via Fidelity-Steering Decomposition
summary: Continuous image editing aims to provide slider-style control of edit strength while preserving source-image fidelity and maintaining a consistent edit direction. Existing learning-based slider methods typically rely on auxiliary modules trained with synthetic or proxy supervision. This introduces additional training overhead and couples slider behavior to the training distribution, which can reduce reliability under distribution shifts in edits or domains. We propose \textit{FlowSlider}, a training-free method for continuous editing in Rectified Flow that requires no post-training. \textit{FlowSlider} decomposes FlowEdit's update into (i) a fidelity term, which acts as a source-conditioned stabilizer that preserves identity and structure, and (ii) a steering term that drives semantic transition toward the target edit. Geometric analysis and empirical measurements show that these terms are approximately orthogonal, enabling stable strength control by scaling only the steering term while keeping the fidelity term unchanged. As a result, \textit{FlowSlider} provides smooth and reliable control without post-training, improving continuous editing quality across diverse tasks.
summary_zh: 连续图像编辑旨在提供滑块式编辑强度控制，同时保持源图像保真度与编辑方向的一致性。现有基于学习的滑块方法通常依赖通过合成数据或代理监督训练的辅助模块，这会引入额外训练开销，并使滑块行为与训练数据分布耦合，导致在编辑或领域分布变化时可靠性降低。我们提出\textit{FlowSlider}——一种无需训练后处理的Rectified Flow连续编辑方法，该方法完全无需训练。\textit{FlowSlider}将FlowEdit的更新分解为：（i）作为源条件稳定器的保真项，用于保持身份与结构特征；（ii）驱动语义向目标编辑过渡的转向项。几何分析与实证测量表明这两项近似正交，通过仅缩放转向项并保持保真项不变，可实现稳定的强度控制。因此，\textit{FlowSlider}无需训练后处理即可提供平滑可靠的控制，在多类任务中提升了连续编辑质量。
tldr: A training-free method for continuous image editing via a fidelity-steering decomposition in Rectified Flow, enabling smooth slider-style control of edit strength without post-training.
tldr_zh: 一种用于连续图像编辑的无训练方法，通过保真度-转向分解实现平滑的滑块式强度控制，无需后训练。

title: True to Tone? Quantifying Skin Tone Fidelity and Bias in Photographic-to-Virtual Human Pipelines
summary: Accurate reproduction of facial skin tone is essential for realism, identity preservation, and fairness in Virtual Human (VH) rendering. However, most accessible avatar creation pipelines rely on photographic inputs that lack colorimetric calibration, which can introduce inconsistencies and bias. We propose a fully automatic and scalable methodology to systematically evaluate skin tone fidelity across the VH generation pipeline. Our approach defines a full workflow that integrates skin color and illumination extraction, texture recolorization, real-time rendering, and quantitative color analysis. Using facial images from the Chicago Face Database (CFD), we compare skin tone extraction strategies based on cheek-region sampling, following the literature, and multidimensional masking derived from full-face analysis. Additionally, we test both strategies with lighting isolation, using the pre-trained TRUST framework, employed without any training or optimization within our pipeline. Extracted skin tones are applied to MetaHuman textures and rendered under multiple lighting configurations. Skin tone consistency is evaluated objectively in the CIELAB color space using the $ΔE$ metric and the Individual Typology Angle (ITA). The proposed methodology operates without manual intervention and, with the exception of pre-trained illumination compensation modules, the pipeline does not include learning or training stages, enabling low computational cost and large-scale evaluation. Using this framework, we generate and analyze approximately 19,848 rendered instances. Our results show phenotype-dependent behavior of extraction strategies and consistently higher colorimetric errors for darker skin tones.
summary_zh: 在虚拟人（VH）渲染中，准确复现面部肤色对于真实感、身份保持和公平性至关重要。然而，目前大多数可访问的虚拟化身创建流程依赖于缺乏色彩校准的摄影输入，这可能导致色彩不一致与偏差。本文提出了一种全自动、可扩展的方法，用于系统评估VH生成流程中的肤色保真度。该方法定义了一个完整的工作流，集成了肤色与光照提取、纹理重着色、实时渲染以及定量色彩分析。基于芝加哥面部数据库（CFD）的面部图像，我们比较了两种肤色提取策略：遵循文献的面颊区域采样方法，以及基于全脸分析的多维掩膜技术。此外，我们结合光照隔离测试了两种策略，使用了预训练的TRUST框架，该框架在我们的流程中未经任何训练或优化。提取的肤色被应用于MetaHuman纹理，并在多种光照配置下进行渲染。肤色一致性在CIELAB色彩空间中使用$ΔE$指标和个体类型角度（ITA）进行客观评估。所提出的方法无需人工干预，且除预训练的光照补偿模块外，流程中不包含学习或训练阶段，可实现低计算成本和大规模评估。借助此框架，我们生成并分析了约19,848个渲染实例。结果表明，提取策略的表现与面部表型相关，且深色肤色的色度误差持续偏高。
tldr: This paper proposes a fully automatic methodology to quantify skin tone fidelity and bias in virtual human avatar creation pipelines, focusing on colorimetric analysis and evaluation of rendering consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种全自动方法，用于量化虚拟人创建流程中的肤色保真度与偏差，侧重于色彩分析和渲染一致性的评估。

title: Jagle: Building a Large-Scale Japanese Multimodal Post-Training Dataset for Vision-Language Models
summary: Developing vision-language models (VLMs) that generalize across diverse tasks requires large-scale training datasets with diverse content. In English, such datasets are typically constructed by aggregating and curating numerous existing visual question answering (VQA) resources. However, this strategy does not readily extend to other languages, where VQA datasets remain limited in both scale and domain coverage, posing a major obstacle to building high-quality multilingual and non-English VLMs. In this work, we introduce Jagle, the largest Japanese multimodal post-training dataset to date, comprising approximately 9.2 million instances across diverse tasks. Rather than relying on existing VQA datasets, we collect heterogeneous source data, including images, image-text pairs, and PDF documents, and generate VQA pairs through multiple strategies such as VLM-based QA generation, translation, and text rendering. Experiments demonstrate that a 2.2B model trained with Jagle achieves strong performance on Japanese tasks, surpassing InternVL3.5-2B in average score across ten Japanese evaluation tasks and approaching within five points of Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct. Furthermore, combining Jagle with FineVision does not degrade English performance; instead, it improves English performance compared to training with FineVision alone. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release the dataset, trained models, and code.
summary_zh: 开发能够泛化于多样化任务的视觉语言模型（VLMs）需要大规模且内容丰富的训练数据集。在英语领域，这类数据集通常通过聚合和整理大量现有视觉问答（VQA）资源来构建。然而，这一策略难以直接扩展到其他语言，因为其他语言的VQA数据集在规模和领域覆盖上仍较为有限，这成为构建高质量多语言及非英语VLMs的主要障碍。本研究介绍了Jagle，迄今为止规模最大的日语多模态后训练数据集，包含约920万个覆盖多样化任务的实例。我们不依赖现有VQA数据集，而是收集了图像、图文对及PDF文档等异构源数据，并通过基于VLM的问答生成、翻译和文本渲染等多种策略生成VQA对。实验表明，使用Jagle训练的22亿参数模型在日语任务上表现优异，在十项日语评测任务中平均得分超越InternVL3.5-2B，并接近Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct模型五个百分点以内。此外，将Jagle与FineVision结合使用不会降低英语性能，反而较仅使用FineVision训练时提升了英语表现。为促进研究的可复现性和未来探索，我们公开了数据集、训练模型及代码。
tldr: This paper introduces Jagle, a large-scale Japanese multimodal post-training dataset for vision-language models, created by generating VQA pairs from heterogeneous sources rather than relying on existing datasets. It demonstrates strong performance on Japanese benchmarks without degrading English performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Jagle，一个用于视觉语言模型的大规模日语多模态后训练数据集，通过从异构来源生成VQA对而非依赖现有数据集创建。它在日语基准测试上表现出色，且不降低英语性能。

title: Decouple and Rectify: Semantics-Preserving Structural Enhancement for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation in the remote sensing (RS) field requires both language-aligned recognition and fine-grained spatial delineation. Although CLIP offers robust semantic generalization, its global-aligned visual representations inherently struggle to capture structural details. Recent methods attempt to compensate for this by introducing RS-pretrained DINO features. However, these methods treat CLIP representations as a monolithic semantic space and cannot localize where structural enhancement is required, failing to effectively delineate boundaries while risking the disruption of CLIP's semantic integrity. To address this limitation, we propose DR-Seg, a novel decouple-and-rectify framework in this paper. Our method is motivated by the key observation that CLIP feature channels exhibit distinct functional heterogeneity rather than forming a uniform semantic space. Building on this insight, DR-Seg decouples CLIP features into semantics-dominated and structure-dominated subspaces, enabling targeted structural enhancement by DINO without distorting language-aligned semantics. Subsequently, a prior-driven graph rectification module injects high-fidelity structural priors under DINO guidance to form a refined branch, while an uncertainty-guided adaptive fusion module dynamically integrates this refined branch with the original CLIP branch for final prediction. Comprehensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that DR-Seg establishes a new state-of-the-art.
summary_zh: 遥感领域的开放词汇语义分割既需要语言对齐的识别能力，也要求细粒度的空间划分能力。尽管CLIP模型具备强大的语义泛化能力，但其全局对齐的视觉表征天生难以捕捉结构细节。近期研究尝试通过引入遥感预训练的DINO特征来弥补这一缺陷，但这些方法将CLIP表征视为单一语义空间，无法定位需要结构增强的区域，在破坏CLIP语义完整性的同时未能有效划定边界。为突破此局限，本文提出新型解耦校正框架DR-Seg。我们的研究基于关键发现：CLIP特征通道表现出显著的功能异质性，而非构成均匀语义空间。基于此洞察，DR-Seg将CLIP特征解耦为语义主导与结构主导的子空间，使得DINO能够实施针对性结构增强而不扭曲语言对齐的语义。随后，先验驱动的图校正模块在DINO引导下注入高保真结构先验以构建优化分支，而不确定性引导的自适应融合模块则动态整合该优化分支与原始CLIP分支以生成最终预测。在八个基准数据集上的综合实验表明，DR-Seg实现了全新的最优性能。
tldr: Proposes DR-Seg, a framework for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation in remote sensing by decoupling CLIP features into semantics and structure subspaces, enhancing structure with DINO features without disrupting semantic alignment.
tldr_zh: 提出DR-Seg框架，用于遥感领域的开放词汇语义分割，通过将CLIP特征解耦为语义和结构子空间，利用DINO特征增强结构而不破坏语义对齐。

title: Resonance4D: Frequency-Domain Motion Supervision for Preset-Free Physical Parameter Learning in 4D Dynamic Physical Scene Simulation
summary: Physics-driven 4D dynamic simulation from static 3D scenes remains constrained by an overlooked contradiction: reliable motion supervision often relies on online video diffusion or optical-flow pipelines whose computational cost exceeds that of the simulator itself. Existing methods further simplify inverse physical modeling by optimizing only partial material parameters, limiting realism in scenes with complex materials and dynamics. We present Resonance4D, a physics-driven 4D dynamic simulation framework that couples 3D Gaussian Splatting with the Material Point Method through lightweight yet physically expressive supervision. Our key insight is that dynamic consistency can be enforced without dense temporal generation by jointly constraining motion in complementary domains. To this end, we introduce Dual-domain Motion Supervision (DMS), which combines spatial structural consistency for local deformation with frequency-domain spectral consistency for oscillatory and global dynamic patterns, substantially reducing training cost and memory overhead while preserving physically meaningful motion cues. To enable stable full-parameter physical recovery, we further combine zero-shot text-prompted segmentation with simulation-guided initialization to automatically decompose Gaussians into object-part-level regions and support joint optimization of full material parameters. Experiments on both synthetic and real scenes show that Resonance4D achieves strong physical fidelity and motion consistency while reducing peak GPU memory from over 35\,GB to around 20\,GB, enabling high-fidelity physics-driven 4D simulation on a single consumer-grade GPU.
summary_zh: 基于静态3D场景的物理驱动4D动态模拟始终受限于一个被忽视的矛盾：可靠的运动监督往往依赖在线视频扩散或光流流程，其计算成本甚至超过模拟器本身。现有方法通过仅优化部分材料参数来简化逆向物理建模，这限制了复杂材料与动态场景的真实感。我们提出Resonance4D——一个通过轻量级且物理表达充分的监督机制，将3D高斯点云与质点法耦合的物理驱动4D动态模拟框架。我们的核心观点是：通过在互补域中联合约束运动，无需密集时序生成即可实现动态一致性。为此，我们提出了双域运动监督（DMS），该方法将局部形变的空间结构一致性与振荡/全局动态模式的频域谱一致性相结合，在保留物理意义运动线索的同时，显著降低了训练成本与内存开销。为实现稳定的全参数物理重建，我们进一步结合零样本文本提示分割与模拟引导初始化，将高斯点云自动分解为物体部件级区域，并支持全材料参数的联合优化。在合成与真实场景上的实验表明，Resonance4D在保持强物理保真度与运动一致性的同时，将峰值GPU内存从超过35GB降至约20GB，使得在单张消费级GPU上实现高保真物理驱动4D模拟成为可能。
tldr: Resonance4D is a framework for physics-driven 4D dynamic scene simulation from 3D static scenes, using frequency-domain motion supervision to efficiently learn full physical parameters for realistic material and motion.
tldr_zh: Resonance4D是一个用于从3D静态场景进行物理驱动的4D动态场景模拟的框架，它利用频域运动监督来高效地学习完整的物理参数，以实现逼真的材料和运动效果。

title: SDesc3D: Towards Layout-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from Short Descriptions
summary: 3D indoor scene generation conditioned on short textual descriptions provides a promising avenue for interactive 3D environment construction without the need for labor-intensive layout specification. Despite recent progress in text-conditioned 3D scene generation, existing works suffer from poor physical plausibility and insufficient detail richness in such semantic condensation cases, largely due to their reliance on explicit semantic cues about compositional objects and their spatial relationships. This limitation highlights the need for enhanced 3D reasoning capabilities, particularly in terms of prior integration and spatial anchoring.Motivated by this, we propose SDesc3D, a short-text conditioned 3D indoor scene generation framework, that leverages multi-view structural priors and regional functionality implications to enable 3D layout reasoning under sparse textual guidance.Specifically, we introduce a Multi-view scene prior augmentation that enriches underspecified textual inputs with aggregated multi-view structural knowledge, shifting from inaccessible semantic relation cues to multi-view relational prior aggregation. Building on this, we design a Functionality-aware layout grounding, employing regional functionality grounding for implicit spatial anchors and conducting hierarchical layout reasoning to enhance scene organization and semantic plausibility.Furthermore, an Iterative reflection-rectification scheme is employed for progressive structural plausibility refinement via self-rectification.Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing approaches on short-text conditioned 3D indoor scene generation.Code will be publicly available.
summary_zh: 基于简短文本描述的三维室内场景生成技术，为无需人工密集布局标注的交互式三维环境构建提供了有前景的解决路径。尽管当前文本条件三维场景生成领域已取得一定进展，但现有方法在语义高度浓缩的短文本条件下仍存在物理合理性不足与细节丰富度欠缺的问题，这主要源于其对显式物体组合语义及空间关系线索的过度依赖。这一局限性凸显了增强三维推理能力的必要性，尤其在先验知识融合与空间锚定方面。为此，我们提出SDesc3D——一个基于短文本条件的三维室内场景生成框架，通过融合多视角结构先验与区域功能语义，实现稀疏文本引导下的三维布局推理。具体而言，我们设计了多视角场景先验增强模块，通过聚合多视角结构知识来丰富文本输入的隐含信息，将依赖不可见的语义关系线索转变为多视角关系先验的集成机制。在此基础上，我们提出功能感知的布局定位方法，利用区域功能语义建立隐式空间锚点，并通过分层布局推理增强场景组织的语义合理性。此外，框架采用迭代式反思-修正机制，通过自校正过程逐步优化场景结构的合理性。大量实验表明，本方法在短文本条件三维室内场景生成任务上优于现有技术。代码将公开提供。
tldr: SDesc3D is a framework for generating 3D indoor scenes from short textual descriptions, focusing on improving physical plausibility and detail by leveraging multi-view structural priors and functionality-aware layout reasoning.
tldr_zh: SDesc3D 是一个用于从简短文本描述生成 3D 室内场景的框架，通过利用多视图结构先验和功能感知的布局推理，重点提升物理合理性和细节丰富度。

title: A Self supervised learning framework for imbalanced medical imaging datasets
summary: Two problems often plague medical imaging analysis: 1) Non-availability of large quantities of labeled training data, and 2) Dealing with imbalanced data, i.e., abundant data are available for frequent classes, whereas data are highly limited for the rare class. Self supervised learning (SSL) methods have been proposed to deal with the first problem to a certain extent, but the issue of investigating the robustness of SSL to imbalanced data has rarely been addressed in the domain of medical image classification. In this work, we make the following contributions: 1) The MIMV method proposed by us in an earlier work is extended with a new augmentation strategy to construct asymmetric multi-image, multi-view (AMIMV) pairs to address both data scarcity and dataset imbalance in medical image classification. 2) We carry out a data analysis to evaluate the robustness of AMIMV under varying degrees of class imbalance in medical imaging . 3) We evaluate eight representative SSL methods in 11 medical imaging datasets (MedMNIST) under long-tailed distributions and limited supervision. Our experimental results on the MedMNIST dataset show an improvement of 4.25% on retinaMNIST, 1.88% on tissueMNIST, and 3.1% on DermaMNIST.
summary_zh: 医学影像分析领域常面临两大难题：一是缺乏大量带标注的训练数据，二是数据分布不平衡问题，即常见类别数据充裕而罕见类别数据极度匮乏。自监督学习方法在一定程度上被提出用于应对第一个问题，但在医学影像分类领域中，关于自监督学习方法对不平衡数据鲁棒性的研究却鲜有涉及。本研究作出以下贡献：1）基于前期工作中提出的MIMV方法，我们扩展了新的数据增强策略，构建非对称多图像多视角对，以同步应对医学影像分类中的数据稀缺与数据集不平衡问题；2）通过数据实验分析评估AMIMV方法在不同程度类别不平衡条件下的鲁棒性；3）我们在长尾分布和有限监督条件下，于11个医学影像数据集上评估了八种代表性自监督学习方法。在MedMNIST数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在retinaMNIST上提升4.25%，在tissueMNIST上提升1.88%，在DermaMNIST上提升3.1%。
tldr: This paper proposes a self-supervised learning method with a new data augmentation strategy to address data scarcity and class imbalance in medical image classification, evaluating it on 11 medical imaging datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有新数据增强策略的自监督学习方法，用于解决医学图像分类中的数据稀缺和类别不平衡问题，并在11个医学影像数据集上进行了评估。

title: Light-ResKAN: A Parameter-Sharing Lightweight KAN with Gram Polynomials for Efficient SAR Image Recognition
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image recognition is vital for disaster monitoring, military reconnaissance, and ocean observation. However, large SAR image sizes hinder deep learning deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, and existing lightweight models struggle to balance high-precision feature extraction with low computational requirements. The emerging Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) enhances fitting by replacing fixed activations with learnable ones, reducing parameters and computation. Inspired by KAN, we propose Light-ResKAN to achieve a better balance between precision and efficiency. First, Light-ResKAN modifies ResNet by replacing convolutions with KAN convolutions, enabling adaptive feature extraction for SAR images. Second, we use Gram Polynomials as activations, which are well-suited for SAR data to capture complex non-linear relationships. Third, we employ a parameter-sharing strategy: each kernel shares parameters per channel, preserving unique features while reducing parameters and FLOPs. Our model achieves 99.09%, 93.01%, and 97.26% accuracy on MSTAR, FUSAR-Ship, and SAR-ACD datasets, respectively. Experiments on MSTAR resized to $1024 \times 1024$ show that compared to VGG16, our model reduces FLOPs by $82.90 \times$ and parameters by $163.78 \times$. This work establishes an efficient solution for edge SAR image recognition.
summary_zh: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像识别在灾害监测、军事侦察与海洋观测中具有重要作用。然而，SAR图像尺寸庞大，制约了其在资源受限的边缘设备上部署深度学习模型；现有轻量级模型难以兼顾高精度特征提取与低计算需求。新兴的科尔莫戈罗夫-阿诺德网络（KAN）通过将固定激活函数替换为可学习激活函数，在增强拟合能力的同时减少了参数量和计算量。受此启发，我们提出Light-ResKAN模型，以在精度与效率间实现更优平衡。首先，Light-ResKAN对ResNet进行改进，将传统卷积替换为KAN卷积，使模型能自适应提取SAR图像特征；其次，采用格拉姆多项式作为激活函数，其特性更适合SAR数据中复杂非线性关系的建模；第三，引入参数共享策略：每个卷积核在通道维度共享参数，在降低参数量与浮点运算量的同时保留特征独特性。实验表明，在MSTAR、FUSAR-Ship和SAR-ACD数据集上，模型分别达到99.09%、93.01%和97.26%的准确率。在尺寸调整至$1024\times 1024$的MSTAR数据上，与VGG16相比，本模型将浮点运算量降低$82.90$倍、参数量减少$163.78$倍。该研究为边缘端SAR图像识别提供了一种高效解决方案。
tldr: The paper proposes a lightweight neural network architecture for SAR image recognition using KANs and Gram Polynomials to reduce parameters and computational costs for edge deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于SAR图像识别的轻量级神经网络架构，利用KANs和Gram多项式来减少参数和计算成本，以实现在边缘设备上的部署。

title: FTPFusion: Frequency-Aware Infrared and Visible Video Fusion with Temporal Perturbation
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion plays a critical role in intelligent surveillance and low-light monitoring. However, maintaining temporal stability while preserving spatial detail remains a fundamental challenge. Existing methods either focus on frame-wise enhancement with limited temporal modeling or rely on heavy spatio-temporal aggregation that often sacrifices high-frequency details. In this paper, we propose FTPFusion, a frequency-aware infrared and visible video fusion method based on temporal perturbation and sparse cross-modal interaction. Specifically, FTPFusion decomposes the feature representations into high-frequency and low-frequency components for collaborative modeling. The high-frequency branch performs sparse cross-modal spatio-temporal interaction to capture motion-related context and complementary details. The low-frequency branch introduces a temporal perturbation strategy to enhance robustness against complex video variations, such as flickering, jitter, and local misalignment. Furthermore, we design an offset-aware temporal consistency constraint to explicitly stabilize cross-frame representations under temporal disturbances. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FTPFusion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple metrics in both spatial fidelity and temporal consistency. The source code will be available at https://github.com/ixilai/FTPFusion.
summary_zh: 红外与可见光视频融合在智能监控和低照度监测中发挥着关键作用。然而，在保持空间细节的同时维持时序稳定性仍是一项根本性挑战。现有方法要么侧重于时序建模能力有限的逐帧增强，要么依赖粗粒度的时空聚合，往往以牺牲高频细节为代价。本文提出FTPFusion，一种基于时序扰动和稀疏跨模态交互的频率感知红外与可见光视频融合方法。具体而言，FTPFusion将特征表示分解为高频与低频分量进行协同建模。高频分支执行稀疏跨模态时空交互，以捕捉运动相关上下文与互补细节；低频分支引入时序扰动策略，增强对闪烁、抖动及局部错位等复杂视频变化的鲁棒性。此外，我们设计了一种偏移感知时序一致性约束，显式地稳定时序扰动下的跨帧特征表示。在多个公开基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FTPFusion在空间保真度与时序一致性方面均优于现有先进方法。源代码将发布于https://github.com/ixilai/FTPFusion。
tldr: FTPFusion is a method for fusing infrared and visible light video by separating features into frequency components and using temporal perturbation to improve stability and detail.
tldr_zh: FTPFusion 是一种红外与可见光视频融合方法，通过将特征分解为频率分量并利用时间扰动来提高稳定性和细节保留。

title: Low-Effort Jailbreak Attacks Against Text-to-Image Safety Filters
summary: Text-to-image generative models are widely deployed in creative tools and online platforms. To mitigate misuse, these systems rely on safety filters and moderation pipelines that aim to block harmful or policy violating content. In this work we show that modern text-to-image models remain vulnerable to low-effort jailbreak attacks that require only natural language prompts. We present a systematic study of prompt-based strategies that bypass safety filters without model access, optimization, or adversarial training. We introduce a taxonomy of visual jailbreak techniques including artistic reframing, material substitution, pseudo-educational framing, lifestyle aesthetic camouflage, and ambiguous action substitution. These strategies exploit weaknesses in prompt moderation and visual safety filtering by masking unsafe intent within benign semantic contexts. We evaluate these attacks across several state-of-the-art text-to-image systems and demonstrate that simple linguistic modifications can reliably evade existing safeguards and produce restricted imagery. Our findings highlight a critical gap between surface-level prompt filtering and the semantic understanding required to detect adversarial intent in generative media systems. Across all tested models and attack categories we observe an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 74.47%.
summary_zh: 文本到图像生成模型已广泛应用于创意工具和在线平台。为防止滥用，这些系统依赖安全过滤器和审核流程来阻止有害或违反政策的内容。本研究显示，现代文本到图像模型仍易受低成本的越狱攻击影响，此类攻击仅需自然语言提示即可实现。我们系统性地研究了基于提示的攻击策略，这些策略无需模型访问、优化或对抗训练即可绕过安全过滤器。我们提出了视觉越狱技术的分类体系，包括艺术重构、材质替换、伪教育框架、生活美学伪装及模糊动作替代等方法。这些策略通过在良性语义语境中隐藏有害意图，揭示了提示审核与视觉安全过滤机制的薄弱环节。我们在多个先进文本到图像系统中评估了这些攻击，证明简单的语言修改即可可靠规避现有安全措施并生成受限图像。研究结果凸显了表层提示过滤与生成式媒体系统所需语义理解之间的关键差距——在所有测试模型和攻击类别中，攻击成功率最高可达74.47%。
tldr: This paper studies simple natural language prompt attacks that can reliably bypass safety filters in text-to-image generation models, exposing a critical gap in semantic understanding for content moderation.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了针对文本到图像生成模型安全过滤器的简单自然语言提示攻击，这些攻击能可靠地绕过防护，揭示了内容审核在语义理解方面的关键缺陷。

title: FaCT-GS: Fast and Scalable CT Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian Splatting (GS) has emerged as a dominating technique for image rendering and has quickly been adapted for the X-ray Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction task. However, despite being on par or better than many of its predecessors, the benefits of GS are typically not substantial enough to motivate a transition from well-established reconstruction algorithms. This paper addresses the most significant remaining limitations of the GS-based approach by introducing FaCT-GS, a framework for fast and flexible CT reconstruction. Enabled by an in-depth optimization of the voxelization and rasterization pipelines, our new method is significantly faster than its predecessors and scales well with projection and output volume size. Furthermore, the improved voxelization enables rapid fitting of Gaussians to pre-existing volumes, which can serve as a prior for warm-starting the reconstruction, or simply as an alternative, compressed representation. FaCT-GS is over 4X faster than the State of the Art GS CT reconstruction on standard 512x512 projections, and over 13X faster on 2k projections. Implementation available at: https://github.com/PaPieta/fact-gs.
summary_zh: 高斯溅射（GS）已成为图像渲染的主导技术，并已迅速应用于X射线计算机断层扫描（CT）重建任务。然而，尽管其性能与众多先前方法持平或更优，但GS的优势通常不足以促使用户从成熟的重建算法转向该技术。本文通过引入FaCT-GS框架，解决了基于GS方法中最显著的遗留限制，该框架旨在实现快速且灵活的CT重建。通过对体素化和光栅化流程的深度优化，我们的新方法速度显著超越先前方法，并能良好适应投影和输出体积尺寸的变化。此外，改进的体素化技术可快速将高斯模型拟合到现有体积数据中，这既可作为预热启动重建的先验信息，也可作为替代的压缩表示形式。在标准的512x512投影数据上，FaCT-GS比当前最先进的GS CT重建方法快4倍以上，在2k投影数据上则快13倍以上。实现代码发布于：https://github.com/PaPieta/fact-gs。
tldr: This paper introduces FaCT-GS, a fast and scalable CT reconstruction method using Gaussian Splatting, significantly outperforming prior state-of-the-art in speed and scaling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了FaCT-GS，一种使用高斯溅射的快速、可扩展的CT重建方法，在速度和可扩展性上显著优于先前技术。

title: Investigating Permutation-Invariant Discrete Representation Learning for Spatially Aligned Images
summary: Vector quantization approaches (VQ-VAE, VQ-GAN) learn discrete neural representations of images, but these representations are inherently position-dependent: codes are spatially arranged and contextually entangled, requiring autoregressive or diffusion-based priors to model their dependencies at sample time. In this work, we ask whether positional information is necessary for discrete representations of spatially aligned data. We propose the permutation-invariant vector-quantized autoencoder (PI-VQ), in which latent codes are constrained to carry no positional information. We find that this constraint encourages codes to capture global, semantic features, and enables direct interpolation between images without a learned prior. To address the reduced information capacity of permutation-invariant representations, we introduce matching quantization, a vector quantization algorithm based on optimal bipartite matching that increases effective bottleneck capacity by $3.5\times$ relative to naive nearest-neighbour quantization. The compositional structure of the learned codes further enables interpolation-based sampling, allowing synthesis of novel images in a single forward pass. We evaluate PI-VQ on CelebA, CelebA-HQ and FFHQ, obtaining competitive precision, density and coverage metrics for images synthesised with our approach. We discuss the trade-offs inherent to position-free representations, including separability and interpretability of the latent codes, pointing to numerous directions for future work.
summary_zh: 矢量量化方法（VQ-VAE、VQ-GAN）能够学习图像的离散神经表示，但这些表示本质上是位置依赖的：编码以空间方式排列且上下文相互纠缠，在生成时需依赖自回归或基于扩散的先验模型来建模其依赖关系。本文探讨了位置信息对于空间对齐数据的离散表示是否必需。我们提出置换不变的矢量量化自编码器（PI-VQ），其潜在编码被约束为不携带任何位置信息。研究发现，这种约束促使编码捕捉全局语义特征，并能在无需学习先验的情况下直接实现图像间插值。为解决置换不变表示信息容量降低的问题，我们引入匹配量化——一种基于最优二分图匹配的矢量量化算法，相对于朴素最近邻量化，该算法将有效瓶颈容量提升了3.5倍。所学编码的复合结构进一步支持基于插值的采样，允许单次前向传播即可合成新图像。我们在CelebA、CelebA-HQ和FFHQ数据集上评估PI-VQ，使用该方法合成的图像在精度、密度和覆盖度指标上均获得具有竞争力的结果。我们讨论了无位置表示固有的权衡问题，包括潜在编码的可分离性和可解释性，为未来研究指明了多个方向。
tldr: Proposes a permutation-invariant discrete image representation method (PI-VQ) that encodes global semantic features, enabling direct interpolation and novel image synthesis without a learned prior, using a matching quantization technique.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种排列不变离散图像表示方法（PI-VQ），编码全局语义特征，无需先验模型即可直接插值和生成新图像，并采用匹配量化技术提升容量。

title: GardenDesigner: Encoding Aesthetic Principles into Jiangnan Garden Construction via a Chain of Agents
summary: Jiangnan gardens, a prominent style of Chinese classical gardens, hold great potential as digital assets for film and game production and digital tourism. However, manual modeling of Jiangnan gardens heavily relies on expert experience for layout design and asset creation, making the process time-consuming. To address this gap, we propose GardenDesigner, a novel framework that encodes aesthetic principles for Jiangnan garden construction and integrates a chain of agents based on procedural modeling. The water-centric terrain and explorative pathway rules are applied by terrain distribution and road generation agents. Selection and spatial layout of garden assets follow the aesthetic and cultural constraints. Consequently, we propose asset selection and layout optimization agents to select and arrange objects for each area in the garden. Additionally, we introduce GardenVerse for Jiangnan garden construction, including expert-annotated garden knowledge to enhance the asset arrangement process. To enable interaction and editing, we develop an interactive interface and tools in Unity, in which non-expert users can construct Jiangnan gardens via text input within one minute. Experiments and human evaluations demonstrate that GardenDesigner can generate diverse and aesthetically pleasing Jiangnan gardens. Project page is available at https://monad-cube.github.io/GardenDesigner.
summary_zh: 江南园林作为中国古典园林的重要流派，在影视游戏制作与数字旅游领域具有成为数字资产的巨大潜力。然而，当前人工建模江南园林的方式在布局设计与资产创建上高度依赖专家经验，耗时耗力。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了GardenDesigner——一个创新性框架，该框架编码了江南园林构建的美学原则，并融合了基于程序化建模的智能体链。以水为核心的地形设计与探索性路径规则通过地形分布与道路生成智能体实现，园林资产的选择与空间布局则遵循美学与文化约束。为此，我们提出资产选择与布局优化智能体，以完成园林各区域的物件选取与排布。此外，我们构建了包含专家标注园林知识的江南园林数据集GardenVerse，以优化资产布置流程。为实现交互式编辑，我们在Unity中开发了交互界面与工具，非专业用户可通过文本输入在一分钟内完成江南园林的构建。实验与人工评估表明，GardenDesigner能够生成多样化且具有美学价值的江南园林。项目页面详见https://monad-cube.github.io/GardenDesigner。
tldr: The paper proposes a multi-agent system, GardenDesigner, to automate the procedural generation of 3D Jiangnan gardens for digital assets using encoded aesthetic principles, with an interactive Unity interface.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个多智能体系统GardenDesigner，通过编码美学原则在Unity中自动化生成用于数字资产的江南园林3D模型。

title: Hidden Meanings in Plain Sight: RebusBench for Evaluating Cognitive Visual Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable proficiency in explicit visual recognition, effectively describing what is directly visible in an image. However, a critical cognitive gap emerges when the visual input serves only as a clue rather than the answer. We identify that current models struggle with the complex, multi-step reasoning required to solve problems where information is not explicitly depicted. Successfully solving a rebus puzzle requires a distinct cognitive workflow: the model must extract visual and textual attributes, retrieve linguistic prior knowledge (such as idioms), and perform abstract mapping to synthesize these elements into a meaning that exists outside the pixel space. To evaluate this neurosymbolic capability, we introduce RebusBench, a benchmark of 1,164 puzzles designed to test this specific integration of perception and knowledge. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art models (including Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA) shows a severe deficiency: performance saturates below 10% Exact Match and 20% semantic accuracy, with no significant improvement observed from model scaling or In-Context Learning (ICL). These findings suggest that while models possess the necessary visual and linguistic components, they lack the cognitive reasoning glue to connect them. Project page available at https://amirkasaei.com/rebusbench/.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在显式视觉识别方面已达到显著水平，能够有效描述图像中直接可见的内容。然而，当视觉输入仅作为线索而非答案时，一个关键的认知缺口便显现出来。我们发现当前模型在解决信息未被明确描绘的复杂多步推理问题时存在困难。成功破解字谜游戏需要一种独特的认知流程：模型必须提取视觉与文本属性、检索语言先验知识（如成语）、并进行抽象映射，从而将这些元素综合为像素空间之外存在的意义。为评估这种神经符号化能力，我们引入了RebusBench——一个包含1，164个谜题的基准测试集，专门用于检验感知与知识的这种特定整合能力。对包括Qwen、InternVL和LLaVA在内的前沿模型进行评估后，发现其存在严重缺陷：精确匹配准确率低于10%，语义准确率低于20%，且模型缩放或上下文学习均未带来显著提升。这些结果表明，尽管模型具备必要的视觉与语言组件，却缺乏连接二者的认知推理粘合剂。项目页面详见https://amirkasaei.com/rebusbench/。
tldr: This paper introduces RebusBench, a benchmark to evaluate the cognitive visual reasoning of LVLMs on rebus puzzles, showing models are severely deficient at multi-step reasoning requiring integration of perception and knowledge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RebusBench基准，用于评估大视觉语言模型在解谜推理任务上的认知视觉推理能力，发现模型在需要融合感知和知识的多步推理方面存在严重缺陷。

title: Cosine-Normalized Attention for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Transformer-based methods have improved hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) by modeling long-range spatial-spectral dependencies; however, their attention mechanisms typically rely on dot-product similarity, which mixes feature magnitude and orientation and may be suboptimal for hyperspectral data. This work revisits attention scoring from a geometric perspective and introduces a cosine-normalized attention formulation that aligns similarity computation with the angular structure of hyperspectral signatures. By projecting query and key embeddings onto a unit hypersphere and applying a squared cosine similarity, the proposed method emphasizes angular relationships while reducing sensitivity to magnitude variations. The formulation is integrated into a spatial-spectral Transformer and evaluated under extremely limited supervision. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves higher performance, outperforming several recent Transformer- and Mamba-based models despite using a lightweight backbone. In addition, a controlled analysis of multiple attention score functions shows that cosine-based scoring provides a reliable inductive bias for hyperspectral representation learning.
summary_zh: 基于Transformer的方法通过建模长距离空间-光谱依赖关系提升了高光谱图像分类（HSIC）性能，但其注意力机制通常依赖于点积相似度，这种机制将特征幅值与方向信息混合，可能对高光谱数据并非最优。本研究从几何角度重新审视注意力评分机制，引入了一种余弦归一化的注意力公式，使相似度计算与高光谱特征的角向结构相适配。通过将查询和键嵌入投影到单位超球面并应用平方余弦相似度，所提出的方法强调了角度关系，同时降低了对幅值变化的敏感性。该公式被整合到空间-光谱Transformer中，并在极度有限的监督条件下进行评估。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法使用轻量级骨干网络，仍能持续实现更高的性能，优于多个近期基于Transformer和Mamba的模型。此外，对多种注意力评分函数的对比分析表明，基于余弦的评分为高光谱表征学习提供了可靠的归纳偏置。
tldr: Proposes a cosine-normalized attention mechanism for Transformer-based hyperspectral image classification, emphasizing angular relationships over feature magnitudes to improve performance under limited supervision.
tldr_zh: 为基于Transformer的高光谱图像分类提出了余弦归一化注意力机制，强调角度关系而非特征幅度，以在有限监督下提升性能。

title: Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization with Reinforced Point Selection for Crowd Instance Segmentation
summary: Crowd instance segmentation is a crucial task with a wide range of applications, including surveillance and transportation. Currently, point labels are common in crowd datasets, while region labels (e.g., boxes) are rare and inaccurate. The masks obtained through segmentation help to improve the accuracy of region labels and resolve the correspondence between individual location coordinates and crowd density maps. However, directly applying currently popular large foundation models such as SAM does not yield ideal results in dense crowds. To this end, we first propose Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization (DPMO), which integrates SAM with the Nearest Neighbor Exclusive Circle (NNEC) constraint to generate dense instance segmentation from point annotations. With DPMO and manual correction, we obtain mask annotations from the existing point annotations for traditional crowd datasets. Then, to predict instance segmentation in dense crowds, we propose a Reinforced Point Selection (RPS) framework trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which selects the best predicted point from a sampling of the initial point prediction. Through extensive experiments, we achieve state-of-the-art crowd instance segmentation performance on ShanghaiTech, UCF-QNRF, JHU-CROWD++, and NWPU-Crowd datasets. Furthermore, we design new loss functions supervised by masks that boost counting performance across different models, demonstrating the significant role of mask annotations in enhancing counting accuracy.
summary_zh: 人群实例分割是一项关键任务，在安防监控和交通管理等领域具有广泛的应用前景。当前，人群数据集普遍采用点标注形式，而区域标注（如边界框）较为稀缺且精度有限。通过分割获得的掩码有助于提升区域标注的精度，并能建立个体位置坐标与人群密度图之间的对应关系。然而，直接将当前流行的大型基础模型（如SAM）应用于密集人群场景时效果并不理想。为此，我们首先提出了密集点-掩码优化方法（DPMO），该方法将SAM模型与最近邻互斥圆约束（NNEC）相结合，从点标注中生成密集的实例分割结果。基于DPMO并结合人工修正，我们从现有传统人群数据集的点标注中获取了掩码标注。随后，为预测密集人群中的实例分割，我们提出了强化点选择框架（RPS），该框架通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练，能够从初始点预测的采样中选取最优预测点。通过大量实验，我们在ShanghaiTech、UCF-QNRF、JHU-CROWD++和NWPU-Crowd数据集上实现了最先进的人群实例分割性能。此外，我们设计了基于掩码监督的新损失函数，该函数在不同模型上均能提升计数性能，验证了掩码标注对于提高计数准确性的重要作用。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for crowd instance segmentation, combining a point-to-mask optimization technique with a reinforced point selection strategy, validated on dense crowd datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人群实例分割的方法，结合了点对掩码优化技术和强化点选择策略，并在密集人群数据集上进行了验证。

title: Setup-Independent Full Projector Compensation
summary: Projector compensation seeks to correct geometric and photometric distortions that occur when images are projected onto nonplanar or textured surfaces. However, most existing methods are highly setup-dependent, requiring fine-tuning or retraining whenever the surface, lighting, or projector-camera pose changes. Progress has been limited by two key challenges: (1) the absence of large, diverse training datasets and (2) existing geometric correction models are typically constrained by specific spatial setups; without further retraining or fine-tuning, they often fail to generalize directly to novel geometric configurations. We introduce SIComp, the first Setup-Independent framework for full projector Compensation, capable of generalizing to unseen setups without fine-tuning or retraining. To enable this, we construct a large-scale real-world dataset spanning 277 distinct projector-camera setups. SIComp adopts a co-adaptive design that decouples geometry and photometry: A carefully tailored optical flow module performs online geometric correction, while a novel photometric network handles photometric compensation. To further enhance robustness under varying illumination, we integrate intensity-varying surface priors into the network design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SIComp consistently produces high-quality compensation across diverse unseen setups, substantially outperforming existing methods in terms of generalization ability and establishing the first generalizable solution to projector compensation. The code and dataset are available on our project page: https://hai-bo-li.github.io/SIComp/
