summary_zh: 投影仪补偿旨在校正图像投射到非平面或纹理表面时产生的几何与光度畸变。然而，现有方法大多高度依赖特定设置，一旦表面、光照或投影仪-相机相对位姿发生变化，就需要重新微调或训练。这一领域的进展主要受限于两个关键挑战：（1）缺乏大规模、多样化的训练数据集；（2）现有几何校正模型通常受限于特定的空间配置，若不经过重新训练或微调，往往无法直接泛化到新的几何配置中。本文提出SIComp，首个独立于设置的全投影仪补偿框架，能够在不进行微调或重新训练的情况下泛化到未见过的设置。为实现这一目标，我们构建了一个涵盖277种不同投影仪-相机设置的大规模真实世界数据集。SIComp采用解耦几何与光度特性的协同自适应设计：一个精心定制的光流模块实现在线几何校正，而一种新颖的光度网络则负责光度补偿。为进一步增强多变光照条件下的鲁棒性，我们将强度变化表面先验知识整合到网络设计中。大量实验表明，SIComp能够在多种未见过的设置中持续产生高质量补偿结果，其泛化能力显著优于现有方法，由此建立了首个可泛化的投影仪补偿解决方案。代码与数据集已在项目页面公开：https://hai-bo-li.github.io/SIComp/
tldr: This paper introduces a Setup-Independent Compensator (SIComp) for correcting geometric and photometric distortions in projector images on arbitrary surfaces, using a new dataset and co-adaptive design to generalize to unseen setups without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种与设置无关的投影仪补偿器（SIComp），用于校正任意表面上的几何和光度失真，通过新数据集和协同自适应设计，无需重新训练即可泛化到新场景。

title: From Understanding to Erasing: Towards Complete and Stable Video Object Removal
summary: Video object removal aims to eliminate target objects from videos while plausibly completing missing regions and preserving spatio-temporal consistency. Although diffusion models have recently advanced this task, it remains challenging to remove object-induced side effects (e.g., shadows, reflections, and illumination changes) without compromising overall coherence. This limitation stems from the insufficient physical and semantic understanding of the target object and its interactions with the scene. In this paper, we propose to introduce understanding into erasing from two complementary perspectives. Externally, we introduce a distillation scheme that transfers the relationships between objects and their induced effects from vision foundation models to video diffusion models. Internally, we propose a framewise context cross-attention mechanism that grounds each denoising block in informative, unmasked context surrounding the target region. External and internal guidance jointly enable our model to understand the target object, its induced effects, and the global background context, resulting in clear and coherent object removal. Extensive experiments demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance, and we establish the first real-world benchmark for video object removal to facilitate future research and community progress. Our code, data, and models are available at: https://github.com/WeChatCV/UnderEraser.
summary_zh: 视频物体移除旨在从视频中消除目标物体，同时合理补全缺失区域并保持时空一致性。尽管扩散模型近期推动了该任务的发展，但在不损害整体连贯性的前提下移除物体引起的副作用（如阴影、反射和光照变化）仍面临挑战。这一局限源于对目标物体及其与场景交互关系的物理和语义理解不足。本文提出从两个互补视角将理解能力引入擦除过程：对外部，我们设计了一种蒸馏方案，将视觉基础模型中物体与其引发效应之间的关联知识迁移至视频扩散模型；对内部，我们提出了一种逐帧上下文交叉注意力机制，使每个去噪模块能够基于目标区域周围未被遮蔽的信息化上下文进行推理。外部引导与内部引导协同作用，使模型能够理解目标物体、其引发的副作用以及全局背景语境，从而实现清晰连贯的物体移除效果。大量实验证明了我们方法的先进性能，同时我们建立了首个真实世界视频物体移除基准，以推动未来研究与社区发展。相关代码、数据及模型已开源：https://github.com/WeChatCV/UnderEraser。
tldr: This paper presents a method for improved video object removal by combining external knowledge distillation from vision foundation models and an internal cross-attention mechanism for better understanding of object-scene interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的视频对象去除方法，通过结合来自视觉基础模型的外部知识蒸馏和用于更好理解对象与场景交互的内部交叉注意力机制。

title: BTS-rPPG: Orthogonal Butterfly Temporal Shifting for Remote Photoplethysmography
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological sensing from facial videos by analyzing subtle appearance variations induced by blood circulation. However, modeling the temporal dynamics of these signals remains challenging, as many deep learning methods rely on temporal shifting or convolutional operators that aggregate information primarily from neighboring frames, resulting in predominantly local temporal modeling and limited temporal receptive fields. To address this limitation, we propose BTS-rPPG, a temporal modeling framework based on Orthogonal Butterfly Temporal Shifting (BTS). Inspired by the butterfly communication pattern in the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), BTS establishes structured frame interactions via an XOR-based butterfly pairing schedule, progressively expanding the temporal receptive field and enabling efficient propagation of information across distant frames. Furthermore, we introduce an orthogonal feature transfer mechanism (OFT) that filters the source feature with respect to the target context before temporal shifting, retaining only the orthogonal component for cross-frame transmission. This reduces redundant feature propagation and encourages complementary temporal interaction. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that BTS-rPPG improves long-range temporal modeling of physiological dynamics and consistently outperforms existing temporal modeling strategies for rPPG estimation.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
远程光电容积描记（rPPG）技术通过分析面部视频中由血液循环引起的细微外观变化，实现无接触生理感知。然而，对这些信号的时间动态建模仍具挑战性：许多深度学习方法依赖于时域平移或卷积操作，这些方法主要聚合相邻帧的信息，导致建模局限于局部时间依赖，且时间感受野有限。为突破此局限，我们提出BTS-rPPG——一种基于正交蝴蝶时序平移（BTS）的时间建模框架。该方法受快速傅里叶变换（FFT）中蝴蝶通信模式的启发，通过基于异或运算的蝴蝶配对机制建立结构化帧间交互，逐步扩展时间感受野，实现远距离帧间信息的高效传递。此外，我们引入了正交特征传递机制（OFT），在时序平移前依据目标上下文对源特征进行筛选，仅保留正交分量进行跨帧传输。这一设计减少了冗余特征传播，促进了互补性时序交互。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，BTS-rPPG显著提升了生理动态的远距离时序建模能力，并持续优于现有rPPG估计中的时序建模方法。
tldr: This paper proposes BTS-rPPG, a new temporal modeling framework for remote photoplethysmography (contactless heart rate measurement) that uses a butterfly temporal shifting mechanism to improve long-range feature interactions in video analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出BTS-rPPG，一种用于远程光电容积描记法（非接触式心率测量）的新时序建模框架，利用蝶形时序移位机制改进视频分析中的长距离特征交互。

title: Towards Minimal Focal Stack in Shape from Focus
summary: Shape from Focus (SFF) is a depth reconstruction technique that estimates scene structure from focus variations observed across a focal stack, that is, a sequence of images captured at different focus settings. A key limitation of SFF methods is their reliance on densely sampled, large focal stacks, which limits their practical applicability. In this study, we propose a focal stack augmentation that enables SFF methods to estimate depth using a reduced stack of just two images, without sacrificing precision. We introduce a simple yet effective physics-based focal stack augmentation that enriches the stack with two auxiliary cues: an all-in-focus (AiF) image estimated from two input images, and Energy-of-Difference (EOD) maps, computed as the energy of differences between the AiF and input images. Furthermore, we propose a deep network that computes a deep focus volume from the augmented focal stacks and iteratively refines depth using convolutional Gated Recurrent Units (ConvGRUs) at multiple scales. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed augmentation benefits existing state-of-the-art SFF models, enabling them to achieve comparable accuracy. The results also show that our approach maintains state-of-the-art performance with a minimal stack size.
summary_zh: Shape from Focus（SFF）是一种深度重建技术，通过从对焦堆栈（即在不同焦距设置下拍摄的一系列图像）中观察到的焦点变化来估计场景结构。SFF方法的一个主要局限性在于其依赖密集采样的大规模对焦堆栈，这限制了其实际应用。在本研究中，我们提出一种对焦堆栈增强方法，使SFF方法能够仅使用两幅图像构成的精简堆栈估计深度，同时不牺牲精度。我们引入了一种简单而有效的基于物理原理的对焦堆栈增强方案，通过两个辅助线索丰富堆栈信息：一是从两幅输入图像中估计出的全聚焦（AiF）图像，二是将AiF图像与输入图像差分后的能量构成的差异能量（EOD）图。此外，我们提出一种深度网络架构，该网络从增强的对焦堆栈中计算深度聚焦体积，并采用多尺度卷积门控循环单元（ConvGRU）迭代优化深度估计。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的增强方案能够有效提升现有先进SFF模型的性能，使其达到可比的精度。实验结果还证明，我们的方法能够在最小堆栈尺寸下保持最先进的性能水平。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to reduce the number of images needed for Shape from Focus depth estimation from a dense stack to just two images, using a physics-based augmentation with an all-in-focus image and energy-of-difference maps, and a deep network for refinement.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种方法，将形状聚焦深度估计所需的图像从密集堆栈减少到仅需两张，通过基于物理的增强（包括全焦图像和能量差图）以及用于精炼的深度网络实现。

title: Cross-Domain Vessel Segmentation via Latent Similarity Mining and Iterative Co-Optimization
summary: Retinal vessel segmentation serves as a critical prerequisite for automated diagnosis of retinal pathologies. While recent advances in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated promising performance in this task, significant performance degradation occurs when domain shifts exist between training and testing data. To address these limitations, we propose a novel domain transfer framework that leverages latent vascular similarity across domains and iterative co-optimization of generation and segmentation networks. Specifically, we first pre-train generation networks for source and target domains. Subsequently, the pretrained source-domain conditional diffusion model performs deterministic inversion to establish intermediate latent representations of vascular images, creating domain-agnostic prototypes for target synthesis. Finally, we develop an iterative refinement strategy where segmentation network and generative model undergo mutual optimization through cyclic parameter updating. This co-evolution process enables simultaneous enhancement of cross-domain image synthesis quality and segmentation accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-domain retinal vessel segmentation, particularly in challenging clinical scenarios with significant modality discrepancies.
summary_zh: 视网膜血管分割是实现视网膜病变自动化诊断的关键前提。尽管卷积神经网络在该任务中已展现出优异性能，但当训练数据与测试数据存在域偏移时，其性能会出现显著下降。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种新颖的域迁移框架，该框架通过跨域潜在血管相似性挖掘以及生成网络与分割网络的迭代协同优化来实现性能提升。具体而言，我们首先对源域和目标域的生成网络进行预训练。随后，预训练的源域条件扩散模型通过确定性反演建立血管图像的中间潜在表示，从而构建用于目标合成的域无关原型。最后，我们设计了一种迭代优化策略，通过循环参数更新实现分割网络与生成模型的相互优化。这种协同进化过程能同时提升跨域图像合成质量与分割精度。实验表明，我们的框架在跨域视网膜血管分割任务中取得了最先进的性能表现，尤其在模态差异显著的临床挑战场景中效果显著。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for cross-domain retinal vessel segmentation, using a conditional diffusion model and iterative co-optimization to improve performance under domain shifts.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于跨域视网膜血管分割的框架，利用条件扩散模型和迭代协同优化来改善存在域偏移时的性能。

title: Prototype-Based Low Altitude UAV Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation of low-altitude UAV imagery presents unique challenges due to extreme scale variations, complex object boundaries, and limited computational resources on edge devices. Existing transformer-based segmentation methods achieve remarkable performance but incur high computational overhead, while lightweight approaches struggle to capture fine-grained details in high-resolution aerial scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PBSeg, an efficient prototype-based segmentation framework tailored for UAV applications. PBSeg introduces a novel prototype-based cross-attention (PBCA) that exploits feature redundancy to reduce computational complexity while maintaining segmentation quality. The framework incorporates an efficient multi-scale feature extraction module that combines deformable convolutions (DConv) with context-aware modulation (CAM) to capture both local details and global semantics. Experiments on two challenging UAV datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. PBSeg achieves 71.86\% mIoU on UAVid and 80.92\% mIoU on UDD6, establishing competitive performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangda1018/PBSeg.
summary_zh: 低空无人机影像的语义分割由于极端尺度变化、复杂物体边界以及边缘设备有限的计算资源而面临独特挑战。现有的基于Transformer的分割方法虽能取得显著性能，但计算开销高昂，而轻量化方法则难以捕捉高分辨率航拍场景中的精细细节。针对这些局限，我们提出了PBSeg——一种专为无人机应用设计的、基于原型的高效分割框架。PBSeg引入了一种新颖的基于原型的交叉注意力机制，通过利用特征冗余在保持分割质量的同时降低计算复杂度。该框架还包含一个高效的多尺度特征提取模块，该模块结合了可变形卷积与上下文感知调制机制，以同时捕捉局部细节和全局语义。在两个具有挑战性的无人机数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。PBSeg在UAVid数据集上取得了71.86\%的mIoU，在UDD6数据集上达到了80.92\%的mIoU，在保持计算效率的同时建立了具有竞争力的性能。代码发布于https://github.com/zhangda1018/PBSeg。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel prototype-based semantic segmentation framework for low-altitude UAV imagery, focusing on efficiency and accuracy. It achieves competitive results on aerial datasets but does not directly address robotics control or embodied AI tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于原型的低空无人机图像语义分割框架，专注于效率和精度。它在航空数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，但未直接涉及机器人控制或具身AI任务。

title: Universal computational thermal imaging overcoming the ghosting effect
summary: Thermal imaging is crucial for night vision but fundamentally hampered by the ghosting effect, a loss of detailed texture in cluttered photon streams. While conventional ghosting mitigation has relied on data post-processing, the recent breakthrough in heat-assisted detection and ranging (HADAR) opens a promising frontier for hyperspectral computational thermal imaging that produces night vision with day-like visibility. However, universal anti-ghosting imaging remains elusive, as state-of-the-art HADAR applies only to limited scenes with uniform materials, whereas material non-uniformity is ubiquitous in the real world. Here, we propose a universal computational thermal imaging framework, TAG (thermal anti-ghosting), to address material non-uniformity and overcome ghosting for high-fidelity night vision. TAG takes hyperspectral photon streams for nonparametric texture recovery, enabling our experimental demonstration of unprecedented expression recovery in thus-far-elusive ghostly human faces -- the archetypal, long-recognized ghosting phenomenon. Strikingly, TAG not only universally outperforms HADAR across various scenes, but also reveals the influence of material non-uniformity, shedding light on HADAR's effectiveness boundary. We extensively test facial texture and expression recovery across day and night, and demonstrate, for the first time, thermal 3D topological alignment and mood detection. This work establishes a universal foundation for high-fidelity computational night vision, with potential applications in autonomous navigation, reconnaissance, healthcare, and wildlife monitoring.
summary_zh: 热成像技术是夜视系统的关键，但其性能从根本上受限于重影效应——在杂乱光子流中丢失细节纹理的问题。传统方法主要通过数据后处理来缓解重影，而近期热辅助探测与测距技术的突破为高光谱计算热成像开辟了新前景，有望实现接近白昼视觉的夜视效果。然而，由于现有技术仅适用于材质均匀的有限场景，而现实世界中材料非均匀性普遍存在，普适性抗重影成像仍是未解难题。本文提出名为TAG的通用计算热成像框架，通过处理材料非均匀性问题克服重影效应，实现高保真夜视成像。该框架利用高光谱光子流进行非参数纹理重建，首次在实验中实现了对典型重影现象——人脸表情的高保真复原。值得注意的是，TAG不仅在不同场景中普遍优于现有技术，还揭示了材料非均匀性对成像的影响，界定了现有技术的有效性边界。我们通过昼夜人脸纹理与表情复原实验，首次实现了热成像三维拓扑对齐与情绪检测。这项研究为高保真计算夜视建立了通用基础，在自动驾驶导航、侦察勘测、医疗保健及野生动物监测等领域具有广阔应用前景。
tldr: This paper proposes a universal computational thermal imaging framework called TAG to overcome the ghosting effect in thermal imaging, enabling high-fidelity night vision and texture recovery, including for human faces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为TAG的通用计算热成像框架，以克服热成像中的鬼影效应，实现高保真夜视和纹理恢复，包括对于人脸纹理的恢复。

title: Why Instruction-Based Unlearning Fails in Diffusion Models?
summary: Instruction-based unlearning has proven effective for modifying the behavior of large language models at inference time, but whether this paradigm extends to other generative models remains unclear. In this work, we investigate instruction-based unlearning in diffusion-based image generation models and show, through controlled experiments across multiple concepts and prompt variants, that diffusion models systematically fail to suppress targeted concepts when guided solely by natural-language unlearning instructions. By analyzing both the CLIP text encoder and cross-attention dynamics during the denoising process, we find that unlearning instructions do not induce sustained reductions in attention to the targeted concept tokens, causing the targeted concept representations to persist throughout generation. These results reveal a fundamental limitation of prompt-level instruction in diffusion models and suggest that effective unlearning requires interventions beyond inference-time language control.
summary_zh: 基于指令的遗忘方法已被证明在推理时能有效调整大型语言模型的行为，但这一范式是否适用于其他生成模型仍不明确。本研究探讨了基于扩散的图像生成模型中的指令式遗忘，通过针对多个概念及提示变体的对照实验发现：仅依靠自然语言遗忘指令时，扩散模型无法系统性地抑制目标概念。通过分析CLIP文本编码器及去噪过程中的交叉注意力机制，我们发现遗忘指令未能持续降低对目标概念词元的注意力强度，导致目标概念表征在生成过程中持续存在。这些结果揭示了扩散模型中提示级指令的根本局限，表明有效的遗忘需要在推理时语言控制之外进行干预。
tldr: This paper investigates instruction-based unlearning in diffusion models for image generation, showing they fail to suppress targeted concepts via natural language instructions, and reveals a fundamental limitation in this approach.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了扩散模型在图像生成中的基于指令的遗忘方法，发现其无法通过自然语言指令有效抑制特定概念，揭示了该范式在扩散模型中的根本局限性。

title: Perceptual misalignment of texture representations in convolutional neural networks
summary: Mathematical modeling of visual textures traces back to Julesz's intuition that texture perception in humans is based on local correlations between image features. An influential approach for texture analysis and generation generalizes this notion to linear correlations between the nonlinear features computed by convolutional neural networks (CNNs), compiled into Gram matrices. Given that CNNs are often used as models for the visual system, it is natural to ask whether such "texture representations" spontaneously align with the textures' perceptual content, and in particular whether those CNNs that are regarded as better models for the visual system also possess more human-like texture representations. Here we compare the perceptual content captured by feature correlations computed for a diverse pool of CNNs, and we compare it to the models' perceptual alignment with the mammalian visual system as measured by Brain-Score. Surprisingly, we find that there is no connection between conventional measures of CNN quality as a model of the visual system and its alignment with human texture perception. We conclude that texture perception involves mechanisms that are distinct from those that are commonly modeled using approaches based on CNNs trained on object recognition, possibly depending on the integration of contextual information.
summary_zh: 视觉纹理的数学模型可追溯到Julesz的直觉，即人类的纹理感知基于图像特征之间的局部相关性。一种有影响力的纹理分析与生成方法将这一概念推广至卷积神经网络（CNN）所计算的非线性特征之间的线性相关性，并将其编译为格拉姆矩阵。鉴于CNN常被用作视觉系统的模型，我们自然要问：此类"纹理表征"是否与纹理的感知内容自发对齐？特别是，那些被认为更适合作为视觉系统模型的CNN是否拥有更接近人类感知的纹理表征？本研究比较了不同CNN模型所计算的特征相关性捕获的感知内容，并将其与通过Brain-Score测量得到的模型与哺乳动物视觉系统的感知对齐程度进行对比。令人意外的是，我们发现作为视觉系统模型的CNN质量传统衡量指标与其对人类纹理感知的匹配程度之间并无关联。我们得出结论：纹理感知涉及的机制与通常基于物体识别训练的CNN建模方法所模拟的机制不同，可能依赖于上下文信息的整合。
tldr: This paper investigates the alignment between human texture perception and texture representations in convolutional neural networks, finding that conventional measures of model quality (e.g., Brain-Score) do not correlate with perceptual alignment on texture tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了人类纹理感知与卷积神经网络中纹理表示的对齐性，发现常规的模型质量评估指标与纹理感知任务上的对齐性无关。

title: SECURE: Stable Early Collision Understanding via Robust Embeddings in Autonomous Driving
summary: While deep learning has significantly advanced accident anticipation, the robustness of these safety-critical systems against real-world perturbations remains a major challenge. We reveal that state-of-the-art models like CRASH, despite their high performance, exhibit significant instability in predictions and latent representations when faced with minor input perturbations, posing serious reliability risks. To address this, we introduce SECURE - Stable Early Collision Understanding Robust Embeddings, a framework that formally defines and enforces model robustness. SECURE is founded on four key attributes: consistency and stability in both prediction space and latent feature space. We propose a principled training methodology that fine-tunes a baseline model using a multi-objective loss, which minimizes divergence from a reference model and penalizes sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. Experiments on DAD and CCD datasets demonstrate that our approach not only significantly enhances robustness against various perturbations but also improves performance on clean data, achieving new state-of-the-art results.
summary_zh: 虽然深度学习显著推动了事故预测的进展，但这些安全关键系统在面对现实世界干扰时的鲁棒性仍然是重大挑战。我们发现，尽管CRASH等先进模型具有高性能，但在面对微小输入扰动时，其预测和潜在表征仍表现出显著的不稳定性，带来了严重的可靠性风险。为解决这一问题，我们提出SECURE框架——稳定早期碰撞理解鲁棒嵌入，该框架正式定义并强化了模型的鲁棒性。SECURE建立在四个关键属性之上：预测空间和潜在特征空间的一致性与稳定性。我们提出了一种基于原则的训练方法，通过多目标损失函数对基线模型进行微调，该损失函数最小化与参考模型的差异，并惩罚对对抗性扰动的敏感性。在DAD和CCD数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法不仅显著增强了针对各类扰动的鲁棒性，还提升了在干净数据上的性能，取得了全新的最优结果。
tldr: This paper introduces SECURE, a framework to improve the robustness of deep learning models for accident anticipation in autonomous driving against input perturbations, by enforcing consistency and stability in predictions and latent features.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SECURE框架，旨在通过强制预测和潜在特征的一致性和稳定性，提升自动驾驶中事故预测深度学习模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性。

title: ViTs for Action Classification in Videos: An Approach to Risky Tackle Detection in American Football Practice Videos
summary: Early identification of hazardous actions in contact sports enables timely intervention and improves player safety. We present a method for detecting risky tackles in American football practice videos and introduce a substantially expanded dataset for this task. Our work contains 733 single-athlete-dummy tackle clips, each temporally localized around first point contact and labeled with a strike zone component of the standardized Assessment for Tackling Technique (SATT-3), extending prior work that reported 178 annotated videos. Using a Vision transformer-based model with imbalance-aware training, we obtain risky recall of 0.67 and Risky F1 of 0.59 under crossvalidation. Relative to the previous baseline in a smaller subset (risky recall of 0.58; Risky F1 0.56 ), our approach improves risky recall by more than 8% points on a much larger dataset. These results indicate that the vision transformer-based video analysis, coupled with careful handling of class imbalance, can reliably detect rare but safety-critical tackling patterns, offering a practical pathway toward coach-centered injury prevention tools.
summary_zh: 在接触性运动中及早识别危险动作能够实现及时干预并提升运动员安全。本研究提出一种用于检测美式足球训练视频中高风险擒抱动作的方法，并为此任务构建了大规模扩展数据集。我们收集了733段运动员单独对抗训练假人的擒抱视频片段，每段均以首次接触点为时间中心进行定位，并依据标准化擒抱技术评估体系（SATT-3）的撞击区域组件进行标注，该数据规模较此前文献报道的178段标注视频实现了显著扩展。通过采用基于视觉Transformer的模型并结合类别不平衡感知训练策略，我们在交叉验证中取得了0.67的风险召回率与0.59的风险F1值。相较于先前在小规模数据集上的基线性能（风险召回率0.58，风险F1值0.56），本方法在更大规模数据集上将风险召回率提升了超过8个百分点。这些结果表明：基于视觉Transformer的视频分析方法，结合对类别不平衡问题的精细化处理，能够可靠地检测出罕见但关乎安全的关键擒抱模式，为开发以教练为中心的损伤预防工具提供了可行路径。
tldr: The paper uses a Vision Transformer model to detect risky tackles in American football practice videos, improving recall on an expanded dataset, with the goal of providing a coach-centered injury prevention tool.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用Vision Transformer模型在美式橄榄球训练视频中检测危险擒抱，在扩展数据集上提高了召回率，旨在为教练提供伤害预防工具。

title: Topological Effects in Neural Network Field Theory
summary: Neural network field theory formulates field theory as a statistical ensemble of fields defined by a network architecture and a density on its parameters. We extend the construction to topological settings via the inclusion of discrete parameters that label the topological quantum number. We recover the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition, including the spin-wave critical line and the proliferation of vortices at high temperatures. We also verify the T-duality of the bosonic string, showing invariance under the exchange of momentum and winding on $S^1$, the transformation of the sigma model couplings according to the Buscher rules on constant toroidal backgrounds, the enhancement of the current algebra at self-dual radius, and non-geometric T-fold transition functions.
summary_zh: 神经网络场理论将场论表述为由网络架构及其参数密度定义的场统计系综。我们通过引入标记拓扑量子数的离散参数，将这一构建拓展至拓扑场景。我们重现了Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless相变，包括自旋波临界线及高温下的涡旋增殖现象。同时，我们验证了玻色弦的T-对偶性：在$S^1$上实现了动量与绕数交换下的不变性；在恒定环面背景上根据Buscher规则实现了sigma模型耦合常数的变换；在自对偶半径处实现了流代数的增强；并验证了非几何T-折叠的转移函数。
tldr: This paper extends neural network field theory to topological settings, deriving phase transitions like BKT and verifying T-duality in string theory contexts.
tldr_zh: 本文将神经网络场论扩展到拓扑设置，推导出BKT等相变，并在弦理论背景下验证了T-对偶性。

title: Taming the Exponential: A Fast Softmax Surrogate for Integer-Native Edge Inference
summary: Softmax can become a computational bottleneck in the Transformer model's Multi-Head Attention (MHA) block, particularly in small models under low-precision inference, where exponentiation and normalization incur significant overhead. As such, we suggest using Head-Calibrated Clipped-Linear Softmax (HCCS), a bounded, monotone surrogate to the exponential softmax function, which uses a clipped linear mapping of the max centered attention logits. This approximation produces a stable probability distribution, maintains the ordering of the original logits and has non-negative values. HCCS differs from previous softmax surrogates as it includes a set of lightweight calibration parameters that are optimized offline based on a representative dataset and calibrated for each individual attention head to preserve the statistical properties of the individual heads. We describe a hardware-motivated implementation of HCCS for high-throughput scenarios targeting the AMD Versal AI Engines. The current reference implementations from AMD for this platform rely upon either bfloat16 arithmetic or LUTs to perform the exponential operation, which might limit the throughput of the platform and fail to utilize the high-throughput integer vector processing units of the AI Engine. In contrast, HCCS provides a natural mapping to the AI Engines' int8 multiply accumulate (MAC) units. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first int8 optimized softmax surrogate for AMD AI engines that significantly exceeds the speed performance of other reference implementations while maintaining competitive task accuracy on small or heavily quantized MHA workloads after quantization-aware retraining.
summary_zh: 在Transformer模型的多头注意力(MHA)模块中，Softmax可能成为计算瓶颈，尤其是在低精度推理的小型模型中，指数运算与归一化处理会带来显著的开销。为此，我们提出使用头部校准裁剪线性Softmax(HCCS)作为指数Softmax函数的单调有界替代方案。该方法通过对中心化对数注意力值进行裁剪线性映射，生成稳定的概率分布，保持原始对数数值的顺序，并确保所有值为非负。与以往的Softmax替代方法不同，HCCS引入了一组轻量级校准参数，这些参数基于代表性数据集进行离线优化，并为每个注意力头单独校准，以保留各注意力头的统计特性。我们针对AMD Versal AI引擎的高吞吐量场景，提出了一种基于硬件架构的HCCS实现方案。目前AMD针对该平台的参考实现方案依赖bfloat16算术或查找表(LUT)执行指数运算，这可能限制平台的吞吐量，且未能充分利用AI引擎的高吞吐量整数向量处理单元。相比之下，HCCS能天然映射到AI引擎的int8乘累加(MAC)单元。据我们所知，这是首个针对AMD AI引擎的int8优化Softmax替代方案，在量化感知重训练后，对于小型或重度量化的MHA任务，能在保持竞争力的任务精度的同时，显著超越其他参考实现方案的速度性能。
tldr: The paper proposes a fast, integer-optimized softmax surrogate called HCCS for efficient inference on AMD AI Engines, focusing on computational efficiency for small or heavily quantized Transformer models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为HCCS的快速、整数优化的softmax替代方法，旨在提高在AMD AI Engines上的推理效率，专注于小型或严重量化的Transformer模型的计算效率。

title: Best-Arm Identification with Noisy Actuation
summary: In this paper, we consider a multi-armed bandit (MAB) instance and study how to identify the best arm when arm commands are conveyed from a central learner to a distributed agent over a discrete memoryless channel (DMC). Depending on the agent capabilities, we provide communication schemes along with their analysis, which interestingly relate to the zero-error capacity of the underlying DMC.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一个多臂老虎机问题，探讨了当臂指令通过离散无记忆信道从中央学习器传递到分布式代理时，如何识别最优臂。根据代理的能力，我们提出了相应的通信方案及其分析，有趣的是，这些方案与底层离散无记忆信道的零错误容量密切相关。
tldr: This paper studies best-arm identification in multi-armed bandits when arm commands are communicated over a noisy channel, analyzing schemes related to the channel's zero-error capacity.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在多臂老虎机中，当臂命令通过离散无记忆信道从中央学习者传递到分布式代理时，如何识别最佳臂，分析了与信道零误差容量相关的通信方案。

title: Smoothing the Landscape: Causal Structure Learning via Diffusion Denoising Objectives
summary: Understanding causal dependencies in observational data is critical for informing decision-making. These relationships are often modeled as Bayesian Networks (BNs) and Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). Existing methods, such as NOTEARS and DAG-GNN, often face issues with scalability and stability in high-dimensional data, especially when there is a feature-sample imbalance. Here, we show that the denoising score matching objective of diffusion models could smooth the gradients for faster, more stable convergence. We also propose an adaptive k-hop acyclicity constraint that improves runtime over existing solutions that require matrix inversion. We name this framework Denoising Diffusion Causal Discovery (DDCD). Unlike generative diffusion models, DDCD utilizes the reverse denoising process to infer a parameterized causal structure rather than to generate data. We demonstrate the competitive performance of DDCDs on synthetic benchmarking data. We also show that our methods are practically useful by conducting qualitative analyses on two real-world examples. Code is available at this url: https://github.com/haozhu233/ddcd.
summary_zh: 理解观测数据中的因果依赖关系对于指导决策至关重要。这些关系通常被建模为贝叶斯网络和定向无环图。现有方法如NOTEARS和DAG-GNN在处理高维数据时，特别是在特征-样本不平衡的情况下，常面临可扩展性和稳定性问题。本文提出，扩散模型的去噪得分匹配目标能够平滑梯度，从而实现更快、更稳定的收敛。我们同时提出一种自适应k跳无环约束，相比需要矩阵求逆的现有解决方案，显著提升了运行效率。我们将该框架命名为去噪扩散因果发现模型。与生成式扩散模型不同，DDCD利用反向去噪过程推断参数化因果结构，而非生成数据。我们在合成基准数据上验证了DDCD具有竞争力的性能，并通过对两个真实案例的定性分析，证明了该方法的实际应用价值。代码可通过此链接获取：https://github.com/haozhu233/ddcd。
tldr: The paper introduces DDCD, a causal discovery method that uses diffusion denoising objectives and an adaptive acyclicity constraint for more stable and scalable learning of DAGs from observational data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DDCD，一种利用扩散去噪目标和自适应无环约束的因果发现方法，用于从观测数据中更稳定、可扩展地学习有向无环图。

title: BVFLMSP : Bayesian Vertical Federated Learning for Multimodal Survival with Privacy
summary:
Multimodal time-to-event prediction often requires integrating sensitive data distributed across multiple parties, making centralized model training impractical due to privacy constraints. At the same time, most existing multimodal survival models produce single deterministic predictions without indicating how confident the model is in its estimates, which can limit their reliability in real-world decision making. To address these challenges, we propose BVFLMSP, a Bayesian Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) framework for multimodal time-to-event analysis based on a Split Neural Network architecture. In BVFLMSP, each client independently models a specific data modality using a Bayesian neural network, while a central server aggregates intermediate representations to perform survival risk prediction. To enhance privacy, we integrate differential privacy mechanisms by perturbing client side representations before transmission, providing formal privacy guarantees against information leakage during federated training.
  We first evaluate our Bayesian multimodal survival model against widely used single modality survival baselines and the centralized multimodal baseline MultiSurv. Across multimodal settings, the proposed method shows consistent improvements in discrimination performance, with up to 0.02 higher C-index compared to MultiSurv. We then compare federated and centralized learning under varying privacy budgets across different modality combinations, highlighting the tradeoff between predictive performance and privacy. Experimental results show that BVFLMSP effectively includes multimodal data, improves survival prediction over existing baselines, and remains robust under strict privacy constraints while providing uncertainty estimates.
summary_zh:
多模态事件时间预测通常需要整合分布在多方参与的敏感数据，由于隐私限制，集中式模型训练往往难以实现。同时，现有的大多数多模态生存模型仅能提供单一的确定性预测，而无法表明模型对其估计的置信度，这在实际决策中可能限制其可靠性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出基于拆分神经网络架构的贝叶斯纵向联邦学习框架——BVFLMSP，用于多模态事件时间分析。在该框架中，各客户端通过贝叶斯神经网络独立建模特定数据模态，中央服务器则聚合中间表示以进行生存风险预测。为增强隐私保护，我们引入差分隐私机制，在传输前对客户端表示添加扰动，从而为联邦训练过程中的信息泄露提供形式化的隐私保障。  

首先，我们评估了提出的贝叶斯多模态生存模型与广泛使用的单模态生存基线及集中式多模态基线MultiSurv的性能。在多模态场景下，该方法在区分性能上取得一致提升，C指数相较MultiSurv最高提升0.02。其次，我们在不同模态组合下对比了不同隐私预算下的联邦学习与集中式学习，揭示了预测性能与隐私保护之间的权衡关系。实验结果表明，BVFLMSP能够有效整合多模态数据，在现有基线基础上提升生存预测性能，并在严格隐私约束下保持鲁棒性，同时提供不确定性估计。
tldr: This paper proposes a Bayesian vertical federated learning framework for multimodal survival analysis, integrating differential privacy for data protection and uncertainty estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多模态生存分析的贝叶斯垂直联邦学习框架，结合了差分隐私进行数据保护和不确定性估计。

title: (PAC-)Learning state machines from data streams: A generic strategy and an improved heuristic (Extended version)
summary:
This is an extended version of our publication Learning state machines from data streams: A generic strategy and an improved heuristic, International Conference on Grammatical Inference (ICGI) 2023, Rabat, Morocco. It has been extended with a formal proof on PAC-bounds, and the discussion and analysis of a similar approach has been moved from the appendix and is now a full Section.
  State machines models are models that simulate the behavior of discrete event systems, capable of representing systems such as software systems, network interactions, and control systems, and have been researched extensively. The nature of most learning algorithms however is the assumption that all data be available at the beginning of the algorithm, and little research has been done in learning state machines from streaming data. In this paper, we want to close this gap further by presenting a generic method for learning state machines from data streams, as well as a merge heuristic that uses sketches to account for incomplete prefix trees. We implement our approach in an open-source state merging library and compare it with existing methods. We show the effectiveness of our approach with respect to run-time, memory consumption, and quality of results on a well known open dataset. Additionally, we provide a formal analysis of our algorithm, showing that it is capable of learning within the PAC framework, and show a theoretical improvement to increase run-time, without sacrificing correctness of the algorithm in larger sample sizes.
summary_zh: 本文是我们发表于2023年在摩洛哥拉巴特举行的国际文法推断会议（ICGI）的论文《从数据流中学习状态机：通用策略与改进启发式方法》的扩展版本。本次扩展增加了对PAC界限的形式化证明，并将原附录中关于类似方法的讨论与分析移至正文，形成独立章节。状态机模型是模拟离散事件系统行为的模型，能够表征软件系统、网络交互和控制系统等各类系统，已获得广泛研究。然而大多数学习算法都默认在算法启动时所有数据均已就绪，针对从数据流中学习状态机的研究仍较为有限。本文通过提出一种从数据流中学习状态机的通用方法，以及一种利用草图技术处理不完整前缀树的合并启发式策略，进一步填补了这一研究空白。我们在开源状态合并库中实现了该方法，并与现有方法进行了比较。通过在知名开放数据集上验证运行时间、内存消耗和结果质量，证明了本方法的有效性。此外，我们对算法进行了形式化分析，证明其能够在PAC框架下实现有效学习，并提出理论改进方案以提升运行效率，同时确保算法在更大样本规模下仍保持正确性。
tldr: This paper presents a generic method for learning state machines from data streams, along with a merge heuristic for incomplete prefix trees, with formal PAC analysis and runtime improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从数据流中学习状态机的通用方法，以及一种用于处理不完整前缀树的合并启发式算法，并提供了形式化的PAC分析和运行时间改进。

title: On the Role of Depth in the Expressivity of RNNs
summary: The benefits of depth in feedforward neural networks are well known: composing multiple layers of linear transformations with nonlinear activations enables complex computations. While similar effects are expected in recurrent neural networks (RNNs), it remains unclear how depth interacts with recurrence to shape expressive power. Here, we formally show that depth increases RNNs' memory capacity efficiently with respect to the number of parameters, thus enhancing expressivity both by enabling more complex input transformations and improving the retention of past information. We broaden our analysis to 2RNNs, a generalization of RNNs with multiplicative interactions between inputs and hidden states. Unlike RNNs, which remain linear without nonlinear activations, 2RNNs perform polynomial transformations whose maximal degree grows with depth. We further show that multiplicative interactions cannot, in general, be replaced by layerwise nonlinearities. Finally, we validate these insights empirically on synthetic and real-world tasks.
summary_zh: 前馈神经网络中深度的优势已广为人知：将线性变换与非线性激活函数的多层组合能够实现复杂的计算。尽管在循环神经网络（RNN）中预期存在类似效果，但深度如何与循环结构相互作用以塑造表达能力仍不明确。本文通过形式化证明表明，深度能有效提升RNN的记忆容量（相对于参数数量而言），从而既增强了输入变换的复杂性，又改善了对历史信息的保留能力。我们将分析拓展至2RNN——一种在输入与隐藏状态间引入乘法交互的RNN推广模型。不同于缺乏非线性激活时保持线性的传统RNN，2RNN可执行多项式变换，其最大阶数随深度增长。我们进一步证明乘法交互通常无法通过逐层非线性替代。最后，我们通过合成任务与真实场景任务对这些理论洞见进行了实证验证。
tldr: This theoretical paper analyzes the role of depth and multiplicative interactions in enhancing the expressivity and memory capacity of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and 2RNNs, with empirical validation.
tldr_zh: 这篇理论性论文分析了深度和乘法交互在增强循环神经网络（RNN）和2RNN的表达能力和记忆容量中的作用，并进行了实证验证。

title: AEGIS: Adversarial Entropy-Guided Immune System -- Thermodynamic State Space Models for Zero-Day Network Evasion Detection
summary: As TLS 1.3 encryption limits traditional Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), the security community has pivoted to Euclidean Transformer-based classifiers (e.g., ET-BERT) for encrypted traffic analysis. However, these models remain vulnerable to byte-level adversarial morphing -- recent pre-padding attacks reduced ET-BERT accuracy to 25.68%, while VLESS Reality bypasses certificate-based detection entirely. We introduce AEGIS: an Adversarial Entropy-Guided Immune System powered by a Thermodynamic Variance-Guided Hyperbolic Liquid State Space Model (TVD-HL-SSM). Rather than competing in the Euclidean payload-reading domain, AEGIS discards payload bytes in favor of 6-dimensional continuous-time flow physics projected into a non-Euclidean Poincare manifold. Liquid Time-Constants measure microsecond IAT decay, and a Thermodynamic Variance Detector computes sequence-wide Shannon Entropy to expose automated C2 tunnel anomalies. A pure C++ eBPF Harvester with zero-copy IPC bypasses the Python GIL, enabling a linear-time O(N) Mamba-3 core to process 64,000-packet swarms at line-rate. Evaluated on a 400GB, 4-tier adversarial corpus spanning backbone traffic, IoT botnets, zero-days, and proprietary VLESS Reality tunnels, AEGIS achieves an F1-score of 0.9952 and 99.50% True Positive Rate at 262 us inference latency on an RTX 4090, establishing a new state-of-the-art for physics-based adversarial network defense.
summary_zh: 随着TLS 1.3加密技术限制了传统深度数据包检测（DPI）的应用，安全领域已转向基于欧几里得变换分类器（如ET-BERT）进行加密流量分析。然而，这些模型仍易受字节级对抗性变异攻击——近期预填充攻击将ET-BERT准确率降至25.68%，而VLESS Reality协议则完全绕过了基于证书的检测。本文提出AEGIS：一种基于对抗性熵引导的免疫系统，其核心为热力学方差引导的双曲液态状态空间模型（TVD-HL-SSM）。与在欧几里得负载解析领域竞争不同，AEGIS舍弃载荷字节，转而在六维连续时间流物理量投影至非欧几里得庞加莱流形上实现检测。液态时间常数测量微秒级到达间隔衰减，热力学方差检测器通过计算序列级香农熵揭示自动化C2隧道异常。纯C++编写的eBPF采集器采用零拷贝进程间通信绕过Python全局解释器锁，使线性时间复杂度O(N)的Mamba-3核心能以线速处理64000个数据包群组。在涵盖骨干流量、物联网僵尸网络、零日攻击及私有VLESS Reality隧道的400GB四级对抗语料库测试中，AEGIS在RTX 4090上实现262微秒推理延迟，取得0.9952的F1分数与99.50%真阳性率，为基于物理学的对抗性网络防御确立了全新性能基准。
tldr: This paper proposes AEGIS, a physics-based adversarial network defense system for encrypted traffic analysis using novel thermodynamic state space models, achieving state-of-the-art detection on an adversarial network corpus.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AEGIS，一种基于物理的对抗性网络防御系统，利用新型热力学状态空间模型分析加密流量，在对抗性网络数据集上实现了最先进的检测性能。

title: Demographic Parity Tails for Regression
summary: Demographic parity (DP) is a widely studied fairness criterion in regression, enforcing independence between the predictions and sensitive attributes. However, constraining the entire distribution can degrade predictive accuracy and may be unnecessary for many applications, where fairness concerns are localized to specific regions of the distribution. To overcome this issue, we propose a new framework for regression under DP that focuses on the tails of target distribution across sensitive groups. Our methodology builds on optimal transport theory. By enforcing fairness constraints only over targeted regions of the distribution, our approach enables more nuanced and context-sensitive interventions. Leveraging recent advances, we develop an interpretable and flexible algorithm that leverages the geometric structure of optimal transport. We provide theoretical guarantees, including risk bounds and fairness properties, and validate the method through experiments in regression settings.
summary_zh: 人口统计公平性（DP）是回归分析中广泛研究的公平性准则，它要求预测结果与敏感属性之间相互独立。然而，约束整个分布可能会降低预测准确性，且对于许多应用而言并非必要，因为这些应用中的公平性关注点通常集中在分布的特定区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种在DP约束下进行回归的新框架，该框架重点关注敏感群体间目标分布的尾部情况。我们的方法建立在最优传输理论基础上。通过仅对分布的目标区域施加公平性约束，我们的方法能够实现更细致、更贴合具体情境的干预。借助最新进展，我们开发了一种可解释且灵活的算法，该算法利用了最优传输的几何结构。我们提供了理论保证，包括风险界和公平性性质，并通过回归场景下的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a new fairness framework for regression that focuses on demographic parity constraints only in the tails of the target distribution, using optimal transport theory.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的回归公平性框架，仅关注目标分布尾部的群体平等性约束，并基于最优传输理论构建方法。

title: Apriel-Reasoner: RL Post-Training for General-Purpose and Efficient Reasoning
summary: Building general-purpose reasoning models using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) across diverse domains has been widely adopted by frontier open-weight models. However, their training recipes and domain mixtures are often not disclosed. Joint optimization across domains poses significant challenges: domains vary widely in rollout length, problem difficulty and sample efficiency. Further, models with long chain-of-thought traces increase inference cost and latency, making efficiency critical for practical deployment. We present Apriel-Reasoner, trained with a fully reproducible multi-domain RL post-training recipe on Apriel-Base, a 15B-parameter open-weight LLM, across five domains using public datasets: mathematics, code generation, instruction following, logical puzzles and function calling. We introduce an adaptive domain sampling mechanism that preserves target domain ratios despite heterogeneous rollout dynamics, and a difficulty-aware extension of the standard length penalty that, with no additional training overhead, encourages longer reasoning for difficult problems and shorter traces for easy ones. Trained with a strict 16K-token output budget, Apriel-Reasoner generalizes to 32K tokens at inference and improves over Apriel-Base on AIME 2025, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and LiveCodeBench while producing 30-50% shorter reasoning traces. It matches strong open-weight models of similar size at lower token cost, thereby pushing the Pareto frontier of accuracy versus token budget.
summary_zh: 构建通用推理模型已成为前沿开源模型的主流方法，通常采用基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行跨领域训练。然而，这些模型的训练方案与领域混合策略往往不公开。跨领域联合优化面临显著挑战：不同领域在任务执行长度、问题难度和样本效率上存在巨大差异。此外，具有长链思维推理轨迹的模型会增加推理成本与延迟，使得效率成为实际部署的关键因素。我们提出Apriel-Reasoner模型，该模型基于150亿参数的开源基础模型Apriel-Base，使用公开数据集在数学、代码生成、指令遵循、逻辑谜题和函数调用五个领域上，采用完全可复现的多领域强化学习后训练方案进行训练。我们引入了一种自适应领域采样机制，能够在异构任务执行动态下保持目标领域比例；同时提出难度感知的标准长度惩罚扩展方法，无需额外训练开销即可鼓励模型对难题进行更长的推理，对简单问题生成更短的推理轨迹。在严格的16K token输出预算下训练后，Apriel-Reasoner在推理时能泛化至32K token长度，在AIME 2025、GPQA、MMLU-Pro和LiveCodeBench基准测试中超越Apriel-Base，同时生成缩短30-50%的推理轨迹。该模型以更低的token消耗匹配了同规模优秀开源模型的性能，从而在准确率与token预算的帕累托边界上实现了突破。
tldr: Presents a multi-domain RL post-training method for improving reasoning efficiency and accuracy in an LLM, focusing on tasks like math, code, and puzzles.
tldr_zh: 提出一种多领域RL后训练方法，用于提高LLM在数学、代码和谜题等任务中的推理效率和准确性。

title: Homogenized Transformers
summary: We study a random model of deep multi-head self-attention in which the weights are resampled independently across layers and heads, as at initialization of training. Viewing depth as a time variable, the residual stream defines a discrete-time interacting particle system on the unit sphere. We prove that, under suitable joint scalings of the depth, the residual step size, and the number of heads, this dynamics admits a nontrivial homogenized limit. Depending on the scaling, the limit is either deterministic or stochastic with common noise; in the mean-field regime, the latter leads to a stochastic nonlinear Fokker--Planck equation for the conditional law of a representative token. In the Gaussian setting, the limiting drift vanishes, making the homogenized dynamics explicit enough to study representation collapse. This yields quantitative trade-offs between dimension, context length, and temperature, and identifies regimes in which clustering can be mitigated.
summary_zh: 我们研究一种深层多头自注意力的随机模型，其中权重在训练初始化时以各层和各头之间独立重采样的方式设置。将深度视为时间变量，残差流在单位球面上定义了一个离散时间交互粒子系统。我们证明，在深度、残差步长和头数适当的联合缩放条件下，该动力学存在非平凡的均匀化极限。根据缩放方式的不同，极限可能是确定性的，也可能是具有公共噪声的随机过程；在平均场机制下，后者导出了一个描述代表性令牌条件分布的非线性随机福克-普朗克方程。在高斯设置中，极限漂移项消失，使得均匀化动力学足够显式化，从而可以研究表示崩溃现象。这揭示了维度、上下文长度和温度之间的量化权衡关系，并识别出能够缓解聚类现象的参数区域。
tldr: A theoretical analysis of deep multi-head self-attention using a random model and stochastic dynamics, deriving homogenized limits and studying representation collapse in transformers.
tldr_zh: 使用随机模型和随机动力学对深度多头自注意力进行理论分析，推导出齐次化极限并研究Transformer中的表征崩溃问题。

title: Generalization Bounds and Statistical Guarantees for Multi-Task and Multiple Operator Learning with MNO Networks
summary: Multiple operator learning concerns learning operator families $\{G[α]:U\to V\}_{α\in W}$ indexed by an operator descriptor $α$. Training data are collected hierarchically by sampling operator instances $α$, then input functions $u$ per instance, and finally evaluation points $x$ per input, yielding noisy observations of $G[α][u](x)$. While recent work has developed expressive multi-task and multiple operator learning architectures and approximation-theoretic scaling laws, quantitative statistical generalization guarantees remain limited. We provide a covering-number-based generalization analysis for separable models, focusing on the Multiple Neural Operator (MNO) architecture: we first derive explicit metric-entropy bounds for hypothesis classes given by linear combinations of products of deep ReLU subnetworks, and then combine these complexity bounds with approximation guarantees for MNO to obtain an explicit approximation-estimation tradeoff for the expected test error on new (unseen) triples $(α,u,x)$. The resulting bound makes the dependence on the hierarchical sampling budgets $(n_α,n_u,n_x)$ transparent and yields an explicit learning-rate statement in the operator-sampling budget $n_α$, providing a sample-complexity characterization for generalization across operator instances. The structure and architecture can also be viewed as a general purpose solver or an example of a "small'' PDE foundation model, where the triples are one form of multi-modality.
summary_zh: 多重算子学习涉及学习由算子描述符$α$索引的算子族$\{G[α]:U\to V\}_{α\in W}$。训练数据通过分层采样收集：先采样算子实例$α$，再为每个实例采样输入函数$u$，最后为每个输入采样评估点$x$，从而获得$G[α][u](x)$的含噪声观测值。尽管近期研究已发展出表达能力强的多任务与多重算子学习架构及逼近理论尺度律，但定量的统计泛化保证仍较为有限。我们针对可分离模型进行了基于覆盖数的泛化分析，聚焦于多重神经算子（MNO）架构：首先推导了由深度ReLU子网络乘积线性组合构成的假设类显式度量熵界，随后将这些复杂度界与MNO的逼近保证相结合，从而获得新（未见）三元组$(α,u,x)$上期望测试误差的显式逼近-估计权衡关系。所得界限清晰展现了与分层采样预算$(n_α,n_u,n_x)$的依赖关系，并在算子采样预算$n_α$中给出了显式学习率表述，为跨算子实例的泛化提供了样本复杂度表征。该结构与架构亦可视为通用求解器或“小型”PDE基础模型的一种示例，其中三元组是多模态的一种形式。
tldr: This paper provides statistical generalization bounds for multi-task operator learning, specifically for the Multiple Neural Operator architecture, analyzing the sample complexity of learning families of operators from hierarchical data.
tldr_zh: 本文为多任务算子学习提供了统计泛化边界，针对多重神经算子架构，分析了从分层数据中学习算子族的样本复杂度。

title: annbatch unlocks terabyte-scale training of biological data in anndata
summary: The scale of biological datasets now routinely exceeds system memory, making data access rather than model computation the primary bottleneck in training machine-learning models. This bottleneck is particularly acute in biology, where widely used community data formats must support heterogeneous metadata, sparse and dense assays, and downstream analysis within established computational ecosystems. Here we present annbatch, a mini-batch loader native to anndata that enables out-of-core training directly on disk-backed datasets. Across single-cell transcriptomics, microscopy and whole-genome sequencing benchmarks, annbatch increases loading throughput by up to an order of magnitude and shortens training from days to hours, while remaining fully compatible with the scverse ecosystem. Annbatch establishes a practical data-loading infrastructure for scalable biological AI, allowing increasingly large and diverse datasets to be used without abandoning standard biological data formats. Github: https://github.com/scverse/annbatch
summary_zh: 生物数据集的规模现已常规性地超出系统内存容量，使得数据访问而非模型计算成为训练机器学习模型的主要瓶颈。这一瓶颈在生物学领域尤为突出，因为该领域广泛使用的社区数据格式必须支持异构元数据、稀疏与密集的检测数据，并能在现有计算生态系统中进行下游分析。本文提出annbatch——一种基于anndata原生构建的小批量数据加载器，能够直接在磁盘存储的数据集上实现核外训练。在单细胞转录组学、显微成像和全基因组测序的基准测试中，annbatch将数据加载吞吐量提升至一个数量级，并将训练时间从数天缩短至数小时，同时保持与scverse生态系统的完全兼容性。Annbatch为可扩展的生物人工智能建立了实用的数据加载基础设施，使得在不放弃标准生物数据格式的前提下，能够充分利用日益庞大且多样化的数据集。项目地址：https://github.com/scverse/annbatch
tldr: Annbatch is a mini-batch loader for anndata that enables out-of-core training on disk-backed biological datasets, significantly improving data loading throughput and reducing training time for large-scale biological AI applications.
tldr_zh: Annbatch是一个针对anndata的小批量数据加载器，它支持在磁盘数据上进行外存训练，显著提高了生物数据处理吞吐量，缩短了训练时间，适用于大规模生物人工智能应用。

title: PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning
summary: Estimating optimal individualized treatment rules (ITRs) via outcome weighted learning (OWL) often relies on observed rewards that are noisy or optimistic proxies for the true latent utility. Ignoring this reward uncertainty leads to the selection of policies with inflated apparent performance, yet existing OWL frameworks lack the finite-sample guarantees required to systematically embed such uncertainty into the learning objective. To address this issue, we propose PAC-Bayesian Reward-Certified Outcome Weighted Learning (PROWL). Given a one-sided uncertainty certificate, PROWL constructs a conservative reward and a strictly policy-dependent lower bound on the true expected value. Theoretically, we prove an exact certified reduction that transforms robust policy learning into a unified, split-free cost-sensitive classification task. This formulation enables the derivation of a nonasymptotic PAC-Bayes lower bound for randomized ITRs, where we establish that the optimal posterior maximizing this bound is exactly characterized by a general Bayes update. To overcome the learning-rate selection problem inherent in generalized Bayesian inference, we introduce a fully automated, bounds-based calibration procedure, coupled with a Fisher-consistent certified hinge surrogate for efficient optimization. Our experiments demonstrate that PROWL achieves improvements in estimating robust, high-value treatment regimes under severe reward uncertainty compared to standard methods for ITR estimation.
summary_zh: 估计最优个体化治疗规则（ITR）常通过结果加权学习（OWL）实现，其依赖的观测奖励往往是对真实潜在效用的噪声或乐观估计。忽略奖励不确定性会导致选择看似性能优异但实际效果被夸大的策略，而现有的OWL框架缺乏将此类不确定性系统嵌入学习目标的有限样本保证。为解决这一问题，我们提出PAC-贝叶斯奖励认证结果加权学习（PROWL）。在给定单侧不确定性证书的前提下，PROWL构建了保守奖励值并针对真实期望值给出了严格依赖策略的下界。理论上，我们证明了精确的认证约简方法，能将鲁棒策略学习转化为统一、无拆分的成本敏感分类任务。该框架支持推导随机化ITR的非渐近PAC-贝叶斯下界，并证明该下界的最大化最优后验分布可通过广义贝叶斯更新精确刻画。针对广义贝叶斯推断中固有的学习率选择问题，我们提出完全自动化的基于边界的校准流程，并结合具有费希尔一致性的认证铰链替代损失函数以实现高效优化。实验结果表明，在严重奖励不确定性条件下，相较于传统ITR估计方法，PROWL在估计鲁棒高价值治疗方案方面取得了显著改进。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for learning individualized treatment rules that accounts for reward uncertainty, providing theoretical guarantees and automated calibration, but it is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种考虑奖励不确定性的个体化治疗规则学习方法，提供了理论保证和自动校准，但与机器人或具身AI无直接关联。

title: Dual-Attention Based 3D Channel Estimation
summary: For multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) channels, the optimal channel estimation (CE) based on linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) requires three-dimensional (3D) filtering. However, the complexity is often prohibitive due to large matrix dimensions. Suboptimal estimators approximate 3DCE by decomposing it into time, frequency, and spatial domains, while yields noticeable performance degradation under correlated MIMO channels. On the other hand, recent advances in deep learning (DL) can explore channel correlations in all domains via attention mechanisms. Building on this capability, we propose a dual attention mechanism based 3DCE network (3DCENet) that can achieve accurate estimates.
summary_zh: 在多输入多输出（MIMO）信道中，基于线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）的最优信道估计（CE）需要三维（3D）滤波。然而，由于矩阵维度较大，其计算复杂度通常难以承受。次优估计器通过将三维信道估计分解为时间、频率和空间域来逼近最优解，但在相关MIMO信道下会导致明显的性能下降。另一方面，深度学习（DL）的最新进展能够通过注意力机制探索所有域的信道相关性。基于此能力，我们提出一种基于双注意力机制的三维信道估计网络（3DCENet），该网络能够实现准确的信道估计。
tldr: Proposes a deep learning network (3DCENet) with a dual attention mechanism for accurate 3D channel estimation in MIMO systems, addressing the complexity of optimal filtering.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于双重注意力机制的深度学习网络（3DCENet），用于准确估计MIMO系统中的三维信道，以解决最优滤波器的复杂度问题。

title: Label Shift Estimation With Incremental Prior Update
summary: An assumption often made in supervised learning is that the training and testing sets have the same label distribution. However, in real-life scenarios, this assumption rarely holds. For example, medical diagnosis result distributions change over time and across locations; fraud detection models must adapt as patterns of fraudulent activity shift; the category distribution of social media posts changes based on trending topics and user demographics. In the task of label shift estimation, the goal is to estimate the changing label distribution $p_t(y)$ in the testing set, assuming the likelihood $p(x|y)$ does not change, implying no concept drift. In this paper, we propose a new approach for post-hoc label shift estimation, unlike previous methods that perform moment matching with confusion matrix estimated from a validation set or maximize the likelihood of the new data with an expectation-maximization algorithm. We aim to incrementally update the prior on each sample, adjusting each posterior for more accurate label shift estimation. The proposed method is based on intuitive assumptions on classifiers that are generally true for modern probabilistic classifiers. The proposed method relies on a weaker notion of calibration compared to other methods. As a post-hoc approach for label shift estimation, the proposed method is versatile and can be applied to any black-box probabilistic classifier. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and MNIST show that the proposed method consistently outperforms the current state-of-the-art maximum likelihood-based methods under different calibrations and varying intensities of label shift.
summary_zh: 在监督学习中，通常假设训练集和测试集具有相同的标签分布。然而，在现实场景中，这一假设很少成立。例如，医学诊断结果的分布会随着时间和地点变化而变化；欺诈检测模型必须随着欺诈活动模式的转变而调整；社交媒体帖子的类别分布则受热门话题和用户人口特征的影响而动态变化。在标签偏移估计任务中，我们的目标是在假设似然函数 \(p(x|y)\) 不发生变化（即不存在概念漂移）的前提下，估计测试集中变化的标签分布 \(p_t(y)\)。本文提出了一种新的后验标签偏移估计方法，该方法不同于以往基于验证集估计混淆矩阵进行矩匹配、或通过期望最大化算法最大化新数据似然的方法。我们旨在对每个样本的先验进行增量更新，调整每个后验分布以实现更准确的标签偏移估计。所提方法基于对分类器的直观假设，这些假设对于现代概率分类器通常成立。与其他方法相比，该方法仅需依赖较弱的校准概念。作为一种后验标签偏移估计方法，本方法具有通用性，可适用于任何黑盒概率分类器。在CIFAR-10和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，在不同校准程度和不同强度的标签偏移下，本方法始终优于当前最先进的基于最大似然估计的方法。
tldr: Proposes a post-hoc method for estimating label distribution shifts in test data by incrementally updating prior probabilities for each sample, assuming a stable likelihood function.
tldr_zh: 提出一种事后标签偏移估计方法，通过为每个样本增量更新先验概率来估计测试数据中的标签分布变化，假设似然函数保持稳定。

title: Pseudo-Quantized Actor-Critic Algorithm for Robustness to Noisy Temporal Difference Error
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal difference (TD) errors are widely adopted for optimizing value and policy functions. However, since the TD error is defined by a bootstrap method, its computation tends to be noisy and destabilize learning. Heuristics to improve the accuracy of TD errors, such as target networks and ensemble models, have been introduced so far. While these are essential approaches for the current deep RL algorithms, they cause side effects like increased computational cost and reduced learning efficiency. Therefore, this paper revisits the TD learning algorithm based on control as inference, deriving a novel algorithm capable of robust learning against noisy TD errors. First, the distribution model of optimality, a binary random variable, is represented by a sigmoid function. Alongside forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler divergences, this new model derives a robust learning rule: when the sigmoid function saturates with a large TD error probably due to noise, the gradient vanishes, implicitly excluding it from learning. Furthermore, the two divergences exhibit distinct gradient-vanishing characteristics. Building on these analyses, the optimality is decomposed into multiple levels to achieve pseudo-quantization of TD errors, aiming for further noise reduction. Additionally, a Jensen-Shannon divergence-based approach is approximately derived to inherit the characteristics of both divergences. These benefits are verified through RL benchmarks, demonstrating stable learning even when heuristics are insufficient or rewards contain noise.
summary_zh: 在强化学习中，时序差分误差被广泛用于优化价值与策略函数。然而，由于时序差分误差通过自举法定义，其计算往往存在噪声且易导致学习过程不稳定。迄今为止，学界已提出多种启发式方法来提升时序差分误差的精确度，例如目标网络与集成模型。尽管这些方法是当前深度强化学习算法的核心组成部分，但也会引发计算成本增加与学习效率降低等副作用。因此，本文基于推断控制框架重新审视时序差分学习算法，推导出一种能够对噪声时序差分误差实现鲁棒学习的新算法。首先，通过Sigmoid函数表示二元随机变量——最优性分布模型。结合前向与反向KL散度，该模型导出一个鲁棒学习规则：当Sigmoid函数因时序差分误差较大（可能由噪声引起）而趋于饱和时，梯度将消失，从而隐式地将该误差排除在学习过程之外。此外，两种散度表现出不同的梯度消失特性。基于这些分析，通过将最优性分解为多层级以实现时序差分误差的伪量化，从而进一步降低噪声影响。此外，本文还近似推导了基于Jensen-Shannon散度的方法，以兼具两种散度的特性。通过在强化学习基准测试中的验证，这些优势得到证实：即使在启发式方法不足或奖励存在噪声的情况下，该算法仍能保持稳定的学习性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a pseudo-quantized actor-critic RL algorithm designed to improve robustness against noisy TD errors by leveraging insights from control as inference and a novel distribution model of optimality, which induces gradient vanishing for large, likely noisy errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种伪量化演员-评论家强化学习算法，通过基于控制即推理的推导和一种新的最优性分布模型来提高对噪声TD误差的鲁棒性，使大的、可能由噪声引起的误差梯度消失，从而被排除在学习之外。

title: Variational LSTM with Augmented Inputs: Nonlinear Response History Metamodeling with Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty
summary: Uncertainty propagation in high-dimensional nonlinear dynamic structural systems is pivotal in state-of-the-art performance-based design and risk assessment, where uncertainties from both excitations and structures, i.e., the aleatoric uncertainty, must be considered. This poses a significant challenge due to heavy computational demands. Machine learning techniques are thus introduced as metamodels to alleviate this burden. However, the "black box" nature of Machine learning models underscores the necessity of avoiding overly confident predictions, particularly when data and training efforts are insufficient. This creates a need, in addition to considering the aleatoric uncertainty, of estimating the uncertainty related to the prediction confidence, i.e., epistemic uncertainty, for machine learning-based metamodels. We developed a probabilistic metamodeling technique based on a variational long short-term memory (LSTM) with augmented inputs to simultaneously capture aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties. Key random system parameters are treated as augmented inputs alongside excitation series carrying record-to-record variability to capture the full range of aleatoric uncertainty. Meanwhile, epistemic uncertainty is effectively approximated via the Monte Carlo dropout scheme. Unlike computationally expensive full Bayesian approaches, this method incurs negligible additional training costs while enabling nearly cost-free uncertainty simulation. The proposed technique is demonstrated through multiple case studies involving stochastic seismic or wind excitations. Results show that the calibrated metamodels accurately reproduce nonlinear response time histories and provide confidence bounds indicating the associated epistemic uncertainty.
summary_zh: 高维非线性动力结构系统中的不确定性传播在基于性能的先进设计与风险评估中至关重要，需同时考虑来自激励与结构本身的不确定性，即随机不确定性。由于巨大的计算需求，这带来了重大挑战。机器学习技术因此被引入作为元模型以减轻此负担。然而，机器学习模型的“黑箱”特性凸显了避免过度自信预测的必要性，尤其是在数据与训练资源不足的情况下。这催生了除随机不确定性外，还需对基于机器学习的元模型估计与预测置信度相关的不确定性，即认知不确定性的需求。我们开发了一种基于变分长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的概率元建模技术，通过增强输入同时捕捉随机与认知不确定性。关键的随机系统参数与携带记录间变异性的激励序列共同作为增强输入，以全面捕捉随机不确定性；同时，认知不确定性通过蒙特卡洛丢弃方案得到有效近似。与计算成本高昂的完全贝叶斯方法不同，该方法仅增加极少的额外训练成本，同时可实现近乎无成本的不确定性模拟。通过多个涉及随机地震或风激励的案例研究，验证了所提技术的有效性。结果表明，校准后的元模型能够准确复现非线性响应时程，并提供反映认知不确定性的置信区间。
tldr: The paper proposes a probabilistic metamodeling technique using a variational LSTM with augmented inputs to capture both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties in nonlinear dynamic structural systems, such as buildings under seismic or wind loads.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于变分LSTM的概率元建模技术，通过增强输入来捕捉非线性动态结构系统（如地震或风荷载下的建筑）中的随机和认知不确定性。

title: A Determinantal Approach to a Sharp $\ell^1-\ell^\infty-\ell^2$ Norm Inequality
summary: We give a short linear--algebraic proof of the inequality \[ \|x\|_1\,\|x\|_\infty \le \frac{1+\sqrt{p}}{2}\,\|x\|_2^2, \] valid for every \(x\in\mathbb{R}^p\). This inequality relates three fundamental norms on finite-dimensional spaces and has applications in optimization and numerical analysis. Our proof exploits the determinantal structure of a parametrized family of quadratic forms, and we show the constant $(1+\sqrt{p})/2$ is optimal.
summary_zh: 我们针对所有 \(x\in\mathbb{R}^p\)，给出了不等式 \[ \|x\|_1\,\|x\|_\infty \le \frac{1+\sqrt{p}}{2}\,\|x\|_2^2 \] 的一个简短线性代数证明。该不等式关联了有限维空间上的三种基本范数，并在优化和数值分析中具有应用。我们的证明利用了一个参数化二次型族的行列式结构，并证明了常数 $(1+\sqrt{p})/2$ 是最优的。
tldr: This paper presents a short linear-algebraic proof for a sharp inequality relating three fundamental vector norms, with applications in optimization and numerical analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种简洁的线性代数证明，用于建立关于三个基本向量范数的尖锐不等式，并在优化和数值分析中有应用。

title: Beyond Logit Adjustment: A Residual Decomposition Framework for Long-Tailed Reranking
summary: Long-tailed classification, where a small number of frequent classes dominate many rare ones, remains challenging because models systematically favor frequent classes at inference time. Existing post-hoc methods such as logit adjustment address this by adding a fixed classwise offset to the base-model logits. However, the correction required to restore the relative ranking of two classes need not be constant across inputs, and a fixed offset cannot adapt to such variation. We study this problem through Bayes-optimal reranking on a base-model top-k shortlist. The gap between the optimal score and the base score, the residual correction, decomposes into a classwise component that is constant within each class, and a pairwise component that depends on the input and competing labels. When the residual is purely classwise, a fixed offset suffices to recover the Bayes-optimal ordering. We further show that when the same label pair induces incompatible ordering constraints across contexts, no fixed offset can achieve this recovery. This decomposition leads to testable predictions regarding when pairwise correction can improve performance and when cannot. We develop REPAIR (Reranking via Pairwise residual correction), a lightweight post-hoc reranker that combines a shrinkage-stabilized classwise term with a linear pairwise term driven by competition features on the shortlist. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning image classification, species recognition, scene recognition, and rare disease diagnosis confirm that the decomposition explains where pairwise correction helps and where classwise correction alone suffices.
summary_zh: 长尾分类问题中，少数常见类别主导大量罕见类别的现象依然具有挑战性，因为模型在推理时系统性地偏向常见类别。现有的后处理方法（如logit调整）通过对基础模型logit添加固定的类间偏移来解决此问题。然而，恢复两个类别相对排序所需的修正量并非在所有输入中保持恒定，固定偏移无法适应这种变化。我们通过基础模型top-k候选列表上的贝叶斯最优重排序研究该问题。最优得分与基础得分之间的差距——残差修正——可分解为每个类别内保持恒定的类间分量，以及依赖于输入和竞争标签的成对分量。当残差仅为类间分量时，固定偏移足以恢复贝叶斯最优排序。我们进一步证明，当同一标签对在不同上下文中引发矛盾的排序约束时，任何固定偏移都无法实现这种恢复。该分解引出了关于成对修正何时能提升性能、何时不能的可检验预测。我们开发了REPAIR（通过成对残差修正的重排序器），这是一种轻量级后处理重排序器，它将收缩稳定的类间项与由候选列表竞争特征驱动的线性成对项相结合。在图像分类、物种识别、场景识别和罕见疾病诊断五个基准测试上的实验证实，该分解能够解释成对修正何时有效，以及何时仅需类间修正即可。
tldr: This paper proposes a residual decomposition framework for long-tailed classification, introducing a lightweight post-hoc reranker that combines classwise and pairwise corrections to improve ranking accuracy, evaluated on image classification and related tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于长尾分类的残差分解框架，引入了一种轻量级的事后重排序器，结合了类间和成对校正以提高排名准确性，并在图像分类及相关任务上进行了评估。

title: Non-monotonicity in Conformal Risk Control
summary:
Conformal risk control (CRC) provides distribution-free guarantees for controlling the expected loss at a user-specified level. Existing theory typically assumes that the loss decreases monotonically with a tuning parameter that governs the size of the prediction set. This assumption is often violated in practice, where losses may behave non-monotonically due to competing objectives such as coverage and efficiency.
  We study CRC under non-monotone loss functions when the tuning parameter is selected from a finite grid, a common scenario in thresholding or discretized decision rules. Revisiting a known counterexample, we show that the validity of CRC without monotonicity depends on the relationship between the calibration sample size and the grid resolution. In particular, risk control can still be achieved when the calibration sample is sufficiently large relative to the grid.
  We provide a finite-sample guarantee for bounded losses over a grid of size $m$, showing that the excess risk above the target level $α$ is of order $\sqrt{\log(m)/n}$, where $n$ is the calibration sample size. A matching lower bound shows that this rate is minimax optimal. We also derive refined guarantees under additional structural conditions, including Lipschitz continuity and monotonicity, and extend the analysis to settings with distribution shift via importance weighting.
  Numerical experiments on synthetic multilabel classification and real object detection data illustrate the practical impact of non-monotonicity. Methods that account for finite-sample deviations achieve more stable risk control than approaches based on monotonicity transformations, while maintaining competitive prediction-set sizes.
summary_zh:
保形风险控制（CRC）能够在无需分布假设的前提下，以用户指定的水平对期望损失提供控制保证。现有理论通常假设损失会随着调控预测集大小的调谐参数单调递减，但在实际应用中这一假设往往不成立：由于覆盖率与效率等目标之间的相互制约，损失可能呈现非单调性。

本文研究了在调谐参数从有限网格中选取时（常见于阈值化或离散化决策规则场景），非单调损失函数下的保形风险控制问题。通过重新审视一个已知的反例，我们证明了在非单调条件下CRC的有效性取决于校准样本量与网格分辨率之间的关系。具体而言，当校准样本量相对于网格足够大时，仍可实现风险控制。

针对规模为$m$的网格上的有界损失，我们给出了有限样本保证，证明超出目标水平$α$的额外风险量级为$\sqrt{\log(m)/n}$，其中$n$为校准样本量。匹配下界表明该速率是极小化极大最优的。我们还在李普希茨连续性与单调性等附加结构条件下推导了更精细的保证，并通过重要性加权将分析扩展到存在分布偏移的场景。

在合成多标签分类和真实目标检测数据上的数值实验揭示了非单调性的实际影响。相较于基于单调性变换的方法，考虑有限样本偏差的方法能够实现更稳定的风险控制，同时保持具有竞争力的预测集规模。
tldr: This paper analyzes the theoretical guarantees of conformal risk control when the loss function is non-monotonic, providing finite-sample bounds and optimality results for the case where the tuning parameter is selected from a finite grid.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了当损失函数非单调时，对风险控制的理论保证，并针对从有限网格中选择调参参数的情况给出了有限样本界限和最优性结果。

title: The topological gap at criticality: scaling exponent d + η, universality, and scope
summary: The topological gap $Δ= TP_{H_1}^{real} - TP_{H_1}^{shuf}$ -- the excess $H_1$ total persistence of the majority-spin alpha complex over a density-matched null -- encodes critical correlations in spin models. We establish finite-size scaling: $Δ(L,T) = A L^{d+η} G_-(L|t/T_c|)$, with $G_-(x) \sim (1+x/x_0)^{-(1+β/ν)}$. For 2D Ising, $α= 2.249 \pm 0.038$, matching $d+η= 9/4$ to $0.03σ$; the $G_-$ exponent $γ= 1.089 \pm 0.077$ is consistent with $1+β/ν= 9/8$ ($ΔR^2 < 10^{-5}$). For 2D Potts $q=3$ with $L$ up to 1024, $α= 2.272 \pm 0.024$ ($0.2σ$ from $d+η= 2.267$), with two-term corrections to scaling ($R^2 = 0.9999$). The $G_-$ exponent $γ= 1.114$ (68% CI $[1.053, 1.173]$) matches $1+β/ν= 17/15$. Scope boundaries: the law fails for 2D Potts $q=4$ ($α= 2.347 \pm 0.017$, $9.3σ$ from $d+η= 5/2$) where logarithmic corrections prevent convergence, and for raw 3D Ising ($4σ$ from $d+η$), but density normalization $Δ/|M|^{1/2}$ recovers $α= 3.06 \pm 0.04$ ($0.6σ$). The framework fails for first-order, BKT, and percolation. The criterion: $α= d+η$ holds when corrections to scaling are algebraic ($ω> 0$) but fails when logarithmic ($ω\to 0$).

tldr: This paper studies a topological gap quantity in spin models, analyzing its scaling properties and universality near critical points, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究自旋模型中的一个拓扑间隙量，分析其在临界点附近的标度性质和普适性，与机器人学或具身智能无直接关联。

title: Generative Profiling for Soft Real-Time Systems and its Applications to Resource Allocation
summary: Modern real-time systems require accurate characterization of task timing behavior to ensure predictable performance, particularly on complex hardware architectures. Existing methods, such as worst-case execution time analysis, often fail to capture the fine-grained timing behaviors of a task under varying resource contexts (e.g., an allocation of cache, memory bandwidth, and CPU frequency), which is necessary to achieve efficient resource utilization. In this paper, we introduce a novel generative profiling approach that synthesizes context-dependent, fine-grained timing profiles for real-time tasks, including those for unmeasured resource allocations. Our approach leverages a nonparametric, conditional multi-marginal Schrödinger Bridge (MSB) formulation to generate accurate execution profiles for unseen resource contexts, with maximum likelihood guarantees. We demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our approach through real-world benchmarks, and showcase its practical utility in a representative case study of adaptive multicore resource allocation for real-time systems.
summary_zh: 现代实时系统需要准确刻画任务的时间行为特性，以确保性能的可预测性，尤其是在复杂硬件架构上。现有方法如最坏情况执行时间分析，往往难以捕捉任务在不同资源上下文（如缓存分配、内存带宽和CPU频率）下的细粒度时间行为，而这种能力对于实现高效资源利用至关重要。本文提出一种创新的生成式分析方法，能够为实时任务合成具有上下文相关性的细粒度时间特征，包括针对未测量资源分配的预测。该方法采用非参数化、条件多边际薛定谔桥（MSB）模型，以最大似然保证为未见资源上下文生成精确的执行特征。我们通过实际基准测试验证了该方法的效率与有效性，并在一项具有代表性的实时系统自适应多核资源分配案例研究中展示了其实用价值。
tldr: This paper introduces a generative profiling method using a nonparametric, conditional multi-marginal Schrödinger Bridge to synthesize fine-grained timing profiles for real-time system tasks across different resource contexts, applied to adaptive multicore resource allocation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生成式分析方法，利用非参数条件多边际薛定谔桥来合成实时系统任务在不同资源上下文下的细粒度时间配置文件，并应用于自适应多核资源分配。

title: Know Your Streams: On the Conceptualization, Characterization, and Generation of Intentional Event Streams
summary: The shift toward IoT-enabled, sensor-driven systems has transformed how operational data is generated, favoring continuous, real-time event streams (ES) over static event logs. This evolution presents new challenges for Streaming Process Mining (SPM), which must cope with out-of-order events, concurrent activities, incomplete cases, and concept drifts. Yet, the evaluation of SPM algorithms remains rooted in outdated practices, relying on static logs or artificially streamified data that fail to reflect the complexities of real-world streams. To address this gap, we first perform a comprehensive review of data stream literature to identify stream characteristics currently not reflected in the SPM community. Next, we use this information to extend the conceptual foundation for ES. Finally, we propose Stream of Intent, a prototype generator to produce ES with specific features. Our evaluation shows excellence in producing reproducible, intentional ES for targeted benchmarking and adaptive algorithm development in SPM.
summary_zh: 转向物联网支持、传感器驱动的系统已改变了操作数据的生成方式，更倾向于采用连续、实时的事件流而非静态事件日志。这一发展为流式过程挖掘带来了新的挑战，必须应对无序事件、并发活动、不完整案例以及概念漂移等问题。然而，目前对流式过程挖掘算法的评估仍停留在过时的方法上，依赖静态日志或人工生成的流式数据，这些方法无法反映真实事件流的复杂性。为弥补这一不足，我们首先对数据流文献进行了全面回顾，识别出当前流式过程挖掘领域尚未体现的流式数据特征。随后，基于此信息扩展了事件流的概念基础。最后，我们提出了一种原型生成器——意图流，用于生成具有特定特征的事件流。评估结果表明，该系统在流式过程挖掘领域为针对性基准测试和自适应算法开发提供了卓越的可复现、具备特定意图的事件流生成能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for generating intentional event streams to better benchmark and develop Streaming Process Mining algorithms, addressing challenges like out-of-order events and concept drifts in IoT sensor data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个生成具有特定特征的、可复现的意图性事件流的框架，用于改进流式过程挖掘算法的基准测试和开发，针对物联网传感器数据中的乱序事件和概念漂移等挑战。

title: Improving Latent Generalization Using Test-time Compute
summary: Language Models (LMs) exhibit two distinct mechanisms for knowledge acquisition: in-weights learning (i.e., encoding information within the model weights) and in-context learning (ICL). Although these two modes offer complementary strengths, in-weights learning frequently struggles to facilitate deductive reasoning over the internalized knowledge. We characterize this limitation as a deficit in latent generalization, of which the reversal curse is one example. Conversely, in-context learning demonstrates highly robust latent generalization capabilities. To improve latent generalization from in-weights knowledge, prior approaches rely on train-time data augmentation, yet these techniques are task-specific, scale poorly, and fail to generalize to out-of-distribution knowledge. To overcome these shortcomings, this work studies how models can be taught to use test-time compute, or 'thinking', specifically to improve latent generalization. We use Reinforcement Learning (RL) from correctness feedback to train models to produce long chains-of-thought (CoTs) to improve latent generalization. Our experiments show that this thinking approach not only resolves many instances of latent generalization failures on in-distribution knowledge but also, unlike augmentation baselines, generalizes to new knowledge for which no RL was performed. Nevertheless, on pure reversal tasks, we find that thinking does not unlock direct knowledge inversion, but the generate-and-verify ability of thinking models enables them to get well above chance performance. The brittleness of factual self-verification means thinking models still remain well below the performance of in-context learning for this task. Overall, our results establish test-time thinking as a flexible and promising direction for improving the latent generalization of LMs.
summary_zh: 语言模型（LMs）展现出两种截然不同的知识获取机制：权重内学习（即在模型权重内编码信息）与上下文学习（ICL）。尽管这两种模式各有互补优势，但权重内学习往往难以促进对内部化知识的演绎推理。我们将这种局限性描述为潜在泛化能力的缺失，其中“逆转诅咒”即为一例。相比之下，上下文学习则表现出高度稳健的潜在泛化能力。为提升权重内知识的潜在泛化水平，现有方法依赖训练时的数据增强技术，但这些方法通常针对特定任务、可扩展性差，且难以泛化至分布外知识。为克服这些缺陷，本研究探讨如何教导模型利用测试时的计算资源（即“思考”）来专门提升潜在泛化能力。我们采用基于正确性反馈的强化学习（RL）训练模型，使其生成长链推理过程（CoTs）以增强潜在泛化。实验表明，这种思考方法不仅能解决分布内知识中大量潜在泛化失败的实例，而且与数据增强基线方法不同，还能泛化到未经强化学习训练的新知识领域。然而，在纯粹的反转任务中，我们发现思考并未直接实现知识逆向推导，但思考模型所具备的“生成-验证”能力使其表现显著优于随机猜测。由于事实自验证的脆弱性，思考模型在该任务上的表现仍远不及上下文学习。总体而言，我们的研究结果证实了测试时思考作为一种灵活且具有前景的方向，能够有效提升语言模型的潜在泛化能力。
tldr: The paper investigates using RL to train language models to produce long chains-of-thought at test time, aiming to improve their latent generalization from in-weights knowledge rather than relying solely on in-context learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究如何利用强化学习训练语言模型在测试时生成长思维链，旨在提升其从权重中学习的潜在泛化能力，而非仅依赖上下文学习。

title: Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal
summary: Modern LLMs scale at test-time, e.g. via repeated sampling, where inference cost grows with model size and the number of samples. This creates a trade-off that pretraining scaling laws, such as Chinchilla, do not address. We present Train-to-Test ($T^2$) scaling laws that jointly optimize model size, training tokens, and number of inference samples under fixed end-to-end budgets. $T^2$ modernizes pretraining scaling laws with pass@$k$ modeling used for test-time scaling, then jointly optimizes pretraining and test-time decisions. Forecasts from $T^2$ are robust over distinct modeling approaches: measuring joint scaling effect on the task loss and modeling impact on task accuracy. Across eight downstream tasks, we find that when accounting for inference cost, optimal pretraining decisions shift radically into the overtraining regime, well-outside of the range of standard pretraining scaling suites. We validate our results by pretraining heavily overtrained models in the optimal region that $T^2$ scaling forecasts, confirming their substantially stronger performance compared to pretraining scaling alone. Finally, as frontier LLMs are post-trained, we show that our findings survive the post-training stage, making $T^2$ scaling meaningful in modern deployments.
summary_zh: 现代大语言模型在测试时会进行扩展，例如通过重复采样，其中推理成本随模型规模和采样次数增加。这带来了一个权衡，而现有的预训练扩展法则（如Chinchilla）并未对此进行考虑。本文提出了训练至测试（$T^2$）扩展法则，在固定端到端预算下联合优化模型规模、训练词元量和推理采样次数。$T^2$将用于测试时扩展的pass@$k$建模方法融入预训练扩展法则，实现了预训练与测试决策的联合优化。$T^2$的预测在不同建模方法中表现稳健：既能衡量联合扩展对任务损失的影响，也能评估建模方式对任务准确性的作用。在八个下游任务中，我们发现当考虑推理成本时，最优预训练决策会显著转向过度训练区间，远远超出标准预训练扩展实验的范围。我们通过在$T^2$扩展预测的最优区域预训练高度过度训练的模型，验证了所得结论，并证实这些模型相较于仅遵循预训练扩展法则的模型具有显著更强的性能。最后，鉴于前沿大语言模型普遍采用后训练流程，我们证明本文结论在后训练阶段依然成立，使得$T^2$扩展在现代部署中具有实际意义。
tldr: This paper introduces Train-to-Test (T^2) scaling laws to optimize the trade-off between model pretraining, size, and the number of inference samples (test-time compute) for a fixed total compute budget, showing that optimal pretraining shifts into the overtraining regime when inference costs are considered.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了训练到测试（T^2）缩放定律，旨在固定总计算预算下，联合优化模型预训练、规模和推理采样次数，并发现当考虑推理成本时，最优预训练会转向过度训练区域。

title: Causal Optimal Coupling for Gaussian Input-Output Distributional Data
summary: We study the problem of identifying an optimal coupling between input-output distributional data generated by a causal dynamical system. The coupling is required to satisfy prescribed marginal distributions and a causality constraint reflecting the temporal structure of the system. We formulate this problem as a Schr"odinger Bridge, which seeks the coupling closest - in Kullback-Leibler divergence - to a given prior while enforcing both marginal and causality constraints. For the case of Gaussian marginals and general time-dependent quadratic cost functions, we derive a fully tractable characterization of the Sinkhorn iterations that converges to the optimal solution. Beyond its theoretical contribution, the proposed framework provides a principled foundation for applying causal optimal transport methods to system identification from distributional data.
summary_zh: 我们研究如何从因果动态系统生成的输入输出分布数据中辨识最优耦合问题。该耦合需满足给定的边缘分布以及反映系统时间结构的因果约束。我们将此问题表述为薛定谔桥问题，即在强制满足边缘分布与因果约束条件下，寻找与给定先验分布（以Kullback-Leibler散度衡量）最接近的耦合。针对高斯边缘分布与一般时变二次成本函数的情况，我们推导出完全可处理的Sinkhorn迭代的解析表征，该迭代可收敛至最优解。本研究的理论贡献之外，所提出的框架为将因果最优传输方法应用于分布数据驱动的系统辨识提供了原理性基础。
tldr: This paper proposes a theoretical framework for causal optimal transport between Gaussian input-output distributions using a Schrödinger Bridge formulation, with a focus on system identification from distributional data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于高斯输入-输出分布之间因果最优传输的理论框架，基于薛定谔桥的表述，专注于从分布数据中进行系统辨识。

title: VIANA: character Value-enhanced Intensity Assessment via domain-informed Neural Architecture
summary: Predicting the perceived intensity of odorants remains a fundamental challenge in sensory science due to the complex, non-linear behavior of their response, as well as the difficulty in correlating molecular structure with human perception. While traditional deep learning models, such as Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), excel at capturing molecular topology, they often fail to account for the biological and perceptual context of olfaction. This study introduces VIANA, a novel "tri-pillar" framework that integrates structural graph theory, character value embeddings, and phenomenological behavior. This methodology systematically evaluates knowledge transfer across three distinct domains: molecular structure via GCNs, semantic odor character values via Principal Odor Map (POM) embeddings, and biological dose-response logic via Hill's law. We demonstrate that knowledge transfer is not inherently positive; rather, a balance must be maintained in the volume of information provided to the model. While raw semantic data led to "information overload" in domain-informed models, applying Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to distill the 95% most impactful semantic variance yielded a superior "signal distillation" effect. Results indicate that the synthesis of these three knowledge transfer pillars significantly outperforms baseline structural models, with VIANA achieving a peak R^2 of 0.996 and a test Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.19. In this context, VIANA successfully captures the physical ceiling of saturation, the sensitivity of detection thresholds, and the nuance of odor character value expression, providing a domain grounded simulation of the human olfactory experience. This research provides a robust framework for digital olfaction, effectively bridging the gap between molecular informatics and sensory perception.
summary_zh: 预测气味物质的感知强度仍然是感官科学领域的一项基本挑战，这源于其响应行为的复杂非线性特性，以及分子结构与人类感知难以建立关联的困境。传统的深度学习方法（如图卷积网络）虽然擅长捕捉分子拓扑结构，却往往忽略了嗅觉的生物学与感知背景。本研究提出了一种新型“三支柱”框架VIANA，该框架整合了结构图理论、气味特征值嵌入与现象学行为。该方法系统性地评估了三个不同领域的知识迁移：通过图卷积网络解析分子结构，借助主气味图嵌入处理语义气味特征值，并利用希尔定律分析生物剂量-响应逻辑。研究表明，知识迁移并非必然产生正向效应，而需在模型输入信息量上保持平衡。当原始语义数据导致领域感知模型出现“信息过载”时，采用主成分分析提取95%最具影响力的语义方差，可产生更优的“信号提纯”效果。实验结果表明，整合这三类知识迁移支柱的性能显著优于基准结构模型，VIANA框架的最高R^2达到0.996，测试均方误差仅为0.19。在此框架下，VIANA成功捕捉了饱和现象的物理上限、检测阈值的敏感性以及气味特征值表达的细微差异，为人类嗅觉体验提供了基于领域知识的仿真模拟。这项研究为数字嗅觉领域提供了坚实的框架，有效弥合了分子信息学与感官感知之间的鸿沟。
tldr: Proposes a novel tri-pillar framework, VIANA, combining molecular structure, odor semantics, and dose-response logic to predict the perceived intensity of odorants, significantly outperforming baseline models in digital olfaction.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的VIANA三支柱框架，整合分子结构、气味语义和剂量响应逻辑来预测气味感知强度，在数字嗅觉领域显著优于基线模型。

title: Malliavin Calculus for Counterfactual Gradient Estimation in Adaptive Inverse Reinforcement Learning
