summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers the loss function of a forward learner from its observed responses adaptive IRL aims to reconstruct the loss function of a forward learner by passively observing its gradients as it performs reinforcement learning (RL). This paper proposes a novel passive Langevin-based algorithm that achieves adaptive IRL. The key difficulty in adaptive IRL is that the required gradients in the passive algorithm are counterfactual, that is, they are conditioned on events of probability zero under the forward learner's trajectory. Therefore, naive Monte Carlo estimators are prohibitively inefficient, and kernel smoothing, though common, suffers from slow convergence. We overcome this by employing Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate the required counterfactual gradients. We reformulate the counterfactual conditioning as a ratio of unconditioned expectations involving Malliavin quantities, thus recovering standard estimation rates. We derive the necessary Malliavin derivatives and their adjoint Skorohod integral formulations for a general Langevin structure, and provide a concrete algorithmic approach which exploits these for counterfactual gradient estimation.
summary_zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）旨在通过观察正向学习者的响应来恢复其损失函数；自适应IRL则进一步寻求通过被动观察正向学习者在进行强化学习（RL）时产生的梯度来重构其损失函数。本文提出了一种新颖的、基于被动Langevin机制的算法，实现了自适应IRL。自适应IRL中的关键难点在于：被动算法所需的梯度具有反事实性，即这些梯度是基于正向学习者轨迹中概率为零的事件进行条件化得到的。因此，简单的蒙特卡洛估计器效率极低，而常用的核平滑方法则收敛缓慢。我们通过运用Malliavin微积分来高效估计所需的反事实梯度，从而克服了这一困难。我们将反事实条件化问题重新表述为涉及Malliavin量的无条件期望之比，从而恢复了标准估计速率。我们针对一般的Langevin结构推导了必要的Malliavin导数及其伴随的Skorohod积分形式，并提供了一种具体的算法框架，利用这些工具进行反事实梯度估计。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel passive Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) algorithm that uses Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate counterfactual gradients from observed forward learner data, addressing a key challenge in adaptive IRL.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的被动逆强化学习算法，利用Malliavin微积分从观察到的前向学习者数据中高效估计反事实梯度，解决了自适应逆强化学习中的一个关键挑战。

title: Model Merging via Data-Free Covariance Estimation
summary: Model merging provides a way of cheaply combining individual models to produce a model that inherits each individual's capabilities. While some merging methods can approach the performance of multitask training, they are often heuristically motivated and lack theoretical justification. A principled alternative is to pose model merging as a layer-wise optimization problem that directly minimizes interference between tasks. However, this formulation requires estimating per-layer covariance matrices from data, which may not be available when performing merging. In contrast, many of the heuristically-motivated methods do not require auxiliary data, making them practically advantageous. In this work, we revisit the interference minimization framework and show that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while also reducing computational costs. We validate our approach across vision and language benchmarks on models ranging from 86M parameters to 7B parameters, outperforming previous data-free state-of-the-art merging methods
summary_zh: 模型融合提供了一种将多个独立模型经济地组合起来的方法，以生成一个能够继承各自能力的新模型。尽管某些融合方法能接近多任务训练的性能，但它们往往依赖于启发式策略而缺乏理论依据。一个更具原则性的替代方案是将模型融合定义为逐层优化问题，以直接最小化任务间的干扰。然而，这种表述需要从数据中估计每层协方差矩阵，而这在进行模型融合时可能无法获得数据。相比之下，许多基于启发式的方法无需辅助数据，使其在实际应用中更具优势。本研究重新审视了干扰最小化框架，并证明在特定条件下，协方差矩阵可以直接从差异矩阵中估计，从而无需数据支持，同时降低了计算成本。我们在涵盖8600万至70亿参数模型的视觉和语言基准测试中验证了该方法，结果表明其性能优于此前最先进的无数据融合方法。
tldr: Proposes a data-free model merging method that estimates per-layer covariance matrices from difference matrices, eliminating the need for auxiliary data and outperforming previous data-free state-of-the-art methods on vision and language benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种无需数据的模型融合方法，通过差异矩阵直接估计每层的协方差矩阵，从而无需辅助数据，在视觉和语言基准测试中超越了之前最先进的无数据融合方法。

title: Efficient and Principled Scientific Discovery through Bayesian Optimization: A Tutorial
summary: Traditional scientific discovery relies on an iterative hypothesise-experiment-refine cycle that has driven progress for centuries, but its intuitive, ad-hoc implementation often wastes resources, yields inefficient designs, and misses critical insights. This tutorial presents Bayesian Optimisation (BO), a principled probability-driven framework that formalises and automates this core scientific cycle. BO uses surrogate models (e.g., Gaussian processes) to model empirical observations as evolving hypotheses, and acquisition functions to guide experiment selection, balancing exploitation of known knowledge and exploration of uncharted domains to eliminate guesswork and manual trial-and-error. We first frame scientific discovery as an optimisation problem, then unpack BO's core components, end-to-end workflows, and real-world efficacy via case studies in catalysis, materials science, organic synthesis, and molecule discovery. We also cover critical technical extensions for scientific applications, including batched experimentation, heteroscedasticity, contextual optimisation, and human-in-the-loop integration. Tailored for a broad audience, this tutorial bridges AI advances in BO with practical natural science applications, offering tiered content to empower cross-disciplinary researchers to design more efficient experiments and accelerate principled scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 传统科学发现依赖于“提出假设-实验验证-优化改进”的迭代循环，这一范式虽推动数百年科技进步，但其依赖直觉的临时性实施常导致资源浪费、设计效率低下及关键洞察缺失。本教程系统介绍贝叶斯优化（BO）——一种基于概率驱动的规范化框架，旨在将这一核心科学循环形式化与自动化。BO通过代理模型（如高斯过程）将经验观察建模为动态演化的假设，并利用采集函数指导实验选择，在已知知识的利用与未知领域的探索间寻求平衡，从而消除猜测与手动试错。我们首先将科学发现问题形式化为优化框架，继而解析BO的核心组件、端到端工作流，并结合催化、材料科学、有机合成及分子发现等领域的案例研究展示其实际效能。同时，本文涵盖科学应用中的关键扩展技术，包括批量实验、异方差处理、情境优化及人机协同集成。本教程面向广泛科研群体，旨在搭建BO人工智能进展与自然科学实践间的桥梁，通过分层内容设计助力跨学科研究者设计更高效的实验方案，推动规范化科学发现进程的加速。
tldr: This tutorial paper presents Bayesian Optimization as a principled framework for automating and accelerating scientific discovery, providing an overview of its core components, workflows, and case studies in fields like materials science and chemistry.
tldr_zh: 本教程论文将贝叶斯优化作为一种原则性框架，用于自动化并加速科学发现，概述了其核心组件、工作流程以及在材料科学和化学等领域的案例研究。

title: Detecting Complex Money Laundering Patterns with Incremental and Distributed Graph Modeling
summary: Money launderers take advantage of limitations in existing detection approaches by hiding their financial footprints in a deceitful manner. They manage this by replicating transaction patterns that the monitoring systems cannot easily distinguish. As a result, criminally gained assets are pushed into legitimate financial channels without drawing attention. Algorithms developed to monitor money flows often struggle with scale and complexity. The difficulty of identifying such activities is further intensified by the (persistent) inability of current solutions to control the excessive number of false positive signals produced by rigid, risk-based rules systems. We propose a framework called ReDiRect (REduce, DIstribute, and RECTify), specifically designed to overcome these challenges. The primary contribution of our work is a novel framing of this problem in an unsupervised setting; where a large transaction graph is fuzzily partitioned into smaller, manageable components to enable fast processing in a distributed manner. In addition, we define a refined evaluation metric that better captures the effectiveness of exposed money laundering patterns. Through comprehensive experimentation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performance compared to existing and state-of-the-art techniques, particularly in terms of efficiency and real-world applicability. For validation, we used the real (open source) Libra dataset and the recently released synthetic datasets by IBM Watson. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/mhaseebtariq/redirect.
summary_zh: 洗钱者通过以欺骗性手段隐藏其金融足迹，利用现有检测方法的局限性。他们通过复制监控系统难以区分的交易模式来达成这一目标，从而使犯罪所得资产在不受关注的情况下流入合法金融渠道。为监测资金流而开发的算法往往难以应对规模与复杂性带来的挑战。当前解决方案持续无法控制由僵化、基于风险的规则系统所产生的大量误报信号，这进一步加剧了识别此类活动的难度。我们提出一种名为ReDiRect（REduce、DIstribute和RECTify）的框架，专门设计用于克服这些挑战。本研究的主要贡献在于以一种新颖的无监督设定框架来重新定义该问题：将大规模交易图模糊划分为更小、更易管理的组件，从而实现快速分布式处理。此外，我们定义了一种更精细的评估指标，能更好地捕捉已暴露洗钱模式的有效性。通过全面实验，我们证明相较于现有及最先进技术，该框架在效率和实际应用性方面均表现出更优性能。为验证效果，我们使用了真实的（开源）Libra数据集以及IBM Watson近期发布的合成数据集。相关代码与数据集发布于https://github.com/mhaseebtariq/redirect。
tldr: The paper proposes ReDiRect, an unsupervised graph-based framework for detecting complex money laundering patterns by partitioning large transaction graphs for distributed processing, with refined evaluation metrics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ReDiRect，一个用于检测复杂洗钱模式的基于图的非监督框架，通过分区大型交易图进行分布式处理，并提出了精细化的评估指标。

title: JetPrism: diagnosing convergence for generative simulation and inverse problems in nuclear physics
summary: High-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations and complex inverse problems, such as mapping smeared experimental observations to ground-truth states, are computationally intensive yet essential for robust data analysis. Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) offers a mathematically robust approach to accelerating these tasks, but we demonstrate its standard training loss is fundamentally misleading. In rigorous physics applications, CFM loss plateaus prematurely, serving as an unreliable indicator of true convergence and physical fidelity. To investigate this disconnect, we designed JetPrism, a configurable CFM framework acting as an efficient generative surrogate for evaluating unconditional generation and conditional detector unfolding. Using synthetic stress tests and a Jefferson Lab kinematic dataset ($γp \to ρ^0 p \to π^+π^- p$) relevant to the forthcoming Electron-Ion Collider (EIC), we establish that physics-informed metrics continue to improve significantly long after the standard loss converges. Consequently, we propose a multi-metric evaluation protocol incorporating marginal and pairwise $χ^2$ statistics, $W_1$ distances, correlation matrix distances ($D_{\mathrm{corr}}$), and nearest-neighbor distance ratios ($R_{\mathrm{NN}}$). By demonstrating that domain-specific evaluations must supersede generic loss metrics, this work establishes JetPrism as a dependable generative surrogate that ensures precise statistical agreement with ground-truth data without memorizing the training set. While demonstrated in nuclear physics, this diagnostic framework is readily extensible to parameter generation and complex inverse problems across broad domains. Potential applications span medical imaging, astrophysics, semiconductor discovery, and quantitative finance, where high-fidelity simulation, rigorous inversion, and generative reliability are critical.
summary_zh: 高保真蒙特卡洛模拟与复杂逆问题——例如将模糊的实验观测映射到真实状态——虽然计算密集，但却是鲁棒数据分析的核心。条件流匹配提供了一种数学上严谨的加速方法，然而我们发现其标准训练损失具有根本性的误导性。在严格的物理应用中，条件流匹配损失会过早停滞，无法可靠指示真实收敛与物理保真度。为探究这一脱节现象，我们设计了JetPrism——一个可配置的条件流匹配框架，作为高效生成式代理模型，用于评估无条件生成和条件探测器反演。通过合成压力测试及与未来电子-离子对撞机相关的杰斐逊实验室运动学数据集（$γp \to ρ^0 p \to π^+π^- p$），我们证实：在标准损失收敛后，基于物理的评估指标仍持续显著提升。因此，我们提出一套多指标评估协议，涵盖边缘分布与成对$χ^2$统计量、$W_1$距离、相关矩阵距离（$D_{\mathrm{corr}}$）及最近邻距离比（$R_{\mathrm{NN}}$）。通过证明领域特异性评估必须取代通用损失指标，本工作确立JetPrism为可靠的生成式代理模型，其在避免记忆训练集的同时，确保与真实数据达成精确的统计一致性。该诊断框架虽在核物理领域得到验证，但可轻松扩展至跨领域的参数生成和复杂逆问题，潜在应用涵盖医学影像、天体物理、半导体发现和量化金融等对高保真模拟、严格反演及生成可靠性要求严苛的领域。
tldr: This paper introduces a diagnostic framework, JetPrism, to expose misleading convergence of Conditional Flow Matching in high-fidelity generative simulations and inverse problems in nuclear physics, proposing a multi-metric evaluation protocol for reliability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了JetPrism诊断框架，用于揭示核物理中高保真生成模拟和反问题中条件流匹配收敛性的误导性，并提出了一个保证可靠性的多指标评估协议。

title: The Self Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
summary: Agentic AI shifts the investor's role from analytical execution to oversight. We present an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which approximately 50 specialized agents produce capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using over 20 competing methods, and critique and vote on each other's output. A researcher agent proposes new portfolio construction methods not yet represented, and a meta-agent compares past forecasts against realized returns and rewrites agent code and prompts to improve future performance. The entire pipeline is governed by the Investment Policy Statement--the same document that guides human portfolio managers can now constrain and direct autonomous agents.
summary_zh: 智能代理AI将投资者的角色从分析执行转向了监督。本文提出了一种代理式战略资产配置流程，该流程中约50个专业代理生成资本市场假设，运用超过20种竞争性方法构建投资组合，并相互评审和投票决定彼此的输出结果。研究者代理会提出尚未被纳入的新投资组合构建方法，而元代理则通过对比历史预测与实际回报来重写代理代码及指令，以提升未来表现。整个流程由投资政策声明所管辖——这份曾指导人类投资经理的文档，如今同样能够约束和引导自主代理系统。
tldr: This paper presents an agentic architecture for autonomous financial asset management, where numerous specialized AI agents collaborate to forecast markets, construct portfolios, critique each other's work, and self-improve their code, all governed by a human-defined investment policy statement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主金融资产管理的智能体架构，其中多个专门化的AI智能体协作预测市场、构建投资组合、相互批评工作，并自我改进其代码，整个过程由一个人类定义的投资政策声明管理。

title: Crystalite: A Lightweight Transformer for Efficient Crystal Modeling
summary: Generative models for crystalline materials often rely on equivariant graph neural networks, which capture geometric structure well but are costly to train and slow to sample. We present Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal modeling built around two simple inductive biases. The first is Subatomic Tokenization, a compact chemically structured atom representation that replaces high-dimensional one-hot encodings and is better suited to continuous diffusion. The second is the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), which injects periodic minimum-image pair geometry directly into attention through additive geometric biases. Together, these components preserve the simplicity and efficiency of a standard Transformer while making it better matched to the structure of crystalline materials. Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction benchmarks, and de novo generation performance, attaining the best S.U.N. discovery score among the evaluated baselines while sampling substantially faster than geometry-heavy alternatives.
summary_zh: 晶体材料生成模型通常依赖于等变图神经网络，这些网络虽能较好捕捉几何结构，但训练成本高昂且采样速度缓慢。我们提出Crystalite——一种基于两种简单归纳偏置的轻量级扩散Transformer晶体建模框架。首先是亚原子分词技术，这种紧凑的化学结构原子表示法替代了高维独热编码，更适用于连续扩散过程。其次是几何增强模块，该模块通过加法式几何偏置将周期最小镜像对几何结构直接注入注意力机制。这些组件共同保持了标准Transformer的简洁性与高效性，同时使其更贴合晶体材料的结构特性。Crystalite在晶体结构预测基准测试中实现了最先进的结果，其从头生成性能在评估基线中获得了最佳S.U.N.发现分数，同时采样速度显著优于几何结构密集型替代方案。
tldr: Crystalite is a lightweight Transformer for efficient crystal modeling, using novel Subatomic Tokenization and a Geometry Enhancement Module to improve performance on crystal structure prediction and generation.
tldr_zh: Crystalite 是一种用于高效晶体建模的轻量级Transformer，采用新颖的亚原子标记化和几何增强模块，在晶体结构预测和生成方面实现了最先进的性能。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over Scientific Literature for the Electron-Ion Collider
summary: To harness the power of Language Models in answering domain specific specialized technical questions, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is been used widely. In this work, we have developed a Q\&A application inspired by the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), which is comprised of an in-house database indexed on the arXiv articles related to the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) experiment - one of the largest international scientific collaboration and incorporated an open-source LLaMA model for answer generation. This is an extension to it's proceeding application built on proprietary model and Cloud-hosted external knowledge-base for the EIC experiment. This locally-deployed RAG-system offers a cost-effective, resource-constraint alternative solution to build a RAG-assisted Q\&A application on answering domain-specific queries in the field of experimental nuclear physics. This set-up facilitates data-privacy, avoids sending any pre-publication scientific data and information to public domain. Future improvement will expand the knowledge base to encompass heterogeneous EIC-related publications and reports and upgrade the application pipeline orchestration to the LangGraph framework.
summary_zh: 为利用语言模型在回答特定领域专业技术问题方面的能力，检索增强生成（RAG）技术已得到广泛应用。本研究基于检索增强生成思想，开发了一款问答应用。该系统构建了一个涵盖电子-离子对撞机（EIC）实验相关arXiv论文的内部数据库索引——EIC实验作为全球最大的国际科学合作项目之一，同时集成了开源的LLaMA模型进行答案生成。该应用是在先前基于专有模型和云托管外部知识库的EIC实验应用基础上的拓展。这种本地化部署的RAG系统为实验核物理领域构建特定领域问答应用，提供了一种成本效益高、资源受限的替代解决方案。该架构既保障了数据隐私，又避免了将任何预发表的科学数据信息泄露至公共领域。未来改进将把知识库扩展至涵盖异构的EIC相关出版物与报告，并将应用流程编排升级至LangGraph框架。
tldr: This paper describes a locally-deployed RAG application for question-answering over specialized scientific literature about the Electron-Ion Collider, focusing on cost-effectiveness and data privacy.
tldr_zh: 本文描述了一个用于电子-离子对撞机专业科学文献问答的本地部署RAG应用，侧重于成本效益和数据隐私。

title: Do Emotions in Prompts Matter? Effects of Emotional Framing on Large Language Models
summary: Emotional tone is pervasive in human communication, yet its influence on large language model (LLM) behaviour remains unclear. Here, we examine how first-person emotional framing in user-side queries affect LLM performance across six benchmark domains, including mathematical reasoning, medical question answering, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning and social inference. Across models and tasks, static emotional prefixes usually produce only small changes in accuracy, suggesting that affective phrasing is typically a mild perturbation rather than a reliable general-purpose intervention. This stability is not uniform: effects are more variable in socially grounded tasks, where emotional context more plausibly interacts with interpersonal reasoning. Additional analyses show that stronger emotional wording induces only modest extra change, and that human-written prefixes reproduce the same qualitative pattern as LLM-generated ones. We then introduce EmotionRL, an adaptive emotional prompting framework that selects emotional framing adaptively for each query. Although no single emotion is consistently beneficial, adaptive selection yields more reliable gains than fixed emotional prompting. Together, these findings show that emotional tone is neither a dominant driver of LLM performance nor irrelevant noise, but a weak and input-dependent signal that can be exploited through adaptive control.
summary_zh: 情感基调在人类交流中普遍存在，但其对大型语言模型行为的影响尚不明确。本文研究了用户端查询中第一人称情感框架如何影响大语言模型在数学推理、医疗问答、阅读理解、常识推理与社会推断等六个基准领域的表现。实验表明，在各类模型与任务中，静态情感前缀通常仅引起准确率的微小变化，这表明情感表达方式多为轻度扰动，而非可靠的通用干预手段。模型稳定性并非普遍存在：在社交基础型任务中，情感效应更具波动性，因情感语境更可能与人际推理产生交互作用。进一步分析显示，强烈的情感表达仅引发有限额外变化，且人工撰写的情感前缀与大语言模型生成的前缀呈现出相同的定性模式。随后我们提出EmotionRL——一种自适应情感提示框架，能够为每个查询动态选择情感框架。尽管单一情感并非始终有效，但自适应选择比固定情感提示带来更稳定的性能提升。综合而言，这些发现表明情感基调既非大语言模型表现的主导驱动因素，也非无关噪声，而是一种可通过自适应控制加以利用的、微弱且依赖于输入特征的信号。
tldr: This paper investigates how adding emotional tone to user queries affects LLM performance across various reasoning tasks, finding it a weak but exploitable signal.
tldr_zh: 该研究探讨了在用户查询中添加情绪语气对各种推理任务中LLM表现的影响，发现情绪是一个弱信号，但可以通过自适应选择被利用。

title: Goose: Anisotropic Speculation Trees for Training-Free Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple candidate tokens and verifying them in a single forward pass. Candidates are organized as a tree: deeper trees accept more tokens per step, but adding depth requires sacrificing breadth (fallback options) under a fixed verification budget. Existing training-free methods draft from a single token source and shape their trees without distinguishing candidate quality across origins. We observe that two common training-free token sources - n-gram matches copied from the input context, and statistical predictions from prior forward passes - differ dramatically in acceptance rate (~6x median gap, range 2-18x across five models and five benchmarks). We prove that when such a quality gap exists, the optimal tree is anisotropic (asymmetric): reliable tokens should form a deep chain while unreliable tokens spread as wide branches, breaking through the depth limit of balanced trees. We realize this structure in GOOSE, a training-free framework that builds an adaptive spine tree - a deep chain of high-acceptance context-matched tokens with wide branches of low-acceptance alternatives at each node. We prove that the number of tokens accepted per step is at least as large as that of either source used alone. On five LLMs (7B-33B) and five benchmarks, GOOSE achieves 1.9-4.3x lossless speedup, outperforming balanced-tree baselines by 12-33% under the same budget.
summary_zh:
摘要：
推测解码通过草拟多个候选令牌并在单次前向传播中验证它们，从而加速大语言模型的推理。候选令牌以树形结构组织：更深的树在每步接受更多令牌，但在固定验证预算下，增加深度需要牺牲广度（后备选项）。现有的无训练方法从单一令牌源生成草稿，并构建其树形结构，而不区分不同来源的候选令牌质量。我们观察到，两种常见的无训练令牌源——从输入上下文复制的n-gram匹配和先前前向传播的统计预测——在接收率上存在显著差异（中位数差距约6倍，在五个模型和五个基准测试中范围为2-18倍）。我们证明，当存在这种质量差距时，最优树形应是各向异性（非对称）的：可靠令牌应形成深链，而不可靠令牌则作为宽分支展开，从而突破平衡树的深度限制。我们在GOOSE框架中实现了这一结构，这是一个无训练框架，它构建了一种自适应骨干树——由高接收率的上下文匹配令牌形成的深链，并在每个节点处扩展出低接收率替代令牌的宽分支。我们证明，每一步接受的令牌数量至少与单独使用任一源时相当。在五个大语言模型（7B-33B）和五个基准测试中，GOOSE实现了1.9-4.3倍的无损加速，在相同预算下优于平衡树基线12-33%。
tldr: Proposes GOOSE, a training-free speculative decoding framework that uses anisotropic trees with a deep chain of high-acceptance tokens and wide branches of low-acceptance alternatives to accelerate LLM inference.
tldr_zh: 提出GOOSE，一种免训练的推测解码框架，通过使用包含高接受率令牌的深链和低接受率令牌的宽分支的非对称树来加速LLM推理。

title: AI in Insurance: Adaptive Questionnaires for Improved Risk Profiling
summary:
Insurance application processes often rely on lengthy and standardized questionnaires that struggle to capture individual differences. Moreover, insurers must blindly trust users' responses, increasing the chances of fraud. The ARQuest framework introduces a new approach to underwriting by using Large Language Models (LLMs) and alternative data sources to create personalized and adaptive questionnaires. Techniques such as social media image analysis, geographic data categorization, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) are used to extract meaningful user insights and guide targeted follow-up questions.
  A life insurance system integrated into an industry partner mobile app was tested in two experiments. While traditional questionnaires yielded slightly higher accuracy in risk assessment, adaptive versions powered by GPT models required fewer questions and were preferred by users for their more fluid and engaging experience.
  ARQuest shows great potential to improve user satisfaction and streamline insurance processes. With further development, this approach may exceed traditional methods regarding risk accuracy and help drive innovation in the insurance industry.
summary_zh:
保险申请流程通常依赖冗长且标准化的问卷，难以捕捉个体差异。同时，保险公司必须完全信任用户的回答，这增加了欺诈风险。ARQuest框架通过采用大型语言模型（LLM）和替代数据源，提出了一种创新的承保方法，能够生成个性化、自适应的问卷。该框架运用社交媒体图像分析、地理数据分类及检索增强生成（RAG）等技术，以提取有价值的用户信息并引导有针对性的后续问题。

我们将一套人寿保险系统集成至行业合作伙伴的移动应用程序中，并进行了两项实验测试。尽管传统问卷在风险评估方面表现出略高的准确性，但基于GPT模型驱动的自适应问卷不仅所需问题更少，其流畅且引人入胜的体验也获得了用户青睐。

ARQuest在提升用户满意度和简化保险流程方面展现出巨大潜力。随着进一步的发展，该方法有望在风险预测准确性上超越传统模式，从而推动保险行业的创新进程。
tldr: Proposes ARQuest, an LLM-based adaptive questionnaire system for insurance underwriting, using social media analysis and RAG to improve user experience and streamline processes, but with slightly lower accuracy than traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 提出了ARQuest，一个基于LLM的保险核保自适应问卷系统，利用社交媒体分析和RAG技术改善用户体验并简化流程，但准确率略低于传统方法。

title: Optimizing Interventions for Agent-Based Infectious Disease Simulations
summary: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) are commonly used tools for controlling infectious disease transmission when pharmaceutical options are unavailable. Yet, identifying effective interventions that minimize societal disruption remains challenging. Agent-based simulation is a popular tool for analyzing the impact of possible interventions in epidemiology. However, automatically optimizing NPIs using agent-based simulations poses a complex problem because, in agent-based epidemiological models, interventions can target individuals based on multiple attributes, affect hierarchical group structures (e.g., schools, workplaces, and families), and be combined arbitrarily, resulting in a very large or even infinite search space. We aim to support decision-makers with our Agent-based Infectious Disease Intervention Optimization System (ADIOS) that optimizes NPIs for infectious disease simulations using Grammar-Guided Genetic Programming (GGGP). The core of ADIOS is a domain-specific language for expressing NPIs in agent-based simulations that structures the intervention search space through a context-free grammar. To make optimization more efficient, the search space can be further reduced by defining constraints that prevent the generation of semantically invalid intervention patterns. Using this constrained language and an interface that enables coupling with agent-based simulations, ADIOS adopts the GGGP approach for simulation-based optimization. Using the German Epidemic Micro-Simulation System (GEMS) as a case study, we demonstrate the potential of our approach to generate optimal interventions for realistic epidemiological models
summary_zh: 非药物干预措施（NPIs）是在缺乏药物选择时控制传染病传播的常用工具。然而，如何确定既能有效控制疫情又能最大限度减少社会影响的干预措施仍是一大挑战。基于智能体的模拟是流行病学中分析潜在干预措施影响的主流工具。但利用基于智能体的模拟自动优化非药物干预措施是一个复杂问题，因为在这类流行病学模型中，干预措施可以根据多个属性针对个体实施，影响层级化的群体结构（例如学校、工作场所和家庭），并能任意组合，导致搜索空间极其庞大甚至无限。本研究旨在通过"基于智能体的传染病干预优化系统"（ADIOS）为决策者提供支持，该系统采用语法引导的遗传编程技术优化传染病模拟中的非药物干预措施。ADIOS的核心是一种特定领域语言，通过上下文无关文法在基于智能体的模拟中表达非药物干预措施，从而构建干预措施的搜索空间。为提高优化效率，可通过定义约束条件进一步缩小搜索空间，避免生成语义无效的干预模式。利用这种受约束的语言及与基于智能体模拟的耦合接口，ADIOS采用语法引导的遗传编程方法实现基于模拟的优化。以德国疫情微观模拟系统（GEMS）为案例研究，我们展示了该方法在现实流行病学模型中生成最优干预措施的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a system for optimizing non-pharmaceutical interventions in epidemiological agent-based simulations using grammar-guided genetic programming, with a case study in the German Epidemic Micro-Simulation System.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种系统，使用语法引导的遗传编程优化流行病学基于代理的模拟中的非药物干预措施，并以德国流行病微观模拟系统为例进行研究。

title: RuleForge: Automated Generation and Validation for Web Vulnerability Detection at Scale
summary:
Security teams face a challenge: the volume of newly disclosed Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) far exceeds the capacity to manually develop detection mechanisms. In 2025, the National Vulnerability Database published over 48,000 new vulnerabilities, motivating the need for automation. We present RuleForge, an AWS internal system that automatically generates detection rules--JSON-based patterns that identify malicious HTTP requests exploiting specific vulnerabilities--from structured Nuclei templates describing CVE details. Nuclei templates provide standardized, YAML-based vulnerability descriptions that serve as the structured input for our rule generation process.
  This paper focuses on RuleForge's architecture and operational deployment for CVE-related threat detection, with particular emphasis on our novel LLM-as-a-judge (Large Language Model as judge) confidence validation system and systematic feedback integration mechanism. This validation approach evaluates candidate rules across two dimensions--sensitivity (avoiding false negatives) and specificity (avoiding false positives)--achieving AUROC of 0.75 and reducing false positives by 67% compared to synthetic-test-only validation in production. Our 5x5 generation strategy (five parallel candidates with up to five refinement attempts each) combined with continuous feedback loops enables systematic quality improvement. We also present extensions enabling rule generation from unstructured data sources and demonstrate a proof-of-concept agentic workflow for multi-event-type detection. Our lessons learned highlight critical considerations for applying LLMs to cybersecurity tasks, including overconfidence mitigation and the importance of domain expertise in both prompt design and quality review of generated rules through human-in-the-loop validation.
summary_zh:
安全团队面临一个严峻挑战：新披露的通用漏洞披露（CVE）数量远超人工制定检测机制的能力。2025年，美国国家漏洞数据库收录了超过48,000个新漏洞，这凸显了自动化解决方案的迫切需求。本文介绍RuleForge——一个由AWS内部开发的自动化检测规则生成系统，该系统能够从描述CVE细节的结构化Nuclei模板中自动生成检测规则。这些规则是基于JSON的匹配模式，用于识别利用特定漏洞的恶意HTTP请求。Nuclei模板提供基于YAML的标准化漏洞描述，构成我们规则生成过程的结构化输入。

本文重点阐述RuleForge在CVE相关威胁检测中的架构与生产部署，特别聚焦于我们创新的“LLM-as-a-judge”置信度验证系统及系统性反馈集成机制。该验证方法从灵敏度（避免漏报）和特异度（避免误报）两个维度评估候选规则，在生产环境中相比纯合成测试验证，实现了0.75的AUROC值，并将误报率降低67%。我们采用的“5x5”生成策略（五个并行候选规则，每个最多进行五次优化迭代）结合持续反馈循环，实现了系统性的质量提升。本文还展示了从非结构化数据源生成规则的扩展能力，并论证了用于多事件类型检测的智能体工作流概念验证。实践中的经验教训揭示了将大语言模型应用于网络安全任务的关键要素，包括过度自信的缓解策略、提示工程中领域专业知识的重要性，以及通过人机协同验证对生成规则进行质量审查的必要性。
tldr: RuleForge is a system that uses LLMs to automatically generate and validate detection rules for web vulnerabilities from structured templates, focusing on a confidence validation system to reduce false positives.
tldr_zh: RuleForge 是一个利用大语言模型，从结构化模板自动生成和验证 Web 漏洞检测规则的系统，其核心是一个减少误报的置信度验证机制。

title: Do We Need Bigger Models for Science? Task-Aware Retrieval with Small Language Models
summary: Scientific knowledge discovery increasingly relies on large language models, yet many existing scholarly assistants depend on proprietary systems with tens or hundreds of billions of parameters. Such reliance limits reproducibility and accessibility for the research community. In this work, we ask a simple question: do we need bigger models for scientific applications? Specifically, we investigate to what extent carefully designed retrieval pipelines can compensate for reduced model scale in scientific applications. We design a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework that performs task-aware routing to select specialized retrieval strategies based on the input query. The system further integrates evidence from full-text scientific papers and structured scholarly metadata, and employs compact instruction-tuned language models to generate responses with citations. We evaluate the framework across several scholarly tasks, focusing on scholarly question answering (QA), including single- and multi-document scenarios, as well as biomedical QA under domain shift and scientific text compression. Our findings demonstrate that retrieval and model scale are complementary rather than interchangeable. While retrieval design can partially compensate for smaller models, model capacity remains important for complex reasoning tasks. This work highlights retrieval and task-aware design as key factors for building practical and reproducible scholarly assistants.
summary_zh: 科学知识发现正日益依赖大语言模型，然而现有的许多学术辅助工具依赖于参数规模达数百亿甚至数千亿的专有系统。这种依赖限制了研究界的可复现性与可访问性。本研究提出一个简单问题：科学应用是否真的需要更大的模型？具体而言，我们探讨了在科学应用中，精心设计的检索流程能在多大程度上弥补模型规模的缩减。我们设计了一个轻量级的检索增强框架，通过任务感知路由机制根据输入查询选择专业检索策略。该系统进一步整合了来自全文科学论文与结构化学术元数据的证据，并采用经过指令微调的紧凑语言模型生成带引用的回答。我们在多项学术任务上评估该框架，重点关注学术问答场景（包括单文档与多文档情境），以及领域迁移下的生物医学问答与科学文本压缩任务。研究发现：检索能力与模型规模是互补而非替代关系。虽然检索设计可以部分弥补较小模型的不足，但模型容量对于复杂推理任务仍至关重要。本研究表明，检索机制与任务感知设计是构建实用、可复现学术辅助工具的关键因素。
tldr: The paper investigates whether retrieval-augmented frameworks can compensate for smaller model size in scientific applications, finding that retrieval design and model scale are complementary for tasks like scholarly question answering.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了检索增强框架能否在科学应用中补偿小型模型规模，发现在学术问答等任务中，检索设计和模型规模是互补的。

title: Abnormal Head Movements in Neurological Conditions: A Knowledge-Based Dataset with Application to Cervical Dystonia
summary: Abnormal head movements (AHMs) manifest across a broad spectrum of neurological disorders; however, the absence of a multi-condition resource integrating kinematic measurements, clinical severity scores, and patient demographics constitutes a persistent barrier to the development of AI-driven diagnostic tools. To address this gap, this study introduces NeuroPose-AHM, a knowledge-based dataset of neurologically induced AHMs constructed through a multi-LLM extraction framework applied to 1,430 peer-reviewed publications. The dataset contains 2,756 patient-group-level records spanning 57 neurological conditions, derived from 846 AHM-relevant papers. Inter-LLM reliability analysis confirms robust extraction performance, with study-level classification achieving strong agreement (kappa = 0.822). To demonstrate the dataset's analytical utility, a four-task framework is applied to cervical dystonia (CD), the condition most directly defined by pathological head movement. First, Task 1 performs multi-label AHM type classification (F1 = 0.856). Task 2 constructs the Head-Neck Severity Index (HNSI), a unified metric that normalizes heterogeneous clinical rating scales. The clinical relevance of this index is then evaluated in Task 3, where HNSI is validated against real-world CD patient data, with aligned severe-band proportions (6.7%) providing a preliminary plausibility indication for index calibration within the high severity range. Finally, Task 4 performs bridge analysis between movement-type probabilities and HNSI scores, producing significant correlations (p less than 0.001). These results demonstrate the analytical utility of NeuroPose-AHM as a structured, knowledge-based resource for neurological AHM research. The NeuroPose-AHM dataset is publicly available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19386862).
summary_zh: 异常头部运动（AHMs）广泛存在于多种神经系统疾病中；然而，缺乏一个整合了运动学测量、临床严重程度评分和患者人口统计学信息的多病种资源，始终是开发人工智能驱动诊断工具的一个持续障碍。为填补这一空白，本研究引入了NeuroPose-AHM，这是一个基于知识的、由神经系统疾病诱发的异常头部运动数据集，通过一个应用于1,430篇同行评审出版物的多大型语言模型提取框架构建而成。该数据集包含来自846篇AHM相关论文的2,756条患者群体层面记录，涵盖57种神经系统疾病。大型语言模型间可靠性分析证实了提取的稳健性，研究层面分类具有高度一致性（kappa = 0.822）。为展示该数据集的分析效用，我们应用了一个四任务框架于以病理性头部运动为最直接定义的疾病——颈肌张力障碍。首先，任务1执行了多标签AHM类型分类（F1 = 0.856）。任务2构建了头颈部严重程度指数（HNSI），这是一个用于归一化异质临床评分量表的统一指标。随后，在任务3中评估了该指数的临床相关性，通过现实世界CD患者数据对HNSI进行了验证，其匹配的重度区间比例（6.7%）为指数在高严重程度范围内的校准提供了初步的合理性支持。最后，任务4执行了运动类型概率与HNSI评分之间的桥梁分析，产生了显著的相关性（p < 0.001）。这些结果证明了NeuroPose-AHM作为一个结构化的、基于知识的资源，在神经系统AHM研究中的分析效用。NeuroPose-AHM数据集已在Zenodo平台公开发布（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19386862）。
tldr: This paper introduces NeuroPose-AHM, a knowledge-based dataset of abnormal head movements extracted from medical literature, with analysis and metric validation focused on cervical dystonia. It is a dataset creation and validation study for AI-driven clinical diagnostics, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了NeuroPose-AHM，一个从医学文献中提取的异常头部运动知识数据集，并以颈部肌张力障碍为重点进行分析和指标验证。这是一项针对AI驱动临床诊断的数据集创建和验证研究，与机器人学或具身AI无关。

title: Physics-Informed Transformer for Multi-Band Channel Frequency Response Reconstruction
summary: Wideband channel frequency response (CFR) estimation is challenging in multi-band wireless systems, especially when one or more sub-bands are temporarily blocked by co-channel interference. We present a physics-informed complex Transformer that reconstructs the full wideband CFR from such fragmented, partially observed spectrum snapshots. The interference pattern in each sub-band is modeled as an independent two-state discrete-time Markov chain, capturing realistic bursty occupancy behavior. Our model operates on the joint time-frequency grid of $T$ snapshots and $F$ frequency bins and uses a factored self-attention mechanism that separately attends along both axes, reducing the computational complexity to $O(TF^2 + FT^2)$. Complex-valued inputs and outputs are processed through a holomorphic linear layer that preserves phase relationships. Training uses a composite physics-informed loss combining spectral fidelity, power delay profile (PDP) reconstruction, channel impulse response (CIR) sparsity, and temporal smoothness. Mobility effects are incorporated through per-sample velocity randomization, enabling generalization across different mobility regimes. Evaluation against three classical baselines, namely, last-observation-carry-forward, zero-fill, and cubic-spline interpolation, shows that our approach achieves the highest PDP similarity with respect to the ground truth, reaching $ρ\geq 0.82$ compared to $ρ\geq 0.62$ for the best baseline at interference occupancy levels up to 50%. Furthermore, the model degrades smoothly across the full velocity range, consistently outperforming all other baselines.
summary_zh: 宽带信道频率响应（CFR）估计在多频段无线系统中具有挑战性，尤其当一个或多个子频段被同频干扰暂时阻塞时。本文提出了一种基于物理知识的复数Transformer模型，能够从碎片化的、部分观测的频谱快照中重建完整的宽带CFR。每个子频段内的干扰模式被建模为独立的两态离散时间马尔可夫链，以捕捉实际环境中突发性占用行为。该模型在由$T$个时间快照和$F$个频点构成的时频联合网格上运行，采用因子分解自注意力机制，分别沿时间轴与频率轴进行注意力计算，将计算复杂度降至$O(TF^2 + FT^2)$。通过全纯线性层处理复数输入与输出，以保持相位关系。训练过程采用融合物理知识的复合损失函数，综合考量频谱保真度、功率延迟分布（PDP）重建、信道脉冲响应（CIR）稀疏性与时间平滑性。通过每样本速度随机化引入移动性影响，使模型能够泛化至不同移动场景。与三种经典基线方法（前次观测值填充、零值填充和三次样条插值）的对比实验表明，在干扰占用率高达50%的条件下，本文方法获得的PDP与真实值相似度最高，达到$ρ≥0.82$，而最优基线方法仅为$ρ≥0.62$。此外，该模型在全速度范围内性能下降平缓，始终优于所有基线方法。
tldr: A physics-informed Transformer model is proposed to reconstruct wideband channel frequency response from fragmented spectrum data in wireless systems, leveraging factored self-attention and a composite loss for improved performance over classical baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出一种物理信息驱动的Transformer模型，用于从无线系统中碎片化的频谱数据中重建宽带信道频率响应，采用分解自注意力机制和复合损失函数，性能优于经典基线方法。

title: Reliable News or Propagandist News? A Neurosymbolic Model Using Genre, Topic, and Persuasion Techniques to Improve Robustness in Classification
summary:
Among news disorders, propagandist news are particularly insidious, because they tend to mix oriented messages with factual reports intended to look like reliable news. To detect propaganda, extant approaches based on Language Models such as BERT are promising but often overfit their training datasets, due to biases in data collection. To enhance classification robustness and improve generalization to new sources, we propose a neurosymbolic approach combining non-contextual text embeddings (fastText) with symbolic conceptual features such as genre, topic, and persuasion techniques. Results show improvements over equivalent text-only methods, and ablation studies as well as explainability analyses confirm the benefits of the added features.
  Keywords: Information disorder, Fake news, Propaganda, Classification, Topic modeling, Hybrid method, Neurosymbolic model, Ablation, Robustness
summary_zh:
在新闻类信息失序中，宣传性新闻尤为隐蔽，因为它们往往将导向性信息与看似可靠新闻的事实报道混合在一起。现有基于语言模型（如BERT）的检测方法虽具潜力，但常因数据收集偏差导致对训练集过度拟合。为提升分类的鲁棒性并增强对新来源的泛化能力，本文提出一种神经符号化方法，将非上下文相关的文本嵌入（fastText）与体裁、主题、说服技巧等符号化概念特征相结合。实验结果表明，该方法优于同等的纯文本方法；消融研究与可解释性分析也验证了所添加特征的有效性。
关键词：信息失序，虚假新闻，宣传，分类，主题建模，混合方法，神经符号化模型，消融研究，鲁棒性
tldr: Proposes a neurosymbolic model combining fastText embeddings with symbolic features (genre, topic, persuasion techniques) to improve robustness and generalization in propaganda news classification over text-only methods.
tldr_zh: 提出一种神经符号模型，结合 fastText 嵌入与符号特征（体裁、主题、说服技巧）来提升宣传新闻分类的鲁棒性和泛化能力，优于纯文本方法。

title: Combating Data Laundering in LLM Training
summary: Data rights owners can detect unauthorized data use in large language model (LLM) training by querying with proprietary samples. Often, superior performance (e.g., higher confidence or lower loss) on a sample relative to the untrained data implies it was part of the training corpus, as LLMs tend to perform better on data they have seen during training. However, this detection becomes fragile under data laundering, a practice of transforming the stylistic form of proprietary data, while preserving critical information to obfuscate data provenance. When an LLM is trained exclusively on such laundered variants, it no longer performs better on originals, erasing the signals that standard detections rely on. We counter this by inferring the unknown laundering transformation from black-box access to the target LLM and, via an auxiliary LLM, synthesizing queries that mimic the laundered data, even if rights owners have only the originals. As the search space of finding true laundering transformations is infinite, we abstract such a process into a high-level transformation goal (e.g., "lyrical rewriting") and concrete details (e.g., "with vivid imagery"), and introduce synthesis data reversion (SDR) that instantiates this abstraction. SDR first identifies the most probable goal for synthesis to narrow the search; it then iteratively refines details so that synthesized queries gradually elicit stronger detection signals from the target LLM. Evaluated on the MIMIR benchmark against diverse laundering practices and target LLM families (Pythia, Llama2, and Falcon), SDR consistently strengthens data misuse detection, providing a practical countermeasure to data laundering.
summary_zh: 数据所有者可以通过使用专有样本进行查询，检测大型语言模型训练中未经授权的数据使用。通常，相对于未训练数据，模型在特定样本上表现出更优性能（如更高置信度或更低损失）意味着该样本是训练数据的一部分，因为大型语言模型在训练期间见过的数据上往往表现更好。然而，在数据洗白操作下，这种检测变得脆弱——数据洗白通过改变专有数据的风格形式，同时保留关键信息以模糊数据来源。当大型语言模型仅使用此类洗白变体进行训练时，其在原始数据上的表现不再更优，从而抹除了标准检测所依赖的信号。针对此问题，我们提出通过黑盒访问目标大型语言模型推断未知的洗白变换，并借助辅助模型合成模拟洗白数据的查询，即使数据所有者仅拥有原始数据。由于寻找真实洗白变换的搜索空间是无限的，我们将此过程抽象为高级变换目标（如“抒情化改写”）与具体细节（如“使用生动意象”），并引入合成数据还原技术来实现该抽象。该技术首先识别最可能的合成目标以缩小搜索范围；随后通过迭代优化细节，使合成的查询逐渐从目标模型中引出更强的检测信号。在MIMIR基准测试中，针对多种数据洗白实践及不同目标模型系列（Pythia、Llama2和Falcon）的评估表明，该技术持续增强了数据滥用检测能力，为应对数据洗白提供了切实可行的对策。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to detect unauthorized data use in LLMs even when the data has been laundered (stylistically transformed) to obfuscate its provenance, by inferring the laundering transformation and synthesizing queries that mimic the laundered data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于检测LLM中未经授权的数据使用，即使数据已被清洗（风格转换）以掩盖其来源，该方法通过推断清洗变换并合成模仿清洗后数据的查询来实现。

title: A deep learning pipeline for PAM50 subtype classification using histopathology images and multi-objective patch selection
summary: Breast cancer is a highly heterogeneous disease with diverse molecular profiles. The PAM50 gene signature is widely recognized as a standard for classifying breast cancer into intrinsic subtypes, enabling more personalized treatment strategies. In this study, we introduce a novel optimization-driven deep learning framework that aims to reduce reliance on costly molecular assays by directly predicting PAM50 subtypes from H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs). Our method jointly optimizes patch informativeness, spatial diversity, uncertainty, and patch count by combining the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) with Monte Carlo dropout-based uncertainty estimation. The proposed method can identify a small but highly informative patch subset for classification. We used a ResNet18 backbone for feature extraction and a custom CNN head for classification. For evaluation, we used the internal TCGA-BRCA dataset as the training cohort and the external CPTAC-BRCA dataset as the test cohort. On the internal dataset, an F1-score of 0.8812 and an AUC of 0.9841 using 627 WSIs from the TCGA-BRCA cohort were achieved. The performance of the proposed approach on the external validation dataset showed an F1-score of 0.7952 and an AUC of 0.9512. These findings indicate that the proposed optimization-guided, uncertainty-aware patch selection can achieve high performance and improve the computational efficiency of histopathology-based PAM50 classification compared to existing methods, suggesting a scalable imaging-based replacement that has the potential to support clinical decision-making.
summary_zh: 乳腺癌是一种具有高度异质性和多样化分子特征的疾病。PAM50基因标记被广泛认为是将乳腺癌划分为内在亚型的标准工具，有助于实现更精准的个性化治疗策略。本研究提出了一种新颖的优化驱动深度学习框架，旨在通过直接从H&E染色全切片图像中预测PAM50亚型，降低对昂贵分子检测的依赖。我们通过将非支配排序遗传算法II与基于蒙特卡洛Dropout的不确定性估计相结合，联合优化了图像区块的信息量、空间多样性、不确定性及区块数量。该方法能够筛选出少量但信息量高的图像区块子集用于分类任务。我们采用ResNet18主干网络进行特征提取，并设计自定义CNN头部进行分类。在评估阶段，我们使用内部TCGA-BRCA数据集作为训练队列，外部CPTAC-BRCA数据集作为测试队列。在内部数据集上，基于TCGA-BRCA队列的627张全切片图像，模型取得了0.8812的F1分数和0.9841的AUC值。在外部验证数据集上，该方法获得0.7952的F1分数和0.9512的AUC值。这些结果表明，与现有方法相比，所提出的优化引导、不确定性感知的图像区块选择策略能够实现高性能表现，并提升基于组织病理学的PAM50分类计算效率，为临床决策支持提供了一种可扩展的影像学替代方案。
tldr: The paper proposes a deep learning framework using NSGA-II and Monte Carlo dropout for selecting informative patches from histopathology images to predict breast cancer subtypes, aiming to replace costly molecular assays.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种深度学习框架，结合NSGA-II和蒙特卡洛dropout从组织病理学图像中选择信息丰富的斑块，以预测乳腺癌亚型，旨在替代昂贵的分子检测。

title: FSKD: Monocular Forest Structure Inference via LiDAR-to-RGBI Knowledge Distillation
summary: Very High Resolution (VHR) forest structure data at individual-tree scale is essential for carbon, biodiversity, and ecosystem monitoring. Still, airborne LiDAR remains costly and infrequent despite being the reference for forest structure metrics like Canopy Height Model (CHM), Plant Area Index (PAI), and Foliage Height Diversity (FHD). We propose FSKD: a LiDAR-to-RGB-Infrared (RGBI) knowledge distillation (KD) framework in which a multi-modal teacher fuses RGBI imagery with LiDAR-derived planar metrics and vertical profiles via cross-attention, and an RGBI-only SegFormer student learns to reproduce these outputs. Trained on 384 $km^2$ of forests in Saxony, Germany (20 cm ground sampling distance (GSD)) and evaluated on eight geographically distinct test tiles, the student achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot CHM performance (MedAE 4.17 m, $R^2$=0.51, IoU 0.87), outperforming HRCHM/DAC baselines by 29--46% in MAE (5.81 m vs. 8.14--10.84 m) with stronger correlation coefficients (0.713 vs. 0.166--0.652). Ablations show that multi-modal fusion improves performance by 10--26% over RGBI-only training, and that asymmetric distillation with appropriate model capacity is critical. The method jointly predicts CHM, PAI, and FHD, a multi-metric capability not provided by current monocular CHM estimators, although PAI/FHD transfer remains region-dependent and benefits from local calibration. The framework also remains effective under temporal mismatch (winter LiDAR, summer RGBI), removing strict co-acquisition constraints and enabling scalable 20 cm operational monitoring for workflows such as Digital Twin Germany and national Digital Orthophoto programs.
summary_zh: 单木尺度的超高分辨率森林结构数据对于碳监测、生物多样性及生态系统监测至关重要。然而，尽管机载激光雷达是冠层高度模型、植物面积指数和叶层高度多样性等森林结构指标的标准获取手段，其仍存在成本高昂、采集频率不足的问题。本研究提出FSKD框架：一种基于知识蒸馏的激光雷达至红绿蓝-红外多光谱转换方法。该框架采用多模态教师模型，通过交叉注意力机制融合红绿蓝-红外影像与激光雷达衍生的平面指标及垂直剖面特征；同时训练仅使用红绿蓝-红外数据的SegFormer学生模型，使其学习复现教师模型的输出结果。基于德国萨克森州384平方公里森林区域（地面采样距离20厘米）数据进行训练，并在八个地理分布独立的测试区域进行评估，学生模型在零样本冠层高度模型预测中取得最先进性能（中位绝对误差4.17米，决定系数0.51，交并比0.87），其平均绝对误差较HRCHM/DAC基线方法降低29%至46%（5.81米对比8.14-10.84米），且具有更强的相关系数（0.713对比0.166-0.652）。消融实验表明：多模态融合较纯红绿蓝-红外训练性能提升10%至26%，采用适当模型容量的非对称蒸馏策略至关重要。该方法能同时预测冠层高度模型、植物面积指数和叶层高度多样性，实现了当前单目冠层高度模型估计器不具备的多指标预测能力，但植物面积指数/叶层高度多样性的迁移效果仍存在区域依赖性，需通过本地校准优化。该框架在时序不匹配条件下（冬季激光雷达数据与夏季红绿蓝-红外影像）仍保持有效性，突破了严格同步采集的限制，可为"德国数字孪生"项目及国家数字正射影像计划等工作流程提供可扩展的20厘米级业务化监测能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a knowledge distillation method to infer forest structure from monocular RGB-Infrared imagery, using a multi-modal teacher with LiDAR data. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance for metrics like canopy height, with applications in environmental monitoring, but has no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识蒸馏方法，利用融合了LiDAR数据的多模态教师模型，从单目RGB-红外图像推断森林结构。该方法在树冠高度等指标上实现了零样本的SOTA性能，应用于环境监测领域，但与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。

title: FourierMoE: Fourier Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for adapting large language models (LLMs) under constrained computational budgets. However, standard PEFT methods often struggle in multi-task fine-tuning settings, where diverse optimization objectives induce task interference and limited parameter budgets lead to representational deficiency. While recent approaches incorporate mixture-of-experts (MoE) to alleviate these issues, they predominantly operate in the spatial domain, which may introduce structural redundancy and parameter overhead. To overcome these limitations, we reformulate adaptation in the spectral domain. Our spectral analysis reveals that different tasks exhibit distinct frequency energy distributions, and that LLM layers display heterogeneous frequency sensitivities. Motivated by these insights, we propose FourierMoE, which integrates the MoE architecture with the inverse discrete Fourier transform (IDFT) for frequency-aware adaptation. Specifically, FourierMoE employs a frequency-adaptive router to dispatch tokens to experts specialized in distinct frequency bands. Each expert learns a set of conjugate-symmetric complex coefficients, preserving complete phase and amplitude information while theoretically guaranteeing lossless IDFT reconstruction into real-valued spatial weights. Extensive evaluations across 28 benchmarks, multiple model architectures, and scales demonstrate that FourierMoE consistently outperforms competitive baselines in both single-task and multi-task settings while using significantly fewer trainable parameters. These results highlight the promise of spectral-domain expert adaptation as an effective and parameter-efficient paradigm for LLM fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 摘要：参数高效微调已成为在有限计算资源下适配大型语言模型的关键范式。然而，标准PEFT方法在多任务微调场景中常面临挑战——多样化的优化目标易引发任务间干扰，而有限参数预算则导致表示能力不足。现有研究虽引入专家混合架构以缓解此类问题，但其主要基于空间域操作，可能引入结构冗余与参数开销。为突破这些局限，我们提出在频域中重构适配过程。频谱分析表明：不同任务呈现出差异化的频率能量分布，且大语言模型各层对频率的敏感度存在异质性。基于此发现，我们提出FourierMoE，将MoE架构与离散傅里叶逆变换结合，实现频率感知的模型适配。该方法通过频率自适应路由器将词元分配给专注于不同频段的专家模块，每个专家学习一组共轭对称的复数系数，在保留完整相位与振幅信息的同时，理论上可通过无损IDFT重建为实数空间权重。在28个基准测试、多种模型架构与规模的综合评估中，FourierMoE在单任务与多任务场景下均显著优于现有基线方法，且可训练参数大幅减少。这些成果揭示了频域专家适配作为高效参数微调范式的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces FourierMoE, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for LLMs that uses a mixture-of-experts architecture in the spectral domain to reduce task interference and improve multi-task adaptation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FourierMoE，一种用于大语言模型的参数高效微调方法，在频谱域中采用专家混合架构，以减少任务干扰并提升多任务适应能力。

title: Solving the Two-dimensional single stock size Cuting Stock Problem with SAT and MaxSAT
summary: Cutting rectangular items from stock sheets to satisfy demands while minimizing waste is a central manufacturing task. The Two-Dimensional Single Stock Size Cutting Stock Problem (2D-CSSP) generalizes bin packing by requiring multiple copies of each item type, which causes a strong combinatorial blow-up. We present a SAT-based framework where item types are expanded by demand, each copy has a sheet-assignment variable and non-overlap constraints are activated only for copies assigned to the same sheet. We also introduce an infeasible-orientation elimination rule that fixes rotation variables when only one orientation can fit the sheet. For minimizing the number of sheets, we compare three approaches: non-incremental SAT with binary search, incremental SAT with clause reuse across iterations and weighted partial MaxSAT. On the Cui--Zhao benchmark suite, our best SAT configurations certify two to three times more instances as provably optimal and achieve lower optimality gaps than OR-Tools, CPLEX and Gurobi. The relative ranking among SAT approaches depends on rotation: incremental SAT is strongest without rotation, while non-incremental SAT is more effective when rotation increases formula size.
summary_zh: 从库存板材中切割矩形件以满足需求，同时最小化浪费是制造业的核心任务。二维单规格板材切割问题（2D-CSSP）通过要求每种零件类型的多个副本推广了装箱问题，这导致了强烈的组合爆炸。我们提出了一种基于可满足性理论的框架，其中零件类型按需求量展开，每个副本设有板材分配变量，且仅当副本被分配至同一板材时才激活非重叠约束。我们还引入了一种不可行方向消除规则，当仅有一种方向能适应板材时，用于固定旋转变量。在最小化板材数量方面，我们比较了三种方法：基于二分搜索的非增量可满足性理论求解、跨迭代重用子句的增量可满足性理论求解，以及加权部分最大可满足性理论求解。在Cui-Zhao基准测试集中，我们最优的可满足性理论配置被证明为最优解的实例数量是OR-Tools、CPLEX和Gurobi的两到三倍，且获得了更小的最优性间隙。可满足性理论方法间的相对排序取决于旋转因素：无旋转时增量可满足性理论最强，而旋转增加公式规模时，非增量可满足性理论更为有效。
tldr: A SAT-based approach for the 2D single stock size cutting stock problem, focusing on minimizing waste by efficiently arranging items on sheets, with performance improvements over existing optimization tools.
tldr_zh: 针对二维单尺寸板材切割问题，提出了一种基于SAT的方法，通过有效排列板材上的物品来最小化浪费，其性能优于现有优化工具。

title: The AnIML Ontology: Enabling Semantic Interoperability for Large-Scale Experimental Data in Interconnected Scientific Labs
summary: Achieving semantic interoperability across heterogeneous experimental data systems remains a major barrier to data-driven scientific discovery. The Analytical Information Markup Language (AnIML), a flexible XML-based standard for analytical chemistry and biology, is increasingly used in industrial R&D labs for managing and exchanging experimental data. However, the expressivity of the XML schema permits divergent interpretations across stakeholders, introducing inconsistencies that undermine the interoperability the AnIML schema was designed to support. In this paper, we present the AnIML Ontology, an OWL 2 ontology that formalises the semantics of AnIML and aligns it with the Allotrope Data Format to support future cross-system and cross-lab interoperability. The ontology was developed using an expert-in-the-loop approach combining LLM-assisted requirement elicitation with collaborative ontology engineering. We validate the ontology through a multi-layered approach: data-driven transformation of real-world AnIML files into knowledge graphs, competency question verification via SPARQL, and a novel validation protocol based on adversarial negative competency questions mapped to established ontological anti-patterns and enforced via SHACL constraints.
summary_zh: 在异构实验数据系统之间实现语义互操作性，仍然是数据驱动科学发现面临的主要障碍。分析信息标记语言（AnIML）作为一种基于XML的灵活标准，适用于分析化学和生物学领域，正日益广泛地应用于工业研发实验室以管理和交换实验数据。然而，其XML模式的表达性允许各利益相关方产生不同的解读，导致不一致性，从而削弱了AnIML模式本应支持的互操作性。本文提出了一种基于OWL 2的本体——AnIML本体，它形式化地定义了AnIML的语义，并将其与Allotrope数据格式对齐，以支持未来跨系统、跨实验室的互操作。该本体采用专家参与的循环开发方法，结合了大型语言模型辅助的需求提取与协作式本体工程。我们通过多层面方法验证了该本体：将真实世界的AnIML文件转换为知识图谱，利用SPARQL进行能力问题验证，并提出一种基于对抗性负能力问题的新型验证协议，该协议映射至已建立的本体反模式，并通过SHACL约束加以实施。
tldr: This paper introduces the AnIML Ontology, an OWL 2 ontology that formalizes the semantics of the AnIML XML standard used in analytical chemistry and biology to improve data interoperability across labs, validated using LLM-assisted development and knowledge graph transformation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AnIML本体，一种用于形式化分析化学和生物学领域AnIML XML标准语义的OWL 2本体，旨在提高跨实验室数据互操作性，并通过LLM辅助开发、知识图谱转换和SHACL约束进行验证。

title: Development and multi-center evaluation of domain-adapted speech recognition for human-AI teaming in real-world gastrointestinal endoscopy
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) is a critical interface for human-AI interaction in gastrointestinal endoscopy, yet its reliability in real-world clinical settings is limited by domain-specific terminology and complex acoustic conditions. Here, we present EndoASR, a domain-adapted ASR system designed for real-time deployment in endoscopic workflows. We develop a two-stage adaptation strategy based on synthetic endoscopy reports, targeting domain-specific language modeling and noise robustness. In retrospective evaluation across six endoscopists, EndoASR substantially improves both transcription accuracy and clinical usability, reducing character error rate (CER) from 20.52% to 14.14% and increasing medical term accuracy (Med ACC) from 54.30% to 87.59%. In a prospective multi-center study spanning five independent endoscopy centers, EndoASR demonstrates consistent generalization under heterogeneous real-world conditions. Compared with the baseline Paraformer model, CER is reduced from 16.20% to 14.97%, while Med ACC is improved from 61.63% to 84.16%, confirming its robustness in practical deployment scenarios. Notably, EndoASR achieves a real-time factor (RTF) of 0.005, significantly faster than Whisper-large-v3 (RTF 0.055), while maintaining a compact model size of 220M parameters, enabling efficient edge deployment. Furthermore, integration with large language models demonstrates that improved ASR quality directly enhances downstream structured information extraction and clinician-AI interaction. These results demonstrate that domain-adapted ASR can serve as a reliable interface for human-AI teaming in gastrointestinal endoscopy, with consistent performance validated across multi-center real-world clinical settings.
summary_zh: 自动语音识别（ASR）是胃肠道内窥镜人机交互的关键接口，但其在真实临床环境中的可靠性受限于领域术语的复杂性和声学条件的多变性。本文提出了EndoASR，一种面向内窥镜工作流程实时部署的领域自适应ASR系统。我们基于合成内窥镜报告开发了针对领域语言建模和噪声鲁棒性的两阶段适应策略。在六位内镜医师的回顾性评估中，EndoASR显著提升了转录准确率与临床可用性，将字符错误率（CER）从20.52%降至14.14%，医学术语准确率（Med ACC）从54.30%提升至87.59%。在一项覆盖五个独立内窥镜中心的前瞻性多中心研究中，EndoASR在异构真实场景中表现出稳定的泛化能力：与基线Paraformer模型相比，CER从16.20%降至14.97%，Med ACC从61.63%提升至84.16%，证实了其在真实部署场景中的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，EndoASR实现了0.005的实时因子（RTF），显著快于Whisper-large-v3（RTF 0.055），同时保持2.2亿参数的紧凑模型规模，支持高效边缘部署。此外，与大语言模型的集成验证了ASR质量的提升能直接增强下游结构化信息提取与临床人机交互效能。这些结果表明，领域自适应ASR可作为胃肠道内窥镜人机协同的可靠接口，其性能在多中心真实临床环境中得到了一致验证。
tldr: This paper presents EndoASR, a domain-adapted speech recognition system for real-time human-AI interaction in clinical gastrointestinal endoscopy. It is not related to robotics, embodied AI, or physical control.
tldr_zh: 本研究介绍了EndoASR，一种用于临床胃肠道内窥镜中实时人机交互的领域自适应语音识别系统。该工作与机器人学、具身人工智能或物理控制无关。

title: MiCA Learns More Knowledge Than LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning
summary: Minor Component Adaptation (MiCA) is a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models that focuses on adapting underutilized subspaces of model representations. Unlike conventional methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which target dominant subspaces, MiCA leverages Singular Value Decomposition to identify subspaces related to minor singular vectors associated with the least significant singular values and constrains the update of parameters during fine-tuning to those directions. This strategy leads to up to 5.9x improvement in knowledge acquisition under optimized training hyperparameters and a minimal parameter footprint of 6-60% compared to LoRA. These results suggest that constraining adaptation to minor singular directions provides a more efficient and stable mechanism for integrating new knowledge into pre-trained language models.
summary_zh:
摘要：
微成分自适应（MiCA）是一种面向大型语言模型的新型参数高效微调方法，其核心在于对模型表征中未充分利用的子空间进行适配。与传统方法如低秩自适应（LoRA）主要作用于优势子空间不同，MiCA利用奇异值分解识别与最小奇异值相关的微奇异向量子空间，并将微调过程中的参数更新约束于这些方向。在优化训练超参数条件下，该方法相较于LoRA在知识获取能力上实现最高5.9倍的提升，同时仅需6-60%的参数规模。研究结果表明，将自适应过程约束于微奇异方向，能为预训练语言模型整合新知识提供更高效、更稳定的机制。
tldr: MiCA is a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models that adapts minor, underutilized representation subspaces, achieving up to 5.9x better knowledge acquisition than LoRA with fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: MiCA是一种新颖的参数高效微调方法，它通过适配模型中未充分利用的次要表征子空间，以比LoRA更少的参数实现了高达5.9倍的知识获取提升。

title: GPA: Learning GUI Process Automation from Demonstrations
summary: GUI Process Automation (GPA) is a lightweight but general vision-based Robotic Process Automation (RPA), which enables fast and stable process replay with only a single demo. Addressing the fragility of traditional RPA and the non-deterministic risks of current vision language model-based GUI agents, GPA introduces three core benefits: (1) Robustness via Sequential Monte Carlo-based localization to handle rescaling and detection uncertainty; (2) Deterministic and Reliability safeguarded by readiness calibration; and (3) Privacy through fast, fully local execution. This approach delivers the adaptability, robustness, and security required for enterprise workflows. It can also be used as an MCP/CLI tool by other agents with coding capabilities so that the agent only reasons and orchestrates while GPA handles the GUI execution. We conducted a pilot experiment to compare GPA with Gemini 3 Pro (with CUA tools) and found that GPA achieves higher success rate with 10 times faster execution speed in finishing long-horizon GUI tasks.
summary_zh:
摘要：
图形用户界面过程自动化（GPA）是一种轻量级但通用的基于视觉的机器人过程自动化（RPA），它仅需单次演示即可实现快速稳定的过程重放。针对传统RPA的脆弱性以及当前基于视觉语言模型的GUI代理所存在的非确定性风险，GPA引入了三大核心优势：（1）通过基于序贯蒙特卡洛的定位机制提升鲁棒性，以处理界面缩放及检测不确定性；（2）通过就绪状态校准确保确定性与可靠性；（3）借助快速、完全本地化执行保障隐私性。该方法满足了企业工作流所需的适应性、鲁棒性与安全性。GPA还可作为MCP/CLI工具供具备编码能力的其他智能体调用，使智能体仅需进行推理与任务编排，而由GPA处理GUI执行。我们通过初步实验将GPA与Gemini 3 Pro（搭载CUA工具）进行对比，发现GPA在执行长周期GUI任务时，不仅达成更高成功率，且执行速度提升达十倍。
tldr: This paper presents GPA, a vision-based method for automating GUI processes from a single demonstration. It focuses on robustness, reliability, and privacy for enterprise workflows, outperforming a large language model agent in long-horizon GUI tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GPA，一种基于视觉的、仅需单次演示即可学习并自动化GUI流程的方法。它专注于企业工作流的鲁棒性、可靠性和隐私性，在完成长视野GUI任务时，其成功率和速度优于大型语言模型代理。

title: Ontology-Aware Design Patterns for Clinical AI Systems: Translating Reification Theory into Software Architecture
summary: Clinical AI systems routinely train on health data structurally distorted by documentation workflows, billing incentives, and terminology fragmentation. Prior work has characterised the mechanisms of this distortion: the three-forces model of documentary enactment, the reification feedback loop through which AI may amplify coding artefacts, and terminology governance failures that allow semantic drift to accumulate. Yet translating these insights into implementable software architecture remains an open problem. This paper proposes seven ontology-aware design patterns in Gang-of-Four pattern language for building clinical AI pipelines resilient to ontological distortion. The patterns address data ingestion validation (Ontological Checkpoint), low-frequency signal preservation (Dormancy-Aware Pipeline), continuous drift monitoring (Drift Sentinel), parallel representation maintenance (Dual-Ontology Layer), feedback loop interruption (Reification Circuit Breaker), terminology evolution management (Terminology Version Gate), and pluggable regulatory compliance (Regulatory Compliance Adapter). Each pattern is specified with Problem, Forces, Solution, Consequences, Known Uses, and Related Patterns. We illustrate their composition in a reference architecture for a primary care AI system and provide a walkthrough tracing all seven patterns through a diabetes risk prediction scenario. This paper does not report empirical validation; it offers a design vocabulary grounded in theoretical analysis, subject to future evaluation in production systems. Three patterns have partial precedent in existing systems; the remaining four have not been formally described. Limitations include the absence of runtime benchmarks and restriction to the German and EU regulatory context.
summary_zh: 临床AI系统通常基于被文档工作流程、计费激励和术语碎片化结构性扭曲的健康数据训练。先前的研究已经刻画了这种扭曲的机制：文档化实施的三力模型、AI可能放大编码人工制品的具象化反馈循环，以及允许语义漂移积累的术语治理失效。然而，将这些洞见转化为可实施的软件架构仍是一个开放问题。本文以四人组设计模式语言提出七种本体感知设计模式，用于构建能够抵抗本体扭曲的临床AI流水线。这些模式涵盖数据摄取验证（本体检查点）、低频信号保留（休眠感知流水线）、持续漂移监控（漂移哨兵）、并行表征维护（双本体层）、反馈循环中断（具象化熔断器）、术语演化管理（术语版本门）以及可插拔监管合规（监管合规适配器）。每种模式均以问题、约束条件、解决方案、后果、已知应用和相关模式进行详细说明。我们通过一个初级诊疗AI系统的参考架构展示其组合方式，并以糖尿病风险预测场景为例贯穿所有七种模式进行演示。本文未报告实证验证结果，而是提供了一套基于理论分析的设计词汇，有待未来在生产系统中进行评估。其中三种模式在现有系统中已有部分先例，其余四种模式尚未被正式描述。局限性包括缺少运行时性能基准测试，且仅适用于德国及欧盟监管背景。
tldr: Proposes seven ontology-aware design patterns for building clinical AI systems that are resilient to distortions in health data, translating theoretical insights into a software architecture framework with a focus on healthcare terminology and regulatory compliance.
tldr_zh: 提出了七种面向本体的设计模式，用于构建能够抵御健康数据失真的临床人工智能系统，将理论见解转化为软件架构框架，重点关注医学术语和法规遵从性。

title: Moiré Video Authentication: A Physical Signature Against AI Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made AI-synthesized content increasingly difficult to distinguish from real footage. We propose a physics-based authentication signature that real cameras produce naturally, but that generative models cannot faithfully reproduce. Our approach exploits the Moiré effect: the interference fringes formed when a camera views a compact two-layer grating structure. We derive the Moiré motion invariant, showing that fringe phase and grating image displacement are linearly coupled by optical geometry, independent of viewing distance and grating structure. A verifier extracts both signals from video and tests their correlation. We validate the invariant on both real-captured and AI-generated videos from multiple state-of-the-art generators, and find that real and AI-generated videos produce significantly different correlation signatures, suggesting a robust means of differentiating them. Our work demonstrates that deterministic optical phenomena can serve as physically grounded, verifiable signatures against AI-generated video.
summary_zh: 近期视频生成技术的进步使得AI合成内容与真实影像的区分日益困难。我们提出一种基于物理的认证特征——这种特征由真实摄像机自然产生，而生成模型无法精确复现。该方法利用莫尔效应：当摄像机拍摄紧凑的双层光栅结构时产生的干涉条纹。我们推导出莫尔运动不变性，证明条纹相位与光栅图像位移通过光学几何线性耦合，且与观测距离和光栅结构无关。验证器从视频中提取两种信号并检验其相关性。我们在多个前沿生成器制作的真实拍摄视频与AI生成视频上验证了该不变性，发现真实视频与AI生成视频呈现出显著不同的相关特征，这为区分两者提供了可靠方法。本研究证明，确定性光学现象可作为对抗AI生成视频的、基于物理的可验证特征。
tldr: This paper proposes a physics-based authentication method using Moiré patterns to distinguish AI-generated videos from real footage, exploiting optical invariants that current generative models cannot replicate.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于莫尔条纹的物理认证方法，利用光学不变性来区分AI生成的视频和真实录像，当前生成模型无法复制这种物理特征。

title: Analysis of LLM Performance on AWS Bedrock: Receipt-item Categorisation Case Study
summary: This paper presents a systematic, cost-aware evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for receipt-item categorisation within a production-oriented classification framework. We compare four instruction-tuned models available through AWS Bedrock: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 4 Sonnet, Mixtral 8x7B Instruct, and Mistral 7B Instruct. The aim of the study was (1) to assess performance across accuracy, response stability, and token-level cost, and (2) to investigate what prompting methods, zero-shot or few-shot, are especially appropriate both in terms of accuracy and in terms of incurred costs. Results of our experiments demonstrated that Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves the most favourable balance between classification accuracy and cost efficiency.
summary_zh: 本文以生产导向的分类框架为基础，对用于收据条目分类的大语言模型进行了系统性、成本敏感性的评估。我们比较了通过AWS Bedrock提供的四种指令调优模型：Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Claude 4 Sonnet、Mixtral 8x7B Instruct以及Mistral 7B Instruct。研究目标为：（1）从准确性、响应稳定性和令牌级成本三个维度评估模型性能；（2）探究在准确性与成本考量下，零样本提示与少样本提示中何种方法更具适用性。实验结果表明，Claude 3.7 Sonnet在分类准确性与成本效益之间取得了最佳平衡。
tldr: This paper evaluates the cost and performance of several large language models (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 4 Sonnet, Mixtral 8x7B Instruct, Mistral 7B Instruct) on AWS Bedrock for a receipt-item categorization task, focusing on accuracy and cost-efficiency across different prompting methods.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了在AWS Bedrock平台上使用几种大型语言模型进行收据条目分类的成本和性能，重点关注不同提示方法下的准确性和成本效益。

title: ModTrans: Translating Real-world Models for Distributed Training Simulator
summary: Large-scale distributed training has been a research hot spot in machine learning systems for industry and academia in recent years. However, conducting experiments without physical machines and corresponding resources is difficult. One solution is to leverage distributed training simulators, but current ones like ASTRA-sim do not support importing real-world developed models, which poses challenges for ML researchers seeking to use them. Based on this challenge, we developed ModTrans, a translator supporting format translation from any real-world model to the ASTRA-sim simulator's input, removing the barrier between machine learning experts and machine learning system researchers. The experiment results show that ModTrans's cost is negligible.
summary_zh: 近年来，大规模分布式训练已成为工业界与学术界在机器学习系统领域的研究热点。然而，在没有实体机器和相应资源的情况下进行实验十分困难。一种解决方案是利用分布式训练模拟器，但当前如ASTRA-sim等模拟器尚不支持导入真实场景开发的模型，这为希望使用该工具的机器学习研究者带来了挑战。基于此问题，我们开发了ModTrans——一款支持将任意真实模型格式转换为ASTRA-sim模拟器输入的翻译器，从而消除了机器学习专家与机器学习系统研究者之间的壁垒。实验结果表明，ModTrans引入的开销可忽略不计。
tldr: This paper presents ModTrans, a tool for translating real-world ML models into a format compatible with the ASTRA-sim distributed training simulator, aiming to reduce the barrier for ML researchers to use simulation tools.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ModTrans工具，可将真实世界开发的机器学习模型转换为ASTRA-sim分布式训练模拟器的输入格式，旨在降低机器学习研究人员使用仿真工具的门槛。

title: CRaFT: Circuit-Guided Refusal Feature Selection via Cross-Layer Transcoders
summary: As safety concerns around large language models (LLMs) grow, understanding the internal mechanisms underlying refusal behavior has become increasingly important. Recent work has studied this behavior by identifying internal features associated with refusal and manipulating them to induce compliance with harmful requests. However, existing refusal feature selection methods rely on how strongly features activate on harmful prompts, which tends to capture superficial signals rather than the causal factors underlying the refusal decision. We propose CRaFT, a circuit-guided refusal feature selection framework that ranks features by their influence on the model's refusal-compliance decision using prompts near the refusal boundary. On Gemma-3-1B-it, CRaFT improves attack success rate (ASR) from 6.7% to 48.2% and outperforms baseline methods across multiple jailbreak benchmarks. These results suggest that circuit influence is a more reliable criterion than activation magnitude for identifying features that causally mediate refusal behavior.
summary_zh: 随着人们对大型语言模型安全性的日益关注，理解拒绝行为的内在机制变得越来越重要。近期研究通过识别与拒绝行为相关的内部特征并操纵这些特征来促使模型遵从有害请求，从而探究这一行为。然而，现有的拒绝特征选择方法依赖于特征在有害提示上的激活强度，这往往捕捉到的是表面信号而非拒绝决策背后的因果因素。本文提出CRaFT，一种基于因果回路的拒绝特征选择框架，该框架通过使用接近拒绝决策边界的提示来评估特征对模型拒绝-遵从决策的影响程度，并据此对特征进行排序。在Gemma-3-1B-it模型上的实验表明，CRaFT将攻击成功率从6.7%提升至48.2%，并在多个越狱基准测试中优于现有基线方法。这些结果证明，相较于激活强度，回路影响程度是识别因果性调节拒绝行为特征的更可靠标准。
tldr: The paper introduces CRaFT, a method for identifying and manipulating the internal 'circuit' features that causally drive refusal behavior in large language models, using boundary prompts to improve the selection process over activation-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为CRaFT的方法，通过边界提示识别和操纵大语言模型内部导致拒绝行为的因果‘回路’特征，相比基于激活幅度的方法，能更可靠地提升越狱攻击的成功率。

title: Acoustic and perceptual differences between standard and accented Chinese speech and their voice clones
summary: Voice cloning is often evaluated in terms of overall quality, but less is known about accent preservation and its perceptual consequences. We compare standard and heavily accented Mandarin speech and their voice clones using a combined computational and perceptual design. Embedding-based analyses show no reliable accented-standard difference in original-clone distances across systems. In the perception study, clones are rated as more similar to their originals for standard than for accented speakers, and intelligibility increases from original to clone, with a larger gain for accented speech. These results show that accent variation can shape perceived identity match and intelligibility in voice cloning even when it is not reflected in an off-the-shelf speaker-embedding distance, and they motivate evaluating speaker identity preservation and accent preservation as separable dimensions.
summary_zh: 语音克隆通常从整体质量角度进行评估，但对其口音保留能力及感知影响的研究仍不充分。本研究通过计算与感知相结合的设计，比较了标准普通话与重度口音普通话及其语音克隆效果。基于嵌入向量的分析表明，在不同系统中，原始语音与克隆语音之间的距离并未呈现稳定的口音-标准差异。感知实验发现，相较于带口音者，标准发音者的克隆语音被评价为与原始语音更相似；同时克隆语音的清晰度较原始语音有所提升，且带口音语音的清晰度增益更为显著。这些结果表明，即使现成的说话人嵌入距离未能反映出口音差异，口音变化仍会影响语音克隆中感知身份匹配度和清晰度，这提示我们应将说话人身份保留与口音保留作为两个独立维度进行评估。
tldr: This paper investigates accent preservation in voice cloning, comparing standard and accented Mandarin speech. It finds clones are perceived as more similar for standard speakers, and that accent variation affects perceived identity and intelligibility, even when not reflected in standard embedding metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了语音克隆中的口音保持问题，比较了标准普通话和带口音的普通话及其克隆语音。研究发现，克隆语音在标准口音说话者上感知相似度更高，且口音差异影响身份感知和可懂度，尽管标准嵌入指标未能反映这些差异。

title: RAE-AR: Taming Autoregressive Models with Representation Autoencoders
summary: The latent space of generative modeling is long dominated by the VAE encoder. The latents from the pretrained representation encoders (e.g., DINO, SigLIP, MAE) are previously considered inappropriate for generative modeling. Recently, RAE method lights the hope and reveals that the representation autoencoder can also achieve competitive performance as the VAE encoder. However, the integration of representation autoencoder into continuous autoregressive (AR) models, remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the challenges of employing high-dimensional representation autoencoders within the AR paradigm, denoted as \textit{RAE-AR}. We focus on the unique properties of AR models and identify two primary hurdles: complex token-wise distribution modeling and the high-dimensionality amplified training-inference gap (exposure bias). To address these, we introduce token simplification via distribution normalization to ease modeling difficulty and improve convergence. Furthermore, we enhance prediction robustness by incorporating Gaussian noise injection during training to mitigate exposure bias. Our empirical results demonstrate that these modifications substantially bridge the performance gap, enabling representation autoencoder to achieve results comparable to traditional VAEs on AR models. This work paves the way for a more unified architecture across visual understanding and generative modeling.
summary_zh: 生成模型的潜在空间长期由变分自编码器（VAE）编码器主导。以往认为，来自预训练表征编码器（如DINO、SigLIP、MAE）的潜在表示并不适合用于生成建模。近期，RAE方法的出现带来了希望，揭示出表征自编码器同样能达到与VAE编码器相竞争的性能。然而，将表征自编码器整合到连续自回归（AR）模型中的研究仍处于探索阶段。本文深入探讨了在AR范式下采用高维表征自编码器（称为“RAE-AR”）所面临的挑战。我们聚焦于AR模型的独特性质，识别出两大主要障碍：复杂的逐令牌分布建模，以及高维度下加剧的训练-推断差距（曝光偏差）。针对这些问题，我们通过分布归一化引入令牌简化，以降低建模难度并提升收敛效率。此外，我们在训练过程中加入高斯噪声注入，以增强预测鲁棒性并缓解曝光偏差。实验结果表明，这些改进显著缩小了性能差距，使表征自编码器在AR模型上取得了与传统VAE相当的结果。此项工作为视觉理解与生成建模架构的统一化铺平了道路。
tldr: RAE-AR improves the integration of representation autoencoders into continuous autoregressive models for image generation, addressing training-inference gaps and high-dimensionality challenges.
tldr_zh: RAE-AR改善了表征自编码器在连续自回归模型中的整合，用于图像生成，解决了训练-推理差距和高维度挑战。

title: A Role-Based LLM Framework for Structured Information Extraction from Healthy Food Policies
summary: Current Large Language Model (LLM) approaches for information extraction (IE) in the healthy food policy domain are often hindered by various factors, including misinformation, specifically hallucinations, misclassifications, and omissions that result from the structural diversity and inconsistency of policy documents. To address these limitations, this study proposes a role-based LLM framework that automates the IE from unstructured policy data by assigning specialized roles: an LLM policy analyst for metadata and mechanism classification, an LLM legal strategy specialist for identifying complex legal approaches, and an LLM food system expert for categorizing food system stages. This framework mimics expert analysis workflows by incorporating structured domain knowledge, including explicit definitions of legal mechanisms and classification criteria, into role-specific prompts. We evaluate the framework using 608 healthy food policies from the Healthy Food Policy Project (HFPP) database, comparing its performance against zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought (CoT) baselines using Llama-3.3-70B. Our proposed framework demonstrates superior performance in complex reasoning tasks, offering a reliable and transparent methodology for automating IE from health policies.
summary_zh: 当前健康食品政策领域的信息提取大语言模型方法常受多种因素制约，包括政策文本结构多样性与不一致性导致的错误信息，具体表现为幻觉生成、错误分类和关键信息遗漏。为解决这些局限，本研究提出一种基于角色分工的大语言模型框架，通过分配专业化角色实现非结构化政策数据的自动信息提取：由大语言模型政策分析师负责元数据与机制分类，大语言模型法律战略专家识别复杂法律路径，大语言模型食品系统专家划分食品系统阶段。该框架通过将结构化领域知识（包括法律机制的明确定义与分类标准）融入角色定制提示词，模拟了专家分析工作流。我们在健康食品政策项目数据库的608项政策上进行评估，采用Llama-3.3-70B模型对比零样本学习、少样本学习和思维链基准方法。实验表明，该框架在复杂推理任务中表现优异，为健康政策信息自动化提取提供了可靠且透明的解决方案。
tldr: This paper proposes a role-based LLM framework for structured information extraction from healthy food policy documents, improving accuracy over standard baselines by assigning specialized expert roles to the LLM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于角色的LLM框架，用于从健康食品政策文件中进行结构化信息提取，通过为LLM分配专业角色来提升准确性，优于标准基线方法。

title: CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe
summary: High-performance GPU kernels are critical to modern machine learning systems, yet developing efficient implementations remains a challenging, expert-driven process due to the tight coupling between algorithmic structure, memory hierarchy usage, and hardware-specific optimizations. Recent work has explored using large language models (LLMs) to generate GPU kernels automatically, but generated implementations often struggle to maintain correctness and achieve competitive performance across iterative refinements. We present CuTeGen, an agentic framework for automated generation and optimization of GPU kernels that treats kernel development as a structured generate--test--refine workflow. Unlike approaches that rely on one-shot generation or large-scale search over candidate implementations, CuTeGen focuses on progressive refinement of a single evolving kernel through execution-based validation, structured debugging, and staged optimization. A key design choice is to generate kernels using the CuTe abstraction layer, which exposes performance-critical structures such as tiling and data movement while providing a more stable representation for iterative modification. To guide performance improvement, CuTeGen incorporates workload-aware optimization prompts and delayed integration of profiling feedback. Experimental results on matrix multiplication and activation workloads demonstrate that the framework produces functionally correct kernels and achieves competitive performance relative to optimized library implementations.
summary_zh: 高性能GPU内核是现代机器学习系统的核心，然而由于算法结构、内存层次使用与硬件特定优化之间的紧密耦合，开发高效实现仍然是一项依赖专家经验的挑战性任务。近期研究尝试利用大型语言模型自动生成GPU内核，但生成的实现在迭代优化过程中往往难以保持正确性并达到有竞争力的性能。本文提出CuTeGen——一个用于GPU内核自动生成与优化的智能体框架，该框架将内核开发视为结构化的生成-测试-精炼工作流。区别于依赖单次生成或对候选实现进行大规模搜索的方法，CuTeGen通过基于执行的验证、结构化调试和分阶段优化，专注于对单个演化内核进行渐进式改进。其关键设计在于使用CuTe抽象层生成内核，该层暴露了分块和数据移动等性能关键结构，同时为迭代修改提供了更稳定的表示形式。为引导性能提升，CuTeGen整合了工作负载感知的优化提示机制，并采用延迟集成性能分析反馈的策略。在矩阵乘法和激活函数工作负载上的实验表明，该框架能够生成功能正确的内核，并在性能上达到与优化库实现相当的水平。
tldr: A framework for using LLMs to iteratively generate and optimize GPU kernels via structured generation, testing, and refinement, demonstrated on matrix multiplication and activation workloads.
tldr_zh: 一个利用大型语言模型通过结构化生成、测试和优化，迭代式生成和优化GPU内核的框架，在矩阵乘法和激活函数工作负载上进行了演示。

title: SelfGrader: Stable Jailbreak Detection for Large Language Models using Token-Level Logits
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful tools for answering user queries, yet they remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing guardrail methods typically rely on internal features or textual responses to detect malicious queries, which either introduce substantial latency or suffer from the randomness in text generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose SelfGrader, a lightweight guardrail method that formulates jailbreak detection as a numerical grading problem using token-level logits. Specifically, SelfGrader evaluates the safety of a user query within a compact set of numerical tokens (NTs) (e.g., 0-9) and interprets their logit distribution as an internal safety signal. To align these signals with human intuition of maliciousness, SelfGrader introduces a dual-perspective scoring rule that considers both the maliciousness and benignness of the query, yielding a stable and interpretable score that reflects harmfulness and reduces the false positive rate simultaneously. Extensive experiments across diverse jailbreak benchmarks, multiple LLMs, and state-of-the-art guardrail baselines demonstrate that SelfGrader achieves up to a 22.66% reduction in ASR on LLaMA-3-8B, while maintaining significantly lower memory overhead (up to 173x) and latency (up to 26x).
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型（LLM）是回答用户查询的强大工具，但其仍极易受到越狱攻击的威胁。现有的防护方法通常依赖内部特征或文本响应来检测恶意查询，这些方法要么引入显著延迟，要么受限于文本生成的随机性。为克服这些局限，本文提出SelfGrader——一种轻量级防护方法，通过词元级对数概率将越狱检测转化为数值评分问题。具体而言，SelfGrader在紧凑的数值词元（NT）（如0-9）集合中评估用户查询的安全性，并将其对数概率分布解释为内部安全信号。为使这些信号与人类对恶意行为的直觉认知对齐，SelfGrader引入双视角评分规则，同时考量查询的恶意性和良性特征，从而生成稳定且可解释的评分：该评分既能反映危害程度，又能同步降低误报率。在多样化越狱基准测试、多类大语言模型及前沿防护基线的广泛实验中，SelfGrader在LLaMA-3-8B模型上实现了最高22.66%的攻击成功率下降，同时保持显著更低的内存开销（最高达173倍）与延迟（最高达26倍）。
tldr: The paper proposes SelfGrader, a lightweight guardrail method for detecting jailbreak attacks on LLMs by grading user queries based on token-level logits to improve safety and reduce latency.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SelfGrader，一种轻量级的护栏方法，通过基于token级别logits对用户查询进行评分来检测LLMs的越狱攻击，以提高安全性并降低延迟。

title: The Newton-Muon Optimizer
summary: The Muon optimizer has received considerable attention for its strong performance in training large language models, yet the design principle behind its matrix-gradient orthogonalization remains largely elusive. In this paper, we introduce a surrogate model that not only sheds new light on the design of Muon, but more importantly leads to a new optimizer.
