In the same spirit as the derivation of Newton's method, the surrogate approximates the loss as a quadratic function of the perturbation to a weight matrix $W$ using only three matrices: the gradient $G$, an output-space curvature matrix $H$, and the data matrix $Z$ that stacks the layer inputs. By minimizing this surrogate in one step and adopting a certain isotropic assumption on the weights, we obtain the closed-form update rule (up to momentum and weight decay) $W \leftarrow W - η\cdot \mathrm{msgn}(G(ZZ^\top)^{-1})$, where $η$ is the learning rate and $\mathrm{msgn}(X)=UV^\top$ if $X=USV^\top$ is a compact singular value decomposition. This new optimization method, which we refer to as Newton-Muon, shows that standard Muon can be interpreted as an implicit Newton-type method that neglects the right preconditioning induced by the input second moment. Empirically, on a reproduction of the earliest publicly released Modded-NanoGPT speedrun configuration using Muon for GPT-2 pretraining, Newton-Muon reaches the target validation loss in 6\% fewer iteration steps and reduces wall-clock training time by about 4\%.
summary_zh: Muon优化器因在训练大型语言模型中的卓越性能而备受关注，但其矩阵梯度正交化背后的设计原理在很大程度上仍不明确。本文引入一个代理模型，不仅为Muon的设计提供了新的视角，更重要的是由此推导出一种新的优化器。与牛顿法推导的思路相似，该代理模型仅使用三个矩阵——梯度$G$、输出空间曲率矩阵$H$以及堆叠层输入的数据矩阵$Z$，将损失近似为权重矩阵$W$扰动的二次函数。通过一步最小化该代理模型，并对权重采用各向同性的假设，我们得到闭式更新规则（忽略动量和权重衰减）：$W \leftarrow W - η\cdot \mathrm{msgn}(G(ZZ^\top)^{-1})$，其中$η$为学习率，$\mathrm{msgn}(X)=UV^\top$（当$X=USV^\top$为紧凑奇异值分解时）。我们将这一新优化方法称为Newton-Muon，它表明标准Muon可被解释为一种隐式牛顿型方法，其忽略了输入二阶矩所诱导的右预处理效应。实验表明，在采用Muon进行GPT-2预训练的最早公开Modded-NanoGPT速通配置复现中，Newton-Muon以减少6%的迭代步数达到目标验证损失，并将实际训练时间缩短约4%。
tldr: A theoretical analysis of the Muon optimizer leads to a new optimizer called Newton-Muon, which is shown to be a Newton-type method and achieves slightly faster training for GPT-2 pretraining.
tldr_zh: 对Muon优化器的理论分析导出了名为Newton-Muon的新优化器，该优化器被证明是一种牛顿型方法，并在GPT-2预训练中实现了略微更快的训练。

title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-based Scientific Literature Analysis Using Peer Context Outlier Detection
summary: Reducing hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for improving the accuracy of data extraction from large text corpora. Current methods, like prompt engineering and chain-of-thought prompting, focus on individual documents but fail to consider relationships across a corpus. This paper introduces Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD), a novel approach that uses the relationships between documents to improve extraction accuracy. Our application domain is in scientific literature summarization, where papers with similar experiment settings should draw similar conclusions. By comparing extracted data to validated peer information within the corpus, we adjust confidence scores and flag low-confidence results for expert review. High-confidence results, supported by peer validation, are considered reliable. Our experiments demonstrate up to 98% precision in outlier detection across 6 domains of science, demonstrating that our design reduces hallucinations, enhances trust in automated systems, and allows researchers to focus on ambiguous cases, streamlining the data extraction workflows.
summary_zh: 降低大型语言模型（LLM）中的幻觉现象，对于提高从大型文本语料库中提取数据的准确性至关重要。当前方法如提示工程和思维链提示主要关注单个文档，但未能考虑语料库中文档间的关联。本文提出了一种新颖的跨文档关系利用方法——同行上下文异常检测（P-COD），以提升数据提取的准确性。我们的应用领域为科学文献综述，其中实验设置相似的论文应得出相似结论。通过将提取的数据与语料库中经过验证的同行信息进行比对，我们调整置信度分数并对低置信度结果进行专家审核标记。获得同行验证支持的高置信度结果被视为可靠数据。实验表明，在六个科学领域的异常检测中，我们的方法达到了高达98%的准确率，证明该设计能够有效减少幻觉、增强对自动化系统的信任，并使研究人员能够专注于模糊案例，从而优化数据提取工作流程。
tldr: Proposes Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD) to reduce LLM hallucinations in scientific literature analysis by comparing extracted data against similar documents in a corpus, improving extraction precision.
tldr_zh: 提出Peer Context Outlier Detection（P-COD）方法，通过对比科学文献语料库中相似文档的提取数据，减少大语言模型在科学文献分析中的幻觉，提高信息提取精度。

title: Reproducible, Explainable, and Effective Evaluations of Agentic AI for Software Engineering
summary: With the advancement of Agentic AI, researchers are increasingly leveraging autonomous agents to address challenges in software engineering (SE). However, the large language models (LLMs) that underpin these agents often function as black boxes, making it difficult to justify the superiority of Agentic AI approaches over baselines. Furthermore, missing information in the evaluation design description frequently renders the reproduction of results infeasible. To synthesize current evaluation practices for Agentic AI in SE, this study analyzes 18 papers on the topic, published or accepted by ICSE 2026, ICSE 2025, FSE 2025, ASE 2025, and ISSTA 2025. The analysis identifies prevailing approaches and their limitations in evaluating Agentic AI for SE, both in current research and potential future studies. To address these shortcomings, this position paper proposes a set of guidelines and recommendations designed to empower reproducible, explainable, and effective evaluations of Agentic AI in software engineering. In particular, we recommend that Agentic AI researchers make their Thought-Action-Result (TAR) trajectories and LLM interaction data, or summarized versions of these artifacts, publicly accessible. Doing so will enable subsequent studies to more effectively analyze the strengths and weaknesses of different Agentic AI approaches. To demonstrate the feasibility of such comparisons, we present a proof-of-concept case study that illustrates how TAR trajectories can support systematic analysis across approaches.
summary_zh: 随着Agentic AI的发展，研究人员越来越多地利用自主智能体来解决软件工程中的挑战。然而，支撑这些智能体的大语言模型往往如同黑箱，使得Agentic AI方法相较于基线方法的优越性难以得到合理解释。此外，评估设计描述中的信息缺失常常导致实验结果无法复现。为了综合当前软件工程领域Agentic AI的评估实践，本研究分析了发表于ICSE 2026、ICSE 2025、FSE 2025、ASE 2025及ISSTA 2025的18篇相关论文。通过分析，本文梳理了当前研究及未来潜在研究中评估软件工程领域Agentic AI的主流方法及其局限性。针对这些不足，本立场论文提出了一套指导原则与建议，旨在推动软件工程中Agentic AI评估实现可复现、可解释且高效的目标。我们特别建议Agentic AI研究者公开其思维-行动-结果轨迹及大语言模型交互数据（或这些产物的摘要版本），以便后续研究能够更有效地分析不同Agentic AI方法的优势与局限。为了验证此类对比研究的可行性，我们还展示了一个概念验证案例，说明如何通过思维-行动-结果轨迹支持跨方法的系统性分析。
tldr: This position paper analyzes and proposes guidelines for reproducible, explainable, and effective evaluation of Agentic AI in software engineering, focusing on the analysis of thought-action-result trajectories and LLM interactions.
tldr_zh: 这篇立场论文分析并提出了在软件工程中可复现、可解释和有效的 Agentic AI 评估指南，重点关注思想-行动-结果轨迹和大型语言模型交互的分析。

title: Semantically Annotated Multimodal Dataset for RF Interpretation and Prediction
summary: Current limitations in wireless modeling and radio frequency (RF)-based AI are primarily driven by a lack of high-quality, measurement-based datasets that connect RF signals to their physical environments. RF heatmaps, the typical form of such data, are high-dimensional and complex but lack the geometric and semantic context needed for interpretation, constraining the development of supervised machine learning models. To address this bottleneck, we propose a new class of multimodal datasets that combines RF measurements with auxiliary modalities like high-resolution cameras and lidar to bridge the gap between RF signals and their physical causes. The proposed data collection will span diverse indoor and outdoor environments, featuring both static and dynamic scenarios, including human activities ranging from walking to subtle gestures. By achieving precise spatial and temporal co-registration and creating digital replicas for voxel-level annotation, this dataset will enable transformative AI research. Key tasks include the forward problem of predicting RF heatmaps from visual data to revolutionize wireless system design, and the inverse problem of inferring scene semantics from RF signals, creating a new form of RF-based perception.
summary_zh: 当前无线建模及基于射频的人工智能面临的主要局限在于缺乏高质量、基于实测的数据集，这些数据应能建立射频信号与其物理环境之间的联系。射频热图作为此类数据的典型形式，虽具有高维度和复杂性，却缺乏解读所需的几何与语义上下文，从而制约了监督式机器学习模型的发展。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出一种新型多模态数据集，将射频测量数据与高分辨率相机、激光雷达等辅助模态相结合，以弥合射频信号与其物理成因之间的鸿沟。所提出的数据收集将涵盖多样化的室内外环境，包含静态与动态场景，并涉及从行走到细微手势等多种人类活动。通过实现精确的时空配准并创建用于体素级标注的数字孪生环境，该数据集将推动变革性的人工智能研究。核心任务包括从视觉数据预测射频热图的正向问题——这将彻底改变无线系统设计，以及从射频信号推断场景语义的逆向问题——从而开创一种全新的射频感知形式。
tldr: Proposes a multimodal dataset combining RF measurements with vision/lidar to link RF signals to physical scenes, enabling AI tasks like predicting RF maps from vision and inferring scene semantics from RF signals.
tldr_zh: 提出一个结合射频测量与视觉/激光雷达的多模态数据集，旨在连接射频信号与物理场景，支持从视觉数据预测射频热图、从射频信号推断场景语义等AI任务。

title: Friends and Grandmothers in Silico: Localizing Entity Cells in Language Models
summary: Language models can answer many entity-centric factual questions, but it remains unclear which internal mechanisms are involved in this process. We study this question across multiple language models. We localize entity-selective MLP neurons using templated prompts about each entity, and then validate them with causal interventions on PopQA-based QA examples. On a curated set of 200 entities drawn from PopQA, localized neurons concentrate in early layers. Negative ablation produces entity-specific amnesia, while controlled injection at a placeholder token improves answer retrieval relative to mean-entity and wrong-cell controls. For many entities, activating a single localized neuron is sufficient to recover entity-consistent predictions once the context is initialized, consistent with compact entity retrieval rather than purely gradual enrichment across depth. Robustness to aliases, acronyms, misspellings, and multilingual forms supports a canonicalization interpretation. The effect is strong but not universal: not every entity admits a reliable single-neuron handle, and coverage is higher for popular entities. Overall, these results identify sparse, causally actionable access points for analyzing and modulating entity-conditioned factual behavior.
summary_zh: 语言模型能够回答许多以实体为中心的事实性问题，但其中涉及哪些内部机制仍不清楚。我们在多个语言模型中对这一问题展开研究。我们使用针对每个实体的模板化提示来定位实体选择性MLP神经元，并通过对基于PopQA的问答示例进行因果干预来验证这些神经元。从PopQA抽取的200个实体构成的集合中，定位到的神经元集中在模型早期层。负向消融操作会引发特定实体遗忘，而在占位符标记处进行受控注入时，相比于平均实体和错误单元对照，能提升答案检索效果。对于许多实体，一旦上下文初始化，激活单个定位神经元即可恢复与实体一致的预测结果，这符合紧凑实体检索机制，而非纯粹依赖深度渐增的逐步信息丰富过程。对别名、缩写、拼写错误及多语言形式的鲁棒性支持了"规范化表征"的解释。该效应虽强但非普适：并非每个实体都存在可靠的单神经元操控点，且热门实体的覆盖度更高。总体而言，这些结果为分析和调控实体关联的事实性行为提供了稀疏且可因果干预的切入点。
tldr: This paper investigates the internal mechanisms of language models for entity-centric factual recall, localizing and causally manipulating specific neurons responsible for entity retrieval, which suggests a compact, canonicalized representation for many entities.
tldr_zh: 本研究探究语言模型在实体相关事实问答中的内部机制，通过定位和因果干预特定神经元，揭示了实体检索的紧凑、规范化表示形式。

title: Can LLMs Predict Academic Collaboration? Topology Heuristics vs. LLM-Based Link Prediction on Real Co-authorship Networks
summary: Can large language models (LLMs) predict which researchers will collaborate? We study this question through link prediction on real-world co-authorship networks from OpenAlex (9.96M authors, 108.7M edges), evaluating whether LLMs can predict future scientific collaborations using only author profiles, without access to graph structure. Using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct across three historical eras of AI research, we find that LLMs and topology heuristics capture distinct signals and are strongest in complementary settings. On new-edge prediction under natural class imbalance, the LLM achieves AUROC 0.714--0.789, outperforming Common Neighbors, Jaccard, and Preferential Attachment, with recall up to 92.9\%; under balanced evaluation, the LLM outperforms \emph{all} topology heuristics in every era (AUROC 0.601--0.658 vs.\ best-heuristic 0.525--0.538); on continued edges, the LLM (0.687) is competitive with Adamic-Adar (0.684). Critically, 78.6--82.7\% of new collaborations occur between authors with no common neighbor -- a blind spot where all topology heuristics score zero but the LLM still achieves AUROC 0.652 by reasoning from author metadata alone. A temporal metadata ablation reveals that research concepts are the dominant signal (removing concepts drops AUROC by 0.047--0.084). Providing pre-computed graph features to the LLM \emph{degrades} performance due to anchoring effects, confirming that LLMs and topology methods should operate as separate, complementary channels. A socio-cultural ablation finds that name-inferred ethnicity and institutional country do not predict collaboration beyond topology, reflecting the demographic homogeneity of AI research. A node2vec baseline achieves AUROC comparable to Adamic-Adar, establishing that LLMs access a fundamentally different information channel -- author metadata -- rather than encoding the same structural signal differently.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否预测研究者之间的合作行为？本研究通过在OpenAlex的真实合著网络（包含996万作者、1.087亿条边）上进行链接预测，评估LLM能否仅凭作者档案（无需图结构信息）预测未来的科学合作。基于Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct模型在人工智能研究的三个历史时期进行实验，我们发现LLM与拓扑启发式方法捕捉到不同信号，并在互补场景中表现最强。在自然类别不平衡的新边预测任务中，LLM的AUROC达到0.714–0.789，超越共同邻居、Jaccard系数和优先连接等基线方法，召回率最高达92.9%；在平衡评估中，LLM在每个时期均优于所有拓扑启发式方法（AUROC 0.601–0.658 vs. 最佳启发式0.525–0.538）；在持续边预测中，LLM（0.687）与Adamic-Adar方法（0.684）表现相当。关键发现是：78.6–82.7%的新合作发生在无共同邻居的作者之间——这是所有拓扑启发式方法得分为零的盲区，而LLM仅通过作者元数据推理仍能达到0.652的AUROC。时序元数据消融实验显示研究概念是主导信号（移除概念会使AUROC下降0.047–0.084）。向LLM提供预计算图特征会因锚定效应降低性能，这证实了LLM与拓扑方法应作为独立互补的通道运行。社会文化消融实验发现，基于姓名推断的种族和机构所属国家在拓扑特征之外对合作预测无贡献，反映出人工智能研究领域的人口同质性。node2vec基线取得的AUROC与Adamic-Adar相当，表明LLM利用了根本不同的信息通道——作者元数据，而非对相同结构信号进行差异化编码。
tldr: This paper uses LLMs to predict future academic collaborations from author metadata, analyzing its performance against topological graph heuristics on co-authorship networks.
tldr_zh: 该论文利用大型语言模型根据作者元数据预测学术合作，并在合著网络中对标拓扑图启发式方法评估其性能。

title: Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences
summary: Learning human preferences in language models remains fundamentally challenging, as reward modeling relies on subtle, subjective comparisons or shades of gray rather than clear-cut labels. This study investigates the limits of current approaches and proposes a feature-augmented framework to better capture the multidimensional nature of human judgment. Using the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset, we evaluate ten diverse large language models LLMs under a standard pairwise preference setting, where baseline performance remains below 0.74 ROC AUC, highlighting the difficulty of the task. To address this, we enrich textual representations with interpretable signals: response length, refusal indicators, toxicity scores and prompt response semantic similarity, enabling models to explicitly capture key aspects of helpfulness, safety and relevance. The proposed hybrid approach yields consistent improvements across all models, achieving up to 0.84 ROC AUC and significantly higher pairwise accuracy, with DeBERTav3Large demonstrating the best performance. Beyond accuracy, we integrate SHAP and LIME to provide fine-grained interpretability, revealing that model decisions depend on contextualized safety and supportive framing rather than isolated keywords. We further analyze bias amplification, showing that while individual features have weak marginal effects, their interactions influence preference learning.
summary_zh: 学习人类对语言模型的偏好仍是一项根本性挑战，因为奖励建模依赖于微妙、主观的比较或灰色地带，而非明确的标签。本研究探讨了现有方法的局限性，并提出了一种特征增强框架，以更好地捕捉人类判断的多维特性。基于Anthropic HHRLLF数据集，我们在标准成对偏好设置下评估了十个不同的大语言模型，其基线性能均低于0.74 ROC AUC，凸显了该任务的难度。为此，我们通过可解释信号增强文本表示：响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数及提示-响应语义相似度，使模型能够显式捕捉有益性、安全性和相关性的关键维度。所提出的混合方法在所有模型中均实现了稳定提升，最高达到0.84 ROC AUC并显著提高成对准确率，其中DeBERTa-v3-Large表现出最佳性能。除准确率外，我们结合SHAP和LIME方法提供细粒度可解释性分析，揭示模型决策依赖于情境化的安全框架与支持性表达，而非孤立的关键词。进一步分析表明，尽管单一特征的边际效应较弱，但其交互作用会影响偏好学习中的偏差放大。
tldr: This paper proposes a feature-augmented framework for human preference learning in large language models, focusing on interpretability and bias analysis using safety and relevance signals, applied to the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种用于大型语言模型人类偏好学习的特征增强框架，利用安全性和相关性等信号，重点在于可解释性和偏见分析，并应用于Anthropic HHRLHF数据集。

title: CXR-LT 2026 Challenge: Projection-Aware Multi-Label and Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Classification
summary: This challenge tackles multi-label classification for known chest X-ray (CXR) lesions and zero-shot classification for unseen ones. To handle diverse CXR projections, we integrate projection-specific models via a classification network into a unified framework. For zero-shot classification (Task 2), we extend CheXzero with a novel dual-branch architecture that combines contrastive learning, Asymmetric Loss (ASL), and LLM-generated descriptive prompts. This effectively mitigates severe long-tail imbalances and maximizes zero-shot generalization. Additionally, strong data and test-time augmentations (TTA) ensure robustness across both tasks.
summary_zh: 本项研究旨在解决已知胸部X光片（CXR）病灶的多标签分类与未知病灶的零样本分类问题。为处理多样化的CXR拍摄角度，我们通过分类网络将针对特定拍摄角度的模型集成至统一框架中。针对零样本分类任务（任务2），我们基于CheXzero框架提出了一种新型双分支架构，该架构融合了对比学习、非对称损失函数以及大语言模型生成的描述性提示，有效缓解了极端长尾数据分布问题，并最大化零样本泛化能力。此外，在两项任务中均采用强数据增强与测试时增强策略，确保了模型在不同场景下的鲁棒性。
tldr: A medical imaging paper proposing a unified framework for multi-label and zero-shot classification of chest X-ray lesions using projection-specific models, contrastive learning, and LLM-generated prompts.
tldr_zh: 一篇医学影像论文，提出一个统一框架，用于胸部X光片的已知和未知病变的多标签及零样本分类，结合投影特定模型、对比学习和LLM生成提示。

title: ViT-Explainer: An Interactive Walkthrough of the Vision Transformer Pipeline
summary: Transformer-based architectures have become the shared backbone of natural language processing and computer vision. However, understanding how these models operate remains challenging, particularly in vision settings, where images are processed as sequences of patch tokens. Existing interpretability tools often focus on isolated components or expert-oriented analysis, leaving a gap in guided, end-to-end understanding of the full inference pipeline. To bridge this gap, we present ViT-Explainer, a web-based interactive system that provides an integrated visualization of Vision Transformer inference, from patch tokenization to final classification. The system combines animated walkthroughs, patch-level attention overlays, and a vision-adapted Logit Lens within both guided and free exploration modes. A user study with six participants suggests that ViT-Explainer is easy to learn and use, helping users interpret and understand Vision Transformer behavior.
summary_zh: 基于Transformer的架构已成为自然语言处理与计算机视觉的共享基础模型。然而，理解这些模型的工作原理仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在视觉任务中，图像被处理为补丁标记序列。现有的可解释性工具往往侧重于孤立组件或专家导向分析，缺乏对完整推理流程的引导式端到端理解。为填补这一空白，我们提出ViT-Explainer——一个基于网络的交互式系统，能够提供从补丁标记化到最终分类的视觉Transformer推理全过程集成可视化。该系统结合了动画演示、补丁级注意力叠加层以及适配视觉任务的Logit Lens技术，同时支持引导式与自由探索两种模式。一项包含六名参与者的用户研究表明，ViT-Explainer易于学习使用，能有效帮助用户解读和理解视觉Transformer的行为机制。
tldr: A web-based interactive visualization tool for understanding the full inference pipeline of Vision Transformers, from patch tokenization to classification.
tldr_zh: 一个基于Web的交互式可视化工具，用于理解Vision Transformer从图像分块到分类的完整推理流程。

title: Beyond the Fold: Quantifying Split-Level Noise and the Case for Leave-One-Dataset-Out AU Evaluation
summary:
Subject-exclusive cross-validation is the standard evaluation protocol for facial Action Unit (AU) detection, yet reported improvements are often small. We show that cross-validation itself introduces measurable stochastic variance. On BP4D+, repeated 3-fold subject-exclusive splits produce an empirical noise floor of $\pm 0.065$ in average F1, with substantially larger variation for low-prevalence AUs. Operating-point metrics such as F1 fluctuate more than threshold-independent measures such as AUC, and model ranking can change under different fold assignments.
  We further evaluate cross-dataset robustness using a Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) protocol across five AU datasets. LODO removes partition randomness and exposes domain-level instability that is not visible under single-dataset cross-validation. Together, these results suggest that gains often reported in cross-fold validation may fall within protocol variance. Leave-one-dataset-out cross-validation yields more stable and interpretable findings
summary_zh:
主题排他性交叉验证是面部动作单元检测的标准评估方法，但文献中报道的性能提升往往十分有限。本研究表明，交叉验证本身会引入可测量的随机方差。在BP4D+数据集上，重复进行3折主题排他性划分会在平均F1分数上产生±0.065的经验性噪声基底，而对于低出现频率的动作单元，其波动幅度更大。相较于与阈值无关的评估指标（如AUC），F1等基于操作点的度量指标波动更为显著，且模型排名会因不同的折划分方案而发生变化。

为进一步评估跨数据集鲁棒性，我们在五个动作单元数据集上采用留一数据集交叉验证协议进行分析。该方法消除了划分随机性，并揭示了在单数据集交叉验证中无法观察到的领域级不稳定性。综合来看，这些结果表明交叉验证中常报告的性能提升可能处于协议方差范围内。留一数据集交叉验证能够产生更稳定且更具解释性的研究结果。
tldr: This paper quantifies the stochastic variance introduced by standard cross-validation in facial Action Unit (AU) detection, advocating for a Leave-One-Dataset-Out protocol for more stable and interpretable evaluation of models.
tldr_zh: 本文量化了面部动作单元检测中标准交叉验证引入的随机方差，并主张使用留一数据集出协议以获得更稳定和可解释的模型评估结果。

title: CASHG: Context-Aware Stylized Online Handwriting Generation
summary: Online handwriting represents strokes as time-ordered trajectories, which makes handwritten content easier to transform and reuse in a wide range of applications. However, generating natural sentence-level online handwriting that faithfully reflects a writer's style remains challenging, since sentence synthesis demands context-dependent characters with stroke continuity and spacing. Prior methods treat these boundary properties as implicit outcomes of sequence modeling, which becomes unreliable at the sentence scale and under limited compositional diversity. We propose CASHG, a context-aware stylized online handwriting generator that explicitly models inter-character connectivity for style-consistent sentence-level trajectory synthesis. CASHG uses a Character Context Encoder to obtain character identity and sentence-dependent context memory and fuses them in a bigram-aware sliding-window Transformer decoder that emphasizes local predecessor--current transitions, complemented by gated context fusion for sentence-level context.Training proceeds through a three-stage curriculum from isolated glyphs to full sentences, improving robustness under sparse transition coverage. We further introduce Connectivity and Spacing Metrics (CSM), a boundary-aware evaluation suite that quantifies cursive connectivity and spacing similarity. Under benchmark-matched evaluation protocols, CASHG consistently improves CSM over comparison methods while remaining competitive in DTW-based trajectory similarity, with gains corroborated by a human evaluation.
summary_zh: 在线手写将笔迹表示为时间有序的轨迹，这使得手写内容在各类应用中更易于转换与复用。然而，生成自然且忠实反映书写者风格的句子级在线手写仍具挑战，因为句子合成需要具有笔画连续性和间距的上下文相关字符。现有方法将这些边界属性视为序列建模的隐式结果，这在句子尺度及有限组合多样性下表现不可靠。我们提出CASHG——一种上下文感知的在线手写风格生成器，其显式建模字符间连接性以实现风格一致的句子级轨迹合成。CASHG通过字符上下文编码器获取字符身份和句子相关的上下文记忆，并在关注局部前驱-当前转移的双字滑动窗口Transformer解码器中融合这些信息，同时通过门控上下文融合机制补充句子级上下文。训练采用从孤立字形到完整句子的三阶段课程学习策略，提升了稀疏过渡覆盖下的鲁棒性。我们进一步提出连接性与间距度量标准——一种量化草书连笔和间距相似性的边界感知评估体系。在基准匹配的评估协议下，CASHG在连接性与间距度量上持续优于对比方法，同时在基于动态时间规整的轨迹相似性评估中保持竞争力，其提升效果通过人工评估得到进一步验证。
tldr: Proposes a context-aware Transformer-based method for generating natural, style-consistent, sentence-level online handwriting trajectories by explicitly modeling inter-character connectivity and spacing.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于上下文感知的Transformer方法，用于生成自然、风格一致的句子级在线手写轨迹，通过显式建模字符间连接性和间距来实现。

title: Country-wide, high-resolution monitoring of forest browning with Sentinel-2
summary: Natural and anthropogenic disturbances are impacting the health of forests worldwide. Monitoring forest disturbances at scale is important to inform conservation efforts. Here, we present a scalable approach for country-wide mapping of forest greenness anomalies at the 10 m resolution of Sentinel-2. Using relevant ecological and topographical context and an established representation of the vegetation cycle, we learn a predictive quantile model of the normalised difference vegetation index (NDVI) derived from Sentinel-2 data. The resulting expected seasonal cycles are used to detect NDVI anomalies across Switzerland between April 2017 and August 2025. Goodness-of-fit evaluations show that the conditional model explains 65% of the observed variations in the median seasonal cycle. The model consistently benefits from the local context information, particularly during the green-up period. The approach produces coherent spatial anomaly patterns and enables country-wide quantification of forest browning. Case studies with independent reference data from known events illustrate that the model reliably detects different types of disturbances.
summary_zh: 自然与人为干扰正影响着全球森林的健康状况。开展大规模森林干扰监测对指导保护工作具有重要意义。本文提出了一种基于哨兵2号10米分辨率数据的可扩展方法，用于在全国范围内绘制森林绿度异常图。通过结合相关生态与地形背景信息以及已建立的植被周期表征模型，我们学习出基于哨兵2号数据归一化植被指数（NDVI）的预测分位数模型。利用所得的预期季节性周期，可检测2017年4月至2025年8月期间瑞士全境的NDVI异常。拟合优度评估表明，该条件模型能够解释中位数季节性周期观测变异的65%。模型持续受益于局部背景信息，尤其在植被返青期表现显著。该方法生成的空间异常模式具有连贯性，实现了全国尺度森林褐变现象的量化分析。结合已知事件的独立参考数据进行的案例研究表明，该模型能可靠检测各类森林干扰。
tldr: The paper presents a scalable method for monitoring forest health and detecting disturbances across Switzerland using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and a quantile model of the NDVI vegetation index.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用Sentinel-2卫星影像和NDVI植被指数的分位数模型，对瑞士全国的森林健康状况进行规模化监测和干扰检测的方法。

title: Network Structure in UK Payment Flows: Evidence on Economic Interdependencies and Implications for Real-Time Measurement
summary: Network analysis of inter-industry payment flows reveals structural economic relationships invisible to traditional bilateral measurement approaches, with significant implications for real-time economic monitoring. Analysing 532,346 UK payment records (2017--2024) across 89 industry sectors, we demonstrate that graph-theoretic features which include centrality measures and clustering coefficients improve payment flow forecasting by 8.8 percentage points beyond traditional time-series methods. Critically, network features prove most valuable during economic disruptions: during the COVID-19 pandemic, when traditional forecasting accuracy collapsed (R2} falling from 0.38 to 0.19), network-enhanced models maintained substantially better performance, with network contributions reaching +13.8 percentage points. The analysis identifies Financial Services, Wholesale Trade, and Professional Services as structurally central industries whose network positions indicate systemic importance beyond their transaction volumes. Network density increased 12.5\% over the sample period, with visible disruption during 2020 followed by recovery exceeding pre-pandemic integration levels. These findings suggest payment network monitoring could enhance official statistics production by providing leading indicators of structural economic change and improving nowcasting accuracy during periods when traditional temporal patterns prove unreliable.
summary_zh: 产业间支付流的网络分析揭示了传统双边测量方法无法观测的结构性经济关系，这对实时经济监测具有重要启示。通过对英国89个行业部门532,346条支付记录（2017-2024年）的分析，我们发现包含中心性指标和聚类系数在内的图论特征将支付流预测精度较传统时间序列方法提升8.8个百分点。关键发现表明，网络特征在经济动荡时期最具价值：在COVID-19大流行期间，当传统预测精度崩溃时（R²从0.38降至0.19），网络增强模型仍保持显著更好的性能，网络贡献度达到+13.8个百分点。该分析确定金融服务、批发贸易和专业服务业为结构性核心产业，其网络位置显示的系统重要性远超交易量规模。样本期内网络密度增长12.5%，其中2020年出现明显中断，随后恢复至超越疫情前的一体化水平。这些发现表明，支付网络监测可通过提供结构性经济变化的先行指标，并在传统时间模式失效时期提高即时预测精度，从而增强官方统计数据的生成能力。
tldr: This paper analyzes UK inter-industry payment flows using network analysis to improve economic forecasting and monitoring, showing significant benefits during disruptions like the COVID-19 pandemic.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过分析英国产业间支付流网络，提出利用图论特征改善经济预测，特别是在COVID-19等经济混乱时期，其模型表现优于传统方法。

title: Curia-2: Scaling Self-Supervised Learning for Radiology Foundation Models
summary: The rapid growth of medical imaging has fueled the development of Foundation Models (FMs) to reduce the growing, unsustainable workload on radiologists. While recent FMs have shown the power of large-scale pre-training to CT and MRI analysis, there remains significant room to optimize how these models learn from complex radiological volumes. Building upon the Curia framework, this work introduces Curia-2, which significantly improves the original pre-training strategy and representation quality to better capture the specificities of radiological data. The proposed methodology enables scaling the architecture up to billion-parameter Vision Transformers, marking a first for multi-modal CT and MRI FMs. Furthermore, we formalize the evaluation of these models by extending and restructuring CuriaBench into two distinct tracks: a 2D track tailored for slice-based vision models and a 3D track for volumetric benchmarking. Our results demonstrate that Curia-2 outperforms all FMs on vision-focused tasks and fairs competitively to vision-language models on clinically complex tasks such as finding detection. Weights will be made publicly available to foster further research.
summary_zh: 医学影像的快速发展推动了对基础模型的研究，以缓解放射科医生日益增长且不可持续的工作负担。尽管近期的基础模型已展现大规模预训练在CT和MRI分析中的潜力，但这些模型如何从复杂的放射学三维数据中学习仍有巨大优化空间。基于Curia框架，本研究提出Curia-2模型，通过显著改进原始预训练策略与表征质量，以更精准捕捉放射学数据的特性。该方法实现了亿级参数视觉Transformer架构的扩展，开创了多模态CT与MRI基础模型的先河。此外，我们通过将CuriaBench扩展重构为两个独立评估体系——针对基于切片的二维视觉模型任务与面向三维体积数据的基准测试——建立了系统化的模型评估标准。实验结果表明，Curia-2在视觉任务上优于所有基础模型，且在病灶检测等临床复杂任务中表现出与视觉语言模型相当的竞争力。我们将公开模型权重以促进后续研究。
tldr: Curia-2 is a billion-parameter vision foundation model for medical imaging, specifically designed for CT and MRI analysis, with new pre-training strategies and a 2D/3D benchmark.
tldr_zh: Curia-2是一个用于医学影像（CT和MRI）的十亿参数视觉基础模型，采用了新的预训练策略并提出了2D/3D基准测试。

title: Automated Prostate Gland Segmentation in MRI Using nnU-Net
summary: Accurate segmentation of the prostate gland in multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is a fundamental step for a wide range of clinical and research applications, including image registration, volume estimation, and radiomic analysis. However, manual delineation is time-consuming and subject to inter-observer variability, while general-purpose segmentation tools often fail to provide sufficient accuracy for prostate-specific tasks. In this work, we propose a dedicated deep learning-based approach for automatic prostate gland segmentation using the nnU-Net v2 framework. The model leverages multimodal mpMRI data, including T2-weighted imaging, diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps, to exploit complementary tissue information. Training was performed on 981 cases from the PI-CAI dataset using whole-gland annotations, and model performance was assessed through 5-fold cross-validation and external validation on an independent cohort of 54 patients from Hospital La Fe. The proposed model achieved a mean Dice score of 0.96 +/- 0.00 in cross-validation and 0.82 on the external test set, demonstrating strong generalization despite domain shift. In comparison, a general-purpose approach (TotalSegmentator) showed substantially lower performance, with a Dice score of 0.15, primarily due to under-segmentation of the gland. These results highlight the importance of task-specific, multimodal segmentation strategies and demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach for reliable integration into clinical research workflows. To facilitate reproducibility and deployment, the model has been fully containerized and is available as a ready-to-use inference tool.
summary_zh: 在多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）中实现前列腺腺体的精确分割是众多临床与科研应用的基础步骤，包括图像配准、体积估算以及影像组学分析。然而，手动勾划分割既耗时又存在观察者间差异，而通用分割工具通常难以在前列腺特异性任务中提供足够的精度。本研究提出一种基于深度学习的专用方法，利用nnU-Net v2框架实现前列腺腺体自动分割。该模型融合多模态mpMRI数据（包括T2加权成像、扩散加权成像及其表观扩散系数图），以挖掘互补的组织信息。我们使用PI-CAI数据集中981例全腺体标注数据进行训练，并通过五折交叉验证及在拉费医院54例独立患者队列上的外部验证评估模型性能。所提模型在交叉验证中平均戴斯系数达0.96±0.00，在外部测试集上为0.82，显示出面对域偏移时优异的泛化能力。相比之下，通用分割工具在同等测试条件下仅获得0.15的戴斯系数，主要因腺体分割不足导致。这些结果凸显了任务特异性多模态分割策略的重要性，并证明该方法具备可靠融入临床研究流程的潜力。为促进可重复性与部署应用，该模型已完全容器化，可作为即用型推理工具公开获取。
tldr: This paper proposes a deep learning model based on nnU-Net v2 for automated segmentation of the prostate gland in MRI, achieving high Dice scores on internal and external validation, and is presented as a tool for clinical research.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于nnU-Net v2框架的深度学习模型，用于MRI中前列腺腺体的自动分割，在内部和外部验证中均取得了较高的Dice分数，并作为临床研究工具发布。

title: Rethinking Representations for Cross-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection: A Generalizable Perspective from the Frequency Domain
summary: The accurate target-background separation in infrared small target detection (IRSTD) highly depends on the discriminability of extracted representations. However, most existing methods are confined to domain-consistent settings, while overlooking whether such discriminability can generalize to unseen domains. In practice, distribution shifts between training and testing data are inevitable due to variations in observational conditions and environmental factors. Meanwhile, the intrinsic indistinctiveness of infrared small targets aggravates overfitting to domain-specific patterns. Consequently, the detection performance of models trained on source domains can be severely degraded when deployed in unseen domains. To address this challenge, we propose a spatial-spectral collaborative perception network (S$^2$CPNet) for cross-domain IRSTD. Moving beyond conventional spatial learning pipelines, we rethink IRSTD representations from a frequency perspective and reveal inconsistencies in spectral phase as the primary manifestation of domain discrepancies. Based on this insight, we develop a phase rectification module (PRM) to derive generalizable target awareness. Then, we employ an orthogonal attention mechanism (OAM) in skip connections to preserve positional information while refining informative representations. Moreover, the bias toward domain-specific patterns is further mitigated through selective style recomposition (SSR). Extensive experiments have been conducted on three IRSTD datasets, and the proposed method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance under diverse cross-domain settings.
summary_zh: 红外小目标检测（IRSTD）中的精确目标与背景分离高度依赖于所提取特征的可区分性。然而，现有方法大多局限于域内一致性设定，忽视了这种可区分性是否能推广到未知领域。实践中，由于观测条件和环境因素的变化，训练与测试数据之间的分布差异不可避免。同时，红外小目标固有的模糊性加剧了模型对特定领域模式的过拟合。因此，当在未知域部署时，基于源域训练的模型检测性能会出现严重下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种面向跨域红外小目标检测的空间-频谱协同感知网络（S$^2$CPNet）。突破传统空间学习范式，我们从频率视角重新审视红外小目标特征表达，发现频谱相位的不一致性是域差异的主要表现形式。基于此发现，我们设计了相位校正模块（PRM）以获取泛化性的目标感知能力。随后，在跳跃连接中采用正交注意力机制（OAM），在精炼有效特征的同时保留位置信息。此外，通过选择性风格重组（SSR）进一步缓解模型对特定领域模式的偏向。在三个红外小目标检测数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在多种跨域场景下均能取得先进的性能表现。
tldr: This paper proposes a spatial-spectral network for cross-domain infrared small target detection, focusing on frequency-domain representations to improve generalization across different environmental conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于跨域红外小目标检测的空间-光谱协作感知网络，通过从频域角度重新思考表示以提高跨不同环境条件的泛化能力。

title: Enhancing Medical Visual Grounding via Knowledge-guided Spatial Prompts
summary: Medical Visual Grounding (MVG) aims to identify diagnostically relevant phrases from free-text radiology reports and localize their corresponding regions in medical images, providing interpretable visual evidence to support clinical decision-making. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising multimodal reasoning ability, their grounding remains insufficient spatial precision, largely due to a lack of explicit localization priors when relying solely on latent embeddings. In this work, we analyze this limitation from an attention perspective and propose KnowMVG, a Knowledge-prior and global-local attention enhancement framework for MVG in VLMs that explicitly strengthens spatial awareness during decoding. Specifically, we present a knowledge-enhanced prompting strategy that encodes phrase related medical knowledge into compact embeddings, together with a global-local attention that jointly leverages coarse global information and refined local cues to guide precise region localization. localization. This design bridges high-level semantic understanding and fine-grained visual perception without introducing extra textual reasoning overhead. Extensive experiments on four MVG benchmarks demonstrate that our KnowMVG consistently outperforms existing approaches, achieving gains of 3.0% in AP50 and 2.6% in mIoU over prior state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative and ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component.
summary_zh: 医学视觉定位旨在从自由文本放射学报告中识别具有诊断意义的短语，并定位其在医学图像中的对应区域，从而为临床决策提供可解释的视觉证据。尽管现有的视觉语言模型展现出强大的多模态推理能力，但其定位结果仍缺乏足够的空间精度，这主要源于仅依赖隐式嵌入而缺乏显式定位先验知识。本研究从注意力机制的角度分析了这一局限，提出了KnowMVG框架——一种基于知识先验和全局-局部注意力增强的视觉语言模型医学视觉定位方法，显式强化解码过程中的空间感知能力。具体而言，我们设计了一种知识增强提示策略，将短语相关的医学知识编码为紧凑的嵌入表示；同时提出全局-局部注意力机制，协同利用粗略的全局信息与精细的局部线索来指导精确区域定位。该设计在无需引入额外文本推理开销的前提下，实现了高层语义理解与细粒度视觉感知的融合。在四个医学视觉定位基准数据集上的实验表明，KnowMVG始终优于现有方法，在AP50指标上提升3.0%，在mIoU指标上提升2.6%。定性分析与消融实验进一步验证了各模块的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a knowledge-guided framework to improve the spatial precision of Vision-Language Models for medical visual grounding, which involves localizing text phrases in radiology images.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识引导的框架，用于提高视觉语言模型在医学视觉定位（将放射学报告中的文本短语与图像区域对应）中的空间精度。

title: Night Eyes: A Reproducible Framework for Constellation-Based Corneal Reflection Matching
summary: Corneal reflection (glint) detection plays an important role in pupil-corneal reflection (P-CR) eye tracking, but in practice it is often handled as heuristics embedded within larger systems, making reproducibility difficult across hardware setups. We introduce a 2D geometry-driven, constellation-based pipeline for mulit-glint detection and matching, focusing on reproducibility and clear evaluation. Inspired by lost-in-space star identification, we treat glints as structured constellations rather than independent blobs. We propose a Similarity-Layout Alignment (SLA) procedure which adapts constellation matching to the specific constraints of multi-LED eye tracking. The framework brings together controlled over-detection, adaptive candidate fallback, appearance-aware scoring, and optional semantic layout priors while keeping detection and correspondence explicitly separated. Evaluated on a public multi-LED dataset, the system provides stable identity-preserving correspondence under noisy conditions. We release code, presets, and evaluation scripts to enable transparent replication, comparison, and dataset annotation.
summary_zh: 角膜反射光斑检测在瞳孔-角膜反射式眼动追踪中具有重要作用，但在实际应用中常作为启发式算法嵌入大型系统，导致不同硬件配置下的可复现性较差。我们提出一种基于二维几何结构的星群式多光斑检测与匹配流程，注重可复现性与清晰评估。受"空间迷失"星体识别技术启发，我们将光斑视作结构化星群而非独立斑点。提出相似性-布局对齐算法，使星群匹配适应多LED眼动追踪的特殊约束。该框架整合了可控过检测、自适应候补回退机制、外观感知评分系统及可选的语义布局先验知识，同时保持检测与对应关系的显式分离。在公开多LED数据集上的测试表明，系统能在噪声环境下提供稳定的身份保持型对应关系。我们公开了代码、预设参数与评估脚本，以支持透明的复现、比较与数据集标注工作。
tldr: The paper introduces a reproducible, constellation-based pipeline for detecting and matching corneal reflections (glints) in eye tracking, using 2D geometry and similarity-layout alignment, inspired by lost-in-space star identification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可复现的、基于星群匹配的角膜反射检测与匹配流程，采用2D几何和相似性-布局对齐方法，灵感来自空间星体识别。

title: GS^2: Graph-based Spatial Distribution Optimization for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated breakthrough performance in novel view synthesis and real-time rendering. Nevertheless, its practicality is constrained by the high memory cost due to a huge number of Gaussian points. Many pruning-based 3DGS variants have been proposed for memory saving, but often compromise spatial consistency and may lead to rendering artifacts. To address this issue, we propose graph-based spatial distribution optimization for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS\textasciicircum2), which enhances reconstruction quality by optimizing the spatial distribution of Gaussian points. Specifically, we introduce an evidence lower bound (ELBO)-based adaptive densification strategy that automatically controls the densification process. In addition, an opacity-aware progressive pruning strategy is proposed to further reduce memory consumption by dynamically removing low-opacity Gaussian points. Furthermore, we propose a graph-based feature encoding module to adjust the spatial distribution via feature-guided point shifting. Extensive experiments validate that GS\textasciicircum2 achieves a compact Gaussian representation while delivering superior rendering quality. Compared with 3DGS, it achieves higher PSNR with only about 12.5\% Gaussian points. Furthermore, it outperforms all compared baselines in both rendering quality and memory efficiency.
summary_zh: 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）在新视角合成与实时渲染中已展现出突破性性能。然而，由于大量高斯点造成的高内存开销，其实用性受到限制。为降低内存占用，已有多种基于剪枝的3DGS变体被提出，但这些方法往往牺牲空间一致性，可能导致渲染伪影。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于图结构的空间分布优化方法（GS²），通过优化高斯点的空间分布来提升重建质量。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于证据下界（ELBO）的自适应致密化策略，能够自动控制高斯点的致密化过程。此外，提出了一种透明度感知的渐进式剪枝策略，通过动态移除低透明度高斯点进一步降低内存消耗。同时，我们设计了基于图结构的特征编码模块，通过特征引导的点位移调整空间分布。大量实验验证表明，GS²在实现紧凑高斯表示的同时，提供了更优的渲染质量。与3DGS相比，该方法仅需约12.5%的高斯点即可获得更高的峰值信噪比。此外，其在渲染质量与内存效率方面均优于所有对比基线方法。
tldr: A method for optimizing the spatial distribution of Gaussian points in 3D Gaussian Splatting to reduce memory consumption while maintaining high rendering quality.
tldr_zh: 一种优化3D高斯溅射中高斯点空间分布的方法，以在保持高渲染质量的同时减少内存消耗。

title: Combining Boundary Supervision and Segment-Level Regularization for Fine-Grained Action Segmentation
summary: Recent progress in Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS) has increasingly relied on complex architectures, which can hinder practical deployment. We present a lightweight dual-loss training framework that improves fine-grained segmentation quality with only one additional output channel and two auxiliary loss terms, requiring minimal architectural modification. Our approach combines a boundary-regression loss that promotes accurate temporal localization via a single-channel boundary prediction and a CDF-based segment-level regularization loss that encourages coherent within-segment structure by matching cumulative distributions over predicted and ground-truth segments. The framework is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing TAS models (e.g., MS-TCN, C2F-TCN, FACT) as a training-time loss function. Across three benchmark datasets, the proposed method improves segment-level consistency and boundary quality, yielding higher F1 and Edit scores across three different models. Frame-wise accuracy remains largely unchanged, highlighting that precise segmentation can be achieved through simple loss design rather than heavier architectures or inference-time refinements.
summary_zh: 近期时序动作分割领域的研究日益依赖复杂架构，这可能会阻碍实际应用部署。我们提出了一种轻量级双损失训练框架，仅需增加一个输出通道和两个辅助损失项即可提升细粒度分割质量，且对架构改动极小。该方法结合了边界回归损失与基于累积分布函数的片段级正则化损失：前者通过单通道边界预测提升时序定位精度，后者通过匹配预测片段与真实片段的累积分布来增强片段内部结构的一致性。该框架与具体架构无关，可作为训练时损失函数集成到现有时序动作分割模型（如MS-TCN、C2F-TCN、FACT）中。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效提升了片段一致性与边界质量，在三种不同模型上均实现了更高的F1分数和编辑分数。帧级精度基本保持不变，这证明通过简明的损失设计即可实现精确分割，无需依赖复杂架构或推理阶段的优化策略。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight dual-loss training framework for Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS), improving boundary quality and segment-level consistency with minimal architectural changes. It is a vision method focused on fine-grained video understanding, not on robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于时序动作分割的轻量级双损失训练框架，通过最小化架构修改来提升边界质量和段内一致性。这是一种专注于细粒度视频理解的视觉方法，不涉及机器人或具身智能体。

title: Enhanced Polarization Locking in VCSELs
summary: While optical injection locking (OIL) of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) has been widely studied in the past, the polarization dynamics of OIL have received far less attention. Recent studies suggest that polarization locking via OIL could enable novel computational applications such as polarization-encoded Ising computers. However, the inherent polarization preference and limited polarization switchability of VCSELs hinder their use for such purposes. To address these challenges, we fabricate VCSELs with tailored oxide aperture designs and combine these with bias current tuning to study the overall impact on polarization locking. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach reduces the required injection power (to as low as 3.6 μW) and expands the locking range. To investigate the impact of the approach, the spin-flip model (SFM) is used to analyze the effects of amplitude anisotropy and bias current on polarization locking, demonstrating strong coherence with experimental results.
summary_zh: 虽然垂直腔面发射激光器（VCSEL）的光注入锁定技术在过去已得到广泛研究，但其偏振动力学特性却鲜有关注。近期研究表明，通过光注入锁定实现偏振锁定可应用于偏振编码伊辛计算机等新型计算领域。然而，VCSEL固有的偏振偏好与有限的偏振切换能力阻碍了其在此类应用中的发展。为应对这些挑战，我们制备了具有定制氧化孔径设计的VCSEL器件，并结合偏置电流调谐技术，系统研究了其对偏振锁定的综合影响。实验结果表明，该方法能显著降低所需注入功率（最低至3.6 μW）并扩大锁定范围。为深入探究该方法的机理，我们采用自旋翻转模型分析振幅各向异性和偏置电流对偏振锁定的影响，理论结果与实验数据呈现出高度一致性。
tldr: This paper presents a study on enhancing polarization locking in vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) through tailored oxide aperture designs and bias current tuning, aimed at enabling novel computational applications like polarization-encoded Ising computers.
tldr_zh: 本研究通过定制氧化物孔径设计和偏置电流调谐来增强垂直腔面发射激光器（VCSEL）的偏振锁定，旨在实现偏振编码伊辛计算机等新型计算应用。

title: Ranking-Guided Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation for Severity Classification
summary: Semi-supervised domain adaptation leverages a few labeled and many unlabeled target samples, making it promising for addressing domain shifts in medical image analysis. However, existing methods struggle with severity classification due to unclear class boundaries. Severity classification involves naturally ordered class labels, complicating adaptation. We propose a novel method that aligns source and target domains using rank scores learned via ranking with class order. Specifically, Cross-Domain Ranking ranks sample pairs across domains, while Continuous Distribution Alignment aligns rank score distributions. Experiments on ulcerative colitis and diabetic retinopathy classification validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating successful alignment of class-specific rank score distributions.
summary_zh: 半监督域自适应方法利用少量标注目标样本和大量未标注目标样本，使其在解决医学图像分析中的域偏移问题上展现出广阔前景。然而，现有方法因类别边界模糊在严重程度分级任务中面临挑战。严重程度分级涉及天然有序的类别标签，这增加了域适应的复杂性。本文提出一种新颖方法，通过引入类别顺序的排序机制学习秩得分，从而实现源域与目标域的对齐。具体而言，跨域排序模块对跨域样本对进行排序，而连续分布对齐模块则实现秩得分分布的对齐。在溃疡性结肠炎和糖尿病视网膜病变分级任务上的实验验证了我们方法的有效性，成功实现了针对特定类别的秩得分分布对齐。
tldr: Proposes a ranking-guided semi-supervised domain adaptation method for severity classification in medical images, using cross-domain ranking and continuous distribution alignment to handle ordered class labels.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于医学图像严重程度分类的排序引导半监督域适应方法，通过跨域排序和连续分布对齐处理有序类别标签。

title: SafeRoPE: Risk-specific Head-wise Embedding Rotation for Safe Generation in Rectified Flow Transformers
summary: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models based on rectified-flow transformers (e.g., SD3, FLUX) achieve high generative fidelity but remain vulnerable to unsafe semantics, especially when triggered by multi-token interactions. Existing mitigation methods largely rely on fine-tuning or attention modulation for concept unlearning; however, their expensive computational overhead and design tailored to U-Net-based denoisers hinder direct adaptation to transformer-based diffusion models (e.g., MMDiT). In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the attention mechanism in MMDiT and find that unsafe semantics concentrate within interpretable, low-dimensional subspaces at head level, where a finite set of safety-critical heads is responsible for unsafe feature extraction. We further observe that perturbing the Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) applied to the query and key vectors can effectively modify some specific concepts in the generated images. Motivated by these insights, we propose SafeRoPE, a lightweight and fine-grained safe generation framework for MMDiT. Specifically, SafeRoPE first constructs head-wise unsafe subspaces by decomposing unsafe embeddings within safety-critical heads, and computes a Latent Risk Score (LRS) for each input vector via projection onto these subspaces. We then introduce head-wise RoPE perturbations that can suppress unsafe semantics without degrading benign content or image quality. SafeRoPE combines both head-wise LRS and RoPE perturbations to perform risk-specific head-wise rotation on query and key vector embeddings, enabling precise suppression of unsafe outputs while maintaining generation fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SafeRoPE achieves SOTA performance in balancing effective harmful content mitigation and utility preservation for safe generation of MMDiT. Codes are available at https://github.com/deng12yx/SafeRoPE.
summary_zh: 基于整流流变换器（如SD3、FLUX）的文本到图像生成模型近期在生成保真度上取得了显著成就，但对不安全语义的鲁棒性依然较弱，尤其当面临多词元交互的触发时。现有缓解方法主要依赖微调或注意力调节以进行概念消除，但其高昂计算成本及专为U-Net去噪器设计的架构，阻碍了它们直接适配于基于变换器的扩散模型（如MMDiT）。本文深入分析了MMDiT中的注意力机制，发现不安全语义集中于注意力头层面的可解释低维子空间中，其中有限的一组安全关键头负责不安全特征提取。进一步研究显示，扰动应用于查询和键向量的旋转位置编码可有效修改生成图像中的特定概念。基于此发现，我们提出轻量化细粒度安全生成框架SafeRoPE。该方法首先通过分解安全关键头中的不安全嵌入来构建头级不安全子空间，并通过将输入向量投影至这些子空间计算潜在风险评分。随后，我们引入头级RoPE扰动以抑制不安全语义，同时保持良性内容与图像质量不受影响。SafeRoPE结合头级潜在风险评分与RoPE扰动，对查询和键向量嵌入执行风险感知的头级旋转操作，实现精准抑制不安全输出并维持生成保真度。大量实验表明，SafeRoPE在平衡有害内容消除与效用保持方面达到了当前最优性能。代码已开源。
tldr: Proposes a lightweight method for making transformer-based diffusion models (MMDiT) safe by perturbing rotary positional embeddings in unsafe attention heads, suppressing harmful content while preserving image quality.
tldr_zh: 提出一种轻量级方法，通过扰动不安全注意力头中的旋转位置嵌入（RoPE），使基于Transformer的扩散模型（MMDiT）生成安全内容，在抑制有害信息的同时保持图像质量。

title: Ultrasound-CLIP: Semantic-Aware Contrastive Pre-training for Ultrasound Image-Text Understanding
summary: Ultrasound imaging is widely used in clinical diagnostics due to its real-time capability and radiation-free nature. However, existing vision-language pre-training models, such as CLIP, are primarily designed for other modalities, and are difficult to directly apply to ultrasound data, which exhibit heterogeneous anatomical structures and diverse diagnostic attributes. To bridge this gap, we construct US-365K, a large-scale ultrasound image-text dataset containing 365k paired samples across 52 anatomical categories. We establish Ultrasonographic Diagnostic Taxonomy (UDT) containing two hierarchical knowledge frameworks. Ultrasonographic Hierarchical Anatomical Taxonomy standardizes anatomical organization, and Ultrasonographic Diagnostic Attribute Framework formalizes nine diagnostic dimensions, including body system, organ, diagnosis, shape, margins, echogenicity, internal characteristics, posterior acoustic phenomena, and vascularity. Building upon these foundations, we propose Ultrasound-CLIP, a semantic-aware contrastive learning framework that introduces semantic soft labels and semantic loss to refine sample discrimination. Moreover, we construct a heterogeneous graph modality derived from UDAF's textual representations, enabling structured reasoning over lesion-attribute relations. Extensive experiments with patient-level data splitting demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification and retrieval benchmarks, while also delivering strong generalization to zero-shot, linear probing, and fine-tuning tasks.
summary_zh: 超声成像因其实时性和无辐射特性，在临床诊断中被广泛应用。然而，现有视觉-语言预训练模型（如CLIP）主要针对其他模态设计，难以直接适用于呈现异质解剖结构和多样化诊断属性的超声数据。为弥合这一差距，我们构建了US-365K大规模超声图文数据集，涵盖52个解剖类别共36.5万组配对样本。我们建立了包含两个层次化知识框架的超声诊断分类体系（UDT）：超声层次化解剖分类体系规范了组织结构，超声诊断属性框架则形式化了包括身体系统、器官、诊断结论、形状、边缘、回声特性、内部特征、后方声学现象及血管分布在内的九个诊断维度。基于此，我们提出语义感知对比学习框架Ultrasound-CLIP，通过引入语义软标签和语义损失函数优化样本区分能力。此外，我们构建了基于超声诊断属性框架文本表征的异构图模态，实现对病灶-属性关系的结构化推理。采用患者级数据划分的广泛实验表明，该方法在分类与检索基准测试中达到最先进性能，同时在零样本学习、线性探测和微调任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Ultrasound-CLIP, a semantic-aware contrastive learning framework pre-trained on a large-scale ultrasound image-text dataset, designed for medical image understanding and diagnostic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Ultrasound-CLIP，一个基于大规模超声图像-文本数据集的语义感知对比学习框架，专为医学图像理解和诊断任务而设计。

title: SteerFlow: Steering Rectified Flows for Faithful Inversion-Based Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in flow-based generative models have enabled training-free, text-guided image editing by inverting an image into its latent noise and regenerating it under a new target conditional guidance. However, existing methods struggle to preserve source fidelity: higher-order solvers incur additional model inferences, truncated inversion constrains editability, and feature injection methods lack architectural transferability. To address these limitations, we propose SteerFlow, a model-agnostic editing framework with strong theoretical guarantees on source fidelity. In the forward process, we introduce an Amortized Fixed-Point Solver that implicitly straightens the forward trajectory by enforcing velocity consistency across consecutive timesteps, yielding a high-fidelity inverted latent. In the backward process, we introduce Trajectory Interpolation, which adaptively blends target-editing and source-reconstruction velocities to keep the editing trajectory anchored to the source. To further improve background preservation, we introduce an Adaptive Masking mechanism that spatially constrains the editing signal with concept-guided segmentation and source-target velocity differences. Extensive experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium demonstrate that SteerFlow consistently achieves better editing quality than existing methods. Finally, we show that SteerFlow extends naturally to a complex multi-turn editing paradigm without accumulating drift.
summary_zh: 基于流的生成模型近期取得了重要进展，通过将图像反演至隐空间噪声并在新目标条件引导下重建，实现了无需训练即可进行文本引导的图像编辑。然而，现有方法难以保持源图像保真度：高阶求解器需要额外模型推理，截断反演限制了可编辑性，而特征注入方法缺乏架构通用性。针对这些局限，我们提出SteerFlow——一个具有强理论保真度保证的模型无关编辑框架。在前向过程中，我们引入"摊销定点求解器"，通过强制相邻时间步间的速度一致性，隐式地拉直前向轨迹，从而获得高保真度的反演隐向量。在反向过程中，我们提出"轨迹插值"方法，自适应混合目标编辑速度与源重建速度，使编辑轨迹始终锚定源图像。为进一步提升背景保留效果，我们引入"自适应掩码机制"，利用概念引导的分割和源-目标速度差对编辑信号进行空间约束。在FLUX.1-dev和Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上的大量实验表明，SteerFlow在编辑质量上持续优于现有方法。最后，我们展示了该框架可自然扩展到复杂多轮次编辑场景，且不会产生漂移累积。
tldr: A method for improving text-guided image editing by inverting and steering flow-based generative models to better preserve source fidelity during edits.
tldr_zh: 一种通过反转和引导基于流的生成模型，在文本引导的图像编辑中更好地保持源图像保真度的方法。

title: Bias mitigation in graph diffusion models
summary: Most existing graph diffusion models have significant bias problems. We observe that the forward diffusion's maximum perturbation distribution in most models deviates from the standard Gaussian distribution, while reverse sampling consistently starts from a standard Gaussian distribution, which results in a reverse-starting bias. Together with the inherent exposure bias of diffusion models, this results in degraded generation quality. This paper proposes a comprehensive approach to mitigate both biases. To mitigate reverse-starting bias, we employ a newly designed Langevin sampling algorithm to align with the forward maximum perturbation distribution, establishing a new reverse-starting point. To address the exposure bias, we introduce a score correction mechanism based on a newly defined score difference. Our approach, which requires no network modifications, is validated across multiple models, datasets, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results.Code is at https://github.com/kunzhan/spp
summary_zh: 现有的大多数图扩散模型存在显著的偏差问题。我们观察到，在多数模型中，前向扩散的最大扰动分布偏离标准高斯分布，而反向采样却始终从标准高斯分布开始，这导致了反向起点偏差。结合扩散模型固有的曝光偏差问题，这些因素共同导致了生成质量的下降。本文提出了一种综合方法来缓解这两种偏差。为减少反向起点偏差，我们采用了一种新设计的Langevin采样算法，使其与前向最大扰动分布保持一致，从而建立新的反向起始点。针对曝光偏差问题，我们引入了一种基于新定义的分数差异的分数校正机制。该方法无需修改网络结构，在多个模型、数据集和任务中得到验证，并取得了最先进的结果。代码已发布于https://github.com/kunzhan/spp。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to mitigate bias issues in graph diffusion models, focusing on reverse-starting bias and exposure bias, improving generation quality without modifying network architecture.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种缓解图扩散模型中偏差问题的方法，重点解决反向起始偏差和曝光偏差，在不修改网络架构的情况下提高生成质量。

title: HOT: Harmonic-Constrained Optimal Transport for Remote Photoplethysmography Domain Adaptation
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact physiological measurement from facial videos; however, its practical deployment is often hindered by substantial performance degradation under domain shift. While recent deep learning-based rPPG methods have achieved strong performance on individual datasets, they frequently overfit to appearance-related factors, such as illumination, camera characteristics, and color response, that vary significantly across domains. To address this limitation, we introduce frequency domain adaptation (FDA) as a principled strategy for modeling appearance variation in rPPG. By transferring low-frequency spectral components that encode domain-dependent appearance characteristics, FDA encourages rPPG models to learn invariance to appearance variations while retaining cardiac-induced signals. To further support physiologically consistent alignment under such appearance variation, we propose Harmonic-Constrained Optimal Transport (HOT), which leverages the harmonic property of cardiac signals to guide alignment between original and FDA-transferred representations. Extensive cross-dataset experiments demonstrate that the proposed FDA and HOT framework effectively enhances the robustness and generalization of rPPG models across diverse datasets.
summary_zh: 远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）能够通过面部视频实现非接触式生理测量，但其实际应用常因领域偏移导致的性能显著下降而受阻。尽管近期基于深度学习的rPPG方法在独立数据集上取得了优异表现，但这些方法往往过度拟合于外观相关因素，如光照、摄像机特性和色彩响应等，这些因素在不同领域间存在显著差异。为解决这一局限，我们提出频域适应（FDA）作为一种原则性策略，用于建模rPPG中的外观变化。通过迁移编码领域相关外观特征的低频频谱分量，FDA促使rPPG模型学习对外观变化的不变性，同时保留心脏诱导信号。为进一步支持在外观变化下保持生理一致性的对齐，我们提出谐波约束最优传输（HOT），该方法利用心脏信号的谐波特性来指导原始表示与FDA迁移表示之间的对齐。跨数据集的广泛实验表明，所提出的FDA与HOT框架有效增强了rPPG模型在不同数据集间的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a frequency domain adaptation method and harmonic-constrained optimal transport framework to improve the generalization of remote photoplethysmography models across different datasets, focusing on appearance variation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种频率域适应方法和谐波约束的最优传输框架，旨在提高远程光电容积描记技术模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力，主要解决外观变化问题。

title: Mitigating the ID-OOD Tradeoff in Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Open-set test-time adaptation (OSTTA) addresses the challenge of adapting models to new environments where out-of-distribution (OOD) samples coexist with in-distribution (ID) samples affected by distribution shifts. In such settings, covariate shift-for example, changes in weather conditions such as snow-can alter ID samples, reducing model reliability. Consequently, models must not only correctly classify covariate-shifted ID (csID) samples but also effectively reject covariate-shifted OOD (csOOD) samples. Entropy minimization is a common strategy in test-time adaptation to maintain ID performance under distribution shifts, while entropy maximization is widely applied to enhance OOD detection. Several studies have sought to combine these objectives to tackle the challenges of OSTTA. However, the intrinsic conflict between entropy minimization and maximization inevitably leads to a trade-off between csID classification and csOOD detection. In this paper, we first analyze the limitations of entropy maximization in OSTTA and then introduce an angular loss to regulate feature norm magnitudes, along with a feature-norm loss to suppress csOOD logits, thereby improving OOD detection. These objectives form ROSETTA, a $\underline{r}$obust $\underline{o}$pen-$\underline{se}$t $\underline{t}$est-$\underline{t}$ime $\underline{a}$daptation. Our method achieves strong OOD detection while maintaining high ID classification performance on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, Tiny-ImageNet-C and ImageNet-C. Furthermore, experiments on the Cityscapes validate the method's effectiveness in real-world semantic segmentation, and results on the HAC dataset demonstrate its applicability across different open-set TTA setups.
summary_zh: 开放集测试时适应（OSTTA）旨在解决模型在新环境下的适应挑战，其中分布外样本与受分布偏移影响的分布内样本共存。在此类场景中，协变量偏移（例如天气条件变化，如积雪）可能改变分布内样本，从而降低模型可靠性。因此，模型不仅需要正确分类协变量偏移的分布内样本，还必须有效拒绝协变量偏移的分布外样本。熵最小化是测试时适应中保持分布内性能的常用策略，而熵最大化则被广泛应用于增强分布外检测。已有若干研究尝试结合这两种目标以应对OSTTA的挑战。然而，熵最小化与最大化之间的内在矛盾不可避免地导致了对协变量偏移分布内样本分类与协变量偏移分布外样本检测之间的权衡。本文首先分析了熵最大化在OSTTA中的局限性，随后引入角度损失以调节特征范数大小，并结合特征范数损失以抑制协变量偏移分布外样本的logit值，从而提升分布外检测能力。这些目标共同构成了ROSETTA方法——一种鲁棒的开放集测试时适应框架。该方法在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、Tiny-ImageNet-C和ImageNet-C数据集上实现了强大的分布外检测能力，同时保持了高水平的分布内分类性能。此外，在Cityscapes数据集上的实验验证了该方法在真实世界语义分割任务中的有效性，而HAC数据集上的结果则证明了其在不同开放集测试时适应配置中的广泛适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces ROSETTA, a method for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation that aims to improve both in-distribution classification and out-of-distribution detection under covariate shift, with experiments on image classification benchmarks and semantic segmentation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为ROSETTA的开集测试时适应方法，旨在改善协变量偏移下的分布内分类和分布外检测性能，并在图像分类基准和语义分割任务上进行了实验验证。

title: Satellite-Free Training for Drone-View Geo-Localization
summary: Drone-view geo-localization (DVGL) aims to determine the location of drones in GPS-denied environments by retrieving the corresponding geotagged satellite tile from a reference gallery given UAV observations of a location. In many existing formulations, these observations are represented by a single oblique UAV image. In contrast, our satellite-free setting is designed for multi-view UAV sequences, which are used to construct a geometry-normalized UAV-side location representation before cross-view retrieval. Existing approaches rely on satellite imagery during training, either through paired supervision or unsupervised alignment, which limits practical deployment when satellite data are unavailable or restricted. In this paper, we propose a satellite-free training (SFT) framework that converts drone imagery into cross-view compatible representations through three main stages: drone-side 3D scene reconstruction, geometry-based pseudo-orthophoto generation, and satellite-free feature aggregation for retrieval. Specifically, we first reconstruct dense 3D scenes from multi-view drone images using 3D Gaussian splatting and project the reconstructed geometry into pseudo-orthophotos via PCA-guided orthographic projection. This rendering stage operates directly on reconstructed scene geometry without requiring camera parameters at rendering time. Next, we refine these orthophotos with lightweight geometry-guided inpainting to obtain texture-complete drone-side views. Finally, we extract DINOv3 patch features from the generated orthophotos, learn a Fisher vector aggregation model solely from drone data, and reuse it at test time to encode satellite tiles for cross-view retrieval. Experimental results on University-1652 and SUES-200 show that our SFT framework substantially outperforms satellite-free generalization baselines and narrows the gap to methods trained with satellite imagery.
summary_zh: 无人机视角地理定位（DVGL）的目标是在无GPS环境下，通过无人机对某位置的观测数据，从参考图库中检索出对应的地理标记卫星图块，从而确定无人机的位置。许多现有方法中，这些观测数据仅以单张倾斜无人机图像表示。与此不同，我们提出的无卫星数据设定专为多视角无人机序列设计，这类序列在跨视图检索前用于构建几何归一化的无人机端位置表示。现有方法在训练过程中依赖卫星图像，无论是通过配对监督还是无监督对齐，这在卫星数据不可用或受限时限制了实际部署。本文提出一种无卫星训练（SFT）框架，通过三个阶段将无人机图像转换为跨视图兼容的表示：无人机端三维场景重建、基于几何的伪正射影像生成以及用于检索的无卫星特征聚合。具体而言，我们首先利用三维高斯泼溅技术从多视角无人机图像重建稠密三维场景，并通过PCA引导的正射投影将重建的几何结构投影为伪正射影像。该渲染阶段直接在重建的场景几何上操作，无需渲染时的相机参数。随后，我们采用轻量级几何引导修复技术优化这些正射影像，以获取纹理完整的无人机端视图。最后，我们从生成的正射影像中提取DINOv3图像块特征，仅使用无人机数据学习费舍尔向量聚合模型，并在测试时复用该模型对卫星图块进行编码以实现跨视图检索。在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的SFT框架显著优于无卫星泛化基线方法，并缩小了与使用卫星图像训练方法之间的性能差距。
tldr: This paper proposes a satellite-free training framework for drone-view geo-localization, using 3D reconstruction and pseudo-orthophoto generation to enable cross-view retrieval without satellite imagery during training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无人机视图地理定位的无卫星训练框架，利用3D重建和伪正射影像生成，实现在训练期间无需卫星图像的跨视图检索。

title: VideoZeroBench: Probing the Limits of Video MLLMs with Spatio-Temporal Evidence Verification
summary: Recent video multimodal large language models achieve impressive results across various benchmarks. However, current evaluations suffer from two critical limitations: (1) inflated scores can mask deficiencies in fine-grained visual understanding and reasoning, and (2) answer correctness is often measured without verifying whether models identify the precise spatio-temporal evidence supporting their predictions. To address this, we present VideoZeroBench, a hierarchical benchmark designed for challenging long-video question answering that rigorously verifies spatio-temporal evidence. It comprises 500 manually annotated questions across 13 domains, paired with temporal intervals and spatial bounding boxes as evidence. To disentangle answering generation, temporal grounding, and spatial grounding, we introduce a five-level evaluation protocol that progressively tightens evidence requirements. Experiments show that even Gemini-3-Pro correctly answers fewer than 17% of questions under the standard end-to-end QA setting (Level-3). When grounding constraints are imposed, performance drops sharply: No model exceeds 1% accuracy when both correct answering and accurate spatio-temporal localization are required (Level-5), with most failing to achieve any correct grounded predictions. These results expose a significant gap between surface-level answer correctness and genuine evidence-based reasoning, revealing that grounded video understanding remains a bottleneck for long-video QA. We further analyze performance across minimal evidence spans, atomic abilities, and inference paradigms, providing insights for future research in grounded video reasoning. The benchmark and code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 近期视频多模态大语言模型在各项基准测试中表现优异。然而，当前评估存在两大关键局限：（1）虚高的分数可能掩盖模型在细粒度视觉理解与推理方面的缺陷；（2）答案正确性的评判往往未验证模型是否识别了支撑其预测的精确时空证据。为此，我们提出VideoZeroBench——一个为挑战性长视频问答设计的层级化基准，其核心在于严格验证时空证据。该基准包含覆盖13个领域的500个人工标注问题，每个问题均配有作为证据的时间区间与空间边界框。为区分答案生成、时序定位和空间定位能力，我们引入了五级评估协议，逐级加强对证据的约束要求。实验表明，即使在标准端到端问答场景（第三级）下，Gemini-3-Pro的正确回答率也低于17%。当施加时空定位约束时，模型性能急剧下降：在要求同时满足正确答案与精确时空定位的条件下（第五级），所有模型准确率均未超过1%，多数模型甚至无法做出任何正确的基础定位预测。这些结果揭示了表层答案正确性与基于证据的真实推理能力之间存在显著差距，表明基于证据的视频理解仍是长视频问答的技术瓶颈。我们进一步从最小证据跨度、基础能力维度及推理范式等角度展开分析，为未来基于证据的视频推理研究提供方向。本基准与代码将公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces VideoZeroBench, a hierarchical benchmark for long-video QA that requires spatio-temporal evidence verification, revealing a significant gap in current video MLLMs' grounded reasoning capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VideoZeroBench，一个用于长视频问答的分层基准，要求时空证据验证，揭示了当前视频MLLMs在基于证据的推理能力上存在显著差距。

title: Nonlinear Methods for Analyzing Pose in Behavioral Research
summary: Advances in markerless pose estimation have made it possible to capture detailed human movement in naturalistic settings using standard video, enabling new forms of behavioral analysis at scale. However, the high dimensionality, noise, and temporal complexity of pose data raise significant challenges for extracting meaningful patterns of coordination and behavioral change. This paper presents a general-purpose analysis pipeline for human pose data, designed to support both linear and nonlinear characterizations of movement across diverse experimental contexts. The pipeline combines principled preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and recurrence-based time series analysis to quantify the temporal structure of movement dynamics. To illustrate the pipeline's flexibility, we present three case studies spanning facial and full-body movement, 2D and 3D data, and individual versus multi-agent behavior. Together, these examples demonstrate how the same analytic workflow can be adapted to extract theoretically meaningful insights from complex pose time series.
summary_zh: 无标记姿态估计技术的进步使得使用标准视频捕捉自然场景中的精细人体运动成为可能，从而实现了大规模行为分析的新范式。然而，姿态数据的高维度、噪声干扰及时间复杂性为提取协调行为和变化的有意义模式带来了重大挑战。本文提出一种通用的人体姿态数据分析流程，旨在支持不同实验场景下对运动的线性和非线性表征。该流程结合了基于原理的预处理、降维技术与递归时间序列分析方法，以量化运动动力学的时间结构。为展示其灵活性，我们呈现了三个案例研究，涵盖面部与全身运动、二维与三维数据，以及个体与多主体行为分析。这些案例共同证明了同一分析框架如何通过适应性调整，从复杂姿态时间序列中提取具有理论意义的研究发现。
tldr: The paper presents a general-purpose analysis pipeline for human pose data, combining preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and recurrence-based time series analysis to quantify movement dynamics, demonstrated across three case studies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通用的人体姿态数据分析流程，结合预处理、降维和基于递归的时间序列分析来量化运动动态，并通过三个案例研究进行演示。

title: Non-Rigid 3D Shape Correspondences: From Foundations to Open Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Estimating correspondences between deformed shape instances is a long-standing problem in computer graphics; numerous applications, from texture transfer to statistical modelling, rely on recovering an accurate correspondence map. Many methods have thus been proposed to tackle this challenging problem from varying perspectives, depending on the downstream application. This state-of-the-art report is geared towards researchers, practitioners, and students seeking to understand recent trends and advances in the field. We categorise developments into three paradigms: spectral methods based on functional maps, combinatorial formulations that impose discrete constraints, and deformation-based methods that directly recover a global alignment. Each school of thought offers different advantages and disadvantages, which we discuss throughout the report. Meanwhile, we highlight the latest developments in each area and suggest new potential research directions. Finally, we provide an overview of emerging challenges and opportunities in this growing field, including the recent use of vision foundation models for zero-shot correspondence and the particularly challenging task of matching partial shapes.
summary_zh: 在计算机图形学中，估计变形形状实例之间的对应关系是一个长期存在的问题；从纹理传递到统计建模，众多应用都依赖于恢复准确的对应映射。因此，根据下游应用的需求，研究者们从不同角度提出了多种方法来解决这一难题。本前沿技术报告旨在帮助研究人员、从业者和学生理解该领域的最新趋势和进展。我们将相关进展分为三类范式：基于功能映射的谱方法、施加离散约束的组合优化方法，以及直接恢复全局对齐的基于变形的方法。每种思路都各具优缺点，我们将在报告中逐一讨论。同时，我们重点介绍了各领域的最新进展，并提出了潜在的新研究方向。最后，我们概述了这个快速发展领域中新兴的挑战与机遇，包括近期利用视觉基础模型实现零样本对应的方法，以及极具挑战性的部分形状匹配任务。
tldr: This is a state-of-the-art report surveying methods for 3D shape correspondence, categorizing approaches into spectral, combinatorial, and deformation-based paradigms, and discussing emerging challenges like using vision foundation models for zero-shot matching.
tldr_zh: 这是一篇关于3D形状非刚性对应方法的技术报告，将方法分为基于函数映射的谱方法、施加离散约束的组合方法以及直接恢复全局对齐的形变方法，并探讨了使用视觉基础模型进行零样本匹配等新兴挑战。

title: Computing the Exact Pareto Front in Average-Cost Multi-Objective Markov Decision Processes
summary: Many communication and control problems are cast as multi-objective Markov decision processes (MOMDPs). The complete solution to an MOMDP is the Pareto front. Much of the literature approximates this front via scalarization into single-objective MDPs. Recent work has begun to characterize the full front in discounted or simple bi-objective settings by exploiting its geometry. In this work, we characterize the exact front in average-cost MOMDPs. We show that the front is a continuous, piecewise-linear surface lying on the boundary of a convex polytope. Each vertex corresponds to a deterministic policy, and adjacent vertices differ in exactly one state. Each edge is realized as a convex combination of the policies at its endpoints, with the mixing coefficient given in closed form. We apply these results to a remote state estimation problem, where each vertex on the front corresponds to a threshold policy. The exact Pareto front and solutions to certain non-convex MDPs can be obtained without explicitly solving any MDP.
summary_zh: 许多通信与控制问题被建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDPs）。MOMDP的完整解是帕累托前沿。现有文献大多通过标量化将其转化为单目标MDP来近似求解该前沿。近期的研究开始利用其几何特性，在折扣或简单双目标设定下刻画完整前沿。本文针对平均成本MOMDP，精确刻画了其前沿结构。我们证明该前沿是位于凸多面体边界上的连续分段线性曲面，其每个顶点对应一个确定性策略，且相邻顶点仅在一个状态上存在差异。每条边可由其端点对应策略的凸组合实现，混合系数以闭式形式给出。我们将这些结果应用于远程状态估计问题，其中前沿上的每个顶点对应一个阈值策略。无需显式求解任何MDP，即可获得精确帕累托前沿以及特定非凸MDP问题的解。
tldr: This paper presents a theoretical characterization of the exact Pareto front for average-cost multi-objective Markov decision processes (MOMDPs), showing it is a continuous, piecewise-linear surface on a convex polytope, and applies it to a remote state estimation problem.
tldr_zh: 本文在平均成本多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDP）中，理论刻画了精确帕累托前沿，证明其是凸多面体边界上的连续分段线性曲面，并应用于远程状态估计问题。

title: Neural network methods for two-dimensional finite-source reflector design
summary: We address the inverse problem of designing two-dimensional reflectors that transform light from a finite, extended source into a prescribed far-field distribution. We propose a neural network parameterization of the reflector height and develop two differentiable objective functions: (i) a direct change-of-variables loss that pushes the source distribution through the learned inverse mapping, and (ii) a mesh-based loss that maps a target-space grid back to the source, integrates over intersections, and remains continuous even when the source is discontinuous. Gradients are obtained via automatic differentiation and optimized with a robust quasi-Newton method. As a comparison, we formulate a deconvolution baseline built on a simplified finite-source approximation: a 1D monotone mapping is recovered from flux balance, yielding an ordinary differential equation solved in integrating-factor form; this solver is embedded in a modified Van Cittert iteration with nonnegativity clipping and a ray-traced forward operator. Across four benchmarks -- continuous and discontinuous sources, and with/without minimum-height constraints -- we evaluate accuracy by ray-traced normalized mean absolute error (NMAE). Our neural network approach converges faster and achieves consistently lower NMAE than the deconvolution method, and handles height constraints naturally. We discuss how the method may be extended to rotationally symmetric and full three-dimensional settings via iterative correction schemes.
summary_zh: 我们研究二维反射器的逆向设计问题，即如何将有限扩展光源发出的光线转换为预设的远场分布。我们提出了一种反射器高度的神经网络参数化方法，并构建了两个可微目标函数：（i）基于变量替换的直接损失函数，通过习得的逆映射将光源分布向前传输；（ii）基于网格的损失函数，将目标空间网格映射回光源域，在交叉区域进行积分计算，且即使光源分布不连续时仍保持函数连续性。通过自动微分计算梯度，并采用鲁棒的拟牛顿法进行优化。作为对比，我们构建了一种基于简化有限光源近似的反卷积基准方法：通过光通量平衡恢复一维单调映射，得到以积分因子形式求解的常微分方程；将该求解器嵌入改进的Van Cittert迭代框架，结合非负截断处理和光线追迹前向算子。在四个基准测试案例中（包含连续/非连续光源分布，以及有/无最小高度约束的情况），我们通过光线追迹归一化平均绝对误差评估设计精度。实验表明，神经网络方法比反卷积法收敛更快，且在所有测试中均获得更低的误差值，同时能自然处理高度约束条件。最后，我们探讨了如何通过迭代校正方案将该方法推广至旋转对称及完全三维场景的应用。
tldr: This paper proposes a neural network method for designing two-dimensional optical reflectors, focusing on solving an inverse problem in illumination engineering, not robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于二维光学反射器设计的神经网络方法，重点解决照明工程中的反问题，与机器人学无关。

title: Do Lexical and Contextual Coreference Resolution Systems Degrade Differently under Mention Noise? An Empirical Study on Scientific Software Mentions
summary: We present our participation in the SOMD 2026 shared task on cross-document software mention coreference resolution, where our systems ranked second across all three subtasks. We compare two fine-tuning-free approaches: Fuzzy Matching (FM), a lexical string-similarity method, and Context Aware Representations (CAR), which combines mention-level and document-level embeddings. Both achieve competitive performance across all subtasks (CoNLL F1 of 0.94-0.96), with CAR consistently outperforming FM by 1 point on the official test set, consistent with the high surface regularity of software names, which reduces the need for complex semantic reasoning. A controlled noise-injection study reveals complementary failure modes: as boundary noise increases, CAR loses only 0.07 F1 points from clean to fully corrupted input, compared to 0.20 for FM, whereas under mention substitution, FM degrades more gracefully (0.52 vs. 0.63). Our inference-time analysis shows that FM scales superlinearly with corpus size, whereas CAR scales approximately linearly, making CAR the more efficient choice at large scale. These findings suggest that system selection should be informed by both the noise profile of the upstream mention detector and the scale of the target corpus. We release our code to support future work on this underexplored task.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了我们参与SOMD 2026跨文档软件指代消解共享任务的研究成果，我们的系统在全部三项子任务中均位列第二。我们比较了两种无需微调的方法：基于词汇字符串相似度的模糊匹配方法，以及结合指称级与文档级嵌入的上下文感知表示方法。两种方法在所有子任务中均取得竞争性性能（CoNLL F1值为0.94-0.96），其中上下文感知表示方法在官方测试集上始终领先模糊匹配方法1个点，这与软件名称高度规范化的表面特征相符，从而降低了对复杂语义推理的需求。通过受控噪声注入实验，我们发现两种方法具有互补的失效模式：在边界噪声增加时，上下文感知表示方法从干净输入到完全污染输入的F1值仅下降0.07，而模糊匹配方法下降0.20；在指称替换场景下，模糊匹配方法性能下降更平缓（0.52对比0.63）。推理时间分析表明，模糊匹配方法的计算规模随语料库大小呈超线性增长，而上下文感知表示方法近似线性增长，这使后者在大规模场景下成为更高效的选择。这些发现表明，系统选择应综合考虑上游指称检测器的噪声特征和目标语料库的规模。我们已公开代码，以支持这一尚未充分探索任务的研究发展。
tldr: The paper compares lexical and contextual methods for cross-document coreference resolution of software mentions, analyzing their robustness to noise and computational scaling.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了两种软件提及跨文档共指消解方法（词法匹配与上下文感知模型）在噪声下的鲁棒性及计算效率，为系统选择提供了依据。

title: A Practical Two-Stage Framework for GPU Resource and Power Prediction in Heterogeneous HPC Systems
summary: Efficient utilization of GPU resources and power has become critical with the growing demand for GPUs in high-performance computing (HPC). In this paper, we analyze GPU utilization and GPU memory utilization, as well as the power consumption of the Vienna ab initio Simulation Package (VASP), using the Slurm workload manager historical logs and GPU performance metrics collected by NVIDIA's Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM). VASP is a widely used materials science application on Perlmutter at NERSC, an HPE Cray EX system based on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Using our insights from the resource utilization analysis of VASP applications, we propose a resource prediction framework to predict the average GPU power, maximum GPU utilization, and maximum GPU memory utilization values of heterogeneous HPC system applications to enable more efficient scheduling decisions and power-aware system operation. Our prediction framework consists of two stages: 1) using only the Slurm accounting logs as training data and 2) augmenting the training data with historical GPU profiling metrics collected with DCGM. The maximum GPU utilization predictions using only the Slurm submission features achieve up to 97% accuracy. Furthermore, features engineered from GPU-compute and memory activity metrics exhibit good correlations with average power utilization, and our runtime power usage prediction experiments result in up to 92% prediction accuracy. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of DCGM metrics in capturing application characteristics and highlight their potential for developing predictive models to support dynamic power management in HPC systems.
summary_zh: 随着高性能计算（HPC）领域对图形处理器（GPU）需求的不断增长，如何高效利用GPU资源与功耗已成为关键问题。本文基于Slurm工作负载管理器的历史日志以及NVIDIA数据中心GPU管理器（DCGM）收集的GPU性能指标，对维也纳从头算模拟软件包（VASP）的GPU利用率、GPU内存利用率及功耗进行了分析。VASP是美国国家能源研究科学计算中心（NERSC）Perlmutter系统（基于NVIDIA A100 GPU的HPE Cray EX架构）上广泛使用的材料科学应用程序。通过对VASP应用程序资源利用情况的分析，我们提出一种资源预测框架，用于预测异构高性能计算系统应用程序的平均GPU功耗、最大GPU利用率及最大GPU内存使用值，以支持更高效的调度决策与功耗感知系统运行。该预测框架包含两个阶段：1）仅使用Slurm记账日志作为训练数据；2）在训练数据中补充DCGM收集的历史GPU性能分析指标。仅使用Slurm提交特征的预测方法对最大GPU利用率的预测准确率可达97%。此外，从GPU计算与内存活动指标中提取的特征与平均功耗利用率表现出良好的相关性，我们的运行时功耗预测实验实现了最高92%的预测准确率。这些发现证明了DCGM指标在捕获应用程序特征方面的有效性，并凸显了其在开发预测模型以支持高性能计算系统动态功耗管理方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage framework for predicting GPU resource usage and power consumption in HPC systems to improve scheduling and power management, using data from Slurm logs and NVIDIA DCGM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，利用Slurm日志和NVIDIA DCGM数据，预测HPC系统中的GPU资源使用情况和功耗，以改进调度和能耗管理。

title: AstroConcepts: A Large-Scale Multi-Label Classification Corpus for Astrophysics
summary: Scientific multi-label text classification suffers from extreme class imbalance, where specialized terminology exhibits severe power-law distributions that challenge standard classification approaches. Existing scientific corpora lack comprehensive controlled vocabularies, focusing instead on broad categories and limiting systematic study of extreme imbalance. We introduce AstroConcepts, a corpus of English abstracts from 21,702 published astrophysics papers, labeled with 2,367 concepts from the Unified Astronomy Thesaurus. The corpus exhibits severe label imbalance, with 76% of concepts having fewer than 50 training examples. By releasing this resource, we enable systematic study of extreme class imbalance in scientific domains and establish strong baselines across traditional, neural, and vocabulary-constrained LLM methods. Our evaluation reveals three key patterns that provide new insights into scientific text classification. First, vocabulary-constrained LLMs achieve competitive performance relative to domain-adapted models in astrophysics classification, suggesting a potential for parameter-efficient approaches. Second, domain adaptation yields relatively larger improvements for rare, specialized terminology, although absolute performance remains limited across all methods. Third, we propose frequency-stratified evaluation to reveal performance patterns that are hidden by aggregate scores, thereby making robustness assessment central to scientific multi-label evaluation. These results offer actionable insights for scientific NLP and establish benchmarks for research on extreme imbalance.
