summary_zh: 科学多标签文本分类面临极端的类别不平衡问题，其中专业术语呈现出严重的幂律分布，这对标准分类方法构成了挑战。现有的科学语料库缺乏全面的受控词汇表，主要侧重于广泛类别，限制了对极端不平衡问题的系统性研究。我们引入了AstroConcepts语料库，该库包含来自21,702篇已发表天体物理学论文的英文摘要，并标注了统一天文学词表中的2,367个概念。该语料库表现出严重的标签不平衡现象，76%的概念拥有少于50个训练样本。通过发布这一资源，我们能够系统研究科学领域中的极端类别不平衡问题，并在传统方法、神经网络方法及词汇约束大语言模型方法上建立了强基线。我们的评估揭示了三个关键模式，为科学文本分类提供了新的见解：首先，词汇约束大语言模型在天体物理学分类中相较于领域适应模型展现出竞争力，表明参数高效方法具有潜力；其次，领域适应方法对罕见专业术语的改进相对更大，但所有方法的绝对性能仍有限制；第三，我们提出频率分层评估方法，以揭示被综合分数掩盖的性能模式，从而使鲁棒性评估成为科学多标签评估的核心。这些结果为科学自然语言处理提供了可操作的见解，并为极端不平衡研究建立了基准。
tldr: This paper introduces a large-scale, multi-label corpus for astrophysics, designed to study extreme class imbalance in scientific text classification, and evaluates traditional, neural, and LLM-based methods, highlighting vocabulary-constrained LLMs' potential for rare terminology.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个用于天体物理学的大规模多标签语料库，旨在研究科学文本分类中的极端类别不平衡问题，并评估了传统、神经网络和基于大语言模型的方法，强调了词汇受限大语言模型在处理稀有术语上的潜力。

title: Application of parametric Shallow Recurrent Decoder Network to magnetohydrodynamic flows in liquid metal blankets of fusion reactors
summary: Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) phenomena play a pivotal role in the design and operation of nuclear fusion systems, where electrically conducting fluids (such as liquid metals or molten salts employed in reactor blankets) interact with magnetic fields of varying intensity and orientation, influencing the resulting flow dynamics. The numerical solution of MHD models entails the resolution of highly nonlinear, multiphysics systems of equations, which can become computationally demanding, particularly in multi-query, parametric, or real-time contexts. This study investigates a fully data-driven framework for MHD state reconstruction that integrates dimensionality reduction through Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) with the SHallow REcurrent Decoder (SHRED), a neural network architecture designed to reconstruct the full spatio-temporal state from sparse time-series measurements of selected observables, including previously unseen parametric configurations. The SHRED methodology is applied to a three-dimensional geometry representative of a portion of a WCLL blanket cell, in which lead-lithium flows around a water-cooled tube. Multiple magnetic field configurations are examined, including constant toroidal fields, combined toroidal-poloidal fields, and time-dependent magnetic fields. Across all considered scenarios, SHRED achieves high reconstruction accuracy, robustness, and generalization to magnetic field intensities, orientations, and temporal evolutions not seen during training. Notably, in the presence of time-varying magnetic fields, the model accurately infers the temporal evolution of the magnetic field itself using temperature measurements alone. Overall, the findings identify SHRED as a computationally efficient, data-driven, and flexible approach for MHD state reconstruction, with significant potential for real-time monitoring, diagnostics and control in fusion reactor systems.
summary_zh: 磁流体动力学（MHD）现象在核聚变系统的设计与运行中具有关键作用，其中导电流体（如反应堆包层中使用的液态金属或熔盐）与不同强度和方向的磁场相互作用，影响最终的流动动力学。MHD模型的数值求解需要处理高度非线性、多物理场的方程组，其计算成本可能很高，尤其是在多查询、参数化或实时应用场景中。本研究提出了一种完全数据驱动的MHD状态重构框架，该框架通过奇异值分解（SVD）进行降维，并结合浅层循环解码器（SHRED）——一种专为从稀疏时间序列测量数据中重构完整时空状态而设计的神经网络架构，能够处理包括先前未见过参数配置在内的多种可观测数据。SHRED方法被应用于一个代表WCLL包层单元部分的三维几何模型，该模型中铅锂流体围绕水冷管流动。研究考察了多种磁场配置，包括恒定环向磁场、环向-极向组合磁场以及时变磁场。在所有考虑的场景中，SHRED均展现出高重构精度、鲁棒性，并能泛化至训练过程中未出现过的磁场强度、方向及时间演变。特别值得注意的是，在存在时变磁场的情况下，该模型仅通过温度测量数据即可准确推断磁场自身的时间演变。总体而言，研究结果表明SHRED是一种计算高效、数据驱动且灵活多变的MHD状态重构方法，在聚变反应堆系统的实时监测、诊断与控制方面具有重要潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven method using SHRED neural networks for reconstructing complex magnetohydrodynamic flows in fusion reactor systems, aiming to enable real-time monitoring and control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SHRED神经网络的数据驱动方法，用于重建聚变反应堆系统中复杂的磁流体动力学流动，旨在实现实时监测和控制。

title: Gradient estimators for parameter inference in discrete stochastic kinetic models
summary: Stochastic kinetic models are ubiquitous in physics, yet inferring their parameters from experimental data remains challenging. In deterministic models, parameter inference often relies on gradients, as they can be obtained efficiently through automatic differentiation. However, these tools cannot be directly applied to stochastic simulation algorithms (SSA) such as the Gillespie algorithm, since sampling from a discrete set of reactions introduces non-differentiable operations. In this work, we adopt three gradient estimators from machine learning for the Gillespie SSA: the Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through (GS-ST) estimator, the Score Function estimator, and the Alternative Path estimator. We compare the properties of all estimators in two representative systems exhibiting relaxation or oscillatory dynamics, where the latter requires gradient estimation of time-dependent objective functions. We find that the GS-ST estimator mostly yields well-behaved gradient estimates, but exhibits diverging variance in challenging parameter regimes, resulting in unsuccessful parameter inference. In these cases, the other estimators provide more robust, lower variance gradients. Our results demonstrate that gradient-based parameter inference can be integrated effectively with the Gillespie SSA, with different estimators offering complementary advantages.
summary_zh: 随机动力学模型在物理学中普遍存在，但其参数从实验数据中推断仍然具有挑战性。在确定性模型中，参数推断通常依赖于梯度，因为它们可以通过自动微分高效获取。然而，这些工具无法直接应用于随机模拟算法（如Gillespie算法），因为从离散反应集合中采样引入了不可微分的操作。本研究为Gillespie随机模拟算法引入了三种机器学习中的梯度估计器：Gumbel-Softmax直通估计器、评分函数估计器和替代路径估计器。我们在两个具有弛豫或振荡动态的代表性系统中比较了所有估计器的特性，其中后者需要对时间依赖的目标函数进行梯度估计。我们发现，Gumbel-Softmax直通估计器通常能产生表现良好的梯度估计，但在挑战性参数区域中会出现方差发散的问题，导致参数推断失败。在这些情况下，其他估计器提供了更稳健、方差更低的梯度。我们的结果表明，基于梯度的参数推断可以与Gillespie随机模拟算法有效结合，不同估计器各自提供互补优势。
tldr: This paper compares gradient estimators for parameter inference in discrete stochastic kinetic models (e.g., using the Gillespie algorithm), finding the Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through estimator works well in many cases but alternatives are more robust for challenging regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了用于离散随机动力学模型（如使用Gillespie算法）参数推断的梯度估计器，发现Gumbel-Softmax直通估计器在许多情况下有效，但在挑战性参数区域中，其他估计器提供更稳健的梯度。

title: AA-SVD : Anchored and Adaptive SVD for Large Language Model Compression
summary: We introduce a fast low-rank factorization-based framework for compressing large language models that enables rapid compression of billion-parameter models without retraining. Unlike existing factorization-based approaches that optimize only on the original inputs, ignoring distribution shifts from upstream compression and thus propagating errors forward, or those that rely only on shifted inputs and risk drifting away from the original outputs, our approach accounts for both. Beyond individual layer compression, we further refine each transformer block end-to-end, minimizing block-level output distortion and allowing compressed layers to jointly compensate for accumulated errors. By anchoring each compressed layer to the original outputs while explicitly modeling input distribution shifts, our method finds a low-rank approximation that maintains functional equivalence with the original model. Experiments on large language models show that our method consistently outperforms existing SVD-based baselines across compression ratios, with the advantage becoming increasingly pronounced at aggressive compression budgets, where competing methods degrade substantially or collapse entirely, offering a practical solution for efficient, large-scale model deployment.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于快速低秩分解的大型语言模型压缩框架，能够无需训练即可快速压缩十亿参数规模的模型。现有基于分解的方法通常仅针对原始输入进行优化，忽视了上游压缩带来的分布偏移，从而导致误差传播；或仅依赖偏移后的输入而面临输出偏离原始模型的风险。我们的方法则同时兼顾两者：除了逐层压缩，我们还对每个Transformer模块进行端到端精调，最小化模块级输出失真，使压缩后的各层能够协同补偿累积误差。通过将每个压缩层锚定于原始输出，并显式建模输入分布偏移，本方法所得的低秩近似能够保持与原始模型的功能等效性。在大规模语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在不同压缩率下均优于现有基于SVD的基准方法，且在激进压缩设定下优势尤为显著——当对比方法性能大幅下降或完全失效时，我们的方法仍能保持稳定，为高效大规模模型部署提供了实用解决方案。
tldr: Proposes a fast low-rank factorization method for compressing large language models, using both original and shifted inputs to maintain functional equivalence without retraining, outperforming SVD-based baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于压缩大语言模型的快速低秩分解方法，利用原始和偏移的输入来保持功能等效性，无需重新训练，在压缩率上优于基于SVD的基线方法。

title: Prosodic ABX: A Language-Agnostic Method for Measuring Prosodic Contrast in Speech Representations
summary: Speech representations from self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to be sensitive to phonemic contrasts, but their sensitivity to prosodic contrasts has not been directly measured. The ABX discrimination task has been used to measure phonemic contrast in S3M representations via minimal pairs. We introduce prosodic ABX, an extension of this framework to evaluate prosodic contrast with only a handful of examples and no explicit labels. Also, we build and release a dataset of English and Japanese minimal pairs and use it along with a Mandarin dataset to evaluate contrast in English stress, Japanese pitch accent, and Mandarin tone. Finally, we show that model and layer rankings are often preserved across several experimental conditions, making it practical for low-resource settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：
自监督语音模型（S3Ms）的语音表征已知对音位对比敏感，但其对韵律对比的敏感度尚未得到直接测量。ABX辨别任务此前通过最小对比对来评估S3M表征中的音位对比能力。本文提出韵律ABX方法，将此框架扩展至仅需少量样本且无需显式标注的韵律对比评估。同时，我们构建并发布了英语与日语的最小对比对数据集，结合现有普通话数据集，系统性评估了英语重音、日语音高重音及普通话声调的对比表征能力。实验结果表明，不同实验条件下模型与网络层级的性能排序具有较高一致性，这为低资源场景下的实际应用提供了可行性。
tldr: The paper introduces a method to evaluate the sensitivity of self-supervised speech models to prosodic contrasts (e.g., stress, tone, pitch accent) using a minimal-pair ABX task, and releases a multi-language dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新方法，用于通过最小对立对ABX任务评估自监督语音模型对韵律特征（如重音、声调、音高重音）的敏感性，并发布了用于评估的多语言数据集。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Speculative Trading under Exploratory Framework
summary: We study a speculative trading problem within the exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) framework of Wang et al. [2020]. The problem is formulated as a sequential optimal stopping problem over entry and exit times under general utility function and price process. We first consider a relaxed version of the problem in which the stopping times are modeled by the jump times of Cox processes driven by bounded, non-randomized intensity controls. Under the exploratory formulation, the agent's randomized control is characterized via the probability measure over the jump intensities, and their objective function is regularized by Shannon's differential entropy. This yields a system of the exploratory HJB equations and Gibbs distributions in closed-form as the optimal policy. Error estimates and convergence of the RL objective to the value function of the original problem are established. Finally, an RL algorithm is designed, and its implementation is showcased in a pairs-trading application.
summary_zh: 本文在Wang等人[2020]提出的探索性强化学习框架下研究了一种投机交易问题。该问题被建模为基于一般效用函数和价格过程的进入与退出时序最优停止问题。我们首先考虑该问题的松弛版本，其中停止时间由受有界非随机化强度控制驱动的考克斯过程跳跃时间建模。在探索性框架下，智能体的随机化控制通过跳跃强度上的概率测度进行刻画，其目标函数通过香农微分熵进行正则化。由此推导出一个探索性HJB方程系统以及闭式表达的吉布斯分布作为最优策略。我们建立了强化学习目标函数与原问题值函数之间的误差估计和收敛性分析。最后，本文设计了一种强化学习算法，并通过配对交易应用展示了其具体实现。
tldr: This paper applies exploratory reinforcement learning to a speculative trading problem, formulating it as a sequential optimal stopping problem and deriving optimal policies via HJB equations and Gibbs distributions.
tldr_zh: 本文在探索性强化学习框架下研究投机交易问题，将其表述为一个序贯最优停止问题，并通过HJB方程和吉布斯分布推导出最优策略。

title: Feature Weighting Improves Pool-Based Sequential Active Learning for Regression
summary: Pool-based sequential active learning for regression (ALR) optimally selects a small number of samples sequentially from a large pool of unlabeled samples to label, so that a more accurate regression model can be constructed under a given labeling budget. Representativeness and diversity, which involve computing the distances among different samples, are important considerations in ALR. However, previous ALR approaches do not incorporate the importance of different features in inter-sample distance computation, resulting in sub-optimal sample selection. This paper proposes three feature weighted single-task ALR approaches and two feature weighted multi-task ALR approaches, where the ridge regression coefficients trained from a small amount of previously labeled samples are used to weight the corresponding features in inter-sample distance computation. Experiments showed that this easy-to-implement enhancement almost always improves the performance of four existing ALR approaches, in both single-task and multi-task regression problems. The feature weighting strategy may also be easily extended to stream-based ALR, and classification algorithms.
summary_zh: 基于池的序列回归主动学习(ALR)从大量未标记样本池中依次选择少量样本进行标记，从而在给定标记预算下构建更准确的回归模型。代表性与多样性涉及不同样本间距离的计算，是ALR的重要考量因素。然而，现有ALR方法在样本间距离计算时未考虑不同特征的重要性，导致样本选择效果欠佳。本文提出三种特征加权的单任务ALR方法和两种特征加权的多任务ALR方法，利用少量已标记样本训练的岭回归系数对样本间距离计算中的相应特征进行加权。实验表明，在单任务与多任务回归问题中，这一易于实现的改进方法几乎总能提升四种现有ALR方法的性能。该特征加权策略亦可轻松扩展至基于流的ALR及分类算法中。
tldr: This paper proposes feature weighting strategies to improve pool-based sequential active learning for regression, by using ridge regression coefficients to weight features in inter-sample distance calculations, leading to more effective sample selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种特征加权策略来改进基于池的顺序主动学习回归方法，通过使用岭回归系数对特征进行加权计算样本间距离，从而实现更有效的样本选择。

title: A Novel Theoretical Analysis for Clustering Heteroscedastic Gaussian Data without Knowledge of the Number of Clusters
summary: This paper addresses the problem of clustering measurement vectors that are heteroscedastic in that they can have different covariance matrices. From the assumption that the measurement vectors within a given cluster are Gaussian distributed with possibly different and unknown covariant matrices around the cluster centroid, we introduce a novel cost function to estimate the centroids. The zeros of the gradient of this cost function turn out to be the fixed-points of a certain function. As such, the approach generalizes the methodology employed to derive the existing Mean-Shift algorithm. But as a main and novel theoretical result compared to Mean-Shift, this paper shows that the sole fixed-points of the identified function tend to be the cluster centroids if both the number of measurements per cluster and the distances between centroids are large enough. As a second contribution, this paper introduces the Wald kernel for clustering. This kernel is defined as the p-value of the Wald hypothesis test for testing the mean of a Gaussian. As such, the Wald kernel measures the plausibility that a measurement vector belongs to a given cluster and it scales better with the dimension of the measurement vectors than the usual Gaussian kernel. Finally, the proposed theoretical framework allows us to derive a new clustering algorithm called CENTRE-X that works by estimating the fixed-points of the identified function. As Mean-Shift, CENTRE-X requires no prior knowledge of the number of clusters. It relies on a Wald hypothesis test to significantly reduce the number of fixed points to calculate compared to the Mean-Shift algorithm, thus resulting in a clear gain in complexity. Simulation results on synthetic and real data sets show that CENTRE-X has comparable or better performance than standard clustering algorithms K-means and Mean-Shift, even when the covariance matrices are not perfectly known.
summary_zh: 本文针对具有异方差性的测量向量聚类问题展开研究，即允许不同簇的测量向量具有不同的协方差矩阵。基于给定簇内测量向量服从高斯分布的假设（其协方差矩阵可能不同且未知，但均围绕簇中心分布），我们提出了一种估计中心点的新型成本函数。该成本函数梯度的零点等价于特定函数的不动点。由此，本方法推广了现有均值漂移算法的推导框架。但与均值漂移相比，本文的主要创新理论贡献在于：证明了当每个簇的测量点数量足够多且中心点间距足够大时，该函数的不动点将收敛于真实的簇中心点。其次，本文提出了适用于聚类的Wald核函数，该核定义为检验高斯分布均值的Wald假设检验的p值。因此，Wald核能够衡量测量向量属于特定簇的合理程度，且相较于传统高斯核函数，其对测量向量维度具有更好的可扩展性。基于所提出的理论框架，我们进一步推导出名为CENTRE-X的新型聚类算法，该算法通过估计目标函数的不动点实现聚类。与均值漂移算法类似，CENTRE-X无需预先设定簇的数量。其创新之处在于利用Wald假设检验显著减少了需要计算的不动点数量，从而在复杂度上获得明显优势。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的仿真结果表明，即使在协方差矩阵未完全已知的情况下，CENTRE-X仍能取得与经典聚类算法（K-means和均值漂移）相当或更优的性能表现。
tldr: This paper introduces a new clustering algorithm, CENTRE-X, which generalizes the Mean-Shift approach using a novel cost function and a Wald kernel, and provides theoretical guarantees for accurate centroid estimation in heteroscedastic Gaussian data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的聚类算法CENTRE-X，它通过新的成本函数和Wald核推广了Mean-Shift方法，并为异方差高斯数据中的质心估计提供了理论保证。

title: Enhancing the Reliability of Medical AI through Expert-guided Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems accelerate medical workflows and improve diagnostic accuracy in healthcare, serving as second-opinion systems. However, the unpredictability of AI errors poses a significant challenge, particularly in healthcare contexts, where mistakes can have severe consequences. A widely adopted safeguard is to pair predictions with uncertainty estimation, enabling human experts to focus on high-risk cases while streamlining routine verification. Current uncertainty estimation methods, however, remain limited, particularly in quantifying aleatoric uncertainty, which arises from data ambiguity and noise. To address this, we propose a novel approach that leverages disagreement in expert responses to generate targets for training machine learning models. These targets are used in conjunction with standard data labels to estimate two components of uncertainty separately, as given by the law of total variance, via a two-ensemble approach, as well as its lightweight variant. We validate our method on binary image classification, binary and multi-class image segmentation, and multiple-choice question answering. Our experiments demonstrate that incorporating expert knowledge can enhance uncertainty estimation quality by $9\%$ to $50\%$ depending on the task, making this source of information invaluable for the construction of risk-aware AI systems in healthcare applications.
summary_zh: 人工智能系统作为第二诊疗意见系统，在医疗健康领域加速了工作流程并提高了诊断准确性。然而，人工智能错误的不可预测性构成了重大挑战，尤其在医疗场景中，错误可能导致严重后果。当前广泛采用的保障措施是为预测结果附上不确定性估计，使人类专家能聚焦于高风险病例，同时简化常规核查流程。但现有不确定性估计方法仍存在局限，特别是在量化由数据模糊性和噪声引起的随机不确定性方面。为此，我们提出一种创新方法，通过利用专家反馈之间的差异来生成机器学习模型训练目标。这些目标与标准数据标签结合，通过双集成方法及其轻量级变体，依据全方差定律分别估算不确定性的两个组成部分。我们在二值图像分类、二值及多类别图像分割、以及多项选择题回答任务上验证了本方法。实验表明，结合专家知识可将不确定性估计质量提升9%至50%（具体取决于任务类型），这一信息源对于构建医疗应用中具备风险感知能力的人工智能系统具有重要价值。
tldr: Proposes a novel expert-guided uncertainty modeling method to improve AI reliability in medical applications by using expert disagreement to estimate aleatoric uncertainty, validated on medical image classification and segmentation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的专家引导不确定性建模方法，通过利用专家间的分歧来估计认知不确定性，以提高医疗AI系统的可靠性，并在医学图像分类和分割任务上进行了验证。

title: LI-DSN: A Layer-wise Interactive Dual-Stream Network for EEG Decoding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into brain activity, offering high temporal resolution crucial for understanding and interacting with neural processes through brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Current dual-stream neural networks for EEG often process temporal and spatial features independently through parallel branches, delaying their integration until a final, late-stage fusion. This design inherently leads to an "information silo" problem, precluding intermediate cross-stream refinement and hindering spatial-temporal decompositions essential for full feature utilization. We propose LI-DSN, a layer-wise interactive dual-stream network that facilitates progressive, cross-stream communication at each layer, thereby overcoming the limitations of late-fusion paradigms. LI-DSN introduces a novel Temporal-Spatial Integration Attention (TSIA) mechanism, which constructs a Spatial Affinity Correlation Matrix (SACM) to capture inter-electrode spatial structural relationships and a Temporal Channel Aggregation Matrix (TCAM) to integrate cosine-gated temporal dynamics under spatial guidance. Furthermore, we employ an adaptive fusion strategy with learnable channel weights to optimize the integration of dual-stream features. Extensive experiments across eight diverse EEG datasets, encompassing motor imagery (MI) classification, emotion recognition, and steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP), consistently demonstrate that LI-DSN significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline models, showcasing its superior robustness and decoding performance. The code will be publicized after acceptance.
summary_zh: 脑电图（EEG）为非侵入式观测大脑活动提供了窗口，其高时间分辨率对于通过脑机接口（BCI）理解和干预神经过程至关重要。当前用于脑电信号的双流神经网络通常通过并行分支独立处理时间与空间特征，直至最后阶段才进行融合。这种设计本质上导致了“信息孤岛”问题，阻碍了跨流中间层的信息优化，限制了实现全特征利用所必需的时空特征解耦。本文提出层级交互式双流网络（LI-DSN），通过在每一层建立渐进式跨流交互机制，克服了晚期融合范式的局限性。LI-DSN引入了新颖的时空集成注意力机制（TSIA），该机制构建了空间亲和关联矩阵（SACM）以捕捉电极间空间结构关系，并构建时间通道聚合矩阵（TCAM）以在空间引导下集成余弦门控的时间动态特征。此外，我们采用具有可学习通道权重的自适应融合策略来优化双流特征的整合。在涵盖运动想象分类、情绪识别和稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）的八个多样化脑电数据集上的大量实验表明，LI-DSN在13个先进基线模型上均取得显著优势，展现了其卓越的鲁棒性和解码性能。代码将在论文录用后公开。
tldr: This paper proposes LI-DSN, a novel layer-wise interactive dual-stream network for EEG decoding that introduces a Temporal-Spatial Integration Attention mechanism to overcome the 'information silo' problem in late-fusion models, demonstrating superior performance across various EEG datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LI-DSN，一种用于脑电图解码的层间交互式双流网络，通过引入时空集成注意力机制来克服晚期融合模型中的信息孤岛问题，在多个脑电图数据集上表现出优越性能。

title: Bridging Deep Learning and Integer Linear Programming: A Predictive-to-Prescriptive Framework for Supply Chain Analytics
summary: Although demand forecasting is a critical component of supply chain planning, actual retail data can exhibit irreconcilable seasonality, irregular spikes, and noise, rendering precise projections nearly unattainable. This paper proposes a three-step analytical framework that combines forecasting and operational analytics. The first stage consists of exploratory data analysis, where delivery-tracked data from 180,519 transactions are partitioned, and long-term trends, seasonality, and delivery-related attributes are examined. Secondly, the forecasting performance of a statistical time series decomposition model N-BEATS MSTL and a recent deep learning architecture N-HiTS were compared. N-BEATS and N-HiTS were both statistically, and hence were N-BEATS's and N-HiTS's statistically selected. Most recent time series deep learning models, N-HiTS, N-BEATS. N-HiTS and N-BEATS N-HiTS and N-HiTS outperformed the statistical benchmark to a large extent. N-BEATS was selected to be the most optimized model, as the one with the lowest forecasting error, in the 3rd and final stage forecasting values of the next 4 weeks of 1918 units, and provided those as a model with a set of deterministically integer linear program outcomes that are aimed to minimize the total delivery time with a set of bound budget, capacity, and service constraints. The solution allocation provided a feasible and cost-optimal shipping plan. Overall, the study provides a compelling example of the practical impact of precise forecasting and simple, highly interpretable model optimization in logistics.
summary_zh: 尽管需求预测是供应链规划的关键组成部分，但实际零售数据往往呈现出不可调和的季节性、不规则峰值和噪声，使得精确预测几乎难以实现。本文提出了一种结合预测与运营分析的三步分析框架。第一阶段为探索性数据分析，对来自180,519笔交易的配送追踪数据进行分区，并考察长期趋势、季节性及配送相关属性。第二阶段比较了统计时间序列分解模型N-BEATS MSTL与近期深度学习架构N-HiTS的预测性能。N-HiTS和N-BEATS在很大程度上超越了统计基准模型，两者均通过统计方法筛选。在第三阶段，N-BEATS因其最低的预测误差被选为最优模型，用于预测未来四周1918个单元的需求量，并将预测值输入一个确定性的整数线性规划模型，该模型在预算、产能和服务约束条件下以最小化总配送时间为目标。解决方案给出了可行且成本最优的运输计划。总体而言，本研究通过精确预测与简洁高可解释性模型优化的结合，为物流领域实践提供了具有说服力的范例。
tldr: This paper proposes a three-step framework for supply chain analytics, combining deep learning time series forecasting (N-BEATS, N-HiTS) with integer linear programming to optimize shipping plans for logistics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个供应链分析的三步框架，结合深度学习时间序列预测与整数线性规划，为物流优化制定运输计划。

title: DDCL: Deep Dual Competitive Learning: A Differentiable End-to-End Framework for Unsupervised Prototype-Based Representation Learning
summary: A persistent structural weakness in deep clustering is the disconnect between feature learning and cluster assignment. Most architectures invoke an external clustering step, typically k-means, to produce pseudo-labels that guide training, preventing the backbone from directly optimising for cluster quality. This paper introduces Deep Dual Competitive Learning (DDCL), the first fully differentiable end-to-end framework for unsupervised prototype-based representation learning. The core contribution is architectural: the external k-means is replaced by an internal Dual Competitive Layer (DCL) that generates prototypes as native differentiable outputs of the network. This single inversion makes the complete pipeline, from backbone feature extraction through prototype generation to soft cluster assignment, trainable by backpropagation through a single unified loss, with no Lloyd iterations, no pseudo-label discretisation, and no external clustering step. To ground the framework theoretically, the paper derives an exact algebraic decomposition of the soft quantisation loss into a simplex-constrained reconstruction error and a non-negative weighted prototype variance term. This identity reveals a self-regulating mechanism built into the loss geometry: the gradient of the variance term acts as an implicit separation force that resists prototype collapse without any auxiliary objective, and leads to a global Lyapunov stability theorem for the reduced frozen-encoder system. Six blocks of controlled experiments validate each structural prediction. The decomposition identity holds with zero violations across more than one hundred thousand training epochs; the negative feedback cycle is confirmed with Pearson -0.98; with a jointly trained backbone, DDCL outperforms its non-differentiable ablation by 65% in clustering accuracy and DeepCluster end-to-end by 122%.
summary_zh: 深度聚类中一个长期存在的结构缺陷在于特征学习与聚类分配之间的脱节。多数架构采用外部聚类步骤（通常为k-means）生成伪标签以指导训练，这阻碍了主干网络直接优化聚类质量。本文提出深度双竞争学习（DDCL），这是首个完全可微分的端到端无监督原型表示学习框架。核心贡献在于架构创新：外部k-means被内部双竞争层（DCL）替代，该层能够生成原型作为网络固有的可微分输出。这一关键转变使得从主干特征提取、原型生成到软聚类分配的完整流程，均可通过反向传播在单一统一损失函数下进行训练，无需劳埃德迭代、无需伪标签离散化、无需外部聚类步骤。为建立理论框架，本文推导出软量化损失的精确代数分解式，将其分解为单纯形约束的重构误差与非负加权原型方差项。该恒等式揭示了损失几何中内置的自调节机制：方差项的梯度作为隐式分离力，无需任何辅助目标即可抵抗原型坍塌，并为简化后的冻结编码器系统推导出全局李雅普诺夫稳定性定理。六组对照实验验证了所有结构预测：分解恒等式在超过十万次训练周期中保持零违反；负反馈循环通过皮尔逊系数-0.98得到证实；在联合训练主干网络时，DDCL的聚类精度比其不可微分消融版本提升65%，比DeepCluster端到端方法提升122%。
tldr: Introduces a fully differentiable end-to-end framework for unsupervised prototype-based representation learning, replacing external clustering with an internal differentiable layer to directly optimize cluster quality.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种完全可微分的端到端无监督原型表示学习框架，用内部可微分层替代外部聚类步骤，以直接优化聚类质量。

title: MATA-Former & SIICU: Semantic Aware Temporal Alignment for High-Fidelity ICU Risk Prediction
summary: Forecasting evolving clinical risks relies on intrinsic pathological dependencies rather than mere chronological proximity, yet current methods struggle with coarse binary supervision and physical timestamps. To align predictive modeling with clinical logic, we propose the Medical-semantics Aware Time-ALiBi Transformer (MATA-Former), utilizing event semantics to dynamically parameterize attention weights to prioritize causal validity over time lags. Furthermore, we introduce Plateau-Gaussian Soft Labeling (PSL), reformulating binary classification into continuous multi-horizon regression for full-trajectory risk modeling. Evaluated on SIICU -- a newly constructed dataset featuring over 506k events with rigorous expert-verified, fine-grained annotations -- and the MIMIC-IV dataset, our framework demonstrates superior efficacy and robust generalization in capturing risks from text-intensive, irregular clinical time series.
summary_zh: 临床风险演化预测依赖内在病理学关联而非简单时序邻近性，但现有方法受限于粗粒度二元监督和物理时间戳的局限。为使预测模型与临床逻辑相契合，本研究提出医学语义感知型时域偏置变换器（MATA-Former），通过事件语义动态参数化注意力权重，以因果有效性优先于时间间隔的建模原则。进一步提出平台-高斯软标签（PSL）方法，将二元分类重构为连续多区间回归任务，实现全轨迹风险建模。在SIICU——新构建的包含50.6万余次事件、经专家严格验证的细粒度标注数据集——及MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，该框架在解析文本密集型、非规则临床时间序列中的风险模式时，展现出卓越的预测效能与稳健的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper proposes MATA-Former, a transformer model with semantically-guided attention, and a soft labeling method for forecasting clinical risks from irregular, text-intensive time series data in an ICU setting, evaluated on a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种MATA-Former模型，使用语义引导的注意力机制和一种软标签方法，用于从ICU环境中不规则、文本密集的时序数据中预测临床风险，并在一个新数据集上进行了评估。

title: Coupled Query-Key Dynamics for Attention
summary: Standard scaled dot-product attention computes scores from static, independent projections of the input. We show that evolving queries and keys \emph{jointly} through shared learned dynamics before scoring - which we call \textbf{coupled QK dynamics} - improves language modeling perplexity and training stability. On WikiText-103 at 60M parameters, coupled dynamics achieves 22.55--22.62 perplexity vs.\ 24.22 for standard attention ($-$6.6--6.9\%), with only 0.11\% additional parameters (shared across both instantiations). A structural ablation isolates coupling as the active ingredient: a symplectic (Hamiltonian) and a non-symplectic (Euler) integrator perform identically when both couple Q and K, while an uncoupled MLP baseline of matched capacity reaches only 23.81 with 8$\times$ higher seed variance. The integration step count (1--7) is similarly irrelevant - a single coupled step suffices. A compute-matched comparison reveals that coupling is a \emph{sample-efficiency} mechanism: standard attention trained for 2.4$\times$ longer (matching wall-clock) reaches the same perplexity, but requires 2.4$\times$ more tokens. The advantage scales to 150M ($-$6.7\%) but narrows at 350M ($-$1.0\%), where Differential Attention (18.93) overtakes coupled dynamics (19.35). The benefit is corpus-dependent: coupling helps on domain-coherent text (WikiText-103 $-$6.6\%, PubMed $-$4.5\%) but degrades on heterogeneous web text ($+$10.3\%) and shows no benefit on GLUE. We characterize when coupling helps and when it does not, providing practical guidelines.
summary_zh: 标准的缩放点积注意力通过输入的静态独立投影计算得分。本研究提出一种**耦合查询-键动态机制**：在计算注意力得分前，通过共享的学习动态机制使查询向量与键向量**协同演化**，从而提升语言模型的困惑度与训练稳定性。在6000万参数的WikiText-103数据集上，耦合动态机制将困惑度从标准注意力的24.22降至22.55–22.62（相对降低6.6–6.9%），仅增加0.11%的参数量（跨实例共享）。通过结构消融实验发现耦合机制是核心影响因素：当查询向量与键向量保持耦合时，辛积分器（哈密顿体系）与非辛积分器（欧拉体系）表现一致；而参数规模相当的非耦合多层感知机基线仅达到23.81困惑度，其随机种子方差高达8倍。积分步数（1–7步）的影响同样微弱——单步耦合即可达成效果。算力匹配对比实验表明耦合机制是一种**样本效率提升**策略：标准注意力需要延长2.4倍训练时间（匹配实际耗时）才能达到同等困惑度，但需多消耗2.4倍数据量。该优势在1.5亿参数规模下持续存在（降低6.7%），但在3.5亿参数规模下收窄（降低1.0%），此时差分注意力（18.93）优于耦合动态机制（19.35）。改进效果受语料特性影响：耦合机制在领域连贯文本上有效（WikiText-103降低6.6%，PubMed降低4.5%），但在异构网络文本上表现下降（上升10.3%），在GLUE基准测试中未见增益。本研究系统阐释了耦合机制的适用条件与局限性，为实际应用提供了明确指导。
tldr: This paper introduces coupled query-key dynamics, a method where queries and keys evolve jointly through shared learned dynamics before scoring, which improves language modeling perplexity and training efficiency compared to standard attention.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种耦合查询-键动态机制，即在计算注意力分数前让查询和键通过共享的已学习动态共同演化，从而在语言建模任务中取得了比标准注意力机制更低的困惑度和更高的训练效率。

title: Training In-Context and In-Weights Mixtures Via Contrastive Context Sampling
summary:
We investigate training strategies that co-develop in-context learning (ICL) and in-weights learning (IWL), and the ability to switch between them based on context relevance. Although current LLMs exhibit both modes, standard task-specific fine-tuning often erodes ICL, motivating IC-Train - fine-tuning with in-context examples. Prior work has shown that emergence of ICL after IC-Train depends on factors such as task diversity and training duration.
  In this paper we show that the similarity structure between target inputs and context examples also plays an important role. Random context leads to loss of ICL and IWL dominance, while only similar examples in context causes ICL to degenerate to copying labels without regard to relevance. To address this, we propose a simple Contrastive-Context which enforces two types of contrasts: (1) mix of similar and random examples within a context to evolve a correct form of ICL, and (2) varying grades of similarity across contexts to evolve ICL-IWL mixtures. We present insights on the importance of such contrast with theoretical analysis of a minimal model. We validate with extensive empirical evaluation on four LLMs and several tasks. Diagnostic probes confirm that contrasted contexts yield stable ICL-IWL mixtures, avoiding collapse into pure ICL, IWL, or copying.
summary_zh:
本文研究共同发展上下文学习（ICL）与权重学习（IWL）的训练策略，以及根据上下文相关性在两种模式间切换的能力。尽管当前大型语言模型同时具备这两种模式，但标准的任务特定微调常会削弱ICL能力，这促使我们采用IC-Train——即在微调过程中引入上下文示例。已有研究表明，IC-Train后ICL能力的涌现取决于任务多样性和训练时长等因素。

本文进一步揭示目标输入与上下文示例之间的相似性结构同样起着关键作用。随机上下文会导致ICL能力丧失并转向IWL主导，而仅使用相似示例则会使ICL退化为不考虑相关性的标签复制行为。为解决此问题，我们提出一种简单的对比上下文方法，该方法强制实施两种对比：（1）在单个上下文中混合相似与随机示例以形成正确的ICL模式；（2）在不同上下文间设置多级相似度以演化ICL-IWL混合模式。我们通过对最小模型的理论分析，阐述了此类对比机制的重要性。在四种大型语言模型和多项任务上的广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性。诊断探针证实，对比上下文能产生稳定的ICL-IWL混合模式，避免陷入纯ICL、纯IWL或标签复制的极端状态。
tldr: This paper proposes a training method called Contrastive-Context for large language models to develop balanced in-context and in-weights learning by strategically controlling the similarity between target inputs and context examples.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种称为对比上下文的训练方法，通过策略性地控制目标输入与上下文示例之间的相似性，促使大型语言模型发展出平衡的上下文学习与权重内学习能力。

title: Optimizing EEG Graph Structure for Seizure Detection: An Information Bottleneck and Self-Supervised Learning Approach
summary: Seizure detection from EEG signals is highly challenging due to complex spatiotemporal dynamics and extreme inter-patient variability. To model them, recent methods construct dynamic graphs via statistical correlations, predefined similarity measures, or implicit learning, yet rarely account for EEG's noisy nature. Consequently, these graphs usually contain redundant or task-irrelevant connections, undermining model performance even with state-of-the-art architectures. In this paper, we present a new perspective for EEG seizure detection: jointly learning denoised dynamic graph structures and informative spatial-temporal representations guided by the Information Bottleneck (IB). Unlike prior approaches, our graph constructor explicitly accounts for the noisy characteristics of EEG data, producing compact and reliable connectivity patterns that better support downstream seizure detection. To further enhance representation learning, we employ a self-supervised Graph Masked AutoEncoder that reconstructs masked EEG signals based on dynamic graph context, promoting structure-aware and compact representations aligned with the IB principle. Bringing things together, we introduce Information Bottleneck-guided EEG SeizuRE DetectioN via SElf-Supervised Learning (IRENE), which explicitly learns dynamic graph structures and interpretable spatial-temporal EEG representations. IRENE addresses three core challenges: (i) Identifying the most informative nodes and edges; (ii) Explaining seizure propagation in the brain network; and (iii) Enhancing robustness against label scarcity and inter-patient variability. Extensive experiments on benchmark EEG datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in seizure detection and provides clinically meaningful insights into seizure dynamics. The source code is available at https://github.com/LabRAI/IRENE.
summary_zh: 脑电图（EEG）信号中的癫痫检测极具挑战性，原因在于其复杂的时空动态特性及患者间的高度变异性。为建模这些特征，现有方法通常通过统计相关性、预设相似性度量或隐式学习构建动态图，却鲜少考虑脑电信号的噪声本质。这导致所构建的图常包含冗余或与任务无关的连接，即使采用最先进的架构也会损害模型性能。本文提出一种脑电癫痫检测的新视角：在信息瓶颈（IB）原则指导下，联合学习去噪的动态图结构及具有信息量的时空表征。与以往方法不同，本研究的图构建器明确考虑了脑电数据的噪声特性，生成紧凑且可靠的连接模式，从而更好地支持下游癫痫检测任务。为进一步增强表征学习，我们采用自监督图掩码自动编码器，基于动态图上下文重构被掩码的脑电信号，促进与IB原则对齐的结构感知紧凑表征。综合以上思路，我们提出基于信息瓶颈引导的自监督脑电癫痫检测框架（IRENE），该框架显式学习动态图结构及可解释的脑电时空表征。IRENE应对三大核心挑战：（i）识别最具信息量的节点与边；（ii）解释癫痫在大脑网络中的传播机制；（iii）提升模型对标签稀缺和患者间变异性的鲁棒性。在多个脑电基准数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法在癫痫检测任务上优于当前最优基线模型，并为癫痫动态过程提供了具有临床意义的解释。源代码已公开于https://github.com/LabRAI/IRENE。
tldr: The paper proposes a novel EEG seizure detection method that jointly learns denoised dynamic graph structures and representations using an Information Bottleneck principle and a self-supervised Graph Masked AutoEncoder.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的EEG癫痫检测方法，通过信息瓶颈原则和自监督图掩码自编码器，联合学习去噪的动态图结构和表征。

title: EXHIB: A Benchmark for Realistic and Diverse Evaluation of Function Similarity in the Wild
summary:
Binary Function Similarity Detection (BFSD) is a core problem in software security, supporting tasks such as vulnerability analysis, malware classification, and patch provenance. In the past few decades, numerous models and tools have been developed for this application; however, due to the lack of a comprehensive universal benchmark in this field, researchers have struggled to compare different models effectively. Existing datasets are limited in scope, often focusing on a narrow set of transformations or types of binaries, and fail to reflect the full diversity of real-world applications.
  We introduce EXHIB, a benchmark comprising five realistic datasets collected from the wild, each highlighting a distinct aspect of the BFSD problem space. We evaluate 9 representative models spanning multiple BFSD paradigms on EXHIB and observe performance degradations of up to 30% on firmware and semantic datasets compared to standard settings, revealing substantial generalization gaps. Our results show that robustness to low- and mid-level binary variations does not generalize to high-level semantic differences, underscoring a critical blind spot in current BFSD evaluation practices.
summary_zh:
二进制函数相似性检测是软件安全领域的核心问题，支撑着漏洞分析、恶意软件分类和补丁溯源等任务。在过去的几十年中，已有大量针对该应用的模型与工具被开发出来；然而，由于该领域缺乏全面通用的基准测试标准，研究者难以有效比较不同模型之间的优劣。现有数据集通常范围有限，往往集中于少数几种二进制转换类型或特定类型的二进制文件，未能充分反映真实应用场景的多样性。  
我们提出EXHIB基准，该基准包含从真实环境中收集的五类数据集，每类数据突显了二进制函数相似性检测问题空间的不同维度。我们在EXHIB上对涵盖多种检测范式的9个代表性模型进行评估，发现与传统测试环境相比，这些模型在固件和语义相关数据集上的性能下降高达30%，显示出明显的泛化能力缺陷。实验结果表明，针对中低级二进制变异的鲁棒性无法推广至高级语义差异的应对，这揭示了当前二进制函数相似性检测评估实践中的一个关键盲区。
tldr: A benchmark for binary function similarity detection in software security, highlighting performance gaps in current models.
tldr_zh: 软件安全中二进制函数相似性检测的基准，揭示了当前模型在真实场景中的性能差距。

title: Learning ECG Image Representations via Dual Physiological-Aware Alignments
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) are among the most widely used diagnostic tools for cardiovascular diseases, and a large amount of ECG data worldwide appears only in image form. However, most existing automated ECG analysis methods rely on access to raw signal recordings, limiting their applicability in real-world and resource-constrained settings. In this paper, we present ECG-Scan, a self-supervised framework for learning clinically generalized representations from ECG images through dual physiological-aware alignments: 1) Our approach optimizes image representation learning using multimodal contrastive alignment between image and gold-standard signal-text modalities. 2) We further integrate domain knowledge via soft-lead constraints, regularizing the reconstruction process and improving signal lead inter-consistency. Extensive benchmarking across multiple datasets and downstream tasks demonstrates that our image-based model achieves superior performance compared to existing image baselines and notably narrows the gap between ECG image and signal analysis. These results highlight the potential of self-supervised image modeling to unlock large-scale legacy ECG data and broaden access to automated cardiovascular diagnostics.
summary_zh: 心电图是心血管疾病诊断中最广泛使用的工具之一，全球范围内大量心电图数据仅以图像形式存在。然而，现有的大多数自动化心电图分析方法依赖于获取原始信号记录，限制了其在现实世界和资源受限环境中的适用性。本文提出ECG-Scan——一种基于双重生理感知对齐的自监督框架，旨在从心电图图像中学习临床通用表征：1）我们通过图像与金标准信号-文本模态间的多模态对比对齐，优化图像表征学习；2）进一步通过软导联约束整合领域知识，在规范化重建过程的同时提升信号导联间的一致性。跨多个数据集与下游任务的广泛基准测试表明，我们的图像模型在性能上优于现有图像基线方法，并显著缩小了心电图图像分析与信号分析之间的差距。这些结果凸显了自监督图像建模在释放大规模历史心电图数据、拓宽自动化心血管诊断可及性方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents ECG-Scan, a self-supervised learning framework for learning clinically useful representations from electrocardiogram (ECG) images by using multimodal contrastive alignment with signal and text data, and integrating domain knowledge through soft-lead constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ECG-Scan，一种自监督学习框架，通过利用信号和文本数据的多模态对比对齐，以及通过软引导约束整合领域知识，从心电图图像中学习具有临床实用性的表征。

title: Benchmark Problems and Benchmark Datasets for the evaluation of Machine and Deep Learning methods on Photoplethysmography signals: the D4 report from the QUMPHY project
summary: This report is part of the Qumphy project (22HLT01 Qumphy) that is funded by the European Union and is dedicated to the development of measures to quantify the uncertainties associated with Machine Learning algorithms applied to medical problems, in particular the analysis and processing of Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. In this report, a list of six medical problems that are related to PPG signals and serve as Benchmark Problems is given. Suitable Benchmark datasets and their usage are described also.
summary_zh: 本报告是欧盟资助项目Qumphy（22HLT01 Qumphy）的一部分，该项目致力于开发量化应用于医学问题的机器学习算法不确定性的方法，特别是针对光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号的分析与处理。本报告列出了六项与PPG信号相关的医学问题，作为基准问题。同时，报告还介绍了适用的基准数据集及其使用方法。
tldr: A project report introducing benchmark problems and datasets for evaluating machine learning on Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals in medical applications, focused on uncertainty quantification.
tldr_zh: 一份项目报告，介绍了用于评估机器学习在医疗应用中的光电容积描记（PPG）信号性能的基准问题和数据集，重点在于不确定性量化。

title: Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes
summary: Multivariate Hawkes processes are a widely used class of self-exciting point processes, but maximum likelihood estimation naively scales as $O(N^2)$ in the number of events. The canonical linear exponential Hawkes process admits a faster $O(N)$ recurrence, but prior work evaluates this recurrence sequentially, without exploiting parallelization on modern GPUs. We show that the Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as a product of sparse transition matrices admitting a linear-time associative multiply, enabling computation via a parallel prefix scan. This yields a simple yet massively parallelizable algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation of linear exponential Hawkes processes. Our method reduces the computational complexity to approximately $O(N/P)$ with $P$ parallel processors, and naturally yields a batching scheme to maintain constant memory usage, avoiding GPU memory constraints. Importantly, it computes the exact likelihood without any additional assumptions or approximations, preserving the simplicity and interpretability of the model. We demonstrate orders-of-magnitude speedups on simulated and real datasets, scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events, substantially beyond scales reported in prior work. We provide an open-source PyTorch library implementing our optimizations.
summary_zh: 多元霍克斯过程是一类广泛使用的自激励点过程，但其最大似然估计在事件数量上存在朴素的$O(N^2)$计算复杂度。经典的线性指数霍克斯过程虽然存在更快的$O(N)$递归计算方式，但现有研究对该递归的实现均为顺序执行，未能充分利用现代GPU的并行计算能力。我们证明，霍克斯过程强度函数可表示为稀疏转移矩阵的乘积形式，该矩阵具有线性时间复杂度的结合律乘法特性，从而可通过并行前缀扫描进行计算。由此我们提出一种简洁且高度可并行化的算法，用于线性指数霍克斯过程的最大似然估计。该方法将计算复杂度降低至约$O(N/P)$（其中$P$为并行处理器数量），并自然地形成批处理方案以保持恒定内存占用，有效规避GPU内存限制。重要的是，该方法在无需任何额外假设或近似的情况下计算精确似然值，完整保留了模型的简洁性与可解释性。我们在模拟和真实数据集上实现了数量级的速度提升，可扩展至数千节点和数千万事件规模，远超现有研究报道的尺度范围。我们同时提供了实现该优化方法的开源PyTorch库。
tldr: A massively parallel, exact inference algorithm for Hawkes processes that leverages GPU parallelization via a prefix scan to achieve substantial speedups, enabling scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events.
tldr_zh: 针对霍克斯过程提出了一种大规模并行且精确的推断算法，利用GPU并行化和前缀扫描实现显著加速，可扩展到数千节点和数千万事件。

title: Bias Inheritance in Neural-Symbolic Discovery of Constitutive Closures Under Function-Class Mismatch
summary: We investigate the data-driven discovery of constitutive closures in nonlinear reaction-diffusion systems with known governing PDE structures. Our objective is to robustly recover diffusion and reaction laws from spatiotemporal observations while avoiding the common pitfall where low residuals or short-horizon predictions are conflated with physical recovery. We propose a three-stage neural-symbolic framework: (1) learning numerical surrogates under physical constraints using a noise-robust weak-form-driven objective; (2) compressing these surrogates into restricted interpretable symbolic families (e.g., polynomial, rational, and saturation forms); and (3) validating the symbolic closures through explicit forward re-simulation on unseen initial conditions. Extensive numerical experiments reveal two distinct regimes. Under matched-library settings, weak polynomial baselines behave as correctly specified reference estimators, showing that neural surrogates do not uniformly outperform classical bases. Conversely, under function-class mismatch, neural surrogates provide necessary flexibility and can be compressed into compact symbolic laws with minimal rollout degradation. However, we identify a critical "bias inheritance" mechanism where symbolic compression does not automatically repair constitutive bias. Across various observation regimes, the true error of the symbolic closure closely tracks that of the neural surrogate, yielding a bias inheritance ratio near one. These findings demonstrate that the primary bottleneck in neural-symbolic modeling lies in the initial numerical inverse problem rather than the subsequent symbolic compression. We underscore that constitutive claims must be rigorously supported by forward validation rather than residual minimization alone.
summary_zh: 我们研究具有已知偏微分方程结构的非线性反应扩散系统中本构关系的数据驱动发现。目标是从时空观测数据中稳健地恢复扩散与反应规律，同时避免将低残差或短期预测与物理规律的恢复混为一谈的常见误区。我们提出一种三阶段神经符号框架：(1) 使用噪声鲁棒的弱形式驱动目标，在物理约束下学习数值代理模型；(2) 将这些代理模型压缩到受限的可解释符号族（如多项式、有理式和饱和形式）中；(3) 通过对未见初始条件进行显式前向重仿真来验证符号化本构关系。大量数值实验揭示了两种不同机制。在函数库匹配的条件下，弱多项式基线表现为正确设定的参考估计器，表明神经代理模型并非始终优于经典基函数。反之，在函数类不匹配的情况下，神经代理模型提供了必要的灵活性，能够被压缩为紧凑的符号规律且滚动预测误差最小。然而，我们发现了一种关键的"偏差继承"机制：符号压缩不会自动修正本构偏差。在不同观测机制下，符号化本构关系的真实误差始终紧密跟踪神经代理模型的误差，偏差继承比接近于一。这些结果表明，神经符号建模的主要瓶颈在于初始数值反问题，而非后续的符号压缩过程。我们强调，本构关系的论断必须通过前向验证严格支撑，而不能仅依赖残差最小化。
tldr: This paper proposes a neural-symbolic framework for discovering constitutive laws (e.g., diffusion and reaction terms) in reaction-diffusion PDE systems from data, and identifies a 'bias inheritance' phenomenon where the bias of the initial neural surrogate is passed to the compressed symbolic model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于从数据中发现反应-扩散偏微分方程系统中本构律的神经符号框架，并识别出一种'偏差继承'现象，即初始神经代理的偏差会传递到压缩后的符号模型中。

title: An Online Machine Learning Multi-resolution Optimization Framework for Energy System Design Limit of Performance Analysis
summary: Designing reliable integrated energy systems for industrial processes requires optimization and verification models across multiple fidelities, from architecture-level sizing to high-fidelity dynamic operation. However, model mismatch across fidelities obscures the sources of performance loss and complicates the quantification of architecture-to-operation performance gaps. We propose an online, machine-learning-accelerated multi-resolution optimization framework that estimates an architecture-specific upper bound on achievable performance while minimizing expensive high-fidelity model evaluations. We demonstrate the approach on a pilot energy system supplying a 1 MW industrial heat load. First, we solve a multi-objective architecture optimization to select the system configuration and component capacities. We then develop an machine learning (ML)-accelerated multi-resolution, receding-horizon optimal control strategy that approaches the achievable-performance bound for the specified architecture, given the additional controls and dynamics not captured by the architectural optimization model. The ML-guided controller adaptively schedules the optimization resolution based on predictive uncertainty and warm-starts high-fidelity solves using elite low-fidelity solutions. Our results on the pilot case study show that the proposed multi-resolution strategy reduces the architecture-to-operation performance gap by up to 42% relative to a rule-based controller, while reducing required high-fidelity model evaluations by 34% relative to the same multi-fidelity approach without ML guidance, enabling faster and more reliable design verification. Together, these gains make high-fidelity verification tractable, providing a practical upper bound on achievable operational performance.
summary_zh: 为工业过程设计可靠的集成能源系统需要从架构层面的规模设计到高保真动态运行的多保真度优化与验证模型。然而，不同保真度模型之间的不匹配问题掩盖了性能损失的来源，并使得量化从架构到运行性能差距的过程复杂化。我们提出一种在线机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架，该框架在估计特定架构可实现性能上限的同时，最大限度减少昂贵的高保真模型评估。我们以供应1兆瓦工业热负荷的试验能源系统为例验证该方法。首先，通过求解多目标架构优化来选择系统配置和组件容量。随后，我们开发了一种机器学习加速的多分辨率滚动时域最优控制策略，该策略在考虑架构优化模型未涵盖的额外控制与动态因素后，能够逼近特定架构的可实现性能边界。该机器学习引导的控制器根据预测不确定性自适应调度优化分辨率，并利用优质低保真解热启动高保真求解。试验案例研究结果表明，相较于基于规则的控制器，所提出的多分辨率策略将架构到运行性能差距缩小了42%；同时相比于无机器学习指导的同类多保真度方法，将所需高保真模型评估减少了34%，从而实现了更快速、更可靠的设计验证。这些改进共同使高保真验证切实可行，为可实现的操作性能提供了实用上限。
tldr: The paper proposes an online machine-learning framework for multi-resolution optimization of integrated energy system design, focusing on minimizing high-fidelity model evaluations to estimate performance bounds and verify designs for industrial heat loads.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于综合能源系统设计的在线机器学习多分辨率优化框架，专注于最小化高保真度模型评估，以估计性能边界并验证工业热负荷的设计。

title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning
summary:
Anticipating supply chain disruptions before they materialize is a core challenge for firms and policymakers alike. A key difficulty is learning to reason reliably about infrequent, high-impact events from noisy and unstructured inputs - a setting where general-purpose models struggle without task-specific adaptation. We introduce an end-to-end framework that trains LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts using realized disruption outcomes as supervision. The resulting model substantially outperforms strong baselines - including GPT-5 - on accuracy, calibration, and precision. We also show that training induces more structured and reliable probabilistic reasoning without explicit prompting. These results suggest a general pathway for training domain-specific forecasting models that produce decision-ready signals. To support transparency we open-source the evaluation dataset used in this study.
  Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LightningRodLabs/supply-chain-predictions
summary_zh:
在供应链中断实际发生前进行预测，是企业和政策制定者共同面临的核心挑战。关键难点在于如何从嘈杂且非结构化的输入数据中，学习对低频高影响事件进行可靠推理——通用模型在此类任务中若无针对性调整往往难以胜任。本文提出一种端到端框架，通过已实现的中断结果作为监督信号，训练大型语言模型生成经过校准的概率预测。该模型在准确性、校准度和精确度上显著优于包括GPT-5在内的强基线模型。研究还表明，训练过程能诱导模型形成更结构化、更可靠的概率推理能力，而无需显式提示。这些成果为训练能够提供决策支持信号的领域专用预测模型提供了通用路径。为促进研究透明度，我们开源了本研究所用的评估数据集。
数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/LightningRodLabs/supply-chain-predictions
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end framework for training LLMs to generate calibrated probabilistic forecasts of supply chain disruptions, outperforming strong baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端框架，用于训练大型语言模型生成供应链中断的校准概率预测，其性能优于强大的基线模型。

title: Descending into the Modular Bootstrap
summary: In this paper, we attempt to explore the landscape of two-dimensional conformal field theories (2d CFTs) by efficiently searching for numerical solutions to the modular bootstrap equation using machine-learning-style optimization. The torus partition function of a 2d CFT is fixed by the spectrum of its primary operators and its chiral algebra, which we take to be the Virasoro algebra with $c>1$. We translate the requirement that this partition function is modular invariant into a loss function, which we then minimize to identify possible primary spectra. Our approach involves two technical innovations that facilitate finding reliable candidate CFTs. The first is a strategy to estimate the uncertainty associated with truncating the spectrum to the lowest dimension operators. The second is the use of a new singular-value-based optimizer (Sven) that is more effective than gradient descent at navigating the hierarchical structure of the loss landscape. We numerically construct candidate truncated CFT partition functions with central charges between 1 and $\frac{8}{7}$, a range devoid of known examples, and argue that these candidates likely come from a continuous space of modular bootstrap solutions. We also provide evidence for a more stringent constraint on the spectral gap near $c = 1$ than the existing bound of $Δ_{\rm gap} \le \frac{c}{6} + \frac{1}{3}$.
summary_zh: 本文试图通过运用机器学习式优化方法，高效搜索模引导方程的数值解，以探索二维共形场论（2d CFTs）的理论图景。二维共形场论在环面上的配分函数由其原初算符谱及其手征代数决定，此处我们取中心荷 $c>1$ 的维拉索罗代数。我们将该配分函数需满足模不变性这一要求转化为损失函数，并通过最小化该函数来识别可能的原初算符谱。本研究采用了两种技术革新以提高寻找可靠候选共形场论的效率。其一是提出一种评估谱截断（仅保留最低维算符）所致不确定性的策略；其二是采用基于奇异值的新型优化器（Sven），相较于梯度下降法，该优化器能更有效地处理损失函数景观的层次化结构。我们数值构建了中心荷介于 $1$ 到 $\frac{8}{7}$ 之间的候选截断共形场论配分函数——该区间内尚无已知理论实例，并论证这些候选解很可能来源于模引导方程解的连续空间。同时，我们为 $c = 1$ 附近谱隙存在比现有界限 $Δ_{\rm gap} \le \frac{c}{6} + \frac{1}{3}$ 更严格的约束提供了证据。
tldr: This paper uses machine-learning optimization to numerically search for solutions to the modular bootstrap equation in two-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs), with technical innovations in uncertainty estimation and a new optimizer.
tldr_zh: 本文使用机器学习优化方法，数值搜索二维共形场论中的模块化自举方程解，并在不确定性估计和新型优化器方面提出了技术创新。

title: Multi-View Video Diffusion Policy: A 3D Spatio-Temporal-Aware Video Action Model
summary: Robotic manipulation requires understanding both the 3D spatial structure of the environment and its temporal evolution, yet most existing policies overlook one or both. They typically rely on 2D visual observations and backbones pretrained on static image--text pairs, resulting in high data requirements and limited understanding of environment dynamics. To address this, we introduce MV-VDP, a multi-view video diffusion policy that jointly models the 3D spatio-temporal state of the environment. The core idea is to simultaneously predict multi-view heatmap videos and RGB videos, which 1) align the representation format of video pretraining with action finetuning, and 2) specify not only what actions the robot should take, but also how the environment is expected to evolve in response to those actions. Extensive experiments show that MV-VDP enables data-efficient, robust, generalizable, and interpretable manipulation. With only ten demonstration trajectories and without additional pretraining, MV-VDP successfully performs complex real-world tasks, demonstrates strong robustness across a range of model hyperparameters, generalizes to out-of-distribution settings, and predicts realistic future videos. Experiments on Meta-World and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that MV-VDP consistently outperforms video-prediction--based, 3D-based, and vision--language--action models, establishing a new state of the art in data-efficient multi-task manipulation.
summary_zh: 机器人操作需要同时理解环境的三维空间结构及其时间演化，然而现有的大多数策略往往忽视了其中一者或两者。这些策略通常依赖于二维视觉观测以及在静态图像-文本对上进行预训练的骨干网络，导致数据需求高且对环境动态的理解有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MV-VDP——一种多视角视频扩散策略，能够联合建模环境的三维时空状态。其核心思想是同步预测多视角热图视频和RGB视频，这既实现了视频预训练与动作微调的表征格式对齐，又不仅明确了机器人应执行何种动作，还预测了环境在响应这些动作时的预期演化过程。大量实验表明，MV-VDP能够实现数据高效、鲁棒、可泛化且可解释的机器人操作。仅需十条演示轨迹且无需额外预训练，MV-VDP即可成功执行复杂的真实世界任务，在不同模型超参数范围内展现出强鲁棒性，泛化至分布外场景，并预测逼真的未来视频。在Meta-World仿真平台和真实机器人平台上的实验证明，MV-VDP在基于视频预测、三维建模以及视觉-语言-动作的各类模型中均表现优异，为数据高效的多任务操作确立了新的技术标杆。
tldr: This paper introduces MV-VDP, a multi-view video diffusion policy for robotic manipulation that jointly models 3D spatio-temporal states by predicting heatmap and RGB videos, enabling data-efficient, robust, and generalizable manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MV-VDP，一种用于机器人操作的多视角视频扩散策略，通过预测热图和RGB视频共同建模3D时空状态，实现了数据高效、鲁棒且可泛化的操作。

title: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
summary: Model predictive control (MPC) with learned world models has emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control, particularly for its ability to generalize zero-shot when deployed in new environments. However, learned world models often struggle with long-horizon control due to the accumulation of prediction errors and the exponentially growing search space. In this work, we address these challenges by learning latent world models at multiple temporal scales and performing hierarchical planning across these scales, enabling long-horizon reasoning while substantially reducing inference-time planning complexity. Our approach serves as a modular planning abstraction that applies across diverse latent world-model architectures and domains. We demonstrate that this hierarchical approach enables zero-shot control on real-world non-greedy robotic tasks, achieving a 70% success rate on pick-&-place using only a final goal specification, compared to 0% for a single-level world model. In addition, across physics-based simulated environments including push manipulation and maze navigation, hierarchical planning achieves higher success while requiring up to 4x less planning-time compute.
summary_zh: 基于学习世界模型的模型预测控制（MPC）已成为具身控制领域一种前景广阔的研究范式，尤其因其在新环境中部署时具备零样本泛化能力而备受关注。然而，学习型世界模型在长时序控制任务中常面临预测误差累积和搜索空间指数级增长的双重挑战。本研究通过构建多时间尺度的潜在世界模型，并在这些尺度上进行分层规划，从而在显著降低推理时规划复杂度的同时，实现了长时序推理能力。该方法作为一种模块化规划抽象框架，可广泛应用于不同潜在世界模型架构与任务领域。实验表明，这种分层规划策略能够在真实世界非贪婪型机器人任务中实现零样本控制——在仅给定最终目标指令的情况下，抓取放置任务的成功率达到70%，而单层世界模型成功率仅为0%。此外，在包括推动操作与迷宫导航在内的多个物理仿真环境中，分层规划在取得更高成功率的同时，将规划计算时间最高降低了4倍。
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical planning method using learned latent world models at multiple temporal scales for long-horizon, zero-shot robotic control, demonstrating success on real-world manipulation and simulated tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用多时间尺度潜在世界模型进行分层规划的方法，用于长时域、零样本的机器人控制，在真实世界操作和模拟任务中取得了成功。

title: The Compression Gap: Why Discrete Tokenization Limits Vision-Language-Action Model Scaling
summary: Scaling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by upgrading the vision encoder is expected to improve downstream manipulation performance--as it does in vision-language modeling. We show that this expectation fails when actions are represented as discrete tokens, and explain why through an information-theoretic principle we call the Compression Gap: in any visuomotor pipeline, scaling behavior is governed by the location of the tightest information bottleneck. When actions are continuous (e.g., Diffusion Policy), the vision encoder is the binding constraint, and upgrading it directly improves performance. When actions are discretized through a fixed-capacity codebook (e.g., OAT), the codebook becomes the binding constraint, and encoder improvements cannot propagate past it--regardless of how rich the upstream representation is. We validate this principle on the LIBERO benchmark with three lines of evidence: a factorial experiment showing that encoder upgrades improve Diffusion Policy by over 21 percentage points while OAT gains are substantially attenuated across model scales; an encoder quality gradient across four encoders confirming that Diffusion Policy tracks encoder quality monotonically while OAT remains flat; and a codebook size experiment demonstrating that relaxing codebook capacity partially recovers encoder sensitivity, providing causal evidence for the bottleneck hypothesis. Our findings reveal that scaling in Physical AI requires identifying where information bottlenecks lie in the pipeline, rather than uniformly increasing model or data size.
summary_zh:
摘要：
通过提升视觉编码器来扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，有望改善下游操作性能——正如在视觉-语言建模中的表现那样。然而，当动作被表示为离散标记时，这种预期却未能实现。我们通过一个称为“压缩间隙”的信息论原理解释了这一现象：在任何视觉-运动流程中，扩展行为的规模受制于信息瓶颈最窄的位置。当动作为连续值（如扩散策略）时，视觉编码器是主要约束，升级它可直接提升性能；而当动作用固定容量的码本进行离散化（如OAT）时，码本则成为主要约束，编码器的改进无法突破其限制——无论上游表示如何丰富。我们在LIBERO基准上通过三条证据验证了该原理：一项析因实验表明，编码器升级使扩散策略提升超过21个百分点，而OAT的性能增益在各模型规模上均大幅减弱；四种编码器质量梯度实验证实，扩散策略性能随编码器质量单调提升，而OAT则保持平缓；码本容量实验证明，放宽码本容量可部分恢复编码器的敏感性，为瓶颈假设提供了因果证据。我们的研究结果表明，物理AI的扩展需识别流程中的信息瓶颈位置，而非简单地增加模型或数据规模。
tldr: The paper identifies a critical information bottleneck in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models when actions are represented as discrete tokens, showing that scaling the vision encoder fails to improve robot manipulation performance, unlike with continuous action policies, and validates this on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文发现，在动作表示为离散token的视觉-语言-动作模型中，信息瓶颈位于离散码本，导致扩大视觉编码器规模无法提升机器人操作性能；该结论在LIBERO基准上通过实验验证。

title: Open-Loop Planning, Closed-Loop Verification: Speculative Verification for VLA
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, as large foundation models for embodied control, have shown strong performance in manipulation tasks. However, their performance comes at high inference cost. To improve efficiency, recent methods adopt action chunking, which predicts a sequence of future actions for open-loop execution. Although effective for reducing computation, open-loop execution is sensitive to environmental changes and prone to error accumulation due to the lack of close-loop feedback. To address this limitation, we propose Speculative Verification for VLA Control (SV-VLA), a framework that combines efficient open-loop long-horizon planning with lightweight closed-loop online verification. Specifically, SV-VLA uses a heavy VLA as a low-frequency macro-planner to generate an action chunk together with a planning context, while a lightweight verifier continuously monitors execution based on the latest observations. Conditioned on both the current observation and the planning context, the verifier compares the planned action against a closed-loop reference action and triggers replanning only when necessary. Experiments demonstrate that SV-VLA combines the efficiency of chunked prediction with the robustness of closed-loop control, enabling efficient and reliable VLA-based control in dynamic environments. Code is available: https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为具身控制的大型基础模型，在操作任务中展现出强大性能。然而，其优越性能伴随着高昂的推理成本。为提升效率，近期方法采用动作分块预测技术，通过预测未来动作序列进行开环执行。尽管开环执行能有效降低计算量，但由于缺乏闭环反馈，其对环境变化敏感且易产生误差累积。针对这一局限，我们提出面向VLA控制的推测性验证框架（SV-VLA），该框架将高效的开环长程规划与轻量级闭环在线验证相结合。具体而言，SV-VLA采用重型VLA模型作为低频宏规划器，生成包含规划上下文信息的动作序列，同时由轻量级验证器基于最新观测持续监控执行过程。验证器结合当前观测与规划上下文，将规划动作与闭环参考动作进行比对，仅在必要时触发重新规划。实验表明，SV-VLA融合了分块预测的效率与闭环控制的鲁棒性，在动态环境中实现了高效可靠的VLA控制。代码已开源：https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA。
tldr: This paper introduces SV-VLA, a framework that combines efficient open-loop action chunking for long-horizon planning with a lightweight closed-loop verifier to monitor and correct execution in real-time, improving the robustness and efficiency of VLA models for robot control in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SV-VLA框架，结合了用于长时规划的高效开环动作分块预测与轻量级闭环验证器，以实时监控和校正执行，提升了VLA模型在动态环境中进行机器人控制的鲁棒性和效率。

title: Learning Task-Invariant Properties via Dreamer: Enabling Efficient Policy Transfer for Quadruped Robots
summary: Achieving quadruped robot locomotion across diverse and dynamic terrains presents significant challenges, primarily due to the discrepancies between simulation environments and real-world conditions. Traditional sim-to-real transfer methods often rely on manual feature design or costly real-world fine-tuning. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the DreamTIP framework, which incorporates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model architecture to enhance sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Guided by large language models, DreamTIP identifies and leverages Task-Invariant Properties, such as contact stability and terrain clearance, which exhibit robustness to dynamic variations and strong transferability across tasks. These properties are integrated into the world model as auxiliary prediction targets, enabling the policy to learn representations that are insensitive to underlying dynamic changes. Furthermore, an efficient adaptation strategy is designed, employing a mixed replay buffer and regularization constraints to rapidly calibrate to real-world dynamics while effectively mitigating representation collapse and catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on complex terrains, including Stair, Climb, Tilt, and Crawl, demonstrate that DreamTIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both simulated and real-world environments. Our method achieves an average performance improvement of 28.1% across eight distinct simulated transfer tasks. In the real-world Climb task, the baseline method achieved only a 10\ success rate, whereas our method attained a 100% success rate. These results indicate that incorporating Task-Invariant Properties into Dreamer learning offers a novel solution for achieving robust and transferable robot locomotion.
summary_zh: 实现四足机器人在多样化和动态地形上的移动面临着巨大挑战，这主要源于仿真环境与真实条件之间的差异。传统的仿真到现实迁移方法通常依赖于人工特征设计或昂贵的真实世界微调。为克服这些限制，本文提出DreamTIP框架，该框架在Dreamer世界模型架构中融入任务不变属性学习，以增强仿真到现实迁移能力。在大型语言模型引导下，DreamTIP识别并利用任务不变属性（如接触稳定性与离地间隙），这些属性对动态变化具有鲁棒性且在任务间具备强迁移性。通过将这些属性作为辅助预测目标整合到世界模型中，使策略能够学习对底层动态变化不敏感的表征。此外，本文设计了一种高效适应策略，采用混合经验回放池与正则化约束，在有效缓解表征崩溃和灾难性遗忘的同时，快速校准至真实世界动态。在楼梯、攀爬、倾斜、爬行等复杂地形上的大量实验表明，DreamTIP在仿真和真实环境中均显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。本方法在八种不同的仿真迁移任务中平均性能提升达28.1%。在真实世界攀爬任务中，基线方法成功率仅为10%，而本文方法实现了100%的成功率。这些结果表明，将任务不变属性融入Dreamer学习为获得鲁棒且可迁移的机器人移动能力提供了一种创新解决方案。
tldr: Proposes DreamTIP, a framework that integrates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model to improve sim-to-real transfer for quadruped robot locomotion, guided by LLMs and demonstrating strong performance on complex terrains.
tldr_zh: 提出DreamTIP框架，将任务不变属性学习集成到Dreamer世界模型中，以改进四足机器人运动控制的模拟到真实迁移，通过大语言模型指导，在复杂地形上表现出强大性能。

title: Learning Structured Robot Policies from Vision-Language Models via Synthetic Neuro-Symbolic Supervision
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in mapping multimodal observations to robot behaviors. However, most current approaches rely on end-to-end visuomotor policies that remain opaque and difficult to analyze, limiting their use in safety-critical robotic applications. In contrast, classical robotic systems often rely on structured policy representations that provide interpretability, modularity, and reactive execution. This work investigates how foundation models can be specialized to generate structured robot policies grounded in multimodal perception, bridging high-dimensional learning and symbolic control. We propose a neuro-symbolic approach in which a VLM synthesizes executable Behavior Tree policies from visual observations, natural language instructions, and structured system specifications. To enable scalable supervision without manual annotation, we introduce an automated pipeline that generates a synthetic multimodal dataset of domain-randomized scenes paired with instruction-policy examples produced by a foundation model. Real-world experiments on two robotic manipulators show that structured policies learned entirely from synthetic supervision transfer successfully to physical systems. The results indicate that foundation models can be adapted to produce interpretable and structured robot policies, providing an alternative to opaque end-to-end approaches for multimodal robot decision making.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型近来在将多模态观测映射到机器人行为方面展现出强大的能力。然而，当前大多数方法依赖于端到端的视觉运动策略，这些策略仍不透明且难以分析，限制了其在安全关键机器人应用中的使用。相比之下，传统机器人系统通常依赖于结构化的策略表示，以提供可解释性、模块化和反应式执行能力。本研究探讨了如何利用基础模型生成基于多模态感知的结构化机器人策略，以桥接高维学习与符号控制。我们提出了一种神经符号方法，其中视觉-语言模型根据视觉观测、自然语言指令和结构化系统规范，合成可执行的行为树策略。为实现无需手动标注的可扩展监督，我们引入了一种自动化流程，该流程生成一个合成多模态数据集，其中包含通过领域随机化生成的场景与由基础模型生成的指令-策略示例。在两个机械臂机器人上进行的真实世界实验表明，完全通过合成监督学习到的结构化策略能够成功迁移到物理系统中。结果表明，基础模型可以被适配以生成可解释且结构化的机器人策略，为多模态机器人决策提供了一种替代不透明端到端方法的新途径。
tldr: This paper proposes using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate synthetic neuro-symbolic supervision for learning structured, interpretable Behavior Tree policies for robot manipulation, which successfully transfer to real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出利用视觉语言模型生成合成的神经符号监督数据，用于学习机器人操作的结构化、可解释的行为树策略，并成功迁移至真实机器人系统。

title: QuadAgent: A Responsive Agent System for Vision-Language Guided Quadrotor Agile Flight
summary: We present QuadAgent, a training-free agent system for agile quadrotor flight guided by vision-language inputs. Unlike prior end-to-end or serial agent approaches, QuadAgent decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control using an asynchronous multi-agent architecture: Foreground Workflow Agents handle active tasks and user commands, while Background Agents perform look-ahead reasoning. The system maintains scene memory via the Impression Graph, a lightweight topological map built from sparse keyframes, and ensures safe flight with a vision-based obstacle avoidance network. Simulation results show that QuadAgent outperforms baseline methods in efficiency and responsiveness. Real-world experiments demonstrate that it can interpret complex instructions, reason about its surroundings, and navigate cluttered indoor spaces at speeds up to 5 m/s.
summary_zh: 本文提出QuadAgent，一种无需训练、基于视觉语言输入的敏捷四旋翼飞行智能体系统。与传统端到端或串行智能体方案不同，QuadAgent通过异步多智能体架构将高层推理与底层控制解耦：前景工作流智能体负责主动任务与用户指令处理，而背景智能体执行前瞻性推理。该系统通过"印象图"——一种基于稀疏关键帧构建的轻量化拓扑地图——维持场景记忆，并借助基于视觉的避障网络确保飞行安全。仿真结果表明QuadAgent在效率与响应性上优于基准方法。实际飞行实验验证了该系统能解析复杂指令、对周围环境进行推理，并以最高5米/秒的速度在杂乱室内空间自主导航。
tldr: QuadAgent is a training-free, asynchronous multi-agent system for vision-language-guided agile quadrotor flight. It decouples reasoning from control, uses a scene memory graph, and demonstrates high-speed navigation in cluttered indoor spaces.
tldr_zh: QuadAgent 是一个无需训练的异步多智能体系统，用于视觉语言引导的敏捷四旋翼飞行。它将高层推理与底层控制解耦，使用场景记忆图，并在杂乱室内环境中演示了高速导航能力。

title: Learning Locomotion on Complex Terrain for Quadrupedal Robots with Foot Position Maps and Stability Rewards
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion over complex terrain has been a long-standing research topic in robotics. While recent reinforcement learning-based locomotion methods improve generalizability and foot-placement precision, they rely on implicit inference of foot positions from joint angles, lacking the explicit precision and stability guarantees of optimization-based approaches. To address this, we introduce a foot position map integrated into the heightmap, and a dynamic locomotion-stability reward within an attention-based framework to achieve locomotion on complex terrain. We validate our method extensively on terrains seen during training as well as out-of-domain (OOD) terrains. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method enables precise and stable movement, resulting in improved locomotion success rates on both in-domain and OOD terrains.
summary_zh: 四足机器人在复杂地形上的运动一直是机器人学中一个长期的研究课题。尽管近年来基于强化学习的运动方法提升了泛化能力和足部落点精度，但它们依赖于从关节角度隐式推断足部位置，缺乏基于优化的方法所具有的显式精度和稳定性保证。为此，我们提出了一种集成到高度图中的足部位置映射，以及一种基于注意力框架下的动态运动-稳定性奖励机制，以实现在复杂地形上的运动。我们不仅在对训练地形进行了广泛验证，还在域外（OOD）地形上进行了测试。实验结果表明，该方法能够实现精确稳定的运动，从而在训练域内及域外地形上均提高了运动成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning method for quadrupedal robot locomotion on complex terrain, using a foot position map and a stability reward within an attention-based framework to improve precision and stability over in-domain and out-of-domain terrains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人在复杂地形上运动的强化学习方法，通过引入足部位置图和在注意力框架内的动态稳定性奖励，提高了在训练域内和域外地形上的运动精度和稳定性。

title: A Rapid Instrument Exchange System for Humanoid Robots in Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Humanoid robot technologies have demonstrated immense potential for minimally invasive surgery (MIS). Unlike dedicated multi-arm surgical platforms, the inherent dual-arm configuration of humanoid robots necessitates an efficient instrument exchange capability to perform complex procedures, mimicking the natural workflow where surgeons manually switch instruments. To address this, this paper proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system. The system utilizes a low-latency mechanism based on single-axis compliant docking and environmental constraint release. Integrated with real-time first-person view (FPV) perception via a head-mounted display (HMD), this framework significantly reduces operational complexity and cognitive load during the docking process. Comparative evaluations between experts and novices demonstrate high operational robustness and a rapidly converging learning curve; novice performance in instrument attachment and detachment improved substantially after brief training. While long-distance spatial alignment still presents challenges in time cost and collaborative stability, this study successfully validates the technical feasibility of humanoid robots executing stable instrument exchanges within constrained clinical environments.
summary_zh: 人形机器人技术在微创手术领域展现出巨大潜力。与专用多臂手术平台不同，人形机器人固有的双臂结构需要高效的器械交换能力，以执行复杂手术流程，模拟外科医生手动切换器械的自然工作模式。为此，本文提出一种沉浸式遥操作快速器械交换系统。该系统采用基于单轴顺应性对接与环境约束释放的低延迟机制，结合头戴式显示器提供的实时第一人称视角感知，显著降低了对接过程中的操作复杂性与认知负荷。专家与新手的对比实验表明，该系统具有高度操作鲁棒性及快速收敛的学习曲线；新手经过短期训练后器械装拆性能显著提升。尽管远距离空间对准在时间成本与协作稳定性方面仍存在挑战，本研究成功验证了人形机器人在受限临床环境中执行稳定器械交换的技术可行性。
tldr: Proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system for humanoid robots in surgery, using compliant docking and first-person view to reduce complexity and cognitive load.
tldr_zh: 为手术人形机器人提出了一种沉浸式遥操作快速器械交换系统，利用顺从对接和第一人称视角，降低了操作复杂性和认知负担。

title: Differentiable SpaTiaL: Symbolic Learning and Reasoning with Geometric Temporal Logic for Manipulation Tasks
summary: Executing complex manipulation in cluttered environments requires satisfying coupled geometric and temporal constraints. Although Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) offers a principled specification framework, its use in gradient-based optimization is limited by non-differentiable geometric operations. Existing differentiable temporal logics focus on the robot's internal state and neglect interactive object-environment relations, while spatial logic approaches that capture such interactions rely on discrete geometry engines that break the computational graph and preclude exact gradient propagation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox that constructs smooth, autograd-compatible geometric primitives directly over polygonal sets. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end differentiable symbolic spatio-temporal logic toolbox. By analytically deriving differentiable relaxations of key spatial predicates--including signed distance, intersection, containment, and directional relations--we enable an end-to-end differentiable mapping from high-level semantic specifications to low-level geometric configurations, without invoking external discrete solvers. This fully differentiable formulation unlocks two core capabilities: (i) massively parallel trajectory optimization under rigorous spatio-temporal constraints, and (ii) direct learning of spatial logic parameters from demonstrations via backpropagation. Experimental results validate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed framework.Code Available: https://github.com/plen1lune/DiffSpaTiaL
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中执行复杂操作需要同时满足耦合的几何与时间约束。尽管时空逻辑（SpaTiaL）为规范描述提供了理论框架，但其在基于梯度的优化中的应用受限于不可微的几何运算。现有可微时间逻辑主要关注机器人内部状态，忽略了交互物体与环境间的关联；而能够捕捉此类交互的空间逻辑方法则依赖于离散几何引擎，这会中断计算图并阻碍精确梯度传播。为突破这一局限，我们提出了可微时空逻辑（Differentiable SpaTiaL）——一个完全张量化的工具箱，可直接在多边形集合上构建平滑的、兼容自动求导机制的几何基元。据我们所知，这是首个端到端可微的符号化时空逻辑工具箱。通过解析推导关键空间谓词（包括有向距离、相交、包含及方向关系）的可微松弛形式，我们实现了从高层语义规范到底层几何配置的端到端可微映射，且无需调用外部离散求解器。这种完全可微的表述解锁了两项核心能力：（1）在严格时空约束下的大规模并行轨迹优化；（2）通过反向传播从演示数据中直接学习空间逻辑参数。实验结果验证了所提框架的有效性与可扩展性。代码已开源：https://github.com/plen1lune/DiffSpaTiaL
tldr: Proposes Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox for end-to-end differentiable spatio-temporal logic, enabling gradient-based optimization and learning for manipulation tasks with geometric and temporal constraints.
tldr_zh: 提出Differentiable SpaTiaL，一个完全张量化的端到端可微分时空逻辑工具箱，用于实现具有几何和时序约束的机器人操作任务的梯度优化与学习。

title: From Impact to Insight: Dynamics-Aware Proprioceptive Terrain Sensing on Granular Media
summary: Robots that traverse natural terrain must interpret contact forces generated under highly dynamic conditions. However, most terrain characterization approaches rely on quasi-static assumptions that neglect velocity- and acceleration-dependent effects arising during impact and rapid stance transitions. In this work, we investigate granular terrain interaction during high-speed hopping and develop a physics-based framework for dynamic terrain characterization using proprioceptive sensing alone. Through controlled hopping experiments with systematically varied impact speed and leg compliance, our measurements reveal that quasi-static based assumptions lead to large discrepancies in granular terrain property estimation during high-speed hopping, particularly upon touchdown and controller-induced stiffness transitions. Velocity-dependent drag alone cannot explain these discrepancies. Instead, acceleration-dependent added-mass effects-associated with grain entrainment beneath the foot-dominate transient force responses. We integrate this force decomposition with a momentum-observer-based estimator that compensates for rigid-body inertia and gravity, and introduce an acceleration-aware weighted regression to account for increased force variance during high-acceleration events. Together, these methods enable consistent recovery of granular stiffness parameters across locomotion conditions, closely matching linear-actuator ground truth. Our results demonstrate that accurate terrain inference during high-speed locomotion requires explicit treatment of acceleration-dependent granular effects, and provide a foundation for robots to characterize complex deformable terrain during dynamic exploration of terrestrial and planetary environments.
summary_zh: 在自然地形中穿行的机器人必须解读高度动态条件下产生的接触力。然而，大多数地形表征方法依赖准静态假设，忽略了撞击和快速姿态转换过程中产生的速度与加速度相关效应。本研究通过高速跳跃过程中的颗粒地形交互实验，开发了一种仅依靠本体感知的动力学地形表征物理框架。通过系统改变冲击速度与腿部刚度的受控跳跃实验，测量结果显示准静态假设会导致高速跳跃过程中颗粒地形特性估计出现显著偏差，尤其是在触地阶段和控制器引发的刚度转换过程中。仅靠速度相关的阻力无法解释这些偏差，相反，加速度相关的附加质量效应——由足部下方颗粒裹挟运动引起——主导了瞬态力响应。我们将这种力分解与基于动量观测器的估计器相结合，补偿刚体惯性和重力影响，并引入加速度感知加权回归方法以处理高加速度事件中增大的力方差。这些方法共同实现了在不同运动条件下对颗粒刚度参数的一致性重构，与线性执行器的基准测试结果高度吻合。研究表明，高速运动过程中实现精确地形推断需要显式处理加速度相关的颗粒效应，为机器人在陆地及行星环境的动态探索中表征复杂可变形地形奠定了理论基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-based framework for dynamic terrain characterization using proprioceptive sensing during high-speed robotic hopping, addressing acceleration-dependent granular effects neglected by quasi-static assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一个基于物理的框架，利用本体感知在高速度机器人跳跃过程中进行动态地形表征，解决了准静态假设忽略的加速度依赖型颗粒效应。

title: Tune to Learn: How Controller Gains Shape Robot Policy Learning
summary: Position controllers have become the dominant interface for executing learned manipulation policies. Yet a critical design decision remains understudied: how should we choose controller gains for policy learning? The conventional wisdom is to select gains based on desired task compliance or stiffness. However, this logic breaks down when controllers are paired with state-conditioned policies: effective stiffness emerges from the interplay between learned reactions and control dynamics, not from gains alone. We argue that gain selection should instead be guided by learnability: how amenable different gain settings are to the learning algorithm in use. In this work, we systematically investigate how position controller gains affect three core components of modern robot learning pipelines: behavior cloning, reinforcement learning from scratch, and sim-to-real transfer. Through extensive experiments across multiple tasks and robot embodiments, we find that: (1) behavior cloning benefits from compliant and overdamped gain regimes, (2) reinforcement learning can succeed across all gain regimes given compatible hyperparameter tuning, and (3) sim-to-real transfer is harmed by stiff and overdamped gain regimes. These findings reveal that optimal gain selection depends not on the desired task behavior, but on the learning paradigm employed. Project website: https://younghyopark.me/tune-to-learn
summary_zh: 位置控制器已成为执行习得操作策略的主导接口。然而，一个关键的设计决策仍未得到充分研究：我们应如何为策略学习选择控制器增益？传统观点是根据期望的任务顺应性或刚度来选择增益。然而，当控制器与状态条件策略结合使用时，这一逻辑便失效了：有效刚度源于习得反应与控制动力学之间的相互作用，而非仅由增益决定。我们认为，增益选择应转而以可学习性为指导：即不同增益设置对当前所用学习算法的适应程度。本研究系统性地探讨了位置控制器增益如何影响现代机器人学习流程的三个核心组成部分：行为克隆、从零开始的强化学习以及仿真到现实的迁移。通过跨多个任务与机器人实体的广泛实验，我们发现：（1）行为克隆受益于顺应性和过阻尼增益机制，（2）在适当的超参数调优下，强化学习能在所有增益机制中取得成功，（3）刚性与过阻尼增益机制会损害仿真到现实的迁移效果。这些研究结果表明，最优增益选择并非取决于期望的任务行为，而是取决于所采用的学习范式。项目网址：https://younghyopark.me/tune-to-learn
tldr: This paper systematically studies how the choice of position controller gains affects the learning of robot manipulation policies, focusing on behavior cloning, reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文系统性地研究了位置控制器增益的选择如何影响机器人操作策略的学习，重点关注行为克隆、强化学习和仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Mitigating Data Scarcity in Spaceflight Applications for Offline Reinforcement Learning Using Physics-Informed Deep Generative Models
summary: The deployment of reinforcement learning (RL)-based controllers on physical systems is often limited by poor generalization to real-world scenarios, known as the simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gap. This gap is particularly challenging in spaceflight, where real-world training data are scarce due to high cost and limited planetary exploration data.
