In contrast, we find that VLMs are excellent estimators of color coverage, yet blatantly contradict their own reasoning in their final responses. Across all models and strategies for eliciting introspective rules, world-knowledge priors systematically degrade faithfulness in ways that do not mirror human cognition. Our findings challenge the view that VLM reasoning failures are difficulty-driven and suggest that VLM introspective self-knowledge is miscalibrated, with direct implications for high-stakes deployment.

title: XR-CareerAssist: An Immersive Platform for Personalised Career Guidance Leveraging Extended Reality and Multimodal AI
summary: Conventional career guidance platforms rely on static, text-driven interfaces that struggle to engage users or deliver personalised, evidence-based insights. Although Computer-Assisted Career Guidance Systems have evolved since the 1960s, they remain limited in interactivity and pay little attention to the narrative dimensions of career development. We introduce XR-CareerAssist, a platform that unifies Extended Reality (XR) with several Artificial Intelligence (AI) modules to deliver immersive, multilingual career guidance. The system integrates Automatic Speech Recognition for voice-driven interaction, Neural Machine Translation across English, Greek, French, and Italian, a Langchain-based conversational Training Assistant for personalised dialogue, a BLIP-based Vision-Language model for career visualisations, and AWS Polly Text-to-Speech delivered through an interactive 3D avatar. Career trajectories are rendered as dynamic Sankey diagrams derived from a repository of more than 100,000 anonymised professional profiles. The application was built in Unity for Meta Quest 3, with backend services hosted on AWS. A pilot evaluation at the University of Exeter with 23 participants returned 95.6% speech recognition accuracy, 78.3% overall user satisfaction, and 91.3% favourable ratings for system responsiveness, with feedback informing subsequent improvements to motion comfort, audio clarity, and text legibility. XR-CareerAssist demonstrates how the fusion of XR and AI can produce more engaging, accessible, and effective career development tools, with the integration of five AI modules within a single immersive environment yielding a multimodal interaction experience that distinguishes it from existing career guidance platforms.

title: SIM1: Physics-Aligned Simulator as Zero-Shot Data Scaler in Deformable Worlds
summary: Robotic manipulation with deformable objects represents a data-intensive regime in embodied learning, where shape, contact, and topology co-evolve in ways that far exceed the variability of rigids. Although simulation promises relief from the cost of real-world data acquisition, prevailing sim-to-real pipelines remain rooted in rigid-body abstractions, producing mismatched geometry, fragile soft dynamics, and motion primitives poorly suited for cloth interaction. We posit that simulation fails not for being synthetic, but for being ungrounded. To address this, we introduce SIM1, a physics-aligned real-to-sim-to-real data engine that grounds simulation in the physical world. Given limited demonstrations, the system digitizes scenes into metric-consistent twins, calibrates deformable dynamics through elastic modeling, and expands behaviors via diffusion-based trajectory generation with quality filtering. This pipeline transforms sparse observations into scaled synthetic supervision with near-demonstration fidelity. Experiments show that policies trained on purely synthetic data achieve parity with real-data baselines at a 1:15 equivalence ratio, while delivering 90% zero-shot success and 50% generalization gains in real-world deployment. These results validate physics-aligned simulation as scalable supervision for deformable manipulation and a practical pathway for data-efficient policy learning.
summary_zh: 机器人对可变形物体的操纵体现了具身学习中的数据密集型特性，其形态、接触与拓扑结构的协同演化远超刚体物体的变异性。尽管仿真有望缓解真实世界数据采集的成本压力，但当前主流的仿真到现实流程仍基于刚体抽象框架，导致几何匹配失准、软体动力学模型脆弱，且运动基元难以适应布料交互需求。我们认为仿真技术的不足并非源于其合成属性，而是因其缺乏物理世界的 grounding。为此，我们提出SIM1——一个基于物理对齐的现实-仿真-现实数据引擎，将仿真系统锚定于物理世界。该系统通过有限示教数据，将场景数字化为度量一致的双生模型，通过弹性建模校准可变形动力学，并借助基于扩散的轨迹生成与质量过滤机制拓展行为空间。该流程能够将稀疏观察转化为具有接近示教保真度的规模化合成监督数据。实验表明，仅使用合成数据训练的策略在1:15等效比下达到与真实数据基线相当的性能，在真实世界部署中实现90%的零样本成功率，并取得50%的泛化能力提升。这些结果验证了物理对齐仿真可作为可变形物体操纵的可扩展监督方案，并为数据高效策略学习提供了可行路径。
tldr: SIM1 introduces a physics-aligned simulation pipeline for generating scalable synthetic data for robotic manipulation of deformable objects, enabling zero-shot policy transfer with high success rates in the real world.
tldr_zh: SIM1提出了一种用于生成可变形物体机器人操作可扩展合成数据的物理对齐模拟管道，实现了零样本策略迁移，在真实世界中取得了高成功率。

title: HEX: Humanoid-Aligned Experts for Cross-Embodiment Whole-Body Manipulation
summary: Humans achieve complex manipulation through coordinated whole-body control, whereas most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models treat robot body parts largely independently, making high-DoF humanoid control challenging and often unstable. We present HEX, a state-centric framework for coordinated manipulation on full-sized bipedal humanoid robots. HEX introduces a humanoid-aligned universal state representation for scalable learning across heterogeneous embodiments, and incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts Unified Proprioceptive Predictor to model whole-body coordination and temporal motion dynamics from large-scale multi-embodiment trajectory data. To efficiently capture temporal visual context, HEX uses lightweight history tokens to summarize past observations, avoiding repeated encoding of historical images during inference. It further employs a residual-gated fusion mechanism with a flow-matching action head to adaptively integrate visual-language cues with proprioceptive dynamics for action generation. Experiments on real-world humanoid manipulation tasks show that HEX achieves state-of-the-art performance in task success rate and generalization, particularly in fast-reaction and long-horizon scenarios.
summary_zh: 人类通过协调的全身控制实现复杂操作，而大多数视觉-语言-动作模型将机器人身体部位视为独立部件，导致高自由度仿人机器人控制充满挑战且常常失稳。本文提出HEX——一种基于状态中心的全尺寸双足仿人机器人协调操作框架。HEX引入仿人机器人对齐的通用状态表示法，支持跨异构机器人的可扩展学习；同时集成专家混合统一本体感知预测器，通过大规模多机器人轨迹数据建模全身协调与时序运动动力学。为高效捕捉时序视觉上下文，HEX采用轻量级历史标记总结过往观测，避免推理过程中对历史图像的重复编码。该框架进一步运用残差门控融合机制与流匹配动作头，自适应整合视觉-语言线索与本体感知动力学以生成动作。在真实世界仿人机器人操作任务上的实验表明，HEX在任务成功率和泛化能力上均达到最先进水平，尤其在快速反应与长时程任务场景中表现突出。
tldr: HEX is a framework for coordinated whole-body control of humanoid robots, featuring a universal state representation, a Mixture-of-Experts proprioceptive predictor, and efficient temporal visual context processing.
tldr_zh: HEX是一个用于人形机器人协调全身控制的框架，采用通用状态表示、专家混合本体感知预测器和高效的时序视觉上下文处理。

title: Safe Large-Scale Robust Nonlinear MPC in Milliseconds via Reachability-Constrained System Level Synthesis on the GPU
summary: We present GPU-SLS, a GPU-parallelized framework for safe, robust nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) that scales to high-dimensional uncertain robotic systems and long planning horizons. Our method jointly optimizes an inequality-constrained, dynamically-feasible nominal trajectory, a tracking controller, and a closed-loop reachable set under disturbance, all in real-time. To efficiently compute nominal trajectories, we develop a sequential quadratic programming procedure with a novel GPU-accelerated quadratic program (QP) solver that uses parallel associative scans and adaptive caching within an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) framework. The same GPU QP backend is used to optimize robust tracking controllers and closed-loop reachable sets via system level synthesis (SLS), enabling reachability-constrained control in both fixed- and receding-horizon settings. We achieve substantial performance gains, reducing nominal trajectory solve times by 97.7% relative to state-of-the-art CPU solvers and 71.8% compared to GPU solvers, while accelerating SLS-based control and reachability by 237x. Despite large problem scales, our method achieves 100% empirical safety, unlike high-dimensional learning-based reachability baselines. We validate our approach on complex nonlinear systems, including whole-body quadrupeds (61D) and humanoids (75D), synthesizing robust control policies online on the GPU in 20 milliseconds on average and scaling to problems with 2 x 10^5 decision variables and 8 x 10^4 constraints. The implementation of our method is available at https://github.com/Jeff300fang/gpu_sls.
summary_zh: 本文提出 GPU-SLS，一种基于 GPU 并行化的安全鲁棒非线性模型预测控制（MPC）框架，适用于高维不确定机器人系统与长时域规划。我们的方法在实时环境下联合优化受不等式约束、动态可行的标称轨迹、跟踪控制器以及扰动下的闭环可达集。为高效计算标称轨迹，我们开发了序列二次规划方法，并采用一种新颖的 GPU 加速二次规划（QP）求解器，该求解器在交替方向乘子法（ADMM）框架内结合了并行关联扫描与自适应缓存技术。同一 GPU QP 后端通过系统级综合（SLS）优化鲁棒跟踪控制器与闭环可达集，从而在固定时域与滚动时域两种场景下实现可达性约束控制。相比最先进的 CPU 求解器，我们将标称轨迹求解时间降低了 97.7%，相比 GPU 求解器亦降低了 71.8%，同时将基于 SLS 的控制与可达性计算加速了 237 倍。尽管问题规模巨大，我们的方法仍实现了 100% 的实证安全性，而基于学习的高维可达性基准则无法做到。我们在复杂非线性系统上验证了该方法的有效性，包括全身四足机器人（61 维）和人形机器人（75 维），在 GPU 上平均仅需 20 毫秒即可在线合成鲁棒控制策略，并可扩展至包含 2×10^5 个决策变量和 8×10^4 个约束的问题。本方法的实现代码已公开于 https://github.com/Jeff300fang/gpu_sls。
tldr: This paper introduces GPU-SLS, a GPU-parallelized framework for real-time, safe, and robust nonlinear MPC, validated on high-dimensional robotic systems like quadrupeds and humanoids.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GPU-SLS，一个用于实时、安全、鲁棒非线性MPC的GPU并行化框架，并在高维机器人系统（如四足和仿人机器人）上进行了验证。

title: EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World
summary: Robot learning increasingly depends on large and diverse data, yet robot data collection remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric human data offer a promising alternative by capturing rich manipulation behavior across everyday environments. However, existing human datasets are often limited in scope, difficult to extend, and fragmented across institutions. We introduce EgoVerse, a collaborative platform for human data-driven robot learning that unifies data collection, processing, and access under a shared framework, enabling contributions from individual researchers, academic labs, and industry partners. The current release includes 1,362 hours (80k episodes) of human demonstrations spanning 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, and 2,087 unique demonstrators, with standardized formats, manipulation-relevant annotations, and tooling for downstream learning. Beyond the dataset, we conduct a large-scale study of human-to-robot transfer with experiments replicated across multiple labs, tasks, and robot embodiments under shared protocols. We find that policy performance generally improves with increased human data, but that effective scaling depends on alignment between human data and robot learning objectives. Together, the dataset, platform, and study establish a foundation for reproducible progress in human data-driven robot learning. Videos and additional information can be found at https://egoverse.ai/
summary_zh: 机器人学习越来越依赖于大量多样化数据，但机器人数据收集依然成本高昂且难以规模化。以人类第一视角数据为替代方案展现出巨大潜力，它能捕捉日常环境中丰富的操作行为。然而，现有的人类数据集通常范围有限、难以扩展，且分散在不同研究机构中。我们推出EgoVerse——一个面向人类数据驱动式机器人学习的协同平台，它将数据收集、处理与访问整合在共享框架下，支持个人研究者、学术实验室及行业合作伙伴共同贡献数据。当前版本包含1,362小时（8万条记录）的人类示范数据，涵盖1,965项任务、240个场景及2,087位独立示范者，所有数据均采用标准化格式、包含操作相关标注，并提供下游学习工具。除数据集外，我们通过在多实验室、多任务及多形态机器人平台遵循统一协议开展大规模实验，系统研究了人类数据到机器人的迁移效果。研究发现：策略性能通常随人类数据量增加而提升，但有效的规模化应用取决于人类数据与机器人学习目标的一致性。本数据集、平台及研究共同为人类数据驱动的机器人学习奠定了可复现发展的基础。视频及更多信息请访问https://egoverse.ai/
tldr: EgoVerse is a large-scale collaborative platform and dataset of egocentric human demonstrations for robot learning, with standardized data and a study on human-to-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: EgoVerse 是一个用于机器人学习的大规模协作平台和人类自我中心视角演示数据集，包含标准化数据，并研究了从人类数据到机器人的迁移。

title: Grasp as You Dream: Imitating Functional Grasping from Generated Human Demonstrations
summary: Building generalist robots capable of performing functional grasping in everyday, open-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the vast diversity of objects and tasks. Existing methods are either constrained to narrow object/task sets or rely on prohibitively large-scale data collection to capture real-world variability. In this work, we present an alternative approach, GraspDreamer, a method that leverages human demonstrations synthesized by visual generative models (VGMs) (e.g., video generation models) to enable zero-shot functional grasping without labor-intensive data collection. The key idea is that VGMs pre-trained on internet-scale human data implicitly encode generalized priors about how humans interact with the physical world, which can be combined with embodiment-specific action optimization to enable functional grasping with minimal effort. Extensive experiments on the public benchmarks with different robot hands demonstrate the superior data efficiency and generalization performance of GraspDreamer compared to previous methods. Real-world evaluations further validate the effectiveness on real robots. Additionally, we showcase that GraspDreamer can (1) be naturally extended to downstream manipulation tasks, and (2) can generate data to support visuomotor policy learning.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于物体与任务的巨大多样性，构建能够在日常开放世界中执行功能性抓取的通用型机器人仍是一项重大挑战。现有方法或受限于狭窄的物体/任务集，或需依赖成本极高的大规模数据采集以覆盖真实世界的复杂性。本文提出一种创新方法——GraspDreamer，该方法利用视觉生成模型（如视频生成模型）合成的人类演示数据，实现零样本功能性抓取，从而避免繁重的数据采集工作。其核心思想在于：基于互联网规模人类数据预训练的视觉生成模型已隐式编码了关于人类如何与物理世界交互的通用先验知识，通过结合具体机器人本体的动作优化，即可实现以最小代价完成功能性抓取。在不同机器人手爪上的公开基准测试实验表明，相比现有方法，GraspDreamer具有显著的数据效率优势与泛化性能。真实场景测试进一步验证了该方法在实际机器人上的有效性。此外，我们展示了GraspDreamer可（1）自然延伸至下游操作任务，（2）生成数据以支持视觉运动策略学习。
tldr: A method for functional robotic grasping that uses generative video models to synthesize human demonstrations, enabling zero-shot transfer with minimal real-world data, applied to real robots.
tldr_zh: 一种利用生成视频模型合成人类演示数据，以极少的真实数据实现零样本功能抓取的方法，并在真实机器人上验证。

title: ActiveGlasses: Learning Manipulation with Active Vision from Ego-centric Human Demonstration
summary: Large-scale real-world robot data collection is a prerequisite for bringing robots into everyday deployment. However, existing pipelines often rely on specialized handheld devices to bridge the embodiment gap, which not only increases operator burden and limits scalability, but also makes it difficult to capture the naturally coordinated perception-manipulation behaviors of human daily interaction. This challenge calls for a more natural system that can faithfully capture human manipulation and perception behaviors while enabling zero-shot transfer to robotic platforms. We introduce ActiveGlasses, a system for learning robot manipulation from ego-centric human demonstrations with active vision. A stereo camera mounted on smart glasses serves as the sole perception device for both data collection and policy inference: the operator wears it during bare-hand demonstrations, and the same camera is mounted on a 6-DoF perception arm during deployment to reproduce human active vision. To enable zero-transfer, we extract object trajectories from demonstrations and use an object-centric point-cloud policy to jointly predict manipulation and head movement. Across several challenging tasks involving occlusion and precise interaction, ActiveGlasses achieves zero-shot transfer with active vision, consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same hardware setup, and generalizes across two robot platforms.
summary_zh: 大规模真实世界的机器人数据采集是将机器人引入日常部署的先决条件。然而，现有流程通常依赖专用手持设备来弥合本体差距，这不仅增加了操作者负担、限制了可扩展性，还难以捕捉人类日常交互中自然协调的感知-操控行为。这一挑战呼唤一种更自然的系统，能够忠实记录人类的操控与感知行为，同时实现向机器人平台的零样本迁移。我们提出ActiveGlasses系统，通过主动视觉从第一人称人类演示中学习机器人操控。该系统以智能眼镜上搭载的立体相机作为唯一感知设备，同时用于数据采集和策略推理：操作者在徒手演示时佩戴该设备，部署期间则将同一相机安装于六自由度感知臂上，以复现人类的主动视觉。为实现零样本迁移，我们从演示中提取物体轨迹，并采用以物体为中心的点云策略联合预测操控动作与头部运动。在涉及遮挡和精细交互的多个挑战性任务中，ActiveGlasses通过主动视觉实现了零样本迁移，在相同硬件设置下持续优于强基线模型，并能在两种机器人平台上实现泛化。
tldr: This paper introduces ActiveGlasses, a system for learning robot manipulation policies from ego-centric human demonstrations using active vision, achieving zero-shot transfer to robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ActiveGlasses系统，它通过主动视觉从第一人称视角的人类演示中学习机器人操作策略，并实现了向机器人平台的零样本迁移。

title: A-SLIP: Acoustic Sensing for Continuous In-hand Slip Estimation
summary: Reliable in-hand manipulation requires accurate real-time estimation of slip between a gripper and a grasped object. Existing tactile sensing approaches based on vision, capacitance, or force-torque measurements face fundamental trade-offs in form factor, durability, and their ability to jointly estimate slip direction and magnitude. We present A-SLIP, a multi-channel acoustic sensing system integrated into a parallel-jaw gripper for estimating continuous slip in the grasp plane. The A-SLIP sensor consists of piezoelectric microphones positioned behind a textured silicone contact pad to capture structured contact-induced vibrations. The A-SLIP model processes synchronized multi-channel audio as log-mel spectrograms using a lightweight convolutional network, jointly predicting the presence, direction, and magnitude of slip. Across experiments with robot- and externally induced slip conditions, the fine-tuned four-microphone configuration achieves a mean absolute directional error of 14.1 degrees, outperforms baselines by up to 12 percent in detection accuracy, and reduces directional error by 32 percent. Compared with single-microphone configurations, the multi-channel design reduces directional error by 64 percent and magnitude error by 68 percent, underscoring the importance of spatial acoustic sensing in resolving slip direction ambiguity. We further evaluate A-SLIP in closed-loop reactive control and find that it enables reliable, low-cost, real-time estimation of in-hand slip. Project videos and additional details are available at https://a-slip.github.io.
summary_zh: 可靠的手内操作需要精确实时估计夹持器与抓取物体之间的滑动。现有基于视觉、电容或力-力矩测量的触觉传感方法在形态尺寸、耐用性以及联合估计滑动方向和大小的能力方面存在根本性权衡。我们提出A-SLIP——一种集成于平行夹爪中的多通道声学传感系统，用于在抓取平面内实现连续滑动的估计。A-SLIP传感器由布置在纹理化硅胶接触垫后方的压电麦克风阵列组成，用于捕获结构化的接触诱发振动。A-SLIP模型通过轻量级卷积网络将同步多通道音频处理为对数梅尔频谱图，联合预测滑动的存在、方向与幅度。在机器人诱发及外部诱发滑动的系列实验中，经过微调的四麦克风配置实现了14.1度的平均绝对方向误差，检测精度超越基线方法达12%，方向误差降低32%。与单麦克风配置相比，多通道设计将方向误差减少64%，幅度误差降低68%，凸显了空间声学传感在解决滑动方向模糊性问题中的重要性。我们进一步在闭环响应控制中评估A-SLIP系统，验证其能够实现可靠、低成本、实时的手内滑动估计。项目视频及详细信息请访问 https://a-slip.github.io。
tldr: This paper introduces A-SLIP, a multi-channel acoustic sensing system for a robot gripper that estimates continuous in-hand slip direction and magnitude in real-time using a lightweight neural network, and demonstrates its effectiveness in closed-loop reactive control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人手爪的A-SLIP多通道声学传感系统，通过轻量级神经网络实时估计手中物体滑移的连续方向和大小，并展示了其在闭环反应控制中的有效性。

title: Sumo: Dynamic and Generalizable Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a sim-to-real approach that enables legged robots to dynamically manipulate large and heavy objects with whole-body dexterity. Our key insight is that by performing test-time steering of a pre-trained whole-body control policy with a sample-based planner, we can enable these robots to solve a variety of dynamic loco-manipulation tasks. Interestingly, we find our method generalizes to a diverse set of objects and tasks with no additional tuning or training, and can be further enhanced by flexibly adjusting the cost function at test time. We demonstrate the capabilities of our approach through a variety of challenging loco-manipulation tasks on a Spot quadruped robot in the real world, including uprighting a tire heavier than the robot's nominal lifting capacity and dragging a crowd-control barrier larger and taller than the robot itself. Additionally, we show that the same approach can be generalized to humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, such as opening a door and pushing a table, in simulation. Project code and videos are available at \href{https://sumo.rai-inst.com/}{https://sumo.rai-inst.com/}.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种从仿真到现实的方法，使足式机器人能够通过全身协调灵巧地动态操控大型重物。我们的核心思路是：通过基于采样的规划器对预训练的全身控制策略进行测试时引导，使机器人能够完成多种动态移动操控任务。值得注意的是，该方法无需额外调参或训练即可泛化至多种不同物体与任务，并可通过测试时灵活调整成本函数进一步增强性能。我们在真实场景的Spot四足机器人上通过一系列高难度移动操控任务验证了方法的有效性，包括扶正超过额定举重能力的轮胎、拖拽比机器人尺寸更大的防暴屏障等。此外，仿真实验表明该方案可推广至人形机器人的移动操控任务（如开门、推桌等）。项目代码与视频详见 \href{https://sumo.rai-inst.com/}{https://sumo.rai-inst.com/}。
tldr: The paper introduces a sim-to-real method for legged robots to perform dynamic whole-body loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects by combining a pre-trained policy with test-time steering and sample-based planning, demonstrated on real-world tasks with a Spot robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从仿真到现实的方法，使腿式机器人能够通过结合预训练策略与测试时引导及基于采样的规划，执行动态全身移动操作，处理大型重物，并在真实世界的Spot机器人上进行了多种任务验证。

title: BLaDA: Bridging Language to Functional Dexterous Actions within 3DGS Fields
summary: In unstructured environments, functional dexterous grasping calls for the tight integration of semantic understanding, precise 3D functional localization, and physically interpretable execution. Modular hierarchical methods are more controllable and interpretable than end-to-end VLA approaches, but existing ones still rely on predefined affordance labels and lack the tight semantic--pose coupling needed for functional dexterous manipulation. To address this, we propose BLaDA (Bridging Language to Dexterous Actions in 3DGS fields), an interpretable zero-shot framework that grounds open-vocabulary instructions as perceptual and control constraints for functional dexterous manipulation. BLaDA establishes an interpretable reasoning chain by first parsing natural language into a structured sextuple of manipulation constraints via a Knowledge-guided Language Parsing (KLP) module. To achieve pose-consistent spatial reasoning, we introduce the Triangular Functional Point Localization (TriLocation) module, which utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting as a continuous scene representation and identifies functional regions under triangular geometric constraints. Finally, the 3D Keypoint Grasp Matrix Transformation Execution (KGT3D+) module decodes these semantic-geometric constraints into physically plausible wrist poses and finger-level commands. Extensive experiments on complex benchmarks demonstrate that BLaDA significantly outperforms existing methods in both affordance grounding precision and the success rate of functional manipulation across diverse categories and tasks. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/PopeyePxx/BLaDA.
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中，功能化灵巧抓取需要语义理解、精准三维功能定位与物理可解释执行能力的紧密整合。相比端到端视觉语言动作模型，模块化分层方法更具可控性与可解释性，但现有方法仍依赖预定义的功能可供性标签，且缺乏功能化灵巧操作所需的语义-姿态紧密耦合机制。为此，我们提出BLaDA（三维高斯场中语言到灵巧动作的桥梁）——一个可解释的零样本框架，将开放词汇指令转化为功能化灵巧操作的感知与控制约束。BLaDA通过知识引导语言解析模块将自然语言解析为结构化的六元组操作约束，构建可解释的推理链条。为实现姿态一致的空间推理，我们提出三角功能点定位模块，利用三维高斯泼溅作为连续场景表征，在三角形几何约束下识别功能区域。最后，三维关键点抓取矩阵变换执行模块将这些语义-几何约束解码为物理可行的腕部姿态与手指级指令。在复杂基准测试中的大量实验表明，BLaDA在不同类别和任务的功能可供性定位精度与功能化操作成功率上均显著优于现有方法。代码将在https://github.com/PopeyePxx/BLaDA公开。
tldr: Proposes BLaDA, a zero-shot, interpretable framework for grounding open-vocabulary language instructions into perceptual and control constraints, enabling functional dexterous manipulation via a reasoning chain from language parsing to 3D keypoint-based execution.
tldr_zh: 提出了BLaDA，一个用于开放词汇语言指令的零样本、可解释框架，通过从语言解析到3D关键点执行的推理链，将语义指令转化为感知和控制约束，实现功能性灵巧操作。

title: A Unified Multi-Layer Framework for Skill Acquisition from Imperfect Human Demonstrations
summary: Current Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) systems for skill teaching are fragmented, and existing approaches in the literature do not offer a cohesive framework that is simultaneously efficient, intuitive, and universally safe. This paper presents a novel, layered control framework that addresses this fundamental gap by enabling robust, compliant Learning from Demonstration (LfD) built upon a foundation of universal robot compliance. The proposed approach is structured in three progressive and interconnected stages. First, we introduce a real-time LfD method that learns both the trajectory and variable impedance from a single demonstration, significantly improving efficiency and reproduction fidelity. To ensure high-quality and intuitive {kinesthetic teaching}, we then present a null-space optimization strategy that proactively manages singularities and provides a consistent interaction feel during human demonstration. Finally, to ensure generalized safety, we introduce a foundational null-space compliance method that enables the entire robot body to compliantly adapt to post-learning external interactions without compromising main task performance. This final contribution transforms the system into a versatile HRI platform, moving beyond end-effector (EE)-specific applications. We validate the complete framework through comprehensive comparative experiments on a 7-DOF KUKA LWR robot. The results demonstrate a safer, more intuitive, and more efficient unified system for a wide range of human-robot collaborative tasks.
summary_zh: 当前用于技能教授的人机交互系统较为分散，现有文献中的方法未能提供一个同时具备高效性、直观性和普适安全性的统一框架。本文提出一种新颖的分层控制框架，通过在通用机器人顺应性基础上构建稳健的顺从式示教学习，从而弥补这一根本性缺陷。该框架采用三个渐进式互联阶段的结构设计：首先，我们提出一种实时示教学习方法，能够通过单次演示同时学习轨迹与可变阻抗，显著提升了效率与再现精度；其次，为确保高质量直观的动觉示教，我们提出零空间优化策略，可主动管理奇点问题并在人机演示过程中提供一致的交互感受；最后，为实现广义安全性，我们提出基础性零空间顺应方法，使整个机器人系统在保持主任务性能的前提下，能够顺应性地适应学习后的外部交互。这一最终贡献将系统转化为超越末端执行器专用场景的通用人机交互平台。我们在7自由度KUKA LWR机器人上通过综合对比实验验证了完整框架，结果表明该系统能为广泛的人机协作任务提供更安全、更直观、更高效的一体化解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a layered control framework for learning robot manipulation skills from human demonstrations, featuring trajectory and impedance learning, null-space optimization for safe teaching, and whole-body compliance for safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于从人类演示中学习机器人操作技能的分层控制框架，包括轨迹和阻抗学习、用于安全示教的零空间优化，以及保证全身安全性的柔顺控制方法。

title: EMMa: End-Effector Stability-Oriented Mobile Manipulation for Tracked Rescue Robots
summary: The autonomous operation of tracked mobile manipulators in rescue missions requires not only ensuring the reachability and safety of robot motion but also maintaining stable end-effector manipulation under diverse task demands. However, existing studies have overlooked many end-effector motion properties at both the planning and control levels. This paper presents a motion generation framework for tracked mobile manipulators to achieve stable end-effector operation in complex rescue scenarios. The framework formulates a coordinated path optimization model that couples end-effector and mobile base states and designs compact cost/constraint representations to mitigate nonlinearities and reduce computational complexity. Furthermore, an isolated control scheme with feedforward compensation and feedback regulation is developed to enable coordinated path tracking for the robot. Extensive simulated and real-world experiments on rescue scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms SOTA methods across key metrics, including task success rate and end-effector motion stability, validating its effectiveness and robustness in complex mobile manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 在救援任务中，履带式移动机械臂的自主运行不仅需要确保机器人运动的可达性和安全性，还需在多样化任务需求下维持稳定的末端执行器操控。然而，现有研究在规划与控制层面均忽略了许多末端执行器的运动特性。本文提出一种面向履带式移动机械臂的运动生成框架，旨在复杂救援场景中实现稳定的末端执行器操作。该框架构建了耦合末端执行器与移动底座状态的协同路径优化模型，并设计了紧凑的成本/约束表征方法以降低非线性影响并减少计算复杂度。此外，开发了一种结合前馈补偿与反馈调节的隔离控制方案，以实现机器人的协同路径跟踪。通过在救援场景中开展的大量仿真与真实实验表明，所提框架在任务成功率和末端执行器运动稳定性等关键指标上均优于现有先进方法，验证了其在复杂移动操控任务中的有效性与鲁棒性。
tldr: A framework for tracked mobile manipulators to achieve stable end-effector manipulation in complex rescue scenarios, featuring coordinated path optimization and a dedicated control scheme.
tldr_zh: 为履带式移动机械臂提出一个运动生成框架，以在复杂救援场景中实现稳定的末端执行器操作，包括协调路径优化和专门的控制方案。

title: State and Trajectory Estimation of Tensegrity Robots via Factor Graphs and Chebyshev Polynomials
summary: Tensegrity robots offer compliance and adaptability, but their nonlinear, and underconstrained dynamics make state estimation challenging. Reliable continuous-time estimation of all rigid links is crucial for closed-loop control, system identification, and machine learning; however, conventional methods often fall short. This paper proposes a two-stage approach for robust state or trajectory estimation (i.e., filtering or smoothing) of a cable-driven tensegrity robot. For online state estimation, this work introduces a factor-graph-based method, which fuses measurements from an RGB-D camera with on-board cable length sensors. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this is the first application of factor graphs in this domain. Factor graphs are a natural choice, as they exploit the robot's structural properties and provide effective sensor fusion solutions capable of handling nonlinearities in practice. Both the Mahalanobis distance-based clustering algorithm, used to handle noise, and the Chebyshev polynomial method, used to estimate the most probable velocities and intermediate states, are shown to perform well on simulated and real-world data, compared to an ICP-based algorithm. Results show that the approach provides high fidelity, continuous-time state and trajectory estimates for complex tensegrity robot motions.
summary_zh: 张拉整体机器人具备柔顺性与适应性，但其非线性和欠约束动力学特性使得状态估计面临挑战。对所有刚性构件进行可靠的连续时间估计是实现闭环控制、系统辨识和机器学习的关键，然而传统方法往往难以满足要求。本文提出一种两阶段方法，用于电缆驱动张拉整体机器人的鲁棒状态或轨迹估计（即滤波或平滑）。针对在线状态估计，本研究引入了一种基于因子图的方法，该方法融合了RGB-D相机与机载电缆长度传感器的测量数据。据作者所知，这是因子图在该领域的首次应用。因子图能自然利用机器人的结构特性，并提供能够实际处理非线性的有效传感器融合方案，因而成为理想选择。实验表明，用于处理噪声的基于马氏距离的聚类算法和用于估计最可能速度及中间状态的切比雪夫多项式方法，在仿真和真实数据上均表现出优于传统基于ICP算法的性能。研究结果表明，该方法能为复杂的张拉整体机器人运动提供高保真度的连续时间状态与轨迹估计。
tldr: Proposes a factor-graph-based approach for online state estimation and a Chebyshev polynomial method for trajectory smoothing of a cable-driven tensegrity robot, using RGB-D camera and cable sensor fusion.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于因子图的在线状态估计方法和一种用于轨迹平滑的切比雪夫多项式方法，用于电缆驱动的张拉整体机器人，融合了RGB-D相机和电缆传感器数据。

title: ViVa: A Video-Generative Value Model for Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robot manipulation through large-scale pretraining, but real-world deployment remains challenging due to partial observability and delayed feedback. Reinforcement learning addresses this via value functions, which assess task progress and guide policy improvement. However, existing value models built on vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to capture temporal dynamics, undermining reliable value estimation in long-horizon tasks. In this paper, we propose ViVa, a video-generative value model that repurposes a pretrained video generator for value estimation. Taking the current observation and robot proprioception as input, ViVa jointly predicts future proprioception and a scalar value for the current state. By leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of a pretrained video generator, our approach grounds value estimation in anticipated embodiment dynamics, moving beyond static snapshots to intrinsically couple value with foresight. Integrated into RECAP, ViVa delivers substantial improvements on real-world box assembly. Qualitative analysis across all three tasks confirms that ViVa produces more reliable value signals, accurately reflecting task progress. By leveraging spatiotemporal priors from video corpora, ViVa also generalizes to novel objects, highlighting the promise of video-generative models for value estimation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通过大规模预训练推动了机器人操作能力的发展，然而在实际应用中，部分可观测性和延迟反馈等问题仍使其部署面临挑战。强化学习通过价值函数来评估任务进展并指导策略优化，从而应对这些挑战。但现有基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）构建的价值模型难以捕捉时序动态变化，导致其在长周期任务中的价值估计可靠性不足。本文提出ViVa——一种基于视频生成的价值模型，该模型将预训练视频生成器重新用于价值估计。ViVa以当前观测数据和机器人本体感知为输入，联合预测未来本体感知状态及当前状态的标量价值。通过利用预训练视频生成器的时空先验知识，我们的方法将价值估计根植于预期的具身动态变化中，突破静态场景的局限，实现价值与前瞻能力的本质耦合。将ViVa整合到RECAP框架中后，在现实世界的箱体装配任务中实现了显著提升。三项任务的定性分析均证实，ViVa能生成更可靠的价值信号，准确反映任务进展。通过利用视频数据集的时空先验知识，ViVa还能泛化至新物体，凸显了视频生成模型在价值估计领域的应用潜力。
tldr: Proposes ViVa, a video-generative value model that uses a pretrained video generator to predict future proprioception and estimate state values for robot reinforcement learning, improving performance on real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出ViVa，一种视频生成价值模型，利用预训练视频生成器预测未来本体感知并估计状态价值，用于机器人强化学习，在真实世界装配任务中提升性能。

title: PriPG-RL: Privileged Planner-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Partially Observable Systems with Anytime-Feasible MPC
summary: This paper addresses the problem of training a reinforcement learning (RL) policy under partial observability by exploiting a privileged, anytime-feasible planner agent available exclusively during training. We formalize this as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) in which a planner agent with access to an approximate dynamical model and privileged state information guides a learning agent that observes only a lossy projection of the true state. To realize this framework, we introduce an anytime-feasible Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithm that serves as the planner agent. For the learning agent, we propose Planner-to-Policy Soft Actor-Critic (P2P-SAC), a method that distills the planner agent's privileged knowledge to mitigate partial observability and thereby improve both sample efficiency and final policy performance. We support this framework with rigorous theoretical analysis. Finally, we validate our approach in simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Lab and successfully deploy it on a real-world Unitree Go2 quadruped navigating complex, obstacle-rich environments.
summary_zh: 本文针对部分可观测性下强化学习策略的训练问题，提出了一种利用仅在训练阶段可用的特权、实时可行规划智能体的解决方案。我们将此问题形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），其中规划智能体通过近似动力学模型和特权状态信息指导学习智能体，而学习智能体仅能观测到真实状态的有损投影。为实现该框架，我们提出了一种作为规划智能体的实时可行模型预测控制（MPC）算法。对于学习智能体，我们设计了规划器至策略软演员-评论家（P2P-SAC）方法，通过提炼规划智能体的特权知识来缓解部分可观测性问题，从而提升样本效率并优化最终策略性能。我们通过严格的理论分析为该框架提供支撑。最后，我们在NVIDIA Isaac Lab仿真环境中验证了该方法的有效性，并成功将其部署于现实世界的Unitree Go2四足机器人上，使其能够在复杂多障碍物环境中实现自主导航。
tldr: This paper introduces PriPG-RL, a framework for training RL policies under partial observability by distilling knowledge from a privileged MPC planner during training, and validates it on a quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PriPG-RL框架，通过将训练期间特权MPC规划器的知识蒸馏到学习中，解决部分可观测下的RL策略训练问题，并在四足机器人上验证。

title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and generative world models are opening new opportunities for embodied navigation. VLMs are increasingly used as direct planners or trajectory predictors, while world models support look-ahead reasoning by imagining future views. Yet predicting a reliable trajectory from a single egocentric observation remains challenging. Current VLMs often generate unstable trajectories, and world models, though able to synthesize plausible futures, do not directly provide the grounded signals needed for navigation learning. This raises a central question: how can generated futures be turned into supervision for grounded trajectory prediction? We present WorldMAP, a teacher--student framework that converts world-model-generated futures into persistent semantic-spatial structure and planning-derived supervision. Its world-model-driven teacher builds semantic-spatial memory from generated videos, grounds task-relevant targets and obstacles, and produces trajectory pseudo-labels through explicit planning. A lightweight student with a multi-hypothesis trajectory head is then trained to predict navigation trajectories directly from vision-language inputs. On Target-Bench, WorldMAP achieves the best ADE and FDE among compared methods, reducing ADE by 18.0% and FDE by 42.1% relative to the best competing baseline, while lifting a small open-source VLM to DTW performance competitive with proprietary models. More broadly, the results suggest that, in embodied navigation, the value of world models may lie less in supplying action-ready imagined evidence than in synthesizing structured supervision for navigation learning.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）和生成式世界模型正在为具身导航开辟新的可能性。视觉语言模型越来越多地被用作直接规划器或轨迹预测器，而世界模型则通过想象未来视图来支持前瞻性推理。然而，从单次第一人称观测中预测可靠轨迹仍然具有挑战性。当前视觉语言模型生成的轨迹往往不稳定，而世界模型虽然能够合成合理的未来场景，却无法直接提供导航学习所需的具身化信号。这引发了一个核心问题：如何将生成的未来场景转化为具身化轨迹预测的监督信号？我们提出WorldMAP——一种教师-学生框架，可将世界模型生成的未来场景转化为持久的语义-空间结构以及规划衍生的监督信号。该框架中由世界模型驱动的教师从生成视频中构建语义-空间记忆，定位任务相关的目标与障碍物，并通过显式规划生成轨迹伪标签。随后，配备多假设轨迹预测头的轻量级学生模型通过视觉语言输入直接学习预测导航轨迹。在Target-Bench基准测试中，WorldMAP在所有对比方法中取得了最佳的ADE和FDE指标，相较于最优基线分别将ADE降低了18.0%，FDE降低了42.1%，同时使小型开源视觉语言模型在DTW指标上达到与专用模型相竞争的水平。更广泛而言，这些结果表明：在具身导航领域，世界模型的价值或许不在于提供可直接用于行动的想象证据，而在于为导航学习合成结构化的监督信号。
tldr: WorldMAP uses world models to generate structured supervision for training lightweight student models in vision-language navigation, achieving state-of-the-art trajectory prediction performance.
tldr_zh: WorldMAP利用世界模型生成结构化监督来训练轻量级学生模型，用于视觉语言导航任务，实现了最先进的轨迹预测性能。

title: Incremental Residual Reinforcement Learning Toward Real-World Learning for Social Navigation
summary: As the demand for mobile robots continues to increase, social navigation has emerged as a critical task, driving active research into deep reinforcement learning (RL) approaches. However, because pedestrian dynamics and social conventions vary widely across different regions, simulations cannot easily encompass all possible real-world scenarios. Real-world RL, in which agents learn while operating directly in physical environments, presents a promising solution to this issue. Nevertheless, this approach faces significant challenges, particularly regarding constrained computational resources on edge devices and learning efficiency. In this study, we propose incremental residual RL (IRRL). This method integrates incremental learning, which is a lightweight process that operates without a replay buffer or batch updates, with residual RL, which enhances learning efficiency by training only on the residuals relative to a base policy. Through the simulation experiments, we demonstrated that, despite lacking a replay buffer, IRRL achieved performance comparable to those of conventional replay buffer-based methods and outperformed existing incremental learning approaches. Furthermore, the real-world experiments confirmed that IRRL can enable robots to effectively adapt to previously unseen environments through the real-world learning.
summary_zh: 随着移动机器人需求的持续增长，社交导航已成为关键任务，推动了深度强化学习方法的广泛研究。然而，由于不同区域的行人动态和社会规范差异显著，仿真难以覆盖所有可能的真实场景。真实环境强化学习使智能体直接在物理环境中运行学习，为这一问题提供了有潜力的解决方案。但该方法仍面临严峻挑战，特别是边缘设备计算资源受限以及学习效率问题。本研究提出增量残差强化学习方法，该方法将无需经验回放缓冲区或批量更新的轻量级增量学习，与通过仅针对基策略残差进行训练以提升学习效率的残差强化学习相结合。仿真实验表明，尽管未使用经验回放缓冲区，所提方法仍能达到与传统基于经验回放方法相当的性能，并优于现有增量学习方法。此外，真实环境实验证实了该方法能使机器人通过实时学习有效适应先前未见过的环境。
tldr: This paper proposes Incremental Residual Reinforcement Learning (IRRL), a method for efficient real-world adaptation of robots in social navigation tasks by combining incremental learning with residual RL to train without a replay buffer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出增量残差强化学习方法，结合无重放缓冲区的增量学习和残差强化学习，使机器人能在真实世界的社会导航任务中进行高效在线适应。

title: Harnessing Embodied Agents: Runtime Governance for Policy-Constrained Execution
summary:
Embodied agents are evolving from passive reasoning systems into active executors that interact with tools, robots, and physical environments. Once granted execution authority, the central challenge becomes how to keep actions governable at runtime. Existing approaches embed safety and recovery logic inside the agent loop, making execution control difficult to standardize, audit, and adapt.
  This paper argues that embodied intelligence requires not only stronger agents, but stronger runtime governance. We propose a framework for policy-constrained execution that separates agent cognition from execution oversight. Governance is externalized into a dedicated runtime layer performing policy checking, capability admission, execution monitoring, rollback handling, and human override.
  We formalize the control boundary among the embodied agent, Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), and runtime governance layer, and validate through 1000 randomized simulation trials across three governance dimensions. Results show 96.2% interception of unauthorized actions, reduction of unsafe continuation from 100% to 22.2% under runtime drift, and 91.4% recovery success with full policy compliance, substantially outperforming all baselines (p<0.001). By reframing runtime governance as a first-class systems problem, this paper positions policy-constrained execution as a key design principle for embodied agent systems.
summary_zh:
具身智能体正从被动的推理系统演变为与工具、机器人及物理环境交互的主动执行体。一旦获得执行权限，核心挑战便在于如何在运行时保持行动的可控性。现有方法将安全与恢复逻辑嵌入智能体循环内部，导致执行控制难以标准化、审计与适配。

本文主张，具身智能不仅需要更强的智能体，更需强化运行时治理机制。我们提出了一种策略约束执行框架，将智能体认知与执行监管相分离。治理功能被外置至专用的运行时层，负责执行策略检查、能力准入、运行监控、回滚处理及人工干预。

我们形式化定义了具身智能体、具身能力模块与运行时治理层之间的控制边界，并通过覆盖三个治理维度的1000次随机模拟实验进行验证。结果表明：该系统实现了对未授权行动96.2%的拦截率，在运行时漂移场景下将不安全延续比例从100%降至22.2%，并以完全策略合规性达成91.4%的恢复成功率，显著优于所有基线方法（p<0.001）。通过将运行时治理重构为核心系统问题，本文确立了策略约束执行作为具身智能体系统关键设计原则的地位。
tldr: This paper proposes a runtime governance framework for embodied agents that separates agent cognition from execution oversight, using a dedicated layer to enforce policies, monitor execution, and manage safety/rollback, validated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种具身智能体的运行时治理框架，将代理认知与执行监管分离，通过专用层进行策略检查、能力许可、执行监控和回滚处理，并在仿真中验证了有效性。

title: Vision-Language Navigation for Aerial Robots: Towards the Era of Large Language Models
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (Aerial VLN) aims to enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to interpret natural language instructions and autonomously navigate complex three-dimensional environments by grounding language in visual perception. This survey provides a critical and analytical review of the Aerial VLN field, with particular attention to the recent integration of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We first formally introduce the Aerial VLN problem and define two interaction paradigms: single-instruction and dialog-based, as foundational axes. We then organize the body of Aerial VLN methods into a taxonomy of five architectural categories: sequence-to-sequence and attention-based methods, end-to-end LLM/VLM methods, hierarchical methods, multi-agent methods, and dialog-based navigation methods. For each category, we systematically analyze design rationales, technical trade-offs, and reported performance. We critically assess the evaluation infrastructure for Aerial VLN, including datasets, simulation platforms, and metrics, and identify their gaps in scale, environmental diversity, real-world grounding, and metric coverage. We consolidate cross-method comparisons on shared benchmarks and analyze key architectural trade-offs, including discrete versus continuous actions, end-to-end versus hierarchical designs, and the simulation-to-reality gap. Finally, we synthesize seven concrete open problems: long-horizon instruction grounding, viewpoint robustness, scalable spatial representation, continuous 6-DoF action execution, onboard deployment, benchmark standardization, and multi-UAV swarm navigation, with specific research directions grounded in the evidence presented throughout the survey.
summary_zh: 空中视觉语言导航旨在通过将自然语言指令与视觉感知相融合，使无人机能够理解人类指令并自主在复杂三维环境中导航。本文对该领域进行了批判性评述与分析，重点关注大语言模型及视觉语言模型的最新融合进展。首先，我们形式化定义了空中视觉语言导航任务，并以单指令与对话式交互为基本轴线，阐明两种核心交互范式。随后将现有研究方法归纳为五大架构类别：序列到序列与注意力机制方法、端到端大语言模型/视觉语言模型方法、分层方法、多智能体方法以及对话式导航方法，并逐类系统剖析其设计原理、技术权衡与性能表现。进一步地，我们批判性评估了现有空中视觉语言导航评估体系，包括数据集、仿真平台与评测指标，指出其在规模、环境多样性、现实世界适配度及指标覆盖度等方面的不足。通过整合跨方法在公共基准上的对比数据，我们深入分析了关键架构权衡：离散与连续动作选择、端到端与分层设计的取舍以及仿真到现实的鸿沟。最后，基于综述论证的证据，提炼出七大开放性挑战：长跨度指令理解、视点鲁棒性、可扩展空间表征、连续六自由度动作执行、机载部署、基准标准化及多无人机集群导航，并为每个方向提出了具体的研究路径。
tldr: This survey paper reviews the field of aerial vision-and-language navigation (Aerial VLN), focusing on the integration of large language models for enabling unmanned aerial vehicles to follow natural language instructions in 3D environments.
tldr_zh: 本综述论文回顾了空中视觉与语言导航（Aerial VLN）领域，重点关注将大语言模型集成到无人机中，使其能够遵循自然语言指令在三维环境中导航。

title: Active Reward Machine Inference From Raw State Trajectories
summary: Reward machines are automaton-like structures that capture the memory required to accomplish a multi-stage task. When combined with reinforcement learning or optimal control methods, they can be used to synthesize robot policies to achieve such tasks. However, specifying a reward machine by hand, including a labeling function capturing high-level features that the decisions are based on, can be a daunting task. This paper deals with the problem of learning reward machines directly from raw state and policy information. As opposed to existing works, we assume no access to observations of rewards, labels, or machine nodes, and show what trajectory data is sufficient for learning the reward machine in this information-scarce regime. We then extend the result to an active learning setting where we incrementally query trajectory extensions to improve data (and indirectly computational) efficiency. Results are demonstrated with several grid world examples.
summary_zh: 奖励机是一种类似自动机的结构，能够捕获完成多阶段任务所需的记忆信息。当与强化学习或最优控制方法结合时，它们可用于合成机器人策略以实现此类任务。然而，手动构建奖励机是一项艰巨的工作，包括需要设计能够捕捉决策依赖的高层特征的标记函数。本文致力于直接从原始状态与策略信息中学习奖励机。与现有研究不同，我们假设无法获取奖励信号、标签或机器节点的观测信息，并证明了在此类信息稀缺场景下，何种轨迹数据足以支撑奖励机的学习。随后，我们将结果扩展至主动学习场景，通过增量式查询轨迹扩展来提升数据效率（间接提升计算效率）。研究结果通过多个网格世界示例进行了验证。
tldr: This paper presents a method for learning reward machines—a structure for multi-stage task specification—directly from raw state and policy trajectories, without access to rewards, labels, or machine nodes, and introduces an active learning extension for improved data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从原始状态和策略轨迹中直接学习奖励机器（用于多阶段任务规划）的方法，该方法无需奖励、标签或机器节点信息，并引入了主动学习扩展以提高数据效率。

title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
summary: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.
summary_zh: 虽然腿式移动机械臂的解耦控制方案已展现出良好的鲁棒性，但在面对传感器噪声或不可行用户指令引发的分布外输入时，学习用于跟踪全局末端执行器位姿的整体全身控制策略仍显脆弱。为在不牺牲任务性能与连续性的前提下提升系统对这些扰动的鲁棒性，我们提出能力流形投影方法。具体而言，我们采用帧级安全方案，将无限时域安全约束转化为计算高效的单步流形包含问题。为实例化该能力流形，我们构建了下界安全估计器，用于区分训练分布之外的未掌握意图。随后引入同构潜在空间，将流形几何结构与安全概率对齐，实现对任意分布外意图的高效O(1)级无缝防御。实验表明，在基线方法遭遇灾难性失败的典型分布外场景中，能力流形投影可将生存率提升高达10倍，同时保持低于10%的跟踪性能衰减。值得注意的是，该系统展现出涌现的"尽力而为"泛化行为，通过遵循能力边界逐步完成分布外目标。实验视频详见：https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP。
tldr: The paper proposes Competence Manifold Projection (CMP) to improve the robustness of whole-body control policies for legged mobile manipulators against out-of-distribution inputs, maintaining safety and performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出能力流形投影（CMP），用于提高腿式移动机械手全身控制策略对分布外输入的鲁棒性，同时保持安全性和任务性能。

title: ASPECT:Analogical Semantic Policy Execution via Language Conditioned Transfer
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle to generalize knowledge to new tasks, even those structurally similar to ones they have mastered. Although recent approaches have attempted to mitigate this issue via zero-shot transfer, they are often constrained by predefined, discrete class systems, limiting their adaptability to novel or compositional task variations. We propose a significantly more generalized approach, replacing discrete latent variables with natural language conditioning via a text-conditioned Variational Autoencoder (VAE). Our core innovation utilizes a Large Language Model (LLM) as a dynamic \textit{semantic operator} at test time. Rather than relying on rigid rules, our agent queries the LLM to semantically remap the description of the current observation to align with the source task. This source-aligned caption conditions the VAE to generate an imagined state compatible with the agent's original training, enabling direct policy reuse. By harnessing the flexible reasoning capabilities of LLMs, our approach achieves zero-shot transfer across a broad spectrum of complex and truly novel analogous tasks, moving beyond the limitations of fixed category mappings. Code and videos are available \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ASPECT-85C3/}{here}.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）智能体常常难以将已掌握的知识推广至新任务，即便是结构上与已学会任务高度相似的情形。尽管近期研究尝试通过零样本迁移来缓解这一问题，但这些方法通常受限于预定义的离散类别体系，难以适应新颖或组合式的任务变体。我们提出一种显著更通用的方法，通过文本条件变分自编码器（VAE）以自然语言条件替代离散潜变量。我们的核心创新在于引入大型语言模型（LLM）作为测试时的动态“语义操作器”。该方法不依赖刚性规则，而是让智能体通过查询LLM，将当前观测的语义描述重映射至源任务框架。这种源任务对齐的文本描述随后作为条件输入VAE，生成与智能体原始训练兼容的想象状态，从而实现策略的直接复用。通过利用LLM的灵活推理能力，我们的方法在广泛而复杂、且真正新颖的类比任务中实现了零样本迁移，突破了固定类别映射的局限。代码与演示视频可见\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ASPECT-85C3/}{此处}。
tldr: This paper proposes using LLMs as semantic operators to remap observation descriptions, enabling zero-shot transfer of RL policies to novel analogous tasks via language-conditioned VAEs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出利用大语言模型作为语义操作器，通过重映射观察描述，实现基于语言条件VAE的强化学习策略在新型类比任务上的零样本迁移。

title: HiRO-Nav: Hybrid ReasOning Enables Efficient Embodied Navigation
summary: Embodied navigation agents built upon large reasoning models (LRMs) can handle complex, multimodal environmental input and perform grounded reasoning per step to improve sequential decision-making for long-horizon tasks. However, a critical question remains: \textit{how can the reasoning capabilities of LRMs be harnessed intelligently and efficiently for long-horizon navigation tasks?} In simple scenes, agents are expected to act reflexively, while in complex ones they should engage in deliberate reasoning before acting.To achieve this, we introduce \textbf{H}ybr\textbf{i}d \textbf{R}eas\textbf{O}ning \textbf{Nav}igation (\textbf{HiRO-Nav}) agent, the first kind of agent capable of adaptively determining whether to perform thinking at every step based on its own action entropy. Specifically, by examining how the agent's action entropy evolves over the navigation trajectories, we observed that only a small fraction of actions exhibit high entropy, and these actions often steer the agent toward novel scenes or critical objects. Furthermore, studying the relationship between action entropy and task completion (i.e., Q-value) reveals that improving high-entropy actions contributes more positively to task success.Hence, we propose a tailored training pipeline comprising hybrid supervised fine-tuning as a cold start, followed by online reinforcement learning with the proposed hybrid reasoning strategy to explicitly activate reasoning only for high-entropy actions, significantly reducing computational overhead while improving decision quality. Extensive experiments on the \textsc{CHORES}-$\mathbb{S}$ ObjectNav benchmark showcases that HiRO-Nav achieves a better trade-off between success rates and token efficiency than both dense-thinking and no-thinking baselines.
summary_zh: 基于大型推理模型构建的具身导航代理能够处理复杂的多模态环境输入，并执行每一步的落地推理，从而提升长周期任务中的序列决策能力。然而，一个关键问题依然存在：如何智能且高效地利用大型推理模型的推理能力来完成长周期导航任务？在简单场景中，代理应具备反射式行动能力；而在复杂场景中，代理则需要在行动前进行审慎推理。为实现这一目标，我们提出了**混合推理导航**代理，这是首类能够根据自身动作熵自适应决定每步是否进行推理的智能体。具体而言，通过分析代理在导航轨迹中动作熵的动态演变，我们发现仅有少量动作呈现出高熵特征，且这些动作往往将代理导向新场景或关键目标。进一步研究动作熵与任务完成度（即Q值）的关系表明，提升高熵动作的决策质量对任务成功率具有更显著的积极影响。为此，我们设计了一套定制化训练流程：首先通过混合监督微调实现冷启动，随后采用提出的混合推理策略进行在线强化学习，该策略仅针对高熵动作显式激活推理过程，在显著降低计算开销的同时提升决策质量。在CHORES-S ObjectNav基准测试上的大量实验表明，相比全程推理与无推理基线方法，HiRO-Nav在成功率与计算效率之间取得了更优的平衡。
tldr: This paper proposes HiRO-Nav, an embodied navigation agent that uses a hybrid reasoning strategy to adaptively trigger computationally expensive reasoning from a large reasoning model only for high-entropy actions, improving efficiency and performance on long-horizon navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HiRO-Nav导航智能体，采用混合推理策略，仅针对高熵动作自适应地触发大模型进行复杂推理，从而在长期导航任务中实现了效率与性能的更好平衡。

title: LAMP: Lift Image-Editing as General 3D Priors for Open-world Manipulation
summary: Human-like generalization in open-world remains a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation. Existing learning-based methods, including reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and vision-language-action-models (VLAs), often struggle with novel tasks and unseen environments. Another promising direction is to explore generalizable representations that capture fine-grained spatial and geometric relations for open-world manipulation. While large-language-model (LLMs) and vision-language-model (VLMs) provide strong semantic reasoning based on language or annotated 2D representations, their limited 3D awareness restricts their applicability to fine-grained manipulation. To address this, we propose LAMP, which lifts image-editing as 3D priors to extract inter-object 3D transformations as continuous, geometry-aware representations. Our key insight is that image-editing inherently encodes rich 2D spatial cues, and lifting these implicit cues into 3D transformations provides fine-grained and accurate guidance for open-world manipulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \codename delivers precise 3D transformations and achieves strong zero-shot generalization in open-world manipulation. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/LAMP/.
summary_zh: 在开放世界中实现类人泛化能力仍然是机器人操作领域的核心挑战。现有基于学习的方法，包括强化学习、模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），在面对新任务和未见环境时往往表现不佳。另一条有前景的路径是探索可泛化的表征方法，以捕捉开放世界操作中细粒度的空间与几何关系。尽管大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）能够基于语言或标注的二维表征提供强大的语义推理能力，但其有限的三维感知能力制约了它们在细粒度操作任务中的应用。为此，我们提出LAMP方法，通过将图像编辑提升为三维先验知识，提取物体间的三维变换作为连续、几何感知的表征。我们的核心思路是：图像编辑本身编码了丰富的二维空间信息，将这些隐含线索提升至三维变换层面，能够为开放世界操作提供细粒度且精确的指导。大量实验表明，LAMP能够生成精确的三维变换，并在开放世界操作任务中实现强大的零样本泛化能力。项目主页：https://zju3dv.github.io/LAMP/。
tldr: LAMP lifts 2D image-editing priors into 3D transformations to provide geometry-aware representations for fine-grained, open-world robot manipulation, achieving strong zero-shot generalization.
tldr_zh: LAMP 将图像编辑先验提升为 3D 变换，以提供几何感知的表示，用于精细、开放世界的机器人操作，实现了强大的零样本泛化能力。

title: Visually-grounded Humanoid Agents
summary: Digital human generation has been studied for decades and supports a wide range of real-world applications. However, most existing systems are passively animated, relying on privileged state or scripted control, which limits scalability to novel environments. We instead ask: how can digital humans actively behave using only visual observations and specified goals in novel scenes? Achieving this would enable populating any 3D environments with digital humans at scale that exhibit spontaneous, natural, goal-directed behaviors. To this end, we introduce Visually-grounded Humanoid Agents, a coupled two-layer (world-agent) paradigm that replicates humans at multiple levels: they look, perceive, reason, and behave like real people in real-world 3D scenes. The World Layer reconstructs semantically rich 3D Gaussian scenes from real-world videos via an occlusion-aware pipeline and accommodates animatable Gaussian-based human avatars. The Agent Layer transforms these avatars into autonomous humanoid agents, equipping them with first-person RGB-D perception and enabling them to perform accurate, embodied planning with spatial awareness and iterative reasoning, which is then executed at the low level as full-body actions to drive their behaviors in the scene. We further introduce a benchmark to evaluate humanoid-scene interaction in diverse reconstructed environments. Experiments show our agents achieve robust autonomous behavior, yielding higher task success rates and fewer collisions than ablations and state-of-the-art planning methods. This work enables active digital human population and advances human-centric embodied AI. Data, code, and models will be open-sourced.
summary_zh: 数字人生成技术历经数十年研究，已支撑众多现实应用。然而现有系统大多依赖预设状态或脚本控制实现被动式驱动，这限制了其在未知环境中的可扩展性。我们提出新问题：数字人如何仅通过视觉观察与既定目标，在陌生场景中实现主动行为？该能力的实现将使大规模数字人入驻任意三维环境成为可能，并展现出自主、自然、目标导向的行为模式。为此，我们提出视觉基础人形智能体——一种耦合的双层（世界层-智能体层）范式，在多层面复现人类特质：能够在真实三维场景中像真人一样观察、感知、推理与行动。世界层通过遮挡感知重建流程，从真实世界视频中构建语义丰富的三维高斯场景，并适配基于可动画高斯建模的数字人化身；智能体层则将化身转化为自主人形智能体，赋予其第一人称RGB-D感知能力，使其能够基于空间感知与迭代推理实现精确的具身规划，最终通过底层全身动作执行驱动场景行为。我们进一步构建基准测试以评估多样化重建环境中的人形-场景交互。实验表明，相较于消融实验与现有先进规划方法，本系统智能体展现出更强的自主行为能力，实现更高任务成功率与更低碰撞率。此项工作为主动型数字人规模化部署提供支持，并推动以人为中心的具身人工智能发展。数据、代码与模型将全部开源。
tldr: This paper introduces a system for creating autonomous digital human agents that perceive and act in 3D environments using only first-person RGB-D vision and goal specifications, enabling them to plan and execute full-body actions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种系统，用于创建仅使用第一人称RGB-D视觉和指定目标在3D环境中感知和行动的自主体数字人代理，使其能够规划并执行全身动作。

title: Exploring Temporal Representation in Neural Processes for Multimodal Action Prediction
summary: Inspired by the human ability to understand and predict others, we study the applicability of Conditional Neural Processes (CNP) to the task of self-supervised multimodal action prediction in robotics. Following recent results regarding the ontogeny of the Mirror Neuron System (MNS), we focus on the preliminary objective of self-actions prediction. We find a good MNS-inspired model in the existing Deep Modality Blending Network (DMBN), able to reconstruct the visuo-motor sensory signal during a partially observed action sequence by leveraging the probabilistic generation of CNP. After a qualitative and quantitative evaluation, we highlight its difficulties in generalizing to unseen action sequences, and identify the cause in its inner representation of time. Therefore, we propose a revised version, termed DMBN-Positional Time Encoding (DMBN-PTE), that facilitates learning a more robust representation of temporal information, and provide preliminary results of its effectiveness in expanding the applicability of the architecture. DMBN-PTE figures as a first step in the development of robotic systems that autonomously learn to forecast actions on longer time scales refining their predictions with incoming observations.
summary_zh: 受人类理解与预测他人能力启发，本研究探索条件神经过程（CNP）在机器人自监督多模态动作预测任务中的适用性。基于近期关于镜像神经元系统（MNS）个体发育的研究成果，我们聚焦于自我动作预测这一基础目标。现有深度模态混合网络（DMBN）通过结合CNP的概率生成机制，能在部分观测的动作序列中重建视觉-运动感知信号，成为符合MNS启发的理想模型。经过定性与定量评估，我们发现该模型在泛化至未见过动作序列时存在困难，并确定其时间内部表征是主要原因。为此，我们提出改进版本DMBN-位置时间编码（DMBN-PTE），通过强化时间信息的鲁棒性表征，初步验证了该架构在拓展应用范围方面的有效性。DMBN-PTE为开发能够自主预测长时程动作、并随观测实时优化预测的机器人系统迈出了关键一步。
tldr: This paper proposes a revised Conditional Neural Process model, DMBN-PTE, with improved temporal representation for self-supervised multimodal action prediction, evaluated in a robotics context.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的条件神经过程模型DMBN-PTE，通过增强时间表征能力，用于机器人场景下的自监督多模态动作预测。

title: EvoGymCM: Harnessing Continuous Material Stiffness for Soft Robot Co-Design
summary: In the automated co-design of soft robots, precisely adapting the material stiffness field to task environments is crucial for unlocking their full physical potential. However, mainstream platforms (e.g., EvoGym) strictly discretize the material dimension, artificially restricting the design space and performance of soft robots. To address this, we propose EvoGymCM (EvoGym with Continuous Materials), a benchmark suite formally establishing continuous material stiffness as a first-class design variable alongside morphology and control. Aligning with real-world material mechanisms, EvoGymCM introduces two settings: (i) EvoGymCM-R (Reactive), motivated by programmable materials with dynamically tunable stiffness; and (ii) EvoGymCM-I (Invariant), motivated by traditional materials with invariant stiffness fields. To tackle the resulting high-dimensional coupling, we formulate two Morphology-Material-Control co-design paradigms: (i) Reactive-Material Co-Design, which learns real-time stiffness tuning policies to guide programmable materials; and (ii) Invariant-Material Co-Design, which jointly optimizes morphology and fixed material fields to guide traditional material fabrication. Systematic experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate that continuous material optimization boosts performance and unlocks synergy across morphology, material, and control.
summary_zh: 在软体机器人自动化协同设计中，精确根据任务环境适配材料刚度场对于释放其物理潜能至关重要。然而主流平台（如EvoGym）将材料维度严格离散化，人为限制了软体机器人的设计空间与性能表现。为此，我们提出EvoGymCM（支持连续材料的EvoGym）——一个将连续材料刚度正式确立为与形态、控制并行的首要设计变量的基准套件。通过贴合现实材料机制，EvoGymCM引入两种设定：（一）EvoGymCM-R（反应型），其设计灵感源于具有动态可调刚度的可编程材料；（二）EvoGymCM-I（恒定型），其设计动机源于具有恒定刚度场的传统材料。为应对由此产生的高维度耦合问题，我们构建了两种形态-材料-控制协同设计范式：（一）反应型材料协同设计，通过实时学习刚度调节策略来指导可编程材料；（二）恒定型材料协同设计，通过联合优化形态与固定材料场来指导传统材料制造。跨多种任务的系统实验表明，连续材料优化显著提升了性能表现，并释放了形态、材料与控制三者之间的协同效应。
tldr: This paper introduces EvoGymCM, a benchmark suite for soft robot co-design that treats continuous material stiffness as a core design variable, enabling optimization of morphology, material properties, and control policies.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了EvoGymCM，一个用于软体机器人协同设计的基准套件，将连续材料刚度作为核心设计变量，实现了形态、材料属性和控制策略的联合优化。

title: Governed Capability Evolution for Embodied Agents: Safe Upgrade, Compatibility Checking, and Runtime Rollback for Embodied Capability Modules
summary:
Embodied agents are increasingly expected to improve over time by updating their executable capabilities rather than rewriting the agent itself. Prior work has separately studied modular capability packaging, capability evolution, and runtime governance. However, a key systems problem remains underexplored: once an embodied capability module evolves into a new version, how can the hosting system deploy it safely without breaking policy constraints, execution assumptions, or recovery guarantees?
  We formulate governed capability evolution as a first-class systems problem for embodied agents. We propose a lifecycle-aware upgrade framework in which every new capability version is treated as a governed deployment candidate rather than an immediately executable replacement. The framework introduces four upgrade compatibility checks -- interface, policy, behavioral, and recovery -- and organizes them into a staged runtime pipeline comprising candidate validation, sandbox evaluation, shadow deployment, gated activation, online monitoring, and rollback.
  We evaluate over 6 rounds of capability upgrade with 15 random seeds. Naive upgrade achieves 72.9% task success but drives unsafe activation to 60% by the final round; governed upgrade retains comparable success (67.4%) while maintaining zero unsafe activations across all rounds (Wilcoxon p=0.003). Shadow deployment reveals 40% of regressions invisible to sandbox evaluation alone, and rollback succeeds in 79.8% of post-activation drift scenarios.
summary_zh:
具身智能体日益需要通过更新其可执行能力而非重写智能体本身来实现持续改进。现有研究已分别探讨了模块化能力封装、能力演进与运行时治理，但一个关键系统问题仍未得到充分探索：当具身能力模块演进为新版本后，主机系统如何在不断违反策略约束、执行假设或恢复保证的前提下安全部署该版本？

我们将治理能力演进确立为具身智能体的首要系统问题，提出一种生命周期感知的升级框架。该框架将每个新能力版本视为受治理的部署候选而非即时可执行替代品，通过引入接口兼容性、策略兼容性、行为兼容性与恢复兼容性四重检查机制，构建包含候选验证、沙箱评估、影子部署、门控激活、在线监测与回滚操作的阶段性运行时管道。

经15组随机种子、6轮能力升级实验评估：原始升级方案虽能实现72.9%的任务成功率，但在最终轮次导致不安全激活率达60%；治理升级方案在保持相当成功率（67.4%）的同时，实现所有轮次零不安全激活（Wilcoxon检验p=0.003）。影子部署检测到沙箱评估无法发现的40%性能退化案例，而在激活后漂移场景中，回滚操作成功率可达79.8%。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for safely evolving the capabilities of embodied agents through staged upgrades, compatibility checks, and runtime rollback, aiming to prevent unsafe activations and ensure policy compliance.
tldr_zh: 本文为具身智能体提出了一个框架，通过分阶段升级、兼容性检查和运行时回滚来安全地演进其能力，旨在防止不安全的激活并确保策略合规性。

title: Karma Mechanisms for Decentralised, Cooperative Multi Agent Path Finding
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a fundamental coordination problem in large-scale robotic and cyber-physical systems, where multiple agents must compute conflict-free trajectories with limited computational and communication resources. While centralised optimal solvers provide guarantees on solution optimality, their exponential computational complexity limits scalability to large-scale systems and real-time applicability. Existing decentralised heuristics are faster, but result in suboptimal outcomes and high cost disparities. This paper proposes a decentralised coordination framework for cooperative MAPF based on Karma mechanisms - artificial, non-tradeable credits that account for agents' past cooperative behaviour and regulate future conflict resolution decisions. The approach formulates conflict resolution as a bilateral negotiation process that enables agents to resolve conflicts through pairwise replanning while promoting long-term fairness under limited communication and without global priority structures. The mechanism is evaluated in a lifelong robotic warehouse multi-agent pickup-and-delivery scenario with kinematic orientation constraints. The results highlight that the Karma mechanism balances replanning effort across agents, reducing disparity in service times without sacrificing overall efficiency. Code: https://github.com/DerKevinRiehl/karma_dmapf
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是大规模机器人及信息物理系统中的基础协调问题，多个智能体需在有限的计算与通信资源下规划无冲突的移动轨迹。虽然集中式最优求解器能保证解的优化性，但其指数级计算复杂度限制了大规模系统的可扩展性与实时应用性。现有分散式启发算法虽速度更快，但会导致结果次优及高昂的成本差异。本文提出一种基于Karma机制的分散式协作多智能体路径规划协调框架——Karma是一种人工设定且不可交易的信用积分，用于记录智能体过往协作行为并调控未来的冲突解决决策。该方法将冲突解决构建为双边协商过程，使智能体能通过成对重规划解决冲突，同时在有限通信且无全局优先级结构的条件下促进长期公平性。该机制在具有运动方向约束的终身机器人仓库多智能体取送货场景中进行评估。结果表明，Karma机制能平衡智能体间的重规划代价，在不牺牲整体效率的前提下减少服务时间差异。代码仓库：https://github.com/DerKevinRiehl/karma_dmapf
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized, cooperative Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) framework using Karma mechanisms, which are non-tradeable credits, to resolve agent conflicts through bilateral negotiation, promoting long-term fairness. It is evaluated in a lifelong robotic warehouse scenario with kinematic constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于业力（Karma）机制的去中心化、协作式多智能体路径规划框架，该机制通过不可交易的信誉记录智能体的合作历史，并通过双边协商解决冲突以促进长期公平性，并在一个具有运动学约束的终身机器人仓库场景中进行了评估。

title: Learning Without Losing Identity: Capability Evolution for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents are expected to operate persistently in dynamic physical environments, continuously acquiring new capabilities over time. Existing approaches to improving agent performance often rely on modifying the agent itself -- through prompt engineering, policy updates, or structural redesign -- leading to instability and loss of identity in long-lived systems. In this work, we propose a capability-centric evolution paradigm for embodied agents. We argue that a robot should maintain a persistent agent as its cognitive identity, while enabling continuous improvement through the evolution of its capabilities. Specifically, we introduce the concept of Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), which represent modular, versioned units of embodied functionality that can be learned, refined, and composed over time. We present a unified framework in which capability evolution is decoupled from agent identity. Capabilities evolve through a closed-loop process involving task execution, experience collection, model refinement, and module updating, while all executions are governed by a runtime layer that enforces safety and policy constraints. We demonstrate through simulated embodied tasks that capability evolution improves task success rates from 32.4% to 91.3% over 20 iterations, outperforming both agent-modification baselines and established skill-learning methods (SPiRL, SkiMo), while preserving zero policy drift and zero safety violations. Our results suggest that separating agent identity from capability evolution provides a scalable and safe foundation for long-term embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 具身智能体需在动态物理环境中持续运行，并随时间不断提升能力。现有提升智能体性能的方法通常依赖于修改智能体本身——通过提示工程、策略更新或结构重构——这会导致长期运行系统的不稳定性和身份丢失。本研究提出一种以能力为中心的具身智能体进化范式。我们认为机器人应保持持久智能体作为其认知身份，同时通过能力进化实现持续改进。具体而言，我们引入具身能力模块概念，这些模块代表模块化、版本化的具身功能单元，可随时间进行学习、优化和组合。我们提出一个统一框架，其中能力进化与智能体身份解耦：能力通过任务执行、经验收集、模型精化与模块更新的闭环过程实现进化，而所有执行由运行时层统一管控，确保安全策略约束。通过在仿真具身任务中的实验表明，能力进化机制经过20次迭代将任务成功率从32.4%提升至91.3%，其表现优于智能体修改基线方法及现有技能学习方法，同时保持零策略漂移与零安全违规。实验结果表明，将智能体身份与能力进化分离能为长期具身智能提供可扩展且安全的基础框架。
tldr: This paper introduces a capability-centric evolution paradigm using modular Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs) for embodied agents, decoupling persistent agent identity from skill improvement, which improves task success rates while maintaining safety and zero policy drift.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向具身智能体的能力中心进化范式，使用模块化、可版本化的具身能力模块（ECM），将智能体身份与能力改进解耦，在保持安全性和零策略漂移的同时显著提升了任务成功率。

title: How Far Are Large Multimodal Models from Human-Level Spatial Action? A Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Embodied Navigation in Urban Airspace
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) show strong visual-linguistic reasoning but their capacity for spatial decision-making and action remains unclear. In this work, we investigate whether LMMs can achieve embodied spatial action like human through a challenging scenario: goal-oriented navigation in urban 3D spaces. We first spend over 500 hours constructing a dataset comprising 5,037 high-quality goal-oriented navigation samples, with an emphasis on 3D vertical actions and rich urban semantic information. Then, we comprehensively assess 17 representative models, including non-reasoning LMMs, reasoning LMMs, agent-based methods, and vision-language-action models. Experiments show that current LMMs exhibit emerging action capabilities, yet remain far from human-level performance. Furthermore, we reveal an intriguing phenomenon: navigation errors do not accumulate linearly but instead diverge rapidly from the destination after a critical decision bifurcation. The limitations of LMMs are investigated by analyzing their behavior at these critical decision bifurcations. Finally, we experimentally explore four promising directions for improvement: geometric perception, cross-view understanding, spatial imagination, and long-term memory. The project is available at: https://github.com/serenditipy-AC/Embodied-Navigation-Bench.
summary_zh: 大规模多模态模型展现出强大的视觉-语言推理能力，但其空间决策与行动能力仍不明确。本研究通过一个具有挑战性的场景——城市三维空间中的目标导向导航，探索大规模多模态模型能否实现类人的具身空间行动。我们首先投入超过500小时构建了包含5,037个高质量目标导向导航样本的数据集，重点关注三维垂直行动与丰富的城市语义信息。随后对17个代表性模型进行了全面评估，包括非推理型大规模多模态模型、推理型大规模多模态模型、基于智能体的方法以及视觉-语言-行动模型。实验表明，当前大规模多模态模型虽已显现初步行动能力，但仍远未达到人类水平。研究进一步发现一个有趣现象：导航误差并非线性累积，而是在关键决策分岔点后迅速偏离目标。通过分析这些关键决策分岔点的模型行为，我们深入探讨了大规模多模态模型的局限性。最后，我们通过实验探索了四个有潜力的改进方向：几何感知、跨视角理解、空间想象与长时记忆。项目地址为：https://github.com/serenditipy-AC/Embodied-Navigation-Bench。
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models (LMMs) on goal-oriented, 3D embodied navigation in urban environments, finding their action capabilities emergent but still far from human performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个用于评估大语言模型在城市场景中进行三维目标导向、具身导航的基准测试，发现其行动能力虽然初步显现，但仍远不及人类水平。

title: DailyArt: Discovering Articulation from Single Static Images via Latent Dynamics
summary: Articulated objects are essential for embodied AI and world models, yet inferring their kinematics from a single closed-state image remains challenging because crucial motion cues are often occluded. Existing methods either require multi-state observations or rely on explicit part priors, retrieval, or other auxiliary inputs that partially expose the structure to be inferred. In this work, we present DailyArt, which formulates articulated joint estimation from a single static image as a synthesis-mediated reasoning problem. Instead of directly regressing joints from a heavily occluded observation, DailyArt first synthesizes a maximally articulated opened state under the same camera view to expose articulation cues, and then estimates the full set of joint parameters from the discrepancy between the observed and synthesized states. Using a set-prediction formulation, DailyArt recovers all joints simultaneously without requiring object-specific templates, multi-view inputs, or explicit part annotations at test time. Taking estimated joints as conditions, the framework further supports part-level novel state synthesis as a downstream capability. Extensive experiments show that DailyArt achieves strong performance in articulated joint estimation and supports part-level novel state synthesis conditioned on joints. Project page is available at https://rangooo123.github.io/DaliyArt.github.io/.
summary_zh: 关节物体对具身人工智能和世界模型至关重要，然而仅从单一闭合状态图像推断其运动学仍具有挑战性，因为关键运动线索常常被遮挡。现有方法要么需要多状态观察数据，要么依赖于显式部件先验、检索或其他辅助输入，这些方法部分暴露了待推断的结构信息。本研究提出DailyArt方法，将单张静态图像的关节估计问题构建为合成介导的推理任务。该方法不直接从严重遮挡的观测结果中回归关节参数，而是首先在同一相机视角下合成一个最大化张开的关节状态以揭示运动线索，随后通过对比观测状态与合成状态之间的差异来估计完整的关节参数集合。基于集合预测的建模框架，DailyArt无需物体特定模板、多视角输入或测试时的显式部件标注，即可同时恢复所有关节信息。该框架进一步将估计的关节参数作为条件，支持部件级新状态合成作为下游能力。大量实验表明，DailyArt在关节参数估计方面表现优异，并能支持基于关节条件的部件级新状态合成。项目页面详见：https://rangooo123.github.io/DaliyArt.github.io/。
tldr: DailyArt infers articulation parameters of objects from single static images by synthesizing a fully-opened state and analyzing the discrepancy between observed and synthesized states, without needing multi-view or annotated data at test time.
tldr_zh: DailyArt从单张静态图像推断物体的铰接参数，其方法是通过合成完全打开状态，并分析观察状态与合成状态之间的差异，无需在测试时使用多视角或标注数据。

title: MotionScape: A Large-Scale Real-World Highly Dynamic UAV Video Dataset for World Models
summary: Recent advances in world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in simulating physical reality, making them an increasingly important foundation for embodied intelligence. For UAV agents in particular, accurate prediction of complex 3D dynamics is essential for autonomous navigation and robust decision-making in unconstrained environments. However, under the highly dynamic camera trajectories typical of UAV views, existing world models often struggle to maintain spatiotemporal physical consistency. A key reason lies in the distribution bias of current training data: most existing datasets exhibit restricted 2.5D motion patterns, such as ground-constrained autonomous driving scenes or relatively smooth human-centric egocentric videos, and therefore lack realistic high-dynamic 6-DoF UAV motion priors. To address this gap, we present MotionScape, a large-scale real-world UAV-view video dataset with highly dynamic motion for world modeling. MotionScape contains over 30 hours of 4K UAV-view videos, totaling more than 4.5M frames. This novel dataset features semantically and geometrically aligned training samples, where diverse real-world UAV videos are tightly coupled with accurate 6-DoF camera trajectories and fine-grained natural language descriptions. To build the dataset, we develop an automated multi-stage processing pipeline that integrates CLIP-based relevance filtering, temporal segmentation, robust visual SLAM for trajectory recovery, and large-language-model-driven semantic annotation. Extensive experiments show that incorporating such semantically and geometrically aligned annotations effectively improves the ability of existing world models to simulate complex 3D dynamics and handle large viewpoint shifts, thereby benefiting decision-making and planning for UAV agents in complex environments. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/Thelegendzz/MotionScape
summary_zh: 世界模型的最新进展展现出强大的物理现实模拟能力，使其逐渐成为具身智能的重要基础。特别是对于无人机智能体，准确预测复杂的三维动态特性对于无约束环境下的自主导航与鲁棒决策至关重要。然而，在无人机视角特有的高动态相机轨迹下，现有世界模型往往难以保持时空物理一致性。其核心原因在于当前训练数据的分布偏差：多数现有数据集呈现受限的2.5维运动模式，如地面受限的自动驾驶场景或相对平缓的以人为中心的第一人称视频，因而缺乏真实的高动态六自由度无人机运动先验。为弥补这一空白，我们推出MotionScape——一个面向世界建模的大规模真实世界高动态无人机视角视频数据集。MotionScape包含超过30小时的4K无人机视角视频，总计逾450万帧。该创新数据集具有语义与几何对齐的训练样本特征，其中多样化的真实无人机视频与精确的六自由度相机轨迹及细粒度自然语言描述紧密耦合。为构建数据集，我们开发了自动化多阶段处理流程，整合了基于CLIP的相关性过滤、时序分割、鲁棒视觉SLAM轨迹重建以及大语言模型驱动的语义标注。大量实验表明，引入此类语义与几何对齐的标注能有效提升现有世界模型模拟复杂三维动态、处理大视角变化的能力，从而助力无人机智能体在复杂环境中的决策与规划。本数据集已在https://github.com/Thelegendzz/MotionScape公开。
tldr: A large-scale UAV video dataset for training world models, with 6-DoF camera trajectories and language descriptions, aimed at improving dynamic scene prediction for UAV agents.
tldr_zh: 一个用于训练世界模型的大规模无人机视频数据集，包含6-DoF相机轨迹和语言描述，旨在提升无人机在复杂环境下的动态场景预测能力。

title: AgiPIX: Bridging Simulation and Reality in Indoor Aerial Inspection
summary: Autonomous indoor flight for critical asset inspection presents fundamental challenges in perception, planning, control, and learning. Despite rapid progress, there is still a lack of a compact, active-sensing, open-source platform that is reproducible across simulation and real-world operation. To address this gap, we present Agipix, a co-designed open hardware and software platform for indoor aerial autonomy and critical asset inspection. Agipix features a compact, hardware-synchronized active-sensing platform with onboard GPU-accelerated compute that is capable of agile flight; a containerized ROS~2-based modular autonomy stack; and a photorealistic digital twin of the hardware platform together with a reliable UI. These elements enable rapid iteration via zero-shot transfer of containerized autonomy components between simulation and real flights. We demonstrate trajectory tracking and exploration performance using onboard sensing in industrial indoor environments. All hardware designs, simulation assets, and containerized software are released openly together with documentation.
summary_zh: 面向关键资产检测的室内自主飞行在感知、规划、控制与学习方面存在根本性挑战。尽管进展迅速，目前仍缺乏一种可在仿真与实景操作间复现的紧凑型主动感知开源平台。为填补这一空白，本文提出Agipix——一个为室内空中自主系统及关键资产检测而协同设计的开源软硬件平台。Agipix具备以下特点：搭载板载GPU加速计算单元、可实现敏捷飞行的紧凑型硬件同步主动感知平台；基于容器化ROS~2的模块化自主系统栈；硬件平台的高保真数字孪生体及可靠用户界面。这些组件通过容器化自主模块在仿真与真实飞行间的零样本迁移，实现了快速迭代。我们在工业室内环境中利用板载传感器展示了平台的轨迹跟踪与自主探索性能。所有硬件设计、仿真资产及容器化软件均与文档一同公开发布。
tldr: Presents AgiPIX, an open-source hardware and software platform for autonomous indoor aerial inspection, featuring a compact active-sensing drone and a digital twin for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of autonomy components.
tldr_zh: 提出了AgiPIX，一个用于自主室内空中检测的开源软硬件平台，包含紧凑型主动感知无人机和数字孪生，用于自主组件的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

title: SANDO: Safe Autonomous Trajectory Planning for Dynamic Unknown Environments
summary: SANDO is a safe trajectory planner for 3D dynamic unknown environments, where obstacle locations and motions are unknown a priori and a collision-free plan can become unsafe at any moment, requiring fast replanning. Existing soft-constraint planners are fast but cannot guarantee collision-free paths, while hard-constraint methods ensure safety at the cost of longer computation. SANDO addresses this trade-off through three contributions. First, a heat map-based A* global planner steers paths away from high-risk regions using soft costs, and a spatiotemporal safe flight corridor (STSFC) generator produces time-layered polytopes that inflate obstacles only by their worst-case reachable set at each time layer, rather than by the worst case over the entire horizon. Second, trajectory optimization is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Quadratic Program (MIQP) with hard collision-avoidance constraints, and a variable elimination technique reduces the number of decision variables, enabling fast computation. Third, a formal safety analysis establishes collision-free guarantees under explicit velocity-bound and estimation-error assumptions. Ablation studies show that variable elimination yields up to 7.4x speedup in optimization time, and that STSFCs are critical for feasibility in dense dynamic environments. Benchmark simulations against state-of-the-art methods across standardized static benchmarks, obstacle-rich static forests, and dynamic environments show that SANDO consistently achieves the highest success rate with no constraint violations across all difficulty levels; perception-only experiments without ground truth obstacle information confirm robust performance under realistic sensing. Hardware experiments on a UAV with fully onboard planning, perception, and localization demonstrate six safe flights in static environments and ten safe flights among dynamic obstacles.
summary_zh: SANDO是一种面向三维动态未知环境的安全轨迹规划器，该环境中障碍物位置与运动状态均未知，且无碰撞路径可能随时失效，需进行快速重规划。现有软约束规划器虽速度快但无法保证路径无碰撞，而硬约束方法虽确保安全却需付出更长计算时间。SANDO通过三项创新解决这一权衡问题：首先，基于热图的A*全局规划器采用软代价引导路径避开高风险区域，时空安全飞行走廊（STSFC）生成器构建时间分层多面体，其仅根据各时间层障碍物的最坏可达集进行膨胀，而非整个时间跨度内的最坏情况。其次，将轨迹优化建模为具有硬避碰约束的混合整数二次规划（MIQP），并采用变量消除技术减少决策变量数量，实现快速求解。第三，通过形式化安全分析，在明确速度边界与估计误差假设下建立了无碰撞保证。消融研究表明变量消除技术可使优化时间加速高达7.4倍，且STSFC在密集动态环境中对保障可行性至关重要。在标准化静态基准测试、障碍物密集的静态森林及动态环境中的对比实验表明，SANDO在所有难度级别下始终保持最高成功率且无约束违反；仅依赖感知信息（无地面真值障碍物数据）的实验验证了其在现实传感条件下的鲁棒性。搭载全机载规划、感知与定位系统的无人机硬件实验表明，在静态环境中完成六次安全飞行，在动态障碍物环境中完成十次安全飞行。
