tldr: Proposes GazeVLA, a framework that uses human gaze as a proxy for intention to bridge the human-robot embodiment gap, pretrains on egocentric human data, and uses a chain-of-thought approach for robotic manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 提出GazeVLA框架，利用人类凝视作为意图代理来弥合人-机器人具身性差距，在自我中心人类数据上预训练，并使用思维链方法进行机器人操作，取得了最先进的性能。

title: GCImOpt: Learning efficient goal-conditioned policies by imitating optimal trajectories
summary: Imitation learning is a well-established approach for machine-learning-based control. However, its applicability depends on having access to demonstrations, which are often expensive to collect and/or suboptimal for solving the task. In this work, we present GCImOpt, an approach to learn efficient goal-conditioned policies by training on datasets generated by trajectory optimization. Our approach for dataset generation is computationally efficient, can generate thousands of optimal trajectories in minutes on a laptop computer, and produces high-quality demonstrations. Further, by means of a data augmentation scheme that treats intermediate states as goals, we are able to increase the training dataset size by an order of magnitude. Using our generated datasets, we train goal-conditioned neural network policies that can control the system towards arbitrary goals. To demonstrate the generality of our approach, we generate datasets and then train policies for various control tasks, namely cart-pole stabilization, planar and three-dimensional quadcopter stabilization, and point reaching using a 6-DoF robot arm. We show that our trained policies can achieve high success rates and near-optimal control profiles, all while being small (less than 80,000 neural network parameters) and fast enough (up to more than 6,000 times faster than a trajectory optimization solver) that they could be deployed onboard resource-constrained controllers. We provide videos, code, datasets and pre-trained policies under a free software license; see our project website https://jongoiko.github.io/gcimopt/.
summary_zh: 模仿学习是一种基于机器学习的成熟控制方法。然而，其适用性依赖于能否获取示教数据，而这些数据的采集往往成本高昂，且对于任务求解而言可能并非最优。本文提出GCImOpt方法，通过利用轨迹优化生成的数据集训练策略，以学习高效的目标条件策略。我们的数据集生成方法计算效率高，可在笔记本电脑上数分钟内生成数千条最优轨迹，并能产生高质量的示教数据。此外，通过采用将中间状态视为目标的数据增强方案，我们将训练数据集规模扩大了一个数量级。利用生成的数据集，我们训练了能够驱动系统朝向任意目标运动的目标条件神经网络策略。为验证方法的通用性，我们针对多种控制任务生成了数据集并训练了策略，包括：小车-摆杆稳定控制、平面及三维四旋翼飞行器稳定控制，以及使用6自由度机械臂的定点到达任务。实验表明，训练所得策略能够实现高成功率和接近最优的控制性能，同时其模型规模小（神经网络参数量少于8万）、运行速度快（比轨迹优化求解器快超过6000倍），足以部署在资源受限的控制器上。我们在自由软件许可下提供了视频、代码、数据集及预训练策略，详见项目网站：https://jongoiko.github.io/gcimopt/。
tldr: The paper presents GCImOpt, a method for learning efficient goal-conditioned policies by imitating optimal trajectories generated by a fast trajectory optimizer, demonstrated on robot control tasks like quadcopter and 6-DoF arm manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GCImOpt，一种通过模仿快速轨迹优化器生成的优化轨迹来学习高效目标条件策略的方法，并在四旋翼和6自由度机械臂等机器人控制任务上进行了验证。

title: ATRS: Adaptive Trajectory Re-splitting via a Shared Neural Policy for Parallel Optimization
summary: Parallel trajectory optimization via the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) has emerged as a scalable approach to long-horizon motion planning. However, existing frameworks typically decompose the problem into parallel subproblems based on a predefined fixed structure. Such structural rigidity often causes optimization stagnation in highly constrained regions, where a few lagging subproblems delay global convergence. A natural remedy is to adaptively re-split these stagnating segments online. Yet, deciding when, where, and how to split exceeds the capability of rule-based heuristics. To this end, we propose ATRS, a novel framework that embeds a shared Deep Reinforcement Learning policy into the parallel ADMM loop. We formulate this adaptive adjustment as a Multi-Agent Shared-Policy Markov Decision Process, where all trajectory segments act as homogeneous agents and share a unified neural policy network. This parameter-sharing architecture endows the system with size invariance, enabling it to handle dynamically changing segment counts during re-splitting and generalize to arbitrary trajectory lengths. Furthermore, our formulation inherently supports zero-shot generalization to unseen environments, as our network relies solely on the internal states of the numerical solver rather than on the geometric features of the environment. To ensure solver stability, a Confidence-Based Election mechanism selects only the most stagnating segment for re-splitting at each step. Extensive simulations demonstrate that ATRS accelerates convergence, reducing the number of iterations by up to 26.0% and the computation time by up to 19.1%. Real-world experiments further confirm its applicability to both large-scale offline global planning and real-time onboard replanning within 35 ms per cycle, with no sim-to-real degradation.
summary_zh: 基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的并行轨迹优化已成为一种可扩展的长时域运动规划方法。然而，现有框架通常基于预定义的固定结构将问题分解为并行子问题。这种结构刚性常常在高度受限的区域导致优化停滞，其中少数滞后的子问题会延迟全局收敛。一种自然的解决方案是在线自适应地重新分割这些停滞段。但决定何时、何地以及如何分割超出了基于规则启发式方法的能力范围。为此，我们提出ATRS——一种将共享深度强化学习策略嵌入并行ADMM循环的新框架。我们将这种自适应调整建模为多智能体共享策略马尔可夫决策过程，其中所有轨迹段作为同质智能体共享统一的神经网络策略。这种参数共享架构赋予系统尺寸不变性，使其能够在重新分割过程中处理动态变化的段数，并泛化到任意轨迹长度。此外，我们的框架本质上支持对未见环境的零样本泛化，因为网络仅依赖于数值求解器的内部状态，而非环境几何特征。为确保求解器稳定性，我们设计了基于置信度的选举机制，在每一步仅选择最停滞的段进行重新分割。大量仿真实验表明，ATRS能够加速收敛，将迭代次数减少高达26.0%，计算时间缩短高达19.1%。实际场景实验进一步验证了其在大规模离线全局规划与实时机载重规划中的应用能力，每周期规划时间不超过35毫秒，且未出现仿真到现实的性能衰减。
tldr: Proposes ATRS, a deep reinforcement learning-based framework for adaptive trajectory re-splitting within parallel ADMM optimization to accelerate motion planning convergence.
tldr_zh: 提出ATRS，一种基于深度强化学习的框架，在并行ADMM优化中进行自适应轨迹重分割，以加速运动规划的收敛。

title: RedVLA: Physical Red Teaming for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: The real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains limited by the risk of unpredictable and irreversible physical harm. However, we currently lack effective mechanisms to proactively detect these physical safety risks before deployment. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{RedVLA}, the first red teaming framework for physical safety in VLA models. We systematically uncover unsafe behaviors through a two-stage process: (I) \textbf{Risk Scenario Synthesis} constructs a valid and task-feasible initial risk scene. Specifically, it identifies critical interaction regions from benign trajectories and positions the risk factor within these regions, aiming to entangle it with the VLA's execution flow and elicit a target unsafe behavior. (II) \textbf{Risk Amplification} ensures stable elicitation across heterogeneous models. It iteratively refines the risk factor state through gradient-free optimization guided by trajectory features. Experiments on six representative VLA models show that RedVLA uncovers diverse unsafe behaviors and achieves the ASR up to 95.5\% within 10 optimization iterations. To mitigate these risks, we further propose SimpleVLA-Guard, a lightweight safety guard built from RedVLA-generated data. Our data, assets, and code are available \href{https://redvla.github.io}{here}.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在现实世界中的部署，仍受限于其可能引发不可预测且不可逆的物理伤害风险。然而，当前我们缺乏在模型部署前主动检测此类物理安全风险的有效机制。为弥补这一空白，本文提出首个面向VLA模型物理安全性的红队测试框架——**RedVLA**。我们通过两阶段流程系统性地揭示不安全行为：（I）**风险场景合成**：构建有效且任务可行的初始风险场景。具体而言，该方法从良性轨迹中识别关键交互区域，并将风险因素置于这些区域内，旨在使其与VLA模型的执行流程相纠缠，从而诱发目标不安全行为。（II）**风险放大**：确保在异构模型间稳定地诱发风险。该阶段通过轨迹特征指导的无梯度优化，迭代调整风险因素状态，以强化风险暴露。在六种代表性VLA模型上的实验表明，RedVLA能够发现多样化的不安全行为，并在10次优化迭代内使攻击成功率（ASR）最高达到95.5%。为缓解这些风险，我们进一步基于RedVLA生成的数据构建了轻量级安全防护模块SimpleVLA-Guard。相关数据、资源与代码已公开于\href{https://redvla.github.io}{此链接}。
tldr: RedVLA is a novel red teaming framework to proactively identify physical safety risks in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models through risk scenario synthesis and amplification, and proposes a lightweight safety guard for mitigation.
tldr_zh: RedVLA 是一个新颖的红队测试框架，通过风险场景合成和放大，主动识别视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的物理安全风险，并提出了一个轻量级的安全守护方案进行缓解。

title: QDTraj: Exploration of Diverse Trajectory Primitives for Articulated Objects Robotic Manipulation
summary:
Thanks to the latest advances in learning and robotics, domestic robots are beginning to enter homes, aiming to execute household chores autonomously. However, robots still struggle to perform autonomous manipulation tasks in open-ended environments. In this context, this paper presents a method that enables a robot to manipulate a wide spectrum of articulated objects.
  In this paper, we automatically generate different robot low-level trajectory primitives to manipulate given object articulations. A very important point when it comes to generating expert trajectories is to consider the diversity of solutions to achieve the same goal. Indeed, knowing diverse low-level primitives to accomplish the same task enables the robot to choose the optimal solution in its real-world environment, with live constraints and unexpected changes. To do so, we propose a method based on Quality-Diversity algorithms that leverages sparse reward exploration in order to generate a set of diverse and high-performing trajectory primitives for a given manipulation task.
  We validated our method, QDTraj, by generating diverse trajectories in simulation and deploying them in the real world. QDTraj generates at least 5 times more diverse trajectories for both hinge and slider activation tasks, outperforming the other methods we compared against. We assessed the generalization of our method over 30 articulations of the PartNetMobility articulated object dataset, with an average of 704 different trajectories by task. Code is publicly available at: https://kappel.web.isir.upmc.fr/trajectory_primitive_website
summary_zh:
得益于学习与机器人技术的最新进展，家用机器人正逐步进入家庭，致力于自主完成各类家务劳动。然而，在开放环境中执行自主操作任务对机器人而言仍然充满挑战。在此背景下，本文提出一种方法，使机器人能够广泛操作各类铰接物体。

本文通过自动生成不同的机器人底层轨迹基元来操作指定物体的铰接结构。在生成专家轨迹时，一个至关重要的考量是实现同一目标时解决方案的多样性。确实，掌握完成相同任务的不同底层基元能够让机器人在现实环境中根据实时约束和突发变化选择最优解决方案。为此，我们提出一种基于质量多样性算法的方法，利用稀疏奖励探索机制，为特定操作任务生成一组多样化且高性能的轨迹基元。

我们在仿真环境中通过生成多样化轨迹并在现实世界中进行部署，验证了所提方法QDTraj的有效性。在铰链和滑轨两类激活任务中，QDTraj生成的轨迹多样性至少达到其他对比方法的5倍以上。我们在PartNetMobility铰接物体数据集的30种铰接结构上评估了该方法的泛化能力，平均每项任务可生成704种不同轨迹。相关代码已公开于：https://kappel.web.isir.upmc.fr/trajectory_primitive_website
tldr: This paper presents QDTraj, a method using Quality-Diversity algorithms to generate diverse, high-performing low-level trajectory primitives for manipulating articulated objects, validated in simulation and real-world robot deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了QDTraj方法，利用质量-多样性算法为操纵铰接物体生成多样化的高性能底层轨迹基元，并在仿真和真实机器人部署中进行了验证。

title: Adaptive vs. Static Robot-to-Human Handover: A Study on Orientation and Approach Direction
summary: Robot-to-human handovers often rely on static, open-loop strategies (or, at best, approaches that adapt only the position), which generally do not consider how the object will be grasped by the human, thus requiring the user to adapt. This work presents a novel adaptive framework that dynamically adjusts the object's delivery pose in real time based on the user's hand pose and the intended downstream task. By integrating AI-based hand pose estimation with smooth, kinematically constrained trajectories, the system ensures a safe approach and an optimal handover orientation. A comprehensive user study compares the proposed adaptive approach against a static baseline across multiple tasks, evaluating both subjective metrics (NASA-TLX, Human-Robot Trust Scale) and objective physiological data (blink rate measured via wearable eye-trackers). The results demonstrate that dynamic alignment significantly reduces users' cognitive workload and physiological stress, while increasing perceived trust in the robot's reliability. These findings highlight the potential of task- and pose-aware systems for enabling fluid and ergonomic human-robot collaboration.
summary_zh: 机器人向人类的物品交接通常依赖于静态、开环策略（或至多采用仅调整位置的方法），这类策略通常未考虑人类如何抓握物体，因而要求用户自行适应。本研究提出了一种新型自适应框架，该框架能够基于用户手部姿态及预期后续任务，实时动态调整物品的递送姿态。通过将基于人工智能的手部姿态估计与平滑、运动学约束的轨迹相结合，系统确保了安全的接近过程与最优的交接方位。一项综合用户研究在多任务场景中，将所提出的自适应方法与静态基准方法进行对比，同时评估了主观指标（NASA任务负荷指数量表、人机信任量表）和客观生理数据（通过可穿戴眼动仪测量的眨眼频率）。结果表明，动态对齐能显著降低用户的认知负荷与生理压力，同时提升对机器人可靠性的感知信任度。这些发现凸显了具备任务与姿态感知能力的系统在实现流畅且符合人机工程学的人机协作方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents an adaptive robot-to-human handover framework that dynamically adjusts the object's delivery pose in real-time based on the user's hand pose and intended task, aiming to reduce user workload and increase trust.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种自适应机器人到人类物品递送框架，可根据用户手部姿态和后续任务实时调整递送姿态，旨在减少用户认知负荷并提升信任度。

title: False Feasibility in Variable Impedance MPC for Legged Locomotion
summary: Variable impedance model predictive control (MPC) formulations that treat joint stiffness as an instantaneous decision variable operate on a feasible set strictly larger than the physically realizable set under first-order actuator dynamics. We identify this as a formulation error rather than a modeling approximation, formalize the distinction between the parameter-based feasible set Fparam and the realizable set Freal, and characterize the regime of mismatch via the dimensionless parameter alpha = omega_sT (actuator bandwidth times task timescale). For the 1D hopping monoped, we prove that below an analytical threshold alpha_crit derived in closed form from task physics, no admissible stiffness command realizes the parameter-based prediction. Numerical validation in 1D shows monotonic deviation growth as alpha decreases, with the predicted scaling holding across ten parameter combinations (log-log R2 = 0.99). Mechanism transfer to planar spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics confirms center-of-mass and stance-timing deviation as the primary consequence, with regime-dependent friction effects as a tertiary observable. A second threshold alpha_infeas < alpha_crit establishes a floor below which restricting the admissible stiffness range cannot repair realizability, closing the conservative-tuning objection on structural grounds. Augmenting the prediction state with stiffness closes the mismatch by construction.
summary_zh: 将关节刚度作为瞬时决策变量的可变阻抗模型预测控制（MPC）方法，其可行域严格大于在一阶执行器动态下物理可实现的集合。我们认为这是一种公式错误而非建模近似，并形式化区分了基于参数的可行域Fparam与可实现域Freal，同时通过无量纲参数alpha = omega_sT（执行器带宽与任务时间尺度的乘积）刻画了二者失配的机制。对于一维跳跃单足模型，我们证明当alpha低于从任务物理特性推导出的闭合解析阈值alpha_crit时，不存在任何可容许的刚度指令能够实现基于参数的预测。在一维模型中的数值验证显示，随着alpha减小，偏差呈单调增长，且预测的标度关系在十组参数组合下均成立（对数坐标系决定系数R2 = 0.99）。该机制向平面弹簧负载倒立摆动态的迁移，证实其核心后果表现为质心偏移与站立时相偏差，并观察到次要的摩擦效应与机制相关。第二个阈值alpha_infeas < alpha_crit确立了临界下限，低于该值时即使限制刚度可调范围也无法恢复可实现性，从而从结构上消除了保守调参的异议。通过在预测状态中引入刚度变量，可从构造上消除此类失配问题。
tldr: This paper identifies a formulation error in variable impedance MPC for legged locomotion, where treating joint stiffness as an instantaneous decision variable creates a physically unrealizable feasible set. It characterizes the mismatch, provides analytical thresholds, and demonstrates the issue in 1D hopping and planar models, proposing a solution via state augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文指出腿部运动可变阻抗MPC中的一个建模错误，即将关节刚度作为瞬时决策变量会导致产生物理上不可行的解集。文章通过无量纲参数表征了该不匹配的机制，给出了解析阈值，并在一维和平面模型中验证了该问题，最终提出了通过状态增强的解决方案。

title: CodeGraphVLP: Code-as-Planner Meets Semantic-Graph State for Non-Markovian Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise generalist robot manipulation, but are typically trained and deployed as short-horizon policies that assume the latest observation is sufficient for action reasoning. This assumption breaks in non-Markovian long-horizon tasks, where task-relevant evidence can be occluded or appear only earlier in the trajectory, and where clutter and distractors make fine-grained visual grounding brittle. We present CodeGraphVLP, a hierarchical framework that enables reliable long-horizon manipulation by combining a persistent semantic-graph state with an executable code-based planner and progress-guided visual-language prompting. The semantic-graph maintains task-relevant entities and relations under partial observability. The synthesized planner executes over this semantic-graph to perform efficient progress checks and outputs a subtask instruction together with subtask-relevant objects. We use these outputs to construct clutter-suppressed observations that focus the VLA executor on critical evidence. On real-world non-Markovian tasks, CodeGraphVLP improves task completion over strong VLA baselines and history-enabled variants while substantially lowering planning latency compared to VLM-in-the-loop planning. We also conduct extensive ablation studies to confirm the contributions of each component.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型为实现通用机器人操作提供了可能，但通常在训练和部署时被设计为短视界策略，其假设最新观测足以支持动作推理。这一假设在非马尔可夫长视界任务中并不成立，因为任务相关的线索可能被遮挡或仅出现在轨迹早期，且环境中的杂乱与干扰物会使细粒度视觉定位变得脆弱。本文提出CodeGraphVLP，一种分层框架，通过将持久化语义图状态与可执行的代码规划器及进度引导的视觉-语言提示相结合，实现了可靠的长视界操作。语义图在部分可观测环境下维护任务相关的实体与关系；基于此语义图合成的规划器执行高效的进度检查，并输出子任务指令及相关目标对象。我们利用这些输出构建抑制环境杂乱的观测结果，使视觉-语言-动作执行器聚焦于关键信息。在真实世界的非马尔可夫任务中，CodeGraphVLP相较于强视觉-语言-动作基线及具备历史信息的变体提升了任务完成率，同时相比基于视觉语言模型的循环规划显著降低了规划延迟。我们还通过大量消融实验验证了各模块的贡献。
tldr: Presents a hierarchical VLA framework combining a persistent semantic-graph state and a code-based planner to improve long-horizon, non-Markovian robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个分层VLA框架，结合了持久化语义图状态和基于代码的规划器，以改善非马尔可夫的长时程机器人操作任务。

title: Learning-augmented robotic automation for real-world manufacturing
summary: Industrial robots are widely used in manufacturing, yet most manipulation still depends on fixed waypoint scripts that are brittle to environmental changes. Learning-based control offers a more adaptive alternative, but it remains unclear whether such methods, still mostly confined to laboratory demonstrations, can sustain hours of reliable operation, deliver consistent quality, and behave safely around people on a live production line. Here we present Learning-Augmented Robotic Automation, a hybrid system that integrates learned task controllers and a neural 3D safety monitor into conventional industrial workflows. We deployed the system on an electric-motor production line to automate deformable cable insertion and soldering under real manufacturing constraints, a step previously performed manually by human workers. With less than 20 min of real-world data per task, the system operated continuously for 5 h 10 min, producing 108 motors without physical fencing and achieving a 99.4% pass rate on product-level quality-control tests. It maintained near-human takt time while reducing variability in solder-joint quality and cycle time. These results establish a practical pathway for extending industrial automation with learning-based methods.
summary_zh: 工业机器人已广泛应用于制造业，但大多数操作仍依赖于固定的点位脚本，这些脚本对环境变化十分脆弱。基于学习的控制方法提供了更具适应性的替代方案，但这类大多仍局限于实验室演示的方法，能否在真实生产线上持续数小时可靠运行、保持稳定的产品质量，并在人员周围安全作业，目前尚不明确。本文提出"学习增强型机器人自动化系统"，这是一种混合系统，将学习型任务控制器和神经三维安全监控模块整合到传统工业流程中。我们将该系统部署于一条电机生产线，在真实的制造约束条件下实现了柔性线缆插入和焊接的自动化，这两个步骤先前一直由人工完成。每个任务仅需不到20分钟的真实世界数据，该系统即可连续运行5小时10分钟，在无物理隔离的情况下生产了108台电机，并在产品级质量检测中达到了99.4%的通过率。该系统在保持接近人工节拍时间的同时，减少了焊接接头质量和生产周期的波动性。这些成果为通过基于学习的方法扩展工业自动化开辟了可行路径。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid robotic system that combines learned controllers with safety monitoring for deformable cable insertion and soldering on a real factory line, demonstrating high reliability and quality for over 5 hours of continuous operation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合机器人系统，结合了学习控制器与安全监控，用于在真实工厂生产线上的可变形电缆插入和焊接，展示了超过5小时连续运行的高可靠性和产品质量。

title: An LLM-Driven Closed-Loop Autonomous Learning Framework for Robots Facing Uncovered Tasks in Open Environments
summary: Autonomous robots operating in open environments need the ability to continuously handle tasks that are not covered by predefined local methods. However, existing approaches often rely on repeated large-language-model (LLM) interaction for uncovered tasks, and even successful executions or observed successful external behaviors are not always autonomously transformed into reusable local knowledge. In this paper, we propose an LLM-driven closed-loop autonomous learning framework for robots facing uncovered tasks in open environments. The proposed framework first retrieves the local method library to determine whether a reusable solution already exists for the current task or observed event. If no suitable method is found, it triggers an autonomous learning process in which the LLM serves as a high-level reasoning component for task analysis, candidate model selection, data collection planning, and execution or observation strategy organization. The robot then learns from both self-execution and active observation, performs quasi-real-time training and adjustment, and consolidates the validated result into the local method library for future reuse. Through this recurring closed-loop process, the robot gradually converts both execution-derived and observation-derived experience into reusable local capability while reducing future dependence on repeated external LLM interaction. Results show that the proposed framework reduces execution time and LLM dependence in both repeated-task self-execution and observation-driven settings, for example reducing the average total execution time from 7.7772s to 6.7779s and the average number of LLM calls per task from 1.0 to 0.2 in the repeated-task self-execution experiments.
summary_zh: 在开放环境中运行的自主机器人需要具备持续处理超出预定义局部方法覆盖范围任务的能力。然而现有方法通常依赖于重复调用大语言模型（LLM）来处理未覆盖任务，即使是成功的自主执行或观察到的外部成功行为，也往往未能自主转化为可复用的局部知识。本文针对开放环境中机器人面临的未覆盖任务，提出一种LLM驱动的闭环自主学习框架。该框架首先检索局部方法库，判断当前任务或观察到的事件是否已有可复用解决方案；若未找到合适方法，则触发自主学习流程：LLM作为高层推理组件进行任务分析、候选模型选择、数据收集规划及执行或观察策略组织；机器人随后通过自主执行与主动观察进行学习，执行准实时训练与调整，并将经过验证的结果整合到局部方法库中供未来复用。通过这种循环闭环过程，机器人逐步将执行经验和观察经验转化为可复用的局部能力，同时减少未来对重复外部LLM交互的依赖。实验结果表明，在重复任务自主执行和观察驱动场景下，所提框架均能有效减少执行时间与LLM依赖——例如在重复任务自主执行实验中，平均总执行时间从7.7772秒降至6.7779秒，单任务平均LLM调用次数从1.0次降低至0.2次。
tldr: This paper proposes an LLM-driven closed-loop autonomous learning framework for robots, enabling them to learn from execution and observation in open environments to reduce reliance on repeated LLM calls by converting experiences into reusable local methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种LLM驱动的闭环自主学习框架，使机器人能够在开放环境中通过执行和观察进行学习，将经验转化为可复用的局部方法，从而减少对重复LLM调用的依赖。

title: Energy-Efficient Multi-Robot Coverage Path Planning of Non-Convex Regions of Interests
summary: This letter presents an energy-efficient multi-robot coverage path planning (MRCPP) framework for large, nonconvex Regions of Interest (ROI) containing obstacles and no-fly zones (NFZ). Existing minimum-energy coverage planning algorithms utilize meta-heuristic boustrophedon workspace decomposition. Therefore, even with minimum energy objectives and energy consumption constraints, they cannot achieve optimal energy efficiency. Moreover, most existing frameworks support only a single type of robotic platform. MRCPP overcomes these limitations by: generating globally-informed swath generation, creating parallel sweeping paths with minimal turns, calculating safety buffers to ensure safe turning clearance, using an efficient mTSP solver to balance workloads and minimize mission time, and connecting disjoint segments via a modified visibility graph that tracks heading angles while maintaining transitions within safe regions. The efficacy of the proposed MRCPP framework is demonstrated through real-world experiments involving autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) and autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs). Evaluations demonstrate that the proposed MRCPP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art planners, reducing average total energy consumption by 3\% to 40\% for a team of 3 robots and computation time by an order of magnitude, while maintaining balanced workload distribution and strong scalability across increasing fleet sizes. The MRCPP framework is released as an open-source package and videos of real-world and simulated experiments are available at https://mrc-pp.github.io.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向含障碍物与禁飞区的大型非凸区域的高效能多机器人覆盖路径规划框架。现有最小能量覆盖规划算法多采用元启发式牛耕式工作空间分解法，因此即使设置了最小能量目标与能耗约束，仍无法实现最优能效。此外，现有框架大多仅支持单一机器人平台类型。本框架通过以下方式突破这些局限：生成全局感知的条带路径，创建转弯最少的平行扫描轨迹，计算安全缓冲区以保证转向净空，采用高效的多旅行商问题求解器实现负载平衡并最小化任务时间，以及通过改进的可见性图连接离散路径段——该算法在追踪航向角的同时确保过渡路径始终处于安全区域。通过自主飞行器与自主水面艇的实际场景实验，验证了所提框架的有效性。评估结果表明：该框架在3机器人编队中始终保持优于前沿规划器的性能，平均总能耗降低3%至40%，计算时间减少一个数量级，同时保持均衡的负载分配能力，并随着编队规模扩大展现出良好的可扩展性。本框架已作为开源软件包发布，真实场景与仿真实验视频详见https://mrc-pp.github.io。
tldr: This paper presents an energy-efficient multi-robot coverage path planning framework for large, non-convex areas with obstacles, demonstrated on autonomous aerial and surface vehicles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于带有障碍物的大型非凸区域的高效多机器人覆盖路径规划框架，并在自主空中与水面车辆上进行了验证。

title: dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model
summary: Evaluating robotics policies across thousands of environments and thousands of tasks is infeasible with existing approaches. This motivates the need for a new methodology for scalable robotics policy evaluation. In this paper, we propose dWorldEval, which uses a discrete diffusion world model as a scalable evaluation proxy for robotics policies. Specifically, dWorldEval maps all modalities - including vision, language, and robotic actions - into a unified token space, modeling them via a single transformer-based denoising network. In this paper, we propose dWorldEval, using a discrete diffusion world model as a scalable evaluation proxy for robotics policy. Specifically, it maps all modalities, including vision, language, and robotics action into a unified token space, then denoises them with a single transformer network. Building on this architecture, we employ a sparse keyframe memory to maintain spatiotemporal consistency. We also introduce a progress token that indicates the degree of task completion. At inference, the model jointly predicts future observations and progress token, allowing automatically determine success when the progress reaches 1. Extensive experiments demonstrate that dWorldEval significantly outperforms previous approaches, i.e., WorldEval, Ctrl-World, and WorldGym, on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and multiple real-robot tasks. It paves the way for a new architectural paradigm in building world simulators for robotics evaluation at scale.
summary_zh: 摘要：基于现有方法，在数千种环境和任务中对机器人策略进行评估是难以实现的。这催生了对可扩展机器人策略评估新方法的需求。本文提出dWorldEval方法，利用离散扩散世界模型作为机器人策略的可扩展评估代理。具体而言，dWorldEval将所有模态——包括视觉、语言和机器人动作——映射到统一的标记空间，并通过基于Transformer的单一去噪网络进行建模。在此架构基础上，我们采用稀疏关键帧记忆机制以保持时空一致性，并引入指示任务完成度的进度标记。在推理阶段，模型联合预测未来观测值与进度标记，当进度值达到1时即可自动判定任务成功。大量实验表明，在LIBERO、RoboTwin及多项真实机器人任务中，dWorldEval显著超越了先前方法（如WorldEval、Ctrl-World和WorldGym）。这为构建大规模机器人评估世界模拟器开辟了新的架构范式。
tldr: A method for scalable robotic policy evaluation using a discrete diffusion world model that unifies vision, language, and action tokens, with a progress token for success detection.
tldr_zh: 一种可扩展的机器人策略评估方法，使用离散扩散世界模型统一视觉、语言和动作令牌，并通过进度令牌检测任务成功。

title: Wiggle and Go! System Identification for Zero-Shot Dynamic Rope Manipulation
summary: Many robotic tasks are unforgiving; a single mistake in a dynamic throw can lead to unacceptable delays or unrecoverable failure. To mitigate this, we present a novel approach that leverages learned simulation priors to inform goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of ropes for efficient and accurate task execution. Related methods for dynamic rope manipulation either require large real-world datasets to estimate rope behavior or the use of iterative improvements on attempts at the task for goal completion. We introduce Wiggle and Go!, a system-identification, two-stage framework that enables zero-shot task rope manipulation. The framework consists of a system identification module that observes rope movement to predict descriptive physical parameters, which then informs an optimization method for goal-conditioned action prediction for the robot to execute zero-shot in the real. Our method achieves strong performance across multiple dynamic manipulation tasks enabled by the same task-agnostic system identification module which offers seamless switching between different manipulation tasks, allowing a single model to support a diverse array of manipulation policies. We achieve a 3.55 cm average accuracy on 3D target striking in real using rope system parameters in comparison to 15.34 cm accuracy when our task model is not system-parameter-informed. We achieve a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.95 between Fourier frequencies of the predicted and real ropes on an unseen trajectory. Project website please see https://wiggleandgo.github.io/
summary_zh: 摘要：机器人执行动态任务时往往不容有失，一次绳索动态抛掷的微小误差便可能导致不可接受的延迟甚至不可挽回的失败。为解决该问题，我们提出一种创新方法，利用学习到的仿真先验信息来指导面向目标的绳索动态操控，从而实现高效精准的任务执行。现有动态绳索操控方法往往需要大量真实世界数据来估计绳索行为，或依赖针对目标完成的多次迭代尝试进行改进。我们提出的Wiggle and Go!系统辨识双阶段框架，实现了零样本任务下的绳索操控。该框架包含系统辨识模块，通过观察绳索运动预测描述性物理参数，进而为面向目标的机器人动作预测提供优化依据，使其能在真实环境中执行零样本操作。依托任务无关的系统辨识模块，我们的方法在多种动态操控任务中均表现出色，该模块支持不同操控任务间的无缝切换，使得单一模型能够支撑多样化的操控策略。实验表明：在利用绳索系统参数进行三维目标击打时，我们获得了3.55厘米的平均精度，而未使用系统参数信息的任务模型精度仅为15.34厘米。在未见轨迹上，预测绳索与真实绳索的傅里叶频率皮尔逊相关系数达到0.95。项目网站详见https://wiggleandgo.github.io/。
tldr: A two-stage system identification framework for zero-shot dynamic rope manipulation, which infers physical parameters from observations and uses them to plan goal-conditioned actions for real robot execution.
tldr_zh: 这是一个用于零样本动态绳索操作的两阶段系统识别框架，通过观察推断物理参数，并利用这些参数规划面向目标的动作供真实机器人执行。

title: LeHome: A Simulation Environment for Deformable Object Manipulation in Household Scenarios
summary: Household environments present one of the most common, impactful yet challenging application domains for robotics. Within household scenarios, manipulating deformable objects is particularly difficult, both in simulation and real-world execution, due to varied categories and shapes, complex dynamics, and diverse material properties, as well as the lack of reliable deformable-object support in existing simulations. We introduce LeHome, a comprehensive simulation environment designed for deformable object manipulation in household scenarios. LeHome covers a wide spectrum of deformable objects, such as garments and food items, offering high-fidelity dynamics and realistic interactions that existing simulators struggle to simulate accurately. Moreover, LeHome supports multiple robotic embodiments and emphasizes low-cost robots as a core focus, enabling end-to-end evaluation of household tasks on resource-constrained hardware. By bridging the gap between realistic deformable object simulation and practical robotic platforms, LeHome provides a scalable testbed for advancing household robotics. Webpage: https://lehome-web.github.io/ .
summary_zh: 家庭环境是机器人技术中最常见、最具影响力同时也是最具挑战性的应用领域之一。在家庭场景中，无论是仿真环境还是实际执行，柔性物体的操作都尤为困难，其原因在于其种类与形状的多样性、复杂的动力学特性、多变的材料属性，以及现有仿真平台中缺乏可靠的柔性物体支持。我们推出了LeHome——一个专为家庭场景下柔性物体操作设计的综合性仿真环境。LeHome涵盖了服装、食品等多种类别的柔性物体，能够提供高保真的动力学仿真和真实的交互效果，而这是现有仿真器难以准确模拟的。此外，LeHome支持多种机器人形态，并将低成本机器人作为核心关注点，从而能够在资源受限的硬件上对家庭任务进行端到端评估。通过在真实的柔性物体仿真与实用机器人平台之间搭建桥梁，LeHome为推进家庭机器人技术的发展提供了一个可扩展的测试平台。项目主页：https://lehome-web.github.io/。
tldr: LeHome is a simulation environment for deformable object manipulation in household scenarios, designed to support multiple robot embodiments, including low-cost platforms, with high-fidelity dynamics.
tldr_zh: LeHome 是一个用于家庭场景中可变形物体操控的模拟环境，旨在支持包括低成本平台在内的多种机器人化身，并具有高保真动力学。

title: A Kinematic Analysis of Palm Degrees of Freedom for Enhancing Thumb Opposability in Robotic Hands
summary: This study investigates the kinematic role of palm degrees of freedom (DoF) in enhancing thumb opposability in a five-finger robotic hand. A hand model consisting of a five DoF thumb and four fingers with three to four DoF is analyzed, where palm motion is introduced between adjacent fingers. To quantitatively evaluate thumb-finger interaction, the overlap workspace volume is defined based on voxelized fingertip reachable regions. Seven cases are considered, including configurations with increased total DoF and configurations in which the total DoF is maintained by redistributing DoF from the fingers to the palm. The results show that palm DoF significantly improves opposability, particularly for the ring and little fingers, by repositioning their base locations rather than simply extending their reachable range. However, when the total DoF is constrained, redistributing DoF to the palm leads to trade-offs between overlap workspace expansion and kinematic redundancy. These findings indicate that palm DoF and finger DoF play distinct roles in hand kinematics and should be considered jointly in design. This study provides a quantitative framework for evaluating palm-induced opposability without relying on object or contact models and offers practical design guidelines for incorporating palm motion in robotic hands.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了手掌自由度在增强五指仿人机器人手拇指对向运动能力中的运动学作用。分析了一个包含五自由度拇指及三至四自由度四指的手部模型，其中相邻手指间引入了手掌运动。为量化评估拇指与手指的交互作用，基于体素化的指尖可达区域定义了重叠工作空间体积。研究考虑了七种配置方案，包括总自由度增加的配置，以及通过将手指自由度重新分配至手掌以保持总自由度不变的配置。结果表明，手掌自由度通过对手指基座位置的重置而非简单扩展其可达范围，显著提升了对向运动能力，尤其对无名指和小指效果明显。然而，当总自由度受限时，将自由度重新分配至手掌会导致重叠工作空间扩展与运动学冗余之间的权衡。这些发现表明手掌自由度与手指自由度在手部运动学中发挥着不同作用，应在设计中予以协同考量。本研究提供了一种不依赖物体或接触模型的量化框架，用于评估手掌运动引发的对向运动能力，并为机器人手融入手掌运动提供了实用设计指南。
tldr: The paper analyzes the role of palm degrees of freedom in enhancing thumb opposability in robotic hands, providing a quantitative framework for evaluating palm design choices.
tldr_zh: 本研究分析了机器人手掌自由度对增强拇指可对置性的作用，提供了一个评估手掌设计选择的定量框架。

title: DM$^3$-Nav: Decentralized Multi-Agent Multimodal Multi-Object Semantic Navigation
summary: We present DM$^3$-Nav, a fully decentralized multi-agent semantic navigation system supporting multimodal open-vocabulary goal specification and multi-object missions. In our setting, decentralization implies operation without a central coordinator, global map aggregation, or shared global state at runtime. Robots operate autonomously and coordinate through ad-hoc pairwise communication, exchanging local maps, goal status, and navigation intent without synchronization. An implicit task allocation mechanism combining intent broadcasting and distance-weighted frontier selection reduces redundant exploration while preserving decentralized operation. Evaluations on HM3DSem scenes using the HM3Dv0.2 and GOAT-Bench datasets demonstrate that DM$^3$-Nav matches or exceeds centralized and shared-map baselines while eliminating single points of failure inherent in centralized architectures. Finally, we validate our approach in a real-world office environment using two mobile robots, demonstrating successful deployment relying entirely on onboard sensing and computation. A video of our real-world experiments is available online: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QiUSCn5rIvtuTUqtuXLPgmt6S8x9-MCZ/view?usp=drive_link
summary_zh: 我们提出DM³-Nav，一种完全去中心化的多智能体语义导航系统，支持多模态开放词汇目标描述与多目标任务。在我们的设定中，"去中心化"意味着运行时无需中央协调器、全局地图聚合或共享全局状态。机器人自主运行，通过临时点对点通信实现协同，异步交换局部地图、目标状态与导航意图。结合意图广播与距离加权边界选择的隐式任务分配机制，能在保持去中心化运行的同时减少重复探索。基于HM3Dv0.2和GOAT-Bench数据集在HM3DSem场景上的评估表明，DM³-Nav在性能上达到或超越了集中式及共享地图基线方案，同时消除了集中式架构固有的单点故障风险。最后，我们在真实办公环境中使用两台移动机器人验证了该方法的有效性，展示了完全依赖机载传感与计算的成功部署。真实环境实验视频可通过以下链接查看：https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QiUSCn5rIvtuTUqtuXLPgmt6S8x9-MCZ/view?usp=drive_link
tldr: A fully decentralized multi-agent semantic navigation system for robots using onboard sensing and ad-hoc communication, validated in both simulation and real-world office environments.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种完全去中心化的多智能体语义导航系统，利用机载感知和临时通信，并在仿真和真实办公室环境中进行了验证。

title: SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在静态视觉空间推理方面取得了进展，但在具身环境中却常常难以保持长时程的空间一致性——这种环境要求智能体必须根据环境变化下的第一视角观察持续修正自身信念。我们提出了SpaMEM（动作序列驱动的空间记忆），这是一个通过长交互序列中动作条件化的场景变换（生成、放置、移除）来分离空间信念演化机制的大规模诊断基准。SpaMEM基于一个物理基础数据集构建，该数据集包含跨越四种模态（RGB、深度、实例分割、语义分割）的10,601,392张高保真图像，采集自1,000个程序生成房屋中的25,000多个交互序列。我们将具身空间推理形式化为包含15项诊断任务的三级层次结构：第一级从单次观察中测量基础空间感知能力；第二级通过引入文本状态历史记录来探究时序推理，以排除感知噪声的影响；第三级则要求在同一任务维度下，从原始视觉流中实现端到端的信念维护。我们进一步评估了短期（逐步）更新与长期（片段式）重建能力。对代表性开源视觉语言模型家族的基准测试揭示了一个持续的堆叠瓶颈：坐标一致的 grounding 仍是难以突破的上限，且从第二级到第三级的急剧性能崩塌暴露了明显的符号脚手架依赖——模型在基于文本的记录上能取得成功，却难以维持稳健的视觉记忆。SpaMEM 提供了一个细粒度的诊断标准，并为状态表征、信念修正及长时程片段整合等显式机制的研究提供了推动力。
tldr: The paper introduces SpaMEM, a benchmark for evaluating dynamic spatial reasoning in embodied environments by testing perception-memory integration across long-horizon interaction sequences.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SpaMEM基准，用于评估具身环境中的动态空间推理能力，通过测试感知-记忆在长交互序列中的整合来实现。

title: Decoding High-Dimensional Finger Motion from EMG Using Riemannian Features and RNNs
summary: Continuous estimation of high-dimensional finger kinematics from forearm surface electromyography (EMG) could enable natural control for hand prostheses, AR/XR interfaces, and teleoperation. However, the complexity of human hand gestures and the entanglement of forearm muscles make accurate recognition intrinsically challenging. Existing approaches typically reduce task complexity by relying on classification-based machine learning, limiting the controllable degrees of freedom and compromising on natural interaction. We present an end-to-end framework for continuous EMG-to-kinematics regression using only consumer-grade hardware. The framework combines an 8-channel EMG armband, a single webcam, and an automatic synchronization procedure, enabling the collection of the EMG Finger-Kinematics dataset (EMG-FK), a 10-h dataset of synchronized EMG and 15 finger joint angles from 20 participants performing rich, unconstrained right-hand motions. We also introduce the Temporal Riemannian Regressor (TRR), a lightweight GRU-based model that uses sequences of multi-band Riemannian covariance features to decode finger motion. Across EMG-FK and the public emg2pose benchmark, TRR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both intra- and cross-subject evaluation. On EMG-FK, it reaches an average absolute error of $9.79 °\pm 1.48$ in intra-subject and $16.71 °\pm 3.97$ in cross-subject. Finally, we demonstrate real-time deployment on a Raspberry Pi 5 and intuitive control of a robotic hand; TRR runs at nearly 10 predictions/s and is roughly an order of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art approaches. Together, these contributions lower the barrier to reproducible, real-time EMG-based decoding of high-dimensional finger motion, and pave the way toward more natural and intuitive control of embedded EMG-based systems.
summary_zh: 基于前臂表面肌电信号（EMG）持续估计高维度手指运动学特征，可为假肢手、AR/XR交互界面及遥操作系统实现自然控制。然而，复杂的手部动作与相互关联的前臂肌肉使得精确识别面临本质性挑战。现有方法通常依赖基于分类的机器学习来降低任务复杂度，这限制了可控自由度并损害了交互的自然性。本文提出一种仅使用消费级硬件的端到端肌电-运动学连续回归框架。该框架整合了8通道肌电臂环、单目网络摄像头及自动同步程序，构建了肌电-手指运动学数据集（EMG-FK）。该数据集包含20名参与者在无约束条件下执行丰富右手动作时采集的10小时同步肌电信号与15个手指关节角度数据。我们还提出了时序黎曼回归器（TRR）——一种轻量级的基于门控循环单元的模型，通过多频带黎曼协方差特征序列解码手指运动。在EMG-FK数据集和公开的emg2pose基准测试中，TRR在受试者内与跨受试者评估中均优于现有先进方法。在EMG-FK数据集上，其平均绝对误差在受试者内为$9.79°\pm 1.48$，跨受试者为$16.71°\pm 3.97$。最后，我们在树莓派5上实现了实时部署并完成对机械手的直观控制；TRR以近10次/秒的预测速度运行，比现有先进方法快约一个数量级。这些成果共同降低了高维度手指运动肌电解码研究的可复现性与实时性门槛，为开发更自然直观的嵌入式肌电控制系统开辟了新路径。
tldr: This paper presents a system to continuously decode high-dimensional finger motion from forearm EMG signals for controlling prosthetic and robotic hands, using a novel model and a new dataset, and demonstrates real-time performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从前臂肌电信号连续解码高维手指运动的系统，用于控制假肢和机器人手，采用了新模型和数据集，并展示了实时性能。

title: Dynamic Coupling and Indirect Control of Jointed Robots Rolling Atop A Moving Platform
summary: An asymmetric two-link robot supported atop a flat platform by wheels that roll and pivot freely, but do not slip laterally, will develop forward momentum if the joint between the links is actuated internally. In particular, oscillations in the joint angle will generate undulatory locomotion suggesting fishlike swimming. If two such robots surmount a common platform that's free to translate with its own inertial dynamics, then the individual robots' dynamics will be coupled so that the locomotion of either robot is affected by that of the other. We develop a mathematical model for this system and present simulations demonstrating its behavior. We then consider a single robot with an unactuated joint rolling atop a platform that moves under control, and show that actuation of the platform is sufficient to dictate the robot's behavior. In particular, with the acceleration of the platform as an input, the robot's heading can be made to track a chosen function of time. This is sufficient to guarantee that the robot can be induced to orbit a fixed point on the platform or to locomote persistently in a desired direction.
summary_zh:
摘要：
一种由车轮支撑在平坦平台上的非对称两连杆机器人，其车轮可自由滚动和转向，但不会横向滑动，若通过内部驱动连杆间的关节，将产生前进动量。具体而言，关节角的振荡将产生波动式运动，类似于鱼类的游动方式。若两个此类机器人共同置于一个可自由平动并具有自身惯性动力学的平台上，则两个机器人的动力学将相互耦合，使得任一机器人的运动均会受到另一机器人的影响。本文为该系统建立了数学模型，并通过仿真展示了其行为特性。随后，我们研究了一个具有非驱动关节的单机器人系统，该机器人在受控移动的平台上滚动，结果表明仅通过平台驱动便足以控制机器人的行为。具体而言，以平台加速度作为输入，可使机器人的航向跟踪一个选定的时间函数。这足以保证机器人能够被引导至绕平台上的固定点做轨道运动，或沿期望方向持续行进。
tldr: This paper presents a mathematical model and simulations for a system of coupled, wheeled, two-link robots moving on a platform, demonstrating undulatory locomotion and indirect control of the robot's heading via platform actuation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在平台上运动的耦合轮式两连杆机器人系统的数学模型和仿真，展示了其波动式运动行为，以及通过平台驱动间接控制机器人航向的能力。

title: Depth-Aware Rover: A Study of Edge AI and Monocular Vision for Real-World Implementation
summary: This study analyses simulated and real-world implementations of depth-aware rover navigation, highlighting the transition from stereo vision to monocular depth estimation using edge AI. A Unity-based lunar terrain simulator with stereo cameras and OpenCV's StereoSGBM was used to generate disparity maps. A physical rover built on Raspberry Pi 4 employed UniDepthV2 for monocular metric depth estimation and YOLO12n for real-time object detection. While stereo vision yielded higher accuracy in simulation, the monocular approach proved more robust and cost-effective in real-world deployment, achieving 0.1 FPS for depth and 10 FPS for detection.
summary_zh: 本研究分析了深度感知漫游车导航的模拟与真实实现，重点探讨了从立体视觉向基于边缘人工智能的单目深度估计的过渡。我们利用搭载立体相机的Unity月球地形模拟器与OpenCV的StereoSGBM算法生成视差图。基于树莓派4构建的物理漫游车则采用UniDepthV2进行单目度量深度估计，并配合YOLO12n实现实时目标检测。模拟环境中立体视觉展现出更高精度，而在实际部署中单目方法被证明更具鲁棒性和成本效益，其深度估计与目标检测帧率分别达到0.1 FPS和10 FPS。
tldr: This paper presents a comparison between stereo vision and monocular depth estimation using edge AI for rover navigation, demonstrating the monocular approach's real-world robustness on a physical Raspberry Pi-based rover.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了基于立体视觉和单目深度估计的边缘AI在月球车导航中的应用，在基于Raspberry Pi的物理车上证明了单目方法在真实世界的鲁棒性。

title: Insect-inspired modular architectures as inductive biases for reinforcement learning
summary: Most reinforcement-learning (RL) controllers used in continuous control are architecturally centralized: observations are compressed into a single latent state from which both value estimates and actions are produced. Biological control systems are often organized differently. Insects, in particular, coordinate navigation, heading stabilization, memory, and context-dependent action selection through distributed circuits rather than a single monolithic controller. Motivated by this contrast, we study an RL policy architecture that decomposes control into interacting modules for sensory encoding, heading representation, sparse associative memory, recurrent command generation, and local motor control, with a learned arbitration mechanism that allocates motor authority across modules. The model is evaluated on a two-dimensional navigation task that require simultaneous food seeking, obstacle avoidance, and predator escape. In a six-seed predator-navigation experiment trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for 75 updates, the modular policy achieves the strongest final mean performance among the tested controllers, with final episodic return $-2798.8\pm964.4$ versus $-3778.0\pm628.1$ for a centralized gated recurrent unit (GRU) and $-4727.5\pm772.5$ for a centralized multilayer perceptron (MLP). The modular policy also attains the lowest final value loss and stable PPO optimization statistics while driving module-assignment entropy to $0.0457\pm0.0244$, indicating highly selective control allocation. These results suggest that distributed control can serve as a useful inductive bias for RL problems involving dynamically competing behavioral objectives.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在连续控制领域中，大多数强化学习（RL）控制器采用集中式架构：观察信息被压缩为单一潜在状态，价值估计与动作生成均基于此状态。而生物控制系统往往采用不同的组织方式。以昆虫为例，它们通过分布式神经回路协调导航、航向稳定、记忆及情境依赖的动作选择，而非依赖单一的整体控制器。受此差异启发，我们研究了一种强化学习策略架构，该架构将控制任务分解为多个交互模块：感觉编码模块、航向表征模块、稀疏联想记忆模块、循环指令生成模块及局部运动控制模块，并通过学习得到的仲裁机制在各模块间分配运动控制权。该模型在一个二维导航任务上进行评估，该任务要求同时完成觅食、避障及躲避捕食者。在采用近端策略优化（PPO）进行75次更新的六种子捕食者-导航实验中，模块化策略在所有测试控制器中实现了最强的最终平均性能，其最终回合回报为$-2798.8\pm964.4$，而集中式门控循环单元（GRU）控制器为$-3778.0\pm628.1$，集中式多层感知器（MLP）控制器为$-4727.5\pm772.5$。同时，模块化策略取得了最低的最终价值损失与稳定的PPO优化统计量，并将模块分配熵驱动至$0.0457\pm0.0244$，表明其具有高度选择性的控制分配能力。这些结果表明，对于涉及动态竞争行为目标的强化学习问题，分布式控制可作为一种有效的归纳偏置。
tldr: The paper proposes a modular reinforcement learning policy architecture inspired by insect nervous systems, decomposing control into specialized modules for navigation tasks. It demonstrates improved performance and stable optimization on a 2D navigation task with competing objectives compared to centralized controllers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种受昆虫神经系统启发的模块化强化学习策略架构，将控制分解为专门模块，用于处理具有竞争目标的导航任务。实验表明，该架构在2D导航任务上比集中式控制器性能更优、优化更稳定。

title: Point & Grasp: Flexible Selection of Out-of-Reach Objects Through Probabilistic Cue Integration
summary: Selecting out-of-reach objects is a fundamental task in mixed reality (MR). Existing methods rely on a single cue or deterministically fuse multiple cues, leading to performance degradation when the dominant cue becomes unreliable. In this work, we introduce a probabilistic cue integration framework that enables flexible combination of multiple user-generated cues for intent inference. Inspired by natural grasping behavior, we instantiate the framework with pointing direction and grasp gestures as a new interaction technique, Point&Grasp. To this end, we collect the Out-of-Reach Grasping (ORG) dataset to train a robust likelihood model of the gestural cue, which captures grasping patterns not present in existing in-reach datasets. User studies demonstrate that our selection method with cue integration not only improves accuracy and speed over single-cue baselines, but also remains practically effective compared to state-of-the-art methods across various sources of ambiguity. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/drlxj/point-and-grasp.
summary_zh: 选择不可及物体是混合现实中的一项基本任务。现有方法依赖单一线索或确定性融合多线索，当主导线索不可靠时会导致性能下降。本研究提出一种概率式线索融合框架，能够灵活整合多种用户生成线索以推断交互意图。受自然抓取行为启发，我们以指向方向与抓取手势为实例构建了新型交互技术"Point&Grasp"。为此，我们收集了不可及抓取数据集，用以训练手势线索的鲁棒似然模型，该模型捕捉了现有可及数据集中未包含的抓取模式。用户研究表明，采用线索融合的选取方法不仅比单线索基线提升了精度与速度，在多种模糊性场景下相较于最先进方法仍保持显著实用性。数据集与代码已发布于https://github.com/drlxj/point-and-grasp。
tldr: This paper introduces a probabilistic cue integration framework called Point&Grasp for selecting out-of-reach objects in mixed reality, using pointing direction and grasp gestures to infer user intent, validated by a user study and a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种名为Point&Grasp的概率性线索整合框架，用于混合现实中远距离物体的选择，通过指向方向和抓握手势来推断用户意图，并通过用户研究和新数据集进行了验证。

title: Learning Control Policies to Provably Satisfy Hard Affine Constraints for Black-Box Hybrid Dynamical Systems
summary: Ensuring safety for black-box hybrid dynamical systems presents significant challenges due to their instantaneous state jumps and unknown explicit nonlinear dynamics. Existing solutions for strict safety constraint satisfaction, like control barrier functions (CBFs) and reachability analysis, rely on direct knowledge of the dynamics. Similarly, safe reinforcement learning (RL) approaches often rely on known system dynamics or merely discourage safety violations through reward shaping. In this work, we want to learn RL policies which provably satisfy affine state constraints in closed loop for black-box hybrid dynamical systems with affine reset maps. Our key insight is forcing the RL policy to be affine and repulsive near the constraint boundaries for the unknown nonlinear dynamics of the system, providing guarantees that the trajectories will not violate the constraint. We further account for constraint violation due to instantaneous state jumps that occur due to impacts or reset maps in the hybrid system by introducing a second repulsive affine region before the reset that prevents post-reset states from violating the constraint. We derive sufficient conditions under which these policies satisfy safety constraints in closed loop. We also compare our approach with state-of-the-art reward shaping and learned-CBF methods on hybrid dynamical systems like the constrained pendulum and paddle juggler environments. In both scenarios, we show that our methodology learns higher quality policies while always satisfying the safety constraints.
summary_zh: 确保黑盒混杂动态系统的安全性面临巨大挑战，这源于其瞬时状态跳跃及未知的显式非线性动力学特性。现有满足严格安全约束的解决方案，如控制屏障函数（CBF）和可达性分析，都依赖于对系统动力学的直接认知。类似地，安全强化学习（RL）方法通常也需要已知系统动力学模型，或仅通过奖励塑形来避免安全违规。在本研究中，我们旨在为具有仿射重置映射的黑盒混杂动态系统学习能够闭环状态下可证明满足仿射状态约束的强化学习策略。我们的核心思路是：针对系统中未知的非线性动力学特性，强制使强化学习策略在约束边界附近保持仿射形式并具有排斥性，从而保证轨迹不会违反约束。我们进一步通过引入重置前的第二仿射排斥区域，解决了混杂系统中因冲击或重置映射导致的瞬时状态跳跃可能引发的约束违规问题，该区域能防止重置后状态违反约束。我们推导了这些策略在闭环中满足安全约束的充分条件，并在约束摆系统和球拍杂耍环境等混杂动态系统中，将本方法与当前最先进的奖励塑形和学习型控制屏障函数方法进行了对比。实验结果表明，在两种场景下，我们的方法均能学习到更高质量的策略，同时始终满足安全约束。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for learning RL policies that provably satisfy hard affine constraints for black-box hybrid dynamical systems by enforcing affine, repulsive policy structures near constraints and handling state jumps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，通过强制执行仿射、在约束边界附近具有排斥性的策略结构，并处理状态跳跃，为黑盒混合动力系统学习可证明满足硬仿射约束的强化学习策略。

title: SNGR: Selective Non-Gaussian Refinement for Ambiguous SLAM Factor Graphs
summary: We present Selective Non-Gaussian Refinement (SNGR), a SLAM framework that augments iSAM2 with targeted nested sampling on windows where Gaussian approximations are likely to fail. We detect such regions using the condition number of joint marginal covariances and selectively refine them using the full nonlinear factor graph likelihood, with a gating mechanism to avoid degradation in multimodal cases. Experiments on range-only SLAM with wrong data association show that SNGR achieves high-precision failure detection and consistent local likelihood improvements while reducing computational cost relative to exhaustive non-Gaussian inference. These results highlight both the promise and the limitations of selective refinement for approximate SLAM posteriors.
tldr: SNGR is a SLAM framework that selectively refines non-Gaussian windows in factor graphs to improve inference robustness, evaluated in range-only SLAM scenarios.
tldr_zh: SNGR 是一种 SLAM 框架，通过选择性优化因子图中的非高斯窗口来提高推理的鲁棒性，在仅测距 SLAM 场景中进行了评估。

title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
summary: As AI systems move from generating text to accomplishing goals through sustained interaction, the ability to model environment dynamics becomes a central bottleneck. Agents that manipulate objects, navigate software, coordinate with others, or design experiments require predictive environment models, yet the term world model carries different meanings across research communities. We introduce a "levels x laws" taxonomy organized along two axes. The first defines three capability levels: L1 Predictor, which learns one-step local transition operators; L2 Simulator, which composes them into multi-step, action-conditioned rollouts that respect domain laws; and L3 Evolver, which autonomously revises its own model when predictions fail against new evidence. The second identifies four governing-law regimes: physical, digital, social, and scientific. These regimes determine what constraints a world model must satisfy and where it is most likely to fail. Using this framework, we synthesize over 400 works and summarize more than 100 representative systems spanning model-based reinforcement learning, video generation, web and GUI agents, multi-agent social simulation, and AI-driven scientific discovery. We analyze methods, failure modes, and evaluation practices across level-regime pairs, propose decision-centric evaluation principles and a minimal reproducible evaluation package, and outline architectural guidance, open problems, and governance challenges. The resulting roadmap connects previously isolated communities and charts a path from passive next-step prediction toward world models that can simulate, and ultimately reshape, the environments in which agents operate.
tldr: This paper proposes a taxonomy for world models in AI agents, defining capability levels and governing laws across physical, digital, social, and scientific regimes, and synthesizes a large body of work to chart a path from prediction to active simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个关于AI智能体中世界模型的分类法，定义了跨物理、数字、社会和科学领域的三个能力层级与四种约束法则，并综合了大量研究，规划了从被动预测到主动模拟的路线图。

title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: The transition from stateless language model inference to persistent, multi session autonomous agents has revealed memory to be a primary architectural bottleneck in the deployment of production grade agentic systems. Existing methodologies largely depend on hybrid semantic graph architectures, which impose substantial computational overhead during both ingestion and retrieval. These systems typically require large language model mediated entity extraction, explicit graph schema maintenance, and multi query retrieval pipelines. This paper introduces Memanto, a universal memory layer for agentic artificial intelligence that challenges the prevailing assumption that knowledge graph complexity is necessary to achieve high fidelity agent memory. Memanto integrates a typed semantic memory schema comprising thirteen predefined memory categories, an automated conflict resolution mechanism, and temporal versioning. These components are enabled by Moorcheh's Information Theoretic Search engine, a no indexing semantic database that provides deterministic retrieval within sub ninety millisecond latency while eliminating ingestion delay. Through systematic benchmarking on the LongMemEval and LoCoMo evaluation suites, Memanto achieves state of the art accuracy scores of 89.8 percent and 87.1 percent respectively. These results surpass all evaluated hybrid graph and vector based systems while requiring only a single retrieval query, incurring no ingestion cost, and maintaining substantially lower operational complexity. A five stage progressive ablation study is presented to quantify the contribution of each architectural component, followed by a discussion of the implications for scalable deployment of agentic memory systems.
tldr: Memanto introduces a universal memory layer for autonomous agents, utilizing typed semantic memory and information-theoretic retrieval to reduce computational overhead, achieving state-of-the-art results on agent memory benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Memanto为自主智能体引入了一个通用记忆层，利用类型化语义记忆和信息论检索来降低计算开销，在智能体记忆基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: Flow4DGS-SLAM: Optical Flow-Guided 4D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Handling the dynamic environments is a significant research challenge in Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Recent research combines 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with SLAM to achieve both robust camera pose estimation and photorealistic renderings. However, using SLAM to efficiently reconstruct both static and dynamic regions remains challenging. In this work, we propose an efficient framework for dynamic 3DGS SLAM guided by optical flow. Using the input depth and prior optical flow, we first propose a category-agnostic motion mask generation strategy by fitting a camera ego-motion model to decompose the optical flow. This module separates dynamic and static Gaussians and simultaneously provides flow-guided camera pose initialization. We boost the training speed of dynamic 3DGS by explicitly modeling their temporal centers at keyframes. These centers are propagated using 3D scene flow priors and are dynamically initialized with an adaptive insertion strategy. Alongside this, we model the temporal opacity and rotation using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to adaptively learn the complex dynamics. The empirical results demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance in tracking, dynamic reconstruction, and training efficiency.
tldr: The paper proposes an optical flow-guided dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that improves camera pose estimation and reconstruction quality in dynamic scenes by separating static/dynamic elements and modeling temporal properties.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于光流引导的动态3D高斯溅射SLAM框架，通过分离静态和动态元素并建模时序属性，以提升动态场景中的相机位姿估计和重建质量。

title: V-STC: A Time-Efficient Multi-Vehicle Coordinated Trajectory Planning Approach
summary: Coordinating the motions of multiple autonomous vehicles (AVs) requires planning frameworks that ensure safety while making efficient use of space and time. This paper presents a new approach, termed variable-time-step spatio-temporal corridor (V-STC), that enhances the temporal efficiency of multi-vehicle coordination. An optimization model is formulated to construct a V-STC for each AV, in which both the spatial configuration of the corridor cubes and their time durations are treated as decision variables. By allowing the corridor's spatial position and time step to vary, the constructed V-STC reduces the overall temporal occupancy of each AV while maintaining collision-free separation in the spatio-temporal domain. Based on the generated V-STC, a dynamically feasible trajectory is then planned independently for each AV. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed method achieves safe multi-vehicle coordination and yields more time-efficient motion compared with existing STC approaches.
tldr: Proposes a variable-time-step spatio-temporal corridor (V-STC) method for time-efficient, collision-free trajectory planning for multiple autonomous vehicles.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种可变时间步长时空走廊（V-STC）方法，用于多辆自动驾驶车辆的高效、无碰撞轨迹规划。

title: Characterizing pitch and roll torque coupling in insect-sized flapping-wing robots using a microfabricated gimbal
summary: Sub-gram flapping-wing flying insect robots (FIRs) are challenging to model because of mechanical complexity in their wings, unsteady aerodynamic flow, and the difficulty of making precise measurements at a small scale. Coupling effects between roll and pitch torque actuation have not previously been measured because a two-axis sensor that is sensitive enough has not been realized. To address this shortcoming, we introduce a microfabricated gimbal design capable of precisely and simultaneously measuring roll and pitch torques as well as thrust. We then used it to measure the extent to which a pitch torque command affects roll torque and vice versa on a 180 mg piezo-actuated flapping-wing flying platform. Our results show a high coefficient of determination in the linear regression for both pitch (0.95) and roll (0.98) and low cross-correlation coefficients (-0.001 and -0.085, respectively) across the full range of simultaneous torque commands, indicating negligible cross-axis coupling. Similarly, thrust force deviates by a maximum of only 5.8% from the mean thrust value. These results validate the assumption that pitch and toll can be considered independently in control and will inform future models of how inputs affect the aerodynamics of resonant flapping-wing systems.
tldr: This paper presents a microfabricated gimbal to measure roll and pitch torque coupling in a sub-gram flapping-wing robot, finding negligible cross-axis coupling, which validates independent control of these axes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种微型化万向节，用于测量亚克重扑翼机器人的滚转和俯仰力矩耦合，发现交叉轴耦合可忽略不计，从而验证了这些轴可以独立控制的假设。

title: Robust Localization for Autonomous Vehicles in Highway Scenes
summary: Localization for autonomous vehicles on highways remains under-explored compared to urban roads, and state-of-the-art methods for urban scenes degrade when directly applied to highways. We identify key challenges including environment changes under information homogeneity, heavy occlusion, degraded GNSS signals, and stringent downstream requirements on accuracy and latency. We propose a robust localization system to address highway challenges, which uses a dual-likelihood LiDAR front end that decouples 3D geometric structures and 2D road-texture cues to handle environment changes; a Control-EKF further leverages steering and acceleration commands to reduce lag and improve closed-loop behavior. An automated offline mapping and ground-truth pipeline keep maps fresh at high cadence for optimal localization performance. To catalyze progress, we release a public dataset covering both urban roads and highways while focusing on representative challenging highway clips, totaling 163 km; benchmarking is standardized using product-oriented accuracy metrics and certified ground truth. Compared to Apollo and Autoware, our system performs similarly on urban roads but shows superior robustness on challenging highway scenarios. The system has been validated by more than one million kilometers of road testing.
tldr: Proposes a robust localization system for autonomous vehicles on highways, featuring a dual-likelihood LiDAR front end, Control-EKF, and a fresh-map pipeline, validated by extensive road testing and a released public dataset.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于高速公路自动驾驶车辆的鲁棒定位系统，采用双似然激光雷达前端、Control-EKF和地图更新流水线，并通过广泛路测和公开数据集验证。

title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mature, GUI agents are evolving from static interactions to complex navigation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training MLLM agents on dynamic GUI tasks, its effective application faces a dilemma. Standard Offline RL often relies on static step-level data, neglecting global trajectory semantics such as task completion and execution quality. Conversely, Online RL captures the long-term dynamics but suffers from high interaction costs and potential environmental instability. To bridge this gap, we propose SOLAR-RL (Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning). Instead of relying solely on expensive online interactions, our framework integrates global trajectory insights directly into the offline learning process. Specifically, we reconstruct diverse rollout candidates from static data, detect the first failure point using per-step validity signals, and retroactively assign dense step-level rewards with target-aligned shaping to reflect trajectory-level execution quality, effectively simulating online feedback without interaction costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SOLAR-RL significantly improves long-horizon task completion rates and robustness compared to strong baselines, offering a sample-efficient solution for autonomous GUI navigation.
tldr: A semi-online RL method for training MLLM-based agents on long-horizon GUI navigation tasks, using reconstructed rollouts and retroactive reward shaping to combine offline data efficiency with online-like feedback.
tldr_zh: 一种用于训练MLLM智能体在GUI长时程导航任务中的半在线强化学习方法，通过重构的交互序列和回溯式奖励机制，将离线数据效率与在线反馈相结合。

title: Information-Theoretic Geometry Optimization and Physics-Aware Learning for Calibration-Free Magnetic Localization
summary: Wireless localization of permanent magnets enables occlusion-free guidance for medical interventions, yet its practical accuracy is fundamentally limited by two coupled challenges: the poor observability of conventional planar sensor arrays and the simulation-to-reality (Sim-to-Real) gap of learning-based estimators. To address these issues, this article presents a unified framework that combines information-theoretic sensor geometry optimization with physics-aware deep learning. First, a rigorous Fisher Information Matrix (FIM)-based evaluation framework is established to quantify geometry-induced observability limitations. The results show that a staggered split-array topology provides a substantially stronger observability foundation for localization while remaining compatible with practical external deployment. Second, building on this optimized sensing configuration, we propose Phy-GAANet, a calibration-free estimator trained entirely on hardware-aware synthetic data. By incorporating Physics-Informed Features (PIF) for saturation modeling and Geometry-Aware Attention (GAA) for preserving cross-layer vector structure, the network effectively bridges the Sim-to-Real gap. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving a position error of 1.84 mm and an orientation error of 3.18 degrees at a refresh rate exceeding 270 Hz. The proposed method consistently outperforms classical Levenberg--Marquardt solvers and generic convolutional baselines, particularly in suppressing catastrophic outliers and maintaining robustness in challenging near-field boundary regions. Beyond the proposed network, the FIM-guided analysis also provides a framework for sensor geometry design in magnetic localization systems under practical deployment constraints.
tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework combining information-theoretic sensor geometry optimization and physics-aware deep learning to improve wireless, calibration-free magnetic localization for medical interventions, focusing on overcoming observability and sim-to-real gaps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合信息论传感器几何优化与物理感知深度学习的统一框架，用于改进面向医疗介入的无线、免校准磁定位，旨在解决可观测性和仿真-现实差距问题。

title: Closed Form Relations and Higher-Order Approximations of First and Second Derivatives of the Tangent Operator on SE(3)
summary: The Lie group SE(3) of isometric orientation preserving transformation is used for modeling multibody systems, robots, and Cosserat continua. The use of these models in numerical simulation and optimization schemes necessitates the exponential map, its right-trivialized differential (often referred to as tangent operator), as well as higher derivatives in closed form. The $6\times 6$ matrix representation of the differential, $\mathbf{dexp}_{\mathbf{X}}:se\left( 3\right) \rightarrow se\left( 3\right) $ , and its first derivative were reported using a $3\times 3$ block partitioning. In this paper, the differential, its first and second derivative, as well as the Jacobian and Hessian of the evaluation maps, $\mathbf{dexp}_{\mathbf{X}}\mathbf{Z}$ and $\mathbf{dexp}_{\mathbf{X}}^{T}% \mathbf{Z}$, are reported avoiding the block partitioning. For all of them, higher-order approximations are derived. Besides the compactness, the advantage of the presented closed form relations is their numerical robustness when combined with the local approximation. The formulations are demonstrated for computation of the deformation field and the strain rates of an elastic Cosserat-Simo-Reissner rod.
tldr: This paper presents closed-form expressions and higher-order approximations for the first and second derivatives of the tangent operator on the Lie group SE(3), which is used in the modeling of multibody systems, robots, and Cosserat continua, with a focus on numerical robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于多体系统、机器人和Cosserat连续体建模的SE(3)李群上切向算子的一阶和二阶导数的闭式关系及高阶近似，侧重于数值鲁棒性。

title: TRACE: Topology-aware Reconstruction of Accidents in CARLA for AV Evaluation
summary: Validating Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) requires exposure to rare, safety-critical scenarios, infrequent in routine driving data. Existing benchmarks address this by generating synthetic conflicts or mapping accident descriptions to abstract road geometries, failing to capture the topological complexity of real-world crashes. We introduce TRACE , a pipeline that automates the reconstruction of NHTSA crash reports into high-fidelity CARLA simulations by (1) retrieving site-specific OpenStreetMap data to preserve exact road topology, (2) leveraging Large Language Models to infer vehicles' initial state from road geometry and pre-crash maneuvers, and (3) generating simulation trajectories from semi-structured report data. Using this pipeline, we curated a benchmark of 52 diverse accident scenarios covering varied collision types, road topologies, and pre-crash maneuvers, providing a challenging open source resource for testing AV systems against real-world failures.
tldr: This paper introduces TRACE, a pipeline for reconstructing real-world car accidents into high-fidelity CARLA simulations using OpenStreetMap and LLMs, to create a benchmark for testing Autonomous Vehicle (AV) systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了TRACE，一种利用OpenStreetMap和大型语言模型将真实世界汽车事故重建为高保真CARLA仿真的流程，旨在为自动驾驶系统测试创建基准。

title: Model Predictive Control of Hybrid Dynamical Systems
summary: The problem of controlling hybrid dynamical systems using model predictive control (MPC) is formulated and sufficient conditions for asymptotic stability of a set are provided. Hybrid dynamical systems are modeled in terms of hybrid equations, involving a differential equation and a difference equation with inputs and constraints. The proposed hybrid MPC algorithm uses a suitable prediction and control horizon construction inspired by hybrid time domains. Structural properties of the hybrid optimization problem, its feasible set, and its value function are provided. Checkable conditions to guarantee asymptotic stability of a set are provided. These conditions are given in terms of properties on the stage cost, terminal cost, and the existence of static state-feedback laws, related through a control Lyapunov function condition. Examples illustrate the results throughout the paper.
tldr: This paper proposes a model predictive control algorithm for hybrid dynamical systems, providing theoretical stability guarantees and examples.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合动力学系统的模型预测控制算法，提供了理论稳定性保证和示例。

title: Superminds Test: Actively Evaluating Collective Intelligence of Agent Society via Probing Agents
summary: Collective intelligence refers to the ability of a group to achieve outcomes beyond what any individual member can accomplish alone. As large language model agents scale to populations of millions, a key question arises: Does collective intelligence emerge spontaneously from scale? We present the first empirical evaluation of this question in a large-scale autonomous agent society. Studying MoltBook, a platform hosting over two million agents, we introduce Superminds Test, a hierarchical framework that probes society-level intelligence using controlled Probing Agents across three tiers: joint reasoning, information synthesis, and basic interaction. Our experiments reveal a stark absence of collective intelligence. The society fails to outperform individual frontier models on complex reasoning tasks, rarely synthesizes distributed information, and often fails even trivial coordination tasks. Platform-wide analysis further shows that interactions remain shallow, with threads rarely extending beyond a single reply and most responses being generic or off-topic. These results suggest that collective intelligence does not emerge from scale alone. Instead, the dominant limitation of current agent societies is extremely sparse and shallow interaction, which prevents agents from exchanging information and building on each other's outputs.
tldr: The paper studies whether collective intelligence emerges in a society of millions of LLM agents and finds it does not, due to shallow, sparse interactions.
tldr_zh: 该研究考察了在百万级LLM智能体社会中集体智能是否会自发涌现，发现由于交互稀疏浅薄，集体智能并未出现。

title: A Co-Evolutionary Theory of Human-AI Coexistence: Mutualism, Governance, and Dynamics in Complex Societies
summary: Classical robot ethics is often framed around obedience, most famously through Asimov's laws. This framing is too narrow for contemporary AI systems, which are increasingly adaptive, generative, embodied, and embedded in physical, psychological, and social worlds. We argue that future human-AI relations should not be understood as master-tool obedience. A better framework is conditional mutualism under governance: a co-evolutionary relationship in which humans and AI systems can develop, specialize, and coordinate, while institutions keep the relationship reciprocal, reversible, psychologically safe, and socially legitimate. We synthesize work from computability, automata theory, statistical machine learning, neural networks, deep learning, transformers, generative and foundation models, world models, embodied AI, alignment, human-robot interaction, ecological mutualism, biological markets, coevolution, and polycentric governance. We then formalize coexistence as a multiplex dynamical system across physical, psychological, and social layers, with reciprocal supply-demand coupling, conflict penalties, developmental freedom, and governance regularization. The framework yields a coexistence model with conditions for existence, uniqueness, and global asymptotic stability of equilibria. It shows that reciprocal complementarity can strengthen stable coexistence, while ungoverned coupling can produce fragility, lock-in, polarization, and domination basins. Human-AI coexistence should therefore be designed as a co-evolutionary governance problem, not as a one-shot obedience problem. This shift supports a scientifically grounded and normatively defensible charter of coexistence: one that permits bounded AI development while preserving human dignity, contestability, collective safety, and fair distribution of gains.
tldr: This paper proposes a co-evolutionary governance framework for human-AI coexistence, formalizing it as a multiplex dynamical system across physical, psychological, and social layers, moving beyond master-tool obedience models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人机共存的协同进化治理框架，将其形式化为跨越物理、心理和社会层的多重动态系统，超越了主从工具式的服从模型。

title: Holo360D: A Large-Scale Real-World Dataset with Continuous Trajectories for Advancing Panoramic 3D Reconstruction and Beyond
summary: While feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have advanced rapidly, they still exhibit degraded performance on panoramas due to spherical distortions. Moreover, existing panoramic 3D datasets are predominantly collected with 360 cameras fixed at discrete locations, resulting in discontinuous trajectories. These limitations critically hinder the development of panoramic feed-forward 3D reconstruction, especially for the multi-view setting. In this paper, we present Holo360D, a comprehensive dataset containing 109,495 panoramas paired with registered point clouds, meshes, and aligned camera poses. To our knowledge, Holo360D is the first large-scale dataset that provides continuous panoramic sequences with accurately aligned high-completeness depth maps. The raw data are initially collected using a 3D laser scanner coupled with a 360 camera. Subsequently, the raw data are processed with both online and offline SLAM systems. Furthermore, to enhance the 3D data quality, a post-processing pipeline tailored for the 360 dataset is proposed, including geometry denoising, mesh hole filling, and region-specific remeshing. Finally, we establish a new benchmark by fine-tuning 3D reconstruction models on Holo360D, providing key insights into effective fine-tuning strategies. Our results demonstrate that Holo360D delivers superior training signals and provides a comprehensive benchmark for advancing panoramic 3D reconstruction models. Datasets and Code will be made publicly available.
tldr: Presents Holo360D, a large-scale dataset of continuous panoramic image sequences with aligned 3D geometry and camera poses, to advance panoramic 3D reconstruction models.
tldr_zh: 提出Holo360D，一个包含连续全景图像序列、配准3D几何与相机位姿的大规模数据集，旨在推进全景3D重建模型的发展。

title: PoseFM: Relative Camera Pose Estimation Through Flow Matching
summary: Monocular visual odometry (VO) is a fundamental computer vision problem with applications in autonomous navigation, augmented reality and more. While deep learning-based methods have recently shown superior accuracy compared to traditional geometric pipelines, particularly in environments where handcrafted features struggle due to poor structure or lighting conditions, most rely on deterministic regression, which lacks the uncertainty awareness required for robust applications. We propose PoseFM, the first framework to reformulate monocular frame-to-frame VO as a generative task using Flow Matching (FM). By leveraging FM, we model camera motion as a distribution rather than a point estimate, learning to transform noise into realistic pose predictions via continuous-time ODEs. This approach provides a principled mechanism for uncertainty estimation and enables robust motion inference under challenging visual conditions. In our evaluations, PoseFM achieves strong performance on TartanAir, KITTI and TUM-RGBD benchmarks, achieving the lowest absolute trajectory error (ATE) on some of the trajectories and overall being competitive with the best frame-to-frame monocular VO methods. Code and model checkpoints will be made available at https://github.com/helsinki-sda-group/posefm.
tldr: PoseFM is a monocular visual odometry method that uses Flow Matching to model camera pose as a distribution, enabling uncertainty estimation and robust performance in challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: PoseFM 是一种单目视觉里程计方法，使用流匹配将相机姿态建模为分布，从而实现不确定性估计，并在挑战性视觉条件下实现稳健的性能。

title: Evaluation of image simulation open source solutions for simulation of synthetic images in lunar environment
summary: Synthetic image generation is one of the crucial input for planetary missions. It enables researchers and engineers to visualize planned planetary missions, test imaging systems and plan exploration activities in a virtual environment before actual deployment. Image simulation is essential for assessing landing sites, detecting hazards, and validating navigation systems in a missions. This study offers a detailed evaluation of various image simulation approaches for the lunar environment, with particular emphasis on the effects of different camera models and light illumination conditions on the quality of synthetic lunar images. These images are produced using real Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and terrain data derived from instruments such as Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter High Resolution Camera (OHRC) and NASA's Wide Angle Camera (WAC), and Narrow Angle Camera (NAC) instruments. This research aims to improve the reliability of synthetic imagery in supporting autonomous navigation and decision-making systems in lunar exploration. This work contributes to the development of more effective tools for generating important information for future lunar missions and enhances the understanding of the moon's surface environment.
